examples.text: In economic theory, competition is assumed to be perfect.
examples.translation_cn: 在经济理论中，竞争被假定为完全的。

senses.meaning_en: not using more money, fuel, etc. than necessary

examples.text: The new engine is very economic on fuel.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新发动机非常省油。

senses.meaning_en: to stop living

examples.text: He died of cancer at a young age.
examples.translation_cn: 他年纪轻轻就死于癌症。

senses.meaning_en: to want something very much

examples.text: I am absolutely dying to hear the result.
examples.translation_cn: 我非常渴望听到结果。

senses.meaning_en: to undergo a specified death

examples.text: She died a hero's death in the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 她在火灾中英勇牺牲。

senses.meaning_en: to be so overcome with emotion or laughter as to be incapacitated

examples.text: The audience nearly died laughing at the comedian's final joke.
examples.translation_cn: 观众听到那位喜剧演员最后的笑话时都笑得前仰后合。

senses.meaning_en: to arrive at or get as far as a place

examples.text: We finally reached the hotel just before midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们终于在午夜前到达了酒店。

senses.meaning_en: to get to a particular level, amount, decision, or agreement

examples.text: After months of talks, they finally reached an agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数月的谈判，他们终于达成了协议。

senses.meaning_en: to be able to touch or get something by stretching out your arm

examples.text: She can't reach the pedals because her legs are too short.
examples.translation_cn: 她的腿太短，够不到踏板。

senses.meaning_en: to stretch out your hand

examples.text: He reached for the last slice of pizza.
examples.translation_cn: 他伸手去拿最后一片披萨。

senses.meaning_en: immediately after; as soon as

examples.text: Upon hearing the alarm, everyone left the building quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 一听到警报，大家迅速离开了大楼。

senses.meaning_en: on; on top of

examples.text: He placed the letter upon the manager's desk.
examples.translation_cn: 他把信放在经理的桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: concerning; based on

examples.text: The final decision was based upon evidence from the survey.
examples.translation_cn: 最终决定是根据调查中的证据做出的。

senses.meaning_en: a period of 100 years

examples.text: In the 20th century, two world wars and the Cold War shaped the modern world.
examples.translation_cn: 二十世纪的两次世界大战和冷战塑造了现代世界。

senses.meaning_en: a physical power or a mental awareness

examples.text: A dog has a keen sense of smell and a strong sense of danger.
examples.translation_cn: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉，也能敏锐地感知危险。

senses.meaning_en: good practical judgment

examples.text: She had the sense to turn off the electricity before fixing the switch.
examples.translation_cn: 她明智地在修开关前切断了电源。

senses.meaning_en: the meaning or value of something

examples.text: In a sense, moving abroad gave her the freedom she needed.
examples.translation_cn: 从某种意义上说，移居国外给了她所需的自由。

senses.meaning_en: a natural ability to appreciate or do something

examples.text: He has a wonderful sense of humour and can laugh at himself.
examples.translation_cn: 他很有幽默感，也能自嘲。

senses.meaning_en: for that reason; consequently

examples.text: The committee must, therefore, review the policy before making a decision.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会因此必须在做出决定之前审查这项政策。

senses.meaning_en: a part of a document or book

examples.text: A section of the report was devoted to climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 报告的一部分专门讨论了气候变化。

senses.meaning_en: a department or group within an organization
senses.collocation: the marketing section of a company

examples.text: She works in the marketing section of the company.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公司的市场营销部门工作。

senses.meaning_en: a piece cut out from the rest of something

examples.text: Cut the orange into small sections before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前把橙子切成小瓣。

senses.meaning_en: a view of something as if cut along a plane
senses.collocation: a cross section of the stem

examples.text: The diagram shows the stem in cross section.
examples.translation_cn: 这张图显示的是茎的横截面。

senses.meaning_en: making effort and taking action; not passive

examples.text: She has been active in the campaign for years.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年积极参与这项运动。

senses.meaning_en: busy or quick in movement; lively

examples.text: Their son is very active and needs plenty of outdoor play.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的儿子非常活跃，需要大量户外活动。

senses.meaning_en: currently functioning or able to act; not extinct

examples.text: The volcano is still active and may erupt soon.
examples.translation_cn: 这座火山仍处于活跃期，可能很快喷发。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being active or busy

examples.text: The street was full of activity during the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 节日期间，街道上热闹非凡。

senses.meaning_en: something done as an action or movement

examples.text: The students did a problem-solving activity in small groups.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们在小组中做了一项解决问题的活动。

senses.meaning_en: something done for pleasure, especially involving movement or an outing

examples.text: Our school offers a range of outdoor activities after class.
examples.translation_cn: 我们学校课后提供各种户外活动。

senses.meaning_en: the end of life; dying

examples.text: The death of her father changed her life completely.
examples.translation_cn: 她父亲的去世彻底改变了她的人生。

senses.meaning_en: the end or failure of something

examples.text: The rise of streaming spelled the death of many video rental stores.
examples.translation_cn: 流媒体的兴起给许多录像带租赁店带来了终结。

senses.meaning_en: the personification of death

examples.text: In the legend, Death came for him at midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 在传说中，死神在午夜时分来带走他。

senses.meaning_en: to include or require something as a necessary part

examples.text: The job involves traveling abroad twice a month.
examples.translation_cn: 这份工作需要每月出国两次。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone or something to take part in an activity or situation

examples.text: He was involved in a serious car accident.
examples.translation_cn: 他卷入了一起严重车祸。

examples.text: She has experience in managing large teams and solving conflicts.
examples.translation_cn: 她在管理大团队和解决冲突方面很有经验。

examples.text: My first experience of living alone taught me to be independent.
examples.translation_cn: 我第一次独自生活的经历教会了我独立。

examples.text: Travel allows you to experience different cultures and ways of life.
examples.translation_cn: 旅行让你体验不同的文化和生活方式。

senses.meaning_en: a type of person or thing

examples.text: I don't usually go for this sort of thing, but the film was brilliant.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常不太喜欢这类东西，但这部电影很棒。

senses.meaning_en: to separate items into different groups

examples.text: We sorted the documents into several categories for easier review.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把文件分成了几类，以便更容易审阅。

senses.meaning_en: an act of putting data or items in order

examples.text: The program ran a sort on the names and displayed them in alphabetical order.
examples.translation_cn: 程序对姓名进行了排序，并按字母顺序显示。

senses.meaning_en: a person with a particular character

examples.text: He is a good sort and always helps his neighbours.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个好人，总是帮助邻居。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange into a particular sequence

examples.text: Click the column heading to sort the list by date.
examples.translation_cn: 点击列标题，按日期对列表排序。

senses.meaning_en: probable; expected

examples.text: Prices are likely to rise again this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年价格很可能再次上涨。

senses.meaning_en: seeming suitable or promising

examples.text: She is a likely candidate for the scholarship.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这项奖学金的有望候选人。

senses.meaning_en: probably

examples.text: The weather will likely clear up by noon.
examples.translation_cn: 中午前天很可能会放晴。

senses.meaning_en: people employed by a business or organisation

examples.text: She has been on the staff at the hospital for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她已在这家医院工作十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a long straight stick, especially used for walking or as a flagpole

examples.text: The old man walked slowly up the hill with a wooden staff.
examples.translation_cn: 老人拄着木杖慢慢上山。

senses.meaning_en: a set of five horizontal lines on which music is written

examples.text: The music teacher wrote the notes on the staff.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐老师把音符写在谱表上。

senses.meaning_en: to provide an organization, business, etc. with staff

examples.text: The new clinic is staffed by volunteer doctors and nurses.
examples.translation_cn: 这家新诊所配有志愿医生和护士。

senses.meaning_en: to put to death; to extinguish the life of

examples.text: The hunter killed a deer with one shot.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人一枪杀死了一头鹿。

senses.meaning_en: to stop, terminate, or render void/inoperative

examples.text: They killed the project after the budget review.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在预算审查后终止了这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: to use up or waste time, especially while waiting

examples.text: We killed time playing cards while waiting for the train.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在等火车时打牌消磨时间。

senses.meaning_en: to cause great pain, discomfort, or distress to; to hurt

examples.text: My feet are killing me after the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途徒步后我的脚疼得要命。

senses.meaning_en: to make a picture using a pen or pencil

examples.text: The child drew a picture of his family at school.
examples.translation_cn: 那个孩子在学校画了一幅他的全家福。

senses.meaning_en: to attract attention or interest

examples.text: Her speech drew attention to the need for better mental health care.
examples.translation_cn: 她的演讲引起了人们对改善心理健康护理需求的关注。

senses.meaning_en: to pull something or move it in a particular direction

examples.text: She drew the curtains back to let in the morning light.
examples.translation_cn: 她拉开窗帘让早晨的阳光照进来。

senses.meaning_en: to take something out of a container or select something by chance

examples.text: The students drew lots to decide who would give the first presentation.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们抽签决定谁先做报告。

senses.meaning_en: especially great or noticeable; special

examples.text: You should pay particular attention to the safety warnings.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该特别注意安全警告。

senses.meaning_en: specific and not general

examples.text: I have a question about this particular paragraph.
examples.translation_cn: 我对这一段有个问题。

senses.meaning_en: careful about details; not easily satisfied

examples.text: She is very particular about what she eats.
examples.translation_cn: 她对吃的东西非常讲究。

senses.meaning_en: unique to a person, place, or thing

examples.text: This custom is particular to the northern region.
examples.translation_cn: 这种习俗是北部地区特有的。

senses.meaning_en: a student or recent graduate who works to gain experience

examples.text: He works as an intern at a local hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 他在当地一家医院当实习生。

senses.meaning_en: to work as an intern

examples.text: She hopes to intern as a journalist next year.
examples.translation_cn: 她希望明年实习做记者。

senses.meaning_en: to detain or confine somebody, especially for political or military reasons

examples.text: Thousands of refugees were interned in camps during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间成千上万的难民被关押在营地。

senses.meaning_en: involving more than one nation

examples.text: The border dispute could become international if more countries intervene.
examples.translation_cn: 如果更多国家介入，这场边境争端可能国际化。

senses.meaning_en: common to all people; not limited by national boundaries

examples.text: The fishing boats were operating in international waters.
examples.translation_cn: 这些渔船正在国际水域作业。

senses.meaning_en: designed for a particular purpose

examples.text: This room is reserved for a special purpose, not for everyday meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 这个房间是留作特殊用途的，不是用于日常会议的。

senses.meaning_en: of particular value or interest; dear
senses.collocation: hold a special place in one's heart

examples.text: This locket is very special to her because it belonged to her mother.
examples.translation_cn: 这个挂坠盒对她来说格外珍贵，因为那是她母亲的。

senses.meaning_en: of or related to disabilities, especially learning or intellectual disabilities

examples.text: The school offers support for children with special needs.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校为有特殊需求的儿童提供支持。

senses.meaning_en: sure; confident

examples.text: She is certain that she heard the phone ring.
examples.translation_cn: 她确信自己听到了电话铃响。

senses.meaning_en: particular but unnamed

examples.text: There is a certain charm to the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老城有一种独特的魅力。

senses.meaning_en: definitely true; not in doubt

examples.text: It is certain that the climate is changing.
examples.translation_cn: 气候无疑正在变化。

senses.meaning_en: sure to happen; inevitable

examples.text: The new policy is certain to attract criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策肯定会招致批评。

senses.meaning_en: especially; more than usual

examples.text: Traffic is particularly heavy during the morning rush hour.
examples.translation_cn: 早高峰期间交通特别拥堵。

senses.meaning_en: having previously been a particular thing or had a particular status

examples.text: She met a former colleague at the conference.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会议上遇到了一位前同事。

senses.meaning_en: the first of two people or things just mentioned

examples.text: Of the two plans, the former is cheaper than the latter.
examples.translation_cn: 在这两个方案中，前者比后者更便宜。

senses.meaning_en: to direct or be in charge of

examples.text: She manages the family business with her brother.
examples.translation_cn: 她和哥哥一起经营家族生意。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed at an attempt in spite of difficulty

examples.text: We managed to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 我们设法按时完成了项目。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed in dealing with problems or living with little money

examples.text: They managed on very little money during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机期间他们靠很少的钱勉强维持。

senses.meaning_en: to handle or control (a situation, job)

examples.text: We had to manage a crisis when the system failed.
examples.translation_cn: 系统出故障时，我们不得不处理一场危机。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of running and controlling a business or organization

examples.text: The day-to-day management of a hotel requires strong organizational skills.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店的日常经营需要很强的组织能力。

senses.meaning_en: the act of controlling or dealing with something such as time, money, or a problem

examples.text: The management of money is essential for young families.
examples.translation_cn: 金钱管理对年轻家庭来说至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: the people who run and control a business or organization, especially senior executives

examples.text: He has been in senior management for over a decade.
examples.translation_cn: 他担任高级管理职务已有十多年。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a place or start a journey

examples.text: The train departs for Chicago at 6 a.m.
examples.translation_cn: 火车早上六点开往芝加哥。

senses.meaning_en: to deviate from a standard, principle, or usual way

examples.text: The company's new policy departs from standard practice.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的新政策背离了常规做法。

senses.meaning_en: a part of a company, university, or government that deals with a particular area of work or study

examples.text: She works in the marketing department of a large firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家大公司的市场部工作。

senses.meaning_en: an administrative district, especially in France

examples.text: They live in the department of Gironde in southwestern France.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在法国西南部的吉伦特省。

senses.meaning_en: a particular area of activity or responsibility

examples.text: Organizing the event is not my department; please ask the coordinator.
examples.translation_cn: 组织这次活动不归我管；请问协调员。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people chosen to make decisions or deal with a particular subject

examples.text: She currently serves on the school's finance committee.
examples.translation_cn: 她目前在学校财务委员会任职。

senses.meaning_en: something that is produced; a result

examples.text: The report is the product of months of research.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告是数月研究的产物。

senses.meaning_en: something that is made or grown to be sold

examples.text: Customers can buy a product online or in a local store.
examples.translation_cn: 顾客可以在网上或当地商店购买产品。

senses.meaning_en: the number obtained by multiplying two or more numbers
senses.pattern: the product of X and Y

examples.text: The product of 6 and 7 is 42.
examples.translation_cn: 6和7的乘积是42。

senses.meaning_en: a character or part played by an actor

examples.text: She played the role of Juliet in the school play.
examples.translation_cn: 她在学校戏剧中扮演朱丽叶的角色。

senses.meaning_en: the function or expected behaviour of someone or something in a particular situation

examples.text: Parents play a role in their children's education.
examples.translation_cn: 父母在孩子的教育中发挥着作用。

senses.meaning_en: entire; with all parts; undivided

examples.text: The baby slept the whole time we were flying.
examples.translation_cn: 婴儿在我们飞行途中一直睡着。

senses.meaning_en: all of something as a single unit

examples.text: The country must be viewed as a whole.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家必须被看作一个整体。

senses.meaning_en: sound; uninjured; healthy

examples.text: After months of therapy, she finally felt whole again.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数月治疗后，她终于再次感到完整。

senses.meaning_en: entirely; wholly

examples.text: This is a whole new way of looking at the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 这是一种看待问题的全新方式。

senses.meaning_en: the use of physical or mental energy to do something

examples.text: He opened the heavy jar with great effort.
examples.translation_cn: 他费了很大劲才打开那个沉重的罐子。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt to do something, especially when it is difficult

examples.text: We made an effort to catch the early train, but it was already full.
examples.translation_cn: 我们试图赶上早班火车，但车已经满了。

senses.meaning_en: clearly seen or understood; obvious

examples.text: It is evident that the new policy has failed.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策显然已经失败。

senses.meaning_en: facts or signs that make you believe something is true

examples.text: There is no evidence for the claim that the drug is effective.
examples.translation_cn: 没有证据支持这种药物有效的说法。

senses.meaning_en: information used in court to prove something

examples.text: The witness gave evidence in court about what she saw that night.
examples.translation_cn: 证人出庭就当晚所见作证。

senses.meaning_en: a sign or indication that something exists or is true

examples.text: The empty streets were evidence of the impending storm.
examples.translation_cn: 空荡荡的街道是暴风雨即将来临的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: to show or suggest that something is true

examples.text: The growing popularity of the sport is evidenced by rising ticket sales.
examples.translation_cn: 这项运动日益受欢迎体现在门票销量上升上。

senses.meaning_en: to a certain degree; quite

examples.text: The exam was rather difficult, but I think I passed.
examples.translation_cn: 考试相当难，但我觉得我通过了。

senses.meaning_en: used to express preference

examples.text: I would rather stay home than go out tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿今晚出去。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce a correction or contrast

examples.text: The report focuses on causes rather than effects.
examples.translation_cn: 报告关注原因而不是结果。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used as a medicine or in making medicines

examples.text: You should not take this drug on an empty stomach.
examples.translation_cn: 你不应该空腹服用这种药。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal substance taken for pleasure

examples.text: Many teenagers start using drugs because of peer pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 许多青少年因为同伴压力开始吸毒。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a drug without their knowledge; to put a drug into food or drink

examples.text: Someone drugged the guard's drink and he passed out.
examples.translation_cn: 有人给卫兵的饮料下了药，他昏了过去。

senses.meaning_en: something to which a person becomes addicted

examples.text: Fame can be a drug for some celebrities.
examples.translation_cn: 对某些名人来说，名声可能是一种使人上瘾的事物。

senses.meaning_en: a person who leads or directs

examples.text: She was elected leader of the party last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年当选为党领袖。

senses.meaning_en: a person, animal, or thing that leads or is ahead

examples.text: The company is a leader in solar technology.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司是太阳能技术的领先者。

senses.meaning_en: the sound produced by humans when speaking or singing; the ability to speak

examples.text: She spoke in a low voice so the baby wouldn't wake.
examples.translation_cn: 她低声说话以免吵醒婴儿。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion, wish, or the right to express it

examples.text: Workers want to have a voice in company decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们希望对公司的决定有发言权。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being united or joined; unity or harmony

examples.text: The two groups acted in union with each other to demand fair elections.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个团体联合行动，要求举行公平选举。

senses.meaning_en: a group of states, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a common purpose

examples.text: The three countries formed a union to coordinate trade and travel.
examples.translation_cn: 这三个国家组成了一个联盟来协调贸易和旅行。

senses.meaning_en: the set containing all the elements of two or more sets
senses.pattern: the union of A and B

examples.text: The union of set A and set B contains every element from both sets.
examples.translation_cn: 集合A与集合B的并集包含来自两个集合的所有元素。

senses.meaning_en: the act or state of marriage

examples.text: The king finally approved the union between the princess and the duke.
examples.translation_cn: 国王最终批准了公主与公爵的婚事。

senses.meaning_en: last; coming at the end

examples.text: This is the final stage of the negotiation process.
examples.translation_cn: 这是谈判过程的最后阶段。

senses.meaning_en: conclusive; not to be changed

examples.text: The referee's decision is final and cannot be appealed.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判的裁决是最终决定，不可上诉。

senses.meaning_en: the last game or match in a competition

examples.text: The team reached the final after a dramatic penalty shoot-out.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在一场戏剧性的点球大战后进入了决赛。

senses.meaning_en: a final examination; an exam at the end of a course

examples.text: She stayed up late to study for her chemistry final.
examples.translation_cn: 她熬夜复习化学期末考试。

senses.meaning_en: after a long time or series of events

examples.text: After a long delay, the train finally arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间延误，火车终于到了。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce the last point or item in a list

examples.text: Finally, remember to turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.translation_cn: 最后，离开时要记得关灯。

senses.meaning_en: the solid part of Earth's surface, not sea

examples.text: After the storm, the sailors were relieved to be back on land.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，水手们松了一口气回到陆地上。

senses.meaning_en: soil used for farming

examples.text: Farmers use this land for farming because the soil is rich.
examples.translation_cn: 农民用这块地耕种，因为土壤肥沃。

senses.meaning_en: a country or homeland

examples.text: He returned to his native land after ten years abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 他在国外待了十年后回到故土。

senses.meaning_en: to descend to a surface, especially from the air

examples.text: The pilot managed to land on the narrow runway safely.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员设法在狭窄的跑道上安全着陆。

senses.meaning_en: an occurrence; something that happens

examples.text: The events of that day changed the course of history.
examples.translation_cn: 那天发生的事情改变了历史进程。

senses.meaning_en: a planned public or social occasion

examples.text: We met at a charity event in London last month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上个月在伦敦的一个慈善活动上相识。

senses.meaning_en: one of the contests in a competition

examples.text: She is competing in the 100-meter event at the Olympics.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在参加奥运会的100米项目。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a country's armed forces or soldiers

examples.text: He was exempted from military service because of his poor eyesight.
examples.translation_cn: 他因视力差而免服兵役。

senses.meaning_en: connected with war or armed conflict
senses.pattern: be engaged in a military conflict

examples.text: The two countries are engaged in a military conflict over the border region.
examples.translation_cn: 两国因边境地区而陷入军事冲突。

senses.meaning_en: the armed forces of a country

examples.text: She plans to join the military after graduating.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划毕业后参军。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that makes something happen

examples.text: The cause of the fire is still under investigation.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾原因仍在调查中。

senses.meaning_en: to make something happen, especially something bad

examples.text: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重损坏。

senses.meaning_en: an aim or principle that people support or fight for

examples.text: Many people are willing to fight for a just cause.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人愿意为正义事业而战。

senses.meaning_en: in this way; in this manner

examples.text: She described the scene thus: darkness, silence, fear.
examples.translation_cn: 她这样描述那一幕：黑暗、寂静、恐惧。

senses.meaning_en: as a result; therefore

examples.text: The old bridge collapsed, thus blocking the river.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧桥倒塌了，因此堵塞了河道。

senses.meaning_en: to make something clear or easy to understand

examples.text: The teacher explained the rules to the new students.
examples.translation_cn: 老师向新学生解释了规则。

senses.meaning_en: to give a reason or justification for something

examples.text: He explained why he was absent from school.
examples.translation_cn: 他解释了他为什么没去上学。

senses.meaning_en: to hold something up and stop it from falling

examples.text: These steel beams support the weight of the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 这些钢梁支撑着屋顶的重量。

senses.meaning_en: to be in favor of a person, plan, or cause

examples.text: Most people in the town support a plan to build a new school.
examples.translation_cn: 镇上大多数人支持建一所新学校的计划。

senses.meaning_en: to provide money, food, or other things necessary for life

examples.text: She works two jobs to support a family of four.
examples.translation_cn: 她打两份工来养活一个四口之家。

senses.meaning_en: to provide evidence for something or show that it is true

examples.text: These findings support a claim that the drug is safe.
examples.translation_cn: 这些发现支持该药物安全的主张。

senses.meaning_cn: 支持时间：试用期间可提供帮助的时段
senses.meaning_en: the hours during which help or assistance is available

examples.text: Support is weekdays 8 to 4.
examples.translation_cn: 支持时间为工作日8点到4点。

senses.meaning_en: a period or step in a process

examples.text: The negotiations are still at an early stage.
examples.translation_cn: 谈判仍处于早期阶段。

senses.meaning_en: a raised platform for performances

examples.text: She performed on stage for the first time.
examples.translation_cn: 她第一次在舞台上演出。

senses.meaning_en: to organize and present a performance or event

examples.text: Workers staged a protest outside city hall yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们昨天在市政厅外举行了抗议。

senses.meaning_en: to rest in a horizontal position

examples.text: The cat was lying on the warm kitchen floor.
examples.translation_cn: 猫躺在温暖的厨房地板上。

senses.meaning_en: to be placed or situated

examples.text: The small village lies in a narrow valley.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小村庄坐落在一个狭窄的山谷里。

senses.meaning_en: to exist or consist in something

examples.text: The main problem lies in poor communication between teams.
examples.translation_cn: 主要问题在于团队之间沟通不畅。

senses.meaning_en: to be the responsibility of somebody; to be incumbent upon

examples.text: The final decision lies with the managing director.
examples.translation_cn: 最终决定由总经理作出。

senses.meaning_en: a number of different things of the same general type

examples.text: The store offers a range of products for children.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店提供一系列儿童产品。

senses.meaning_en: a line of mountains or hills

examples.text: The Andes form a range of mountains along South America's west coast.
examples.translation_cn: 安第斯山脉沿着南美洲西海岸形成一条山脉。

senses.meaning_en: a large kitchen appliance for cooking, using gas or electricity

examples.text: She cooked a large dinner on the gas range.
examples.translation_cn: 她在煤气灶上做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

senses.meaning_en: an area for shooting practice or military testing

examples.text: Soldiers test missiles on a military range in the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在沙漠中的军事靶场测试导弹。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of buying and selling goods and services, especially between countries or on a market

examples.text: The country's trade in oil has grown rapidly.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家在石油方面的贸易增长迅速。

senses.meaning_en: a particular type of business or industry, especially one that needs special skill with your hands; a skilled job

examples.text: He is a carpenter by trade and builds furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 他的职业是木匠，制作家具。

senses.meaning_en: an exchange of things between people or groups, especially without using money

examples.text: He got the bike in a trade for his old phone.
examples.translation_cn: 他用旧手机换来了那辆自行车。

senses.meaning_en: the people or companies who work in a particular business or industry

examples.text: Word spread quickly in the trade that the company was for sale.
examples.translation_cn: 业内很快传开说那家公司要出售。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which two or more people behave towards and deal with each other

examples.text: We have a good working relationship with our suppliers.
examples.translation_cn: 我们和供应商有着良好的工作关系。

senses.meaning_en: a romantic or sexual involvement between two people

examples.text: He has been in a relationship with Mia for three years.
examples.translation_cn: 他和米娅谈恋爱已经三年了。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which two or more things are connected
senses.pattern: the relationship between A and B

examples.text: The study shows a clear relationship between sleep and memory.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究表明睡眠和记忆力之间存在明显的关联。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which a person is related to someone by blood or marriage

examples.text: The application form asks about your relationship to the deceased.
examples.translation_cn: 申请表询问你与逝者的亲属关系。

senses.meaning_en: to take something offered willingly

examples.text: I accepted the invitation to speak at the conference.
examples.translation_cn: 我接受了在这次会议上发言的邀请。

senses.meaning_en: to say yes to an idea, plan, or suggestion

examples.text: The committee finally accepted our proposal for a shorter workweek.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会最终接受了我们缩短工作周的建议。

senses.meaning_en: to allow someone to join a group or enter a place

examples.text: She was accepted into a top university last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年春天被一所顶尖大学录取。

senses.meaning_en: to regard as true, proper, or usual

examples.text: Many scientists now accept that the climate is changing.
examples.translation_cn: 现在许多科学家承认气候正在变化。

senses.meaning_en: a supernatural being with power over nature or human fortunes

examples.text: Ancient Greeks worshipped a god for each aspect of life, such as love or war.
examples.translation_cn: 古希腊人为生活的每个方面都崇拜一位神，如爱神或战神。

senses.meaning_en: the supreme being in Christianity, Judaism, and Islam

examples.text: Many people pray to God when they are facing a serious illness.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人在面对重病时向上帝祈祷。

senses.meaning_en: used to express surprise, anger, etc.

examples.text: Oh God, I forgot to lock the door!
examples.translation_cn: 天哪，我忘记锁门了！

senses.meaning_en: a person who is very good at something

examples.text: He is a god of chess, beating everyone in the club.
examples.translation_cn: 他是国际象棋大师，击败了俱乐部里的所有人。

senses.meaning_en: an exceedingly handsome man

examples.text: With his striking features, he looks like a god.
examples.translation_cn: 他五官出众，看上去像个神。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy stick used as a weapon or in sports

examples.text: The man used a club to break the car window.
examples.translation_cn: 那个男人用棍棒砸碎了车窗。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people go to dance and drink

examples.text: They spent the evening at a club near the harbor.
examples.translation_cn: 他们晚上在港口附近的一家夜总会度过。

senses.meaning_en: an organization for people who share an interest

examples.text: She joined the school photography club last month.
examples.translation_cn: 她上个月加入了学校摄影俱乐部。

senses.meaning_en: a black clover shape (♣), one of the four suits in playing cards

examples.text: She won the trick with the ace of clubs.
examples.translation_cn: 她凭借梅花A赢了这一墩牌。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the national government of a federal country, rather than state or local government

examples.text: Funding for the program is managed at the federal level.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目的资金由联邦层面管理。

senses.meaning_en: to separate into pieces or damage something

examples.text: She broke the vase while cleaning the shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 她在清理架子时打破了花瓶。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to obey a law, rule, or promise

examples.text: He broke the law by selling alcohol without a license.
examples.translation_cn: 他因无证卖酒而违法。

senses.meaning_en: a short period of rest or pause

examples.text: Let's take a short break before the next meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在下次会议前短暂休息一下吧。

senses.meaning_en: to interrupt or stop something temporarily

examples.text: They broke off negotiations after the serious disagreement.
examples.translation_cn: 在严重分歧后，他们中断了谈判。

senses.meaning_en: to feel extremely sad; (of one's heart) to be overcome with grief

examples.text: My heart breaks whenever I think of the children who lost their homes in the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 每当我想到那些在洪水中失去家园的孩子们，我的心都碎了。

senses.meaning_en: to be different from somebody/something

examples.text: The two brothers differ from each other in personality.
examples.translation_cn: 这两兄弟性格不同。

senses.meaning_en: to have a different opinion; to disagree

examples.text: The committee members differ on the best way to cut costs.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会成员在如何削减成本的问题上意见不同。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which two or more things are not the same

examples.text: Can you tell the difference between these two sauces?
examples.translation_cn: 你能分辨出这两种酱汁的区别吗？

senses.meaning_en: a disagreement or argument

examples.text: They settled their differences after a long discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间讨论，他们解决了分歧。

senses.meaning_en: the amount by which one thing is bigger or smaller than another; (math.) the set of elements in one set but not another

examples.text: There is a difference of $20 between the two prices.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个价格相差20美元。

senses.meaning_en: the effect that something has on a situation or state

examples.text: A little kindness can make a big difference to someone's day.
examples.translation_cn: 一点善意就能对某人的一天产生很大影响。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement with a bank or online service to keep money or data

examples.text: You can open an account online in just five minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 你只需五分钟就能在网上开户。

senses.meaning_en: a written or spoken report of an event

examples.text: She gave the police a full account of what happened.
examples.translation_cn: 她向警方完整描述了所发生的事。

senses.meaning_en: a reason or careful thought given to something

examples.text: You should take the weather into account when planning the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 计划旅行时你应该把天气考虑在内。

senses.meaning_en: a business relationship with a company, especially one that provides professional services

examples.text: The agency won a major account with a global brand.
examples.translation_cn: 该代理商赢得了一个全球品牌的大客户。

senses.meaning_en: connected with money and possessions rather than spiritual or intellectual things

examples.text: They are well off in material terms but still unhappy.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在物质上很富有，但仍不快乐。

senses.meaning_en: a substance from which things are made

examples.text: Cotton is a common material for making light summer clothes.
examples.translation_cn: 棉花是制作轻薄夏装的常用材料。

senses.meaning_en: information or ideas used in a book, film, etc.

examples.text: She collected material on local history for her novel.
examples.translation_cn: 她为写小说收集了有关当地历史的资料。

senses.meaning_en: important; having real importance or significance

examples.text: The new evidence is material to the case.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据对案件有重大影响。

senses.meaning_en: the combination of circumstances at a particular moment, especially a difficult or unpleasant one

examples.text: The refugees are now in a desperate situation.
examples.translation_cn: 难民们现在处于绝望的境地。

senses.meaning_en: the position or location of something in relation to its surroundings

examples.text: The hotel stands in a beautiful situation above the harbor.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆位于港口上方，位置优美。

senses.meaning_en: a representation of a physical object, usually smaller than the real thing

examples.text: He built a model of the Eiffel Tower out of cardboard.
examples.translation_cn: 他用纸板搭了一座埃菲尔铁塔模型。

senses.meaning_en: a successful example to be copied

examples.text: She serves as a model for hard work and honesty.
examples.translation_cn: 她是勤奋和诚实的榜样。

senses.meaning_en: a person employed to wear clothes or pose for an artist

examples.text: She works as a model for a well-known fashion brand.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家著名时尚品牌担任模特。

senses.meaning_en: a particular design or type of product

examples.text: The latest model of this phone has a better camera.
examples.translation_cn: 这款手机的最新机型配备更好的摄像头。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of information or set of data kept for future use

examples.text: The school keeps a record of each student's attendance.
examples.translation_cn: 学校保存每个学生的出勤记录。

senses.meaning_en: to put sounds, images, or information onto a medium

examples.text: She recorded the whole concert on her phone.
examples.translation_cn: 她用手机录下了整场音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: a flat disc with music or sound on it

examples.text: She played a record on the old turntable.
examples.translation_cn: 她在旧唱机上放了一张唱片。

senses.meaning_en: the best or fastest ever achieved in a particular activity

examples.text: She set a new world record in the 100 metres.
examples.translation_cn: 她在100米赛跑中创造了新的世界纪录。

senses.meaning_en: higher or greater than ever before; breaking previous records

examples.text: The city experienced a record number of visitors this summer.
examples.translation_cn: 今年夏天这座城市接待的游客数量创下纪录。

senses.meaning_en: a planned piece of work with a specific goal

examples.text: She is working on a research project about renewable energy.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在做一个关于可再生能源的研究项目。

senses.meaning_en: to throw or cast light, an image, etc. onto a surface
senses.collocation: project an image onto a screen

examples.text: The teacher projected the slides onto the whiteboard.
examples.translation_cn: 老师把幻灯片投射到白板上。

senses.meaning_en: to forecast or estimate something based on present trends

examples.text: Analysts project that the company's profits will rise by 20 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 分析师预计该公司利润将增长20%。

senses.meaning_en: to present or convey a particular impression, usually a positive one

examples.text: She projects an image of confidence even when she feels nervous.
examples.translation_cn: 即使感到紧张，她也展现出自信的形象。

senses.meaning_en: (US) a housing development for low-income residents

examples.text: She grew up in a housing project in Chicago.
examples.translation_cn: 她在芝加哥的一个公共住房区长大。

senses.meaning_en: money that people or businesses must pay to the government

examples.text: You have to pay tax on the interest you earn.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须为赚取的利息纳税。

senses.meaning_en: to impose a tax on a person, company, or thing

examples.text: The government taxes cigarettes heavily to reduce smoking.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对香烟征收重税以减少吸烟。

senses.meaning_en: a strain or heavy demand on something

examples.text: The long commute is a tax on her energy.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间通勤是对她精力的消耗。

senses.meaning_en: to make excessive demands on

examples.text: The long hours of overtime taxed his patience.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间的加班让他几乎失去耐心。

senses.meaning_en: going in the straightest line between two places without stopping or changing direction

examples.text: There is a direct train from Paris to Berlin.
examples.translation_cn: 从巴黎到柏林有直达火车。

senses.meaning_en: saying what you mean; plain and unambiguous

examples.text: She was direct with me about her concerns.
examples.translation_cn: 她坦率地向我表达了她的担忧。

senses.meaning_en: to tell somebody to do something

examples.text: The officer directed the soldiers to move forward.
examples.translation_cn: 军官命令士兵向前移动。

senses.meaning_en: to aim something in a particular direction

examples.text: He directed the hose at the burning car.
examples.translation_cn: 他把软管对准燃烧的汽车。

senses.meaning_en: to be in charge of a film, play, etc.

examples.text: She directed her first feature film last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年执导了她的第一部故事片。

senses.meaning_en: a person who directs a film, play, or television program

examples.text: He has worked as a film director in Hollywood for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他已在好莱坞担任电影导演二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the board of directors of a company or organization

examples.text: She sits on the board of directors of a large international bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家大型国际银行的董事会任职。

senses.meaning_en: a person in charge of a department, project, or organization

examples.text: She is director of marketing at a software company.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一家软件公司的市场营销总监。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes part in a game or sport

examples.text: He is a key player on the school basketball team.
examples.translation_cn: 他是校篮球队的关键球员。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company involved in a particular activity

examples.text: The company is a major player in the online retail market.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司是在线零售市场的重要参与者。

senses.meaning_en: a machine for playing recorded sound or video

examples.text: He bought a portable MP3 player for his long train journeys.
examples.translation_cn: 他买了一台便携式MP3播放器，用于长途火车旅行。

senses.meaning_en: the basis or foundation on which something rests or is built

examples.text: Careful research is the base of her argument.
examples.translation_cn: 仔细的研究是她论点的根据。

senses.meaning_en: a site where military personnel and equipment are stationed

examples.text: He was stationed at a military base in Texas.
examples.translation_cn: 他驻扎在得克萨斯州的一个军事基地。

senses.meaning_en: the main place where an organization is located or from which activities are organized

examples.text: The rescue team set up a base of operations near the port.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队在港口附近设立了行动基地。

senses.meaning_en: a basic ingredient or component that forms the main part of something

examples.text: Use chicken stock as a base for the soup.
examples.translation_cn: 用鸡汤作为这道汤的底料。

senses.meaning_en: to a greater extent than normal; particularly

examples.text: This area is especially busy during the summer months.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区在夏季尤其繁忙。

senses.meaning_en: for a particular purpose, person, or thing

examples.text: The kitchen was designed especially for a large family.
examples.translation_cn: 这个厨房是专门为一个大家庭设计的。

senses.meaning_en: in the middle of an area or object

examples.text: The hotel is in central London, close to the British Museum.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆位于伦敦市中心，靠近大英博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: most important; key

examples.text: Trust is central to building a long-term partnership.
examples.translation_cn: 信任对于建立长期合作关系至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: an empty area or the amount of room available

examples.text: There is plenty of space for a table here.
examples.translation_cn: 这里有足够空间放一张桌子。

senses.meaning_en: a gap or an empty place between things

examples.text: Leave a space between each line for notes.
examples.translation_cn: 每行之间留出空隙写笔记。

senses.meaning_en: the area beyond the earth's atmosphere; outer space

examples.text: Astronauts work in space for months at a time.
examples.translation_cn: 宇航员在太空中一次工作数月。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time

examples.text: He returned twice in the space of an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一小时内回来了两次。

senses.meaning_en: to make a formal request, especially in writing, for something such as a job, place, or permission

examples.text: She decided to apply for the marketing manager position.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定申请市场经理一职。

senses.meaning_en: to use a method, law, idea, etc. in a particular situation

examples.text: We need to apply this theory to real-life situations.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要把这一理论应用到实际情境中。

senses.meaning_en: to put or spread a substance such as paint, cream, or glue onto a surface

examples.text: She applied a thin layer of sunscreen to her arms.
examples.translation_cn: 她在手臂上涂了一层薄薄的防晒霜。

senses.meaning_en: to work hard at something; to give all your attention to something

examples.text: He applied himself to learning Spanish before moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 他在移居国外前专心学习西班牙语。

senses.meaning_en: to become larger in amount, number, or value

examples.text: The average temperature has increased from 20°C to 23°C over the past decade.
examples.translation_cn: 过去十年平均气温从20°C上升到了23°C。

senses.meaning_en: to make something larger in amount, number, or value

examples.text: They decided to increase the budget to two million dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 他们决定把预算增加到两百万美元。

senses.meaning_en: a rise in amount, number, or value

examples.text: There has been a dramatic increase in housing prices this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年房价急剧上涨。

senses.meaning_en: relating to authority or an office; approved by authority

examples.text: She attended the meeting in an official capacity.
examples.translation_cn: 她以官方身份出席了会议。

senses.meaning_en: a person who holds a position of authority in an organization

examples.text: A senior official confirmed the new policy on Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 一位高级官员周二确认了新政策。

senses.meaning_en: the sum of everything that exists in space

examples.text: There are billions of galaxies in the universe.
examples.translation_cn: 宇宙中有数十亿个星系。

senses.meaning_en: a particular sphere of activity, interest, or experience

examples.text: She works in the universe of independent film.
examples.translation_cn: 她在独立电影领域工作。

senses.meaning_en: the whole world of a particular person or social setting

examples.text: After the accident, his family became his whole universe.
examples.translation_cn: 事故之后，家人成了他的整个世界。

senses.meaning_en: an institution of higher education

examples.text: She studied biology at university for three years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学学了三年生物。

senses.meaning_en: two things of the same kind considered together

examples.text: The students worked in couples to solve the puzzle.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们两人一组解谜。

senses.meaning_en: two people in a romantic relationship

examples.text: They have been a couple for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们成为情侣已经五年了。

senses.meaning_en: a small number or amount
senses.pattern: a couple of + 名词复数

examples.text: We'll be there in a couple of minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 我们几分钟后就到。

senses.meaning_en: a place where something is, was, or will be located

examples.text: The site of the old factory is now a park.
examples.translation_cn: 老工厂的原址现在是一个公园。

senses.meaning_en: a website

examples.text: I read the story on a news site this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天早上在一个新闻网站上读了那篇报道。

senses.meaning_en: to place or build something in a particular place

examples.text: The new school is sited on the outskirts of town.
examples.translation_cn: 新学校坐落在城郊。

senses.meaning_en: to state that something is true, often without proof

examples.text: She claims to have finished the report already.
examples.translation_cn: 她声称已经完成了报告。

senses.meaning_en: a statement that something is true

examples.text: The report makes a claim that the drug is effective.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告声称这种药物有效。

senses.meaning_en: a legal demand for compensation or damages

examples.text: She filed a claim for the damage to her car.
examples.translation_cn: 她为汽车的损坏提出了索赔。

senses.meaning_en: a demand of ownership for something

examples.text: The company laid claim to the abandoned property.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司对那处废弃房产提出了所有权要求。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something belongs to you and ask for it to be given to you

examples.text: You can claim it at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在前台认领它。

senses.meaning_en: to strike someone or something

examples.text: The car hit a tree during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车在暴风雨中撞上了一棵树。

senses.meaning_en: to touch a target in the right place

examples.text: The arrow hit the target right in the center.
examples.translation_cn: 箭正中靶心。

senses.meaning_en: to switch on or off (a light or device)

examples.text: Could you hit the lights? It is getting dark.
examples.translation_cn: 你能把灯打开吗？天快黑了。

senses.meaning_en: to encounter an obstacle or other difficulty

examples.text: We hit a problem when the payment system went down.
examples.translation_cn: 支付系统宕机时我们遇到了问题。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize a statement or answer; truly

examples.text: Yes, that is indeed the most sensible option.
examples.translation_cn: 是的，那确实是最明智的选择。

senses.meaning_en: used to add information or introduce a supporting statement

examples.text: The plan is risky; indeed, it may fail.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划有风险；事实上，它可能会失败。

senses.meaning_en: used in reply to show surprise, interest, or agreement

examples.text: "He found a new job." "Indeed? I thought he loved the old one."
examples.translation_cn: “他找到了一份新工作。”“真的吗？我以为他喜欢原来那份工作。”

senses.meaning_en: the standard or level of something, as opposed to quantity

examples.text: The quality of the local water supply has declined.
examples.translation_cn: 当地供水的质量已经下降。

senses.meaning_en: a high standard; excellence

examples.text: The software is of high quality and easy to use.
examples.translation_cn: 这款软件质量高且易于使用。

senses.meaning_en: a characteristic or feature

examples.text: He has all the qualities of a great teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 他具备一位优秀教师的所有品质。

senses.meaning_en: a regulation or principle governing conduct or procedure

examples.text: The rules of the school are very strict.
examples.translation_cn: 学校的规定非常严格。

senses.meaning_en: the exercise of authority or control; government

examples.text: The country enjoyed peace and prosperity under her rule.
examples.translation_cn: 在她的统治下，国家享有和平与繁荣。

senses.meaning_en: to make an official decision about something, especially a legal case

examples.text: The court ruled in favour of the defendant.
examples.translation_cn: 法院判决被告胜诉。

senses.meaning_en: a usual or normal condition or practice
senses.collocation: make it a rule to do

examples.text: As a rule, I don't drink coffee after noon.
examples.translation_cn: 通常，我午后不喝咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: to pass on knowledge or skill to someone

examples.text: Miss Green teaches us history twice a week at school.
examples.translation_cn: 格林小姐每周在学校教我们两次历史。

senses.meaning_en: to work as a teacher, especially as a profession

examples.text: He teaches at a high school in Boston.
examples.translation_cn: 他在波士顿的一所高中教书。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to learn or understand something by example or experience

examples.text: Traveling alone taught me to be more independent.
examples.translation_cn: 独自旅行教会我更加独立。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone understand the unpleasant consequences of an action
senses.pattern: teach sb not to do sth

examples.text: The accident taught him not to text while driving.
examples.translation_cn: 那次事故让他认识到开车时不能发短信。

senses.meaning_en: liquid fat used in cooking

examples.text: We cook with olive oil because it is healthier than butter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用橄榄油烹饪，因为它比黄油更健康。

senses.meaning_en: petroleum

examples.text: The price of oil has dropped sharply in recent months.
examples.translation_cn: 近几个月石油价格大幅下跌。

senses.meaning_en: oil paint

examples.text: She prefers to paint in oils rather than watercolours.
examples.translation_cn: 她更喜欢用油彩而不是水彩作画。

senses.meaning_en: to lubricate or coat with oil

examples.text: He oiled the door hinges to stop them squeaking.
examples.translation_cn: 他给门铰链上了油，使其不再吱吱作响。

senses.meaning_en: petroleum-based liquid used as fuel or lubricant

examples.text: The engine was low on oil, so I added a litre before driving.
examples.translation_cn: 发动机缺润滑油，所以开车前我加了一升。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of weight

examples.text: He bought a pound of coffee for the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他买了一磅咖啡周末喝。

senses.meaning_en: the British unit of money

examples.text: The pound fell sharply against the dollar yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 昨天英镑兑美元汇率大幅下跌。

senses.meaning_en: to hit something hard many times

examples.text: She pounded on the door until her hands hurt.
examples.translation_cn: 她不停地猛敲门，直到双手发疼。

senses.meaning_en: to beat quickly and strongly

examples.text: Her heart was pounding with excitement after the race.
examples.translation_cn: 赛跑后她的心因兴奋而剧烈跳动。

senses.meaning_en: to crush something into a powder or paste

examples.text: She pounded the garlic into a paste with a mortar and pestle.
examples.translation_cn: 她用研钵和杵把大蒜捣成糊状。

senses.meaning_en: information stored, processed, or transmitted by a computer

examples.text: The server stores data on user activity and shares it with the analytics team.
examples.translation_cn: 服务器存储用户活动数据，并与分析团队共享。

senses.meaning_en: the physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes

examples.text: The documentary shows animals living in nature without human interference.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片展示了动物在没有人类干扰的自然环境中生活。

senses.meaning_en: the basic character or qualities of a person or animal

examples.text: Children are curious by nature and ask endless questions.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们天生好奇，会问没完没了的问题。

senses.meaning_en: the essential qualities or features of something

examples.text: Economists closely study the nature of financial markets.
examples.translation_cn: 经济学家仔细研究金融市场的本质。

senses.meaning_en: a type or kind of something

examples.text: Books of this nature rarely appear on bestseller lists.
examples.translation_cn: 这类书很少登上畅销书榜。

senses.meaning_en: happening often or found in large numbers
senses.pattern: it is common to do sth

examples.text: It is common to see deer in this park at dusk.
examples.translation_cn: 黄昏时在这个公园里看到鹿很常见。

senses.meaning_en: shared by two or more people or groups

examples.text: A love of music is common to both sisters.
examples.translation_cn: 对音乐的热爱是这两姐妹共有的。

senses.meaning_en: ordinary and not special

examples.text: He was just a common thief, not a mastermind.
examples.translation_cn: 他只是个普通的小偷，不是主谋。

senses.meaning_en: the general impression that a person or organization presents to the public

examples.text: The scandal damaged his image as an honest leader.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻损害了他作为诚实领导人的形象。

senses.meaning_en: a visual or mental representation of something

examples.text: The poem creates a vivid image of spring rain.
examples.translation_cn: 这首诗营造出春雨的生动意象。

senses.meaning_en: a file that contains an exact copy of a disk or hard drive

examples.text: Create a disk image before installing new software.
examples.translation_cn: 安装新软件前创建一个磁盘映像。

senses.meaning_en: a visual or other representation of the external form of something in art

examples.text: The temple houses a carved image of the goddess.
examples.translation_cn: 这座庙里供奉着女神的雕像。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has a position of authority in an organization, especially in the military, police, or government.

examples.text: She has served as an officer in the local government for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地政府担任官员已有十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a respectful term of address for a police officer.

examples.text: Excuse me, officer, could you tell me where the nearest station is?
examples.translation_cn: 打扰一下，警官，您能告诉我最近的车站在哪里吗？

senses.meaning_en: a commissioned officer in the armed forces.

examples.text: He was commissioned as an officer after graduating from the military academy.
examples.translation_cn: 他从军事学院毕业后被任命为军官。

senses.meaning_en: a device or system for speaking to someone at a distance

examples.text: You can reach me by phone during office hours.
examples.translation_cn: 办公时间你可以通过电话联系到我。

senses.meaning_en: to call someone using a telephone

examples.text: He phoned the school to report his son's absence.
examples.translation_cn: 他给学校打电话报告儿子缺勤的事。

senses.meaning_en: a person's telephone number

examples.text: You should include your phone number at the top of every job application.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该在每份求职申请的顶部写上你的电话号码。

senses.meaning_en: a cohesive whole built up of distinct parts; the overall form or organization of something

examples.text: The structure of the human body is incredibly complex.
examples.translation_cn: 人体结构极其复杂。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange or organize something in a systematic way

examples.text: The teacher structured the course around real-world problems.
examples.translation_cn: 老师以现实问题为中心组织这门课程。

senses.meaning_en: to have something inside or include as a part

examples.text: This report contains all the information you need.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告包含你需要的所有信息。

senses.meaning_en: to control or restrain (a feeling or oneself)

examples.text: She could hardly contain herself when she heard she had won the prize.
examples.translation_cn: 当她听说自己获奖时，几乎无法控制自己。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent something harmful from spreading or getting worse

examples.text: The government acted quickly to contain the spread of the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 政府迅速采取行动遏制病毒的传播。

senses.meaning_en: a standard measure of a quantity

examples.text: A litre is a unit of volume, not of weight.
examples.translation_cn: 升是体积单位，不是重量单位。

senses.meaning_en: a single complete thing that can form part of a larger whole

examples.text: We installed a new air-conditioning unit in the bedroom.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在卧室安装了一台新的空调设备。

senses.meaning_en: an organized group of people or pieces of equipment, especially one that is part of a larger organization

examples.text: She served in an army unit for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个部队单位服役了两年。

senses.meaning_en: the number one; the digit in the ones place

examples.text: Write the digit five in the units column on your answer sheet.
examples.translation_cn: 把数字五写在答题纸的个位列上。

senses.meaning_en: a way of doing something

examples.text: The school is testing a new method of teaching languages.
examples.translation_cn: 学校正在试用一种新的语言教学方法。

senses.meaning_en: orderly arrangement or procedure

examples.text: There is method in his madness: he knows exactly where everything is.
examples.translation_cn: 他看似疯狂，实则有条理：每样东西的位置他都一清二楚。

senses.meaning_en: an act of moving or changing position; a movement of the body

examples.text: She made a sudden movement towards the door.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然朝门口动了一下。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people working together to achieve shared aims

examples.text: Many young people joined a movement for cleaner air.
examples.translation_cn: 许多年轻人加入了一场争取清洁空气的运动。

senses.meaning_en: one of the main parts of a long piece of music

examples.text: The first movement of the symphony opens with a solo violin.
examples.translation_cn: 这部交响曲的第一乐章以小提琴独奏开始。

senses.meaning_en: a small individual fact or point

examples.text: The officer asked me to describe every detail of the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 警官让我描述事故的每一个细节。

senses.meaning_en: full information or all the facts about something

examples.text: Please send me full details of the job.
examples.translation_cn: 请把这份工作的详细情况发给我。

senses.meaning_en: to list or describe something fully

examples.text: The final report details how the new system works.
examples.translation_cn: 最终报告详细说明了新系统如何运作。

senses.meaning_en: a person's name, address and other personal information

examples.text: Please enter your personal details to create an account.
examples.translation_cn: 请填写您的个人信息以创建账户。

senses.meaning_en: having happened a short while ago

examples.text: In recent years, the number of electric cars has risen sharply.
examples.translation_cn: 近年来，电动汽车的数量急剧上升。

senses.meaning_en: having recently done something that makes them what they are called

examples.text: The company hired a recent graduate to manage its social media.
examples.translation_cn: 公司聘用了一名刚毕业的学生来管理其社交媒体。

senses.meaning_en: to make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or intensity

examples.text: The new policy aims to reduce carbon emissions by half by 2030.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策旨在到2030年将碳排放量减少一半。

senses.meaning_en: to bring someone or something into a worse state or condition

examples.text: The defeat reduced the proud champion to tears.
examples.translation_cn: 这次失败使这位骄傲的冠军流下了眼泪。

senses.meaning_en: to lose weight, especially by dieting

examples.text: She reduced by five kilos after following a strict diet.
examples.translation_cn: 她在严格控制饮食后减了五公斤。

senses.meaning_en: to remove oxygen from or add electrons to a substance

examples.text: The furnace reduces iron ore to molten iron.
examples.translation_cn: 高炉将铁矿石还原成铁水。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a particular person; private

examples.text: The letter is personal to her, so please don't read it.
examples.translation_cn: 这封信是她私人的，所以请不要读。

senses.meaning_en: done in person; without an intermediary

examples.text: The mayor made a personal appearance at the opening ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 市长亲自出席了开幕式。

senses.meaning_en: to challenge or put a strain on something

examples.text: The difficult climb will test your strength and stamina.
examples.translation_cn: 这次艰难的攀登将考验你的力量和耐力。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone an examination

examples.text: The teacher tested the class on irregular verbs.
examples.translation_cn: 老师测验了全班的不规则动词。

senses.meaning_en: a set of questions or exercises to measure knowledge or ability

examples.text: She took a difficult math test yesterday afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨天下午参加了一次难度较大的数学测验。

senses.meaning_en: a medical examination of a part of the body

examples.text: She had a blood test to check for anemia.
examples.translation_cn: 她验了血以检查是否贫血。

senses.meaning_en: a challenge or trial

examples.text: The marathon was a real test of endurance.
examples.translation_cn: 马拉松赛跑真是对耐力的考验。

senses.meaning_en: to start or create an organization, system, relationship, etc.

examples.text: The charity established a strong relationship with local schools.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构与当地学校建立了密切关系。

senses.meaning_en: to discover or prove the facts of a situation

examples.text: Police are trying to establish whether the fire was started deliberately.
examples.translation_cn: 警方正试图查明这场火灾是否为蓄意纵火。

senses.meaning_en: to achieve acceptance or recognition for oneself or something

examples.text: She quickly established herself as a trusted adviser.
examples.translation_cn: 她迅速确立了自己作为值得信赖的顾问的地位。

senses.meaning_en: a film or video

examples.text: We watched a movie about ocean life last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于海洋生物的电影。

senses.meaning_en: a cinema; a movie theater

examples.text: We go to the movies every Friday night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周五晚上都去看电影。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to a particular person, not the state

examples.text: The castle has been in private hands for over a century.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城堡归私人所有已有一个多世纪。

senses.meaning_en: not publicly known; confidential

examples.text: She asked to speak to him in private.
examples.translation_cn: 她要求和他私下谈话。

senses.meaning_en: quiet and not open to the public
senses.pattern: a private place to do sth

examples.text: We found a private place to sit and relax by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在河边找到一个僻静的地方坐下来放松。

senses.meaning_en: not traded on a stock exchange

examples.text: The firm remains private and has no plans to sell shares to the public.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司未上市，且无计划向公众出售股票。

senses.meaning_en: a way of dealing with somebody or something; a way of doing or thinking about something

examples.text: We need a fresh approach to solving this problem.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要一种解决这个问题的新方法。

senses.meaning_en: to come near to somebody or something in distance or time

examples.text: The train slowed down as it approached the station.
examples.translation_cn: 火车进站时慢了下来。

senses.meaning_en: to start dealing with a problem, task, etc. in a particular way

examples.text: You should approach the problem from a different angle.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该从不同的角度处理这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: to speak to somebody about something, especially to ask them for something or to offer to do something

examples.text: She approached her manager about taking a few days off.
examples.translation_cn: 她向经理提出请几天假。

senses.meaning_en: a quantity or total

examples.text: The total amount of rainfall this year was far below average.
examples.translation_cn: 今年总降雨量远低于平均水平。

senses.meaning_en: to add up to; to total

examples.text: Their total debts amount to over ten thousand dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的债务总计超过一万美元。

senses.meaning_en: to be equivalent to

examples.text: His long silence amounted to a clear refusal.
examples.translation_cn: 他长时间的沉默无异于明确拒绝。

senses.meaning_en: scientific knowledge and techniques

examples.text: The technology for recycling plastic has improved dramatically.
examples.translation_cn: 塑料回收技术已大幅改进。

senses.meaning_en: machinery or equipment developed from scientific knowledge

examples.text: This pocket-sized scanner is a remarkable piece of technology.
examples.translation_cn: 这款袖珍扫描仪是一件了不起的科技产品。

senses.meaning_en: a plan or system for doing or organizing something

examples.text: The city launched a new scheme for reducing air pollution.
examples.translation_cn: 该市启动了一项减少空气污染的新计划。

senses.meaning_en: a secret plan to get an advantage, especially by cheating

examples.text: They cooked up a scheme to defraud elderly investors.
examples.translation_cn: 他们策划了一场欺骗老年投资者的阴谋。

senses.meaning_en: to make secret plans to get an advantage, especially by deceiving people

examples.text: He schemed to replace the manager within a year.
examples.translation_cn: 他密谋在一年内取代经理。

senses.meaning_en: a movement made by lifting the foot and putting it down again

examples.text: He took a step forward and held out his hand.
examples.translation_cn: 他向前迈了一步，伸出手来。

senses.meaning_en: a stair or rung for the foot to rest on

examples.text: She sat on the front steps and tied her shoes.
examples.translation_cn: 她坐在门前台阶上系鞋带。

senses.meaning_en: one of a series of actions taken to achieve something

examples.text: We must take steps to protect the environment.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护环境。

senses.meaning_en: to move by lifting the foot and putting it down elsewhere

examples.text: He stepped out of the taxi and paid the driver.
examples.translation_cn: 他走出出租车并付了车费。

senses.meaning_en: a prize or honor given for an achievement

examples.text: She won an award for her first novel last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年因第一部小说获奖。

senses.meaning_en: to officially give something such as a prize or money to someone
senses.pattern: award sth to sb / award sb sth

examples.text: The university awarded a scholarship to the top student.
examples.translation_cn: 大学授予了那名尖子生奖学金。

senses.meaning_en: the act of watching or listening carefully

examples.text: Please pay attention to the warning signs around the building.
examples.translation_cn: 请留意建筑物周围的警示标志。

senses.meaning_en: the act of dealing with or caring for someone or something

examples.text: The injured driver received medical attention from the paramedics.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤的司机接受了急救人员的医疗处理。

senses.meaning_en: actions or remarks showing interest in someone, especially romantic interest
senses.pattern: be the object of sb's attentions

examples.text: She was the object of his attentions at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她在聚会上是他献殷勤的对象。

senses.meaning_en: a position of standing straight with feet together, especially in the military

examples.text: The soldiers stood at attention during the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在仪式上立正站立。

senses.meaning_en: to try to find or obtain someone or something

examples.text: We sought shelter from the storm in a nearby cave.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在附近的一个山洞里躲避暴风雨。

senses.meaning_en: to try to reach or come to a place

examples.text: They sought higher ground before the storm surge arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 在风暴潮到来之前，他们向地势较高的地方转移。

senses.meaning_en: to try or attempt to do something

examples.text: Many companies are seeking to reduce costs during the recession.
examples.translation_cn: 许多公司正设法在经济衰退期间降低成本。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for something such as advice or help

examples.text: You should seek advice from a qualified accountant.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该向合格的会计寻求建议。

examples.text: She worked hard to achieve her goal of becoming a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她努力实现了成为一名医生的目标。

examples.text: He achieved great success in his career as a scientist.
examples.translation_cn: 他在科学家的职业生涯中取得了巨大成功。

examples.text: The team achieved the task in record time.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队以创纪录的时间完成了任务。

senses.meaning_en: one of the main sections into which a book or other published work is divided

examples.text: The first chapter of the book describes her childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 书的第一章描述了她的童年。

senses.meaning_en: a local branch of a society or organization; a division of a social body

examples.text: She joined the local chapter of the environmental group.
examples.translation_cn: 她加入了环保组织的地方分会。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time in a person's life or history

examples.text: Moving to New York opened a new chapter in her life.
examples.translation_cn: 搬到纽约翻开了她人生的新篇章。

senses.meaning_en: to pick; to make a choice; to select

examples.text: You need to choose between a full-time job and further study.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要在全职工作和继续深造之间做出选择。

senses.meaning_en: to decide to act in a certain way; to prefer

examples.text: He chose to remain silent during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他决定在会议上保持沉默。

senses.meaning_en: to elect

examples.text: The committee chose her as the new chair.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会推选她为新主席。

senses.meaning_en: supporting or advocating a republic as a form of government

examples.text: He remained republican in his political views throughout his life.
examples.translation_cn: 他一生在政治观点上保持共和主义。

senses.meaning_en: of or belonging to a republic

examples.text: The country adopted a republican form of government after the revolution.
examples.translation_cn: 革命后该国采用了共和政体。

senses.meaning_en: a person who favors a republic as a form of government

examples.text: He is a republican who supports an elected head of state.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一位共和主义者，支持民选国家元首。

senses.meaning_en: Of or pertaining to the Republican Party of the United States.

examples.text: The Republican candidate won the election by a narrow margin.
examples.translation_cn: 共和党候选人以微弱优势赢得选举。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount or quantity; a lot

examples.text: He spent a great deal of time on the project.
examples.translation_cn: 他在这个项目上花了大量时间。

senses.meaning_en: to take action to solve a problem or manage a situation

examples.text: We need to deal with this issue immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要立即处理这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: an agreement or arrangement, especially in business

examples.text: The two companies made a deal to work together.
examples.translation_cn: 两家公司达成了一项合作协议。

senses.meaning_en: to give out cards to players or distribute something

examples.text: She dealt out five cards to each player.
examples.translation_cn: 她给每位玩家发了五张牌。

senses.meaning_en: to deliver a blow, damage, or cut; to inflict

examples.text: The scandal could deal a blow to his career.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻可能给他的事业造成打击。

senses.meaning_en: a part of the body that performs a specific function

examples.text: The liver is an organ of the body that filters waste from the blood.
examples.translation_cn: 肝脏是身体中过滤血液废物的器官。

senses.meaning_en: an organization within a larger institution or government

examples.text: The ministry is an organ of government responsible for public health.
examples.translation_cn: 该部是负责公共卫生的政府机关。

senses.meaning_en: a large musical instrument with pipes

examples.text: She learned to play the organ at her local church.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地的教堂学会了弹管风琴。

senses.meaning_en: an official magazine, newsletter, or similar publication of an organization

examples.text: The journal serves as the official organ of the medical association.
examples.translation_cn: 该期刊是医学协会的官方机关刊物。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange or plan an event or activity

examples.text: She organized a party for her parents' anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 她为父母的结婚纪念日组织了一场聚会。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange things in a tidy or ordered way

examples.text: You should organize your notes from the lecture before class.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该在上课前把讲座笔记整理好。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange your time, life, etc. in a sensible or ordered way

examples.text: She organized her time efficiently to balance work and study.
examples.translation_cn: 她有效地安排时间，以平衡工作和学习。

senses.meaning_en: to form or join a group or union, especially a labor union, to bargain collectively

examples.text: The workers organized into a union to demand better pay.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们组织起来成立工会，要求提高工资。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people with a particular purpose, such as a business or government department

examples.text: She works for a charity organization that helps homeless people.
examples.translation_cn: 她为一家帮助无家可归者的慈善组织工作。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being organized and tidy

examples.text: His essay lacks organization, so the arguments are hard to follow.
examples.translation_cn: 他的文章缺乏条理，所以论点难以理解。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which something is organized or arranged

examples.text: The organization of the report makes it easy to find key information.
examples.translation_cn: 报告的结构使人容易找到关键信息。

senses.meaning_en: a set of ideas that explains facts and predicts new ones

examples.text: Astronomers use the theory of gravity to predict planetary motion.
examples.translation_cn: 天文学家利用引力理论预测行星运动。

senses.meaning_en: general principles of a subject, as opposed to practice

examples.text: In theory the new method should save time, but it has not been tested.
examples.translation_cn: 理论上新方法应该节省时间，但尚未经过检验。

senses.meaning_en: an idea or guess that explains something, not yet proved

examples.text: Police have a theory that the fire was started deliberately.
examples.translation_cn: 警方推测这起火灾是有人蓄意引发的。

senses.meaning_en: right or suitable for a particular situation or purpose
senses.pattern: the proper way to do sth

examples.text: You must learn the proper way to handle dangerous chemicals.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须学会正确处理危险化学品的方法。

senses.meaning_en: following accepted standards of behavior; polite and correct

examples.text: It is not proper to wear jeans to a formal dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 穿牛仔裤参加正式晚宴不合礼仪。

senses.meaning_en: real, true, or deserving the name; genuine

examples.text: After days of fast food, we finally had a proper meal.
examples.translation_cn: 吃了几天快餐后，我们终于吃了顿像样的饭。

senses.meaning_en: something that is owned

examples.text: The car is the property of my father.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车是我父亲的财产。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of real estate

examples.text: They bought a property in the countryside last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去年在乡下买了一处房产。

senses.meaning_en: real estate; the business of buying and selling houses

examples.text: Many people invest in property to build long-term wealth.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人投资房地产以积累长期财富。

senses.meaning_en: an attribute or quality

examples.text: Flexibility is a key property of this plastic.
examples.translation_cn: 柔韧性是这种塑料的一个关键特性。

senses.meaning_en: a person, place, or thing from which something comes or is obtained

examples.text: This book is an excellent source of information on local history.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书是关于当地历史的一个极好的信息来源。

senses.meaning_en: a spring or place where a stream or river starts

examples.text: The source of the river is a small lake in the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河的源头是山中的一个小湖。

senses.meaning_en: a person who provides information, especially for a journalist

examples.text: A source close to the mayor confirmed the resignation.
examples.translation_cn: 一位接近市长的消息人士证实了辞职一事。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain something (goods, materials, information, etc.) from a particular place or person; to find the origin of something

examples.text: The company sources its coffee beans directly from farmers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司直接从农民那里采购咖啡豆。

senses.meaning_en: the original code of a computer program before it is compiled

examples.text: The source code of the program is available online.
examples.translation_cn: 这个程序的源代码可以在线获取。

senses.meaning_en: relating to money or finance

examples.text: The school is in financial difficulty after losing its main sponsor.
examples.translation_cn: 学校失去主要赞助者后陷入财务困难。

senses.meaning_en: having paid all dues to a club or society

examples.text: As a financial member, you can vote at the annual meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 作为已缴清会费的会员，你可以在年会上投票。

senses.meaning_en: solid and stable; not easily moved or changed

examples.text: The ground is firm enough to build on.
examples.translation_cn: 这块地面足够坚实，可以在上面建造。

senses.meaning_en: a business company or partnership

examples.text: She works for a law firm in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伦敦的一家律师事务所工作。

senses.meaning_en: fixed in intention or opinion; not likely to change

examples.text: We must stand firm on this important issue.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须在这个重要问题上立场坚定。

senses.meaning_en: a formal written or spoken request for something such as a job or a place at college

examples.text: She sent off an application for the marketing post this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她今天早上寄出了申请营销职位的材料。

senses.meaning_en: the act of putting something onto a surface; a substance put onto a surface

examples.text: The application of heat may help to relieve muscle pain.
examples.translation_cn: 热敷可能有助于缓解肌肉疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: a computer program designed to help the user perform a particular task

examples.text: You can install an application on any smartphone for free.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以免费在任何智能手机上安装一个应用程序。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thin, flat piece of wood or other hard material

examples.text: She chopped the carrots on a wooden board in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 她在厨房里的木板上切胡萝卜。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who manage or direct a company or organization

examples.text: She has served on the board of directors for six years.
examples.translation_cn: 她已经在董事会任职六年。

senses.meaning_en: a flat piece of material used for a particular purpose, such as a blackboard, notice board, or chessboard

examples.text: The teacher writes the new words on the board.
examples.translation_cn: 老师把新单词写在黑板上。

senses.meaning_en: to get on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle

examples.text: Passengers should board the plane at gate twelve now.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客现在应在十二号登机口登机。

senses.meaning_en: regular meals provided in return for payment, often with lodging

examples.text: The hotel provides room and board for all staff.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆为所有员工提供食宿。

senses.meaning_en: the customs, arts, and way of life of a particular society or group

examples.text: The culture of ancient Greece still influences Western art.
examples.translation_cn: 古希腊文化仍然影响着西方艺术。

senses.meaning_en: a very large number or amount

examples.text: There are billions of grains of sand on the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 海滩上有无数沙粒。

senses.meaning_en: the number 1,000,000,000

examples.text: The new bridge will cost a billion dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新桥将耗资十亿美元。

senses.meaning_en: a male ruler of a country, usually inheriting the position

examples.text: He became king of Norway after his father died.
examples.translation_cn: 他父亲去世后，他成为挪威国王。

senses.meaning_en: a playing card with a picture of a king, usually ranking below an ace

examples.text: She won the trick with the king of hearts.
examples.translation_cn: 她凭借红桃K赢了这一墩牌。

senses.meaning_en: the most important chess piece, whose capture ends the game

examples.text: He moved his queen to put the king in check.
examples.translation_cn: 他移动王后来将对方的王。
