examples.text: The company detected a cyber attack on its database.
examples.translation_cn: 公司检测到对其数据库的网络攻击。

senses.meaning_en: to get or gain something

examples.text: You must obtain permission from the manager before entering.
examples.translation_cn: 进入之前，你必须获得经理的许可。

senses.meaning_en: to exist or be in use; to hold true

examples.text: The same conditions still obtain in many regions.
examples.translation_cn: 同样的条件在许多地区仍然存在。

senses.meaning_en: to make something known publicly, especially for the first time

examples.text: The company announced that it would cut 500 jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 公司宣布将裁员500人。

senses.meaning_en: to declare officially, especially a legal decision or sentence

examples.text: The judge announced a sentence of five years.
examples.translation_cn: 法官宣布了五年刑期的判决。

senses.meaning_en: to describe an event, especially a sports event, as it happens for an audience

examples.text: He announced the championship game live on national radio.
examples.translation_cn: 他在国家广播电台直播解说了冠军赛。

senses.meaning_en: a sensation, especially through the skin
senses.collocation: loss of feeling in one's fingers

examples.text: She lost feeling in her fingers after swimming in icy water.
examples.translation_cn: 在冰冷的水里游过泳后，她的手指失去了感觉。

senses.meaning_en: an emotion or emotional state

examples.text: She had mixed feelings about moving away from home.
examples.translation_cn: 对于离开家，她心情复杂。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion, belief, or intuition

examples.text: I have a feeling that the train will be late again.
examples.translation_cn: 我有种预感火车又要晚点了。

senses.meaning_en: romantic attraction or affection

examples.text: He has never revealed his feelings for his classmate.
examples.translation_cn: 他从未表露过对同学的爱慕。

senses.meaning_en: attractive to look at, especially (of women or children); (of things) nice-looking, appealing

examples.text: She looks pretty in that dark blue dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿那件深蓝色连衣裙看起来很漂亮。

senses.meaning_en: to a moderately high degree; fairly; quite (sometimes very in speech)

examples.text: The final exam was pretty difficult, but I think I passed.
examples.translation_cn: 期末考试相当难，但我想我通过了。

senses.meaning_en: a corridor or hallway

examples.text: The bathroom is down the hall on the left.
examples.translation_cn: 洗手间在走廊左侧尽头。

senses.meaning_en: a large meeting room

examples.text: The lecture will be given in the hall next Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 讲座将于下周一在大厅举行。

senses.meaning_en: a manor house

examples.text: The stately hall dates from the 17th century and is surrounded by parkland.
examples.translation_cn: 这座雄伟古宅可追溯至17世纪，四周环绕着园林。

senses.meaning_en: a building providing student accommodation at a university

examples.text: Many first-year students live in halls of residence.
examples.translation_cn: 许多一年级学生住在学生宿舍楼。

senses.meaning_en: an ability to do something well, usually acquired through practice

examples.text: She showed great skill at handling difficult customers.
examples.translation_cn: 她表现出处理难缠顾客的高超技巧。

senses.meaning_en: a reusable configuration that defines how an AI agent performs a specific task

examples.text: You can configure a custom skill to handle refunds automatically.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以配置一个自定义技能来自动处理退款。

senses.meaning_en: of the human body

examples.text: You should wash your hands after any physical contact with animals.
examples.translation_cn: 接触动物后你应该洗手。

senses.meaning_en: relating to real things that you can see and touch

examples.text: We cannot touch radio waves in the physical world.
examples.translation_cn: 无线电波在物质世界中无法被触摸。

senses.meaning_en: relating to physics

examples.text: Chemists measure the physical properties of each new material.
examples.translation_cn: 化学家测量每种新材料的物理性质。

senses.meaning_en: a physical examination

examples.text: He went for a physical before joining the football team.
examples.translation_cn: 他在加入足球队前去做了一次体检。

senses.meaning_en: to put something down in a horizontal position
senses.collocation: lay the book on the desk

examples.text: He laid the keys on the table and went upstairs.
examples.translation_cn: 他把钥匙放在桌上就上楼了。

senses.meaning_en: to produce eggs

examples.text: The sea turtle lays eggs on the beach at night.
examples.translation_cn: 海龟夜间在沙滩上产卵。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange a table for a meal; to spread something over a surface

examples.text: Please lay the table for dinner while I cook.
examples.translation_cn: 我做饭时，请把餐桌摆好。

senses.meaning_en: to risk money on something
senses.collocation: lay a bet on a horse

examples.text: He laid a bet on the horse race last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他上周末在赛马比赛上下了注。

senses.meaning_en: a person who uses a product, service, or place

examples.text: Users of the app can sync their data across devices.
examples.translation_cn: 该应用的用户可以跨设备同步数据。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes illegal drugs

examples.text: He was a heavy drug user for over a decade.
examples.translation_cn: 他曾是个重度吸毒者长达十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a spoken or written piece of information that you send or leave for someone

examples.text: I received a message from her this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天早上收到了她的一条信息。

senses.meaning_en: to send a written or spoken message to someone, especially by phone

examples.text: She messaged me about the change in plans.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我发信息说了计划变更。

senses.meaning_en: the main idea or moral that an artist, writer, speaker, etc. wants to communicate

examples.text: The main message of the film is that hope never dies.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影的主旨是希望永不消逝。

senses.meaning_en: having a healthy mind; not mentally ill

examples.text: After weeks of treatment, the patient appears mentally normal again.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几周治疗，病人看起来精神又正常了。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the training of teachers

examples.text: She attended a normal school for three years and then became a teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 她在师范学校学习了三年，然后成了一名教师。

senses.meaning_en: usual, typical or expected; conforming to a standard

examples.text: It is normal to feel tired after a long flight.
examples.translation_cn: 长途飞行后感到疲劳是正常的。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being male or female

examples.text: The new law bans discrimination based on sex.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律禁止基于性别的歧视。

senses.meaning_en: sexual activity, especially sexual intercourse

examples.text: She had sex with her boyfriend for the first time.
examples.translation_cn: 她第一次和男友发生了性行为。

senses.meaning_en: all members of one sex considered as a group

examples.text: He often feels shy around the opposite sex.
examples.translation_cn: 他在异性面前常常感到害羞。

senses.meaning_en: to spend time or energy on something in order to get a benefit

examples.text: She invested all her energy in preparing for the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 她投入全部精力准备面试。

senses.meaning_en: to put money into something to make a profit

examples.text: He decided to invest in a small tech startup.
examples.translation_cn: 他决定投资一家小型科技初创公司。

senses.meaning_en: the act of putting money into something to make a profit, or the money that is invested

examples.text: They made an investment in renewable energy last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去年投资了可再生能源。

senses.meaning_en: the act of spending time or effort on something in order to get a future benefit
senses.pattern: an investment of time and effort

examples.text: Learning a language requires an investment of time and effort.
examples.translation_cn: 学习一门语言需要投入时间和精力。

senses.meaning_en: the act of surrounding a place with an armed force to capture it

examples.text: The army began the investment of the city at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在拂晓开始包围这座城市。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is trained and qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court

examples.text: She works as a lawyer at a large law firm in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伦敦一家大型律师事务所当律师。

senses.meaning_en: a large organized military force that fights on land

examples.text: He joined the army after graduating from high school.
examples.translation_cn: 他高中毕业后参了军。

senses.meaning_en: a large group of people or things

examples.text: An army of volunteers helped clean up the park after the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 节日过后，一大群志愿者帮忙打扫了公园。

senses.meaning_en: to be badly affected by pain, sadness, or difficulty

examples.text: He has been suffering from severe back pain for months.
examples.translation_cn: 他几个月来一直背部剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: to experience something unpleasant, such as loss or damage

examples.text: The company suffered a huge loss last year.
examples.translation_cn: 公司去年遭受了重大损失。

senses.meaning_en: to become worse

examples.text: Her grades suffered as a result of her part-time job.
examples.translation_cn: 她的成绩因兼职工作而变差了。

senses.meaning_en: to tolerate or endure something unpleasant

examples.text: I cannot suffer such rude behavior any longer.
examples.translation_cn: 我再也无法忍受这么粗鲁的行为。

senses.meaning_en: happening or existing before something else

examples.text: The previous day had been warm, but now it was snowing.
examples.translation_cn: 前一天还很暖和，现在却下雪了。

senses.meaning_en: to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.

examples.text: The company maintained output at last year's level.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司把产量维持在了去年的水平。

senses.meaning_en: to keep in good condition and working order

examples.text: They maintain the machinery properly to avoid breakdowns.
examples.translation_cn: 他们妥善保养机器以避免故障。

senses.meaning_en: to assert something is true

examples.text: She maintained that she was innocent throughout the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 整个审判过程中她坚称自己无辜。

senses.meaning_en: a teacher at a university or college; also used as a title

examples.text: She became a professor of chemistry at Harvard in 2010.
examples.translation_cn: 她于2010年成为哈佛大学的化学教授。

senses.meaning_en: the most senior rank of academic at a university

examples.text: She was promoted to full professor after publishing two books.
examples.translation_cn: 她出版了两本书后被晋升为正教授。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal act that can be punished by law

examples.text: He committed a crime and was sent to prison.
examples.translation_cn: 他犯了罪并被送进了监狱。

senses.meaning_en: an act that is considered immoral or a serious mistake
senses.pattern: It is a crime to do

examples.text: It is a crime to waste so much food.
examples.translation_cn: 浪费这么多食物是一种罪过。

senses.meaning_en: criminal activities in general

examples.text: The government promised to fight crime in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 政府承诺在该市打击犯罪。

senses.meaning_en: to produce and distribute a book, magazine, etc.

examples.text: The small press publishes a book about local history every year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家小出版社每年出版一本地方史书。

senses.meaning_en: to make official information available to the public

examples.text: The government has published the results of the investigation.
examples.translation_cn: 政府公布了调查结果。

senses.meaning_en: to have work printed in a newspaper or journal

examples.text: Her research was published in the journal Nature last month.
examples.translation_cn: 她的研究上月发表在《自然》杂志上。

senses.meaning_en: to make a message or post publicly available online

examples.text: She published a post about the new policy on social media.
examples.translation_cn: 她在社交媒体上发布了一篇关于新政策的帖子。

senses.meaning_en: a country in Western Europe

examples.text: My cousin is studying in France for a year.
examples.translation_cn: 我表姐在法国学习一年。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being responsible or accountable

examples.text: The school has responsibility for the safety of its students.
examples.translation_cn: 学校对学生的安全负有责任。

senses.meaning_en: a duty or obligation to deal with something

examples.text: All staff have a responsibility to report any safety concerns.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工都有责任报告任何安全隐患。

senses.meaning_en: blame for something bad that has happened

examples.text: No one has claimed responsibility for the bombing at the central station.
examples.translation_cn: 尚无人声称对中央车站的爆炸案负责。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being liable, culpable, or responsible for something in particular

examples.text: The company bears responsibility for the oil spill.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司对石油泄漏负有责任。

senses.meaning_en: the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together

examples.text: Two hundred guests attended the wedding in total.
examples.translation_cn: 共有两百位宾客出席了婚礼。

senses.meaning_en: to add up to a particular amount

examples.text: The repair costs for the old building totalled over $1,200.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧楼的维修费用总计超过1200美元。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the whole of something

examples.text: The total cost of the project was just under $2 million.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目的总成本略低于200万美元。

senses.meaning_en: complete; absolute

examples.text: The meeting was a total waste of time.
examples.translation_cn: 这次会议完全是浪费时间。

senses.meaning_en: a verbal dispute or quarrel

examples.text: They had an argument over who should pay the bill.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为谁该付账而争吵。

senses.meaning_en: a fact or statement used to support a proposition

examples.text: She made an argument for hiring more staff.
examples.translation_cn: 她提出了招聘更多员工的理由。

senses.meaning_en: the process of reasoning

examples.text: He persuaded them by argument, not by threats.
examples.translation_cn: 他靠论证说服了他们，而不是靠威胁。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to hit, catch, reach, or achieve something
senses.pattern: miss a chance to do sth

examples.text: She missed a chance to study abroad last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年错过了一个出国留学的机会。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sad because someone or something is not present

examples.text: She misses having dinner with her family back home.
examples.translation_cn: 她很想念和家人共进晚餐的时光。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to understand something

examples.text: He completely missed the point of my argument.
examples.translation_cn: 他完全没有理解我的论点。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to notice or see something

examples.text: The editor missed several mistakes in the final draft.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑在终稿中漏掉了几个错误。

senses.meaning_en: to stay away from somebody or something

examples.text: Residents were warned to avoid the beach during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨期间，居民被警告避开海滩。

senses.meaning_en: to try not to do something

examples.text: You should avoid discussing politics at family dinners.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该避免在家庭聚餐时谈论政治。

senses.meaning_en: a proposed law presented to a legislature

examples.text: The committee voted on the bill after a long debate.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会在长时间辩论后对该法案进行了表决。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of paper money

examples.text: He handed me a five-dollar bill for the coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 他递给我一张五美元钞票买咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services

examples.text: We received a bill for the repairs last week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周收到了修理费账单。

senses.meaning_en: First in importance, degree, or rank; first in time, order, or sequence.

examples.text: Good nutrition is of prime importance to children's development.
examples.translation_cn: 良好的营养对儿童成长至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: First in excellence, quality, or value.

examples.text: The boutique is in a prime location near the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 这家精品店位于市中心附近的黄金地段。

senses.meaning_en: Having exactly two integral factors: itself and unity.

examples.text: A prime number is divisible only by one and itself.
examples.translation_cn: 质数只能被1和它本身整除。

senses.meaning_en: moving or operating quickly, as a train not making local stops

examples.text: Take the express train to the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 乘坐特快列车前往市中心。

senses.meaning_en: a train that does not make local stops

examples.text: We took the express to Boston last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末乘坐了快车去波士顿。

senses.meaning_en: to show or make known a thought, feeling, or idea through words, actions, or appearance

examples.text: He expressed his feelings in a letter to her.
examples.translation_cn: 他在给她的信中表达了自己的感情。

senses.meaning_en: specific or precise; directly and distinctly stated; not merely implied

examples.text: He came here for the express purpose of seeing her.
examples.translation_cn: 他来这里就是为了见她。

senses.meaning_en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells

examples.text: The man pointed a gun at the cashier and demanded money.
examples.translation_cn: 那名男子用枪指着收银员并要钱。

senses.meaning_en: to make an engine run faster by pressing the accelerator

examples.text: The driver gunned the engine and sped off.
examples.translation_cn: 司机猛踩油门加速离开了。

senses.meaning_en: a device operated by a trigger and acting in a manner similar to a firearm

examples.text: She used a hot glue gun to attach the ribbon.
examples.translation_cn: 她用热熔胶枪把丝带粘上。

senses.meaning_en: to think or believe that something is true or possible

examples.text: I suppose that he's telling the truth, but I'm not entirely sure.
examples.translation_cn: 我想他说的是实话，但我不完全确定。

senses.meaning_en: to assume something as true for the sake of argument

examples.text: Suppose that interest rates rise again; what will happen to bonds?
examples.translation_cn: 假设利率再次上升，债券会怎样？

senses.meaning_en: to be expected or required to do something

examples.text: You are supposed to turn off your phone during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 开会时你应该关掉手机。

senses.meaning_en: one of the essential parts or principles of something

examples.text: Trust is an essential element of a strong relationship.
examples.translation_cn: 信任是牢固关系的基本要素。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of a quality or feeling

examples.text: There was an element of truth in what she said.
examples.translation_cn: 她说的话里有一点真实的成分。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that consists of only one type of atom

examples.text: Carbon is a chemical element found in all living things.
examples.translation_cn: 碳是一种存在于所有生物中的化学元素。

senses.meaning_en: the forces of nature, such as strong winds and rain

examples.text: The hikers braved the elements and continued their journey.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者们顶风冒雨继续他们的旅程。

senses.meaning_en: the art of planning and directing overall military operations

examples.text: The army used clever strategy to defeat a much larger force.
examples.translation_cn: 这支军队运用巧妙的战略击败了一支强大得多的部队。

senses.meaning_en: a plan designed to achieve a particular goal

examples.text: The company has developed a new strategy for entering the Asian market.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司制定了一个进入亚洲市场的新策略。

senses.meaning_en: the process of planning or putting plans into effect skilfully

examples.text: The team worked on strategy for weeks before the product launch.
examples.translation_cn: 团队在产品发布前几周致力于策略制定。

senses.meaning_en: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility
senses.pattern: have a duty to do something

examples.text: You have a duty to report any accident at work.
examples.translation_cn: 你有责任报告工作中的任何事故。

senses.meaning_en: a tax that you pay on goods that you buy, especially those imported from another country

examples.text: You have to pay duty on imported wine.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须为进口葡萄酒缴纳关税。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being at work and responsible for doing a particular task

examples.text: The nurse is on duty from eight to four.
examples.translation_cn: 那名护士从八点值班到四点。

senses.meaning_en: to look after or take care of

examples.text: He tended the wounded soldiers after the battle.
examples.translation_cn: 战斗之后他照料受伤的士兵。

senses.meaning_en: to be likely to do or happen

examples.text: People tend to feel sleepy after a heavy meal.
examples.translation_cn: 人们大吃一顿后往往会感到困倦。

senses.meaning_en: the true facts about something, not what is imagined or invented

examples.text: Please just tell the truth about what happened last night.
examples.translation_cn: 请把昨晚发生的事如实说出来吧。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being true, accurate, or based on fact

examples.text: The truth of her account was never seriously questioned.
examples.translation_cn: 她叙述的真实性从未受到严重质疑。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or idea that is generally accepted as true

examples.text: It is a universal truth that hard work pays off.
examples.translation_cn: 勤奋终有回报，这是一条普遍真理。

senses.meaning_en: what is real or genuine in a deep or spiritual sense

examples.text: She found truth in the quiet of the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 她在山间的静谧中找到了真谛。

senses.meaning_en: based on the principle of democracy, with government elected by the people

examples.text: The country held its first democratic election in decades.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家几十年来首次举行民主选举。

senses.meaning_en: based on the principle that all people are equal and should be treated fairly

examples.text: The club is democratic in its approach to decision-making.
examples.translation_cn: 这个社团在决策方式上讲究人人平等。

senses.meaning_en: of or supporting the Democratic Party of the United States

examples.text: She voted for the Democratic candidate in the last election.
examples.translation_cn: 她在上次选举中投了民主党候选人的票。

senses.meaning_en: happening quickly and unexpectedly

examples.text: There was a sudden drop in temperature last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚气温突然下降。

senses.meaning_en: quickly and unexpectedly; without warning

examples.text: She suddenly realized that she had forgotten her passport.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然意识到自己忘了带护照。

senses.meaning_en: the name of a book, film, painting, piece of music, etc.

examples.text: The title of her new novel comes from an old poem.
examples.translation_cn: 她新小说的书名来自一首古诗。

senses.meaning_en: a book, magazine, or other published work

examples.text: The publisher releases about fifty new titles every year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家出版社每年出版大约五十种图书。

senses.meaning_en: legal right to own property, or a document proving this

examples.text: She holds the title to the family farm.
examples.translation_cn: 她拥有家庭农场的所有权。

senses.meaning_en: in every part of; all through

examples.text: The tradition is observed throughout the country on this holiday.
examples.translation_cn: 这个节日期间，全国都遵循这一传统。

senses.meaning_en: during an entire period of time

examples.text: The children remained quiet throughout the entire ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在整个仪式中一直保持安静。

senses.meaning_en: in every part; everywhere

examples.text: Local crafts are found throughout, even in this remote valley.
examples.translation_cn: 当地手工艺品到处都有，即使在这个偏僻的山谷里也能找到。

senses.meaning_en: the act of talking about something with others to exchange ideas or make a decision; a conversation or debate about a topic

examples.text: We had a discussion about the new policy before voting.
examples.translation_cn: 在投票之前，我们就新政策进行了讨论。

senses.meaning_en: a text giving further detail on a subject

examples.text: The report includes a discussion of the causes of the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 报告对危机的起因进行了论述。

senses.meaning_en: usually; in most cases

examples.text: Cats generally sleep for many hours each day.
examples.translation_cn: 猫通常每天睡很多小时。

senses.meaning_en: by or to most people; widely

examples.text: This theory is generally accepted by most scientists.
examples.translation_cn: 这个理论被大多数科学家普遍接受。

senses.meaning_en: without considering details; broadly

examples.text: The report spoke generally about the risks involved.
examples.translation_cn: 报告笼统地谈到了所涉及的风险。

senses.meaning_en: a particular part or feature of something

examples.text: Cost is just one aspect of the plan that needs attention.
examples.translation_cn: 成本只是这项计划需要关注的一个方面。

senses.meaning_en: the appearance or expression of someone or something

examples.text: The old castle takes on a mysterious aspect in the fog.
examples.translation_cn: 在雾中，那座古堡呈现出一种神秘的样子。

senses.meaning_en: a grammatical category of verbs

examples.text: In 'She was walking home', the verb is in the continuous aspect.
examples.translation_cn: 在“她当时正走回家”这个句子中，动词是进行体。

senses.meaning_en: a person with senior managerial authority in a company or organization

examples.text: She is a senior executive at a global bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一家全球银行的高级主管。

senses.meaning_en: connected with managing an organization or carrying out decisions

examples.text: The president holds executive power under the constitution.
examples.translation_cn: 总统根据宪法掌握行政权。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a government that puts laws into effect

examples.text: The executive is responsible for carrying out the laws.
examples.translation_cn: 行政部门负责执行法律。

senses.meaning_en: relating to industry, especially manufacturing

examples.text: Many factories are located in industrial areas outside the city.
examples.translation_cn: 许多工厂位于城外的工业区。

senses.meaning_en: produced by industry

examples.text: These chemicals are now produced on an industrial scale.
examples.translation_cn: 这些化学品现已实现工业化生产。

senses.meaning_en: used in industry

examples.text: These powerful acids are designed for industrial use.
examples.translation_cn: 这些强酸是为工业用途设计的。

senses.meaning_en: a person presiding over a meeting

examples.text: He acted as chairman at the community meeting last night.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨晚在社区会议上担任主席。

senses.meaning_en: the head of a board of directors or similar formal body

examples.text: He was appointed chairman of the board last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年被任命为董事会主席。

senses.meaning_en: to serve as chairman of

examples.text: She will chairman the planning committee next month.
examples.translation_cn: 她下个月将担任规划委员会主席。

senses.meaning_en: to take away or get rid of

examples.text: She removed the old label from the jar.
examples.translation_cn: 她把旧标签从罐子上取了下来。

senses.meaning_en: to dismiss from a job or position

examples.text: The board removed the CEO from office after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻发生后，董事会免去了首席执行官的职务。

senses.meaning_en: to take off (clothing or jewellery)

examples.text: Please remove your coat before entering the dining room.
examples.translation_cn: 请在进入餐厅前脱下外套。

senses.meaning_en: to delete

examples.text: You can remove the old address from your contact list.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把旧地址从联系人列表中删除。

senses.meaning_en: to be supported from above

examples.text: The picture hangs on the wall above the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 那幅画挂在沙发上方的墙上。

senses.meaning_en: to put something so that it hangs
senses.collocation: hang your coat on a hook

examples.text: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
examples.translation_cn: 把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

senses.meaning_en: to bend downward

examples.text: The willow branches hang down over the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 柳枝低垂在湖面上。

senses.meaning_en: to spend time relaxing

examples.text: My sister likes to hang out with her friends at the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹喜欢周末和朋友们一起闲逛。

senses.meaning_en: including everything or everyone; whole or complete

examples.text: She spent the entire afternoon reading under the oak tree.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个下午都在橡树下读书。

senses.meaning_en: a hard solid mineral substance that forms part of the earth's surface, or a piece of this

examples.text: The entire mountain is made of solid rock.
examples.translation_cn: 整座山都是由坚硬的岩石构成的。

senses.meaning_en: to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side, or to make something move in this way

examples.text: The branches rocked back and forth in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 树枝在暴风雨中前后摇晃。

senses.meaning_en: a type of popular music with a strong beat, usually played on electric guitars and drums

examples.text: They play rock music in local bars every weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每个周末都在当地酒吧演奏摇滚乐。

senses.meaning_en: a lump or cube of ice

examples.text: He poured himself a whiskey on the rocks.
examples.translation_cn: 他给自己倒了一杯加冰块的威士忌。

senses.meaning_en: to be; have existence or reality

examples.text: Many different species exist in this tropical forest.
examples.translation_cn: 这个热带森林里存在许多不同物种。

senses.meaning_en: to live, especially under difficult conditions or with very little money

examples.text: They exist on a few dollars a day.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每天靠几美元生存。

senses.meaning_en: a common practice or traditional way of behaving
senses.pattern: it is a custom to do

examples.text: It is a local custom to remove your shoes before entering.
examples.translation_cn: 进屋前脱鞋是当地的风俗。

senses.meaning_en: made or changed to meet individual needs

examples.text: She wore a custom-made suit to the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一套定制的西装去面试。

senses.meaning_en: the government department that checks goods and bags at borders

examples.text: Allow extra time to go through customs at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 留出额外时间在机场过海关。

senses.meaning_en: regular support or trade given by a customer

examples.text: The restaurant depends on repeat custom from local families.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐馆依赖当地家庭的回头生意。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that buys goods or services from a business

examples.text: The staff are trained to serve each customer with patience and respect.
examples.translation_cn: 员工接受培训，要耐心而尊重地接待每一位顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a person, especially one engaging in some sort of interaction with others

examples.text: She's a cool customer who never loses her temper in a crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个冷静的家伙，在危机中从不发脾气。

senses.meaning_en: an organization for education or research; its building

examples.text: She works at an institute for medical research in Beijing.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家位于北京的医学研究所工作。

senses.meaning_en: to establish or start something such as a system, policy, or legal action

examples.text: The police instituted an inquiry into the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 警方对事故展开了调查。

senses.meaning_en: a custom or practice of a society or community

examples.text: The institution of marriage has changed over time.
examples.translation_cn: 婚姻制度已随时间改变。

senses.meaning_en: a large important organization such as a university or bank

examples.text: A major regional financial institution collapsed last month.
examples.translation_cn: 一家大型区域性金融机构上个月倒闭了。

senses.meaning_en: a mental institution; a psychiatric hospital
senses.pattern: be committed to a mental institution

examples.text: He was committed to a mental institution after the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 事件发生后，他被送进了精神病院。

senses.meaning_en: any long established and respected place or business

examples.text: That old café is really a local institution.
examples.translation_cn: 那家老咖啡馆确实是当地的著名去处。

senses.meaning_en: to give somebody confidence, hope or support; to persuade somebody to do something

examples.text: My parents encouraged me to apply for the scholarship.
examples.translation_cn: 我父母鼓励我申请奖学金。

senses.meaning_en: to make something more likely to happen or develop

examples.text: The tax cuts encourage growth in the small business sector.
examples.translation_cn: 减税促进了小企业领域的增长。

senses.meaning_en: a fabric or structure of threads, wires, etc. crossing each other

examples.text: The old building has a complex network of pipes and wires.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老建筑有复杂的管道和电线网络。

senses.meaning_en: to interact socially to get connections or advancement

examples.text: He networked with potential clients at the conference.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会议上与潜在客户建立关系网。

senses.meaning_en: to connect computers, devices, or systems into a network

examples.text: The office networked all the printers to a central server.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室把所有打印机联网到一个中央服务器。

senses.meaning_en: an interconnected group or system

examples.text: The city has an efficient network of bike paths.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市有高效的自行车道网络。

senses.meaning_en: connected with one particular thing only

examples.text: The new rule is specific to full-time employees.
examples.translation_cn: 这条新规定只适用于全职员工。

senses.meaning_en: detailed, exact, or clearly defined

examples.text: Can you be more specific about what happened?
examples.translation_cn: 你能更具体地说说发生了什么吗？

senses.meaning_en: suitable, proper, or socially correct

examples.text: It is not appropriate to laugh at a funeral.
examples.translation_cn: 在葬礼上笑是不合适的。

senses.meaning_en: to take or use something, especially without permission

examples.text: The official was caught appropriating public funds for his own use.
examples.translation_cn: 这名官员被抓住挪用公款私用。

senses.meaning_en: to set aside money for a particular purpose

examples.text: The government appropriated two million dollars for the new bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 政府为新桥拨款200万美元。

senses.meaning_en: money gained in business

examples.text: The company made a large profit on the sale last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司去年从这笔交易中获得了丰厚利润。

senses.meaning_en: to gain benefit or advantage

examples.text: You can profit from the experience of older workers.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以从老员工的经验中获益。

senses.meaning_en: advantage or benefit

examples.text: There is no profit in arguing with him.
examples.translation_cn: 与他争论没有好处。

senses.meaning_en: Concerning religion.

examples.text: Meditation is a central religious practice in Buddhism.
examples.translation_cn: 冥想是佛教中的一项核心宗教修行。

senses.meaning_en: Committed to the practice or adherence of religion.

examples.text: My grandmother is deeply religious and goes to church every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母非常虔诚，每周日都去教堂。

senses.meaning_en: Highly dedicated, as one would be to a religion.

examples.text: He is religious about backing up his computer files every day.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天一丝不苟地备份电脑文件。

senses.meaning_en: having a low temperature

examples.text: The water was much too cold for swimming.
examples.translation_cn: 水太冷，不能游泳。

senses.meaning_en: feeling the sensation of coldness

examples.text: She felt cold after waiting outside in the snow.
examples.translation_cn: 她在雪中等候后感到冷。

senses.meaning_en: unfriendly; emotionally distant

examples.text: He was cold to me at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他在聚会上对我很冷淡。

senses.meaning_en: a common illness that affects the nose and throat

examples.text: She caught a cold from her brother last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周被她哥哥传染了感冒。

senses.meaning_en: to throw back light, heat, sound, or an image from a surface

examples.text: The mountains were reflected in the still lake.
examples.translation_cn: 群山倒映在平静的湖水中。

senses.meaning_en: to show or express something; to be a sign of a situation or feeling

examples.text: The survey results reflect the fact that working patterns have changed.
examples.translation_cn: 调查结果反映出工作模式已经改变。

senses.meaning_en: to think carefully and deeply about something

examples.text: I need some time to reflect on your suggestion.
examples.translation_cn: 我需要一些时间来考虑你的建议。

senses.meaning_en: to think or suppose that something is true without proof

examples.text: We cannot assume that the plan will succeed.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不能假定这个计划会成功。

senses.meaning_en: to take on a position, duty, or responsibility

examples.text: She will assume responsibility for the project next month.
examples.translation_cn: 她下个月将承担这个项目的责任。

senses.meaning_en: to adopt an idea or cause

examples.text: She assumed the cause of prison reform after working in rural schools.
examples.translation_cn: 在农村学校工作后，她投身于监狱改革事业。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to have a particular quality or appearance

examples.text: He assumed an air of confidence before the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试前他装出一副自信的样子。

senses.meaning_en: to say that you have done something wrong or that something is true

examples.text: He admitted to making a serious mistake in the report.
examples.translation_cn: 他承认在报告中犯了一个严重错误。

senses.meaning_en: to allow someone to enter a place or join an organization

examples.text: She was admitted to a top university last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被一所顶尖大学录取。

senses.meaning_en: to allow someone to enter a hospital for treatment

examples.text: He was admitted to hospital with chest pains.
examples.translation_cn: 他因胸痛被收治入院。

senses.meaning_en: to allow something; to permit (formal)

examples.text: This new evidence admits of more than one interpretation.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新证据容许不止一种解释。

senses.meaning_en: hard solid mineral substance used as material

examples.text: The old bridge is made of stone and still stands.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老桥由石头建成，至今仍屹立不倒。

senses.meaning_en: a hard mass formed in the body

examples.text: He had a kidney stone that caused severe pain.
examples.translation_cn: 他得了肾结石，疼痛难忍。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of rock

examples.text: There was a stone in my shoe that hurt my heel.
examples.translation_cn: 我鞋里有一块石子，硌得脚后跟疼。

senses.meaning_en: a precious stone, especially a diamond

examples.text: The ring is set with three small stones.
examples.translation_cn: 这枚戒指镶着三颗小宝石。

senses.meaning_en: a course of action taken to achieve a particular purpose

examples.text: The school took strict measures to prevent bullying.
examples.translation_cn: 学校采取了严格措施来防止欺凌。

senses.meaning_en: to find the size, length, amount, etc. using standard units

examples.text: We measured the room carefully in square meters.
examples.translation_cn: 我们仔细地用平方米测量了这个房间。

senses.meaning_en: to estimate or judge the size, amount, or importance of something

examples.text: It is hard to measure a teacher's success by exam results alone.
examples.translation_cn: 很难仅凭考试成绩来衡量教师的成功。

senses.meaning_en: a certain amount or degree of something

examples.text: The new job gave her a measure of independence.
examples.translation_cn: 新工作给了她一定的独立性。

senses.meaning_en: to be of a particular size or length

examples.text: The room measures five metres by four metres.
examples.translation_cn: 这个房间长五米宽四米。

senses.meaning_en: to separate into two or more parts

examples.text: The teacher divided the class into four groups for the project.
examples.translation_cn: 老师把全班分成四组来做这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: to share something by dividing it

examples.text: We divided the money equally between the children.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把钱平均分给孩子们。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate how many times one number contains another

examples.text: Divide the total distance by the time to find the average speed.
examples.translation_cn: 用总距离除以时间来得到平均速度。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a group of people to disagree

examples.text: The new policy divided the committee over funding.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策使委员会在资金问题上产生分歧。

senses.meaning_en: a difference or gap between groups, often causing disagreement

examples.text: The divide between rich and poor has widened.
examples.translation_cn: 贫富之间的鸿沟已经扩大。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of dividing something

examples.text: The division of the estate among the heirs caused a long dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 遗产在继承人之间的分配引起了一场漫长的纠纷。

senses.meaning_en: the process of dividing one number by another
senses.pattern: the division of A by B

examples.text: The division of 12 by 3 gives a quotient of 4.
examples.translation_cn: 12除以3得商4。

senses.meaning_en: one of the parts into which something is divided; a major section of a large company

examples.text: She manages a division of the company that handles online sales.
examples.translation_cn: 她管理公司里负责在线销售的一个部门。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to remember things

examples.text: She has a good memory for names and faces.
examples.translation_cn: 她对名字和面孔记性很好。

senses.meaning_en: something remembered from the past

examples.text: He has vivid memories of his childhood in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 他对乡下童年有着清晰的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a computer that stores data

examples.text: The program loads data into memory before running.
examples.translation_cn: 程序在运行前将数据加载到内存中。

senses.meaning_en: the period that people can remember

examples.text: The storm was the worst in living memory.
examples.translation_cn: 这场风暴是人们记忆中最严重的一次。

senses.meaning_en: to put something back in its former place

examples.text: He replaced the book on the shelf and left the room.
examples.translation_cn: 他把书放回书架，然后离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: to put a new thing in the place of an old, broken, or used one

examples.text: We replaced the old windows with double glazing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把旧窗户换成了双层玻璃。

senses.meaning_en: to take over the position or role from someone

examples.text: She will replace Ms Chen as team leader next month.
examples.translation_cn: 她下个月将接替陈女士担任队长。

senses.meaning_en: to take the place of something; to be used instead of something

examples.text: Gas lamps were replaced by electric lights long ago.
examples.translation_cn: 煤气灯很久以前就被电灯取代了。

senses.meaning_en: a particular method of performing a task

examples.text: There is no simple procedure for resolving the conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 解决这一冲突没有简单的方法。

senses.meaning_en: a series of actions or steps taken to achieve an end

examples.text: Follow the procedure step by step to set up the device.
examples.translation_cn: 按照程序一步步设置设备。

senses.meaning_en: an official or formal way of doing something

examples.text: You have to go through a formal procedure to get a refund.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须经过正式手续才能获得退款。

senses.meaning_en: the steps taken in an action or other legal proceeding

examples.text: The new rules simplify the legal procedure for filing a claim.
examples.translation_cn: 新规则简化了提起诉讼的法律程序。

senses.meaning_en: to do something illegal or wrong

examples.text: He committed a serious crime and was sentenced to five years in prison.
examples.translation_cn: 他犯了重罪，被判处五年监禁。

senses.meaning_en: to promise or devote yourself to something

examples.text: She committed herself to improving conditions for factory workers.
examples.translation_cn: 她致力于改善工厂工人的条件。

senses.meaning_en: to give or send somebody/something to a person or place for safekeeping or treatment; to send to prison

examples.text: The judge committed him to prison for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 法官判他入狱十年。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people officially appointed to investigate or control something

examples.text: The government set up a commission to investigate the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 政府成立了一个委员会来调查这起事故。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money paid to somebody for selling goods, calculated as a percentage of the sale

examples.text: She works on commission, so her income varies each month.
examples.translation_cn: 她按佣金取酬，因此每月收入不固定。

senses.meaning_en: a formal request to create a particular piece of work, especially art or music

examples.text: She accepted a commission for a portrait of the mayor.
examples.translation_cn: 她接受了一项为市长画像的委托。

senses.meaning_en: the act of committing a crime or doing something wrong
senses.collocation: prevent the commission of a crime

examples.text: The commission of a serious crime can lead to a long prison sentence.
examples.translation_cn: 犯下严重罪行可能导致长期监禁。

senses.meaning_en: a formal examination of evidence in court to decide if someone is guilty

examples.text: He will stand trial for fraud next month.
examples.translation_cn: 他下个月将因欺诈受审。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult or unpleasant experience that tests someone's patience or faith

examples.text: The long wait was a trial to everyone's patience.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的等待是对每个人耐心的考验。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or used as a test; provisional

examples.text: You can use the app for a trial period of two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以试用这款应用两周。

senses.meaning_en: to test a new player in a sports team

examples.text: The coach will trial several new players for the cup match.
examples.translation_cn: 教练将在杯赛中试用几名新球员。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing special skill or knowledge because of training or experience

examples.text: He is expert at repairing antique clocks and has trained two apprentices.
examples.translation_cn: 他擅长修理古董钟表，还培训过两名学徒。

senses.meaning_en: a person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject

examples.text: She is an expert on ancient history and has published several books.
examples.translation_cn: 她是古代史专家，出版过几本书。

senses.meaning_en: characteristic of an expert; given or done by an expert

examples.text: The agency offers expert advice on food safety and public health.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构在食品安全和公共卫生方面提供专家建议。

senses.meaning_en: to suggest a plan or course of action

examples.text: The committee proposed that the meeting be postponed.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会提议会议延期。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone to marry you

examples.text: He proposed to his girlfriend on the beach at sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 他在日落时在海滩上向女友求婚。

senses.meaning_en: to intend to do something

examples.text: I propose to take action before the situation gets worse.
examples.translation_cn: 我打算在事态恶化之前采取行动。

senses.meaning_en: a plan or suggestion put forward for consideration

examples.text: The council rejected a proposal to build a new airport.
examples.translation_cn: 市议会否决了修建新机场的提议。

senses.meaning_en: an offer of marriage

examples.text: She accepted his marriage proposal in front of their families.
examples.translation_cn: 她当着双方家人的面接受了他的求婚。

senses.meaning_en: except if; if not

examples.text: Unless we leave now, we will miss the train.
examples.translation_cn: 除非我们现在出发，否则我们会错过火车。

senses.meaning_en: to make something better

examples.text: Regular speaking practice can greatly improve your English.
examples.translation_cn: 定期口语练习可以大大提高你的英语。

senses.meaning_en: to become better

examples.text: His condition improved with time after the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后他的病情随着时间好转了。

senses.meaning_en: a condition or fact that affects a situation

examples.text: Under the circumstances, her decision to resign was entirely understandable.
examples.translation_cn: 在这种情况下，她辞职的决定完全可以理解。

senses.meaning_en: a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is

examples.text: The report described the circumstances of the incident in detail.
examples.translation_cn: 报告详细描述了事件的情况。

senses.meaning_en: the conditions of a person's life, especially financial conditions

examples.text: They lived in comfortable circumstances before the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战前他们生活条件舒适。

senses.meaning_en: easily seen or understood; clear
senses.pattern: it is obvious to sb that...

examples.text: It was obvious to everyone that she was lying.
examples.translation_cn: 大家都看得出她在说谎。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is easy to see or notice

examples.text: His explanation was obviously wrong, but nobody challenged him.
examples.translation_cn: 他的解释显然是错的，但没有人质疑他。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize that something is already known or agreed on

examples.text: Obviously, you don't have to ask my permission every time.
examples.translation_cn: 当然，你不必每次征求我的同意。

senses.meaning_en: used as a filler word or to introduce information

examples.text: I'm not sure, obviously, but I think we should wait.
examples.translation_cn: 我当然不太确定，但我认为我们应该等一等。

senses.meaning_en: to form a mental image of something

examples.text: Can you imagine yourself living on another planet?
examples.translation_cn: 你能想象自己生活在另一个星球上吗？

senses.meaning_en: to think or believe something, often wrongly

examples.text: I imagine that she'll be late because of the traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 我想她可能会因为交通而迟到。

senses.meaning_en: the line or course along which someone or something moves, points, or faces

examples.text: The car sped off in the direction of the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车朝机场方向疾驰而去。

senses.meaning_en: the act or skill of managing, guiding, or directing a film, play, or organization

examples.text: The play was produced under the direction of a young director.
examples.translation_cn: 这部戏剧是在一位年轻导演的指导下制作的。

senses.meaning_en: instructions about how to do something or get somewhere

examples.text: Follow the directions on the label before taking the medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 服药前请按照标签上的说明。

senses.meaning_en: a general course or trend for future action or development

examples.text: The company is moving in a new direction after the merger.
examples.translation_cn: 合并后公司正朝着新方向发展。

senses.meaning_en: necessary; essential for life or a process

examples.text: Water is basic to all living things on Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 水对地球上所有生物都是必需的。

senses.meaning_en: elementary; simple; fundamental

examples.text: She has a basic knowledge of French grammar.
examples.translation_cn: 她有基础的法语语法知识。

senses.meaning_en: having a pH greater than 7

examples.text: This liquid is basic, so it turns litmus paper blue.
examples.translation_cn: 这种液体是碱性的，所以它使石蕊试纸变蓝。

senses.meaning_en: unremarkable or uninteresting; boring; uncool

examples.text: Her taste in music is so basic that everyone can predict it.
examples.translation_cn: 她的音乐品味太平庸了，每个人都能猜到。

senses.meaning_en: very large in size

examples.text: Their new house is huge, with ten bedrooms and a large garden.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的新房子很大，有十间卧室和一个大花园。

senses.meaning_en: very strong, powerful, or dedicated

examples.text: The team made a huge effort to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 团队为按时完成项目付出了巨大努力。

senses.meaning_en: very popular or successful

examples.text: Her first novel was a huge success, selling millions of copies.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一部小说大获成功，销量达数百万册。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Soviet Union or its people

examples.text: The Soviet government controlled most of the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 苏联政府控制了大部分经济。

senses.meaning_en: a citizen of the Soviet Union

examples.text: As a Soviet, she needed special permission to travel abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 作为苏联公民，她出国旅行需要特别许可。

senses.meaning_en: resulting in success; having the desired effect

examples.text: The rescue team was successful in locating the missing hikers.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队成功找到了失踪的徒步者。

senses.meaning_en: having achieved a lot, especially in work or business

examples.text: She is successful as a novelist, with three bestsellers.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为小说家很成功，有三本畅销书。

senses.meaning_en: to plan or mean to do something

examples.text: She fully intends to accept the job offer in May.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全打算在五月接受这份工作录用通知。

senses.meaning_en: to design or intend something for a particular person or purpose

examples.text: The new policy is intended for families with young children.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策面向有幼儿的家庭。

senses.meaning_en: the point from which something starts; the cause of something

examples.text: The origin of the disease is still unknown.
examples.translation_cn: 这种病的起因仍然未知。

senses.meaning_en: the source of a river, information, goods, etc.

examples.text: Customs officers traced the origin of the smuggled goods.
examples.translation_cn: 海关官员追查了走私货物的来源。

senses.meaning_en: a person's social and family background

examples.text: She is of Chinese origin but grew up in Canada.
examples.translation_cn: 她有中国血统，但在加拿大长大。

senses.meaning_en: existing at the beginning of a period or process, before any changes

examples.text: The original plan was to drive, but we took the train instead.
examples.translation_cn: 我们原来的计划是开车，但后来改乘了火车。

senses.meaning_en: fresh and different; showing new and interesting ideas

examples.text: Her approach to the problem is highly original.
examples.translation_cn: 她处理这个问题的方法非常新颖。

senses.meaning_en: first in a series of copies or versions; produced by the artist or writer, not copied

examples.text: The museum owns an original painting by Monet.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆藏有一幅莫奈的原作。

senses.meaning_en: a thing from which copies are made; the first version of a work

examples.text: The original of this letter is stored in the library archive.
examples.translation_cn: 这封信的原件保存在图书馆档案室。

senses.meaning_en: the striking of one body against another

examples.text: The car's windshield cracked on impact during the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 撞车时汽车挡风玻璃裂了。

senses.meaning_en: a strong influence or effect

examples.text: The new law will have a lasting impact on the environment.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律将对环境产生持久影响。

senses.meaning_en: a way of thinking or feeling about something

examples.text: She has a positive attitude towards her new job.
examples.translation_cn: 她对新工作持积极态度。

senses.meaning_en: rude or unfriendly behavior

examples.text: The boy gave his parents attitude when they asked him to clean his room.
examples.translation_cn: 父母让他打扫房间时，男孩对他们很无礼。

senses.meaning_en: a position of the body

examples.text: The nun knelt in an attitude of prayer.
examples.translation_cn: 修女以祈祷的姿势跪着。

senses.meaning_en: to say something in return; to answer

examples.text: He responded that he would attend the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他回答说他会参加会议。

senses.meaning_en: to do something as a reaction to something

examples.text: The patient responded well to the new treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 病人对这种新疗法反应良好。

senses.meaning_en: watchful and alert to danger

examples.text: Tourists should be aware of pickpockets in crowded markets.
examples.translation_cn: 游客在拥挤的市场里应当警惕扒手。

senses.meaning_en: knowing or realizing something

examples.text: He was well aware that his decision might upset people.
examples.translation_cn: 他十分清楚自己的决定可能会让别人不高兴。

senses.meaning_en: interested in and knowledgeable about something

examples.text: She is politically aware and votes in every election.
examples.translation_cn: 她关心政治，每次选举都投票。

senses.meaning_en: to find or learn something for the first time

examples.text: Scientists have discovered a new species of frog in the rainforest.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在雨林中发现了一种新的青蛙。

senses.meaning_en: to learn or become aware of a fact or information

examples.text: I discovered that I had left my phone at the office.
examples.translation_cn: 我发觉自己把手机落在办公室了。

senses.meaning_en: to notice someone's talent or ability

examples.text: The coach discovered a new talent at the youth tournament.
examples.translation_cn: 教练在青少年锦标赛上发掘了一名新秀。

senses.meaning_en: liked or enjoyed by many people

examples.text: The new café is very popular with local students.
examples.translation_cn: 这家新咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: connected with or intended for ordinary people

examples.text: The festival celebrates popular culture from around the world.
examples.translation_cn: 这个节日庆祝来自世界各地的大众文化。

senses.meaning_en: believed or shared by many people

examples.text: Contrary to popular belief, the economy is improving.
examples.translation_cn: 与普遍看法相反，经济正在改善。

senses.meaning_en: a belief, custom, or way of doing something passed down within a group or family
senses.pattern: It is a tradition to do sth

examples.text: It is a tradition to eat roast turkey on Thanksgiving.
examples.translation_cn: 感恩节吃烤火鸡是一项传统。

senses.meaning_en: an established style or method in a particular field

examples.text: Her poetry is in the tradition of Emily Dickinson.
examples.translation_cn: 她的诗歌沿袭了艾米莉·狄金森的风格。

senses.meaning_en: of, relating to, or derived from tradition

examples.text: They celebrate the festival in the traditional way.
examples.translation_cn: 他们以传统方式庆祝这个节日。

senses.meaning_en: following old-fashioned ideas or methods

examples.text: Many older voters hold traditional views about family roles.
examples.translation_cn: 许多年长选民对家庭角色持保守看法。

senses.meaning_en: Arriving upon or on top of (speaking of a physical or metaphorical movement).

examples.text: The cat jumped onto the kitchen table this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上猫跳到了厨房的桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: used to show direction or a place that something faces or leads to

examples.text: My bedroom window looks onto a quiet garden.
examples.translation_cn: 我的卧室窗户朝向一个安静的花园。

senses.meaning_en: Aware of.

examples.text: I think she is onto his little trick.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得她识破了他的小把戏。

senses.meaning_en: to make something hidden become visible

examples.text: The full picture gradually revealed itself over the following days.
examples.translation_cn: 全貌在接下来的日子里逐渐显露出来。

senses.meaning_en: to make known something secret or unknown

examples.text: The investigation revealed that the manager had lied.
examples.translation_cn: 调查揭露经理撒了谎。

senses.meaning_en: a moment or fact in a story when a hidden truth is made known

examples.text: The reveal that she was the villain shocked fans.
examples.translation_cn: 她才是反派的揭晓震惊了粉丝。

senses.meaning_en: a country in central Europe

examples.text: My aunt has lived in Germany for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑妈在德国已经住了十多年。

senses.meaning_en: an object used for fighting or attacking, such as a gun or knife

examples.text: The suspect was armed with a weapon when officers arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 警察赶到时，嫌疑人持有武器。

senses.meaning_en: something used to gain an advantage or achieve a purpose

examples.text: He used the scandal as a weapon against his political opponents.
examples.translation_cn: 他把丑闻当作攻击政敌的武器。

senses.meaning_en: a person who provides labor to a company or another person

examples.text: She is a full-time employee of a software company.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一家软件公司的全职员工。

senses.meaning_en: to hire someone to work for you; to keep someone as an employee

examples.text: The company employed her as a software engineer last month.
examples.translation_cn: 公司上个月聘用她为软件工程师。

senses.meaning_en: to use something for a job or task

examples.text: The surgeon employed a new technique to repair the damaged artery.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生运用一项新技术修复受损动脉。

senses.meaning_en: to make busy; to occupy

examples.text: She employed herself in sorting old letters all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个下午忙于整理旧信件。

senses.meaning_en: work, especially paid work; the state of being employed

examples.text: She has been in continuous employment since graduating.
examples.translation_cn: 她毕业后一直有稳定的工作。

senses.meaning_en: the act of employing someone

examples.text: The employment of new staff is the manager's responsibility.
examples.translation_cn: 招聘新员工是经理的职责。

senses.meaning_en: the use of something

examples.text: The employment of digital tools has changed the way we work.
examples.translation_cn: 数字工具的使用改变了我们的工作方式。

senses.meaning_en: the number or percentage of people at work

examples.text: The employment rate among young people has improved slightly.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻人的就业率略有提高。

senses.meaning_en: a state of being calm or quiet

examples.text: She just wants to finish her coffee in peace.
examples.translation_cn: 她只想安安静静地喝完咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: harmony in personal relations

examples.text: He made peace with his brother after years of silence.
examples.translation_cn: 在多年的沉默之后，他与弟弟和解了。

senses.meaning_en: freedom from war or violence

examples.text: After decades of conflict, the two countries are finally at peace with each other.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几十年的冲突，两国终于彼此和平相处。

senses.meaning_en: freedom from worry or disturbing thoughts

examples.text: After years of anxiety, she finally found peace.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的焦虑，她终于找到了内心的平静。

senses.meaning_en: items or material that have been discarded; rubbish

examples.text: Household refuse should be placed in the bins provided.
examples.translation_cn: 家庭垃圾应放入提供的垃圾桶中。

senses.meaning_en: to decline a request or demand; to withhold permission

examples.text: He refused to answer questions about his private life.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝回答关于他私人生活的问题。

senses.meaning_en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness

examples.text: I felt a sharp pain in my left knee when I stood up.
examples.translation_cn: 我站起来时左膝感到一阵剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: mental suffering or distress

examples.text: She tried to hide the pain of losing her dog.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图掩饰失去狗的悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: an annoying person or thing

examples.text: Her little brother can be a real pain when he keeps asking questions.
examples.translation_cn: 她弟弟一直问问题时真是个讨厌鬼。

senses.meaning_en: great care or effort taken to do something

examples.text: She took great pains to make sure every detail was correct.
examples.translation_cn: 她费尽心思确保每个细节都准确无误。

senses.meaning_en: to stop an outcome from happening; to keep someone from doing something

examples.text: The new law aims to prevent people from driving after drinking.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律旨在防止人们酒后驾车。

senses.meaning_en: to keep an illness from happening

examples.text: Regular exercise and a healthy diet can help prevent heart disease.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼和健康饮食有助于预防心脏病。

senses.meaning_en: personal or business matters

examples.text: He hired an accountant to manage his financial affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 他雇了一名会计来管理自己的财务事务。

senses.meaning_en: a romantic or sexual relationship, especially a secret or illicit one

examples.text: He had a secret affair with a colleague for years.
examples.translation_cn: 他与一名同事秘密恋爱多年。

senses.meaning_en: an event or matter

examples.text: The whole affair turned out to be a complete misunderstanding.
examples.translation_cn: 整件事原来完全是一场误会。

senses.meaning_en: a formal social gathering

examples.text: The charity gala was a formal affair with dinner and dancing.
examples.translation_cn: 慈善晚会是一场有晚宴和舞蹈的正式社交活动。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being attractive or interesting

examples.text: The appeal of remote work has grown significantly since the pandemic.
examples.translation_cn: 自疫情以来，远程工作的吸引力显著增长。

senses.meaning_en: to make a serious request for help or support

examples.text: The hospital appealed to the public for blood donations.
examples.translation_cn: 医院向公众呼吁献血。

senses.meaning_en: a formal request to a higher court to review a decision

examples.text: The company filed an appeal against the court ruling.
examples.translation_cn: 公司对法院裁决提出上诉。

senses.meaning_en: a resort to some means or recourse

examples.text: The general's appeal to force only deepened the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 将军诉诸武力只是加深了危机。

senses.meaning_en: a use of a principle or quality for purposes of persuasion

examples.text: The speech was an appeal to emotion rather than reason.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇演讲诉诸情感而非理性。

senses.meaning_en: to move something quickly from side to side or up and down; to move one's head to refuse or disagree

examples.text: He shook his head slowly in total disbelief.
examples.translation_cn: 他慢慢地摇头，完全不相信。

senses.meaning_en: to shock or upset someone; to make something less certain

examples.text: Her confidence was badly shaken by the unexpected failure.
examples.translation_cn: 这次意外的失败使她的信心大受打击。

senses.meaning_en: to tremble or move quickly from side to side

examples.text: She was shaking with fear during the terrible storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨中她吓得发抖。

senses.meaning_en: to clasp someone's right hand in one's own and move it up and down as a greeting or to show agreement

examples.text: The two leaders shook hands with each other before the talks.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人在会谈前互相握手。

senses.meaning_en: to have a formal meeting to be assessed for a job or place

examples.text: She will interview for the manager position at the hospital next week.
examples.translation_cn: 她下周将在医院面试经理职位。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone questions for a newspaper, broadcast, etc.

examples.text: The reporter interviewed the mayor about the new education policy.
examples.translation_cn: 记者就新教育政策采访了市长。

senses.meaning_en: a formal questioning of a suspect by the police

examples.text: He was questioned about the robbery in a police interview.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一次警方审讯中就被抢劫案接受了问话。

senses.meaning_en: respect and admiration

examples.text: Doctors are held in high regard in many societies.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在许多社会里很受尊重。

senses.meaning_en: good wishes; greetings

examples.text: Please give my regards to your parents when you visit them.
examples.translation_cn: 你去看望父母时，请代我向他们问好。

senses.meaning_en: consider or think of in a particular way

examples.text: Many experts regard this as a major breakthrough.
examples.translation_cn: 许多专家认为这是一项重大突破。

senses.meaning_en: relation or reference; concern

examples.text: The committee has concerns with regard to the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会对这项新政策有些担忧。

senses.meaning_en: a job that needs special education and training

examples.text: She is a lawyer by profession and has worked in this field for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她是职业律师，已在这一领域工作十多年。

senses.meaning_en: the people who work in a particular profession

examples.text: The profession as a whole supports the new regulation.
examples.translation_cn: 整个行业支持这项新规定。

senses.meaning_en: a statement of belief or feeling

examples.text: He made a public profession of his faith during the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 他在仪式上公开表明了自己的信仰。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a profession or requiring special training

examples.text: She was calm and professional in dealing with the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 她在处理危机时冷静而专业。

senses.meaning_en: a person who belongs to a profession

examples.text: She works as a professional in a top law firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家顶级律师事务所担任专业人士。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has a lot of skill and experience

examples.text: He is regarded as a leading professional in cancer research.
examples.translation_cn: 他被认为是癌症研究领域的顶尖专家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who earns money by playing a sport or doing an activity as their main job

examples.text: He turned professional after winning the national championship.
examples.translation_cn: 他赢得全国冠军后转为职业选手。

senses.meaning_en: a device for taking photographs

examples.text: She took these photos with a small digital camera.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一台小型数码相机拍了这些照片。

senses.meaning_en: a device for recording moving pictures and sound

examples.text: They recorded the ceremony with a video camera.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用摄像机录下了仪式。

senses.meaning_en: a small camera on a computer or phone used for video calls

examples.text: She turned on her camera for the online interview.
examples.translation_cn: 她为在线面试打开了摄像头。

senses.meaning_en: a particular way of doing something, especially one that needs special training or skill

examples.text: The book describes a simple technique for improving concentration.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书介绍了一种提高专注力的简单方法。

senses.meaning_en: the practical skill or ability that someone has in an activity such as art, music, or sport

examples.text: The young pianist has really improved her technique over the past year.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻的钢琴手在过去一年里确实提高了技巧。

senses.meaning_en: a single object or thing

examples.text: He picked up an item of clothing from the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 他从地板上捡起一件衣物。

senses.meaning_en: one thing on a list or agenda
senses.collocation: the next item on the agenda

examples.text: Let's move to the next item on the agenda.
examples.translation_cn: 我们进行议程上的下一项吧。

senses.meaning_en: a question on a test

examples.text: Read each test item carefully before you answer.
examples.translation_cn: 答题前请仔细阅读每道试题。

senses.meaning_en: a short article in a newspaper

examples.text: The website published a news item about the school fair.
examples.translation_cn: 网站发布了一则关于学校义卖会的新闻。

examples.text: The internet is used as a medium for education.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网被用作一种教育媒介。

examples.text: She tried to contact him through a medium.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图通过一位灵媒联系他。

examples.text: The suspect is of medium height and slim.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人中等身材，体形偏瘦。

examples.text: Sound waves travel through a medium such as air or water.
examples.translation_cn: 声波通过空气或水等介质传播。

senses.meaning_en: political affairs or profession

examples.text: She went into politics after years as a community organizer.
examples.translation_cn: 她在做了多年社区组织者后进入了政界。

senses.meaning_en: political opinions or beliefs

examples.text: His politics have shifted toward the center in recent years.
examples.translation_cn: 他的政治观点近年来已转向中间立场。

senses.meaning_en: maneuvering; office politics

examples.text: He lost the promotion because he ignored office politics.
examples.translation_cn: 他因忽视办公室政治而失去了晋升机会。

senses.meaning_en: irrelevant real-world political issues

examples.text: Please don't bring politics into our holiday dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 请别把政治话题带进我们的节日晚餐。

senses.meaning_en: a form of something that is slightly different from other forms of the same thing

examples.text: The band played a slower version of the song.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队演奏了这首歌的慢版。

senses.meaning_en: an account or description of an event from a person's point of view

examples.text: She gave a different version of events to the police.
examples.translation_cn: 她向警方给出了对事件的不同说法。

senses.meaning_en: a translation of a book or text into another language
senses.collocation: a new version of the novel

examples.text: He is reading the English version of the novel.
examples.translation_cn: 他正在读这部小说的英译本。

senses.meaning_en: a particular revision of software, firmware, CPU, etc.

examples.text: The company released a new version of the app.
examples.translation_cn: 公司发布了该应用的新版本。

senses.meaning_en: a person who seeks or is nominated for a position or office

examples.text: She is a strong candidate for the sales manager position.
examples.translation_cn: 她是销售经理职位的有力候选人。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing considered likely to get or do something

examples.text: This drug is considered a promising candidate for cancer treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药物被认为是治疗癌症的有希望的候选药物。

senses.meaning_en: a person taking an examination

examples.text: Candidates take a written exam at the end of the course.
examples.translation_cn: 考生在课程结束时参加笔试。

senses.meaning_en: used to show agreement or acceptance

examples.text: Okay, I'll pick up the kids after school.
examples.translation_cn: 好的，我放学后去接孩子。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is acceptable but not very well

examples.text: The team did okay in the first half but lost in the end.
examples.translation_cn: 球队上半场表现得还行，但最后输了。

senses.meaning_en: acceptable; not a problem

examples.text: It's okay to feel frustrated.
examples.translation_cn: 感到沮丧是可以的。

examples.text: That's okay. We don't have to talk about it now.
examples.translation_cn: 没关系，我们现在不必谈这件事。

senses.meaning_en: the print-based media, including newspapers and journalists

examples.text: The scandal was widely reported in the press.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻被媒体广泛报道。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that applies pressure to shape, flatten, or squeeze something

examples.text: Workers use a hydraulic press to shape steel sheets.
examples.translation_cn: 工人使用液压机把钢板成型。

senses.meaning_en: a machine used for printing

examples.text: The company runs a large printing press day and night.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司日夜运转一台大型印刷机。

senses.meaning_en: to push something firmly, especially with your fingers

examples.text: Press down on the lid to seal the jar.
examples.translation_cn: 按压盖子以密封罐子。

senses.meaning_en: to try hard to persuade someone to do something

examples.text: The reporters pressed the mayor to explain the delay.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们催促市长解释延误原因。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion offered to guide someone's behavior

examples.text: The doctor gave me some useful advice on how to sleep better.
examples.translation_cn: 医生给了我一些关于如何睡得更好的实用建议。

senses.meaning_en: a formal document giving information about a financial transaction

examples.text: We received a remittance advice from the bank yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨天收到了银行的汇款通知单。

senses.meaning_en: a formal statement giving an opinion about a legal matter

examples.text: The law firm sent us written legal advice on the liability issue.
examples.translation_cn: 律师事务所给我们寄来了关于责任问题的书面法律意见。

senses.meaning_en: in or into the inner part of something

examples.text: We waited inside the car until the rain stopped.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在车里一直等到雨停。

senses.meaning_en: the inner part or surface of something

examples.text: The box was painted green on the inside.
examples.translation_cn: 盒子里面被漆成了绿色。

senses.meaning_en: situated on or near the inner side or surface

examples.text: He kept the letter in his inside pocket.
examples.translation_cn: 他把信放在内袋里。

senses.meaning_en: the organs inside the body, especially the stomach

examples.text: I felt my insides churn when I heard the bad news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到那个坏消息时，我感到肠胃一阵翻腾。

examples.text: As an adult, she returned to her hometown.
examples.translation_cn: 成年后，她回到了家乡。

examples.text: By late summer the young birds reach adult size.
examples.translation_cn: 到了夏末，幼鸟达到成年体型。

senses.meaning_en: a condition or circumstance that gives you a better chance of success

examples.text: Her language skills gave her a clear advantage over the other candidates.
examples.translation_cn: 她的语言技能使她在其他候选人中占有明显优势。

senses.meaning_en: benefit or gain

examples.text: It would be to your advantage to arrive early.
examples.translation_cn: 早到对你有利。

senses.meaning_en: the first point scored after deuce in tennis

examples.text: Nadal had the advantage after deuce but failed to win the game.
examples.translation_cn: 纳达尔在平分后占先，但未能赢得这一局。

senses.meaning_en: to do something for one's own benefit; to take advantage of

examples.text: We took advantage of the sunny weather to go for a walk.
examples.translation_cn: 我们趁着阳光明媚的天气出去散步。

senses.meaning_en: happening or done without delay

examples.text: The doctor took immediate action to stop the bleeding.
examples.translation_cn: 医生立即采取行动止血。

senses.meaning_en: of concern at the present time; pressing
senses.pattern: be of immediate concern to sb

examples.text: Safety is of immediate concern to parents of young children.
examples.translation_cn: 安全是幼儿父母当前最关心的问题。

senses.meaning_en: nearest in relationship or with nothing in between

examples.text: The immediate cause of the fire was a faulty wire.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾的直接原因是一根故障电线。

senses.meaning_en: instantly; without delay

examples.text: Please act immediately if you notice any unusual symptoms.
examples.translation_cn: 如有异常症状，请立即采取行动。

senses.meaning_en: without any intervening time or space; directly

examples.text: The storage room is immediately behind the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 储藏室就在厨房正后方。

senses.meaning_en: as soon as; the moment that

examples.text: Immediately the meeting ended, people stood up and left.
examples.translation_cn: 会议一结束，人们就起身离开。

senses.meaning_en: the outside limit of an object, area, or surface

examples.text: The child sat on the edge of the bed and put on his shoes.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子坐在床边穿鞋。

senses.meaning_en: an advantage over others

examples.text: She has an edge over her rivals because she trains every day.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天训练，所以比对手更占优势。

senses.meaning_en: the sharp cutting part of a blade

examples.text: Use the edge of the knife to slice the tomatoes thinly.
examples.translation_cn: 用刀刃把西红柿切成薄片。

senses.meaning_en: to move slowly and carefully in a particular direction

examples.text: He edged closer to the exit as the crowd began to push.
examples.translation_cn: 人群开始拥挤时，他慢慢挪向出口。

senses.meaning_en: a type or sort of something

examples.text: There are many varieties of apples grown in this region.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区种植许多品种的苹果。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being varied or diverse

examples.text: She adds variety to her meals by trying new recipes.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过尝试新菜谱让饭菜变得多样化。

senses.meaning_en: a collection or number of different things

examples.text: The museum has a wide variety of exhibits for all ages.
examples.translation_cn: 这个博物馆有适合各个年龄段的多种展品。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to write books, articles, etc.

examples.text: My aunt is a writer of historical novels.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑姑是一位历史小说作家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has written a particular text or document

examples.text: The writer of this letter wishes to remain anonymous.
examples.translation_cn: 写这封信的人希望保持匿名。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land completely surrounded by water

examples.text: They lived on an island for a whole year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一座岛上住了整整一年。

senses.meaning_en: a raised area in the middle of a road where pedestrians can wait
senses.collocation: a traffic island in the road

examples.text: They waited on a traffic island until the lights changed.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在交通岛等待，直到信号灯变化。

senses.meaning_en: an invitation to compete or fight

examples.text: The boxer accepted a challenge from a younger fighter.
examples.translation_cn: 拳击手接受了一位更年轻拳手的挑战。

senses.meaning_en: to invite someone to compete or fight

examples.text: Tom challenged his brother to play a game of chess after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 汤姆晚饭后向他哥哥挑战，要下一盘国际象棋。

senses.meaning_en: to question whether something is true, right, or legal

examples.text: The lawyer challenged the witness's account of the event.
examples.translation_cn: 律师对目击者对事件的描述提出了质疑。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult task that tests your ability

examples.text: Learning a new language is a real challenge for many adults.
examples.translation_cn: 学习一门新语言对许多成年人来说是一项真正的挑战。

senses.meaning_en: a strong unpleasant emotion caused by danger or threat

examples.text: He stood frozen in fear when the thunder crashed.
examples.translation_cn: 雷声响起时，他吓得僵住了。

senses.meaning_en: a phobia or strong sense of fear induced by a specific thing

examples.text: His fear of spiders kept him out of the basement.
examples.translation_cn: 他对蜘蛛的恐惧让他不敢进地下室。

senses.meaning_en: to feel fear or worry about something

examples.text: He fears losing his best friend after the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 他害怕在争吵后失去最好的朋友。

senses.meaning_en: to worry about or feel concern for somebody or something

examples.text: Rescue workers feared for the missing hiker's life.
examples.translation_cn: 救援人员为失踪徒步者的生命安全担忧。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body between the neck and the arm

examples.text: She glanced over her shoulder to see who was following her.
examples.translation_cn: 她回头看了看是谁在跟着她。

senses.meaning_en: to accept or take on a responsibility or burden

examples.text: You shouldn't have to shoulder the blame for their mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 你不必为他们的错误承担责任。

senses.meaning_en: a part shaped like a shoulder, such as the edge of a road

examples.text: The car broke down on the shoulder of the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车在公路的路肩上抛锚了。

senses.meaning_en: having a practical or beneficial use

examples.text: This feature is useful for comparing prices online.
examples.translation_cn: 此功能对在线比价很有用。

senses.meaning_en: to rely on or trust someone or something

examples.text: Many elderly people depend on their children for daily care.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老人依靠子女进行日常照料。

senses.meaning_en: to be determined or decided by something

examples.text: Whether we go hiking tomorrow depends on the weather.
examples.translation_cn: 我们明天是否去远足取决于天气。

senses.meaning_en: more than half of a group

examples.text: A majority of the students supported the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数学生支持新政策。

senses.meaning_en: the number by which votes for one side exceed those for the other
senses.pattern: win by a majority of + number

examples.text: She won the election by a majority of 2,500 votes.
examples.translation_cn: 她以2500票的多数赢得选举。

senses.meaning_en: imaginary events seen in the mind while sleeping

examples.text: I had a strange dream about flying last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我昨晚做了一个关于飞翔的怪梦。

senses.meaning_en: a hope or wish

examples.text: She has a dream of opening a small café.
examples.translation_cn: 她梦想开一家小咖啡馆。

senses.meaning_en: to see imaginary events in one's mind while sleeping

examples.text: I often dream about falling off a cliff.
examples.translation_cn: 我经常梦见从悬崖上掉下去。

senses.meaning_en: to hope or wish

examples.text: She dreams of becoming a famous astronaut one day.
examples.translation_cn: 她梦想有一天成为一名著名的宇航员。

senses.meaning_en: a range of values or locations

examples.text: The map shows the full extent of the city's protected wetlands.
examples.translation_cn: 这张地图显示了城市受保护湿地的全部范围。

senses.meaning_en: the degree or limit to which something extends

examples.text: To some extent, the increased traffic explains the rise in pollution.
examples.translation_cn: 在某种程度上，交通量增加解释了污染上升。
