senses.meaning_en: a place where drinks and food are served, or a counter where this happens

examples.text: They first met at a bar near the stadium.
examples.translation_cn: 他们第一次见面是在体育场附近的一家酒吧。

senses.meaning_en: a solid piece of something, especially metal, wood, chocolate or soap, that is longer than it is wide

examples.text: She unwrapped a bar of soap and placed it by the sink.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开一块肥皂，把它放在水槽边。

senses.meaning_en: to officially prevent someone from doing something or going somewhere

examples.text: The judge barred him from driving for six months.
examples.translation_cn: 法官禁止他驾驶六个月。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow line or band of light or colour

examples.text: A bar of light fell across the dusty floor.
examples.translation_cn: 一道光带落在布满灰尘的地板上。

senses.meaning_en: to give somebody the ability or opportunity to do something

examples.text: The new training program enables employees to work remotely.
examples.translation_cn: 新的培训计划使员工能够远程工作。

senses.meaning_en: to make something possible or feasible

examples.text: The recent discovery enables a much clearer understanding of the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新发现使人们对这种疾病有了更清晰的认识。

senses.meaning_en: to activate or make a device or feature operational

examples.text: You can enable two-factor authentication for extra security.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以启用双重认证以增加安全性。

senses.meaning_en: the action of competing

examples.text: There is fierce competition for jobs in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 这个城市里的就业竞争很激烈。

senses.meaning_en: a contest for a prize or award

examples.text: She entered a competition and won first prize.
examples.translation_cn: 她参加了一个比赛并赢得了一等奖。

senses.meaning_en: the competitors in a contest

examples.text: Our company works hard to beat the competition.
examples.translation_cn: 我们公司努力击败竞争对手。

senses.meaning_en: the group of people who make and change laws

examples.text: She has served in parliament for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在议会任职二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a loudspeaker

examples.text: The announcement came through the speakers in the station.
examples.translation_cn: 公告通过车站的扬声器播放出来。

senses.meaning_en: a person who speaks, especially a particular language

examples.text: My colleague is a native speaker of Spanish and often helps me with translations.
examples.translation_cn: 我的同事是西班牙语母语者，经常帮我做翻译。

senses.meaning_en: a person who makes a speech to an audience

examples.text: The keynote speaker at the conference addressed climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 大会主讲人谈到了气候变化。

senses.meaning_en: the chair or presiding officer of certain legislative bodies

examples.text: The Speaker of the House called for order.
examples.translation_cn: 众议院议长要求保持秩序。

senses.meaning_en: unspecified things or matters; personal effects

examples.text: I've got a lot of stuff to do before the guests arrive.
examples.translation_cn: 客人们到达之前，我有许多事情要做。

senses.meaning_en: tangible substance or material of unknown type

examples.text: The box is made of some lightweight stuff.
examples.translation_cn: 这个盒子是用某种轻质材料做的。

senses.meaning_en: to fill tightly or put into a small space

examples.text: She stuffed the clothes into her suitcase and left.
examples.translation_cn: 她把衣服塞进手提箱，然后离开了。

senses.meaning_en: worthless talk or ideas; foolish or meaningless words

examples.text: Don't give me that stuff about being too busy; I saw you at the mall.
examples.translation_cn: 别跟我来你太忙那套废话；我看见你在商场了。

senses.meaning_en: to finish making or doing something

examples.text: She completed the marathon in under four hours.
examples.translation_cn: 她用不到四个小时完成了马拉松。

senses.meaning_en: finished; concluded

examples.text: The construction of the new bridge is now complete.
examples.translation_cn: 新桥的施工现在完成了。

senses.meaning_en: having all necessary parts

examples.text: The puzzle is complete; no pieces are missing.
examples.translation_cn: 这个拼图是完整的，没有缺块。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize a noun

examples.text: His sudden resignation came as a complete surprise.
examples.translation_cn: 他突然辞职，令人完全意想不到。

senses.meaning_en: to make something whole or entire

examples.text: She completed her collection with a rare first edition.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一部罕见的初版书补全了她的收藏。

senses.meaning_en: a way of entering or reaching a place

examples.text: The only access to the building is through the side door.
examples.translation_cn: 进入这栋楼的唯一通道是侧门。

senses.meaning_en: the right or opportunity to use something

examples.text: All children should have access to primary education.
examples.translation_cn: 所有儿童都应有接受初等教育的机会。

senses.meaning_en: to open or use a computer file or system

examples.text: You need a password to access the database.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要密码才能访问数据库。

senses.meaning_en: a container holding ammunition and feeding it into a firearm

examples.text: He loaded a high-capacity magazine into the rifle before taking aim.
examples.translation_cn: 他瞄准前给步枪装上了大容量弹匣。

senses.meaning_en: a large thin book with a paper cover, published regularly, containing articles and photographs

examples.text: He likes to read a fashion magazine while waiting for the bus.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢在等公交车时读时尚杂志。

senses.meaning_en: without difficulty

examples.text: With this app, you can easily learn basic Spanish.
examples.translation_cn: 有了这个应用，你可以轻松学会基础西班牙语。

senses.meaning_en: without question

examples.text: She is easily the most experienced doctor in this hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她无疑是这家医院最有经验的医生。

senses.meaning_en: very likely

examples.text: Teenagers are easily distracted by social media during online classes.
examples.translation_cn: 青少年上网课时很容易被社交媒体分心。

senses.meaning_en: comfortably, without anxiety

examples.text: After the big exam, she could finally rest easily.
examples.translation_cn: 大考之后，她终于能安心休息了。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sex or sexual activity

examples.text: Many teenagers engage in sexual activity before the age of sixteen.
examples.translation_cn: 许多青少年在十六岁前就有性行为。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sex or gender

examples.text: The new law forbids sexual discrimination in hiring.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律禁止招聘中的性别歧视。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sexual desire

examples.text: She felt a strong sexual attraction to her new boss.
examples.translation_cn: 她对她的新上司产生了强烈的性吸引。

senses.meaning_en: producing a successful or decisive result

examples.text: This program is effective in helping students improve their reading skills.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目能有效地帮助学生提高阅读能力。

senses.meaning_en: officially in use or operation

examples.text: The new safety rules become effective from next June.
examples.translation_cn: 新的安全规则从明年六月起生效。

senses.meaning_en: actual or real, though not officially recognized

examples.text: The rebel forces have effective control of the northern region.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军实际控制着北部地区。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being hot; thermal energy

examples.text: I can't concentrate in this heat without a fan.
examples.translation_cn: 这种高温下，没有风扇我无法集中注意力。

senses.meaning_en: to make or become hot

examples.text: She heated up the leftover soup for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 她把剩下的汤热了一下当午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a preliminary race

examples.text: She competed in the first heat and qualified for the final.
examples.translation_cn: 她参加了第一组预赛并晋级决赛。

senses.meaning_en: intense feeling or excitement

examples.text: In the heat of the argument, she said something she now regrets.
examples.translation_cn: 在激烈的争论中，她说了一些现在后悔的话。

senses.meaning_en: spicy taste causing burning

examples.text: This curry has a slow heat that builds as you eat.
examples.translation_cn: 这种咖喱有一种慢慢上来的辣味。

senses.meaning_en: the act of paying

examples.text: Please make a payment for your order before delivery.
examples.translation_cn: 请在发货前为您的订单付款。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being married

examples.text: Shared values play an important role in a lasting marriage.
examples.translation_cn: 共同的价值观在持久的婚姻中起着重要作用。

senses.meaning_en: a wedding ceremony

examples.text: They held their marriage ceremony in a small park.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在小公园里举行了婚礼。

senses.meaning_en: a close union or joining of two parts
senses.pattern: a marriage of A and B

examples.text: The building is a marriage of modern and traditional design.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑是现代与传统设计的融合。

senses.meaning_en: strong and resilient; physically hardy

examples.text: These gloves are tough enough to withstand daily wear.
examples.translation_cn: 这些手套足够结实，经得起日常磨损。

senses.meaning_en: difficult or demanding

examples.text: It is tough to find affordable housing in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个城市找到负担得起的住房很难。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to cut or chew

examples.text: The chicken was tough to chew after being overcooked.
examples.translation_cn: 鸡肉煮过头后嚼不烂。

senses.meaning_en: harsh or severe

examples.text: The climbers waited out the blizzard in tough conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者在恶劣天气条件下等待暴风雪过去。

senses.meaning_en: not dependent on other people or things; free

examples.text: At 22, she became financially independent of her parents.
examples.translation_cn: 22岁时，她不再在经济上依赖父母。

senses.meaning_en: not affiliated with any political party

examples.text: He has always remained independent of any political party.
examples.translation_cn: 他一直保持独立，不隶属于任何政党。

senses.meaning_en: having enough money to live without financial help from others

examples.text: She is now of independent means after inheriting the estate.
examples.translation_cn: 她继承遗产后如今已能自食其力。

senses.meaning_en: not subject to bias or influence; self-directing

examples.text: The agency conducted an independent review of the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构对事故进行了独立审查。

senses.meaning_en: buildings, services, and equipment provided for a particular purpose

examples.text: The school provides excellent facilities for playing outdoor sports.
examples.translation_cn: 学校提供出色的户外运动设施。

senses.meaning_en: a natural ability to learn or do something easily

examples.text: She has a remarkable facility for learning languages.
examples.translation_cn: 她学习语言有非凡的天赋。

senses.meaning_en: a place or building designed for a specific purpose

examples.text: The university opened a new research facility last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学去年新设了一个研究机构。

senses.meaning_en: an investigation of people's opinions or conditions

examples.text: We conducted a survey of people's eating habits.
examples.translation_cn: 我们对人们的饮食习惯进行了一项调查。

senses.meaning_en: a general view or description of a subject

examples.text: The course gives a survey of modern European history.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程概述了现代欧洲历史。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of measuring land, especially making maps or plans

examples.text: Engineers carried out a land survey before the new road was built.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师们在修建新路之前进行了一次土地测量。

senses.meaning_en: to look over or examine something carefully; to view from a high place

examples.text: The police surveyed the scene carefully for any signs of a struggle.
examples.translation_cn: 警察仔细查看现场，寻找任何打斗的痕迹。

senses.meaning_en: the act of mentioning or referring to someone or something

examples.text: The article makes reference to several earlier studies.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章提及了几项早期研究。

senses.meaning_en: a letter or statement about somebody's character or abilities; a person who provides such information

examples.text: She agreed to give me a reference for my job application.
examples.translation_cn: 她同意为我的求职申请提供推荐信。

senses.meaning_en: a standard or point of comparison

examples.text: Use last year's sales figures as a reference for this quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 把去年的销售数据作为本季度的参考。

senses.meaning_en: a source or previously published work cited in a text

examples.text: You must cite a reference for every direct quotation.
examples.translation_cn: 每个直接引语都必须注明参考文献。

senses.meaning_en: a number, word, or symbol that identifies a particular document, record, or item and is used to find information about it

examples.text: My reference number is 8842.
examples.translation_cn: 我的参考编号是8842。

senses.meaning_en: a native or inhabitant of Germany

examples.text: Her grandfather was a German who moved to Canada after the war.
examples.translation_cn: 她祖父是德国人，战后移居加拿大。

senses.meaning_en: the German language

examples.text: Can you introduce yourself in German without looking at your notes?
examples.translation_cn: 你能不看笔记用德语自我介绍吗？

senses.meaning_en: relating to Germany

examples.text: We studied German history during the twentieth century.
examples.translation_cn: 我们学习了二十世纪的德国历史。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the German language

examples.text: There is no exact English equivalent for this German word.
examples.translation_cn: 这个德语词在英语中没有完全对应的说法。

senses.meaning_en: the outer covering of the body

examples.text: The vaccine is injected just under the skin.
examples.translation_cn: 疫苗正好注射到皮肤下。

senses.meaning_en: the outer layer of a fruit

examples.text: The skin of a kiwi is thin and fuzzy.
examples.translation_cn: 猕猴桃的果皮薄而多毛。

senses.meaning_en: the skin and fur of an animal used for clothing

examples.text: They traded animal skins for blankets in the early frontier days.
examples.translation_cn: 在早期边疆时期，他们用兽皮交换毯子。

senses.meaning_en: a customizable interface theme

examples.text: You can install a new skin to change the player's look.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以安装一个新皮肤来改变播放器的外观。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns something

examples.text: The owner of the lost dog offered a reward for its return.
examples.translation_cn: 丢失狗的主人悬赏寻找它。

senses.meaning_en: a person who runs a business

examples.text: The owner of the shop employs two assistants.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店的老板雇了两名店员。

senses.meaning_en: to stretch out a part of your body

examples.text: She extended her hand to greet me warmly.
examples.translation_cn: 她伸出手热情地迎接我。

senses.meaning_en: to make something last longer

examples.text: They agreed to extend the deadline by two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 他们同意把截止日期延长两周。

senses.meaning_en: to offer or give something such as help or welcome

examples.text: We extend our sincere thanks to all volunteers.
examples.translation_cn: 我们向所有志愿者表示诚挚的感谢。

senses.meaning_en: to cover a particular distance or area

examples.text: The road extends from the village to the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路从村庄一直延伸到海边。

senses.meaning_en: any substance like air that is not solid or liquid

examples.text: Oxygen exists as a gas at room temperature.
examples.translation_cn: 氧气在室温下以气体形式存在。

senses.meaning_en: gas used as fuel for heating or cooking

examples.text: Many households in this region heat with gas.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区的许多家庭用燃气取暖。

senses.meaning_en: liquid fuel for cars; petrol

examples.text: I need to fill up with gas before we leave town.
examples.translation_cn: 我们离城前我需要加满汽油。

senses.meaning_en: to bring goods or services into a country from abroad

examples.text: The country imports most of its wheat from Canada.
examples.translation_cn: 该国大部分小麦从加拿大进口。

senses.meaning_en: a product brought into a country from abroad

examples.text: The market is full of cheap imports from Southeast Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 市场充斥着来自东南亚的廉价进口商品。

senses.meaning_en: a player from another country who joins a sports team

examples.text: The club signed an American import to strengthen its defense.
examples.translation_cn: 俱乐部签下了一名美国外援来加强防守。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being important or significant

examples.text: Education is of great importance to a child's development.
examples.translation_cn: 教育对一个孩子的发展非常重要。

senses.meaning_en: personal status or standing; prominence

examples.text: She became a person of some importance in local politics.
examples.translation_cn: 她成了当地政坛的重要人物。

senses.meaning_en: something that is important

examples.text: The committee discussed several matters of national importance.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会讨论了几个全国性的重要事项。

senses.meaning_en: to produce something, especially as the result of a chemical or physical process

examples.text: The new plant generates electricity from wind and solar power.
examples.translation_cn: 新电厂利用风能和太阳能发电。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a particular feeling or reaction to happen

examples.text: The plan generated a lot of interest among local investors.
examples.translation_cn: 该计划在当地投资者中引起了很大兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: all of the people born and living at about the same time

examples.text: A new generation of voters is changing the political landscape.
examples.translation_cn: 新一代选民正在改变政治格局。

senses.meaning_en: a single stage in the descent of a family

examples.text: This recipe has been passed down from generation to generation.
examples.translation_cn: 这道菜谱代代相传。

senses.meaning_en: the production of something, especially energy

examples.text: The generation of electricity from solar panels is becoming cheaper.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳能电池板发电正变得越来越便宜。

senses.meaning_en: the production of young living things

examples.text: The generation of offspring is essential for the survival of a species.
examples.translation_cn: 繁衍后代对物种生存至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: an advertisement on television or radio

examples.text: They ran a commercial for the new car during the game.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在比赛期间为这款新车播放了一则广告。

senses.meaning_en: connected with trade, industry, or commerce

examples.text: The building is used for commercial purposes only.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑仅用于商业用途。

senses.meaning_en: designating an airplane flight that carries passengers or cargo

examples.text: They took an overnight commercial flight to Rome.
examples.translation_cn: 他们乘坐了一趟深夜商业航班前往罗马。

senses.meaning_en: the place where someone lives or an organization is located

examples.text: You can reach me at this address until the end of this month.
examples.translation_cn: 这个月底前你都可以用这个地址联系我。

senses.meaning_en: to deal with or give attention to a problem or situation

examples.text: We need to address the problem of rising costs immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要立即处理成本上涨的问题。

senses.meaning_en: to speak to a person or group

examples.text: She addressed the audience in a calm, clear voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她用平静清晰的声音向观众讲话。

senses.meaning_en: to write the name and address of the person you are sending something to on it

examples.text: She addressed the package to her brother in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 她在包裹上写上了巴黎哥哥的地址。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that has physical existence or is the target of an emotion

examples.text: The sculpture became an object of admiration for all visitors.
examples.translation_cn: 这座雕塑成了所有游客钦佩的对象。

senses.meaning_en: the goal or purpose of an activity

examples.text: The object of the game is to score more points than the other team.
examples.translation_cn: 这个游戏的目标是比对方得分更多。

senses.meaning_en: to express disagreement with or opposition to something

examples.text: Many residents object to the new airport being built near their homes.
examples.translation_cn: 许多居民反对在自家附近修建新机场。

senses.meaning_en: the noun phrase that receives the action of a verb or follows a preposition

examples.text: In the sentence 'She wrote a letter,' the phrase 'a letter' is the direct object.
examples.translation_cn: 在句子“她写了一封信”中，“一封信”是直接宾语。

senses.meaning_en: a serious disease in which cells grow uncontrollably

examples.text: She was diagnosed with breast cancer last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

senses.meaning_en: something harmful that spreads and is difficult to remove

examples.text: Corruption is a cancer on the whole economy.
examples.translation_cn: 腐败是整个经济中的毒瘤。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being possible; chance

examples.text: There is a possibility of rain this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 今天下午有可能下雨。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that may happen or be chosen; option

examples.text: Moving abroad is a possibility I am seriously considering.
examples.translation_cn: 移居国外是我在认真考虑的一个选项。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being real; realness

examples.text: The committee questioned the reality of the claims.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会质疑这些说法的真实性。

senses.meaning_en: the real world, as opposed to imagination or fiction

examples.text: The film blurs the line between fantasy and reality.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影模糊了幻想与现实之间的界限。

senses.meaning_en: something that actually exists or happens; a fact

examples.text: Their dream of owning a house is now becoming a reality.
examples.translation_cn: 他们拥有房子的梦想如今正在变为现实。

senses.meaning_en: television programmes in which ordinary people are filmed in real situations
senses.collocation: appear on a reality TV show

examples.text: He became a celebrity after appearing on a reality TV show.
examples.translation_cn: 他因参加一档真人秀节目而成名。

senses.meaning_en: a trainer or instructor

examples.text: She works as a coach for a youth soccer club.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个青年足球俱乐部担任教练。

senses.meaning_en: to train or instruct

examples.text: He coaches young players in the basics of basketball.
examples.translation_cn: 他教年轻球员篮球的基本功。

senses.meaning_en: a long-distance bus

examples.text: We travelled to Edinburgh by coach last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 去年夏天我们乘长途汽车去了爱丁堡。

senses.meaning_en: the economy class section of a plane or train

examples.text: We flew in coach to save money on the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 为了省钱，我们这次旅行乘坐经济舱。

senses.meaning_en: a passenger car on a train

examples.text: The buffet car is in the coach behind ours.
examples.translation_cn: 餐车在我们后面的那节车厢里。

senses.meaning_en: an action, object, or system by which a result is achieved; a way of achieving or doing something

examples.text: Email is a convenient means of communicating with customers.
examples.translation_cn: 电子邮件是与客户沟通的便捷方式。

senses.meaning_en: the money or financial resources that a person or organization has
senses.pattern: have the means to do sth

examples.text: They don't have the means to send their children to college.
examples.translation_cn: 他们没有钱送孩子上大学。

senses.meaning_en: to become aware of; attention

examples.text: She noticed that the door was ajar.
examples.translation_cn: 她注意到门半开着。

senses.meaning_en: a written or printed announcement; formal notification

examples.text: The office posted a notice about the new parking rules.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室张贴了关于新停车规定的通知。

senses.meaning_en: a published critical review

examples.text: The paper ran a favorable notice of the exhibition.
examples.translation_cn: 该报刊登了一篇对展览的好评。

senses.meaning_en: an area of ground next to a house, often with grass, flowers, etc.

examples.text: The children love playing in the yard after school.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们放学后喜欢在院子里玩。

senses.meaning_en: an enclosed outside area used for a particular purpose, e.g. on farms, railways

examples.text: Containers are kept in the railway yard overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 集装箱夜间存放在铁路站场里。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to 3 feet or 0.9144 metre

examples.text: She bought three yards of silk for the dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了三码丝绸做这件连衣裙。

senses.meaning_en: using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill

examples.text: The man was violent towards the police officers during the arrest.
examples.translation_cn: 那名男子在被捕时对警察有暴力行为。

senses.meaning_en: very strong and sudden; forceful

examples.text: The wave hit the boat with violent force during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨中，海浪猛烈地拍打着船。

senses.meaning_en: very strong in feeling or effect

examples.text: She was in a violent temper after hearing the verdict.
examples.translation_cn: 听到判决后，她勃然大怒。

senses.meaning_en: intensely vivid (especially of colours)

examples.text: The sunset flared in violent colors of red and orange.
examples.translation_cn: 日落时天空呈现出红橙交织的浓艳色彩。

senses.meaning_en: physical force used to hurt, damage, or kill

examples.text: The charity works to end violence against children.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构致力于终结针对儿童的暴力。

senses.meaning_en: widespread fighting or unrest

examples.text: Violence often erupts in the region after elections.
examples.translation_cn: 选举后该地区经常爆发暴力冲突。

senses.meaning_en: extreme force or intensity

examples.text: The volcano erupted with tremendous violence, covering the sky in ash.
examples.translation_cn: 火山猛烈喷发，灰烬遮天蔽日。

senses.meaning_en: harm or injustice done to something

examples.text: The court ruling does violence to the principle of equality.
examples.translation_cn: 法院裁决对平等原则造成了伤害。

senses.meaning_en: to gather together; amass

examples.text: The guide collected all the tourists together before entering the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 导游在进入博物馆前把所有游客集合起来。

senses.meaning_en: to get or fetch something or someone from a place

examples.text: She collects her son from school every day at four.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天四点从学校接儿子。

senses.meaning_en: to gather items as a hobby or for study

examples.text: He has been collecting stamps since he was a child.
examples.translation_cn: 他从小就集邮。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for or receive money, especially for charity

examples.text: We collected for the local hospital after the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾后我们为当地医院募捐。

senses.meaning_en: a set of items gathered together

examples.text: The museum has a collection of ancient Greek coins.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆收藏有古希腊硬币。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of collecting

examples.text: The collection of data for the survey took several weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 为这项调查收集数据花了几个星期。

senses.meaning_en: a gathering of money for a purpose

examples.text: They took up a collection for the family who lost their home in the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为在火灾中失去家园的那家人募捐。

senses.meaning_en: to exchange information or ideas

examples.text: We communicate with our team by video call every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每天早上通过视频电话与团队沟通。

senses.meaning_en: to make your ideas or feelings known to others

examples.text: She communicated her concerns to the manager in writing.
examples.translation_cn: 她以书面形式向经理表达了她的担忧。

senses.meaning_en: to be connected to another room or place

examples.text: The two offices communicate with each other through a side door.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个办公室通过侧门相通。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or process of expressing ideas, feelings, or information

examples.text: Good communication with your team is essential for success.
examples.translation_cn: 与团队的良好沟通对成功至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: a message, letter, or telephone call

examples.text: We received a communication from the school about the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 我们收到了学校关于此次旅行的通知。

senses.meaning_en: systems and equipment used for sending information

examples.text: The storm destroyed all communications systems in the area.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨摧毁了该地区所有的通讯设施。

senses.meaning_en: important or worth considering

examples.text: Her research has been of considerable importance to the field.
examples.translation_cn: 她的研究对该领域一直具有相当重要的意义。

senses.meaning_en: large in amount or degree

examples.text: The project will require a considerable amount of time and money.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目将需要相当多的时间和金钱。

senses.meaning_en: one of the four long thin parts on your hand, not including your thumb

examples.text: He placed a gold ring on her finger.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一枚金戒指戴在她的手指上。

senses.meaning_en: something shaped like a finger, especially a long narrow piece of food

examples.text: She ate a finger of toast with butter.
examples.translation_cn: 她吃了一根抹黄油的吐司条。

senses.meaning_en: to happen or begin to exist

examples.text: If further problems arise during the trial, the study will be stopped.
examples.translation_cn: 如果在试验期间出现更多问题，这项研究将被停止。

senses.meaning_en: to get up from bed or a chair

examples.text: He arises early in the morning to walk his dog.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天早上早起遛狗。

senses.meaning_en: a type or kind

examples.text: This species of problem requires a different approach.
examples.translation_cn: 这类问题需要不同的解决方法。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes part in an activity or business with another person or group

examples.text: She became a partner in a leading law firm after many years.
examples.translation_cn: 多年后，她成为了一家顶级律师事务所的合伙人。

senses.meaning_en: a person's husband, wife, or romantic partner

examples.text: He lives with his partner and their two children.
examples.translation_cn: 他和伴侣以及他们的两个孩子住在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to join as a partner with someone

examples.text: The university partnered with a local tech company.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学与当地一家科技公司合作。

senses.meaning_en: to work or perform as a partner

examples.text: The two companies partnered on a renewable energy project.
examples.translation_cn: 这两家公司在一个可再生能源项目上进行了合作。

senses.meaning_en: to provide something needed

examples.text: The company supplies fresh vegetables to local supermarkets.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司向当地超市供应新鲜蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of something available for use

examples.text: The hospital keeps a supply of blood for emergencies.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院储存血液以备紧急情况。

senses.meaning_en: hopeful and confident; focusing on good things

examples.text: She is positive about her recovery despite the setback.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管遇到挫折，她对自己的康复持乐观态度。

senses.meaning_en: having no doubt; certain

examples.text: I am positive that I locked the door before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 我确信离开前锁了门。

senses.meaning_en: formally laid down; giving clear and definite proof

examples.text: The report offers positive proof that the policy works.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告提供了政策有效的确凿证据。

senses.meaning_en: greater than zero; showing a substance or condition is present

examples.text: The athlete tested positive for a banned substance.
examples.translation_cn: 这名运动员被检测出违禁药物阳性。

senses.meaning_en: relating to ordinary citizens and their government, not military or religious

examples.text: The new law protects the civil rights of every citizen.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律保护每个公民的公民权利。

senses.meaning_en: relating to legal disputes between individuals, not criminal

examples.text: She decided to file a civil case against her landlord.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定对房东提起民事诉讼。

senses.meaning_en: secular; not religious or connected with church

examples.text: The couple had a civil ceremony at the town hall.
examples.translation_cn: 这对夫妇在市政厅举行了世俗婚礼。

senses.meaning_en: polite and courteous; behaving in a reasonable manner

examples.text: Even when you disagree, try to be civil to others.
examples.translation_cn: 即使你不同意，也要尽量对他人保持礼貌。

senses.meaning_en: to observe carefully in order to inspect or check

examples.text: The customs officer examined every bag for hidden goods.
examples.translation_cn: 海关官员仔细检查了每个包裹以寻找藏匿物品。

senses.meaning_en: to test someone's knowledge or skill with a formal assessment

examples.text: Students are examined in mathematics at the end of each term.
examples.translation_cn: 学生在每学期末参加数学考试。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone questions formally, especially in a court of law

examples.text: The witness was examined in court by both lawyers.
examples.translation_cn: 证人接受了双方律师的法庭讯问。

senses.meaning_en: to use up

examples.text: This heating system consumes less energy than the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 这套供暖系统比旧的耗能少。

senses.meaning_en: to eat or drink

examples.text: He consumed a large meal after the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途徒步后他吃了一顿大餐。

senses.meaning_en: to completely occupy the thoughts or attention of

examples.text: She was consumed with guilt after lying to her best friend.
examples.translation_cn: 她对最好的朋友撒谎后内疚不已。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy completely

examples.text: The old library was consumed by fire in less than an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧图书馆不到一小时就被大火吞噬。

senses.meaning_en: a person who buys goods or services for their own use

examples.text: Consumers of organic food are willing to pay a higher price.
examples.translation_cn: 有机食品的消费者愿意支付更高的价格。

senses.meaning_en: the group of people who buy a particular product or service

examples.text: The company is trying to expand its consumer base in rural areas.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司正努力在农村地区扩大其消费者群体。

senses.meaning_en: a paper or computer file containing information

examples.text: The terms are set out in a legal document.
examples.translation_cn: 条款载于一份法律文件中。

senses.meaning_en: to record information in documents or other media

examples.text: The study documents how the brain forms new memories.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究记录了大脑如何形成新记忆。

senses.meaning_en: to furnish with documents or papers necessary to establish facts or give information

examples.text: You need to document your expenses with receipts.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要用收据来证明你的开支。

senses.meaning_en: to state the meaning of a word, phrase, sign, or symbol

examples.text: The dictionary defines 'culture' as the shared customs and beliefs of a group.
examples.translation_cn: 该词典将“文化”定义为一个群体共有的习俗和信仰。

senses.meaning_en: to express the essential nature of something

examples.text: The school's culture is defined by its emphasis on kindness and respect.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校的文化由其强调善良和尊重所界定。

senses.meaning_en: to mark sharply the outlines or limits of an area or concept

examples.text: A low wall defines the boundary of our garden.
examples.translation_cn: 一堵矮墙界定了我们花园的边界。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of firing a gun

examples.text: The police officer fired a shot at the suspect.
examples.translation_cn: 警察向嫌疑人开了一枪。

senses.meaning_en: an act of kicking, hitting, or throwing a ball towards a goal

examples.text: He took a shot at goal from outside the penalty area.
examples.translation_cn: 他在禁区外射门。

senses.meaning_en: the heavy metal ball used in the shot put

examples.text: She put the shot over twenty metres to win the event.
examples.translation_cn: 她推出超过二十米远的铅球而赢得比赛。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt to do something

examples.text: I've never tried sushi, but I'll give it a shot.
examples.translation_cn: 我从没尝过寿司，但我会试试。

senses.meaning_en: an injection of a drug or vaccine

examples.text: The patient needs a shot now.
examples.translation_cn: 病人现在需要打一针。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of money available or planned for a particular purpose

examples.text: The school has a budget of two million dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 学校有两百万美元的预算。

senses.meaning_en: low-priced; suitable for people with limited money

examples.text: We stayed at a budget hotel near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在车站附近的一家经济型旅馆。

senses.meaning_en: to make a plan for how to spend money

examples.text: We need to budget carefully for the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 我们得为这次旅行仔细做预算。

senses.meaning_en: a relatively small amount of money available

examples.text: They managed to travel around Europe on a tight budget.
examples.translation_cn: 他们设法用很少的钱游遍了欧洲。

senses.meaning_en: having the duty to take care of something or to make decisions

examples.text: The manager is responsible for training new employees.
examples.translation_cn: 经理负责培训新员工。

senses.meaning_en: being the cause of something

examples.text: The new policy is largely responsible for the rise in prices.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策是价格上涨的主要原因。

senses.meaning_en: involving important duties and personal accountability

examples.text: She has a responsible job in the finance department.
examples.translation_cn: 她在财务部门担任责任重大的职务。

senses.meaning_en: able to be trusted; reliable

examples.text: We need a responsible person to look after the children.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要一个可靠的人来照看孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a picture made with paint

examples.text: The museum owns a painting of the harbor by a local artist.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆藏有一幅当地画家画的港口画。

senses.meaning_en: the act of applying paint to a surface

examples.text: We did all the painting in the kitchen over the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们周末把厨房的油漆活全干了。

senses.meaning_en: the art or activity of painting pictures

examples.text: My grandmother took up painting at the age of seventy.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母七十岁开始学绘画。

senses.meaning_en: a person who studies or does research in science

examples.text: A scientist who studies ancient climate must combine many kinds of evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 研究古代气候的科学家必须结合多种证据。

senses.meaning_en: not in danger; out of harm's reach

examples.text: The children are safe from harm after the rescue.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们获救后安然无恙。

senses.meaning_en: having reached a base without being put out in baseball

examples.text: The runner was called safe at home plate.
examples.translation_cn: 跑垒员在本垒被判安全上垒。

senses.meaning_en: a strong metal box for storing valuables

examples.text: She keeps her passport in a safe at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她把护照放在家里的保险箱里。

senses.meaning_en: free from risk

examples.text: It is safe to swim in this lake.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个湖里游泳是安全的。

senses.meaning_en: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation

examples.text: We must find a solution to the housing crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须找到住房危机的解决办法。

senses.meaning_en: an answer to a problem or puzzle

examples.text: The solution to the puzzle is on the last page.
examples.translation_cn: 谜题的答案在最后一页。

senses.meaning_en: a homogeneous mixture formed by dissolving one or more substances

examples.text: They used an aqueous solution of salt for the experiment.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用盐水溶液做实验。

senses.meaning_en: a product, service or suite thereof, especially software

examples.text: The company offers a software solution for managing inventory.
examples.translation_cn: 公司提供用于管理库存的软件解决方案。

senses.meaning_en: to affect or change someone or something

examples.text: Many different factors can influence the outcome of a presidential election.
examples.translation_cn: 许多不同因素能影响总统选举的结果。

senses.meaning_en: the power to have an effect on someone or something

examples.text: Public opinion can have a strong influence on government policy.
examples.translation_cn: 公众舆论能对政府政策产生强烈影响。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that affects someone or something

examples.text: Her teacher was a great influence on her career choice.
examples.translation_cn: 她的老师对她的职业选择有很大影响。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade or induce someone to do something

examples.text: Advertisers often try to influence children to buy unhealthy snacks.
examples.translation_cn: 广告商经常试图影响儿童购买不健康的零食。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action

examples.text: She was a victim of identity theft last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年成了身份盗窃案的受害者。

senses.meaning_en: computer programs

examples.text: You can use this special software to recover lost files.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以使用这个专门的软件来恢复丢失的文件。

senses.meaning_en: a large heavy mammal with thick fur and a very short tail

examples.text: A brown bear was fishing for salmon in the river.
examples.translation_cn: 一只棕熊正在河里捕鲑鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to accept or tolerate something unpleasant

examples.text: She couldn't bear to listen to the sad news any longer.
examples.translation_cn: 她再也无法忍受听这个悲伤的消息。

senses.meaning_en: to take responsibility or support weight

examples.text: The manager must bear responsibility for the team's poor performance.
examples.translation_cn: 经理必须为团队糟糕的表现承担责任。

senses.meaning_en: a statement that you will hurt or punish someone if they do not do what you want

examples.text: The gang members made threats against the witness.
examples.translation_cn: 帮派成员对证人进行了威胁。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is likely to cause harm or damage

examples.text: Cyber attacks pose a serious threat to national security.
examples.translation_cn: 网络攻击对国家安全构成严重威胁。

senses.meaning_en: a sign that something bad or unpleasant may happen

examples.text: There was a threat of violence in the air.
examples.translation_cn: 空气中弥漫着暴力的凶兆。

senses.meaning_en: a personal belief or judgment about something

examples.text: In my opinion, the new policy will benefit small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 在我看来，新政策将使小企业受益。

senses.meaning_en: the beliefs or judgments of a group of people

examples.text: Public opinion on the new law remains sharply divided.
examples.translation_cn: 公众对新法律的舆论仍然分歧严重。

senses.meaning_en: what you think about the worth or nature of somebody or something

examples.text: She has a very high opinion of her new colleague.
examples.translation_cn: 她对新同事评价很高。

senses.meaning_en: the number of points, goals, or marks achieved in a game, competition, or test

examples.text: The final score was 3-2 in favor of the home team.
examples.translation_cn: 最终比分为3比2，主队获胜。

senses.meaning_en: a written form of a musical composition

examples.text: The conductor studied the score before the performance.
examples.translation_cn: 指挥在演出前研究了乐谱。

senses.meaning_en: the music of a movie or play

examples.text: She composed the score for a well-known Broadway musical.
examples.translation_cn: 她为一部著名的百老汇音乐剧谱写了配乐。

senses.meaning_en: a large number of people or things

examples.text: Scores of people attended the outdoor concert on Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 周日许多人参加了户外音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: an area with a particular feature or character

examples.text: He found an apartment in a quiet residential district.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一个安静的住宅区找到一套公寓。

senses.meaning_en: an area used for official or administrative purposes

examples.text: They opened a new library in the school district.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在学区开了一座新图书馆。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, etc.

examples.text: A member of the audience asked a question after the lecture.
examples.translation_cn: 讲座结束后，一位听众提了一个问题。

senses.meaning_en: the people who watch or listen to a programme, or read a particular publication

examples.text: The novel found a wide audience among young readers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说在年轻读者中拥有广泛的读者群。

senses.meaning_en: a formal meeting with an important person, such as a king or president

examples.text: The ambassador requested an audience with the president.
examples.translation_cn: 大使要求拜会总统。

senses.meaning_en: physical harm caused to something

examples.text: The fire caused extensive damage to the building.
examples.translation_cn: 大火给那栋建筑造成了严重损坏。

senses.meaning_en: to harm or impair something

examples.text: The crops were badly damaged by the heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 庄稼被大雨严重损坏。

senses.meaning_en: something that is needed or required

examples.text: She didn't meet the requirements for the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她没有达到这份工作的要求。

senses.meaning_en: something that must be done because of a rule or law

examples.text: There is a legal requirement to wear seat belts.
examples.translation_cn: 法律规定必须系安全带。

senses.meaning_en: an act or instance of choosing in an election or meeting

examples.text: The board will take a vote on the proposed merger next week.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会下周将就拟议的合并进行投票。

senses.meaning_en: to cast a vote in an election or meeting

examples.text: Most citizens voted for the independent candidate in the election.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数公民在选举中投票支持独立候选人。

senses.meaning_en: to choose or grant (something) by means of a vote, or by general consent

examples.text: Parliament voted the bill through after a long debate.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间辩论，议会投票通过了该法案。

senses.meaning_en: more than is usual, expected, or necessary; additional

examples.text: Please bring an extra chair for our guest.
examples.translation_cn: 请为我们的客人多带一把椅子。

senses.meaning_en: to a greater degree than usual; exceptionally

examples.text: You need to be extra careful when driving in fog.
examples.translation_cn: 雾天开车时你需要格外小心。

senses.meaning_en: a person hired to play a small part in a film or play

examples.text: She worked as an extra in a Hollywood action movie.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一部好莱坞动作片中当临时演员。

senses.meaning_en: a formal or informal discussion of opposing views

examples.text: The two leaders took part in a debate on trade.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人参加了关于贸易的辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to argue or discuss a topic, especially in public

examples.text: The committee debated the new parking rules with residents.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会与居民就新的停车规定进行了辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to think carefully about something before deciding

examples.text: He debated whether to quit his job and travel.
examples.translation_cn: 他考虑是否辞职去旅行。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives in a town or city

examples.text: Any citizen of the town can use the community center for free.
examples.translation_cn: 镇上的任何居民都可以免费使用社区中心。

senses.meaning_en: a legally recognized member of a state with rights and duties

examples.text: She was born in Italy but is now a citizen of France.
examples.translation_cn: 她出生在意大利，但现在是法国公民。

senses.meaning_en: a civilian, not a member of the police, army, etc.

examples.text: The army has promised not to harm ordinary citizens.
examples.translation_cn: 军队已承诺不伤害普通平民。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving or receiving something in return

examples.text: He offered his old watch in exchange for a meal.
examples.translation_cn: 他用他的旧手表换了一顿饭。

senses.meaning_en: a place for conducting trading

examples.text: Prices fell sharply on the exchange this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上交易所的价格大幅下跌。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving or sharing ideas, information, etc.

examples.text: The meeting encouraged an open exchange of ideas.
examples.translation_cn: 会议鼓励大家公开交流想法。

senses.meaning_en: the value difference between currencies

examples.text: The bank offered dollars at an exchange rate of 1.1 to the euro.
examples.translation_cn: 银行给出的美元兑欧元汇率为1.1。

senses.meaning_en: one of several possible choices

examples.text: The software provides an option to encrypt all outgoing messages.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件提供了一个加密所有外发消息的选项。

senses.meaning_en: the freedom or right to choose
senses.pattern: have the option of doing sth
senses.collocation: have no option but to do

examples.text: You have the option of cancelling your subscription at any time.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以随时选择取消订阅。

senses.meaning_en: a contract giving the right to buy or sell an asset at a set price

examples.text: She bought a call option on 200 shares of the company.
examples.translation_cn: 她买入了该公司200股的看涨期权。

senses.meaning_en: having a particular quality or character from birth; innate

examples.text: She was born to lead the entire company.
examples.translation_cn: 她天生就是领导整个公司的料。

senses.meaning_en: having started life; brought into existence by birth

examples.text: He was born in a small village in India.
examples.translation_cn: 他出生在印度的一个小村庄。

senses.meaning_en: in the end; after a long time or series of events

examples.text: After several failed attempts, she eventually solved the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几次失败的尝试，她最终解决了问题。

examples.text: The awards ceremony provided an occasion to recognize outstanding students.
examples.translation_cn: 颁奖典礼为表彰优秀学生提供了一次机会。

examples.text: On one occasion, the power failed during the test.
examples.translation_cn: 有一次，测试期间停电了。

examples.text: They saved a bottle of champagne for a special occasion.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为特殊场合留了一瓶香槟。

examples.text: I had no occasion to question his judgment.
examples.translation_cn: 我没有理由质疑他的判断。

senses.meaning_en: older in age; elder

examples.text: She is senior to me by three years.
examples.translation_cn: 她比我大三岁。

senses.meaning_en: higher in rank or position

examples.text: She holds a senior position in the sales department.
examples.translation_cn: 她在销售部门担任高级职务。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is older than another person

examples.text: He is my senior by exactly two years.
examples.translation_cn: 他正好比我大两岁。

senses.meaning_en: an elderly person

examples.text: The museum is free for seniors over 65.
examples.translation_cn: 65岁以上的老年人在博物馆免费。

senses.meaning_en: very; to a high degree

examples.text: It is highly unlikely that they will cancel the event now.
examples.translation_cn: 他们现在取消活动的可能性极小。

senses.meaning_en: with praise or admiration

examples.text: The director thinks highly of your creative ideas.
examples.translation_cn: 主任高度评价你的创意。

senses.meaning_en: at or to a high rank or level

examples.text: The university ranks highly for research quality in Europe.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学在欧洲的研究质量排名靠前。

senses.meaning_en: to plan or organize something; to make arrangements for something to happen
senses.pattern: arrange to do / arrange for sb to do

examples.text: We arranged to meet at the station at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 我们约好中午在车站见面。

senses.meaning_en: to put things in a neat, attractive, or required order

examples.text: She arranged the files in alphabetical order on her desk.
examples.translation_cn: 她把文件按字母顺序排列在桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: to change a piece of music so that it can be played by different instruments or voices

examples.text: The composer arranged the folk tune for full orchestra.
examples.translation_cn: 作曲家把这首民间曲调改编成管弦乐。

senses.meaning_en: a plan or preparation for something to happen

examples.text: We need to make arrangements for the meeting next week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要为下周的会议做好安排。

senses.meaning_en: the act or way of arranging things; a group of things arranged

examples.text: The arrangement of dried flowers on the table looked beautiful.
examples.translation_cn: 桌上干花的布置看起来很漂亮。

senses.meaning_en: an agreement or plan made between two or more people or groups

examples.text: They came to an arrangement over the use of the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他们就汽车的使用达成了协议。

senses.meaning_en: a version of a piece of music adapted for different instruments or style

examples.text: She played an arrangement for piano at the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 她在音乐会上演奏了一首钢琴改编曲。

senses.meaning_en: moving air, especially outdoors

examples.text: The old flag fluttered gently in the wind.
examples.translation_cn: 旧旗在风中轻轻飘动。

senses.meaning_en: air or gas in the stomach or intestines

examples.text: He felt embarrassed after breaking wind in the silent elevator.
examples.translation_cn: 他在安静的电梯里放屁后感到很尴尬。

senses.meaning_en: to follow a curving or twisting course

examples.text: The river winds through the valley to the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过山谷流向大海。

senses.meaning_en: to wrap or coil something around something else; to turn a handle or key to make a device operate

examples.text: She wound the scarf around her neck before going outside.
examples.translation_cn: 她出门前把围巾绕在脖子上。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to breathe easily
senses.collocation: knock the wind out of sb

examples.text: The exhausted runner stopped briefly to get her wind back.
examples.translation_cn: 这位筋疲力尽的赛跑者停下片刻恢复呼吸。

senses.meaning_en: a task or duty that someone is sent to do

examples.text: The rescue team carried out a mission to save the trapped miners.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队执行了一项营救被困矿工的任务。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people sent to represent their country or organization

examples.text: The government sent a diplomatic mission to negotiate peace.
examples.translation_cn: 政府派遣了一个外交使团去谈判和平。

senses.meaning_en: work done to spread a religion; a group of people doing this work

examples.text: They supported mission work in the remote village.
examples.translation_cn: 他们支持在偏远村庄的传教工作。

senses.meaning_en: an object or mark that people aim at when shooting

examples.text: The soldiers aimed at a target in the distance.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们瞄准了远处的靶子。

senses.meaning_en: a result that you try to achieve

examples.text: The company failed to meet its annual sales target.
examples.translation_cn: 公司未能实现其年度销售目标。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that people frequently criticize, attack, or mock

examples.text: The actor became the target of criticism after his speech.
examples.translation_cn: 那位演员演讲后成了批评的对象。

senses.meaning_en: help or assistance

examples.text: They crossed the river with the aid of a local map.
examples.translation_cn: 他们借助当地地图过了河。

senses.meaning_en: something that helps you to do something

examples.text: These diagrams serve as an aid to understanding the process.
examples.translation_cn: 这些图表作为理解这一过程的辅助手段。

senses.meaning_en: to help or assist

examples.text: The program aids young people in finding permanent work.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目帮助年轻人找到长期工作。

senses.meaning_en: without any other person; solitary

examples.text: He was alone in the office when the fire alarm rang.
examples.translation_cn: 火警响起时，他独自在办公室里。

senses.meaning_en: without help from others

examples.text: She raised three children alone after her husband left.
examples.translation_cn: 丈夫离开后，她独自抚养了三个孩子。

senses.meaning_en: only; just (used after a noun or pronoun)

examples.text: The cost alone was more than our monthly rent.
examples.translation_cn: 仅费用就超过了我们每月的房租。

senses.meaning_en: without anyone sharing one's beliefs or experiences

examples.text: She was alone in thinking the plan was too risky.
examples.translation_cn: 她认为这个计划风险太大，但只有她这么想。

senses.meaning_en: to be present at an event or place

examples.text: All staff are expected to attend the meeting on Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工都应出席周一的会议。

senses.meaning_en: to pay attention

examples.text: You should attend to what the instructor says.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该注意听教员说的话。

senses.meaning_en: to take care of or deal with

examples.text: The nurse attended to the patient throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 护士整夜照料那位病人。

senses.meaning_en: to go with or escort somebody

examples.text: The ambassador was attended by two bodyguards during the visit.
examples.translation_cn: 大使在访问期间由两名保镖陪同。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to speak or spoken language

examples.text: After the stroke, he slowly regained the power of speech.
examples.translation_cn: 中风后，他慢慢恢复了说话能力。

senses.meaning_en: a formal talk given to an audience

examples.text: She made a powerful speech about climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 她发表了一篇关于气候变化的精彩演讲。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which someone speaks

examples.text: The patient's slurred speech was a sign of a serious stroke.
examples.translation_cn: 病人说话含糊不清是严重中风的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: spoken language rather than written language

examples.text: Many idioms are used more often in speech than in writing.
examples.translation_cn: 许多习语在口语中比在书面语中用得更多。

senses.meaning_en: an abstract idea or general notion

examples.text: The concept of freedom is central to modern democracy.
examples.translation_cn: 自由这一概念是现代民主的核心。

senses.meaning_en: an original idea or design

examples.text: They developed a concept for a mobile app that tracks mood.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为追踪情绪的移动应用提出了一个设计理念。

senses.meaning_en: to be without; not to have

examples.text: Many students lack the confidence to speak English in public.
examples.translation_cn: 许多学生缺乏在公共场合说英语的自信。

senses.meaning_en: a deficiency or absence of something

examples.text: Lack of sleep can seriously affect your health and concentration.
examples.translation_cn: 缺乏睡眠会严重影响你的健康和注意力。

senses.meaning_en: to be short of something

examples.text: As a popular actor, he does not lack for admirers.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一位受欢迎的演员，他不乏仰慕者。

senses.meaning_en: of, facing, situated in, or related to the south

examples.text: They live in the southern part of the country.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在该国的南部。

senses.meaning_en: of or pertaining to a southern region, especially the southern United States

examples.text: My grandmother speaks with a soft Southern accent.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖母说话带着柔和的南方口音。

senses.meaning_en: newly produced or obtained; recent

examples.text: The new intern is fresh from college and full of ideas.
examples.translation_cn: 新来的实习生刚从大学毕业，满脑子想法。

senses.meaning_en: not dried, frozen, or spoiled

examples.text: Wrap the bread tightly to keep it fresh for two days.
examples.translation_cn: 把面包包紧，可以保鲜两天。

senses.meaning_en: invigoratingly cool and refreshing; rested

examples.text: After a cold shower, I felt fresh and ready for the day.
examples.translation_cn: 洗了个冷水澡后，我感到清爽又精神，准备好迎接这一天。

senses.meaning_en: without salt; not saline

examples.text: These fish live only in fresh water, not in the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 这些鱼只生活在淡水中，不在海里。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of land covered with trees

examples.text: Many rare birds nest in the forest, so visitors must keep to the paths.
examples.translation_cn: 许多珍稀鸟类在森林里筑巢，因此游客必须沿小路行走。

senses.meaning_en: a recording of moving visual images, or the medium for such recordings

examples.text: We watched a video about climate change in class today.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天课堂上观看了一个关于气候变化的视频。

senses.meaning_en: to record moving images and sound using a video camera or other device

examples.text: I videoed the whole concert on my phone.
examples.translation_cn: 我用手机录下了整场音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: the earth, considered as a whole

examples.text: The company has offices in cities around the globe.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在世界各地的城市设有办事处。

senses.meaning_en: a round model of the earth

examples.text: I found Singapore on a globe in the library.
examples.translation_cn: 我在图书馆的地球仪上找到了新加坡。

senses.meaning_en: any spherical or nearly spherical object

examples.text: The lamp is enclosed in a glass globe.
examples.translation_cn: 那盏灯被一个玻璃球罩着。

senses.meaning_en: considering or including all parts of something

examples.text: We need to take a global view of the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要全面看待这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: covering or affecting the whole world

examples.text: The company plans to expand on a global scale.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司计划在全球范围内扩张。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the whole of a system, set, or situation

examples.text: Use global search to find files across all folders.
examples.translation_cn: 使用全局搜索在所有文件夹中查找文件。

senses.meaning_en: the upper house of a legislature, especially in the US

examples.text: The Senate voted to approve the new tax bill.
examples.translation_cn: 参议院投票通过了新的税收法案。

senses.meaning_en: a governing body in some universities

examples.text: Professor Li now serves on the university senate.
examples.translation_cn: 李教授现在在大学评议会任职。

senses.meaning_en: small in amount or degree; not serious

examples.text: There was a slight drop in temperature overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 夜间气温略有下降。

senses.meaning_en: thin and delicate in build

examples.text: She was slight of build but could lift heavy boxes.
examples.translation_cn: 她身材纤细，但能提起重箱子。

senses.meaning_en: to treat someone as if they are not important; to insult by neglect

examples.text: He was slighted by his colleagues when they didn't invite him.
examples.translation_cn: 他因同事没邀请他而感到被冷落了。

senses.meaning_en: to give lesser weight or importance to

examples.text: The report slighted the importance of early education.
examples.translation_cn: 报告忽视了早期教育的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: to a small extent or degree

examples.text: The two designs are slightly different in color.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种设计在颜色上略有不同。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to improve a system, law, etc.

examples.text: He called for a reform of the voting system.
examples.translation_cn: 他呼吁改革投票制度。

senses.meaning_en: to improve a system, law, etc. by making changes

examples.text: The new government promised to reform the tax system.
examples.translation_cn: 新政府承诺改革税收制度。

senses.meaning_en: to change someone's behaviour and make them a better person

examples.text: The new program aims to reform young offenders.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新项目旨在改造年轻罪犯。

senses.meaning_en: to change one's behaviour and become a better person

examples.text: After years in prison, he promised to reform and find a steady job.
examples.translation_cn: 在监狱多年后，他承诺改过自新并找一份稳定工作。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain or win something

examples.text: The hackers gained access to the sensitive files.
examples.translation_cn: 黑客获得了敏感文件的访问权限。

senses.meaning_en: to increase in amount or degree

examples.text: My sister gained weight during her first year at college.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐上大学第一年体重增加了。

senses.meaning_en: to benefit from something

examples.text: Students often gain from working in small groups.
examples.translation_cn: 学生经常从小组合作中获益。

senses.meaning_en: to get closer to someone or something

examples.text: The runner gradually gained on the leader in the final lap.
examples.translation_cn: 这名赛跑运动员在最后一圈逐渐逼近领先者。

senses.meaning_en: a public official who presides over trials and administers the law

examples.text: The suspect appeared before a judge on Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人周一在法官面前出庭。

senses.meaning_en: a person who decides the result of a competition or contest

examples.text: She was chosen to act as a judge in the singing contest.
examples.translation_cn: 她被选为歌唱比赛的评委。

senses.meaning_en: to form an opinion or evaluation about someone or something

examples.text: It is unfair to judge people on their appearance alone.
examples.translation_cn: 仅凭外表评价人是不公平的。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has the knowledge to give an opinion about something

examples.text: My grandmother is a good judge of character.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母很会看人。

senses.meaning_en: to hear and decide a case in a court of law

examples.text: The court judged him guilty of fraud yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭昨天判他犯有诈骗罪。

senses.meaning_en: size; scope

examples.text: The company now operates on a global scale.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司目前在全球范围内运营。

senses.meaning_en: a system of measurement or grading

examples.text: Please rate the pain on a scale of 1 to 10.
examples.translation_cn: 请按1到10的尺度给疼痛打分。

senses.meaning_en: a series of musical notes

examples.text: She plays the C major scale every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上弹奏C大调音阶。

senses.meaning_en: ratio between a drawing and the actual object

examples.text: This floor plan is drawn to scale, so one centimeter equals one meter.
examples.translation_cn: 这张平面图按比例绘制，所以一厘米等于一米。

senses.meaning_en: to supply with necessary equipment or tools

examples.text: The school equipped the science lab with new computers.
examples.translation_cn: 学校给科学实验室配备了新电脑。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone the skills or knowledge needed

examples.text: This course equips students to solve real-world problems.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程使学生能够解决现实世界的问题。

senses.meaning_en: the things needed for a particular purpose or activity

examples.text: The hospital needs more equipment for treating patients in intensive care.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院需要更多用于治疗重症监护病人的设备。

senses.meaning_en: the act of equipping or the state of being equipped
senses.pattern: the equipment of sth with sth

examples.text: The equipment of the new hospital with modern devices took over a year.
examples.translation_cn: 为新医院配备现代化设备耗时一年多。

senses.meaning_en: the act of setting someone or something free

examples.text: The release of the political prisoners was announced this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天上午宣布了释放政治犯的消息。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making a product available to the public
senses.pattern: the release of a new version

examples.text: The release of the new software version is scheduled for next month.
examples.translation_cn: 新版软件计划下个月发布。

senses.meaning_en: something recently released or made available

examples.text: The latest release from the band has received critical acclaim.
examples.translation_cn: 这支乐队的最新作品获得了好评。

senses.meaning_en: something that is released, esp. into the environment

examples.text: An accidental release of chemicals contaminated the water supply.
examples.translation_cn: 一次意外的化学品泄漏污染了供水。

senses.meaning_en: a person who expresses disapproval of someone or something

examples.text: He is a fierce critic of the government's tax plans.
examples.translation_cn: 他强烈批评政府的税收计划。

senses.meaning_en: a specialist in judging works of art, music, films, etc.

examples.text: She works as a film critic for The Guardian.
examples.translation_cn: 她在《卫报》担任影评人。

senses.meaning_en: extremely important and decisive

examples.text: The peace talks are at a critical point.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判正处在一个关键时刻。

senses.meaning_en: involving careful analysis or judgment

examples.text: Her essay offers a critical analysis of the film's themes.
examples.translation_cn: 她的文章对这部电影的主题进行了批判性分析。

senses.meaning_en: seriously ill or unstable

examples.text: He is in critical condition at the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 他在医院里，情况危急。

senses.meaning_en: inclined to find fault

examples.text: Many experts are critical of the government's new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 许多专家对政府的新政策持批评态度。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the sex that produces sperm or to the gender typically associated with it

examples.text: A male student raised his hand to ask a question.
examples.translation_cn: 一名男学生举手提问。

senses.meaning_en: having qualities considered typical of men or male animals

examples.text: He refused to ask for help out of male pride.
examples.translation_cn: 他出于男性自尊拒绝求助。

senses.meaning_en: a male person, animal, or plant

examples.text: The male of this species is larger than the female.
examples.translation_cn: 这个物种的雄性比雌性大。

senses.meaning_en: a critical evaluation or report on a book, play, film, etc.

examples.text: The magazine printed a review of his latest album.
examples.translation_cn: 该杂志刊登了对他最新专辑的评论。

senses.meaning_en: a careful examination of something to see if it is satisfactory or to learn from it

examples.text: The company's safety procedures are under review after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故发生后，公司的安全程序正在接受审查。

senses.meaning_en: the act of reading or studying something again

examples.text: We did a quick review of the key points before the test.
examples.translation_cn: 考试前我们快速复习了要点。

senses.meaning_en: a survey of available items or material

examples.text: The journal article begins with a review of recent research.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇期刊文章开头回顾了近期研究。

senses.meaning_en: to officially order someone or something to return, or to remove an elected official from office

examples.text: Voters recalled the mayor from office after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻发生后，选民罢免了市长。

senses.meaning_en: to remember something, especially by making an effort

examples.text: She clearly recalled visiting the museum as a child.
examples.translation_cn: 她清楚地记得小时候参观过博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone remember or think of something; to be reminiscent of

examples.text: The old town recalls the atmosphere of the 1960s.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老城让人想起20世纪60年代的气氛。

senses.meaning_en: to officially withdraw or revoke something said or decided

examples.text: The general was forced to recall the order to retreat.
examples.translation_cn: 将军被迫撤销了撤退命令。

senses.meaning_en: to look fixedly at somebody or something

examples.text: He stared at the strange fish in the tank.
examples.translation_cn: 他盯着鱼缸里那条奇怪的鱼看。

senses.meaning_en: to look at nothing in particular because you are bored or shocked

examples.text: After the bad news, she sat staring into space.
examples.translation_cn: 听到坏消息后，她坐着发呆。

senses.meaning_en: a long steady look

examples.text: The teacher fixed the noisy student with a stern stare.
examples.translation_cn: 老师严厉地瞪了那个吵闹的学生一眼。

senses.meaning_en: to influence somebody by staring at them

examples.text: She stared him down until he looked away.
examples.translation_cn: 她瞪着他，直到他移开目光。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being safe and protected from danger or harm

examples.text: The hikers carried a first-aid kit for safety.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者随身携带急救包以确保安全。

senses.meaning_en: if not; or else

examples.text: Put on your coat, otherwise you'll catch a cold.
examples.translation_cn: 穿上外套，否则你会感冒。

senses.meaning_en: apart from that; in other respects

examples.text: The hotel was rather old but otherwise comfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆相当旧，但其他方面很舒适。

senses.meaning_en: in a different way; differently

examples.text: I asked her to wait, but she thought otherwise.
examples.translation_cn: 我叫她等着，但她不这么想。

senses.meaning_en: different from what has been stated

examples.text: His story sounded true, but the truth was otherwise.
examples.translation_cn: 他的说法听起来是真的，但事实并非如此。

senses.meaning_en: the residential area near one's home

examples.text: There's a small park in the neighborhood where my parents live.
examples.translation_cn: 我父母住的那一带有一个小公园。

senses.meaning_en: the people who live in a particular area

examples.text: The whole neighborhood pitched in to clean the park.
examples.translation_cn: 整个邻里乡亲都来帮忙打扫公园。

senses.meaning_en: a district or section of a town or city

examples.text: We visited a beautiful historic neighborhood of Boston.
examples.translation_cn: 我们参观了波士顿一个美丽的历史地段。

senses.meaning_en: an approximate amount or range

examples.text: The repairs will cost in the neighborhood of $500.
examples.translation_cn: 修理费将在500美元左右。

senses.meaning_en: barely; only just; almost not

examples.text: I could hardly hear what she was saying.
examples.translation_cn: 我几乎听不见她在说什么。

senses.meaning_en: certainly not; not at all

examples.text: It is hardly surprising that she refused the offer.
examples.translation_cn: 她拒绝了那个提议，这毫不奇怪。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something is not really true or likely

examples.text: When I asked if he was sorry, he just said, “Hardly!”
examples.translation_cn: 当我问他是否感到抱歉时，他只是说：“才不呢！”

senses.meaning_en: A person’s condition, position or standing relative to that of others.

examples.text: Her status as a best-selling author brings many speaking invitations.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为畅销书作家的身份带来了许多演讲邀请。

senses.meaning_en: A situation or state of affairs.

examples.text: We need an update on the status of the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要关于项目状况的最新消息。

senses.meaning_en: The legal condition of a person or thing.

examples.text: He was granted legal status after five years in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 他在该国五年后获得了法律地位。

senses.meaning_en: Prestige or high standing.

examples.text: Owning a sports car gives him status among his peers.
examples.translation_cn: 拥有一辆跑车使他在同龄人中很有地位。

senses.meaning_en: soldiers, especially in large numbers

examples.text: The UN has sent in troops to keep the peace.
examples.translation_cn: 联合国已派军队维持和平。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or animals

examples.text: A troop of monkeys gathered near the temple.
examples.translation_cn: 一群猴子聚集在寺庙附近。

senses.meaning_en: to move together in a group

examples.text: The children trooped into the classroom after the bell rang.
examples.translation_cn: 铃声过后，孩子们成群结队地走进教室。

senses.meaning_en: in a direct line or manner

examples.text: He went directly to the manager's office without stopping.
examples.translation_cn: 他径直去了经理办公室，没有停留。

senses.meaning_en: immediately; at once

examples.text: Directly after the meeting, she called her boss.
examples.translation_cn: 会议一结束，她立刻给老板打了电话。

senses.meaning_en: exactly; just

examples.text: The café is directly opposite the cinema on Elm Street.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡馆正好在榆树街电影院的对面。

senses.meaning_en: honestly; frankly

examples.text: When asked, she answered directly that she opposed the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 当被问到时，她直率地回答说她反对该计划。

senses.meaning_en: a word or phrase, especially a common or idiomatic one

examples.text: He used an old-fashioned expression to describe the situation.
examples.translation_cn: 他用了一个过时的表达方式来描述这个情况。

senses.meaning_en: a look on someone's face that shows what they are thinking or feeling

examples.text: She looked at me with an expression of surprise.
examples.translation_cn: 她面带惊讶地看着我。

senses.meaning_en: the act of showing or making known thoughts, feelings, or ideas

examples.text: The expression of different opinions is essential for a healthy debate.
examples.translation_cn: 表达不同意见对于健康的辩论至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: to cause physical pain or injury to somebody/an animal

examples.text: He hurt his back badly when he tried to lift the heavy box.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图搬起那个重箱子时，背部严重受伤。

senses.meaning_en: to cause somebody emotional pain

examples.text: Her careless remark about his work hurt his feelings deeply.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他工作的轻率评论深深伤害了他的感情。

senses.meaning_en: to be painful

examples.text: My head still hurts after last night's loud concert.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚吵闹的音乐会之后，我的头还在疼。

senses.meaning_en: to damage or have a bad effect on somebody/something

examples.text: The scandal severely hurt the company's reputation and sales.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻严重损害了公司的声誉和销售。

senses.meaning_en: December 25th, a Christian festival celebrating the birth of Jesus Christ

examples.text: We always visit our grandparents on Christmas Day.
examples.translation_cn: 我们总是在圣诞节那天去看望祖父母。

senses.meaning_en: the act of selling something

examples.text: The sale of the company is expected to close next month.
examples.translation_cn: 公司出售预计下个月完成。

senses.meaning_en: an event where goods are sold cheaply or by auction

examples.text: I bought this jacket at a sale for half price.
examples.translation_cn: 我在大甩卖时半价买了这件夹克。

senses.meaning_en: a mark left by a person, animal, or thing that has passed

examples.text: The hunters followed the deer's tracks through the snow.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人们循着鹿的足迹穿过雪地。

senses.meaning_en: a path or course for racing or exercise

examples.text: The runners are doing warm-up laps on the track.
examples.translation_cn: 运动员们正在跑道上做热身圈。

senses.meaning_en: the direction or progress of someone or something

examples.text: It is difficult to keep track of all the new developments in this field.
examples.translation_cn: 很难掌握这一领域的所有新进展。

senses.meaning_en: the way or rails along which a train moves

examples.text: The old steam train chugged along the track through the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 老式蒸汽火车沿着轨道穿过山谷。

senses.meaning_en: a strip of material used to fasten, strengthen or decorate something

examples.text: She held the papers together with a rubber band.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一根橡皮筋把文件套在一起。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who act together or share a purpose

examples.text: A band of protesters gathered outside the city hall.
examples.translation_cn: 一群抗议者聚集在市政厅外。

senses.meaning_en: a group of musicians who play music together

examples.text: She plays lead guitar in a rock band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个摇滚乐队里弹主音吉他。

senses.meaning_en: a long strip of color or material that is different from the area around it

examples.text: A band of color stretched across the evening sky.
examples.translation_cn: 一道色带横贯傍晚的天空。

senses.meaning_en: to have a sudden and strong effect on someone or something, especially something bad

examples.text: The area was struck by a powerful earthquake last night.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区昨晚遭受了一次强烈地震。

senses.meaning_en: to hit or come into contact with force

examples.text: He struck the ball with his left foot and scored a goal.
examples.translation_cn: 他用左脚击球并得分。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time when workers refuse to work as a protest

examples.text: The workers voted to go on strike for higher wages.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们投票决定罢工以要求加薪。

senses.meaning_en: to come into someone's mind; to give an impression

examples.text: It struck me that I had left my keys at home.
examples.translation_cn: 我突然想到我把钥匙落在家里了。

senses.meaning_en: to delete or cross out

examples.text: The editor struck out the last sentence of the report.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑把报告的最后一句划掉了。

senses.meaning_en: lack of success

examples.text: Their first attempt to climb the mountain ended in failure.
examples.translation_cn: 他们第一次攀登这座山的尝试以失败告终。

senses.meaning_en: breakdown; loss of ability to function

examples.text: A sudden power failure plunged the city into darkness.
examples.translation_cn: 突然的停电使整个城市陷入黑暗。

senses.meaning_en: an act of not doing something that is required or expected

examples.text: His failure to report the accident led to serious consequences.
examples.translation_cn: 他未报告事故导致了严重后果。

senses.meaning_en: bankruptcy; financial collapse

examples.text: The failure of the company left hundreds of people unemployed.
examples.translation_cn: 公司破产使数百人失业。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being free from something unpleasant

examples.text: The new drug provides complete freedom from pain.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药能完全消除疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: the right or power to act, speak, or use something without restriction

examples.text: Freedom of speech is protected by the constitution.
examples.translation_cn: 言论自由受宪法保护。

senses.meaning_en: a person who reads, especially a publication

examples.text: She has been an avid reader of science fiction for years.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年来一直是科幻小说的忠实读者。

senses.meaning_en: an electronic device for reading digital texts

examples.text: I read the news on my e-reader every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我每天早上在电子阅读器上读新闻。

senses.meaning_en: a book containing texts for reading, especially for learners

examples.text: I bought a graded reader for my Spanish class.
examples.translation_cn: 我买了一本西班牙语课用的分级读物。

senses.meaning_en: complete or total

examples.text: The whole trip was an absolute disaster from start to finish.
examples.translation_cn: 整个旅行从头到尾都是一场十足的灾难。

senses.meaning_en: not limited or restricted in any way

examples.text: The king had absolute power over his people.
examples.translation_cn: 国王对他的人民拥有绝对权力。

senses.meaning_en: certain or definite; not in doubt

examples.text: She knew with absolute certainty that he was lying.
examples.translation_cn: 她绝对肯定他在撒谎。

senses.meaning_en: completely; extremely

examples.text: I am absolutely certain that she left the keys here.
examples.translation_cn: 我完全肯定她把钥匙落在这里了。

senses.meaning_en: yes; certainly; used to show strong agreement

examples.text: When asked if she was happy, she replied, “Absolutely!”
examples.translation_cn: 当被问到是否开心时，她回答说：“当然！”

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize a negative

examples.text: There is absolutely no truth in that story.
examples.translation_cn: 那个故事毫无真实性。

senses.meaning_en: light in color; pale, especially skin or hair

examples.text: Both children have fair skin and red hair.
examples.translation_cn: 两个孩子都有白皙的皮肤和红头发。

senses.meaning_en: just; treating people equally

examples.text: The judge promised to be fair to both sides.
examples.translation_cn: 法官承诺对双方都公平。

senses.meaning_en: adequate, reasonable, or decent but not excellent

examples.text: We have a fair chance of winning the game.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有相当好的机会赢得这场比赛。

senses.meaning_en: an event where people gather to buy and sell goods or show products

examples.text: We bought honey at a fair last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末在集市上买了蜂蜜。

senses.meaning_en: a necessary item or a basic point

examples.text: I always pack the essentials for a weekend trip.
examples.translation_cn: 周末旅行我总是收拾必需品。

senses.meaning_en: extremely important; completely necessary

examples.text: It is essential that you read the instructions before use.
examples.translation_cn: 使用前阅读说明是必不可少的。

senses.meaning_en: needed by the body but not made by it, so must come from food

examples.text: Some amino acids are essential to the body and must come from food.
examples.translation_cn: 有些氨基酸是人体必需的，必须从食物中摄取。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the basic nature or fundamental quality of something

examples.text: The essential feature of a desert is its dryness.
examples.translation_cn: 沙漠的本质特征是干燥。

examples.text: New evidence has confirmed that the original diagnosis was correct.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据证实了最初的诊断是正确的。

examples.text: Please confirm your reservation with the hotel before you travel.
examples.translation_cn: 请在出行前与酒店确认你的预订。

examples.text: The committee confirmed him as the new chief executive officer.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会批准他担任新任首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: to take a child into your family legally as your own

examples.text: They decided to adopt a child from overseas.
examples.translation_cn: 他们决定从海外收养一个孩子。
