senses.meaning_en: to start to use a particular method, plan, or attitude

examples.text: We need to adopt an approach that works for everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要采用一种对每个人都有效的方法。

senses.meaning_en: to formally accept a suggestion or policy by voting

examples.text: The committee adopted a resolution to improve working conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会通过了一项决议来改善工作条件。

senses.meaning_en: having a lot of power or influence

examples.text: As a powerful figure in the media, he can shape public opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 作为媒体的权势人物，他能左右公众舆论。

senses.meaning_en: having great force or effect
senses.pattern: be powerful enough to do sth

examples.text: The truck is powerful enough to pull the trailer up the hill.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆卡车动力强劲，足以把拖车拉上山。

senses.meaning_en: confidence in or reliance on someone or something

examples.text: She has complete trust in her doctor's advice.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全信任医生的建议。

senses.meaning_en: a legal arrangement in which someone manages property for another person's benefit

examples.text: The estate is held in trust for the young heir.
examples.translation_cn: 该遗产以信托方式为年轻继承人持有。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone something to take care of because you believe they will be responsible

examples.text: I wouldn't trust him with my car keys.
examples.translation_cn: 我不会把车钥匙托付给他。

senses.meaning_en: to lead or direct people or tasks

examples.text: She conducted the school orchestra with remarkable energy.
examples.translation_cn: 她以非凡的精力指挥了学校管弦乐队。

senses.meaning_en: to allow heat or electricity to go through

examples.text: Copper conducts electricity much better than iron does.
examples.translation_cn: 铜导电比铁好得多。

senses.meaning_en: to organize and carry out an activity or task

examples.text: Researchers conducted a survey of two thousand adults.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员对两千名成年人进行了一项调查。

senses.meaning_en: the act or method of managing or directing something

examples.text: The conduct of the election was praised by observers.
examples.translation_cn: 选举的进行受到了观察员们的称赞。

senses.meaning_en: in a complete manner; thoroughly

examples.text: The two answers to the question are completely different.
examples.translation_cn: 这个问题的两个答案完全不同。

senses.meaning_en: to put your hand or fingers on someone or something

examples.text: He touched her on the shoulder to get her attention.
examples.translation_cn: 他碰了碰她的肩膀以引起她的注意。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel strong emotions such as sympathy or sadness

examples.text: Many readers were touched by the story of the old couple.
examples.translation_cn: 许多读者被这对老夫妇的故事感动了。

senses.meaning_en: communication or contact between people

examples.text: We have stayed in touch with our college friends for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 我们和大学朋友们保持联系已经十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: to have an effect on or concern someone or something

examples.text: The new law will touch the lives of many ordinary people.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律将影响许多普通人的生活。

senses.meaning_en: a group of words that expresses a complete thought, usually containing a subject and a verb

examples.text: Please use each new word in a complete sentence.
examples.translation_cn: 请把每个生词都用在一个完整的句子里。

senses.meaning_en: the punishment given by a court to someone found guilty of a crime

examples.text: The judge will pass a five-year prison sentence on the defendant next Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 法官将于下周一判处被告五年监禁。

senses.meaning_en: to officially order someone to receive a punishment after they have been found guilty

examples.text: The judge sentenced him to five years in prison for fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 法官因诈骗罪判处他五年监禁。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of papers or documents kept together, usually for reference

examples.text: Your medical records are kept on file at the clinic.
examples.translation_cn: 你的病历在诊所存档。

senses.meaning_en: a named collection of data stored on a computer

examples.text: Please save the document as a PDF file.
examples.translation_cn: 请将文档保存为PDF文件。

senses.meaning_en: to submit a document to an official body or put papers in order

examples.text: She filed a complaint with the city council.
examples.translation_cn: 她向市议会提交了投诉书。

senses.meaning_en: to walk in a line

examples.text: The students filed into the hall two by two.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们两人一排地列队进入大厅。

senses.meaning_en: main; most important

examples.text: Safety is of primary importance in this industry.
examples.translation_cn: 安全在这个行业至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the education of children between about 5 and 11

examples.text: In many countries, children attend primary school between the ages of five and eleven.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多国家，儿童在五至十一岁之间上小学。

senses.meaning_en: an election in which voters choose candidates for a political party

examples.text: She voted in the primary for the first time this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年她第一次在初选中投票。

senses.meaning_en: first or earliest in a group or series

examples.text: Researchers must use primary sources to verify historical facts.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员必须使用原始资料来核实史实。

senses.meaning_en: the distance measured along the longest dimension of an object

examples.text: The blue whale is about 30 metres in length.
examples.translation_cn: 蓝鲸身长约30米。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of time that something lasts

examples.text: The length of time required for the test is about 40 minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 考试所需的时间长度约为40分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of something long and thin

examples.text: He cut a length of rope to tie the boat.
examples.translation_cn: 他剪下一段绳子来系船。

senses.meaning_en: to try to find out the truth about a crime, accident, or problem

examples.text: The police are investigating a series of break-ins in the area.
examples.translation_cn: 警方正在调查该地区的一系列入室盗窃案。

senses.meaning_en: to study or inquire into something in order to learn the facts

examples.text: Scientists are investigating how music affects brain development in young children.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家正在研究音乐如何影响幼儿的大脑发育。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of examining something carefully in order to discover the truth

examples.text: Scientists conducted a thorough investigation into the effects of sleep on memory.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家对睡眠对记忆的影响进行了深入的调查。

senses.meaning_en: a state of equilibrium

examples.text: She struggled to keep her balance on the icy path.
examples.translation_cn: 她在结冰的小路上努力保持平衡。

senses.meaning_en: mental calmness

examples.text: After the shocking news, she struggled to regain her emotional balance.
examples.translation_cn: 听到令人震惊的消息后，她努力恢复情绪平衡。

senses.meaning_en: fair consideration of both sides
senses.pattern: strike a balance between A and B

examples.text: The editor tried to strike a balance between accuracy and readability.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑努力在准确性和可读性之间取得平衡。

senses.meaning_en: amount of money in an account

examples.text: I checked my bank balance online this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天早上在网上查了银行余额。

senses.meaning_en: relating to atomic nuclei, nuclear energy, or nuclear weapons

examples.text: Many countries are turning to nuclear energy to reduce their carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 许多国家正转向核能以减少碳排放。

senses.meaning_en: being the central or most important part; relating to the nuclear family

examples.text: A nuclear family consists of two parents and their children.
examples.translation_cn: 核心家庭由父母及其子女组成。

senses.meaning_en: possessing nuclear weapons

examples.text: The two nuclear powers signed a new arms control treaty.
examples.translation_cn: 两个核大国签署了一项新的军控条约。

senses.meaning_en: involving an extreme course of action or one with severe consequences

examples.text: The board chose the nuclear option and closed the unprofitable division.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会选择了极端做法，关闭了亏损部门。

senses.meaning_en: a person who studies something carefully to discover new facts

examples.text: Dr Lee is a leading researcher in cancer biology.
examples.translation_cn: 李博士是癌症生物学领域的一位领先研究人员。

senses.meaning_en: a woody part of a tree growing out from the trunk

examples.text: A robin was perched on a branch outside my window.
examples.translation_cn: 一只知更鸟停在我窗外的树枝上。

senses.meaning_en: a local office or shop belonging to a larger organization

examples.text: The bank opened a new branch near the station last month.
examples.translation_cn: 这家银行上个月在车站附近开了一家新分行。

senses.meaning_en: a part that divides from a main part

examples.text: The main road divides into two branches beyond the old mill.
examples.translation_cn: 大路过了老磨坊后分成两条岔路。

senses.meaning_en: a river or stream that flows into a larger one
senses.collocation: a major branch of the river

examples.text: This small river is a major branch of the Colorado River.
examples.translation_cn: 这条小河是科罗拉多河的一条主要支流。

senses.meaning_en: a clash or disagreement, often violent, between opposing groups or individuals
senses.pattern: a conflict between A and B

examples.text: There was a conflict between the two communities over water rights.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个社区因水权发生了冲突。

senses.meaning_en: an incompatibility, as of two things that cannot be simultaneously fulfilled
senses.pattern: a conflict between A and B

examples.text: There is often a conflict between work and family life.
examples.translation_cn: 工作和家庭生活之间常常存在矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: to be at odds with; to disagree or be incompatible

examples.text: His account of the incident conflicts with the witness's version.
examples.translation_cn: 他对该事件的叙述与目击者的说法相矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: to overlap, as in a schedule

examples.text: The meeting conflicts with my dentist appointment this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 会议与我今天下午的牙医预约时间冲突。

senses.meaning_en: the soul of a person or creature

examples.text: Many people believe that the human spirit lives on after death.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人相信人的灵魂死后仍然存在。

senses.meaning_en: courage, energy, and enthusiasm

examples.text: Despite her injury, she played with great spirit and inspired her teammates.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管受伤，她仍然斗志昂扬地比赛，激励了队友。

senses.meaning_en: a supernatural being, such as a ghost or fairy

examples.text: She believes in spirits and says she once saw a ghost.
examples.translation_cn: 她相信鬼魂，并说她见过一次鬼。

senses.meaning_en: distilled alcoholic drink, usually in plural form spirits

examples.text: He rarely drinks spirits, but he enjoys a glass of wine now and then.
examples.translation_cn: 他很少喝烈酒，但偶尔喜欢喝一杯葡萄酒。

senses.meaning_en: to feel uncertain about something; to think that something may not be true or likely

examples.text: I seriously doubt whether the new policy will actually work.
examples.translation_cn: 我非常怀疑这项新政策是否真的会奏效。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of uncertainty; a point about which one is uncertain

examples.text: There is still some doubt about the cause of the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 关于火灾的起因仍有一些疑问。

senses.meaning_en: a point about which one is uncertain; a question one has

examples.text: Please raise your hand if you have doubts about any question.
examples.translation_cn: 如果对任何问题有疑问，请举手。

senses.meaning_en: a place used for camping or a military base

examples.text: The hikers set up camp in a forest clearing before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者在日落前在一片林间空地上扎了营。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people sharing similar beliefs or interests

examples.text: She is in the scientific camp on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 在气候变化问题上，她属于科学阵营。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to think and reason

examples.text: You need to use your brain to work out the answer.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要动脑筋才能得出答案。

senses.meaning_en: a very intelligent person, often the one who plans something

examples.text: He was the brains behind the company's expansion into Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 他是公司拓展亚洲市场的策划人。

senses.meaning_en: the organ inside the head that controls thought, memory, feelings, and activity

examples.text: The scan showed bleeding in the brain after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 扫描显示事故后大脑出血。

senses.meaning_en: a set of twelve

examples.text: She bought a dozen roses for the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她为聚会买了一打玫瑰。

senses.meaning_en: a large, unspecified number; many

examples.text: Dozens of people lined up outside the theater.
examples.translation_cn: 几十人在剧院外排队。

senses.meaning_en: the quality or degree of being strong

examples.text: The strength of the wind made it difficult to walk.
examples.translation_cn: 风力太大，走路很困难。

senses.meaning_en: physical power or energy

examples.text: She did not have the strength to lift the heavy box.
examples.translation_cn: 她没有力气抬起那个重箱子。

senses.meaning_en: a quality or ability that gives someone or something an advantage

examples.text: One of her greatest strengths is her ability to stay calm under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 她最大的优点之一是在压力下保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being brave or determined; the power or influence of a person, country, or organization

examples.text: She found the strength to speak out against the injustice.
examples.translation_cn: 她鼓起勇气公开反对不公正。

senses.meaning_en: usually; under normal conditions

examples.text: I normally get up at six, but today I overslept.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常六点起床，但今天睡过头了。

senses.meaning_en: in a normal way

examples.text: The doctor said her heart is beating normally now.
examples.translation_cn: 医生说她的心脏现在跳动正常。

senses.meaning_en: the state of communicating with someone

examples.text: We have been in contact with the supplier by email all week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们整个星期都在通过电子邮件与供应商联系。

senses.meaning_en: the act of touching or meeting something

examples.text: The chemicals should not come into contact with bare skin.
examples.translation_cn: 这些化学品不应与裸露的皮肤接触。

senses.meaning_en: a small plastic lens placed on the eye to correct vision

examples.text: I usually wear contacts instead of glasses when I play sports.
examples.translation_cn: 我运动时通常戴隐形眼镜而不戴框架眼镜。

senses.meaning_en: a point where electrical parts touch to complete or break a circuit

examples.text: The switch has a contact point that opens the circuit when overloaded.
examples.translation_cn: 这个开关有一个触点，在过载时会断开电路。

senses.meaning_en: to communicate with someone, especially by phone or email

examples.text: You will be contacted if a spot opens.
examples.translation_cn: 如果有空位，我们会联系你。

senses.meaning_en: to buy insurance for something

examples.text: You should insure your camera against accidental damage.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该给相机投保以防意外损坏。

senses.meaning_en: to make certain that something happens

examples.text: Please insure that all doors are locked before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 离开前请确保所有门都已锁好。

senses.meaning_en: a means of protection against future loss or risk

examples.text: She bought a generator as insurance against power cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一台发电机作为停电的预防措施。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of money paid for an insurance policy

examples.text: The insurance on my car costs over $200 a month.
examples.translation_cn: 我每月的车险保费超过200美元。

senses.meaning_en: an insurance policy

examples.text: They took out insurance against fire last month.
examples.translation_cn: 他们上个月购买了火灾保险。

senses.meaning_en: the first part or earliest stage of something

examples.text: At the beginning of the year, I made a plan to save more money.
examples.translation_cn: 年初我制定了一个多存钱的计划。

senses.meaning_en: the origin or source of something

examples.text: The custom has its beginnings in ancient Egypt, according to historians.
examples.translation_cn: 据历史学家说，这种习俗起源于古埃及。

senses.meaning_en: the form or outer outline of an object

examples.text: The pool was built in the shape of a heart.
examples.translation_cn: 游泳池建成了心形。

senses.meaning_en: the condition or state of someone or something

examples.text: She is in good shape after months of training.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几个月的训练，她身体状况良好。

senses.meaning_en: to influence or determine the development of something

examples.text: Our habits are shaped by the people around us.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的习惯受到周围人的影响。

senses.meaning_en: to give money, goods, or time to help a person or organization

examples.text: Local residents contributed food and clothes to the flood victims.
examples.translation_cn: 当地居民为洪灾灾民捐献了食物和衣物。

senses.meaning_en: to be one of the causes of an event or situation

examples.text: A series of errors contributed to the company's collapse.
examples.translation_cn: 一系列错误导致了那家公司的倒闭。

senses.meaning_en: to write articles, stories, etc. for a publication

examples.text: She contributes feature articles to several national newspapers.
examples.translation_cn: 她为多家全国性报纸撰写专题文章。

senses.meaning_en: something that you give or do to help make something successful

examples.text: She made a significant contribution to medical research.
examples.translation_cn: 她对医学研究做出了重要贡献。

senses.meaning_en: money or goods given to help a person or organization

examples.text: They made a contribution of $50 to the relief fund.
examples.translation_cn: 他们向救济基金捐了50美元。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of writing or drawing published as part of a magazine, book, etc.

examples.text: Her contribution to the journal appeared in the March issue.
examples.translation_cn: 她向该期刊投的稿件刊登在三月号上。

senses.meaning_en: the act of transporting; conveyance

examples.text: The transport of goods by rail is often cheaper than by road.
examples.translation_cn: 铁路运输货物通常比公路运输便宜。

senses.meaning_en: to carry or convey from one place to another
senses.pattern: transport sth from A to B

examples.text: The trucks transport fresh fruit from farms to local markets.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车把新鲜水果从农场运到当地市场。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Africa

examples.text: Several wild animals are found only in African countries.
examples.translation_cn: 一些野生动物只在非洲国家被发现。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Africa

examples.text: As an African, she is proud of her heritage.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名非洲人，她为自己的传统感到自豪。

senses.meaning_en: money in the form of notes and coins; money in general

examples.text: We paid in cash because the card machine was broken.
examples.translation_cn: 因为刷卡机坏了，我们付了现金。

senses.meaning_en: to exchange a check/cheque for money in notes and coins

examples.text: She went to the bank to cash her paycheck.
examples.translation_cn: 她去银行把工资支票兑现。

senses.meaning_en: a time of great danger or difficulty, especially in public affairs or in a person's life

examples.text: The healthcare system is in crisis after the budget cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 预算削减后，医疗系统陷入危机。

senses.meaning_en: a decisive or crucial point; a turning point

examples.text: The peace talks came to a crisis over the border dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判因边界争端到了紧要关头。

senses.meaning_en: a person who admires and supports a person, sport, team, etc.

examples.text: I'm a big fan of this band.
examples.translation_cn: 我是这个乐队的忠实粉丝。

senses.meaning_en: an electrical device for moving air

examples.text: He switched on the fan to cool the room.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开电风扇给房间降温。

senses.meaning_en: a hand-held device for cooling oneself

examples.text: She waved a fan to cool herself in the heat.
examples.translation_cn: 她扇着扇子给自己降温。

senses.meaning_en: anything shaped like a fan

examples.text: The peacock's tail opened out like a fan.
examples.translation_cn: 孔雀的尾巴像扇子一样展开。

senses.meaning_en: a building where objects of historical, artistic, or scientific interest are kept and shown to the public

examples.text: We spent the whole afternoon looking at ancient pottery in a museum.
examples.translation_cn: 我们整个下午都在博物馆里看古代陶器。

senses.meaning_en: a long thin piece of wood, used for a purpose

examples.text: My grandmother rarely leaves the house without her walking stick.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母很少不带手杖出门。

senses.meaning_en: to push a pointed object into something

examples.text: He stuck a fork into the potato to check if it was done.
examples.translation_cn: 他把叉子插进土豆里看看熟了没有。

senses.meaning_en: to attach something with glue or another sticky substance

examples.text: She stuck the photo to the page with glue.
examples.translation_cn: 她用胶水把照片粘在页面上。

senses.meaning_en: a long thin piece of a substance, especially food or writing material

examples.text: She melted a stick of butter in the pan.
examples.translation_cn: 她在平底锅里融化了一条黄油。

senses.meaning_en: unable to move or make progress

examples.text: I got stuck on the third question.
examples.translation_cn: 我在第三题上卡住了。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow place where an animal lives

examples.text: The rabbit disappeared into its hole when it saw us.
examples.translation_cn: 兔子一看见我们就钻进了洞里。

senses.meaning_en: an opening through a solid object or surface

examples.text: He drilled a hole in the wall to hang the shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 他在墙上钻了个洞来挂架子。

senses.meaning_en: a weakness or flaw in a plan, argument, etc.

examples.text: The defense attorney found a hole in the prosecution's case.
examples.translation_cn: 辩护律师发现控方案件中有漏洞。

senses.meaning_en: a hole on a golf course

examples.text: He scored a hole in one on the ninth hole.
examples.translation_cn: 他在第九洞一杆进洞。

senses.meaning_en: happening once every year

examples.text: The club holds an annual meeting every January.
examples.translation_cn: 俱乐部每年一月举行年会。

senses.meaning_en: a publication issued once a year

examples.text: The school publishes an annual of student writing.
examples.translation_cn: 该校出版一本学生写作年刊。

senses.meaning_en: a plant that lives for one growing season

examples.text: We grow basil as an annual in this climate.
examples.translation_cn: 在这种气候下，我们把罗勒当作一年生植物种植。

senses.meaning_en: a medical checkup taken once a year

examples.text: He has an annual checkup at the clinic every June.
examples.translation_cn: 他每年六月在诊所做年度体检。

senses.meaning_en: the sense or ability of sight

examples.text: She has perfect vision and doesn't need glasses.
examples.translation_cn: 她视力很好，不需要戴眼镜。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to plan the future with imagination; a mental image of what the future could be like

examples.text: He had a vision of a fairer society.
examples.translation_cn: 他对一个更公平的社会有着愿景。

senses.meaning_en: something seen in a dream, trance, or supernatural experience; a mental image produced by the imagination

examples.text: The feverish patient had visions of strange animals.
examples.translation_cn: 那个发高烧的病人看见了奇怪的动物。

senses.meaning_en: something seen; an object perceived visually, often beautiful

examples.text: The bride was a vision of beauty in white.
examples.translation_cn: 新娘穿着白色礼服，美得像一幅画。

senses.meaning_en: to become someone's husband or wife; to enter into marriage

examples.text: She got married to a doctor she met at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她嫁给了一位她在工作中认识的医生。

senses.meaning_en: to perform the ceremony of marriage for (a couple)

examples.text: The pastor married them in a small ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师在一个简短的仪式上为他们主持了婚礼。

senses.meaning_en: to combine two different things, ideas, or qualities successfully

examples.text: The design marries traditional style with modern materials.
examples.translation_cn: 这个设计将传统风格与现代材料结合在一起。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of being in a particular place

examples.text: Please do not smoke in the presence of children.
examples.translation_cn: 请不要在孩子面前吸烟。

senses.meaning_en: the impressive quality of someone's appearance or manner

examples.text: The actor has a commanding presence on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 这位演员在舞台上有着威严的气场。

senses.meaning_en: the presence of an organization or country in an area and the influence it has there

examples.text: The company has a strong presence in the global market.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在全球市场有着强大的影响力。

senses.meaning_en: the act of protecting or the state of being protected

examples.text: Children need protection from online bullying and abuse.
examples.translation_cn: 儿童需要保护，以免遭受网络欺凌和虐待。

senses.meaning_en: a thing or measure that keeps someone or something safe

examples.text: He wore earplugs as protection against hearing damage.
examples.translation_cn: 他戴上耳塞作为防护，以免听力受损。

senses.meaning_en: a condom or other method of preventing pregnancy or disease

examples.text: They had sex without protection and later worried about pregnancy.
examples.translation_cn: 他们发生性行为时没有采取避孕措施，后来担心怀孕。

senses.meaning_en: money paid to criminals to avoid harm or attack

examples.text: The shop owner paid for protection from the local gang.
examples.translation_cn: 店主向当地帮派交纳保护费。

senses.meaning_en: at a slow pace

examples.text: She walked slowly along the shore, watching the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 她沿着海岸缓慢地走着，看着日落。

senses.meaning_en: the wife or widow of a king

examples.text: She became queen consort when her husband took the throne.
examples.translation_cn: 她丈夫即位时，她成为王后。

senses.meaning_en: a female monarch

examples.text: Elizabeth II ruled as queen for seventy years.
examples.translation_cn: 伊丽莎白二世作为女王统治了七十年。

senses.meaning_en: a woman considered the best in a particular field or activity

examples.text: She was called the queen of jazz in the 1950s.
examples.translation_cn: 20世纪50年代，她被称为爵士乐女王。

senses.meaning_en: a playing card or chess piece with the image of a queen

examples.text: He moved his queen to capture the knight.
examples.translation_cn: 他移动皇后去吃对方的马。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has control over something or someone; an owner or employer; a person who owns an animal or a slave

examples.text: He is the master of a large estate.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一座大庄园的主人。

senses.meaning_en: the captain of a merchant ship

examples.text: The master of the ship ordered the crew to lower the sails.
examples.translation_cn: 船长命令船员降下船帆。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is very skilled at something

examples.text: She is a master of traditional Chinese painting.
examples.translation_cn: 她是中国传统绘画的大师。

senses.meaning_en: a skilled worker who is qualified to teach apprentices

examples.text: After years of training, he is a master craftsman and now teaches apprentices.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年培训，他成了一名师傅，现在带学徒。

senses.meaning_en: a small round mark or stain

examples.text: There is a dark spot on the wall near the window.
examples.translation_cn: 窗户旁边的墙上有一个深色斑点。

senses.meaning_en: a particular place or area

examples.text: We found a quiet spot for a picnic by the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在湖边找到一个安静的野餐地点。

senses.meaning_en: to notice or recognize someone or something

examples.text: She spotted her son cycling along the river path.
examples.translation_cn: 她看见儿子沿着河边小路骑车。

senses.meaning_en: a pimple or small raised area on the skin

examples.text: He has a painful spot on his chin today.
examples.translation_cn: 他今天下巴上长了个很疼的痘。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of something

examples.text: Could I have a spot of milk in my coffee?
examples.translation_cn: 我的咖啡里可以加一点牛奶吗？

senses.meaning_en: a place or position available for someone in a group, activity, or schedule

examples.text: There are still two spots open in the morning class.
examples.translation_cn: 上午的课还有两个名额。

senses.meaning_en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it

examples.text: You should drink plenty of water during the hot summer months.
examples.translation_cn: 热天你应该多喝水。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid for drinking; a beverage

examples.text: We stopped at a café and had a cold drink.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一家咖啡馆停下来喝了杯冷饮。

senses.meaning_en: to drink alcohol

examples.text: He never drinks alcohol because he has to drive home.
examples.translation_cn: 他从不喝酒，因为他要开车回家。

senses.meaning_en: a result or effect of an action or condition

examples.text: As a consequence of heavy rain, the match was postponed.
examples.translation_cn: 由于大雨，比赛被推迟了。

senses.meaning_en: importance or significance

examples.text: This decision is of great consequence to the project.
examples.translation_cn: 这个决定对项目至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: far away in space or time

examples.text: The village is distant from any major city.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村庄远离任何大城市。

senses.meaning_en: not friendly or emotionally involved

examples.text: She has been distant towards her colleagues since the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 自从争吵后，她对同事们一直很冷淡。

senses.meaning_en: not closely related

examples.text: She inherited the house from a distant relative.
examples.translation_cn: 她从一位远房亲戚那里继承了这座房子。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of space between two points or things

examples.text: The distance between the two towns is only five miles.
examples.translation_cn: 这两座小镇之间的距离只有五英里。

senses.meaning_en: a place far away; the far part of a view

examples.text: From a distance, the island looks peaceful and empty.
examples.translation_cn: 从远处看，这座岛显得宁静而空旷。

senses.meaning_en: emotional or social separation; a feeling of unfriendliness

examples.text: He keeps his colleagues at a distance and never talks about his private life.
examples.translation_cn: 他与同事保持距离，从不谈论自己的私生活。

senses.meaning_en: an interval of time between events

examples.text: There is a distance of twenty years between the two wars.
examples.translation_cn: 这两场战争之间相隔二十年。

senses.meaning_en: the hard material that trees are made of

examples.text: The old bench is made of solid wood.
examples.translation_cn: 这条旧长凳是用实木做的。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land covered with trees

examples.text: We stayed in a cabin deep in the woods.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在树林深处的一间小屋里。

senses.meaning_en: wood used as fuel

examples.text: We collected wood for the fire before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 日落前我们拾了生火用的柴火。

senses.meaning_en: a type of golf club with a large head, originally made of wood

examples.text: He used a three wood to reach the green in two strokes.
examples.translation_cn: 他用三号木杆两杆攻上了果岭。

senses.meaning_en: considered in relation or proportion to something else; comparative

examples.text: The cost of housing is high relative to wages in most large cities.
examples.translation_cn: 在大多数大城市，房价相对于工资较高。

senses.meaning_en: a person connected by blood or marriage; a family member

examples.text: He stayed with a relative of his while studying in London.
examples.translation_cn: 他在伦敦学习期间住在一个亲戚家。

senses.meaning_en: compared with other similar things or with a standard

examples.text: Relatively speaking, prices here are lower than in the capital.
examples.translation_cn: 相对而言，这里的物价比首都低。

senses.meaning_en: to a fairly large degree; quite

examples.text: The new software is relatively simple to install.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新软件安装起来相当简单。

senses.meaning_en: a large motor vehicle for carrying goods

examples.text: The company delivers goods by truck across the state.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司用卡车在全州运送货物。

senses.meaning_en: a railway vehicle for carrying goods

examples.text: The boxes were stacked in a goods truck at the station.
examples.translation_cn: 箱子被堆放在车站的一节铁路货车里。

senses.meaning_en: the part of an object designed to be held in the hand when used or moved

examples.text: He turned the handle and pushed the door open.
examples.translation_cn: 他转动把手，推开了门。

senses.meaning_en: to deal with or manage a situation, problem, or person

examples.text: She handled the difficult situation with patience and skill.
examples.translation_cn: 她耐心而巧妙地处理了那个棘手的情况。

senses.meaning_en: to touch, hold, or move something with your hands

examples.text: Please handle the glass with care when you move it.
examples.translation_cn: 移动玻璃杯时请小心轻放。

senses.meaning_en: closely connected with the subject or situation

examples.text: These documents are relevant to the court case.
examples.translation_cn: 这些文件与这起诉讼有关。

senses.meaning_en: still important and useful today

examples.text: Her ideas about education remain relevant in today's world.
examples.translation_cn: 她关于教育的观点在当今世界仍然有意义。

senses.meaning_en: fast movement or the ability to move quickly

examples.text: The car was travelling at speed when it hit the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车高速行驶时撞到了墙。

senses.meaning_en: to move or happen faster, or to make something do this

examples.text: The new system will speed up the process of checking passengers.
examples.translation_cn: 新系统将加快检查旅客的流程。

senses.meaning_en: to drive a vehicle faster than the legal speed limit

examples.text: He was fined for speeding on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 他因在高速公路上超速行驶被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: the rate at which someone or something moves or happens

examples.text: The train travels at a speed of 300 kilometres per hour.
examples.translation_cn: 列车以每小时300公里的速度行驶。

senses.meaning_en: a way or course taken to get from one place to another

examples.text: We took a scenic route to the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走了一条风景优美的路线去海边。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed path followed by a bus, plane, etc.; to send along such a path

examples.text: The courier routed the package through a regional hub.
examples.translation_cn: 快递员把包裹经一个区域枢纽转运。

senses.meaning_en: a road or path, especially a highway

examples.text: We drove along a route used mainly by farmers.
examples.translation_cn: 我们开车走了一条农民主要使用的道路。

senses.meaning_en: a method or way of achieving something

examples.text: Apprenticeships offer a practical route to a trade.
examples.translation_cn: 学徒制提供了一条成为手艺人的实用途径。

senses.meaning_en: a part or share of a whole

examples.text: A proportion of first-year students live off campus.
examples.translation_cn: 一部分一年级学生住在校外。

senses.meaning_en: the correct relationship between the size, amount, or importance of different things

examples.text: Salaries should be in proportion to employees' skills and experience.
examples.translation_cn: 工资应当与员工的技能和经验相称。

senses.meaning_en: the size or extent of something, often used in the plural

examples.text: The economic crisis was of unprecedented proportions, affecting millions of workers.
examples.translation_cn: 这场经济危机规模空前，影响了数百万工人。

senses.meaning_en: thoughtful about other people's feelings, needs, and comfort

examples.text: She is always considerate of her neighbours' need for quiet.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是体贴邻居需要安静。

senses.meaning_en: a matter that must be thought about when deciding something

examples.text: A key consideration is how the change will affect local jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 一个关键因素是这一变化将如何影响当地就业。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being thoughtful and sensitive to others

examples.text: Please show consideration for people who are still working.
examples.translation_cn: 请顾及仍在工作的人。

senses.meaning_en: careful thought

examples.text: We will take your suggestions into consideration before deciding.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在作决定前会仔细考虑你的建议。

senses.meaning_en: to move by turning over and over

examples.text: The ball rolled down the hill and hit a tree.
examples.translation_cn: 球滚下山坡，撞到了一棵树。

senses.meaning_en: to wrap something around itself or into a ball

examples.text: She rolled the paper into a tight ball and threw it away.
examples.translation_cn: 她把纸揉成一个紧实的球扔掉了。

senses.meaning_en: an official list of names

examples.text: The teacher calls the roll at the beginning of class.
examples.translation_cn: 老师在上课开始时点名。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a steady wave-like motion

examples.text: Fog rolled in from the sea during the early morning.
examples.translation_cn: 清晨，雾气从海面涌来。

senses.meaning_en: to flow or trickle

examples.text: Tears rolled down her cheeks as she listened to the sad news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到这个悲伤的消息，泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。

senses.meaning_en: the second largest continent, located south of Europe

examples.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza is located in Africa.
examples.translation_cn: 吉萨大金字塔位于非洲。

senses.meaning_en: near or nearer to the end

examples.text: Rain fell in the latter part of the afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 下午后半段下雨了。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or being the second of two items

examples.text: Of the two plans, the latter is more practical.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个计划中，后者更可行。

senses.meaning_en: to come into view

examples.text: A ship emerged from the fog just before noon.
examples.translation_cn: 一艘船在中午前从雾中显现出来。

senses.meaning_en: to come out of a difficult situation

examples.text: The nation emerged from the war stronger and more united.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家从战争中走出来，变得更强、更团结。

senses.meaning_en: to become known

examples.text: It later emerged that the company had concealed the test results.
examples.translation_cn: 后来查明，该公司隐瞒了测试结果。

senses.meaning_en: a physical barrier that shelters or hides

examples.text: The nurse moved behind a screen to protect the patient's privacy.
examples.translation_cn: 护士走到屏风后面以保护患者的隐私。

senses.meaning_en: the flat surface on an electronic device where images are shown

examples.text: The chart appeared on screen almost immediately after I clicked.
examples.translation_cn: 我点击后图表几乎立刻出现在屏幕上。

senses.meaning_en: to examine or test someone or something to check if they are suitable or have a particular problem

examples.text: Doctors now screen all newborns for hearing loss.
examples.translation_cn: 医生现在为所有新生儿做听力筛查。

senses.meaning_en: to show a film, television programme, etc. to an audience

examples.text: The final episode will be screened on TV tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 最后一集将于明天在电视上播出。

senses.meaning_en: to protect or hide someone or something from view or from something harmful

examples.text: A row of trees screens the house from the road.
examples.translation_cn: 一排树遮挡了房子，使其不暴露在路边视野中。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives in a particular place

examples.text: She is a long-time resident of this neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这个街区的老住户。

senses.meaning_en: a person allowed by law to live permanently in a country

examples.text: She became a permanent resident of Australia after five years.
examples.translation_cn: 五年后她成为澳大利亚的永久居民。

senses.meaning_en: living or based in a particular place; local

examples.text: The artist is resident in Paris for the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 这位艺术家夏天常驻巴黎。

senses.meaning_en: a doctor who is receiving advanced training in a hospital, especially after finishing medical school

examples.text: She is a medical resident at Boston City Hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她是波士顿市医院的一名住院医生。

senses.meaning_en: to put something in a place where it will be out of sight or harder to discover

examples.text: She hid the old letters away in a wooden box.
examples.translation_cn: 她把旧信藏在一个木盒子里。

senses.meaning_en: to put yourself in a place where you will be out of sight or harder to find

examples.text: The frightened child hid from the strangers behind the door.
examples.translation_cn: 受惊的孩子躲在门后避开陌生人。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something secret, especially your feelings

examples.text: He tried to hide his disappointment from his wife.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图对妻子隐瞒自己的失望。

senses.meaning_en: the skin of an animal, especially when removed and processed

examples.text: The hunter sold the deer's hide at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人把鹿皮卖了。

senses.meaning_en: one's own life or personal safety, especially when in danger

examples.text: He risked his hide to rescue the trapped hiker.
examples.translation_cn: 他冒着生命危险去救被困的徒步者。

senses.meaning_en: a visible sign or symbol

examples.text: He made a small mark on the wall to show where the shelf should go.
examples.translation_cn: 他在墙上做个小标记，标明架子该放的位置。

senses.meaning_en: to make a visible sign or label on something

examples.text: The teacher asked us to mark the main points with a yellow highlighter.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们用黄色荧光笔标出要点。

senses.meaning_en: a score or grade given for work

examples.text: She got a good mark for her science project.
examples.translation_cn: 她的科学课题得了个好成绩。

senses.meaning_en: a target or standard

examples.text: Her response hit the mark and answered the question directly.
examples.translation_cn: 她的回答直中要害，直接回答了问题。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy yellow precious metal, used for jewellery and coins

examples.text: The old watch is made of pure gold.
examples.translation_cn: 这块旧表是纯金做的。

senses.meaning_en: made of gold or having the colour of gold

examples.text: He gave her a gold ring for their anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 他送给她一枚金戒指作为周年纪念。

senses.meaning_en: a deep yellow colour like gold

examples.text: The leaves turned a rich gold in autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 秋天树叶变成了浓郁的金黄色。

senses.meaning_en: gold coins or money made of gold

examples.text: They paid the ransom in gold and jewels.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用黄金和珠宝支付了赎金。

senses.meaning_en: to divide into parts

examples.text: The teacher separated the class into four groups.
examples.translation_cn: 老师把全班分成了四组。

senses.meaning_en: not together; independent

examples.text: The two issues should remain separate from each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个问题应该保持彼此独立。

senses.meaning_en: to distinguish

examples.text: It is difficult to separate fact from opinion online.
examples.translation_cn: 在网上很难区分事实和观点。

senses.meaning_en: to become divided

examples.text: The mixture quickly separates into two clear layers.
examples.translation_cn: 混合物迅速分成两层清晰的液体。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something is not true

examples.text: She denied taking the money from the office.
examples.translation_cn: 她否认从办公室拿了钱。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to give or allow something requested

examples.text: The company denied him access to the files.
examples.translation_cn: 公司拒绝让他查看文件。

senses.meaning_en: likely to work or be effective in real situations

examples.text: It isn't practical to drive to work every day.
examples.translation_cn: 每天开车上班不实际可行。

senses.meaning_en: sensible and good at dealing with real situations

examples.text: My mother is practical about solving everyday problems.
examples.translation_cn: 我母亲在解决日常问题方面很务实。

senses.meaning_en: a lesson or exam in which you do or make things rather than only write about them

examples.text: We have a practical in chemistry tomorrow morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们明天上午有化学实验考试。

senses.meaning_en: relating to practice or action rather than theory or hypothesis

examples.text: The internship helped me gain practical experience in software development.
examples.translation_cn: 实习帮助我获得了软件开发方面的实践经验。

senses.meaning_en: a natural ability that may develop

examples.text: She has the potential to become a world-class violinist.
examples.translation_cn: 她有潜力成为一名世界级小提琴家。

senses.meaning_en: possible but not yet actual

examples.text: Doctors warned patients about potential side effects of the drug.
examples.translation_cn: 医生提醒病人注意这种药的潜在副作用。

senses.meaning_en: the knowledge or ability to understand something

examples.text: She has a clear understanding of the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 她清楚了解这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion or judgement about something

examples.text: It is my understanding that the meeting is postponed.
examples.translation_cn: 我的理解是会议延期了。

senses.meaning_en: sympathy or willingness to forgive

examples.text: She listened with understanding as he talked about his failure.
examples.translation_cn: 她体谅地听他谈论自己的失败。

senses.meaning_en: showing compassion and tolerance

examples.text: She is always understanding of her colleagues' problems.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是体谅同事们的问题。

senses.meaning_en: the act or skill of pointing a weapon at a target; the ability to hit a target

examples.text: The hunter took careful aim at the deer.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人仔细瞄准了那只鹿。

senses.meaning_en: a purpose or goal; a result that you intend to achieve; a target

examples.text: The aim of the project is to reduce waste.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目的目标是减少浪费。

senses.meaning_en: to have as one's purpose or intention

examples.text: We aim to finish the project by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的目标是在周五前完成项目。

senses.meaning_en: to point or direct a weapon or object toward a target

examples.text: He aimed at the centre of the target but missed.
examples.translation_cn: 他瞄准了靶心，但没有射中。

senses.meaning_en: to direct words, actions, or products at a particular person or group

examples.text: This advertising campaign is aimed at young voters.
examples.translation_cn: 这个广告活动针对的是年轻选民。

senses.meaning_en: the possibility of harm or death; risk
senses.pattern: be in danger of doing sth

examples.text: The old bridge is in danger of collapsing.
examples.translation_cn: 这座旧桥有坍塌的危险。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that may cause harm

examples.text: Sharp tools can be a danger to small children.
examples.translation_cn: 尖锐工具可能对小孩子造成危险。

senses.meaning_en: the process of improving or developing

examples.text: She has made steady progress in her studies this term.
examples.translation_cn: 她这学期学习稳步进步。

senses.meaning_en: movement forwards or towards a place

examples.text: The expedition made little progress toward the summit because of heavy snow.
examples.translation_cn: 探险队因大雪向山顶行进缓慢。

senses.meaning_en: to develop or improve

examples.text: The disease progressed to a critical stage within weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 疾病在几周内发展到了危急阶段。

senses.meaning_en: to move forward

examples.text: The line of cars progressed slowly through the tunnel.
examples.translation_cn: 车流缓慢地穿过隧道。

senses.meaning_en: a track or way for walking, made or used by people or animals

examples.text: We walked along a narrow path through the woods.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着一条穿过树林的小路行走。

senses.meaning_en: the course or route taken; a course of action or progress

examples.text: She is on a path toward a career in medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 她正走在从医的职业道路上。

senses.meaning_en: a method or direction of proceeding

examples.text: There is no easy path to success in business.
examples.translation_cn: 在商业中没有通往成功的捷径。

senses.meaning_en: a line of characters showing the location of a file or folder in a computer system

examples.text: Enter the full path to the folder on your computer.
examples.translation_cn: 输入你电脑上文件夹的完整路径。

senses.meaning_en: to act in response to something

examples.text: Local residents reacted angrily to the proposed tax increase.
examples.translation_cn: 当地居民对拟议的增税作出了愤怒的反应。

senses.meaning_en: to undergo a chemical change

examples.text: Iron reacts with oxygen in the air to form rust.
examples.translation_cn: 铁与空气中的氧反应生成铁锈。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a chemical reaction

examples.text: You can react hydrogen with oxygen to produce water.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以使氢气与氧气反应生成水。

senses.meaning_en: to post a reaction icon or emoji on social media
senses.pattern: react to sth with an emoji

examples.text: She reacted to my photo with a heart emoji.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一颗爱心表情回应了我的照片。

senses.meaning_en: an action or statement in response to something

examples.text: His reaction to my apology was immediate and warm.
examples.translation_cn: 他对我的道歉反应迅速而热情。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical change in which substances combine or break down

examples.text: The chemical reaction between the two gases produced water.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种气体之间的化学反应生成了水。

senses.meaning_en: an icon or emoji used on social media to express a feeling about a post
senses.pattern: add a reaction to a post

examples.text: She added a heart reaction to my post about the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 她在我关于演唱会的帖子下点了一个爱心表情。

senses.meaning_en: to come together in large numbers; to move as a crowd

examples.text: Fans crowded into the stadium for the final match.
examples.translation_cn: 球迷涌入体育场观看决赛。

senses.meaning_en: a large number of people gathered together

examples.text: A crowd of tourists gathered around the palace gate.
examples.translation_cn: 一群游客聚集在宫殿门口。

senses.meaning_en: ordinary people; the general public

examples.text: She has a style that stands out from the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 她有一种与众不同的风格。

senses.meaning_en: to fill a space so that it is very full; to push many people or things into a small space

examples.text: The narrow streets were crowded with tourists on Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 周日狭窄的街道挤满了游客。

senses.meaning_en: a person who believes in Christianity

examples.text: She became a Christian after years of searching.
examples.translation_cn: 她经过多年探寻后成了一名基督徒。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Christianity or Jesus Christ

examples.text: The Christian community in the area has grown rapidly.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的基督徒群体迅速发展。

senses.meaning_en: kind, charitable; moral

examples.text: It was not very Christian of him to refuse to help.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝帮助，这不太像基督徒该有的仁慈。

senses.meaning_en: to name someone to a post or role

examples.text: The board appointed her to the position of chief editor.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会任命她为主编。

senses.meaning_en: to set or decide on a time or place for something

examples.text: The committee has appointed a time for the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会已经确定了会议时间。

senses.meaning_en: at a distance in space or time

examples.text: The two towns are only five miles apart.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个小镇相距只有五英里。

senses.meaning_en: except for; not considering

examples.text: Apart from the noise, the room is fine.
examples.translation_cn: 除了噪音，房间还不错。

senses.meaning_en: into separate pieces

examples.text: The old book fell apart in my hands.
examples.translation_cn: 这本旧书在我手里散了架。

senses.meaning_en: not together; separately

examples.text: The couple have lived apart for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 这对夫妇已经分居两年了。

senses.meaning_en: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building

examples.text: They rent an apartment downtown so they can walk to work.
examples.translation_cn: 他们租了市中心的一套公寓，以便可以步行上班。

senses.meaning_en: nothing more than; only; just

examples.text: Their victory was mere luck, not careful planning.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的胜利仅仅是运气，而不是精心策划。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize how small or unimportant something is

examples.text: He completed the puzzle in a mere ten minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 他只用了十分钟就完成了拼图。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize that something is exactly what you say and nothing more

examples.text: The mere sight of blood makes him faint.
examples.translation_cn: 仅仅看到血就让他晕倒。

senses.meaning_en: only; just and nothing more

examples.text: She merely nodded and left the room without a word.
examples.translation_cn: 她只是点了点头，一言不发地离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: ready to do something; not objecting

examples.text: She is willing to work extra hours this week.
examples.translation_cn: 她愿意本周加班。

senses.meaning_en: given or done voluntarily; not forced

examples.text: He was a willing participant in the project.
examples.translation_cn: 他是该项目中的自愿参与者。

senses.meaning_en: happening at constant intervals

examples.text: We hold team meetings on a regular basis.
examples.translation_cn: 我们定期召开团队会议。

senses.meaning_en: ordinary; usual

examples.text: I'd like a regular size, not a large one.
examples.translation_cn: 我要一个普通的尺寸，不是大号的。

senses.meaning_en: evenly arranged or shaped

examples.text: The tiles form a regular pattern across the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 瓷砖在地板上形成规则的图案。

senses.meaning_en: following the usual rules of grammar

examples.text: In English, 'walk' is an example of a regular verb.
examples.translation_cn: 在英语中，walk 是一个规则动词。

senses.meaning_en: a connection between two or more people, things, places, or ideas

examples.text: There is a clear link between smoking and heart disease.
examples.translation_cn: 吸烟与心脏病之间有明显的联系。

senses.meaning_en: one of the parts in a chain or connected series

examples.text: A single weak link in the chain can cause the whole system to fail.
examples.translation_cn: 链上的一个薄弱环节就可能导致整个系统失灵。

senses.meaning_en: a connection between documents or pages on the internet

examples.text: You can click on a link to see the full article online.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以点击链接查看完整文章。

senses.meaning_en: to connect or join two or more things or people

examples.text: The new bridge links the island to the mainland.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新桥把岛和大陆连接起来。

senses.meaning_en: a connection between buses, trains, or other transport systems

examples.text: The city has good transport links to the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市有良好的通往机场的交通连接。

senses.meaning_en: a remark or opinion

examples.text: She made a helpful comment on my essay.
examples.translation_cn: 她对我的文章发表了有帮助的评论。

senses.meaning_en: to make a remark

examples.text: The minister refused to comment on the report.
examples.translation_cn: 部长拒绝对该报告发表评论。

senses.meaning_en: a note in source code

examples.text: She added a comment to the code to clarify the logic.
examples.translation_cn: 她给代码添加了一条注解来说明逻辑。

senses.meaning_en: to say or remark (that)

examples.text: The CEO commented to reporters that the deal was still on.
examples.translation_cn: 首席执行官向记者评论说交易仍在进行。

senses.meaning_en: caused by; attributable to

examples.text: The flight delay was due to thick fog.
examples.translation_cn: 航班延误是由于浓雾。

senses.meaning_en: expected to happen or arrive at a particular time

examples.text: The next train is due to arrive at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 下一班火车预计中午到达。

senses.meaning_en: owed and payable

examples.text: The rent is due on the first of the month.
examples.translation_cn: 租金应在每月第一天支付。

senses.meaning_en: directly on a compass point

examples.text: The island is due north of the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛位于港口正北方向。

senses.meaning_en: satisfied; pleased

examples.text: He is content with his simple life in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 他对自己在乡下的简朴生活感到满足。

senses.meaning_en: the amount or constituent contained

examples.text: The sugar content of this drink is surprisingly high.
examples.translation_cn: 这种饮料的含糖量高得惊人。

senses.meaning_en: subject matter; information contained

examples.text: The two novels are similar in content and tone.
examples.translation_cn: 这两部小说在内容和语气上很相似。

senses.meaning_en: to satisfy; to make content

examples.text: He contented himself with a simple lunch and a quiet afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 他满足于一顿简单的午餐和一个安静的下午。

senses.meaning_en: to come to an end; to bring something to an end

examples.text: She concluded her speech by thanking everyone for their support.
examples.translation_cn: 她以感谢大家的支持来结束演讲。

senses.meaning_en: to decide or believe something as a result of what you have heard or seen

examples.text: Scientists concluded from the data that the climate is changing faster than expected.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家根据数据得出结论，气候变化比预期更快。

senses.meaning_en: to formally arrange or agree to something

examples.text: The two companies concluded an agreement with the government to reduce emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 两家公司与政府达成协议减少排放。

senses.meaning_en: a decision or opinion reached after considering the facts

examples.text: After reviewing the evidence, we reached the conclusion that the fire was accidental.
examples.translation_cn: 审查证据后，我们得出结论：火灾是意外。

senses.meaning_en: the end of something

examples.text: At the conclusion of the ceremony, the graduates threw their caps into the air.
examples.translation_cn: 典礼结束时，毕业生们把帽子抛向空中。

senses.meaning_en: a result or outcome

examples.text: Winning the election was a foregone conclusion for the popular governor.
examples.translation_cn: 对这位受欢迎的州长来说，赢得选举是预料中的结果。

senses.meaning_en: the formal signing or finalizing of an agreement

examples.text: The two countries celebrated the conclusion of an agreement that ended years of conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 两国庆祝了一项结束多年冲突的协议的缔结。

senses.meaning_en: a building where people are kept as punishment

examples.text: The castle once served as a prison for political prisoners.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城堡曾被用作关押政治犯的监狱。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being kept in prison

examples.text: He spent ten years in prison for bank robbery.
examples.translation_cn: 他因抢银行在监狱里度过了十年。

senses.meaning_en: a place or situation that you cannot escape from

examples.text: The small town can become a prison for young people.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇对年轻人来说可能成为牢笼。

senses.meaning_en: the leader or head of a group or organization

examples.text: The chief of police called an urgent meeting about the recent burglaries.
examples.translation_cn: 警察局长就最近的入室盗窃案召开了紧急会议。

senses.meaning_en: most important; primary

examples.text: Safety is our chief concern during the construction work.
examples.translation_cn: 安全是施工期间我们最关心的问题。

senses.meaning_en: used as an informal term of address for a man

examples.text: He always calls me chief, though I'm not his boss.
examples.translation_cn: 他总叫我“老兄”，尽管我不是他老板。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that protects or watches over something

examples.text: He works as a guard at the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 他在博物馆当警卫。

senses.meaning_en: to protect somebody or something from danger or attack

examples.text: The soldiers guard the border day and night.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们日夜守卫边境。

senses.meaning_en: to take care to prevent something unpleasant from happening

examples.text: Regular exercise helps guard against heart disease and stroke.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼有助于预防心脏病和中风。

senses.meaning_en: a squad responsible for protecting something

examples.text: She serves part-time in the National Guard on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 她周末在国民警卫队兼职服役。

senses.meaning_en: to give a written or spoken answer

examples.text: He replied to my message just a few minutes later.
examples.translation_cn: 他几分钟后就回复了我的消息。

senses.meaning_en: a written or spoken answer

examples.text: In reply to her request, he sent a detailed report.
examples.translation_cn: 作为对她请求的答复，他发了一份详细报告。

senses.meaning_en: to respond with an action or gesture

examples.text: She replied with a nod and left the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她点了点头作为回答，然后离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: a journalist who investigates and reports news stories

examples.text: My sister works as a reporter for a local news station.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在当地一家新闻台当记者。

senses.meaning_en: a person who records and issues official reports of proceedings

examples.text: She serves as the official reporter for the state legislature and publishes its debates.
examples.translation_cn: 她担任州议会的官方报告人并发布其辩论记录。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being fair and reasonable

examples.text: She has a strong sense of justice and fights for equal rights.
examples.translation_cn: 她有强烈的正义感，为平等权利而奋斗。

senses.meaning_en: the legal system used to punish people who commit crimes

examples.text: The police are determined to bring the murderer to justice.
examples.translation_cn: 警方决心将凶手绳之以法。

senses.meaning_en: a judge in a court of law, especially a higher court

examples.text: She was appointed a justice of the Supreme Court last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被任命为最高法院大法官。

senses.meaning_en: to take goods, letters, parcels, etc. to the person or place they are sent to

examples.text: The courier delivered the package to my office before noon.
examples.translation_cn: 快递员中午前把包裹送到了我的办公室。

senses.meaning_en: to help a woman give birth to a baby

examples.text: The midwife delivered a healthy baby girl at home.
examples.translation_cn: 助产士在家接生了一个健康的女婴。

senses.meaning_en: to hand over or surrender someone or something to another
senses.collocation: deliver a prisoner to the authorities

examples.text: The guards delivered the prisoner to the authorities at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 卫兵中午把囚犯移交给了当局。

senses.meaning_en: to set free from restraint or danger

examples.text: Firefighters delivered the family from the burning building.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员把一家人从着火的大楼里救了出来。

senses.meaning_en: to see or notice sb/sth, especially by watching carefully

examples.text: Scientists observed the glacier retreating over the past decade.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们观察到冰川在过去十年中退缩。

senses.meaning_en: to obey rules, laws, customs, etc.

examples.text: All players must observe the rules of the game.
examples.translation_cn: 所有运动员都必须遵守比赛规则。

senses.meaning_en: to make a remark or comment

examples.text: The critic observed that the film lacked emotional depth.
examples.translation_cn: 这位评论家评论说这部电影缺乏情感深度。

senses.meaning_en: to celebrate or keep (a holiday, anniversary, etc.)

examples.text: They observe the national holiday by holding a parade.
examples.translation_cn: 他们通过举行游行来庆祝这个全国性节日。

senses.meaning_en: acceptance that something is true or real; trust or confidence

examples.text: She has a firm belief in her own ability.
examples.translation_cn: 她对自己的能力有坚定的信心。

senses.meaning_en: something believed; an opinion or conviction

examples.text: He holds a strong belief that education should be free.
examples.translation_cn: 他坚信教育应该是免费的。

senses.meaning_en: religious faith; religious or moral convictions

examples.text: She finds strength in her belief in God.
examples.translation_cn: 她在对上帝的信仰中找到力量。

senses.meaning_en: a physical device used to make a task easier

examples.text: You'll need a sharp tool for cutting the leather.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要一把锋利的工具来切割皮革。

senses.meaning_en: anything that helps you to do or achieve something

examples.text: She uses social media as a tool for raising awareness.
examples.translation_cn: 她利用社交媒体作为提高公众意识的手段。

senses.meaning_en: behaving in an uncontrolled, excited, or noisy way

examples.text: The crowd went wild when the band came on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队上台时，人群疯狂起来。

senses.meaning_en: living in the natural environment, not kept by people

examples.text: These birds are wild and should not be kept as pets.
examples.translation_cn: 这些鸟是野生的，不应作为宠物饲养。

senses.meaning_en: the natural environment where animals and plants live

examples.text: These rare birds are seldom seen in the wild nowadays.
examples.translation_cn: 如今这些珍稀鸟类在野外很少见。

senses.meaning_en: very angry

examples.text: She was wild with anger when she saw the damage to her car.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到自己的车被损坏时怒不可遏。

senses.meaning_en: a machine used for carrying people or goods on land

examples.text: The suspects were seen leaving the area in a stolen vehicle.
examples.translation_cn: 有人看见嫌疑人开着一辆偷来的车离开该地区。

senses.meaning_en: a way of expressing ideas or achieving a result

examples.text: The novel is a vehicle for social criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说是社会批评的载体。

senses.meaning_en: to go to live permanently in a place; to make oneself comfortable

examples.text: After years of travel, they settled down in a small coastal town.
examples.translation_cn: 多年旅行后，他们在一个海滨小镇定居下来。

senses.meaning_en: to end an argument or disagreement; to resolve something

examples.text: They settled the dispute with their neighbors over the fence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们和邻居就围栏问题解决了争端。

senses.meaning_en: to pay money owed, especially a bill

examples.text: Please settle the bill before you leave the hotel.
examples.translation_cn: 离开酒店前请结账。

senses.meaning_en: to become calm, quiet, or orderly

examples.text: The children settled down after the teacher entered the room.
examples.translation_cn: 老师进房间后，孩子们安静下来。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately not listen or pay attention to somebody/something

examples.text: He ignored my advice and bought the car anyway.
examples.translation_cn: 他不理会我的建议，还是买了那辆车。

senses.meaning_en: to pretend not to notice somebody or something

examples.text: She ignored him, pretending not to see him.
examples.translation_cn: 她装作没看见他，没有理他。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to see

examples.text: My grandmother has very poor sight and wears thick glasses.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母视力很差，戴着厚厚的眼镜。

senses.meaning_en: the act of seeing someone or something

examples.text: She caught sight of her friend in the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 她在人群中瞥见了她的朋友。

senses.meaning_en: something that you see, especially something impressive or unusual

examples.text: The sunset over the mountains was a sight to behold.
examples.translation_cn: 山上的日落美不胜收。

senses.meaning_en: the result of adding several amounts together and dividing the total by the number of amounts

examples.text: We get an average of ten emails a day.
examples.translation_cn: 我们平均每天收到十封电子邮件。

senses.meaning_en: calculated as an average

examples.text: The average temperature here in July is 28°C.
examples.translation_cn: 这里七月的平均气温是28摄氏度。

senses.meaning_en: neither very good nor very bad; ordinary

examples.text: She is of average height for her age.
examples.translation_cn: 就她年龄来说，她身高一般。

senses.meaning_en: typical or normal

examples.text: The average person checks their phone many times a day.
examples.translation_cn: 普通人一天会查看手机很多次。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate or be equal to an average

examples.text: We averaged the three scores to get the final mark.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把三个分数平均得出最终成绩。

senses.meaning_en: all the money and property that a person owns, especially after death

examples.text: He left his entire estate to his two children.
examples.translation_cn: 他把全部遗产留给了两个孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of land owned by one person or organization

examples.text: He manages a large agricultural estate in the south of France.
examples.translation_cn: 他在法国南部管理着一大片农业地产。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of land in the country, usually with a large house

examples.text: They live on a country estate in Yorkshire.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在约克郡的一座乡村庄园里。

senses.meaning_en: a group of houses or factories built close together in a planned way

examples.text: She lives on a large housing estate in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她住在伦敦的一个大型住宅区。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to lead a group of people

examples.text: She showed leadership when others were afraid to act.
examples.translation_cn: 当其他人不敢行动时，她展现了领导能力。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who lead an organization

examples.text: The leadership of the company unanimously approved the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 公司领导层一致批准了这项提案。

senses.meaning_en: the state or position of being a leader

examples.text: She assumed the leadership of the party last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年接任了该党的领导职务。

senses.meaning_en: an alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice

examples.text: She poured me a glass of red wine after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后她给我倒了一杯红酒。

senses.meaning_en: a serving of wine

examples.text: The waiter brought us two red wines and two glasses of water.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员给我们端来了两杯红酒和两杯水。

senses.meaning_en: an alcoholic beverage made by fermenting other substances, producing a similar ABV

examples.text: They make wine from rice in many parts of Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 亚洲许多地方用大米酿酒。

senses.meaning_en: to entertain (someone) with wine

examples.text: The firm wined and dined its top clients at a rooftop restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 公司在屋顶餐厅设酒宴款待了最重要的客户。

senses.meaning_en: to get money for work or services

examples.text: She earns a living by selling handmade jewelry online.
examples.translation_cn: 她靠网上卖手工饰品谋生。

senses.meaning_en: to get something such as respect or trust through one's actions

examples.text: She earned the respect of her colleagues through hard work.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to get something such as a reward or praise

examples.text: Her performance earned her a promotion within six months.
examples.translation_cn: 她的表现为她在六个月内赢得了晋升。

senses.meaning_en: to achieve by being worthy of
senses.collocation: earn the right to do sth

examples.text: She earned a place on the national team.
examples.translation_cn: 她赢得了国家队的一席之地。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of adding something

examples.text: The sauce tastes better with the addition of fresh herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 加入新鲜香草后，酱汁味道更好。

senses.meaning_en: the arithmetic operation of adding numbers

examples.text: The children are learning addition and subtraction this term.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们这学期正在学习加法和减法。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is added

examples.text: The new puppy is a lovely addition to our family.
examples.translation_cn: 这只新来的小狗是我们家可爱的新成员。

senses.meaning_en: supplemental or added to something

examples.text: The maintenance fee is additional to the monthly rent.
examples.translation_cn: 维护费是在月租之外另收的。

senses.meaning_en: a small part or piece taken or given to show the quality of the whole

examples.text: We received a sample of the new wallpaper.
examples.translation_cn: 我们收到了新壁纸的样品。

senses.meaning_en: a subset of a population selected for measurement to reflect the whole

examples.text: The poll was based on a random sample of 1,000 adults.
examples.translation_cn: 这项民意调查基于1000名成年人的随机样本。

senses.meaning_en: a small quantity of food for tasting, often given free

examples.text: The supermarket was offering free samples of cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 超市当时免费提供奶酪试吃品。

senses.meaning_en: to try or test a small amount of something

examples.text: We sampled several local dishes during our trip.
examples.translation_cn: 旅途中我们品尝了几道当地菜。

senses.meaning_en: perhaps; maybe

examples.text: The flight may possibly be delayed because of the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 航班可能因暴风雨而延误。

senses.meaning_en: used in questions and negatives to emphasize impossibility or surprise, often with can/could

examples.text: How could he possibly know my new address?
examples.translation_cn: 他究竟怎么会知道我的新地址？

senses.meaning_en: very small in size or amount

examples.text: A tiny crack appeared in the old wall.
examples.translation_cn: 旧墙上出现了一条极小的裂缝。

senses.meaning_en: give food to a person or animal

examples.text: She feeds her cat before she leaves for work.
examples.translation_cn: 她上班前喂猫。

senses.meaning_en: eat, usually of animals

examples.text: Cows feed on grass in the field all day.
examples.translation_cn: 牛整天在地里吃草。

senses.meaning_en: supply a machine or system with something to be processed

examples.text: She feeds the data into the computer every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上把数据输入电脑。

senses.meaning_en: satisfy or encourage a feeling, habit, etc.

examples.text: The novel feeds his curiosity about ancient history.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说满足了他对古代史的好奇心。

senses.meaning_en: a person or organization that employs people

examples.text: The company is the largest employer of engineers in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司是该地区工程师的最大雇主。

senses.meaning_en: money that is owed

examples.text: He worked extra shifts to pay off his debts.
examples.translation_cn: 他加班加点来还清债务。

senses.meaning_en: the state of owing money

examples.text: After losing his job, he was in debt for years.
examples.translation_cn: 失业后，他多年来一直负债。

senses.meaning_en: an obligation to do something or show gratitude
senses.pattern: owe a debt of gratitude to

examples.text: I owe a debt of gratitude to my mentor for guiding me.
examples.translation_cn: 我欠导师一份感激之情，感谢他的指导。

senses.meaning_en: who a person is, especially their name and legal status

examples.text: He refused to reveal his identity to the reporters.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝向记者透露自己的身份。

senses.meaning_en: the sense of who you are or what a group is

examples.text: Moving abroad for work gradually threatened her sense of identity.
examples.translation_cn: 为工作移居国外逐渐动摇了她的认同感。

senses.meaning_en: the qualities that make someone or something different from others
senses.pattern: have an identity of one's own

examples.text: The small town has an identity of its own, unlike the suburbs.
examples.translation_cn: 这座小城有自己的特色，与郊区不同。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being exactly the same

examples.text: The two governments reached an identity of purpose on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 两国政府在气候变化问题上达成了目的一致。

senses.meaning_en: not influenced by personal feelings; based on facts

examples.text: The report tries to be objective about both sides of the debate.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告试图客观地看待辩论双方。

senses.meaning_en: a goal that you are trying to achieve

examples.text: The team worked hard to achieve its objective before the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 团队努力在截止日期前实现了目标。

senses.meaning_en: existing outside the mind; real

examples.text: The book argues that the objective world exists independently of our minds.
examples.translation_cn: 该书认为客观世界独立于我们的意识而存在。

senses.meaning_en: to a great extent; mostly

examples.text: Poor management was largely responsible for the failure.
examples.translation_cn: 管理不善是这次失败的主要原因。

senses.meaning_en: mainly; chiefly; for the most part

examples.text: The new building is mostly glass and steel.
examples.translation_cn: 新建筑主要是玻璃和钢材结构。

senses.meaning_en: usually; generally

examples.text: We mostly stay at home in the evenings.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚上通常待在家里。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to live after a dangerous event

examples.text: He survived the plane crash with only minor injuries.
examples.translation_cn: 他在飞机失事中幸存，仅受轻伤。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to live, especially in difficult conditions

examples.text: Many families survived on very little money during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机期间许多家庭靠很少的钱生存。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to exist

examples.text: The old custom survives to this day in many small towns.
examples.translation_cn: 这一古老习俗在许多小城镇留存至今。

senses.meaning_en: to live longer than someone or something

examples.text: He survived his wife by nearly twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他比妻子多活了近二十年。

senses.meaning_en: trust or firm belief in someone or something

examples.text: I have complete faith in her ability to manage the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我完全相信她能管理好这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: a system of religious belief

examples.text: Leaders of different faiths attended the peace conference.
examples.translation_cn: 不同宗教信仰的领导人出席了和平会议。

senses.meaning_en: sincerity or honesty of intention

examples.text: The committee acted in good faith when making its decision.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会在做决定时是出于善意。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a higher job or rank

examples.text: He was promoted to senior editor last week.
examples.translation_cn: 他上周被晋升为高级编辑。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage people to support or believe in something

examples.text: The campaign is designed to promote awareness of mental health.
examples.translation_cn: 该活动旨在提高人们对心理健康的认识。

senses.meaning_en: to help something develop or increase

examples.text: The policy aims to promote the development of clean energy.
examples.translation_cn: 该政策旨在促进清洁能源的发展。

senses.meaning_en: to advertise or make something more popular

examples.text: They are using social media to promote a new product.
examples.translation_cn: 他们正在使用社交媒体推广一款新产品。

senses.meaning_en: having life; alive

examples.text: All living things need water and food to survive.
examples.translation_cn: 所有生物都需要水和食物才能生存。

senses.meaning_en: a means of maintaining life; livelihood

examples.text: He makes a living by teaching English online.
examples.translation_cn: 他靠在线教英语谋生。

senses.meaning_en: true to life; lifelike

examples.text: That portrait is the living image of her grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 那幅肖像酷似她的祖母。

senses.meaning_en: in use or existing now

examples.text: Yiddish is still a living language in some communities.
examples.translation_cn: 意第绪语在一些社区仍是一种通用语言。

senses.meaning_en: continually updated; not static
senses.pattern: treat sth as a living document

examples.text: The team treats the policy manual as a living document, updating it every year.
examples.translation_cn: 团队将政策手册视为动态文件，每年更新。

senses.meaning_en: to determine how many there are

examples.text: He counted the coins on the table and found five missing.
examples.translation_cn: 他数了数桌上的硬币，发现少了五枚。

senses.meaning_en: to be important; to matter

examples.text: In any team, trust counts for more than skill.
examples.translation_cn: 在任何团队里，信任比技能更重要。

senses.meaning_en: to be considered as; to qualify as

examples.text: Does walking to work every day count as exercise?
examples.translation_cn: 每天步行上班算作锻炼吗？

senses.meaning_en: to say numbers in order

examples.text: She taught her little brother to count from one to twenty.
examples.translation_cn: 她教弟弟从一数到二十。

senses.meaning_en: the total number of people or things

examples.text: The guest count went up after we sent the invitations.
examples.translation_cn: 我们发出邀请后，客人人数增加了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns or manages a farm

examples.text: He works as a farmer and manages a large dairy farm.
examples.translation_cn: 他当农民，并经营一个大型奶牛场。

senses.meaning_en: physical harm or damage to the body

examples.text: He suffered a serious injury during the match.
examples.translation_cn: 他在比赛中受了重伤。

senses.meaning_en: damage to a person's feelings or reputation

examples.text: The remark caused deep injury to her pride.
examples.translation_cn: 那句话严重伤害了她的自尊。

senses.meaning_en: violation of a person's reputation, rights, property, or interests

examples.text: The court ruled that the policy was an injury to citizens' rights.
examples.translation_cn: 法院裁定该政策侵害了公民的权利。

senses.meaning_en: a box or parcel that is sent or delivered

examples.text: I received a package from my parents this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我收到了父母寄来的一个包裹。

senses.meaning_en: a set of related items or measures offered or proposed together

examples.text: The government announced a package of measures to cut emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 政府宣布了一揽子减排措施。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of software that can be installed

examples.text: You can install the package with a single command.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用一条命令安装这个软件包。

senses.meaning_en: to put something into a box or wrap it for sale or transport

examples.text: The company packages its products in recycled cardboard.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司用回收纸板包装其产品。

senses.meaning_en: a holiday arranged by a company at a fixed price

examples.text: We went on a package holiday to Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 我们参加了一个去希腊的包价旅游。

senses.meaning_en: despite what has just been said

examples.text: The task looked impossible; nevertheless, she finished it on time.
examples.translation_cn: 这项任务看起来不可能；尽管如此，她还是按时完成了。

senses.meaning_en: a person you work with, especially in a profession or business

examples.text: A colleague of mine recommended this restaurant for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我的一位同事推荐了这家餐厅吃午饭。

senses.meaning_en: not simple or easy; complicated

examples.text: The tax system is too complex to understand without help.
examples.translation_cn: 这个税务系统太复杂，没有帮助很难理解。

senses.meaning_en: made up of many connected parts or elements; composite

examples.text: The brain is a complex network of neurons.
examples.translation_cn: 大脑是一个由神经元构成的复杂网络。

senses.meaning_en: a group of buildings or facilities with a common purpose

examples.text: The hospital is a complex of buildings linked by glass walkways.
examples.translation_cn: 这座医院是由玻璃通道连接的一组建筑。

senses.meaning_en: people in general

examples.text: Some folks say that the old market will close next year.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人说旧市场明年要关门了。

senses.meaning_en: one's relatives, especially parents

examples.text: I'm going to visit my folks in Chicago this weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我这个周末要去芝加哥看望父母。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the traditional art or culture of a community

examples.text: The town hosts a folk music festival every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天举办一场民间音乐节。

senses.meaning_en: not possible; not able to be done or happen

examples.text: It is impossible to prove that claim without solid evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 没有确凿证据，那个说法不可能得到证实。

senses.meaning_en: very difficult to deal with or tolerate

examples.text: The traffic in the city center is impossible to deal with.
examples.translation_cn: 市中心的交通简直难以对付。

senses.meaning_en: something that cannot happen or be done

examples.text: She achieved the impossible by finishing the marathon in under three hours.
examples.translation_cn: 她在三小时内跑完马拉松，完成了不可能的事。

senses.meaning_en: to bring or come together in one place

examples.text: Emergency supplies were concentrated in the school hall.
examples.translation_cn: 应急物资集中存放在学校礼堂里。

senses.meaning_en: to make a liquid thicker and stronger by removing water

examples.text: The fruit juice is concentrated into a thick syrup.
examples.translation_cn: 果汁被浓缩成浓糖浆。

senses.meaning_en: to give all your attention to something

examples.text: I couldn't concentrate on my homework because of the noise.
examples.translation_cn: 因为噪音，我无法专心做家庭作业。
