senses.meaning_en: very sure of something

examples.text: We are confident of a successful outcome in this project.
examples.translation_cn: 我们对这个项目的成功结果有把握。

senses.meaning_en: self-assured, sure of oneself

examples.text: You should be confident in yourself during the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 你在求职面试时应该自信。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of trust in your own abilities or judgment

examples.text: She answered all the interview questions with confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 她自信地回答了所有面试问题。

senses.meaning_en: belief that someone or something is reliable, good, or honest

examples.text: Many voters have lost confidence in the government.
examples.translation_cn: 许多选民对政府失去了信任。

senses.meaning_en: a secret or private matter told to someone

examples.text: She told me the news in confidence during lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午饭时她私下把消息告诉了我。

senses.meaning_en: to raise something to a higher position

examples.text: He lifted the heavy box onto the table.
examples.translation_cn: 他把那个重箱子抬到了桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that carries people or goods between floors

examples.text: We went up in the lift to the tenth floor.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘电梯上到十楼。

senses.meaning_en: a free ride in a vehicle

examples.text: Could you give me a lift to the station?
examples.translation_cn: 你能让我搭车去车站吗？

senses.meaning_en: to remove or end a ban or restriction

examples.text: The government finally lifted the ban on imported beef.
examples.translation_cn: 政府终于解除了进口牛肉禁令。

senses.meaning_en: to make pressure, stress, etc. less heavy

examples.text: A pay rise would lift the pressure on many families.
examples.translation_cn: 加薪将减轻许多家庭的压力。

senses.meaning_en: for the most part; chiefly

examples.text: The concert was cancelled mainly because of the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会主要因为暴风雨而取消。

senses.meaning_en: the line dividing two countries or regions
senses.pattern: the border between A and B

examples.text: The border between the two countries is marked by a stone wall.
examples.translation_cn: 两国之间的边界由一道石墙标示。

senses.meaning_en: a decorative strip along an edge

examples.text: She decorated the card with a border of flowers.
examples.translation_cn: 她给卡片装饰了一圈花边。

senses.meaning_en: to share a border with; be next to

examples.text: France is bordered by Germany to the east and Belgium to the north.
examples.translation_cn: 法国东接德国，北接比利时。

senses.meaning_en: the outer edge of something

examples.text: A narrow path runs along the border of the field.
examples.translation_cn: 一条小路沿着田地的边缘延伸。

senses.meaning_en: a strip of ground planted with flowers

examples.text: They planted tulips in the border beside the lawn.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在草坪边的花坛里种了郁金香。

senses.meaning_en: to collect or come together; to bring parts of a whole closer

examples.text: She gathered the scattered papers together before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 她离开前把散落的文件收拢到一起。

senses.meaning_en: to infer or conclude; to know from a different source

examples.text: I gather from the report that sales have fallen.
examples.translation_cn: 我从报告推断销售额下降了。

senses.meaning_en: to gain or win

examples.text: The campaign gradually gathered momentum on social media.
examples.translation_cn: 该运动在社交媒体上逐渐获得势头。

senses.meaning_en: a restriction on the amount or size of something

examples.text: There is a strict limit on the number of passengers.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客人数有严格的限制。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something within a particular amount or range

examples.text: The number of tickets is limited to two per person.
examples.translation_cn: 每人限购两张票。

senses.meaning_en: the furthest point or edge of something; a border

examples.text: The fence marks the limits of the property.
examples.translation_cn: 栅栏标出了这块地皮的边界。

senses.meaning_en: the value that a sequence converges to

examples.text: Find the limit of the sequence as n approaches infinity.
examples.translation_cn: 求当 n 趋近于无穷时该序列的极限。

senses.meaning_en: to go from one side of something to the other

examples.text: Men in uniform helped children cross the street safely.
examples.translation_cn: 穿制服的男子帮助孩子们安全地穿过马路。

senses.meaning_en: angry or annoyed

examples.text: She was cross with me for forgetting her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 她因为我忘了她的生日而生气。

senses.meaning_en: a shape made of two straight lines crossing each other; an object in this shape used as a symbol of Christianity
senses.pattern: in the shape of a cross

examples.text: The badge was in the shape of a cross.
examples.translation_cn: 那枚徽章呈十字形。

senses.meaning_en: the sign of the cross
senses.pattern: make the sign of the cross

examples.text: The priest made the sign of the cross over the coffin.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师在棺木上方划了十字圣号。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult situation that you must bear

examples.text: Her painful memories became a cross to bear for years.
examples.translation_cn: 痛苦的回忆多年来成了她必须背负的苦难。

senses.meaning_en: a person who visits someone else or a place, especially as a guest

examples.text: We had a visitor from Japan at our house yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 昨天我们家来了一位来自日本的访客。

senses.meaning_en: an extraterrestrial being visiting Earth

examples.text: The movie is about a visitor from another planet who lands on Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影讲述一个来自另一星球的外星访客降落地球的故事。

senses.meaning_en: an official visitor who inspects the management of an institution

examples.text: An official visitor to the prison will arrive next week.
examples.translation_cn: 监狱的官方视察员下周到达。

senses.meaning_en: a team playing away from home

examples.text: We were the visitors at the stadium and the crowd was hostile.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在体育场作客队，观众很不友好。

senses.meaning_en: a promise or firm decision to do something
senses.pattern: make a commitment to do sth

examples.text: The government made a commitment to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 政府承诺减少碳排放。

senses.meaning_en: sincere belief in and support for an idea or cause

examples.text: Her deep commitment to free speech made her a powerful voice for reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她对言论自由的信奉使她成为改革的有力声音。

senses.meaning_en: willingness to work hard and give time and energy to something you believe in

examples.text: He showed great commitment to serving his local community.
examples.translation_cn: 他表现出对服务当地社区的极大投入。

senses.meaning_cn: 已承诺的事项；约定；安排
senses.meaning_en: a thing that you have promised or arranged to do, especially one that takes up your time

examples.text: I have another commitment at 4 p.m.
examples.translation_cn: 我下午四点另有安排。

senses.meaning_en: added to; combined with

examples.text: The teacher asked what three plus four equals.
examples.translation_cn: 老师问三加四等于多少。

senses.meaning_en: as well as; in addition to

examples.text: The final bill was $120 plus tax and a tip.
examples.translation_cn: 最终账单是120美元，外加税费和小费。

senses.meaning_en: the symbol +

examples.text: The teacher told us to mark each correct answer with a plus.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们在每个正确答案旁标上加号。

senses.meaning_en: an advantage; a positive quality

examples.text: Being bilingual is definitely a plus in this job.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个工作中，会双语无疑是一个优势。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of space that an object or substance fills

examples.text: Scientists measured the volume of the gas released during the reaction.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家测量了反应中释放出气体的体积。

senses.meaning_en: the strength of sound; how loud it is

examples.text: She played music at full volume late into the night.
examples.translation_cn: 她把音乐开到最大声直到深夜。

senses.meaning_en: a single book, especially one of a set

examples.text: The first volume of the encyclopedia contains 800 pages.
examples.translation_cn: 这套百科全书的第一卷有800页。

senses.meaning_en: a complete set of a periodical's issues over one year

examples.text: The library has a bound volume of the journal for 2005.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆藏有该期刊2005年的合订本。

senses.meaning_en: to state firmly that something is true

examples.text: She insisted that she had done nothing wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 她坚持说自己没做错任何事。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of making laws

examples.text: The government introduced legislation to ban smoking in public places.
examples.translation_cn: 政府提出了禁止在公共场所吸烟的立法。

senses.meaning_en: a law or set of laws passed by a government

examples.text: A new piece of legislation protects consumers from hidden fees.
examples.translation_cn: 一项新法规保护消费者免受隐藏费用。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which something is done or happens

examples.text: All applications must be submitted in a timely manner.
examples.translation_cn: 所有申请都必须及时提交。

senses.meaning_en: the way a person behaves towards others

examples.text: He has a calm and friendly manner with patients.
examples.translation_cn: 他对病人态度平静友好。

senses.meaning_en: polite behaviour; good social conduct

examples.text: She has good manners and treats everyone with respect.
examples.translation_cn: 她很有礼貌，尊重每一个人。

senses.meaning_en: sort; kind

examples.text: The market sells all manner of fresh fruit and vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 市场出售各种新鲜水果和蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a view or picture that is behind the main things

examples.text: The old house stood in the background of the photo.
examples.translation_cn: 老房子位于照片的背景中。

senses.meaning_en: a person's education, experience, or social class

examples.text: She has a strong background in mathematics and physics.
examples.translation_cn: 她在数学和物理方面有很强的背景。

senses.meaning_en: less important or less noticeable

examples.text: The café played soft background music all evening.
examples.translation_cn: 咖啡馆整晚播放着轻柔的背景音乐。

senses.meaning_en: information relevant to the current situation about past events; history

examples.text: The article explains the background to the conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章解释了这场冲突的背景。

senses.meaning_en: to open out or unfold something so it covers an area

examples.text: She spread the large map out on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她在桌上摊开那张大地图。

senses.meaning_en: to make something widely known or present

examples.text: Mosquitoes can spread the disease to humans quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 蚊子能迅速将这种疾病传播给人类。

senses.meaning_en: to scatter or distribute over an area

examples.text: The farmer spread seeds across the field every spring.
examples.translation_cn: 每年春天农民在田地里撒种。

senses.meaning_en: to become widely known or present

examples.text: The news spread quickly through the small town.
examples.translation_cn: 消息很快在小镇上传开了。

senses.meaning_en: a team sport played with a bat and ball

examples.text: My brother and I play baseball in the local park on Sundays.
examples.translation_cn: 我和弟弟每周日在当地公园打棒球。

senses.meaning_en: a variant of poker in which cards with baseball-related values have special significance

examples.text: We played a hand of baseball after dinner, using a deck of cards.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚饭后玩了一局棒球扑克，用的是一副纸牌。

senses.meaning_en: the ball used in baseball

examples.text: He threw the baseball to me across the yard.
examples.translation_cn: 他把棒球从院子那边扔给我。

senses.meaning_en: the act of entering

examples.text: The protesters gained entry into the building through a side door.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议者从侧门进入了那栋大楼。

senses.meaning_en: a door or opening used to enter

examples.text: Visitors should use the side entry to the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 参观者应从博物馆的侧门进入。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of information recorded in a list, dictionary, or database

examples.text: Each entry in the list includes a brief description.
examples.translation_cn: 列表中的每条记录都包含简短说明。

senses.meaning_en: permission to enter

examples.text: He was denied entry to the club because he was wearing shorts.
examples.translation_cn: 他因穿短裤被拒绝进入俱乐部。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that converts energy into motion

examples.text: The engine started immediately in the cold weather.
examples.translation_cn: 在寒冷的天气里，发动机立即启动了。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that makes something happen

examples.text: Small businesses are the engine of the local economy.
examples.translation_cn: 小企业是当地经济的驱动力。

senses.meaning_en: a self-powered vehicle for pulling railway cars

examples.text: A railway engine pulled the long freight train across the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆铁路机车拉着长长的货运列车穿过大桥。

senses.meaning_en: not hard; easily giving way under pressure

examples.text: The ground feels soft after the heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨过后地面很软。

senses.meaning_en: smooth and not rough or harsh

examples.text: The cashmere scarf is soft to the touch.
examples.translation_cn: 这条羊绒围巾触感柔滑。

senses.meaning_en: quiet and gentle in sound

examples.text: She spoke in a soft voice so as not to wake the baby.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒宝宝。

senses.meaning_en: gentle; not strong or violent

examples.text: She handled the newborn with a soft touch.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻柔地抱着新生儿。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing or displaying things

examples.text: The plates are kept in a cabinet above the sink.
examples.translation_cn: 盘子存放在水槽上方的柜子里。

senses.meaning_en: a group of senior ministers or advisers

examples.text: She served in the cabinet as finance minister.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾担任内阁财政部长。

senses.meaning_en: to show how to use or do something

examples.text: The instructor demonstrated how to use the new software step by step.
examples.translation_cn: 教练逐步演示了如何使用新软件。

senses.meaning_en: to prove or show by reasoning or evidence

examples.text: The results demonstrate that regular exercise reduces the risk of heart disease.
examples.translation_cn: 结果表明定期锻炼能降低心脏病风险。

senses.meaning_en: to display a skill, quality, or feeling
senses.pattern: demonstrate an ability to do sth

examples.text: She demonstrated an ability to stay calm under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 她在压力下表现出保持冷静的能力。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in a public protest

examples.text: Hundreds of students demonstrated against the new tuition fees.
examples.translation_cn: 数百名学生示威反对新学费。

senses.meaning_en: the act of introducing one person to another, or a formal letter or presentation that does this

examples.text: Our host gave us a brief introduction to the other guests.
examples.translation_cn: 主人把我们简要地介绍给了其他客人。

senses.meaning_en: an initial section of a book or article that introduces the subject

examples.text: The author explains her methods in the introduction to the book.
examples.translation_cn: 作者在书的序言中解释了方法。

senses.meaning_en: the act of bringing something into use or operation for the first time

examples.text: The introduction of new technology improved work efficiency.
examples.translation_cn: 新技术的引进提高了工作效率。

senses.meaning_en: a written or oral explanation that gives the basic ideas of a subject

examples.text: The book serves as a general introduction to genetics.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书可作为遗传学的入门读物。

senses.meaning_en: at an earlier time; before now

examples.text: The species was previously thought to be extinct.
examples.translation_cn: 该物种曾被认为已灭绝。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce a recap of previous episodes in a series

examples.text: Previously on the show, the detective found a new clue.
examples.translation_cn: 在上集节目中，侦探找到了一条新线索。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the home

examples.text: They share the domestic duties equally, from cooking to cleaning.
examples.translation_cn: 他们平均分担家务，从做饭到打扫。

senses.meaning_en: kept by humans as a pet or farm animal

examples.text: Goats are kept as domestic animals for their milk.
examples.translation_cn: 山羊被作为家养动物饲养以获取羊奶。

senses.meaning_en: internal to a specific country; not foreign

examples.text: The report compares domestic and foreign sales figures.
examples.translation_cn: 报告比较了国内和国外的销售数据。

senses.meaning_en: enjoying staying at home; not outgoing

examples.text: He's not very domestic; he'd rather go to a club than stay at home.
examples.translation_cn: 他不太居家；他宁愿去俱乐部也不愿待在家里。

senses.meaning_en: to kill somebody unlawfully and deliberately

examples.text: He murdered his business partner for the insurance money.
examples.translation_cn: 他为了保险金谋杀了他的商业伙伴。

senses.meaning_en: the crime of killing somebody unlawfully and deliberately

examples.text: She was charged with murder after the police found the weapon.
examples.translation_cn: 警方找到凶器后，她被控谋杀罪。

senses.meaning_en: something very difficult or unpleasant to endure

examples.text: Carrying those boxes upstairs was murder on my knees.
examples.translation_cn: 把那些箱子搬上楼真是让我的膝盖难受极了。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat somebody completely, especially in sport

examples.text: We absolutely murdered the opposition in the second half.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在下半场彻底击败了对手。

senses.meaning_en: a system of faith and worship based on belief in a god or gods

examples.text: She follows a religion that requires daily prayer and fasting.
examples.translation_cn: 她信奉一种要求每日祈祷和斋戒的宗教。

senses.meaning_en: a pursuit or interest followed with great devotion

examples.text: He makes a religion of keeping fit and never misses a workout.
examples.translation_cn: 他把健身当作一种狂热爱好，从不缺练。

senses.meaning_en: to like one thing better than another

examples.text: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我早上更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: to choose one thing rather than another
senses.pattern: prefer to do rather than do
senses.collocation: prefer to drive rather than walk

examples.text: I prefer to stay at home rather than go out tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，也不愿出去。

senses.meaning_en: to present or submit charges to an authority

examples.text: The police will prefer charges against the driver.
examples.translation_cn: 警方将对司机提出控告。

senses.meaning_en: to attract and hold someone's attention or interest

examples.text: The opening chapter immediately engages the reader's attention.
examples.translation_cn: 开篇一章立刻吸引了读者的注意力。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in something; to be involved in an activity

examples.text: The two governments agreed to engage in peace talks.
examples.translation_cn: 两国政府同意举行和平谈判。

senses.meaning_en: to employ someone to do a particular job

examples.text: The firm engaged an expert to review its security.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司聘请了一位专家来审查其安全状况。

senses.meaning_en: to interact socially

examples.text: She engaged me in conversation about the project.
examples.translation_cn: 她和我攀谈起了这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: normal; customary; routine

examples.text: In ordinary circumstances, the library closes at six.
examples.translation_cn: 在通常情况下，图书馆六点关门。

senses.meaning_en: having no special features; everyday, common, mundane

examples.text: He's just an ordinary guy with no special talents.
examples.translation_cn: 他只是一个没有特殊才能的普通人。

senses.meaning_en: farthest or outermost

examples.text: They live in the extreme north of the country.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在这个国家的最北端。

senses.meaning_en: very great in degree; intense

examples.text: The hikers suffered from extreme heat during the climb.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者在攀登过程中遭受酷热。

senses.meaning_en: drastic or of great severity

examples.text: They took extreme measures to deal with the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 他们采取严厉措施应对危机。

senses.meaning_en: far beyond what is usual or reasonable; not moderate

examples.text: He holds extreme views on immigration and refuses to change.
examples.translation_cn: 他对移民持极端看法，不肯改变。

senses.meaning_en: to an extreme degree

examples.text: She was extremely tired after the long journey.
examples.translation_cn: 长途旅行后她极其疲惫。

examples.text: The robbers threatened the banker with a gun.
examples.translation_cn: 劫匪用枪威胁银行家。

examples.text: The dam threatened to burst after days of heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 连日大雨后，大坝随时可能决堤。

examples.text: The oil spill threatens the survival of many marine species.
examples.translation_cn: 石油泄漏危及许多海洋物种的生存。

senses.meaning_en: the good feeling you have when something bad stops or does not happen

examples.text: She felt a great sense of relief when the results came back negative.
examples.translation_cn: 当检查结果出来呈阴性时，她感到如释重负。

senses.meaning_en: money, food, or help given to people who need it

examples.text: The charity provides relief for families made homeless by the floods.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构为因洪水而无家可归的家庭提供救济。

senses.meaning_en: a reduction in pain, tax, or a heavy burden

examples.text: This cream offers fast relief from muscle pain after exercise.
examples.translation_cn: 运动后，这种药膏能快速缓解肌肉疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: a person or group that takes over a shift or duty from another

examples.text: He acted as relief for the exhausted nurse.
examples.translation_cn: 他为那名筋疲力尽的护士替班。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the internal mechanics of a market rather than more basic factors

examples.text: Technical analysis focuses on price patterns rather than company profits.
examples.translation_cn: 技术分析关注价格形态而非公司利润。

senses.meaning_en: involving specialized knowledge or language; specifically related to a particular discipline

examples.text: The manual is too technical for beginners to follow.
examples.translation_cn: 这本手册对初学者来说太专业，难以看懂。

senses.meaning_en: of or related to technology

examples.text: We provide free technical support for all our software users.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为所有软件用户提供免费技术支持。

senses.meaning_en: in the strictest sense, but not practically or meaningfully

examples.text: In a technical sense, the deal was legal, but many regarded it as unfair.
examples.translation_cn: 严格来说，这笔交易是合法的，但许多人认为它不公平。

senses.meaning_en: to give something formally or legally, especially as a response to a request

examples.text: The university granted her a full scholarship for her excellent grades.
examples.translation_cn: 大学因她成绩优异授予她全额奖学金。

senses.meaning_en: a sum of money given by a government or organization for a particular purpose

examples.text: She applied for a government grant to restore the old bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 她申请了一笔政府拨款来修复这座老桥。

senses.meaning_en: to admit that something is true, often when you are also saying something else

examples.text: I grant you that the plan is risky, but it is still worth trying.
examples.translation_cn: 我承认这个计划有风险，但仍值得一试。

senses.meaning_en: having qualities or features typically associated with women or girls

examples.text: Her female intuition told her that something was wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 她的女性直觉告诉她出事了。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the sex that can produce eggs or give birth to young

examples.text: The company hired more female engineers this year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司今年雇用了更多女工程师。

senses.meaning_en: a female person or animal

examples.text: Both males and females took part in the study.
examples.translation_cn: 男性和女性都参加了这项研究。

senses.meaning_en: unusual or surprising; difficult to understand

examples.text: It is strange that the house was completely silent.
examples.translation_cn: 奇怪的是，房子里一片寂静。

senses.meaning_en: not familiar; not known or experienced before

examples.text: The city was strange to me at first, but now it feels like home.
examples.translation_cn: 起初这座城市对我来说很陌生，但现在感觉像家一样。

senses.meaning_en: a young man; a male adolescent or young adult

examples.text: A youth was seen running from the building.
examples.translation_cn: 有人看见一个男青年从大楼里跑出来。

senses.meaning_en: the period of life when a person is young

examples.text: In her youth, she traveled across Asia by train.
examples.translation_cn: 她年轻时乘火车游历了亚洲。

senses.meaning_en: young people considered as a group

examples.text: The youth of today face many social pressures.
examples.translation_cn: 当今的年轻人面临许多社会压力。

senses.meaning_en: the quality or state of being young

examples.text: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you retain your youth.
examples.translation_cn: 健康的饮食和经常锻炼有助于保持青春。

senses.meaning_en: to do or say something again

examples.text: Could you repeat what you just said about the meeting?
examples.translation_cn: 你能重复一下你刚才关于会议说的话吗？

senses.meaning_en: to say something again, especially after another person

examples.text: The teacher asked us to repeat the new words after her.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们跟着她读这些生词。

senses.meaning_en: a programme that is broadcast again, or an event that happens again

examples.text: Tonight's show is a repeat of last week's episode.
examples.translation_cn: 今晚的节目是上周那一集的重播。

senses.meaning_en: to move your hand from side to side, especially to greet someone or say goodbye

examples.text: He waved to his neighbors as he drove past.
examples.translation_cn: 他开车经过时向邻居们挥手。

senses.meaning_en: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of a sea or lake

examples.text: The children surfed the waves until the sun went down.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们冲浪直到太阳下山。

senses.meaning_en: a form of energy such as sound or light that travels through air, water, or space

examples.text: Sound waves travel faster in water than in air.
examples.translation_cn: 声波在水中的传播速度比在空气中快。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden increase in a particular feeling or activity, often spreading through a group

examples.text: A wave of panic spread through the crowd when the lights went out.
examples.translation_cn: 灯光熄灭时，人群中蔓延开一阵恐慌。

senses.meaning_en: to move back and forth repeatedly and loosely, especially in the wind

examples.text: The flags waved in the wind during the parade.
examples.translation_cn: 游行期间旗帜在风中飘扬。

senses.meaning_en: to control or direct according to rule, principle, or law

examples.text: The government regulates the banking industry to protect consumers.
examples.translation_cn: 政府监管银行业以保护消费者。

senses.meaning_en: to adjust a mechanism for accurate and proper functioning

examples.text: This valve regulates the flow of water into the tank.
examples.translation_cn: 这个阀门调节流入水箱的水量。

senses.meaning_en: the act of regulating or the condition of being regulated

examples.text: Government regulation of the food industry is carried out by a federal agency.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对食品行业的监管由一个联邦机构执行。

senses.meaning_en: a law or administrative rule that guides or prescribes conduct

examples.text: All factories must comply with strict safety regulations.
examples.translation_cn: 所有工厂必须遵守严格的安全法规。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the original people of a region

examples.text: The museum displays art from native peoples of the region.
examples.translation_cn: 该博物馆展出了该地区土著人民的艺术。

senses.meaning_en: that you are born with

examples.text: She showed native intelligence when she solved the puzzle quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 她解谜很快，显示出与生俱来的聪慧。

senses.meaning_en: growing naturally in a place

examples.text: The giant panda is native to the mountains of China.
examples.translation_cn: 大熊猫原产于中国山区。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the place of your birth or your first language

examples.text: Although he lives abroad, he still dreams in his native language.
examples.translation_cn: 虽然他住在国外，他仍然用母语做梦。

senses.meaning_en: general; not detailed

examples.text: The speaker outlined the plan in broad terms.
examples.translation_cn: 发言人概括地介绍了该计划。

senses.meaning_en: wide

examples.text: The river is two metres broad at this point.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河在这里有两米宽。

senses.meaning_en: covering a wide range

examples.text: The course covers a broad range of topics.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

senses.meaning_en: clear; obvious; open

examples.text: The robbery took place in broad daylight near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 抢劫发生在车站附近的光天化日之下。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated per hour

examples.text: He works long hours to earn a wage.
examples.translation_cn: 他长时间工作以挣取一份工资。

senses.meaning_en: to conduct or carry out (a war or other contest)

examples.text: The government is waging a campaign against smoking.
examples.translation_cn: 政府正在开展反对吸烟的运动。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; very impressive

examples.text: It was wonderful to see the whole family together at the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 在婚礼上看到全家人聚在一起真是太好了。

senses.meaning_en: a line of things or people, or a line of cells in a table

examples.text: A row of poplar trees lined the quiet street.
examples.translation_cn: 一排杨树排列在安静的街道两旁。

senses.meaning_en: to move a boat through water using oars

examples.text: We rowed across the lake in a small boat.
examples.translation_cn: 我们划小船穿过了湖。

senses.meaning_en: to gain or learn something, especially through effort

examples.text: She acquired basic cooking skills from her grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 她从祖母那里学会了基本的烹饪技能。

senses.meaning_en: to buy or obtain a company or property

examples.text: The firm acquired a smaller company last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司去年收购了一家较小的公司。

senses.meaning_en: to gradually develop a habit or taste

examples.text: He acquired a taste for classical music in college.
examples.translation_cn: 他在大学时养成了对古典音乐的爱好。

senses.meaning_en: to become affected with an illness

examples.text: Patients can acquire an infection during a long surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 患者在长时间手术期间可能受到感染。

senses.meaning_en: a set of matching jacket and trousers or skirt, especially for business or formal occasions

examples.text: He wore a grey suit to the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿着灰色西装去参加工作面试。

senses.meaning_en: a set of clothing designed for a particular activity or purpose

examples.text: Astronauts must wear a space suit to survive outside the spacecraft.
examples.translation_cn: 宇航员必须穿太空服才能在航天器外生存。

senses.meaning_en: a legal case brought to a court

examples.text: The company filed a suit against its former employee for leaking secrets.
examples.translation_cn: 公司对泄露机密的前雇员提起诉讼。

senses.meaning_en: a complete set of metal armour worn in the past

examples.text: The knight stood in a suit of armour at the castle gate.
examples.translation_cn: 那名骑士身穿一套盔甲站在城堡门口。

senses.meaning_en: a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something

examples.text: From the customer's perspective, the new pricing is unfair.
examples.translation_cn: 从顾客的角度看，新定价不公平。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to think about a situation in a reasonable way without exaggerating its importance

examples.text: Talking to others helped him put his problems in perspective.
examples.translation_cn: 与别人交谈帮助他正确看待自己的问题。

senses.meaning_en: in a fair and just manner

examples.text: We must ensure that all workers are treated fairly.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须确保所有工人都受到公平对待。

senses.meaning_en: to a moderately high degree

examples.text: The exam was fairly easy, but a few questions were tricky.
examples.translation_cn: 考试相当容易，但有几道题很难。

senses.meaning_en: to build or form something by assembling parts

examples.text: The workers constructed the hall from local timber and stone.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们用当地的木材和石头建造了大厅。

senses.meaning_en: to form (a sentence, an argument, etc.) by arranging words or ideas

examples.text: He constructed a logical argument to support his view.
examples.translation_cn: 他构建了一个合乎逻辑的论据来支持自己的观点。

senses.meaning_en: a concept or model

examples.text: Their model is a theoretical construct, not a direct observation.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的模型是一个理论构想，而不是直接观察。

senses.meaning_en: the process of building or making something

examples.text: The new hospital is under construction and will open next year.
examples.translation_cn: 新医院正在建设中，将于明年开业。

senses.meaning_en: the way something is built or made

examples.text: The machine is of solid metal construction and very heavy.
examples.translation_cn: 这台机器是坚固的金属结构，非常重。

senses.meaning_en: the business or work of building structures

examples.text: My uncle works in construction and often travels to different sites.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔从事建筑行业，经常去不同的工地。

senses.meaning_en: a group of words arranged as a grammatical unit

examples.text: In a passive construction, the object of the active verb becomes the subject.
examples.translation_cn: 在被动结构中，主动动词的宾语变为主语。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; of very high quality

examples.text: She is excellent at explaining difficult ideas clearly.
examples.translation_cn: 她善于把难懂的观点讲清楚。

senses.meaning_en: used to express approval or pleasure

examples.text: “Excellent!” said the coach after the final whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 终场哨响后，教练说：“好极了！”

senses.meaning_en: smart; quick to learn and understand
senses.pattern: be intelligent enough to do sth

examples.text: My sister is intelligent enough to solve difficult math problems.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹足够聪明，能解决困难的数学问题。

senses.meaning_en: able to store and process information and respond to it, often like a human
senses.pattern: an intelligent system can do sth

examples.text: This intelligent system can learn from user behavior.
examples.translation_cn: 这个智能系统能从用户行为中学习。

senses.meaning_en: well thought-out; showing good judgment and careful thought

examples.text: She made an intelligent decision by saving money for the future.
examples.translation_cn: 她做了明智的决定，为未来存钱。

senses.meaning_en: having at least a similar level of brain power to humankind

examples.text: Scientists are searching for intelligent life beyond Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家正在寻找地球以外的智慧生命。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to learn, understand, and think logically
senses.pattern: have the intelligence to do sth

examples.text: Not everyone has the intelligence to grasp abstract mathematical concepts.
examples.translation_cn: 不是每个人都有理解抽象数学概念的智力。

senses.meaning_en: a being with the ability to learn and understand

examples.text: The robot is an intelligence capable of adapting to new tasks.
examples.translation_cn: 这台机器人是一种能够适应新任务的智能体。

senses.meaning_en: secret information about an enemy or hostile activities

examples.text: Agents were sent to gather intelligence on the enemy's movements.
examples.translation_cn: 特工被派去收集敌军动向的情报。

senses.meaning_en: to damage beyond repair or use; to put an end to

examples.text: The fire destroyed the old factory last night.
examples.translation_cn: 大火昨晚摧毁了那座旧工厂。

senses.meaning_en: to ruin (someone's life, career, etc.)

examples.text: The scandal completely destroyed his career in politics.
examples.translation_cn: 这场丑闻彻底毁掉了他的政治事业。

senses.meaning_en: to neutralize or undo (a property, condition, etc.)

examples.text: The security camera footage destroyed his alibi within minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 监控录像几分钟内就推翻了他的不在场证明。

senses.meaning_en: to put down or euthanize (an animal)

examples.text: The vet had to destroy the badly injured dog.
examples.translation_cn: 兽医不得不人道毁灭那只伤势严重的狗。

senses.meaning_en: of or situated on the inside

examples.text: These connections are internal to the device and cannot be changed.
examples.translation_cn: 这些连接是设备内部的，无法更改。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a country's domestic affairs

examples.text: This is an internal matter and should be resolved by the country itself.
examples.translation_cn: 这是内部事务，应由该国自行解决。

senses.meaning_en: experienced in one's mind; inner rather than expressed

examples.text: He struggled with an internal conflict for weeks before making a decision.
examples.translation_cn: 他在做决定前，内心挣扎了好几个星期。

senses.meaning_en: of the inner nature of a thing

examples.text: His argument has an internal logic that is hard to fault.
examples.translation_cn: 他的论点具有难以挑剔的内在逻辑。

senses.meaning_en: a journey for pleasure or a guided visit to a place

examples.text: We went on a guided tour of the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 我们参加了老城区的导游游览。

senses.meaning_en: a journey by a performer or band to give concerts in several places

examples.text: The band will go on tour in Europe this summer.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队今年夏天将在欧洲巡回演出。

senses.meaning_en: a sports trip to another country to play several matches

examples.text: The national team is on tour in South Africa.
examples.translation_cn: 国家队正在南非巡回比赛。

senses.meaning_en: to join two objects or attach one object to another

examples.text: Connect the printer to the computer with a USB cable.
examples.translation_cn: 用USB线将打印机连接到计算机。

senses.meaning_en: to join a device to an electrical or communications network

examples.text: My laptop will not connect to the office Wi-Fi without the new password.
examples.translation_cn: 我的笔记本电脑没有新密码就无法连接办公室的Wi-Fi。

senses.meaning_en: to show or think that there is a link between things or people

examples.text: Researchers connect the rise in asthma with air pollution.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员将哮喘增多与空气污染联系起来。

senses.meaning_en: to form a good relationship with someone, or to communicate well with someone

examples.text: A good manager knows how to connect with her team.
examples.translation_cn: 优秀的管理者懂得如何与团队建立良好关系。

senses.meaning_en: a link or relationship between two or more things

examples.text: There is a close connection between diet and heart health.
examples.translation_cn: 饮食与心脏健康之间有密切的联系。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being linked to a network or system

examples.text: The office has a fast connection to the internet.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室有一条快速的互联网连接。

senses.meaning_en: a train, bus, or plane that leaves soon after another arrives

examples.text: Our train was late and we missed our connection to Berlin.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的火车晚点了，我们错过了去柏林的联运。

senses.meaning_en: the point where two or more things are joined

examples.text: The electrician found a loose connection in the socket.
examples.translation_cn: 电工在插座里发现了一个松动的接头。

senses.meaning_en: an injury caused by heat, cold, electricity, radiation, or chemicals

examples.text: He suffered a serious burn on his right hand.
examples.translation_cn: 他右手严重烧伤。

senses.meaning_en: the act of burning something with fire

examples.text: Firefighters set a controlled burn to clear dry brush.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员进行受控燃烧以清除干灌木。

senses.meaning_en: to use up energy or calories

examples.text: She burned off 300 calories during her workout on the treadmill.
examples.translation_cn: 她在跑步机上锻炼时消耗了300卡路里。

senses.meaning_en: a hot or painful feeling like a burn

examples.text: You should feel the burn in your legs during squats.
examples.translation_cn: 做深蹲时你应该感到腿部灼热。

senses.meaning_en: moving vehicles or pedestrians

examples.text: We were stuck in traffic for over an hour on the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在高速公路上堵车堵了一个多小时。

senses.meaning_en: the movement of passengers or goods, or commercial transportation

examples.text: The new high-speed rail line is expected to handle heavy passenger traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 这条新高铁线预计将承担大量客运量。

senses.meaning_en: illegal trade, especially in drugs or weapons

examples.text: The police are investigating traffic in stolen weapons.
examples.translation_cn: 警方正在调查被盗武器的非法交易。

senses.meaning_en: to display or show something for others to see

examples.text: The artist will exhibit her paintings at the city gallery.
examples.translation_cn: 这位艺术家将在市立美术馆展出她的画作。

senses.meaning_en: something that is exhibited

examples.text: The dinosaur skeleton is a popular museum exhibit.
examples.translation_cn: 恐龙骨架是博物馆里很受欢迎的展品。

senses.meaning_en: to show clearly that you have a feeling, quality, or ability

examples.text: He began to exhibit signs of anxiety during the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试时他开始表现出焦虑的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: a large-scale public showing of objects or products

examples.text: The museum is holding an exhibition of contemporary African art.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆正在举办一场当代非洲艺术展。

senses.meaning_en: an act of showing a skill, quality, or feeling

examples.text: The champion gave an exhibition of superb footwork at the tournament.
examples.translation_cn: 冠军在比赛中展示了精湛的步法。

senses.meaning_en: a public display of embarrassing or foolish behaviour

examples.text: He made an exhibition of himself by singing loudly at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他在聚会上大声唱歌，出了洋相。

senses.meaning_en: to send a rocket, missile, satellite, etc. into the air or space

examples.text: The space agency will launch a new satellite into orbit next month.
examples.translation_cn: 航天局下个月将把一颗新卫星送入轨道。

senses.meaning_en: to start an activity, project, or campaign; to make a product available to the public for the first time

examples.text: The charity launched a campaign against hunger last autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构去年秋天发起了一场反饥饿运动。

senses.meaning_en: a thin cloth covering a bed

examples.text: He lay still under the sheet in the hospital bed.
examples.translation_cn: 他静静地躺在病床上，盖着床单。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of paper for writing or printing

examples.text: She wrote her name on a sheet of paper.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一张纸上写下自己的名字。

senses.meaning_en: a thin flat piece or broad covering of something

examples.text: A thin sheet of ice covered the lake in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 早晨湖面覆盖着一层薄冰。

senses.meaning_en: a flat metal pan used for baking

examples.text: Spread the vegetables evenly on a baking sheet before roasting them.
examples.translation_cn: 烤之前把蔬菜均匀摊在烤盘上。

senses.meaning_en: to find the exact position of somebody or something

examples.text: Rescue workers are using drones to locate the missing hikers.
examples.translation_cn: 救援人员正使用无人机寻找失踪的徒步者。

senses.meaning_en: to put or build something in a particular place

examples.text: The new library is located in the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 新图书馆坐落在市中心。

senses.meaning_en: to settle in a place; to take up residence

examples.text: After retiring, they decided to locate in a quiet coastal town.
examples.translation_cn: 退休后，他们决定在一个宁静的海滨小镇定居。

senses.meaning_en: a particular point or place in physical space

examples.text: The police asked witnesses to report the exact location of the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 警方要求目击者报告事故的确切地点。

senses.meaning_en: the act of appearing or coming into sight

examples.text: The appearance of the first snow always excites the children.
examples.translation_cn: 初雪的出现总是让孩子们兴奋不已。

senses.meaning_en: the way someone or something looks

examples.text: The twins are alike in appearance but very different in character.
examples.translation_cn: 这对双胞胎外表相似，但性格迥异。

senses.meaning_en: relating to India or its people; a person from India

examples.text: Her mother is Indian, and she cooks Indian food at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她母亲是印度人，在家做印度菜。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the indigenous peoples of the Americas; a member of these peoples

examples.text: Her grandfather is American Indian and grew up on a reservation.
examples.translation_cn: 她祖父是美洲原住民，在保留地长大。

senses.meaning_en: a statement telling someone that you will definitely do or not do something

examples.text: She made a promise to visit her grandparents every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 她许诺每周日去看望祖父母。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone that you will definitely do or not do something

examples.text: He promised to call me as soon as he landed.
examples.translation_cn: 他答应一落地就给我打电话。

senses.meaning_en: a sign of future success or improvement

examples.text: Young players who show promise often get better coaching.
examples.translation_cn: 表现出潜力的年轻球员通常会得到更好的指导。

senses.meaning_en: to show signs of future success or excellence

examples.text: The new film promises to be a huge hit.
examples.translation_cn: 这部新电影有望大获成功。

senses.meaning_en: the act of improving or the state of being improved

examples.text: The company plans to make improvements to its customer service.
examples.translation_cn: 公司计划改进其客户服务。

senses.meaning_en: an increase or progress toward a better condition, especially in health or weather

examples.text: The patient showed signs of improvement after the new treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 接受新治疗后，病人出现了好转的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that is better than the one it replaces, or a useful addition or modification

examples.text: This updated model is a big improvement on the previous version.
examples.translation_cn: 这款升级版比之前的型号大有改进。

senses.meaning_en: a spoken or written account of somebody/something; the act of describing

examples.text: The police asked him to give a description of the attacker.
examples.translation_cn: 警方让他描述一下袭击者。

senses.meaning_en: a type or kind

examples.text: The harbor was crowded with boats of every description.
examples.translation_cn: 港口里挤满了各种各样的船只。

senses.meaning_en: the hard material that forms the skeleton of vertebrates

examples.text: The human skeleton is made of bone and cartilage.
examples.translation_cn: 人体骨骼由骨和软骨构成。

senses.meaning_en: a small bone in a fish; a fishbone

examples.text: She choked on a small bone while eating fish.
examples.translation_cn: 她吃鱼时被一根小鱼刺卡住了。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time devoted to a particular activity

examples.text: We had a long study session in the library last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚在图书馆学习了很长时间。

senses.meaning_en: an official meeting or series of meetings of a council, court, etc.

examples.text: The court will be in session next Monday to hear the appeal.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭下周一开庭审理此上诉案。

senses.meaning_en: a period during which a user is logged in or connected to a computer system

examples.text: Please start a new session after clearing your browser cookies.
examples.translation_cn: 清除浏览器 Cookie 后请启动新会话。

senses.meaning_en: an academic term; a period of study at a school or university

examples.text: She is taking two courses during the summer session.
examples.translation_cn: 她在夏季学期修两门课程。

senses.meaning_en: of, facing, situated in, or related to the north

examples.text: They live in the northern part of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在这座城市的北部。

senses.meaning_en: blowing from the north

examples.text: A northern wind was blowing across the plain.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵北风吹过平原。

senses.meaning_en: to bring two or more things together; to mix

examples.text: The chef combines fresh herbs with olive oil to make the dressing.
examples.translation_cn: 厨师将新鲜香草与橄榄油混合来制作调味汁。

senses.meaning_en: to have two or more different qualities or activities together

examples.text: The new smartphone combines powerful hardware and simple software.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新智能手机兼具强大的硬件和简单的软件。

senses.meaning_en: to come together or work together; to unite

examples.text: Several local groups combined to organize the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 几个当地团体联合起来组织了这次节日。

senses.meaning_en: smooth and level, without raised areas or bumps

examples.text: Make sure the map lies flat on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 确保地图平放在桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: having lost air, charge, or liveliness; dull or without energy

examples.text: My car battery went flat because I left the lights on.
examples.translation_cn: 我的汽车电池没电了，因为我忘了关车灯。

senses.meaning_en: complete and definite; without any doubt

examples.text: She issued a flat denial of the accusation.
examples.translation_cn: 她对指控断然否认。

senses.meaning_en: lower in pitch by a semitone or than expected

examples.text: She tends to sing flat when she is nervous.
examples.translation_cn: 她紧张时唱歌容易走音偏低。

senses.meaning_en: to train someone by instruction and practice

examples.text: Parents must discipline their children to respect others.
examples.translation_cn: 父母必须管教孩子尊重他人。

senses.meaning_en: to punish someone for breaking rules

examples.text: The school disciplined him for cheating on the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 学校因他考试作弊而处分了他。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of obeying rules and controlling your own behaviour

examples.text: She has the discipline to practise the piano every day.
examples.translation_cn: 她有每天练习钢琴的自制力。

senses.meaning_en: a branch of knowledge studied or taught

examples.text: She works across disciplines, from biology to chemistry.
examples.translation_cn: 她从事跨学科工作，从生物学到化学。

senses.meaning_en: difference in color or brightness that makes objects distinguishable

examples.text: The high contrast between the dark text and the light background improves readability.
examples.translation_cn: 深色文字与浅色背景之间的高反差提高了可读性。

senses.meaning_en: a difference between two or more things; something very different

examples.text: There is a sharp contrast between life in the city and life in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 城市生活与乡村生活之间存在着鲜明的对比。

senses.meaning_en: one of the two soft parts around the mouth

examples.text: She pursed her lips and shook her head.
examples.translation_cn: 她抿起嘴唇，摇了摇头。

senses.meaning_en: an edge that sticks out like a lip

examples.text: The nurse cleaned the lip of the wound carefully.
examples.translation_cn: 护士小心地清洗了伤口的边缘。

senses.meaning_en: the projecting rim of an open container, glass, etc.

examples.text: She wiped the lip of the cup before pouring juice.
examples.translation_cn: 倒果汁前，她擦了擦杯口。

senses.meaning_en: increasing in amount or intensity

examples.text: Remote work is becoming increasingly common in the tech industry.
examples.translation_cn: 远程工作在科技行业正变得越来越普遍。

senses.meaning_en: the state or fact of being real or living

examples.text: Scientists are still searching for evidence of the existence of life on Mars.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家仍在寻找火星上存在生命的证据。

senses.meaning_en: a way of life, especially when difficult

examples.text: The refugees led a miserable existence in the camp.
examples.translation_cn: 难民们在难民营里过着悲惨的生活。

senses.meaning_en: a well-bred, well-mannered man

examples.text: He was a perfect gentleman even when the discussion became heated.
examples.translation_cn: 即使讨论变得激烈，他依然表现得很有教养。

senses.meaning_en: any man; used as a polite way of referring to a man

examples.text: This gentleman asked me for directions to the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 这位先生向我问去博物馆的路。

senses.meaning_en: knowledge gained through study or experience

examples.text: She is, in fact, a woman of learning.
examples.translation_cn: 事实上，她是一位有学问的女性。

senses.meaning_en: something learned, especially a lesson from experience

examples.text: We shared our key learnings from the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我们分享了从这个项目中得到的重要经验。

senses.meaning_en: the process of gaining knowledge or skills

examples.text: Learning by doing helps students remember new words.
examples.translation_cn: 在做中学有助于学生记住新单词。

senses.meaning_en: to supply goods to retail outlets

examples.text: The firm distributes its products to independent retailers.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司向独立零售商分销其产品。

senses.meaning_en: to give out portions to people

examples.text: The charity distributed food parcels to elderly residents.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构向老年居民分发了食品包。

senses.meaning_en: to spread over an area

examples.text: The plant is widely distributed throughout tropical forests.
examples.translation_cn: 这种植物广泛分布于热带森林。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving out or delivering something

examples.text: The distribution of aid to remote villages took three days.
examples.translation_cn: 向偏远村庄分发援助物资花了三天。

senses.meaning_en: the way that something is spread or arranged over an area

examples.text: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across the region.
examples.translation_cn: 地图显示该地区降雨量的分布情况。

senses.meaning_en: the business of transporting and supplying goods to stores

examples.text: The company manages distribution to pharmacies across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司负责向全国各地的药房配送货物。

senses.meaning_en: the way income or wealth is divided among people or groups

examples.text: Economists study the distribution of wealth across different social groups.
examples.translation_cn: 经济学家研究不同社会群体之间的财富分配。

senses.meaning_en: a situation or experience of great suffering or difficulty

examples.text: She went through hell during the long divorce.
examples.translation_cn: 她在漫长的离婚过程中受尽了苦。

senses.meaning_en: used to express anger, annoyance, or surprise, or for emphasis

examples.text: What the hell is going on in here?
examples.translation_cn: 这里究竟发生了什么事？

senses.meaning_en: in some religions, the place where bad people are punished after death

examples.text: They believe sinners will go to hell after death.
examples.translation_cn: 他们相信罪人死后会下地狱。

senses.meaning_en: used as an intensifier in phrases requiring a noun

examples.text: That was a hell of a storm last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚那场暴风雨可真大。

senses.meaning_en: likely to cause harm or injury

examples.text: It is dangerous to leave young children near water.
examples.translation_cn: 让年幼的孩子在水边无人看管很危险。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to remember to do something

examples.text: My mother always reminds me to lock the door at night.
examples.translation_cn: 我妈妈总是提醒我晚上锁门。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone remember someone or something from the past

examples.text: The old photograph reminds me of my grandfather.
examples.translation_cn: 这张旧照片让我想起了我的祖父。

senses.meaning_en: relating to principles of right and wrong

examples.text: We have a moral duty to protect the environment.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有保护环境的道义责任。

senses.meaning_en: the lesson or meaning of a story or event

examples.text: The moral of the story is that honesty pays.
examples.translation_cn: 这个故事的寓意是诚实有回报。

senses.meaning_en: standards of behaviour; principles of right and wrong

examples.text: The film was criticized for offending public morals.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因有伤风化而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: conforming to standards of right behaviour; virtuous

examples.text: She tried to lead a moral life despite many temptations.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管有许多诱惑，她努力过正派的生活。

senses.meaning_en: to keep or continue to have something

examples.text: The board struggled to retain control of the company.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会努力保持对公司的控制。

senses.meaning_en: to remember information

examples.text: The brain can retain information better when it is well rested.
examples.translation_cn: 大脑在休息充足时能更好地记住信息。

senses.meaning_en: to employ or keep someone in one's service, especially a professional such as a lawyer

examples.text: They retained her as a consultant to review the merger.
examples.translation_cn: 他们聘请她担任顾问，审查这次并购案。

senses.meaning_en: success in a battle, competition, or effort

examples.text: The team celebrated their victory over their old rivals.
examples.translation_cn: 球队庆祝他们战胜了老对手。

senses.meaning_en: Used to encourage someone to achieve success, or to celebrate a success or triumph.

examples.text: Victory!" he shouted as he crossed the finish line.
examples.translation_cn: “胜利！”他冲过终点线时喊道。

senses.meaning_en: a building where plays are performed

examples.text: We went to the theatre to see a new musical.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去了剧院看一部新音乐剧。

senses.meaning_en: the art or activity of writing, performing, or producing plays

examples.text: She has worked in theatre since she left drama school.
examples.translation_cn: 她离开戏剧学校后一直从事戏剧工作。

senses.meaning_en: a building where films are shown

examples.text: They watched the blockbuster at a movie theatre near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在车站附近的一家电影院看了那部大片。

senses.meaning_en: relating to education and scholarship

examples.text: She has published several papers in academic journals.
examples.translation_cn: 她在学术期刊上发表了几篇论文。

senses.meaning_en: having little practical value; theoretical

examples.text: The whole debate is purely academic at this point.
examples.translation_cn: 在这一点上，整个辩论纯属理论。

senses.meaning_en: having a love of or aptitude for learning

examples.text: She is very academic and plans to study medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 她学业很好，打算学医。

senses.meaning_en: a male member of a royal family other than the ruler

examples.text: The prince of Wales is next in line to the throne.
examples.translation_cn: 威尔士亲王是王位的第一顺位继承人。

senses.meaning_en: the male ruler or head of a principality

examples.text: He ruled as prince of the small Alpine state for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他作为这个小高山国的国君统治了三十年。

senses.meaning_en: a man who is preeminent in his field

examples.text: Everyone described him as a prince among men, kind and generous.
examples.translation_cn: 大家都说他是个正人君子，善良又慷慨。

senses.meaning_en: Internet access or connection; internet connectivity

examples.text: Many students connect to the internet to attend online classes.
examples.translation_cn: 许多学生连接互联网来上网课。

senses.meaning_en: To use the internet; specifically, to search for information by using the internet

examples.text: She searched the internet for a good dentist near her office.
examples.translation_cn: 她上网搜索她办公室附近的好牙医。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money that you borrow and must pay back, usually with interest

examples.text: They took out a loan to start a small business.
examples.translation_cn: 他们贷款创办了一家小企业。

senses.meaning_en: to lend something to someone

examples.text: She loaned me her car for the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 她周末把车借给了我。

senses.meaning_en: permission to borrow something

examples.text: The painting is on loan from the National Gallery.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画是从国家美术馆借来的。

senses.meaning_en: a set of letters, numbers, or signs used to identify something

examples.text: Enter the code for your country before dialing the number.
examples.translation_cn: 拨号前请输入你的国家代码。

senses.meaning_en: a set of rules or principles that people are expected to obey

examples.text: The company requires all employees to follow its code of conduct.
examples.translation_cn: 公司要求所有员工遵守其行为准则。

senses.meaning_en: a system of words, letters, numbers, or symbols used to keep a message secret

examples.text: The message was written in code to keep it secret.
examples.translation_cn: 这条信息是用密码写的，以保密。

senses.meaning_en: instructions for a computer, written in a programming language; a program

examples.text: She learned to write code for mobile apps in college.
examples.translation_cn: 她大学时学会了编写手机应用代码。

senses.meaning_en: bad or harmful; not positive

examples.text: He is always negative about his work and rarely sees any good in it.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是对自己的工作持消极态度，很少看到其中任何好处。

senses.meaning_en: less than zero

examples.text: When the temperature falls below zero, the reading is a negative number.
examples.translation_cn: 当温度降到零度以下时，读数就是一个负数。

senses.meaning_en: not positive; not detected in a test

examples.text: After treatment, the patient tested negative for the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 治疗后，该患者的病毒检测结果呈阴性。

senses.meaning_en: denying a proposition; expressing negation

examples.text: In English, the negative form of 'I am' is 'I am not'.
examples.translation_cn: 在英语中，“I am”的否定形式是“I am not”。

senses.meaning_en: typical of a larger group

examples.text: Their opinions are representative of the whole community.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的观点代表了整个社区。

senses.meaning_en: consisting of elected people who act for others

examples.text: The country has a representative government elected by its citizens.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家有一个由公民选举产生的代议制政府。

senses.meaning_en: a person chosen to speak or act for others

examples.text: A representative of the company will meet you at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的一位代表将在机场接你。

senses.meaning_en: concerned with or based on recorded history rather than legend or fiction

examples.text: She has just published a historical novel set during the French Revolution.
examples.translation_cn: 她刚出版了一部以法国大革命为背景的历史小说。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the past or the study of history

examples.text: The library owns a diary once belonging to a historical figure.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆拥有一本曾属于一位历史人物的日记。

senses.meaning_en: happening, done, or existing most of the time; typical
senses.pattern: It is usual for sb to do

examples.text: It is usual for shops to close early on Sundays.
examples.translation_cn: 商店在星期天通常很早关门。

senses.meaning_en: the thing that is typical or normally happens; a drink or food that someone usually orders

examples.text: When the waiter came over, she ordered the usual.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员过来时，她点了平时常点的那种。

senses.meaning_en: not able to do something

examples.text: I was unable to attend the meeting yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 我昨天未能参加会议。

senses.meaning_en: to be owned by someone; to be the property of

examples.text: The old painting belongs to a private collector in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅古老的画属于巴黎的一位私人收藏家。

senses.meaning_en: to be a member of a group or part of something

examples.text: She has belonged to the university debating society since last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她自去年起就是大学辩论社的成员。

senses.meaning_en: to feel comfortable and accepted in a situation or group

examples.text: After a month, she finally felt like she belonged at the school.
examples.translation_cn: 一个月后，她终于在学校里有了归属感。

senses.meaning_en: to have its proper place; to be in the right place

examples.text: These plates belong in the top cupboard, not on the counter.
examples.translation_cn: 这些盘子应该放在顶层橱柜里，而不是台面上。

senses.meaning_en: a result of research or an investigation

examples.text: The latest research findings suggest that regular exercise improves mental health.
examples.translation_cn: 最新研究结果表明，定期锻炼能改善心理健康。

senses.meaning_en: a formal conclusion by a judge, jury or regulatory agency

examples.text: The court's finding of fact cleared the company of negligence.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭对事实的认定判定该公司不存在过失。

senses.meaning_en: something that has been found, especially something interesting or valuable

examples.text: The museum exhibited the archaeological findings from the ancient tomb.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出了古墓中的考古发现物。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of admiration for someone or something

examples.text: He has great respect for his former teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 他对以前的老师很敬重。

senses.meaning_en: to admire someone or something; to treat with consideration

examples.text: I really respect her for speaking the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 我真的很敬佩她讲了真话。

senses.meaning_en: a particular aspect or feature

examples.text: In this respect, the two reports are in agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 在这方面，两份报告是一致的。

senses.meaning_en: to obey a rule, agreement, etc.

examples.text: Both sides promised to respect the ceasefire agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 双方都承诺遵守停火协议。

senses.meaning_en: polite greetings, especially to show sympathy

examples.text: They came to pay their respects to the family.
examples.translation_cn: 他们前来向家属表示慰问。

senses.meaning_en: to pull something toward itself without touching

examples.text: The magnet attracts nails and other metal objects.
examples.translation_cn: 磁铁吸引钉子和其他金属物体。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody feel interested or want to come closer

examples.text: The scholarship attracts talented students to the university.
examples.translation_cn: 这项奖学金吸引有才华的学生来这所大学。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a particular reaction or result

examples.text: The proposal has attracted considerable criticism from experts.
examples.translation_cn: 该提议招致了专家的大量批评。

senses.meaning_en: restricted in size, amount, or extent; not great

examples.text: Tickets for the opening night are limited in number and usually sell out quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 首演之夜的门票数量有限，通常很快售罄。

senses.meaning_en: a picture made with a camera

examples.text: I found an old photograph of my grandmother in the drawer.
examples.translation_cn: 我在抽屉里发现了一张祖母的旧照片。

senses.meaning_en: to take a photograph of somebody/something

examples.text: She spent the whole afternoon photographing the bride and groom at the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个下午都在拍摄婚礼上的新娘和新郎。

senses.meaning_en: to look attractive in photographs

examples.text: She always photographs well in natural light by the window.
examples.translation_cn: 她在窗边自然光下总是很上相。

senses.meaning_en: following official rules or procedures; official

examples.text: The committee made a formal request for further information.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会正式要求提供更多信息。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the form or structure of something

examples.text: The essay examines the formal structure of the novel.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章分析了小说的形式结构。

senses.meaning_en: suitable for official or important occasions; not casual

examples.text: He always wears a suit for formal occasions.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是穿西装出席正式场合。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in an activity or event

examples.text: Children learn better when they participate in hands-on activities.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们参与实践活动时学得更好。

senses.meaning_en: happening or done every day

examples.text: The database is updated on a daily basis.
examples.translation_cn: 数据库每天更新。

senses.meaning_en: every day

examples.text: The tablet should be taken once daily with water.
examples.translation_cn: 这片药应每天一次用水送服。

senses.meaning_en: a newspaper published every day

examples.text: She has written for a national daily for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 她为一家全国性日报撰稿已有五年。

senses.meaning_en: letters or other symbols that represent language

examples.text: Cuneiform is an early form of writing used in Mesopotamia.
examples.translation_cn: 楔形文字是美索不达米亚使用的一种早期文字形式。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of writing

examples.text: The writing of the report took several weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告的写作花了几周时间。

senses.meaning_en: a person's handwriting

examples.text: The address was written in his neat writing.
examples.translation_cn: 地址是用他整洁的笔迹写的。

senses.meaning_en: a written work, such as a book, article, or document

examples.text: The writings of Plato have influenced Western philosophy.
examples.translation_cn: 柏拉图的著作影响了西方哲学。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to accept or agree to something, such as a proposal or idea

examples.text: The committee rejected the proposal as too expensive.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会以费用过高为由否决了该提案。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to accept someone as a romantic partner

examples.text: She rejected him gently, but he still felt hurt.
examples.translation_cn: 她委婉地拒绝了他，但他仍然感到受伤。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to accept a product because it is not good enough, and often send it back

examples.text: The factory rejected the parts as below standard.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂以不合标准为由拒收了这些零件。

senses.meaning_en: to attack and fail to accept a transplanted organ or tissue as a foreign object

examples.text: His body rejected the transplanted kidney despite the drugs.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管用了药物，他的身体还是排斥了移植的肾脏。

senses.meaning_en: to judge or decide the nature, quality, or value of something

examples.text: The study assessed how sleep quality affects students' attention in class.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究评估了睡眠质量如何影响学生的课堂注意力。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate and officially require someone to pay a tax or fine

examples.text: The court assessed a fine on the company for safety violations.
examples.translation_cn: 法院因安全违规对该公司处以罚款。

senses.meaning_en: the joint between the thigh and the lower leg

examples.text: He was on his knees scrubbing the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 他跪着擦地板。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a garment covering the knee

examples.text: My jeans are torn at the knees, but I still wear them.
examples.translation_cn: 我的牛仔裤膝盖处破了，但我仍然穿着。

senses.meaning_en: the presence of a parent etc., where a young child acquires early knowledge

examples.text: She learned to read at her mother's knee.
examples.translation_cn: 她幼时在母亲膝边学会了阅读。

senses.meaning_en: involving two or more people or groups together

examples.text: The two parties issued a joint statement after the talks.
examples.translation_cn: 会谈后双方发表了联合声明。

senses.meaning_en: a place where two parts are joined

examples.text: Seal the joint between the two pipes with waterproof tape.
examples.translation_cn: 用防水胶带密封两根管子之间的接合处。

senses.meaning_en: a place where two bones meet in the body

examples.text: He felt a sharp pain in his knee joint while running.
examples.translation_cn: 他跑步时感到膝关节剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: money paid regularly to a retired person

examples.text: After forty years of work, she now lives on a modest pension.
examples.translation_cn: 工作四十年后，她现在靠微薄的养老金生活。

senses.meaning_en: a small hotel or boarding house, especially in continental Europe

examples.text: We stayed at a small family-run pension near the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在湖边一家家庭经营的小膳宿公寓里。

senses.meaning_en: to force or allow someone to retire and pay them a pension

examples.text: Several senior managers were pensioned off last year.
examples.translation_cn: 几位高级经理去年被安排退休。

senses.meaning_en: flexible material with a sticky surface, used for sticking things together
senses.pattern: stick sth to sth with tape

examples.text: She stuck the poster to the wall with tape.
examples.translation_cn: 她用胶带把海报贴在墙上。

senses.meaning_en: magnetic tape used for recording sound or pictures; a recording made on such tape

examples.text: We recorded the interview on tape for the archives.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把采访录在磁带上存档。

senses.meaning_en: a strip stretched across the finish line of a race

examples.text: The marathon winner broke the tape at the finish line.
examples.translation_cn: 马拉松冠军在终点线撞线。

senses.meaning_en: to employ someone and pay them to work for you

examples.text: The firm hired a young designer to lead the project.
examples.translation_cn: 公司雇了一名年轻设计师来负责这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: to pay to use something for a short time

examples.text: We hired a car from the rental company for the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们周末从租车公司租了一辆车。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being employed

examples.text: He was in the hire of a local newspaper.
examples.translation_cn: 他受雇于一家当地报社。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has recently been hired

examples.text: As a new hire, she received extra training.
examples.translation_cn: 作为新员工，她接受了额外培训。

senses.meaning_en: payment for the temporary use of something

examples.text: The hire of the hall for the reception was £200.
examples.translation_cn: 租用大厅举办招待会的费用是200英镑。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of explaining; a statement or fact that explains something

examples.text: She gave a clear explanation of the grammar rule.
examples.translation_cn: 她对语法规则作了清楚的解释。

senses.meaning_en: a reason or excuse given for something

examples.text: His explanation for being late was that his alarm didn't ring.
examples.translation_cn: 他对迟到的解释是闹钟没响。

senses.meaning_en: well known; often seen, heard, or experienced

examples.text: The smell of fresh bread is familiar to everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 新鲜面包的气味对每个人来说都很熟悉。

senses.meaning_en: knowing something very well

examples.text: All engineers must be familiar with safety regulations.
examples.translation_cn: 所有工程师都必须熟悉安全规章。

senses.meaning_en: friendly and informal
senses.pattern: be on familiar terms with sb

examples.text: He is on familiar terms with the manager.
examples.translation_cn: 他和经理关系很熟。

senses.meaning_en: an attendant spirit, often in animal or demon form

examples.text: In the story, the witch's familiar was a black cat.
examples.translation_cn: 故事中，女巫的使魔是一只黑猫。

senses.meaning_en: to be made up or composed of

examples.text: The committee consists of ten members from different departments.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会由来自不同部门的十名成员组成。

senses.meaning_en: to have something as a main or basic part; to be inherent

examples.text: True happiness consists in appreciating what you have.
examples.translation_cn: 真正的幸福在于珍惜你所拥有的。

senses.meaning_en: a person who performs in plays, films, or television programmes

examples.text: The lead actor in that film gave a brilliant performance.
examples.translation_cn: 那部电影的主角表演出色。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that takes part in an action or process

examples.text: This organization is a key actor in climate policy debates.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织是气候政策辩论中的关键参与者。

senses.meaning_en: unwilling to accept change or new ideas

examples.text: She is conservative in her taste in music.
examples.translation_cn: 她对音乐的品味很保守。

senses.meaning_en: a person who resists change or supports traditional values

examples.text: He is a conservative by nature and dislikes sudden changes.
examples.translation_cn: 他生性保守，不喜欢突然变化。

senses.meaning_en: cautious or moderate; avoiding risk

examples.text: He is conservative with his investments during volatile markets.
examples.translation_cn: 在市场动荡时期，他对投资十分谨慎。

senses.meaning_en: deliberately low or cautious, based on pessimistic assumptions

examples.text: Analysts were conservative in estimating next year's profits.
examples.translation_cn: 分析师对明年利润的估计偏保守。

senses.meaning_en: the process or act of giving birth
senses.collocation: give birth to a healthy baby

examples.text: She gave birth to a healthy baby girl last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚生下了一个健康的女婴。

senses.meaning_en: a beginning or start; origin
senses.collocation: the birth of a new era

examples.text: The invention of the printing press marked the birth of mass communication.
examples.translation_cn: 印刷机的发明标志着大众传播的诞生。

senses.meaning_en: to bear or give birth to (a child)

examples.text: She birthed her first child at home with a midwife.
examples.translation_cn: 她在助产士的帮助下在家生下了第一个孩子。

senses.meaning_en: family origin or social position

examples.text: She is French by birth but has lived in Canada since childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她原籍法国，但从小就生活在加拿大。

senses.meaning_en: familial relationship established by childbirth

examples.text: She finally met her birth mother after years of searching.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年寻找，她终于见到了自己的亲生母亲。

senses.meaning_en: to try to find someone or something by looking carefully

examples.text: The rescue team searched for survivors throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队整夜搜寻幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: to look carefully in a place for something

examples.text: Police searched every room of the house for weapons.
examples.translation_cn: 警方搜查了房子的每个房间以寻找武器。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt to find something

examples.text: The police launched a search for the missing child.
examples.translation_cn: 警方对失踪儿童展开了搜索。

senses.meaning_en: to use a search engine to find information on the internet

examples.text: She searched the web for cheap flights to Berlin.
examples.translation_cn: 她在网上搜索飞往柏林的廉价航班。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten or attach with a string, rope, etc.

examples.text: She tied the rope tightly around the tree.
examples.translation_cn: 她把绳子紧紧地系在树上。

senses.meaning_en: a strip of cloth worn around the neck and tied in front

examples.text: He wore a blue silk tie to the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 他面试时系了一条蓝色丝质领带。

senses.meaning_en: a result in a game or competition where two or more players or teams have the same score

examples.text: The game ended in a tie after overtime.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛加时后以平局告终。

senses.meaning_en: a connection between people or groups of people, especially a strong connection

examples.text: She has maintained close ties with her former colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 她和以前的同事保持着密切的联系。

senses.meaning_en: a system of government in which the people have the power to choose their leaders and influence decisions

examples.text: The transition to democracy brought free elections and a new constitution.
examples.translation_cn: 向民主制度的过渡带来了自由选举和新宪法。

senses.meaning_en: a country with a democratic system of government

examples.text: Canada is a stable democracy with strong legal institutions.
examples.translation_cn: 加拿大是一个拥有稳固法律制度的稳定民主国家。

senses.meaning_en: fair and equal treatment of people in an organization and their right to take part in decisions

examples.text: The new head teacher encouraged democracy in school decision-making.
examples.translation_cn: 新校长鼓励学校决策中的民主参与。

senses.meaning_en: the belief in freedom and equality between people, or the spirit of democracy

examples.text: The new constitution was written in the spirit of democracy.
examples.translation_cn: 新宪法本着民主精神编写。

senses.meaning_en: to ask somebody to come to a social event

examples.text: They invited all their friends to the opening ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 他们邀请了所有朋友来参加开幕式。

senses.meaning_en: to ask somebody formally for something such as suggestions or comments

examples.text: The editor invited comments from readers on the new design.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑邀请读者对新设计提出意见。

senses.meaning_en: to make something, especially something bad, more likely to happen

examples.text: Such behavior will only invite trouble for the company.
examples.translation_cn: 这种行为只会给公司招来麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: an invitation

examples.text: Did you get an invite to the party?
examples.translation_cn: 你收到参加聚会的邀请了吗？

senses.meaning_en: located in or facing the east

examples.text: The eastern part of the city is growing fast.
examples.translation_cn: 城市的东部正在快速发展。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the eastern part of the world

examples.text: Rice is a staple food in eastern countries.
examples.translation_cn: 大米是东方国家的主食。

senses.meaning_en: blowing from the east

examples.text: A cold eastern wind brought rain to the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵寒冷的东风给海岸带来了雨。

senses.meaning_en: a round shape; a line forming a ring

examples.text: The children sat in a circle on the floor, waiting for story time.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在地板上坐成一圈，等着听故事。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people sharing a common interest or activity

examples.text: She is well known in academic circles for her research.
examples.translation_cn: 她因研究在学术界很有名。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a circle, especially in the air

examples.text: A hawk was circling above the river, looking for fish.
examples.translation_cn: 一只鹰在河面上空盘旋，寻找鱼。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to do or understand something

examples.text: Children have a remarkable capacity to learn languages.
examples.translation_cn: 儿童学习语言的能力非凡。

senses.meaning_en: the amount that a container or space can hold

examples.text: The tank has a capacity of 50 litres.
examples.translation_cn: 这个水箱的容量是50升。

senses.meaning_en: the official position or role in which someone does something

examples.text: She was invited in her capacity as a judge.
examples.translation_cn: 她以法官的身份受邀。

senses.meaning_en: completely full; filling the allotted space

examples.text: The band played to a capacity crowd at the stadium.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队在体育场为满座的观众演出。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment made for a particular purpose

examples.text: A pacemaker is a device for controlling heart rhythm.
examples.translation_cn: 心脏起搏器是一种用于控制心率的装置。

senses.meaning_en: a way of doing something, especially one that is clever or intended to achieve a particular effect
senses.pattern: use sth as a device to do

examples.text: The author uses irony as a device to criticize society.
examples.translation_cn: 作者用讽刺作为批评社会的一种手段。

senses.meaning_en: a bomb or other explosive weapon

examples.text: Police discovered an explosive device in the parked car.
examples.translation_cn: 警方在那辆停着的汽车里发现了一个爆炸装置。

senses.meaning_en: to be different from each other

examples.text: Teaching methods vary considerably from school to school.
examples.translation_cn: 各学校的教学方法差异很大。

senses.meaning_en: to change according to the situation

examples.text: Prices vary with the season and local demand.
examples.translation_cn: 价格随季节和当地需求而变化。

senses.meaning_en: to make changes to something

examples.text: You should vary your routine to keep your workouts interesting.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该改变一下日常安排，让锻炼保持有趣。

senses.meaning_en: the lowest part of something

examples.text: There is some sand at the bottom of the glass.
examples.translation_cn: 玻璃杯底有些沙子。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body on which a person sits

examples.text: He slipped and landed hard on his bottom on the icy step.
examples.translation_cn: 他滑倒了，在结冰的台阶上重重摔在屁股上。

senses.meaning_en: the far end of something
senses.pattern: at the bottom of the street

examples.text: The bakery is at the bottom of the street.
examples.translation_cn: 面包店在街道的尽头。

senses.meaning_en: to choose one or more options

examples.text: Please select your country from the drop-down menu.
examples.translation_cn: 请从下拉菜单中选择你的国家。

senses.meaning_en: specially selected; of high quality

examples.text: Only a select few were invited to the private dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 只有少数精选者被邀请参加私人晚宴。

senses.meaning_en: to retrieve data using a query

examples.text: You can select data from a database with this query.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用这个查询从数据库中选取数据。

senses.meaning_en: the act of choosing someone or something from a group

examples.text: It is important to make a selection based on quality, not price.
