examples.translation_cn: 重要的是根据质量而不是价格来做出选择。

senses.meaning_en: a range or collection of things chosen from a larger group

examples.text: The bakery offers a wide selection of fresh bread and pastries.
examples.translation_cn: 这家面包店提供多种新鲜面包和糕点。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that has been chosen

examples.text: Her selection for the lead role was announced yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 她入选主角一事昨天公布了。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone aware of a possible danger or problem

examples.text: The sign near the cliff warns visitors of falling rocks.
examples.translation_cn: 悬崖附近的标志警告游客注意落石。

senses.meaning_en: to strongly advise someone not to do something

examples.text: The doctor warned him against eating too much salt.
examples.translation_cn: 医生告诫他不要吃太多盐。

senses.meaning_en: the management of money and other assets

examples.text: She works in finance at an international bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家国际银行从事金融工作。

senses.meaning_en: to provide money for a project, company, etc.

examples.text: The bank agreed to finance the company's expansion.
examples.translation_cn: 银行同意为公司的扩张提供资金。

senses.meaning_en: money available to a person, company, or government
senses.pattern: have the finances to do sth

examples.text: She does not have the finances to start her own business.
examples.translation_cn: 她没有足够的资金创办自己的企业。

senses.meaning_en: certainly; without a doubt

examples.text: This plan will surely succeed if we work together.
examples.translation_cn: 如果我们共同努力，这个计划一定会成功。

senses.meaning_en: used in negative statements or questions to emphasize certainty or surprise

examples.text: Surely you can't be serious about moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 你肯定不是在认真考虑移居国外吧。

senses.meaning_en: to officially introduce or force something such as a law, tax, or rule on people

examples.text: The government imposed a new tax on fuel.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对燃料征收新税。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for help or a favour in a way that may be inconvenient for someone

examples.text: I didn't want to impose on you during your busy week.
examples.translation_cn: 我不想在你这周忙碌时给你添麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the countryside or agriculture

examples.text: Many small clinics in rural areas struggle to find doctors.
examples.translation_cn: 许多农村地区的小诊所很难找到医生。

senses.meaning_en: to incline, bend, or rest against a surface

examples.text: He leaned back against the wall and closed his eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 他向后靠在墙上，闭上了眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: thin and without much fat

examples.text: Eating well helps you stay lean and healthy.
examples.translation_cn: 饮食合理有助于保持身材苗条和健康。

senses.meaning_en: difficult or unprofitable, with little money or resources

examples.text: It was a lean year for small businesses after the recession.
examples.translation_cn: 经济衰退后，对小企业来说是拮据的一年。

senses.meaning_en: to depend on someone or something for help or support

examples.text: She leaned on her family for emotional support.
examples.translation_cn: 她依靠家人的情感支持。

senses.meaning_en: to tend to choose or prefer something

examples.text: I'm leaning toward the blue design.
examples.translation_cn: 我倾向于蓝色设计。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders
senses.collocation: wear a scarf around one's neck

examples.text: She wore a silver chain around her neck to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她脖子上戴着一条银链去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a garment that fits around the neck

examples.text: This shirt is too tight at the neck, so I can't button it.
examples.translation_cn: 这件衬衫领口太紧，我扣不上扣子。

senses.meaning_en: the narrow part of a bottle, jar, etc. near the opening
senses.collocation: the narrow neck of a bottle

examples.text: The neck of the bottle was too narrow to pour the sauce quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 瓶颈太窄，酱汁倒不快。

senses.meaning_en: the long narrow part of a stringed instrument where the strings are pressed
senses.collocation: slide one's fingers along the neck of a guitar

examples.text: His fingers moved quickly along the neck of the guitar during the solo.
examples.translation_cn: 独奏时他的手指在吉他琴颈上快速移动。

senses.meaning_en: a plan or aim to do something

examples.text: The chairman announced his intention to resign next month.
examples.translation_cn: 主席宣布他打算下个月辞职。

senses.meaning_en: the purpose behind an action

examples.text: The intention behind the policy was to reduce traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 该政策背后的意图是减少交通流量。

senses.meaning_en: a light, strong synthetic material made from polymers

examples.text: The bottle is made of plastic and can be recycled.
examples.translation_cn: 这个瓶子由塑料制成，并且可以回收。

senses.meaning_en: capable of being moulded or shaped; flexible

examples.text: A child's brain is highly plastic during early childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 儿童在幼儿期大脑可塑性很强。

senses.meaning_en: credit or debit cards used in place of cash

examples.text: You can pay with plastic at most supermarkets.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数超市都可以用信用卡支付。

senses.meaning_en: used to contrast two facts or situations

examples.text: She loves city life, whereas her husband prefers the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢城市生活，而她丈夫更喜欢乡村。

senses.meaning_en: first; happening at the beginning

examples.text: At the initial stage of the project, we focused on collecting data.
examples.translation_cn: 在项目的最初阶段，我们专注于收集数据。

senses.meaning_en: the first letter of a name or word, especially a person's initials

examples.text: Please write your initials at the bottom of each page.
examples.translation_cn: 请在每页底部写上你名字的首字母。

senses.meaning_en: to sign with one's initials

examples.text: Please initial each page of the contract to confirm you have read it.
examples.translation_cn: 请在合同每一页上草签，以确认你已阅读。

senses.meaning_en: to dislike intensely

examples.text: I hate doing housework on weekends, especially after a long week.
examples.translation_cn: 我讨厌周末做家务，尤其是在漫长的一周之后。

senses.meaning_en: to be unwilling or sorry to do something

examples.text: I hate to bother you, but could you spare a minute?
examples.translation_cn: 我不想打扰你，但你能抽出一分钟吗？

senses.meaning_en: a strong feeling of dislike

examples.text: The politician's speeches are full of hate and division.
examples.translation_cn: 那位政客的演讲充满了仇恨和分裂。

senses.meaning_en: negative or abusive comments

examples.text: She received a lot of hate for expressing her honest opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 她因表达自己诚实的看法而收到很多恶评。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that one hates

examples.text: Being kept waiting is my pet hate at restaurants.
examples.translation_cn: 在餐厅里让我久等是我最讨厌的事。

senses.meaning_en: a medical check or inspection

examples.text: She underwent a thorough examination at the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在医院接受了全面检查。

senses.meaning_en: a formal test of knowledge

examples.text: All students must take a written examination in June.
examples.translation_cn: 所有学生必须在六月参加笔试。

senses.meaning_en: the act of looking at closely

examples.text: On closer examination, the signature turned out to be a forgery.
examples.translation_cn: 仔细检查后，签名被证明是伪造的。

senses.meaning_en: formal questioning in court

examples.text: The witness remained calm under examination by the prosecutor.
examples.translation_cn: 证人在检察官盘问下保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: having life; living; not dead

examples.text: Both of her grandparents are still alive and well.
examples.translation_cn: 她的祖父母都还健在。

senses.meaning_en: continuing to exist; in force or operation

examples.text: The old law remains alive in some states.
examples.translation_cn: 这部旧法在一些州仍然有效。

senses.meaning_en: full of life and energy

examples.text: The party came alive once the music started.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐一响起，聚会就热闹起来了。

senses.meaning_en: swarming; thronged; busy

examples.text: The city streets are alive with street performers.
examples.translation_cn: 城市街道上到处都是街头艺人。

senses.meaning_en: clear and exact; certain; free from doubt

examples.text: The witness was definite about what she had seen.
examples.translation_cn: 证人对她所看到的情况非常肯定。

senses.meaning_en: fixed and unlikely to change

examples.text: They set a definite date for the meeting to avoid further delays.
examples.translation_cn: 他们确定了会议日期，以避免进一步拖延。

senses.meaning_en: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary

examples.text: Look up the definition of 'culture' in the dictionary.
examples.translation_cn: 在词典中查一下“culture”的定义。

senses.meaning_en: a statement of what something is or what it means; essential nature

examples.text: By definition, freedom is the absence of external constraint.
examples.translation_cn: 从本质上说，自由就是不受外部约束。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being clear and sharp in an image or sound

examples.text: This new monitor displays images in high definition.
examples.translation_cn: 这台新显示器以高清显示图像。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is a perfect example of a quality

examples.text: Her warm smile was the definition of joy.
examples.translation_cn: 她温暖的微笑就是快乐的典范。

senses.meaning_en: to say something officially or publicly

examples.text: The president declared that the country would rebuild the coastal towns.
examples.translation_cn: 总统宣布该国将重建沿海城镇。

senses.meaning_en: to state something clearly and firmly

examples.text: He declared himself satisfied with the final result.
examples.translation_cn: 他宣称自己对最终结果满意。

senses.meaning_en: to tell customs or tax authorities about goods or income

examples.text: You must declare all valuable items to customs.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须向海关申报所有贵重物品。

senses.meaning_en: Large in size, quantity, or value; ample; significant.

examples.text: A substantial number of students voted against the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 相当多的学生投票反对这项提议。

senses.meaning_en: real; actual; not imaginary

examples.text: The rumour has no substantial basis in fact.
examples.translation_cn: 这个谣言没有任何事实根据。

senses.meaning_en: strong; solid; well built

examples.text: They live in a substantial stone house by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在河边一栋坚固的石屋里。

senses.meaning_en: moderately wealthy; well-to-do

examples.text: The family is of substantial means but lives modestly.
examples.translation_cn: 这家人家境殷实但生活简朴。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle capable of atmospheric flight due to interaction with the air, such as buoyancy or lift

examples.text: The rescue team reached the remote village by aircraft within two hours.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队在两小时内乘飞机抵达了那个偏远的村庄。

senses.meaning_en: the meat from a chicken

examples.text: We had roast chicken for dinner at my aunt's house.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在姑妈家晚餐吃了烤鸡。

senses.meaning_en: a common farm bird

examples.text: My grandmother keeps a few chickens in her backyard.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母在后院养了几只鸡。

senses.meaning_en: a coward

examples.text: He is a chicken when it comes to speaking in public.
examples.translation_cn: 他一到公开演讲就胆怯。

senses.meaning_en: a game of dare

examples.text: The two drivers played chicken on the narrow road.
examples.translation_cn: 两个司机在狭窄的道路上玩胆量游戏。

senses.meaning_en: to use something for a bad purpose; improper use

examples.text: Several officials abused their power to help relatives get contracts.
examples.translation_cn: 几名官员滥用权力帮助亲属获得合同。

senses.meaning_en: cruel or violent treatment; to treat someone cruelly

examples.text: She was abused by her stepfather for several years.
examples.translation_cn: 她遭继父虐待多年。

senses.meaning_en: rude, offensive words; to speak to someone insultingly

examples.text: The players shouted abuse at the referee after the penalty decision.
examples.translation_cn: 判罚点球后，球员们对裁判大声辱骂。

senses.meaning_en: the amount or thing that is produced

examples.text: The output of the factory has doubled in three years.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂的产量在三年内翻了一番。

senses.meaning_en: to produce or send out something

examples.text: The program outputs the processed data to a file for later use.
examples.translation_cn: 该程序将处理后的数据输出到文件，以便日后使用。

senses.meaning_en: to close (a door, window, etc.)

examples.text: Please shut the window before you leave the room.
examples.translation_cn: 你离开房间前请关上窗户。

senses.meaning_en: to stop being open for business or service

examples.text: The small shop shuts at six on Sundays.
examples.translation_cn: 这家小店星期天六点关门。

senses.meaning_en: to turn off (a device or power supply)

examples.text: He shut the engine off and got out of the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他关掉发动机，下了车。

senses.meaning_en: to catch or pinch by closing something
senses.collocation: shut your finger in the door

examples.text: I shut my finger in the car door this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我的手指被汽车门夹住了。

senses.meaning_en: appropriate or fitting for a purpose or occasion

examples.text: This movie is suitable for children of all ages.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影适合所有年龄段的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: used to say what is the right or sensible thing to do

examples.text: You ought to call your parents more often.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该更常给父母打电话。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something is likely or probable

examples.text: Everything ought to be all right in the end.
examples.translation_cn: 最终一切应该都会好起来的。

senses.meaning_en: the same in status, rights, or opportunities

examples.text: All people are equal in dignity and rights.
examples.translation_cn: 人人在尊严和权利上一律平等。

senses.meaning_en: the same as or as good as

examples.text: She is equal to any opponent on the tennis court.
examples.translation_cn: 她在网球场上不输给任何对手。

senses.meaning_en: to amount to; to mean

examples.text: A missed deadline could equal failure for the project.
examples.translation_cn: 错过最后期限可能意味着项目失败。

senses.meaning_en: having the ability or qualities needed

examples.text: She is equal to the task of leading the team.
examples.translation_cn: 她能胜任领导团队的任务。

senses.meaning_en: writing considered as an art form, especially novels, plays, and poetry

examples.text: She plans to study literature and history at university.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划在大学学习文学和历史。

senses.meaning_en: books and articles on a particular subject

examples.text: She reviewed the literature on climate change for her thesis.
examples.translation_cn: 她为论文查阅了关于气候变化的文献。

senses.meaning_en: fair and sensible; agreeable to reason

examples.text: It is reasonable to ask for more details.
examples.translation_cn: 要求提供更多细节是合理的。

senses.meaning_en: not excessive; within proper limits

examples.text: You should keep your demands within reasonable limits.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该把你的要求控制在合理的限度内。

senses.meaning_en: not expensive; fairly priced

examples.text: You can get a good meal here at a reasonable price.
examples.translation_cn: 在这里，你可以以合理的价格吃到一顿美餐。

senses.meaning_en: satisfactory; acceptable

examples.text: The house is in reasonable condition for its age.
examples.translation_cn: 这房子就其房龄而言状况还过得去。

senses.meaning_en: to want something very much

examples.text: She desires to become a nurse so she can support her family.
examples.translation_cn: 她渴望成为一名护士，以便养家糊口。

senses.meaning_en: a strong wish for something

examples.text: The pandemic has given many people a strong desire for real human connection.
examples.translation_cn: 疫情使许多人强烈渴望真实的人际联系。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for something formally

examples.text: The board desires a written response from the director within ten days.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会要求主管在十天内给出书面答复。

senses.meaning_en: most important; main

examples.text: Lack of exercise is a leading cause of diabetes.
examples.translation_cn: 缺乏锻炼是糖尿病的一个主要原因。

senses.meaning_en: ranking first; ahead of others

examples.text: She is the leading scorer in the league.
examples.translation_cn: 她是联盟里的头号得分手。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of making something smaller or less; a decrease

examples.text: There has been a sharp reduction in traffic since the new bridge opened.
examples.translation_cn: 新桥开通以来，这里的交通量急剧减少。

senses.meaning_en: an amount by which a price is reduced; a discount

examples.text: The store offered a 20% reduction on all winter coats.
examples.translation_cn: 该商店所有冬季外套八折优惠。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical reaction in which a substance gains electrons, often by losing oxygen or gaining hydrogen
senses.pattern: the reduction of X to Y

examples.text: The reduction of iron ore to iron requires high temperatures.
examples.translation_cn: 将铁矿石还原为铁需要高温。

senses.meaning_en: a sauce or liquid made thicker and more concentrated by boiling

examples.text: A reduction of red wine gives the sauce a rich flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 红酒浓缩汁为酱汁增添了浓郁的风味。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid or paste that dries into a solid coating, used to protect or add colour to surfaces

examples.text: We need to apply paint to the wooden fence before winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们入冬前需要给木栅栏刷油漆。

senses.meaning_en: a set of containers or blocks of paint of different colours, used for painting pictures

examples.text: She bought a new box of paints for her art class.
examples.translation_cn: 她为美术课买了一盒新颜料。

senses.meaning_en: to move your head up and down to show agreement or approval

examples.text: She nodded in agreement when I asked if she was ready.
examples.translation_cn: 当我问她是否准备好时，她点头表示同意。

senses.meaning_en: to fall asleep for a short time, especially unintentionally

examples.text: Grandpa often nods off in front of the TV.
examples.translation_cn: 爷爷经常在电视机前打瞌睡。

senses.meaning_en: to move your head down and up once as a greeting or signal

examples.text: He nodded at me as he walked past.
examples.translation_cn: 他从我身边走过时朝我点了点头。

senses.meaning_en: to move up and down repeatedly

examples.text: The tulips in the garden nodded gently in the breeze.
examples.translation_cn: 花园里的郁金香在微风中轻轻摇曳。

senses.meaning_en: the act of appointing someone to a job or position

examples.text: The board officially announced his appointment as CEO.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会正式宣布任命他为首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place

examples.text: I made an appointment with my professor for Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 我预约了周一见教授。

senses.meaning_en: a job or position to which someone is appointed

examples.text: She holds a senior appointment at the university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学担任高级职务。

senses.meaning_en: any material that produces heat or power when it is burnt

examples.text: The factory uses natural gas as fuel for its generators.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂使用天然气作为发电机的燃料。

senses.meaning_en: to increase or strengthen something, especially a feeling or situation

examples.text: His unexpected comments fuelled speculation about a possible merger.
examples.translation_cn: 他出人意料的评论引发了人们对可能合并的猜测。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes a feeling or situation stronger

examples.text: The latest report provided fresh fuel for the debate on education reform.
examples.translation_cn: 最新报告为教育改革辩论提供了新的弹药。

senses.meaning_en: to supply something with material that can be burnt to produce heat or power

examples.text: The ground crew fuelled the aircraft with aviation fuel before departure.
examples.translation_cn: 地勤人员在飞机起飞前给它加注了航空燃料。

senses.meaning_en: a flattened structure of a plant, usually green

examples.text: A leaf usually has a flat blade and a stalk.
examples.translation_cn: 叶子通常有扁平的叶片和叶柄。

senses.meaning_en: to turn the pages of a book, magazine, etc. quickly

examples.text: She leafed through the report before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会前翻阅了报告。

senses.meaning_en: dried leaves of tea

examples.text: She strained the tea leaves before pouring the tea.
examples.translation_cn: 她倒茶前滤掉了茶叶。

senses.meaning_en: a thin sheet of metal

examples.text: The craftsman applied gold leaf to the picture frame.
examples.translation_cn: 工匠给画框贴上金箔。

senses.meaning_en: to teach someone a skill or subject

examples.text: He instructs all new employees in safety procedures.
examples.translation_cn: 他给所有新员工讲授安全规程。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone to do something, especially formally
senses.collocation: instruct the jury to disregard the remark

examples.text: The judge instructed the jury to disregard the remark.
examples.translation_cn: 法官指示陪审团忽略那句话。

senses.meaning_en: detailed information on how to do or use something

examples.text: Follow the instructions on the box to assemble the toy.
examples.translation_cn: 按照盒子上的说明组装玩具。

senses.meaning_en: something that someone tells you to do

examples.text: She was under instructions to keep the information secret.
examples.translation_cn: 她被指示对信息保密。

senses.meaning_en: the act of teaching or providing information

examples.text: He provides instruction in basic computer skills every evening.
examples.translation_cn: 他每晚教授基础电脑技能。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to direct all your attention to one thing

examples.text: The game demands total concentration on every shot.
examples.translation_cn: 这项比赛需要全神贯注于每一次击球。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of a substance in a particular volume or mass
senses.pattern: the concentration of X in Y

examples.text: The concentration of salt in the water is too high.
examples.translation_cn: 水中盐的浓度太高了。

senses.meaning_en: a large number of people or things gathered together in one area

examples.text: There is a heavy concentration of troops along the border.
examples.translation_cn: 边境沿线有大量的军队集结。

senses.meaning_en: including everything; general

examples.text: The overall effect of the design is calm and modern.
examples.translation_cn: 设计的整体效果宁静而现代。

senses.meaning_en: generally; when everything is considered

examples.text: Overall, the project was considered a great success.
examples.translation_cn: 总的来说，这个项目被认为是巨大的成功。

senses.meaning_en: a protective garment with legs and a bib, held up by straps

examples.text: He spent the morning painting in his old overalls.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个上午穿着旧工装裤刷漆。

senses.meaning_en: a small area of still water, such as a swimming pool or pond

examples.text: The kids spent all afternoon in the pool.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在游泳池里。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of liquid lying on a surface

examples.text: A pool of blood had formed under the injured man's leg.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤男子腿下形成了一滩血。

senses.meaning_en: a supply of resources that people can share

examples.text: The company has a large pool of skilled engineers.
examples.translation_cn: 公司拥有大量熟练工程师。

senses.meaning_en: to combine resources for a shared purpose

examples.text: The two companies pooled their resources to develop a new product.
examples.translation_cn: 两家公司集中资源开发新产品。

senses.meaning_en: to move up towards the top of something using your hands and feet

examples.text: The firefighter climbed up the ladder to rescue the cat.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员爬上梯子去救猫。

senses.meaning_en: to increase in amount or level

examples.text: The unemployment rate climbed to six percent last month.
examples.translation_cn: 上个月失业率攀升至百分之六。

senses.meaning_en: to get into or onto a vehicle

examples.text: He climbed into the back seat and closed the door.
examples.translation_cn: 他爬进后座，关上了车门。

senses.meaning_en: to practise the sport of climbing

examples.text: They often go climbing in the mountains during the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们夏天常去山里攀岩。

senses.meaning_en: a white substance used to season and preserve food

examples.text: Add salt to the water before boiling the pasta.
examples.translation_cn: 煮面之前往水里加盐。

senses.meaning_en: to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

examples.text: She salted the meat and left it overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 她把肉抹上盐，放了一夜。

senses.meaning_en: skepticism; the attitude of not fully believing something
senses.pattern: take sth with a grain of salt

examples.text: You should take his claims with a grain of salt.
examples.translation_cn: 你应当对他的说法持保留态度。

senses.meaning_en: to become larger or make something larger in size, amount, number, or scope

examples.text: The company plans to expand into the European market next year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司计划明年扩展到欧洲市场。

senses.meaning_en: to give more details or a fuller account of something

examples.text: She asked him to expand on his earlier statement.
examples.translation_cn: 她请他详细说明他先前的陈述。

senses.meaning_en: to rewrite an algebraic expression as an equivalent sum of terms

examples.text: You can expand an expression into a sum of simpler terms.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把一个式子展开成更简单的项的和。

senses.meaning_en: a hard, shiny solid material that conducts heat and electricity

examples.text: The frame of the chair is made of metal, not plastic.
examples.translation_cn: 椅子的框架是金属做的，不是塑料。

senses.meaning_en: a type of loud rock music with strong drumbeats and electric guitars

examples.text: They play metal in a local band on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 他们周末在本地乐队演奏重金属音乐。

senses.meaning_en: to become impossible to see

examples.text: Suddenly the plane disappeared from the radar screen.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机突然从雷达屏幕上消失了。

senses.meaning_en: to be taken away secretly and killed or imprisoned, especially for political reasons

examples.text: Many activists were disappeared during the military dictatorship.
examples.translation_cn: 许多活动人士在军事独裁期间被秘密失踪。

senses.meaning_en: to no longer exist; to become extinct

examples.text: Many ancient species have disappeared from the earth.
examples.translation_cn: 许多古老物种已经从地球上灭绝了。

senses.meaning_en: to be lost or unable to be found; to go missing

examples.text: The child disappeared without a trace on his way home.
examples.translation_cn: 那个孩子在回家路上失踪了，杳无音信。

senses.meaning_en: to suggest that someone or something is good or suitable

examples.text: My teacher recommended this dictionary to the whole class.
examples.translation_cn: 我的老师向全班推荐了这本词典。

senses.meaning_en: to advise someone to do something

examples.text: Doctors recommend eating more fruit and vegetables every day.
examples.translation_cn: 医生建议每天多吃水果和蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: free from error; accurate

examples.text: Make sure all the details on the form are correct before you submit it.
examples.translation_cn: 提交表格之前，请确保所有细节都正确无误。

senses.meaning_en: to make something right or accurate; to remove errors from

examples.text: Please correct any spelling errors before you hand in your essay.
examples.translation_cn: 交作文之前，请改正任何拼写错误。

senses.meaning_en: proper; suitable; well-behaved

examples.text: Wearing jeans to a formal wedding is not the correct thing to do.
examples.translation_cn: 穿牛仔裤参加正式婚礼是不合适的。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone that they have made a mistake

examples.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but I think the meeting is on Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 如果我说错了请纠正，但我想会议是在星期二。

senses.meaning_en: the process of interpreting written language

examples.text: She did some reading before going to bed.
examples.translation_cn: 她睡前读了一会儿书。

senses.meaning_en: a value indicated by a measuring device

examples.text: The technician took a reading from the gas meter.
examples.translation_cn: 技术员从燃气表上读取了读数。

senses.meaning_en: an event at which written material is read aloud

examples.text: She invited me to a poetry reading at the library.
examples.translation_cn: 她邀请我去图书馆参加诗歌朗诵会。

senses.meaning_en: a pronunciation of a character or word

examples.text: This kanji has two different readings depending on context.
examples.translation_cn: 这个汉字根据语境有两种不同读音。

senses.meaning_en: as much as is needed; enough

examples.text: The evidence was sufficient to prove his guilt.
examples.translation_cn: 这些证据足以证明他有罪。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a city or town, or the people who live there

examples.text: More than half of the world's population now lives in urban areas.
examples.translation_cn: 现在世界上一半以上的人口居住在城市地区。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the mind

examples.text: She has struggled with her mental health since the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 她自从事故以来一直与心理健康作斗争。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or affected by a mental illness

examples.text: He was diagnosed with a serious mental illness last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有严重的精神疾病。

senses.meaning_en: crazy or irrational

examples.text: She went mental when she saw the mess in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到厨房一团糟时气得发疯。

senses.meaning_en: not in a place because of sickness, holiday, etc.

examples.text: He was absent from school yesterday because of a fever.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨天因为发烧没去上学。

senses.meaning_en: showing that you are not really looking at or thinking about what is happening around you

examples.text: She nodded with an absent look, lost in thought.
examples.translation_cn: 她心不在焉地点了点头，陷入沉思。

senses.meaning_en: to not go to or be in a place where you are expected to be, especially a meeting or class

examples.text: He absented himself from the meeting without giving a reason.
examples.translation_cn: 他没有说明理由就缺席了会议。

senses.meaning_en: without; in the absence of

examples.text: Absent a clear plan, the project is unlikely to succeed.
examples.translation_cn: 没有明确的计划，这个项目不太可能成功。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being away from a place or person

examples.text: His unexplained absence from school worried his parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他无法解释的缺课让父母很担心。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time when someone is away

examples.text: During his absence, the team continued to work efficiently.
examples.translation_cn: 他不在期间，团队继续高效工作。

senses.meaning_en: the lack or non-existence of something

examples.text: The complete absence of evidence made the case difficult.
examples.translation_cn: 完全没有证据使案子很难办。

senses.meaning_en: inattention to things present; absent-mindedness
senses.collocation: a moment of absence of mind

examples.text: In a moment of absence of mind, she signed the wrong form.
examples.translation_cn: 她一时心不在焉，签错了表格。

senses.meaning_en: the act of expressing disapproval or critical judgments

examples.text: The proposal drew sharp criticism of its environmental impact from local residents.
examples.translation_cn: 该提案因其环境影响招致了当地居民的尖锐批评。

senses.meaning_en: the analysis and judgment of the merits and faults of a literary or artistic work

examples.text: She teaches literary criticism at a well-known university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一所知名大学教授文学评论。

senses.meaning_en: a critical observation, review, or detailed examination

examples.text: He made several criticisms of the report during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会上对报告提出了几点批评意见。

senses.meaning_en: the work or profession of a teacher; the act of teaching

examples.text: He went into teaching because he wanted to help young people learn.
examples.translation_cn: 他从事教学工作是因为他想帮助年轻人学习。

senses.meaning_en: an idea or set of beliefs that is taught, especially by a religion or philosophy

examples.text: Many people still follow the teachings of Confucius.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人仍然遵循孔子的教导。

senses.meaning_en: a large round object in space that orbits a star

examples.text: The planet orbits a star similar to our sun.
examples.translation_cn: 这颗行星围绕着一颗与太阳相似的恒星运行。

senses.meaning_en: the Earth; the world we live on

examples.text: We must save the planet for future generations.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须为了子孙后代拯救地球。

senses.meaning_en: liked more than any other

examples.text: My favorite way to relax is reading by the window.
examples.translation_cn: 我最喜欢的放松方式是在窗边读书。

senses.meaning_en: to move or pass from one place, person or thing to another
senses.pattern: transfer sth from A to B

examples.text: You can transfer these files from your old phone to your new one.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把这些文件从旧手机转移到新手机。

senses.meaning_en: to change from one vehicle or line to another

examples.text: You'll need to transfer to the red line at Central Station.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要在中央车站换乘红线。

senses.meaning_en: to move to a different job, school, team, etc.

examples.text: She transferred to the London office last month.
examples.translation_cn: 她上个月调到了伦敦办事处。

senses.meaning_en: to examine or investigate something systematically

examples.text: The committee will explore all options before cutting costs.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将在削减开支之前探索所有方案。

senses.meaning_en: to travel around an area to learn about it

examples.text: We spent the weekend exploring the coastal villages on foot.
examples.translation_cn: 我们周末徒步探索了沿海村庄。

senses.meaning_en: to discuss or think about something carefully

examples.text: The article explores the topic of sleep and mental health.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章探讨了睡眠与心理健康这一主题。

senses.meaning_en: to experience something yourself, especially something new
senses.pattern: explore what it is like to do

examples.text: He lived in Paris to explore what it is like to work as a chef.
examples.translation_cn: 他住在巴黎，体验当厨师是怎样的感觉。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being wrong

examples.text: The package was sent in error to our old address.
examples.translation_cn: 包裹被错误地寄到了我们的旧地址。

senses.meaning_en: the difference between a measured or calculated value and the true value

examples.text: The survey results have a margin of error of three percent.
examples.translation_cn: 调查结果有百分之三的误差幅度。

senses.meaning_en: a mistake in a trial that may be grounds for review
senses.collocation: based on an error of law

examples.text: The appeal was based on an error of law during the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 这次上诉是基于审判过程中的法律错误。

senses.meaning_en: a mistake; an accidental wrong action or a false statement not made deliberately

examples.text: She made an error in judgment about the risks.
examples.translation_cn: 她对风险做出了错误的判断。

senses.meaning_en: the process of putting together the parts of something

examples.text: The assembly of the new engine takes about two hours.
examples.translation_cn: 新发动机的组装大约需要两个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people gathered together in one place for a particular purpose

examples.text: The school holds an assembly every Monday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 学校每周一早上举行一次集会。

senses.meaning_en: a group of elected people who make laws or decisions for a country or region

examples.text: She was elected to the state assembly last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被选入州议会。

senses.meaning_en: a group of parts that fit together to make a complete machine or device

examples.text: An assembly of parts can be replaced as one unit.
examples.translation_cn: 一组零件可以作为一个整体进行更换。

senses.meaning_en: a person who hates or wants to harm you

examples.text: He made an enemy of his boss by refusing to lie.
examples.translation_cn: 他因拒绝撒谎而与老板结仇。

senses.meaning_en: a hostile force or its soldiers

examples.text: The soldiers were ordered to engage the enemy at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们奉命在拂晓与敌军交战。

senses.meaning_en: something harmful or threatening

examples.text: Cold weather is an enemy of these tropical plants.
examples.translation_cn: 寒冷的天气是这些热带植物的一大危害。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to or relating to an enemy

examples.text: The patrol came under enemy fire near the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 巡逻队在桥附近遭到敌方火力袭击。

senses.meaning_en: sour or sharp to the taste; having the properties of an acid

examples.text: These green apples have an acid taste that makes your mouth pucker.
examples.translation_cn: 这些青苹果有酸味，让你的嘴巴发皱。

senses.meaning_en: sharp and hurtful in speech; sarcastic

examples.text: She made an acid remark about his untidy room.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他凌乱的房间说了句尖酸的话。

senses.meaning_en: denoting a style of electronic dance music with a fast beat and psychedelic effects, as in acid house

examples.text: They danced all night to acid house at the club.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整夜在俱乐部里伴着酸性浩室音乐跳舞。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical substance, usually liquid, that contains hydrogen and reacts with metals and bases

examples.text: The car battery contains sulfuric acid and should be handled with care.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车电池含有硫酸，应小心处理。

senses.meaning_en: to encircle or extend all around something

examples.text: The small village is surrounded by green hills.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村庄被绿色的小山环绕着。

senses.meaning_en: to enclose or confine on all sides so as to prevent escape

examples.text: Police surrounded the building and blocked all exits.
examples.translation_cn: 警察包围了大楼并封锁了所有出口。

senses.meaning_en: a border or area around the edge of something, such as a bath or fireplace

examples.text: They fitted a marble surround around the fireplace.
examples.translation_cn: 他们给壁炉安装了大理石围边。

senses.meaning_en: a person who competes in athletics such as running, jumping, and throwing

examples.text: She is a track-and-field athlete who trains six days a week.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一名田径运动员，每周训练六天。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes part in a sport, especially as a professional or skilled competitor

examples.text: He became a professional athlete at nineteen and won his first medal at twenty.
examples.translation_cn: 他十九岁成为职业运动员，二十岁时赢得第一枚奖牌。

senses.meaning_en: payment of a debt or claim

examples.text: The company paid $50,000 in settlement of the claim.
examples.translation_cn: 公司支付了5万美元以了结该索赔。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people live together; a colony or community

examples.text: The settlement on the coast was founded by fishermen in the 1800s.
examples.translation_cn: 该海岸定居点由渔民建于19世纪。

senses.meaning_en: an official agreement that ends a dispute

examples.text: The two sides reached a settlement after long talks.
examples.translation_cn: 双方经过长时间谈判达成了协议。

senses.meaning_en: related to or connected with science

examples.text: They are conducting scientific research on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 他们正在进行关于气候变化的科学研究。

senses.meaning_en: careful and systematic

examples.text: A scientific approach to language teaching relies on evidence rather than intuition.
examples.translation_cn: 科学严谨的语言教学方法依靠证据而非直觉。

senses.meaning_en: the spiritual part of a person, believed to exist after death

examples.text: Many people believe in the soul and an afterlife.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人相信灵魂和来世。

senses.meaning_en: life, energy, vigor

examples.text: She put her whole soul into the performance.
examples.translation_cn: 她把全部精力投入到这场演出中。

senses.meaning_en: a person, especially in negative statements

examples.text: There was not a soul in the office after midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 午夜过后办公室里一个人也没有。

senses.meaning_en: soul music

examples.text: I often listen to soul when I drive.
examples.translation_cn: 我开车时经常听灵魂乐。

senses.meaning_en: to take upon oneself; to start or embark on

examples.text: She decided to undertake the task of planning the entire conference.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定承担规划整个会议的任务。

senses.meaning_en: to commit oneself to an obligation or activity

examples.text: He undertook to pay back the loan within a year.
examples.translation_cn: 他承诺一年内还清贷款。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people chosen to discuss or judge something, often on television or radio

examples.text: She was invited to serve on a panel that selects the award winners.
examples.translation_cn: 她受邀加入一个评审小组，负责评选获奖者。

senses.meaning_en: a flat board or surface, especially one forming part of a larger structure or device

examples.text: The front panel of the oven gets very hot during use.
examples.translation_cn: 烤箱的前面板在使用时会变得很烫。

senses.meaning_en: one of the separate drawings in a comic strip or graphic novel

examples.text: In the last panel, the cat suddenly jumps off the table.
examples.translation_cn: 在最后一格漫画里，猫突然从桌子上跳了下来。

senses.meaning_en: having a husband or wife

examples.text: She has been happily married to a doctor for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她与一位医生结婚十多年，婚姻幸福。

senses.meaning_en: strongly committed or attached to something

examples.text: He is married to his job and rarely takes a holiday.
examples.translation_cn: 他醉心于工作，很少休假。

senses.meaning_en: a device used to produce music

examples.text: She plays an instrument in a local jazz band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地爵士乐队演奏一种乐器。

senses.meaning_en: a tool or device used for manipulation or measurement

examples.text: The surgeon used an instrument to remove the damaged tissue.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生用一件器械切除了受损组织。

senses.meaning_en: a formal legal document

examples.text: Both parties must sign the instrument to make the agreement legally binding.
examples.translation_cn: 双方必须签署该文书，使协议具有法律约束力。

senses.meaning_en: a means or agency for achieving something

examples.text: Education is a powerful instrument for social change.
examples.translation_cn: 教育是社会变革的有力工具。

senses.meaning_en: during the time that; at the same time as

examples.text: She kept typing whilst listening to the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她一边打字一边听新闻。

senses.meaning_en: although; in spite of the fact that

examples.text: Whilst it is true that the plan is risky, it is worth trying.
examples.translation_cn: 虽然这个计划确实有风险，但值得一试。

senses.meaning_en: whereas; in contrast

examples.text: Some students learn best by reading, whilst others prefer listening.
examples.translation_cn: 有些学生通过阅读学习效果最好，而另一些则更喜欢听。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something will happen in the future

examples.text: Experts predict that the economy will recover next year.
examples.translation_cn: 专家预测经济明年将复苏。

senses.meaning_en: a television or radio station and its programs

examples.text: Dad changed channels as soon as the commercials started.
examples.translation_cn: 广告一开始，爸爸就换了频道。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow body of water between two land masses

examples.text: The channel between England and France is one of the busiest shipping lanes.
examples.translation_cn: 英法之间的海峡是最繁忙的航道之一。

senses.meaning_en: a natural or man-made deeper course through shallow water, or the navigable part of a river

examples.text: Large vessels must navigate the shipping channel slowly to avoid running aground.
examples.translation_cn: 大型船只需缓慢航行于航道以避免搁浅。

senses.meaning_en: a way or system for communicating, distributing, or doing something

examples.text: The information was passed through official channels to the press office.
examples.translation_cn: 信息通过官方渠道传递到了新闻办公室。

senses.meaning_en: a strong feeling such as love, anger, or fear

examples.text: After the funeral, she found it hard to express emotion.
examples.translation_cn: 葬礼后，她发现自己很难表达情感。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the emotions

examples.text: Children need emotional support from their parents to feel secure.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们需要父母的情感支持才能感到安全。

senses.meaning_en: easily affected by emotion; characterized by emotion

examples.text: He often gets emotional about small things that remind him of home.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常因为让他想起家的小事而情绪激动。

senses.meaning_en: determined by strong emotion rather than logic

examples.text: She made an emotional decision and later regretted it.
examples.translation_cn: 她做了一个感情用事的决定，后来后悔了。

senses.meaning_en: appealing to or arousing emotion

examples.text: Many viewers found the final scene of the film deeply emotional.
examples.translation_cn: 许多观众觉得电影的最后一场戏非常感人。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money charged for professional services

examples.text: She charges a fee for her legal advice.
examples.translation_cn: 她为自己的法律咨询收取费用。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money paid for the right to do something
senses.pattern: pay a fee to do sth

examples.text: You must pay a small fee to enter the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须付一小笔费用才能进入博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: having power over all others; dominant

examples.text: The emperor reigned supreme over all the regional rulers.
examples.translation_cn: 皇帝凌驾于所有地方统治者之上。

senses.meaning_en: greatest or most extreme

examples.text: Access to education is of supreme importance for children.
examples.translation_cn: 受教育对儿童至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: a bag sewn into clothing for carrying small items

examples.text: He kept his hands in his pockets because it was cold.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为冷把手插在口袋里。

senses.meaning_en: one of the netted holes around the edge of a billiard table

examples.text: She drove the ball into a side pocket to win the frame.
examples.translation_cn: 她把球打入边袋赢得了这一局。

senses.meaning_en: small enough to fit in a pocket; compact

examples.text: She always keeps a pocket dictionary in her bag.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是在包里放一本袖珍词典。

senses.meaning_en: a person's financial resources

examples.text: We paid for the repairs out of pocket.
examples.translation_cn: 我们自掏腰包付了修理费。

senses.meaning_en: the degree of heat or cold of a place or thing

examples.text: The water reached a temperature of 90 degrees Celsius.
examples.translation_cn: 水温达到了九十摄氏度。

senses.meaning_en: an abnormally high body temperature; fever

examples.text: She had a temperature and stayed in bed all day.
examples.translation_cn: 她发烧了，整天卧床休息。

senses.meaning_en: a survey of public opinion

examples.text: According to a recent poll, most employees prefer flexible working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 根据最近的一项民意调查，大多数员工更喜欢弹性工作时间。

senses.meaning_en: a formal vote or the number of votes cast

examples.text: The candidate topped the poll with over sixty percent of the votes.
examples.translation_cn: 该候选人在投票中以超过百分之六十的得票率高居榜首。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people vote

examples.text: Voters lined up at the polls early in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 选民们一大早就到投票站排队。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling caused by something unexpected

examples.text: She stared at the blank screen in surprise.
examples.translation_cn: 她惊讶地盯着空白的屏幕。

senses.meaning_en: an unexpected event or thing

examples.text: The visit was a surprise for her parents.
examples.translation_cn: 这次来访让她的父母很意外。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel surprised

examples.text: The news of his resignation completely surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他辞职的消息让所有人都很惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: to do something unexpected for someone as a surprise

examples.text: He surprised his parents with a short visit.
examples.translation_cn: 他去看望父母，给了他们一个惊喜。

senses.meaning_en: the use of more money, time, energy, etc. than is necessary or useful

examples.text: The long meeting was a waste of time and money for everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 这次漫长的会议对每个人来说都是浪费时间和金钱。

senses.meaning_en: unwanted materials or substances that are left after you have used something, or substances that are no longer needed

examples.text: Residents must dispose of household waste separately from recyclables.
examples.translation_cn: 居民必须将生活垃圾与可回收物分开处理。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land that is empty and has no living things or has been destroyed

examples.text: They walked through a desolate waste land for days.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一片荒凉的废土上走了好几天。

senses.meaning_en: solid or liquid material that your body gets rid of, especially excrement or urine

examples.text: The campers buried their human waste to keep the area clean.
examples.translation_cn: 露营者掩埋了他们的粪便以保持该地区清洁。

senses.meaning_en: happening or doing something often; occurring at short intervals

examples.text: Power cuts are frequent in the old quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 老城区经常停电。

senses.meaning_en: to visit often

examples.text: He used to frequent the jazz clubs around the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 他过去常去港口附近的爵士乐俱乐部。

senses.meaning_en: at frequent intervals; often

examples.text: People frequently check their phones during meetings without realizing it.
examples.translation_cn: 人们在开会时经常不自觉地查看手机。

senses.meaning_en: to have something as a necessary part or result

examples.text: The new policy implies higher costs for small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策意味着小企业成本上升。

senses.meaning_en: to suggest something without saying it directly

examples.text: He didn't say it directly, but he implied that I was lying.
examples.translation_cn: 他没有直说，但他暗示我在撒谎。

senses.meaning_en: a possible effect or result of an action or decision

examples.text: This decision has serious implications for public health.
examples.translation_cn: 这项决定对公共健康有严重影响。

senses.meaning_en: something that is suggested or indirectly stated

examples.text: The implication was that he had known all along.
examples.translation_cn: 言外之意是他一直都知道。

senses.meaning_en: the act or state of being implicated in something bad

examples.text: His implication in the scandal ended his career.
examples.translation_cn: 他与该丑闻有牵连，这断送了他的职业生涯。

senses.meaning_en: an act of breathing in or out

examples.text: She took a deep breath and began to speak.
examples.translation_cn: 她深吸了一口气，开始说话。

senses.meaning_en: air breathed out, especially as smell

examples.text: His breath smelled of garlic long after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后很久他呼出的气还有蒜味。

senses.meaning_en: a slight movement of air; a trace of something

examples.text: There was a breath of wind in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 花园里有一丝微风。

senses.meaning_en: the act of identifying someone or something from previous experience

examples.text: His recognition of the thief in the police lineup helped solve the case.
examples.translation_cn: 他在警方列队辨认中认出窃贼，帮助破案。

senses.meaning_en: acceptance that something is true, valid, or official

examples.text: The recognition of the new government as legitimate came after long peace talks.
examples.translation_cn: 新政府被承认为合法是在漫长的和谈之后。

senses.meaning_en: public praise or reward for someone's achievements

examples.text: The scientist won the prize in recognition of her major discovery.
examples.translation_cn: 这位科学家因重大发现而获奖。

senses.meaning_en: one of several parts that combine to form a whole; a piece of a machine or system

examples.text: Trust is an essential component of any strong team.
examples.translation_cn: 信任是任何强大团队的重要组成部分。

senses.meaning_en: forming part of a larger whole

examples.text: The component parts of the machine must be checked before assembly.
examples.translation_cn: 机器的零部件在组装前必须检查。

senses.meaning_en: a country that has an elected government and no monarch

examples.text: The country became a republic after a long struggle.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家经过长期斗争后成为一个共和国。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people regarded as equals within a particular field

examples.text: She felt at home in the republic of letters.
examples.translation_cn: 她在文学界感到很自在。

senses.meaning_en: less important, serious, or significant

examples.text: He played a minor role in the team's success.
examples.translation_cn: 他在团队的成功中扮演了次要角色。

senses.meaning_en: a person under the legal age of adulthood
senses.pattern: minors are not allowed to do

examples.text: Minors are not allowed to purchase alcohol in this state.
examples.translation_cn: 这个州未成年人不得购买酒精饮品。

senses.meaning_en: a secondary subject studied at college or university

examples.text: She decided to take a minor in psychology during her degree.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定在攻读学位期间辅修心理学。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who form less than half of a larger group

examples.text: People who disagree with the plan are in the minority.
examples.translation_cn: 不赞成这项计划的人占少数。

senses.meaning_en: a person who belongs to a minority group, especially an ethnic one

examples.text: She was a minority in the department and often had to speak for her ethnic group.
examples.translation_cn: 她在部门里是少数族裔，经常不得不代表她的族群发言。

senses.meaning_en: in a serious or literal manner

examples.text: She takes her responsibilities at work very seriously.
examples.translation_cn: 她对待工作上的职责非常认真。

senses.meaning_en: gravely; deeply; very much

examples.text: The bridge was seriously damaged by the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥被洪水严重损坏。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce a serious point

examples.text: Seriously, you should think about moving to a bigger city.
examples.translation_cn: 说真的，你应该考虑搬去更大的城市。

senses.meaning_en: used to express disbelief or emphasis

examples.text: Seriously? You forgot our anniversary again last week?
examples.translation_cn: 不会吧？你上周又把我们的纪念日忘了？

senses.meaning_en: correctly; in a satisfactory way

examples.text: Make sure you do the task properly before you submit it.
examples.translation_cn: 提交之前，务必把任务正确完成。

senses.meaning_en: in a socially acceptable way; politely

examples.text: The children were told to behave properly at the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们被告知在典礼上要举止得体。

senses.meaning_en: thoroughly; completely

examples.text: We were properly tired after the long hill walk.
examples.translation_cn: 走了很长的山路后，我们累坏了。

senses.meaning_en: not alike; dissimilar

examples.text: The two designs are quite unlike, though they both serve the same purpose.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种设计很不相似，尽管它们用途相同。

senses.meaning_en: different from; not like; in contrast with

examples.text: Unlike many politicians, she actually keeps her promises.
examples.translation_cn: 与许多政客不同，她真的信守承诺。

senses.meaning_en: not typical of one's character or personality
senses.pattern: It is unlike sb to do sth

examples.text: It is unlike him to forget his keys.
examples.translation_cn: 他不像是会忘记钥匙的人。

senses.meaning_en: not likely to happen; not probable

examples.text: The train is unlikely to arrive on time.
examples.translation_cn: 火车不太可能准时到达。

senses.meaning_en: not holding out a prospect of success; likely to fail; unpromising

examples.text: He seemed an unlikely candidate for the job.
examples.translation_cn: 他看起来不太可能获得这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: in part; to some degree but not completely

examples.text: She left early partly because she was tired.
examples.translation_cn: 她提前离开，部分是因为累了。

senses.meaning_en: in, at, or to some other place

examples.text: The restaurant was full, so we decided to go elsewhere.
examples.translation_cn: 餐厅客满了，所以我们决定去别处。

senses.meaning_en: inevitably; of necessity

examples.text: Improving the system will necessarily involve some disruption to services.
examples.translation_cn: 改进系统必然会给服务带来一些干扰。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something is not always true or does not always happen

examples.text: A higher price does not necessarily mean better quality.
examples.translation_cn: 价格更高并不一定意味着质量更好。

senses.meaning_en: all the people living together in a house or flat; a domestic unit

examples.text: A household of six needs a much larger budget for food.
examples.translation_cn: 一个六口之家需要更多的食物预算。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a home or house; used in homes

examples.text: The store sells a wide range of household goods.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店出售各种家用商品。

senses.meaning_en: the work involved in running a home and managing family affairs

examples.text: She runs the entire household on her own.
examples.translation_cn: 她独自操持整个家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who shows the way, especially one employed to guide tourists

examples.text: She works as a tour guide in Rome during the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个夏天在罗马当旅游向导。

senses.meaning_en: a book or document that gives information or instructions

examples.text: This book is a practical guide to growing tomatoes at home.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书是在家种植西红柿的实用指南。

senses.meaning_en: a sign or object that shows the way

examples.text: A row of orange flags served as a guide for drivers entering the construction zone.
examples.translation_cn: 一排橙色旗帜为进入施工区的司机充当路标。

senses.meaning_en: to be losing or behind in a competition

examples.text: Our team trailed by ten points at half-time.
examples.translation_cn: 我们队在半场时落后十分。

senses.meaning_en: to follow someone secretly

examples.text: The detective trailed the suspect through the busy market.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探在繁忙的市场里跟踪那个嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: a path through the countryside or forest

examples.text: We followed a trail through the dark pine forest.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着一条小路穿过了黑暗的松树林。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a trail of something

examples.text: The wounded deer trailed blood across the snow.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤的鹿在雪地上留下血迹。

senses.meaning_en: to hang or drag loosely behind

examples.text: Her long dress trailed behind her as she walked.
examples.translation_cn: 她走路时长长的连衣裙拖在身后。

senses.meaning_en: new and original, not like anything seen before

examples.text: The team developed a novel way of recycling old batteries.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队开发了一种回收旧电池的新方法。

senses.meaning_en: a long written story, usually in prose

examples.text: She borrowed a novel about life in a small Irish town.
examples.translation_cn: 她借了一本关于爱尔兰小镇生活的小说。

senses.meaning_en: newly made, formed, or evolved; having no precedent; of recent origin; new

examples.text: Scientists identified a novel strain of the virus in bats.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在蝙蝠体内发现了一种新型病毒株。

senses.meaning_en: in some way not yet known or explained; by some means

examples.text: We somehow managed to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 我们设法按时完成了项目。

senses.meaning_en: for some reason that is not clear; in a way that is surprising

examples.text: He somehow felt uneasy about the whole plan.
examples.translation_cn: 他不知何故对整个计划感到不安。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people chosen to hear a court case and decide the verdict

examples.text: She was called to serve on a jury for a murder trial.
examples.translation_cn: 她被传召在一桩谋杀案审判中担任陪审员。

senses.meaning_en: a group of judges in a competition
senses.pattern: the jury awards sth to sb

examples.text: The jury awarded the top prize to a young pianist.
examples.translation_cn: 评审团将最高奖授予了一位年轻钢琴家。

senses.meaning_en: the chest; the front part of the human thorax

examples.text: The old soldier wore his medals on his left breast.
examples.translation_cn: 这位老士兵把勋章戴在左胸。

senses.meaning_en: the seat of emotions and innermost thoughts; the heart

examples.text: A sudden feeling of hope rose in her breast.
examples.translation_cn: 她胸中突然涌起希望。

senses.meaning_en: a cut of meat from the breast of poultry or other animals

examples.text: He served a tender breast of chicken with rice.
examples.translation_cn: 他上了一份嫩鸡胸肉配米饭。

senses.meaning_en: either of the two milk-secreting organs on a woman's chest

examples.text: She found a lump in her left breast while showering.
examples.translation_cn: 她淋浴时在左乳发现了一个肿块。

senses.meaning_en: free from sound or noise; quiet

examples.text: The whole village fell silent in the snow.
examples.translation_cn: 整个村庄在雪中寂静无声。

senses.meaning_en: not speaking; not talkative

examples.text: She remained silent when questioned by the police.
examples.translation_cn: 面对警察的询问，她保持沉默。

senses.meaning_en: not pronounced; having no sound

examples.text: The letter 'h' is silent in the word 'hour'.
examples.translation_cn: 字母 h 在 hour 中不发音。

senses.meaning_en: the absence of any sound

examples.text: The silence of the mountains was broken only by the wind.
examples.translation_cn: 山间的寂静只被风声打破。

senses.meaning_en: the act of refraining from speaking

examples.text: They ate their dinner in silence, both lost in thought.
examples.translation_cn: 他们默默地吃着晚饭，各自陷入沉思。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something silent

examples.text: A sudden power cut silenced the entire building.
examples.translation_cn: 突然的停电使整栋楼安静下来。

senses.meaning_en: to repress the expression of something

examples.text: The government tried to silence dissent by closing newspapers.
examples.translation_cn: 政府试图通过关闭报纸来压制异议。

senses.meaning_en: to admit or accept that something is true

examples.text: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。

senses.meaning_en: to recognize someone's status, ability, or authority

examples.text: Historians now acknowledge her as a pioneer of modern art.
examples.translation_cn: 历史学家现在承认她是现代艺术的先驱。

senses.meaning_en: to confirm that you have received something

examples.text: Please acknowledge receipt of this message by email.
examples.translation_cn: 请通过电子邮件确认收到此消息。

senses.meaning_en: the number 60

examples.text: My father is sixty years old, but he still runs every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲六十岁了，但他仍然每天早上跑步。

senses.meaning_en: the subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art

examples.text: The theme of the book is family relationships.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书的主题是家庭关系。

senses.meaning_en: the main melody of a piece of music, especially one that is the source of variations

examples.text: The theme from Titanic is instantly recognizable worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 《泰坦尼克号》的主题曲在全世界立刻就能听出来。

senses.meaning_en: the act of publishing printed matter

examples.text: The publication of her first novel was delayed by two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一部小说的出版被推迟了两年。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making information known to the public

examples.text: The report was leaked before its official publication.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告在正式公布前被泄露了。

senses.meaning_en: a published book, magazine, or similar work

examples.text: She works as an editor for a monthly fashion publication.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家时尚月刊担任编辑。

senses.meaning_en: a formal written agreement between countries or organizations

examples.text: The two nations signed a peace treaty after years of negotiation.
examples.translation_cn: 两国经过多年谈判后签署了一项和平条约。

senses.meaning_en: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially over a long distance

examples.text: They went on a long journey across the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 他们穿越沙漠进行了一次长途旅行。

senses.meaning_en: a long and often difficult process of change or personal development

examples.text: Her recovery was a journey of small daily victories.
examples.translation_cn: 她的康复是一次每天都有小胜利的历程。

senses.meaning_en: to travel somewhere, especially over a long distance

examples.text: They journeyed to the coast for the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们前往海岸过夏天。

senses.meaning_en: a dark shape made on a surface when something blocks light

examples.text: The tall fence cast a long shadow on the grass.
examples.translation_cn: 高高的栅栏在草地上投下长长的影子。

senses.meaning_en: partial darkness, especially in a place

examples.text: A man stood in the shadows near the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 一个男人站在大门附近的阴影里。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of sadness or worry that follows a bad event

examples.text: The scandal cast a shadow over the mayor's career.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻给市长的职业生涯蒙上了阴影。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount; a trace
senses.pattern: beyond a shadow of a doubt

examples.text: The photo proves her point beyond a shadow of a doubt.
examples.translation_cn: 这张照片毫无疑问地证明了她的观点。

senses.meaning_en: to follow and watch somebody closely and secretly

examples.text: Police shadowed the suspect for nearly two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 警方几乎跟踪了嫌疑人两周。

senses.meaning_en: to try very hard to do something difficult

examples.text: The young artist struggled to make a name for herself in the crowded art market.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻艺术家努力在竞争激烈的艺术市场中成名。

senses.meaning_en: a hard fight or effort to achieve something

examples.text: The team faced a struggle for survival after losing their sponsor.
examples.translation_cn: 失去赞助商后，团队面临着一场生存斗争。

senses.meaning_en: to fight physically against someone

examples.text: The burglar struggled with the homeowner until police arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 窃贼与房主扭打，直到警察赶到。

senses.meaning_en: the whole amount resulting from addition

examples.text: The sum of the three angles in a triangle is always 180 degrees.
examples.translation_cn: 三角形内角之和总是180度。

senses.meaning_en: a quantity of money

examples.text: He paid a large sum of money for the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他花了一大笔钱买这辆车。

senses.meaning_en: a simple arithmetic calculation

examples.text: I had to do some quick sums to check the bill.
examples.translation_cn: 我不得不快速算一下账单。

senses.meaning_en: to give a summary of

examples.text: She summed up the main points of the report.
examples.translation_cn: 她总结了报告的要点。

senses.meaning_en: to make something clear by giving examples or comparisons

examples.text: She illustrated her argument with a simple chart.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一张简单的图表阐明了她的论点。

senses.meaning_en: to provide a book or publication with pictures or diagrams

examples.text: This textbook is illustrated with clear diagrams and photos.
examples.translation_cn: 这本教科书配有清晰的图表和照片。

senses.meaning_en: to show that something is true or that a situation exists

examples.text: These results illustrate that regular exercise reduces stress.
examples.translation_cn: 这些结果表明定期锻炼能减轻压力。

senses.meaning_en: the person in command of a ship

examples.text: The captain of the ship remained calm during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 船长在暴风雨中保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: the pilot in command of an aircraft

examples.text: The captain of the flight announced that we would be landing soon.
examples.translation_cn: 机长宣布我们即将降落。

senses.meaning_en: the leader of a team or group

examples.text: He was chosen as captain of the basketball team.
examples.translation_cn: 他被选为篮球队队长。

senses.meaning_en: an officer in the army, navy, or air force

examples.text: He served as a captain in the army for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在陆军当了十年上尉。

senses.meaning_en: to move or change from one position, direction, or focus to another

examples.text: The company shifted its focus from manufacturing to software.
examples.translation_cn: 公司将重点从制造业转向了软件。

senses.meaning_en: a slight movement or change in position, direction, or focus

examples.text: There has been a shift in public opinion on this issue.
examples.translation_cn: 公众对这一问题的看法发生了转变。

senses.meaning_en: a scheduled period of work, or the group of workers who work during this period

examples.text: She works the night shift at the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在医院上夜班。

senses.meaning_en: a key on a keyboard used to type capital letters and symbols

examples.text: Hold down the Shift key and press A to type a capital letter.
examples.translation_cn: 按住 Shift 键并按 A 键即可输入大写字母。

senses.meaning_en: a simple straight, loose-fitting dress

examples.text: She wore a simple black shift dress to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿了一件简单的黑色直筒连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: to move something to a later time

examples.text: We can shift the product catalogue page to next week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以把产品目录页推迟到下周。

senses.meaning_en: a stage in a process of change or development

examples.text: The company is entering a critical phase of expansion.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正在进入扩张的关键阶段。

senses.meaning_en: To show conspicuously; to exhibit; to demonstrate; to manifest.

examples.text: She displayed great courage when she rescued the child from the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 她从火中救出孩子时表现出了巨大的勇气。

senses.meaning_en: An electronic screen that shows graphics or text.

examples.text: The flight details are shown on the display above the check-in desk.
examples.translation_cn: 航班信息显示在值机柜台上方的显示屏上。

senses.meaning_en: The presentation of information for visual or tactile reception.

examples.text: Rare manuscripts are currently on display at the city museum.
examples.translation_cn: 珍稀手稿目前正在市博物馆展出。

senses.meaning_en: A show or spectacle.

examples.text: The festival ended with a spectacular display of fireworks over the harbor.
examples.translation_cn: 节日以海港上空壮观的烟花表演结束。

senses.meaning_en: a new plan or process to achieve something or solve a problem

examples.text: The city launched an initiative to reduce plastic waste.
examples.translation_cn: 该市启动了一项减少塑料垃圾的倡议。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to act first or on one's own; a first move

examples.text: She took the initiative to organize the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她主动组织会议。

senses.meaning_en: an issue to be voted on, brought to the ballot by a sufficient number of signatures from among the voting public

examples.text: A voter initiative to raise the minimum wage will appear on the ballot.
examples.translation_cn: 一项提高最低工资的公民提案将出现在选票上。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce the main point or a simple summary

examples.text: Basically, we need to cut costs and improve quality.
examples.translation_cn: 基本上，我们需要削减成本并提高质量。

senses.meaning_en: in the main or most important ways; essentially

examples.text: The plan is basically sound, but it needs more details.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划基本上是合理的，但还需要更多细节。

senses.meaning_en: a set of events, actions, numbers, etc. that follow each other in a particular order

examples.text: The police are investigating a sequence of strange events.
examples.translation_cn: 警方正在调查一连串奇怪的事件。

senses.meaning_en: the order in which things happen or are arranged

examples.text: The cards are arranged in sequence from 1 to 100.
examples.translation_cn: 卡片按从1到100的顺序排列。

senses.meaning_en: an ordered set of numbers, etc.

examples.text: The numbers 2, 4, 6, 8 form an arithmetic sequence.
examples.translation_cn: 数字2、4、6、8构成一个等差数列。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange things in a particular order; to determine the order of

examples.text: Scientists can now sequence an entire genome in a day.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家现在一天就能测定整个基因组的序列。

senses.meaning_en: by a lot of people or in many places

examples.text: Solar panels are widely used in sunny regions.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳能电池板在阳光充足的地区被广泛使用。

senses.meaning_en: to a great degree; very much

examples.text: Opinions on this issue vary widely among experts.
examples.translation_cn: 专家们在这个问题上的意见大相径庭。

senses.meaning_en: to get free; to free oneself

examples.text: Two prisoners escaped from the local jail last night.
examples.translation_cn: 两名囚犯昨晚从当地监狱逃走了。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid something unpleasant; to elude

examples.text: The driver narrowly escaped injury in the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 司机在车祸中侥幸没有受伤。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid punishment; to get away with something

examples.text: The boys escaped with a warning from the head teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 男孩们只受到校长的警告，没有受到更重的处罚。

senses.meaning_en: a way of forgetting problems or avoiding reality

examples.text: For many people, music is an escape from daily stress.
examples.translation_cn: 对许多人来说，音乐是摆脱日常压力的一种方式。

senses.meaning_en: to be forgotten by someone; to fail to be remembered

examples.text: I'm afraid his name escapes me right now.
examples.translation_cn: 恐怕我此刻想不起他的名字。

senses.meaning_en: a general direction in which something is developing or changing; a tendency

examples.text: There is a clear trend toward flexible working.
examples.translation_cn: 灵活工作有明显的上升趋势。

senses.meaning_en: a fashion or popular style

examples.text: Celebrities often set a trend for casual wear.
examples.translation_cn: 名人经常引领休闲装潮流。

senses.meaning_en: to change or develop in a general direction

examples.text: Unemployment has trended upward for three months in a row.
examples.translation_cn: 失业率连续三个月呈上升趋势。

senses.meaning_en: to be widely discussed on social media or online

examples.text: The topic trended on social media all weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 这个话题整个周末在社交媒体上都是热门。

senses.meaning_en: contentment; ease

examples.text: After a long journey, she relaxed in comfort on the hotel bed.
examples.translation_cn: 长途旅行后，她在酒店床上舒适地放松。

senses.meaning_en: consolation; something that relieves suffering or worry

examples.text: He took comfort in the support of his close friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他在密友的支持中得到安慰。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel less worried or unhappy; to relieve distress or suffering

examples.text: The nurse comforted the frightened patient before the procedure.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在手术前安慰了受惊的病人。

senses.meaning_en: providing physical comfort and ease

examples.text: This old armchair is very comfortable to sit in.
examples.translation_cn: 这把旧扶手椅坐上去非常舒服。

senses.meaning_en: feeling physically relaxed and free from worry

examples.text: She now feels comfortable speaking in front of a crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 她现在在众人面前讲话感到自在了。

senses.meaning_en: amply sufficient or satisfactory

examples.text: The team won the game by a comfortable margin.
examples.translation_cn: 这支队伍以明显优势赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: having enough money to live without financial worry

examples.text: They have a comfortable income from their investments.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从投资中获得宽裕的收入。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who work together

examples.text: A crew of six set up the stage before the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 六名工作人员在音乐会前搭好了舞台。

senses.meaning_en: all the people working on a ship or plane

examples.text: The crew of the ship refused to leave during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 船员们在暴风雨中拒绝离开。

senses.meaning_en: the sport of rowing in a crew

examples.text: She rowed crew at university and won two medals.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学参加赛艇运动并获得两枚奖牌。

senses.meaning_en: to be a member of a vessel's crew

examples.text: He crewed on a fishing boat last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年夏天在一艘渔船上当船员。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of body tissue that can contract to produce movement

examples.text: He pulled a muscle in his leg while playing football.
examples.translation_cn: 他踢足球时拉伤了腿部肌肉。

senses.meaning_en: physical strength or power

examples.text: It takes real muscle to lift a piano by yourself.
examples.translation_cn: 独自抬起一架钢琴需要真正的力气。

senses.meaning_en: power or influence, especially in business or politics

examples.text: The union used its political muscle to block the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 工会运用其政治影响力阻止了新法律。

senses.meaning_en: to use force to make progress or to move forcefully

examples.text: He muscled his way through the crowd to the front.
examples.translation_cn: 他用力挤过人群到了前面。

senses.meaning_en: a building or room where works of art are shown and often sold

examples.text: The portrait is on display at a private gallery.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅肖像正在一家私人画廊展出。

senses.meaning_en: a raised seating area in a theatre, courtroom, etc.

examples.text: We sat in the gallery and watched the play.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在楼座里看戏。

senses.meaning_en: the spectators at an event, considered as a group

examples.text: The gallery erupted when the verdict was announced.
examples.translation_cn: 宣判时，旁听席上的观众一片哗然。

senses.meaning_en: an idea or belief

examples.text: The notion that success comes without effort is simply false.
examples.translation_cn: 认为不努力就能成功的观念是完全错误的。

senses.meaning_en: an understanding or conception

examples.text: He has no notion of how long the journey will take.
examples.translation_cn: 他完全不知道旅程要花多长时间。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden wish or intention

examples.text: She had a sudden notion to visit the old castle.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然有了去参观那座古城堡的念头。

senses.meaning_en: to catch or take control of a person, animal, or place, especially by force

examples.text: The army captured the city after a long battle.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间的战斗，军队占领了这座城市。

senses.meaning_en: to attract and hold someone's attention or interest

examples.text: Her opening sentence captured the audience's attention immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 她的开场白立刻吸引了听众的注意。

senses.meaning_en: to record or store sounds, images, or data

examples.text: The security camera captured the incident on video.
examples.translation_cn: 监控摄像头拍下了事件的视频。

senses.meaning_en: the act of catching or taking control of someone or something

examples.text: The capture of the city ended the long war.
examples.translation_cn: 占领这座城市结束了漫长的战争。

senses.meaning_en: the process of recording or storing sounds, images, or data

examples.text: The new software allows easy capture of data from sensors.
examples.translation_cn: 新软件可以轻松采集传感器的数据。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that involves a strong connection or cooperation

examples.text: These two issues are closely related to each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个问题彼此密切相关。

senses.meaning_en: with careful attention to detail

examples.text: She looked closely at the old photograph to find the date.
examples.translation_cn: 她仔细地查看那张旧照片以找到日期。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is very near in space or time, or closely following

examples.text: The younger runner followed closely behind the leader throughout the race.
examples.translation_cn: 较年轻的跑步者在整场比赛中紧跟领先者。

senses.meaning_en: a large strong box with a lid

examples.text: They found a chest of old toys in the attic.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在阁楼里发现了一箱旧玩具。

senses.meaning_en: a place where public money is kept; a treasury

examples.text: The governor was accused of taking money from the public chest to pay for his travels.
examples.translation_cn: 州长被指控从公共金库取钱支付旅行费用。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture with drawers

examples.text: She keeps her sweaters in a chest of drawers beside her bed.
examples.translation_cn: 她把毛衣放在床边的五斗柜里。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body between the neck and the stomach

examples.text: He felt a sharp pain in his chest after running up the hill.
examples.translation_cn: 跑上山后他感到胸口一阵剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: a government department headed by a minister

examples.text: The Ministry of Health has issued new guidelines.
examples.translation_cn: 卫生部发布了新指南。

senses.meaning_en: the body of government ministers

examples.text: The ministry as a whole endorsed the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 全体部长一致支持该计划。

senses.meaning_en: the occupation or body of clergy

examples.text: He felt called to enter the ministry at thirty.
examples.translation_cn: 他三十岁时感到受召唤去当牧师。

senses.meaning_en: work of a spiritual or charitable nature

examples.text: She began a ministry to the homeless after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 地震后她开始了一项服务无家可归者的事工。

senses.meaning_en: special weight or force given to something important

examples.text: Many teachers place emphasis on practical communication skills.
examples.translation_cn: 许多教师强调实际沟通技能。

senses.meaning_en: prominence given to a syllable or word in speech or text
senses.collocation: place the emphasis on the first syllable

examples.text: In 'photograph', the emphasis falls on the first syllable.
examples.translation_cn: 在 'photograph' 一词中，重音落在第一个音节上。

senses.meaning_en: very; used to emphasize a quality or feeling

examples.text: The concert was a truly amazing experience for us.
examples.translation_cn: 那场音乐会对我们来说是一次非常精彩的体验。

senses.meaning_en: honestly; genuinely; in fact, really

examples.text: I am truly grateful for everything you have done.
examples.translation_cn: 我真诚地感激你所做的一切。

senses.meaning_en: truthfully; accurately; in accordance with facts

examples.text: The report truly reflects the current social climate.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告如实反映了当前的社会风气。

senses.meaning_en: having a large distance between opposite sides; measuring a certain number of units in this dimension

examples.text: The walls of the castle are over two metres thick.
examples.translation_cn: 城堡的墙有两米多厚。

senses.meaning_en: heavy in build; thickset

examples.text: The wrestler had a thick neck and powerful shoulders.
examples.translation_cn: 摔跤手脖子粗壮，肩膀有力。

senses.meaning_en: densely crowded or packed; abounding in number; impenetrable to sight

examples.text: The air was thick with smoke from the forest fire.
examples.translation_cn: 森林大火产生的浓烟使空气浑浊不清。

senses.meaning_en: having a viscous consistency

examples.text: The soup was thick and creamy and rich in flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 这汤浓稠细腻，味道浓郁。

senses.meaning_en: to have enough money or time for something

examples.text: We can't afford a bigger house in this neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在这个街区买不起更大的房子。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being pleasing to the senses or to the mind

examples.text: The garden is a place of great beauty.
examples.translation_cn: 这座花园景色十分美丽。

senses.meaning_en: a beautiful person or thing that is very pleasing

examples.text: Her new silk dress is a real beauty.
examples.translation_cn: 她的新丝绸连衣裙真是个漂亮的东西。

senses.meaning_en: the pleasing or attractive features of something
senses.pattern: the beauty of sth is that...

examples.text: The beauty of this plan is that it costs almost nothing.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划的妙处在于它几乎不花什么钱。

senses.meaning_en: the possibility that something good will happen

examples.text: The prospect of peace talks brought renewed hope to the region.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判的前景给该地区带来了新的希望。

senses.meaning_en: chances for future success, especially in a career

examples.text: After completing the course, her prospects for promotion improved considerably.
examples.translation_cn: 完成课程后，她晋升的机会大大增加。

senses.meaning_en: to search for valuable minerals, oil, etc.

examples.text: The company is prospecting for gold in the northern region.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司正在北部地区勘探金矿。

senses.meaning_en: a view over an area of land, especially a wide one
