examples.text: From the tower, visitors enjoy a fine prospect of the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 从塔上望去，游客们可以欣赏到山谷的美景。

senses.meaning_en: a serious situation requiring immediate action

examples.text: In an emergency, call for help and stay calm.
examples.translation_cn: 遇到紧急情况时，呼救并保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: the hospital department that treats emergencies

examples.text: The patient was treated in the emergency room.
examples.translation_cn: 该病人在急诊室接受了治疗。

senses.meaning_en: having a small width; not wide

examples.text: The gate is too narrow for the truck.
examples.translation_cn: 大门对卡车来说太窄了。

senses.meaning_en: to make or become narrower; to reduce the difference or gap
senses.pattern: narrow the gap between A and B

examples.text: The company is trying to narrow the gap between online and offline sales.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正试图缩小线上线下销售之间的差距。

senses.meaning_en: very limited; having a small margin

examples.text: The president won the election by a narrow margin.
examples.translation_cn: 总统以微弱优势赢得选举。

senses.meaning_en: restrictive; without flexibility

examples.text: He has a very narrow view of success.
examples.translation_cn: 他对成功的看法非常狭隘。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone about something, especially officially

examples.text: The airline will inform passengers of any delays before boarding.
examples.translation_cn: 航空公司将在登机前通知乘客任何延误。

senses.meaning_en: to tell the police or authorities about someone's illegal activities

examples.text: He informed on his own brother to escape punishment.
examples.translation_cn: 他为了逃脱惩罚告发了自己的亲兄弟。

senses.meaning_en: to have an influence on or guide something such as a decision or policy

examples.text: The study will inform future policy on urban transport.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究将为未来的城市交通政策提供依据。

senses.meaning_en: being the only one of its kind

examples.text: This manuscript is unique among the museum's collections.
examples.translation_cn: 这份手稿在博物馆藏品中是独一无二的。

senses.meaning_en: very special, unusual, or rare

examples.text: The restaurant is unique in its use of local ingredients.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅在使用当地食材方面独具特色。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to a particular person, thing, or place

examples.text: This species of frog is unique to the island.
examples.translation_cn: 这种蛙是该岛特有的。

senses.meaning_en: to tell somebody what you think they should do; to recommend

examples.text: My lawyer advised me to accept the offer.
examples.translation_cn: 我的律师建议我接受这个提议。

senses.meaning_en: to formally give information or notice to somebody

examples.text: We will advise you of the outcome in writing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们将书面通知你结果。

senses.meaning_en: coming before in order or time; earlier, former, previous

examples.text: Applicants must have prior experience of working with children.
examples.translation_cn: 申请者必须有与儿童一起工作的经验。

senses.meaning_en: before; in advance of

examples.text: All passengers must check in prior to boarding the plane.
examples.translation_cn: 所有乘客必须在登机前办理登机手续。

senses.meaning_en: a previous arrest or criminal conviction

examples.text: The suspect has a prior for theft and will face a longer sentence.
examples.translation_cn: 该嫌疑人有盗窃前科，将面临更长的刑期。

senses.meaning_en: determined without knowledge of other events; before additional data is collected
senses.pattern: be based on a prior probability

examples.text: The estimate is based on a prior probability of full recovery.
examples.translation_cn: 该估计基于完全康复的先验概率。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being more important or coming before others

examples.text: Safety should have priority over speed in this design.
examples.translation_cn: 在此设计中，安全应优先于速度。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that is more important than others and needs to be dealt with first

examples.text: Finding a new job is my top priority right now.
examples.translation_cn: 找新工作是我现在的头等大事。

senses.meaning_en: the right to go before other road users, especially at a junction

examples.text: At this junction, traffic from the left has priority.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个路口，从左方来的车辆有优先通行权。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or start of something

examples.text: The principal spoke at the opening of the school year.
examples.translation_cn: 校长在学年开始时讲了话。

senses.meaning_en: a vacant position, especially in an array

examples.text: The company has an opening for a senior engineer.
examples.translation_cn: 公司有一个高级工程师的空缺。

senses.meaning_en: a gap permitting passage through

examples.text: They cut an opening in the wall for a new window.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在墙上开了一个口安装新窗户。

senses.meaning_en: at the beginning; initial

examples.text: The opening scene of the film is set in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 电影的开头场景设定在巴黎。

senses.meaning_en: emotional pressure caused by problems in life

examples.text: She has been under a lot of stress at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她最近工作压力很大。

senses.meaning_en: to emphasize a fact or point

examples.text: The report stresses the importance of regular exercise.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告强调经常锻炼的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: physical force or pressure put on something

examples.text: Heavy snow can put stress on the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 大雪会对屋顶造成压力。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of combining; a thing made by combining

examples.text: The team's success comes from a combination of hard work and good planning.
examples.translation_cn: 该队的成功源于努力工作和良好规划的结合。

senses.meaning_en: a sequence of numbers or letters used to open a combination lock

examples.text: He could not remember the combination for his locker.
examples.translation_cn: 他记不起自己储物柜的密码。

senses.meaning_en: to trust someone or something to do what you expect
senses.pattern: rely on sb to do sth

examples.text: You can rely on Sarah to keep her word.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以信赖莎拉会信守诺言。

senses.meaning_en: to need or depend on someone or something in order to continue or succeed

examples.text: Many small businesses rely on online sales for most of their income.
examples.translation_cn: 许多小企业依靠在线销售获得大部分收入。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a plant that grows under the ground

examples.text: The roots of this old tree spread far underground.
examples.translation_cn: 这棵老树的根在地下延伸得很远。

senses.meaning_en: the main cause or origin of something

examples.text: Poor communication is at the root of many conflicts.
examples.translation_cn: 沟通不畅是许多冲突的根源。

senses.meaning_en: to grow roots; to become established

examples.text: The cuttings will take root within a few weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 这些插条几周内就会生根。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a tooth or hair that is below the surface of the body

examples.text: The root of the infected tooth had to be removed.
examples.translation_cn: 那颗受感染的牙齿的牙根必须拔除。

senses.meaning_en: a vegetable such as a carrot that grows under the ground

examples.text: We roasted some root vegetables with olive oil.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用橄榄油烤了些根菜。

senses.meaning_en: willing to give freely; generous

examples.text: He is liberal with his money and often treats friends to dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他对钱很大方，经常请朋友吃饭。

senses.meaning_en: willing to respect or accept opinions different from your own

examples.text: He has liberal attitudes towards those who disagree with him.
examples.translation_cn: 他对与他意见不同的人持开明态度。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a political philosophy that supports individual rights and free markets

examples.text: The party advocates liberal policies on immigration and trade.
examples.translation_cn: 该党主张在移民和贸易方面采取自由主义政策。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supports liberal political ideas or a liberal party

examples.text: He is a liberal who believes in protecting civil rights.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一个相信保护公民权利的自由主义者。

senses.meaning_en: to be grateful for something

examples.text: I really appreciate your help with the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我真的很感激你在这个项目上的帮助。

senses.meaning_en: to recognize the worth of something

examples.text: She learned to appreciate classical music after attending a concert.
examples.translation_cn: 她参加了一场音乐会后，学会了欣赏古典音乐。

senses.meaning_en: to understand or be aware of something

examples.text: I appreciate that this is a difficult decision.
examples.translation_cn: 我理解这是一个艰难的决定。

senses.meaning_en: to increase in value

examples.text: Their house has appreciated in value since 2010.
examples.translation_cn: 自2010年以来，他们的房子已经升值了。

senses.meaning_en: to achieve what you have been trying to do

examples.text: She succeeded in passing the exam on her first attempt.
examples.translation_cn: 她第一次尝试就成功通过了考试。

senses.meaning_en: to come after someone and take their place, position, or property

examples.text: He succeeded to the throne after his uncle died.
examples.translation_cn: 他在叔父去世后继位了。

senses.meaning_en: to replace someone in an office, position, or title

examples.text: She succeeded him as chief executive officer last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年接替他担任首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: to come after something else in sequence or time and take its place

examples.text: The old system was succeeded by a modern one.
examples.translation_cn: 旧系统被现代系统取代了。

senses.meaning_en: the place, time, or circumstances in which something is set

examples.text: The school is in a rural setting outside the city.
examples.translation_cn: 学校坐落在城外一个乡村环境中。

senses.meaning_en: a level or position at which a control is set

examples.text: The oven works best on a medium heat setting.
examples.translation_cn: 烤箱在中火设定下效果最好。

senses.meaning_en: at a higher physical position, level, rank or order

examples.text: The upper part of the old tower was badly damaged in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 旧塔的上部在暴风雨中受损严重。

senses.meaning_en: to explain the meaning of something

examples.text: She tried to interpret the strange dream for her friend.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图为朋友解释那个奇怪的梦。

senses.meaning_en: to translate spoken words from one language to another

examples.text: The guide interpreted for the tourists during the museum tour.
examples.translation_cn: 导游在博物馆参观期间为游客做口译。

senses.meaning_en: to decide that something has a particular meaning

examples.text: He interpreted her long silence as a sign of agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 他把她的长时间沉默理解为同意。

senses.meaning_en: to perform a piece of music or a role in a way that shows your understanding of it

examples.text: The actor interpreted the role of Hamlet with great depth.
examples.translation_cn: 这位演员极具深度地演绎了哈姆雷特一角。

senses.meaning_en: an explanation or understanding of something

examples.text: Her interpretation of the poem differed from the teacher's.
examples.translation_cn: 她对这首诗的解释与老师的理解不同。

senses.meaning_en: the act of translating spoken language orally

examples.text: She trained in interpretation from Spanish into English.
examples.translation_cn: 她受过西班牙语到英语的口译训练。

senses.meaning_en: a particular way of performing a piece of music or drama

examples.text: Her interpretation of the violin concerto impressed the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 她对这部小提琴协奏曲的演绎给观众留下了深刻的印象。

senses.meaning_en: the final result of a process, meeting, or activity

examples.text: The outcome of the election will be announced tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 选举结果将于今晚公布。

senses.meaning_en: short for advertisement; advertising

examples.text: We placed an ad online to sell our old sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在网上登了一则广告来卖掉我们的旧沙发。

senses.meaning_en: Anno Domini; used before or after a year to show it is after the birth of Christ

examples.text: The city wall was built in AD 800.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城墙建于公元800年。

senses.meaning_en: to protect someone or something from attack

examples.text: Soldiers defended the city against a fierce attack.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们保卫城市，抵御了一次猛烈进攻。

senses.meaning_en: to say or write something in support of someone or something

examples.text: He defended his decision against criticism in a long statement.
examples.translation_cn: 他发表长篇声明，为自己的决定辩护并反驳批评。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent the other team from scoring

examples.text: The team defended against constant pressure in the second half.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在下半场顶住了持续的压力进行防守。

senses.meaning_en: to act as a lawyer for an accused person

examples.text: A young lawyer defended the accused in court.
examples.translation_cn: 一位年轻律师在法庭上为被告辩护。

senses.meaning_en: that can be used instead of something else

examples.text: We took an alternative route to avoid the traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走了另一条路来避开交通拥堵。

senses.meaning_en: different from what is usual or traditional

examples.text: She enjoys alternative rock bands from the 1990s.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢20世纪90年代的另类摇滚乐队。

senses.meaning_en: a thing you can choose instead of another

examples.text: Online courses offer a flexible alternative to classroom learning.
examples.translation_cn: 在线课程提供了一种灵活的面授替代方案。

senses.meaning_en: the only remaining option
senses.pattern: have no alternative but to do

examples.text: With the last bus gone, we had no alternative but to walk home.
examples.translation_cn: 最后一班公交开走了，我们别无选择，只能步行回家。

senses.meaning_en: a flat part of an aircraft that produces lift for flight

examples.text: The wing of the plane was hit by a bird.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机的机翼被一只鸟撞了。

senses.meaning_en: one of the two body parts that birds, bats, insects, or flying fish use for flying

examples.text: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
examples.translation_cn: 那只鸟展开翅膀飞走了。

senses.meaning_en: a group within a political party or organization that has particular opinions or functions

examples.text: The right wing of the party opposes the new tax plan.
examples.translation_cn: 该党的右翼反对新的税收计划。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow road or path, especially in the country or between walls

examples.text: We drove slowly down a country lane between tall hedges.
examples.translation_cn: 我们开车缓慢行驶在一条两旁有高高树篱的乡间小路上。

senses.meaning_en: a section of a road marked for one line of vehicles

examples.text: A slow truck was driving in the right lane.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆慢速卡车正行驶在右侧车道。

senses.meaning_en: a section of a track or swimming pool for one competitor

examples.text: The swimmer in lane four set a new record.
examples.translation_cn: 第四泳道的游泳运动员创造了一项新纪录。

senses.meaning_en: a road or street, especially used in street names

examples.text: They live on Maple Lane, just past the post office.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在枫树巷，就在邮局过去一点。

senses.meaning_en: continuous movement of a liquid, gas, traffic, etc.

examples.text: The flow of traffic increased during rush hour.
examples.translation_cn: 高峰时段车流量增加。

senses.meaning_en: to move steadily and continuously in one direction

examples.text: The river flows into the sea near the city.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河在城市附近流入大海。

senses.meaning_en: (of ideas, words, etc.) to come easily; to proceed smoothly

examples.text: The conversation flowed easily throughout the dinner party.
examples.translation_cn: 晚餐聚会上谈话一直很流畅。

senses.meaning_en: the rising movement of the tide

examples.text: The fishing boats return on the flow of the tide.
examples.translation_cn: 渔船趁涨潮返航。

senses.meaning_en: to stir together or combine ingredients

examples.text: Mix the flour with the eggs to make a smooth batter.
examples.translation_cn: 把面粉和鸡蛋混合，制成光滑的面糊。

senses.meaning_en: to be socially compatible

examples.text: She mixes well with her colleagues at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她在工作中与同事们相处得很好。

senses.meaning_en: to combine several audio tracks

examples.text: The band is mixing down their new album in the studio.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队正在录音室里混录他们的新专辑。

senses.meaning_en: a combination of different things

examples.text: The city has a mix of old and new buildings.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市新旧建筑混合。

senses.meaning_en: a circular ornamental headdress worn by a king or queen as a symbol of authority

examples.text: The queen wore a golden crown at the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 女王在典礼上戴着一顶金王冠。

senses.meaning_en: the power or authority of a king or queen, or the government of a country ruled by a king or queen

examples.text: The island remained under the Crown until its independence in 1962.
examples.translation_cn: 该岛在1962年独立前一直处于王权统治之下。

senses.meaning_en: the top part of the head or of something such as a hill or hat

examples.text: The hikers reached the crown of the hill at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者中午到达了山顶。

senses.meaning_en: a prize or title for winning a competition, or a mark of honour

examples.text: The young athlete won the crown at the regional championship.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻运动员在地区锦标赛中赢得了桂冠。

senses.meaning_en: a black mineral used as fuel

examples.text: Many power stations still burn coal to generate electricity.
examples.translation_cn: 许多发电站仍烧煤发电。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of coal, especially one that is burning

examples.text: He put a few coals on the fire and watched them glow.
examples.translation_cn: 他往火里添了几块煤，看着它们烧红。

senses.meaning_en: to officially agree to or accept something

examples.text: The committee approved the new safety plan at yesterday's meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会在昨天的会议上批准了新的安全计划。

senses.meaning_en: to think that someone or something is good or acceptable

examples.text: Most teachers approve of the new teaching method.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数老师赞成这种新的教学方法。

senses.meaning_en: an area distinguished by a particular feature or use

examples.text: They live in a quiet residential zone near the park.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在公园附近一个安静的住宅区。

senses.meaning_en: a restricted or virtual area, often psychological

examples.text: Public speaking pushes me out of my comfort zone.
examples.translation_cn: 公开演讲迫使我走出舒适区。

senses.meaning_en: a change or difference in amount, level, or form

examples.text: There is wide variation in temperature between day and night.
examples.translation_cn: 昼夜之间温度变化很大。

senses.meaning_en: a musical form in which a theme is repeated with changes

examples.text: The orchestra played variations on a folk theme.
examples.translation_cn: 管弦乐队演奏了一个民间主题的变奏。

senses.meaning_en: a related but distinct form or version

examples.text: This design is a modern variation of a traditional pattern.
examples.translation_cn: 这个设计是传统图案的现代变体。

senses.meaning_en: a large strong building with towers and thick walls

examples.text: The royal family lived in a castle for centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 王室家族在城堡里住了几个世纪。

senses.meaning_en: a chess piece shaped like a castle tower

examples.text: You can move a castle only in straight lines.
examples.translation_cn: 你只能沿着直线移动车。

senses.meaning_en: a particular way of doing something

examples.text: Walking is a mode of transport that costs nothing.
examples.translation_cn: 步行是一种不花钱的出行方式。

senses.meaning_en: a particular state or setting of equipment

examples.text: My laptop is in sleep mode to save battery.
examples.translation_cn: 我的笔记本电脑处于睡眠模式以节省电量。

senses.meaning_en: the most frequently occurring value in a distribution

examples.text: The mode of the data set is 7; no other value appears as often.
examples.translation_cn: 这组数据的众数是7；没有其他数值出现得这么频繁。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of moving

examples.text: The train was already in motion when we reached the platform.
examples.translation_cn: 我们到达站台时火车已经在移动了。

senses.meaning_en: to move your hand or head to give a signal
senses.pattern: motion to sb to do sth

examples.text: She motioned to the waiter to bring the bill.
examples.translation_cn: 她向服务员示意把账单拿来。

senses.meaning_en: a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting

examples.text: The committee passed a motion to reduce working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会通过了一项减少工作时间的动议。

senses.meaning_en: easy to see or understand; obvious

examples.text: It is apparent that the damage is worse than we thought.
examples.translation_cn: 显然，损失比我们想的更严重。

senses.meaning_en: seeming to be true or real but not necessarily so

examples.text: He listened with apparent interest, but his mind wandered.
examples.translation_cn: 他表面上饶有兴趣地听着，但心思已经飘走了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who operates an aircraft

examples.text: He works as a pilot for a major airline.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家大型航空公司当飞行员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who guides ships into or out of a harbor
senses.pattern: take a harbor pilot on board

examples.text: The captain took a harbor pilot on board before entering the port.
examples.translation_cn: 船长在进港前请了一名引水人上船。

senses.meaning_en: done as an experiment or test

examples.text: The school launched a pilot program to test flexible scheduling.
examples.translation_cn: 学校启动了一个试点项目来测试弹性排课。

senses.meaning_en: final; last in a series

examples.text: Our ultimate goal is to provide clean water for every family.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的最终目标是为每个家庭提供清洁用水。

senses.meaning_en: being the best or most extreme example of its kind

examples.text: This concert was the ultimate live music experience.
examples.translation_cn: 这场音乐会是现场音乐的极致体验。

senses.meaning_en: the best or most extreme thing of its kind

examples.text: This hotel is the ultimate in modern comfort.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店是现代舒适的极致。

senses.meaning_en: in the end; finally

examples.text: After hours of debate, the committee ultimately decided to approve the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数小时辩论，委员会最终决定批准该计划。

senses.meaning_en: at the most basic level

examples.text: The conflict between the two countries is ultimately about control of resources.
examples.translation_cn: 两国之间的冲突归根结底是为了争夺资源控制权。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone agree to do something by giving good reasons

examples.text: She persuaded her father to lend her the car.
examples.translation_cn: 她说服了父亲把车借给她。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone believe that something is true

examples.text: She persuaded me that the plan was safe.
examples.translation_cn: 她使我相信那个计划是安全的。

senses.meaning_en: to deal effectively with something difficult

examples.text: She is learning to cope with the stress of her new job.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在学习应对新工作带来的压力。

senses.meaning_en: having the power to attract; pleasing to the eye or mind

examples.text: I find her voice attractive and easy to listen to.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得她的嗓音很迷人，听起来很舒服。

senses.meaning_en: appealing to the mind, especially of an offer or idea

examples.text: The low price is attractive to first-time home buyers.
examples.translation_cn: 低价对首次购房者很有诱惑力。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is in politics, especially an elected or appointed official

examples.text: As a politician, he was elected to the state senate in 2018.
examples.translation_cn: 作为政治家，他于2018年当选州参议员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who uses political activity for personal gain, often in a manipulative way

examples.text: He is a politician who will say anything to win votes.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个为了赢得选票什么都会说的政客。

senses.meaning_en: to take something from a person, shop, etc. without permission and without intending to return it

examples.text: A thief stole her wallet from her handbag while she was shopping.
examples.translation_cn: 她购物时，小偷偷走了她手提包里的钱包。

senses.meaning_en: to take and use someone else's idea, credit, etc. without permission or acknowledgment

examples.text: He accused his colleague of stealing his idea for the new product.
examples.translation_cn: 他指责同事剽窃了他对新产品的构想。

senses.meaning_en: to do something secretly or without being noticed

examples.text: She stole a glance at her phone during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会议期间她偷偷看了一眼手机。

senses.meaning_en: to move somewhere secretly and quietly

examples.text: He stole into the room so as not to wake the baby.
examples.translation_cn: 他悄悄溜进房间，以免吵醒婴儿。

senses.meaning_en: something that happens, especially something unusual or unpleasant

examples.text: A minor incident occurred outside the stadium during the match.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛期间体育场外发生了一起小事件。

senses.meaning_en: to try to achieve or do something over a period of time

examples.text: He moved to London to pursue a career in journalism.
examples.translation_cn: 他搬到伦敦从事新闻工作。

senses.meaning_en: to chase someone or something quickly in order to catch them

examples.text: The police pursued the suspect through the narrow streets.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在狭窄的街道上追捕嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to discuss, investigate, or be involved in something

examples.text: The police decided to pursue the matter further after new evidence emerged.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据出现后，警方决定进一步追查此事。

senses.meaning_en: to follow or continue along a particular course of action

examples.text: The government will pursue a different course of action on the issue.
examples.translation_cn: 政府将在这个问题上采取不同的行动方针。

senses.meaning_en: to lose your balance on a slippery surface and fall

examples.text: She slipped on an icy patch and sprained her wrist.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一块冰上滑倒，扭伤了手腕。

senses.meaning_en: to put something somewhere quietly or secretly
senses.collocation: slip a note under the door

examples.text: He slipped the note under her door and left.
examples.translation_cn: 他把字条从她门底下塞进去，然后离开了。

senses.meaning_en: to fall to a lower level or standard

examples.text: The team slipped to fourth place after a poor run of results.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在连续几场糟糕的比赛后排名下滑到第四位。

senses.meaning_en: to make a careless mistake

examples.text: She slipped up on the final question and failed the test.
examples.translation_cn: 她在最后一道题上失误，结果考试不及格。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of paper, especially one used as a receipt or proof of collection

examples.text: Please bring the pickup slip when you collect your parcel.
examples.translation_cn: 领取包裹时请带上取件单。

senses.meaning_en: a number or rate expressed as a fraction of 100

examples.text: The increase is expressed as a percentage of last year's revenue.
examples.translation_cn: 这个增长是用占去年收入的百分比来表示的。

senses.meaning_en: a share or portion of something

examples.text: The agent gets a percentage of every property she sells.
examples.translation_cn: 这位代理人从她卖出的每处房产中收取一定比例的佣金。

senses.meaning_en: amusing; making you laugh

examples.text: The film was funny from start to finish.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影从头到尾都很滑稽。

senses.meaning_en: strange or unusual

examples.text: There's something funny about the smell coming from the fridge.
examples.translation_cn: 冰箱里散发出的气味有点奇怪。

senses.meaning_en: slightly unwell or uneasy

examples.text: I felt a bit funny after eating that old cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 吃了那块陈奶酪后我觉得有点不舒服。

examples.text: The winner of the race received a gold medal.
examples.translation_cn: 赛跑的获胜者获得了一枚金牌。

examples.text: He scored the winner in the last minute.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最后一分钟打进了制胜球。

examples.text: She is a winner in business and in life.
examples.translation_cn: 她在事业和生活中都是赢家。

senses.meaning_en: the top layer of the earth in which plants grow

examples.text: The plant's roots need enough water in the soil to grow properly.
examples.translation_cn: 植物的根需要土壤里有足够的水分才能正常生长。

senses.meaning_en: to make something dirty or to damage someone's reputation

examples.text: The corruption scandal has soiled the politician's reputation.
examples.translation_cn: 这起腐败丑闻玷污了那位政治人物的名誉。

senses.meaning_en: territory; land belonging to a country

examples.text: The attack on American soil shocked the entire nation.
examples.translation_cn: 发生在美国本土的袭击事件震惊了整个国家。

senses.meaning_en: a list of names or topics arranged alphabetically, usually at the end of a book

examples.text: You can find the topic in the index at the back of the book.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在书末的索引中找到该主题。

senses.meaning_en: a number that shows changes in prices or quantities

examples.text: The report uses a price index to compare living costs.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告使用价格指数来比较生活成本。

senses.meaning_en: the finger next to the thumb; the forefinger

examples.text: She pointed at the map with her index finger.
examples.translation_cn: 她用食指指着地图。

senses.meaning_en: medical operation involving cutting into the body

examples.text: The footballer is undergoing surgery on his knee this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 这名足球运动员今天下午正在接受膝盖手术。

senses.meaning_en: a doctor's office or clinic; the time when a doctor is available to see patients

examples.text: You can see a doctor at the surgery on weekdays.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在工作日去诊所看医生。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of medicine concerned with treating injuries and diseases by operation

examples.text: She decided to specialize in surgery after medical school.
examples.translation_cn: 她医学院毕业后决定专攻外科。

senses.meaning_en: connected with Jews or Judaism

examples.text: My best friend comes from a Jewish family.
examples.translation_cn: 我最好的朋友来自一个犹太家庭。

senses.meaning_en: a low area between hills or mountains, often with a river

examples.text: In spring, a clear stream runs through the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 春天，一条清澈的小溪流过山谷。

senses.meaning_en: an area drained by a river

examples.text: The valley of the Mississippi covers parts of ten states.
examples.translation_cn: 密西西比河流域覆盖十个州的部分地区。

senses.meaning_en: a low point or period

examples.text: The housing market went through a valley after the bubble burst.
examples.translation_cn: 泡沫破灭后，房地产市场经历了一段低谷期。

senses.meaning_en: to say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad
senses.pattern: blame sb for sth / blame sth on sb

examples.text: Many politicians blamed the media for the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 许多政客把丑闻归咎于媒体。

senses.meaning_en: responsibility for something bad or wrong

examples.text: The CEO accepted blame for the company's poor performance.
examples.translation_cn: 首席执行官为公司的糟糕业绩承担了责任。

senses.meaning_en: to deduce a conclusion by reasoning

examples.text: We can derive a rational conclusion from the available evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以从现有证据中推导出合理的结论。

senses.meaning_en: to get something, especially a feeling or benefit, from something

examples.text: He derives a lot of pleasure from teaching.
examples.translation_cn: 他从教学中得到了很多乐趣。

senses.meaning_en: to come from something; to have something as its origin

examples.text: A great many English words derive from Latin roots.
examples.translation_cn: 许多英语单词源自拉丁词根。

senses.meaning_en: to form an idea of the cost, size, value, etc. without calculating exactly

examples.text: We estimate that the repairs will cost about $500.
examples.translation_cn: 我们估计维修费用约为500美元。

senses.meaning_en: a judgement or calculation of the approximate cost

examples.text: The builder gave us an estimate for the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑工人给了我们厨房的报价。

senses.meaning_en: a rough calculation or assessment of the value, size, or cost of something

examples.text: A rough estimate suggests the project will take two years.
examples.translation_cn: 粗略估计表明这个项目将耗时两年。

senses.meaning_en: a game played on a large outdoor course, the aim being to hit a small ball into a series of holes with as few strokes as possible

examples.text: My father and I play golf together every weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲和我每个周末一起打高尔夫球。

senses.meaning_en: to play the game of golf

examples.text: She golfs with her father when she visits home.
examples.translation_cn: 她回家探望时和父亲一起打高尔夫球。

senses.meaning_en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles

examples.text: She drew a square on the whiteboard to explain the concept of area.
examples.translation_cn: 她在白板上画了一个正方形来解释面积的概念。

senses.meaning_en: an open public area in a town or city

examples.text: A large crowd gathered in the square to listen to the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上听音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: the result of multiplying a number by itself

examples.text: The square of 9 is 81, which is easy to remember.
examples.translation_cn: 9的平方是81，这很容易记住。

senses.meaning_en: having the shape of a square

examples.text: It's square, not round.
examples.translation_cn: 它是正方形的，不是圆的。

senses.meaning_en: mentally ill; insane

examples.text: They thought she was crazy because she heard voices in her head.
examples.translation_cn: 他们以为她疯了，因为她脑子里听到声音。

senses.meaning_en: very enthusiastic or in love

examples.text: She is crazy about jazz and goes to every concert.
examples.translation_cn: 她酷爱爵士乐，每场音乐会都去。

senses.meaning_en: foolish; unreasonable

examples.text: It would be crazy to go out in this storm.
examples.translation_cn: 在这种暴风雨中外出是愚蠢的。

senses.meaning_en: very unexpected; wildly surprising

examples.text: It is crazy that they finished the whole project in one day.
examples.translation_cn: 他们一天就完成了整个项目，真令人难以置信。

senses.meaning_en: extremely important; essential

examples.text: Good communication is vital to a strong team.
examples.translation_cn: 良好的沟通对一个强大团队至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or characteristic of life; necessary to continued existence

examples.text: Doctors checked the patient's vital signs every hour.
examples.translation_cn: 医生每小时检查病人的生命体征。

senses.meaning_en: containing life; living; full of energy

examples.text: My grandmother remains vital in her late eighties.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母在八十多岁时仍然精力充沛。

senses.meaning_en: to become healthy again

examples.text: She is recovering from a bad case of the flu.
examples.translation_cn: 她正从一场重感冒中康复。

senses.meaning_en: to get back something lost or stolen

examples.text: The police recovered the stolen car from a warehouse.
examples.translation_cn: 警方从一个仓库中找回了被盗汽车。

senses.meaning_en: to regain a calm or conscious state

examples.text: It took him a moment to recover his composure.
examples.translation_cn: 他过了一会儿才恢复镇定。

senses.meaning_en: to rescue or salvage

examples.text: Two survivors were recovered from the collapsed building.
examples.translation_cn: 两名幸存者从倒塌的建筑中被救出。

senses.meaning_en: a series of metal rings connected together

examples.text: The dog was tied to a post with a chain.
examples.translation_cn: 那只狗被用链子拴在柱子上。

senses.meaning_en: a series of connected things or events

examples.text: The accident set off a chain of events that led to new safety rules.
examples.translation_cn: 这起事故引发了一连串事件，最终带来了新的安全规定。

senses.meaning_en: a group of shops or businesses owned by the same company

examples.text: The company runs a chain of stores across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在全国经营连锁店。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten something with a chain

examples.text: He chained his bicycle to the fence outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 他把自行车用链子锁在车站外的栅栏上。

senses.meaning_en: involving detailed knowledge of a restricted subject

examples.text: The job requires specialist knowledge of tax law.
examples.translation_cn: 这份工作需要税法方面的专业知识。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is an expert in a particular area, especially a doctor

examples.text: She is a leading specialist in childhood diseases.
examples.translation_cn: 她是儿童疾病方面的顶尖专家。

senses.meaning_en: typical of a person or thing

examples.text: This painting is characteristic of his early style.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画是他早期风格的典型代表。

senses.meaning_en: a distinguishing feature or quality

examples.text: The main characteristics of this metal are strength and lightness.
examples.translation_cn: 这种金属的主要特性是强度和轻质。

senses.meaning_en: the chief executive of a state or province

examples.text: The governor of a state must balance many interests.
examples.translation_cn: 一个州的州长必须平衡许多利益。

senses.meaning_en: an official appointed to govern a colony or territory

examples.text: The governor of a colony introduced new trade rules.
examples.translation_cn: 一个殖民地的总督出台了新的贸易规定。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the board of governors of an institution, especially a central bank

examples.text: The governor of the central bank warned about rising inflation.
examples.translation_cn: 中央银行行长警告通胀上升。

senses.meaning_en: the way someone speaks that shows their feelings or attitude

examples.text: She answered in a gentle tone to calm him.
examples.translation_cn: 她用温和的语气回答，让他冷静下来。

senses.meaning_en: the pitch of a word's sound that distinguishes a difference in meaning

examples.text: The tone of a word can change its meaning in Mandarin.
examples.translation_cn: 在普通话里，一个词的声调可以改变它的意思。

senses.meaning_en: a specific pitch

examples.text: The device produced a tone of 440 hertz.
examples.translation_cn: 该设备发出一个 440 赫兹的纯音。

senses.meaning_en: an interval of a major second in the diatonic scale

examples.text: The next note is a tone above C.
examples.translation_cn: 下一个音比 C 高一个全音。

senses.meaning_en: the use of science to design and build machines, structures, and systems

examples.text: She plans to study engineering at university next year.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划明年在大学学习工程学。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a company or organization that deals with engineering

examples.text: She works in engineering at a large tech company.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家大型科技公司的工程部门工作。

senses.meaning_en: the area aboard a ship where the engine is located

examples.text: The chief engineer found the leak down in engineering.
examples.translation_cn: 轮机长在引擎室下面发现了泄漏。

senses.meaning_en: to hit or move something with your foot

examples.text: She kicked the ball straight into the goal.
examples.translation_cn: 她把球直接踢进了球门。

senses.meaning_en: to force somebody to leave a place or group

examples.text: He was kicked out of the chat group for breaking the rules.
examples.translation_cn: 他因违反规则被踢出了聊天群。

senses.meaning_en: to move your legs sharply, especially in water or while lying down

examples.text: The swimmer kicked hard in the water to stay afloat.
examples.translation_cn: 游泳者用力蹬水以保持漂浮。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of excitement or pleasure

examples.text: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
examples.translation_cn: 我从看老电影中获得乐趣。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to a time long past; of antiquity

examples.text: In ancient times, people used bronze tools for farming.
examples.translation_cn: 在古代，人们使用青铜工具耕作。

senses.meaning_en: very old; having existed for a long time

examples.text: These stone walls are ancient but still stand strong.
examples.translation_cn: 这些石墙很古老，但仍然坚固。

senses.meaning_en: people who lived in ancient times

examples.text: The ancients mapped the stars with remarkable accuracy.
examples.translation_cn: 古代人极其精确地绘制了星图。

senses.meaning_en: made of gold or relating to gold

examples.text: He bought her a golden ring for their anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 他给她买了一只金戒指作为周年纪念礼物。

senses.meaning_en: having the bright yellow colour of gold

examples.text: In October, the leaves slowly turn golden and start to fall.
examples.translation_cn: 到了十月，树叶慢慢变成金色，开始飘落。

senses.meaning_en: special, successful, or giving hope; marked by prosperity or creativity

examples.text: She missed a golden opportunity to study abroad last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年错过了一个出国留学的绝好机会。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the elderly or retired

examples.text: They plan to travel in their golden years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们打算在退休后的岁月里去旅行。

senses.meaning_en: act of asking for something

examples.text: The report was published at the board's request.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告是应董事会的请求发表的。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for something

examples.text: You can request a refund within thirty days.
examples.translation_cn: 您可以在三十天内要求退款。

senses.meaning_en: to ask somebody to do something

examples.text: Passengers are requested to show their boarding passes at the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客被要求在登机口出示登机牌。

senses.meaning_en: to start or build an institution, organization, or structure

examples.text: The university was founded in 1851 by a group of local business leaders.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学由一群当地商界领袖于1851年创办。

senses.meaning_en: to use as a foundation; to base

examples.text: His theory is founded on years of careful research.
examples.translation_cn: 他的理论建立在多年认真研究的基础上。

senses.meaning_en: a principle or idea that something is based on

examples.text: Honesty forms the foundation of a strong friendship.
examples.translation_cn: 诚实是牢固友谊的基础。

senses.meaning_en: an organization that gives money for charity or research

examples.text: She set up a foundation to support local artists.
examples.translation_cn: 她成立了一个基金会来支持本地艺术家。

senses.meaning_en: the solid underground base of a building

examples.text: Workers are laying the foundations of the new library.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们正在为新图书馆打地基。

senses.meaning_en: the act of founding or establishing an institution

examples.text: The university has grown rapidly since its foundation in 1998.
examples.translation_cn: 该大学自1998年创办以来发展迅速。

senses.meaning_en: to find an answer or solution to a problem, question, mystery, or crime

examples.text: Detectives finally solved the mystery of the missing painting.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探们终于解开了那幅失踪画作之谜。

senses.meaning_en: to find the value or values of unknown numbers that make an equation true

examples.text: You need to solve the equation for x before you can find y.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要先解出方程中的 x，才能求出 y。

senses.meaning_en: a person appointed to act for another

examples.text: She was appointed deputy to the chief executive last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被任命为首席执行官副手。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a legislature in some countries

examples.text: He has served as a deputy for Marseille since 2012.
examples.translation_cn: 自2012年以来，他一直担任马赛选区议员。

senses.meaning_en: a round container for food or liquid, or the amount it holds

examples.text: She ate a bowl of cereal before school.
examples.translation_cn: 她上学前吃了一碗麦片。

senses.meaning_en: the act of bowling a ball in a game

examples.text: We had a bowl at the club after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们午饭后在俱乐部打了一会儿保龄球。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow rounded part of an object shaped like a bowl

examples.text: The bowl of the spoon was covered in honey.
examples.translation_cn: 勺子的凹陷处沾满了蜂蜜。

senses.meaning_en: to throw a ball in a sport such as cricket or bowling

examples.text: He bowled the ball straight into the stumps.
examples.translation_cn: 他把球直接投进了三柱门。

senses.meaning_en: not common; infrequent
senses.pattern: it is rare for sb to do

examples.text: It is rare for him to arrive late.
examples.translation_cn: 他很少迟到。

senses.meaning_en: cooked lightly so still red inside

examples.text: I'll have my steak rare, please, with no sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 我的牛排要半熟的，请不要加酱。

senses.meaning_en: thin; low in density

examples.text: Climbers often struggle in the rare air of high mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者在高山的稀薄空气中常常感到吃力。

senses.meaning_en: a structure that surrounds or supports something

examples.text: The frame of the house was still standing after the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 大火过后，房子的框架仍然矗立。

senses.meaning_en: to formulate or design a plan, question, or rule

examples.text: They will frame a policy to protect small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 他们将制定一项政策来保护小企业。

senses.meaning_en: the size and shape of someone's body

examples.text: He has a slight frame but swings the bat with power.
examples.translation_cn: 他体格瘦小，但挥棒很有力。

senses.meaning_en: to conspire to falsely incriminate an innocent person

examples.text: He was framed for a crime he did not commit.
examples.translation_cn: 他因一桩自己没有犯下的罪行而被陷害。

senses.meaning_en: to position visually within a fixed boundary

examples.text: The director framed the shot against the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 导演以日落为背景取景。

examples.text: The explorers went forth into the world to seek their fortune.
examples.translation_cn: 探险家们走向世界去寻求财富。

examples.text: The long discussion brought forth several new ideas.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间的讨论产生了几个新想法。

senses.meaning_en: having the usual features or qualities of a particular type

examples.text: This painting is typical of his early style.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画是他早期风格的典型代表。

senses.meaning_en: happening in the usual way; showing what something is normally like
senses.pattern: it is typical of sb to do

examples.text: It's typical of him to forget my birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 他忘记我的生日，这很平常。

senses.meaning_en: older, especially of two members of the same family

examples.text: My elder sister often helps me with my homework.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐经常帮助我做家庭作业。

senses.meaning_en: a respected older person, especially a leader in a community or tribe

examples.text: The village elders met to discuss the harvest festival.
examples.translation_cn: 村里的长者们聚集起来讨论丰收节的事宜。

senses.meaning_en: an older person; one who is older than another; a person who lived in earlier times

examples.text: It is important to respect your elders in many cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多文化中，尊重长辈是很重要的。

senses.meaning_en: an officer of a church, sometimes having teaching responsibilities

examples.text: He was appointed a church elder after many years of service.
examples.translation_cn: 在服务多年后，他被任命为教会长老。

senses.meaning_en: old; having lived for many years

examples.text: An elderly person may need more time to cross the road.
examples.translation_cn: 老年人过马路可能需要更多时间。

senses.meaning_en: older people as a group

examples.text: The community centre offers free lunch for the elderly.
examples.translation_cn: 社区中心为老年人提供免费午餐。

senses.meaning_en: to completely remove or get rid of something

examples.text: The new policy aims to eliminate corruption from the system.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策旨在消除制度中的腐败。

senses.meaning_en: to kill a person or animal

examples.text: The secret agent was ordered to eliminate a high-profile target.
examples.translation_cn: 这名特工奉命消灭一个高价值目标。

senses.meaning_en: to excrete waste products from the body

examples.text: Regular exercise helps eliminate waste products from the body.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼有助于将废物排出体外。

senses.meaning_en: to remove a person or team from further competition

examples.text: The team was eliminated from the tournament in the first round.
examples.translation_cn: 该队在锦标赛第一轮就被淘汰了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who receives or entertains guests

examples.text: My father acted as host at the dinner party.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲在晚宴上做东。

senses.meaning_en: a person who introduces or moderates a show

examples.text: The host of the show introduced the next act.
examples.translation_cn: 该节目的主持人介绍了下一位表演者。

senses.meaning_en: a person or organization that runs an event

examples.text: The university will play host to an international conference.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学将主办一场国际会议。

senses.meaning_en: a computer connected to a network

examples.text: Each host computer has a unique network address.
examples.translation_cn: 每台主机都有唯一的网络地址。

senses.meaning_en: the act of observing or the fact of being observed

examples.text: Close observation of the night sky revealed a new comet.
examples.translation_cn: 对夜空的仔细观察发现了一颗新彗星。

senses.meaning_en: a remark or comment

examples.text: She made an observation about the lack of clear signs.
examples.translation_cn: 她就缺乏清晰标识的问题发表了意见。

senses.meaning_en: a judgement based on observing

examples.text: The survey confirmed the observation that most users prefer mobile apps.
examples.translation_cn: 调查证实了大多数用户偏好移动应用这一判断。

senses.meaning_en: one of the large bodies of water separating the continents

examples.text: The Pacific Ocean separates Asia from the Americas.
examples.translation_cn: 太平洋将亚洲和美洲隔开。

senses.meaning_en: the mass of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface

examples.text: Many kinds of plastic waste end up in the ocean every year.
examples.translation_cn: 每年有许多种塑料垃圾最终进入海洋。

senses.meaning_en: an immense expanse; any vast space or quantity without apparent limits

examples.text: The system collects oceans of data every day.
examples.translation_cn: 这个系统每天收集大量数据。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel admiration and respect

examples.text: She impressed the interviewers with her confident answers.
examples.translation_cn: 她自信的回答给面试官留下了深刻印象。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone understand the importance of something

examples.text: The coach impressed the importance of teamwork on the players.
examples.translation_cn: 教练使球员们铭记团队合作的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: the overall effect that something has on a person

examples.text: Her speech made a strong impression on the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 她的演讲给听众留下了深刻印象。

senses.meaning_en: an imitation of someone's mannerisms

examples.text: He does a brilliant impression of the president.
examples.translation_cn: 他模仿总统学得很像。

senses.meaning_en: the outward appearance or look of something

examples.text: The abandoned house gave an impression of neglect.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋废弃的房子看上去疏于照管。

senses.meaning_en: a mark left by pressure on a surface
senses.collocation: a deep impression in the carpet

examples.text: The heavy vase left a deep impression in the carpet.
examples.translation_cn: 沉重的花瓶在地毯上留下了深深的印痕。

senses.meaning_en: at the same time

examples.text: She was working in London; meanwhile, back home, the children were doing their homework.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伦敦工作；与此同时，在家里，孩子们在做作业。

senses.meaning_en: in the time between two events

examples.text: The train leaves at noon. Meanwhile, we have time for coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 火车中午开。在此期间，我们有时间喝咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: used to contrast two things

examples.text: The city center is busy, but the suburbs, meanwhile, are quiet.
examples.translation_cn: 市中心很热闹，但郊区则很安静。

senses.meaning_en: the time between two events

examples.text: The meeting is at 3; in the meanwhile, you can wait here.
examples.translation_cn: 会议三点开始；在此期间，你可以在这里等。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives near you

examples.text: A neighbour of mine offered to feed my cat while I was ill.
examples.translation_cn: 我的一位邻居在我生病时主动帮我喂猫。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is next to another

examples.text: My seat neighbour on the train offered me a mint.
examples.translation_cn: 火车上坐在我旁边的人给了我一颗薄荷糖。

senses.meaning_en: a country that is next to another

examples.text: Canada is a neighbour of the United States.
examples.translation_cn: 加拿大是美国的邻国。

senses.meaning_en: to be next to

examples.text: Our campus is neighboured by a large public park.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的校园毗邻一个大公园。

senses.meaning_en: a close-fitting hat, either brimless or peaked

examples.text: He always wears a baseball cap when he goes running.
examples.translation_cn: 他跑步时总是戴着棒球帽。

senses.meaning_en: a protective cover or seal

examples.text: She put the cap back on the pen to keep the ink from drying out.
examples.translation_cn: 她把笔帽盖回笔上，以免墨水变干。

senses.meaning_en: an artificial upper limit or ceiling

examples.text: The government imposed a cap on carbon emissions from factories.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对工厂的碳排放实行了上限。

senses.meaning_en: a crown for covering a tooth

examples.text: The dentist placed a cap over the broken tooth to protect it.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医在受损的牙齿上覆盖了一个牙冠以保护它。

senses.meaning_en: having the ability to do something

examples.text: She is perfectly capable of making her own decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全有能力自己做决定。

senses.meaning_en: competent and efficient

examples.text: She proved to be a capable manager during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机期间她证明了自己是一位能干的经理。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten or join one thing to another

examples.text: She carefully attached a label to each box.
examples.translation_cn: 她仔细地把标签贴到每个箱子上。

senses.meaning_en: to add a file, photo, etc. to a message

examples.text: I have attached the report to this email.
examples.translation_cn: 我已将报告附在这封电子邮件中。

senses.meaning_en: to like someone or something very much

examples.text: The little girl is deeply attached to her grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小女孩很依恋她的祖母。

senses.meaning_en: to stick to something

examples.text: The sticker attaches to the glass surface easily.
examples.translation_cn: 贴纸很容易粘在玻璃表面上。

senses.collocation: fix a shelf to the wall

examples.text: He fixed a small shelf to the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一个小架子固定在墙上。

examples.text: I need to get my bike fixed before the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我需要在这个周末前把自行车修好。

examples.text: Let's fix a date for the next meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们定下次会议日期吧。

senses.meaning_en: a thousand dollars or pounds

examples.text: He borrowed a couple of grand from his brother.
examples.translation_cn: 他向他哥哥借了两千美元。

senses.meaning_en: impressive in size, appearance, or effect

examples.text: The palace was built on a grand scale to impress visiting rulers.
examples.translation_cn: 皇宫建得规模宏大，以给来访的统治者留下深刻印象。

senses.meaning_en: large and impressive in scale or importance

examples.text: Their daughter's wedding was a grand occasion for the whole family.
examples.translation_cn: 他们女儿的婚礼对全家来说是一个盛大的场合。

senses.meaning_en: behaving in a proud or superior way

examples.text: She spoke to us with a grand air, as if we were her servants.
examples.translation_cn: 她以一种傲慢的态度跟我们说话，好像我们是她的仆人似的。

senses.meaning_en: a popular style of clothes, hair, etc.; the business of fashion

examples.text: High-waisted jeans are back in fashion this season.
examples.translation_cn: 高腰牛仔裤本季重新流行。

senses.meaning_en: a way or manner of doing something

examples.text: She explained the rules in a clear and simple fashion.
examples.translation_cn: 她以清晰简单的方式解释了规则。

senses.meaning_en: to make or shape something, especially with your hands

examples.text: He fashioned a small boat from a piece of wood.
examples.translation_cn: 他用一块木头做了一只小船。

senses.meaning_en: a reflective surface, typically of glass coated with a metal amalgam, that reflects a clear image

examples.text: She looked in the mirror and adjusted her hair.
examples.translation_cn: 她照了照镜子，整理了一下头发。

senses.meaning_en: a website or server that contains replicated data from another site

examples.text: You can download the update from a mirror site.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以从镜像站点下载更新。

senses.meaning_en: to reflect or show something as if in a mirror

examples.text: The conflict was mirrored in the strained atmosphere at home.
examples.translation_cn: 这种冲突反映在家里紧张的气氛中。

senses.meaning_en: to create an identical copy of data on another server or device

examples.text: We mirror the database to a backup server every night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每天晚上将数据库镜像到备份服务器。

senses.meaning_en: the land along the edge of the sea

examples.text: They rented a small house on the coast for the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们夏天在海边租了一所小房子。

senses.meaning_en: to move without using power

examples.text: The car coasted down the hill without using the engine.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车没有发动引擎，顺着山坡滑行。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed or progress without much effort

examples.text: He coasted through his final year without much effort.
examples.translation_cn: 他没费多大力气就轻松度过了最后一年。

senses.meaning_en: the mixture of gases around the Earth or another planet

examples.text: Carbon dioxide levels in the atmosphere are rising.
examples.translation_cn: 大气中的二氧化碳水平正在上升。

senses.meaning_en: the air in a particular place

examples.text: The atmosphere in the room grew thick with cigarette smoke.
examples.translation_cn: 房间里的空气因香烟烟雾而变得混浊。

senses.meaning_en: the mood or feeling in a place or situation

examples.text: The two leaders met in an atmosphere of trust.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人在相互信任的气氛中会面。

senses.meaning_en: clever; quick at learning and understanding

examples.text: She is smart enough to solve the puzzle on her own.
examples.translation_cn: 她足够聪明，能独自解出谜题。

senses.meaning_en: equipped with intelligent digital or electronic control

examples.text: The house uses smart technology to save energy.
examples.translation_cn: 这座房子使用智能技术来节能。

senses.meaning_en: neat and stylish; well dressed

examples.text: He looked very smart in his new suit.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿上新西装，看上去很精神。

senses.meaning_en: to feel or cause a sharp stinging pain

examples.text: My eyes smarted from the thick campfire smoke.
examples.translation_cn: 篝火的浓烟熏得我眼睛刺痛。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of matter in an object

examples.text: The mass of the Earth is roughly 6 × 10^24 kilograms.
examples.translation_cn: 地球的质量大约是6×10^24千克。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount or quantity of something

examples.text: A mass of dark clouds gathered over the city.
examples.translation_cn: 一团乌云聚集在城市上空。

senses.meaning_en: involving large numbers of people or things; connected with ordinary people

examples.text: The campaign relied on mass media to reach a wide audience.
examples.translation_cn: 这场运动依靠大众媒体来接触大量受众。

senses.meaning_en: the main religious ceremony in the Roman Catholic Church

examples.text: They go to Mass at the local church every Sunday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每周日早上去当地教堂做弥撒。

senses.meaning_en: to come together in large numbers; to assemble

examples.text: Huge crowds massed in the square to protest against the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 大批人群聚集在广场上抗议新法律。

senses.meaning_en: a political upheaval in which a government or state is replaced, often by force

examples.text: The revolution against the dictatorship lasted nearly a decade.
examples.translation_cn: 那场反对独裁统治的革命持续了近十年。

senses.meaning_en: one complete turn of an object around an axis

examples.text: The fan spins at 2,000 revolutions per minute when set to high.
examples.translation_cn: 风扇在高档时每分钟旋转2000转。

senses.meaning_en: the movement of one celestial body around another along an orbit
senses.collocation: make one revolution around the sun

examples.text: The earth makes one revolution around the sun every year.
examples.translation_cn: 地球每年绕太阳公转一周。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden, great change in a situation, discipline, or way of thinking

examples.text: The discovery of penicillin brought about a revolution in medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 青霉素的发现给医学带来了一场巨变。

senses.meaning_en: to say that you are unhappy or annoyed about something

examples.text: My grandfather always complains about the cold weather in winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父总是抱怨冬天天气寒冷。

senses.meaning_en: to formally tell someone in authority about a problem

examples.text: We had to complain to the airline about the delayed flight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不向航空公司投诉航班延误。

senses.meaning_en: a subject or theme that people talk or write about

examples.text: The rising cost of housing has become the main topic of conversation in our office.
examples.translation_cn: 房价上涨已成为我们办公室谈话的主要话题。

senses.meaning_en: a discussion thread on an online forum

examples.text: She started a topic on the forum about the city's new bike lanes.
examples.translation_cn: 她在论坛上发了一个关于该市新自行车道的主题帖。

senses.meaning_en: to pull something apart or into pieces

examples.text: She tore the letter into pieces and threw them in the bin.
examples.translation_cn: 她把信撕成碎片扔进了垃圾桶。

senses.meaning_en: to remove something by pulling it away from something else

examples.text: He tore a page from his notebook and handed it to me.
examples.translation_cn: 他从笔记本上撕下一页递给我。

senses.meaning_en: a drop of salty liquid from the eye

examples.text: She was in tears after the phone call.
examples.translation_cn: 接完电话后她泪流满面。

senses.meaning_en: to injure a muscle or ligament by stretching it too far

examples.text: He tore a calf muscle during the match.
examples.translation_cn: 他在比赛中拉伤了小腿肌肉。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or demolish a building, wall, etc.

examples.text: They tore down the old factory and built apartments there.
examples.translation_cn: 他们拆除了旧工厂，并在那里建了公寓。

senses.meaning_en: able to be changed or adjusted

examples.text: The heater has variable temperature settings for different rooms.
examples.translation_cn: 这款取暖器有适用于不同房间的可变温度设置。

senses.meaning_en: likely to change often or differ

examples.text: The weather in the mountains is highly variable.
examples.translation_cn: 山里的天气变化无常。

senses.meaning_en: a factor that can change, especially in mathematics

examples.text: Temperature is a variable in this mathematical model.
examples.translation_cn: 温度是这个数学模型中的一个变量。

senses.meaning_en: lasting only a short time; happening quickly

examples.text: He hesitated for a brief moment before answering.
examples.translation_cn: 他在回答前犹豫了片刻。

senses.meaning_en: concise; using few words

examples.text: Please keep it brief; we have many items to discuss.
examples.translation_cn: 请保持简洁；我们有许多事项要讨论。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone official information or instructions

examples.text: The officer briefed the team on the rescue plan.
examples.translation_cn: 警官向团队简要介绍了救援计划。

senses.meaning_en: a written or spoken summary of important information

examples.text: She prepared a brief on the market trends for the board.
examples.translation_cn: 她为董事会准备了一份市场趋势简报。

senses.meaning_en: a legal document stating the facts of a case

examples.text: The attorney filed a brief with the appellate court.
examples.translation_cn: 律师向上诉法院提交了辩护状。

senses.meaning_en: different and separate

examples.text: The two rooms are quite distinct from each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个房间彼此截然不同。

senses.meaning_en: noticeably different from others; distinctive

examples.text: The town has a distinct identity shaped by its history.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇有着由其历史塑造的独特身份。

senses.meaning_en: clearly perceived; obvious

examples.text: There was a distinct smell of gas in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房里有明显的煤气味。

senses.meaning_en: a clear difference between similar things

examples.text: There is a clear distinction between facts and opinions.
examples.translation_cn: 事实和观点之间有明显的区别。

senses.meaning_en: the act of distinguishing
senses.pattern: make a distinction between A and B

examples.text: Parents should make a distinction between needs and wants.
examples.translation_cn: 父母应该区分需要和想要。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being excellent

examples.text: She is a scholar of great distinction in her field.
examples.translation_cn: 她是她所在领域中一位非常杰出的学者。

senses.meaning_en: something that is kept hidden from others

examples.text: She shared a secret with me about her brother.
examples.translation_cn: 她和我分享了一个关于她弟弟的秘密。

senses.meaning_en: kept hidden from other people

examples.text: The company kept the new product secret until last week.
examples.translation_cn: 公司把新产品保密到上周才发布。

senses.meaning_en: the best or only way to achieve something

examples.text: Regular practice is the secret to learning a language.
examples.translation_cn: 经常练习是学习语言的秘诀。

senses.meaning_en: something that is not understood or known

examples.text: The astronomer spent years studying the secrets of the universe.
examples.translation_cn: 这位天文学家花了多年研究宇宙的奥秘。

senses.meaning_en: outside of something; on the exterior

examples.text: The staircase is external to the main building.
examples.translation_cn: 楼梯在主体建筑外部。

senses.meaning_en: coming from outside; outwardly perceived

examples.text: External pressures on employees can lead to burnout.
examples.translation_cn: 施加在员工身上的外部压力会导致倦怠。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or connected with foreign nations or institutions

examples.text: The minister handles external affairs for the government.
examples.translation_cn: 部长为政府处理外交事务。

senses.meaning_en: a large closed container for liquids or gases

examples.text: The plant stores liquid oxygen in a sealed storage tank.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂将液氧储存在一个密封的储罐里。

senses.meaning_en: a pond or pool, often artificial, for holding water or fish

examples.text: The farm keeps fish in large outdoor tanks.
examples.translation_cn: 这家农场在大型户外水池里养鱼。

senses.meaning_en: the fuel reservoir of a vehicle

examples.text: He stopped to fill the tank before crossing the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 他在穿越沙漠前停下来把油箱加满。

senses.meaning_en: an armoured fighting vehicle that moves on tracks

examples.text: A column of tanks rolled through the capital at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 一列坦克在黎明时分穿过首都。

senses.meaning_en: a common hard, silvery-grey metal that rusts and is used to make steel

examples.text: The old fence is made of iron and covered with rust.
examples.translation_cn: 旧篱笆是铁做的，上面长满了锈。

senses.meaning_en: a device with a flat metal base that is heated and used to press clothes smooth

examples.text: She pressed the shirt with a hot iron to remove the creases.
examples.translation_cn: 她用热熨斗熨平了衬衫上的褶皱。

senses.meaning_en: to press clothes smooth with a hot iron

examples.text: He ironed his shirt carefully before the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试前他仔细地熨了衬衫。

senses.meaning_en: to one side; out of the way

examples.text: He quickly stepped aside for the delivery cart.
examples.translation_cn: 他迅速闪到一边让送货车过去。

senses.meaning_en: excluded from consideration; reserved

examples.text: She puts aside a little money every month.
examples.translation_cn: 她每个月都会存一点钱。

senses.meaning_en: a quiet remark to one person or to the audience

examples.text: She whispered in an aside that the boss was drunk.
examples.translation_cn: 她低声悄悄说老板喝醉了。

senses.meaning_en: an incidental note; an afterthought

examples.text: As an aside, he mentioned that the manager was leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 他顺带提了一句，经理要走了。

senses.meaning_en: a person employed to do household work for someone

examples.text: She worked as a servant in a large country house.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾在一个大庄园里当仆人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who works for the government or the public

examples.text: He has been a public servant for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他当公务员已经二十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who serves another person, a group, or a cause

examples.text: The nurse saw herself as a servant of the community, always putting patients first.
examples.translation_cn: 这位护士把自己视为社区的服务者，总是把病人放在第一位。

senses.meaning_en: in or at any location

examples.text: You are free to sit anywhere in the library.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以坐在图书馆的任何地方。

senses.meaning_en: to any place (used in negative sentences and questions)

examples.text: He didn't go anywhere last weekend because he was ill.
examples.translation_cn: 他上周末哪儿也没去，因为他病了。

senses.meaning_en: used to indicate a range of numbers or amounts, approximately

examples.text: The project will take anywhere from two to three years.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目将需要大约两到三年时间。

senses.meaning_en: any place; an unspecified location

examples.text: For our next meeting, anywhere is fine with me.
examples.translation_cn: 对于我们的下次会议，对我来说任何地方都可以。

senses.meaning_en: the outside covering of the top of a building

examples.text: They sat on the roof of the old farmhouse.
examples.translation_cn: 他们坐在老农舍的屋顶上。

senses.meaning_en: the upper part of a cavity, especially the mouth
senses.collocation: burn the roof of your mouth

examples.text: Hot tea burned the roof of my mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 热茶烫到了我的上腭。

senses.meaning_en: to cover or furnish with a roof

examples.text: The old barn is roofed with corrugated iron.
examples.translation_cn: 旧谷仓用波纹铁皮盖顶。

senses.meaning_en: to move forward in space or time

examples.text: Troops advanced rapidly towards the border at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时分，部队迅速向边境推进。

senses.meaning_en: improvement or progress

examples.text: The discovery is an advance in the fight against malaria.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现是抗击疟疾的一大进步。

senses.meaning_en: money paid before it is due or as a loan

examples.text: She asked for an advance on her monthly salary to pay the rent.
examples.translation_cn: 她预支了月薪来付房租。

senses.meaning_en: to help something to succeed

examples.text: The campaign aims to advance the cause of free speech worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 这场运动旨在推动全球言论自由事业。

senses.meaning_en: to rise in amount or level

examples.text: Interest rates advanced sharply after the central bank announcement.
examples.translation_cn: 中央银行声明后，利率大幅上涨。

senses.meaning_en: a close connection between people or groups

examples.text: There is a deep bond between the twins.
examples.translation_cn: 这对双胞胎之间有一种深厚的纽带。

senses.meaning_en: a certificate issued by a government or company promising to repay borrowed money with interest

examples.text: The city issued bonds to fund the new hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 该市发行债券为新建医院筹资。

senses.meaning_en: a sum of money paid as a guarantee or deposit

examples.text: You may have to pay a bond before you rent a flat.
examples.translation_cn: 租房前你可能需要支付押金。

senses.meaning_en: a link or force between neighbouring atoms in a molecule

examples.text: A bond between two hydrogen atoms holds the molecule together.
examples.translation_cn: 两个氢原子之间的化学键使分子保持在一起。

senses.meaning_en: health, happiness, and well-being

examples.text: The charity works to improve the welfare of abandoned animals.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构致力于改善被遗弃动物的福利。

senses.meaning_en: financial aid provided by the government

examples.text: Many families in the area are on welfare.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区许多家庭靠福利金生活。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time, especially in history or someone's life, with particular characteristics or events

examples.text: The internet has ushered in an era of instant communication.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网迎来了一个即时通信的时代。

senses.meaning_en: a division of geological time, longer than a period and shorter than an eon

examples.text: Dinosaurs ruled the planet during the Mesozoic era for over 150 million years.
examples.translation_cn: 恐龙在中生代统治地球超过1.5亿年。

senses.meaning_en: to cohere or stick together; to unite

examples.text: Add water until the ingredients bind together into a soft dough.
examples.translation_cn: 加水，直到各种食材黏合成柔软的面团。

senses.meaning_en: to tie or fasten tightly together

examples.text: She bound the letters together with a red ribbon.
examples.translation_cn: 她用红丝带把信捆在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to confine, restrain, or hold by obligation

examples.text: The contract binds you to pay the full amount.
examples.translation_cn: 合同规定你必须支付全款。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to design, build, or maintain machines, structures, or systems

examples.text: She works as a civil engineer at a large construction firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家大型建筑公司担任土木工程师。

senses.meaning_en: to design and build something such as a machine, bridge, or system

examples.text: The new bridge was engineered to withstand earthquakes.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新桥的设计能够抵御地震。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange for something to happen, especially secretly or cleverly

examples.text: He engineered a deal that saved the company.
examples.translation_cn: 他促成了一笔交易，挽救了公司。

senses.meaning_en: a person who drives a train

examples.text: He works as a train engineer for a regional railway.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一家地区铁路公司的火车司机。

senses.meaning_en: in or to a lower position than; below

examples.text: The submarine glided silently beneath the cold surface.
examples.translation_cn: 潜艇在冰冷的海面下悄无声息地滑行。

senses.meaning_en: at a lower level or rank than; not good enough for

examples.text: He felt it was beneath him to ask for help.
examples.translation_cn: 他觉得开口求助有失身份。

senses.meaning_en: covered or hidden by something

examples.text: The village lay hidden beneath a thick blanket of fog.
examples.translation_cn: 村庄隐藏在浓雾之下。

senses.meaning_en: below; underneath

examples.text: A faint tapping sound came from beneath, as though someone were knocking on the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 下面传来轻轻的敲击声，好像有人在敲地板。

senses.meaning_en: a belief about what will happen in the future

examples.text: There is a widespread expectation that the government will cut taxes.
examples.translation_cn: 人们普遍预期政府将会减税。

senses.meaning_en: a hope or standard that people expect from someone or something

examples.text: The company failed to meet customers' expectations of quality service.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司未能达到顾客对优质服务的期望。

senses.meaning_en: a picture made with a pencil, pen, etc.

examples.text: She made a quick drawing of the old bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 她给那座老桥画了一幅速写。

senses.meaning_en: the act or skill of making pictures, plans, etc.

examples.text: He is good at drawing and wants to study art.
examples.translation_cn: 他擅长绘画，想学艺术。

senses.meaning_en: the process or act of drawing lots, especially to choose a winner

examples.text: The winner was chosen by drawing lots at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 获胜者是在聚会上通过抽签选出的。

senses.meaning_en: to say that somebody has committed a crime or offence

examples.text: The police accused the store manager of theft.
examples.translation_cn: 警方指控商店经理盗窃。

senses.meaning_en: to say that somebody has done something wrong

examples.text: She accused him of lying about his age.
examples.translation_cn: 她指责他谎报年龄。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that produces power to make something move

examples.text: He started the motor and let it run for a few seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 他发动了马达，让它运转了几秒钟。

senses.meaning_en: a car or other motor vehicle

examples.text: They drove a motor car through the winding mountain roads.
examples.translation_cn: 他们开着一辆汽车穿过蜿蜒的山路。

senses.meaning_en: relating to movement or muscles that control movement

examples.text: Children develop fine motor skills through drawing and painting.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们通过画画和涂色发展精细运动技能。

senses.meaning_en: a force that makes something happen; a source of energy

examples.text: Private investment is the motor of economic growth.
examples.translation_cn: 私人投资是经济增长的动力。

senses.meaning_en: to a limited extent or degree; not completely

examples.text: The new policy is somewhat difficult to understand.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策有点难以理解。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a liquid or substance to flow in a stream

examples.text: She poured the milk into a cup and handed it to me.
examples.translation_cn: 她把牛奶倒进杯子里递给我。

senses.meaning_en: to flow or come in large numbers

examples.text: Hundreds of football fans poured into the stadium before the match.
examples.translation_cn: 数百名足球迷在赛前涌入体育场。

senses.meaning_en: to rain heavily

examples.text: The rain poured down all night, flooding the streets.
examples.translation_cn: 雨下了一整夜，街道都被淹了。

senses.meaning_en: having the colour of smoke or ashes; (of hair) turning grey or white

examples.text: My father's hair went grey in his early forties.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲四十出头头发就变灰白了。

senses.meaning_en: to become grey

examples.text: The sky is greying over, so we should take an umbrella.
examples.translation_cn: 天空正变得灰蒙蒙的，所以我们该带把伞。

senses.meaning_en: the colour of smoke or ashes

examples.text: She was dressed in grey from head to toe.
examples.translation_cn: 她从头到脚穿着一身灰色。

senses.meaning_en: to mix or move a liquid or substance by moving a spoon, etc.

examples.text: She stirred the cream into the soup and waited for it to heat.
examples.translation_cn: 她把奶油搅入汤中，等它加热。

senses.meaning_en: to cause or awaken (a feeling, memory, etc.)

examples.text: The old photograph stirred memories of our school trip.
examples.translation_cn: 那张旧照片唤起了我们学校旅行的回忆。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage or provoke (trouble, rebellion, etc.)

examples.text: The article stirred up a heated debate among scientists.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章在科学家中引发了激烈辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to move, especially gently, from a still or unmoving position

examples.text: The injured man stirred from a deep sleep and opened his eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 那个受伤的人从沉睡中动了动，睁开了眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: an area of sand or small stones beside the sea or a lake

examples.text: They built a fire on the beach and watched the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在海滩上生了堆火，看日落。

senses.meaning_en: to come or bring something onto a beach from the water, especially a boat or whale

examples.text: The whale was beached on the shore and could not return to the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸鱼搁浅在岸边，无法返回大海。

senses.meaning_en: to go somewhere with someone

examples.text: My brother accompanied me to the airport last Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥上周日陪我去机场。

senses.meaning_en: to perform a musical accompaniment

examples.text: He accompanied the singer on the piano and received warm applause.
examples.translation_cn: 他为歌手钢琴伴奏，赢得了热烈掌声。

senses.meaning_en: to happen at the same time as something else

examples.text: A high fever is often accompanied by a headache.
examples.translation_cn: 高烧常伴有头痛。

senses.meaning_en: to be provided along with something else

examples.text: She accompanied her lecture with interesting slides and short videos.
examples.translation_cn: 她讲座中配了有趣的幻灯片和短视频。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of establishing

examples.text: The establishment of a national park was approved last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这座国家公园的设立去年获得批准。

senses.meaning_en: an organization, business, or hotel

examples.text: They run a small establishment near the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在港口附近经营一家小旅馆。

senses.meaning_en: the ruling class or authority group in a society, especially when seen as opposed to change

examples.text: After years in office, she is now part of the political establishment.
examples.translation_cn: 在任职多年后，她现在已是政治建制的一部分。

senses.meaning_en: for this reason; as a result

examples.text: He works with children, hence the need for patience.
examples.translation_cn: 他做与儿童相关的工作，因此需要耐心。

senses.meaning_en: from now; in the future

examples.text: They plan to launch the product a year hence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划一年后推出该产品。

senses.meaning_en: the number 19

examples.text: Nineteen passengers were injured in the bus crash.
examples.translation_cn: 十九名乘客在公交车事故中受伤。

senses.meaning_en: not lucky; suffering from bad luck

examples.text: She was unfortunate to lose her passport before the flight.
examples.translation_cn: 她很不幸，在航班起飞前丢了护照。

senses.meaning_en: unsuitable or causing embarrassment or regret

examples.text: It was unfortunate that she mentioned his ex-wife at dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 真尴尬，她在晚餐时提到了他的前妻。

senses.meaning_en: by bad luck; because of an unfortunate event

examples.text: Unfortunately, the outdoor concert was postponed because of heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 不幸的是，户外音乐会因大雨推迟了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is admired for bravery or noble deeds

examples.text: The pilot was hailed as a hero after the emergency landing.
examples.translation_cn: 这位飞行员在紧急降落后被誉为英雄。

senses.meaning_en: the main male character in a story, film, or play

examples.text: People still debate whether Hamlet is the hero of the story.
examples.translation_cn: 人们仍在争论哈姆雷特是不是故事的主角。

senses.meaning_en: a person you admire very much

examples.text: My grandfather was a hero to everyone in our family.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父是我们家每个人的偶像。

senses.meaning_en: a large sandwich filled with meat and cheese

examples.text: On game days, they usually order a hero with extra cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛日他们通常会点一份加额外奶酪的大号三明治。

senses.meaning_en: the measurement from the base to the top of something

examples.text: The doorway is just over two metres in height.
examples.translation_cn: 这个门口刚好两米多高。

senses.meaning_en: the distance of something above the ground or another level; a high point

examples.text: The balloon stayed at a height of 800 metres for an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 气球在八百米高度停留了一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: the most intense part or highest degree of something

examples.text: He retired at the height of his career.
examples.translation_cn: 他在事业巅峰时退休了。

senses.meaning_en: happening all the time or repeatedly; persistent

examples.text: The constant noise from the street made it hard to concentrate.
examples.translation_cn: 街上持续不断的噪音让人难以集中注意力。

senses.meaning_en: steady and not changing

examples.text: Prices have remained constant for the past three months.
examples.translation_cn: 过去三个月价格保持不变。

senses.meaning_en: a number or quantity that does not vary

examples.text: In this equation, the value of x is a constant.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个方程中，x 的值是一个常数。

senses.meaning_en: to extend one's limbs or body, often to improve elasticity

examples.text: She stood up to stretch her legs after the long meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的会议结束后，她站起来伸展双腿。

senses.meaning_en: to make something longer or tighter by pulling; to become longer when pulled

examples.text: He stretched the rope tight between the two posts.
examples.translation_cn: 他把绳子在两个柱子之间绷紧。

senses.meaning_en: to extend over an area or period of time

examples.text: The forest stretches for miles along the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 森林沿海岸绵延数英里。

senses.meaning_en: a continuous area or period of time

examples.text: They drove along a quiet stretch of road for an hour.
