senses.meaning_en: to be much taller than the people or things around you

examples.text: The new office building towers above the surrounding houses.
examples.translation_cn: 新办公楼高耸于周围的房屋之上。

senses.meaning_en: a computer case that is taller than it is wide and stands upright

examples.text: There is a small fan inside the computer tower to keep it cool.
examples.translation_cn: 电脑塔式机箱里有一个小风扇来散热。

senses.meaning_en: the act of arresting someone

examples.text: The suspect was placed under arrest after a short chase.
examples.translation_cn: 短暂追逐后，嫌疑人被逮捕了。

senses.meaning_en: a stop or interruption

examples.text: The cold weather caused an arrest of the plant's growth.
examples.translation_cn: 寒冷天气导致植物生长停止。

senses.meaning_en: to stop or slow the progress of something

examples.text: The new measures are intended to arrest the spread of the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 这些新措施旨在阻止病毒传播。

senses.meaning_en: mainly; chiefly

examples.text: The report is primarily concerned with climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告主要关注气候变化。

senses.meaning_en: an outer garment with sleeves, worn over other clothes

examples.text: She put on her coat and left the house.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿上外套，离开了房子。

senses.meaning_en: a layer of a substance covering a surface

examples.text: The front door needs another coat of paint.
examples.translation_cn: 前门需要再刷一层漆。

senses.meaning_en: to cover something with a layer of a substance

examples.text: Coat the chicken pieces with flour before frying.
examples.translation_cn: 炸之前给鸡块裹上面粉。

senses.meaning_en: the fur or hair covering an animal's body

examples.text: That breed has a thick coat that keeps it warm.
examples.translation_cn: 那个品种有厚厚的皮毛来保暖。

senses.meaning_en: to examine or think about something carefully in order to understand it

examples.text: We need to analyse the problem from different angles.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要从不同角度分析这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: a plan of times when things will happen

examples.text: We need to draw up a schedule for the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要为这个项目制定一份时间表。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

examples.text: The train is scheduled to arrive at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 火车定于中午到达。

senses.meaning_en: a list of items or details

examples.text: The website provides a schedule of fees for all services.
examples.translation_cn: 网站提供所有服务的收费明细表。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to communism

examples.text: The country was ruled by a communist government for over thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家被一个共产主义政府统治了三十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a supporter of communism

examples.text: She became a committed communist after studying Marx at university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学学习马克思后成为了一名坚定的共产主义者。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a Communist Party

examples.text: He joined the Communist Party in 2005 and has been an active member ever since.
examples.translation_cn: 他2005年加入共产党，自那时起一直是活跃党员。

senses.meaning_en: to make something harmful by adding unwanted substances

examples.text: The factory was fined for polluting the river with chemicals.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂因向河中排放化学品而被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: to corrupt or make morally harmful

examples.text: Some people worry that such content will pollute the minds of young readers.
examples.translation_cn: 一些人担心这类内容会玷污年轻读者的心灵。

senses.meaning_en: the process of making air, water, land etc. dirty and unsafe; substances that cause this

examples.text: Pollution from factories has made the river unsafe for swimming.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂排放的污染使这条河不再适合游泳。

senses.meaning_en: the system of basic laws and principles by which a country or organization is governed

examples.text: Under the constitution, all citizens have equal rights.
examples.translation_cn: 根据宪法，所有公民权利平等。

senses.meaning_en: a person's physical strength and health

examples.text: He has a strong constitution, so he rarely falls ill.
examples.translation_cn: 他体质强壮，很少生病。

senses.meaning_en: the way something is formed or organized; its composition

examples.text: Scientists analyzed the chemical constitution of the rock.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们分析了这块岩石的化学构成。

senses.meaning_en: to put a plan, policy, etc. into effect

examples.text: The school will implement a new policy next year.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校明年将实施一项新政策。

senses.meaning_en: a tool or instrument, especially for farming or gardening

examples.text: She bought some new garden implements at the store.
examples.translation_cn: 她在商店买了一些新的园艺工具。

senses.meaning_en: to buy something

examples.text: We plan to purchase a new car next year.
examples.translation_cn: 我们计划明年购买一辆新车。

senses.meaning_en: the act of buying something

examples.text: The purchase of the building was completed last week.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋楼的购买手续上周完成了。

senses.meaning_en: something that you have bought

examples.text: That winter coat was a smart purchase; I wear it every day.
examples.translation_cn: 那件冬衣买得很值，我天天都穿。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of heredity that determines a particular trait

examples.text: Scientists have identified the gene for Huntington's disease.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家已经识别出亨廷顿病的致病基因。

senses.meaning_en: a strong hard metal made from iron

examples.text: The bridge is made of steel, so it can withstand strong winds.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥是钢制的，所以能承受强风。

senses.meaning_en: to prepare yourself to do something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: She steeled herself to tell her parents the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 她鼓起勇气告诉父母真相。

senses.meaning_en: extreme hardness or resilience

examples.text: She faced the crisis with nerves of steel.
examples.translation_cn: 她以钢铁般的意志面对危机。

senses.meaning_en: in large amounts or to a great degree

examples.text: The local economy relies heavily on winter tourism.
examples.translation_cn: 当地经济严重依赖冬季旅游。

senses.meaning_en: with a lot of force or weight

examples.text: She fell heavily on the ice and hurt her arm.
examples.translation_cn: 她重重地摔在冰上，弄伤了手臂。

senses.meaning_en: in a laboured manner

examples.text: He was breathing heavily after the long race.
examples.translation_cn: 长跑后他呼吸粗重。

senses.meaning_en: so as to be thick or heavy

examples.text: The hills are heavily forested with pine trees.
examples.translation_cn: 这些山丘上长满茂密的松树。

senses.meaning_en: concerning; about

examples.text: Please contact us regarding any changes to your booking.
examples.translation_cn: 如有任何预订变更，请联系我们。

senses.meaning_en: related to seeing or the ability to see

examples.text: The teacher used visual aids to help students understand the diagram.
examples.translation_cn: 老师用视觉辅助工具帮助学生理解图表。

senses.meaning_en: a picture, diagram, or piece of film used to present information

examples.text: The speaker used visuals to explain the complex data.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲者用视觉材料来解释复杂数据。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 cm

examples.text: The shelf is only a few inches long.
examples.translation_cn: 架子只有几英寸长。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount or distance

examples.text: The car missed the cyclist by an inch.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车差一点就撞到骑车人。

senses.meaning_en: to move or make something move slowly and carefully

examples.text: He inched the car forward through the narrow gate.
examples.translation_cn: 他把车缓缓地向前开过狭窄的大门。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring the amount of rain that falls

examples.text: The city received three inches of rain overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 该市一夜之间下了三英寸的雨。

senses.meaning_en: the vertical distance below a surface; how deep something is

examples.text: The wreck lies at a depth of 40 metres.
examples.translation_cn: 沉船位于40米深处。

senses.meaning_en: the deepest part of a place or thing

examples.text: The giant squid lives in the depths of the ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 巨型鱿鱼生活在海洋深处。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being deep, strong, or intense

examples.text: He spoke with a depth of feeling that surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他说话时感情深厚，令所有人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: to help someone do something

examples.text: Our staff will assist you with your application.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的员工将协助您办理申请。

senses.meaning_en: to pass the ball or puck to a teammate who then scores

examples.text: She assisted on two goals in the second half.
examples.translation_cn: 她下半场助攻两球。

senses.meaning_en: a pass that leads directly to a score

examples.text: The point guard recorded ten assists in the game.
examples.translation_cn: 这名控球后卫在比赛中送出十次助攻。

senses.meaning_en: an act of helping

examples.text: He completed the project with an assist from a colleague.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一位同事的帮助下完成了这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: a person's essential being or identity; the subject of one's own experience

examples.text: Years of criticism slowly destroyed his sense of self.
examples.translation_cn: 多年的批评慢慢摧毁了他的自我意识。

senses.meaning_en: one's own interests or advantage

examples.text: He agreed to help only out of pure self-interest.
examples.translation_cn: 他同意帮忙纯粹出于私利。

senses.meaning_en: one's personality or character

examples.text: He only reveals his true self to close friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他只对亲密的朋友展现真实的自己。

senses.meaning_en: a reduction in cost or expenditure

examples.text: We made a saving of over $200 by buying in bulk.
examples.translation_cn: 我们批量购买，节省了200多美元。

senses.meaning_en: money saved, especially for the future

examples.text: She put her savings into a high-interest account.
examples.translation_cn: 她把积蓄存入高息账户。

senses.meaning_en: that saves someone from damnation; redemptive

examples.text: Her sense of humor is her saving grace.
examples.translation_cn: 她的幽默感是她唯一的长处。

senses.meaning_en: to become aware of something through the senses or intuition

examples.text: She immediately perceived a change in his tone of voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她立刻察觉到他语气的变化。

senses.meaning_en: to regard or interpret something in a particular way

examples.text: Many employees perceived the restructuring as a threat to their jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 许多员工认为这次重组对其工作构成了威胁。

senses.meaning_en: a place on the coast where ships shelter, or a town with such a place

examples.text: The ferry remained in port until the storm passed.
examples.translation_cn: 渡轮一直停在港内直到风暴过去。

senses.meaning_en: the left-hand side of a ship or aircraft when facing forward

examples.text: The lifeboats are located on the port side of the ship.
examples.translation_cn: 救生艇位于船的左舷。

senses.meaning_en: to dock at a port

examples.text: The cargo ship ported at Hamburg to unload containers.
examples.translation_cn: 货轮在汉堡靠港卸货。

senses.meaning_en: to turn the helm to the left

examples.text: The captain ordered the helmsman to port the helm.
examples.translation_cn: 船长命令舵手向左转舵。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone officially to do something

examples.text: The officer commanded his soldiers to stand at attention.
examples.translation_cn: 军官命令士兵立正。

senses.meaning_en: an order to do something

examples.text: The captain issued the command to abandon ship.
examples.translation_cn: 船长下达了弃船命令。

senses.meaning_en: an instruction given to a computer program

examples.text: You need to enter a command before pressing the Enter key.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要在按回车键前输入命令。

senses.meaning_en: the right or authority to order, control, or dispose of

examples.text: She is in command of the whole sales team.
examples.translation_cn: 她掌管整个销售团队。

senses.meaning_en: mastery or ability to use something well

examples.text: He has a good command of spoken English.
examples.translation_cn: 他英语口语很好。

senses.meaning_en: to find an answer or amount by using mathematics

examples.text: The engineer calculated how much weight the bridge could support.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师计算了这座桥能承受多少重量。

senses.meaning_en: to estimate something using information or evidence

examples.text: Experts have calculated that the new policy will reduce emissions by 30 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 专家们估计新政策将把排放量减少30%。

senses.meaning_en: a single thickness of material over a surface or forming a horizontal deposit

examples.text: The cliff face revealed a layer of clay under the topsoil.
examples.translation_cn: 崖面露出了表土层下的一层黏土。

senses.meaning_en: one of the levels in a system or hierarchy

examples.text: The report passed through several layers of management.
examples.translation_cn: 报告经过了多个管理层级的审批。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange something in layers

examples.text: Layer the potatoes with sliced onions and cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 将土豆与切片的洋葱和奶酪分层叠放。

senses.meaning_en: to cut or divide something into layers

examples.text: She had her long hair layered at the salon.
examples.translation_cn: 她在美发沙龙把长发剪出了层次。

senses.meaning_en: the act of conveying goods or information

examples.text: The restaurant offers free delivery of meals to offices.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅提供免费送餐到办公室的服务。

senses.meaning_en: the process of giving birth

examples.text: The doctor monitored the baby's heartbeat closely during delivery.
examples.translation_cn: 分娩过程中医生密切监测了婴儿的心跳。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which someone speaks or performs in public

examples.text: Her delivery of the opening speech was calm and confident.
examples.translation_cn: 她发表开幕演讲时从容而自信。

senses.meaning_en: something that has been delivered

examples.text: The shop received a delivery of new laptops and monitors.
examples.translation_cn: 店里收到了一批新的笔记本电脑和显示器。

senses.meaning_en: a number of things connected or following one after another

examples.text: A string of scandals forced the minister to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 一连串丑闻迫使部长辞职。

senses.meaning_en: a thin cord used for tying things

examples.text: Please tie the package with a piece of string.
examples.translation_cn: 请用一根细绳把包裹捆起来。

senses.meaning_en: a thin wire or cord in a musical instrument that produces sound

examples.text: He broke a guitar string during the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 他在音乐会上弹断了一根吉他弦。

senses.meaning_en: a sequence of characters treated as data in computing

examples.text: The program stores each command as a text string.
examples.translation_cn: 该程序将每条命令存储为文本字符串。

senses.meaning_en: to put things onto a thread or cord
senses.pattern: string the beads onto the cord

examples.text: String the beads onto the cord.
examples.translation_cn: 把珠子穿到绳子上。

senses.meaning_en: to find a solution to (a problem)

examples.text: The two countries finally resolved their border dispute through diplomatic talks.
examples.translation_cn: 两国最终通过外交谈判解决了边界争端。

senses.meaning_en: to make a firm decision to do something

examples.text: He resolved to cut back on sugar after his health check-up.
examples.translation_cn: 体检后，他决心减少糖的摄入。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce to simple or intelligible notions; to make clear or certain; to unravel; to explain

examples.text: The compound resolves into its elements when heated.
examples.translation_cn: 加热时，该化合物分解为其组成元素。

senses.meaning_en: to move smoothly over a surface while keeping contact with it

examples.text: The children slid down the steep snowy hill.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们从陡峭的雪坡上滑了下来。

senses.meaning_en: a picture on film or in digital form shown on a screen

examples.text: The teacher showed a slide of the water cycle.
examples.translation_cn: 老师展示了一张水循环的幻灯片。

senses.meaning_en: a gradual fall or decline in amount, value, etc.

examples.text: There has been a slide in consumer confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 消费者信心出现了下滑。

senses.meaning_en: to decrease in amount or value

examples.text: The company's shares slid to a record low.
examples.translation_cn: 公司股价跌至历史低点。

senses.meaning_en: a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down

examples.text: The children took turns going down the slide.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们轮流滑滑梯。

senses.meaning_en: a sturdy shoe that covers the foot and part of the leg

examples.text: She bought a pair of boots for her trip to the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 她为登山旅行买了一双靴子。

senses.meaning_en: the storage space at the back of a car (BrE; AmE trunk)

examples.text: She keeps a spare blanket in the boot of her car.
examples.translation_cn: 她在汽车后备箱里放了一条备用毯子。

senses.meaning_en: to start a computer and load its operating system

examples.text: It took ages to boot up my laptop this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我的笔记本电脑启动了很久。

senses.meaning_en: a blow with the foot; a kick

examples.text: He gave the ball a hard boot towards the goal.
examples.translation_cn: 他朝球门狠狠地踢了一脚球。

senses.meaning_en: a marriage ceremony

examples.text: They invited us to attend their wedding in June.
examples.translation_cn: 他们邀请我们六月参加他们的婚礼。

senses.meaning_en: an anniversary of a marriage, especially a silver or golden wedding

examples.text: My grandparents celebrated their golden wedding last year.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父母去年庆祝了金婚。

senses.meaning_en: a basic conceptual structure

examples.text: The new policy provides a framework for reducing carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策为减少碳排放提供了一个框架。

senses.meaning_en: a supporting structure of joined parts or beams

examples.text: The framework of the building was completed in just three weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋建筑的框架仅用三周就完工了。

senses.meaning_en: an established system of rules and principles for analyzing language

examples.text: Linguists work within a framework to describe how sentences are built.
examples.translation_cn: 语言学家在一个框架内描述句子是如何构成的。

senses.meaning_en: an allocated amount or share

examples.text: Each child received a portion of the cake as a special treat.
examples.translation_cn: 每个孩子都分到了一块蛋糕作为特别的款待。

senses.meaning_en: to divide and give out

examples.text: The volunteers portioned out food to the flood victims.
examples.translation_cn: 志愿者把食物分发给洪水灾民。

senses.meaning_en: a shrub with fragrant flowers

examples.text: They grow roses in neat rows along the fence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们沿着篱笆整齐地种着玫瑰。

senses.meaning_en: a flower of the rose plant

examples.text: He gave her a dozen red roses for her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 他在她生日那天送了她一打红玫瑰。

senses.meaning_en: a purplish-red or pink color, the color of some rose flowers

examples.text: The sky turned a deep rose just before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 日落前天空变成了深玫瑰色。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is against a plan, idea, etc.

examples.text: She is a leading opponent of the proposed tax reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这项拟议税制改革的主要反对者。

senses.meaning_en: a person you compete against or fight against in a game, competition, etc.

examples.text: He faced a tough opponent in the opening match.
examples.translation_cn: 他在首场比赛中面对一个强劲的对手。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of writing in verse

examples.text: The children wrote a poem about the changing seasons.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们写了一首关于季节更替的诗。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to do something, especially by law, rule, or duty

examples.text: All employees are obliged to follow safety rules.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工都必须遵守安全规定。

senses.meaning_en: to do someone a service or favour

examples.text: Could you oblige me by sending the report today?
examples.translation_cn: 你能帮我把报告今天发出去吗？

senses.meaning_en: to cause somebody to feel indebted
senses.pattern: be obliged to sb for sth

examples.text: I am much obliged to you for your advice.
examples.translation_cn: 我非常感谢你的建议。

senses.meaning_en: a legal or moral duty to do something
senses.pattern: be under an obligation to do

examples.text: Parents are under an obligation to protect their children.
examples.translation_cn: 父母有义务保护他们的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a debt of gratitude or favour
senses.pattern: be under an obligation to sb

examples.text: She felt under an obligation to him for his support.
examples.translation_cn: 她因他的支持而觉得欠他人情。

senses.meaning_en: covering a large area; vast

examples.text: The palace grounds cover an extensive area and are open to the public.
examples.translation_cn: 宫殿的庭院占地广阔，对公众开放。

senses.meaning_en: large in amount or scale; wide-ranging

examples.text: She has extensive experience in international project management.
examples.translation_cn: 她在国际项目管理方面拥有丰富的经验。

senses.meaning_en: to change greatly in appearance or form

examples.text: The makeup artist transformed the actor into an old man.
examples.translation_cn: 化妆师把演员变成了一个老人。

senses.meaning_en: to change the nature, condition, or function of

examples.text: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网改变了人们的沟通方式。

senses.meaning_en: to undergo a transformation; to change in appearance or character

examples.text: The caterpillar transforms into a butterfly within two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 毛毛虫在两周内变成蝴蝶。

senses.meaning_en: a mesh used for catching things

examples.text: The fisherman cast a net into the sea at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时渔夫把网撒进海里。

senses.meaning_en: the internet

examples.text: She found the recipe on the net last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚在网上找到了那个食谱。

senses.meaning_cn: 净的；最终的（指扣除所有费用或折扣后的）
senses.meaning_en: remaining after all deductions, such as taxes or discounts

examples.text: The net price is 23 dollars per box.
examples.translation_cn: 净价是每箱23美元。

senses.meaning_en: beverages containing ethanol, collectively

examples.text: He does not drink alcohol before driving or operating heavy machinery.
examples.translation_cn: 他开车或操作重型机械前不喝酒。

senses.meaning_en: ethanol; pure alcohol

examples.text: Hand sanitizers often contain alcohol to kill germs quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 洗手液通常含有酒精以快速杀菌。

senses.meaning_en: any organic compound with a hydroxyl group

examples.text: Ethanol is an alcohol used in fuels and solvents.
examples.translation_cn: 乙醇是一种用于燃料和溶剂的醇。

senses.meaning_en: to look briefly at someone or something

examples.text: She quickly glanced at her watch during the long meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 在漫长的会议中，她匆匆瞥了一眼手表。

senses.meaning_en: to hit something at an angle and move away in a different direction

examples.text: The arrow glanced off the soldier's shield and fell to the ground.
examples.translation_cn: 那支箭擦过士兵的盾牌，掉在地上。

senses.meaning_en: a large complex molecule made of chains of amino acids

examples.text: Insulin is a protein that controls blood sugar levels.
examples.translation_cn: 胰岛素是一种控制血糖水平的蛋白质。

senses.meaning_en: a substance in food that people need for growth and health

examples.text: Meat, fish, and beans are all rich in protein.
examples.translation_cn: 肉、鱼和豆类都富含蛋白质。

senses.meaning_en: to cause sth to curve or change shape

examples.text: He bent the metal bar into a curve.
examples.translation_cn: 他把金属棒弯成了弧形。

senses.meaning_en: to become curved

examples.text: The branch bent under the weight of snow.
examples.translation_cn: 树枝被积雪压弯了。

senses.meaning_en: to move your body down and forward

examples.text: She bent down to pick up the fallen pen.
examples.translation_cn: 她弯腰捡起掉落的钢笔。

senses.meaning_en: to change direction

examples.text: The narrow road bends sharply to the right.
examples.translation_cn: 狭窄的道路向右急转弯。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of land with little water or vegetation

examples.text: Camels can travel for days in the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 骆驼能在沙漠中行走数日。

senses.meaning_en: to leave somebody or something that needs you, often despite a duty to stay

examples.text: He deserted his friends just when they needed him most.
examples.translation_cn: 他在朋友们最需要他的时候抛弃了他们。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a military post or duty without permission

examples.text: He deserted from the army and hid for weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 他从军队开小差后躲藏了几周。

senses.meaning_en: a place or situation that lacks something desirable or interesting

examples.text: The town is a cultural desert with no cinema or theatre.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇缺乏文化生活，没有电影院或剧院。

senses.meaning_en: that which is deserved or merited; a just punishment or reward

examples.text: The cheats eventually got their just deserts and were banned from the sport.
examples.translation_cn: 作弊者最终得到了应得的惩罚，并被禁止参加这项运动。

senses.meaning_en: producing good results without wasting time or energy

examples.text: She is efficient at organizing files and finds everything quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 她整理文件很高效，找东西很快。

senses.meaning_en: the act of keeping something in good condition by checking and repairing it

examples.text: Regular maintenance of the engine can extend its life.
examples.translation_cn: 定期维护发动机可以延长其使用寿命。

senses.meaning_en: the act of keeping a state or situation continuing

examples.text: The army plays a key role in the maintenance of peace.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在维护和平方面发挥关键作用。

senses.meaning_en: money paid regularly to support a child or former spouse after a divorce or separation

examples.text: He pays maintenance to his ex-wife and son.
examples.translation_cn: 他向前妻和儿子支付赡养费。

senses.meaning_en: a complete rotation or recurring sequence of events

examples.text: The cycle of the seasons affects farming and wildlife.
examples.translation_cn: 季节的循环影响着农业和野生动物。

senses.meaning_en: to ride a bicycle

examples.text: She cycles around the park every morning before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上早餐前在公园里骑自行车。

senses.meaning_en: a programme on a washing machine, dishwasher, or similar device

examples.text: You can wash these clothes on the delicate cycle.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用轻柔洗涤程序洗这些衣服。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Italy, its people, or its culture

examples.text: We had dinner at a small Italian restaurant last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚在一家小意大利餐厅吃了晚饭。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Italy

examples.text: She married an Italian and moved to Naples.
examples.translation_cn: 她嫁给了一个意大利人并搬到了那不勒斯。

senses.meaning_en: the language of Italy

examples.text: The menu is written in Italian and English.
examples.translation_cn: 菜单用意大利语和英语写成。

senses.meaning_en: Italian food considered as a type of cuisine

examples.text: We decided to have Italian for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们决定今晚晚餐吃意大利菜。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Spain

examples.text: We had a delicious Spanish meal at the new restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在那家新餐馆吃了一顿美味的西班牙餐。

senses.meaning_en: the language of Spain

examples.text: She speaks Spanish with her grandparents at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她在家和祖父母说西班牙语。

senses.meaning_en: the people of Spain

examples.text: The Spanish often have dinner late in the evening.
examples.translation_cn: 西班牙人常常很晚吃晚饭。

senses.meaning_en: people of Hispanic origin; native Spanish speakers

examples.text: Many Americans of Spanish descent live in this city.
examples.translation_cn: 许多西班牙裔的美国人住在这座城市。

senses.meaning_en: happening or done sometimes but not often

examples.text: She enjoys an occasional glass of wine with dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 她晚餐时偶尔喝一杯葡萄酒。

senses.meaning_en: sometimes but not often

examples.text: We occasionally meet for lunch at a small café near the office.
examples.translation_cn: 我们偶尔在办公室附近的小咖啡馆见面吃午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a loose granular substance found on beaches and in deserts, used in building

examples.text: The children drew shapes in the wet sand.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在湿沙上画画。

senses.meaning_en: a large stretch of sand, especially by the sea or in a desert

examples.text: Families were playing on the sands as the sun went down.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳落山时，家人们正在沙滩上玩耍。

senses.meaning_en: to make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper

examples.text: You should sand the door down before painting it.
examples.translation_cn: 刷漆之前你应该把门打磨光滑。

senses.meaning_en: a light beige colour, like that of typical sand

examples.text: The sofa is available in sand or dark brown.
examples.translation_cn: 这款沙发有沙色和深棕色可选。

senses.meaning_en: to produce copies of a text or image on a surface, especially by machine

examples.text: She printed out the flight confirmation and put it in her bag.
examples.translation_cn: 她把航班确认单打印出来，放进了包里。

senses.meaning_en: to write very clearly, especially without joining the letters

examples.text: Please print your name clearly at the top of the form.
examples.translation_cn: 请在表格顶端用印刷体清晰书写你的姓名。

senses.meaning_en: to publish something in a book, newspaper, etc.

examples.text: Her first short story was printed in a national magazine.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一篇短篇小说发表在一家全国性杂志上。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or writing for printed publications

examples.text: The report received little attention in the print media.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告在印刷媒体上几乎没有受到关注。

senses.meaning_en: to limit the size, amount or range of something

examples.text: The school restricts phone use to lunch breaks.
examples.translation_cn: 学校将手机使用限制在午休时间。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent someone or something from moving or acting freely

examples.text: The cast on his leg restricted his movement for weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 他腿上的石膏限制了他的活动数周。

senses.meaning_en: an official suggestion about the best thing to do

examples.text: The committee made a recommendation to reduce parking fees.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会提出了一项降低停车费的建议。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or act of saying that someone or something is good or suitable

examples.text: On the recommendation of the local food critic, we tried the restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 根据当地美食评论家的推荐，我们去了那家餐厅。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet spread made from fruit and sugar

examples.text: She opened a jar of preserves and spread it on toast.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开一罐果酱涂在吐司上。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something safe from harm or destruction; to make something continue without changing

examples.text: We must preserve these ancient traditions for future generations.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护这些古老传统。

senses.meaning_en: to treat food with salt, sugar, or similar substances to prevent decay

examples.text: They preserve fish in salt to keep it fresh for months.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用盐腌鱼以便保鲜数月。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land protected for animals and plants

examples.text: The area was declared a nature preserve to protect rare birds.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区被宣布为自然保护区以保护珍稀鸟类。

senses.meaning_en: an activity or subject that belongs only to a particular group

examples.text: High finance used to be the preserve of wealthy men.
examples.translation_cn: 高级金融过去是富人的专属领域。

senses.meaning_en: a burden; a weight to be carried

examples.text: The porter struggled under a heavy load of suitcases.
examples.translation_cn: 搬运工背着一堆沉甸甸的行李，走得很吃力。

senses.meaning_en: a large number or amount

examples.text: He spent loads of money on that old car.
examples.translation_cn: 他在那辆旧车上花了很多钱。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of material that can be transported or processed at one time

examples.text: The truck delivered a full load of bricks to the building site.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车把满满一车砖送到了建筑工地。

senses.meaning_en: a quantity of washing put into a washing machine for a wash cycle

examples.text: I usually do a load of laundry on Saturday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常在周六早上洗一缸衣服。

senses.meaning_en: to bring back a previous situation or feeling

examples.text: The government hopes to restore confidence in the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 政府希望恢复人们对经济的信心。

senses.meaning_en: to repair something so it is in good condition again
senses.pattern: restore sth to its former glory

examples.text: Workers restored the old palace to its former glory.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们使旧宫殿恢复了昔日的辉煌。

senses.meaning_en: to give back something that was lost or stolen

examples.text: The police restored the stolen bike to its owner.
examples.translation_cn: 警方把被盗的自行车归还给了失主。

senses.meaning_en: to recover data from a backup

examples.text: You can restore deleted files from last night's backup.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以从昨晚的备份中恢复已删除的文件。

senses.meaning_en: in a kind and gentle way; not harshly

examples.text: She always treats her elderly neighbor gently, listening to his long stories.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是温柔地对待年迈的邻居，听他讲长长的故事。

senses.meaning_en: with little force or pressure; softly

examples.text: Stir the soup gently for five minutes over low heat.
examples.translation_cn: 用小火轻轻搅拌汤五分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a device for fastening a door, box, etc., needing a key or combination to open

examples.text: He tried to pick the lock on the back door.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图撬开后门的锁。

senses.meaning_en: a mechanism in computing that restricts access to shared data

examples.text: The process holds a lock on the shared file while writing.
examples.translation_cn: 该进程写入时持有共享文件的锁。

senses.meaning_en: a section of a canal or river with gates at each end, used to raise or lower boats

examples.text: The boat waited to go through the lock on the canal.
examples.translation_cn: 小船等着通过运河上的船闸。

senses.meaning_en: complete control over something

examples.text: The firm has a lock on the local market.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司完全控制了当地市场。

senses.meaning_en: on the other side of a space or thing

examples.text: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
examples.translation_cn: 银行在街对面。

senses.meaning_en: completely different or opposed

examples.text: Their conclusions are completely opposite to our expectations.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的结论与我们的预期完全相反。

senses.meaning_en: moving or facing the other way

examples.text: She turned and walked in the opposite direction.
examples.translation_cn: 她转身朝相反的方向走去。

senses.meaning_en: something or someone opposite to something or someone else

examples.text: The opposite of love is not hate but indifference.
examples.translation_cn: 爱的反面不是恨，而是冷漠。

senses.meaning_en: official permission or acceptance

examples.text: The board gave formal approval to the merger yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会昨天正式批准了合并。

senses.meaning_en: a positive opinion or praise

examples.text: Her teacher smiled with approval at her improved essay.
examples.translation_cn: 老师看到她进步的文章，赞许地笑了。

senses.meaning_en: a small house, especially in the country or for holidays

examples.text: They spent a quiet weekend in a cottage in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在乡村的一间小屋里度过了一个安静的周末。

senses.meaning_en: to be worthy of something because of actions or qualities

examples.text: You deserve to know the truth about what happened.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该知道所发生事情的真相。

senses.meaning_en: always behaving in the same way; dependable

examples.text: She has been consistent in her support for the project.
examples.translation_cn: 她对这个项目的支持始终一贯。

senses.meaning_en: in agreement with something; not contradictory

examples.text: His statement is consistent with the security footage.
examples.translation_cn: 他的陈述与监控录像一致。

senses.meaning_en: most important; main

examples.text: The principal reason for the delay was a lack of funding.
examples.translation_cn: 延误的主要原因是缺乏资金。

senses.meaning_en: the original sum of money invested or lent

examples.text: You must repay the principal and interest within five years.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须在五年内偿还本金和利息。

senses.meaning_en: the head of a school

examples.text: The principal of the school greeted us at the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 校长在门口迎接了我们。

senses.meaning_en: a person who authorizes another to act on their behalf

examples.text: The agent signed the contract on behalf of the principal.
examples.translation_cn: 代理人代表委托人签署了合同。

senses.meaning_en: the primary participant in a crime

examples.text: The court found him to be a principal in the robbery.
examples.translation_cn: 法院认定他是这起抢劫案的主犯。

senses.meaning_en: to oppose or fight against someone or something; to refuse to accept

examples.text: Many employees resisted the change at first, but later accepted it.
examples.translation_cn: 许多员工起初抵制这项变革，但后来接受了。

senses.meaning_en: to stop yourself from doing something you want to do

examples.text: I couldn't resist eating another slice of cake.
examples.translation_cn: 我忍不住又吃了一块蛋糕。

senses.meaning_en: to not be harmed or affected by something; to withstand the action or effect of something

examples.text: This coating can resist high temperatures and moisture.
examples.translation_cn: 这种涂层能耐受高温和潮湿。

senses.meaning_en: the act of resisting or the ability to resist

examples.text: There has been strong resistance to the new tax.
examples.translation_cn: 人们对新税有强烈的抵制。

senses.meaning_en: a force that opposes motion

examples.text: The car's streamlined shape helps reduce air resistance.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车的流线型外形有助于减少空气阻力。

senses.meaning_en: the opposition to electric current, measured in ohms

examples.text: Use a multimeter to measure the resistance of the wire.
examples.translation_cn: 用万用表测量电线的电阻。

senses.meaning_en: an underground organization fighting against an occupying force

examples.text: During the war, she joined the resistance to fight against the invaders.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间，她加入了抵抗运动，反抗侵略者。

senses.meaning_en: a rule or limit that controls what you can do

examples.text: There are strict restrictions on parking near the school.
examples.translation_cn: 学校附近有严格的停车限制。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is in charge of a worker or an organization

examples.text: The boss of our department holds a meeting every Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们部门的老板每周一开会。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone what to do in a controlling way

examples.text: My older sister used to boss me around all day.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐过去整天对我发号施令。

senses.meaning_en: a powerful enemy that must be defeated to complete a game level

examples.text: You must defeat the boss at the end of stage three.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须在第三关末尾击败头目。

senses.meaning_en: of excellent quality; first-rate

examples.text: That new skate park downtown is absolutely boss.
examples.translation_cn: 市中心那个新滑板公园棒极了。

senses.meaning_en: a thing or person discovered

examples.text: The rare orchid was an important discovery for the island.
examples.translation_cn: 这种稀有兰花是该岛的一个重要发现。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of discovering something

examples.text: The discovery of the ancient city took years.
examples.translation_cn: 这座古城的发现花了多年时间。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being exposed to something harmful

examples.text: Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

senses.meaning_en: public attention or media coverage

examples.text: The startup gained widespread exposure after the TV interview.
examples.translation_cn: 这家初创公司在电视采访后获得了广泛关注。

senses.meaning_en: the act of revealing something secret or wrong

examples.text: The newspaper's exposure of the scandal forced him to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 报纸对丑闻的揭露迫使他辞职。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of taking a photograph or exposing film to light

examples.text: I took a long exposure of the waterfall at night.
examples.translation_cn: 我在夜间对瀑布进行了长曝光拍摄。

senses.meaning_en: an act of expressing strong disagreement

examples.text: She resigned in protest against the company's new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她辞职以抗议公司的新政策。

senses.meaning_en: to express strong disagreement with something

examples.text: Thousands of students protested against the rise in tuition fees.
examples.translation_cn: 数千名学生抗议学费上涨。

senses.meaning_en: to state firmly that something is true

examples.text: She protested that she had never met the man before.
examples.translation_cn: 她坚称自己以前从未见过那个男人。

senses.meaning_en: to publicly demonstrate against something

examples.text: Hundreds of residents protested the plan to build a new airport.
examples.translation_cn: 数百名居民公开反对修建新机场的计划。

senses.meaning_en: to constitute (a danger, threat, problem, etc.)

examples.text: The new policy poses a serious threat to small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策对小企业构成了严重威胁。

senses.meaning_en: to sit or stand in a particular way, especially to be photographed or painted

examples.text: He was posing for a photo, trying to look like a movie star.
examples.translation_cn: 他摆姿势拍照，想让自己看起来像电影明星。

senses.meaning_en: to ask or set (a question, test, etc.)

examples.text: The student posed a question about the origins of the universe.
examples.translation_cn: 那个学生提出了一个关于宇宙起源的问题。

senses.meaning_en: a particular position of the body

examples.text: The model stood in a relaxed pose for the drawing class.
examples.translation_cn: 模特摆着轻松的姿势让绘画班的学生画。

senses.meaning_en: to behave affectedly in order to attract interest or admiration

examples.text: He's always posing for effect, even when no one is watching.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是在装样子，即使没人在看。

senses.meaning_en: to state something explicitly or in detail

examples.text: The report specifies that the samples were collected in June.
examples.translation_cn: 报告明确说明样本是在六月份采集的。

senses.meaning_en: to include as a requirement in a specification

examples.text: The building code specifies a minimum ceiling height in clause 4.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑规范在第4条中规定了最低天花板高度。

senses.meaning_en: to send goods to another country for sale

examples.text: The company exports coffee to over thirty countries.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司向三十多个国家出口咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: a product that is sold to another country

examples.text: The main exports of Brazil include coffee and soybeans.
examples.translation_cn: 巴西的主要出口商品包括咖啡和大豆。

senses.meaning_en: the act of selling and sending goods to another country

examples.text: The government banned the export of ancient artworks.
examples.translation_cn: 政府禁止出口古代艺术品。

senses.meaning_en: to send data or a file from one program to another or to a different format

examples.text: You can export the report as a PDF file.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将报告导出为 PDF 文件。

senses.meaning_en: a small narrow river

examples.text: We had a picnic by a stream in the woods.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在树林里的小溪边野餐。

senses.meaning_en: a continuous flow or series of things

examples.text: A stream of complaints came in after the new policy was announced.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策公布后，一连串投诉涌了进来。

senses.meaning_en: the flow or current of water

examples.text: He had to struggle to swim against the stream.
examples.translation_cn: 他不得不费力地逆流游泳。

senses.meaning_en: digital data delivered as a continuous flow for playback

examples.text: The event was broadcast on a live stream to viewers worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 这场活动通过在线流媒体向全球观众播出。

senses.meaning_en: a deep container used for cooking food

examples.text: She cooked the soup in a large pot on the stove.
examples.translation_cn: 她在炉灶上的大锅里煮汤。

senses.meaning_en: an open container, especially one used for growing plants

examples.text: She grows basil in a pot by the kitchen window.
examples.translation_cn: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种罗勒。

senses.meaning_en: an allocation of money for a particular purpose

examples.text: The charity set aside a pot of money for emergency repairs.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构留出一笔钱用于紧急维修。

senses.meaning_en: to put a plant into a pot filled with soil

examples.text: He potted up the young tomato plants in larger containers.
examples.translation_cn: 他给幼小的番茄苗换上了更大的花盆。

senses.meaning_en: what somebody or something is known for
senses.pattern: have a reputation for sth/doing sth

examples.text: The school has a reputation for high academic standards.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校以高学术水平而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: worth a lot of money; having great monetary value

examples.text: The antique necklace is extremely valuable because of its rare diamonds.
examples.translation_cn: 这条古董项链因为其稀有钻石而极其贵重。

senses.meaning_en: very useful or important

examples.text: Her experience was valuable to the whole team during the project.
examples.translation_cn: 她的经验在项目期间对整个团队都很宝贵。

senses.meaning_en: a personal possession such as jewellery, of relatively great monetary value; usually plural

examples.text: Keep your money and valuables in the hotel safe.
examples.translation_cn: 把你的钱和贵重物品放在酒店保险箱里。

senses.meaning_en: at regular intervals or according to a fixed schedule; with constant frequency or pattern

examples.text: The committee meets regularly to review its budget.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会定期开会审查预算。

senses.meaning_en: often; frequently; normally; ordinarily

examples.text: I regularly check my phone for messages throughout the day.
examples.translation_cn: 我经常一整天不时查看手机消息。

senses.meaning_en: an action done regularly and often without thinking
senses.pattern: have a habit of doing sth

examples.text: She has a habit of biting her nails when she is nervous.
examples.translation_cn: 她紧张时有咬指甲的习惯。

senses.meaning_en: a strong need to regularly take a drug, alcohol, etc.

examples.text: He checked into a clinic to kick his heroin habit.
examples.translation_cn: 他住进诊所戒除海洛因毒瘾。

senses.meaning_en: a long loose garment worn by monks and nuns

examples.text: The novice wears a plain grey habit every day.
examples.translation_cn: 这位见习修女每天穿着一件朴素的灰色会服。

senses.meaning_en: a story, especially one that is invented or hard to believe

examples.text: He told us a tale about a ghost that haunted the old railway station.
examples.translation_cn: 他给我们讲了一个关于一个鬼魂出没旧火车站的故事。

senses.meaning_en: a report or story that may be untrue, often malicious

examples.text: There are tales of corruption inside the company.
examples.translation_cn: 公司内部有关于腐败的传言。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to race

examples.text: The law bans racial discrimination in housing and employment.
examples.translation_cn: 法律禁止在住房和就业方面的种族歧视。

senses.meaning_en: made of silver

examples.text: She wore a silver ring on her finger.
examples.translation_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指。

senses.meaning_en: dishes, cutlery and other items made of or coated with silver or a similar white metal

examples.text: She carefully polishes the silver every Sunday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每个星期天早上都仔细擦拭银器。

senses.meaning_en: a shiny grayish-white color

examples.text: The new sports car was painted in silver.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆新跑车被漆成了银色。

senses.meaning_en: coins made from silver or a similar white metal

examples.text: They paid the old farmer in silver coins.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用银币付钱给那位老农夫。

senses.meaning_en: to change something into a different form, substance, or state

examples.text: The plant converts sunlight into energy through photosynthesis.
examples.translation_cn: 植物通过光合作用将阳光转化为能量。

senses.meaning_en: to change your religion or beliefs

examples.text: The missionaries converted many locals to Christianity over several decades.
examples.translation_cn: 几十年来，传教士使许多当地人皈依了基督教。

senses.meaning_en: to change something from one system of measurement or currency to another

examples.text: You can easily convert pounds into kilograms using this calculator.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用这个计算器轻松地把磅换算成公斤。

senses.meaning_en: a funny story

examples.text: He told a joke about a parrot that could sing opera.
examples.translation_cn: 他讲了一个关于会唱歌剧的鹦鹉的笑话。

senses.meaning_en: something said or done for amusement, not seriously

examples.text: She joked about her age at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她在聚会上拿自己的年龄开玩笑。

senses.meaning_en: a ridiculous or worthless person or thing

examples.text: The new parking rules are a complete joke.
examples.translation_cn: 新的停车规定完全是个笑话。

senses.meaning_en: something very easy
senses.collocation: find sth to be a joke

examples.text: He found the maths test a joke and finished early.
examples.translation_cn: 他觉得数学考试很容易，早早就做完了。

senses.meaning_en: a group of countries or states controlled by one ruler or government

examples.text: The fall of the empire was caused by years of civil war.
examples.translation_cn: 帝国的衰亡是由多年内战造成的。

senses.meaning_en: a large commercial organization controlled by one person or group

examples.text: She built a fashion empire from a single market stall.
examples.translation_cn: 她从一个市场摊位起家建立了一个时尚帝国。

senses.meaning_en: the study of the nature and meaning of existence, knowledge, etc.

examples.text: She studied the philosophy of science at university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学学习了科学哲学。

senses.meaning_en: a general principle, usually moral

examples.text: His philosophy of life is to be kind and patient.
examples.translation_cn: 他的人生信条是善良和耐心。

senses.meaning_en: a view or system of beliefs about the basic principles in a particular area

examples.text: The philosophy behind the policy is that everyone deserves a second chance.
examples.translation_cn: 这项政策背后的理念是人人都有第二次机会。

senses.meaning_en: following accepted customs or standards; ordinary

examples.text: It is conventional to bring a gift when visiting a friend.
examples.translation_cn: 拜访朋友时带礼物是习俗。

senses.meaning_en: not original; banal or trite

examples.text: Her designs are conventional in style and rarely surprise.
examples.translation_cn: 她的设计风格老套，很少令人惊喜。

senses.meaning_en: not nuclear; used of weapons or warfare

examples.text: Most armies still rely on conventional weapons for border defense.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数军队仍依赖常规武器进行边境防御。

senses.meaning_en: using synthetic fertilizers and pesticides

examples.text: Conventional farming depends heavily on synthetic fertilizers and pesticides.
examples.translation_cn: 常规农业大量依赖合成化肥和农药。

senses.meaning_en: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury

examples.text: She made a surprisingly quick recovery after the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后她恢复得惊人地快。

senses.meaning_en: the process of improving or becoming stronger again, especially in the economy

examples.text: The economy made a slow recovery from the recession.
examples.translation_cn: 经济从衰退中缓慢复苏。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of getting back something lost or stolen

examples.text: The police announced the recovery of the stolen paintings.
examples.translation_cn: 警方宣布找回了被盗的画作。

senses.meaning_en: to give a document, proposal, etc. to someone so that they can consider it

examples.text: Please submit your assignment to the teacher by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请在周五前把作业交给老师。

senses.meaning_en: to yield or give way to authority, control, or greater strength

examples.text: The government refused to submit to public pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 政府拒绝屈服于公众压力。

senses.meaning_en: to subject something to a process or treatment

examples.text: The metal is submitted to intense heat during production.
examples.translation_cn: 这种金属在生产过程中要经受高温。

senses.meaning_en: the number 70

examples.text: Seventy buildings in the area need urgent repairs.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的七十栋建筑需要紧急维修。

senses.meaning_en: a strong desire to do something

examples.text: He felt a sudden urge to apologize immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 他突然感到一股想要道歉的冲动。

senses.meaning_en: to push or drive someone to do something

examples.text: She urged him to hurry or they would miss the train.
examples.translation_cn: 她催促他快点，否则他们会赶不上火车。

senses.meaning_en: to recommend something strongly

examples.text: The committee urged that the plan be revised.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会强烈要求修订该计划。

senses.meaning_en: to sprinkle with fine particles
senses.collocation: dust the cake with icing sugar

examples.text: Dust the workbench with flour before rolling the dough.
examples.translation_cn: 在擀面团前，在工作台上撒些面粉。

senses.meaning_en: fine dry particles of matter

examples.text: The old wooden shelves were covered in dust.
examples.translation_cn: 旧木架子上满是灰尘。

senses.meaning_en: working or done without payment

examples.text: He does voluntary work at a charity shop and receives no pay.
examples.translation_cn: 他在慈善商店做志愿工作，没有报酬。

senses.meaning_en: done or acting of one's own free will

examples.text: She made a voluntary decision to confess her mistake before being questioned.
examples.translation_cn: 她在被询问前主动决定承认错误。

senses.meaning_en: to take air into and send it out of the lungs

examples.text: The doctor asked me to breathe in through my nose and out through my mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 医生让我用鼻子吸气，用嘴巴呼气。

senses.meaning_en: to say something quietly or tell a secret

examples.text: Don't breathe a word to anyone about this.
examples.translation_cn: 这件事对谁都不要说。

senses.meaning_en: to recognize the difference between two or more things or people

examples.text: It is often hard to distinguish between genuine and fake medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 通常很难区分真假药。

senses.meaning_en: to do something so well that you are admired and praised

examples.text: She distinguished herself by leading a challenging rescue operation.
examples.translation_cn: 她因领导了一次艰难的救援行动而声名卓著。

senses.meaning_en: to be able to see or hear something clearly
senses.collocation: distinguish a voice in the crowd

examples.text: At dawn I could distinguish the outline of the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时，我能看清海岸的轮廓。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something noticeably different from others in a way that is admired
senses.pattern: what distinguishes A from B is...

examples.text: What distinguishes this company from its competitors is its exceptional customer service.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司优于竞争对手之处在于其卓越的客户服务。

senses.meaning_en: an outer garment with sleeves, worn on the upper body

examples.text: She wore a leather jacket to the interview yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨天穿了一件皮夹克去面试。

senses.meaning_en: a protective or insulating cover for an object

examples.text: The hot water tank is fitted with a protective jacket to reduce heat loss.
examples.translation_cn: 热水箱装有保护套以减少热量损失。

senses.meaning_en: a removable paper cover of a book, usually with a design

examples.text: The design on the dust jacket of this novel is striking.
examples.translation_cn: 这本小说的防尘护封设计很醒目。

senses.meaning_en: a living being, such as an animal, monster, or alien

examples.text: A creature from the deep sea shocked the scientists.
examples.translation_cn: 来自深海的生物震惊了科学家们。

senses.meaning_en: a person, especially one with a particular quality or in a particular situation

examples.text: My grandfather is a creature of habit and always has tea at four.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父是一个有固定习惯的人，总是四点钟喝茶。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is completely controlled by another; a puppet

examples.text: The minister was merely a creature of the president and never made his own decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 那位部长只是总统的傀儡，从不自己做决定。

senses.meaning_en: a bundle prepared for carrying
senses.pattern: carry a pack on one's back

examples.text: He carried a heavy pack on his back during the hike.
examples.translation_cn: 他徒步时背着一个沉重的背包。

senses.meaning_en: a container holding a standard quantity

examples.text: She bought a pack of cigarettes at the store.
examples.translation_cn: 她在商店买了一包香烟。

senses.meaning_en: a complete set of playing cards

examples.text: He shuffled a pack of cards and dealt them out.
examples.translation_cn: 他洗了一副牌并发出来。

senses.meaning_en: a group of animals or people acting together

examples.text: The dogs were running in a pack through the field.
examples.translation_cn: 狗群跑过田野。

senses.meaning_en: the science or practice of farming

examples.text: She has worked in agriculture for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在农业领域工作了十多年。

senses.meaning_en: to put information into a computer or system

examples.text: You must input your password into the system to log in.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须把密码输入系统才能登录。

senses.meaning_en: information or data that is put into a computer or system; an amount of this

examples.text: The database processes a daily input from thousands of users.
examples.translation_cn: 数据库每天处理来自数千用户的输入。

senses.meaning_en: time, money, effort, etc. that is put into a project or process

examples.text: The project requires a large input of time and money into planning.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目需要在规划上投入大量时间和金钱。

senses.meaning_en: ideas, advice, or opinions that someone contributes

examples.text: We need your input on the new design.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要你对新设计的意见。

senses.meaning_en: many; a large number of

examples.text: Numerous studies have shown that regular exercise improves mental health.
examples.translation_cn: 许多研究表明，经常锻炼能改善心理健康。

senses.meaning_en: a type of solid, liquid, or gas that has particular qualities

examples.text: Salt is a substance that dissolves easily in water.
examples.translation_cn: 盐是一种易溶于水的物质。

senses.meaning_en: the most important or necessary part of something; the quality of being real or true

examples.text: The report lacks substance and fails to answer key questions.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告缺乏实质内容，未能回答关键问题。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal drug

examples.text: The program helps teenagers who struggle with substance abuse.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目帮助那些深受毒品滥用困扰的青少年。

senses.meaning_en: wealth and possessions

examples.text: He was a person of substance in the business world.
examples.translation_cn: 他在商界是个有钱有势的人。

senses.meaning_en: in a short time; soon

examples.text: The train to London will depart shortly from platform two.
examples.translation_cn: 开往伦敦的火车很快就要从二号站台发车。

senses.meaning_en: in few words; briefly

examples.text: She explained the rules shortly and then took questions.
examples.translation_cn: 她简短地解释了规则，然后接受提问。

senses.meaning_en: in an abrupt or irritable manner

examples.text: He replied shortly that he was too busy to talk.
examples.translation_cn: 他不耐烦地回答说，他太忙了，没法说话。

senses.meaning_en: eager or enthusiastic

examples.text: She is keen to learn more about marine biology.
examples.translation_cn: 她渴望了解更多海洋生物学知识。

senses.meaning_en: intense or strong

examples.text: There is keen competition for places at top universities.
examples.translation_cn: 顶尖大学的入学名额竞争激烈。

senses.meaning_en: quick to notice or understand

examples.text: She has a keen eye for detail in historical research.
examples.translation_cn: 她在历史研究中对细节有敏锐的眼光。

senses.meaning_en: sharp

examples.text: The hunter sharpened the knife to a keen edge.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人把刀磨得很锋利。

senses.meaning_en: the act of arriving at a place

examples.text: All visitors must report to the front desk on arrival.
examples.translation_cn: 所有访客必须在抵达时到前台报到。

senses.meaning_en: the attainment of an objective, especially as a result of effort

examples.text: She saw the publication as the arrival of her lifelong ambition.
examples.translation_cn: 她把这本书的出版看作自己毕生抱负的实现。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that has arrived

examples.text: Each new arrival was given a free city map.
examples.translation_cn: 每位新到者都得到了一张免费城市地图。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or arrival of something in time

examples.text: With the arrival of spring, the days grow longer.
examples.translation_cn: 随着春天的到来，白天变长了。

senses.meaning_en: to touch someone or something gently with the flat hand
senses.collocation: pat a dog on the head

examples.text: She patted the child on the head and told him everything was fine.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻拍孩子的头，告诉他一切都会好的。

senses.meaning_en: a gentle touch or slap with the flat hand
senses.pattern: give sb a pat on the back

examples.text: He gave his friend a pat on the back to show support.
examples.translation_cn: 他拍拍朋友的背以示支持。

senses.meaning_en: a small flat piece of something soft

examples.text: Melt a pat of butter in the pan before adding the eggs.
examples.translation_cn: 在锅里融化一小块黄油，然后再放入鸡蛋。

senses.meaning_en: strong emotion, especially romantic love or hate

examples.text: She spoke with passion about the need for change.
examples.translation_cn: 她满怀激情地谈到变革的必要性。

senses.meaning_en: a strong liking or enthusiasm for something

examples.text: He has a passion for classical music and plays the piano daily.
examples.translation_cn: 他酷爱古典音乐，每天弹钢琴。

senses.meaning_en: strong sexual desire or emotional sexual love

examples.text: Their relationship was driven by sexual passion, not love.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的关系由性激情而非爱情驱动。

senses.meaning_en: a strong sustained desire
senses.pattern: be driven by a passion to do

examples.text: She was driven by a passion to succeed in medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 她被一股要在医学上取得成功的强烈欲望驱使。

senses.meaning_en: a person who offers to do something without being paid

examples.text: She works as a volunteer at the community center on Saturdays.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周六在社区中心做志愿者。

senses.meaning_en: to offer to do something without being asked

examples.text: He volunteered to drive us to the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 他主动提出开车送我们去机场。

senses.meaning_en: a person who joins the armed forces by choice

examples.text: He served as a volunteer in the army during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间，他在军中担任志愿兵。

senses.meaning_en: to enlist oneself as a volunteer, especially for military service

examples.text: He volunteered for the army when the war broke out.
examples.translation_cn: 战争爆发时，他自愿参军。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid condiment or accompaniment to food, such as tomato sauce

examples.text: The chicken is cooked in a creamy garlic sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 鸡肉是用奶油蒜香酱烹制的。

senses.meaning_en: a disease or period of sickness affecting the body or mind

examples.text: He suffers from a chronic illness that affects his breathing.
examples.translation_cn: 他患有一种影响呼吸的慢性病。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being ill

examples.text: He is recovering from illness at home this week.
examples.translation_cn: 他本周正在家养病康复。

senses.meaning_en: a person who performs religious ceremonies, especially in a Christian church

examples.text: He served as a priest in a small village for many years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一个小村庄担任牧师多年。

senses.meaning_en: extreme or very strong in degree

examples.text: The pain in her shoulder was intense after the fall.
examples.translation_cn: 摔伤后她肩膀的疼痛很剧烈。

senses.meaning_en: involving a lot of effort, energy, or attention; tense or strained

examples.text: There was intense competition for the few available jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 这几个职位竞争非常激烈。

senses.meaning_en: very focused, earnest, or passionate; having strong feelings or opinions

examples.text: She is intense about her research and often works late.
examples.translation_cn: 她对研究非常专注，经常工作到很晚。

senses.meaning_en: using or producing electricity

examples.text: The company has decided to go electric with its entire delivery fleet.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司已决定让整个送货车队改用电动。

senses.meaning_en: related to an electric musical instrument

examples.text: She plays electric guitar and sings in a jazz band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一支爵士乐队里弹电吉他并唱歌。

senses.meaning_en: emotionally thrilling; electrifying

examples.text: The atmosphere in the stadium was electric before the final whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 终场哨响前，体育场内的气氛令人兴奋。

senses.meaning_en: the electricity supply

examples.text: Heavy snow cut off the electrics in several mountain villages.
examples.translation_cn: 大雪切断了几个山村的电力供应。

senses.meaning_en: electrical power or energy, especially as supplied to homes and businesses

examples.text: The island generates all its electricity from solar panels.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛完全靠太阳能电池板发电。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of excitement or tension

examples.text: There was electricity in the air as the band took the stage.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队登台时，现场气氛兴奋而紧张。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone the desire, confidence, or enthusiasm to do something well

examples.text: Her speech inspired the team to keep trying.
examples.translation_cn: 她的演讲激励了团队继续努力。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone an idea or a strong feeling of enthusiasm, especially for something creative

examples.text: The city's architecture was inspired by ancient Rome.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市的建筑受到古罗马的启发。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone have a particular feeling or emotion

examples.text: His honesty inspired deep trust in his colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 他的诚实使同事们产生了深深的信任。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe in

examples.text: The doctor told her to inspire through the nose and exhale through the mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 医生让她用鼻子吸气，用嘴呼气。

senses.meaning_en: to change something slightly to make it more suitable or better

examples.text: He adjusted the volume to a comfortable level.
examples.translation_cn: 他把音量调到舒适的水平。

senses.meaning_en: to get used to a new situation or conditions

examples.text: It took him several months to adjust to life in a foreign country.
examples.translation_cn: 他花了几个月才适应国外的生活。

senses.meaning_en: to set a device or instrument to a correct position or value
senses.pattern: adjust sth to the correct setting

examples.text: He adjusted the instrument to the correct setting before the test.
examples.translation_cn: 他在测试前把仪器校准到正确的设置。

senses.meaning_en: to stop working permanently, usually because of old age or illness

examples.text: She retired at 60 after a long career in teaching.
examples.translation_cn: 她执教多年后在60岁时退休。

senses.meaning_en: to stop taking part in a sport or competition; to leave a place, especially to go somewhere quieter

examples.text: He retired from professional football at the age of 30.
examples.translation_cn: 他30岁时退出职业足坛。

senses.meaning_en: to go to bed (formal)

examples.text: After the long meeting, she retired to bed before midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的会议结束后，她午夜前就寝了。

senses.meaning_en: to stop using or producing something

examples.text: The company will retire its old equipment next month.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司下个月将淘汰旧设备。

senses.meaning_en: to touch somebody with your lips to show love or affection

examples.text: He kissed her gently on the cheek before leaving for work.
examples.translation_cn: 他上班前在她脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

senses.meaning_en: a touch with the lips as a sign of love or greeting

examples.text: She gave her daughter a goodnight kiss on the forehead.
examples.translation_cn: 她在女儿额头上吻了一下道晚安。

senses.meaning_en: lasting for only a limited time; not permanent

examples.text: The road closure near the station is only temporary.
examples.translation_cn: 车站附近的封路只是暂时的。

senses.meaning_en: a person employed for a limited time, especially in an office

examples.text: She worked as a temporary in a bank last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年夏天在一家银行做临时雇员。

senses.meaning_en: able to be seen

examples.text: The island is clearly visible from the hotel balcony.
examples.translation_cn: 从酒店阳台可以清楚地看到那座岛。

senses.meaning_en: obvious or noticeable

examples.text: Her disappointment was visible in her forced smile and quiet tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她的失望从勉强的微笑和低沉的语气中明显可见。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of doing something well with no waste of time or money

examples.text: The new system greatly improved the efficiency of the production line.
examples.translation_cn: 新系统大大提高了生产线的效率。

senses.meaning_en: involving competition

examples.text: The job market is highly competitive right now.
examples.translation_cn: 目前就业市场竞争非常激烈。

senses.meaning_en: inclined to compete

examples.text: He is competitive by nature and hates losing.
examples.translation_cn: 他天生好竞争，讨厌失败。

senses.meaning_en: able to compete successfully

examples.text: Our products are competitive in the global market.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的产品在全球市场上有竞争力。

senses.meaning_en: cheap, especially used of quality products

examples.text: The store offers high-quality products at competitive prices.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店以有竞争力的价格出售优质产品。

senses.meaning_en: saying exactly what you think even if it seems direct

examples.text: She was frank with me about her concerns.
examples.translation_cn: 她坦率地向我说明了她的担忧。

senses.meaning_en: a play for the theatre, television, or radio

examples.text: We watched a TV drama about a detective in modern Tokyo.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看了一部关于现代东京一名侦探的电视剧。

senses.meaning_en: exaggerated or overly emotional behaviour, especially about unimportant things

examples.text: My sister makes a drama out of losing her keys every week.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐每周丢钥匙都要小题大做一番。

senses.meaning_en: theatrical plays in general as an art form

examples.text: He studied drama at college before joining a touring theatre company.
examples.translation_cn: 他在学院学习戏剧，之后加入了一家巡回剧团。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in real life that has the characteristics of such a theatrical play
senses.pattern: be caught up in a drama

examples.text: Tourists were caught up in a real-life drama when the ferry started sinking.
examples.translation_cn: 渡船开始下沉时，游客们陷入了一场真实发生的戏剧性事件。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet baked food made from flour, sugar, eggs, and often icing

examples.text: We baked a cake for the school fair last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末为学校义卖烤了一个蛋糕。

senses.meaning_en: a flat round piece of food made by cooking a mixture of ingredients

examples.text: They serve fish cakes with a spicy dip at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在聚会上端上带辣酱的鱼饼。

senses.meaning_en: a small block of a dense substance

examples.text: She bought a cake of soap and a towel.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一块肥皂和一条毛巾。

senses.meaning_en: riches; valuable assets

examples.text: She accumulated wealth by investing in property and stocks.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过投资房地产和股票积累财富。

senses.meaning_en: a great amount; abundance

examples.text: The book offers a wealth of information on local history.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书提供了大量关于当地历史的信息。

senses.meaning_en: the pointed top of a mountain, or the whole mountain

examples.text: We finally reached the peak of the mountain after a six-hour climb.
examples.translation_cn: 经过六个小时的攀登，我们终于到达了山顶。

senses.meaning_en: the highest level or value reached by something over a period

examples.text: At the peak of the storm, wind speeds reached over 150 kilometres per hour.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨最猛烈时，风速超过了每小时150公里。

senses.meaning_en: the horizontal part of a cap that sticks out in front and shades the eyes

examples.text: He always wears a cap with a curved peak to shade his eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是戴着一顶带弧形帽檐的帽子来遮挡阳光。

senses.meaning_en: having a pallor, especially because of illness, shock, or fear

examples.text: She turned pale when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到这个消息时脸色变得苍白。

senses.meaning_en: light in color

examples.text: She wore a pale blue dress to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一条浅蓝色的裙子去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: to become pale; to lose colour

examples.text: He paled at the thought of speaking in public.
examples.translation_cn: 一想到要当众讲话，他脸色就变白了。

senses.meaning_en: feeble; faint

examples.text: The sequel is a pale imitation of the original film.
examples.translation_cn: 这部续集是对原版电影的拙劣模仿。

senses.meaning_en: to examine something in detail by breaking it into its parts

examples.text: We analyzed the data to identify hidden patterns.
examples.translation_cn: 我们分析了数据，以找出隐藏的模式。

senses.meaning_en: a room or building used for scientific research, experiments, or the preparation of chemicals, drugs, etc.

examples.text: Scientists are testing the new drug in the laboratory.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们正在实验室里测试这种新药。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden event causing great damage, loss, or suffering

examples.text: The flood was a disaster that destroyed thousands of homes.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水是一场摧毁了数千座房屋的灾难。

senses.meaning_en: a complete failure or very bad situation

examples.text: The camping trip was a disaster from beginning to end.
examples.translation_cn: 这次露营从头到尾都很糟糕。

senses.meaning_en: to have to pay back money or goods to someone

examples.text: I still owe the bank $500 from last year.
examples.translation_cn: 我还欠银行五百美元。

senses.meaning_en: to have something as a result of someone or something

examples.text: She owes her success to hard work and good luck.
examples.translation_cn: 她将自己的成功归功于努力和好运。

senses.meaning_en: to be under an obligation to give or do something for someone
senses.pattern: owe it to sb to do sth

examples.text: I owe it to her to tell the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 我有义务向她讲真话。

senses.meaning_en: a person's emotional state at a particular time

examples.text: She was in a good mood after her morning run.
examples.translation_cn: 她早上跑步后心情很好。

senses.meaning_en: a bad or angry mood

examples.text: He was in a bad mood after hearing the news.
examples.translation_cn: 他听到那个消息后心情很坏。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling or atmosphere of a place, event, etc.

examples.text: The soft lighting helped set the mood for the romantic dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 柔和的灯光为浪漫晚餐营造了气氛。

senses.meaning_en: a disposition to do something
senses.collocation: be in no mood to do

examples.text: I'm not in the mood for a long walk tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我今晚没有心情走很长的路。

senses.meaning_en: happening slowly over a long period; not sudden

examples.text: There has been a gradual increase in online learning.
examples.translation_cn: 在线学习逐渐增多。

senses.meaning_en: not steep (of a slope)

examples.text: The path follows a gradual slope down to the river.
examples.translation_cn: 小路沿着平缓的坡一直通向河边。

senses.meaning_en: in a gradual manner; slowly

examples.text: The economy is gradually recovering after the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机过后，经济正在逐渐复苏。

senses.meaning_en: a body of water partly enclosed by land

examples.text: The ship anchored in a sheltered bay to avoid the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 船停泊在一个避风的海湾里以躲避风暴。

senses.meaning_en: an area designed for a particular purpose, often surrounded by walls or lines

examples.text: The truck waited in a loading bay with its engine running.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车在装卸区等候，发动机还在运转。

senses.meaning_en: a leaf from a bay tree, used as a herb in cooking

examples.text: Add a bay leaf to the soup while it simmers.
examples.translation_cn: 炖汤时加一片月桂叶。

senses.meaning_en: to improve something by adding features or making it better

examples.text: The new features greatly enhance the app's usability.
examples.translation_cn: 新功能大大提升了应用的易用性。

senses.meaning_en: something that you cannot understand or explain

examples.text: The cause of the disease is a mystery to doctors.
examples.translation_cn: 这种疾病的病因对医生来说是个谜。

senses.meaning_en: someone or something that is difficult to understand or know much about

examples.text: The old man is a bit of a mystery to the whole village.
examples.translation_cn: 这位老人对全村人来说有点神秘。

senses.meaning_en: a story, film, or play in which a crime is investigated and the truth is revealed at the end

examples.text: She often stays up late reading a murder mystery.
examples.translation_cn: 她经常熬夜读谋杀悬疑小说。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being poor; lack of money

examples.text: Millions of families still live in poverty in this region.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区仍有数百万家庭生活在贫困中。

senses.meaning_en: a lack of something needed or desired

examples.text: His early writings show a poverty of imagination.
examples.translation_cn: 他早期的作品显示出想象力的贫乏。

senses.meaning_en: an item that belongs to someone

examples.text: That old watch is one of my most valued possessions.
examples.translation_cn: 那块旧表是我最珍视的财物之一。

senses.meaning_en: the state of having or controlling something

examples.text: The family has been in possession of the estate for over a century.
examples.translation_cn: 这个家族拥有这座庄园已有一个多世纪了。

senses.meaning_en: control of the ball in a game

examples.text: Johnson had possession of the ball near the halfway line.
examples.translation_cn: 约翰逊在中线附近控球。

senses.meaning_en: a territory ruled by another country

examples.text: The islands were once a possession of Spain in the Pacific.
examples.translation_cn: 这些岛屿曾是西班牙在太平洋的属地。

senses.meaning_en: to judge or assess the value, quality, or importance of sth

examples.text: We need to evaluate how the new tax will affect small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要评估新税将如何影响小企业。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate the value of an expression

examples.text: The teacher asked us to evaluate the expression when x equals 2.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们求当x等于2时这个表达式的值。

senses.meaning_en: a character or glyph representing an idea, concept, or object

examples.text: In chemistry, O is the symbol for oxygen.
examples.translation_cn: 在化学中，O 是氧的符号。

senses.meaning_en: a person, object, event, etc. that represents a more general quality or situation

examples.text: The olive branch has been a symbol of peace since ancient times.
examples.translation_cn: 橄榄枝自古以来就是和平的象征。

senses.meaning_en: an official document that states a fact is true

examples.text: She received a certificate for completing the first-aid course.
examples.translation_cn: 她因完成急救课程而获得了一张证书。

senses.meaning_en: a document proving ownership of a debt or property

examples.text: The bank issued him a certificate of deposit for $5,000.
examples.translation_cn: 银行给他签发了一张5000美元的存单。

senses.meaning_en: a mark showing the age group allowed to see a film

examples.text: The film was given a 15 certificate because of strong language.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因包含脏话而被定为15级。

senses.meaning_en: to finish successfully; to achieve

examples.text: The team managed to accomplish a difficult task on time.
examples.translation_cn: 这个团队按时完成了一项艰巨的任务。

senses.meaning_en: a way of looking at or thinking about something
senses.pattern: look at sth from a different angle

examples.text: Try to look at the problem from a different angle.
examples.translation_cn: 试着从不同的角度看这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: a particular way of presenting or considering a news story
senses.pattern: find an angle on a story

examples.text: The reporter found a fresh angle on the election story.
examples.translation_cn: 这位记者找到了报道选举故事的新角度。

senses.meaning_en: a corner where two walls or surfaces meet
senses.pattern: in the angle where two walls meet

examples.text: A spider built its web in the angle where the ceiling meets the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 一只蜘蛛在天花板与墙壁的夹角处结网。

senses.meaning_en: a sloping position or direction

examples.text: The old picture hung at a slight angle on the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 那幅旧画在墙上挂得有点歪。

senses.meaning_en: a screen that shows computer output

examples.text: The document looked much clearer on the monitor than on my phone.
examples.translation_cn: 这份文件在显示器上比在我手机上清晰得多。

senses.meaning_en: a screen used to watch a place or person for security

examples.text: The guard watched the entrance on the security monitor all night.
examples.translation_cn: 保安整夜在安全监视器上观察入口。

senses.meaning_en: a person who watches over others or is in charge of a group

examples.text: The teacher asked her to act as class monitor for the week.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让她担任一周的班长。

senses.meaning_en: a device that detects and records or measures something

examples.text: The patient was connected to a heart monitor throughout the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 手术期间病人一直连接着心脏监测仪。

senses.meaning_en: to amuse someone and hold their attention

examples.text: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
examples.translation_cn: 小丑用滑稽的戏法逗孩子们开心。

senses.meaning_en: to invite people to your home and give them food and drink

examples.text: We entertained our guests to dinner last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末设晚宴招待了客人。

senses.meaning_en: to consider or allow yourself to think about an idea, hope, feeling, etc.
senses.pattern: entertain the idea of doing sth

examples.text: She refused to entertain the idea of moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她拒绝考虑移居国外的想法。

senses.meaning_en: activities or performances that entertain people

examples.text: Many people watch television purely for entertainment, not for information.
examples.translation_cn: 很多人看电视纯粹是为了娱乐，而不是为了获取信息。

senses.meaning_en: the act of entertaining guests

examples.text: The company has a separate budget for the entertainment of clients.
examples.translation_cn: 公司有单独的预算用于招待客户。

senses.meaning_en: a leguminous plant or its edible seed

examples.text: Soak the dried beans overnight in cold water.
examples.translation_cn: 把干豆子放在冷水里浸泡一夜。

senses.meaning_en: the edible seedpod of a bean plant

examples.text: Steam the green beans for five minutes until tender.
examples.translation_cn: 把青豆蒸五分钟，直到变软。

senses.meaning_en: an officer who commands a military unit

examples.text: He was appointed commander of the northern fleet last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年被任命为北方舰队司令。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is in charge of a group or activity

examples.text: She acted as commander of the rescue team during the emergency.
examples.translation_cn: 她在紧急情况中担任救援队的负责人。

senses.meaning_en: relying on someone or something for support

examples.text: Many elderly people are dependent on their children for daily care.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老年人依靠子女提供日常照料。
