senses.meaning_en: a person who relies on another for financial support

examples.text: You can claim your daughter as a dependent if she is under 19.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你女儿未满19岁，你可以把她申报为受抚养人。

senses.meaning_en: influenced or decided by something

examples.text: The outcome is dependent on a number of factors.
examples.translation_cn: 结果取决于多种因素。

senses.meaning_en: using discrete values to represent information

examples.text: The image is stored in digital form, so it can be easily copied.
examples.translation_cn: 图像以数字形式存储，因此可以轻松复制。

senses.meaning_en: relating to computers or the Information Age

examples.text: Companies must adapt quickly in the digital age to stay competitive.
examples.translation_cn: 公司必须快速适应数字时代以保持竞争力。

senses.meaning_en: the process of becoming larger or more extensive

examples.text: The rapid expansion of the city has put pressure on public transport.
examples.translation_cn: 城市的快速扩张给公共交通带来了压力。

senses.meaning_en: the process of increasing in size or volume, especially due to heat

examples.text: The expansion of the metal when heated made the lid stick.
examples.translation_cn: 金属受热膨胀使盖子卡住了。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the scientific study of the mind and behavior

examples.text: The course takes a psychological approach to language learning.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程采用心理学方法研究语言学习。

senses.meaning_en: caused by or connected with mental or emotional factors rather than physical ones

examples.text: The doctor says her chronic headaches may be psychological.
examples.translation_cn: 医生说她的慢性头痛可能是心理原因。

senses.meaning_en: growing from the root of a plant

examples.text: This plant has radical leaves at the base of the stem.
examples.translation_cn: 这种植物在茎的基部有根生叶。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the root form of a word
senses.pattern: the radical form of a word

examples.text: The radical form of the word 'writing' is 'write'.
examples.translation_cn: 单词 'writing' 的词根形式是 'write'。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the most basic or important parts

examples.text: The new policy represents a radical change in how the company operates.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策代表了公司运作方式的根本改变。

senses.meaning_en: favoring fundamental or extreme change

examples.text: He is radical in his views and wants sweeping social reforms.
examples.translation_cn: 他在观点上很激进，想要进行彻底的社会改革。

senses.meaning_en: a strong feeling of displeasure and hostility

examples.text: He slammed the door in anger after the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵后，他愤怒地摔门。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone angry

examples.text: The unfair decision angered many residents in the small town.
examples.translation_cn: 这项不公平的决定激怒了小镇上的许多居民。

senses.meaning_en: close to the actual number or amount; not exact

examples.text: The approximate cost of the repairs is $500.
examples.translation_cn: 维修费用大约是500美元。

senses.meaning_en: to come near to something in quality or amount

examples.text: His account of the event approximates to the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 他对事件的描述接近事实。

senses.meaning_en: to estimate a number or amount

examples.text: The appraiser approximated the value of the painting at $50,000.
examples.translation_cn: 鉴定师估计这幅画的价值约为5万美元。

senses.meaning_en: Imprecise but close to in quantity or amount

examples.text: The construction of the new bridge will take approximately two years.
examples.translation_cn: 新桥的建设大约需要两年。

senses.meaning_en: a relationship between two numbers or amounts showing how many times one value contains or is contained within the other
senses.pattern: the ratio of A to B

examples.text: The ratio of boys to girls in the class is three to two.
examples.translation_cn: 班里男孩和女孩的比例是三比二。

senses.meaning_en: a self-propelled weapon that travels through the air and explodes when it hits its target

examples.text: The army fired a missile at the enemy radar station.
examples.translation_cn: 军队向敌方雷达站发射了一枚导弹。

senses.meaning_en: an object thrown or fired as a weapon

examples.text: The protesters threw missiles at the police during the demonstration.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议者在示威期间向警察投掷投射物。

senses.meaning_en: a state of mess or lack of order

examples.text: The files on his desk were in disorder.
examples.translation_cn: 他桌上的文件杂乱无章。

senses.meaning_en: a medical condition affecting the body or mind

examples.text: He suffers from a sleep disorder and often wakes up tired.
examples.translation_cn: 他患有睡眠障碍，醒来时常感到疲倦。

senses.meaning_en: violent or disruptive public behaviour

examples.text: Public disorder broke out after the controversial court ruling.
examples.translation_cn: 争议性法院裁决后爆发了公众骚乱。

senses.meaning_en: untrue; not factual

examples.text: The rumors about the merger proved completely false.
examples.translation_cn: 关于合并的谣言被证明是完全不实的。

senses.meaning_en: not faithful or loyal; insincere

examples.text: She accused him of being false to his promises.
examples.translation_cn: 她指责他不忠于自己的承诺。

senses.meaning_en: not genuine; artificial

examples.text: He was arrested for traveling under a false name.
examples.translation_cn: 他因使用假名旅行被捕。

senses.meaning_en: metal thread or a conductor that carries electricity

examples.text: He cut a length of wire with pliers.
examples.translation_cn: 他用钳子剪下一段金属丝。

senses.meaning_en: to send money electronically

examples.text: The company wired the money to us yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 公司昨天把钱电汇给了我们。

senses.meaning_en: a fence made of usually barbed wire

examples.text: The garden is surrounded by a wire fence.
examples.translation_cn: 花园被铁丝网围着。

senses.meaning_en: responsive to stimuli

examples.text: Some people are highly sensitive to strong sunlight.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人对强光非常敏感。

senses.meaning_en: aware of and careful about others' feelings

examples.text: A good nurse is sensitive to her patients' feelings.
examples.translation_cn: 好护士能体察病人的情绪。

senses.meaning_en: easily offended, upset, or hurt

examples.text: He is sensitive about any criticism of his work.
examples.translation_cn: 他对工作上的任何批评都很敏感。

senses.meaning_en: the act of transporting people or goods from one place to another

examples.text: The transportation of fresh produce requires refrigerated trucks.
examples.translation_cn: 新鲜农产品的运输需要冷藏卡车。

senses.meaning_en: a means or system of carrying people or goods from one place to another

examples.text: Bicycles are an affordable form of transportation in many cities.
examples.translation_cn: 自行车在许多城市是一种负担得起的交通方式。

senses.meaning_en: dedicated to a religious purpose or a god; revered in a religion

examples.text: This mountain is holy to the local villagers.
examples.translation_cn: 这座山对当地村民来说是神圣的。

senses.meaning_en: morally perfect or flawless, or nearly so

examples.text: The old monk lives a quiet and holy life.
examples.translation_cn: 这位老僧过着宁静而圣洁的生活。

senses.meaning_en: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother

examples.text: She is a twin, but her brother looks nothing like her.
examples.translation_cn: 她是双胞胎之一，但她的兄弟和她长得一点也不像。

senses.meaning_en: a bed for one person, especially one of a pair

examples.text: The hotel room has two twin beds and a small desk.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店房间有两张单人床和一张小书桌。

senses.meaning_en: a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction

examples.text: He has a tendency to talk too much when he is nervous.
examples.translation_cn: 他紧张时往往话太多。

senses.meaning_en: an organised unit or faction within a larger political organisation

examples.text: He was expelled for leading a rival tendency within the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他因在党内领导一个对立派别而被开除。

senses.meaning_en: an enclosed space in a body, machine, etc.

examples.text: The left chamber of the heart pumps blood around the body.
examples.translation_cn: 心脏的左心室将血液输送到全身。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a gun that holds a cartridge before firing

examples.text: He checked that a bullet was in the chamber.
examples.translation_cn: 他检查了枪膛里确有一颗子弹。

senses.meaning_en: a room, especially a private room or bedroom

examples.text: She spent the evening reading in her chamber.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个晚上都在自己的房间里读书。

senses.meaning_en: a legislative or deliberative assembly or its meeting hall

examples.text: The debate in the chamber lasted all night.
examples.translation_cn: 议院里的辩论持续了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: to show great respect for someone or something

examples.text: The whole city honoured the firefighters for their bravery.
examples.translation_cn: 全城的人都因消防员的勇敢而向他们致敬。

senses.meaning_en: to do what you promised or agreed to do

examples.text: The government must honour its promise to lower taxes.
examples.translation_cn: 政府必须履行减税的承诺。

senses.meaning_en: a source of pride; something that makes you feel proud
senses.pattern: it is an honour to do sth

examples.text: It is a great honour to receive this award.
examples.translation_cn: 获得这个奖项是极大的荣幸。

senses.meaning_en: great respect and admiration

examples.text: A dinner was held in honour of the retiring professor.
examples.translation_cn: 为向即将退休的教授表示敬意，举行了一场晚宴。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles

examples.text: He was known as a man of honour and integrity.
examples.translation_cn: 他以正直和诚实而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: money placed in a bank account

examples.text: She made a deposit of £500 into her savings account this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她今天早上往储蓄账户里存了500英镑。

senses.meaning_en: a sum paid as security or as a first instalment

examples.text: We had to pay a deposit of one month's rent before moving into the apartment.
examples.translation_cn: 我们入住前必须支付一个月租金的押金。

senses.meaning_en: solid matter left behind by water, wind or other natural processes

examples.text: The river left a thick deposit of mud on the banks after the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水过后，河岸上留下了一层厚厚的淤泥沉积物。

senses.meaning_en: good fortune; something good that happens by chance

examples.text: You're in luck — the store still has one copy left.
examples.translation_cn: 你真走运——店里还剩一本。

senses.meaning_en: the force that causes good or bad things to happen by chance

examples.text: Winning the lottery is a matter of luck, not skill.
examples.translation_cn: 中彩票靠的是运气，不是技巧。

senses.meaning_en: success or good results

examples.text: I had no luck persuading him to change his mind.
examples.translation_cn: 我没能说服他改变主意。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money paid regularly for the use of property, equipment, etc.

examples.text: We pay the rent at the beginning of every month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每个月初支付租金。

senses.meaning_en: to pay money regularly to use something such as a house, room, car, etc.

examples.text: We rented a small flat from the owner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们从房东那里租了一套小公寓。

senses.meaning_en: to allow someone to use something in return for regular payment

examples.text: They rent out bicycles to tourists all summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整个夏天向游客出租自行车。

senses.meaning_en: free of dirt, pollution, or other harmful substances

examples.text: The water from this spring is pure enough to drink.
examples.translation_cn: 这泉水足够纯净，可以饮用。

senses.meaning_en: free of flaws or imperfections; unsullied

examples.text: The bride's dress was pure white and without a single flaw.
examples.translation_cn: 新娘的礼服洁白无瑕，毫无瑕疵。

senses.meaning_en: free of immoral behavior or qualities; morally clean

examples.text: She is pure in heart and always treats others kindly.
examples.translation_cn: 她心地纯洁，总是善待他人。

senses.meaning_en: complete and total; used for emphasis

examples.text: The reason for the delay was pure and simple laziness.
examples.translation_cn: 耽搁的原因纯粹就是懒惰。

senses.meaning_en: good enough to be accepted; passable

examples.text: Most clients find the quality of the work perfectly acceptable.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数客户认为工作质量完全可接受。

senses.meaning_en: allowed; tolerable
senses.pattern: it is acceptable to do sth

examples.text: It is not acceptable to use your phone during the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 考试期间使用手机是不允许的。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular area or activity

examples.text: She is a veteran of environmental campaigns and has advised many governments.
examples.translation_cn: 她是环保运动的老手，为许多政府提供过建议。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has served in the armed forces, especially during a war

examples.text: My uncle is a veteran of the Second World War and still attends reunions.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔是二战老兵，现在还参加战友聚会。

senses.meaning_en: having a lot of experience in a particular area or activity

examples.text: The veteran journalist has interviewed four US presidents.
examples.translation_cn: 这位经验丰富的记者采访过四位美国总统。

senses.meaning_en: relating to former members of the armed forces

examples.text: The charity provides support for veteran organizations nationwide.
examples.translation_cn: 这家慈善机构为全国各地的退伍军人组织提供支持。

senses.meaning_en: an observable fact or event

examples.text: The phenomenon of climate change affects every country on Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 气候变化现象影响着地球上每一个国家。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is very impressive or successful

examples.text: With three best-selling albums at twenty, she is a phenomenon in pop music.
examples.translation_cn: 二十岁就拥有三张畅销专辑，她是流行乐坛的非凡人物。

senses.meaning_en: a bundle of fibres that carries signals between the body and the brain

examples.text: The surgeon avoided cutting a nerve in the patient's neck.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生避免切断病人颈部的神经。

senses.meaning_en: courage or boldness

examples.text: It takes nerve to admit your own mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 承认自己的错误需要勇气。

senses.meaning_en: impudence or audacity

examples.text: You have a nerve borrowing my car without asking.
examples.translation_cn: 你不经允许就借我的车，真是厚脸皮。

senses.meaning_en: mental agitation caused by fear, stress or other negative emotions

examples.text: She was a bundle of nerves before her driving test.
examples.translation_cn: 她在驾照考试前紧张极了。

senses.meaning_en: feeling worried or anxious

examples.text: She was nervous about giving a speech in front of the class.
examples.translation_cn: 她因要在全班面前演讲而感到紧张。

senses.meaning_en: of the nervous system

examples.text: The nervous system sends signals between the brain and the body.
examples.translation_cn: 神经系统在大脑和身体之间传递信号。

senses.meaning_en: an organized series of events such as musical or theatrical performances, often held regularly

examples.text: The city holds a music festival every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市每年夏天举办音乐节。

senses.meaning_en: a day or period of celebration, often for religious or traditional reasons

examples.text: Christmas is a major religious festival for Christians.
examples.translation_cn: 圣诞节是基督徒的一个重要宗教节日。

senses.meaning_en: to throw something lightly or carelessly

examples.text: He tossed the keys to me and walked away.
examples.translation_cn: 他把钥匙扔给我，然后走开了。

senses.meaning_en: the action of tossing a coin to decide something

examples.text: Our captain won the toss and chose to kick off.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的队长掷硬币赢了，选择开球。

senses.meaning_en: a throw or lob, especially a light or careless one

examples.text: With a gentle toss, she sent the ball into the basket.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻轻一投，把球送进了篮筐。

senses.meaning_en: to mix food lightly

examples.text: Toss the pasta with the sauce just before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前把意面和酱汁拌匀。

senses.meaning_en: enough in quantity or quality for a particular purpose or need

examples.text: The facilities are adequate for the camp's basic needs.
examples.translation_cn: 这些设施足以满足营地的基本需求。

senses.meaning_en: good enough or suitable for a particular purpose or person
senses.collocation: more than adequate to the task

examples.text: She is more than adequate to the challenge of leading the campaign.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全有能力胜任领导这场运动的挑战。

senses.meaning_en: to place a dead body or object in the ground and cover it

examples.text: The family buried him in the local cemetery.
examples.translation_cn: 家人将他安葬在当地的公墓。

senses.meaning_en: to end a disagreement or forget something unpleasant

examples.text: After years of conflict, the two families buried the hatchet.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年冲突，两家人终于言归于好。

senses.meaning_en: to hide your feelings or memories deep inside

examples.text: He buried his feelings deep inside and smiled.
examples.translation_cn: 他把感情深埋心底，笑了笑。

senses.meaning_en: to score a goal
senses.collocation: bury the ball in the net

examples.text: He buried a low shot into the bottom corner.
examples.translation_cn: 他一记低射将球打入球门底角。

senses.meaning_en: a round red fruit eaten as a vegetable, or the plant that produces it

examples.text: They grow tomatoes in their garden every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每年夏天在花园里种西红柿。

senses.meaning_en: a bright red colour like a ripe tomato

examples.text: She painted the door in tomato red for the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她为了聚会把门漆成番茄红。

senses.meaning_en: a soft yellow food made from milk, used in cooking and spreading

examples.text: Melt a knob of butter in a large frying pan.
examples.translation_cn: 在大煎锅里融化一块黄油。

senses.meaning_en: to spread butter on something

examples.text: Please butter the toast while I set the table.
examples.translation_cn: 我摆桌子的时候，请给吐司涂上黄油。

senses.meaning_en: a room containing a bath or shower, often with a toilet

examples.text: The mirror in the bathroom was fogged up after her shower.
examples.translation_cn: 她洗完澡后，浴室里的镜子起雾了。

senses.meaning_en: a room containing a toilet, especially in a public place

examples.text: I need to go to the bathroom before we leave.
examples.translation_cn: 我们离开前我需要去一下洗手间。

senses.meaning_en: the rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time

examples.text: The frequency of traffic accidents has fallen by 30%.
examples.translation_cn: 交通事故的发生频率下降了30%。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of happening often

examples.text: She has been visiting her doctor with increasing frequency.
examples.translation_cn: 她看医生的频率越来越高了。

senses.meaning_en: the number of waves or cycles per second, measured in hertz

examples.text: The radio station broadcasts at a frequency of 98.5 MHz.
examples.translation_cn: 该广播电台以98.5兆赫的频率播出。

senses.meaning_en: a subatomic particle with a negative electric charge

examples.text: In a metal wire, the flow of electrons produces an electric current.
examples.translation_cn: 在金属导线中，电子的流动产生电流。

senses.meaning_en: using electronic circuits, especially semiconductors, to operate

examples.text: This electronic thermometer gives a reading in seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 这支电子温度计几秒钟就能给出读数。

senses.meaning_en: generated or transmitted by an electronic device

examples.text: Please submit the report in electronic form by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请在周五前以电子形式提交报告。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the Internet

examples.text: Electronic banking lets customers manage their accounts online.
examples.translation_cn: 电子银行业务让客户在线管理账户。

senses.meaning_en: the act of mixing different substances together

examples.text: A thorough mixture of the ingredients is essential.
examples.translation_cn: 充分混合各种配料至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: a substance made by mixing other substances together

examples.text: Pour the mixture into a greased tin immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 立即把混合物倒入涂了油的烤模。

senses.meaning_en: a combination of different things or qualities
senses.pattern: a mixture of A and B

examples.text: Her voice held a mixture of anger and relief.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音里混合着愤怒和宽慰。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid medicine containing a small amount of a drug

examples.text: He took a cough mixture for his sore throat.
examples.translation_cn: 他因喉咙痛服用了止咳合剂。

senses.meaning_en: causing surprise

examples.text: It is surprising that she agreed to help so quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 她这么快就同意帮忙，真令人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: an aspect or feature of something

examples.text: This discovery adds a new dimension to our understanding of climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现为我们理解气候变化增加了一个新方面。

senses.meaning_en: a measurement in space such as length, width, or height

examples.text: We need to know the exact dimensions of the room before buying furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 买家具前我们需要知道房间的确切尺寸。

senses.meaning_en: the number of coordinates needed to locate a point in space

examples.text: The graph shows the data plotted in three dimensions.
examples.translation_cn: 该图以三维方式展示数据。

senses.meaning_en: a universe or plane of existence

examples.text: The characters find themselves in another dimension where the rules of physics are different.
examples.translation_cn: 角色们发现自己身处一个物理规则不同的次元。

senses.meaning_en: a man or boy

examples.text: Some fellow called this morning and left a message.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上有个家伙打电话留了言。

senses.meaning_en: a companion or colleague

examples.text: She liked spending time with her fellows at the club.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在俱乐部和同伴们待在一起。

senses.meaning_en: a senior member of a college or society

examples.text: She is a research fellow in physics at Oxford.
examples.translation_cn: 她是牛津大学的物理学研究员。

senses.meaning_en: sharing a particular quality, activity, or condition

examples.text: He often works with his fellow students on group projects.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常和同学们一起做小组项目。

senses.meaning_en: a usual or fixed way of doing things

examples.text: He follows a strict morning routine before work.
examples.translation_cn: 他上班前遵循严格的晨间惯例。

senses.meaning_en: done regularly as part of a normal system

examples.text: She scheduled a routine check-up with her dentist.
examples.translation_cn: 她和牙医预约了一次常规检查。

senses.meaning_en: a set performance or rehearsed act

examples.text: The comedian did a comedy routine about airline food.
examples.translation_cn: 喜剧演员表演了一段关于飞机餐的搞笑段子。

senses.meaning_en: ordinary and uninteresting

examples.text: Data entry soon became a routine task that bored her.
examples.translation_cn: 数据录入很快变成了一项让她厌烦的平淡差事。

senses.meaning_en: a set of gymnastic moves performed on an apparatus

examples.text: The gymnast completed her balance beam routine flawlessly.
examples.translation_cn: 体操运动员完美完成了她的平衡木成套动作。

senses.meaning_en: not smooth; uneven

examples.text: The old brick wall was rough to the touch.
examples.translation_cn: 那堵旧砖墙摸起来很粗糙。

senses.meaning_en: approximate; not finished; hasty

examples.text: I wrote a rough draft of the essay before making revisions.
examples.translation_cn: 我在修改之前写了一份论文的初稿。

senses.meaning_en: difficult; unpleasant; turbulent

examples.text: The family went through a rough patch after he lost his job.
examples.translation_cn: 他失业后，这家人经历了一段艰难时期。

senses.meaning_en: crude; unrefined; not gentle or violent

examples.text: He was rough with the waiter and refused to apologize.
examples.translation_cn: 他对服务员很粗鲁，还拒绝道歉。

senses.meaning_en: Having a texture that lacks friction; not rough.

examples.text: The marble floor feels smooth and cool under your bare feet.
examples.translation_cn: 大理石地面踩上去光滑凉爽。

senses.meaning_en: Without difficulty or problems; natural and flowing.

examples.text: The company made a smooth transition to the new system.
examples.translation_cn: 公司向新系统过渡得很顺利。

senses.meaning_en: Suave; sophisticated; often persuasive in a charming but possibly insincere way.

examples.text: He is a smooth talker who can persuade almost anyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个圆滑健谈的人，几乎能说服任何人。

senses.meaning_en: Placid; calm; without waves or disturbance.

examples.text: The smooth sea reflected the moonlight like a mirror.
examples.translation_cn: 平静的海面像镜子一样映出月光。

senses.meaning_en: not far away; close

examples.text: We stayed at a nearby hotel for the night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一家附近的旅馆过夜。

senses.meaning_en: at a short distance

examples.text: My parents live nearby, so I visit them every weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我父母住在附近，所以我每个周末都去看望他们。

senses.meaning_en: a comment or observation

examples.text: He made a casual remark about her new hairstyle.
examples.translation_cn: 他随口评论了一下她的新发型。

senses.meaning_en: to say or write something as a comment

examples.text: She casually remarked that the test was easier than expected.
examples.translation_cn: 她随口说考试比预期的容易。

senses.meaning_en: to make a comment on something

examples.text: The official refused to remark on the matter.
examples.translation_cn: 该官员拒绝对此事发表评论。

senses.meaning_en: unusual or surprising in a way that attracts attention

examples.text: The region is remarkable for its rich cultural diversity.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区以其丰富的文化多样性而引人注目。

senses.meaning_en: the people who work for an organization or in the armed forces

examples.text: The personnel of the hospital are highly trained.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院的人员训练有素。

senses.meaning_en: the department that deals with employing and managing staff

examples.text: She has worked in personnel for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在人事部门工作了十年。

senses.meaning_en: the highest limit or amount

examples.text: The hall holds a maximum of 200 people.
examples.translation_cn: 这个大厅最多容纳200人。

senses.meaning_en: at most

examples.text: The repair job will take two hours maximum.
examples.translation_cn: 修理工作最多需要两个小时。

senses.meaning_en: the greatest value of a set or function

examples.text: The function has a local maximum at x = 2.
examples.translation_cn: 该函数在x=2处有一个局部最大值。

senses.meaning_en: the highest level of security, especially in a prison

examples.text: The killer is being held in maximum security.
examples.translation_cn: 那名杀人犯被关在最高安全级别监狱中。

senses.meaning_en: large movable items used in a room

examples.text: This old piece of furniture belonged to my grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 这件旧家具是我祖母的。

senses.meaning_en: very bright; full of light or strong colour

examples.text: After the rain, the sky was a brilliant blue.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后天空呈现明亮的湛蓝色。

senses.meaning_en: highly intelligent or talented

examples.text: The young child is brilliant at solving logic puzzles.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小孩很擅长解逻辑谜题。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; wonderful

examples.text: We had a brilliant time at the beach yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨天在海滩玩得非常开心。

senses.meaning_en: a strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist to hold up clothes or as a decoration

examples.text: He wears a thick black leather belt to work every day.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天系着一条厚厚的黑色皮带去上班。

senses.meaning_en: a band used to hold someone safely in a seat, especially in a vehicle

examples.text: Always fasten your seat belt when the car is moving.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车行驶时一定要系好安全带。

senses.meaning_en: a continuous band in a machine that transfers motion or power

examples.text: The drive belt transfers power from the engine to the wheels.
examples.translation_cn: 传动带将动力从发动机传递到车轮。

senses.meaning_en: a trophy in the shape of a belt, especially in boxing or martial arts

examples.text: The boxer won the world championship belt last night.
examples.translation_cn: 这位拳击手昨晚赢得了世界冠军腰带。

senses.meaning_en: an official list or record of names, events, transactions, etc.

examples.text: The school keeps a register of all its students.
examples.translation_cn: 学校保存所有学生的登记簿。

senses.meaning_en: to show or record a measurement or result

examples.text: The earthquake registered 6.2 on the Richter scale.
examples.translation_cn: 这次地震里氏震级为6.2级。

senses.meaning_en: to record your name or details on an official list

examples.text: Please register at the front desk before the class starts.
examples.translation_cn: 请在课程开始前到前台登记。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow tube for carrying liquids, gases, etc.

examples.text: The pipe carrying gas across the city was damaged during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 输送天然气穿过城市的管道在暴风雨中受损。

senses.meaning_en: a small device for smoking tobacco, consisting of a bowl and a stem

examples.text: After dinner, he sat by the fire puffing on his pipe.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后，他坐在火边抽着烟斗。

senses.meaning_en: a wind instrument consisting of a tube with holes
senses.pattern: play a tune on a pipe

examples.text: The shepherd played a cheerful tune on his wooden pipe.
examples.translation_cn: 牧羊人用他的木笛吹奏了一支欢快的曲调。

senses.meaning_en: to play music on a pipe instrument, such as a bagpipe or a flute

examples.text: The pipe band piped a cheerful tune as the guests arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 风笛乐队在客人到达时吹奏了一支欢快的曲调。

senses.meaning_en: a person between thirteen and nineteen years old

examples.text: When I was a teenager, I spent most weekends at the local skate park.
examples.translation_cn: 我十几岁时，大部分周末都在当地的滑板公园度过。

senses.meaning_en: a very short period of time; a precise moment

examples.text: All the lights went out in an instant.
examples.translation_cn: 所有的灯一瞬间全灭了。

senses.meaning_en: occurring immediately

examples.text: This app gives you instant access to your files.
examples.translation_cn: 这个应用程序能让你立即访问文件。

senses.meaning_en: very quickly and easily prepared

examples.text: My grandfather always drinks instant coffee in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我爷爷早上总是喝速溶咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: a beverage or food that needs little preparation, especially instant coffee

examples.text: She offered me a cup of instant and some biscuits.
examples.translation_cn: 她给了我一杯速溶咖啡和几块饼干。

senses.meaning_en: an example or case of something

examples.text: The accident was an instance of careless driving.
examples.translation_cn: 这起事故是粗心驾驶的一个实例。

senses.meaning_en: an example used to illustrate or prove something

examples.text: The lawyer cited the email as an instance of fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 律师引用那封邮件作为欺诈的例证。

senses.meaning_en: a particular situation or event

examples.text: In this instance, the rule does not apply.
examples.translation_cn: 在这种情况下，这条规则不适用。

senses.meaning_en: including all or nearly all aspects of something

examples.text: The magazine offers comprehensive coverage of the local music scene.
examples.translation_cn: 该杂志对本地音乐圈进行了全面报道。

senses.meaning_en: thorough and detailed

examples.text: She gave the police a comprehensive account of the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 她向警方详细描述了事件经过。

senses.meaning_en: a comprehensive school

examples.text: My brother went to a comprehensive in south Manchester.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥曾在曼彻斯特南部的一所综合中学上学。

examples.text: Every morning the students raise the national flag in the playground.
examples.translation_cn: 每天早晨学生们在操场上举行升旗仪式。

examples.text: The system flags unusual transactions as possible fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 该系统将异常交易标记为可能的欺诈。

examples.text: After ten hours of work, my concentration began to flag.
examples.translation_cn: 工作十小时后，我的注意力开始下降。

examples.text: The starter waved the green flag and the drivers set off.
examples.translation_cn: 发令员挥动绿旗，车手们出发了。

senses.meaning_en: to speak very quietly

examples.text: She whispered to me that she was leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 她低声对我说她要离开。

senses.meaning_en: a low quiet way of speaking or the sound itself

examples.text: He answered in a whisper so no one else could hear.
examples.translation_cn: 他低声回答，以免别人听见。

senses.meaning_en: a rumor

examples.text: There are whispers about a possible merger between the two companies.
examples.translation_cn: 有传言说这两家公司可能合并。

senses.meaning_en: a faint trace or hint

examples.text: There was a whisper of hope in her voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音里有一丝希望。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rents out property to others; a lessor

examples.text: The landlord of our building raised the rent by ten percent.
examples.translation_cn: 我们楼的房东把房租提高了百分之十。

senses.meaning_en: the owner or manager of a pub

examples.text: The landlord of the pub asked the noisy customers to leave.
examples.translation_cn: 酒吧老板要求那群吵闹的顾客离开。

senses.meaning_en: cereal plants such as wheat; their grain (British English)

examples.text: In Britain, a field of corn is often planted with wheat or barley.
examples.translation_cn: 在英国，一块谷物地常种小麦或大麦。

senses.meaning_en: maize; a tall cereal plant with yellow grains eaten as a vegetable

examples.text: We bought fresh corn on the cob at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在市场上买了新鲜的玉米棒。

senses.meaning_en: the front part of the neck

examples.text: She wrapped a scarf around her throat before stepping outside.
examples.translation_cn: 她出门前在脖子上围了一条围巾。

senses.meaning_en: the passage inside the neck for food and air

examples.text: She cleared her throat and began to speak in a clear voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她清了清喉咙，开始用清晰的声音说话。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow opening or passage

examples.text: The liquid flowed slowly through the narrow throat of the bottle.
examples.translation_cn: 液体缓慢地流过瓶子狭窄的咽喉。

senses.meaning_en: made of wood

examples.text: She placed the fruit in a wooden bowl on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她把水果放在桌上的木碗里。

senses.meaning_en: awkward or lacking emotion

examples.text: His voice was wooden and flat during the speech.
examples.translation_cn: 他演讲时声音呆板而平淡。

senses.meaning_en: to move backwards and forwards from a fixed point

examples.text: The pendulum swung back and forth above the old table.
examples.translation_cn: 钟摆在旧桌子上方来回摆动。

senses.meaning_en: to ride on a swing

examples.text: The children were swinging on a swing when the bell rang.
examples.translation_cn: 铃响时孩子们正在荡秋千。

senses.meaning_en: a change, especially in opinions or moods

examples.text: There has been a dramatic swing in public opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 公众舆论发生了剧烈转变。

senses.meaning_en: to dance to swing music

examples.text: My grandparents used to swing to big band music.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父母过去常跟着大乐队音乐跳摇摆舞。

senses.meaning_en: to fluctuate or change

examples.text: The mood in the hall swung from anger to hope.
examples.translation_cn: 大厅里的情绪从愤怒转为希望。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed amount of money paid to a professional or employee, usually monthly or annually

examples.text: She earns a high salary as a software engineer.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为一名软件工程师挣得高薪。

senses.meaning_en: the soft skin on each side of the face below the eyes

examples.text: She gently kissed her baby on the cheek.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻轻亲吻了宝宝的脸颊。

senses.meaning_en: impudence; cheeky behavior

examples.text: He had the cheek to ask for more money after breaking the vase.
examples.translation_cn: 他打破花瓶后竟有脸要更多的钱。

senses.meaning_en: a person who watches or notices things

examples.text: She is a keen observer of human behaviour.
examples.translation_cn: 她是人类行为的敏锐观察者。

senses.meaning_en: a person who follows laws, rules, etc.

examples.text: He is a strict observer of the club's rules.
examples.translation_cn: 他严格遵守俱乐部的规则。

senses.meaning_en: a country or entity with limited participation rights in an organization

examples.text: The country was granted observer status at the United Nations.
examples.translation_cn: 该国获得了联合国观察员地位。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making things equal or the state of being equal
senses.pattern: the equation of A with B

examples.text: The equation of wealth with happiness is often too simple.
examples.translation_cn: 把财富等同于幸福往往是过于简单的。

senses.meaning_en: a statement in mathematics that two expressions are equal

examples.text: We learned to solve an equation with one variable last week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周学习了求解一元方程。

senses.meaning_en: a situation or factor that must be considered when solving a problem

examples.text: Money is only part of the equation when choosing a career.
examples.translation_cn: 在选择职业时，金钱只是其中一个影响因素。

senses.meaning_en: a cultivated plant grown as food or for other uses

examples.text: Farmers here grow crops such as wheat and corn.
examples.translation_cn: 这里的农民种植小麦和玉米等庄稼。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of a plant product gathered in a season

examples.text: The region produced a good crop of apples this year.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区今年苹果收成很好。

senses.meaning_en: to cut or trim something short

examples.text: She cropped her hair short before the hot summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她在炎热的夏天到来前把头发剪短了。

senses.meaning_en: a group of things or people appearing at the same time

examples.text: The school welcomed a new crop of students in September.
examples.translation_cn: 学校九月份迎来了一批新生。

senses.meaning_en: speed or rate of movement

examples.text: The company has been expanding at a rapid pace in Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司一直在亚洲快速扩张。

senses.meaning_en: a single step or the length of a step

examples.text: He took two paces back and raised his hands.
examples.translation_cn: 他向后退了两步，举起了双手。

senses.meaning_en: to walk back and forth in a small area

examples.text: She paced back and forth in the waiting room.
examples.translation_cn: 她在候诊室里来回踱步。

senses.meaning_en: a way of stepping, especially a particular style

examples.text: She walked with a steady, confident pace into the interview room.
examples.translation_cn: 她迈着平稳而自信的步伐走进了面试室。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty

examples.text: She overcame many obstacles before achieving her dream.
examples.translation_cn: 她在实现梦想之前克服了许多障碍。

senses.meaning_en: to be strongly affected by an emotion

examples.text: She was overcome with joy at the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到这个消息欣喜若狂。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat someone in a competition or fight

examples.text: They overcame the defending champions in the final.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在决赛中战胜了卫冕冠军。

senses.meaning_en: to act or conduct oneself in a particular way

examples.text: The children behaved badly during the long dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在漫长的晚餐期间表现得很差。

senses.meaning_en: to act in a polite or proper way

examples.text: Please behave yourself when we visit your grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 我们拜访你祖母时请守规矩。

senses.meaning_en: to function or react in a particular way

examples.text: The system behaves erratically when the temperature drops.
examples.translation_cn: 温度下降时系统运转异常。

senses.meaning_en: a position in a hierarchy or the armed forces

examples.text: She rose to the rank of colonel within ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在十年内晋升至上校军衔。

senses.meaning_en: a position in a list ordered by quality, popularity, etc.

examples.text: Our school is in the top rank of universities nationwide.
examples.translation_cn: 我们学校在全国大学中名列前茅。

senses.meaning_en: having a very strong, unpleasant smell or taste

examples.text: The meat began to smell rank after two days.
examples.translation_cn: 这块肉两天后开始发臭。

senses.meaning_en: complete, unmitigated, utter

examples.text: He started as a rank outsider but won the election.
examples.translation_cn: 他起初完全不被看好，但最终赢得了选举。

senses.meaning_en: the act or right of entering

examples.text: You need a ticket to gain entrance to the concert hall.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要一张票才能进入音乐厅。

senses.meaning_en: a door or gate for entering

examples.text: The main entrance to the museum is on the left.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆的正门在左边。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or start of something

examples.text: Getting a job marked his entrance into adult life.
examples.translation_cn: 找到工作标志着他的成年生活的开始。

senses.meaning_en: to fill someone with great pleasure and wonder

examples.text: The children were entranced by the magician's tricks.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们被魔术师的戏法迷住了。

examples.text: He felt a deep anxiety about the future of his job.
examples.translation_cn: 他对自己工作的未来深感焦虑。

examples.text: His anxiety to please everyone made him agree to extra work.
examples.translation_cn: 他渴望取悦每个人，这使他同意加班。

examples.text: She was diagnosed with anxiety and began taking medication.
examples.translation_cn: 她被诊断患有焦虑症并开始服药。

senses.meaning_en: authorization or consent

examples.text: Many companies require employees to ask permission to access sensitive data.
examples.translation_cn: 许多公司要求员工获取许可才能访问敏感数据。

senses.meaning_en: to hold someone in your arms as a sign of love or friendship

examples.text: They embraced each other at the airport after a long separation.
examples.translation_cn: 久别后，他们在机场互相拥抱。

senses.meaning_en: to include or contain something

examples.text: The course embraces a wide range of topics from literature to politics.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课涵盖了从文学到政治的广泛主题。

senses.meaning_en: to accept or support an idea, change, or way of life willingly and enthusiastically

examples.text: The company was quick to embrace change and improve its services.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司迅速接受变革并改进其服务。

senses.meaning_en: to accept or experience something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: He embraced the hardships of exile without complaint.
examples.translation_cn: 他毫无怨言地承受了流亡的艰辛。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange for a room, seat, table, etc. to be kept for you to use later

examples.text: I'd like to reserve a table for two at eight.
examples.translation_cn: 我想预订一张八点的两人桌。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something for a particular purpose or person
senses.pattern: reserve the right to do sth

examples.text: The company reserves the right to cancel the event at short notice.
examples.translation_cn: 公司保留在短时间内取消活动的权利。

senses.meaning_en: a supply of something that is kept for future use

examples.text: The country holds a large reserve of oil for emergencies.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家拥有大量应急石油储备。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land where animals and plants are protected

examples.text: We saw rare birds in a nature reserve near the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在海岸附近的自然保护区看到了珍稀鸟类。

senses.meaning_en: a wide, flat metal container used for cooking

examples.text: She fried the eggs in a large pan.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个大平底锅里煎鸡蛋。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize something severely, especially a film, play, etc.

examples.text: The film was panned by critics for being too slow.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因节奏太慢而受到影评人的严厉批评。

senses.meaning_en: the contents of a pan

examples.text: She heated a pan of soup for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 她热了一锅汤当午餐。

senses.meaning_en: a thick fabric covering a floor

examples.text: They laid a thick carpet in the living room yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 他们昨天在客厅铺了一块厚地毯。

senses.meaning_en: a surface or cover resembling a carpet

examples.text: A carpet of snow covered the garden overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 一夜之间，一层雪覆盖了花园。

senses.meaning_en: to cover a floor with carpet

examples.text: They plan to carpet the room next week.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划下周给这个房间铺地毯。

senses.meaning_en: to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong

examples.text: He was carpeted for forgetting the client's name.
examples.translation_cn: 他因忘记客户的名字而被训斥。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to make sensible decisions or give good advice
senses.pattern: show good judgement in doing sth

examples.text: The manager showed good judgement in hiring an experienced assistant.
examples.translation_cn: 经理在聘用一名经验丰富的助手时展现了良好的判断力。

senses.meaning_en: a formal decision made by a court or judge

examples.text: The court issued a judgement against the tobacco company.
examples.translation_cn: 法院对烟草公司作出了不利判决。

senses.meaning_en: the elected head of the government of a city or town

examples.text: The mayor of Seattle announced a new housing plan.
examples.translation_cn: 西雅图市长宣布了一项新的住房计划。

senses.meaning_en: the range or extent of something

examples.text: We need to define the scope of the project before we start.
examples.translation_cn: 开始之前，我们需要界定项目范围。

senses.meaning_en: the opportunity or freedom to do something

examples.text: There is plenty of scope for improvement in the current design.
examples.translation_cn: 当前设计有很大的改进余地。

senses.meaning_en: having a colour between red and white

examples.text: The walls of her bedroom are pale pink.
examples.translation_cn: 她卧室的墙壁是淡粉色。

senses.meaning_en: a pale red colour

examples.text: She arrived at the party dressed in pink.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着粉色衣服来到派对。

senses.meaning_en: a raised stage for speeches or performances, or a place/opportunity to express one's views

examples.text: The protest gave ordinary people a platform for their voices.
examples.translation_cn: 这次抗议给了普通人发声的机会。

senses.meaning_en: a set of policies or promises that a political party or candidate states before an election

examples.text: She was elected on a platform of economic reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她凭借经济改革的政纲当选。

senses.meaning_en: a raised structure at a station where passengers get on or off trains

examples.text: We waited on the platform for the last train.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在站台上等最后一班火车。

senses.meaning_en: a raised floor for any purpose, e.g. for workers during construction or for viewing

examples.text: The workers stood on a raised platform while repairing the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们站在高台上修理屋顶。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of cloth that hangs in front of a window or other opening to keep out light or provide privacy

examples.text: She drew the curtains to block out the evening sun.
examples.translation_cn: 她拉上窗帘，挡住傍晚的阳光。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of thick cloth that hangs at the front of a stage and is raised or lowered during a performance

examples.text: The curtain rises slowly to reveal the empty stage.
examples.translation_cn: 幕布缓缓升起，露出空荡荡的舞台。

senses.meaning_en: the mother of one's father or mother

examples.text: The woman who waved at you just now is my grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 刚才向你招手的那位女士是我祖母。

senses.meaning_en: a distinct section of a piece of writing

examples.text: The key issue is explained in the first paragraph.
examples.translation_cn: 关键问题在第一段中得到了解释。

senses.meaning_en: to divide a piece of writing into paragraphs

examples.text: The teacher asked us to paragraph the essay before submitting it.
examples.translation_cn: 老师要求我们在提交前给这篇文章分段。

senses.meaning_en: a brief article or notice in a newspaper

examples.text: The merger was announced in a news paragraph.
examples.translation_cn: 合并的消息在一则新闻短讯中公布。

senses.meaning_en: a small brown insect that makes a chirping sound

examples.text: At night we heard crickets chirping in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 夜里我们听到蟋蟀在花园里鸣叫。

senses.meaning_en: a game played outdoors with bats and a ball between two teams of eleven

examples.text: Our team plays cricket on the school field every Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们队每周二在学校操场上打板球。

senses.meaning_en: fair and sportsmanlike behavior

examples.text: It is not cricket to lie to your friends.
examples.translation_cn: 对朋友撒谎是不光彩的。

senses.meaning_en: in a successful manner; without failing

examples.text: She completed the marathon successfully despite the heat.
examples.translation_cn: 她不顾炎热成功地跑完了马拉松。

senses.meaning_en: a kind or helpful deed

examples.text: Could you do me a favor and carry this box?
examples.translation_cn: 你能帮我个忙，搬一下这个箱子吗？

senses.meaning_en: to prefer or support sb/sth

examples.text: The coach tends to favor experienced players over young ones.
examples.translation_cn: 教练倾向于偏袒有经验的球员胜过年轻球员。

senses.meaning_en: to give an advantage to; to make more likely

examples.text: Our construction work was favored by the dry weather.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的施工工作得益于干燥的天气。

senses.meaning_en: goodwill; benevolent regard

examples.text: The new teacher soon found favor with her students.
examples.translation_cn: 新老师很快就赢得了学生们的喜爱。

senses.meaning_en: approval or support

examples.text: The committee voted in favor of the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会投票赞成这项提案。

senses.meaning_en: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not obvious

examples.text: I could detect that she was anxious, even though she tried to smile.
examples.translation_cn: 我能察觉到她很焦虑，尽管她试图微笑。

senses.meaning_en: to find out the truth about something, especially a crime or problem

examples.text: Auditors detected the fraud during a routine check.
examples.translation_cn: 审计员在一次例行检查中查出了欺诈。

senses.meaning_en: to discover or identify something using equipment or a scientific method

examples.text: The sensor can detect a gas leak in the basement.
examples.translation_cn: 传感器能检测到地下室里的煤气泄漏。

senses.meaning_en: to express willingness; give permission

examples.text: She consented to the treatment after reading the risks.
examples.translation_cn: 她看了风险后同意了治疗。

senses.meaning_en: voluntary agreement or permission

examples.text: The patient gave her consent to the surgery after the doctor explained the risks.
examples.translation_cn: 病人在医生解释风险后同意了手术。

senses.meaning_en: the organ in the body where food goes after it is swallowed

examples.text: Do not take this painkiller on an empty stomach.
examples.translation_cn: 不要空腹服用这种止痛药。

senses.meaning_en: the front part of the body below the chest

examples.text: The baby always sleeps on her stomach at night.
examples.translation_cn: 这个婴儿晚上总是趴着睡觉。

senses.meaning_en: to be able to accept or deal with something unpleasant

examples.text: I can't stomach the thought of eating raw fish.
examples.translation_cn: 我一想到吃生鱼就受不了。

senses.meaning_en: a desire or willingness to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: They had no stomach for another long debate.
examples.translation_cn: 他们没有兴趣再进行一场长时间的辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to consist of; to be made up of

examples.text: The collection comprises 150 paintings by modern artists.
examples.translation_cn: 这批藏品包括150幅现代艺术家的画作。

senses.meaning_en: to constitute; to form

examples.text: Women now comprise over 60 percent of the workforce.
examples.translation_cn: 如今女性占劳动力的60%以上。

senses.meaning_en: to determine the weight of an object

examples.text: Please weigh the flour before adding it to the bowl.
examples.translation_cn: 在把面粉加入碗中之前，请称一下重量。

senses.meaning_en: to consider something carefully and compare it with something else

examples.text: You should weigh the costs against the benefits before deciding.
examples.translation_cn: 在做决定之前，你应该权衡利弊。

senses.meaning_en: to have a particular weight

examples.text: The baby weighed just over three kilograms at birth.
examples.translation_cn: 这个婴儿出生时体重刚过三公斤。

senses.meaning_en: to be considered important or to have influence

examples.text: His reputation as a fair judge weighs heavily with the voters.
examples.translation_cn: 他作为公正法官的名声在选民中很有分量。

senses.meaning_en: to set up equipment or software for use

examples.text: We installed the new operating system on all the office computers.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在所有办公电脑上安装了新操作系统。

senses.meaning_en: to formally place someone in an official position

examples.text: The committee installed her as the new director last month.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会上个月任命她为新主任。

senses.meaning_en: a line that bends smoothly without angles

examples.text: The ball moved in a smooth curve through the air.
examples.translation_cn: 球在空中划出一道平滑的曲线。

senses.meaning_en: a line on a graph showing how a value changes or is distributed

examples.text: Most test scores follow a normal curve closely.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数考试成绩都接近正态分布曲线。

senses.meaning_en: a bend in a road, river, etc.

examples.text: The car slowed down as it went around a sharp curve.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车驶过一个急转弯时减速了。

senses.meaning_en: to bend or make something bend

examples.text: He curved the metal bar into a hook.
examples.translation_cn: 他把金属棒弯成了一个钩子。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the basic or fundamental part of something; very simple

examples.text: He has only an elementary knowledge of chemistry.
examples.translation_cn: 他只有基础的化学知识。

senses.meaning_en: relating to an elementary school

examples.text: She teaches music at an elementary school in Boston.
examples.translation_cn: 她在波士顿的一所小学教音乐。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters or about 0.264 gallons

examples.text: She drinks two liters of water every day.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天喝两升水。

senses.meaning_en: relating to literature

examples.text: The novel is considered a major literary work of the 20th century.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说被认为是20世纪的重要文学作品。

senses.meaning_en: appropriate to literature rather than everyday writing

examples.text: His report was criticized for its overly literary style.
examples.translation_cn: 他的报告因过于文雅的风格而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: relating to writers, or the profession of literature

examples.text: She hired a literary agent to negotiate her book contract.
examples.translation_cn: 她聘请了一位文学经纪人来洽谈她的图书合同。

senses.meaning_en: knowledgeable about or interested in literature

examples.text: My grandmother was literary and encouraged me to read classic novels.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖母很有文学修养，鼓励我读经典小说。

senses.meaning_en: ready to attack or argue

examples.text: The dog was aggressive toward the mail carrier.
examples.translation_cn: 那条狗对邮递员很凶。

senses.meaning_en: spreading quickly and seriously

examples.text: Doctors found an aggressive form of skin cancer.
examples.translation_cn: 医生发现了一种侵袭性皮肤癌。

senses.meaning_en: determined and forceful in pursuing success or opportunity

examples.text: She is aggressive in pursuing new business opportunities.
examples.translation_cn: 她在争取新的商业机会时很有冲劲。

senses.meaning_en: involving high risk for potentially high reward

examples.text: An aggressive investor accepts higher risk in exchange for higher potential returns.
examples.translation_cn: 激进的投资者愿意接受更高风险以换取更高潜在回报。

senses.meaning_en: a public performance of music

examples.text: We attended a live concert at the city stadium last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚在市体育场听了一场现场音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: a thin, flat, circular object or shape

examples.text: The machine cuts a thin disk of metal from a steel sheet.
examples.translation_cn: 机器从钢板上切割出一个薄的金属圆盘。

senses.meaning_en: a flat circular area in geometry, bounded by a circle

examples.text: Calculate the area of a disk with radius five centimeters.
examples.translation_cn: 计算半径为五厘米的圆盘的面积。

senses.meaning_en: a device for storing computer data, especially a hard disk

examples.text: The backup file is stored on disk for safety.
examples.translation_cn: 备份文件存储在磁盘上以确保安全。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of cartilage between the bones in your back

examples.text: He was diagnosed with a slipped disk last month.
examples.translation_cn: 他上个月被诊断出椎间盘突出。

senses.meaning_en: a soft metal or plastic container with a narrow opening, used for holding thick liquids

examples.text: She bought a tube of sunscreen for the beach trip.
examples.translation_cn: 她为海滩旅行买了一管防晒霜。

senses.meaning_en: the London Underground railway system

examples.text: We took the Tube to get to the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow cylindrical object, often used for carrying liquids or gases

examples.text: Water flows through a narrow tube into the tank.
examples.translation_cn: 水通过一根细管流入水箱。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something is probably true or likely to happen, although you are not sure

examples.text: He presumably works from home because his company has no local office.
examples.translation_cn: 他大概在家工作，因为他的公司没有本地办公室。

senses.meaning_en: to resign from a job or leave school permanently

examples.text: She quit her job at the bank to start her own business.
examples.translation_cn: 她辞去了银行的工作，创办了自己的公司。

senses.meaning_en: to stop doing an activity or give up a habit

examples.text: He finally quit smoking after his doctor warned him about his heart.
examples.translation_cn: 在医生提醒他注意心脏问题后，他终于戒烟了。

senses.meaning_en: to exit or close a computer application

examples.text: You should quit the app before you shut down the computer.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该先退出这个应用，再关闭电脑。

senses.meaning_en: to release from an obligation or accusation; to be free from

examples.text: After the final payment, he was quit of all his debts.
examples.translation_cn: 付清最后一笔款项后，他摆脱了所有债务。

senses.meaning_en: real and exactly what it appears to be; not fake or artificial

examples.text: The signature on the painting is genuine, not a copy.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画上的签名是真的，不是复制品。

senses.meaning_en: sincere and honest; not pretending

examples.text: Her apology sounded genuine, and he forgave her at once.
examples.translation_cn: 她的道歉听起来很真诚，他立刻原谅了她。

senses.meaning_en: to promise or make certain that something will happen

examples.text: We guarantee to reply within three working days.
examples.translation_cn: 我们保证在三个工作日内回复。

senses.meaning_en: a promise or assurance that something will happen or is true

examples.text: The ceasefire offers no guarantee of lasting peace.
examples.translation_cn: 停火并不能保证持久和平。

senses.meaning_en: to take responsibility for the quality or condition of a product or debt

examples.text: The new laptop is guaranteed for three years.
examples.translation_cn: 这台新笔记本电脑保修三年。

senses.meaning_en: to a great extent or degree

examples.text: Online shopping has greatly increased consumer choice in recent years.
examples.translation_cn: 网上购物近年来大大增加了消费者的选择。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the Latin language or alphabet

examples.text: The original version of this book was written in Latin.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书的原版是用拉丁语写的。

senses.meaning_en: of or from Latin America or of Latin American culture

examples.text: The festival celebrates Latin American music and dance.
examples.translation_cn: 这个节日庆祝拉丁美洲音乐和舞蹈。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to ancient Rome or its Empire

examples.text: We studied Latin authors of the Roman Empire.
examples.translation_cn: 我们研究了罗马帝国的拉丁作家。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people are kept as punishment or while waiting for trial

examples.text: Two prisoners escaped from the local jail last night.
examples.translation_cn: 两名囚犯昨晚从当地监狱逃脱。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being kept in prison; imprisonment

examples.text: He was in jail for two years on robbery charges.
examples.translation_cn: 他因抢劫指控在监狱里待了两年。

senses.meaning_en: to put or keep someone in jail; imprison

examples.text: He was jailed for three years for burglary.
examples.translation_cn: 他因入室盗窃被监禁三年。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time when something is late or postponed; the act of delaying

examples.text: There was a long delay in processing the application.
examples.translation_cn: 处理申请出现了长时间的延迟。

senses.meaning_en: to put off until a later time; to defer

examples.text: They delayed making a decision until next week.
examples.translation_cn: 他们推迟到下周才做决定。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something late or slow; to hinder

examples.text: The train was severely delayed by heavy snow.
examples.translation_cn: 火车因大雪严重晚点。

senses.meaning_en: to wait, hesitate, tarry

examples.text: She delayed too long in applying for the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她拖了太久才申请这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: always telling the truth and not cheating

examples.text: The witness was completely honest about everything she remembered.
examples.translation_cn: 证人对她所记得的一切都完全诚实。

senses.meaning_en: not hiding your real opinion

examples.text: She was honest with me about her doubts.
examples.translation_cn: 她坦诚地向我表达了她的疑虑。

senses.meaning_en: earned or done fairly, without cheating

examples.text: She makes an honest living as a baker.
examples.translation_cn: 她靠做面包师本分谋生。

senses.meaning_en: purpose; reason

examples.text: For the sake of clarity, the teacher repeated the instructions twice.
examples.translation_cn: 为了清楚起见，老师把说明重复了两遍。

senses.meaning_en: benefit; interest

examples.text: They agreed to settle the dispute for the children's sake.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为孩子们的利益同意解决争端。

senses.meaning_en: to rest and become less stressed

examples.text: She likes to relax by reading in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在花园里读书来放松。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make something less tight

examples.text: He relaxed his grip on the steering wheel.
examples.translation_cn: 他松开了握着方向盘的手。

senses.meaning_en: to make or become less severe, tense, or strict

examples.text: The government relaxed restrictions on foreign travel last month.
examples.translation_cn: 政府上个月放宽了出国旅行的限制。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel less stressed or worried

examples.text: Listening to gentle music relaxes me after a long day.
examples.translation_cn: 听轻柔的音乐让我在漫长的一天后感到放松。

senses.meaning_en: a short piece of writing on a particular subject

examples.text: She wrote an essay on climate change for her class.
examples.translation_cn: 她为课程写了一篇关于气候变化的短文。

senses.meaning_en: to try to do something

examples.text: He essayed to finish the work before noon.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图在中午前完成工作。

senses.meaning_en: a particular form or version of a published text

examples.text: This is the first edition of the dictionary, published in 1998.
examples.translation_cn: 这是这本词典的第一版，于1998年出版。

senses.meaning_en: one issue of a newspaper or magazine, or one programme in a broadcast series

examples.text: The story appeared in today's edition of the local newspaper.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇报道出现在当地报纸今天的这一期。

senses.meaning_en: the total number of copies of a book, newspaper, etc. printed at one time

examples.text: The novel was published in an edition of 5,000 copies.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说一次印刷了5,000册。

senses.meaning_en: a closed path through which electricity flows

examples.text: You must complete the circuit to make the device work.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须接通电路，设备才能工作。

senses.meaning_en: a regular trip from place to place as part of one's job

examples.text: She is well known on the lecture circuit.
examples.translation_cn: 她在巡回演讲圈里很出名。

senses.meaning_en: a very tall and large person, especially one in stories

examples.text: He was a giant of a man, tall and broad-shouldered.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个高大魁梧的男人。

senses.meaning_en: a very large and powerful company or an important person

examples.text: She built her startup into a giant in the industry.
examples.translation_cn: 她把初创公司发展成为行业巨头。

senses.meaning_en: a very large and bright star

examples.text: Our sun will become a red giant in about five billion years.
examples.translation_cn: 大约五十亿年后，太阳将变成一颗红巨星。

senses.meaning_en: causing great interest or excitement

examples.text: It is exciting to see the team win the championship.
examples.translation_cn: 看到球队赢得冠军令人激动。

senses.meaning_en: sexually stimulating

examples.text: The scene was sexually exciting but not romantic.
examples.translation_cn: 这个场景引起性兴奋但并不浪漫。

senses.meaning_en: an instrument that measures and shows time

examples.text: The kitchen clock on the wall said ten past seven.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房墙上的钟显示七点十分。

senses.meaning_en: to reach or record a particular speed or time

examples.text: The car was clocked at 90 mph on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车在高速公路上被测得时速90英里。

senses.meaning_en: popular music

examples.text: My brother is really into pop from the 1990s.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥真的很喜欢90年代的流行音乐。

senses.meaning_en: to make a short explosive sound; to burst

examples.text: The bottle of champagne popped open at midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 那瓶香槟在午夜砰地打开了。

senses.meaning_en: a loud, sharp sound

examples.text: The cork flew out with a loud pop.
examples.translation_cn: 软木塞砰地一声飞了出来。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet fizzy drink

examples.text: He drank a can of pop with his lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 他午餐时喝了一罐汽水。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to chemistry

examples.text: A catalyst speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed.
examples.translation_cn: 催化剂能加快化学反应而自身不被消耗。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used in or produced by chemistry, such as an element, compound, or artificial product

examples.text: Workers in this factory are exposed to harmful chemicals every day.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂的工人每天接触有害化学物质。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a job or position voluntarily

examples.text: He resigned from his position as finance director after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻后他辞去了财务总监的职务。

senses.meaning_en: to accept something unpleasant that cannot be changed

examples.text: He resigned himself to a long wait for the test results.
examples.translation_cn: 他只好长时间等待检查结果。

senses.meaning_en: to give up a right, claim, or game

examples.text: He resigned all claims to the family estate.
examples.translation_cn: 他放弃了对家族房产的所有权利。

senses.meaning_en: to say that someone or something has done something wrong

examples.text: The report criticized the government for failing to act quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告批评政府未能迅速采取行动。

senses.meaning_en: to judge the good and bad qualities of something

examples.text: The professor criticized the novel from a historical perspective.
examples.translation_cn: 教授从历史角度评论了这部小说。

senses.meaning_en: the act of washing your body in water

examples.text: He takes a cold bath every morning to wake himself up.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天早上洗冷水澡让自己清醒。

senses.meaning_en: a large container that you fill with water to wash in

examples.text: She dropped the shampoo bottle in the bath and it cracked.
examples.translation_cn: 她把洗发水瓶掉进浴缸里，瓶子裂了。

senses.meaning_en: a room where you can have a bath

examples.text: They rented a small flat with one bath and no lift.
examples.translation_cn: 他们租了一间只有一间浴室、没有电梯的小公寓。

senses.meaning_en: the water used for washing in a bath

examples.text: I'll run a bath for you while you unpack.
examples.translation_cn: 你整理行李的时候，我去给你放洗澡水。

senses.meaning_en: at or close to the state of the art; modern and well developed

examples.text: The early smartphone was advanced for its time, featuring a touchscreen and mobile internet.
examples.translation_cn: 早期的智能手机在当时非常先进，配备了触摸屏和移动互联网。

senses.meaning_en: involving greater complexity; more difficult, elaborate or specialized

examples.text: She is taking an advanced course in physics this term.
examples.translation_cn: 她这学期在上高等物理课程。

senses.meaning_en: given or made before something happens; prior

examples.text: The airline gave us advanced notice of the schedule change.
examples.translation_cn: 航空公司提前通知了我们时刻表变更。

senses.meaning_en: lacking intelligence or common sense; not clever

examples.text: It is stupid to leave your keys in the car.
examples.translation_cn: 把钥匙留在车里是愚蠢的。

senses.meaning_en: a stupid person; a fool

examples.text: Don't be such a stupid; you know better than that.
examples.translation_cn: 别做这样的傻瓜，你又不是不知道。

senses.meaning_en: used to show annoyance about something or someone (informal)

examples.text: I'm tired of this stupid phone losing signal.
examples.translation_cn: 我受够了这部破手机老没信号。

senses.meaning_en: to the point of stupor

examples.text: The long lecture bored us stupid by the end.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的讲座最后把我们无聊死了。

senses.meaning_en: to win against someone in a battle, game, or contest

examples.text: The young player defeated the world champion in straight sets.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻选手直落三盘击败了世界冠军。

senses.meaning_en: failure to win or succeed

examples.text: The team suffered a heavy defeat in the cup final.
examples.translation_cn: 该队在杯赛决赛中遭遇惨败。

senses.meaning_en: to make something fail or have no effect

examples.text: A weak conclusion may defeat the purpose of your argument.
examples.translation_cn: 一个无力的结论可能会使你论证的目的落空。

senses.meaning_en: the hard outer covering of an animal or egg

examples.text: She cracked the shell of a hard-boiled egg and peeled it away.
examples.translation_cn: 她敲开一个煮鸡蛋的壳，然后剥掉。

senses.meaning_en: a metal case filled with explosives, fired from a large gun

examples.text: The battleship fired a shell at the enemy submarine.
examples.translation_cn: 战列舰向敌方潜艇发射了一枚炮弹。

senses.meaning_en: the casing of an artillery projectile

examples.text: He picked up an empty shell casing beside the cannon.
examples.translation_cn: 他捡起大炮旁的一个空弹壳。

senses.meaning_en: the hard outer covering of a nut or seed

examples.text: Remove the shell from the peanut before you eat it.
examples.translation_cn: 吃花生前先把壳去掉。

senses.meaning_en: the act of using energy, fuel, etc., or the amount used

examples.text: The consumption of electricity rises sharply in summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏季电力消耗急剧上升。

senses.meaning_en: the act of buying and using goods or services

examples.text: The consumption of luxury goods has increased recently.
examples.translation_cn: 最近奢侈品的消费有所增加。

senses.meaning_en: the act of eating or drinking something

examples.text: The consumption of alcohol is banned in this area.
examples.translation_cn: 该区域禁止饮酒。

senses.meaning_en: having the typical features of a particular style

examples.text: This case is a classic example of poor urban planning.
examples.translation_cn: 这个案例是糟糕城市规划的典型例子。

senses.meaning_en: having lasting quality and excellence

examples.text: The building is a classic design that has influenced many architects.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑是一个经典设计，影响了许多建筑师。

senses.meaning_en: a work of art that is an excellent and typical example

examples.text: The novel is a classic of Russian literature.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说是俄罗斯文学的经典之作。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the past; vintage

examples.text: He owns a classic car from the early 1950s.
examples.translation_cn: 他拥有一辆20世纪50年代初的经典车。

senses.meaning_en: describing art music, especially orchestral music, rather than pop, jazz, etc.

examples.text: He often plays classical music on the piano.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常用钢琴弹奏古典音乐。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to ancient Greek or Roman culture

examples.text: She studied classical mythology as part of her degree.
examples.translation_cn: 她攻读学位期间研习了古希腊罗马神话。

senses.meaning_en: conforming to established principles or the best authority; chaste, pure, refined

examples.text: The essay is classical in style, valued for its clarity and restraint.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇散文风格古典，以清晰和克制见长。

senses.meaning_en: pertaining to physical laws that do not involve quantum or relativistic effects

examples.text: Newton's laws of motion are central to classical mechanics.
examples.translation_cn: 牛顿运动定律是经典力学的核心。

senses.meaning_en: a poor farmer of low social status who owns or rents a small piece of land

examples.text: He was a peasant farmer who owned only a small piece of land.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一个只拥有一小块地的农民。

senses.meaning_en: an uncouth, ill-bred person

examples.text: At the formal dinner, he behaved like a peasant, talking with his mouth full.
examples.translation_cn: 在正式晚宴上，他举止粗鲁，嘴里塞满食物还说话。

senses.meaning_en: one of the main administrative divisions of certain countries

examples.text: Guangdong is a southern province of China with a strong economy.
examples.translation_cn: 广东是中国南方一个经济强劲的省份。

senses.meaning_en: a sphere of activity, responsibility, or knowledge

examples.text: Whether to accept the offer is outside my province.
examples.translation_cn: 是否接受这个提议超出了我的职权范围。

senses.meaning_en: the parts of a country outside its capital city

examples.text: After retiring, they moved to a quiet town in the provinces.
examples.translation_cn: 退休后，他们搬到了外省一个安静的小镇。

senses.meaning_en: to stop doing something for a short time before continuing

examples.text: The speaker paused for a moment to drink some water before continuing.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲者暂停片刻喝了点水，然后继续。

senses.meaning_en: a short period of time when something stops before continuing

examples.text: There was a pause in the conversation before she replied.
examples.translation_cn: 她回答前，谈话停顿了一下。

senses.meaning_en: a short period of rest or a break from an activity

examples.text: We took a pause for rest during the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途徒步中我们停下来休息。

senses.meaning_en: to hesitate before doing or saying something

examples.text: He paused before making a difficult choice, unsure of the consequences.
examples.translation_cn: 他在做出艰难选择前犹豫了，不确定后果。

senses.meaning_en: the act of getting something, especially knowledge or a skill

examples.text: The acquisition of a second language is easier for children.
examples.translation_cn: 第二语言的习得对孩子来说更容易。

senses.meaning_en: something that someone has bought or obtained, especially an object for a collection

examples.text: The museum just added a new acquisition to its collection.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆刚刚为馆藏增添了一件新购藏品。

senses.meaning_en: the act of buying a company, or the company that is bought

examples.text: The acquisition of a company requires careful planning.
examples.translation_cn: 收购一家公司需要周密规划。

senses.meaning_en: a round vegetable with a strong smell and taste, made up of thin layers

examples.text: First chop an onion and fry it in a little oil.
examples.translation_cn: 先把一个洋葱切碎，然后在少许油中煎一下。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or supporting socialism

examples.text: The country became a socialist state after the revolution.
examples.translation_cn: 革命后，这个国家成为一个社会主义国家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supports socialism or belongs to a socialist party

examples.text: She has been a socialist since university and still campaigns for workers' rights.
examples.translation_cn: 她自大学起就是社会主义者，至今仍为工人权利奔走。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to or constituting a socialist party or political group

examples.text: She joined a socialist party after university and soon became a local organizer.
examples.translation_cn: 她大学毕业后加入了一个社会党，很快成为地方组织者。

senses.meaning_en: a name or symbol that identifies a product or service

examples.text: She always buys the same brand of toothpaste.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是买同一个牌子的牙膏。

senses.meaning_en: a particular type or style of something

examples.text: He has his own brand of humour that not everyone gets.
examples.translation_cn: 他有自己独特的幽默风格，并非人人都懂。

senses.meaning_en: the public image or reputation and recognized, typical style of an individual or group

examples.text: Her personal brand as a direct and honest leader makes her popular.
examples.translation_cn: 她直言不讳的坦诚领导者形象使她颇受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: to make something certain to happen

examples.text: Careful planning will help assure the success of the project.
examples.translation_cn: 仔细规划将有助于确保项目成功。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone something is definitely true so they do not worry

examples.text: I assure you that your job is safe.
examples.translation_cn: 我向你保证你的工作是安全的。

senses.meaning_en: insane; crazy

examples.text: After years in solitary confinement, the prisoner went mad.
examples.translation_cn: 在多年单独监禁后，那名囚犯疯了。

senses.meaning_en: angry; annoyed

examples.text: She was mad at me for forgetting her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 她因为我忘了她的生日而生气。

senses.meaning_en: enthusiastic; very fond of

examples.text: He is mad about jazz and goes to every concert.
examples.translation_cn: 他痴迷爵士乐，每场音乐会都去。

senses.meaning_en: foolish; unwise
senses.pattern: it is mad to do sth

examples.text: It was mad to go hiking in that storm.
examples.translation_cn: 在那种暴风雨中去远足是愚蠢的。

senses.meaning_en: to divide or make something divide into two or more parts, often along a straight line

examples.text: He split the log into two pieces with an axe.
examples.translation_cn: 他用斧头把木头劈成了两半。

senses.meaning_en: to share money, food, etc. between people

examples.text: We split the bill between the four of us.
examples.translation_cn: 我们四个人分摊了账单。

senses.meaning_en: to separate from a person or group; to end a relationship

examples.text: She split up with her boyfriend last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周和男朋友分手了。

senses.meaning_en: a crack or division in something

examples.text: The argument caused a split in the party.
examples.translation_cn: 这场争论导致了党内的分裂。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a group to disagree strongly and divide into opposing groups

examples.text: The issue of immigration split the party into two rival camps.
examples.translation_cn: 移民问题使该党分裂成两个对立阵营。

senses.meaning_en: completely; entirely

examples.text: The two situations are altogether different from each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种情况截然不同。

senses.meaning_en: on the whole; all things considered

examples.text: Altogether, the project was well planned and well run.
examples.translation_cn: 总的来说，这个项目规划得很好，执行得也很好。

senses.meaning_en: in total; all together

examples.text: There were twelve of us altogether at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们总共十二个人参加了会议。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being useful

examples.text: The manual is of little utility to new users.
examples.translation_cn: 这本手册对新用户几乎没有用处。

senses.meaning_en: a public service such as water or electricity

examples.text: Water supply is a public utility that everyone relies on.
examples.translation_cn: 供水是每个人都依赖的公用事业。

senses.meaning_en: providing useful help

examples.text: This guide is particularly helpful for understanding the basic grammar rules.
examples.translation_cn: 这本指南对理解基本语法规则特别有帮助。

senses.meaning_en: willing to help other people

examples.text: The hotel staff were helpful to everyone who asked for advice.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店员工对每个寻求建议的人都乐于帮助。

senses.meaning_en: a main public road, especially a multi-lane, high-speed thoroughfare

examples.text: The truck broke down on the highway during rush hour.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆卡车在交通高峰时段在公路上抛锚了。

senses.meaning_en: a way or path that leads to a particular outcome

examples.text: Reading widely is the highway to knowledge and wisdom.
examples.translation_cn: 广泛阅读是通往知识和智慧的途径。

senses.meaning_en: the state of continuing to live or exist, especially after danger

examples.text: The trapped miners struggled for survival until rescue teams reached them.
examples.translation_cn: 被困矿工挣扎求生，直到救援队找到他们。

senses.meaning_en: something that continues to exist from an earlier time

examples.text: This village custom is a survival from the past, when people still worshipped local gods.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村子的习俗是从过去遗存下来的，那时人们还崇拜地方神灵。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of a team avoiding relegation to a lower league

examples.text: The club's survival in the league now depends on winning the final two games.
examples.translation_cn: 俱乐部能否保级现在取决于赢下最后两场比赛。

senses.meaning_en: to move or be moved into something

examples.text: The heavy stone sank slowly into the deep water.
examples.translation_cn: 那块沉重的石头慢慢沉入深水中。

senses.meaning_en: a large open container in a kitchen or bathroom for washing things

examples.text: She left the dirty dishes in the kitchen sink.
examples.translation_cn: 她把脏盘子留在厨房水槽里。

senses.meaning_en: to decrease in volume or level; to subside

examples.text: Share prices sank to a record low yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 昨天股价跌至历史新低。

senses.meaning_en: to become overwhelmed or depressed; to fail in strength

examples.text: After losing his job, he sank into deep depression.
examples.translation_cn: 失去工作后，他陷入深度抑郁。

senses.meaning_en: a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machines

examples.text: He works in a small workshop that repairs bicycles.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家修理自行车的小工场工作。

senses.meaning_en: a brief intensive course or conference for a small group, emphasizing interaction and practical problem solving

examples.text: She attended a writing workshop at the community center last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周末在社区中心参加了一个写作讲习班。

senses.meaning_en: to work on or revise something, especially collaboratively, in a workshop

examples.text: The team will workshop the proposal before presenting it to the board.
examples.translation_cn: 团队将在向董事会提交之前集体研讨这项提案。

senses.meaning_en: a formal talk given to an audience, especially to teach them about a subject

examples.text: She gave a lecture on modern art at the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 她在博物馆作了一场关于现代艺术的讲座。

senses.meaning_en: a class at a college or university that consists mainly of lectures

examples.text: I have a history lecture on Mondays and Wednesdays.
examples.translation_cn: 我周一和周三有历史讲座课。

senses.meaning_en: a long serious talk that criticizes or warns somebody

examples.text: Dad gave me a long lecture about staying out late.
examples.translation_cn: 爸爸就我在外面待到很晚训斥了我一顿。

senses.meaning_en: to give a lecture or series of lectures, especially as a teacher

examples.text: She lectures in economics at the local university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地大学教授经济学。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize or warn somebody in a long serious talk

examples.text: My boss lectured me for missing the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 老板因我错过截止日期而训斥了我。

senses.meaning_en: one of the substances present in a mixture, especially food

examples.text: Onions are the main ingredient in this soup.
examples.translation_cn: 洋葱是这道汤的主要原料。

senses.meaning_en: a necessary element to achieve a certain goal; a component
