examples.translation_cn: 她的铜色头发在秋光中闪闪发亮。

senses.meaning_en: a place where someone lives; a home or building used as a home

examples.text: Police found the suspect at his residence late last night.
examples.translation_cn: 警方昨晚深夜在他的住所找到了嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: the state of living in a particular place

examples.text: After five years of residence in Berlin, she speaks German fluently.
examples.translation_cn: 在柏林居住五年后，她的德语说得很流利。

senses.meaning_en: accommodation for students at a university or college

examples.text: Many first-year students live in residence during their first two terms.
examples.translation_cn: 许多一年级学生在头两个学期住在大学宿舍。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lacks good judgment or intelligence

examples.text: He felt like a fool after believing her obvious lie.
examples.translation_cn: 相信了她明显的谎言后，他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

senses.meaning_en: to trick or deceive someone

examples.text: Don't let his quiet voice fool you into underestimating him.
examples.translation_cn: 别让他平静的语气骗你低估了他。

senses.meaning_en: to act in a silly or foolish way

examples.text: Stop fooling around or we'll miss the last train.
examples.translation_cn: 别瞎闹了，否则我们会错过末班火车。

senses.meaning_en: the title or topic of a document, article, chapter, or section

examples.text: The report was published under the heading of 'Local News'.
examples.translation_cn: 那篇报道发表在“本地新闻”的标题下。

senses.meaning_en: the direction in which a ship or aircraft is pointing or moving

examples.text: The aircraft flew on a heading of 320 degrees.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机以320度的航向飞行。

senses.meaning_en: a government department or office

examples.text: The bureau of environmental protection issued new rules.
examples.translation_cn: 环保局发布了新规定。

senses.meaning_en: an organization or office for collecting or providing information or news

examples.text: She works as a reporter at the news bureau.
examples.translation_cn: 她在新闻局当记者。

senses.meaning_en: a writing desk

examples.text: She sat at her bureau and wrote a thank-you note.
examples.translation_cn: 她坐在写字台前写感谢信。

senses.meaning_en: a chest of drawers for clothes

examples.text: He keeps his sweaters in the bureau drawer during the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏天，他把毛衣放在五斗橱抽屉里。

senses.meaning_en: a thick piece of soft material for sitting or lying on

examples.text: She sat on a thick pad to make the bench more comfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 她坐在一块厚垫子上，让长椅更舒服。

senses.meaning_en: the soft part at the end of a finger, toe, or animal's paw

examples.text: The pad of her index finger was sore after writing all day.
examples.translation_cn: 她写了一天字，食指指垫很疼。

senses.meaning_en: a number of sheets of paper fastened together at one edge

examples.text: He wrote the phone number on a pad by the telephone.
examples.translation_cn: 他把电话号码写在电话旁的便签本上。

senses.meaning_en: the flat floating leaf of a water lily

examples.text: A frog sat on a lily pad in the pond.
examples.translation_cn: 一只青蛙坐在池塘中的睡莲叶上。

senses.meaning_en: in a sad manner; sorrowfully

examples.text: She said goodbye sadly and left the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她悲伤地道别，然后离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: unfortunately; sad to say

examples.text: Sadly, the event was called off due to bad weather.
examples.translation_cn: 遗憾的是，由于天气不好，活动取消了。

senses.meaning_en: badly; terribly

examples.text: The house was sadly neglected for many years.
examples.translation_cn: 这所房子多年来严重失修。

senses.meaning_en: to spread or pass (a disease, etc.) from one person to another

examples.text: The flu virus is transmitted from one person to another.
examples.translation_cn: 流感病毒会在人与人之间传播。

senses.meaning_en: to send out or communicate (a signal, message, etc.) electronically

examples.text: The satellite transmits data to Earth in real time.
examples.translation_cn: 卫星将数据实时传送至地球。

senses.meaning_en: to conduct (heat, electricity, sound, etc.) through a medium

examples.text: Copper wires transmit electricity more efficiently than iron.
examples.translation_cn: 铜线比铁更有效地传导电能。

senses.meaning_en: the act of sending out signals or programmes by radio, television, etc.

examples.text: The live transmission of the ceremony will begin at eight.
examples.translation_cn: 仪式的现场直播将在八点开始。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of passing something from one person, place or thing to another; the spread of a disease

examples.text: The transmission of the virus is highest in crowded places.
examples.translation_cn: 这种病毒在拥挤场所的传播率最高。

senses.meaning_en: the system of gears in a vehicle that passes power from the engine to the wheels
senses.pattern: be equipped with an automatic transmission

examples.text: The new car is equipped with an automatic transmission.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆新车配备自动变速器。

senses.meaning_en: the painful feeling of guilt or embarrassment caused by doing something wrong or foolish

examples.text: He felt shame at having lied to his parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对父母撒谎而感到羞愧。

senses.meaning_en: a situation or fact that makes you feel sad or disappointed

examples.text: It's a shame that you missed the concert last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚你错过了音乐会，真遗憾。

senses.meaning_en: disgrace; a person or thing that causes disgrace

examples.text: His behaviour was a shame to his family.
examples.translation_cn: 他的行为使家人蒙羞。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to feel guilty or embarrassed about one's own bad behaviour
senses.pattern: have no shame about doing sth

examples.text: He has no shame about borrowing money from his children.
examples.translation_cn: 他向自己的孩子们借钱也不觉得难为情。

senses.meaning_en: the act of disuniting two or more things, or the condition of being separated

examples.text: The separation of church and state is written into the constitution.
examples.translation_cn: 政教分离被写入宪法。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time spent apart from someone

examples.text: After years of separation, they finally met again.
examples.translation_cn: 分离多年后，他们终于重逢。

senses.meaning_en: the state or arrangement of a married couple living apart

examples.text: They agreed to a trial separation after months of arguing.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵数月后，他们同意试行分居。

senses.meaning_en: to accidentally pour or drop liquid so that it spreads out

examples.text: I accidentally spilled coffee on my white shirt this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我不小心把咖啡洒在了白衬衫上。

senses.meaning_en: to spread out or fall out of a container

examples.text: Water spilled out of the bottle and soaked the tablecloth.
examples.translation_cn: 水从瓶子里溢出来，浸湿了桌布。

senses.meaning_en: to overflow out of a designated area or space

examples.text: The crowd spilled into the street after the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会结束后，人群涌到了街上。

senses.meaning_en: a flat paper cover for a letter

examples.text: She put the letter in an envelope and sealed it.
examples.translation_cn: 她把信放进信封里并封好。

senses.meaning_en: something that surrounds or covers
senses.pattern: be surrounded by an envelope of sth

examples.text: The earth is surrounded by an envelope of air.
examples.translation_cn: 地球被一层空气包裹着。

senses.meaning_en: to turn or bend something out of its normal shape

examples.text: She twisted the metal wire into a spiral for the sculpture.
examples.translation_cn: 她把金属丝扭成螺旋形用于雕塑。

senses.meaning_en: to injure a joint by turning it suddenly

examples.text: I twisted my ankle while running on the uneven path.
examples.translation_cn: 我在不平的小路上跑步时扭伤了脚踝。

senses.meaning_en: an unexpected change in a story or situation

examples.text: The film's ending has a clever twist in the plot that no one expected.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影结尾有一个没人预料到的巧妙情节转折。

senses.meaning_en: an act of twisting something

examples.text: Give the cap a firm twist to open the bottle.
examples.translation_cn: 用力拧一下盖子打开瓶子。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of lemon peel used to flavour a drink

examples.text: She added a twist of lemon to her iced tea for extra flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 她往冰茶里加了一片柠檬皮增添风味。

senses.meaning_en: a straight, thin piece of wood or metal, often used as a support or tool

examples.text: A metal rod was fixed to the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 一根金属杆被固定在墙上。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thin pole used as part of the frame of a tent or other structure

examples.text: The strong wind bent the tent rods in the night.
examples.translation_cn: 夜里强风吹弯了帐篷杆。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thin pole used for catching fish, typically with a line and hook attached

examples.text: He sat on the bank holding a fishing rod.
examples.translation_cn: 他坐在岸边，拿着一根鱼竿。

senses.meaning_en: a stick or bundle of sticks used to punish someone, especially by hitting them

examples.text: In some schools, children were once beaten with the rod.
examples.translation_cn: 过去在一些学校里，孩子们会被用棍子打。

senses.meaning_en: a long-bladed weapon with a handle and a guard, used for cutting or thrusting

examples.text: The soldier drew his sword and stood ready to fight.
examples.translation_cn: 那名士兵拔出剑，准备战斗。

senses.meaning_en: military force or violence

examples.text: They conquered the city by the sword after a long siege.
examples.translation_cn: 他们经过长期围攻后以武力攻占了那座城市。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid or substance that can flow

examples.text: Drink plenty of fluids when you have a fever.
examples.translation_cn: 发烧时要多喝水。

senses.meaning_en: likely to change; not fixed

examples.text: The political situation remains fluid after the election.
examples.translation_cn: 选举后政治局势仍不稳定。

senses.meaning_en: smooth and graceful

examples.text: He performed the routine with fluid movements and perfect timing.
examples.translation_cn: 他以流畅优美的动作完成了整套动作。

senses.meaning_en: liquid given to a patient through a tube into a vein

examples.text: The patient was on intravenous fluids for two days after surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后病人接受了两天静脉输液。

senses.meaning_en: honest and fair; showing moral integrity

examples.text: He is a decent person who always keeps his word.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个正派人，总是信守诺言。

senses.meaning_en: of a good enough standard or amount; fairly large

examples.text: We made a decent profit from the sale last year.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去年从这笔买卖中获得了可观的利润。

senses.meaning_en: conforming to good taste; appropriate

examples.text: They wore decent clothes to the formal ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 他们穿着得体的衣服参加正式典礼。

senses.meaning_en: wearing enough clothes to be seen

examples.text: Wait outside for a moment until I'm decent.
examples.translation_cn: 在外面等一会儿，等我穿好衣服。

senses.meaning_en: to carry or transport something from one place to another
senses.pattern: convey sth from A to B

examples.text: The pipeline conveys natural gas from the coast to the city.
examples.translation_cn: 这条管道将天然气从海岸输送到城市。

senses.meaning_en: to communicate or make known a message, feeling, etc.

examples.text: I want to convey my sincere thanks to all the volunteers.
examples.translation_cn: 我想向所有志愿者表达诚挚的感谢。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of cloth used for drying things or yourself

examples.text: She quickly dried her hair with a towel.
examples.translation_cn: 她迅速用毛巾擦干了头发。

senses.meaning_en: to dry yourself or someone with a towel

examples.text: He quickly towelled himself dry after his shower.
examples.translation_cn: 他淋浴后迅速用毛巾擦干身体。

senses.meaning_en: an agreement reached by mutual concessions

examples.text: The two sides finally reached a compromise between cost and quality.
examples.translation_cn: 双方最终在成本和质量之间达成了妥协。

senses.meaning_en: to make mutual concessions

examples.text: The government refused to compromise on tax reform.
examples.translation_cn: 政府拒绝在税收改革上妥协。

senses.meaning_en: to cause impairment of

examples.text: The safety of the bridge was compromised by years of neglect.
examples.translation_cn: 大桥的安全因多年疏忽而受到损害。

senses.meaning_en: to go and get something or someone

examples.text: Could you fetch me a glass of water?
examples.translation_cn: 你能给我拿杯水吗？

senses.meaning_en: to sell for a particular price

examples.text: The painting fetched a high price at auction.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画在拍卖会上卖得高价。

senses.meaning_en: to increase or improve something

examples.text: The new ad campaign helped boost sales by 30 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 新的广告活动帮助销售额增长了30%。

senses.meaning_en: something that helps or increases something; an increase or improvement

examples.text: The tax cuts gave a welcome boost to the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 减税给经济带来了可喜的推动。

senses.meaning_en: to lift or push someone from behind, especially to help them climb

examples.text: She boosted her son up so he could reach the branch.
examples.translation_cn: 她把儿子托起来，使他能够到那根树枝。

senses.meaning_en: a small flying animal that comes out at night

examples.text: A bat in flight uses sound to avoid obstacles in the dark.
examples.translation_cn: 一只飞行中的蝙蝠利用声音在黑暗中躲避障碍物。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of wood or metal used to hit the ball in games
senses.pattern: hit the ball with a bat

examples.text: He hit the ball with a bat and scored a run.
examples.translation_cn: 他用球棒击球并得分。

senses.meaning_en: a turn at hitting the ball in baseball or cricket

examples.text: Their best player was at bat when the rain started.
examples.translation_cn: 他们最好的球员轮到击球时下起了雨。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture with shelves and a door, used for storing food, dishes, or other items

examples.text: She keeps her spices in the cupboard next to the stove.
examples.translation_cn: 她把香料放在炉子旁边的橱柜里。

senses.meaning_en: lacking strength or clarity; barely perceptible

examples.text: She felt faint from hunger and had to sit down.
examples.translation_cn: 她饿得浑身无力，只好坐下。

senses.meaning_en: lacking courage or spirit
senses.collocation: not for the faint of heart

examples.text: This horror film is not for the faint of heart.
examples.translation_cn: 这部恐怖片不适合胆小的人看。

senses.meaning_en: to lose consciousness suddenly

examples.text: He fainted from the heat during the afternoon ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 下午仪式上他因高温昏倒了。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden loss of consciousness

examples.text: She collapsed in a faint after the shocking news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到这个令人震惊的消息后，她昏倒在地。

senses.meaning_en: the salty liquid that appears on your skin when you are hot or nervous; the state of sweating

examples.text: After the long climb, he was soaked in sweat.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间攀登后，他浑身是汗。

senses.meaning_en: to produce sweat through your skin because you are hot or doing exercise

examples.text: The players were sweating heavily in the afternoon heat.
examples.translation_cn: 球员们在午后的高温下大汗淋漓。

senses.meaning_en: to feel very worried or nervous about something

examples.text: He has been sweating about his interview all week.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个星期都在为面试担心。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of time or a particular time interval

examples.text: The duration of the flight was just under three hours.
examples.translation_cn: 航程持续了将近三个小时。

senses.meaning_en: the time until the current situation ends, especially the current war

examples.text: The train service will be reduced for the duration.
examples.translation_cn: 火车服务将减少班次，直到局势结束。

senses.meaning_en: a way of pronouncing words; a tone of voice

examples.text: She speaks English with a faint French accent.
examples.translation_cn: 她说英语带着淡淡的法国口音。

senses.meaning_en: stress placed on a particular syllable

examples.text: In the word computer, the accent is on the second syllable.
examples.translation_cn: 在 computer 一词中，重音在第二个音节上。

senses.meaning_en: special importance or emphasis

examples.text: The government has put the accent on improving public transport.
examples.translation_cn: 政府把重点放在改善公共交通上。

senses.meaning_en: a mark on a letter showing pronunciation or stress

examples.text: The word café is written with an acute accent on the e.
examples.translation_cn: 单词 café 的 e 上有尖音符。

senses.meaning_en: intoxicated by alcohol

examples.text: He got drunk on cheap wine at the office party.
examples.translation_cn: 他在办公室聚会上喝廉价葡萄酒喝醉了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has drunk too much alcohol

examples.text: A drunk in the street was shouting at passers-by.
examples.translation_cn: 一个醉汉在街上冲着路人喊叫。

senses.meaning_en: overcome with emotion such as joy or power

examples.text: She was drunk with joy when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到这个消息，她欣喜若狂。

senses.meaning_en: a series of people or things that follow one another

examples.text: A succession of scandals forced the minister to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 一连串丑闻迫使这位部长辞职。

senses.meaning_en: the action or process of following in order

examples.text: It snowed for four days in succession last week.
examples.translation_cn: 上周连续下了四天雪。

senses.meaning_en: the act of taking over an official position or title

examples.text: The prince is first in succession to the throne.
examples.translation_cn: 这位王子是王位第一顺位继承人。

senses.meaning_en: the direction or area halfway between east and south

examples.text: The airport is just southeast of the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 机场就在市中心东南方。

senses.meaning_en: of, in or pertaining to the southeast; southeastern

examples.text: They bought a house on the southeast coast of the island.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在岛的东南海岸买了一所房子。

senses.meaning_en: coming from the southeast; southeasterly

examples.text: A steady southeast wind brought heavy rain to the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 持续的东南风给海岸带来了大雨。

senses.meaning_en: towards or in the direction of the southeast; southeastwards

examples.text: The hurricane is expected to head southeast overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 飓风预计将在一夜之间向东南方向移动。

senses.meaning_en: a natural substance in food that is needed in small amounts to keep the body healthy

examples.text: Fresh vegetables and fruit are rich in essential vitamins.
examples.translation_cn: 新鲜蔬菜和水果富含必需的维生素。

senses.meaning_en: a strong alcoholic drink made from grain

examples.text: He bought a bottle of whisky for his father's birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 他买了一瓶威士忌给他父亲过生日。

senses.meaning_en: a glass of this drink

examples.text: She ordered a whisky and a glass of water.
examples.translation_cn: 她点了一杯威士忌和一杯水。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being probable

examples.text: There is a probability that the flight will be delayed.
examples.translation_cn: 航班有可能延误。

senses.meaning_en: a number between 0 and 1 expressing the likelihood of an event

examples.text: The probability of rolling a six is one in six.
examples.translation_cn: 掷出六点的概率是六分之一。

senses.meaning_en: an event that is likely to occur
senses.pattern: there is a strong probability that...

examples.text: There is a strong probability that the company will be sold.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司很有可能被出售。

senses.meaning_en: a colourless gas that living things need to survive

examples.text: Fish take in oxygen from the water through their gills.
examples.translation_cn: 鱼通过鳃从水中摄取氧气。

senses.meaning_en: an atom of oxygen

examples.text: An oxygen atom has eight protons in its nucleus.
examples.translation_cn: 一个氧原子核内有八个质子。

senses.meaning_en: oxygen given to a patient to help them breathe

examples.text: The patient has been on oxygen since the surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 这位病人手术后一直在吸氧。

senses.meaning_en: words that express approval or admiration

examples.text: The mayor gave a speech in praise of the new hospital staff.
examples.translation_cn: 市长发表讲话赞扬新医院的工作人员。

senses.meaning_en: worship or glorification, especially of God

examples.text: The choir sang hymns in praise of God.
examples.translation_cn: 唱诗班唱赞美诗颂扬上帝。

senses.meaning_en: to worship or glorify (especially God)

examples.text: They gathered to praise God for a safe harvest.
examples.translation_cn: 他们聚集在一起赞美上帝赐予平安的丰收。

senses.meaning_en: to express approval or admiration for somebody/something

examples.text: The teacher praised her for her clear explanation.
examples.translation_cn: 老师因为她清晰的讲解而表扬了她。

senses.meaning_en: to mate and produce young

examples.text: Rabbits breed quickly and can produce several litters each year.
examples.translation_cn: 兔子繁殖很快，每年能产下好几窝。

senses.meaning_en: to keep and selectively reproduce animals

examples.text: They breed dogs for their calm nature and intelligence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们培育性格温顺、聪明的狗。

senses.meaning_en: to cause (something) to happen

examples.text: Unemployment in the region often breeds crime and social unrest.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的失业常常导致犯罪和社会动荡。

senses.meaning_en: a type of animal, plant, or person

examples.text: The collie is a breed of dog known for herding sheep.
examples.translation_cn: 柯利牧羊犬是一种以牧羊闻名的犬种。

senses.meaning_en: having no end

examples.text: The universe offers endless possibilities for scientific discovery.
examples.translation_cn: 宇宙为科学发现提供了无穷的可能性。

senses.meaning_en: continuing for too long and seeming to have no end, often in a way that is boring

examples.text: The team grew tired of the endless round of budget meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 团队对没完没了的预算会议感到厌烦。

senses.meaning_en: a meeting at which people discuss a subject, especially for work or study

examples.text: Our company is holding a seminar on digital marketing next month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们公司下个月将举办一场数字营销研讨会。

senses.meaning_en: a class at university in which a small group of students and a teacher discuss a subject

examples.text: Professor Lin leads a seminar in medieval literature every Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 林教授每周二主持中世纪文学研讨课。

senses.meaning_en: a state of complete disorder and confusion

examples.text: After the earthquake, the city was in chaos.
examples.translation_cn: 地震过后，城市一片混乱。

senses.meaning_en: the formless matter before the creation of the universe in mythology

examples.text: In early Greek cosmology, the ordered universe arose out of chaos.
examples.translation_cn: 在古希腊宇宙论中，有序宇宙从混沌中诞生。

senses.meaning_en: a short summary of a longer publication or speech

examples.text: Please submit the abstract of your research paper by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请在星期五之前提交你研究论文的摘要。

senses.meaning_en: based on general ideas rather than specific things; not representing reality in art

examples.text: Freedom is an abstract concept, not a physical object.
examples.translation_cn: 自由是一个抽象概念，而不是有形的物体。

senses.meaning_en: an abstract work of art, such as a painting or sculpture

examples.text: She plans to paint a large abstract for the gallery's summer show.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划为美术馆的夏季展览画一幅大型抽象作品。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to understand; abstruse

examples.text: His reasoning was too abstract for most students to follow.
examples.translation_cn: 他的推理对大多数学生来说太抽象，难以理解。

senses.meaning_en: a person chosen or elected to represent others, especially at a meeting or conference

examples.text: She was elected as a delegate to the international trade summit.
examples.translation_cn: 她当选为国际贸易峰会的代表。

senses.meaning_en: to give part of your work, power or authority to sb in a lower position than you

examples.text: A good manager learns to delegate tasks to team members.
examples.translation_cn: 好的管理者学会把任务委派给团队成员。

senses.meaning_en: to appoint sb as your representative, especially to attend a meeting or discussion

examples.text: The board delegated the vice president to negotiate with the union.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会委派副总裁与工会谈判。

senses.meaning_en: a strong, coarse cloth used for making tents, sails, bags and clothes

examples.text: The tent is made of thick waterproof canvas.
examples.translation_cn: 这个帐篷是用厚实的防水帆布做的。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of strong cloth stretched across a frame, used for painting on

examples.text: She painted a portrait on a large canvas.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一块大画布上画了一幅肖像。

senses.meaning_en: a basis or background for creative work

examples.text: Artists often use the city as a canvas for their work.
examples.translation_cn: 艺术家们常常把城市当作创作的画布。

senses.meaning_en: following one after another in a series

examples.text: The team won the cup for three successive years.
examples.translation_cn: 这支球队连续三年赢得奖杯。

senses.meaning_en: to say sorry for a fault or problem; to express regret

examples.text: We apologize to passengers for the delay in departure.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为航班延误向乘客道歉。

senses.meaning_en: a long, strong piece of wood or metal used to support a building

examples.text: A steel beam supports the weight of the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 一根钢梁支撑着屋顶的重量。

senses.meaning_en: a line of light that shines from a bright object

examples.text: A bright beam of light shone through the window.
examples.translation_cn: 一束明亮的光线从窗户照进来。

senses.meaning_en: to smile happily and warmly

examples.text: She beamed at the children during the school play.
examples.translation_cn: 学校演出时她对着孩子们眉开眼笑。

senses.meaning_en: similar and able to be compared

examples.text: This year's results are comparable with those of last year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年的结果与去年的差不多。

senses.meaning_en: as good as someone or something else

examples.text: Her performance is comparable to that of any professional dancer.
examples.translation_cn: 她的表演可与任何专业舞者媲美。

senses.meaning_en: thick; having high density

examples.text: The forest was dense with ancient oaks and ferns.
examples.translation_cn: 森林里长满了古老的橡树和蕨类植物，非常茂密。

senses.meaning_en: slow to understand; stupid
senses.pattern: be too dense to do sth

examples.text: He is too dense to realize when someone is joking.
examples.translation_cn: 他太迟钝，别人开玩笑时都意识不到。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to understand; obscure

examples.text: The article was too dense for most readers to finish.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章太难懂，大多数读者都读不完。

senses.meaning_en: the degree to which something is dense, especially mass per unit volume

examples.text: The density of water is greater than that of ice.
examples.translation_cn: 水的密度比冰大。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of having parts close together or a large amount in a given area

examples.text: The plants are grown at high density to save space.
examples.translation_cn: 这些植物以高密度种植以节省空间。

senses.meaning_en: the act of installing something, especially equipment or software

examples.text: The installation of the new heating system took two days.
examples.translation_cn: 新供暖系统的安装花了两天时间。

senses.meaning_en: a work of installation art

examples.text: The gallery is showing a large installation by a contemporary artist.
examples.translation_cn: 美术馆正在展出一件当代艺术家创作的大型装置作品。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment or a system that has been put in place for a particular purpose

examples.text: The power plant has a special installation for cooling the reactors.
examples.translation_cn: 发电厂有一套用于冷却反应堆的特殊装置。

senses.meaning_en: a group of buildings and equipment that form a permanent military base

examples.text: Photography is strictly prohibited on the military installation.
examples.translation_cn: 军事基地内严禁拍照。

senses.meaning_en: the short thick finger on the side of the hand

examples.text: She held the coin between her thumb and forefinger.
examples.translation_cn: 她用拇指和食指捏着硬币。

senses.meaning_en: the movable part of a slider on a computer screen

examples.text: Drag the thumb to the bottom of the scroll bar.
examples.translation_cn: 将滑块拖到滚动条底部。

senses.meaning_en: a small version of an image used as a preview

examples.text: Click on a thumb to see the full-size photo.
examples.translation_cn: 点击缩略图以查看全尺寸照片。

senses.meaning_en: very bad or unpleasant

examples.text: It is horrible to be stuck in traffic for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 堵车几个小时真糟糕。

senses.meaning_en: causing horror or great fear

examples.text: The child woke up screaming from a horrible nightmare.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子从可怕的噩梦中尖叫着醒来。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange or put into groups according to type; to decide which group something belongs to

examples.text: Biologists classify whales as marine mammals, not fish.
examples.translation_cn: 生物学家将鲸归为海洋哺乳动物，而不是鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to declare something secret, especially a government secret

examples.text: The government classified those files as confidential after the leak.
examples.translation_cn: 泄露发生后，政府将那些文件定为机密。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of grouping things according to shared qualities
senses.pattern: the classification of sth into sth

examples.text: The classification of plants into families is a key part of botany.
examples.translation_cn: 将植物分入科是植物学的一个关键部分。

senses.meaning_en: a group or rank into which something is placed

examples.text: The document has a security classification, so access is restricted.
examples.translation_cn: 这份文件有安全等级，因此访问受到限制。

senses.meaning_en: to move apart in different directions; to disperse

examples.text: The crowd scattered in all directions when the fireworks began.
examples.translation_cn: 烟花开始时，人群四散而去。

senses.meaning_en: to cause people or animals to move apart in different directions

examples.text: A loud noise scattered the birds from the tree.
examples.translation_cn: 一声巨响把鸟从树上惊散了。

senses.meaning_en: to throw or drop things so that they spread over an area

examples.text: Farmers scatter seeds over the soil in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天农民把种子撒在土壤上。

senses.meaning_en: to occur or be found at widely spaced intervals

examples.text: Isolated showers scattered across the highlands last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚，局部阵雨零星分布在高地。

senses.meaning_en: a utensil with a handle and several prongs, used for eating or serving food

examples.text: She carefully lifted the hot noodles with a fork.
examples.translation_cn: 她用叉子小心地挑起热面条。

senses.meaning_en: a place where a road, path, river, etc. divides into two or more parts

examples.text: We came to a fork in the road and turned left.
examples.translation_cn: 我们来到一个岔路口，然后向左转。

senses.meaning_en: (in chess) a situation in which one piece attacks two of the opponent's pieces at the same time

examples.text: The knight created a fork, attacking both the king and queen.
examples.translation_cn: 马走出了一着捉双，同时攻击国王和王后。

senses.meaning_en: a point in time when you have to make a decision between two different paths or possibilities
senses.pattern: at a fork in the road
senses.collocation: come to a fork in the road

examples.text: At a fork in the road, she had to choose between medicine and law.
examples.translation_cn: 站在人生的岔路口，她不得不在学医和学法律之间做出选择。

senses.meaning_en: to bring your eyebrows together in an expression of displeasure, worry, or concentration

examples.text: She frowned in concentration as she studied the small print.
examples.translation_cn: 她仔细阅读小字时专注地皱着眉。

senses.meaning_en: to disapprove of something

examples.text: The school frowns on using phones in class.
examples.translation_cn: 学校不赞成在课堂上使用手机。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel less worried or anxious

examples.text: A phone call from the rescue team relieved my mind.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队打来的电话让我放心了。

senses.meaning_en: to make pain, stress, or another unpleasant feeling less severe

examples.text: These simple exercises can relieve back pain quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 这些简单的锻炼能迅速缓解背痛。

senses.meaning_en: to take over a job or duty from someone

examples.text: The soldier was relieved from sentry duty at midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 这名士兵午夜时分被人接替下岗。

senses.meaning_en: to remove someone from a position or responsibility, especially as a punishment or because they can no longer do it

examples.text: The captain was relieved of his command after the failed mission.
examples.translation_cn: 任务失败后，上尉被解除了指挥权。

senses.meaning_en: to get involved in a situation where you are not wanted or needed

examples.text: Please don't interfere in their argument; let them sort it out.
examples.translation_cn: 请不要干涉他们的争论；让他们自己解决。

senses.meaning_en: of waves, to combine so that they affect each other and form a pattern

examples.text: The two light waves interfere with each other to produce bright and dark bands.
examples.translation_cn: 两个光波相互干涉，产生明暗条纹。

senses.meaning_en: in a separate manner; not together; apart

examples.text: The twins traveled separately from each other for the first time.
examples.translation_cn: 这对双胞胎第一次分开旅行。

senses.meaning_en: individually; one by one

examples.text: Each application is considered separately by the committee.
examples.translation_cn: 每份申请由委员会逐份审议。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sorry about something that has happened, wishing it had not happened

examples.text: She regrets not studying harder for the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她后悔没有更努力地准备考试。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sorry about something, used when giving bad news

examples.text: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
examples.translation_cn: 我们遗憾地通知您，您的申请未成功。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of sadness or disappointment about something that has happened or been done

examples.text: It is with deep regret that we announce the cancellation of the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 我们深表遗憾地宣布音乐会取消。

senses.meaning_en: a person's name written by themselves as identification or approval

examples.text: Please put your signature on the last page of the contract.
examples.translation_cn: 请在合同最后一页签上你的名字。

senses.meaning_en: a distinctive feature or quality that makes something recognizable

examples.text: The use of natural light is the signature of her photographs.
examples.translation_cn: 自然光的运用是她摄影作品的鲜明特色。

senses.meaning_en: gentle and not easily angered

examples.text: My grandfather was mild by nature and never raised his voice.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父天生脾气温和，从不提高嗓门。

senses.meaning_en: not severe or strong

examples.text: She had only a mild case of flu and recovered in a few days.
examples.translation_cn: 她只是得了轻微流感，几天就康复了。

senses.meaning_en: not very cold and quite pleasant

examples.text: We had a mild winter this year, with almost no snow.
examples.translation_cn: 今年冬天天气温和，几乎没下雪。

senses.meaning_en: not sharp or bitter; not strong in flavor

examples.text: This cheese is mild in flavor, so it appeals to people who dislike strong tastes.
examples.translation_cn: 这种奶酪味道淡，所以很合不喜欢浓烈口味的人心意。

senses.meaning_en: easily damaged or broken

examples.text: These wine glasses are too delicate to wash in a dishwasher.
examples.translation_cn: 这些酒杯太易碎，不能在洗碗机里清洗。

senses.meaning_en: requiring careful handling; sensitive
senses.pattern: a delicate balance between A and B

examples.text: He managed to strike a delicate balance between work and family.
examples.translation_cn: 他设法在工作和家庭之间取得了微妙的平衡。

senses.meaning_en: fine in structure or shape; slender

examples.text: The portrait shows a woman with delicate features.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅肖像画的是一个五官精致的女人。

senses.meaning_en: refined and gentle in manner

examples.text: She has delicate manners that put guests at ease.
examples.translation_cn: 她举止文雅，让客人感到自在。

senses.meaning_en: to start again or continue after a pause or interruption

examples.text: The two countries will resume talks next week.
examples.translation_cn: 两国将于下周恢复谈判。

senses.meaning_en: a short written account of your education and work experience, used when applying for a job

examples.text: Applicants should submit a resume and a cover letter by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 申请人应在周五前提交简历和求职信。

senses.meaning_en: a person who works casually, not permanently

examples.text: He works as a casual at the docks during summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他夏天在码头当临时工。

senses.meaning_en: informal; relaxed

examples.text: He wore casual clothes to the Friday meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿着休闲装参加了周五的会议。

senses.meaning_en: showing little care or thought; not serious or deep

examples.text: She was far too casual about her final exams.
examples.translation_cn: 她对期末考试太漫不经心了。

senses.meaning_en: happening by chance; without regularity; occasional

examples.text: They had a casual encounter at the railway station.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在火车站偶然相遇。

senses.meaning_en: the number 17

examples.text: My sister is seventeen years old and will start college this fall.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹十七岁，今年秋天将要上大学。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to exist

examples.text: The heavy fog persisted for most of the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 大雾持续了早晨大部分时间。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to do something despite difficulty or opposition

examples.text: He persisted in practicing the piano even when his neighbors complained.
examples.translation_cn: 即使邻居抱怨，他仍坚持练钢琴。

senses.meaning_en: to repeat an utterance; to continue to say something firmly

examples.text: He persisted that he had locked the door.
examples.translation_cn: 他坚称自己锁了门。

senses.meaning_en: to receive property, a title, etc. from somebody when they die

examples.text: She inherited a large house from her grandfather.
examples.translation_cn: 她从祖父那里继承了一栋大房子。

senses.meaning_en: to have a characteristic from a parent or ancestor by genetic transmission

examples.text: She inherited her blue eyes from her parents.
examples.translation_cn: 她遗传了父母的蓝眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: to receive a problem, situation, etc. from a predecessor

examples.text: The new manager inherited a complete mess from her predecessor.
examples.translation_cn: 新经理从前任那里接手了一个烂摊子。

senses.meaning_en: to receive something as a right, especially in biblical language

examples.text: Jesus taught that the meek shall inherit the earth.
examples.translation_cn: 耶稣教导说，温柔的人必承受地土。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline

examples.text: She gave her son a gentle kiss on his forehead.
examples.translation_cn: 她温柔地在儿子的额头上亲了一下。

senses.meaning_en: a curved object used for hanging or holding things

examples.text: Hang your wet coat on a hook by the door.
examples.translation_cn: 把你的湿外套挂在门边的钩子上。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp curved metal hook used for fishing

examples.text: He put a worm on the hook and waited.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一条虫子放在鱼钩上，然后等着。

senses.meaning_en: to attract and keep someone's interest or make them dependent

examples.text: Many teenagers are now hooked on video games.
examples.translation_cn: 许多青少年现在沉迷于电子游戏。

senses.meaning_en: to change direction after hitting a surface

examples.text: The ball bounced off the post and rolled back onto the pitch.
examples.translation_cn: 球击中门柱弹了回来，滚回场上。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to spring back after hitting a surface

examples.text: The tennis ball began to lose its bounce after hours of play.
examples.translation_cn: 打了几个小时后，这个网球开始失去弹性。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly up and down, once or repeatedly

examples.text: The kids bounced up and down on the trampoline for nearly an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在蹦床上上上下下跳了将近一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to move with sudden energy or jump up suddenly

examples.text: She bounced out of bed as soon as the alarm went off.
examples.translation_cn: 闹钟一响，她立刻从床上跳了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to suggest an idea to someone in order to get their feedback

examples.text: We bounced the new marketing plan off a few colleagues before the launch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在发布前就新营销计划征求了几位同事的意见。

senses.meaning_en: having a sharp slope or angle; rising or falling almost vertically

examples.text: The path is too steep to cycle up safely.
examples.translation_cn: 这条小路太陡，无法安全骑上去。

senses.meaning_en: too high; more than is reasonable or affordable

examples.text: The parking fee is too steep for most commuters.
examples.translation_cn: 停车费对大多数通勤者来说太高了。

senses.meaning_en: sudden and very large; rapid (of an increase or decrease)

examples.text: The country saw a steep fall in exports last quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家上个季度出口急剧下降。

senses.meaning_en: to soak something in a liquid; to be deeply filled or influenced by something

examples.text: The tea leaves are steeped in hot water for five minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 茶叶在热水中浸泡五分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to put something into something else or between two things

examples.text: You need to insert a coin into the machine to start it.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要往机器里投一枚硬币才能启动它。

senses.meaning_en: a part placed inside another part

examples.text: The metal insert in the plastic gear reduces wear.
examples.translation_cn: 塑料齿轮中的金属嵌件减少了磨损。

senses.meaning_en: an image placed inside a text

examples.text: The report contains a colour insert in the text to highlight the data.
examples.translation_cn: 报告文本中有一张彩色插图以突出数据。

senses.meaning_en: honor and fame

examples.text: The young pianist brought glory to her school by winning the international competition.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻钢琴家赢得国际比赛，为母校带来了荣耀。

senses.meaning_en: great beauty and splendor

examples.text: Visitors watched the sun rise over the mountains in all its glory.
examples.translation_cn: 游客们观赏着太阳升起，展现出全部壮丽。

senses.meaning_en: victory or success

examples.text: The athlete tasted glory by winning the world championship.
examples.translation_cn: 这位运动员赢得世界冠军，尝到了胜利的滋味。

senses.meaning_en: worship or praise

examples.text: The choir raised their voices to give glory to God.
examples.translation_cn: 唱诗班提高声音赞美上帝。

senses.meaning_en: to go out of or leave a place

examples.text: The audience exited through the side doors after the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会结束后，观众从侧门离开。

senses.meaning_en: a way out of a place

examples.text: Please use the nearest exit in an emergency.
examples.translation_cn: 紧急情况下请使用最近的出口。

senses.meaning_en: to end a computer program or process

examples.text: Press the Esc key to exit the program.
examples.translation_cn: 按 Esc 键退出程序。

senses.meaning_en: an act of leaving a place

examples.text: She made a quick exit from the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她匆匆离开了会议。

senses.meaning_en: strong in the face of fear; courageous
senses.pattern: it is brave of sb to do

examples.text: It was brave of her to speak up at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会上直言不讳，真勇敢。

senses.meaning_en: to face or endure (something dangerous or unpleasant) with courage

examples.text: Hundreds of fans braved the weather to watch the final match.
examples.translation_cn: 数百名球迷冒着风雨观看决赛。

senses.meaning_en: to cut cooked meat into pieces for serving

examples.text: Dad carved the roast into thin slices for Sunday dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 爸爸把烤肉切成薄片作为周日晚餐。

senses.meaning_en: to shape wood, stone, etc. by cutting

examples.text: She carved a small bird out of a piece of wood.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一块木头雕了一只小鸟。

senses.meaning_en: to create or achieve something through effort

examples.text: She carved out a successful career in journalism.
examples.translation_cn: 她在新闻界成功开创了一番事业。

senses.meaning_en: not complete; not whole

examples.text: The recovery in the region has been only partial.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的复苏只是部分的。

senses.meaning_en: biased in favor of a person, side, or point of view
senses.collocation: be partial towards the home team

examples.text: The referee was accused of being partial towards the home team.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判被指控偏袒主队。

senses.meaning_en: liking something or someone very much

examples.text: My grandmother has always been partial to strong tea.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母一直偏爱浓茶。

senses.meaning_en: a small container or package

examples.text: He opened a packet of biscuits and shared them with us.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开一包饼干和我们分享。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of data sent over a network

examples.text: The server sends a packet of data to each client.
examples.translation_cn: 服务器向每个客户端发送一个数据包。

senses.meaning_en: a small plastic bag or container, especially for food such as ketchup or sugar

examples.text: She squeezed a packet of ketchup onto her burger.
examples.translation_cn: 她往汉堡上挤了一小包番茄酱。

senses.meaning_en: a set of printed materials or documents provided together for a specific purpose, such as reading or study

examples.text: You need to register online to receive the reading packet for the course.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要在线注册才能收到课程的阅读材料包。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden feeling of fear

examples.text: I got a nasty scare when the car skidded towards me.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车朝我打滑时，我吓了一大跳。

senses.meaning_en: a situation that causes fear or panic

examples.text: The suspicious package caused a bomb scare at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 那个可疑包裹在机场引起了一场炸弹恐慌。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel frightened

examples.text: The sudden explosion scared the crowd near the stage.
examples.translation_cn: 突然的爆炸吓到了舞台附近的人群。

senses.meaning_en: to become frightened

examples.text: Horses scare easily when they hear loud noises.
examples.translation_cn: 马听到巨大噪音时容易受惊。

senses.meaning_en: requiring special abilities or training

examples.text: Nursing is skilled work that requires years of training.
examples.translation_cn: 护理是一项需要多年培训的技术工作。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing skill; skillful

examples.text: She is skilled at negotiating with difficult clients.
examples.translation_cn: 她善于与难打交道的客户谈判。

senses.meaning_en: a bus, train, or plane that travels regularly between two places

examples.text: We took the shuttle to the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘班车去了市中心。

senses.meaning_en: a spacecraft that travels back and forth

examples.text: The space shuttle returned to Earth safely this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 航天飞机今早安全返回地球。

senses.meaning_en: to travel or carry back and forth

examples.text: A minibus shuttles passengers between the terminal and the car park.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆小巴往返于航站楼和停车场之间运送乘客。

senses.meaning_en: a weaving tool that carries thread back and forth

examples.text: The weaver threw the shuttle across the loom.
examples.translation_cn: 织工把梭子投过织机。

senses.meaning_en: not able to be seen

examples.text: Many bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
examples.translation_cn: 许多细菌用肉眼是看不见的。

senses.meaning_en: ignored or unnoticed by others

examples.text: Quiet employees often feel invisible in large meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 安静寡言的员工在大型会议上常感到被忽视。

senses.meaning_en: to save someone or something from a dangerous or harmful situation

examples.text: Firefighters rescued two children from the burning building.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员从着火的大楼里救出了两个孩子。

senses.meaning_en: to save a situation from failure; to fix something that is going wrong, especially in cooking

examples.text: Her quick thinking rescued the situation before it turned ugly.
examples.translation_cn: 她的机智在事态恶化前挽回了局面。

senses.meaning_en: very seriously or badly

examples.text: The crops were severely damaged by the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 庄稼被暴风雨严重毁坏。

senses.meaning_en: in a strict or harsh way

examples.text: The coach was severely criticized for the team's poor performance.
examples.translation_cn: 教练因球队表现不佳而受到严厉批评。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle

examples.text: A rider on a motorcycle swerved to avoid the pothole.
examples.translation_cn: 一名骑摩托车的人急转弯避让坑洞。

senses.meaning_en: an added clause or condition
senses.collocation: add a rider to a bill

examples.text: The rider to the new tax bill was removed after protests.
examples.translation_cn: 新税法议案中的附加条款在抗议后被删除。

senses.meaning_en: to set apart or cut off from others

examples.text: The heavy snow isolated the village from the rest of the country.
examples.translation_cn: 大雪使该村庄与国内其他地区隔绝。

senses.meaning_en: to place in quarantine or isolation

examples.text: The patient was isolated from his family to prevent the spread of the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 该病人与家人隔离以防止病毒传播。

senses.meaning_en: to separate a substance in pure form from a mixture

examples.text: Scientists isolated the active compound from the plant extract.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家从植物提取物中分离出活性化合物。

senses.meaning_en: to stay away from others, especially to prevent the spread of a disease

examples.text: If you test positive, you should self-isolate for at least five days.
examples.translation_cn: 如果检测呈阳性，你应该至少自我隔离五天。

senses.meaning_en: to move on hands and knees or with the body close to the ground

examples.text: The baby crawled on hands and knees across the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 宝宝用双手和膝盖在地板上爬行。

senses.meaning_en: to move or progress slowly or with difficulty

examples.text: The traffic crawled along the highway after the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后，公路上的车辆缓慢行进。

senses.meaning_en: a very slow speed

examples.text: The rush-hour traffic moved at a crawl for nearly an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 高峰时段的交通以极慢的速度移动了近一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to be full of crawling things

examples.text: The abandoned kitchen was crawling with ants and cockroaches.
examples.translation_cn: 废弃的厨房里爬满了蚂蚁和蟑螂。

senses.meaning_en: to swim using the crawl stroke

examples.text: He swam crawl across the lake with steady strokes.
examples.translation_cn: 他以稳定的划水动作游自由泳横穿湖面。

senses.meaning_en: (of a man) good-looking and attractive

examples.text: He looks handsome in that dark blue suit.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿那套深蓝色西装很英俊。

senses.meaning_en: (of an action) generous or noble

examples.text: He made a handsome gesture by donating his prize money to the library.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过把奖金捐给图书馆做出了慷慨之举。

senses.meaning_en: (of an amount) large or substantial

examples.text: The company paid a handsome sum for the small tech start-up.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司为这家小型科技初创公司支付了一笔可观的金额。

senses.meaning_en: a private teacher who teaches one student or a small group

examples.text: She works as a math tutor after school.
examples.translation_cn: 她放学后当数学家教。

senses.meaning_en: to teach a student or small group, especially individually

examples.text: She tutors local children in maths twice a week.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周两次辅导当地的孩子数学。

senses.meaning_en: a university teacher who guides and supports students

examples.text: Her tutor in modern history reviewed her essay carefully.
examples.translation_cn: 她的现代史导师仔细批阅了她的论文。

senses.meaning_en: unhappy because you are without other people

examples.text: She felt lonely after her best friend moved away.
examples.translation_cn: 她最好的朋友搬走后，她感到很孤独。

senses.meaning_en: far from places where people live; unfrequented by people; desolate

examples.text: They drove along a lonely road for hours without seeing another car.
examples.translation_cn: 他们沿着一条荒凉的公路开了好几个小时，没见到另一辆车。

senses.meaning_en: without companions; solitary

examples.text: A lonely figure stood at the bus stop in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 一个孤单的身影站在雨中的公交站。

senses.meaning_en: a natural tendency or impulse to act in a particular way

examples.text: Birds have an instinct to build nests in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 鸟类在春天有筑巢的本能。

senses.meaning_en: an intuitive feeling that is not based on facts or reasoning

examples.text: She knew by instinct that something was wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 她凭直觉知道出事了。

senses.meaning_en: showing signs of future success

examples.text: The new treatment looks promising, but more tests are needed before it can be approved.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新疗法看起来很有希望，但在获批前还需要更多测试。

senses.meaning_en: slightly wet; moist

examples.text: The towels on the rack are still damp from the shower.
examples.translation_cn: 架子上的毛巾淋浴后还是湿的。

senses.meaning_en: despondent; dispirited

examples.text: The whole office was in a damp mood after the budget cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 预算削减后，整个办公室都情绪低落。

senses.meaning_en: moisture; humidity

examples.text: Don't leave your leather boots in the damp for long.
examples.translation_cn: 别把皮靴长时间放在潮湿处。

senses.meaning_en: a type of music with strong rhythms and improvisation

examples.text: My cousin plays jazz in a small bar downtown on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 我表弟周末在市中心的一家小酒吧演奏爵士乐。

senses.meaning_en: similar or related things; stuff

examples.text: She told me about her new job, her colleagues and all that jazz.
examples.translation_cn: 她跟我讲了她的新工作、同事以及其他类似的事情。

senses.meaning_en: a large bird of prey with a hooked beak and keen sight

examples.text: A bald eagle soared above the river, scanning for fish.
examples.translation_cn: 一只白头鹰在河面上空翱翔，搜寻着鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a score of two strokes under par on a golf hole

examples.text: She made an eagle on the 12th hole and took the lead.
examples.translation_cn: 她在第12洞打出老鹰球，取得领先。

senses.meaning_en: to score an eagle on a hole

examples.text: He eagled the final hole to win by one stroke.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最后一洞打出老鹰球，以一杆优势获胜。

senses.meaning_en: happening before a more important action or event

examples.text: This meeting is preliminary to the main negotiations.
examples.translation_cn: 这次会议是主要谈判的预备阶段。

senses.meaning_en: an early sports contest that decides who continues

examples.text: She set a personal best in the preliminaries.
examples.translation_cn: 她在预赛中创下了个人最好成绩。

senses.meaning_en: a step or action taken before the main event

examples.text: They exchanged greetings as a preliminary to the discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 他们互致问候，作为讨论的开端。

senses.meaning_en: a simple drawing or chart that shows how something works, how parts are arranged, or how information is related

examples.text: The textbook uses a diagram of the heart to explain how blood flows.
examples.translation_cn: 教科书用一张心脏示意图来解释血液如何流动。

senses.meaning_en: standing straight up or down; perpendicular to horizontal

examples.text: Check that the post is vertical before you fill the hole.
examples.translation_cn: 填洞前检查柱子是否竖直。

senses.meaning_en: the imagination; a mental image or idea

examples.text: The story is dismissed as a flight of fancy.
examples.translation_cn: 这个故事被斥为异想天开。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of liking or attraction

examples.text: He took a fancy to the little cottage and bought it.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢上了那座小屋，就把它买了下来。

senses.meaning_en: decorative, elaborate, or expensive

examples.text: We stayed at a fancy hotel by the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在海滩边一家豪华酒店。

senses.meaning_en: to want or like something

examples.text: Do you fancy going out for dinner tonight?
examples.translation_cn: 你今晚想出去吃晚饭吗？

senses.meaning_en: an emergency vehicle used to take sick or injured people to hospital

examples.text: We had to call an ambulance when he collapsed.
examples.translation_cn: 他晕倒时我们不得不叫了救护车。

senses.meaning_en: to cover a road, path, or area with a hard flat surface

examples.text: Workers are paving the courtyard with stone slabs today.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们今天正在用石板铺院子。

senses.meaning_en: to make something easier or possible; to prepare the way for something

examples.text: The new evidence may pave the way for a retrial.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据可能为再审铺平道路。

senses.meaning_en: a path at the side of a road for pedestrians

examples.text: She stepped off the pavement to let the cyclist pass.
examples.translation_cn: 她走下人行道让骑车人通过。

senses.meaning_en: a hard paved surface, especially a road

examples.text: A car skidded on the wet pavement and hit a tree.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆汽车在湿滑的路面上打滑，撞上了一棵树。

senses.meaning_en: a round object shaped like a ball
senses.pattern: in the shape of a sphere

examples.text: The sculpture is in the shape of a sphere.
examples.translation_cn: 这个雕塑呈球体形状。

senses.meaning_en: an area of activity, interest, or expertise

examples.text: She works mainly in the sphere of public health.
examples.translation_cn: 她主要从事公共卫生领域的工作。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people in society with shared rank or interests

examples.text: They moved in very different social spheres and rarely met.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在截然不同的社会圈子里活动，很少见面。

senses.meaning_en: a beam of light or radiation

examples.text: A ray of light shone through the window.
examples.translation_cn: 一束光线透过窗户照进来。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of a good quality or feeling

examples.text: The news brought a ray of hope to the worried family.
examples.translation_cn: 这个消息给忧心忡忡的家人带来了一线希望。

senses.meaning_en: a structure built by a bird or animal for laying eggs and raising young

examples.text: The robin kept her eggs warm in a nest.
examples.translation_cn: 知更鸟在巢里给蛋保暖。

senses.meaning_en: to build or use a nest

examples.text: The swallows nest in holes under the wooden roof.
examples.translation_cn: 燕子在木屋顶下的洞里筑巢。

senses.meaning_en: a snug comfortable place used as a home or retreat

examples.text: She escaped to her cosy nest away from the busy world.
examples.translation_cn: 她躲进自己远离喧嚣世界的安乐小窝。

senses.meaning_en: a hideout for bad people; a den

examples.text: Police raided a nest of smugglers near the docks.
examples.translation_cn: 警方突袭了码头附近的一个走私者巢穴。

senses.meaning_en: the period during which a monarch rules

examples.text: The railway was built during the reign of Queen Victoria.
examples.translation_cn: 这条铁路建于维多利亚女王统治时期。

senses.meaning_en: to rule as a monarch

examples.text: She reigned over the country for more than thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 她统治这个国家三十多年。

senses.meaning_en: to be the most important or noticeable feature of a situation

examples.text: Panic reigned supreme in the city after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 地震后恐慌在该市占主导地位。

senses.meaning_en: the exercise of sovereign power

examples.text: The reign of law is the foundation of a fair society.
examples.translation_cn: 法治是公平社会的基础。

senses.meaning_en: to be the winner of the most recent iteration of a competition

examples.text: The boxer reigned as world champion for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 这位拳击手连续五年蝉联世界冠军。

senses.meaning_en: equally distant from each other at all points; not intersecting or coinciding

examples.text: The two walls are exactly parallel to each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两面墙完全平行。

senses.meaning_en: involving the processing of multiple tasks at the same time

examples.text: The software can process multiple data streams in parallel.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件能并行处理多路数据流。

senses.meaning_en: analogous, similar, comparable

examples.text: The current crisis is parallel to the one that hit the country in the 1990s.
examples.translation_cn: 当前的危机与上世纪九十年代该国遭遇的危机类似。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being happy; joy

examples.text: She finds happiness in simple things like reading and gardening.
examples.translation_cn: 她从阅读和园艺等简单事物中找到快乐。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that carries people or goods between floors of a building

examples.text: We took the elevator to the top floor of the building.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘电梯到了大楼顶层。

senses.meaning_en: a shoe with a hidden insert that makes the wearer appear taller

examples.text: He wore elevators to seem a little taller at the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿内增高鞋，在面试时显得高一点。

senses.meaning_en: having or exerting influence

examples.text: She was influential in shaping public health policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她在制定公共卫生政策方面很有影响力。

senses.meaning_en: a three-dimensional work of art, usually representing a person or animal, created by sculpting, carving, molding, or casting

examples.text: The city erected a bronze statue of the famous poet.
examples.translation_cn: 市里为这位著名诗人竖立了一座铜像。

senses.meaning_en: the act of following or chasing someone or something

examples.text: The police car raced through the streets in pursuit of the suspect.
examples.translation_cn: 警车在街道上疾驰，追捕嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: the act of trying to achieve or get something

examples.text: The pursuit of knowledge should be a lifelong goal.
examples.translation_cn: 对知识的追求应是一生的目标。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that you enjoy doing regularly

examples.text: He took up a new pursuit after he retired.
examples.translation_cn: 他退休后开始了一项新的爱好。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the tropics

examples.text: Many unique species are found in tropical regions.
examples.translation_cn: 许多独特的物种生活在热带地区。

senses.meaning_en: very hot and humid

examples.text: The weather is tropical, hot and damp, even at night.
examples.translation_cn: 天气又热又湿，即便在夜间也是如此。

senses.meaning_en: a tropical plant

examples.text: We grow tropicals in our greenhouse every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每年夏天在温室里种热带植物。

senses.meaning_en: to make known; reveal

examples.text: The report discloses that sales fell by ten percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 报告披露，去年销售额下降了10%。

senses.meaning_en: to allow something to be seen

examples.text: She opened the lid to disclose a secret compartment.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开盖子，露出一个暗格。

senses.meaning_en: to set free, especially from oppression or imprisonment
senses.collocation: liberate a country from colonial rule

examples.text: The soldiers liberated the town from enemy control.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们将该镇从敌人控制下解放出来。

senses.meaning_en: to take property by force or theft; to loot, rob, or steal

examples.text: During the chaos, someone liberated a laptop from the office.
examples.translation_cn: 混乱中，有人从办公室顺走了一台笔记本电脑。

senses.meaning_en: the act of freeing a country or people from oppression or occupation

examples.text: The country celebrated its liberation from colonial rule in 1962.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家在1962年庆祝从殖民统治中获得解放。

senses.meaning_en: the act of freeing oneself from something that restricts or limits

examples.text: Quitting her job gave her a wonderful sense of liberation.
examples.translation_cn: 辞职给她带来了一种奇妙的解脱感。

senses.meaning_en: a hand with the fingers clenched or curled inward

examples.text: He clenched his fist tightly in silent anger.
examples.translation_cn: 他愤怒地默默攥紧了拳头。

senses.meaning_en: the place to which someone or something is going or being sent

examples.text: The train finally arrived at its destination two hours late.
examples.translation_cn: 火车最终晚点两小时到达目的地。

senses.meaning_en: a flat object used for carrying things such as food and drinks

examples.text: The waiter brought our drinks on a silver tray.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员用一个银托盘端来了我们的饮料。

senses.meaning_en: a shallow open container used in an office for holding papers or letters

examples.text: Please put the applications in the tray on the manager's desk.
examples.translation_cn: 请把申请表放在经理桌上的文件盘里。

senses.meaning_en: the amount a tray holds

examples.text: He carried a tray of drinks to the guests.
examples.translation_cn: 他给客人端了一盘饮料。

senses.meaning_en: a small area on a computer screen that shows icons and alerts

examples.text: You can change the volume by clicking the icon in the system tray.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以点击系统托盘中的图标来改变音量。

senses.meaning_en: advice or criticism about how good or useful something is

examples.text: Students gave useful feedback on the new teaching materials.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们对新教材提出了有用的反馈。

senses.meaning_en: the return of part of an output signal to the input, often causing noise or used for control

examples.text: The microphone caused feedback when the singer got too close to the speaker.
examples.translation_cn: 歌手离音箱太近时，麦克风产生了反馈噪声。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who represent an organization or country

examples.text: A delegation of ten doctors visited the flooded region.
examples.translation_cn: 一个由十名医生组成的代表团访问了受灾地区。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving tasks or authority to someone else

examples.text: Delegation of responsibility to junior staff can improve efficiency.
examples.translation_cn: 将责任委派给初级员工可以提高效率。

senses.meaning_en: a colour between red and blue

examples.text: The living room was decorated in purple and gold.
examples.translation_cn: 客厅用紫色和金色装饰。

senses.meaning_en: imperial power

examples.text: In ancient Rome, the purple was a symbol of imperial power.
examples.translation_cn: 在古罗马，紫色是皇权的象征。

senses.meaning_en: the light from the sun

examples.text: The plants on the windowsill thrive in the sunlight.
examples.translation_cn: 窗台上的植物在阳光下茁壮生长。

senses.meaning_en: brightness, hope; a positive outlook

examples.text: Her visit was a ray of sunlight in an otherwise dark week.
examples.translation_cn: 她的来访在原本阴郁的一周里是一缕阳光。

senses.meaning_en: a device that produces a concentrated beam of light

examples.text: The surgeon used a medical laser to remove the tumor.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生用医用激光切除了肿瘤。

senses.meaning_en: a beam of light produced by a laser

examples.text: The laser beam bounced off the mirror and hit the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 激光束从镜子上反弹并击中了墙壁。

senses.meaning_en: to cut, destroy or treat with a laser

examples.text: She decided to laser off the tattoo on her wrist.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定用激光去除手腕上的纹身。

senses.meaning_en: brave and confident; not afraid of danger or risks

examples.text: The rescue team was bold enough to enter the burning building.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队足够勇敢，进入着火的大楼。

senses.meaning_en: printed in thick, dark letters

examples.text: Important words are printed in bold in this textbook.
examples.translation_cn: 本教科书中的重要词语用粗体印刷。

senses.meaning_en: easy to see; having a strong, clear appearance

examples.text: The new building stands in bold contrast to the old neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 新建筑与老街区形成鲜明对比。

senses.meaning_en: too confident and showing a lack of respect
senses.pattern: be so bold as to do

examples.text: He was so bold as to interrupt the speaker.
examples.translation_cn: 他冒失地打断了演讲者。

senses.meaning_en: almost completely; almost entirely

examples.text: The theatre was practically empty by the time we arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 我们到达时，剧场几乎空无一人。

senses.meaning_en: in practice; in effect, though not officially

examples.text: She was practically the head of the department until the new director arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 新主任到任之前，她实际上是这个部门的负责人。

senses.meaning_en: in a practical way; from a practical perspective

examples.text: We have to think practically about how to pay for the repairs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们得切合实际地考虑如何支付维修费用。

senses.meaning_en: a public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or involving soldiers

examples.text: Local bands will march in a parade this Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 当地乐队本周六将参加游行。

senses.meaning_en: to show someone or something in public in order to impress people
senses.pattern: parade sth in front of sb

examples.text: He loves to parade his new car in front of his neighbors.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢在邻居面前炫耀他的新车。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in a parade

examples.text: The school band paraded through the streets during the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 学校乐队在节日期间列队穿过街道。

senses.meaning_en: money given by a government or organization to reduce the cost of something

examples.text: The government provides a subsidy for solar panel installation.
examples.translation_cn: 政府为太阳能电池板的安装提供补贴。

senses.meaning_en: a discrete and complete living thing, such as an animal, plant, fungus or microorganism

examples.text: A fungus is an organism that lives on dead plants.
examples.translation_cn: 真菌是一种生活在死植物上的有机体。

senses.meaning_en: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge

examples.text: The discovery opened up new possibilities in the realm of medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现为医学领域开辟了新的可能性。

senses.meaning_en: a major zoogeographical division of the earth's surface

examples.text: Wolves and deer are found in the Nearctic realm.
examples.translation_cn: 狼和鹿分布于新北界。

senses.meaning_en: a mixture of two or more things

examples.text: This sauce is a blend of garlic, herbs, and olive oil.
examples.translation_cn: 这种酱汁是大蒜、香草和橄榄油的混合物。

senses.meaning_en: to look or sound good together; to combine harmoniously

examples.text: The new library blends well with the surrounding houses.
examples.translation_cn: 新图书馆与周围的房屋很协调。

senses.meaning_en: to mix two or more substances together

examples.text: Blend the eggs with the flour until smooth.
examples.translation_cn: 将鸡蛋和面粉混合，直至顺滑。

senses.meaning_en: a word formed by combining two other words; a portmanteau word

examples.text: The word "brunch" is a blend of "breakfast" and "lunch".
examples.translation_cn: “brunch”是“breakfast”和“lunch”的混合词。

senses.meaning_en: with confidence; without much risk of being wrong

examples.text: We can safely say that the project has succeeded.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以有把握地说，这个项目已经成功。

senses.meaning_en: in a secure way; without being hurt or damaged

examples.text: The hikers arrived safely at the shelter before dark.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者天黑前安全地到达了庇护所。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is unlikely to cause problems or loss

examples.text: Store important records safely in a fireproof cabinet.
examples.translation_cn: 把重要记录安全地存放在防火柜里。

senses.meaning_en: to remove the skin or outer covering of something

examples.text: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices.
examples.translation_cn: 把土豆削皮并切成薄片。

senses.meaning_en: the skin or outer layer of a fruit or vegetable

examples.text: Grate the peel of one lemon into the bowl.
examples.translation_cn: 把一个柠檬的皮擦碎放进碗里。

senses.meaning_en: to come off in small strips or flakes

examples.text: The old paint is peeling off the front door.
examples.translation_cn: 旧油漆正从前门剥落。

senses.meaning_en: to take off one's clothing

examples.text: He quickly peeled off and got into bed.
examples.translation_cn: 他迅速脱掉衣服，上了床。

senses.meaning_en: a stick of wax with a wick that burns to give light

examples.text: She lit a candle and placed it on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她点燃一支蜡烛放在桌上。

senses.meaning_en: very strong, violent, or severe

examples.text: The two teams are in fierce competition for the top spot.
examples.translation_cn: 这两支球队正在为头名展开激烈竞争。

senses.meaning_en: angry and aggressive, or threatening in appearance

examples.text: The guard dog looked fierce when the stranger approached.
examples.translation_cn: 当陌生人靠近时，看门狗显得很凶猛。

senses.meaning_en: very strong and intense (of feelings or conditions)

examples.text: She defended her old hometown with fierce loyalty.
examples.translation_cn: 她以强烈的忠诚守护着自己的故乡。

senses.meaning_en: waste food or material that is thrown away

examples.text: Please take out the garbage before you go to bed.
examples.translation_cn: 请在睡觉前把垃圾拿出去。

senses.meaning_en: stupid or untrue ideas; worthless things or people

examples.text: His excuse for being late was complete garbage.
examples.translation_cn: 他迟到的借口完全是垃圾。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount or number

examples.text: We've got tons of work to finish before the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有一大堆工作要在截止日期前完成。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 2,000 pounds in the US or 2,240 pounds in the UK

examples.text: The truck can carry a ton of sand in a single load.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆卡车一次能装一吨沙子。

senses.meaning_en: a clear, very hard precious stone; the mineral form of carbon

examples.text: The gold necklace was set with dozens of diamonds.
examples.translation_cn: 这条金项链镶嵌了许多钻石。

senses.meaning_en: a shape with four equal sides; a playing card of this shape
senses.pattern: in the shape of a diamond

examples.text: The tiles were arranged in the shape of a diamond.
examples.translation_cn: 瓷砖被摆成菱形。

senses.meaning_en: a diamond ring

examples.text: She wore a diamond engagement ring on her left hand.
examples.translation_cn: 她左手戴了一枚钻石订婚戒指。

senses.meaning_en: the area of a town or city where you live or where you are

examples.text: We live in a quiet neighbourhood near the school.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在学校附近一个安静的街区。

senses.meaning_en: the area around a particular place or point

examples.text: There are two schools in the neighbourhood of the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 医院附近有两所学校。

senses.meaning_en: the bottom part of the face, below the mouth

examples.text: He had a small bandage on his chin.
examples.translation_cn: 他下巴上贴着一小块创可贴。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to withstand being punched in the chin without being knocked out

examples.text: The champion has a good chin and rarely gets knocked down.
examples.translation_cn: 这位拳手抗击打能力很强，很少被击倒。

senses.meaning_en: to stop existing

examples.text: Several ancient languages have vanished from the earth.
examples.translation_cn: 几种古老的语言已经从地球上绝迹了。

senses.meaning_en: to gradually disappear or fade away

examples.text: The confidence slowly vanished from his voice over the years.
examples.translation_cn: 随着岁月流逝，他声音里的自信慢慢消失了。

senses.meaning_en: to disappear suddenly or become impossible to see

examples.text: The little boat vanished without trace in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 小船在风暴中消失得无影无踪。

senses.meaning_en: to admit that you have done something wrong or illegal

examples.text: He confessed to stealing money from the company last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他承认去年从公司偷了钱。

senses.meaning_en: to acknowledge faith in; to profess belief in

examples.text: He publicly confessed his faith in God at the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 他在仪式上公开宣信。

senses.meaning_en: to disclose or reveal

examples.text: She confessed her secret to her closest friend last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚向最亲密的朋友透露了秘密。

senses.meaning_en: to tell God or a priest about your sins so that you can be forgiven

examples.text: She confessed her sins to a priest before Easter.
examples.translation_cn: 她在复活节前向神父忏悔了罪过。

senses.meaning_en: more than normal or required

examples.text: Passengers must pay a fee for excess baggage on this airline.
examples.translation_cn: 这家航空公司的乘客须为超重行李额外付费。

senses.meaning_en: an amount greater than needed or allowed

examples.text: Drivers caught travelling at speeds in excess of 120 km/h face heavy fines.
examples.translation_cn: 以超过120公里/小时的速度行驶被查获的司机将面临高额罚款。

senses.meaning_en: behaviour beyond acceptable limits

examples.text: He drank to excess at the party and had to be driven home.
examples.translation_cn: 他在聚会上饮酒过度，不得不被送回家。

senses.meaning_en: the amount you pay towards an insurance claim

examples.text: You'll have to pay an excess of £200 on each claim.
examples.translation_cn: 每项索赔您必须支付200英镑的垫底费。

senses.meaning_en: more than is necessary, normal, or desirable; too much

examples.text: The excessive consumption of alcohol can damage your liver.
examples.translation_cn: 过度饮酒会损害肝脏。

senses.meaning_en: excellent; very good

examples.text: She came up with a splendid idea for the school project.
examples.translation_cn: 她想出了学校项目的一个绝妙主意。

senses.meaning_en: magnificent; very beautiful

examples.text: The mountain range looked splendid in the golden sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 山脉在金色夕阳下显得壮丽辉煌。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being serious and important

examples.text: We failed to grasp the gravity of the situation.
examples.translation_cn: 我们没有意识到局势的严重性。

senses.meaning_en: the force that attracts objects towards the centre of the earth

examples.text: The force of gravity keeps the moon in orbit around the Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 地球引力使月球绕地球运行。

senses.meaning_en: serious behaviour, speech or appearance

examples.text: He spoke with gravity about the risks facing the community.
examples.translation_cn: 他严肃地谈到了社区面临的风险。

senses.meaning_en: to make something look more attractive by adding ornaments

examples.text: We decorated the living room with balloons for the party.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为聚会用气球装饰了客厅。

senses.meaning_en: to improve the interior of a building by painting, wallpapering, etc.

examples.text: We are having the whole house decorated, including new wallpaper and paint.
examples.translation_cn: 我们正在请人装修整栋房子，包括新壁纸和油漆。

senses.meaning_en: to honor someone by giving them a medal or award

examples.text: The soldier was decorated for bravery in battle.
examples.translation_cn: 这名士兵因作战勇敢被授予勋章。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being exact and free from mistakes

examples.text: The accuracy of the report has been questioned by several experts.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告的准确性受到几位专家的质疑。

senses.meaning_en: a fine-grained earth material that can be shaped when wet and hardens when fired, used for making pots and bricks

examples.text: The children made small animals out of clay.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们用黏土做小动物。

senses.meaning_en: a tennis court surface made of crushed brick, shale, or similar material

examples.text: He prefers playing on clay because the surface is slower.
examples.translation_cn: 他更喜欢在红土场地上打球，因为场地速度较慢。

senses.meaning_en: a cut of meat, often containing a section of a rib

examples.text: He ordered grilled pork chops with rice for dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他晚餐点了烤猪排配米饭。

senses.meaning_en: to cut something with a sharp tool using a heavy downward movement

examples.text: She chopped the onions into small pieces for the soup.
examples.translation_cn: 她把洋葱切成小块做汤。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce something by a large amount

examples.text: The company chopped its workforce by ten percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年公司将员工人数削减了百分之十。

senses.meaning_en: termination, especially from employment; the sack

examples.text: After the merger, several senior managers got the chop.
examples.translation_cn: 合并后，几名高级经理被裁了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who steals something

examples.text: A thief stole my bicycle from the garage last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚有个小偷从车库里偷走了我的自行车。

senses.meaning_en: to give food or drink a particular taste

examples.text: She flavoured the soup with lemon and fresh herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 她用柠檬和新鲜香草给汤调味。

senses.meaning_en: the taste of food or drink

examples.text: This soup has the flavour of fresh tomatoes.
examples.translation_cn: 这汤有新鲜番茄的味道。

senses.meaning_en: a distinctive quality or atmosphere

examples.text: The old town has the flavour of a Mediterranean village.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老城有地中海村庄的情调。

senses.meaning_en: producing a lot, especially of crops; fertile

examples.text: The valley is covered with fertile, productive farmland.
examples.translation_cn: 山谷里遍布着肥沃、多产的农田。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the creation of goods or services

examples.text: Factories have increased their productive capacity this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年工厂提高了生产能力。

senses.meaning_en: yielding good or useful results

examples.text: The meeting was productive and we agreed on next steps.
examples.translation_cn: 会议富有成效，我们就下一步达成了共识。

senses.meaning_en: used to form new words

examples.text: The suffix -ness is a productive suffix in English.
examples.translation_cn: 后缀 -ness 是英语中一个能产后缀。

senses.meaning_en: the physical features of an area

examples.text: The geography of this region includes mountains and deep valleys.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区的地形包括山脉和深谷。

senses.meaning_en: the study of the earth and its features

examples.text: She decided to study geography at university to understand climate patterns.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定在大学学习地理学，以了解气候模式。

senses.meaning_en: the way a particular subject is distributed or organized

examples.text: The geography of poverty in the city has shifted over the past decade.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市的贫困分布在过去十年里发生了变化。

senses.meaning_en: to move from a higher to a lower position

examples.text: The tired hikers descended the hill before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 疲惫的徒步者在日落前下了山。

senses.meaning_en: to arrive and affect a person or place, especially night or silence

examples.text: A deep silence suddenly descended on the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵深深的沉默突然笼罩了人群。

senses.meaning_en: to pass from parent to child; to be inherited

examples.text: The family estate descended to her only son.
examples.translation_cn: 家族庄园传给了她唯一的儿子。

senses.meaning_en: to originate or be passed down from a source

examples.text: Many common English words descend from Latin roots.
examples.translation_cn: 许多常见的英语单词源自拉丁语词根。

senses.meaning_en: to take a firm hold of somebody or something with the hand

examples.text: He grasped hold of the rope and pulled himself up.
examples.translation_cn: 他抓住绳子把自己拉了上去。

senses.meaning_en: to understand something completely; an understanding

examples.text: It took me a while to grasp the meaning of the poem.
examples.translation_cn: 我花了一阵子才领会这首诗的含义。

senses.meaning_en: to take advantage of an opportunity

examples.text: She eagerly grasped the opportunity to study abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她急切地抓住了出国留学的机会。

senses.meaning_en: a firm hold or control

examples.text: The glass slipped from her grasp and shattered.
examples.translation_cn: 玻璃杯从她手中滑落摔碎了。

senses.meaning_en: a glass of beer or cider served by the pint

examples.text: We often go for a pint after work.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下班后经常去喝一杯啤酒。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring volume

examples.text: Add a pint of water and bring to the boil.
examples.translation_cn: 加入一品脱水并煮沸。

senses.meaning_en: changing; active; able to adapt

examples.text: The tech industry is dynamic and ever-changing, so workers must keep learning.
examples.translation_cn: 科技行业是动态且不断变化的，所以从业者必须不断学习。
