senses.meaning_en: powerful; energetic

examples.text: She is dynamic and energetic, always motivating her team.
examples.translation_cn: 她充满活力和干劲，总是激励她的团队。

senses.meaning_en: to say what you think will happen in the future, based on information that you have now

examples.text: Economists forecast that unemployment will fall next year.
examples.translation_cn: 经济学家预测明年失业率将下降。

senses.meaning_en: a statement about what is likely to happen in the future

examples.text: The weather forecast for tomorrow says it will rain heavily.
examples.translation_cn: 明天的天气预报说会有大雨。

senses.meaning_en: the result of translating; a text or work that has been translated

examples.text: She published a new translation of Homer's Odyssey.
examples.translation_cn: 她出版了一部荷马《奥德赛》的新译本。

senses.meaning_en: the process of changing something into a different form
senses.pattern: the translation of A into B

examples.text: The translation of scientific research into new products takes time.
examples.translation_cn: 把科学研究转化为新产品需要时间。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of translating

examples.text: Translation from Chinese into English is often challenging.
examples.translation_cn: 中译英往往很有挑战性。

senses.meaning_en: violent uncontrollable anger

examples.text: He flew into a rage when he saw the damage.
examples.translation_cn: 看到损坏时，他勃然大怒。

senses.meaning_en: a current fashion or fad

examples.text: These wireless earphones are all the rage among teenagers.
examples.translation_cn: 这些无线耳机在青少年中非常流行。

senses.meaning_en: to act or speak in heightened anger

examples.text: She raged at him for forgetting her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 她因他忘记她的生日而大发雷霆。

senses.meaning_en: to move with great violence, as a storm etc.

examples.text: A wildfire raged through the hills for three days.
examples.translation_cn: 一场野火在山丘上肆虐了三天。

senses.meaning_en: serving as a remembrance of someone or something; commemorative

examples.text: A memorial service for the victims will be held in the town hall.
examples.translation_cn: 将在市政厅为遇难者举行悼念仪式。

senses.meaning_en: something, such as a monument, by which someone or something is remembered

examples.text: A memorial to the victims was unveiled in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 一座纪念遇难者的纪念碑在公园揭幕。

senses.meaning_en: of great value or worth; rare and expensive

examples.text: Time with your children is precious, so don't waste it.
examples.translation_cn: 和孩子在一起的时间是宝贵的，所以不要浪费。

senses.meaning_en: loved or valued very much; dear

examples.text: The old photo album is precious to her because it belonged to her mother.
examples.translation_cn: 这本旧相册对她来说很珍贵，因为是她母亲留下的。

senses.meaning_en: extremely protective or strict about something

examples.text: He is very precious about his car and never lets anyone else drive it.
examples.translation_cn: 他非常宝贝他的车，从不让别人开。

senses.meaning_en: to officially forbid something or make it illegal

examples.text: The law prohibits smoking in all public buildings.
examples.translation_cn: 法律禁止在所有公共建筑内吸烟。

senses.meaning_en: to make something impossible; to prevent
senses.pattern: sth prohibits sb from doing sth

examples.text: The high cost of housing prohibits many young people from buying a home.
examples.translation_cn: 高昂的住房成本使许多年轻人买不起房。

senses.meaning_en: in a steady manner; with a steady progression

examples.text: The company's profits have grown steadily over the past five years.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的利润在过去五年里稳步增长。

senses.meaning_en: in a calm, confident, and controlled way

examples.text: She looked steadily at the interviewer and answered every question calmly.
examples.translation_cn: 她镇定地注视着面试官，平静地回答了每一个问题。

senses.meaning_en: only; exclusively

examples.text: She is solely responsible for the project's failure.
examples.translation_cn: 她是项目失败的唯一责任人。

senses.meaning_en: solely; only; to the exclusion of others

examples.text: This offer is exclusively for members of the club.
examples.translation_cn: 此优惠仅限俱乐部会员。

senses.meaning_en: to hide something from view or public knowledge

examples.text: The thick hedge concealed the entrance to the garden from view.
examples.translation_cn: 浓密的树篱遮住了花园入口。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something secret or prevent it from being known

examples.text: He deliberately concealed the truth from his parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他故意对父母隐瞒真相。

senses.meaning_en: to put someone's name on an official list or make them officially join a course, school, or organization

examples.text: Parents must enroll their children in school before the start of term.
examples.translation_cn: 家长必须在学期开始前为孩子报名入学。

senses.meaning_en: to officially join a course, school, or organization

examples.text: She decided to enroll in a part-time language course this autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定今年秋季报名参加一门非全日制语言课程。

senses.meaning_en: one of the bones that form the mouth and hold the teeth

examples.text: The dentist found a crack in my lower jaw.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医在我的下颚发现了一条裂纹。

senses.meaning_en: the lower part of the face, below the mouth

examples.text: He was a tall man with a strong jaw.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个下巴很结实的男人。

senses.meaning_en: to talk at length about unimportant things

examples.text: They spent the whole meeting jawing about football instead of making decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整个会议都在唠叨足球，而不是做决定。

senses.meaning_en: to trip or almost fall while walking

examples.text: She stumbled over a loose stone and nearly fell.
examples.translation_cn: 她被一块松动的石头绊了一下，差点摔倒。

senses.meaning_en: to walk unsteadily

examples.text: He stumbled along the dark path, exhausted after the race.
examples.translation_cn: 他在黑暗的小路上蹒跚而行，赛后精疲力竭。

senses.meaning_en: a fall or clumsy step

examples.text: He took a bad stumble on the stairs but caught the railing.
examples.translation_cn: 他在楼梯上重重踉跄了一下，但抓住了扶手。

senses.meaning_en: an error or blunder

examples.text: His only stumble in the campaign was the controversial remark.
examples.translation_cn: 他在竞选中唯一的失误是那句有争议的言论。

senses.meaning_en: to make a mistake or have trouble when speaking

examples.text: He stumbled over his words during the interview and felt embarrassed.
examples.translation_cn: 他在面试中说话结巴，感到很尴尬。

senses.meaning_en: the back of an animal, especially the upper or projecting part
senses.pattern: along the ridge of the back

examples.text: The dog's hair rose along the ridge of its back.
examples.translation_cn: 狗背脊上的毛竖了起来。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow raised strip of ground or other surface

examples.text: They planted corn in ridges to improve drainage.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把玉米种在垄上以改善排水。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow area of high land where two slopes meet

examples.text: We followed the ridge until we reached the summit.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着山脊一直走到山顶。

senses.meaning_en: the highest part of a roof where two sloping sides meet
senses.pattern: on the ridge of the roof

examples.text: Birds perched on the ridge of the barn roof.
examples.translation_cn: 鸟儿停在谷仓屋脊上。

senses.meaning_en: the time when the sun rises or first light appears

examples.text: We left the camp at dawn to avoid the heat.
examples.translation_cn: 我们天亮时离开营地以避开炎热。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to grow light as the sun rises

examples.text: The day dawned bright and clear over the quiet town.
examples.translation_cn: 曙光初现，小镇上空晴朗明亮。

senses.meaning_en: to become clear or obvious to someone

examples.text: It dawned on me that I had left my keys at home.
examples.translation_cn: 我突然意识到把钥匙落在家里了。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to appear or develop

examples.text: A new era dawned with the rise of the internet.
examples.translation_cn: 随着互联网的兴起，一个新时代开始了。

senses.meaning_en: the earliest phase of something; beginning

examples.text: The internet marked the dawn of a new era in communication.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网标志着通信新时代的开端。

senses.meaning_en: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that carries passengers

examples.text: He learned to drive an automobile when he was sixteen.
examples.translation_cn: 他十六岁时学会了开汽车。

senses.meaning_en: a large organ in the body that stores nutrients, destroys toxins and produces bile

examples.text: Too much alcohol can damage the liver permanently.
examples.translation_cn: 过量饮酒会永久性地损害肝脏。

senses.meaning_en: the liver of an animal, used as food

examples.text: We had liver and onions for dinner last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚吃了洋葱炒肝。

senses.meaning_en: happening or developing gradually

examples.text: There has been a progressive increase in online sales this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年网上销售额逐步增长。

senses.meaning_en: favoring new ideas and social reform

examples.text: The school is known for its progressive approach to education.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校以其进步的教育方法而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: increasing in rate as the taxable amount increases

examples.text: The government introduced a progressive tax on high salaries.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对高薪收入征收累进税。

senses.meaning_en: airport terminal; end of a transport line

examples.text: Passengers waited in the airport terminal for their flight to be announced.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客们在机场航站楼等候航班通知。

senses.meaning_en: computer terminal

examples.text: He checked his bank account on a computer terminal.
examples.translation_cn: 他在计算机终端上查看了银行账户。

senses.meaning_en: likely to cause death soon

examples.text: The patient has a terminal illness and needs palliative care.
examples.translation_cn: 这位病人患有绝症，需要姑息治疗。

senses.meaning_en: battery terminal

examples.text: Check that the red wire is connected to the positive terminal.
examples.translation_cn: 检查红色电线是否连接到正极端子。

senses.meaning_en: to work or act together for a common purpose or benefit

examples.text: Several local groups cooperated to raise funds for the new library.
examples.translation_cn: 几个当地团体合作，为新图书馆筹集资金。

senses.meaning_en: to allow for mutual unobstructed action

examples.text: The witness refused to cooperate with the police.
examples.translation_cn: 证人拒绝配合警方。

senses.meaning_en: a soft cushion used to support the head in bed

examples.text: She rested her head on a soft pillow and soon fell asleep.
examples.translation_cn: 她头靠在软枕头上，很快睡着了。

senses.meaning_en: any similar head support used for sleep, such as a neck pillow or a hard porcelain pillow

examples.text: She sleeps with a neck pillow on long flights.
examples.translation_cn: 她在长途飞行时用颈枕睡觉。

senses.meaning_en: lacking modern technology or comfort; very simple and basic

examples.text: They still live in primitive conditions without running water.
examples.translation_cn: 他们仍然生活在没有自来水的简陋条件下。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a primitive society

examples.text: The book was criticized for referring to tribal people as primitives.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书因把部落民族称为原始人而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: a large sea animal that eats fish and lives near coasts or on ice

examples.text: A group of seals was basking on the rocks near the shore.
examples.translation_cn: 一群海豹正在岸边的岩石上晒太阳。

senses.meaning_en: to close or fasten something securely so that nothing can enter or escape

examples.text: She sealed the jar with wax to keep the jam fresh.
examples.translation_cn: 她用蜡封住罐子以便果酱保鲜。

senses.meaning_en: a stamp or the mark it leaves, used to show that something is official or genuine

examples.text: The certificate bears the official seal of the university.
examples.translation_cn: 证书上有大学的官方印章。

senses.meaning_en: official approval or confirmation, often given as a sign of acceptance

examples.text: The plan received the board's seal of approval after a short review.
examples.translation_cn: 计划在简短审查后得到了董事会的批准。

senses.meaning_en: a hard alloy of copper and tin, or made of this alloy

examples.text: The ancient bell is made of bronze and has survived for centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 这口古钟由青铜制成，已经保存了数百年。

senses.meaning_en: a bronze medal; third place

examples.text: She won a bronze at the World Championships.
examples.translation_cn: 她在世界锦标赛上获得铜牌。

senses.meaning_en: a work of art made of bronze, especially a sculpture

examples.text: The museum has a bronze of a Greek athlete.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆有一尊希腊运动员的青铜像。

senses.meaning_en: a reddish-brown colour, or having this colour

examples.text: The leaves gradually turn bronze in the fall.
examples.translation_cn: 秋天树叶逐渐变成青铜色。

senses.meaning_en: a large group of musicians who play various instruments together, especially classical music

examples.text: She plays the violin in a symphony orchestra in Berlin.
examples.translation_cn: 她在柏林的一个交响乐团演奏小提琴。

senses.meaning_en: recently; not long ago

examples.text: She has felt quite stressed at work lately.
examples.translation_cn: 她最近工作压力很大。

senses.meaning_en: almost not; hardly at all

examples.text: I could scarcely believe my eyes when she walked in.
examples.translation_cn: 她走进来时我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something happens immediately after something else

examples.text: Scarcely had I sat down when the phone rang.
examples.translation_cn: 我刚坐下电话就响了。

senses.meaning_en: to look over quickly

examples.text: She scanned the room for a familiar face.
examples.translation_cn: 她扫视房间寻找熟悉的面孔。

senses.meaning_en: to read or create an image with a scanner or electronic device

examples.text: She scanned the QR code to pay for her coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 她扫二维码付了咖啡钱。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of scanning

examples.text: The doctor performed a scan of the patient's chest.
examples.translation_cn: 医生对病人的胸部做了扫描检查。

senses.meaning_en: working and ready for use

examples.text: The new airport terminal is now fully operational.
examples.translation_cn: 新航站楼现已全面投入使用。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the way something is run

examples.text: We need to solve the problem at an operational level.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要在运营层面解决这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: relating to military operations

examples.text: She took operational command of the naval fleet.
examples.translation_cn: 她接手了这支海军舰队的作战指挥权。

senses.meaning_en: to care for young children or animals until they are fully grown; to breed and raise

examples.text: She was reared by her aunt after her parents moved abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 父母移居国外后，她由姑姑抚养长大。

senses.meaning_en: being behind or in the hindmost part

examples.text: The rear wheels of the bus were covered in mud.
examples.translation_cn: 公共汽车的后轮沾满了泥。

senses.meaning_en: to rise up on the hind legs

examples.text: The horse reared up in fright and threw the rider.
examples.translation_cn: 那匹马受惊后后腿直立，把骑手掀了下来。

senses.meaning_en: to raise physically or metaphorically; to lift up

examples.text: The snake reared its head when it sensed danger.
examples.translation_cn: 那条蛇感到危险时抬起了头。

senses.meaning_en: a political philosophy that favours social equality and community decision-making without full state ownership

examples.text: Democratic socialism is a form of socialism that allows a mixed economy.
examples.translation_cn: 民主社会主义是一种允许混合经济的社会主义形式。

senses.meaning_en: in Marxism, the stage between capitalism and communism with state control of the means of production

examples.text: The party saw the dictatorship of the proletariat as a transition to socialism.
examples.translation_cn: 该党将无产阶级专政视为向社会主义的过渡。

senses.meaning_en: carried out according to a planned, ordered procedure; methodical

examples.text: We need to be systematic in collecting and analyzing the data.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要系统地收集和分析数据。

senses.meaning_en: on or to a lower floor

examples.text: She went downstairs to answer the phone after hearing it ring.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到电话铃响后下楼去接电话。

senses.meaning_en: located on a lower floor

examples.text: The downstairs bedroom has its own private bathroom.
examples.translation_cn: 楼下的卧室有自己的私人浴室。

senses.meaning_en: the lower floor of a building

examples.text: The downstairs has been converted into a separate flat.
examples.translation_cn: 楼下已被改造成一套独立的公寓。

senses.meaning_en: a small vehicle with wheels that you push or pull to carry goods

examples.text: She pushed a cart full of groceries to her car.
examples.translation_cn: 她推着一辆装满食品杂货的手推车走向她的汽车。

senses.meaning_en: to carry or move something in a cart or other vehicle, often with effort or to remove it

examples.text: They carted the old furniture away to the dump.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把旧家具运到垃圾场。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Greece, its people, language, or culture

examples.text: The statue is of Greek origin and dates from the fifth century BC.
examples.translation_cn: 这座雕像源自希腊，可追溯到公元前五世纪。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Greece or of Greek descent

examples.text: Many Greeks living abroad return home for the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 许多旅居国外的希腊人夏天回国。

senses.meaning_en: Greek cuisine; typical Greek food

examples.text: We had Greek for dinner at a small taverna last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚在一家小酒馆吃了希腊菜。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to collegiate fraternities or sororities

examples.text: She is very involved in Greek life on campus.
examples.translation_cn: 她积极参与校园联谊会生活。

senses.meaning_en: a person with extraordinary intelligence or skill

examples.text: My sister is a genius at chess and has won three school titles.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹是国际象棋天才，已经赢得三次校级冠军。

senses.meaning_en: extraordinary mental or creative ability

examples.text: She has a genius for languages and speaks five fluently.
examples.translation_cn: 她有语言天赋，能流利地说五种语言。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden creative idea
senses.pattern: be a stroke of genius to do

examples.text: It was a stroke of genius to hire an experienced manager.
examples.translation_cn: 聘请一位有经验的经理是个妙计。

senses.meaning_en: a structure built to remind people of a person or event

examples.text: The city erected a monument to the victims of the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市为火灾遇难者树立了一座纪念碑。

senses.meaning_en: an old building or site that is historically important

examples.text: The castle was designated an ancient monument in 1952.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城堡于1952年被列为古迹。

senses.meaning_en: something that is a typical example of a quality or achievement
senses.collocation: stand as a monument to sth

examples.text: Her career is a monument to hard work and dedication.
examples.translation_cn: 她的事业是勤奋和奉献的典范。

senses.meaning_en: to perform, display or exhibit for the first time

examples.text: The new documentary will be premiered at the Berlin Film Festival.
examples.translation_cn: 这部新纪录片将在柏林电影节首映。

senses.meaning_en: first in rank or importance; most important or successful

examples.text: The city is home to the premier research institute in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市是该国顶尖的研究所所在地。

senses.meaning_en: the head of government in a parliamentary system

examples.text: The premier of China addressed the United Nations General Assembly.
examples.translation_cn: 中国总理在联合国大会上发表讲话。

senses.meaning_en: an offering made to a god or goddess

examples.text: They offered a goat as a sacrifice to the goddess.
examples.translation_cn: 他们献上一只山羊作为给女神的祭品。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of valuable things; accumulated wealth

examples.text: They found a hoard of treasure buried under the old oak tree.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在那棵老橡树下发现了一批埋藏的财宝。

senses.meaning_en: anything greatly valued

examples.text: This ancient manuscript is a national treasure and must be preserved.
examples.translation_cn: 这份古代手稿是国宝，必须加以保护。

senses.meaning_en: to value highly

examples.text: I treasure the memory of our first meeting in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 我珍视我们在巴黎初次见面的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: to store or stow in a safe place

examples.text: The silver cup is treasured in a glass cabinet in the dining room.
examples.translation_cn: 那只银杯珍藏在餐厅的玻璃柜里。

senses.meaning_en: to attract or make someone want something, especially something unwise

examples.text: Many shoppers are tempted to buy cheap imported goods.
examples.translation_cn: 许多购物者很想购买廉价的进口商品。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade or try to persuade someone to do wrong, often by offering a reward

examples.text: The gang tried to tempt him into stealing the car.
examples.translation_cn: 那伙人试图引诱他偷那辆车。

senses.meaning_en: to risk bad luck or danger by doing something risky

examples.text: Don't tempt fate by driving through that flooded road.
examples.translation_cn: 不要冒险开车穿过那条被淹的路。

senses.meaning_en: without being controlled or restricted; without obstruction

examples.text: Fresh air moves freely through the open window.
examples.translation_cn: 新鲜空气通过敞开的窗户自由流通。

senses.meaning_en: openly and honestly

examples.text: He freely admitted that he had made a mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他坦率地承认自己犯了一个错误。

senses.meaning_en: of one's own free will; willingly

examples.text: She freely offered to organize the school fair.
examples.translation_cn: 她自愿提出组织学校义卖会。

senses.meaning_en: favored by fortune; having good luck

examples.text: She was fortunate to escape injury in the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 她在车祸中幸运地没有受伤。

senses.meaning_en: bringing good luck; auspicious

examples.text: They chose a fortunate date for the wedding to ensure good luck.
examples.translation_cn: 他们选了一个吉利的日子举行婚礼以求好运。

senses.meaning_en: by good luck; luckily

examples.text: Fortunately for her, the exam was postponed until next week.
examples.translation_cn: 对她来说幸运的是，考试推迟到了下周。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid fuel used mainly in car engines

examples.text: This old engine runs on gasoline, not on diesel.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧发动机烧汽油，不烧柴油。

senses.meaning_en: rigid; difficult to bend

examples.text: The cardboard was too stiff to bend easily.
examples.translation_cn: 纸板太硬，不易弯曲。

senses.meaning_en: stiff and aching after exercise

examples.text: My legs feel stiff after yesterday's long run.
examples.translation_cn: 昨天长跑后我的腿感觉僵硬酸痛。

senses.meaning_en: harsh; severe; strong

examples.text: The government faces stiff opposition to its new tax plan.
examples.translation_cn: 政府的新税收计划面临激烈反对。

senses.meaning_en: formal and unfriendly

examples.text: He had a stiff manner that made the guests feel unwelcome.
examples.translation_cn: 他那生硬的态度让客人感到不受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: towards a higher place or position

examples.text: She looked upwards and noticed a bird's nest in the tree.
examples.translation_cn: 她向上看，发现树上有个鸟巢。

senses.meaning_en: to a higher number or amount

examples.text: Fuel prices have moved upwards again after the tax increase.
examples.translation_cn: 税收增加后，燃油价格又上涨了。

senses.meaning_en: towards a higher rank or more important position

examples.text: She moved upwards through the ranks to become regional manager.
examples.translation_cn: 她沿着职级晋升，成了区域经理。

senses.meaning_en: spoken or written words that are meaningless or untrue

examples.text: He talks nonsense when he claims the project was his own idea.
examples.translation_cn: 他声称这个项目是他自己的主意，简直是一派胡言。

senses.meaning_en: silly, illogical or worthless ideas, behaviour or things

examples.text: She has no time for nonsense from her colleagues during busy weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 在繁忙的几周里，她没有时间忍受同事们的胡闹。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to understand

examples.text: The cause of the fire remains mysterious to investigators.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾的原因对调查人员来说仍是个谜。

senses.meaning_en: of unknown origin or qualities

examples.text: A mysterious stranger knocked on my door at midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 一个神秘陌生人半夜敲了我的门。

senses.meaning_en: deliberately evasive or enigmatic

examples.text: He was mysterious about where he had been.
examples.translation_cn: 他对去过哪里故弄玄虚。

senses.meaning_en: at the present time; in the current era

examples.text: Nowadays, most people use smartphones instead of paper maps.
examples.translation_cn: 如今，大多数人使用智能手机而不是纸质地图。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle or missile that travels by expelling gas

examples.text: The space agency launched a rocket into orbit last night.
examples.translation_cn: 航天局昨晚将一枚火箭送入轨道。

senses.meaning_en: to increase or rise very quickly

examples.text: The company's shares rocketed to a record high on Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司股价周一飙升至历史新高。

senses.meaning_en: to move or fly very quickly upwards

examples.text: The red flare rocketed into the evening sky.
examples.translation_cn: 红色信号弹冲入夜空。

senses.meaning_en: to become famous or successful very quickly

examples.text: The young actress rocketed to fame after her first major film.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻女演员在她的第一部大片后迅速走红。

senses.meaning_en: lacking dexterity or skill

examples.text: He is awkward with chopsticks and often drops food.
examples.translation_cn: 他用筷子很笨拙，经常掉食物。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to handle or deal with

examples.text: The large box is awkward to handle because of its shape.
examples.translation_cn: 这个箱子因形状不便搬运。

senses.meaning_en: causing embarrassment or social discomfort

examples.text: She felt awkward about asking her boss for a raise.
examples.translation_cn: 她向老板要求加薪时感到难为情。

senses.meaning_en: to bend your head or body forward as a sign of respect or greeting

examples.text: The musicians bowed to the crowd and left the stage.
examples.translation_cn: 乐手们向观众鞠躬后离开了舞台。

senses.meaning_en: a knot with two loops, used for tying shoelaces, gifts, or as decoration

examples.text: She tied the ribbon in a neat bow around the present.
examples.translation_cn: 她把丝带在礼物上系成一个蝴蝶结。

senses.meaning_en: a weapon made of a curved piece of wood or other material, with a string, used for shooting arrows

examples.text: He practiced shooting with a bow and arrow every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天早上练习用弓箭射击。

senses.meaning_en: a curved bend in something such as a road, river, or an object

examples.text: The river flows in a wide bow around the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河绕山谷形成一个宽阔的弧形。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of liking or love and caring for someone or something

examples.text: She felt deep affection for her grandfather and visited him often.
examples.translation_cn: 她对祖父怀有深厚的感情，经常去看望他。

senses.meaning_en: a ball of air or gas in a liquid

examples.text: The children spent the afternoon blowing bubbles in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在花园里吹泡泡。

senses.meaning_en: a period of rapid economic growth followed by collapse

examples.text: When the housing bubble burst, many people lost their jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 房地产泡沫破裂时，许多人失去了工作。

senses.meaning_en: a closed social environment separated from outside influences

examples.text: Many politicians live in a bubble and ignore what ordinary voters want.
examples.translation_cn: 许多政客生活在自己的小圈子里，忽视普通选民的需求。

senses.meaning_en: elegant movement or pleasing quality

examples.text: The dancer moved across the stage with natural grace.
examples.translation_cn: 这位舞者以自然的优雅舞姿在台上移动。

senses.meaning_en: extra time allowed before a debt must be paid

examples.text: The loan was given a 30-day grace period before interest began.
examples.translation_cn: 这笔贷款在开始计息前获得了30天的宽限期。

senses.meaning_en: a short prayer of thanks before or after a meal

examples.text: We always say grace before dinner at my grandmother's house.
examples.translation_cn: 我们总是在祖母家饭前做谢恩祷告。

senses.meaning_en: favor, kindness, or mercy

examples.text: By the grace of God, the ship reached the harbor safely.
examples.translation_cn: 凭借上帝的恩典，船安全抵达港口。

senses.meaning_en: a large farm building used for storing crops or keeping animals

examples.text: They stored the hay in the barn before the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在暴风雨前把干草存放在谷仓里。

senses.meaning_en: to make a solid become part of a liquid, or to become part of a liquid

examples.text: She dissolved the tablet in water before taking it.
examples.translation_cn: 她在服用前把药片溶解在水里。

senses.meaning_en: to officially end an organization, marriage, or official body

examples.text: The prime minister dissolved parliament and called a general election.
examples.translation_cn: 首相解散了议会并宣布举行大选。

senses.meaning_en: to gradually become weaker and disappear

examples.text: The crowd slowly dissolved into the darkness of the night.
examples.translation_cn: 人群慢慢地消失在夜色中。

senses.meaning_en: to concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill

examples.text: The law firm specializes in cases involving international trade.
examples.translation_cn: 这家律师事务所专门处理涉及国际贸易的案件。

senses.meaning_en: an unreasonable dislike or unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge

examples.text: The report found widespread prejudice against older workers.
examples.translation_cn: 报告发现普遍存在对老年员工的偏见。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to have an unfair opinion

examples.text: Newspaper reports may prejudice the jury against the accused.
examples.translation_cn: 报纸报道可能使陪审团对被告产生偏见。

senses.meaning_en: to damage or harm someone's rights or chances

examples.text: Any further delays could prejudice her chances of promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 任何进一步的延误都可能损害她的晋升机会。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of armor carried on the arm

examples.text: The soldiers raised their shields and marched forward.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们举起盾牌向前行进。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that protects

examples.text: The vaccine provides a shield against the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 疫苗可作为抵御这种病毒的屏障。

senses.meaning_en: to protect someone or something

examples.text: She shielded her eyes from the bright sun.
examples.translation_cn: 她用手遮住眼睛，挡住刺眼的阳光。

senses.meaning_en: serving or intended to protect

examples.text: This sunscreen is highly protective against UV rays.
examples.translation_cn: 这款防晒霜对紫外线有很强的防护作用。

senses.meaning_en: wishing to protect somebody

examples.text: He has always been fiercely protective of his privacy.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是极力保护自己的隐私。

senses.meaning_en: to put something in a safe or hidden place

examples.text: He tucked the letter away in a drawer to keep it safe.
examples.translation_cn: 他把信藏在抽屉里以保安全。

senses.meaning_en: to sew small folds in cloth

examples.text: She tucked the dress to form a neat row of small folds.
examples.translation_cn: 她把裙子打褶，形成一排整齐的小褶。

senses.meaning_en: to push or fold something into a position so that it looks tidy or stays in place

examples.text: He tucked his shirt into his trousers before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 他离开前把衬衫下摆塞进了裤子里。

senses.meaning_en: to cover somebody comfortably with bedclothes

examples.text: She tucked the children in and read them a story.
examples.translation_cn: 她给孩子们掖好被子，然后给他们读了一个故事。

senses.meaning_en: a musical instrument played by hitting with sticks or hands; also its sound

examples.text: She plays the drums in a jazz band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一支爵士乐队里打鼓。

senses.meaning_en: to hit a surface repeatedly and make a continuous sound

examples.text: Rain drummed on the tin roof all through the night.
examples.translation_cn: 雨点打在铁皮屋顶上，响了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow cylindrical container or object, especially a large one for liquids

examples.text: They kept a drum of oil beside the stove.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在炉子旁放了一桶油。

senses.meaning_en: a row of bushes or small trees planted close together, especially to form a boundary

examples.text: They planned to plant a hedge along the back fence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们打算沿着后栅栏种一道树篱。

senses.meaning_en: a financial arrangement that reduces the risk of losing money

examples.text: Investors bought gold to use as a hedge against inflation.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者购买黄金，作为对冲通胀的工具。

senses.meaning_en: a statement that avoids giving a direct answer

examples.text: Her answers were full of hedges, so we learned nothing new.
examples.translation_cn: 她的回答全是含糊其辞，所以我们没得到什么新信息。

senses.meaning_en: a line of people or objects forming a barrier

examples.text: A hedge of police officers blocked the narrow street.
examples.translation_cn: 一排警察组成的人墙挡住了狭窄的街道。

senses.meaning_en: a yellow metal made from copper and zinc, used in industry and plumbing

examples.text: The door handles are made of solid brass.
examples.translation_cn: 门把手是实心黄铜做的。

senses.meaning_en: the group of wind instruments made of metal, or their players in an orchestra or band

examples.text: The brass section enters softly in the second movement.
examples.translation_cn: 铜管乐组在第二乐章轻柔地进入。

senses.meaning_en: a yellowish-brown colour like that of brass

examples.text: The lamp comes in a warm brass colour that matches the decor.
examples.translation_cn: 这盏灯有一种与装饰相配的暖黄铜色。

senses.meaning_en: high-ranking officers or officials; the top brass

examples.text: The top brass met to discuss the military budget.
examples.translation_cn: 高级军官们开会讨论军事预算。

senses.meaning_en: Not taking sides in a conflict such as war; nonaligned.

examples.text: The small country remained neutral in the conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小国在冲突中保持中立。

senses.meaning_en: Favoring neither the supporting nor opposing viewpoint of a topic of debate; unbiased.

examples.text: The judge remained neutral on the case until all evidence was presented.
examples.translation_cn: 法官在案件上保持中立，直到所有证据呈上。

senses.meaning_en: Having no sex; neuter.

examples.text: The English pronoun 'it' is neutral in gender.
examples.translation_cn: 英语代词 it 在性别上是中性的。

senses.meaning_en: Neither positive nor negative; possessing no charge or equivalent positive and negative charge such that there is no imbalance.

examples.text: An atom is electrically neutral when it has an equal number of protons and electrons.
examples.translation_cn: 原子在质子和电子数量相等时是电中性的。

senses.meaning_en: fully grown or developed physically; ready to be eaten or used

examples.text: The tree is fully mature and produces fruit every year.
examples.translation_cn: 这棵树已完全长成，每年结果。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing good judgement and the ability to behave as an adult; fully developed mentally

examples.text: She is mature enough to handle the criticism calmly.
examples.translation_cn: 她足够成熟，能冷静地面对批评。

senses.meaning_en: to become fully grown or developed; to reach a complete or final stage

examples.text: His early sketches matured into a distinctive style.
examples.translation_cn: 他早期的素描逐渐发展成一种独特的风格。

senses.meaning_en: suitable only for adults, especially because of sexual themes, violence, etc.

examples.text: This game is for mature audiences and features violent scenes.
examples.translation_cn: 这款游戏面向成人玩家，包含暴力场景。

senses.meaning_en: to bring something to full development or ripeness

examples.text: They mature the cheese for six months to deepen its flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 他们将奶酪熟成六个月，以加深其风味。

senses.meaning_en: the direction or region between north and east

examples.text: The village lies to the northeast of the town.
examples.translation_cn: 村庄位于城镇的东北方。

senses.meaning_en: situated in or towards the northeast

examples.text: The hotel is on the northeast coast of the island.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店位于该岛的东北海岸。

senses.meaning_en: towards the northeast

examples.text: The storm is moving northeast at twenty miles per hour.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴正以每小时二十英里的速度向东北移动。

senses.meaning_en: coming from the northeast

examples.text: A cold northeast wind was blowing all day.
examples.translation_cn: 寒冷的东北风刮了一整天。

senses.meaning_en: at once; without delay

examples.text: She instantly knew that something was terribly wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 她立刻知道出了严重问题。

senses.meaning_en: having little depth; not deep

examples.text: The water is too shallow to dive into.
examples.translation_cn: 水太浅，不能跳水。

senses.meaning_en: lacking depth of thought or feeling; superficial
senses.pattern: have a shallow understanding of sth

examples.text: He has only a shallow understanding of the issue.
examples.translation_cn: 他对这个问题只有肤浅的理解。

senses.meaning_en: a shallow place in a body of water

examples.text: The children were paddling in the shallows near the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在海滩附近的浅水处嬉水。

senses.meaning_en: not steep; close to horizontal

examples.text: The ramp was built at a shallow angle for wheelchair access.
examples.translation_cn: 坡道以平缓的角度建造，方便轮椅通行。

senses.meaning_en: a thin pointed weapon shot from a bow

examples.text: He shot an arrow at the target and hit the centre.
examples.translation_cn: 他向靶子射了一箭，正中靶心。

senses.meaning_en: a sign shaped like an arrow used to show direction

examples.text: Follow the arrow on the sign to reach the exit.
examples.translation_cn: 顺着标牌上的箭头走到出口。

senses.meaning_en: a large venue for sports events, with seats for spectators

examples.text: We watched the football match at the stadium last Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 上周六我们在体育场观看了足球比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a small round spot

examples.text: The town is only a dot on the map.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇在地图上只是一个小点。

senses.meaning_en: a punctuation mark, especially a full stop

examples.text: The sentence should end with a dot, not a comma.
examples.translation_cn: 句子应该以句点结束，而不是逗号。

senses.meaning_en: to spread or scatter over an area, often in a scattered pattern

examples.text: The meadow was dotted with wildflowers in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天草地上点缀着野花。

senses.meaning_en: one of the two symbols used in Morse code

examples.text: The letter E is a dot in Morse code.
examples.translation_cn: 字母E在摩斯电码中是一个点。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount of something; a speck

examples.text: Add just a dot of glue to the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 在角落涂一点胶水。

senses.meaning_en: a household appliance for keeping food fresh by cooling

examples.text: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator after breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 早餐后请把牛奶放回冰箱。

senses.meaning_en: full of life and energy

examples.text: She is lively and playful, always ready for a game of tennis.
examples.translation_cn: 她活泼好动，总是随时准备打网球。

senses.meaning_en: full of activity and excitement

examples.text: The market is lively with shoppers and street musicians.
examples.translation_cn: 市场上购物者和街头艺人熙熙攘攘，热闹非凡。

senses.meaning_en: bright and vivid

examples.text: She described the mountain scene in lively detail for us.
examples.translation_cn: 她为我们生动详细地描述了山景。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment used for climbing, with two long sides and rungs

examples.text: She climbed up the ladder to reach the top shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 她爬上梯子去够最上面的架子。

senses.meaning_en: a series of stages by which you can progress to a better position

examples.text: It takes years to climb the ladder in this company.
examples.translation_cn: 在这家公司要花多年才能一步步晋升。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thin hole in stockings or tights, like a ladder

examples.text: She got a ladder in her tights just before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她开会前裤袜上刚好抽了丝。

senses.meaning_en: a league table or ranking list
senses.pattern: at the top of the league ladder

examples.text: After three straight wins, our club is now at the top of the league ladder.
examples.translation_cn: 连续三场胜利后，我们俱乐部现在排在联赛积分榜首位。

senses.meaning_en: a person from whom one is descended

examples.text: The ancestors of modern humans lived in Africa.
examples.translation_cn: 现代人类的祖先生活在非洲。

senses.meaning_en: an earlier type from which something developed

examples.text: The abacus is regarded as the ancestor of the modern computer.
examples.translation_cn: 算盘被视为现代计算机的前身。

senses.meaning_en: expecting the best; hopeful

examples.text: She is optimistic about the future of the company.
examples.translation_cn: 她对公司的未来持乐观态度。

senses.meaning_en: an enclosure made of spaced bars for holding animals

examples.text: The zookeeper kept the injured parrot in a cage while its wing healed.
examples.translation_cn: 动物园管理员把受伤的鹦鹉关在笼子里，直到它的翅膀痊愈。

senses.meaning_en: something that hinders freedom

examples.text: After years of strict rules, her comfortable home began to feel like a cage.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的严格管束，她舒适的家开始感觉像个牢笼。

senses.meaning_en: a straight piece of wood, plastic or metal with marks, used for measuring or drawing straight lines
senses.pattern: draw a line with a ruler

examples.text: She drew a straight line with a ruler and marked every centimeter.
examples.translation_cn: 她用直尺画了一条直线，并标出每一厘米。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rules or governs a country or group of people

examples.text: The ruler of the country faced growing demands for political reform.
examples.translation_cn: 该国统治者面临日益增长的政治改革要求。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing worth keeping

examples.text: When I saw how he treated his dog, I knew he was a keeper.
examples.translation_cn: 当我看到他如何对待他的狗时，我就知道他是个值得珍惜的人。

senses.meaning_en: a goalkeeper or wicketkeeper

examples.text: She is the first-choice keeper for the national team.
examples.translation_cn: 她是国家队的首选门将。

senses.meaning_en: unfriendly and aggressive; showing strong dislike and a desire to harm

examples.text: The local people were hostile to the occupying army.
examples.translation_cn: 当地人对占领军怀有敌意。

senses.meaning_en: strongly opposed to something; not willing to accept it

examples.text: The committee was hostile to the idea of cutting costs.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会强烈反对削减成本的想法。

senses.meaning_en: difficult or dangerous to live in or use; very unfavorable

examples.text: The frozen landscape is hostile to most forms of life.
examples.translation_cn: 这片冰封的地貌对大多数生命形式来说是严酷的。

senses.meaning_en: being or relating to a hostile takeover

examples.text: The board is facing a hostile takeover bid from a rival company.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会正面临来自竞争对手的敌意收购。

senses.meaning_en: a large wild animal of the dog family that lives and hunts in groups

examples.text: A pack of wolves surrounded the injured moose.
examples.translation_cn: 一群狼包围了受伤的驼鹿。

senses.meaning_en: to eat something quickly and greedily

examples.text: He wolfed his lunch down before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会议前狼吞虎咽地吃了午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a frame or set of shelves for holding things

examples.text: He put his suitcase on the luggage rack above his seat.
examples.translation_cn: 他把行李箱放在座位上方的行李架上。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to suffer great physical or mental pain

examples.text: She was racked with guilt after lying to her best friend.
examples.translation_cn: 她对最好的朋友撒谎后深受负罪感折磨。

senses.meaning_en: to produce offspring or new organisms

examples.text: Bacteria reproduce by splitting into two identical cells.
examples.translation_cn: 细菌通过分裂成两个相同的细胞进行繁殖。

senses.meaning_en: to make a copy of a picture, sound, etc.

examples.text: This printer faithfully reproduces photographs from a digital file.
examples.translation_cn: 这台打印机能从数字文件忠实复制照片。

senses.meaning_en: to produce again; to recreate

examples.text: The team failed to reproduce the results of the original study.
examples.translation_cn: 研究团队未能重现最初研究的结果。

senses.meaning_en: to move slowly and quietly

examples.text: The cat crept up behind the bird and pounced.
examples.translation_cn: 猫悄悄从鸟身后爬近，然后扑了过去。

senses.meaning_en: to grow across a surface

examples.text: The ivy crept slowly across the garden wall.
examples.translation_cn: 常春藤沿着花园的墙慢慢蔓延开来。

senses.meaning_en: to change gradually

examples.text: House prices have crept up by five percent this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年房价已逐渐上涨了百分之五。

senses.meaning_en: to have a sensation as of insects creeping on the skin

examples.text: The thought of being buried alive makes my skin creep.
examples.translation_cn: 想到被活埋就让我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

senses.meaning_en: to ask God to protect or give good things to someone

examples.text: May God bless you and your family always.
examples.translation_cn: 愿上帝保佑你和你的家人永远。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a good quality or advantage

examples.text: He is blessed with a sharp mind and good health.
examples.translation_cn: 他天生头脑敏锐，身体健康。

senses.meaning_en: feeling lucky or grateful because of good things

examples.text: I feel blessed to have such caring friends around me.
examples.translation_cn: 我很幸运身边有如此体贴的朋友。

senses.meaning_en: to make something holy through prayer or a religious ceremony

examples.text: The priest blessed the water during the baptism.
examples.translation_cn: 神父在洗礼时祝福了水。

senses.meaning_en: a person or animal that lives in a particular place

examples.text: The last inhabitant of the village left in 2005.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村子的最后一位居民于2005年离开了。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a garment that covers the arm

examples.text: There is a tear in the sleeve of his shirt.
examples.translation_cn: 他衬衫的袖子上有个破口。

senses.meaning_en: a protective covering or lining for a machine part or cable

examples.text: You need to fit a protective sleeve over the cable.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要给电缆套上保护套筒。

senses.meaning_en: a protective cover for a record, book, or CD

examples.text: The record came in a sturdy cardboard sleeve.
examples.translation_cn: 这张唱片装在一个结实的硬纸封套里。

senses.meaning_en: a tattoo covering the whole arm

examples.text: He has a full sleeve on his left arm.
examples.translation_cn: 他左臂上有一整条花臂纹身。

senses.meaning_en: a young sheep

examples.text: The farmer carried a newborn lamb into the barn.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫把一只新生小羊抱进谷仓。

senses.meaning_en: meat from a lamb

examples.text: We are having roast lamb for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今晚晚餐吃烤羊肉。

senses.meaning_en: a gentle, meek person

examples.text: My father seems strict, but he can be a lamb around children.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲看似严厉，但在孩子们面前却像只温顺的羔羊。

senses.meaning_en: a box-shaped container that slides in and out of a piece of furniture

examples.text: He found his passport in the drawer by the bed.
examples.translation_cn: 他在床边的抽屉里找到了护照。

senses.meaning_en: a person who draws pictures

examples.text: She is a drawer of portraits with a delicate style.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位画风细腻的肖像画师。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to stay calm and not get annoyed when waiting or dealing with problems

examples.text: She didn't have the patience to wait for the results.
examples.translation_cn: 她没有耐心等待结果。

senses.meaning_en: a card game for one player

examples.text: He often plays patience on his phone during lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 他午餐时经常在手机上玩单人纸牌。

senses.meaning_en: the curved path of one object around another

examples.text: The space station is in orbit around Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 空间站正在绕地球轨道运行。

senses.meaning_en: to move around a planet or star in a curved path

examples.text: The Moon orbits the Earth once every 27 days.
examples.translation_cn: 月球每27天绕地球一周。

senses.meaning_en: an area of influence or control

examples.text: Small nations often fall within the orbit of larger powers.
examples.translation_cn: 小国常常落入大国的势力范围。

senses.meaning_en: a desire to hurt, annoy, or thwart someone

examples.text: She refused to help him purely out of spite.
examples.translation_cn: 她纯粹出于怨恨拒绝帮他。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately annoy or hurt someone

examples.text: He spread rumors just to spite his colleague.
examples.translation_cn: 他散布谣言只是为了气他的同事。

senses.meaning_en: notwithstanding; despite

examples.text: In spite of his injury, he finished the race.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管受伤，他还是完成了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: not excited, nervous or upset

examples.text: The pilot remained calm during the emergency landing.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员在紧急降落过程中保持镇静。

senses.meaning_en: a quiet and peaceful state or condition

examples.text: A sense of calm came over her when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到消息后，她感到一阵平静。

senses.meaning_en: free from noise and disturbance

examples.text: The library is usually calm and quiet, even during the lunch break.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆通常很安静，即使在午休时间也是如此。

senses.meaning_en: with little or no wind and small waves

examples.text: The little boat drifted slowly across the calm waters of the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 小船在平静的湖面上缓缓漂流。

senses.meaning_en: the buying and selling of goods, especially on a large scale between different places

examples.text: The internet has made commerce between distant countries faster and cheaper.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网让相距遥远的国家之间的贸易更快、更便宜。

senses.meaning_en: the business of an undertaker

examples.text: The family has been in the undertaking business for three generations.
examples.translation_cn: 这个家族从事殡仪业已经三代了。

senses.meaning_en: a promise or pledge to do something
senses.pattern: give an undertaking to do sth

examples.text: He gave an undertaking to complete the work by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 他保证在星期五之前完成工作。

senses.meaning_en: a task or project, especially an important one

examples.text: They carried out an undertaking to build a new bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 他们承担了一项修建新桥的任务。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy four-wheeled vehicle for carrying goods or people

examples.text: The pioneers traveled across the valley by wagon in search of new land.
examples.translation_cn: 拓荒者们乘四轮马车穿过山谷寻找新土地。

senses.meaning_en: a railway vehicle for carrying goods

examples.text: A wagon loaded with coal rumbled past the station.
examples.translation_cn: 一节满载煤炭的货车车厢轰隆隆地驶过车站。

senses.meaning_en: a child's small toy vehicle pulled by a handle

examples.text: The children took turns pulling the toy wagon around the yard.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们轮流拉着玩具小拉车在院子里跑。

senses.meaning_en: a shopping cart

examples.text: She pushed her shopping wagon down the narrow supermarket aisle.
examples.translation_cn: 她推着购物车穿过狭窄的超市过道。

senses.meaning_en: after a particular event or time; later

examples.text: Afterward, she apologized to everyone for her careless mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 后来，她为自己粗心的错误向大家道歉。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being equal in rights, status, or opportunities

examples.text: The law guarantees equality between men and women.
examples.translation_cn: 法律保障男女平等。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being equal in value, amount, or number

examples.text: The equation shows the equality of total cost and total revenue.
examples.translation_cn: 这个等式表明总成本与总收入相等。

senses.meaning_en: the remains of a destroyed or damaged building, such as a house or castle

examples.text: We walked through the ruins of the old castle.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走过那座旧城堡的废墟。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being destroyed or financially ruined

examples.text: After the fire, the family business was in ruins.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾过后，家族企业毁于一旦。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes someone's downfall or ruin

examples.text: Bad investments were the ruin of his career.
examples.translation_cn: 糟糕的投资毁掉了他的事业。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to lose all their money or force a business to close

examples.text: He was ruined by a series of bad business deals.
examples.translation_cn: 一连串糟糕的商业交易使他破产了。

senses.meaning_en: to damage something badly or make it impossible to use

examples.text: The flood completely ruined the engine beyond repair.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水彻底毁坏了那台发动机，无法修复。

senses.meaning_en: a hard stone used in building and sculpture

examples.text: The entrance hall is made of white marble.
examples.translation_cn: 门厅是用白色大理石建造的。

senses.meaning_en: a small glass ball used in children's games

examples.text: He rolled a glass marble across the kitchen floor.
examples.translation_cn: 他让一颗玻璃弹珠滚过厨房地板。

senses.meaning_en: a children's game played with small glass balls

examples.text: The children played marbles in the schoolyard after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午饭后孩子们在校园里玩弹珠游戏。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being dependable or trustworthy

examples.text: The reliability of these reports has been questioned by several experts.
examples.translation_cn: 这些报告的可靠性已受到几位专家质疑。

senses.meaning_en: the degree to which repeated measurements give the same result

examples.text: Researchers checked the reliability of the test across two sessions.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员在两次测试中检验了该测验的信度。

senses.meaning_en: a small, flat baked food that is crisp or firm; a cookie

examples.text: She dunked a chocolate biscuit in her tea and ate it.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一块巧克力饼干在茶里蘸了一下然后吃了。

senses.meaning_en: a small, soft bread roll served warm, similar to a scone

examples.text: We had warm biscuits and gravy for breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 我们早餐吃了热司康饼配肉汁。

senses.meaning_en: the part around the neck of a shirt, coat, etc.

examples.text: He turned up the collar of his coat against the cold wind.
examples.translation_cn: 他竖起外套的领子抵御寒风。

senses.meaning_en: a band put around an animal's neck or a similar encircling object

examples.text: She put a collar on her dog before the evening walk.
examples.translation_cn: 她在傍晚散步前给狗戴上项圈。

senses.meaning_en: to catch or seize someone

examples.text: The police collared the thief as he tried to escape.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在窃贼试图逃跑时逮住了他。

senses.meaning_en: an adult male cow

examples.text: A charging bull can cause serious injury if you get too close.
examples.translation_cn: 若靠得太近，一头冲过来的公牛会造成严重伤害。

senses.meaning_en: characterized by rising prices or expecting prices to rise

examples.text: Investors can make large profits in a bull market.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者在牛市中能获得丰厚利润。

senses.meaning_en: nonsense or untrue statements

examples.text: He said he was working, but that's bull.
examples.translation_cn: 他说他在工作，但那是胡说。

senses.meaning_en: large and strong, like a bull

examples.text: He had a bull neck and a shaved head.
examples.translation_cn: 他脖子粗壮，剃着光头。

senses.meaning_en: a small wooden shed

examples.text: They took shelter in a wooden hut during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨期间他们在一个小木屋里躲避。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel less confident or enthusiastic

examples.text: He was discouraged by the lack of progress.
examples.translation_cn: 他因进展甚微而气馁。

senses.meaning_en: to try to prevent something or persuade someone not to do something

examples.text: The campaign aims to discourage young people from smoking.
examples.translation_cn: 这项运动旨在劝阻年轻人吸烟。

senses.meaning_en: a person who runs, especially in races

examples.text: My brother is a runner in the 400-meter race.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥是400米赛跑的选手。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes goods illegally into or out of a country

examples.text: He worked as a drug runner before he was caught.
examples.translation_cn: 他以前当过毒品走私者，后来被抓。

senses.meaning_en: a sports shoe designed for running

examples.text: She bought a new pair of runners for the gym.
examples.translation_cn: 她为去健身房买了一双新跑鞋。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow piece of cloth or carpet

examples.text: She placed a table runner down the center of the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她把桌旗铺在桌子中央。

senses.meaning_en: closely acquainted; familiar
senses.pattern: be on intimate terms with sb

examples.text: She is on intimate terms with the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 她和整个团队关系都很亲密。

senses.meaning_en: personal and private

examples.text: She shared intimate details from her diary with me.
examples.translation_cn: 她跟我分享了日记里的私密细节。

senses.meaning_en: involving a sexual relationship

examples.text: He was intimate with her for over a year.
examples.translation_cn: 他和她有过一年多的亲密关系。

senses.meaning_en: very familiar with something; having a detailed knowledge
senses.pattern: have an intimate knowledge of sth

examples.text: She has an intimate knowledge of the city's history.
examples.translation_cn: 她非常熟悉这座城市的历史。

senses.meaning_en: sensitive or painful to the touch

examples.text: The bruise on my arm is still tender to the touch.
examples.translation_cn: 我胳膊上的淤青碰一下还很疼。

senses.meaning_en: easily bruised or injured; delicate

examples.text: Her skin is so tender that even a gentle touch can leave a mark.
examples.translation_cn: 她的皮肤非常娇嫩，轻轻一碰就会留下痕迹。

senses.meaning_en: soft and easily chewed

examples.text: Cook the chicken until tender before adding the sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 把鸡肉煮到嫩软后再加入酱汁。

senses.meaning_en: gentle and caring

examples.text: She was always tender with her elderly patients.
examples.translation_cn: 她对待老年病人总是温柔体贴。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of life and living things

examples.text: She decided to major in biology because she is fascinated by living things.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定主修生物学，因为她对生物着迷。

senses.meaning_en: the animals and plants of a particular place or environment

examples.text: The biology of the rainforest is incredibly diverse and still not fully understood.
examples.translation_cn: 雨林的生物极其多样，仍未完全被了解。

senses.meaning_en: any sea mammal of the order Cetacea, including dolphins and porpoises

examples.text: Dolphins and porpoises are both species of whale.
examples.translation_cn: 海豚和鼠海豚都是鲸目动物。

senses.meaning_en: a very large sea mammal that breathes air, usually excluding dolphins and porpoises

examples.text: Whales, unlike dolphins, can grow to enormous sizes.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸鱼不像海豚，能长到巨大的体型。

senses.meaning_en: not going in a straight line; not direct

examples.text: We took an indirect route to avoid the traffic jam.
examples.translation_cn: 我们绕道避开交通堵塞。

senses.meaning_en: not saying something openly or clearly

examples.text: He made an indirect reference to the company's financial problems.
examples.translation_cn: 他间接提到了公司的财务问题。

senses.meaning_en: not directly caused or connected

examples.text: The new policy may have an indirect effect on housing prices.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策可能对房价产生间接影响。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; excellent

examples.text: The movie was absolutely terrific from start to finish.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影从头到尾都精彩极了。

senses.meaning_en: very great or intense

examples.text: The rescue workers were under terrific pressure after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 地震后救援人员承受着巨大的压力。

senses.meaning_en: who ever (used for emphasis in questions)

examples.text: Whoever told you that you could take the day off?
examples.translation_cn: 到底是谁告诉你今天可以休假的？

senses.meaning_en: any person who; no matter who

examples.text: Whoever wants to join the team must try out first.
examples.translation_cn: 任何想加入球队的人都必须先参加选拔。

senses.meaning_en: a light, silver-white metal used for making foil, cans, and aircraft parts

examples.text: The frame of the bicycle is made of aluminum.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆自行车的车架是铝制的。

senses.meaning_en: the smallest unit of a chemical element

examples.text: An atom of oxygen usually has eight protons and eight neutrons.
examples.translation_cn: 一个氧原子通常有八个质子和八个中子。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount of something

examples.text: There is not an atom of truth in what he said.
examples.translation_cn: 他说的话里没有一丝真实。

senses.meaning_en: a single loop of thread or yarn made with a needle in sewing or knitting

examples.text: She repaired the torn seam stitch by stitch.
examples.translation_cn: 她一针一针地缝好了撕破的接缝。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden sharp pain in the side of the body

examples.text: I got a stitch in my side after running uphill.
examples.translation_cn: 我跑上坡后一侧岔气了。

senses.meaning_en: a nocturnal bird of prey with large eyes

examples.text: At dusk, an owl hoots from the tall pine trees.
examples.translation_cn: 黄昏时，一只猫头鹰在高高的松树上叫。

senses.meaning_en: a person who stays up late

examples.text: My brother is a night owl and often works until midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥是个夜猫子，经常工作到半夜。

senses.meaning_en: a flying insect that collects pollen and produces honey

examples.text: A swarm of bees flew over the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 一群蜜蜂飞过花园。

senses.meaning_en: a contest, especially in spelling

examples.text: He competed in a spelling bee last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年参加了拼字比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a length of thread, line or rope doubled over to make an opening

examples.text: Make a loop at the end of the rope and pull it tight.
examples.translation_cn: 在绳子末端打个圈，然后拉紧。

senses.meaning_en: a shape produced by a curve that bends around and crosses itself

examples.text: The road forms a loop around the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路绕湖形成一个环。

senses.meaning_en: a process that returns to its beginning and then repeats itself in the same sequence

examples.text: The computer program is stuck in a loop and cannot respond.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计算机程序陷入循环，无法响应。

senses.meaning_en: to form something into a loop or to fasten with a loop

examples.text: She looped the rope around the post and tied a knot.
examples.translation_cn: 她把绳子绕在柱子上，系了个结。

senses.meaning_en: a ring road or beltway

examples.text: Take the loop around the city to avoid the morning rush.
examples.translation_cn: 走环路绕过市区，避开早高峰。

senses.meaning_cn: 让某人知情；把某人拉进（讨论或事务）
senses.meaning_en: to include someone in a conversation or activity so that they are informed

examples.text: Could you loop in the finance team on this email?
examples.translation_cn: 你能把财务团队加进这封邮件，让他们知情吗？

senses.meaning_en: a long thin piece of leather or rope with a handle, used for hitting animals or people

examples.text: The coachman cracked his whip to signal the horses to start.
examples.translation_cn: 车夫甩响鞭子示意马儿出发。

senses.meaning_en: to mix cream, eggs, etc. quickly until they are thick

examples.text: She whipped the egg whites into stiff peaks for the meringue.
examples.translation_cn: 她把蛋清打发成硬性发泡来做蛋白霜。

senses.meaning_en: an official in a political party who makes sure party members attend and vote as the party wants

examples.text: The party whip reminded MPs to attend the crucial vote.
examples.translation_cn: 党鞭提醒议员出席关键投票。

senses.meaning_en: a problem or question that is hard to understand or explain

examples.text: The sudden change in his mood remains a puzzle to us.
examples.translation_cn: 他情绪的突然变化对我们来说仍是个谜。

senses.meaning_en: a game or toy that tests your thinking

examples.text: We spent the evening solving a jigsaw puzzle together.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚上一起拼了一幅拼图。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel confused because they cannot understand something

examples.text: I was puzzled by her sudden silence at dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚餐时她突然沉默，让我很困惑。

senses.meaning_en: to think hard about something difficult to understand

examples.text: He puzzled over the instructions for several minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 他对着说明苦苦思索了好几分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a fungus with a round cap and stem, especially one that can be eaten

examples.text: After the rain, we went to the forest to pick wild mushrooms for dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后，我们到森林里采野蘑菇当晚餐。

senses.meaning_en: something that grows or appears very quickly

examples.text: New apartment blocks have sprung up like mushrooms on the edge of town.
examples.translation_cn: 新公寓楼在城郊如雨后春笋般拔地而起。

senses.meaning_en: a painful infected swelling under the skin

examples.text: He had a painful boil on his neck and went to the doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 他脖子上长了个疼痛的疖子，去看医生了。

senses.meaning_en: to cook food in boiling water

examples.text: Boil the pasta in salted water for eight minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 将意面放入加盐的水中煮八分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to bubble up and turn to vapor when heated

examples.text: The water is boiling in the kettle; turn off the heat.
examples.translation_cn: 水壶里的水正在沸腾；关火。

senses.meaning_en: to heat a liquid until it boils

examples.text: Boil some water for tea before you add the leaves.
examples.translation_cn: 先烧些水泡茶，然后再加茶叶。

senses.meaning_en: an act or state of boiling

examples.text: Wait until the sauce comes to a boil before adding the pasta.
examples.translation_cn: 等酱汁煮沸后再加入意面。

senses.meaning_en: a shaking of the ground caused by movements beneath the earth's surface

examples.text: The coastal city was hit by a massive earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 那座沿海城市遭遇了一场大地震。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden and intense upheaval or disruption

examples.text: The leaked report triggered an earthquake in the banking sector.
examples.translation_cn: 那份泄露的报告在银行业引发了一场剧变。

senses.meaning_en: a glass or clay container with a wide mouth

examples.text: She stores coffee beans in a sealed glass jar.
examples.translation_cn: 她把咖啡豆储藏在一个密封玻璃罐里。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a sudden unpleasant feeling or shock

examples.text: The high-pitched noise jarred my nerves all day.
examples.translation_cn: 那尖锐的噪音一整天都让我心烦意乱。

senses.meaning_en: to preserve food in a jar

examples.text: My grandmother jars fresh peaches every summer for the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母每年夏天把新鲜桃子装罐保存过冬。

senses.meaning_en: a container and its contents; as much as fills such a container; a jarful

examples.text: She used up a whole jar of honey in one day.
examples.translation_cn: 她一天就用完了一整罐蜂蜜。

senses.meaning_en: a glass of beer or cider, served by the pint

examples.text: He ordered a jar of cider at the busy pub.
examples.translation_cn: 他在繁忙的酒吧点了一杯苹果酒。

senses.meaning_en: to use something effectively for a particular purpose

examples.text: We need to utilize existing resources to improve efficiency.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要利用现有资源来提高效率。

senses.meaning_en: good and important enough to spend time, effort, or money on

examples.text: It is worthwhile to compare prices before you buy.
examples.translation_cn: 购买前比较价格是值得做的。

senses.meaning_en: not clearly expressed or not precise

examples.text: The official spoke in vague terms about the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 这位官员对新政策含糊其辞。

senses.meaning_en: not clear in shape or outline; indistinct

examples.text: She could see a vague outline of the mountains through the mist.
examples.translation_cn: 透过雾气，她能看见群山的朦胧轮廓。

senses.meaning_en: not clearly felt or sensed; subconscious

examples.text: I have a vague feeling that something is wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 我隐约感到有什么不对劲。

senses.meaning_en: not thinking or expressing thoughts clearly

examples.text: She was vague about where she had been.
examples.translation_cn: 她含糊其辞，不说自己去了哪里。

senses.meaning_en: a person who catches fish for a living

examples.text: My uncle has worked as a fisherman on this coast for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔在这片海岸当渔民已经三十年了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who fishes for sport or pleasure

examples.text: He is an avid fisherman and spends most weekends by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个钓鱼爱好者，大部分周末都在河边度过。

senses.meaning_en: the sense of right and wrong that guides one's behaviour

examples.text: We cannot in good conscience ignore their suffering.
examples.translation_cn: 我们凭良心不能忽视他们的苦难。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of clothing worn on the foot and ankle

examples.text: She bought a pair of socks at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市场上买了一双袜子。

senses.meaning_en: to hit someone hard

examples.text: He socked the bully right in the jaw.
examples.translation_cn: 他猛击了那个恶霸的下巴。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing sympathy

examples.text: The nurse was sympathetic towards the anxious parents in the waiting room.
examples.translation_cn: 护士对候诊室里焦虑的父母表示同情。

senses.meaning_en: showing approval of or support for something

examples.text: The manager was sympathetic to the proposal for flexible working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 经理赞同灵活工作时间的提议。

senses.meaning_en: to ruin or damage something so that it is no longer enjoyable or useful

examples.text: The bad weather spoiled our plans for the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 恶劣的天气毁掉了我们去海滩的计划。

senses.meaning_en: to give a child too much or let them do what they want, so that they behave badly

examples.text: Her grandparents spoil her with too many gifts.
examples.translation_cn: 她的祖父母用太多礼物把她宠坏了。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone the ending of a story or film before they have seen it

examples.text: Don't spoil the ending for those who haven't seen it.
examples.translation_cn: 别向还没看过的人剧透结局。

senses.meaning_en: to become bad or not safe to eat

examples.text: Milk spoils quickly if you don't keep it cold.
examples.translation_cn: 牛奶如果不冷藏就会很快变质。

senses.meaning_en: a light gentle wind

examples.text: The thin white curtains moved gently in the breeze.
examples.translation_cn: 薄薄的白窗帘在微风中轻轻飘动。

senses.meaning_en: something that is easy to do

examples.text: The final exam was a breeze compared with last year's.
examples.translation_cn: 与去年相比，期末考试轻而易举。

senses.meaning_en: to do something easily

examples.text: She breezed through the interview and got the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻松通过了面试并得到了那份工作。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being certain

examples.text: I can say with certainty that the plan will work.
examples.translation_cn: 我可以肯定地说这个计划会成功。

senses.meaning_en: an instance or fact that is certain

examples.text: It is a certainty that taxes will rise.
examples.translation_cn: 税收将会上涨是确定无疑的事。

senses.meaning_en: Of high cost; expensive.

examples.text: It is costly to maintain a swimming pool all year.
examples.translation_cn: 全年维护一个游泳池很昂贵。

senses.meaning_en: causing serious loss or involving great sacrifice

examples.text: The delay proved costly for the whole project.
examples.translation_cn: 延误对整个项目来说代价很高。

examples.text: She felt great emotional distress over the loss of her job.
examples.translation_cn: 她因失业感到非常痛苦。

examples.text: The ship was in distress and sent a signal for help.
examples.translation_cn: 那艘船遇险并发出求救信号。

examples.text: She was deeply distressed by the news of her father's illness.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到父亲生病的消息后深感焦虑。

examples.text: The landlord used distress for rent to recover the debt.
examples.translation_cn: 房东通过扣押财产来追回欠款。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used for washing and cleaning

examples.text: She bought a bar of soap at the corner shop.
examples.translation_cn: 她在街角商店买了一块肥皂。

senses.meaning_en: a television or radio drama series

examples.text: He has appeared in the same soap opera for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 他出演同一部肥皂剧已经十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: to apply soap to something

examples.text: She soaped up the sponge and began scrubbing the dishes.
examples.translation_cn: 她用肥皂搓起海绵，开始刷盘子。

senses.meaning_en: a period of two weeks; fourteen days

examples.text: She worked on the project for a fortnight before taking a break.
examples.translation_cn: 她在休息前为这个项目工作了两个星期。

senses.meaning_en: a small stall for selling goods

examples.text: We bought fresh bread at a booth in the market.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在市场的一个摊位买了新鲜面包。

senses.meaning_en: a small enclosed space for one person

examples.text: She cast her vote in a polling booth.
examples.translation_cn: 她在投票间投了票。

senses.meaning_en: a seating area in a restaurant

examples.text: We slid into a booth by the window.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐进靠窗的卡座。

senses.meaning_en: a small enclosure for animals

examples.text: The farmer keeps his lambs in a booth at night.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫晚上把羊关在小隔间里。

senses.meaning_en: dried stalks of cereal plants used as material, bedding, or fodder

examples.text: The old basket was made entirely of straw.
examples.translation_cn: 这个旧篮子完全是用稻草做的。

senses.meaning_en: a single dried stalk of a cereal plant

examples.text: A piece of straw stuck to his sleeve.
examples.translation_cn: 一根稻草粘在他的袖子上。

senses.meaning_en: a thin tube used for sucking up liquid

examples.text: She drank her lemonade through a paper straw.
examples.translation_cn: 她用纸吸管喝柠檬水。

senses.meaning_en: a solid piece or mass with no regular shape

examples.text: She dropped a lump of clay onto the pottery wheel.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一块黏土丢到陶轮上。

senses.meaning_en: a swelling or abnormal mass in or under the body

examples.text: He found a lump on his neck while shaving.
examples.translation_cn: 他刮胡子时发现脖子上有个肿块。

senses.meaning_en: to put things together in the same group without careful distinctions

examples.text: It is unfair to lump all teenagers together as troublemakers.
examples.translation_cn: 把所有青少年一概归为捣乱者是不公平的。

senses.meaning_en: a small shaped piece of sugar used for sweetening drinks

examples.text: He dropped a sugar lump into his tea and watched it dissolve.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一块方糖放进茶里，看着它溶解。

senses.meaning_en: standing straight up; upright

examples.text: The guard stood erect with his shoulders back and chin up.
examples.translation_cn: 卫兵站得笔直，双肩后展，下巴微抬。

senses.meaning_en: stiff and standing out, especially because of sexual excitement

examples.text: Some men find it difficult to stay erect when they are stressed.
examples.translation_cn: 有些男性在压力大时难以保持勃起。

senses.meaning_en: to build or put up

examples.text: They erected a temporary fence around the construction site.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在工地周围竖起了一道临时围栏。

senses.meaning_en: a hard protective covering for the head

examples.text: You must wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle.
examples.translation_cn: 骑摩托车时必须戴头盔。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body between the ribs and the hips

examples.text: She wore a wide belt around her waist.
examples.translation_cn: 她在腰间系了一条宽腰带。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the waist

examples.text: She asked the tailor to take in the waist of her skirt.
examples.translation_cn: 她让裁缝把裙子腰部改小。

senses.meaning_en: the narrow middle part of something

examples.text: The waist of the guitar is narrow, so it is comfortable to hold.
examples.translation_cn: 吉他的腰部很窄，所以拿着很舒服。

senses.meaning_en: a small coin worth one hundredth of a pound in the UK or one cent in the US and Canada

examples.text: She paid the exact amount in pennies, and the cashier was not pleased.
examples.translation_cn: 她用便士硬币支付了精确金额，收银员不太高兴。

senses.meaning_en: money in general; a very small amount of money

examples.text: After paying the bills, he didn't have a penny left.
examples.translation_cn: 付完账单后，他身无分文。

examples.text: She left the last question blank because she didn't know the answer.
examples.translation_cn: 因为不知道答案，她最后一道题留了空白。

examples.text: She looked blank when I mentioned his name.
examples.translation_cn: 我提到他的名字时，她一脸茫然。

senses.pattern: a blank refusal to do sth

examples.text: He gave a blank refusal to sign the document.
examples.translation_cn: 他断然拒绝签署文件。

senses.meaning_en: an empty space in a form or document where information is to be filled in

examples.text: Please fill in the blank with your name.
examples.translation_cn: 请在空白处填上你的名字。

senses.meaning_en: a strong but temporary romantic feeling

examples.text: He has had a crush on his colleague for months.
examples.translation_cn: 他迷恋他的同事好几个月了。

senses.meaning_en: to press or squeeze something so hard that it breaks or is damaged

examples.text: The box was crushed under the weight of the books.
examples.translation_cn: 箱子被书的重量压坏了。

senses.meaning_en: to stop a rebellion or protest by force

examples.text: The army was sent to crush the uprising quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 军队被派去迅速镇压起义。

senses.meaning_en: a crowd of people pressing closely together

examples.text: Several people were caught in a crush near the stage.
examples.translation_cn: 几个人在舞台附近被拥挤的人群困住了。

senses.meaning_en: to surround with a wall, fence, etc.

examples.text: The playground is enclosed by a wooden fence.
examples.translation_cn: 操场被木栅栏围住了。

senses.meaning_en: to insert into a container, usually an envelope or package

examples.text: Please enclose a self-addressed envelope with your application.
examples.translation_cn: 请在申请中附上一个回邮信封。

senses.meaning_en: a long thin flexible length of twisted threads

examples.text: She tied the parcel with a length of cord.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一根绳子把包裹系好。

senses.meaning_en: a flexible insulated electrical cable

examples.text: The cord on the kettle is too short to reach the wall socket.
examples.translation_cn: 水壶的电线太短，够不到墙上的插座。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of volume for firewood

examples.text: We bought a cord of wood for the fireplace.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为壁炉买了一考得木柴。

senses.meaning_en: a structure in the body that resembles a cord, especially a tendon or nerve

examples.text: The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the rest of the body.
examples.translation_cn: 脊髓将信号从大脑传递到身体其他部位。

senses.meaning_en: to let out liquid, gas, etc.

examples.text: The factory was fined for discharging toxic waste into the river.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂因向河里排放有毒废物而被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: to officially allow someone to leave a hospital, the army, prison, etc., or to dismiss someone from a job

examples.text: He was discharged from hospital after successful surgery and will recover at home.
examples.translation_cn: 他手术成功后出院，将在家休养。

senses.meaning_en: to release an accumulated electric charge

examples.text: A faulty battery can discharge electricity even when the device is off.
examples.translation_cn: 有故障的电池即使在设备关闭时也会放电。

senses.meaning_en: to perform or complete an obligation; to pay a debt

examples.text: She discharged all her debts before moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她在移居国外前清偿了所有债务。

senses.meaning_en: a false idea or belief about something; the state of being deceived or misled

examples.text: He was under the illusion that the job was easy.
examples.translation_cn: 他误以为这份工作很容易。

senses.meaning_en: a trick performed by a magician

examples.text: The magician created the illusion of a floating ball.
examples.translation_cn: 魔术师制造了球漂浮的假象。

senses.meaning_en: to allow or permit something, especially different opinions or behaviour, without approval

examples.text: A free society must tolerate dissent, even when it is uncomfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 一个自由的社会必须容许异议，即使这令人不安。

senses.meaning_en: to bear or withstand something unpleasant

examples.text: He cannot tolerate extreme heat during the summer months.
examples.translation_cn: 他在夏季无法忍受酷热。

senses.meaning_en: danger; risk

examples.text: Wet floors are a hazard to elderly customers.
examples.translation_cn: 湿滑的地板对老年顾客是一种危险。

senses.meaning_en: to risk saying something that may be wrong

examples.text: She hazarded a guess about the cause of the delay.
examples.translation_cn: 她大胆猜测了延误的原因。

senses.meaning_en: a sand or water obstacle on a golf course

examples.text: His ball is now in a water hazard beside the fifth green.
examples.translation_cn: 他的球现在落进了第五洞果岭旁的水障碍区。

senses.meaning_en: a very large animal with thick grey skin, large ears, two curved tusks and a long nose called a trunk, native to Africa and Asia

examples.text: A herd of elephants was drinking at the waterhole.
examples.translation_cn: 一群大象在水坑边喝水。

senses.meaning_en: infrequently; rarely

examples.text: She seldom eats breakfast before going to work.
examples.translation_cn: 她上班前很少吃早餐。

senses.meaning_en: to go before or happen before something or someone

examples.text: The announcement was preceded by weeks of speculation.
examples.translation_cn: 公告发布前有几周的猜测。

senses.meaning_en: to say or do something to introduce something else

examples.text: He preceded his speech with a few words of welcome.
examples.translation_cn: 他用几句欢迎词作为演讲的开场白。

senses.meaning_en: the regular beat of blood as it is pumped through the body, felt especially at the wrist or neck

examples.text: The nurse took my pulse and wrote it on the chart.
examples.translation_cn: 护士测了我的脉搏并记录在表上。

senses.meaning_en: the rate at which the heart beats, measured in beats per minute

examples.text: He has a resting pulse of 62 beats per minute.
examples.translation_cn: 他的静息心率是每分钟62次。

senses.meaning_en: a single short increase in the amount of power, light, sound, etc., or a regular series of such increases

examples.text: The machine emits short electrical pulses to control the heart rate.
examples.translation_cn: 这台机器发出短促的电脉冲来控制心率。

senses.meaning_en: the beat or rhythm of a piece of music or verse; also, a repeated sequence of such beats

examples.text: The crowd moved to the steady pulse of the music.
examples.translation_cn: 人群随着音乐稳定的节拍移动。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that flows freely and is not a solid or a gas

examples.text: The solid turned to liquid when it was heated.
examples.translation_cn: 固体受热时变成了液体。

senses.meaning_en: in the form of a liquid; flowing freely

examples.text: The medicine is available in liquid form for children.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药有适合儿童的液态剂型。

senses.meaning_en: (of assets) easily sold or disposed of without losing value; having sufficient trading activity to make buying or selling easy

examples.text: The company must keep enough cash to remain liquid.
examples.translation_cn: 公司必须保留足够的现金以保持流动性。

senses.meaning_en: an implement for eating or serving food, with a shallow bowl and a handle

examples.text: She ate her soup with a spoon because it was too hot.
examples.translation_cn: 汤太烫了，她用勺子舀着喝。

senses.meaning_en: an amount that a spoon will hold; a spoonful

examples.text: Add a spoon of honey to the tea.
examples.translation_cn: 往茶里加一勺蜂蜜。

senses.meaning_en: an implement for stirring food while it is being prepared, especially a wooden spoon
