examples.text: Stir the sauce with a wooden spoon until smooth.
examples.translation_cn: 用木勺搅拌酱汁至顺滑。

senses.meaning_en: the middle part of something

examples.text: She stood alone in the midst of the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 她独自站在人群中间。

senses.meaning_en: a rule or fact that limits what people can do

examples.text: The government imposed strict restraints on public spending.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对公共开支实施了严格的限制。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to control your emotions or actions

examples.text: She responded with restraint to the unfair criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 她对不公平的批评表现出克制。

senses.meaning_en: a device that limits movement, such as a seat belt

examples.text: Always use a safety restraint when driving with children.
examples.translation_cn: 带孩子驾车时务必使用安全约束装置。

senses.meaning_en: of Poland, its people, or their language

examples.text: The instruction manual is written in Polish and English.
examples.translation_cn: 这本说明书是用波兰语和英语写的。

senses.meaning_en: to make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing

examples.text: She polished the silver teapot until it shone brilliantly.
examples.translation_cn: 她把银茶壶擦得闪闪发亮。

senses.meaning_en: to improve a piece of writing or speech by making small changes

examples.text: She spent hours polishing up her presentation for the conference.
examples.translation_cn: 她花了几个小时润色她的会议演示文稿。

senses.meaning_en: a small thin piece of metal with a point at one end, used for fastening things

examples.text: She fastened the hem with a pin before sewing it.
examples.translation_cn: 她在缝之前用大头针固定了下摆。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of jewellery that is attached to clothing with a pin

examples.text: She wore a diamond pin on her jacket at the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 仪式上她在夹克上戴了一枚钻石胸针。

senses.meaning_en: to press someone or something firmly against a surface so they cannot move

examples.text: In the struggle, one officer pinned the suspect to the ground.
examples.translation_cn: 搏斗中，一名警察将嫌疑人按倒在地。

senses.meaning_en: any of the individual connecting elements of a multipole electrical connector

examples.text: A pin on the connector is bent and needs to be replaced.
examples.translation_cn: 连接器上的一根插针弯曲了，需要更换。

senses.meaning_en: an object, especially a small ornament, believed to bring luck or magic power

examples.text: She wears a small charm on her bracelet to bring good luck.
examples.translation_cn: 她在手链上戴了一个小幸运符以求好运。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being pleasing or attractive

examples.text: The old town is full of charm, with its narrow streets and stone houses.
examples.translation_cn: 这个老城充满魅力，有狭窄的街道和石头房子。

senses.meaning_en: to attract or please someone very much

examples.text: She charmed the interviewers with her warm smile and confident answers.
examples.translation_cn: 她以温暖的微笑和自信的回答迷住了面试官。

senses.meaning_en: a hard hit made with the fist

examples.text: He threw a punch at the heavy bag and heard it smack.
examples.translation_cn: 他朝沙袋打了一拳，听到砰的一声。

senses.meaning_en: to hit someone or something hard with your fist

examples.text: He punched the intruder in the stomach and fled.
examples.translation_cn: 他朝闯入者的肚子打了一拳，然后逃走了。

senses.meaning_en: the power or impact of something that makes it interesting or effective

examples.text: The final paragraph lacks punch, so the essay ends weakly.
examples.translation_cn: 最后一段缺乏力度，所以文章结尾无力。

senses.meaning_en: to make a hole in something with a special tool or machine

examples.text: The conductor punched a hole in my train ticket.
examples.translation_cn: 检票员在我的火车票上打了一个孔。

senses.meaning_en: to enter information on a device or system

examples.text: She punched her PIN into the keypad and waited for the machine to authorize the card.
examples.translation_cn: 她在键盘上输入密码，等待机器授权卡片。

senses.meaning_en: to break (something brittle) violently

examples.text: He smashed the old plates into pieces with a hammer.
examples.translation_cn: 他用锤子把旧盘子砸得粉碎。

senses.meaning_en: to do much better than a previous record

examples.text: She smashed a world record by nearly two seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 她以近两秒的优势打破了世界纪录。

senses.meaning_en: a traffic collision
senses.pattern: be injured in a car smash

examples.text: He was injured in a car smash on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 他在高速公路上的一次撞车中受伤。

senses.meaning_en: the sound of a violent impact; a violent striking together

examples.text: We heard a loud smash from the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 我们听到厨房里传来一声巨响。

senses.meaning_en: a very hard overhead shot hit sharply downward

examples.text: She hit a powerful smash down the line to win the match.
examples.translation_cn: 她打出一记有力的直线扣球，赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: to leave out or not include

examples.text: The editor omitted several names from the final list.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑从最终名单中漏掉了几个名字。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to do something

examples.text: She omitted to mention that she had changed jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 她忘了提她已经换了工作。

senses.meaning_en: a stop or pause

examples.text: The bus came to a halt at the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 公交车在拐角处停了下来。

senses.meaning_en: the act of saying that something is not true or that someone is wrong

examples.text: The mayor's statement was a direct contradiction of the rumor.
examples.translation_cn: 市长的声明直接否认了谣言。

senses.meaning_en: a lack of consistency between statements, ideas, or facts; a statement that contradicts itself

examples.text: There is a clear contradiction between his words and actions.
examples.translation_cn: 他的言行明显矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: to allow tears or blood to flow

examples.text: She shed tears of joy when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到这个消息时流下了喜悦的眼泪。

senses.meaning_en: to give off light

examples.text: The lamp shed a warm light over the whole room.
examples.translation_cn: 灯把整个房间照亮了。

senses.meaning_en: to cast off skin, hair, leaves, etc.

examples.text: The snake sheds its skin several times a year.
examples.translation_cn: 蛇一年要蜕好几次皮。

senses.meaning_en: a small building for storage or shelter

examples.text: He keeps his tools in a wooden shed behind the house.
examples.translation_cn: 他把工具放在屋后的木棚里。

senses.meaning_en: a wide bowl for washing

examples.text: She filled a basin with warm water to wash her face.
examples.translation_cn: 她往脸盆里倒满温水洗脸。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land drained by a river

examples.text: Farmers have lived in the basin of the Yellow River for centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 农民们在黄河流域生活了几个世纪。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow area in the earth's surface formed by rock movement

examples.text: Slow folding formed a basin between the two mountain ranges.
examples.translation_cn: 缓慢的褶皱作用在两条山脉之间形成了一个盆地。

senses.meaning_en: a sheltered area of water used as a harbour

examples.text: The ferry docked in the harbor basin after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，渡轮停靠在内港。

senses.meaning_en: a small bag for carrying money, especially used by women

examples.text: She always keeps a few coins in her purse.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是在钱包里放几枚硬币。

senses.meaning_en: to press your lips together and push them forward, or to draw into folds or wrinkles

examples.text: She pursed her lips in disapproval at his crude remark.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到他粗鲁的话，不以为然地噘起了嘴唇。

senses.meaning_en: a sum of money available for a particular purpose

examples.text: The new bridge was built with money from the public purse.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新桥是用公款修建的。

senses.meaning_en: a handbag, especially one carried by women

examples.text: She carried a large leather purse over one shoulder.
examples.translation_cn: 她肩上挎着一个大的皮手提包。

senses.meaning_en: the dead body or parts of a dead person or animal

examples.text: Police found the remains of a missing hiker in the woods.
examples.translation_cn: 警方在树林里发现了一名失踪徒步者的遗体。

senses.meaning_en: the parts left after the rest has been used or eaten

examples.text: She threw away the remains of the meal.
examples.translation_cn: 她扔掉了那顿饭的剩余物。

senses.meaning_en: the parts of ancient buildings or objects that still exist

examples.text: We visited the remains of a Roman temple.
examples.translation_cn: 我们参观了一座罗马神庙的遗址。

senses.meaning_en: advantageous or suitable

examples.text: The conditions are now favourable for starting a business.
examples.translation_cn: 现在条件有利于创业。

senses.meaning_en: showing approval or support

examples.text: Most readers were favourable to the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数读者对新政策表示赞同。

senses.meaning_en: a private secondary school in the United States

examples.text: My cousin attends a private academy in Boston.
examples.translation_cn: 我表弟在波士顿的一所私立中学读书。

senses.meaning_en: a school or college that trains people in a particular subject or skill

examples.text: My brother is studying at a military academy.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥在一所军事学院学习。

senses.meaning_en: a society of scholars, scientists, or artists that promotes research or learning

examples.text: She was elected to the National Academy of Sciences last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年当选为国家科学院院士。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals with your feet

examples.text: More and more people are choosing to commute by bicycle.
examples.translation_cn: 越来越多的人选择骑自行车通勤。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being good, moral, or kind
senses.pattern: out of the goodness of one's heart

examples.text: She volunteers out of the goodness of her heart.
examples.translation_cn: 她出于内心的善良做志愿者。

senses.meaning_en: used to express surprise, shock, or relief

examples.text: My goodness, you gave me such a fright!
examples.translation_cn: 我的天哪，你吓了我一大跳！

senses.meaning_en: the healthy or nutritious part or content of something

examples.text: Steaming preserves the natural goodness in fresh vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 蒸煮能保留新鲜蔬菜的天然营养。

senses.meaning_en: to trick or deceive; to break rules to gain an advantage

examples.text: He cheated in the exam and was caught immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 他考试作弊，立刻被抓住了。

senses.meaning_en: to be unfaithful to one's spouse or partner

examples.text: She found out that her husband had been cheating on her.
examples.translation_cn: 她发现丈夫一直对她不忠。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid something that seems inevitable, especially death

examples.text: The pilot narrowly cheated death in the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员在坠机中死里逃生。

senses.meaning_en: a person who cheats

examples.text: Don't trust him; he's a cheat who never plays fair.
examples.translation_cn: 别信他，他是个从不守规矩的骗子。

senses.meaning_en: to cure a disease or injury; to make someone well again

examples.text: The doctor healed the patient's wound with a new treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 医生用新疗法治愈了病人的伤口。

senses.meaning_en: to become healthy again, especially of a wound or injury

examples.text: The cut on his knee healed up in about a week.
examples.translation_cn: 他膝盖上的伤口大约一周就愈合了。

senses.meaning_en: to repair a relationship or division; to reconcile

examples.text: The two leaders met to heal the rift between their countries.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人会晤以消除两国间的裂痕。

senses.meaning_en: a vitamin, mineral, or other substance taken to improve the diet

examples.text: She takes dietary supplements to boost her immune system.
examples.translation_cn: 她服用膳食补充剂来增强免疫系统。

senses.meaning_en: something added to improve or complete something else
senses.collocation: a supplement to the main text

examples.text: The online guide is a supplement to the printed manual.
examples.translation_cn: 这份在线指南是印刷手册的补充。

senses.meaning_en: to add something to something else to improve or complete it

examples.text: She supplements her salary with freelance work at weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 她靠周末做自由职业来补贴工资。

senses.meaning_en: an extra amount of money charged for a service or facility

examples.text: Guests must pay a supplement for a room with a sea view.
examples.translation_cn: 住客必须为海景房支付附加费。

senses.meaning_en: an abnormally high body temperature, usually caused by disease

examples.text: The child has a high fever, so we took him to hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 这个孩子发高烧，所以我们带他去了医院。

senses.meaning_en: any of various diseases, especially one with a high temperature

examples.text: He suffered from yellow fever during his trip to Africa.
examples.translation_cn: 他在非洲旅行期间得了黄热病。

senses.meaning_en: a state of great excitement or anxiety

examples.text: The whole city is in a fever of excitement before the final.
examples.translation_cn: 决赛前，整个城市都沉浸在狂热的兴奋之中。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a navy or warships

examples.text: The government plans to build a new naval base on the southern coast.
examples.translation_cn: 政府计划在南部海岸修建一座新的海军基地。

senses.meaning_en: to some extent; not completely

examples.text: The project was partially successful despite the limited budget.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管预算有限，这个项目取得了部分成功。

senses.meaning_en: a book that gives instructions or information about something

examples.text: The manual for the washing machine explains how to install it.
examples.translation_cn: 洗衣机说明书说明了如何安装它。

senses.meaning_en: done or performed with the hands

examples.text: He does manual work at a construction site.
examples.translation_cn: 他在建筑工地做体力活。

senses.meaning_en: operated by hand rather than automatically

examples.text: You can switch the camera to manual mode to adjust the exposure.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将相机切换到手动模式来调整曝光。

senses.meaning_en: to come into existence; to begin in a particular place or situation

examples.text: The word originates from Latin and Greek roots.
examples.translation_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

senses.meaning_en: to create, start, or cause something

examples.text: She originated the idea of flexible working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 她首创了弹性工作时间的想法。

senses.meaning_en: a heater that burns fuel to warm a room

examples.text: He sat by the wood-burning stove to warm his hands.
examples.translation_cn: 他坐在烧木柴的火炉旁暖手。

senses.meaning_en: a device used for cooking food

examples.text: She left the soup on the stove and it boiled over.
examples.translation_cn: 她把汤留在炉子上，结果溢了出来。

senses.meaning_en: similar; resembling each other

examples.text: The twins look so alike that even their parents sometimes confuse them.
examples.translation_cn: 这对双胞胎长得如此相像，以至于他们的父母有时也会弄混。

senses.meaning_en: in the same way; equally

examples.text: The manager treats all employees alike, regardless of their background.
examples.translation_cn: 经理平等对待所有员工，不论他们的背景如何。

senses.meaning_en: the science of electronic devices and systems

examples.text: She earned a degree in electronics last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年获得了电子学学位。

senses.meaning_en: electronic devices or their circuits

examples.text: The electronics in the car failed after the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后，车内的电子设备坏了。

senses.meaning_en: a barrier built across a river to control water flow

examples.text: They built a dam across the river to control flooding.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在这条河上筑坝以控制洪水。

senses.meaning_en: to block the flow of water; to hold back

examples.text: Beavers dammed up the stream to create a pond.
examples.translation_cn: 海狸筑坝拦溪，形成了一个池塘。

senses.meaning_en: a female parent of an animal, especially a horse or dog

examples.text: This mare is the dam of two champion foals.
examples.translation_cn: 这匹母马是两只冠军马驹的母亲。

senses.meaning_en: a fault or imperfection

examples.text: The car was recalled because of a defect in the braking system.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车因刹车系统存在缺陷而被召回。

senses.meaning_en: to abandon one's country or cause and join an opposing side

examples.text: The scientist defected from East Germany to the West in 1964.
examples.translation_cn: 这位科学家于1964年从东德叛逃到西方。

senses.meaning_en: timid; reserved; easily frightened

examples.text: He is shy around people and rarely starts a conversation.
examples.translation_cn: 他在人前很害羞，很少主动说话。

senses.meaning_en: short of; not having enough

examples.text: The fund is still shy of its goal.
examples.translation_cn: 该基金仍未达到其目标。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid doing something because of fear or lack of confidence

examples.text: He tends to shy away from direct confrontation.
examples.translation_cn: 他倾向于回避直接对抗。

senses.meaning_en: cautious or unwilling to do something

examples.text: He is shy of making promises he cannot keep.
examples.translation_cn: 他不愿做出自己无法兑现的承诺。

senses.meaning_en: the border between two countries or the edge of settled territory

examples.text: Many settlers built homes on the frontier during the nineteenth century.
examples.translation_cn: 十九世纪，许多移民在边境地区建立了家园。

senses.meaning_en: the limit of what is known or has been explored in a field; the leading edge

examples.text: Her research pushes back the frontiers of medical science.
examples.translation_cn: 她的研究拓展了医学科学的前沿。

senses.meaning_en: to send out a liquid in very small drops

examples.text: She sprayed cool water on the dusty leaves.
examples.translation_cn: 她往满是灰尘的叶子上喷凉水。

senses.meaning_en: a fine mist of liquid or something resembling it

examples.text: The boat sent up a fine spray of seawater.
examples.translation_cn: 小船溅起一片细密的海水水雾。

senses.meaning_en: a pressurized container; an atomizer

examples.text: He used a spray to water the seedlings.
examples.translation_cn: 他用喷雾器给幼苗浇水。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of material that attracts some metals by magnetism

examples.text: A strong magnet attracts iron nails from a distance.
examples.translation_cn: 强磁铁能从远处吸引铁钉。

senses.meaning_en: an alluring or attractive person or thing

examples.text: The city is a magnet for young artists.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市吸引着年轻艺术家。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or caused by magnetism

examples.text: A compass needle is magnetic and points north.
examples.translation_cn: 指南针有磁性，能指向北方。

senses.meaning_en: having a strong power to attract people

examples.text: She has a magnetic personality and makes friends easily.
examples.translation_cn: 她性格很有魅力，很容易交到朋友。

senses.meaning_en: a book for writing notes in

examples.text: Students write in a notebook during class every day.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们每天上课时在笔记本上做笔记。

senses.meaning_en: a person who behaves in a violent, antisocial or uncivilized manner

examples.text: He was a beast to his wife after losing his job.
examples.translation_cn: 失业后，他对妻子变得很凶残。

senses.meaning_en: a wild animal, especially a large or dangerous one

examples.text: The hunters followed the tracks of a wild beast for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 猎人追着野兽的足迹走了好几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to shake involuntarily, especially from cold, fear, or excitement

examples.text: She was trembling with fear as she read the letter.
examples.translation_cn: 她读信时吓得直发抖。

senses.meaning_en: to shake slightly, used of the ground, a building, etc.

examples.text: The ground trembled under the weight of the heavy trucks.
examples.translation_cn: 地面在重型卡车的重压下震颤。

senses.meaning_en: to be very afraid or anxious

examples.text: She trembled for her son's safety while he was at sea.
examples.translation_cn: 儿子在海上时，她为他的安全担忧。

senses.meaning_en: a slight shake or quiver, especially in the voice or hands
senses.pattern: with a tremble in one's voice

examples.text: She spoke with a slight tremble in her voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她说话时声音微微颤抖。

senses.meaning_en: to remove a cover from

examples.text: She uncovered the pot and let the steam escape.
examples.translation_cn: 她揭开锅盖让蒸汽散出。

senses.meaning_en: to reveal or disclose something, especially a secret or identity

examples.text: The journalist uncovered the identity of the thief.
examples.translation_cn: 记者揭露了窃贼的身份。

senses.meaning_en: as the representative of someone, or for their benefit

examples.text: She accepted the award on behalf of the entire team.
examples.translation_cn: 她代表整个团队领奖。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of paper or cloth fixed to something to give information about it

examples.text: The sales assistant put a price tag on every jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 销售助理给每件夹克贴上了价格标签。

senses.meaning_en: a children's game in which one player chases the others and tries to touch one of them

examples.text: The children played tag in the playground all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在操场上玩了一下午捉人游戏。

senses.meaning_en: a name or phrase used to describe or identify someone

examples.text: The media gave him the tag of 'bad boy'.
examples.translation_cn: 媒体给他贴上了“坏男孩”的标签。

senses.meaning_en: a final word or phrase added to a statement or speech

examples.text: She added a humorous tag to the end of her speech.
examples.translation_cn: 她在演讲结尾加了一句幽默的结束语。

senses.meaning_en: to make a systematic list of items

examples.text: The librarian cataloged all the new books under subject headings before adding them to the shelves.
examples.translation_cn: 图书管理员在把新书上架前按主题给它们编目。

senses.meaning_en: a series of related events, especially bad ones

examples.text: The inquiry uncovered a catalog of safety failures that had been ignored for years.
examples.translation_cn: 调查揭露了一连串被忽视多年的安全失误。

senses.meaning_en: to force or constrain someone to do something

examples.text: The new regulations compelled the factory to reduce its emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 新法规迫使该工厂减少排放。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a reaction or feeling, especially admiration or respect

examples.text: The scale of the disaster compelled the world's attention.
examples.translation_cn: 灾难的规模引起了全世界的关注。

senses.meaning_en: to announce officially or declare

examples.text: The president proclaimed that the election results were final.
examples.translation_cn: 总统正式宣布选举结果为最终结果。

senses.meaning_en: to show or indicate clearly

examples.text: The anonymous letter proclaimed him to be guilty of the crime.
examples.translation_cn: 那封匿名信显示他犯了罪。

senses.meaning_en: the time in between; interval

examples.text: We have an hour before the train leaves; in the meantime, let's have some coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 火车还有一个小时才开；在等待期间，我们去喝杯咖啡吧。

senses.meaning_en: during the interval; meanwhile

examples.text: The negotiations stalled; meantime, the economic situation continued to worsen across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 谈判陷入僵局；与此同时，全国经济形势继续恶化。

senses.meaning_en: spanning the world; throughout the world

examples.text: The company is known worldwide for its excellent service.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司因其出色的服务而闻名全球。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest

examples.text: My daughter is enthusiastic about learning to play the piano.
examples.translation_cn: 我女儿对学弹钢琴很热衷。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something weaker

examples.text: The scandal has weakened public trust in the government.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻削弱了公众对政府的信任。

senses.meaning_en: to become weaker or less strong

examples.text: The storm gradually weakened as it moved inland.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴向内陆移动时逐渐减弱。

senses.meaning_en: a distinctive smell, often left by an animal for tracing

examples.text: The hounds picked up the scent of a fox near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 猎犬在河边闻到了狐狸的气味。

senses.meaning_en: a perfumed liquid

examples.text: She bought a bottle of scent for her sister's birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 她为妹妹的生日买了一瓶香水。

senses.meaning_en: the sense of smell

examples.text: Dogs rely on their sense of scent to find food.
examples.translation_cn: 狗依靠嗅觉寻找食物。

senses.meaning_en: to detect by smell

examples.text: The tiger scented its prey from half a mile away.
examples.translation_cn: 老虎从半英里外就闻到了猎物的气味。

senses.meaning_en: causing suspicion

examples.text: The man standing alone by the car looked suspicious.
examples.translation_cn: 那个独自站在车旁的男人看起来很可疑。

senses.meaning_en: feeling that someone cannot be trusted or that something is wrong

examples.text: She was suspicious of his sudden offer to drive her home.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他突然提出开车送她回家感到怀疑。

senses.meaning_en: showing suspicion

examples.text: She gave him a suspicious look when he arrived late.
examples.translation_cn: 他迟到时她怀疑地看了他一眼。

senses.meaning_en: causing death

examples.text: The snake's bite was fatal to the young hiker.
examples.translation_cn: 蛇咬伤对年轻的徒步者是致命的。

senses.meaning_en: causing serious failure or a sudden end

examples.text: A single miscalculation proved fatal to the company's expansion plans.
examples.translation_cn: 一个误算让公司的扩张计划一败涂地。

senses.meaning_en: a pile or large amount of things

examples.text: She placed a stack of papers on the desk.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一叠文件放在桌子上。

senses.meaning_en: a tall column of rock in the sea

examples.text: We photographed a dramatic stack just off the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 我们拍摄了海岸附近一座壮观的蚀岩柱。

senses.meaning_en: library bookshelves for large collections

examples.text: The rare books are kept in the library stacks.
examples.translation_cn: 这些珍本书保存在图书馆书库中。

senses.meaning_en: a tall chimney

examples.text: Thick black smoke rose from the factory stack.
examples.translation_cn: 浓浓黑烟从工厂烟囱里升起。

senses.meaning_cn: 把物品整齐地叠放起来
senses.meaning_en: to arrange things in a neat pile
senses.pattern: stack the blocks on top of each other

examples.text: Stack the blocks on top of each other.
examples.translation_cn: 把积木一块一块叠起来。

senses.meaning_en: a large bag made of strong material

examples.text: He carried a sack of potatoes on his back.
examples.translation_cn: 他背着一袋土豆。

senses.meaning_en: dismissal from a job

examples.text: He got the sack for always being late.
examples.translation_cn: 他因总是迟到被解雇了。

senses.meaning_en: the plundering of a city or town

examples.text: The sack of the city lasted three days.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市遭到洗劫持续了三天。

senses.meaning_en: relating to mobile phones, networks, or devices

examples.text: You can check your balance on a mobile device.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在移动设备上查询余额。

senses.meaning_en: able to move freely or easily

examples.text: After the hip operation, she became much less mobile.
examples.translation_cn: 髋部手术后，她行动远不如以前方便。

senses.meaning_en: able to be moved or moving easily; not fixed

examples.text: These days, many young professionals are geographically mobile.
examples.translation_cn: 如今，许多年轻专业人士在地域上流动性很强。

senses.meaning_en: intentionally causing pain and suffering; merciless

examples.text: He was cruel to the new student for no reason.
examples.translation_cn: 他无缘无故地对新学生很残忍。

senses.meaning_en: harsh or severe

examples.text: He had to accept the cruel reality of his failure.
examples.translation_cn: 他不得不接受自己失败的残酷现实。

senses.meaning_en: unkind and hurtful in speech

examples.text: He said cruel things to her during the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵时他对她说了刻薄的话。

senses.meaning_en: a book used for studying a subject, especially in schools or colleges

examples.text: The professor assigned a required textbook on constitutional law.
examples.translation_cn: 教授指定了一本宪法学必修教材。

senses.meaning_en: being a perfect example of something

examples.text: Her response was a textbook example of effective crisis management.
examples.translation_cn: 她的反应是有效危机管理的教科书式范例。

senses.meaning_en: done exactly correctly, in an exemplary way

examples.text: The surgeon performed the operation with textbook precision.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生以教科书式的精准完成了手术。

senses.meaning_en: to become smaller in size or amount

examples.text: The company's profits shrank by 15% last year.
examples.translation_cn: 公司利润去年缩减了15%。

senses.meaning_en: to make something smaller, especially cloth

examples.text: Hot water shrank my favourite cotton shirt in the wash.
examples.translation_cn: 热水使我最喜欢的棉衬衫缩水了。

senses.meaning_en: to move back or away because of fear or disgust

examples.text: He shrank from challenging his boss in public.
examples.translation_cn: 他不敢当众挑战老板。

senses.meaning_en: stiff and difficult to bend

examples.text: The rubber hose becomes rigid in cold weather.
examples.translation_cn: 橡胶管在寒冷天气中变硬。

senses.meaning_en: unwilling to change opinions, rules, or methods

examples.text: My father is rigid about his political views.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲在自己的政治观点上很固执。

senses.meaning_en: not moving; fixed in position

examples.text: She stood rigid with fear during the explosion.
examples.translation_cn: 爆炸时她吓得僵住了。

senses.meaning_en: strange or unusual

examples.text: The empty house looked peculiar in the moonlight.
examples.translation_cn: 那座空房子在月光下看起来很怪异。

senses.meaning_en: particular to a place or situation

examples.text: This species of bird is peculiar to the island.
examples.translation_cn: 这种鸟是该岛特有的。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to do or attend to something

examples.text: He neglected to review the contract before signing it.
examples.translation_cn: 他在签字之前忘记审查合同。

senses.meaning_en: to pay too little attention to someone or something

examples.text: The report neglected the concerns of local residents.
examples.translation_cn: 报告忽视了当地居民的担忧。

senses.meaning_en: the act of failing to give proper care or attention

examples.text: The accident was caused by neglect of safety rules.
examples.translation_cn: 事故是由于忽视安全规则造成的。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being neglected

examples.text: The old mansion fell into neglect after the war.
examples.translation_cn: 这座旧宅第在战后失修了。

senses.meaning_en: a cereal grain used to make flour

examples.text: Farmers in this area grow wheat after the rainy season.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区的农民在雨季后种植小麦。

senses.meaning_en: money paid for transport

examples.text: The fare to the airport is fifteen dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 去机场的车费是十五美元。

senses.meaning_en: a paying passenger, especially in a taxi

examples.text: The taxi driver picked up a fare outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 出租车司机在车站外载了一位乘客。

senses.meaning_en: to progress or perform in a particular way

examples.text: The team fared badly in their final match.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在最后一场比赛中表现糟糕。

senses.meaning_en: food and drink, especially of a particular type or served in a particular place

examples.text: The small restaurant serves traditional French fare at reasonable prices.
examples.translation_cn: 这家小餐馆以合理的价格供应传统法式菜肴。

senses.meaning_en: to move continuously around a system or place; to make something move in this way

examples.text: The heart circulates blood around the body continuously.
examples.translation_cn: 心脏使血液在全身持续循环。

senses.meaning_en: to spread or pass from person to person; to become widely known

examples.text: Rumors about his resignation circulate widely on campus.
examples.translation_cn: 关于他辞职的谣言在校园里广为流传。

senses.meaning_en: to move among people at a social event, talking to different people

examples.text: He circulated among the guests at the reception.
examples.translation_cn: 他在招待会上与客人周旋。

senses.meaning_en: producing a profit

examples.text: The new store is already profitable for the owners.
examples.translation_cn: 这家新店已经为店主带来了利润。

senses.meaning_en: beneficial or useful

examples.text: The training course proved profitable for her teaching.
examples.translation_cn: 这个培训课程对她的教学很有益。

senses.meaning_en: the rubber covering that fits around the wheel of a vehicle, bicycle, etc.

examples.text: We had a flat tyre on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在高速公路上车胎瘪了。

senses.meaning_en: to die or kill by suffocating in water

examples.text: He drowned in the river after falling from the boat.
examples.translation_cn: 他从船上掉到河里淹死了。

senses.meaning_en: to submerge or flood an area

examples.text: The village was drowned by the rising floodwaters.
examples.translation_cn: 村庄被上涨的洪水淹没了。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent a sound from being heard by making a louder noise

examples.text: The sound of the engine drowned out her voice.
examples.translation_cn: 引擎的声音盖过了她说话的声音。

senses.meaning_en: a container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or small items

examples.text: She filled the bucket with cold water from the well.
examples.translation_cn: 她从井里打来冷水装满了桶。

senses.meaning_en: the amount a bucket holds

examples.text: He drank a bucket of water after the marathon.
examples.translation_cn: 他跑完马拉松后喝了一桶水。

senses.meaning_en: to rain very heavily

examples.text: It buckets down every afternoon in the rainy season.
examples.translation_cn: 雨季每天下午都下大雨。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount of something

examples.text: They spent buckets of money on the new house.
examples.translation_cn: 他们花了很多钱买新房子。

senses.meaning_en: in a natural state; not processed or refined

examples.text: The plant's leaves are used in their crude form to treat minor burns.
examples.translation_cn: 这种植物的叶子以天然形态被用来治疗轻微烧伤。

senses.meaning_en: simple and not very accurate or detailed

examples.text: The report offers only a crude estimate of the cost.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告只提供了成本的粗略估计。

senses.meaning_en: vulgar or offensive

examples.text: He apologized for making a crude joke at dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他为在晚餐时开了一个粗俗的玩笑而道歉。

senses.meaning_en: a dense tropical forest

examples.text: The temple lies hidden deep in the jungle.
examples.translation_cn: 寺庙深藏在丛林之中。

senses.meaning_en: a tangled mass or confused place

examples.text: The attic was a jungle of old furniture and boxes.
examples.translation_cn: 阁楼上堆满了旧家具和箱子，一片杂乱。

senses.meaning_en: a situation of ruthless competition

examples.text: In this cutthroat industry, the law of the jungle prevails.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个残酷的行业里，弱肉强食的法则盛行。

senses.meaning_en: an opening or passage through which air, smoke, or liquid escapes

examples.text: The kitchen window acts as an outlet for cooking smoke.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房窗户充当烹饪油烟的排出口。

senses.meaning_en: a shop that sells goods of a particular brand, often at reduced prices

examples.text: We found those jeans at a Levi's outlet.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一家李维斯折扣店找到了那条牛仔裤。

senses.meaning_en: a wall-mounted socket that provides electricity

examples.text: Plug the lamp into the outlet behind the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 把灯插到沙发后面的插座上。

senses.meaning_en: a means of expressing or releasing strong feelings or energy

examples.text: Writing in a journal gives her an outlet for stress.
examples.translation_cn: 写日记给了她一个释放压力的途径。

senses.meaning_en: of a verb form or sentence: in the passive voice

examples.text: In the sentence “The window was broken,” the verb is in the passive voice.
examples.translation_cn: 在句子“The window was broken”中，动词是被动语态。

senses.meaning_en: not active; letting things happen without trying to change or resist

examples.text: She remained passive during the argument instead of defending herself.
examples.translation_cn: 她在争吵中一直很被动，没有为自己辩护。

senses.meaning_en: the act of interfering or something that interferes

examples.text: He resented any interference in his personal life.
examples.translation_cn: 他讨厌别人干涉他的私生活。

senses.meaning_en: unwanted signals or factors that disrupt a device, system, or process

examples.text: The power lines caused interference with the hospital's monitoring equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 输电线对医院的监测设备造成了干扰。

senses.meaning_en: the illegal blocking of an opponent in some ball games

examples.text: The defender was called for interference in the final minute.
examples.translation_cn: 这名后卫在最后一分钟被判阻挡犯规。

senses.meaning_en: a strong desire to know or learn something

examples.text: She read the letter out of curiosity, though it was meant for someone else.
examples.translation_cn: 她出于好奇读了那封信，尽管信是写给别人的。

senses.meaning_en: an unusual or interesting object or fact

examples.text: The old clock in the hall is something of a curiosity for visitors.
examples.translation_cn: 大厅里的那座旧钟对游客来说算是一件奇物。

senses.meaning_en: a mechanical being designed to look like a human or other creature

examples.text: The museum displayed a humanoid robot that can smile and answer simple questions.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出了一个会微笑、能回答简单问题的仿人机器人。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that can perform complex tasks, especially when programmable

examples.text: The factory programmed its robots to weld car bodies at night.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂给它的机器人编程，让它们夜间焊接车身。

senses.meaning_en: software designed to perform a task automatically

examples.text: They use a robot to monitor network traffic for unusual activity.
examples.translation_cn: 他们使用一个自动程序监控网络流量以发现异常活动。

senses.meaning_en: a person who seems to lack emotions or individuality

examples.text: He answered every question like a robot, without any expression.
examples.translation_cn: 他像个机器人一样回答每个问题，毫无表情。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make something wide or wider

examples.text: The narrow track widens into a broad gravel road.
examples.translation_cn: 这条狭窄的小路变宽成了一条宽阔的碎石路。

senses.meaning_en: to broaden or extend in scope or range
senses.pattern: widen the gap between A and B

examples.text: The crisis has widened the gap between rich and poor nations.
examples.translation_cn: 这场危机拉大了富国与穷国之间的差距。

senses.meaning_en: to let out clothes to a larger size

examples.text: She had the dress widened for the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 她让人把那条连衣裙放宽了，准备婚礼时穿。

senses.meaning_en: in a similar manner

examples.text: When the captain lowered his voice, the crew did likewise.
examples.translation_cn: 船长压低声音，船员们也照做了。

senses.meaning_en: the same to you; used as a response

examples.text: 'Enjoy your trip,' he said. 'Likewise!' she answered with a smile.
examples.translation_cn: 他祝她旅途愉快，她微笑着回了一句“彼此彼此！”

senses.meaning_en: also; moreover

examples.text: The new model is faster; likewise, it uses less fuel.
examples.translation_cn: 新款速度更快，而且更省油。

senses.meaning_en: a branching, hair-like structure that grows on the bodies of birds, used for flight, swimming, protection and display.

examples.text: The young eagle is covered in dark brown feathers.
examples.translation_cn: 这只小鹰全身覆盖着深棕色的羽毛。

senses.meaning_en: to put something briefly into a liquid

examples.text: She dipped the brush into the paint and started to paint the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 她把刷子浸入油漆中，开始刷墙。

senses.meaning_en: a lower part of a road or surface

examples.text: The car bounced as it hit a dip in the road.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车驶过路面低洼处时颠了一下。

senses.meaning_en: a short swim
senses.pattern: take a dip in the lake

examples.text: We took a dip in the lake to cool off.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下湖游了一会儿凉快一下。

senses.meaning_en: an act of dipping briefly into a liquid

examples.text: A quick dip in soapy water will remove the insects from the lettuce.
examples.translation_cn: 在肥皂水里快速浸一下就能去除生菜上的虫子。

senses.meaning_en: a downward slope or angle

examples.text: The hillside has a gentle dip toward the river.
examples.translation_cn: 山坡向河流微微倾斜。

senses.meaning_en: to talk with too much pride about something you have or can do

examples.text: She boasted about winning the competition last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周吹嘘自己赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: to have or own something impressive or a special quality that is a reason to be proud

examples.text: The town boasts a long history and a vibrant arts scene.
examples.translation_cn: 这座小镇拥有悠久的历史和充满活力的艺术氛围。

senses.meaning_en: something that a person is proud of and talks about in a proud way

examples.text: The ancient bridge is the boast of the village.
examples.translation_cn: 这座古桥是这个村庄引以为豪的事物。

senses.meaning_en: a proud statement about something you have or can do; a brag

examples.text: His boast that he was the best player was simply untrue.
examples.translation_cn: 他自称是最好的球员，这完全不是事实。

senses.meaning_en: to decrease suddenly and sharply (of prices, values, etc.)

examples.text: Oil prices plunged by 30% during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机期间油价暴跌了30%。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody/something suddenly experience something unpleasant

examples.text: The sudden resignation of the CEO plunged the company into chaos.
examples.translation_cn: 首席执行官的突然辞职使公司陷入混乱。

senses.meaning_en: to jump or dive quickly and forcefully into something

examples.text: She plunged headlong into the river to rescue the child.
examples.translation_cn: 她一头扎进河里救孩子。

senses.meaning_en: to push something suddenly and forcefully into a liquid or a soft substance

examples.text: Plunge the leaves into cold water to preserve their color.
examples.translation_cn: 把叶子浸入冷水中以保持颜色。

senses.meaning_en: a list showing the times at which events happen, especially for transport or classes

examples.text: According to the timetable, the next bus leaves at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 根据时刻表，下一班公共汽车中午发车。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange for an event or activity to take place at a particular time

examples.text: The final exam is timetabled for Friday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 期末考试被安排在周五上午。

senses.meaning_en: the top or cover of a container

examples.text: Put the lid on the pot before it boils over.
examples.translation_cn: 趁锅还没溢出，把盖子盖上。

senses.meaning_en: an eyelid

examples.text: Her lids drooped and she fell asleep on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 她的眼睑耷拉下来，在沙发上睡着了。

senses.meaning_en: extremely large or great

examples.text: She felt immense relief when the test results came back negative.
examples.translation_cn: 当检查结果出来是阴性时，她感到极大的宽慰。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good

examples.text: The band's performance at the festival was absolutely immense.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队在音乐节上的演出精彩绝伦。

senses.meaning_en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted

examples.text: The abandoned garden was overgrown with weeds after the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后，废弃的花园里长满了杂草。

senses.meaning_en: the drug cannabis

examples.text: He was caught smoking weed in the park last night.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨晚在公园吸大麻被抓住了。

senses.meaning_en: to remove weeds from the ground

examples.text: She spent the afternoon weeding the vegetable garden.
examples.translation_cn: 她花了一下午给菜园除草。

senses.meaning_en: to remove unwanted people or things from a group

examples.text: The committee aims to weed out ineffective programs by next year.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会计划在明年之前剔除无效的项目。

senses.meaning_en: a physically weak person

examples.text: He was a shy kid and a bit of a weed at school.
examples.translation_cn: 他上学时是个害羞的孩子，身体有点瘦弱。

senses.meaning_en: to cause or awaken an emotion or reaction

examples.text: The new policy has aroused strong public interest in renewable energy.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策激起了公众对可再生能源的强烈兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to feel sexual excitement

examples.text: He was clearly sexually aroused by the explicit photograph.
examples.translation_cn: 他明显被那张露骨照片激起了性欲。

senses.meaning_en: to wake someone from sleep

examples.text: A loud noise finally aroused him from a deep sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 一声巨响最终把他从沉睡中唤醒。

senses.meaning_en: to use something or someone instead of another thing or person

examples.text: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
examples.translation_cn: 做这道菜时，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

senses.meaning_en: a replacement or stand-in for something that achieves a similar result or purpose

examples.text: Olive oil is a good substitute for butter.
examples.translation_cn: 橄榄油是黄油很好的替代品。

senses.meaning_en: to make something clearer or easier to understand by explaining it

examples.text: The minister was asked to clarify what the new policy would mean for schools.
examples.translation_cn: 这位部长被要求澄清新政策将对学校意味着什么。

senses.meaning_en: to make or become clear by removing impurities, especially from a liquid

examples.text: To make ghee, clarify butter by heating it slowly and removing the solids.
examples.translation_cn: 要制作酥油，需缓慢加热黄油并去除杂质使其澄清。

senses.meaning_en: to make something clearer or easier to understand

examples.text: She clarified that the meeting would start at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 她澄清说会议将在中午开始。

senses.meaning_en: pleasant and charismatic

examples.text: I find the little fishing village charming in the early morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得这个小渔村在清晨很迷人。

senses.meaning_en: to see briefly or catch sight of

examples.text: I glimpsed a deer running through the trees.
examples.translation_cn: 我瞥见一只鹿跑过树林。

senses.meaning_en: to look briefly

examples.text: She glimpsed at her watch and hurried away.
examples.translation_cn: 她匆匆看了一眼手表，然后急忙走了。

senses.meaning_en: a brief or incomplete look or experience

examples.text: The documentary gave us a glimpse of life in the deep ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片让我们初步了解了深海生活。

senses.meaning_en: a primate other than a human, especially a small, long-tailed one

examples.text: A troop of monkeys crossed the road in front of our jeep.
examples.translation_cn: 一群猴子从我们吉普车前穿过马路。

senses.meaning_en: to behave in a silly or playful way, or to handle something carelessly

examples.text: He was monkeying around with the TV remote and broke it.
examples.translation_cn: 他瞎弄电视遥控器，把它弄坏了。

senses.meaning_en: a mischievous child

examples.text: My nephew is a little monkey when he's bored.
examples.translation_cn: 我侄子无聊时是个小淘气鬼。

senses.meaning_en: a person who listens, especially to a speech or broadcast

examples.text: She is a regular listener to the morning news programme.
examples.translation_cn: 她是晨间新闻节目的固定听众。

senses.meaning_en: a flash of very bright light in the sky caused by electricity

examples.text: A flash of lightning lit up the whole valley.
examples.translation_cn: 一道闪电照亮了整个山谷。

senses.meaning_en: extremely fast or sudden; moving (as if) at the speed of lightning

examples.text: The car moved at lightning speed through the tunnel.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车闪电般地穿过隧道。

senses.meaning_en: an event or happening

examples.text: Power cuts are a common occurrence in this area.
examples.translation_cn: 停电在这个地区是常有的事。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which the parts of something are arranged or planned

examples.text: The layout of the apartment makes good use of space.
examples.translation_cn: 这套公寓的布局充分利用了空间。

senses.meaning_en: the act of injecting a drug or vaccine into the body; a dose given by injection

examples.text: The nurse gave him an injection of insulin.
examples.translation_cn: 护士给他注射了胰岛素。

senses.meaning_en: the act of putting money, ideas, code etc. into something so that it operates better or becomes more effective

examples.text: The small business received an injection of cash from a private investor.
examples.translation_cn: 这家小企业获得了私人投资者的一笔现金注入。

senses.meaning_en: to collect and arrange information from different sources

examples.text: We compiled a list of useful websites for beginners.
examples.translation_cn: 我们整理了一份适合初学者的实用网站清单。

senses.meaning_en: to use a compiler to turn source code into executable code

examples.text: You need to compile the program before running it.
examples.translation_cn: 运行之前你需要先编译这个程序。

senses.meaning_en: to be successfully processed by a compiler

examples.text: The updated app now compiles without errors on all platforms.
examples.translation_cn: 更新后的应用现在在各大平台上都能顺利编译。

senses.meaning_en: any of the curved bones extending from the spine to the chest

examples.text: He fell off the ladder and broke a rib.
examples.translation_cn: 他从梯子上摔下来，摔断了一根肋骨。

senses.meaning_en: a cut of meat containing one or more rib bones

examples.text: We bought a rib of beef for Sunday lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们买了一块牛肋肉做周日午餐。

senses.meaning_en: to tease someone in a friendly way

examples.text: His friends ribbed him about his new haircut.
examples.translation_cn: 朋友们拿他的新发型开玩笑。

senses.meaning_en: a raised ridge in knitted material or cloth

examples.text: She knit the cuffs in rib to make them stretchy.
examples.translation_cn: 她用罗纹针法织袖口，使其有弹性。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden loud noise

examples.text: There was a loud bang, and everyone in the room jumped.
examples.translation_cn: 突然一声巨响，房间里的每个人都吓了一大跳。

senses.meaning_en: a hard blow causing a loud noise
senses.collocation: a nasty bang on the head

examples.text: I got a nasty bang on the head when I stood up too quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 我站起来太快，头被重重磕了一下。

senses.meaning_en: to hit hard with a loud noise; to close violently

examples.text: He banged on the table to get everyone's attention.
examples.translation_cn: 他猛敲桌子以引起大家的注意。

senses.meaning_en: the system or practice of owning people as property and forcing them to work

examples.text: The institution of slavery was abolished in the United States in 1865.
examples.translation_cn: 美国的奴隶制于1865年被废除。

senses.meaning_en: the condition of being forced to work without pay or freedom

examples.text: They were held in slavery on a fishing boat for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一艘渔船上被奴役了五年。

senses.meaning_en: a condition of being completely controlled by something such as greed or drugs

examples.text: Her slavery to fashion left her heavily in debt.
examples.translation_cn: 她对时尚的沉迷使她负债累累。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of showing respect and love for a god

examples.text: They knelt in worship before the golden idol.
examples.translation_cn: 他们跪在金色偶像前敬拜。

senses.meaning_en: a strong feeling of love and respect for somebody or something

examples.text: Her fans' worship of the singer grew after the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会后，粉丝们对这位歌手的崇拜更强烈了。

senses.meaning_en: the act of taking part in a religious ceremony

examples.text: Many local villagers attend worship every Sunday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 许多当地村民每周日早晨参加礼拜。

senses.meaning_en: the gray or black powder left after something burns

examples.text: After the fire, the old house was reduced to ashes.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾过后，那座老房子化为灰烬。

senses.meaning_en: the remains of a person or animal after cremation

examples.text: They scattered his ashes over the lake last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 去年春天，他们将他的骨灰撒在湖上。

senses.meaning_en: a pale gray color like that of ashes

examples.text: She painted the kitchen walls in ash grey.
examples.translation_cn: 她把厨房的墙壁刷成了灰白色。

senses.meaning_en: fine particles from a volcano

examples.text: The town was covered in volcanic ash after the eruption.
examples.translation_cn: 火山喷发后，小镇被火山灰覆盖。

senses.meaning_en: helpful or good to something or someone

examples.text: A balanced diet is beneficial to overall health.
examples.translation_cn: 均衡饮食对整体健康有益。

senses.meaning_en: a medicine or treatment that makes an illness go away

examples.text: Scientists are working to find a cure for the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家正在努力寻找治疗这种疾病的方法。

senses.meaning_en: to make a sick person healthy again

examples.text: The new drug cured him of the infection.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药治好了他的感染。

senses.meaning_en: to solve a problem or end a bad habit

examples.text: He finally cured himself of his smoking habit.
examples.translation_cn: 他终于戒掉了吸烟的习惯。

senses.meaning_en: a solution to a problem

examples.text: There is no cure for a broken heart.
examples.translation_cn: 破碎的心无药可治。

senses.meaning_en: approaching death; about to die

examples.text: The young soldier is dying of his wounds.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻的士兵因伤势过重而奄奄一息。

senses.meaning_en: declining; coming to an end

examples.text: Letter writing is now a dying art in the digital age.
examples.translation_cn: 在数字时代，写信如今是一门正在消亡的艺术。

senses.meaning_en: wanting to do something very much; eager

examples.text: She is dying to hear the latest news.
examples.translation_cn: 她迫切想听到最新消息。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is extremely good, kind, or patient

examples.text: My grandmother is a saint; she never complains.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖母是个圣人，她从不抱怨。

senses.meaning_en: a title given to a holy person, used before their name

examples.text: Saint Francis is known for his love of animals.
examples.translation_cn: 圣方济各以热爱动物而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

examples.text: She was raised as a Latter-day Saint and attends church every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 她从小是摩门教徒，每周日都去教堂。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong push or stab

examples.text: He broke the door open with a powerful thrust of his shoulder.
examples.translation_cn: 他用肩膀猛力一推，把门撞开了。

senses.meaning_en: to move forward with force

examples.text: The rescue boat thrust through the rough waves toward the shore.
examples.translation_cn: 救援船穿过汹涌的海浪向岸边冲去。

senses.meaning_en: the force from an engine that pushes a plane or rocket forward
senses.pattern: the thrust of a jet engine

examples.text: The plane moved forward under the thrust of its jet engines.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机在喷气发动机的推力下向前移动。

senses.meaning_en: the main point or purpose

examples.text: The main thrust of his argument is economic reform.
examples.translation_cn: 他论点的主旨是经济改革。

senses.meaning_en: to force something upon someone

examples.text: The extra duties were thrust upon her without warning.
examples.translation_cn: 额外的任务在没有预先通知的情况下强加给了她。

senses.meaning_en: a need or compelling desire for food

examples.text: After the drought, many families suffered from hunger for months.
examples.translation_cn: 旱灾过后，许多家庭挨饿数月。

senses.meaning_en: any strong desire or need

examples.text: She has a hunger for adventure that keeps her travelling.
examples.translation_cn: 她对冒险的渴望让她一直在旅行。

senses.meaning_en: to have a desire for; to long; to yearn

examples.text: The workers hunger for fair wages and respect.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们渴望公平的工资和尊重。

senses.meaning_en: (grammar) the form of an adjective or adverb that expresses a higher degree, or relating to this form

examples.text: In English, the comparative of 'good' is 'better'.
examples.translation_cn: 在英语中，good 的比较级是 better。

senses.meaning_en: measured or judged by comparison; relative

examples.text: She settled into her new job with comparative ease.
examples.translation_cn: 她比较轻松地适应了新工作。

senses.meaning_en: involving comparison, especially as a method of study

examples.text: The course offers a comparative study of European legal systems.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程对欧洲法律体系进行比较研究。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being known by many people

examples.text: She rose to fame after her first novel became a bestseller.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一部小说成为畅销书后，她一举成名。

senses.meaning_en: a diagram showing the relationship between two or more sets of numbers

examples.text: This is a graph of monthly sales showing a clear upward trend.
examples.translation_cn: 这是一张月度销售图表，显示出明显的上升趋势。

senses.meaning_en: to draw a graph or record information on a graph

examples.text: We need to graph the results to show the trend clearly.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要把结果绘制成图表以清晰显示趋势。

senses.meaning_en: the chance that something will happen

examples.text: The likelihood of rain tomorrow is very low.
examples.translation_cn: 明天下雨的可能性很小。

senses.meaning_en: the probability of the observed data under a specific statistical model
senses.pattern: the likelihood of the data under a model

examples.text: The likelihood of the data under this model is extremely small.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个模型下，数据的似然性极小。

senses.meaning_en: a long orange root vegetable

examples.text: She bought a kilo of carrots at the farmers' market.
examples.translation_cn: 她在农贸市场买了一公斤胡萝卜。

senses.meaning_en: a reward or advantage used to persuade someone
senses.pattern: offer something as a carrot to do something

examples.text: The company offered a bonus as a carrot to encourage higher sales.
examples.translation_cn: 公司提供奖金作为激励以提高销售额。

senses.meaning_en: a shade of orange like a carrot

examples.text: The kitchen walls were painted carrot orange to feel warm.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房墙壁刷成胡萝卜色，显得温暖。

senses.meaning_en: a house or place where someone lives

examples.text: They live in a dwelling that was built over a century ago.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在一座建于一个多世纪前的住宅里。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is legally entitled to receive property or rank after someone dies

examples.text: She is the sole heir to her grandfather's estate.
examples.translation_cn: 她是祖父遗产的唯一继承人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is expected to inherit a throne or title

examples.text: The eldest son of the king is heir to the throne.
examples.translation_cn: 国王的长子是王位继承人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who continues the work or tradition of a predecessor

examples.text: She is the spiritual heir to a great artistic tradition.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一项伟大艺术传统的精神继承人。

senses.meaning_en: the length of a straight line through the centre of a circle, from one side to the other

examples.text: The wheel has a diameter of sixty centimeters.
examples.translation_cn: 这个轮子的直径是六十厘米。

senses.meaning_en: a wild animal of the dog family with a pointed face and a bushy tail

examples.text: We saw a fox near the chicken coop.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在鸡舍附近看到了一只狐狸。

senses.meaning_en: the fur of a fox

examples.text: She wore a fox fur coat to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿了一件狐皮大衣去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: to be too difficult for someone to understand or solve

examples.text: She was foxed by the last question in the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她被考试的最后一道题难住了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is clever at tricking others

examples.text: He’s as sly as a fox and rarely shows his true intentions.
examples.translation_cn: 他像狐狸一样狡猾，很少表露真实意图。

senses.meaning_en: a state of safety or protection

examples.text: He took refuge in work to avoid thinking about his loss.
examples.translation_cn: 他埋头工作以逃避思考自己的损失。

senses.meaning_en: a place that provides safety

examples.text: The island serves as a refuge for many rare birds.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛屿是许多稀有鸟类的避难所。

senses.meaning_en: something or someone that gives comfort or help

examples.text: Her garden was a refuge from the stress of city life.
examples.translation_cn: 她的花园是她逃避城市生活压力的慰藉。

senses.meaning_en: a moderate coldness that is uncomfortable

examples.text: There was a chill in the air when we left.
examples.translation_cn: 我们离开时空气中有股寒意。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden feeling of cold with shivering, often from illness or fear

examples.text: She got the chills when she heard the bad news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到坏消息时她打了个寒战。

senses.meaning_en: to relax and stop worrying

examples.text: You should chill out and stop stressing about work.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该放松一下，别再为工作焦虑了。

senses.meaning_en: a lack of warmth or friendliness

examples.text: His sarcastic remark cast a chill over the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他讽刺的话让会议的气氛变得冷淡。

senses.meaning_en: a shout of approval or joy; to shout in this way

examples.text: The fans cheered for the team throughout the game.
examples.translation_cn: 球迷们整场比赛都在为球队加油。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel happier or more hopeful

examples.text: A phone call from her friend cheered her up.
examples.translation_cn: 朋友的一个电话使她高兴起来。

senses.meaning_en: a cheerful mood or positive attitude

examples.text: The whole family is full of cheer at Christmas.
examples.translation_cn: 全家人圣诞节时充满欢乐。

senses.meaning_en: to control the direction of a vehicle, boat, etc.

examples.text: She steered the boat carefully into the harbor.
examples.translation_cn: 她小心地驾驶船驶入港口。

senses.meaning_en: to guide animals in a particular direction

examples.text: The farmer steered the cattle into the barn before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫在日落前把牛赶进谷仓。

senses.meaning_en: to influence or control the course of a person, group, or conversation

examples.text: She steered the conversation toward a more positive topic.
examples.translation_cn: 她把谈话引向更积极的话题。

senses.meaning_en: to conduct oneself; to take or pursue a course of action

examples.text: The company steered a careful course through the economic crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司在经济危机中谨慎行事。

senses.meaning_en: to grow vigorously and stay healthy

examples.text: Young children thrive on a diet rich in fruit and vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 幼儿靠富含水果和蔬菜的饮食茁壮成长。

senses.meaning_en: to become prosperous or successful

examples.text: Many small shops thrive in a highly competitive market.
examples.translation_cn: 许多小商店在竞争激烈的市场中兴旺发展。

senses.meaning_en: suitable for application; relevant

examples.text: This rule is applicable to all employees, including part-time staff.
examples.translation_cn: 这项规定适用于所有员工，包括兼职人员。

senses.meaning_en: matching or related to something

examples.text: Fill in the blank with the word corresponding to each definition.
examples.translation_cn: 用与每个定义对应的单词填空。

senses.meaning_en: complex, detailed, or sophisticated; intricate or showy

examples.text: The researchers designed an elaborate experiment to test the new drug.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员设计了一项复杂的实验来测试这种新药。

senses.meaning_en: to develop or work out in detail

examples.text: The committee will elaborate a new policy before the summit.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将在峰会前详细拟定一项新政策。

senses.meaning_en: to give more details or information about something

examples.text: She refused to elaborate on her earlier statement.
examples.translation_cn: 她拒绝详细说明她先前的声明。

senses.meaning_en: to crush food with teeth

examples.text: She chewed the tough steak slowly before swallowing.
examples.translation_cn: 她慢慢地把那块硬牛排嚼碎后咽下。

senses.meaning_en: to think about something carefully

examples.text: He chewed over the offer for a few days before deciding.
examples.translation_cn: 他反复考虑这个提议几天后才做决定。

senses.meaning_en: a word that indicates an action, event, or state of being

examples.text: In grammar, "seem" is a verb that expresses a state rather than an action.
examples.translation_cn: 在语法中，“seem”是一个表示状态而非动作的动词。

senses.meaning_en: to use a word (especially a noun) as a verb

examples.text: In informal English, people often verb nouns like "text" and "friend" without hesitation.
examples.translation_cn: 在非正式英语中，人们常常毫不犹豫地把“text”和“friend”等名词当作动词使用。

senses.meaning_en: to rub a surface with your nails or claws, especially to stop an itch

examples.text: He scratched the mosquito bite on his arm until it bled.
examples.translation_cn: 他抓挠手臂上的蚊子叮咬处直到流血。

senses.meaning_en: to damage a surface by scraping it with something sharp or rough

examples.text: He scratched the table with a fork by accident.
examples.translation_cn: 他不小心用叉子刮坏了桌子。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a thin mark on a surface by moving something sharp across it

examples.text: Someone had scratched a long line into the car door.
examples.translation_cn: 有人在车门上划出了一道长痕。

senses.meaning_en: to remove or cancel something by drawing a line through it

examples.text: She scratched out the old address and wrote a new one.
examples.translation_cn: 她划掉旧地址，写上了新地址。

senses.meaning_en: a thin mark or cut on a surface caused by something sharp or rough

examples.text: There's a scratch on the lens.
examples.translation_cn: 镜头上有一道刮痕。

senses.meaning_en: not asleep; conscious

examples.text: I was still awake at midnight, staring at the ceiling.
examples.translation_cn: 午夜我仍醒着，盯着天花板。

senses.meaning_en: to stop sleeping or cause somebody to stop sleeping

examples.text: He awoke to find the whole house silent.
examples.translation_cn: 他醒来发现整座房子静悄悄的。

senses.meaning_en: alert and aware of something

examples.text: We must be awake to the risks of climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须意识到气候变化的风险。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody aware of something

examples.text: The accident awoke us to the importance of safety.
examples.translation_cn: 那次事故使我们意识到安全的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: a person who works in or is in charge of a library

examples.text: My aunt is the head librarian at the public library.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑姑是公共图书馆的馆长。

senses.meaning_en: a single-celled organism with cell walls but no nucleus or organelles

examples.text: Harmful bacteria in raw milk can cause serious illness.
examples.translation_cn: 生牛奶中的有害细菌会导致严重疾病。

senses.meaning_en: a thick piece of fabric used to cover part of a floor

examples.text: He sat on the rug in front of the fireplace and read the newspaper.
examples.translation_cn: 他坐在壁炉前的地毯上看报纸。

senses.meaning_en: a thick warm blanket or covering for the body

examples.text: She wrapped a rug around her legs while reading on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 她读书时把盖毯裹在腿上。

senses.meaning_en: stupid; foolish; lacking intellectual content or value
senses.pattern: dumb of sb to do sth

examples.text: It was dumb of me to leave the door unlocked.
examples.translation_cn: 我忘了锁门，真是个蠢事。

senses.meaning_en: temporarily unable to speak due to shock or fear

examples.text: She was dumb with shock when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到这个消息时，她惊得说不出话来。

senses.meaning_en: unable to speak; mute

examples.text: The boy has been dumb from birth and uses sign language.
examples.translation_cn: 这个男孩从出生起就不能说话，使用手语交流。

senses.meaning_en: reduce the intellectual demands of; simplify too much

examples.text: The documentary was criticized for dumbing down the facts.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片因把事实讲得过于简单而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: to scatter small amounts or drops of something over a surface

examples.text: Sprinkle a little salt over the potatoes before roasting.
examples.translation_cn: 烤之前往土豆上撒一点盐。

senses.meaning_en: to fall or appear in scattered small drops or pieces

examples.text: A few drops of paint sprinkled over the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 几滴油漆零星地洒落在地板上。

senses.meaning_en: to rain lightly

examples.text: It is sprinkling outside, so take an umbrella.
examples.translation_cn: 外面下着小雨，带把伞吧。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of something scattered lightly

examples.text: Add a sprinkle of salt to the soup before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前在汤里撒一点盐。

senses.meaning_en: deserving something good

examples.text: The young scientist is worthy of international recognition.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻科学家值得国际认可。

senses.meaning_en: admirable or having worth

examples.text: He proved a worthy successor to the legendary coach.
examples.translation_cn: 他证明自己是那位传奇教练的出色继任者。

senses.meaning_en: a person of importance or virtue

examples.text: The local worthies gathered for the mayor's speech.
examples.translation_cn: 当地的名流们聚集起来听市长演讲。

senses.meaning_en: unlikely or uncertain; causing doubt

examples.text: It is doubtful whether the plan will succeed.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划能否成功还不确定。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing doubt; not sure

examples.text: She was doubtful about his reasons for leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他离开的理由感到怀疑。

senses.meaning_en: suspicious, dubious, or unreliable

examples.text: Some products sold online are of doubtful quality.
examples.translation_cn: 网上卖的某些产品质量可疑。

senses.meaning_en: to order or require

examples.text: Safety rules dictate that all workers wear helmets.
examples.translation_cn: 安全规定要求所有工人佩戴头盔。

senses.meaning_en: to say words aloud for someone to write down

examples.text: The teacher dictated the new words to the class.
examples.translation_cn: 老师给全班听写了生词。

senses.meaning_en: to determine or decisively affect

examples.text: The available data will dictate how we proceed.
examples.translation_cn: 现有数据将决定我们如何推进。

senses.meaning_en: an order or command

examples.text: He always followed the dictates of his conscience.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是遵从良心的要求。

senses.meaning_en: not working or unable to be used

examples.text: This broken phone is useless for making calls.
examples.translation_cn: 这部坏手机没法打电话了。

senses.meaning_en: not helpful or effective; pointless

examples.text: It is useless arguing with him when he is upset.
examples.translation_cn: 他心情不好时跟他争论是无济于事的。

senses.meaning_en: not able to do something well; not dependable

examples.text: She is useless at telling jokes; nobody ever laughs.
examples.translation_cn: 她不擅长讲笑话，没人笑过。

senses.meaning_en: agreement or accord

examples.text: They lived in harmony with their neighbors for years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们多年来与邻居和睦相处。

senses.meaning_en: a pleasing combination of elements

examples.text: The colors in the painting work in harmony with each other.
examples.translation_cn: 画中的色彩彼此协调。

senses.meaning_en: two or more notes played simultaneously to produce a chord

examples.text: The choir sang in three-part harmony at the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 合唱团在音乐会上以三声部和声演唱。

senses.meaning_en: to order somebody not to do something; to not allow something

examples.text: The school strictly forbids students to use phones in class.
examples.translation_cn: 学校严格禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

senses.meaning_en: willingness to accept behaviour and opinions different from your own

examples.text: We need to show tolerance towards people with different beliefs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要对持有不同信仰的人表现出宽容。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to endure or resist the effects of a drug or poison

examples.text: Patients may develop tolerance to the drug after several weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 患者用药数周后可能会产生耐受性。

senses.meaning_en: the amount by which a measurement can vary from a standard

examples.text: The parts are checked to ensure they are within tolerance.
examples.translation_cn: 这些零件要经过检查以确保在公差范围内。

senses.meaning_en: an animal with horns and a beard, often kept for milk or meat

examples.text: A herd of goats was grazing on the hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 一群山羊正在山坡上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is blamed for a failure or problem

examples.text: He was made the goat for the team's poor season.
examples.translation_cn: 他被当成了球队本赛季表现不佳的替罪羊。

senses.meaning_en: the act of tempting or the condition of being tempted

examples.text: The temptation to give up grew stronger as the deadline approached.
examples.translation_cn: 随着截止日期临近，放弃的诱惑越来越强。

senses.meaning_en: something attractive, tempting or seductive; an inducement, seducement, or enticement

examples.text: He could not resist the temptation to check his phone during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会议期间他忍不住看手机。

senses.meaning_en: to emphasize or stress something

examples.text: The report underlines the need for urgent action.
examples.translation_cn: 报告强调需要立即采取行动。

senses.meaning_en: to draw a line underneath something

examples.text: Please underline all the verbs in this exercise.
examples.translation_cn: 请在这个练习中给所有动词画线。

senses.meaning_en: a line placed under text, especially the character '_'

examples.text: Each key term is marked with an underline.
examples.translation_cn: 每个关键术语都标有下划线。

senses.meaning_en: a chart or book showing the days, weeks, and months of a year

examples.text: I marked the date on the office calendar.
examples.translation_cn: 我在办公室日历上标记了那个日期。

senses.meaning_en: a list of planned events or appointments

examples.text: She has a full calendar this week with back-to-back meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 她这周日程很满，会议一个接一个。

senses.meaning_en: a system for dividing time into days, weeks, months, and years

examples.text: The Chinese New Year falls in the lunar calendar.
examples.translation_cn: 中国新年按农历计算。

senses.meaning_en: facial hair growing on a man's chin and cheeks

examples.text: He grew a full beard while living in the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 他住在山里时留了满脸络腮胡子。

senses.meaning_en: a ceremonial chair for a monarch

examples.text: The king sat on the throne as the courtiers bowed before him.
examples.translation_cn: 国王坐在宝座上，朝臣们向他鞠躬。

senses.meaning_en: the position or power of a monarch

examples.text: The young prince ascended the throne after the sudden death of his father.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻的王子在父亲突然去世后登上了王位。

senses.meaning_en: a device for slowing or stopping a vehicle

examples.text: She put on the brakes as the light turned red.
examples.translation_cn: 交通灯变红时她踩了刹车。

senses.meaning_en: to slow or stop a vehicle using a brake

examples.text: He braked sharply to avoid hitting the cyclist.
examples.translation_cn: 他猛地刹车以免撞到骑车人。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being wide

examples.text: The width of the hall made it ideal for large public meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 大厅的宽度使其成为大型公共集会的理想场所。

senses.meaning_en: the measurement from side to side

examples.text: The table is exactly one metre in width and two metres long.
examples.translation_cn: 这张桌子宽正好一米，长两米。

senses.meaning_en: the soft thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals

examples.text: The Arctic fox has thick white fur that keeps it warm in winter.
examples.translation_cn: 北极狐有厚厚的白色皮毛，使它在冬天保持温暖。

senses.meaning_en: the skin of an animal with fur on it, used as a material for making clothes

examples.text: This elegant coat is made of real fur and is very expensive.
examples.translation_cn: 这件优雅的外套是用真毛皮做的，非常昂贵。

senses.meaning_en: a garment made of fur

examples.text: She refused to wear fur and chose a wool coat instead.
examples.translation_cn: 她拒绝穿皮草，改穿羊毛外套。

senses.meaning_en: to prod or jab with an object

examples.text: A boy poked me with a stick during the game.
examples.translation_cn: 一个男孩在比赛中用棍子戳我。

senses.meaning_en: to stir up a fire to remove ash or promote burning
senses.collocation: poke the fire with a poker

examples.text: She poked the fire with a poker to keep it burning.
examples.translation_cn: 她用拨火棍拨了拨火，让火保持燃烧。

senses.meaning_en: to rummage or feel around

examples.text: I poked around in the drawer looking for batteries.
examples.translation_cn: 我在抽屉里翻找电池。

senses.meaning_en: to thrust (something) in a particular direction such as the tongue

examples.text: The child poked her tongue out at me.
examples.translation_cn: 那个孩子朝我伸舌头。

senses.meaning_en: having the shape of a circle

examples.text: The stadium is circular in shape and can hold fifty thousand people.
examples.translation_cn: 这座体育场是圆形的，能容纳五万人。

senses.meaning_en: using a statement to prove itself

examples.text: This is circular reasoning because it assumes what it tries to prove.
examples.translation_cn: 这是循环论证，因为它假设了它试图证明的东西。

senses.meaning_en: not direct; roundabout

examples.text: To avoid the flooded road, we took a circular route through the hills.
examples.translation_cn: 为了避开被淹的道路，我们绕行山路。

senses.meaning_en: a printed notice or advertisement sent to many people

examples.text: The office sent out a circular about the new parking rules.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室发出了一份关于新停车规则的通告。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thin strand of cotton, silk, etc. used for sewing or weaving

examples.text: She mended the tear in her shirt with needle and thread.
examples.translation_cn: 她用针线缝补了衬衫上的裂口。

senses.meaning_en: the main idea or connection that runs through a story, argument, etc.

examples.text: I lost the thread of his explanation halfway through.
examples.translation_cn: 我听到一半就抓不住他解释的思路了。

senses.meaning_en: to pass something through a narrow space or hole

examples.text: She threaded the wire through the narrow gap.
examples.translation_cn: 她把电线从窄缝中穿过去。

senses.meaning_en: not friendly or kind

examples.text: The manager was rather unpleasant to the new employee.
examples.translation_cn: 经理对新员工很不客气。

senses.meaning_en: causing discomfort or dislike

examples.text: Many people find the smell of durian unpleasant.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人觉得榴莲的气味令人不快。

senses.meaning_en: the direct rays, light or warmth of the sun; a place where the sun shines

examples.text: We ate lunch in the sunshine on the terrace.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在露台上阳光下吃午餐。

senses.meaning_en: geniality or cheerfulness

examples.text: Her voice was full of sunshine and laughter.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音充满欢快和笑意。

senses.meaning_en: a source of cheerfulness or joy

examples.text: The baby has been a ray of sunshine to the whole family.
examples.translation_cn: 这个宝宝给全家人带来了快乐。

senses.meaning_en: a friendly form of address, often to a young person or someone sleepy

examples.text: I said good morning, sunshine, and she smiled.
examples.translation_cn: 我说早上好，小太阳，她笑了。

senses.meaning_en: to use up completely

examples.text: The small country has exhausted its oil reserves.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小国已经耗尽了其石油储备。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone very tired

examples.text: The intense training exhausted even the strongest athletes.
examples.translation_cn: 高强度训练甚至使最强壮的运动员精疲力竭。

senses.meaning_en: waste gases from an engine

examples.text: Exhaust from the old truck filled the narrow street.
examples.translation_cn: 旧卡车的废气充满了狭窄的街道。

senses.meaning_en: extremely angry
senses.pattern: be furious with sb for doing sth

examples.text: She was furious with him for missing the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她因他错过会议而大发雷霆。

senses.meaning_en: violent and intense

examples.text: The work continued at a furious pace all night.
examples.translation_cn: 工作整夜以飞快的速度继续。

senses.meaning_en: to order a drug or medical treatment for a patient

examples.text: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the patient's infection.
examples.translation_cn: 医生为病人的感染开了抗生素。

senses.meaning_en: to state officially that something must be done

examples.text: The law prescribes that all drivers must wear seat belts.
examples.translation_cn: 法律规定所有司机必须系安全带。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong gust of wind

examples.text: A blast of cold air swept through the room.
examples.translation_cn: 一股冷空气扫过房间。

senses.meaning_en: an explosion, especially one that destroys rock

examples.text: The blast from the bomb destroyed the building.
examples.translation_cn: 炸弹爆炸摧毁了那座建筑。

senses.meaning_en: a very enjoyable experience or party

examples.text: We all had a blast at the music festival last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚在音乐节上玩得非常开心。

senses.meaning_en: to explode, hit with force, or criticize severely

examples.text: Reporters blasted the mayor for her slow response.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们猛烈抨击市长反应迟缓。

senses.meaning_en: to be current, widespread, or predominant

examples.text: This custom still prevails in many rural areas.
examples.translation_cn: 这种习俗在许多农村地区仍然盛行。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat an opponent or be successful

examples.text: Justice will prevail over evil in the end.
examples.translation_cn: 正义终将战胜邪恶。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade someone to do something

examples.text: She prevailed on him to change his mind.
examples.translation_cn: 她说服了他改变主意。

senses.meaning_en: a brave or noteworthy action; a feat

examples.text: The firefighter was honored for his deed of heroism.
examples.translation_cn: 那名消防员因其英勇行为受到表彰。

senses.meaning_en: an action, especially a good or bad one; actual action as opposed to words

examples.text: He has always been honest in word and deed.
examples.translation_cn: 他言行一致，一向诚实。

senses.meaning_en: a legal document showing who owns a property

examples.text: She signed the deed to the house yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨天签署了那栋房子的房契。

senses.meaning_en: in a very short time

examples.text: People's habits can change overnight after a major event.
examples.translation_cn: 重大事件后，人们的习惯可能一夜之间改变。

senses.meaning_en: during the night

examples.text: The nurses had to work overnight because of the emergency.
examples.translation_cn: 由于紧急情况，护士们不得不通宵工作。

senses.meaning_en: happening between dusk and dawn

examples.text: She took an overnight train to the capital to save on hotel costs.
examples.translation_cn: 她乘夜车前往首都，以节省住宿费。

senses.meaning_en: complete before the next morning

examples.text: Customers can choose overnight delivery for urgent packages.
examples.translation_cn: 顾客可为紧急包裹选择隔夜送达。

senses.meaning_en: a pain in the head

examples.text: I have a splitting headache and can't concentrate on anything.
examples.translation_cn: 我头痛欲裂，无法集中注意力。

senses.meaning_en: a nuisance or unpleasant problem

examples.text: The new tax rules are a major headache for small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 新税收规定对小企业来说是个大麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of having lost all hope

examples.text: He gave up in despair after many failures.
examples.translation_cn: 多次失败后，他绝望地放弃了。

senses.meaning_en: to stop having hope

examples.text: She despaired of ever finding a job in that small town.
examples.translation_cn: 她对在那个小镇找到工作感到绝望。

senses.meaning_en: a thin pointed piece of metal with a raised thread that you turn to fasten things

examples.text: Tighten the screw until the handle feels firm.
examples.translation_cn: 把螺丝拧紧，直到把手感觉牢固。

senses.meaning_en: a turning movement, especially one used to fasten or tighten something

examples.text: Give the handle a half screw to the right.
examples.translation_cn: 将手柄向右拧半圈。

senses.meaning_en: a person who manages the property or affairs of another person or organization

examples.text: He was appointed steward of the estate last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年他被任命为庄园的管家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has charge of buildings, grounds, or animals, often at an event

examples.text: The stewards at the football match directed fans to the exits.
examples.translation_cn: 足球比赛上的工作人员引导球迷走向出口。
