examples.text: The wounded lion roared in pain and limped away.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤的狮子痛苦地吼叫，然后一瘸一拐地走开了。

senses.meaning_en: to laugh in a very loud way

examples.text: The audience roared with laughter at the comedian's final joke.
examples.translation_cn: 观众听了喜剧演员的最后一个笑话放声大笑。

senses.meaning_en: to make a loud resounding noise (of engines, thunder, fire, etc.)

examples.text: The old engine finally roared to life after several attempts.
examples.translation_cn: 那台旧发动机尝试几次后终于轰鸣着启动了。

senses.meaning_en: having or deserving great fame, praise, and honour

examples.text: The team returned home after a glorious victory.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在一场光荣的胜利后回国。

senses.meaning_en: very beautiful and impressive; magnificent

examples.text: We climbed the hill and saw a glorious view of the bay.
examples.translation_cn: 我们爬上山，看到了海湾的壮丽景色。

senses.meaning_en: very pleasant, especially with warm sunshine

examples.text: We spent the afternoon outside on a glorious day.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一个晴朗明媚的日子里在户外度过了一个下午。

senses.meaning_en: excellent, wonderful; delightful

examples.text: The weekend in the mountains was glorious fun.
examples.translation_cn: 在山里度过的那个周末令人非常愉快。

senses.meaning_en: a natural spring of water

examples.text: A fountain of clear water flows from the hillside all year.
examples.translation_cn: 清澈的泉水终年从山坡流出。

senses.meaning_en: an artificial water feature that sends water into the air

examples.text: The children played in the fountain to stay cool.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在喷泉里玩耍以保持凉爽。

senses.meaning_en: a source of a desirable quality or thing

examples.text: She is a fountain of knowledge on local history.
examples.translation_cn: 她是当地历史知识的源泉。

senses.meaning_en: action taken to punish someone who has harmed you

examples.text: He attacked them in revenge for the insult.
examples.translation_cn: 他因受辱而攻击了他们。

senses.meaning_en: a victory over someone who previously defeated you

examples.text: The team gained revenge over their rivals last night.
examples.translation_cn: 那支球队昨晚战胜了宿敌，报了一箭之仇。

senses.meaning_en: to punish or hurt someone because they have harmed you

examples.text: She finally revenged herself on her former boss.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于向前老板报了仇。

senses.meaning_en: to take revenge for something or on behalf of someone; to avenge

examples.text: The family vowed to revenge the murder of their son.
examples.translation_cn: 这家人发誓要为儿子的谋杀报仇。

senses.meaning_en: having an acid taste, like that of lemon or vinegar

examples.text: The lemon tasted too sour to eat without sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 这柠檬太酸，不加糖没法吃。

senses.meaning_en: having an unpleasant taste or smell because of fermentation

examples.text: The milk turned sour overnight because it was left out.
examples.translation_cn: 牛奶放在外面过夜变馊了。

senses.meaning_en: hostile or unfriendly

examples.text: She gave him a sour look and walked away.
examples.translation_cn: 她冷冷地瞪了他一眼，然后走开了。

senses.meaning_en: excessively acidic and therefore infertile (of soil)

examples.text: The soil in this field is sour and needs lime.
examples.translation_cn: 这块地的土壤是酸性的，需要施石灰。

senses.meaning_en: feeling shame or guilt

examples.text: She was ashamed of lying to her best friend.
examples.translation_cn: 她因对最好的朋友撒谎而感到羞愧。

senses.meaning_en: reluctant to do something because of shame or embarrassment

examples.text: He was ashamed to ask for help after failing twice.
examples.translation_cn: 他两次失败后不好意思求助。

senses.meaning_en: the act of repeating something, or something that is repeated

examples.text: The repetition of key phrases helps the audience remember the main point.
examples.translation_cn: 关键短语的重复有助于听众记住要点。

senses.meaning_en: a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles
senses.pattern: in the shape of a triangle

examples.text: The children cut the paper in the shape of a triangle.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们把纸剪成三角形。

senses.meaning_en: a metal percussion instrument shaped like a triangle

examples.text: She learned to play the triangle in the school band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在学校乐队学习演奏三角铁。

senses.meaning_en: a romantic relationship involving three people
senses.pattern: be caught in a love triangle

examples.text: He was caught in a love triangle with two coworkers.
examples.translation_cn: 他陷入了与两个同事的三角恋。

senses.meaning_en: a triangular frame used to rack balls in pool or billiards
senses.pattern: rack the balls with a triangle

examples.text: The player racked the balls with a triangle before the break.
examples.translation_cn: 开球前，球员用三角框把球摆好。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that causes annoyance or inconvenience

examples.text: The noise from the construction site is a real nuisance to the whole neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑工地的噪音确实给整个社区带来麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: a man from England

examples.text: As an Englishman, he was not used to driving on the right.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一个英国人，他不习惯靠右行驶。

senses.meaning_en: equipment or machinery used for a particular purpose

examples.text: The hospital purchased sophisticated apparatus for monitoring patients' vital signs.
examples.translation_cn: 医院购买了用于监测患者生命体征的精密设备。

senses.meaning_en: the system or structure of an organization, especially a government or political party

examples.text: The party increasingly controls the apparatus of government.
examples.translation_cn: 该党越来越多地控制着政府机构。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment used in gymnastics, such as the balance beam or rings

examples.text: The gymnast performed a complex routine on the apparatus.
examples.translation_cn: 这名体操运动员在这件器械上完成了一套复杂的动作。

senses.meaning_en: evil; morally bad
senses.pattern: it is wicked of sb to do sth

examples.text: It was wicked of him to betray his closest friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他背叛最亲密的朋友，真是邪恶。

senses.meaning_en: excellent; wonderful (informal)

examples.text: That guitar solo was absolutely wicked; the crowd went wild.
examples.translation_cn: 那段吉他独奏棒极了，观众都疯狂了。

senses.meaning_en: mischievous; playfully naughty

examples.text: He looked at me with a wicked grin before playing the prank.
examples.translation_cn: 他在搞恶作剧之前，带着调皮的笑容看着我。

senses.meaning_en: harsh; severe (of weather or conditions)

examples.text: We drove home in wicked weather and could barely see the road.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在恶劣的天气里开车回家，几乎看不清路。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange for something to happen at a later time

examples.text: They postponed making a decision until the following week.
examples.translation_cn: 他们推迟到下星期再做决定。

senses.meaning_en: a price quoted for buying or selling

examples.text: We asked three builders for a quotation for the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 我们向三位建筑商要了厨房的报价。

senses.meaning_en: a repeated fragment of speech or writing

examples.text: The essay opens with a quotation from Martin Luther King.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章以马丁·路德·金的一句引文开篇。

senses.meaning_en: the act of quoting someone or something

examples.text: The quotation of long passages requires written permission from the publisher.
examples.translation_cn: 引用长篇段落需要出版方的书面许可。

senses.meaning_en: a large sign made of cloth or other soft material, often carried in demonstrations or hung in public places

examples.text: They hung a banner across the street to announce the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在大街上挂起横幅来宣告节日。

senses.meaning_en: a long piece of cloth with a design, used as a symbol by a military commander, monarch or nation, especially in ceremonies

examples.text: The soldiers marched under the royal banner at the parade.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在游行中行进在皇家旗帜下。

senses.meaning_en: a cause or purpose; a campaign or movement

examples.text: Activists campaigned for reform under the banner of equality.
examples.translation_cn: 活动人士在平等的旗帜下为改革而奔走。

senses.meaning_en: extremely (used of unpleasant things)

examples.text: It was bitterly cold outside that December morning.
examples.translation_cn: 那个十二月的早晨，外面冷极了。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that shows strong negative feelings such as anger or sadness

examples.text: He complained bitterly about the new working conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 他愤愤不平地抱怨新的工作条件。

senses.meaning_en: a group of birds or animals, especially sheep or goats

examples.text: A flock of sheep was grazing on the hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 一群羊正在山坡上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: to go or gather together somewhere in large numbers

examples.text: Thousands of tourists flocked to the beach in summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏天成千上万的游客蜂拥到海滩。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people, especially the members of a church

examples.text: The priest comforted his flock after the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾后，牧师安慰他的会众。

senses.meaning_en: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system

examples.text: She made an arbitrary choice between two equally qualified candidates.
examples.translation_cn: 她在两个同样合格的候选人中任意选了一个。

senses.meaning_en: using power without considering others; autocratic

examples.text: The regime exercised arbitrary power to silence dissidents and critics.
examples.translation_cn: 该政权行使专横权力压制异见者和批评者。

senses.meaning_en: a long period with little or no rain

examples.text: Many farmers lost their entire harvest during a drought.
examples.translation_cn: 许多农民在一次旱灾中失去了全部收成。

senses.meaning_en: a long period when there is a lack of something

examples.text: The company had a drought of new ideas for years.
examples.translation_cn: 公司多年来一直缺乏新想法。

senses.meaning_en: a long period without success, especially in sport

examples.text: The striker finally ended a goal drought in the final minute.
examples.translation_cn: 这名前锋在最后一分钟终于结束了一段进球荒。

senses.meaning_en: not having any wires; functioning without an external wired connection

examples.text: The new headphones are wireless and connect to two devices at once.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新耳机是无线的，可以同时连接两台设备。

senses.meaning_en: the medium of radio communication

examples.text: The ship contacted the shore by wireless after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，那艘船通过无线电与海岸联系。

senses.meaning_en: A wireless connectivity to a computer network

examples.text: You can connect to the wireless in the hotel lobby.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在酒店大堂连接无线网络。

senses.meaning_en: an armed attempt to overthrow a government or ruler

examples.text: The rebels rose in rebellion against the colonial government.
examples.translation_cn: 叛乱者起义反抗殖民政府。

senses.meaning_en: defiance of authority or control; refusal to obey rules

examples.text: His constant rebellion against authority eventually led to his expulsion.
examples.translation_cn: 他不断违抗权威，最终被开除。

senses.meaning_en: a small tailless amphibian that typically hops and lives near water

examples.text: Frogs croak loudly after a heavy summer rain.
examples.translation_cn: 一场大雨后，青蛙大声鸣叫。

senses.meaning_en: to crush into small pieces by rubbing

examples.text: She ground the coffee beans into a fine powder before making coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 她煮咖啡前把咖啡豆磨成细粉。

senses.meaning_en: to make smooth or sharp by rubbing on a rough surface

examples.text: He ground the knife against the whetstone until it was razor-sharp.
examples.translation_cn: 他对着磨刀石磨刀，直到刀刃锋利无比。

senses.meaning_en: to work or study hard for a long time

examples.text: She spent the whole weekend grinding away at her history essay.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个周末都在刻苦写历史论文。

senses.meaning_en: to move slowly with difficulty or make a harsh grating sound

examples.text: The old bus ground to a halt at the top of the hill.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆旧公共汽车在山顶缓慢地停了下来。

senses.meaning_en: a set of keys for typing on a computer or typewriter

examples.text: She can type ninety words per minute on a keyboard.
examples.translation_cn: 她每分钟能在键盘上打九十个词。

senses.meaning_en: the set of black and white keys on a piano or similar instrument

examples.text: Her fingers moved lightly across the keyboard during the piano recital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在钢琴独奏会上手指轻盈地在琴键上滑动。

senses.meaning_en: an electronic musical instrument with keys

examples.text: He plays the keyboard in a local rock band.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一支本地摇滚乐队里弹键盘。

senses.meaning_en: to type on a computer keyboard

examples.text: She keyboards for hours every evening to finish her report.
examples.translation_cn: 她每晚为了完成报告连续打字数小时。

senses.meaning_en: the main land mass, as opposed to islands or a peninsula

examples.text: They live on the mainland and commute to the island by ferry.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在大陆，乘渡轮通勤到岛上。

senses.meaning_en: an underground railway or train in a city

examples.text: I take the subway to work every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。

senses.meaning_en: an underground pedestrian tunnel

examples.text: We walked through the subway to reach the station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们穿过地下通道到达车站。

senses.meaning_en: to transfer tissue or an organ from one body to another

examples.text: Surgeons transplanted a kidney into the patient yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生昨天给病人移植了一个肾脏。

senses.meaning_en: to uproot a growing plant and plant it in another place

examples.text: We transplanted the tomato seedlings into larger pots.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把番茄幼苗移栽到更大的花盆里。

senses.meaning_en: an operation in which an organ or tissue is transplanted

examples.text: He underwent a heart transplant last year and recovered well.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年接受了心脏移植，恢复得很好。

senses.meaning_en: to move someone or something to a different place; to resettle or relocate

examples.text: The company transplanted hundreds of workers from the country to the city.
examples.translation_cn: 公司将数百名工人从乡下迁往城市。

senses.meaning_en: likely to explode

examples.text: The gas is highly explosive and must be stored safely.
examples.translation_cn: 这种气体高度易爆，必须安全储存。

senses.meaning_en: a substance or device that can explode

examples.text: The explosives went off without warning, causing panic in the street.
examples.translation_cn: 爆炸物毫无预警地爆炸，引起街上恐慌。

senses.meaning_en: increasing suddenly and rapidly

examples.text: The city has seen explosive growth in the last decade.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市在过去十年里经历了迅猛增长。

senses.meaning_en: easily becoming angry

examples.text: He has an explosive temper and often shouts at his colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 他脾气暴躁，经常对同事大喊大叫。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet dessert with a thick, creamy texture, made using starch or gelatine

examples.text: She made a smooth chocolate pudding for dessert.
examples.translation_cn: 她做了一个口感细腻的巧克力布丁当甜点。

senses.meaning_en: dessert; the sweet course of a meal

examples.text: We had apple pie for pudding after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们午饭后吃了苹果派当甜点。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet or savoury dish made by steaming or boiling a mixture, often with flour and suet

examples.text: You must steam the pudding for at least two hours.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须把布丁蒸至少两个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a type of sausage made from blood, especially black pudding

examples.text: In Britain, people often have black pudding with breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 在英国，人们早餐常吃黑布丁。

senses.meaning_en: a platform projecting from the wall of a building

examples.text: We had coffee on the balcony while watching the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 我们一边在阳台上喝咖啡，一边看日落。

senses.meaning_en: the upstairs seating area in a theater or auditorium

examples.text: Our seats were in the balcony, so we could see the whole stage.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的座位在楼座，所以能看到整个舞台。

senses.meaning_en: to push a sharp object into someone or something

examples.text: The attacker stabbed him with a screwdriver during the robbery.
examples.translation_cn: 抢劫中，袭击者用螺丝刀刺伤了他。

senses.meaning_en: an act of stabbing; a wound made by stabbing

examples.text: A single stab to the chest killed the victim instantly.
examples.translation_cn: 当胸一刀使受害者当场死亡。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden sharp pain or unpleasant feeling

examples.text: He felt a sudden stab of jealousy when he saw his ex with someone new.
examples.translation_cn: 看到前任和别人在一起，他突然感到一阵嫉妒。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt to do something
senses.pattern: have a stab at doing sth
senses.collocation: take a stab at the answer

examples.text: I'll have a stab at fixing the engine tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 我明天试着修一下引擎。

senses.meaning_en: practice for a performance

examples.text: The cast is in rehearsal for the new musical.
examples.translation_cn: 演员们正在排练这部新音乐剧。

senses.meaning_en: a trial run of an event or procedure

examples.text: The hospital conducted a rehearsal of its emergency procedures last week.
examples.translation_cn: 医院上周进行了一次应急程序预演。

senses.meaning_en: to throw something away because you no longer want or need it

examples.text: She discarded all the letters from her ex-boyfriend.
examples.translation_cn: 她扔掉了前男友的所有来信。

senses.meaning_en: to throw away a card from your hand in a card game because you do not need it

examples.text: Each player must discard a card before drawing a new one.
examples.translation_cn: 每位玩家在抓新牌之前必须先打出一张牌。

senses.meaning_en: smooth and level, not sticking out

examples.text: The new door is flush with the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 新门与墙齐平。

senses.meaning_en: to clean or remove with a sudden flow of water

examples.text: He accidentally flushed his car keys down the toilet.
examples.translation_cn: 他不小心把车钥匙冲进了马桶。

senses.meaning_en: to become red in the face, especially from emotion or heat

examples.text: She flushed with anger when he shouted at her.
examples.translation_cn: 他对她大喊时，她气得脸通红。

senses.meaning_en: having a lot of money, especially for a short time

examples.text: After the sale, they are flush with cash.
examples.translation_cn: 销售之后，他们手头很宽裕。

senses.meaning_en: a flat-bottomed container used for storing, packing, or washing things

examples.text: She washed the potatoes in a tub of cold water.
examples.translation_cn: 她在盆里用冷水洗了土豆。

senses.meaning_en: a large container for water in which a person can bathe

examples.text: She likes to soak in the tub after a long day.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在漫长的一天后泡在浴缸里。

senses.meaning_en: a small container with a lid, used for food

examples.text: The sauce comes in a small plastic tub.
examples.translation_cn: 这种酱装在一个小塑料盒里出售。

senses.meaning_en: the contents or capacity of such a container

examples.text: We ate a tub of ice cream last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚吃了一盒冰淇淋。

senses.meaning_en: a white alkaline powder used in building and farming

examples.text: Farmers spread lime on the field to reduce soil acidity.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在田地上撒石灰来降低土壤酸度。

senses.meaning_en: a green citrus fruit with sour juice

examples.text: She squeezed a fresh lime over the grilled fish.
examples.translation_cn: 她在烤鱼上挤了一个新鲜青柠。

senses.meaning_en: to treat with lime

examples.text: Farmers lime the soil before planting potatoes in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天种植土豆前，农民用石灰处理土壤。

senses.meaning_en: the sweet, usually red, edible fruit of the strawberry plant

examples.text: We had fresh strawberries and cream for dessert.
examples.translation_cn: 我们吃了新鲜草莓和奶油当甜点。

senses.meaning_en: a low plant that produces strawberries

examples.text: They grow strawberries in large pots on a sunny balcony.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在阳光充足的阳台上用大花盆栽种草莓。

senses.meaning_en: able to be carried or easily moved

examples.text: The new speaker is easily portable and fits in a backpack.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新音箱便于携带，可以放进背包里。

senses.meaning_en: of software: able to be run on multiple hardware or operating systems

examples.text: This tool is portable across platforms such as Windows and Linux.
examples.translation_cn: 该工具可跨平台使用，如 Windows 和 Linux。

senses.meaning_en: able to be transferred from one organization to another

examples.text: She chose a pension that is portable between employers.
examples.translation_cn: 她选择了一份可在不同雇主间转移的养老金。

senses.meaning_en: a set of stairs, especially inside a building, including its supporting structure and banisters

examples.text: She walked slowly up the staircase to the attic.
examples.translation_cn: 她慢慢走上通往阁楼的楼梯。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being moist; tiny drops of water in the air or on a surface

examples.text: Moisture in the air condenses on cold surfaces.
examples.translation_cn: 空气中的水分在寒冷表面凝结。

senses.meaning_en: a refrigerator; an appliance for keeping food cold

examples.text: The milk is in the fridge; could you fetch it?
examples.translation_cn: 牛奶在冰箱里，你能去拿一下吗？

senses.meaning_en: to make someone suddenly surprised or frightened

examples.text: The sudden explosion startled everyone in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 突如其来的爆炸声把屋里所有人都吓了一跳。

senses.meaning_en: to move suddenly because of alarm or surprise

examples.text: The horse startled at the loud crash and galloped away.
examples.translation_cn: 那匹马被巨大的撞击声惊得狂奔而去。

senses.meaning_en: a seat for one person without armrests

examples.text: He sat on a wooden stool at the counter and ordered coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 他坐在柜台前的一只木凳上，点了一杯咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: solid waste from the body; feces

examples.text: The patient could not pass a stool, so the doctor asked for a stool sample.
examples.translation_cn: 患者无法排便，因此医生要求采集粪便样本。

senses.meaning_en: a person who serves customers at their tables in a restaurant, cafe, etc.

examples.text: We asked the waiter for the bill and left.
examples.translation_cn: 我们叫服务员结账后离开了。

senses.meaning_en: one of the two periods into which an academic year is divided, especially in the US

examples.text: She plans to spend a semester studying in Spain.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划用一学期时间在西班牙学习。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar, eaten on bread

examples.text: She spread strawberry jam on a slice of warm toast.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一片热吐司上抹了草莓酱。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in which vehicles or people crowd together and cannot move freely

examples.text: We were stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 我们堵车堵了一个多小时。

senses.meaning_en: to push something roughly into a small space; to become stuck

examples.text: He jammed his socks into a drawer that was already full.
examples.translation_cn: 他把袜子塞进一个已经满了的抽屉里。

senses.meaning_en: a session of improvised music

examples.text: The musicians gathered at a late-night jam session.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐家们聚在一起进行深夜即兴演奏。

senses.meaning_en: a song or track, especially one that somebody likes a lot

examples.text: That new song is my jam; I've already played it ten times today.
examples.translation_cn: 那首新歌是我的最爱，我今天已经听了十遍。

senses.meaning_en: to fall or roll end over end

examples.text: He tumbled down the stairs and broke his arm.
examples.translation_cn: 他滚下楼梯，摔断了胳膊。

senses.meaning_en: to fall sharply in value or amount

examples.text: Shares tumbled from $50 to $32 in two days.
examples.translation_cn: 股价两天内从50美元暴跌至32美元。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden fall

examples.text: He took a heavy tumble on the wet floor.
examples.translation_cn: 他在湿地板上重重摔了一跤。

senses.meaning_en: to perform gymnastics such as somersaults, rolls, and handsprings

examples.text: The young gymnast tumbled across the floor during her routine.
examples.translation_cn: 那位年轻体操运动员在例行训练中在地板上翻腾。

senses.meaning_en: to cry out suddenly because of strong emotion

examples.text: She exclaimed in delight when she saw the unexpected gift.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到意想不到的礼物时高兴地叫了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to say suddenly and with strong emotion

examples.text: "I can't believe you won first prize!" she exclaimed excitedly.
examples.translation_cn: “我真不敢相信你得了第一名！”她兴奋地喊道。

senses.meaning_en: to remove something from a surface by rubbing with a hard or sharp object

examples.text: She scraped the mud off her boots before entering the house.
examples.translation_cn: 她进屋前刮掉了靴子上的泥。

senses.meaning_en: to injure or damage by rubbing against a rough surface

examples.text: I scraped my knee on the concrete step and it bled.
examples.translation_cn: 我在水泥台阶上擦破了膝盖，流血了。

senses.meaning_en: to barely manage to achieve or attain something

examples.text: She scrapes a living as a street musician in Rome.
examples.translation_cn: 她在罗马当街头乐师，勉强维持生计。

senses.meaning_en: to collect or gather something with difficulty, often from small amounts

examples.text: We scraped together enough money to buy a used car.
examples.translation_cn: 我们东拼西凑凑足了钱买了一辆二手车。

senses.meaning_en: connected with sight or the eyes

examples.text: The bending of the stick in water is an optical illusion.
examples.translation_cn: 木棍在水中弯曲是一种视错觉。

senses.meaning_en: connected with optics or light; designed to help you see

examples.text: Scientists can observe cells through an optical microscope.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家可以通过光学显微镜观察细胞。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being sad

examples.text: She was filled with sadness at the news of his death.
examples.translation_cn: 听到他去世的消息，她悲痛万分。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes sadness

examples.text: The death of her dog was one of the sadnesses of her childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她的狗去世是她童年的一件伤心事。

senses.meaning_en: to look at someone in an angry way

examples.text: She glared at him without saying a word.
examples.translation_cn: 她一言不发地瞪着他。

senses.meaning_en: an angry look

examples.text: He gave me a fierce glare and walked away.
examples.translation_cn: 他恶狠狠地瞪了我一眼，然后走开了。

senses.meaning_en: to shine with a strong, unpleasant light

examples.text: The sun glared down on the white sand.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳灼眼地照射在白色沙滩上。

senses.meaning_en: a strong, unpleasant bright light

examples.text: She felt uncomfortable in the glare of the spotlight.
examples.translation_cn: 在聚光灯刺眼的强光下，她感到很不自在。

senses.meaning_en: at all; of any kind (used after a noun to emphasize a negative statement)

examples.text: She had no idea whatsoever what I meant.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全不明白我的意思。

senses.meaning_en: located above, especially over the head

examples.text: Please put your bag in the overhead compartment.
examples.translation_cn: 请把你的包放在头顶上方的行李舱里。

senses.meaning_en: the expenses of a business not directly assigned to goods or services

examples.text: The company is trying to cut overheads by moving to a smaller office.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正试图通过搬到更小的办公室来削减间接费用。

senses.meaning_en: the day or night before a holiday, especially Christmas Eve

examples.text: We always have a big dinner on Christmas Eve.
examples.translation_cn: 我们总是在圣诞前夕吃大餐。

senses.meaning_en: the period just before an important event
senses.collocation: on the eve of the election

examples.text: The president addressed the nation on the eve of the war.
examples.translation_cn: 总统在战争前夕向全国发表讲话。

senses.meaning_en: a large water bird with webbed feet, bigger than a duck

examples.text: We saw a flock of geese heading south for the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看见一群大雁南飞过冬。

senses.meaning_en: the meat from a goose used as food

examples.text: We had roast goose with apples for Christmas dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们圣诞节晚餐吃了烤鹅配苹果。

senses.meaning_en: a silly person

examples.text: Don't be a silly goose; it was just an honest mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 别犯傻；那只是一个无心的错误。

senses.meaning_en: to poke or pinch someone's bottom, especially as a joke

examples.text: She goosed him playfully and made him jump.
examples.translation_cn: 她开玩笑地戳了他屁股一下，吓得他跳起来。

senses.meaning_en: a soft juicy fruit with yellow flesh and a rough stone

examples.text: She bit into a ripe peach and juice ran down her chin.
examples.translation_cn: 她咬了一口熟透的桃子，汁水流到了下巴上。

senses.meaning_en: a tree that produces peaches, with pink flowers

examples.text: They planted a peach tree in the backyard last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 去年春天他们在后院种了一棵桃树。

senses.meaning_en: having a pale pinkish-orange colour

examples.text: She wore a peach silk scarf to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她戴着一条桃红色丝绸围巾去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a pale pinkish-orange colour

examples.text: The bedroom walls were painted in soft peach.
examples.translation_cn: 卧室的墙壁刷成了柔和的桃红色。

senses.meaning_en: a particularly admirable or pleasing person or thing

examples.text: Thanks for covering for me—you're a real peach.
examples.translation_cn: 谢谢你替我顶班，你真是个好人。

senses.meaning_en: to give a short statement of the main points of something

examples.text: The manager summarized the quarterly results in a short email.
examples.translation_cn: 经理在一封简短的电子邮件中总结了季度业绩。

senses.meaning_en: clear, detailed, or powerful

examples.text: She described the accident in vivid detail to the police.
examples.translation_cn: 她向警方生动地描述了那场事故。

senses.meaning_en: very bright

examples.text: The walls were painted in vivid colours for the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 为了庆祝节日，墙壁被涂上了鲜艳的颜色。

senses.meaning_en: full of life; lively
senses.pattern: be vivid and full of life

examples.text: Her grandmother is vivid and full of life, even at eighty.
examples.translation_cn: 她祖母即使八十岁了，仍然精力充沛、生气勃勃。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that causes illness or death if taken into the body

examples.text: The victim died after swallowing a deadly dose of poison.
examples.translation_cn: 受害者吞服一剂致命毒药后死亡。

senses.meaning_en: to harm or kill a person or animal by giving them poison

examples.text: They poisoned the prisoner with a slow-acting toxin, and he died.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用慢性毒药毒死了那名囚犯。

senses.meaning_en: to put poison in or on something so that it is dangerous to use

examples.text: They poisoned the village water supply with chemicals.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用化学物质在村里的水源中下毒。

senses.meaning_en: to have a bad effect on someone's mind or on a situation

examples.text: Years of propaganda poisoned their minds against the West.
examples.translation_cn: 多年的宣传毒化了他们对西方的看法。

senses.meaning_en: an alcoholic drink, especially in the phrases name your poison and what's your poison

examples.text: At the bar, he asked me, "What's your poison?"
examples.translation_cn: 在酒吧，他问我：“你想喝点什么酒？”

senses.meaning_en: to change a person's appearance so that people cannot recognize them

examples.text: The spy disguised himself as a tourist to enter the building.
examples.translation_cn: 间谍伪装成游客进入大楼。

senses.meaning_en: something that is worn or used to change your appearance and hide who you are

examples.text: She wore a clever disguise to the masked ball.
examples.translation_cn: 她戴着巧妙的伪装去参加化装舞会。

senses.meaning_en: an appearance that hides the truth about someone or something

examples.text: His friendly manner was just a disguise for his greed.
examples.translation_cn: 他和善的态度只是他贪婪的伪装。

senses.meaning_en: to hide a fact or feeling so that people do not notice it

examples.text: She tried to disguise the fact that she was upset.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图掩饰她难过的事实。

senses.meaning_en: the act of changing your appearance to avoid being recognized, especially as a trick

examples.text: The king travelled in disguise to learn the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 国王微服私访以了解真相。

senses.meaning_en: to thrive or grow well

examples.text: These plants flourish in the rich soil of the botanical garden.
examples.translation_cn: 这些植物在植物园肥沃的土壤里茁壮成长。

senses.meaning_en: to wave or display something in a dramatic way
senses.pattern: flourish sth in front of sb

examples.text: She flourished the signed document in front of the committee.
examples.translation_cn: 她在委员会面前挥动着那份签署过的文件。

senses.meaning_en: to be in a period of greatest influence or popularity

examples.text: Classical music flourished during the late 18th century.
examples.translation_cn: 古典音乐在18世纪晚期繁荣发展。

senses.meaning_en: without problems or difficulties

examples.text: The launch went smoothly and we received positive feedback.
examples.translation_cn: 发布进展顺利，我们收到了积极反馈。

senses.meaning_en: in a smooth manner

examples.text: The dancer moved smoothly across the stage, drawing every eye.
examples.translation_cn: 舞者在舞台上平稳地移动，吸引了所有人的目光。

senses.meaning_en: under or below something; on its underside

examples.text: She wore a jacket with a thin sweater underneath.
examples.translation_cn: 她在夹克里面穿了一件薄毛衣。

senses.meaning_en: under, below, or beneath something

examples.text: The children hid underneath the old wooden bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们躲在旧木桥下面。

senses.meaning_en: an eight-legged creature that spins webs to catch insects

examples.text: A spider spins its web in the corner of the room to catch insects.
examples.translation_cn: 蜘蛛在房间角落结网捕捉昆虫。

senses.meaning_en: a program which follows links on the World Wide Web in order to gather information

examples.text: Search engine spiders crawl the web to index new pages.
examples.translation_cn: 搜索引擎网络爬虫抓取网页以建立索引。

senses.meaning_en: strong, healthy, and full of energy

examples.text: My grandfather remains vigorous well into his eighties.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父八十多岁了仍然精力充沛。

senses.meaning_en: done with a lot of energy and force

examples.text: She does vigorous exercise for an hour every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上做一小时的剧烈运动。

senses.meaning_en: growing quickly and strongly

examples.text: The tomato plants show vigorous growth in the warm spring sun.
examples.translation_cn: 番茄苗在温暖的春日阳光下长势旺盛。

senses.meaning_en: a large vertical post supporting a building

examples.text: The temple roof rests on a pillar of stone.
examples.translation_cn: 寺庙的屋顶由一根石柱支撑。

senses.meaning_en: an important part of something that provides support

examples.text: Agriculture is a key pillar of the local economy.
examples.translation_cn: 农业是当地经济的支柱。

senses.meaning_en: a strong and reliable supporter

examples.text: She has been a pillar of society for years.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年来一直是社会的中坚分子。

senses.meaning_en: a basic principle or idea that supports something

examples.text: Free speech is one of the pillars of democracy.
examples.translation_cn: 言论自由是民主的核心原则之一。

senses.meaning_en: dark, faint or indistinct; unclear

examples.text: The painting's details were obscured by a layer of dust.
examples.translation_cn: 画作的细节被一层灰尘遮得模糊不清。

senses.meaning_en: hidden, out of sight or inconspicuous; to hide

examples.text: The old cottage was obscured from view by overgrown bushes.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧农舍被疯长的灌木遮住了。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to understand; abstruse

examples.text: The professor's lecture was obscure to most of the students.
examples.translation_cn: 教授的讲座让大多数学生觉得费解。

senses.meaning_en: not well-known

examples.text: The poet remained obscure until her work went viral online.
examples.translation_cn: 那位诗人一直默默无闻，直到她的作品在网上走红。

senses.meaning_en: to control your feelings or stop yourself from doing something

examples.text: She could hardly restrain herself from crying at the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到消息时她几乎忍不住哭了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to stop someone or something from doing something, often by using force

examples.text: The police restrained the man from attacking a passerby.
examples.translation_cn: 警察阻止了那名男子攻击路人。

senses.meaning_en: to restrict or limit something

examples.text: The government has taken measures to restrain inflation.
examples.translation_cn: 政府已采取措施抑制通货膨胀。

senses.meaning_en: to deprive someone of liberty, especially by physical control

examples.text: The violent patient was restrained in a straitjacket for his own safety.
examples.translation_cn: 那名狂躁病人为自身安全被束缚在约束衣里。

senses.meaning_en: the place where good people are believed to go after death

examples.text: They believe they will meet again in paradise.
examples.translation_cn: 他们相信会在天堂重逢。

senses.meaning_en: a very beautiful and pleasant place

examples.text: The tropical island is a paradise on earth, with clear water and white sand.
examples.translation_cn: 这个热带岛屿是一片人间乐土，海水清澈，沙滩洁白。

senses.meaning_en: an ideal place for a particular type of person or activity

examples.text: The new mall is a paradise for bargain hunters.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新商场是淘便宜货的人的天堂。

senses.meaning_en: a state of perfect happiness

examples.text: A week on a quiet beach would feel like paradise.
examples.translation_cn: 在宁静的海滩上待一周会让人感觉置身天堂。

senses.meaning_en: a person who specializes in physics

examples.text: She works as a physicist at a national laboratory.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家国家实验室担任物理学家。

senses.meaning_en: a man whose job is to sell things or serve customers in a shop

examples.text: He works as a salesman in a large department store.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家大百货商店当售货员。

senses.meaning_en: to prepare and use land for growing plants or crops

examples.text: Over generations, the villagers have cultivated the land to grow rice and tea.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几代人的努力，村民们耕种土地来种植水稻和茶叶。

senses.meaning_en: to develop a skill, quality, or interest through effort or attention

examples.text: She cultivated a lifelong interest in classical music.
examples.translation_cn: 她培养了对古典音乐的终身兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: to develop a relationship or friendship by making an effort

examples.text: She worked hard to cultivate a good relationship with her colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 她努力与同事建立良好的关系。

senses.meaning_en: extreme physical or mental pain

examples.text: The accident victim lay in agony, waiting for the ambulance.
examples.translation_cn: 事故受害者痛苦地躺着，等待救护车。

senses.meaning_en: the final struggle before death

examples.text: The wounded soldier cried out in his death agony.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤的士兵在临终挣扎中喊叫。

senses.meaning_en: a device that changes sound into an electric signal, used for recording or broadcasting

examples.text: She spoke into the microphone so that the audience could hear her clearly.
examples.translation_cn: 她对着麦克风讲话，让观众能清楚地听到她。

senses.meaning_en: a light, silvery metallic element (symbol Al) extracted from bauxite

examples.text: The bike frame is made of aluminium, so it is both light and strong.
examples.translation_cn: 这个自行车车架由铝制成，因此既轻便又坚固。

senses.meaning_en: a field covered in grass, often used for hay or grazing

examples.text: The sheep were grazing in a meadow near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 羊群在河边的一块草地上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: a small soft round fruit with a hard seed in the middle

examples.text: He offered me a cherry from the bowl on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 他从桌上的碗里给了我一颗樱桃。

senses.meaning_en: a tree that produces cherries

examples.text: We sat under the cherry tree and ate lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在樱桃树下吃午饭。

senses.meaning_en: the hard reddish wood of a cherry tree

examples.text: The desk is made of cherry and has a smooth finish.
examples.translation_cn: 这张书桌是樱桃木做的，表面很光滑。

senses.meaning_en: a bright red colour

examples.text: The new car comes in cherry red and silver.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新车有樱红色和银色可选。

senses.meaning_en: not willing; reluctant

examples.text: She was unwilling to admit that she had made a mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 她不愿意承认自己犯了错。

senses.meaning_en: a device with metal pins that fits into a socket to connect to an electricity supply

examples.text: He fitted a three-pin plug to the table lamp.
examples.translation_cn: 他给台灯装了一个三脚插头。

senses.meaning_en: an object used to block or fill a hole

examples.text: She put a plug in the sink before filling it with water.
examples.translation_cn: 她在水槽里放上塞子，然后注满水。

senses.meaning_en: to connect a piece of electrical equipment to the electricity supply

examples.text: He plugged the printer into the power strip.
examples.translation_cn: 他把打印机插进了电源插排。

senses.meaning_en: a small flat case for carrying paper money, cards, etc.

examples.text: I always keep my ID in my wallet.
examples.translation_cn: 我总是把身份证放在钱包里。

senses.meaning_en: a person's bank account or available money

examples.text: The new tax hit small business owners in the wallet.
examples.translation_cn: 新税打击了小企业主的钱包。

senses.meaning_en: an e-wallet or digital wallet

examples.text: He paid with an e-wallet on his phone in seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 他用手机上的电子钱包几秒钟就付了款。

senses.meaning_en: worried or uncomfortable because of anxiety or uncertainty

examples.text: I feel uneasy about giving out my phone number online.
examples.translation_cn: 我对在网上提供自己的电话号码感到不安。

senses.meaning_en: not relaxed or natural; awkward in manner

examples.text: He was uneasy with people he had just met.
examples.translation_cn: 他和刚认识的人在一起感到拘谨。

senses.meaning_en: causing worry or discomfort; not calm or stable

examples.text: An uneasy silence fell over the room after the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵之后，房间里一片令人不安的沉默。

senses.meaning_en: agreement; harmony

examples.text: His views are in full accord with company policy.
examples.translation_cn: 他的观点与公司政策完全一致。

senses.meaning_en: a formal agreement

examples.text: The two sides reached a peace accord after months of talks.
examples.translation_cn: 双方经过数月谈判达成了和平协议。

senses.meaning_en: to give or grant
senses.pattern: accord sb sth / accord sth to sb

examples.text: They accorded the visiting professor a warm welcome.
examples.translation_cn: 他们热烈欢迎来访的教授。

senses.meaning_en: a pile or mass of things

examples.text: He left a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一堆脏衣服留在地板上。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount or number

examples.text: She has heaps of homework to finish tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 她今晚有大量作业要完成。

senses.meaning_en: to put things in a pile

examples.text: He heaped the dirty plates onto the kitchen counter.
examples.translation_cn: 他把脏盘子堆到厨房台面上。

senses.meaning_en: an imaginary line around which an object spins or is symmetrically arranged

examples.text: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.translation_cn: 地球每24小时绕其轴自转一周。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed line used to position points in a graph or coordinate system

examples.text: Plot time on the x-axis and height on the y-axis.
examples.translation_cn: 在x轴上标出时间，在y轴上标出高度。

senses.meaning_en: a group of things tied or wrapped together

examples.text: She carried a bundle of old newspapers to the recycling bin.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一捆旧报纸拿到了回收箱。

senses.meaning_en: to tie or wrap together; to push roughly

examples.text: She bundled the children into the car and drove off.
examples.translation_cn: 她把孩子们塞进车里，开车走了。

senses.meaning_en: a group of products or services sold together

examples.text: The store sells the game console as a bundle with two controllers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店把游戏机和两个手柄捆绑销售。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount of money

examples.text: He made a bundle selling vintage toys online.
examples.translation_cn: 他靠网上卖复古玩具赚了一大笔钱。

senses.meaning_en: the sound of people clapping to show approval or enjoyment

examples.text: The audience gave her a round of applause for her performance.
examples.translation_cn: 观众为她的表演热烈鼓掌。

senses.meaning_en: public approval and praise

examples.text: She won applause for her handling of the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 她因处理危机的方式赢得了称赞。

senses.meaning_en: happening without planning or external cause

examples.text: The audience burst into spontaneous applause when the result was announced.
examples.translation_cn: 结果一公布，观众自发地鼓起掌来。

senses.meaning_en: natural and unforced in manner

examples.text: Her manner is natural and spontaneous, without any trace of artifice.
examples.translation_cn: 她的举止自然而不做作，没有丝毫矫揉造作。

senses.meaning_en: Said or done without prior planning or prior writing.

examples.text: She made a spontaneous remark about the weather that broke the ice.
examples.translation_cn: 她即兴评论天气，打破了沉默。

senses.meaning_en: more than is usual or expected

examples.text: The weather has been unusually warm for October.
examples.translation_cn: 十月的天气异常温暖。

senses.meaning_en: used to say that something does not happen in the usual way

examples.text: Unusually for such a busy man, he arrived on time.
examples.translation_cn: 对这么忙的人来说，他准时到达很不寻常。

senses.meaning_en: before long; soon

examples.text: The doctor will see you presently in his office.
examples.translation_cn: 医生马上会在他的办公室见你。

senses.meaning_en: at the present time; now

examples.text: She is presently working on a new novel.
examples.translation_cn: 她目前正在写一部新小说。

senses.meaning_en: the state or quality of being simple or easy to understand

examples.text: The simplicity of the instructions makes them easy to follow.
examples.translation_cn: 说明书的简单易懂让人容易照着做。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being plain and without decoration

examples.text: The room's simplicity gives it a calm, uncluttered feel.
examples.translation_cn: 房间的简朴给人一种平静、整洁的感觉。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being natural and sincere

examples.text: She spoke with simplicity and sincerity about her faith.
examples.translation_cn: 她简单真诚地谈了自己的信仰。

senses.meaning_en: a meal eaten outdoors

examples.text: We had a picnic by the lake last Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 上周日我们在湖边野餐。

senses.meaning_en: an easy or pleasant task

examples.text: Looking after three young children is no picnic.
examples.translation_cn: 照看三个小孩可不是件轻松事。

senses.meaning_en: to eat a meal outdoors

examples.text: We picnicked on the beach and watched the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在海滩上野餐并看了日落。

senses.meaning_en: a religious festival or holiday

examples.text: The feast of St John is celebrated every year in June.
examples.translation_cn: 圣约翰节每年在六月庆祝。

senses.meaning_en: a large meal, especially one to celebrate something

examples.text: They held a feast to celebrate their parents' golden wedding anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 他们举办盛宴庆祝父母的金婚纪念日。

senses.meaning_en: to eat a lot of good food

examples.text: The guests feasted on fresh seafood and fine wine.
examples.translation_cn: 客人们尽情享用新鲜海鲜和美酒。

senses.meaning_en: something that gives you great pleasure
senses.pattern: be a feast for the eyes/ears

examples.text: The concert was a feast for the ears.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会是一场听觉盛宴。

senses.meaning_en: to enjoy looking at something with great pleasure
senses.collocation: feast your eyes on the view

examples.text: We feasted our eyes on the breathtaking sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 我们饱览了令人惊叹的日落。

senses.meaning_en: to shape or influence the development of something

examples.text: Parents and teachers help mould a child's character.
examples.translation_cn: 父母和老师帮助塑造孩子的性格。

senses.meaning_en: a fungus that grows on damp surfaces

examples.text: The bathroom walls were covered in black mould.
examples.translation_cn: 浴室的墙上长满了黑霉。

senses.meaning_en: a container used to give shape to a substance as it hardens

examples.text: Pour the chocolate mixture into a mould and let it set.
examples.translation_cn: 把巧克力混合物倒进模具，让它凝固。

senses.meaning_en: milk and products made from milk

examples.text: Cheese and butter are common types of dairy produce.
examples.translation_cn: 奶酪和黄油是常见的乳制品。

senses.meaning_en: a place where milk is produced, processed, or sold

examples.text: We buy fresh milk at the local dairy.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在当地的乳品店买鲜牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: connected with milk or the production of milk and milk products

examples.text: She has worked in the dairy industry for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她已经在乳品业工作了十年。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to translate spoken language from one language to another

examples.text: She works as an interpreter for the European Union.
examples.translation_cn: 她在欧盟担任口译员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who performs or explains something in a way that shows their understanding of it

examples.text: He was regarded as an interpreter of Beethoven's music.
examples.translation_cn: 他被视为贝多芬音乐的演绎者。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of colliding

examples.text: The bus was involved in a collision with a truck.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆公交车与一辆卡车相撞。

senses.meaning_en: conflict or opposition

examples.text: A collision between tradition and innovation often leads to social change.
examples.translation_cn: 传统与创新的冲突常常导致社会变革。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden quick run or movement

examples.text: He made a dash for the exit when the bell rang.
examples.translation_cn: 铃响时他朝出口猛冲过去。

senses.meaning_en: a punctuation mark (—) used to separate parts of a sentence

examples.text: She used a dash to separate the two clauses.
examples.translation_cn: 她用破折号分隔两个分句。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of something, especially a liquid or flavouring

examples.text: Add a dash of lemon juice to the sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 往酱汁里加少许柠檬汁。

senses.meaning_en: to check or test the truth or accuracy of something

examples.text: You must verify that all the information is accurate before submitting the form.
examples.translation_cn: 提交表格前，你必须核实所有信息的准确性。

senses.meaning_en: to show or say that something is true

examples.text: The clinical trial verified that the new drug was effective.
examples.translation_cn: 临床试验证实了这种新药有效。

senses.meaning_en: not polite; showing a lack of respect for others

examples.text: He was rude to the waiter and refused to apologise.
examples.translation_cn: 他对服务员很粗鲁，而且拒绝道歉。

senses.meaning_en: somewhat obscene, pornographic, offensive

examples.text: He told a rude joke that made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 他讲了一个下流的笑话，让大家很不舒服。

senses.meaning_en: sudden and unpleasant, used about shocks or awakenings

examples.text: Losing his job came as a rude shock.
examples.translation_cn: 失业对他来说是一个突然的打击。

senses.meaning_en: hearty, vigorous; found particularly in the phrase rude health

examples.text: My grandfather is in rude health even at 90.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父即使九十岁了仍很健壮。

senses.meaning_en: a flat piece of material used to wipe feet or cover a floor
senses.pattern: wipe one's feet on the mat

examples.text: Please wipe your feet on the mat when you come in.
examples.translation_cn: 进来前请在垫子上擦擦脚。

senses.meaning_en: a thick soft pad that protects athletes in sports

examples.text: The gymnast landed on the mat after the final flip.
examples.translation_cn: 体操运动员完成最后一个空翻后落在垫子上。

senses.meaning_en: a thick tangled mass of hair or fibre

examples.text: The cat had a mat of hair behind its ears.
examples.translation_cn: 猫的耳朵后面有一团缠结的毛。

senses.meaning_en: a person trained to travel in a spacecraft

examples.text: She trained as an astronaut for years before her first mission.
examples.translation_cn: 她接受宇航员训练多年，之后才执行首次任务。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or initial stage of something

examples.text: It was clear from the outset that the plan would fail.
examples.translation_cn: 从一开始就很清楚这个计划会失败。

senses.meaning_en: a hard outer layer on a surface

examples.text: A thin crust of ice covered the windows in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 早晨窗户上结了一层薄冰壳。

senses.meaning_en: the hard outer layer of bread, pastry, or fried food

examples.text: Many children cut off the crusts from their sandwiches before eating.
examples.translation_cn: 许多孩子吃三明治前把面包皮切掉。

senses.meaning_en: the solid outer layer of the Earth

examples.text: Volcanoes form where the earth's crust is thin or cracking.
examples.translation_cn: 火山在地壳薄或开裂的地方形成。

senses.meaning_en: the bread base of a pizza

examples.text: We ordered a pizza with a thin crust and extra cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 我们点了一个薄皮比萨，并加了双份奶酪。

senses.meaning_en: influenza

examples.text: I can't come to work because I have the flu.
examples.translation_cn: 我不能来上班，因为我得了流感。

senses.meaning_en: stomach flu; viral gastroenteritis

examples.text: He missed school because he had stomach flu.
examples.translation_cn: 他因肠胃感冒没去上学。

senses.meaning_en: a type of food made from ground meat and seasoning, usually packed in a long casing

examples.text: Add some sausage to the soup for extra flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 往汤里加些香肠来增添风味。

senses.meaning_en: a single piece of sausage

examples.text: He grilled a sausage over the open fire.
examples.translation_cn: 他在明火上烤了一根香肠。

senses.meaning_en: an object shaped like a sausage

examples.text: She rolled the clay into a sausage shape.
examples.translation_cn: 她把黏土搓成香肠形状。

senses.meaning_en: to formally or officially tell someone about something

examples.text: Please notify us of any change of address.
examples.translation_cn: 地址如有变更请通知我们。

senses.meaning_en: a junior commissioned officer in the army, marines, or navy

examples.text: She was promoted to lieutenant in the army after three years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在陆军服役三年后被提升为中尉。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is second in command or acts as an assistant to a senior person

examples.text: As the CEO's most trusted lieutenant, she oversees daily operations.
examples.translation_cn: 作为首席执行官最信任的副手，她负责监督日常运营。

senses.meaning_en: a small flying insect that bites people and animals to suck blood

examples.text: She was bitten by a mosquito and the bite swelled up.
examples.translation_cn: 她被蚊子咬了，咬伤处肿了起来。

senses.meaning_en: legal membership of a nation or state

examples.text: She has dual nationality and holds both Canadian and British passports.
examples.translation_cn: 她拥有双重国籍，持有加拿大和英国两本护照。

senses.meaning_en: a people sharing a common origin, culture and/or language

examples.text: The Miao nationality is famous for its silver jewelry and festivals.
examples.translation_cn: 苗族以其银饰和节日而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: showing careful consideration

examples.text: We should be thoughtful about the risks before investing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在投资前应认真考虑风险。

senses.meaning_en: showing kindness and consideration for others
senses.pattern: It is thoughtful of sb to do

examples.text: It was thoughtful of you to send me a note.
examples.translation_cn: 你真好，给我寄了张便条。

senses.meaning_en: quiet because deep in thought

examples.text: She looked thoughtful as she read the letter.
examples.translation_cn: 她读信时显得若有所思。

senses.meaning_en: a plant that climbs by tendrils or twining

examples.text: The wild vine climbs up the old stone wall.
examples.translation_cn: 野生藤蔓爬上旧石墙。

senses.meaning_en: a climbing plant that produces grapes

examples.text: Grapes grow on a vine beside the farmhouse.
examples.translation_cn: 葡萄长在农舍旁的藤上。

senses.meaning_en: a long, thick stem of a climbing plant

examples.text: The explorer swung on a thick vine across the river.
examples.translation_cn: 探险者抓着粗藤荡过河。

senses.meaning_en: a short looping video clip on social media

examples.text: She posted a vine of her cat chasing a laser pointer.
examples.translation_cn: 她发了一段她的猫追逐激光笔的循环短视频。

senses.meaning_en: cloth made from flax fiber

examples.text: This summer dress is made of pure linen.
examples.translation_cn: 这条夏装连衣裙是纯亚麻布做的。

senses.meaning_en: household textiles such as sheets, tablecloths, etc.

examples.text: She changed the bed linen in the guest room.
examples.translation_cn: 她更换了客房的床单。

senses.meaning_en: made from linen cloth or thread

examples.text: He wore a linen jacket in the heat.
examples.translation_cn: 他大热天穿了件亚麻夹克。

senses.meaning_en: not required; left to personal choice

examples.text: This training session is optional for new employees.
examples.translation_cn: 这个培训课程对新员工来说是可选择的。

senses.meaning_en: the standard unit of money in several East African countries

examples.text: The fare from Nairobi to Mombasa was quoted in shillings, not dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 从内罗毕到蒙巴萨的票价以先令而非美元计价。

senses.meaning_en: a former British coin worth one twentieth of a pound

examples.text: The old ledger records prices in shillings and pence.
examples.translation_cn: 旧账本以先令和便士记录价格。

senses.meaning_en: in a voice that other people can hear

examples.text: She read the letter aloud, but her voice was barely above a whisper.
examples.translation_cn: 她出声地读了那封信，声音却低得像耳语。

senses.meaning_en: in a loud voice

examples.text: The wounded soldier cried aloud in pain as the medic cleaned the wound.
examples.translation_cn: 那个受伤的士兵在医护人员清理伤口时疼得大声叫喊。

senses.meaning_en: feeling angry or unhappy because someone has something that you want or has an advantage

examples.text: She was jealous of her colleague's success and couldn't hide her resentment.
examples.translation_cn: 她嫉妒同事的成功，无法掩饰自己的怨恨。

senses.meaning_en: feeling angry or unhappy because you think your partner is interested in someone else

examples.text: He gets jealous when his wife talks to other men.
examples.translation_cn: 妻子和其他男人说话时，他会吃醋。

senses.meaning_en: careful to protect or defend something you have or love

examples.text: She is extremely jealous of her personal privacy.
examples.translation_cn: 她极力保护自己的个人隐私。

senses.meaning_en: a multicoloured arch in the sky

examples.text: A rainbow appeared over the hills after the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后一道彩虹出现在山丘上空。

senses.meaning_en: a wide variety of different things

examples.text: The market offers a rainbow of fresh fruits and vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 市场上提供丰富多彩的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: activity done for enjoyment when not working

examples.text: She often does gardening for recreation on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 她周末常做园艺消遣。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of creating something again

examples.text: The museum displays a recreation of the ancient temple.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出了古代庙宇的再现。

senses.meaning_en: strong alcoholic drink made by distillation

examples.text: He never drinks hard liquor because it gives him headaches.
examples.translation_cn: 他从不喝烈酒，因为喝了会头疼。

senses.meaning_en: any alcoholic beverage

examples.text: The restaurant applied for a liquor licence last month.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅上个月申请了酒类执照。

senses.meaning_en: liquid obtained by cooking meat or vegetables

examples.text: The liquor from the roasted chicken makes a rich sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 烤鸡的汁液可以做成浓郁的酱汁。

senses.meaning_en: the length of time that something lasts or the distance between two points

examples.text: The bridge was built over a span of five years.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥是在五年的时间里建成的。

senses.meaning_en: to extend across or over an area or period of time
senses.pattern: span sth from A to B

examples.text: The bridge spans the river from the east bank to the west bank.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥横跨河流，从东岸到西岸。

senses.meaning_en: a vertical pipe or structure that carries smoke or gases away from a fire or engine

examples.text: Smoke rose from the factory chimney all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 浓烟整个下午从工厂烟囱升起。

senses.meaning_en: a glass tube around the flame of an oil lamp
senses.pattern: glass chimney of an oil lamp

examples.text: She wiped the glass chimney of the oil lamp before lighting it.
examples.translation_cn: 她点灯前擦拭了油灯的玻璃灯罩。

senses.meaning_en: a solid with six equal square faces, or an object shaped like one

examples.text: Add a cube of butter to the pan.
examples.translation_cn: 往锅里加一块黄油。

senses.meaning_en: to multiply a number by itself twice

examples.text: If you cube the number 3, you will get 27.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你把数字3立方，会得到27。

senses.meaning_en: the third power of a number

examples.text: The cube of 4 is 64, not 65.
examples.translation_cn: 4的立方是64，不是65。

senses.meaning_en: a puzzle resembling a Rubik's Cube

examples.text: He can solve a cube in under two minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 他能在两分钟内复原魔方。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Switzerland or its people

examples.text: The Swiss watch industry is famous around the world.
examples.translation_cn: 瑞士手表工业在全世界很有名。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Switzerland

examples.text: The Swiss are known for their punctual trains and fine chocolate.
examples.translation_cn: 瑞士人以准时的火车和精美的巧克力而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: a type of cheese with holes

examples.text: Would you like Swiss cheese on your sandwich?
examples.translation_cn: 你的三明治上要加瑞士奶酪吗？

senses.meaning_en: a document sent or received by a fax machine

examples.text: We received a fax from the bank this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天早上收到了银行发来的传真。

senses.meaning_en: to send a document by fax machine

examples.text: Please fax the signed contract to our office by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请在星期五之前把签好的合同传真到我们办公室。

senses.meaning_en: not bright or colorful

examples.text: The lamp was too dim to read by.
examples.translation_cn: 那盏灯太暗，没法看书。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make dim

examples.text: He dimmed the lights before the movie started.
examples.translation_cn: 电影开始前他把灯调暗了。

senses.meaning_en: indistinct, hazy or unclear

examples.text: I have only a dim memory of my early childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 我对童年早期只有模糊的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: not smart or intelligent

examples.text: He can be a bit dim at times.
examples.translation_cn: 他有时有点迟钝。

senses.meaning_en: unfavorable; disapproving

examples.text: The board took a dim view of the proposed budget cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会对拟议的预算削减不看好。

senses.meaning_en: a mark left by a foot or shoe on the ground

examples.text: The muddy footsteps led straight to the kitchen door.
examples.translation_cn: 泥脚印径直通向厨房门。

senses.meaning_en: the sound made by walking or running

examples.text: She heard his heavy footsteps approaching from behind.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到他沉重的脚步声从身后传来。

senses.meaning_en: a course of action or way of life followed by someone; an example to follow

examples.text: She decided to follow in her mother's footsteps and become a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定追随母亲的脚步，成为一名医生。

senses.meaning_en: a large farm where crops are grown

examples.text: He spent his childhood on a tea plantation in India.
examples.translation_cn: 他在印度的一座茶园度过了童年。

senses.meaning_en: an area where trees are planted, often for commercial use

examples.text: A plantation of eucalyptus trees now covers the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 一片桉树人工林现在覆盖了山谷。

senses.meaning_en: the time in the evening when the sun goes down and the sky changes color

examples.text: The sky turned orange as we watched the sunset from the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 当我们从海滩观看日落时，天空变成了橙色。

senses.meaning_en: to phase out or gradually end something

examples.text: The university will sunset the old program in 2026.
examples.translation_cn: 该大学将在2026年淘汰旧课程。

senses.meaning_en: a married woman whose main job is caring for her home and family

examples.text: She became a housewife after her first child arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一个孩子出生后，她成了一名家庭主妇。

senses.meaning_en: a small case or bag for sewing materials

examples.text: She kept her needles and thread in a housewife.
examples.translation_cn: 她把针线放在一个针线包里。

senses.meaning_en: bread that has been toasted

examples.text: She had a piece of toast with butter and honey.
examples.translation_cn: 她吃了一片涂黄油和蜂蜜的烤面包片。

senses.meaning_en: a salutation while drinking alcohol

examples.text: They drank a toast to the happy couple at the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在婚礼上为这对幸福的新人祝酒。

senses.meaning_en: to move on ice or ground using skates

examples.text: My sister and I skate on the frozen lake every winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐和我每年冬天都在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

senses.meaning_en: a boot with a blade or wheels attached, used for skating

examples.text: She bought a pair of skates for her winter holiday.
examples.translation_cn: 她为寒假买了一双溜冰鞋。

senses.meaning_en: to push air from the lungs through the throat with a sudden sharp sound

examples.text: He coughed badly all night and kept the whole family awake.
examples.translation_cn: 他整夜咳嗽得厉害，全家人都没睡好。

senses.meaning_en: to send something out of the lungs or throat by coughing

examples.text: She coughed up blood and called a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她咳出血后叫了医生。

senses.meaning_en: to reluctantly give information or confess

examples.text: The suspect finally coughed up the truth after hours of questioning.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数小时的审问，嫌疑人终于供出了真相。

senses.meaning_en: the ideal of a classless society in which money and the state no longer exist

examples.text: Many people believed in communism as a society without classes, money, or the state.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人曾信仰共产主义，视其为没有阶级、货币或国家的社会。

senses.meaning_en: a social and economic system based on communist ideology

examples.text: Under communism, all major industries were owned by the state.
examples.translation_cn: 在共产主义制度下，所有主要工业均归国家所有。

senses.meaning_en: a supernatural harm caused by a spell

examples.text: The witch put a curse on the prince.
examples.translation_cn: 女巫对王子下了诅咒。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes great harm or trouble

examples.text: Heavy traffic is the curse of modern city life.
examples.translation_cn: 交通拥堵是现代城市生活的祸根。

senses.meaning_en: an offensive or rude word

examples.text: He uttered a curse when he dropped the plate.
examples.translation_cn: 他掉盘子时骂了一句脏话。

senses.meaning_en: to swear or use offensive language

examples.text: He cursed at the taxi driver for blocking the road.
examples.translation_cn: 他对着出租车司机咒骂，因为他挡了路。

senses.meaning_en: to ask a supernatural power to harm someone

examples.text: The old witch cursed the village, and the crops failed for years.
examples.translation_cn: 老女巫诅咒了村庄，庄稼歉收多年。

senses.meaning_en: the system or business of carrying goods

examples.text: The parts are sent by freight to the assembly plant.
examples.translation_cn: 零件通过货运送到组装厂。

senses.meaning_en: goods carried by ship, plane, train, or truck

examples.text: The cargo ship carries freight between Shanghai and Rotterdam.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘货轮在上海和鹿特丹之间运送货物。

senses.meaning_en: money paid for transporting goods

examples.text: Who will pay the freight on this shipment?
examples.translation_cn: 谁来支付这批货物的运费？

senses.meaning_en: to load a ship or vehicle with goods; to hire a ship or vehicle to carry goods

examples.text: They freighted the ship with grain for the long voyage.
examples.translation_cn: 他们给船装上谷物以进行长途航行。

senses.meaning_en: to transport goods by ship, train, truck, or plane

examples.text: The company freights goods by rail across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司通过铁路在全国各地运输货物。

senses.meaning_en: a large cup for drinks, usually with a handle

examples.text: She poured me a mug of hot coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我倒了一大杯热咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: (informal) a person's face

examples.text: I never want to see your ugly mug again.
examples.translation_cn: 我再也不想看见你这张丑脸了。

senses.meaning_en: to attack someone in order to steal from them

examples.text: Two men mugged a tourist for his wallet outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 两名男子在车站外抢劫了一名游客的钱包。

senses.meaning_en: the science of numbers and shapes

examples.text: She has always been good at maths since primary school.
examples.translation_cn: 她自小学起就一直擅长数学。

senses.meaning_en: a mark left on something that is difficult to remove

examples.text: She used a special cleaner to remove the stubborn stain from the carpet.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一种特殊清洁剂除去了地毯上顽固的污渍。

senses.meaning_en: damage to someone's reputation; to damage someone's reputation

examples.text: The scandal stained his reputation so badly that he had to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻严重败坏了他的名誉，他不得不辞职。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used to colour a surface by soaking into it

examples.text: Apply a thin coat of stain to the table and let it dry for four hours.
examples.translation_cn: 在桌子上涂一层薄薄的着色剂，然后晾干四小时。

senses.meaning_en: to colour a surface by applying a stain

examples.text: They stained the wooden floor with a dark walnut stain.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用深胡桃木色着色剂给木地板着色。

senses.meaning_en: to remove hair with a razor

examples.text: He shaved off his beard before the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 他在面试前剃掉了胡须。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce by a small amount

examples.text: The new route shaved twenty minutes off the journey.
examples.translation_cn: 新路线使行程缩短了二十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to cut thin slices from a surface

examples.text: She shaved off thin slices of cheese for the salad.
examples.translation_cn: 她为沙拉削了薄片奶酪。

senses.meaning_en: an act of shaving

examples.text: He had a shave and a shower before dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他在晚饭前刮了脸，洗了澡。

senses.meaning_en: a particular written form of a word

examples.text: The spelling of 'centre' is common in British English.
examples.translation_cn: centre 的拼写在英式英语中很常见。

senses.meaning_en: the correct way to write a word

examples.text: You can check the correct spelling of any word in a dictionary.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在词典中查任何词的正确拼写。

senses.meaning_en: the ability or activity of forming words with letters

examples.text: He is good at spelling and rarely makes mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 他擅长拼写，很少出错。

senses.meaning_en: a container with a lid, spout and handle, used for boiling water

examples.text: Could you put the kettle on for tea?
examples.translation_cn: 你能把水壶烧上吗？

senses.meaning_en: the amount a kettle holds

examples.text: We boiled a kettle of water for the pasta.
examples.translation_cn: 我们烧了一壶水煮意面。

senses.meaning_en: an outdoor area where children can play, often with equipment

examples.text: The children are playing in the playground after school.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们放学后在操场上玩耍。

senses.meaning_en: to remove or erase written, printed, or digital material

examples.text: She deleted the paragraph from the document before sending it.
examples.translation_cn: 她发送前把那段从文件中删除了。

senses.meaning_en: an act of deleting or a deletion

examples.text: You must confirm the delete before the file is permanently removed.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须在文件被永久删除前确认删除。

senses.meaning_en: a strong alcoholic drink distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice

examples.text: He bought a bottle of brandy for the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他为聚会买了一瓶白兰地。

senses.meaning_en: a glass or serving of brandy

examples.text: The waiter poured her a brandy after the meal.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员在饭后给她倒了一杯白兰地。

senses.meaning_en: causing or likely to cause harm

examples.text: Too much sun can be harmful to your skin.
examples.translation_cn: 过多日晒对皮肤有害。

senses.meaning_en: a small insect living in organized colonies

examples.text: A colony of ants marched across the garden path.
examples.translation_cn: 一群蚂蚁穿过花园小径。

senses.meaning_en: instruction or teaching, especially in small groups or individually

examples.text: She received extra tuition in maths before the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她在考试前接受了额外的数学辅导。

senses.meaning_en: money paid for instruction, especially at a school or university

examples.text: Many students work part-time to pay their tuition.
examples.translation_cn: 许多学生做兼职来支付学费。

senses.meaning_en: causing destruction or severe damage

examples.text: The hurricane was destructive to the coastal town, destroying hundreds of homes.
examples.translation_cn: 飓风对沿海城镇造成了破坏，摧毁了数百座房屋。

senses.meaning_en: not costing a lot of money; cheap

examples.text: This phone is inexpensive to produce, so it sells for a low price.
examples.translation_cn: 这款手机生产成本低，所以售价也低。

senses.meaning_en: to make a short, loud, explosive noise, especially a dog

examples.text: The dog barked at every car that passed the house.
examples.translation_cn: 狗对着每辆经过房子的车叫。

senses.meaning_en: to say or shout something in a sharp, loud voice

examples.text: The coach barked out orders to the team during practice.
examples.translation_cn: 训练时教练对球队大声下达命令。

senses.meaning_en: the short, loud explosive sound made by a dog

examples.text: The old dog gave a low bark but did not get up.
examples.translation_cn: 老狗低低地叫了一声，但没有起身。

senses.meaning_en: an abrupt loud vocal utterance

examples.text: She let out a bark of laughter at his joke.
examples.translation_cn: 听到他的笑话，她发出一声短促的笑声。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that produces electricity

examples.text: The camp runs on a small diesel generator at night.
examples.translation_cn: 晚上营地靠一台小型柴油发电机供电。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that produces something

examples.text: The port is a major generator of local employment.
examples.translation_cn: 这个港口是当地就业的主要创造者。

senses.meaning_en: a computer program that produces something automatically
senses.pattern: use a generator to do sth

examples.text: You can use a password generator to create strong, unique passwords.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以使用密码生成器创建强大且唯一的密码。

senses.meaning_en: a place where you can buy coffee, tea, other drinks, and simple meals or light food

examples.text: We sat in a cafe near the station and ordered coffee and sandwiches.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在车站附近的一家咖啡馆里，点了咖啡和三明治。

senses.meaning_en: a word that describes a noun or pronoun

examples.text: An adjective modifies a noun by giving more information about it.
examples.translation_cn: 形容词通过提供更多信息来修饰名词。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or functioning as an adjective

examples.text: An adjective clause modifies a noun in a sentence.
examples.translation_cn: 形容词从句修饰句子中的名词。

senses.meaning_en: the central part of something around which other parts are collected

examples.text: These three players form the nucleus of the team.
examples.translation_cn: 这三名球员构成了球队的核心。

senses.meaning_en: the central part of an atom, consisting of protons and neutrons

examples.text: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
examples.translation_cn: 原子核包含质子和中子。

senses.meaning_en: a large organelle in eukaryotic cells that contains genetic material

examples.text: The nucleus of a cell contains most of its genetic material.
examples.translation_cn: 细胞核包含细胞的大部分遗传物质。

senses.meaning_en: an initial part or version that will receive additions

examples.text: The first draft served as a nucleus for the final project.
examples.translation_cn: 第一稿成了最终项目的雏形。

senses.meaning_en: a cause of sudden excitement; a kick

examples.text: Meeting the famous author was a real thrill for me.
examples.translation_cn: 见到那位著名作家对我来说真是一件令人兴奋的事。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to feel very excited or pleased

examples.text: The magician thrilled the audience with his tricks.
examples.translation_cn: 魔术师用他的戏法让观众兴奋不已。

senses.meaning_en: a slight trembling feeling, often caused by emotion

examples.text: A thrill of fear ran down her spine.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵恐惧的颤栗沿着她的脊背传下去。

senses.meaning_en: a light frame covered with paper or cloth, flown in the wind at the end of a long string

examples.text: The children flew a kite in the park on Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 星期天孩子们在公园里放风筝。

senses.meaning_en: a bird of prey with long wings and a forked tail

examples.text: A kite hovered high above the field, scanning for prey.
examples.translation_cn: 一只鸢在田野上空盘旋，寻找猎物。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical element (symbol N) that is a colorless, odorless gas

examples.text: Air contains about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.
examples.translation_cn: 空气含有约78%的氮和21%的氧。

senses.meaning_en: see-through; clear

examples.text: The bottle is transparent to light, so the water is clearly visible.
examples.translation_cn: 这个瓶子透光，所以里面的水清晰可见。

senses.meaning_en: open; public; not hiding anything

examples.text: The company is transparent about its environmental impact.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司公开其环境影响信息。

senses.meaning_en: obvious; easy to understand

examples.text: His excuse was transparent to everyone in the office.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室里的每个人都看得出他的借口。

senses.meaning_en: the speed of something in a particular direction

examples.text: They measured the velocity of the river current.
examples.translation_cn: 他们测量了河水的流速。

senses.meaning_en: high speed; rapid motion

examples.text: The bullet left the gun at high velocity.
examples.translation_cn: 子弹高速射出枪膛。

senses.meaning_en: the rate at which money changes hands within an economy

examples.text: Economists track the velocity of money to predict inflation.
examples.translation_cn: 经济学家追踪货币周转率以预测通胀。

senses.meaning_en: the rate at which something happens or changes

examples.text: The velocity of change in the tech industry is breathtaking.
examples.translation_cn: 科技行业变革的速度令人惊叹。

senses.meaning_en: the science or practice of flying aircraft

examples.text: Flight simulators are widely used in aviation to train pilots.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行模拟器在航空领域广泛用于训练飞行员。

senses.meaning_en: the industry that designs and builds aircraft

examples.text: Engineers in the aviation industry test new wing designs before aircraft are built.
examples.translation_cn: 航空工业的工程师在飞机制造前测试新机翼设计。

senses.meaning_en: the difference in electrical potential between two points

examples.text: The voltage across a component can be measured with a voltmeter.
examples.translation_cn: 元件两端的电压可以用电压表测量。

senses.meaning_en: connected with grammar

examples.text: The course explains the grammatical structure of everyday English.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程讲解日常英语的语法结构。

senses.meaning_en: following the rules of grammar

examples.text: The sentence is perfectly grammatical, but it sounds unnatural.
examples.translation_cn: 这个句子完全符合语法，但听起来不自然。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow strip of leather, cloth, or other material, used to fasten or carry something

examples.text: She adjusted the leather strap on her camera before the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 旅行前她调整了相机上的背带。

senses.meaning_en: a person who directs an orchestra or choir

examples.text: The conductor of the orchestra raised his baton and the music began.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队指挥举起指挥棒，音乐随之响起。

senses.meaning_en: a person who collects fares or checks tickets on public transport

examples.text: The conductor on the train helped an elderly passenger find her seat.
examples.translation_cn: 列车上的乘务员帮一位老年乘客找到了座位。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that allows electricity, heat, light or sound to pass through it

examples.text: Copper is a very good conductor of electricity and is widely used in wires.
examples.translation_cn: 铜是非常好的导电体，广泛用于电线。

senses.meaning_en: influence or control

examples.text: The old rules still hold sway over many small communities.
examples.translation_cn: 这些旧规则在许多小社区仍然占据支配地位。

senses.meaning_en: a swaying motion

examples.text: The gentle sway of the hammock soon put the baby to sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 吊床轻轻摇晃，宝宝很快就睡着了。

senses.meaning_en: no matter which

examples.text: Whichever way you look at it, the decision was fair.
examples.translation_cn: 无论你从哪个角度看，这个决定都是公平的。

senses.meaning_en: any one that

examples.text: You may choose whichever one you prefer from the menu.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以从菜单中选择你喜欢的任何一个。

senses.meaning_en: to describe something as larger, better, or worse than it really is

examples.text: The report exaggerated the health benefits of the new diet.
examples.translation_cn: 报告夸大了新饮食的健康益处。

senses.meaning_en: to go past a moving vehicle or person ahead because you are moving faster

examples.text: He accelerated to overtake the slow truck ahead.
examples.translation_cn: 他加速超过前面那辆慢速卡车。

senses.meaning_en: to become greater in number, amount, or importance than

examples.text: China has overtaken Japan as the world's second-largest economy.
examples.translation_cn: 中国已超过日本成为世界第二大经济体。

senses.meaning_en: to affect somebody suddenly and strongly, especially in an unpleasant way

examples.text: The climbers were suddenly overtaken by a storm.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者突然遭遇暴风雨。

senses.meaning_en: to move the tongue across a surface

examples.text: The girl licked her ice cream slowly as she walked home.
examples.translation_cn: 女孩一边走回家一边慢慢地舔着冰淇淋。

senses.meaning_en: to lightly touch or flicker over something

examples.text: Flames began to lick the edge of the paper.
examples.translation_cn: 火焰开始轻舔纸的边缘。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat easily in a game or competition

examples.text: They licked us by 30 points in the final.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在决赛中以30分优势轻松打败了我们。

senses.meaning_en: an action taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant

examples.text: You should take precautions against sunburn by wearing a hat.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该戴帽子以防晒伤。

senses.meaning_en: the act of correcting or a change that corrects an error

examples.text: The editor made several corrections to the manuscript before publication.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑在出版前对稿件做了几处修改。

senses.meaning_en: punishment or treatment intended to rehabilitate an offender

examples.text: He has worked in corrections for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在惩教系统工作了十多年。

senses.meaning_en: lower in rank or status
senses.pattern: be inferior to sb in rank

examples.text: A lieutenant is inferior to a captain in rank.
examples.translation_cn: 中尉的军衔低于上尉。

senses.meaning_en: lower in quality; worse than

examples.text: This copy is clearly inferior to the original in quality.
examples.translation_cn: 这个复制品质量明显不如原件。

senses.meaning_en: a person of lower rank

examples.text: He never treats his junior staff as his inferiors.
