senses.meaning_en: a person who prepares and sells meat

examples.text: He works as a butcher at the local market.
examples.translation_cn: 他在当地市场做肉贩。

senses.meaning_en: to slaughter animals and prepare meat for sale

examples.text: The farmer butchers his own pigs every autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 那个农民每年秋天自己宰猪。

senses.meaning_en: to ruin or do something very badly

examples.text: The amateur singer completely butchered the classic song.
examples.translation_cn: 那个业余歌手把这首经典歌曲彻底唱砸了。

senses.meaning_en: to kill people brutally

examples.text: The invading soldiers ruthlessly butchered hundreds of civilians.
examples.translation_cn: 入侵的士兵残忍地屠杀了数百名平民。

senses.meaning_en: boring, monotonous, and time-consuming

examples.text: She found the long meeting tedious and could hardly stay awake.
examples.translation_cn: 她觉得漫长的会议令人厌烦，几乎无法保持清醒。

senses.meaning_en: a delay or gap caused by something falling behind

examples.text: There is often a lag between a new policy and its actual effect.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策与其实际效果之间往往存在滞后。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been imprisoned many times

examples.text: His uncle is an old lag who regrets his past.
examples.translation_cn: 他的叔叔是一个悔恨过去的惯犯。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to keep up with others or with a schedule

examples.text: Some students are lagging behind the rest of the class.
examples.translation_cn: 一些学生落后于班上其他同学。

senses.meaning_en: to have or express an unfavorable opinion

examples.text: They strongly disapprove of my decision to leave school.
examples.translation_cn: 他们强烈反对我退学的决定。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to approve; reject

examples.text: The school board officially disapproved the budget proposal after heated discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 学校董事会经过激烈讨论后正式否决了预算提案。

senses.meaning_en: to lead someone in the wrong direction

examples.text: The hikers were misled by the old map and took a wrong turn.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者被旧地图带错了路，拐错了弯。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone believe something that is not true, especially by giving false or incomplete information

examples.text: The company misled customers about the safety of its product.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司就产品的安全性误导了客户。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone confuse one thing with another because they are similar or unclear
senses.pattern: mislead sb into confusing A with B

examples.text: The similar packaging misled shoppers into confusing one brand with the other.
examples.translation_cn: 相似的包装让购物者把一个品牌和另一个品牌混淆了。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has

examples.text: She looked at the golden trophy with envy.
examples.translation_cn: 她羡慕地看着那座金色奖杯。

senses.meaning_en: to wish you had something that someone else has

examples.text: I envy you your ability to stay calm under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 我羡慕你面对压力保持冷静的能力。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that other people admire and wish they had

examples.text: Her garden is the envy of the whole neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她的花园让整片街区羡慕。

senses.meaning_en: to feel unhappy because someone else has something you want

examples.text: She secretly envied her friend for her beauty.
examples.translation_cn: 她暗自嫉妒朋友的美貌。

senses.meaning_en: not important; too small to have an effect

examples.text: The difference seems insignificant, but it can affect the results.
examples.translation_cn: 这种差异看似微不足道，但会影响结果。

senses.meaning_en: the act of cutting hair

examples.text: I'm getting a haircut at the new salon.
examples.translation_cn: 我要去新开的发廊理发。

senses.meaning_en: the style in which hair is cut

examples.text: She now has a very short modern haircut.
examples.translation_cn: 她现在留着非常短的现代发型。

senses.meaning_en: a set of strong belts worn to protect or support a person

examples.text: She wore a safety harness while climbing the steep rock face.
examples.translation_cn: 她攀爬陡峭岩壁时系着安全带。

senses.meaning_en: a set of leather straps put around a horse's head and body

examples.text: The horses stood quietly in harness, ready to pull the wagon.
examples.translation_cn: 马儿们安静地套着挽具站着，准备拉车。

senses.meaning_en: a set of wires grouped together for a particular purpose

examples.text: The mechanic replaced a wiring harness under the dashboard.
examples.translation_cn: 机修工更换了仪表板下的线束。

senses.meaning_en: to put a harness on a horse or other animal
senses.collocation: harness a horse to a cart

examples.text: He harnessed the horse to the cart before loading the hay.
examples.translation_cn: 他在装干草前把马套到了大车上。

senses.meaning_en: to control and use a force or supply of energy

examples.text: Engineers harness the wind to generate electricity for the village.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师利用风能为村庄发电。

senses.meaning_en: careful with money; thrifty

examples.text: She is economical with her food budget and rarely eats out.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伙食开支上很节省，很少外出吃饭。

senses.meaning_en: saving money or resources

examples.text: This boiler is economical to run and uses much less gas than the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 这台锅炉运行成本低，耗气量比旧的那台少得多。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns or manages a small shop

examples.text: As a shopkeeper, she opens the store at seven every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 作为店主，她每天早上七点开门。

senses.meaning_en: to move or act quickly

examples.text: She hastened to explain that the mistake was not serious.
examples.translation_cn: 她赶紧解释说这个错误并不严重。

senses.meaning_en: to make something happen sooner or faster

examples.text: The scandal may hasten the end of his political career.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻可能会加速他政治生涯的终结。

senses.meaning_en: to read quickly, skipping some detail

examples.text: I skimmed through the report before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我在会前浏览了报告。

senses.meaning_en: to remove floating matter from a liquid

examples.text: She skimmed the fat off the soup before serving it.
examples.translation_cn: 她上汤前撇去了汤面的浮油。

senses.meaning_en: to steal money or information, especially by using a device

examples.text: Criminals skimmed data from the card using a hidden device.
examples.translation_cn: 犯罪分子使用隐藏设备盗取了卡上的数据。

senses.meaning_en: to throw an object so it bounces on water

examples.text: The children skimmed flat stones across the pond.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们用扁石子在水面打水漂。

senses.meaning_en: the daughter of one's son or daughter

examples.text: She is the granddaughter of a retired judge.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位退休法官的孙女。

senses.meaning_en: unfortunate; marked by misfortune

examples.text: We were unlucky to lose the game in the final minute.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不幸在最后一分钟输掉了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: bringing ill luck; inauspicious

examples.text: The number thirteen is considered unlucky in many Western countries.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多西方国家，数字十三被认为是不吉利的。

senses.meaning_en: kind and warmly courteous

examples.text: She was gracious to all the guests and made them feel at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她对所有客人都亲切有礼，让他们感到宾至如归。

senses.meaning_en: full of grace; elegant

examples.text: She moved with gracious ease across the ballroom.
examples.translation_cn: 她优雅自如地穿过舞厅。

senses.meaning_en: showing kindness and compassion, especially to someone who has done wrong
senses.pattern: be gracious to those who wrong you

examples.text: He was gracious to those who had wronged him and forgave them.
examples.translation_cn: 他宽厚地对待曾经伤害过他的人，并原谅了他们。

senses.meaning_en: used to express surprise, annoyance, etc.

examples.text: Good gracious, you gave me such a fright!
examples.translation_cn: 天哪，你吓了我一跳！

senses.meaning_en: absolutely necessary; essential

examples.text: A reliable internet connection is indispensable for remote work.
examples.translation_cn: 可靠的互联网连接对远程工作必不可少。

senses.meaning_en: to feel great joy

examples.text: We rejoiced at the news that the war had finally ended.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为战争终于结束的消息而欢欣鼓舞。

senses.meaning_en: towards the outside or away from a centre

examples.text: The door opens outwards onto a small balcony.
examples.translation_cn: 门向外开，通往一个小阳台。

senses.meaning_en: a poor and crowded area of a city with very bad housing and living conditions

examples.text: Many families in the slums still lack clean water.
examples.translation_cn: 贫民窟里许多家庭仍然缺乏干净的水。

senses.meaning_en: to spend time in conditions that are much worse than usual, especially for a short period

examples.text: We had to slum it in a tiny flat for a month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不在一个小公寓里将就了一个月。

senses.meaning_en: to make something less heavy or severe

examples.text: A pay rise would lighten the burden on low-income families.
examples.translation_cn: 加薪会减轻低收入家庭的负担。

senses.meaning_en: to make a situation or mood less serious

examples.text: She told a joke to lighten the mood at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她讲了一个笑话来缓和会议的气氛。

senses.meaning_en: to become brighter

examples.text: As the storm passed, the sky began to lighten in the east.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，东边的天空开始放亮。

senses.meaning_en: wanting more money, power, etc. than you need; eager to get more

examples.text: He is greedy for power and ignores everyone else.
examples.translation_cn: 他贪权，无视他人。

senses.meaning_en: wanting to eat more food than you need

examples.text: The children are greedy for chocolate and never leave any for us.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们贪吃巧克力，从不给我们留。

senses.meaning_en: suffering or death caused by lack of food

examples.text: Millions of people suffered from starvation during the drought.
examples.translation_cn: 数百万人在干旱期间忍饥挨饿。

senses.meaning_en: towards the outside; away from the centre

examples.text: The seats all face outward, away from the centre.
examples.translation_cn: 所有座位都朝外，背离中心。

senses.meaning_en: visible or noticeable

examples.text: He showed no outward sign of fear during the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试期间，他没有流露出任何恐惧的外在迹象。

senses.meaning_en: serious and grave, not cheerful

examples.text: He looked solemn as he listened to the judge's ruling.
examples.translation_cn: 他听着法官的裁决，神情严肃。

senses.meaning_en: formal and serious, often involving ceremony

examples.text: The award was presented at a solemn ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 奖项在庄严的典礼上颁发。

senses.meaning_en: to fill with surprise and wonder

examples.text: I was amazed at how quickly she learned the new software.
examples.translation_cn: 我惊讶于她学新软件如此之快。

senses.meaning_en: quick and full of energy

examples.text: We walked at a brisk pace to get warm.
examples.translation_cn: 我们轻快地走着让身体暖和起来。

senses.meaning_en: busy and active, especially in business

examples.text: The shop did a brisk trade in cold drinks.
examples.translation_cn: 这家店冷饮生意兴隆。

senses.meaning_en: cold but fresh and pleasant, usually of weather

examples.text: A brisk wind was blowing off the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵寒冷清新的海风吹来。

senses.meaning_en: abrupt or curt in manner

examples.text: She cut me off in a brisk manner, saying she had no time.
examples.translation_cn: 她唐突地打断我，说她没有时间。

senses.meaning_en: worthy of being recommended; desirable

examples.text: It is advisable to book tickets in advance.
examples.translation_cn: 提前订票是明智的。

senses.meaning_en: lacking physical coordination

examples.text: I'm too clumsy with a hammer to hang this picture straight.
examples.translation_cn: 我用锤子太笨拙，挂不正这幅画。

senses.meaning_en: lacking skill or tact

examples.text: He made a clumsy attempt at a joke and offended everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他笨拙地试着开玩笑，冒犯了所有人。

senses.meaning_en: made of wool

examples.text: The woollen blanket kept him warm all night.
examples.translation_cn: 那条羊毛毯让他整夜保持温暖。

senses.meaning_en: clothes or other items made of wool

examples.text: He wore his winter woollens to stay warm.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿上冬季毛料衣服保暖。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of weight equal to about 28 grams

examples.text: Add three ounces of softened butter to the pan.
examples.translation_cn: 往锅里加入三盎司软化的黄油。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount

examples.text: He showed an ounce of courage during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 在危机中他表现出了一点点勇气。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of weight equal to about 31.1 grams, used especially for precious metals

examples.text: Gold is trading at $1,800 per troy ounce today.
examples.translation_cn: 今天黄金交易价格为每金衡盎司1,800美元。

senses.meaning_en: happy and cheerful

examples.text: Everyone was in a jolly mood at the Christmas party.
examples.translation_cn: 圣诞聚会上大家都心情愉快。

senses.meaning_en: slightly drunk

examples.text: He was a bit jolly after a few glasses of wine.
examples.translation_cn: 他喝了几杯红酒后有点微醉。

senses.meaning_en: to amuse or divert

examples.text: She jollied the children up with a funny story.
examples.translation_cn: 她讲了个有趣的故事，逗孩子们开心。

senses.meaning_en: a garden tool with a handle and a flat blade for digging

examples.text: You should use a spade to dig a hole for the rose bush.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该用锹为玫瑰丛挖一个坑。

senses.meaning_en: one of the four suits in a deck of playing cards

examples.text: She drew the ace of spades from the pack.
examples.translation_cn: 她从牌堆里抽出了黑桃A。

senses.meaning_en: to dig or turn over soil with a spade

examples.text: We need to spade the soil before planting the tomatoes.
examples.translation_cn: 种植西红柿之前，我们需要用锹翻地。

senses.meaning_en: a cutting tool with two blades that slide past each other

examples.text: She cut the cloth with a pair of scissors.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一把剪刀剪布。

senses.meaning_en: a hand shape with the index and middle fingers open, used in rock-paper-scissors, that beats paper and loses to rock

examples.text: He threw scissors at the last second and beat my paper.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最后一刻出了剪刀，赢了我的布。

senses.meaning_en: on or relating to the outside of something

examples.text: The exterior walls of the old house are covered in ivy.
examples.translation_cn: 那栋老房子的外墙爬满了常春藤。

senses.meaning_en: the outside part or surface of something

examples.text: The exterior of the building is covered in glass panels.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑的外部覆盖着玻璃面板。

senses.meaning_en: full of change, confusion, or disorder

examples.text: People often look for strong leaders in turbulent times.
examples.translation_cn: 人们在动荡时期往往寻找强有力的领导者。

senses.meaning_en: moving violently and unevenly

examples.text: The plane encountered severe shaking as it passed through turbulent air.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机穿过湍流空气时遭遇剧烈颠簸。

senses.meaning_en: a skilled and respected political leader

examples.text: He is widely regarded as a statesman of rare integrity.
examples.translation_cn: 他被普遍视为一位极为正直的政治家。

senses.meaning_en: to fear greatly; to anticipate with fear

examples.text: She dreaded having to give the presentation at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她害怕在工作中做报告。

senses.meaning_en: great fear or apprehension about something that may happen

examples.text: He lived in dread of being found out.
examples.translation_cn: 他整天害怕被人发现。

senses.meaning_en: reverential or respectful fear; awe

examples.text: The ancient people held the forest spirits in holy dread.
examples.translation_cn: 古人对森林神灵满怀敬畏。

senses.meaning_en: immature or silly, like a child

examples.text: It is childish to sulk when you lose a game.
examples.translation_cn: 输了比赛就生气是幼稚的。

senses.meaning_en: suitable for or typical of a child

examples.text: She wrote in a childish way, with big round letters.
examples.translation_cn: 她写字很孩子气，字母又大又圆。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone laugh or smile

examples.text: The father amused the baby with funny faces.
examples.translation_cn: 父亲做鬼脸逗宝宝笑。

senses.meaning_en: to keep someone entertained or interested

examples.text: She amused herself by practicing card tricks on the train.
examples.translation_cn: 她在火车上练习纸牌魔术来消遣。

senses.meaning_en: hard but easily broken, snapped, or crumbled under stress or bending

examples.text: The plastic cover had become brittle with age and cracked when I bent it.
examples.translation_cn: 这个塑料盖因老化变脆，我一弯它就裂了。

senses.meaning_en: emotionally fragile and easily upset or offended

examples.text: She is emotionally brittle and reacts defensively to even gentle criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 她情感上很脆弱，连温和的批评也会做出防卫性反应。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that conducts electricity better than an insulator but not as well as a conductor

examples.text: Silicon is a semiconductor used in almost every electronic device.
examples.translation_cn: 硅是一种用于几乎所有电子设备的半导体。

senses.meaning_en: done deliberately; not accidental

examples.text: The delay was intentional and not the result of an accident.
examples.translation_cn: 这次延误是故意的，不是意外造成的。

senses.meaning_en: a light soft shoe worn indoors

examples.text: She put on a pair of slippers and walked to the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿上拖鞋，走到厨房。

senses.meaning_en: a competition in which people answer questions

examples.text: Our team took part in a quiz on world history.
examples.translation_cn: 我们队参加了一场世界历史知识竞赛。

senses.meaning_en: a short informal test given at school
senses.pattern: give somebody a quiz on something

examples.text: The teacher gave us a quiz on French vocabulary.
examples.translation_cn: 老师给我们做了法语词汇小测。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone a lot of questions in order to get information

examples.text: Reporters quizzed the mayor about his travel expenses.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们就市长的差旅费进行了盘问。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a short test

examples.text: The teacher quizzed us on state capitals this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 老师今天早上测验了我们关于各州首府的知识。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of mathematics dealing with numbers and basic operations

examples.text: Can you do arithmetic without using a calculator?
examples.translation_cn: 你能不用计算器做算术吗？

senses.meaning_en: relating to arithmetic or computed using addition

examples.text: Students should be able to calculate the arithmetic mean of a data set.
examples.translation_cn: 学生应该能够计算一组数据的算术平均数。

senses.meaning_en: the remains of something that has been badly damaged or destroyed

examples.text: The rescue team searched the wreckage of the building for survivors.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队在建筑物的残骸中搜寻幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: for fear that; in case

examples.text: She spoke softly lest she disturb the sleeping child.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻声说话，以免打扰熟睡的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a small electronic device used for making calculations
senses.pattern: use a calculator to do sth

examples.text: You can use a calculator to check your answers.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用计算器检查答案。

senses.meaning_en: a person who plans things in a calculating or scheming way

examples.text: He is a cold calculator who rarely shows his true feelings.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个冷静的算计者，很少流露真实情感。

senses.meaning_en: having no worth or value

examples.text: The painting is completely worthless, but it has great sentimental value.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画完全不值钱，但有很高的情感价值。

senses.meaning_en: having no practical use or effect

examples.text: These old tools are worthless for fixing modern engines.
examples.translation_cn: 这些旧工具在修理现代发动机方面毫无用处。

senses.meaning_en: having no good qualities or skills (of a person)

examples.text: He is worthless as a leader and has never earned any respect.
examples.translation_cn: 作为领导者，他一无是处，从未赢得任何尊重。

senses.meaning_en: a brass musical instrument that you play by blowing into it

examples.text: She plays the trumpet in the school band.
examples.translation_cn: 她在校乐队吹小号。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that publicly promotes or praises something

examples.text: The newspaper acted as a trumpet for the reform movement.
examples.translation_cn: 这家报纸充当了改革运动的宣传工具。

senses.meaning_en: the loud cry of an elephant

examples.text: We heard an elephant's trumpet from the forest.
examples.translation_cn: 我们听见森林里传来大象的叫声。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of sports equipment with a handle and a round frame strung with strings, used to hit a ball or shuttlecock

examples.text: He practices his serve with a tennis racket every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天早上用网球拍练习发球。

senses.meaning_en: a loud, unpleasant noise

examples.text: The children were making a racket in the playground.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在操场上大吵大闹。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal scheme for making money

examples.text: He ran a racket that sold fake concert tickets.
examples.translation_cn: 他经营一个出售假演唱会门票的诈骗活动。

senses.meaning_en: a garden tool with a row of teeth on a long handle

examples.text: He gathered the fallen leaves with a rake.
examples.translation_cn: 他用耙子把落叶聚拢起来。

senses.meaning_en: to gather, smooth, or loosen with a rake

examples.text: She raked the soil smooth before planting the seeds.
examples.translation_cn: 她在播种前把土壤耙平。

senses.meaning_en: to search carefully by moving things around

examples.text: The police raked through the debris for clues.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在废墟中仔细搜寻线索。

senses.meaning_en: a light yellowish-brown colour

examples.text: The study walls were painted in tan and cream.
examples.translation_cn: 书房墙壁被刷成了棕褐色和奶油色。

senses.meaning_en: the brown colour of someone's skin after being in the sun

examples.text: She got a deep tan after two weeks at the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 她在海滩待了两周后晒得很黑。

senses.meaning_en: to become brown from the sun

examples.text: People with fair skin often don't tan easily.
examples.translation_cn: 皮肤白皙的人往往不容易晒黑。

senses.meaning_en: to change animal hide into leather by soaking it in tannic acid

examples.text: Workers tan hides in large pits to make leather.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们在大坑里鞣制兽皮来制成皮革。

senses.meaning_en: to shine brightly with small flashes of light

examples.text: The snow sparkled in the sunlight as we walked along the trail.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿小径漫步时，雪在阳光下闪闪发光。

senses.meaning_en: a small flash of light

examples.text: The sparkle of the sea at dawn took our breath away.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时海面的闪光令人叹为观止。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being lively and clever

examples.text: His jokes added sparkle to the long car journey.
examples.translation_cn: 他的笑话给漫长的车程增添了趣味。

senses.meaning_en: a bright, shining quality

examples.text: The diamond had a brilliant sparkle under the jeweler's lamp.
examples.translation_cn: 在珠宝商的灯下，钻石闪耀着灿烂的光彩。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of a drink being fizzy

examples.text: The sparkle of the champagne made the party feel festive.
examples.translation_cn: 香槟的气泡使派对气氛活跃。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre

examples.text: The crack in the wall is a few centimetres wide.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上的裂缝有几厘米宽。

senses.meaning_en: a person with no home or job who travels from place to place, especially begging for food or money

examples.text: He lived as a tramp for a year, begging in the streets.
examples.translation_cn: 他当了一年流浪汉，在街头乞讨。

senses.meaning_en: a long walk, especially in the countryside or wilderness

examples.text: We went for a tramp across the hills early this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们一早就去山里徒步了。

senses.meaning_en: the act or sound of walking with heavy steps

examples.text: We could hear the tramp of heavy boots approaching in the dark.
examples.translation_cn: 在黑暗中我们能听见沉重靴子逼近的脚步声。

senses.meaning_en: (offensive) a woman who has many sexual partners and is considered immoral

examples.text: He lost his temper and called her a tramp in public.
examples.translation_cn: 他发脾气当众叫她荡妇。

senses.meaning_en: happening once every year

examples.text: The town's arts festival is held yearly in early May.
examples.translation_cn: 镇上的艺术节每年五月初举行。

senses.meaning_en: over the course of one year

examples.text: She has a yearly income of just under fifty thousand dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 她的年收入略低于五万美元。

senses.meaning_en: a formal gesture or utterance of respect or greeting

examples.text: He gave a quick salute to the officer before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 他离开前快速向军官敬了个礼。

senses.meaning_en: to make a formal gesture of respect toward someone or something

examples.text: The soldiers saluted the flag during the national anthem.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在国歌奏响时向国旗敬礼。

senses.meaning_en: a discharge of guns or cannons as a mark of honor

examples.text: They fired a 21-gun salute for the visiting president.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为来访的总统鸣放21响礼炮。

senses.meaning_en: to express praise, respect, or thanks

examples.text: The community saluted the firefighters for their bravery.
examples.translation_cn: 社区赞扬消防员们的勇敢。

senses.meaning_en: a large group of insects, animals, or people moving together

examples.text: A swarm of bees hovered near the hive entrance.
examples.translation_cn: 一群蜜蜂在蜂箱入口附近盘旋。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a large group

examples.text: Fans swarmed into the stadium as soon as the gates opened.
examples.translation_cn: 大门一开，球迷们蜂拥进入体育场。

senses.meaning_en: to be filled or overrun with moving people or insects

examples.text: The busy market was swarming with shoppers on Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 周六这个繁忙的市场里挤满了购物者。

senses.meaning_en: to fill (a place) with a large group of people or animals

examples.text: Thousands of fans swarmed the streets after the final whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 终场哨响后，成千上万的球迷涌上街头。

senses.meaning_en: to bend the upper body forward and down

examples.text: She stooped down to pick up the fallen keys.
examples.translation_cn: 她弯腰捡起掉落的钥匙。

senses.meaning_en: to lower one's standards or dignity

examples.text: He would never stoop to lying just to win.
examples.translation_cn: 他绝不会为了赢而屈尊撒谎。

senses.meaning_en: a porch or steps at the entrance of a building

examples.text: The kids sat on the stoop sharing stories.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们坐在门前台阶上分享故事。

senses.meaning_en: a man who engages in sports; an athlete

examples.text: As a sportsman, he follows a strict training programme.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名运动员，他遵循严格的训练计划。

senses.meaning_en: a man who shows good sportsmanship

examples.text: He was a good sportsman and accepted the referee's decision calmly.
examples.translation_cn: 他很有体育精神，平静地接受了裁判的判罚。

senses.meaning_en: an amount that fills the mouth

examples.text: He took a mouthful of water before answering the phone.
examples.translation_cn: 他在接电话前喝了一口水。

senses.meaning_en: a word or phrase that is hard to pronounce

examples.text: The full scientific name is quite a mouthful, so we use the abbreviation.
examples.translation_cn: 完整的学名很拗口，所以我们用缩写。

senses.meaning_en: a burst of angry speech

examples.text: He gave the referee a mouthful after the controversial call.
examples.translation_cn: 在那个有争议的判罚后，他把裁判臭骂了一顿。

senses.meaning_en: in any case; used to change topic or add a point

examples.text: I wasn't sure about the plan, but anyhow I agreed.
examples.translation_cn: 我对这个计划没把握，但无论如何我还是同意了。

senses.meaning_en: in any way or manner whatever

examples.text: You can arrange the chairs anyhow you like.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以随便摆放椅子。

senses.meaning_en: carelessly, untidily

examples.text: He threw his clothes anyhow into the suitcase.
examples.translation_cn: 他把衣服胡乱地扔进行李箱。

senses.meaning_en: a device that provides heat for a building

examples.text: We installed a new gas furnace in the basement last week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周在地下室安装了一台新的燃气暖气炉。

senses.meaning_en: an area that is extremely hot

examples.text: The room felt like a furnace after the air conditioning broke.
examples.translation_cn: 空调坏了后，这个房间热得像火炉。

senses.meaning_en: a place or time of severe trial or affliction

examples.text: He was shaped in the furnace of war.
examples.translation_cn: 他是在战争的熔炉中磨炼出来的。

senses.meaning_en: an industrial heating device, such as for smelting metal or firing ceramics

examples.text: They operate a giant blast furnace to produce steel.
examples.translation_cn: 他们运行一座巨大的高炉来炼钢。

senses.meaning_en: an introduction to a book or document, normally written by its author

examples.text: In the preface to his first novel, he explains why he wrote the story.
examples.translation_cn: 在他第一部小说的序言里，他解释了写作这个故事的缘由。

senses.meaning_en: to introduce a book, speech, etc. with something

examples.text: The author prefaced the second edition with a note on new evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 作者在第二版序言中对新证据作了说明。

senses.meaning_en: to make stiff

examples.text: You can stiffen the cloth with a little starch.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用少量淀粉把布浆硬。

senses.meaning_en: to become stiff

examples.text: She stiffened with fear when she heard footsteps behind her.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到身后的脚步声，吓得僵住了。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone more determined or something stronger

examples.text: The threats only stiffened their resolve to fight.
examples.translation_cn: 那些威胁只是坚定了他们抗争的决心。

senses.meaning_en: a small shallow dish that a cup stands on

examples.text: She set the cup down on a saucer with great care.
examples.translation_cn: 她小心翼翼地把杯子放在茶碟上。

senses.meaning_en: an object that is round and gently curved, like a saucer

examples.text: The object they saw was shaped like a saucer and glowed softly.
examples.translation_cn: 他们看到的那个物体形似碟子，发出柔和的光。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to cut men's hair and sometimes shave beards

examples.text: My grandfather worked as a barber for over forty years.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父当理发师四十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: artfully cunning; wily

examples.text: He is as sly as a fox in business.
examples.translation_cn: 他在生意场上像狐狸一样狡猾。

senses.meaning_en: secretive; surreptitious

examples.text: They met on the sly after work yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 他们昨天下班后偷偷见面了。

senses.meaning_en: knowing; suggesting a shared secret

examples.text: She gave me a sly smile, as if she knew the secret.
examples.translation_cn: 她对我会心一笑，仿佛知道这个秘密。

senses.meaning_en: the set of letters used in writing a language

examples.text: The letter Z is the last one in the English alphabet.
examples.translation_cn: 字母 Z 是英语字母表中的最后一个。

senses.meaning_en: single; individual

examples.text: The committee considered each singular case on its own merits.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会根据每一起个案的具体情况加以考虑。

senses.meaning_en: unique

examples.text: Each individual’s genetic code is singular and cannot be copied.
examples.translation_cn: 每个人的遗传密码都是独一无二的，无法复制。

senses.meaning_en: remarkable; exceptional

examples.text: She faced the crisis with singular courage and calm.
examples.translation_cn: 她以非凡的勇气和镇定面对这场危机。

senses.meaning_en: strange; unusual

examples.text: It is singular that he never mentioned his accident.
examples.translation_cn: 奇怪的是，他从未提过自己那场事故。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been captured or confined

examples.text: She was held as a captive for three months.
examples.translation_cn: 她被扣作俘虏三个月。

senses.meaning_en: held prisoner; not free; confined

examples.text: Three soldiers were held captive for over a year.
examples.translation_cn: 三名士兵被俘超过一年。

senses.meaning_en: not free to leave or choose; having no alternative

examples.text: The passengers were a captive audience for his travel stories.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客们被迫听他讲旅行故事。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a seed that can develop into a new plant

examples.text: The germ of a seed contains cells that can grow into a new plant.
examples.translation_cn: 种子的胚芽含有能长成新植物的细胞。

senses.meaning_en: a microorganism that can cause disease

examples.text: Washing your hands helps protect against germs that cause disease.
examples.translation_cn: 洗手有助于抵御致病菌。

senses.meaning_en: the origin or earliest form of an idea or project

examples.text: His early notes contain the germ of an idea for a novel.
examples.translation_cn: 他早期的笔记包含了一部小说的构想萌芽。

senses.meaning_en: willing to take risks or show courage
senses.pattern: it is daring of sb to do

examples.text: It was daring of her to dive off the high cliff.
examples.translation_cn: 她从高崖跳水真是大胆。

senses.meaning_en: boldness or courage

examples.text: He had the daring to challenge the old rules.
examples.translation_cn: 他有勇气挑战旧规则。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp, loud cry

examples.text: She let out a shriek when the lights suddenly went out.
examples.translation_cn: 灯突然熄灭时，她发出一声尖叫。

senses.meaning_en: to make a sharp, loud cry

examples.text: The children shrieked with laughter as the clown fell over.
examples.translation_cn: 小丑摔倒时，孩子们尖叫着大笑。

senses.meaning_en: to say something in a sharp, loud cry

examples.text: She shrieked his name across the crowded hall.
examples.translation_cn: 她隔着拥挤的大厅尖声喊他的名字。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of light and vision

examples.text: She decided to study optics at university because she was fascinated by the behaviour of light.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定在大学学习光学，因为她对光的传播特性着迷。

senses.meaning_en: the public perception or image of a situation

examples.text: The optics of the decision look bad for the company.
examples.translation_cn: 这一决定对该公司来说观感不佳。

senses.meaning_en: the light-related parts of a device, such as lenses

examples.text: This telescope comes with excellent optics for deep-sky viewing.
examples.translation_cn: 这台望远镜配有出色的光学部件，适合观测深空。

senses.meaning_en: a word used instead of a noun or noun phrase
senses.pattern: use a pronoun to refer to

examples.text: We often use a pronoun to refer to a noun or noun phrase already mentioned.
examples.translation_cn: 我们常用代词指代已经提到的名词或名词短语。

senses.meaning_en: no longer existing, especially a species

examples.text: The dodo became extinct in the 17th century.
examples.translation_cn: 渡渡鸟在17世纪灭绝了。

senses.meaning_en: no longer active, especially a volcano

examples.text: This volcano has been extinct for several centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 这座火山已经熄灭数百年了。

senses.meaning_en: no longer used or spoken, as a language or custom

examples.text: Many local dialects have gone extinct over the last century.
examples.translation_cn: 许多地方方言在过去一个世纪里已经消亡。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is severely impaired or deficient in some non-physical way

examples.text: He is an emotional cripple and finds it hard to trust people.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个情感废人，觉得很难信任别人。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone a cripple; to cause someone to become physically impaired

examples.text: She was crippled by arthritis in her twenties.
examples.translation_cn: 她二十多岁时因关节炎致残。

senses.meaning_en: to cause severe and disabling damage; to make unable to function normally

examples.text: The sudden crisis crippled the economy for months.
examples.translation_cn: 突如其来的危机使经济瘫痪了数月。

senses.meaning_en: protected from direct sunlight; giving shade

examples.text: We sat under a shady tree and enjoyed the breeze.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在阴凉的树下，享受着微风。

senses.meaning_en: seeming dishonest or illegal; not trustworthy

examples.text: He was warned to stay away from that shady character.
examples.translation_cn: 他被告知远离那个可疑的人。

senses.meaning_en: a brush with a long handle, used for sweeping floors

examples.text: She swept the kitchen floor with a broom after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后她用扫帚清扫了厨房地板。

senses.meaning_en: to sweep with a broom

examples.text: He broomed the floor before the guests arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 客人们到达之前，他清扫了地板。

senses.meaning_en: most extreme; greatest

examples.text: Please handle the antique vase with the utmost care.
examples.translation_cn: 请极其小心地处理这个古董花瓶。

senses.meaning_en: the greatest possible capability or extent

examples.text: She did her utmost to meet the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 她尽了最大努力赶上截止日期。

senses.meaning_en: paying close attention

examples.text: A good editor is attentive to every detail in the manuscript.
examples.translation_cn: 一位好编辑会注意手稿中的每一处细节。

senses.meaning_en: courteous and mindful of others' needs

examples.text: The nurse was attentive to the elderly patient throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 护士整夜体贴照顾那位老年病人。

senses.meaning_en: full of humor; witty; funny

examples.text: He told a humorous anecdote that had everyone at the party laughing.
examples.translation_cn: 他讲了一个幽默的趣闻，让聚会上的每个人都笑了起来。

senses.meaning_en: speed; swiftness; dispatch
senses.pattern: in one's haste to do sth

examples.text: In his haste to catch the bus, he left his phone behind.
examples.translation_cn: 他急着赶公交车，把手机落下了。

senses.meaning_en: family name

examples.text: My surname is Garcia, but my friends call me Ana.
examples.translation_cn: 我姓加西亚，但朋友们叫我安娜。

senses.meaning_en: with strong winds and heavy rain

examples.text: The match was cancelled because of stormy weather.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛因暴风雨天气而取消。

senses.meaning_en: full of anger, arguments, or strong emotion

examples.text: They had a stormy relationship that finally ended after years of bitter quarrels.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的关系激烈争吵，最终在多年痛苦争吵后结束。

senses.meaning_en: excessive pride in oneself or one's achievements

examples.text: She refused to wear glasses out of vanity.
examples.translation_cn: 她出于虚荣心拒绝戴眼镜。

senses.meaning_en: to press or squeeze something into a smaller space

examples.text: This device compresses air into a small tank.
examples.translation_cn: 这个装置把空气压缩进一个小罐里。

senses.meaning_en: to make digital information smaller by encoding

examples.text: You can compress the folder to save disk space.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以压缩文件夹以节省磁盘空间。

senses.meaning_en: to make something shorter or more concise
senses.pattern: compress sth into a few words

examples.text: He compressed his speech into only two sentences.
examples.translation_cn: 他把演讲压缩成仅仅两句话。

senses.meaning_en: a cloth or pad pressed onto the body to stop bleeding or reduce pain
senses.pattern: apply a cold compress to sth

examples.text: Apply a cold compress to the swollen ankle to reduce the pain.
examples.translation_cn: 在肿胀的脚踝上冷敷以减轻疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: causing death; fatal

examples.text: The soldier suffered a mortal wound in the chest.
examples.translation_cn: 那名士兵胸部受了致命伤。

senses.meaning_en: subject to death; not immortal

examples.text: We are all mortal beings and must face death eventually.
examples.translation_cn: 我们都是凡人，终究要面对死亡。

senses.meaning_en: a human being, especially as contrasted with a god

examples.text: The gods looked upon mere mortals with pity.
examples.translation_cn: 诸神怜悯地俯视着凡人。

senses.meaning_en: extreme or intense; involving a struggle to the death

examples.text: They lived in mortal fear of another attack.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整日提心吊胆，害怕再次遭到袭击。

senses.meaning_en: to an extreme degree; extremely

examples.text: Such genetic mutations are exceedingly rare in the general population.
examples.translation_cn: 这种基因突变在普通人群中极其罕见。

senses.meaning_en: causing illness or death if swallowed or touched

examples.text: The leaves of this plant are poisonous to humans.
examples.translation_cn: 这种植物的叶子对人类有毒。

senses.meaning_en: producing a toxin that is injected by biting or stinging
senses.pattern: be bitten by a poisonous snake

examples.text: He was bitten by a poisonous snake on the leg.
examples.translation_cn: 他被一条毒蛇咬到了腿。

senses.meaning_en: negative or harmful

examples.text: Their constant arguments had a poisonous effect on the team.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的不断争吵对团队产生了恶劣影响。

senses.meaning_en: a person who robs

examples.text: The police arrested the armed robber outside the bank.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在银行外逮捕了那名持枪劫匪。

senses.meaning_en: to decay by natural biological action

examples.text: The fallen leaves began to rot in the damp soil.
examples.translation_cn: 落叶在潮湿的土壤里开始腐烂。

senses.meaning_en: to decline in quality or effectiveness

examples.text: The large organization began to rot from within.
examples.translation_cn: 那个庞大的组织开始从内部腐朽。

senses.meaning_en: the process of decaying or decomposing

examples.text: Once the rot set in, the building became unsafe.
examples.translation_cn: 腐烂一旦开始，这栋建筑就变得不安全。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to deteriorate or become morally bad

examples.text: Watching TV all day will rot your brain.
examples.translation_cn: 整天看电视会让你脑子生锈。

senses.meaning_en: to stay in an unpleasant place or state for a long time

examples.text: He was left to rot in prison for a crime he didn't commit.
examples.translation_cn: 他因一桩并未犯下的罪行而被留在狱中受罪。

senses.meaning_en: expecting that bad things will happen; not hopeful

examples.text: Many economists are pessimistic about the chances of a quick recovery.
examples.translation_cn: 许多经济学家对迅速复苏的可能性感到悲观。

senses.meaning_en: existing in large quantities; abundant

examples.text: Wild berries are plentiful in these woods in late summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏末这些树林里野莓很多。

senses.meaning_en: severe and strict in manner or appearance

examples.text: The teacher was stern with the students who had cheated in the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 老师对考试作弊的学生很严厉。

senses.meaning_en: the back end of a ship or boat

examples.text: The captain stood at the stern as the ship left the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 船驶离港口时，船长站在船尾。

senses.meaning_en: to remove the fleece from a sheep, llama, etc. by clipping

examples.text: The farmer sheared the thick wool from the sheep before summer.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫在夏天来临前剪下了羊身上厚厚的羊毛。

senses.meaning_en: to cut the hair of a person

examples.text: She had her long hair shorn before the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 她在手术前剪去了长发。

senses.meaning_en: a large cutting tool like scissors

examples.text: Use a pair of shears to trim the hedge.
examples.translation_cn: 用一把大剪刀修剪树篱。

senses.meaning_en: to cut, originally with a sword or other bladed weapon, now usually with shears, or as if using shears

examples.text: The gardener sheared off the dead branches from the rose bush.
examples.translation_cn: 园丁把枯枝从玫瑰丛上剪掉。

senses.meaning_en: to break or suddenly separate because of excessive force

examples.text: The bolt sheared off when we applied too much force.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用力过猛时，螺栓突然折断了。

senses.meaning_en: to make a sound or signal louder or stronger

examples.text: The sound engineer amplified the singer's voice to fill the stadium.
examples.translation_cn: 音响工程师放大了歌手的歌声，使歌声传遍体育场。

senses.meaning_en: to add details to a statement, story, etc.

examples.text: The speaker amplified his point with several detailed examples.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲者用几个详细的例子补充说明了他的观点。

senses.meaning_en: to make something greater or more intense

examples.text: Social media can amplify people's fears during a crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 社交媒体会放大人们在危机期间的恐惧。

senses.meaning_en: with a lot of snow; characterized by snow

examples.text: It is snowy outside, so allow extra time for the drive.
examples.translation_cn: 外面下着雪，所以要留出额外时间赶路。

senses.meaning_en: covered with snow

examples.text: The snowy peaks were visible from the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 从山谷里可以看到积雪覆盖的山峰。

senses.meaning_en: white like snow

examples.text: Her hair had turned snowy white by the time she was fifty.
examples.translation_cn: 她五十岁时头发已经雪白了。

senses.meaning_en: causing trouble or anxiety

examples.text: The new rules have been troublesome for small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 新规定给小企业带来了麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to deal with; causing trouble by being disruptive

examples.text: The troublesome child kept interrupting the teacher during the lesson.
examples.translation_cn: 那个捣乱的孩子上课时不停地打断老师。

senses.meaning_en: covered with rust

examples.text: The old bicycle got rusty after sitting outside all winter.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆旧自行车在外面放了一冬后生锈了。

senses.meaning_en: of the rust color; reddish or reddish-brown

examples.text: The leaves turn rusty brown each autumn before falling.
examples.translation_cn: 每年秋天，叶子在落下之前变成锈棕色。

senses.meaning_en: lacking recent practice; out of practice

examples.text: I'm a bit rusty at playing the piano.
examples.translation_cn: 我弹钢琴有点生疏了。

senses.meaning_en: deficient in physical strength

examples.text: After weeks in hospital, she was too feeble to walk unaided.
examples.translation_cn: 住院几周后，她虚弱得无法独立行走。

senses.meaning_en: very weak, not strong or clear (light, sound, signal)

examples.text: A feeble light shone through the window at the end of the hall.
examples.translation_cn: 微弱的灯光从大厅尽头的窗户照进来。

senses.meaning_en: not effective or convincing

examples.text: He gave a feeble excuse for being late.
examples.translation_cn: 他为迟到找了个站不住脚的借口。

senses.meaning_en: an instrument used for measuring temperature

examples.text: The nurse read the digital thermometer and recorded my temperature.
examples.translation_cn: 护士读取数字温度计并记录了我的体温。

senses.meaning_en: able to use a language accurately and confidently

examples.text: She is fluent in Spanish and often translates for tourists.
examples.translation_cn: 她西班牙语流利，经常为游客翻译。

senses.meaning_en: being or relating to a fluent interface

examples.text: The library provides a fluent interface for building search queries.
examples.translation_cn: 该库提供了一个用于构建搜索查询的流畅接口。

senses.meaning_en: producing good results; productive

examples.text: The meeting was fruitful and led to a new agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 会议富有成效并促成了新协议。

senses.meaning_en: producing much fruit or crops; fertile

examples.text: The region's fruitful soil produces abundant crops every year.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区肥沃的土壤每年产出大量农作物。

senses.meaning_en: not fair or right

examples.text: It is unjust to blame her for a mistake she didn't make.
examples.translation_cn: 因为一个她没犯的错而责怪她是不公平的。

senses.meaning_en: sly; crafty; clever in deceiving others

examples.text: She is a cunning liar who knows how to hide the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个狡猾的骗子，知道如何隐瞒真相。

senses.meaning_en: cleverly made or designed

examples.text: The toy uses a cunning mechanism to transform into a car.
examples.translation_cn: 这个玩具使用巧妙的机械装置变成一辆汽车。

senses.meaning_en: too proud of your own appearance, abilities, or achievements

examples.text: She is a little vain about her appearance.
examples.translation_cn: 她对自己的外貌有点自负。

senses.meaning_en: that does not produce the result you want; useless

examples.text: They made a vain attempt to save the old tree.
examples.translation_cn: 他们试图拯救那棵老树，但徒劳无功。

senses.meaning_en: without success; uselessly

examples.text: We waited in vain for an answer to our letter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们徒劳地等待着回信。

senses.meaning_en: to feel very sad, especially because someone has died

examples.text: She is still grieving for her husband after two years.
examples.translation_cn: 两年过去了，她仍在为丈夫悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to feel very sad

examples.text: It grieved her deeply to leave the family home.
examples.translation_cn: 离开家人的房子让她深感悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of money you pay to send a letter or parcel by post

examples.text: Customers must pay postage on any items they return.
examples.translation_cn: 顾客退换任何商品都必须支付邮费。

senses.meaning_en: a postage stamp
senses.pattern: put a postage stamp on sth

examples.text: She put a postage stamp on each card before mailing them.
examples.translation_cn: 她在邮寄前给每张卡片贴了一张邮票。

senses.meaning_en: happening or produced once every three months

examples.text: The committee holds a quarterly meeting to review progress.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会每季度召开一次会议审查进展。

senses.meaning_en: once every three months

examples.text: Interest is paid quarterly on this savings account.
examples.translation_cn: 这个储蓄账户的利息每季度支付一次。

senses.meaning_en: a periodical published four times a year

examples.text: The library subscribes to a quarterly on Asian art.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆订阅了一份关于亚洲艺术的季刊。

senses.meaning_en: so unpleasant or painful that you cannot bear it

examples.text: She found the constant noise unbearable during the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 考试期间，她觉得持续不断的噪音令人难以忍受。

senses.meaning_en: a circular arrangement of flowers, leaves, etc. used as decoration or worn on the head

examples.text: They hung a wreath on the front door at Christmas.
examples.translation_cn: 圣诞节时他们在大门上挂了一个花环。

senses.meaning_en: a circular arrangement of flowers or leaves placed on a grave or memorial as a mark of respect

examples.text: They laid a wreath at the town's war memorial.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在镇上的战争纪念碑前敬献了花圈。

senses.meaning_en: something that curls or forms a ring, such as smoke or mist

examples.text: Smoke from the chimney curled upward in wreaths.
examples.translation_cn: 烟囱里冒出的烟袅袅地卷成圈状。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives by asking for money or food

examples.text: A beggar on the street asked me for change.
examples.translation_cn: 街上的一个乞丐向我要零钱。

senses.meaning_en: a person suffering from extreme poverty
senses.pattern: be as poor as a beggar

examples.text: They were as poor as a beggar before the harvest.
examples.translation_cn: 收成前他们穷得像乞丐一样。

senses.meaning_en: a mean or wretched person; a scoundrel

examples.text: A cheeky beggar took my seat while I was away.
examples.translation_cn: 一个无礼的家伙趁我不在占了我的座位。

senses.meaning_en: to exhaust the resources of; to outdo or go beyond

examples.text: The sheer beauty of the sunset beggars description.
examples.translation_cn: 日落之美简直难以形容。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre

examples.text: The engineers measured the small gap in millimetres.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师们以毫米为单位测量这个小间隙。

senses.meaning_en: to dress somebody or provide them with clothes

examples.text: They clothed the children in warm winter coats.
examples.translation_cn: 他们给孩子们穿上了温暖的冬衣。

senses.meaning_en: to cover something as if with a garment

examples.text: The old castle was clothed in thick ivy.
examples.translation_cn: 那座古堡被茂密的常春藤覆盖着。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp pointed part on a plant, such as a modified branch or prickle

examples.text: He got a thorn in his thumb while picking roses.
examples.translation_cn: 他摘玫瑰时拇指扎了根刺。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that causes trouble or annoyance
senses.pattern: be a thorn in someone's side
senses.collocation: a constant thorn in the side

examples.text: His constant complaints are a thorn in my side.
examples.translation_cn: 他不断的抱怨让我很心烦。

senses.meaning_en: a shrub or small tree with thorns, especially a hawthorn

examples.text: They planted a hedge of thorns around the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在花园四周种了刺篱。

senses.meaning_en: a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh and a hard rind

examples.text: We had a slice of melon after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午饭后我们吃了一片瓜。

senses.meaning_en: a magnetic tape or cassette used for recording moving pictures and sound

examples.text: The police found a videotape of the robbery in his bag.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在他包里发现了一盘抢劫案的录像带。

senses.meaning_en: to make a video recording of something, with or without sound, especially on videotape

examples.text: The teacher asked us to videotape our presentations for review.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们把演示录下来供复习。

senses.meaning_en: no longer fresh, especially food

examples.text: The bread went stale after only two days.
examples.translation_cn: 面包两天后就变味了。

senses.meaning_en: lacking freshness, interest, or originality

examples.text: His ideas sound stale to a young audience.
examples.translation_cn: 他的想法对年轻听众来说显得陈腐。

senses.meaning_en: not fresh; stuffy (of air)

examples.text: The air in the cellar smelled stale and damp.
examples.translation_cn: 地窖里的空气闻起来污浊而潮湿。

senses.meaning_en: out of date; not synchronized (of data)

examples.text: The app showed stale data until I refreshed the page.
examples.translation_cn: 在我刷新页面之前，这个应用显示的是过时的数据。

senses.meaning_en: resistant to water

examples.text: This jacket is waterproof, so you can wear it in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 这件夹克是防水的，所以你可以穿着它淋雨。

senses.meaning_en: a waterproof garment

examples.text: She always wears a lightweight waterproof when cycling in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 她雨天骑车时总是穿一件轻便雨衣。

senses.meaning_en: to make waterproof

examples.text: You should waterproof your boots before the hiking trip.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步旅行前你应该给靴子做防水处理。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who receives or entertains guests at a party or event

examples.text: She acted as hostess at the charity dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 她在慈善晚宴上担任女主人。

senses.meaning_en: a woman employed to welcome customers and show them to their tables in a restaurant

examples.text: She works as a hostess at a busy downtown restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家繁忙的市中心餐厅做女领位员。

senses.meaning_en: a woman steward on an airplane

examples.text: She worked as an airline hostess for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 她做过五年空中乘务员。

senses.meaning_en: able to stretch and return to its original shape or size

examples.text: The rubber band is highly elastic and returns to its original size.
examples.translation_cn: 这根橡皮筋弹性很好，拉伸后能恢复原状。

senses.meaning_en: flexible and able to change or adapt

examples.text: The school rules are elastic enough to allow some freedom.
examples.translation_cn: 学校的规定有弹性，允许一些自由。

senses.meaning_en: made of elastic or elasticated

examples.text: These trousers have an elastic waist for extra comfort.
examples.translation_cn: 这条裤子有弹性腰头，穿着更舒适。

senses.meaning_en: a strip of elastic material used in clothing

examples.text: She sewed a piece of elastic into the waistband.
examples.translation_cn: 她在腰头缝了一段松紧带。

senses.meaning_en: a person who betrays a country, trust, friend, or cause

examples.text: He was publicly branded as a traitor to the cause.
examples.translation_cn: 他被公开称为事业的叛徒。

senses.meaning_en: a message sent by telegraph

examples.text: She received a telegram from her brother in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她收到了她哥哥从伦敦发来的电报。

senses.meaning_en: unable to walk properly because of an injured leg or foot

examples.text: The horse was lame in its left leg after the race.
examples.translation_cn: 那匹马赛后左腿瘸了。

senses.meaning_en: weak and difficult to believe

examples.text: He gave a lame excuse for being late.
examples.translation_cn: 他为迟到找了个站不住脚的借口。

senses.meaning_en: not interesting or fun; of poor quality

examples.text: The party was so lame that we left early.
examples.translation_cn: 派对太无聊了，我们早早就离开了。

senses.meaning_en: at or to a greater distance

examples.text: We walked farther than we had planned and got lost.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走得比原计划更远，迷路了。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid used for washing hair

examples.text: This shampoo for oily hair makes my scalp feel clean.
examples.translation_cn: 这款油性发质洗发水让我的头皮感觉清爽。

senses.meaning_en: to wash your own hair with shampoo

examples.text: I shampoo every other day to keep my scalp clean.
examples.translation_cn: 我每隔一天洗一次头，保持头皮干净。

senses.meaning_en: an act of washing hair with shampoo

examples.text: The hairdresser gave her a quick shampoo before cutting her hair.
examples.translation_cn: 理发师在剪发前给她快速洗了头。

senses.meaning_en: to wash something such as hair or a carpet with shampoo

examples.text: He shampooed the carpet last weekend after the spill.
examples.translation_cn: 上周打翻东西后，他把地毯洗了。

senses.meaning_en: to wake someone from sleep or from apathy

examples.text: A sudden loud crash roused him from sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 一声突如其来的巨响把他从睡梦中惊醒。

senses.meaning_en: to become awake or active after sleep or apathy

examples.text: She roused from sleep only when the phone rang several times.
examples.translation_cn: 电话响了好几次她才醒来。

senses.meaning_en: to cause or stir up a feeling, thought, etc.

examples.text: The new evidence may rouse interest in the cold case.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据可能会重新引起人们对这起悬案的关注。

senses.meaning_en: to provoke someone to action or anger

examples.text: The minister's speech roused the crowd to action.
examples.translation_cn: 部长的演讲促使人群行动起来。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of money equal to one hundredth of the main currency unit; also a coin of this value

examples.text: The price is displayed in cents, not in whole dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 价格以分显示，而不是以整美元显示。

senses.meaning_en: a small sum of money

examples.text: After paying the bills, I didn't have a cent left.
examples.translation_cn: 付完账单后，我身无分文。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the metric system of measurement

examples.text: This recipe gives all quantities in metric units.
examples.translation_cn: 该食谱的所有用量均以公制单位给出。

senses.meaning_en: a standard for measuring or evaluating something

examples.text: Customer retention rate is a key metric for long-term growth.
examples.translation_cn: 客户留存率是衡量长期增长的关键指标。

senses.meaning_en: great enthusiasm or devotion

examples.text: The young volunteers worked with zeal to rebuild the damaged village.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻的志愿者们满怀热情地重建受毁的村庄。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who rents out a room, apartment, or house to tenants

examples.text: We rent a flat from the landlady who lives downstairs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们向住在楼下的女房东租了一套公寓。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who owns or manages a pub or small hotel
senses.pattern: be the landlady of a pub/hotel

examples.text: She is the landlady of a small hotel near the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 她是海边一家小旅馆的女老板。

senses.meaning_en: to take a number or amount away from another number or amount

examples.text: If you subtract 8 from 15, you get 7.
examples.translation_cn: 从15中减去8，得到7。

senses.meaning_en: to speak angrily to somebody, especially a child, because they have done something wrong

examples.text: She scolded her son for breaking the window.
examples.translation_cn: 她因儿子打破窗户而训斥他。

senses.meaning_en: to make loud harsh calls, especially in aggression or alarm

examples.text: A blackbird scolded at me as I walked past.
examples.translation_cn: 我走过时，一只乌鸫冲我尖声鸣叫。

senses.meaning_en: a small stream

examples.text: We sat by a babbling brook and ate our lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在一条潺潺的小溪边吃午餐。

senses.meaning_en: to tolerate or allow

examples.text: She will brook no interference in her private affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 她绝不容忍别人干涉她的私事。

senses.meaning_en: a reddish-brown coating formed on metal by oxidation

examples.text: There was a thick layer of rust on the old gate.
examples.translation_cn: 旧大门上有一层厚厚的锈。

senses.meaning_en: a fungal disease of plants that causes reddish-brown spots

examples.text: The wheat crop was infected with rust and the yield fell sharply.
examples.translation_cn: 小麦作物感染了锈病，产量急剧下降。

senses.meaning_en: to become corroded by oxidation

examples.text: The old car had rusted through near the wheel arches.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆旧车在轮拱附近已经锈穿了。

senses.meaning_en: a reddish-brown color

examples.text: She painted the wall a shade of rust to warm up the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她把墙刷成红褐色调，让房间更温暖。

senses.meaning_en: the crime of betraying one's country

examples.text: The general was charged with treason for handing over military secrets.
examples.translation_cn: 那位将军因泄露军事机密而被控叛国罪。

senses.meaning_en: betrayal of trust or confidence

examples.text: Going behind her back felt like treason to their friendship.
examples.translation_cn: 背着她行事感觉像是对他们友谊的背叛。

senses.meaning_en: a phrase whose meaning cannot be understood from the literal meanings of its individual words

examples.text: The saying 'spill the beans' is an idiom meaning to reveal a secret.
examples.translation_cn: 俗语 spill the beans 是表示泄露秘密的习语。

senses.meaning_en: a style of expression in writing, music, or art that is typical of a particular person, group, or period

examples.text: The composer wrote in the idiom of folk music.
examples.translation_cn: 这位作曲家以民间音乐的风格创作。

senses.meaning_en: a form of a language used by a particular group of people

examples.text: She greeted the elderly villagers in the local idiom.
examples.translation_cn: 她用当地方言问候了年长的村民。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow cut or opening

examples.text: He cut a slit in the fabric with sharp scissors.
examples.translation_cn: 他用锋利的剪刀在布料上剪出一道口子。

senses.meaning_en: to cut a narrow opening in something

examples.text: She slit the package open with a small knife.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一把小刀把包裹划开。

senses.meaning_en: to cut into strips

examples.text: Slit the leaves lengthwise into thin strips for the salad.
examples.translation_cn: 把叶子纵向切成细条，用于沙拉。

senses.meaning_en: a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements
senses.pattern: an alloy of X and Y

examples.text: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
examples.translation_cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

senses.meaning_en: to mix metals to form an alloy

examples.text: Manufacturers alloy nickel with steel to improve strength.
examples.translation_cn: 制造商把镍与钢熔合以提高强度。

senses.meaning_en: something that reduces purity or value; a flaw

examples.text: Her joy at the news was without alloy.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到消息时的喜悦毫无杂质。

senses.meaning_en: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply, usually because you are tired or bored

examples.text: She yawned and stretched after the long, dull lecture.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长而乏味的讲座结束后，她打着哈欠伸了个懒腰。

senses.meaning_en: an act of yawning

examples.text: He let out a yawn during the tedious meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 在冗长的会议期间，他打了一个哈欠。

senses.meaning_en: to say something while yawning

examples.text: "I'm so tired," she yawned as she stood up.
examples.translation_cn: “我太累了，”她打着哈欠说，然后站了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to present a wide opening; gape

examples.text: A deep crack yawned open in the wall after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 地震后墙上裂开了一道深深的口子。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy coat worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather

examples.text: She waited in an overcoat outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着大衣在车站外等候。

senses.meaning_en: to consume or exhaust (time, money, energy, etc.)

examples.text: She expended considerable time and energy on organizing the event.
examples.translation_cn: 她在组织这场活动上花费了大量时间和精力。

senses.meaning_en: containing perceptible moisture, especially in the air; damp

examples.text: Summers in Miami are often hot and humid.
examples.translation_cn: 迈阿密的夏天往往炎热潮湿。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of making a machine or device operate automatically, usually by computer or electronic controls

examples.text: The automation of the assembly line has reduced manual errors.
examples.translation_cn: 装配线的自动化减少了人为失误。

senses.meaning_en: a small electronic device used to amplify or switch signals
senses.pattern: use a transistor to do sth

examples.text: Engineers use a transistor to amplify the weak signal from the microphone.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师们用晶体管放大来自麦克风的微弱信号。

senses.meaning_en: a bright, sparkling light; shininess

examples.text: The glitter of the diamond caught her eye.
examples.translation_cn: 钻石的闪光吸引了她的目光。

senses.meaning_en: a shiny, decorative adornment

examples.text: She sprinkled some gold glitter on the birthday card.
examples.translation_cn: 她在生日贺卡上撒了一些金色亮片。

senses.meaning_en: to sparkle with light

examples.text: The snow glittered in the pale morning light.
examples.translation_cn: 雪在淡淡的晨光中闪闪发光。

senses.meaning_en: to be showy, specious, or striking and hence attractive

examples.text: Her brilliant performance glittered with old Hollywood glamour.
examples.translation_cn: 她精彩的表演闪耀着老好莱坞的魅力。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of dryness in the mouth caused by the need to drink

examples.text: We stopped at a small café to quench our thirst with cold lemonade.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一家小咖啡馆停下来喝冰柠檬水解渴。

senses.meaning_en: a strong desire for something

examples.text: His thirst for adventure led him to travel to over thirty countries.
examples.translation_cn: 他对冒险的渴望使他游历了三十多个国家。

senses.meaning_en: to feel a strong desire for something

examples.text: After the scandal, the public thirsted for more transparency from the government.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻过后，公众渴望政府更加透明。

senses.meaning_en: not afraid of people and willing to obey

examples.text: The deer in the park are quite tame and will eat out of your hand.
examples.translation_cn: 公园里的鹿很温顺，会从你手上吃东西。

senses.meaning_en: not exciting or interesting

examples.text: The film was a bit tame compared with the book.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影与原著相比有点平淡。

senses.meaning_en: to make a wild animal used to living with or being controlled by humans

examples.text: It took years to tame the wild stallion.
examples.translation_cn: 驯服那匹野马花了好几年时间。

senses.meaning_en: to control something powerful or dangerous

examples.text: The government is trying to tame inflation without hurting growth.
examples.translation_cn: 政府正试图在不损害经济增长的情况下抑制通货膨胀。

senses.meaning_en: a single sheet of glass in a window or door

examples.text: A stone cracked a pane of glass in the front door.
examples.translation_cn: 一块石头打裂了前门的一块窗玻璃。

senses.meaning_en: to fit a window or door with panes of glass

examples.text: The builder will pane a window with safety glass before noon.
examples.translation_cn: 这位建筑工人将在中午前给一扇窗户装上安全玻璃。

senses.meaning_en: unable to speak

examples.text: She was mute from birth and communicates using sign language.
examples.translation_cn: 她天生不会说话，使用手语交流。

senses.meaning_en: silent; not making a sound

examples.text: He remained mute with fear as the intruder approached.
examples.translation_cn: 当入侵者靠近时，他吓得不敢出声。

senses.meaning_en: a person who cannot speak

examples.text: He was born a mute and learned to read lips.
examples.translation_cn: 他生来无法说话，学会了读唇语。

senses.meaning_en: an electronic switch or control that mutes sound

examples.text: He kept his microphone on mute throughout the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在整个会议期间都让麦克风保持静音。

senses.meaning_en: a room containing a number of beds, often for students or backpackers

examples.text: The backpackers slept in a dormitory with eight bunk beds.
examples.translation_cn: 背包客们睡在一间有八张双层床的寝室里。

senses.meaning_en: a building or part of a building where students, soldiers, monks etc. live
senses.pattern: be housed in a dormitory building

examples.text: The students are housed in a modern dormitory building near the campus.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们住在校园附近一栋现代化的宿舍楼里。

senses.meaning_en: late, especially past a deadline or later than expected

examples.text: Your library book is overdue by two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 你从图书馆借的书已过期两周。

senses.meaning_en: expected for a long time; needing to happen now

examples.text: A complete review of safety rules is long overdue.
examples.translation_cn: 对安全条例的全面审查早就该进行了。

senses.meaning_en: a borrowed item or payment that has not been returned or paid on time

examples.text: You have two overdues on your library account.
examples.translation_cn: 你的图书馆账户上有两笔逾期未还记录。

senses.meaning_en: to make a device or function stop working

examples.text: You can disable this feature in the settings menu.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在设置菜单中禁用此功能。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody unable to use their body or mind properly, usually permanently

examples.text: He was severely disabled by a serious accident in his twenties.
examples.translation_cn: 他二十多岁时因一场严重事故落下残疾。

senses.meaning_en: a large crowd of people

examples.text: A throng of people gathered outside the stadium to see the band.
examples.translation_cn: 一大群人在体育场外聚集看乐队。

senses.meaning_en: to crowd into and fill a place

examples.text: Tourists thronged the streets around the cathedral at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 中午游客挤满了大教堂周围的街道。

senses.meaning_en: to gather in a crowd

examples.text: Reporters thronged around the actor as he left the hotel.
examples.translation_cn: 那位演员离开酒店时，记者们围聚在他周围。

senses.meaning_en: a stiff hair, especially on an animal or a brush

examples.text: The bristles on this brush are too soft to clean the pan.
examples.translation_cn: 这把刷子的刷毛太软，刷不干净锅。

senses.meaning_en: to rise or stand up like bristles

examples.text: The dog's fur bristled as it growled at the stranger.
examples.translation_cn: 狗对着陌生人低吼时，毛都竖了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to react angrily or defensively

examples.text: She bristled at the suggestion that she had lied.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到别人暗示她撒谎，感到愤怒。

senses.meaning_en: to prove (something) to be false or incorrect

examples.text: The study refutes the claim that video games cause violence.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究驳斥了电子游戏导致暴力的说法。

senses.meaning_en: to deny the truth or correctness of (something); to reject or disagree with an accusation

examples.text: She categorically refuted the accusation that she had leaked the report.
examples.translation_cn: 她断然否认了泄露报告的指控。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sorry for someone who is in a bad situation

examples.text: I sympathize with anyone who is going through a divorce.
examples.translation_cn: 我同情任何正在经历离婚的人。

senses.meaning_en: to support or approve of a cause or movement

examples.text: She sympathizes with the campaign against child labour.
examples.translation_cn: 她支持反对童工的运动。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that amuses you and makes time pass pleasantly

examples.text: Many people enjoy gardening as a pastime on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人喜欢在周末把园艺作为一种消遣。

senses.meaning_en: to put under water; to flood

examples.text: They submerged the vegetables in ice-cold water to keep them fresh.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把蔬菜浸在冰水中保鲜。

senses.meaning_en: to hide or cover something completely, especially an emotion

examples.text: He managed to submerge his feelings of guilt and carry on.
examples.translation_cn: 他设法压抑住内疚感并继续前行。

senses.meaning_en: to become completely absorbed or involved in something

examples.text: He submerged himself in his research for months.
examples.translation_cn: 他数月来一直埋头于研究。

senses.meaning_en: to sink below the surface

examples.text: The submarine quickly submerged beneath the surface to avoid detection.
examples.translation_cn: 潜艇迅速潜入水下以避免被发现。

senses.meaning_en: connected with Arabia

examples.text: The Arabian Peninsula has a hot, dry climate.
examples.translation_cn: 阿拉伯半岛气候炎热干燥。

senses.meaning_en: a horse of a breed originally from Arabia

examples.text: She rides a purebred Arabian in endurance races.
examples.translation_cn: 她骑着一匹纯种阿拉伯马参加耐力赛。

senses.meaning_en: done regularly or repeatedly as a habit

examples.text: His habitual lateness has become a problem for the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 他惯常的迟到已成为整个团队的问题。

senses.meaning_en: doing something regularly as a habit, especially a bad one

examples.text: He is a habitual offender who has been arrested several times.
examples.translation_cn: 他是惯犯，已被逮捕过几次。

senses.meaning_en: lacking courage or confidence; shy

examples.text: She is still timid about speaking in public.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公共场合讲话仍然很羞怯。

senses.meaning_en: a tool with a heavy metal blade on a handle, used for chopping wood

examples.text: He split the logs with an ax before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 他早饭前用斧子劈了柴。

senses.meaning_en: to cut down or destroy with an ax

examples.text: They axed the old tree down to clear the path.
examples.translation_cn: 他们砍倒那棵老树来清理小路。

senses.meaning_en: a violent, fast-moving stream of water or other liquid

examples.text: The rain fell in torrents throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨倾盆而下，持续了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount of words, questions, or criticism delivered quickly

examples.text: After the announcement, she faced a torrent of questions from reporters.
examples.translation_cn: 公告发布后，她面临记者连珠炮般的提问。

senses.meaning_en: a file that enables peer-to-peer downloading, especially via BitTorrent

examples.text: Many people download entire series via torrent these days.
examples.translation_cn: 如今许多人通过种子下载整季剧集。

senses.meaning_en: to download (something) via BitTorrent or a peer-to-peer torrent

examples.text: He torrented the whole season in one night.
examples.translation_cn: 他一晚上就用种子下载了整季剧集。

senses.meaning_en: to become faster or make something faster

examples.text: My pulse quickened as the final results appeared.
examples.translation_cn: 随着最终结果出现，我心跳加速。

senses.meaning_en: to make something more active or exciting

examples.text: The documentary quickened my interest in ancient history.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片激发了我对古代史的兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: able to be measured

examples.text: The impact of the policy is measurable in terms of job growth.
examples.translation_cn: 这项政策的影响在就业增长方面是可测量的。

senses.meaning_en: of significant importance

examples.text: The new rules have had a measurable effect on air quality.
examples.translation_cn: 新规对空气质量产生了显著影响。

senses.meaning_en: something that can be measured; a metric

examples.text: Managers should track key measurables such as revenue and user growth.
examples.translation_cn: 管理者应追踪关键衡量指标，如收入和用户增长。

senses.meaning_en: extremely; in an essential or indispensable way
senses.pattern: it is vitally important to do

examples.text: It is vitally important to keep accurate records.
examples.translation_cn: 保持准确的记录至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: having won a contest, struggle, or war; triumphant

examples.text: The team was victorious in the final after extra time.
examples.translation_cn: 那支球队在加时赛后的决赛中获胜了。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or causing joy; happy

examples.text: The whole family was joyful when they heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 全家听到消息后都很高兴。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lacks courage

examples.text: He called me a coward for not standing up for my friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为我没有为朋友挺身而出而叫我胆小鬼。

senses.meaning_en: done or acting too quickly without enough thought

examples.text: He was too hasty in signing the contract without reading the fine print.
examples.translation_cn: 他太草率，没看细则就签了合同。

senses.meaning_en: quick to become angry

examples.text: He has a hasty temper and often offends people without meaning to.
examples.translation_cn: 他脾气急躁，常无意中得罪人。

senses.meaning_en: moving or happening quickly, often to escape

examples.text: The burglars beat a hasty retreat when the dog barked.
examples.translation_cn: 狗一叫，窃贼们便匆忙逃窜。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being relative; lack of absolute standards

examples.text: The relativity of moral values is a central idea in anthropology.
examples.translation_cn: 道德价值观的相对性是人类学的一个核心观点。

senses.meaning_en: Einstein's theory of space, time, and gravity

examples.text: The theory of relativity changed our understanding of gravity.
examples.translation_cn: 相对论改变了我们对引力的理解。

senses.meaning_en: lacking kindness; cruel or harsh

examples.text: He was unkind to the new student on his first day at school.
examples.translation_cn: 他在学校第一天对新同学不友善。

senses.meaning_en: someone who delivers and collects mail

examples.text: He works as a postman in our town.
examples.translation_cn: 他在我们镇上当邮递员。

senses.meaning_en: involving physical strength only; without thought or intelligence

examples.text: They managed to open the locked door by brute force.
examples.translation_cn: 他们设法用蛮力打开了锁着的门。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is cruel, violent, or unthinking

examples.text: He acts like a brute whenever he loses his temper.
examples.translation_cn: 他每次发脾气时都表现得像个莽汉。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle that travels in space, carrying people

examples.text: The crew will travel in a spaceship to the space station.
examples.translation_cn: 机组人员将乘坐宇宙飞船前往空间站。

senses.meaning_en: containing or covered with stones

examples.text: They pitched their tent on stony ground near the stream.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把帐篷搭在溪边那块多石的地上。

senses.meaning_en: lacking warmth and emotion

examples.text: The jury listened in stony silence as the verdict was read.
examples.translation_cn: 陪审团在冷峻的沉默中听着判决被宣读。

senses.meaning_en: to join metal or plastic parts by heating them and pressing them together

examples.text: The worker welded the steel plate and the beam together.
examples.translation_cn: 工人把钢板和钢梁焊接在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to make something by welding

examples.text: The artist welded a tall sculpture from old bicycle parts.
examples.translation_cn: 那位艺术家用旧自行车零件焊接成一座高大的雕塑。

senses.meaning_en: a joint made by welding
senses.pattern: a weld between A and B

examples.text: The weld between the tank and the pipe cracked under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 油箱和管道之间的焊缝在压力下开裂了。

senses.meaning_en: to unite people or things closely into a single whole

examples.text: The experience welded them into a loyal team.
examples.translation_cn: 这次经历使他们成为一个忠诚的团队。

senses.meaning_en: to feel or show contempt for somebody or something

examples.text: She publicly scorned the minister for his hypocrisy.
examples.translation_cn: 她公开鄙视那位部长的虚伪。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to do or accept something because of pride

examples.text: He scorned to accept help from his rival.
examples.translation_cn: 他不屑于接受对手的帮助。

senses.meaning_en: contempt or disdain

examples.text: He spoke of his rival's work with undisguised scorn.
examples.translation_cn: 他谈到对手的作品时带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑。

senses.meaning_en: homosexual; non-heterosexual or non-cisgender

examples.text: More employees now feel safe identifying as queer at work.
examples.translation_cn: 现在更多员工感到在工作中可以安心认同自己为酷儿。

senses.meaning_en: a person of any non-heterosexual sexuality or genderqueer identity

examples.text: As a queer, she has spent years fighting for equal rights.
examples.translation_cn: 作为性少数者，她多年来一直在争取平等权利。

senses.meaning_en: a question that has a clever or funny answer, especially as a game

examples.text: He solved the riddle in less than a minute.
examples.translation_cn: 他不到一分钟就解开了这个谜语。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is mysterious or hard to understand

examples.text: The cause of the accident remains a riddle to investigators.
examples.translation_cn: 事故的原因对调查人员来说仍然是个谜。

senses.meaning_en: to speak ambiguously or enigmatically

examples.text: Stop speaking in riddles and give me a straight answer.
examples.translation_cn: 别拐弯抹角了，给我一个直接的回答。

senses.meaning_en: to fill or affect with many holes or something undesirable

examples.text: The old wall is riddled with bullet holes.
examples.translation_cn: 那面旧墙上布满了弹孔。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing anger at something unfair or wrong

examples.text: She was indignant at the way they ignored her complaint.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他们无视她投诉的方式感到愤慨。

senses.meaning_en: in a mechanical way; without thinking

examples.text: She folded the laundry mechanically, her eyes fixed on the TV.
examples.translation_cn: 她机械地叠着衣服，眼睛盯着电视。

senses.meaning_en: from a mechanical point of view

examples.text: Mechanically speaking, this engine is more efficient than the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 从机械角度看，这台发动机比旧的更高效。

senses.meaning_en: a cold English dessert made with layers of cake, fruit, custard and cream

examples.text: She made a trifle with fresh berries for the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她为聚会做了一个带有新鲜浆果的乳脂松糕。

senses.meaning_en: something that has little value or importance

examples.text: They argued over a mere trifle at the office.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在办公室里为一件小事争吵。

senses.meaning_en: slightly; a little

examples.text: The room is a trifle cold at night.
examples.translation_cn: 这个房间夜里有点冷。

senses.meaning_en: to treat someone or something without respect or seriousness

examples.text: You should never trifle with other people's feelings.
examples.translation_cn: 你绝不应该玩弄别人的感情。

senses.meaning_en: an adult castrated male of cattle, especially a draft animal; any bovine animal

examples.text: They used a team of oxen to drag the logs out of the forest.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用一队牛把原木拖出森林。

senses.meaning_en: a person who sells food and household items in a shop

examples.text: My grandfather worked as a grocer in a small town for most of his life.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父大半生都在一个小镇当杂货商。

senses.meaning_en: to remove impurities; to make pure

examples.text: The device purifies water by removing bacteria and dirt.
examples.translation_cn: 该装置通过去除细菌和污垢来净化水。

senses.meaning_en: to free from guilt or sin

examples.text: Meditation purifies the mind of negative thoughts and guilt.
examples.translation_cn: 冥想净化心灵中的负面思想和罪疚。

senses.meaning_en: to become pure

examples.text: The liquid purifies over time as the sediment settles to the bottom.
examples.translation_cn: 液体随着沉淀物沉底而逐渐变纯净。

senses.meaning_en: a hot breakfast dish made from oats or other grains boiled in milk or water

examples.text: She made herself a bowl of porridge with sliced banana.
examples.translation_cn: 她给自己做了一碗配香蕉片的麦片粥。

senses.meaning_en: not definite, vague, or unclear

examples.text: She was indefinite about her plans for the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她对自己夏天的计划含糊其辞。

senses.meaning_en: lasting for an unknown or unstated length of time

examples.text: The road will be closed for an indefinite period.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路将无限期封闭。

examples.text: They travelled by steamer from London to New York.
examples.translation_cn: 他们乘汽船从伦敦到纽约。

examples.text: Place the fish in a steamer and cook it for fifteen minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 把鱼放进蒸锅蒸十五分钟。
