senses.meaning_en: a short high-pitched sound, as made by a baby bird or a whistle

examples.text: The chick let out a peep when the light came on.
examples.translation_cn: 灯一亮，小鸡吱吱地叫了一声。

senses.meaning_en: to look at something secretly, especially through a narrow opening

examples.text: He peeped through the keyhole to see who was knocking.
examples.translation_cn: 他从钥匙孔偷看，看是谁在敲门。

senses.meaning_en: to make a short, high-pitched sound like a baby bird

examples.text: The chicks peeped softly when the hen appeared.
examples.translation_cn: 母鸡出现时，小鸡们轻声地吱吱叫。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone likely to think or behave in a particular way

examples.text: The evidence inclined the jury to believe her testimony.
examples.translation_cn: 证据使陪审团倾向于相信她的证词。

senses.meaning_en: to slope or move from a straight position

examples.text: The old tower inclines slightly to one side.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧塔略微向一侧倾斜。

senses.meaning_en: a slope

examples.text: The truck lost power on an incline near the tunnel.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车在隧道附近的一个坡道上失去了动力。

senses.meaning_en: turning around a central point

examples.text: The electric drill works with a rotary motion.
examples.translation_cn: 这个电钻靠旋转运动工作。

senses.meaning_en: a circular area where several roads meet and traffic must go round

examples.text: At the rotary, yield to traffic coming from the left.
examples.translation_cn: 在环岛处，要让左侧来车先行。

senses.meaning_en: a slow-moving land reptile with a hard shell

examples.text: We kept a tortoise in the garden when I was a child.
examples.translation_cn: 我小时候在花园里养过一只陆龟。

senses.meaning_en: still to be paid; owed as a debt

examples.text: The balance is still owing and should be paid by the end of the month.
examples.translation_cn: 余额仍未支付，应在月底前付清。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing skill; expert

examples.text: She is very skillful at handling difficult customers.
examples.translation_cn: 她非常擅长应对难缠的顾客。

senses.meaning_en: requiring skill

examples.text: Restoring antique clocks is a skillful task that requires steady hands and years of training.
examples.translation_cn: 修复古董钟表是一项需要技巧的工作，需要稳定的双手和多年的训练。

senses.meaning_en: done with great skill

examples.text: The director makes skillful use of light and shadow.
examples.translation_cn: 这位导演巧妙地运用光影。

senses.meaning_en: the projecting edge of a hat

examples.text: She wore a straw hat with a wide brim at the garden party.
examples.translation_cn: 她在花园派对上戴着一顶宽边草帽。

senses.meaning_en: to be full to the point of overflowing

examples.text: Her eyes brimmed with tears as she read the letter.
examples.translation_cn: 她读信时眼里满是泪水。

senses.meaning_en: to fill a container to the top edge or fill something fully

examples.text: The waiter brimmed our glasses with ice-cold water.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员把我们的杯子倒满冰水。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of power approximately equal to 735.5 watts

examples.text: The engine produces 150 metric horsepower at 6,500 rpm.
examples.translation_cn: 这台发动机在每分钟6500转时产生150公制马力。

senses.meaning_en: processing power or performance capability

examples.text: Does this computer have enough horsepower to edit 4K video?
examples.translation_cn: 这台计算机有足够的性能来编辑4K视频吗？

senses.meaning_en: unit of electrical potential difference; symbol V

examples.text: The potential difference across the resistor is measured in volts.
examples.translation_cn: 电阻两端的电势差以伏特为单位测量。

senses.meaning_en: to surprise someone very much

examples.text: It astonished me that he agreed so quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 他这么快就同意了，这让我大为惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: toward the west; lying or moving toward the west

examples.text: They set off on a westward journey across the high plains.
examples.translation_cn: 他们启程穿越高原向西旅行。

senses.meaning_en: toward the west

examples.text: A line of storms will travel westward across the state tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 一列暴风雨今晚将穿过该州向西移动。

senses.meaning_en: the chest, especially as the seat of emotions

examples.text: She held the crying child to her bosom until he slept.
examples.translation_cn: 她把哭泣的孩子抱在怀里，直到他睡着。

senses.meaning_en: the inner feelings; the seat of emotion

examples.text: Anger rose in his bosom when he heard the lie.
examples.translation_cn: 听到那句谎言时，他心中升起怒火。

senses.meaning_en: very close; intimate

examples.text: They remained bosom friends long after they left college.
examples.translation_cn: 离开大学很久以后，他们仍是知心朋友。

senses.meaning_en: the protected interior or inner part of something; the area enclosed as by an embrace

examples.text: She was raised in the bosom of a large, loving family.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个充满爱的大家庭的怀抱中长大。

senses.meaning_en: the philosophical theory that matter is the only reality and that everything, including mind, can be explained in physical terms

examples.text: Materialism holds that the mind can be fully explained in physical terms.
examples.translation_cn: 唯物主义认为，心灵可以完全用物理术语来解释。

senses.meaning_en: to shine with a flickering light

examples.text: The stars twinkle in the sky every clear night.
examples.translation_cn: 每个晴朗的夜晚，星星都在天空中闪烁。

senses.meaning_en: to be bright with delight

examples.text: Her eyes twinkle with delight whenever she talks about her grandchildren.
examples.translation_cn: 她一谈起孙辈，眼睛里就闪着喜悦。

senses.meaning_en: a sparkle or glimmer of light

examples.text: From the hill we saw the twinkle of lights in the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 从山上我们看到山谷里灯光闪烁。

senses.meaning_en: able to be dissolved

examples.text: Table salt is soluble in water, and it dissolves faster when heated.
examples.translation_cn: 食盐可溶于水，加热时溶解得更快。

senses.meaning_en: able to be solved or explained

examples.text: Most everyday problems are soluble if you apply a bit of common sense.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数日常问题只要运用一点常识就能解决。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of subsets of a given set that contains the empty set and is closed under unions and complements
senses.pattern: an algebra of sets on X

examples.text: All subsets of a set X form an algebra of sets on X.
examples.translation_cn: 集合 X 的所有子集构成 X 上的一个集合代数。

senses.meaning_en: a device that converts electrical signals into sound

examples.text: The announcement was broadcast over a loudspeaker in the hall.
examples.translation_cn: 通知在大厅里通过扬声器广播了。

senses.meaning_en: to treat people in an unfair and cruel way, especially by denying them rights

examples.text: The regime continued to oppress the people for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 该政权数十年间持续压迫人民。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel sad and anxious

examples.text: She was oppressed by a growing sense of despair.
examples.translation_cn: 她为日益增长的绝望感所压抑。

senses.meaning_en: a small plant with purple flowers

examples.text: We saw violets in bloom along the forest path.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在森林小路边看到盛开的紫罗兰。

senses.meaning_en: the colour between blue and purple

examples.text: The evening sky turned a shade of violet.
examples.translation_cn: 傍晚的天空变成了紫罗兰色。

senses.meaning_en: of a violet colour

examples.text: She has striking violet eyes that everyone notices immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 她有一双引人注目的紫罗兰色眼睛，每个人都会立刻注意到。

senses.meaning_en: a large room or building for indoor sports

examples.text: Students are playing basketball in the gymnasium after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们午饭后正在体育馆里打篮球。

senses.meaning_en: a device that changes the voltage of electricity

examples.text: A power transformer converts high voltage into low voltage for domestic use.
examples.translation_cn: 电力变压器把高压转换成低压供家庭使用。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that transforms something

examples.text: She became a transformer of society through education reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过教育改革成为社会的变革者。

senses.meaning_en: a severe storm with strong winds and heavy snow

examples.text: We were caught in a snowstorm on the mountain pass.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在山路上遇到了暴风雪。

senses.meaning_en: to change from a gas into a liquid

examples.text: Moisture in the air condenses on the cold glass.
examples.translation_cn: 空气中的水分在冷玻璃上凝结。

senses.meaning_en: to become thicker or more concentrated

examples.text: The sauce will condense into a thick, dark syrup after an hour of boiling.
examples.translation_cn: 酱汁煮一小时后会浓缩成浓稠的深色糖浆。

senses.meaning_en: to make shorter by removing less important parts
senses.collocation: condense a report into two pages

examples.text: The editor condensed the long report into a one-page summary.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑把那份长报告压缩成一页摘要。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to see; sight

examples.text: He gradually lost his eyesight after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后他逐渐失去了视力。

senses.meaning_en: superlative of bad; most bad or unpleasant

examples.text: The worst thing about the job was the long commute.
examples.translation_cn: 这份工作最糟糕的是长途通勤。

senses.meaning_en: the worst person or thing

examples.text: He is the worst of all the candidates we interviewed.
examples.translation_cn: 他是我们面试的所有候选人中最差的一个。

senses.meaning_en: to move into a foreign country to stay permanently

examples.text: Her grandparents immigrated to Australia in the 1960s.
examples.translation_cn: 她的祖父母在20世纪60年代移民到了澳大利亚。

senses.meaning_en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes

examples.text: A herd of zebras crossed the river at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 一群斑马黎明时过了河。

senses.meaning_en: a marked road crossing for pedestrians

examples.text: Children should cross the road on a zebra crossing.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们应该走斑马线过马路。

senses.meaning_en: giving help or support; supplementary

examples.text: These volunteers are auxiliary to the hospital's permanent staff.
examples.translation_cn: 这些志愿者辅助医院的正式工作人员。

senses.meaning_en: relating to an auxiliary verb

examples.text: In 'I can swim', 'can' is an auxiliary verb.
examples.translation_cn: 在“I can swim”中，“can”是助动词。

senses.meaning_en: held in reserve for exceptional circumstances

examples.text: The hospital has an auxiliary generator for power cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 医院有一台备用发电机，用于停电时使用。

senses.meaning_en: a person or group that gives auxiliary support

examples.text: She works as a nursing auxiliary in a local care home.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地一家护理院做护理辅助人员。

senses.meaning_en: having qualities traditionally associated with men, such as courage, strength, and nobility

examples.text: He was manly enough to carry the injured hiker down the mountain.
examples.translation_cn: 他很有男子气概，把受伤的徒步者背下了山。

senses.meaning_en: a small brown songbird of the family Passeridae

examples.text: A flock of sparrows was feeding on the ground outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 一群麻雀正在车站外的地面上觅食。

senses.meaning_en: hard-working and focused

examples.text: She is diligent in her research and checks every source carefully.
examples.translation_cn: 她在研究中很勤奋，仔细核对每一个来源。

senses.meaning_en: a bucket, often with a handle, used for carrying liquids

examples.text: She carried an empty pail across the yard to fetch water.
examples.translation_cn: 她提着一个空桶穿过院子去打水。

senses.meaning_en: the amount that a pail holds

examples.text: Add a pail of sand to the mixture and stir it well.
examples.translation_cn: 往混合物里加一桶沙子，然后搅拌均匀。

senses.meaning_en: to remember something, especially by making an effort

examples.text: I suddenly recollected that I had left my keys in the office.
examples.translation_cn: 我忽然想起我把钥匙落在办公室了。

senses.meaning_en: to become calm again

examples.text: She paused to recollect herself before answering the difficult question.
examples.translation_cn: 在回答这个难题之前，她停顿了一下让自己镇定下来。

senses.meaning_en: the season of spring, between winter and summer

examples.text: The cherry trees along the river bloom in springtime.
examples.translation_cn: 河边的樱花树在春天开花。

senses.meaning_en: a period of flourishing and renewal

examples.text: He wrote the novel in the springtime of his youth.
examples.translation_cn: 他在青春年华时写了这部小说。

senses.meaning_en: small drops of water that form on cool surfaces at night

examples.text: The grass was covered with dew early this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天清晨，草上覆盖着露水。

senses.meaning_en: warm and friendly; sincere

examples.text: She was cordial to her new neighbours from the first day.
examples.translation_cn: 她从第一天起就对新邻居很亲切。

senses.meaning_en: a concentrated fruit drink that is mixed with water

examples.text: Dilute the fruit cordial with water before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 饮用前要用水稀释这种浓缩果汁。

senses.meaning_en: causing a feeling of hatred or strong dislike
senses.pattern: it is hateful of sb to do sth

examples.text: It was hateful of them to spread lies about her.
examples.translation_cn: 他们散布关于她的谎言，太可恨了。

senses.meaning_en: full of hatred

examples.text: She gave him a hateful look and walked away.
examples.translation_cn: 她恶狠狠地看了他一眼，然后走开了。

senses.meaning_en: showing strong prejudice or hatred towards a group

examples.text: The group spread hateful propaganda against refugees and immigrants.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织散布针对难民和移民的仇恨宣传。

senses.meaning_en: dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false; a trick

examples.text: He gained access to the building by deceit.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过欺骗手段进入了大楼。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being dishonest or deceptive

examples.text: The salesman's friendly manner was full of deceit.
examples.translation_cn: 那个推销员的友善态度里满是欺骗。

senses.meaning_en: a group of young birds or other egg-laying creatures all born at the same time

examples.text: The hen raised a brood of chicks in the yard.
examples.translation_cn: 母鸡在院子里养了一窝小鸡。

senses.meaning_en: to think a lot about something that makes you unhappy, worried, or angry

examples.text: He brooded over his failure for several weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 他因失败而苦恼了好几个星期。

senses.meaning_en: to sit on eggs to keep them warm until they hatch

examples.text: The eagle broods her eggs for about thirty-five days.
examples.translation_cn: 鹰孵蛋大约三十五天。

senses.meaning_en: a person's children; offspring

examples.text: She brought her brood to the seaside for the day.
examples.translation_cn: 她带着孩子们去海边玩了一天。

senses.meaning_en: a mild rebuke or implied criticism

examples.text: He looked at me with reproach after I broke my promise.
examples.translation_cn: 我违背诺言后，他责备地看着我。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize or rebuke (someone)

examples.text: He reproached himself for not telling the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 他责备自己没有说实话。

senses.meaning_en: disgrace or shame

examples.text: His behavior was a reproach to the entire family.
examples.translation_cn: 他的行为是整个家庭的耻辱。

senses.meaning_en: a large black-and-white bear-like animal that lives in China

examples.text: A giant panda lives in the mountains of central China.
examples.translation_cn: 大熊猫生活在中国中部的山区。

senses.meaning_en: to become ripe

examples.text: The grapes ripened on the vine in late summer.
examples.translation_cn: 那些葡萄在夏末时节在藤上成熟了。

senses.meaning_en: to make something ripe

examples.text: Farmers ripen bananas quickly in warm storage rooms.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在温暖的储藏室里快速催熟香蕉。

senses.meaning_en: to develop to a more complete or final form

examples.text: Their friendship ripened into love over the years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的友谊随着年月发展成了爱情。

senses.meaning_en: a large branch of a tree, especially a main one attached to the trunk

examples.text: A hawk perched on a bough, scanning the ground for prey.
examples.translation_cn: 一只鹰栖息在大树枝上，扫视地面寻找猎物。

senses.meaning_en: a small red or white root vegetable eaten raw in salads

examples.text: I bought a bunch of radishes at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 我在市场买了一串萝卜。

senses.meaning_en: a person who types, especially as a job

examples.text: He works as a typist in the university admissions office.
examples.translation_cn: 他在大学招生办公室当打字员。

senses.meaning_en: to feel regret for something bad you have done

examples.text: He sincerely repented of his harsh words to her.
examples.translation_cn: 他真诚地为对她说的刻薄话感到后悔。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sorry for sin and seek forgiveness

examples.text: The preacher urged the congregation to repent of their sins and seek forgiveness.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师敦促会众忏悔他们的罪并寻求宽恕。

senses.meaning_en: the line that bounds a circle
senses.pattern: on the circumference of a circle

examples.text: Mark three points on the circumference of a circle.
examples.translation_cn: 在圆的圆周上标三个点。

senses.meaning_en: the length of such a line

examples.text: The circumference of the Earth is about 40,000 kilometres.
examples.translation_cn: 地球的周长大约是四万公里。

senses.meaning_en: the outer edge or boundary of an area

examples.text: A low wall runs around the circumference of the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 一道矮墙沿着老城的外围延伸。

senses.meaning_en: a round white root vegetable eaten as food

examples.text: She sliced a turnip and added it to the stew.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一个芜菁切片放进了炖菜里。

senses.meaning_en: the meat of sheep used as food; especially that of adults

examples.text: She roasted a leg of mutton with rosemary and garlic.
examples.translation_cn: 她用迷迭香和大蒜烤了一条羊腿。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

examples.text: We spent the afternoon going sightseeing around the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 我们花了一下午在老城区观光。

senses.meaning_en: consisting of or containing more than one of something

examples.text: The plural noun 'children' refers to more than one child.
examples.translation_cn: 复数名词 “children” 指一个以上的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: the form of a word that expresses more than one; the plural number

examples.text: In English, the plural of 'child' is 'children', not 'childs'.
examples.translation_cn: 在英语中，'child' 的复数形式是 'children'，不是 'childs'。

senses.meaning_en: pluralistic; relating to or consisting of many different groups

examples.text: Their community is plural, with several distinct cultural traditions.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的社区是多元的，有若干不同的文化传统。

senses.meaning_en: a sport played indoors with rackets and a shuttlecock over a high net

examples.text: We play badminton at the gym every Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周六在体育馆打羽毛球。

senses.meaning_en: a Black person (offensive)

examples.text: He was accused of calling his colleague a Negro.
examples.translation_cn: 他被指控称同事为“Negro”。

senses.meaning_en: opposite in effect, nature, or order

examples.text: The frequency of a sound wave is in inverse proportion to its wavelength.
examples.translation_cn: 声波的频率与其波长成反比。

senses.meaning_en: having the properties of an inverse operation

examples.text: Addition and subtraction are inverse operations in arithmetic.
examples.translation_cn: 在算术中，加法和减法是逆运算。

senses.meaning_en: the result of an inversion, especially a reciprocal

examples.text: To find the inverse of a fraction, simply turn it upside down.
examples.translation_cn: 要得到一个分数的倒数，只需把它上下颠倒。

senses.meaning_en: the base unit of mass in the International System of Units, equal to 1,000 grams (symbol kg)

examples.text: She bought half a kilogram of cheese from the local market.
examples.translation_cn: 她从当地市场买了半公斤奶酪。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the ear or the sense of hearing

examples.text: The course develops both aural and visual skills.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程培养听觉和视觉技能。

senses.meaning_en: showing great energy and enthusiasm for something, especially because you strongly believe in it

examples.text: She is zealous in defending the rights of minorities.
examples.translation_cn: 她热心地捍卫少数群体的权利。

senses.meaning_en: a conversation between two or more people

examples.text: The manager wants to have a dialog with employees about the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 经理想就新政策与员工进行对话。

senses.meaning_en: the words spoken by characters in a play, film, or story

examples.text: The dialog between the hero and the villain is sharp and memorable.
examples.translation_cn: 主角和反派之间的对白犀利而令人难忘。

senses.meaning_en: an explosive mixture of saltpetre, charcoal, and sulfur, used especially in fireworks and formerly in guns

examples.text: After the fireworks, the air had a sharp smell of gunpowder.
examples.translation_cn: 烟花过后，空气里有股浓烈的火药味。

senses.meaning_en: to stop sleeping; to become awake

examples.text: He wakened from a light sleep when the train stopped.
examples.translation_cn: 火车停下时，他从浅睡中醒来。

senses.meaning_en: to wake or rouse someone from sleep

examples.text: The sound of the alarm wakened him from a deep sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 闹钟声把他从沉睡中唤醒。

senses.meaning_en: the emission of ionizing radiation from nuclear decay, or the radiation itself

examples.text: High levels of radioactivity were detected near the reactor.
examples.translation_cn: 反应堆附近检测到了高强度的辐射。

senses.meaning_en: a woman whose job is to serve passengers on a ship or aircraft

examples.text: She works as a stewardess for an international airline.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家国际航空公司当空姐。

senses.meaning_en: a word that modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb

examples.text: You can modify a verb with an adverb, as in 'She spoke softly'.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用副词修饰动词，如 She spoke softly。

senses.meaning_en: to annoy or worry

examples.text: She was clearly vexed by his constant interruptions during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她明显被他开会时不断的打扰惹恼了。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or existing as gas

examples.text: Carbon dioxide is in a gaseous state at room temperature.
examples.translation_cn: 二氧化碳在室温下呈气态。

senses.meaning_en: an act of hiding mistakes or unpleasant facts

examples.text: Critics dismissed the official report as a whitewash.
examples.translation_cn: 批评者称这份官方报告是粉饰。

senses.meaning_en: to paint something white with whitewash

examples.text: They whitewash the old wooden fence every spring.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每年春天用石灰水刷白旧木栅栏。

senses.meaning_en: a white liquid used for painting walls and fences

examples.text: We painted the wooden fence with whitewash last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 去年夏天我们用石灰水刷了木栅栏。

senses.meaning_en: to tell again, often differently, what one has read or heard

examples.text: The teacher asked me to retell the story to the class.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我向全班复述这个故事。

senses.meaning_en: to make slippery or smooth by applying a lubricant

examples.text: You should lubricate the door hinges with oil.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该给门铰链上油。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to become drunk

examples.text: The host lubricated his guests with wine before the meal.
examples.translation_cn: 主人在餐前用葡萄酒把客人灌得微醉。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone unhappy or angry

examples.text: The new policy will displease many local residents.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策会使许多当地居民不高兴。

senses.meaning_en: prompt; on time

examples.text: She is always punctual for class, even after a late night.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是准时去上课，即使熬夜到很晚。

senses.meaning_en: the act of speaking or reading aloud so that someone can write down the words

examples.text: The assistant takes dictation from the manager during meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 助理在会议上记录经理的口述。

senses.meaning_en: a school exercise in which students write down a passage read aloud by the teacher

examples.text: We have a short dictation in French class every week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周在法语课上做一次简短的听写。

senses.meaning_en: a town or harbour with facilities for seagoing ships to load and unload cargo

examples.text: The seaport of Rotterdam handles a huge volume of cargo every day.
examples.translation_cn: 鹿特丹海港每天处理大量货物。

senses.meaning_en: a violent tropical storm with very strong winds, especially in the northwestern Pacific

examples.text: A powerful typhoon struck the Philippines last weekend, causing widespread damage.
examples.translation_cn: 一场强台风上周末袭击了菲律宾，造成广泛破坏。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something lose respect or reputation

examples.text: He dishonoured his family by cheating in the election.
examples.translation_cn: 他因选举舞弊使家族蒙羞。

senses.meaning_en: shame or loss of honour

examples.text: His arrest brought dishonour on the whole school.
examples.translation_cn: 他被捕使整个学校蒙受耻辱。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to keep an agreement or promise

examples.text: The company dishonoured its promise to cut emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司违背了减排承诺。

senses.meaning_en: refusal to accept or pay a cheque or bill of exchange

examples.text: The dishonour of the cheque led to a legal dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 支票被拒付引发了一场法律纠纷。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of liquid capacity equal to two pints or one-fourth of a gallon

examples.text: Add a quart of water to the soup and bring it to a boil.
examples.translation_cn: 往汤里加一夸脱水，然后煮沸。

senses.meaning_en: a four-wheeled vehicle for carrying goods, pulled by horses or oxen

examples.text: They loaded sacks of grain onto the horse-drawn waggon.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把一袋袋谷物装上四轮运货马车。

senses.meaning_en: a railway vehicle for carrying goods

examples.text: The train pulled a long line of railway waggons loaded with coal.
examples.translation_cn: 火车拉着一长列装满煤的铁路货车车厢。

senses.meaning_en: the act of congratulating or an expression of pleasure at another's success

examples.text: She received warm congratulations on her remarkable achievement.
examples.translation_cn: 她因出色的成就受到了热烈的祝贺。

senses.meaning_en: to develop industry; to become industrial

examples.text: The country began to industrialize rapidly in the 1960s.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家在20世纪60年代开始迅速实现工业化。

senses.meaning_en: to organize along industrial lines; to develop industry in a country or region

examples.text: The government industrialized a region in only ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 该政府在短短十年内使一个地区实现了工业化。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

examples.text: The recipe calls for 200 grammes of sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 这个食谱需要200克糖。

senses.meaning_en: a word used before a noun or pronoun to show place, time, direction, etc.

examples.text: The verb 'listen' is usually followed by a preposition.
examples.translation_cn: 动词“listen”通常后接介词。

senses.meaning_en: Celsius; relating to a temperature scale with 100 degrees between freezing and boiling

examples.text: Water boils at 100 degrees centigrade at sea level.
examples.translation_cn: 在海平面，水在100摄氏度沸腾。

senses.meaning_en: to make a person less innocent or natural; to make someone worldly

examples.text: Living in the capital soon sophisticated the naive country boy.
examples.translation_cn: 在首都生活很快使这个天真的乡下男孩变得世故。

senses.meaning_en: to make a system, process, etc. more developed or refined

examples.text: Engineers sophisticated the design by adding real-time feedback and automated controls.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师通过增加实时反馈和自动控制使设计更加精密。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Fahrenheit temperature scale

examples.text: The temperature dropped to 5 degrees Fahrenheit last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚气温降到了华氏5度。

senses.meaning_en: a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Ra

examples.text: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered radium in 1898.
examples.translation_cn: 玛丽·居里和皮埃尔·居里于1898年发现了镭。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring electric current

examples.text: The current flowing through the wire is measured in amperes.
examples.translation_cn: 通过电线的电流以安培为单位测量。

senses.meaning_en: a geographical region of the central and south Pacific, including Australasia, Melanesia, Micronesia, and Polynesia

examples.text: Ancient trade networks connected many island communities across Oceania.
examples.translation_cn: 古代贸易网络连接了大洋洲的许多岛屿社区。

senses.meaning_en: US spelling of kilometre

examples.text: The nearest gas station is three kilometers from the exit.
examples.translation_cn: 最近的加油站在出口三公里外。

senses.meaning_en: before Christ; used to show that a year is before the birth of Christ

examples.text: The famous philosopher was born in 551 b.c. and died in 479 b.c.
examples.translation_cn: 这位著名哲学家生于公元前551年，卒于公元前479年。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to satisfy; displease

examples.text: Many customers were dissatisfied with the new refund policy.
examples.translation_cn: 许多顾客对新的退款政策感到不满。

senses.meaning_en: one's spouse's father

examples.text: Mr. Lee is my father-in-law and a retired engineer.
examples.translation_cn: 李先生是我的岳父，也是一位退休工程师。

senses.meaning_en: that is; in other words

examples.text: Submit it by Monday, i.e. the 5th of May.
examples.translation_cn: 请在周一之前提交，即5月5日。

senses.meaning_en: a frozen sweet food made from milk, cream, and sugar, often flavoured

examples.text: We had vanilla ice-cream for dessert after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚饭后吃了香草冰淇淋当甜点。

senses.meaning_en: a room in a house for general everyday use, such as relaxing, watching TV, or entertaining guests

examples.text: We often watch TV in the living-room after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后我们常在客厅看电视。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of physics that deals with forces and motion

examples.text: Engineers apply the laws of mechanics when designing bridges and buildings.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师在设计桥梁和建筑时运用力学定律。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which something works or is done

examples.text: I don't understand the mechanics of how the new software works.
examples.translation_cn: 我不明白这个新软件是如何运作的。

senses.meaning_en: the working parts of a machine

examples.text: The mechanics of a machine require regular maintenance to prevent breakdowns.
examples.translation_cn: 机器的机械部件需要定期维护以防止故障。

senses.meaning_en: the spelling and punctuation of a piece of writing

examples.text: This course covers the mechanics of writing, such as spelling and punctuation.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程涵盖拼写、标点等写作基本功。

senses.meaning_en: the outer parts of a town or city; a suburb

examples.text: They moved to a quiet house on the outskirts of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 他们搬到了市郊一座安静的房子。

senses.meaning_en: an image seen in a mirror or other shiny surface

examples.text: She saw her reflexion in the shop window and quickly turned away.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到商店橱窗里的倒影，迅速转身走开。

senses.meaning_en: serious thought or consideration

examples.text: On reflexion, he realised the plan was too risky.
examples.translation_cn: 经过思考，他意识到计划太冒险。

senses.meaning_en: the process of reflecting light, heat, or sound

examples.text: The reflexion of light from the mirror brightened the room.
examples.translation_cn: 镜子反射的光照亮了房间。

senses.meaning_en: commonly named or called

examples.text: The researchers investigated the so-called 'Mozart effect' in children.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员调查了儿童中所谓的“莫扎特效应”。

senses.meaning_en: falsely or unfittingly called

examples.text: His so-called best friend refused to help him.
examples.translation_cn: 他那个所谓的最好的朋友拒绝帮助他。

senses.meaning_en: systematic and organized

examples.text: The engineer is systematical in checking each component.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师在检查每个零件时很有条理。

senses.meaning_en: including the latest information

examples.text: The website offers up-to-date information on travel restrictions.
examples.translation_cn: 该网站提供关于旅行限制的最新信息。

senses.meaning_en: informed about the latest news or developments

examples.text: Please keep me up-to-date on any changes to the schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 请随时告知我日程的任何变动。

senses.meaning_en: modern and using the latest technology or design

examples.text: The factory uses up-to-date technology to reduce waste.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂使用最新技术来减少浪费。

senses.meaning_en: with the top part where the bottom part should be

examples.text: The picture is upside-down on the wall now.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画现在在墙上挂倒了。

senses.meaning_en: in a state of complete disorder

examples.text: The burglars completely turned the whole house upside-down.
examples.translation_cn: 窃贼把整个房子彻底翻得乱七八糟。

senses.meaning_en: modern; including the latest information

examples.text: The software is uptodate and includes the latest security fixes.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件是最新的，包含最新的安全修复。

senses.meaning_en: famous or widely known

examples.text: She is well-known for her research on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 她因气候变化研究而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: covering or affecting the whole world

examples.text: The company now operates on a world-wide scale.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司现在在全球范围内运营。

senses.meaning_en: a ray of short-wavelength electromagnetic radiation that can pass through many objects and is used to create images of internal structures

examples.text: X-rays reveal hidden fractures in bones that doctors cannot see from outside.
examples.translation_cn: X射线能显示医生从外部看不到的骨骼内隐藏的骨折。

senses.meaning_en: a radiograph: an image made with X-rays

examples.text: The doctor examined an X-ray of my ankle before deciding on treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在决定治疗方案前检查了我脚踝的X光照片。

senses.meaning_en: to take a radiograph of; to obtain an image of using X-ray radiation, especially for medical diagnostic evaluation

examples.text: The doctor X-rayed my broken arm to see if it needed surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 医生给我的断臂拍了X光，以确定是否需要手术。

senses.meaning_en: an X-ray machine; a machine for performing radiography

examples.text: The hospital bought a new X-ray machine to speed up patient exams.
examples.translation_cn: 医院购置了一台新的X光机，以加快病人检查速度。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to X-rays

examples.text: The lab uses advanced X-ray equipment for atomic research.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室使用先进的X射线设备进行原子研究。

senses.meaning_en: having much distance from one end to the other

examples.text: It's a long walk from the hotel to the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 从酒店到海滩走路很远。

senses.meaning_en: having great duration

examples.text: The movie was very long, running for nearly four hours.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影很长，接近四个小时。

senses.meaning_en: seeming to last a lot of time

examples.text: The final hour of the exam seemed long and exhausting.
examples.translation_cn: 考试最后一小时显得漫长又累人。

senses.meaning_en: holding assets for expected rise in value

examples.text: The fund is long on solar energy stocks this quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 该基金本季度做多太阳能股。

senses.meaning_en: to move downwards

examples.text: A few drops of rain fell from the dark clouds.
examples.translation_cn: 几滴雨从乌云中落下。

senses.meaning_en: to suddenly go down onto the ground, especially by accident

examples.text: She fell down the stairs and hurt her knee.
examples.translation_cn: 她从楼梯上摔下来，伤了膝盖。

senses.meaning_en: to pass into a state, especially a bad one

examples.text: After losing his job, he fell into despair.
examples.translation_cn: 失业后，他陷入了绝望。

senses.meaning_en: to happen on a particular day or date

examples.text: My birthday falls on a Sunday this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年我的生日正好是个星期天。

senses.meaning_en: to be of use or advantage to someone; to help

examples.text: All our hard work availed us nothing in the end.
examples.translation_cn: 我们所有的努力最终都无济于事。

senses.meaning_en: to make use of something, especially an opportunity or offer

examples.text: You should avail yourself of the free training offered.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该利用提供的免费培训。

senses.meaning_en: use or benefit, especially in negative phrases

examples.text: She searched everywhere for her lost ring, but to no avail.
examples.translation_cn: 她到处寻找丢失的戒指，但毫无结果。

senses.meaning_en: transparent

examples.text: The water in the lake is so clear that you can see the fish.
examples.translation_cn: 湖水非常清澈，你可以看见鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to remove things from a place or surface

examples.text: Please clear the table and wash the dishes after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后请清理桌子并洗碗。

senses.meaning_en: free of obstacles

examples.text: The police made sure the road was clear of traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 警察确保道路没有车辆阻碍。

senses.meaning_en: without clouds

examples.text: A clear sky is a sign of good weather.
examples.translation_cn: 晴朗的天空是好天气的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: visible light or a source of illumination

examples.text: She read by the light of a small candle.
examples.translation_cn: 她借着一个小蜡烛的光看书。

senses.meaning_en: a point of view or aspect
senses.pattern: see sth in a new light

examples.text: The discovery made scientists see the problem in a new light.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现使科学家们以新的视角看待这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: weighing little

examples.text: This backpack is light enough to carry for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 这个背包很轻，可以背几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to set on fire or illuminate

examples.text: She lit a candle to light up the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她点燃蜡烛照亮房间。

senses.meaning_en: spiritual or mental illumination; enlightenment, useful information

examples.text: The new research sheds light on how the brain works.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新研究揭示了大脑如何工作。

senses.meaning_en: to place in a physical location

examples.text: The hotel is situated on a quiet hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆坐落在一个安静的山坡上。

senses.meaning_en: to place in an intangible context

examples.text: The author situates the novel in 19th-century Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 作者将这部小说置于19世纪巴黎的背景中。

senses.meaning_en: a short written message

examples.text: She left a note for her mother on the kitchen table.
examples.translation_cn: 她在厨房桌子上给妈妈留了一张便条。

senses.meaning_en: a single musical sound

examples.text: He played the first few notes of the melody on the piano.
examples.translation_cn: 他在钢琴上弹奏了旋律的前几个音符。

senses.meaning_en: to notice or pay attention to

examples.text: Please note that all visitors must sign in at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 请注意，所有访客必须在前台登记。

senses.meaning_en: attention or notice

examples.text: Please take note of the emergency exit locations on the map.
examples.translation_cn: 请留意地图上紧急出口的位置。

senses.meaning_en: a brief record of something written down to help memory

examples.text: She took detailed notes during the meeting to share with her team.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会议期间做了详细笔记，以便与团队分享。

senses.meaning_en: that which is normal or typical

examples.text: Taking a gap year is the norm among university students in some countries.
examples.translation_cn: 在一些国家，大学生休学一年是常态。

senses.meaning_en: a rule that is socially enforced

examples.text: People often feel pressure to conform to social norms.
examples.translation_cn: 人们常常感到遵从社会规范的压力。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the natural world

examples.text: Air pollution is a major environmental problem in many cities.
examples.translation_cn: 空气污染是许多城市的一个主要环境问题。

senses.meaning_en: concerned with protecting the environment

examples.text: Local environmental groups are calling for stricter pollution controls.
examples.translation_cn: 当地环保组织正在呼吁更严格的污染管控。

senses.meaning_en: to give an official title, honour, or advantage to somebody

examples.text: The university will confer an honorary degree on her.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学将授予她荣誉学位。

senses.meaning_en: to discuss something with somebody, especially to exchange opinions or reach a decision

examples.text: The manager conferred with her team before making the decision.
examples.translation_cn: 经理在做出决定之前与她的团队进行了商议。

senses.meaning_en: a customer or someone who receives services, especially from a professional

examples.text: She is a regular client of a small accounting firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一家小型会计事务所的常客。

senses.meaning_en: a computer program or device that requests services from a server
senses.pattern: client sends sth to a server

examples.text: The client sends a request to the server every minute.
examples.translation_cn: 该客户端每分钟向服务器发送一次请求。

senses.meaning_en: a distinct part of the economy or society

examples.text: She has worked in the public sector for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公共部门工作了十年。

senses.meaning_en: a part of a circle between two radii

examples.text: The teacher drew a sector of a circle on the whiteboard.
examples.translation_cn: 老师在白板上画了一个圆扇形。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of data storage on a disk

examples.text: The hard drive reads a sector in just a few milliseconds.
examples.translation_cn: 硬盘在几毫秒内就能读取一个扇区。

senses.meaning_en: poetry; writing arranged in lines with rhythm and often rhyme

examples.text: He soon wrote the whole story in verse.
examples.translation_cn: 他很快就把整个故事写成了韵文。

senses.meaning_en: a group of lines forming a unit of a song or poem
senses.pattern: the second verse of the song

examples.text: The second verse of the song is my favorite.
examples.translation_cn: 那首歌的第二段主歌是我最喜欢的。

senses.meaning_en: a small numbered section of a holy book, especially the Bible

examples.text: She quoted a verse from the Bible to comfort him.
examples.translation_cn: 她引用了一节圣经经文来安慰他。

senses.meaning_en: the situation or circumstances in which something happens

examples.text: The policy should be understood in the context of the economic crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 这项政策应在经济危机的背景下理解。

senses.meaning_en: the words that surround a word or passage and help determine its meaning

examples.text: It is important to study new words in context rather than in isolation.
examples.translation_cn: 重要的是结合语境学习生词，而不是孤立地学习。

senses.meaning_en: physically strong and healthy

examples.text: He keeps fit by jogging every morning before work.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天早上上班前慢跑保持健康。

senses.meaning_en: to be the right size and shape for somebody/something

examples.text: This dress fits me well, so I'll take it.
examples.translation_cn: 这条连衣裙很合身，我就买它了。

senses.meaning_en: suitable; good enough

examples.text: She is clearly fit for the role of team leader.
examples.translation_cn: 她显然适合团队领导的角色。

senses.meaning_en: to put or fix something in the right place
senses.collocation: fit a handle to a door

examples.text: He fitted a new lock to the front door.
examples.translation_cn: 他给前门装了一把新锁。

senses.meaning_en: a lawyer who advises or represents clients in legal matters

examples.text: You should hire an attorney before signing the contract.
examples.translation_cn: 签合同前你应该聘请律师。

senses.meaning_en: a person authorized to act on another's behalf

examples.text: She was authorized to act as attorney for her elderly mother.
examples.translation_cn: 她被授权担任她年迈母亲的代理人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes part in an activity or event

examples.text: She was an active participant in the discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 她是讨论的积极参与者。

senses.meaning_en: a place where films, television or radio programmes, or recordings are made

examples.text: The film crew is shooting the final scene in the studio.
examples.translation_cn: 摄制组正在摄影棚内拍摄最后一场戏。

senses.meaning_en: a room where an artist or photographer works

examples.text: She works in a bright artist's studio filled with canvases.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一间摆满画布的明亮画室里工作。

senses.meaning_en: a small apartment with one main room for living and sleeping

examples.text: She rents a small studio apartment near the university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学附近租了一间小型单间公寓。

senses.meaning_en: a place where an art or activity is taught

examples.text: She takes ballet classes at a dance studio near her office.
examples.translation_cn: 她在办公室附近的一家舞蹈室上芭蕾课。

senses.meaning_en: a tall upright post on a ship that carries sails

examples.text: The sailor climbed the mast of a ship to fix the sail.
examples.translation_cn: 水手爬上船的桅杆去修理帆。

senses.meaning_en: a tall pole used to support a radio, television, or flag

examples.text: They erected a tall mast for the new radio antenna.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为新的无线电天线竖起了一根高杆。

senses.meaning_en: following as a result or effect

examples.text: The closure of the factory was consequent on a sharp drop in demand.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂的关闭是需求急剧下降所导致的。

senses.meaning_en: the act of evaluating or judging something

examples.text: The committee will make an assessment of the damage.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将对损失作出评估。

senses.meaning_en: an official amount calculated as payable, especially tax

examples.text: He received a tax assessment of $2,000 last week.
examples.translation_cn: 他上周收到了一份2,000美元的纳税核定单。

senses.meaning_en: at the present time; now

examples.text: Our company is currently hiring several new engineers.
examples.translation_cn: 我们公司目前正在招聘几名新工程师。

senses.meaning_en: to make changes to text or data

examples.text: She edited the report before sending it to her manager.
examples.translation_cn: 她在把报告发给经理之前编辑了该报告。

senses.meaning_en: to select and arrange material for a film, recording, or broadcast

examples.text: The director spent weeks editing the film before its release.
examples.translation_cn: 导演在电影上映前花了好几周剪辑这部影片。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to text, data, etc.

examples.text: She made a few edits to the article before it was published.
examples.translation_cn: 文章发表前她对其做了一些编辑修改。

senses.meaning_en: to make changes to genetic material, especially DNA

examples.text: Scientists are using new tools to edit human genes in the lab.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家正在实验室使用新工具编辑人类基因。

senses.meaning_en: an edited version of a video, image, etc.

examples.text: She posted a short video edit on social media.
examples.translation_cn: 她在社交媒体上发布了一段短视频剪辑。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or things with shared features

examples.text: These products fall into several distinct categories based on their use.
examples.translation_cn: 这些产品根据用途分为几个不同的类别。

senses.meaning_en: very important or notable in history

examples.text: The discovery of antibiotics is of historic importance.
examples.translation_cn: 抗生素的发现具有重大历史意义。

senses.meaning_en: old-fashioned; from the past; not modern

examples.text: We stayed in a historic quarter of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 我们住在城里一个历史悠久的街区。

senses.meaning_en: to seize or clutch suddenly

examples.text: The child grabbed at the toy on the shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子伸手去抓架子上的玩具。

senses.meaning_en: to attract and hold attention

examples.text: The shocking headline in the newspaper immediately grabbed everyone's attention.
examples.translation_cn: 报纸上那则令人震惊的标题立刻吸引了所有人的注意。

senses.meaning_en: to take advantage of quickly

examples.text: She grabbed the chance to study abroad last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年抓住了出国留学的机会。

senses.meaning_en: to get or eat quickly

examples.text: Let's grab a bite to eat before the movie starts.
examples.translation_cn: 电影开始前我们赶紧吃点东西吧。

senses.meaning_en: the state of not having a job; a period of joblessness

examples.text: He went through a period of unemployment after leaving school.
examples.translation_cn: 毕业后他经历了一段失业期。

senses.meaning_en: the phenomenon of joblessness in an economy; the number of people without jobs

examples.text: The unemployment rate dropped to four percent last month.
examples.translation_cn: 上个月失业率降到了4%。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to someone or something

examples.text: She is a valuable asset to the team.
examples.translation_cn: 她是团队中很有价值的人。

senses.meaning_en: a thing of value, especially property owned by a person or company

examples.text: The court froze all of his personal assets.
examples.translation_cn: 法院冻结了他的所有个人财产。

senses.meaning_en: something that is intended; purpose
senses.pattern: with the intent of doing sth

examples.text: She took a second job with the intent of saving for a home.
examples.translation_cn: 她找了第二份工作，目的是攒钱买房。

senses.meaning_en: firmly fixed or concentrated on something; determined to do something

examples.text: She was absolutely intent on winning the national competition.
examples.translation_cn: 她全神贯注，一心要赢得全国比赛。

senses.meaning_en: the state of mind at the time of committing a crime

examples.text: The court heard evidence of his intent to kill.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭听取了他有杀人意图的证据。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal act; a crime

examples.text: He committed a serious offence and was fined heavily.
examples.translation_cn: 他犯下了严重罪行并被处以重罚。

senses.meaning_en: the act of upsetting or insulting someone

examples.text: She took offence at his joke about her age.
examples.translation_cn: 她因他拿她的年龄开玩笑而感到冒犯。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a game that tries to score points

examples.text: The home team was on offence for most of the first half.
examples.translation_cn: 主队在上半场大部分时间都在进攻。

senses.meaning_en: a company or business

examples.text: She runs a medium-sized enterprise that exports furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 她经营一家出口家具的中型企业。

senses.meaning_en: a large or difficult project, especially one that is daring

examples.text: They embarked on a bold enterprise to build a school in the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 他们启动了一项大胆的计划，要在山区建一所学校。

senses.meaning_en: the ability and willingness to think of new projects and make them succeed

examples.text: She showed great enterprise in setting up her own business.
examples.translation_cn: 她表现出极大的进取心，创办了自己的企业。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a corporation or business

examples.text: She has years of experience in the corporate world.
examples.translation_cn: 她在企业界有多年的经验。

senses.meaning_en: shared by all members of a group

examples.text: The team made a corporate effort to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 团队为按时完成项目做出了集体努力。

senses.meaning_en: a self-contained component of a system, often interchangeable, with a well-defined interface

examples.text: A faulty module in a system should be replaced immediately to avoid further damage.
examples.translation_cn: 系统中的故障模块应立即更换，以避免进一步损坏。

senses.meaning_en: a separable section of a spacecraft or other vehicle

examples.text: The lunar module landed on the Moon in 1969.
examples.translation_cn: 登月舱于1969年降落在月球上。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of education covering a single topic

examples.text: All first-year students take a module on academic writing.
examples.translation_cn: 所有一年级学生都选修学术写作课程模块。

senses.meaning_en: a device for lifting heavy objects, especially vehicles

examples.text: He lifted the car with a hydraulic jack.
examples.translation_cn: 他用液压千斤顶把车抬起来。

senses.meaning_en: a socket for connecting electrical equipment

examples.text: Plug your headphones into the jack on the front panel.
examples.translation_cn: 把耳机插入前面板的插孔。

senses.meaning_en: a playing card with a picture of a young man, ranking below a queen

examples.text: She played the jack of hearts and won the trick.
examples.translation_cn: 她打出红心J赢了一墩。

senses.meaning_en: to raise something using a jack

examples.text: We jacked up the car to change a flat tire.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用千斤顶顶起汽车换掉漏气的轮胎。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to design or maintain computer systems
senses.collocation: systems analyst at a tech company

examples.text: My brother works as a systems analyst at a software company.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥在一家软件公司担任系统分析师。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to study financial markets and give investment advice
senses.collocation: financial analyst for an investment bank

examples.text: She works as a financial analyst for an investment bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家投资银行担任金融分析师。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives expert opinions on political or social issues

examples.text: He is a political analyst for a national news network, commenting on current affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一家全国新闻网络的政治评论员，对时事进行评论。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to examine information or data in order to explain or understand it

examples.text: She works as a data analyst for a market research firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家市场调研公司担任数据分析员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has recently joined an organization, especially after a ceremony

examples.text: She became an initiate of the secret society after the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 仪式结束后，她成了这个秘密社团的入会者。

senses.meaning_en: to make something begin

examples.text: The government initiated a public debate on the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 政府就新法律发起了一场公开辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to teach someone the basic facts or skills of something

examples.text: The course initiates students into the basic methods of scientific research.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程让学生初步了解科学研究的基本方法。

senses.meaning_en: the subjects, course content, and standards taught at a school or university

examples.text: Digital literacy is now on the national curriculum.
examples.translation_cn: 数字素养已纳入国家课程大纲。

senses.meaning_en: the central figure of the Christian religion, believed to be the son of God

examples.text: Christians believe in Jesus as the Son of God.
examples.translation_cn: 基督徒相信耶稣是上帝之子。

senses.meaning_en: used to express surprise, anger, or frustration

examples.text: Oh Jesus, I left my keys in the car again!
examples.translation_cn: 天哪，我又把钥匙落在车里了！

senses.meaning_en: connected with a particular race or group of people sharing culture, language, etc.

examples.text: The city is home to people from different ethnic backgrounds.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市居住着来自不同种族背景的人们。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to or typical of a particular culture, especially a minority or traditional one

examples.text: The city has many restaurants serving authentic ethnic food.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市有许多供应正宗民族风味菜肴的餐馆。

senses.meaning_en: to happen or follow one after another repeatedly; to make things do this

examples.text: The course alternates between lectures and group discussions.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程在讲座和小组讨论之间交替进行。

senses.meaning_en: happening or following one after another regularly; alternating

examples.text: The cake had alternate layers of chocolate and vanilla.
examples.translation_cn: 蛋糕有巧克力层和香草层交替。

senses.meaning_en: every other; every second (in a series)

examples.text: The medication should be taken on alternate days.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药应每隔一天服用。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes the place of another; a substitute

examples.text: She was selected as an alternate for the Olympic team.
examples.translation_cn: 她被选为奥林匹克队伍的替补队员。

senses.meaning_en: other; alternative

examples.text: We took an alternate route to avoid the heavy traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走了另一条路线以避开拥堵的交通。

senses.meaning_en: of the Roman Catholic faith

examples.text: Many people in my small hometown are Catholic.
examples.translation_cn: 我家乡的许多人是天主教徒。

senses.meaning_en: including a wide range of things; all-embracing

examples.text: He has catholic tastes in music and art.
examples.translation_cn: 他对音乐和艺术有广泛的兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the Catholic Church

examples.text: She is a devout Catholic who attends Mass every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位虔诚的天主教徒，每周日参加弥撒。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being a member of a group or organization

examples.text: Membership of the society is open to all students.
examples.translation_cn: 该协会的会员资格对所有学生开放。

senses.meaning_en: the body of members of an organization

examples.text: The membership of the club voted to change the rules.
examples.translation_cn: 俱乐部全体会员投票修改规则。

senses.meaning_en: the number of members of a group

examples.text: The club has a membership of over 1,000 people.
examples.translation_cn: 该俱乐部有一千多名会员。

senses.meaning_en: a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided

examples.text: Cost is a criterion for deciding between these options.
examples.translation_cn: 成本是在这些选项之间做决定的一个标准。

senses.meaning_en: an evaluation of status, especially financial status

examples.text: The company has a credit rating of AAA from two agencies.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司从两家机构获得了AAA信用评级。

senses.meaning_en: a score showing quality or popularity

examples.text: The latest model got a rating of 9.2 from reviewers.
examples.translation_cn: 最新款获得了评论家9.2分的评分。

senses.meaning_en: a measure of audience size for a program

examples.text: Ratings for the show dropped sharply last season.
examples.translation_cn: 该节目的收视率在上季大幅下滑。

senses.meaning_en: the maximum power or capacity of a device

examples.text: Check the power rating of the motor before connecting it.
examples.translation_cn: 连接前请检查电机的额定功率。

senses.meaning_en: all the visible features of an area of land

examples.text: The landscape of the island changes dramatically from north to south.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛的风景从北到南变化很大。

senses.meaning_en: the distinctive features of a particular situation or activity

examples.text: New technologies are changing the landscape of journalism.
examples.translation_cn: 新技术正在改变新闻业的格局。

senses.meaning_en: to improve the appearance of a piece of land by changing the design and planting trees, flowers, etc.

examples.text: They landscaped the hotel grounds with native trees and flowers.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用当地树木和花卉美化了酒店庭院。

senses.meaning_en: a painting, photograph or drawing that shows an area of land

examples.text: She painted a landscape of the valley in watercolours.
examples.translation_cn: 她用水彩画了一幅山谷风景画。

senses.meaning_en: a way of printing or displaying a page so that its width is greater than its height

examples.text: If the table is too wide, print the page in landscape mode.
examples.translation_cn: 如果表格太宽，请将页面横向打印。

senses.meaning_en: a depiction or portrayal of someone or something

examples.text: The documentary provides an accurate representation of working-class life in the 1970s.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片准确地展现了20世纪70年代工人阶级的生活。

senses.meaning_en: a figure, image or idea that replaces or stands for reality

examples.text: The photograph is only a representation of the event, not the event itself.
examples.translation_cn: 照片只是事件的表象，而不是事件本身。

senses.meaning_en: the act or right of being represented, especially in government or law

examples.text: The new policy guarantees equal representation in local government.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策保证在地方政府中的平等代表权。

senses.meaning_en: a formal statement or protest made to influence someone
senses.pattern: make representations to sb about sth

examples.text: The union made representations to the board about the proposed pay cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 工会就拟议的减薪向董事会提出了正式抗议。

senses.meaning_en: a person, company, or country that produces goods or services

examples.text: Brazil is the world's largest producer of coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 巴西是世界上最大的咖啡生产国。

senses.meaning_en: a person who arranges the money, people, and equipment for a film, play, television programme, etc.

examples.text: She is the producer of the new television series.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这部新电视剧的制作人。

senses.meaning_en: a method or system of management

examples.text: The company has a strict regime of quality control.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司有一套严格的质量管理制度。

senses.meaning_en: a government, especially an authoritarian one

examples.text: They lived under a military regime for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一个军事政权下生活了几十年。

senses.meaning_en: a regulated system for health or fitness

examples.text: She follows a strict fitness regime every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上都遵循严格的健身方案。

senses.meaning_en: a period of rule

examples.text: During the regime of the former dictator, the press was heavily censored.
examples.translation_cn: 在前独裁者统治时期，新闻受到严格审查。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to notice things through the senses

examples.text: The test measures an infant's perception of depth and distance.
examples.translation_cn: 这项测试测量婴儿对深度和距离的感知。

senses.meaning_en: a belief or opinion based on how things seem

examples.text: There is a common perception that the economy is getting worse.
examples.translation_cn: 人们普遍认为经济正在恶化。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to understand things quickly and clearly

examples.text: She had the perception to realize that the plan was flawed.
examples.translation_cn: 她有洞察力，意识到这个计划有缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: a set of moving parts in a machine that performs a task

examples.text: The locking mechanism on this door is easy to operate.
examples.translation_cn: 这扇门上的锁定机构操作简便。

senses.meaning_en: a mental, physical, or chemical process

examples.text: Researchers are studying the mechanism by which the virus enters cells.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员正在研究病毒进入细胞的机理。

senses.meaning_en: a method or system for achieving something

examples.text: The company has a clear mechanism for reporting safety problems.
examples.translation_cn: 公司有一个报告安全问题的明确机制。

senses.meaning_en: a person accused or sued in a court of law

examples.text: The defendant in the fraud case denied all charges.
examples.translation_cn: 该诈骗案中的被告否认了所有指控。

senses.meaning_en: to discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement

examples.text: We will negotiate with the landlord about the rent next week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下周将与房东协商租金问题。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange or settle something by mutual agreement

examples.text: They successfully negotiated a merger agreement with the rival firm.
examples.translation_cn: 他们与竞争对手公司成功商定了一份合并协议。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed in getting over or past a difficulty or obstacle

examples.text: The driver negotiated the sharp bend carefully on the icy road.
examples.translation_cn: 司机在结冰的路面上小心地通过了急转弯。

senses.meaning_en: the process of achieving agreement through discussion

examples.text: The company is in negotiations with several suppliers over a new contract.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司正与几家供应商就新合同进行谈判。

senses.meaning_en: an obligation, debt or responsibility owed to someone

examples.text: The company has full liability for any damage caused by its products.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司对其产品造成的任何损害承担全部责任。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that causes problems or holds you back

examples.text: He is a liability to the team because he lacks experience.
examples.translation_cn: 他缺乏经验，是团队的累赘。

senses.meaning_en: the likelihood of something happening or being susceptible to something

examples.text: Smokers have a higher liability to heart disease.
examples.translation_cn: 吸烟者患心脏病的风险更高。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or event telling someone that something bad may happen

examples.text: The referee gave him a warning for a dangerous tackle.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判因危险铲球给了他一次警告。

senses.meaning_en: used in signs and notices to warn of danger

examples.text: Warning: this area is monitored by security cameras.
examples.translation_cn: 警告：此区域有监控摄像头。

senses.meaning_en: a sign that something bad may happen

examples.text: The dark clouds were a warning of the approaching storm.
examples.translation_cn: 乌云是暴风雨即将来临的预兆。

senses.meaning_en: the act of becoming involved in a situation to change it

examples.text: The UN called for military intervention in the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 联合国呼吁对这场危机进行军事干预。

senses.meaning_en: unwanted interference in another's affairs

examples.text: They prefer to settle the dispute without foreign intervention.
examples.translation_cn: 他们宁愿在没有外国干涉的情况下解决争端。

senses.meaning_en: a medical procedure or action taken to improve health

examples.text: The child received immediate medical intervention at the scene.
examples.translation_cn: 这名儿童在现场立即接受了医疗干预。

senses.meaning_en: to quote or refer to as evidence

examples.text: She cited a recent study as strong evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 她引用了一项近期研究作为有力证据。

senses.meaning_en: to mention or give as an example

examples.text: He cited the new policy as an example of progress.
examples.translation_cn: 他以新政策作为进步的一个例子。

senses.meaning_en: to list the sources from which information was taken

examples.text: In academic writing, you must cite sources you have consulted.
examples.translation_cn: 在学术写作中，你必须注明参考过的来源。

senses.meaning_en: to summon officially to appear in court

examples.text: He was cited for driving without a license.
examples.translation_cn: 他因无证驾驶被传讯。

senses.meaning_en: a figure or other artistic depiction of Jesus Christ

examples.text: This early icon shows Christ as a shepherd.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅早期的圣像把基督画成牧羊人。

senses.meaning_en: used to express surprise or anger

examples.text: Christ almighty, what a mess in this room!
examples.translation_cn: 天哪，这个房间真是一团糟！

senses.meaning_en: in a specific manner; explicitly

examples.text: The terms specifically state that all sales are final.
examples.translation_cn: 条款明确规定所有销售概不退换。

senses.meaning_en: for a specific purpose or reason

examples.text: This course was specifically designed for working adults.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程是专门为在职成年人设计的。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce a more exact statement or example

examples.text: More specifically, the rule applies only to full-time employees.
examples.translation_cn: 更确切地说，该规定只适用于全职员工。

senses.meaning_en: firm and determined; unwavering

examples.text: The team remained resolute in defending their title despite injuries.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管伤病，球队在卫冕之路上依然坚决。

senses.meaning_en: to enlarge by filling with air or gas; to become filled with air or gas

examples.text: She inflated the balloon with a small hand pump.
examples.translation_cn: 她用手动气泵给气球充了气。

senses.meaning_en: to increase something, especially a price or number, in an unreasonable or artificial way; to make something seem more important than it really is

examples.text: The company inflated its sales figures by including pending orders.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司通过计入未完成订单虚增了销售数字。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of filling something with air or gas; expansion

examples.text: The inflation of the tyre only takes a minute with this pump.
examples.translation_cn: 用这个气泵给轮胎充气只需一分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a general rise in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money

examples.text: The rate of inflation has fallen to its lowest level in five years.
examples.translation_cn: 通货膨胀率已降至五年来的最低水平。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of business, especially an act of buying or selling

examples.text: We completed the transaction for the used car online.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在线完成了那辆二手车的交易。

senses.meaning_en: an act of moving money into or out of a bank account

examples.text: You can make a transaction at any branch or through online banking.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在任何分行或通过网上银行办理转账交易。

senses.meaning_en: the process of carrying out business or an official matter

examples.text: The committee conducts the transaction of business at its monthly meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会在每月例会上办理业务。

senses.meaning_en: a single operation in a computer system that is treated as one unit

examples.text: A database transaction must be completed fully or not at all.
examples.translation_cn: 数据库事务必须完全完成，否则就一点也不做。

senses.meaning_en: to communicate with others

examples.text: The teacher encourages students to interact with each other in class.
examples.translation_cn: 老师鼓励学生在课堂上相互交流。

senses.meaning_en: to have an effect on each other

examples.text: Certain drugs can interact with alcohol and cause harm.
examples.translation_cn: 某些药物会与酒精相互作用并造成伤害。

senses.meaning_en: to include something as a part or combine it into a whole

examples.text: We incorporated your suggestions into the final report.
examples.translation_cn: 我们将你的建议纳入了最终报告。

senses.meaning_en: to form a legal company

examples.text: The founders decided to incorporate the business in Delaware.
examples.translation_cn: 创始人决定在特拉华州注册成立这家公司。

senses.meaning_en: to mix an ingredient into a mixture

examples.text: Gently incorporate the melted butter into the flour mixture.
examples.translation_cn: 轻轻地将融化的黄油拌入面粉混合物中。

senses.meaning_en: legal action

examples.text: She threatened to begin proceedings against the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她威胁要对医院提起诉讼。

senses.meaning_en: a series of events or actions

examples.text: The audience was asked to remain silent during the proceedings.
examples.translation_cn: 观众被要求在活动进行期间保持安静。

senses.meaning_en: published record of a conference or meeting

examples.text: The study was published in the proceedings of the conference.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究发表在该会议的论文集中。

senses.meaning_en: the system or type of money used in a country

examples.text: Most hotels here accept payment in foreign currency, but smaller guesthouses may not.
examples.translation_cn: 这里大多数酒店接受外币付款，但较小的旅馆可能不行。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being commonly accepted or used

examples.text: The idea that stress contributes to illness has gained currency among doctors.
examples.translation_cn: 压力会导致疾病这一观点已得到医生们的普遍认同。

senses.meaning_en: to pull a vehicle, boat, etc. behind another vehicle using a rope or chain

examples.text: The breakdown truck towed the damaged car away to the nearest garage.
examples.translation_cn: 救援车把损坏的车拖到了最近的修理厂。

senses.meaning_en: an act of towing or the state of being towed

examples.text: A passing truck gave us a tow to the garage.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆路过的卡车把我们的车拖到了修理厂。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or idea accepted as true and used as the basis of an argument or story

examples.text: The plan was accepted on the premise that demand would keep growing.
examples.translation_cn: 该计划是在需求将持续增长的前提下获得批准的。

senses.meaning_en: the buildings and land that a business or organization uses

examples.text: All visitors must sign in at the office on the premises.
examples.translation_cn: 所有访客必须在本大楼内的办公室登记。

senses.meaning_en: to base an argument or theory on a particular idea or belief

examples.text: The argument is premised on the assumption that markets are efficient.
examples.translation_cn: 这一论点建立在市场是有效的这一假设之上。

senses.meaning_en: money provided for a particular purpose, especially by a government or organization

examples.text: The university secured funding for a new cancer research centre.
examples.translation_cn: 该大学为新的癌症研究中心争取到了资金。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of providing money for something

examples.text: Government funding of public libraries has been cut this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年政府对公共图书馆的资助被削减了。

senses.meaning_en: treatment of a physical or mental illness

examples.text: She has been in therapy for depression for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她因抑郁症接受心理治疗已经两年了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who speaks on behalf of a group or organization

examples.text: A spokesman for the company confirmed the new policy on Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 公司发言人周一证实了这项新政策。

senses.meaning_en: to establish or create something, especially a committee or institution

examples.text: The university constituted a special committee to review the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 大学设立了一个特别委员会来审查这项提案。

senses.meaning_en: to be the parts that form something; to make up

examples.text: Women constitute approximately 30 percent of the workforce.
examples.translation_cn: 女性约占劳动力的30%。

senses.meaning_en: to be or be considered as something; to amount to

examples.text: The rise in unemployment constitutes a serious threat to social stability.
examples.translation_cn: 失业率的上升是对社会稳定的严重威胁。

senses.meaning_en: a thin slice of potato fried until crisp

examples.text: He opened a bag of chips and shared them with his sister.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开一包薯片和他妹妹分享。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of semiconductor material with an integrated circuit

examples.text: The silicon chip in this phone is very powerful.
examples.translation_cn: 这款手机里的硅芯片非常强大。

senses.meaning_en: a token used in gambling instead of money

examples.text: He cashed in his chips and left the casino.
examples.translation_cn: 他兑换了筹码离开了赌场。

senses.meaning_en: a small damaged area where a piece has broken off

examples.text: There is a chip in the rim of this cup.
examples.translation_cn: 这个杯子的边缘有一个缺口。

senses.meaning_en: a stupid or inconsiderate person

examples.text: Stop acting like an ass and listen to what she has to say.
examples.translation_cn: 别像个傻瓜，听听她要说什么。

senses.meaning_en: the buttocks; the part of the body you sit on

examples.text: I slipped on the ice and fell on my ass.
examples.translation_cn: 我在冰上滑倒了，一屁股坐在地上。

senses.meaning_en: a donkey

examples.text: The old ass brayed loudly at the break of dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 老驴在破晓时分大声叫。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate or estimate an amount

examples.text: The accountant reckoned the total cost at $2 million.
examples.translation_cn: 会计估算总成本为200万美元。

senses.meaning_en: to think or suppose

examples.text: I reckon that the new policy will fail within a year.
examples.translation_cn: 我认为新政策一年内就会失败。

senses.meaning_en: to regard or rank someone or something as having a particular quality or value

examples.text: She is reckoned among the best surgeons in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 她被列为全国最好的外科医生之一。

senses.meaning_en: the act of passing through or stopping briefly in a place while travelling

examples.text: Passengers in transit through the country do not need a visa.
examples.translation_cn: 过境该国的旅客不需要签证。

senses.meaning_en: the process of moving people or goods from one place to another

examples.text: The shipment was damaged in transit and returned to the sender.
examples.translation_cn: 这批货物在运输途中受损，被退回给寄件人。

senses.meaning_en: the system of buses, trains, etc. that the public can use

examples.text: Many commuters travel by public transit instead of driving.
examples.translation_cn: 许多通勤者乘坐公共交通出行，而不是开车。

senses.meaning_en: the passage of a celestial body across another or across the meridian

examples.text: Astronomers observed the transit of Mercury across the Sun.
examples.translation_cn: 天文学家观测到水星从太阳表面经过。

senses.meaning_en: the process of changing from one state, form, or place to another

examples.text: The region's transition from agriculture to industry took decades.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区从农业向工业的过渡花了几十年。

senses.meaning_en: a word or phrase that connects one part of a discourse to another

examples.text: Writers often use a transition to guide readers from one idea to the next.
examples.translation_cn: 作者经常使用过渡词引导读者从一个观点到下一个观点。

senses.meaning_en: a book for keeping photos, stamps, etc.

examples.text: She keeps her travel photos in an album.
examples.translation_cn: 她把旅行照片保存在相册里。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of songs released together as a record, CD, or digital download

examples.text: The singer will release an album later this year.
examples.translation_cn: 这位歌手将于今年晚些时候发行一张专辑。

senses.meaning_en: the chess piece that moves diagonally

examples.text: She moved her bishop to b5, pinning the knight.
examples.translation_cn: 她把象走到 b5，牵制了马。

senses.meaning_en: a type of African weaverbird

examples.text: A flock of bishops nested in the reeds by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 一群主教鸟在河边的芦苇丛中筑巢。

senses.meaning_en: a temporary union of groups or organizations for a shared purpose

examples.text: Several environmental groups formed a coalition with local farmers to protect the river.
examples.translation_cn: 几个环保团体与当地农民结成联盟，以保护这条河流。

senses.meaning_en: a government formed by two or more political parties

examples.text: After weeks of negotiation, the two parties agreed to form a coalition government.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数周谈判，两党同意组建联合政府。

senses.meaning_en: A physical or mental feature indicating a disease.

examples.text: A sore throat is a common symptom of the flu.
examples.translation_cn: 喉咙痛是流感的常见症状。

senses.meaning_en: A sign of the existence of something, especially something undesirable.

examples.text: Rising crime is often a symptom of social unrest.
examples.translation_cn: 犯罪率上升往往是社会动荡的征兆。

senses.meaning_en: a person employed to inspect something

examples.text: An inspector of mines checked the tunnels daily.
examples.translation_cn: 一名矿井检查员每天检查隧道。

senses.meaning_en: a police officer ranking below superintendent

examples.text: Inspector Chen took charge of the murder investigation.
examples.translation_cn: 陈巡官负责这起谋杀案调查。

senses.meaning_en: a period of reduced economic activity

examples.text: The economy fell into recession after the financial crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 金融危机后，经济陷入了衰退。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has intentionally killed themself

examples.text: A suicide left a note saying goodbye to his family.
examples.translation_cn: 一名自杀者留下字条向家人告别。

senses.meaning_en: the act of intentionally killing oneself

examples.text: He committed suicide after losing his job last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年失业后自杀了。

senses.meaning_en: at the beginning

examples.text: He initially seemed to enjoy the job, but later he quit.
examples.translation_cn: 他起初似乎喜欢这份工作，但后来辞职了。

senses.meaning_en: a punishment for breaking a rule or law

examples.text: The court imposed a heavy penalty on the company for breaking safety laws.
examples.translation_cn: 法院因该公司违反安全法规而对其处以重罚。

senses.meaning_en: a punishment in a game for breaking a rule, often a free shot at goal

examples.text: The referee awarded a penalty after the defender handled the ball.
examples.translation_cn: 后卫手球后，裁判判罚了点球。

senses.meaning_en: a disadvantage or bad result caused by something

examples.text: Many small businesses are now paying the penalty for borrowing too heavily.
examples.translation_cn: 许多小企业如今正因过度借贷而尝到苦果。

senses.meaning_en: a talk giving information about something

examples.text: She gave a presentation on climate change in class.
examples.translation_cn: 她在课堂上就气候变化做了报告。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving or awarding something

examples.text: The presentation of prizes will follow the speeches.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲后将颁发奖品。

senses.meaning_en: the act of showing or submitting something

examples.text: Discounts are available on presentation of a student card.
examples.translation_cn: 出示学生证可享受折扣。

senses.meaning_en: a slideshow created on a computer

examples.text: She created a PowerPoint presentation for the sales meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她为销售会议制作了一份演示文稿。

senses.meaning_en: an advance to a higher rank or position

examples.text: Her promotion to senior manager surprised no one.
examples.translation_cn: 她升任高级经理，没人感到意外。

senses.meaning_en: activities to advertise or sell something

examples.text: The company launched a costly promotion for its new smartphone.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司为其新智能手机发起了一场昂贵的促销活动。

senses.meaning_en: the act of encouraging or supporting the development of something

examples.text: The campaign supports the promotion of healthy eating in schools.
examples.translation_cn: 该活动支持在学校推广健康饮食。

senses.meaning_en: the change of a pawn into another piece in chess

examples.text: In the endgame, the pawn's promotion to queen decided the game.
examples.translation_cn: 残局中，兵升变为后决定了胜负。

senses.meaning_en: a formal agreement or relationship between countries, political parties, groups, etc. to work together; the state of being allied

examples.text: The two countries formed an alliance with several neighboring states.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个国家与几个邻国结成了联盟。

senses.meaning_en: the people, countries, or groups that are united in an alliance

examples.text: An alliance of small nations opposed the resolution.
examples.translation_cn: 一个由小国组成的联盟反对这项决议。

senses.meaning_en: the act of judging or assessing something, or a statement of that judgment

examples.text: The committee will conduct an evaluation of the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将对新政策进行评估。

senses.meaning_en: afterwards; later

examples.text: The results were subsequently confirmed by a second study.
examples.translation_cn: 结果随后得到了第二项研究的证实。

senses.meaning_en: to offer to pay a particular price, especially at an auction

examples.text: I decided to bid on the painting before the auction closed.
examples.translation_cn: 我决定在拍卖结束前出价买那幅画。

senses.meaning_en: to make an attempt to achieve or obtain something

examples.text: The city is bidding to host the next Olympic Games.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市正在争取主办下一届奥运会。

senses.meaning_en: to order or tell someone to do something

examples.text: The guard bade us stand back from the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 卫兵命令我们退离大门。

senses.meaning_en: to utter a greeting or salutation

examples.text: She bid her friends farewell and left for the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 她向朋友们告别，然后前往机场。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of the mind and behaviour

examples.text: She wants to study psychology at a leading university.
examples.translation_cn: 她想在一所顶尖大学学习心理学。

senses.meaning_en: the typical way a person or group thinks and behaves

examples.text: The report examines the psychology of online shoppers.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告考察了网购者的心理。

senses.meaning_en: a medical facility where patients receive treatment, especially without staying overnight

examples.text: She had her injured knee examined at a walk-in clinic.
examples.translation_cn: 她在免预约诊所检查了受伤的膝盖。

senses.meaning_en: an organization or center that offers specialized advice or treatment

examples.text: The university runs a legal clinic for low-income families.
examples.translation_cn: 该大学为低收入家庭开设了一个法律咨询处。

senses.meaning_en: a short course or class offering practical instruction or training
