examples.translation_cn: 该国于1975年与邻国建立了外交关系。

senses.meaning_en: to make a process or action easier or to help bring it about
senses.pattern: facilitate communication between A and B

examples.text: The new software facilitates communication between remote teams.
examples.translation_cn: 新软件促进了远程团队之间的沟通。

senses.meaning_en: to preside over a meeting or discussion

examples.text: As a consultant, she facilitates workshops on team building.
examples.translation_cn: 作为顾问，她主持团队建设研讨会。

senses.meaning_en: by which; according to which

examples.text: The company has introduced a system whereby employees can choose their working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 公司推出了一项制度，员工据此可以选择自己的工作时间。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that follows or takes the place of another

examples.text: She is the most likely successor to the current president.
examples.translation_cn: 她是最有可能接替现任总裁的人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has the legal right to inherit a title, office, or property

examples.text: The prince is the rightful successor to the throne.
examples.translation_cn: 王子是王位的合法继承人。

senses.meaning_en: a small printed sheet of paper used to advertise or give information

examples.text: She picked up a leaflet about the new community centre.
examples.translation_cn: 她拿起一张关于新社区中心的传单。

senses.meaning_en: to distribute leaflets to people or an area

examples.text: Volunteers planned to leaflet the area ahead of the vote.
examples.translation_cn: 志愿者们计划在投票前到该地区散发传单。

senses.meaning_en: to distribute leaflets, especially in a public place

examples.text: They planned to leaflet outside the station before the rally.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划在集会前到车站外散发传单。

senses.meaning_en: so strong as to be impossible to resist
senses.pattern: an overwhelming urge to do sth

examples.text: She felt an overwhelming urge to call her mother.
examples.translation_cn: 她感到一股难以抑制的冲动想给母亲打电话。

senses.meaning_en: very great or intense

examples.text: The bill was passed by an overwhelming majority of the committee.
examples.translation_cn: 该法案以委员会压倒性多数通过。

senses.meaning_en: to tear or become torn

examples.text: The dog ripped the toy apart in seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 狗几秒钟就把玩具撕碎了。

senses.meaning_en: to remove something violently or wrongly

examples.text: He ripped the tickets right from her hand.
examples.translation_cn: 他猛地从她手里抢走了票。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly and destructively

examples.text: The storm ripped through the coastal town overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨一夜之间席卷了沿海小镇。

senses.meaning_en: a tear or split in something

examples.text: There is a rip in my jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 我的夹克上有个裂口。

senses.meaning_en: a green leafy plant used to flavour or season food

examples.text: She seasoned the soup with fresh herbs from her garden.
examples.translation_cn: 她用自家花园里的新鲜香草给汤调味。

senses.meaning_en: a plant whose roots, leaves, or seeds are used in medicine

examples.text: He uses dried medicinal herbs to treat mild headaches.
examples.translation_cn: 他用干药草治疗轻微的头痛。

senses.meaning_en: a range of different things, ideas, or qualities

examples.text: The survey covered a broad spectrum of opinions.
examples.translation_cn: 这项调查涵盖了广泛的观点。

senses.meaning_en: the range of electromagnetic radiation wavelengths, including visible light

examples.text: Astronomers study many kinds of radiation across the electromagnetic spectrum.
examples.translation_cn: 天文学家研究电磁波谱中的多种辐射。

senses.meaning_en: the range of neurodevelopmental conditions related to autism

examples.text: He was diagnosed as being on the autism spectrum.
examples.translation_cn: 他被诊断患有自闭症谱系障碍。

senses.meaning_en: at some time in the past; previously

examples.text: The company was formerly known as Acme Software.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司以前名为 Acme Software。

senses.meaning_en: a frightening dream

examples.text: I had a nightmare about being chased by a dog.
examples.translation_cn: 我做了个噩梦，梦见被狗追。

senses.meaning_en: an extremely unpleasant or difficult situation or experience

examples.text: The first week of the project was a nightmare for everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 项目的第一周对每个人来说都糟透了。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is very difficult to deal with
senses.pattern: be a nightmare to deal with

examples.text: This client is a nightmare to deal with over email.
examples.translation_cn: 这个客户通过邮件沟通时很难缠。

senses.meaning_en: the group of people in an organization who have power
senses.pattern: at the top of the hierarchy

examples.text: He remained at the top of the church hierarchy for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在教会领导层顶端待了二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a system in which things are ranked one above another

examples.text: A hierarchy of needs helps explain why people seek safety before status.
examples.translation_cn: 需求层次有助于解释为什么人们先求安全后求地位。

senses.meaning_en: a system of social or organizational ranking

examples.text: In a social hierarchy, wealth often determines a person's status.
examples.translation_cn: 在社会等级制度中，财富常常决定一个人的地位。

senses.meaning_en: the head of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.text: Pope Francis called for peace in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 教皇方济各呼吁该地区和平。

senses.meaning_en: in a consistent way; always behaving or happening in a similar, especially positive, way

examples.text: She consistently produces excellent results in her exams.
examples.translation_cn: 她在考试中一贯取得优异成绩。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that does not contradict or disagree with something

examples.text: The committee acted consistently with the established guidelines.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会按照既定指导方针行事。

senses.meaning_en: a floor of a building below ground level

examples.text: We keep our old furniture in the basement.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把旧家具存放在地下室。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being productive, fertile, or efficient

examples.text: Productivity in the factory has risen steadily since the new system was introduced.
examples.translation_cn: 自新系统引入以来，这家工厂的生产率稳步提高。

senses.meaning_en: a belief or set of beliefs held by a group, especially in religion or politics

examples.text: The church teaches the doctrine that salvation comes through faith.
examples.translation_cn: 教会教导因信得救的教义。

senses.meaning_en: an official principle or policy that guides a country's foreign affairs

examples.text: The country followed the doctrine of non-interference in its foreign policy.
examples.translation_cn: 该国在外交政策上奉行不干涉原则。

senses.meaning_en: a list of questions used to collect information

examples.text: Please fill in this questionnaire about your shopping habits.
examples.translation_cn: 请填写这份关于你购物习惯的问卷。

senses.meaning_en: a statement about what will happen in the future

examples.text: She made a prediction about who would win the election.
examples.translation_cn: 她预测了谁将赢得选举。

senses.meaning_en: a calculation or statement about what is likely to happen based on statistics

examples.text: The statistical prediction of next month's sales was accurate.
examples.translation_cn: 对下个月销售额的统计预测是准确的。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of society, social relationships, and social interaction

examples.text: She is studying the sociology of education this term.
examples.translation_cn: 她这学期正在学习教育社会学。

senses.meaning_en: the underlying framework or foundation that supports an organization, system, or building

examples.text: The company plans to upgrade the infrastructure of its data network.
examples.translation_cn: 公司计划升级其数据网络的基础架构。

senses.meaning_en: the basic systems and services needed for a country or community to function

examples.text: The government plans to invest in infrastructure next year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府计划明年投资基础设施建设。

senses.meaning_en: haphazard; unpredictable

examples.text: The survey was based on a random sample of adults.
examples.translation_cn: 这项调查基于随机抽取的成年人样本。

senses.meaning_en: odd; unexplained

examples.text: Some random guy just started shouting at me.
examples.translation_cn: 一个莫名其妙的家伙刚才冲我大喊大叫。

senses.meaning_en: sensible and practical; based on what is real or achievable

examples.text: You need to be realistic about how long the project will take.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要对项目需要多长时间有现实的认识。

senses.meaning_en: showing things as they really are

examples.text: The robot's facial expressions look realistic, almost human.
examples.translation_cn: 这个机器人的面部表情看起来逼真，几乎像人类。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is accurate or without mistakes

examples.text: She answered every question correctly on the test.
examples.translation_cn: 她在测试中每道题都答对了。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is socially acceptable or proper

examples.text: It is important to behave correctly at formal dinners.
examples.translation_cn: 在正式晚宴上举止得体很重要。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of regret for having done wrong

examples.text: She felt guilt about ignoring her brother's call.
examples.translation_cn: 她因没接哥哥的电话而感到内疚。

senses.meaning_en: the state of having been found guilty or admitted guilt in legal proceedings
senses.pattern: prove sb's guilt beyond reasonable doubt

examples.text: The prosecution failed to prove his guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
examples.translation_cn: 检方未能确凿证明他有罪。

senses.meaning_en: responsibility for wrongdoing

examples.text: The company accepted guilt for the oil spill.
examples.translation_cn: 公司承认对漏油事件负有责任。

senses.meaning_en: To cause someone to feel guilt, particularly in order to influence their behaviour.

examples.text: He guilted me into giving him a ride home.
examples.translation_cn: 他让我感到内疚，只好开车送他回家。

senses.meaning_en: to make fun of someone or something in an unkind way

examples.text: The tabloids ridiculed the celebrity for her outfit.
examples.translation_cn: 小报嘲笑那位名人的穿着。

senses.meaning_en: unkind laughter or remarks that show you think someone or something is stupid

examples.text: The proposal was subjected to ridicule by critics.
examples.translation_cn: 该提议遭到评论家的嘲笑。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is made fun of

examples.text: His once-respected theories are now an object of ridicule.
examples.translation_cn: 他一度受人尊敬的理论如今成了笑柄。

senses.meaning_en: very impressive or amazing

examples.text: The view from the top looked spectacular in the clear morning light.
examples.translation_cn: 从山顶眺望，景色在清晨的阳光下显得壮观极了。

senses.meaning_en: a spectacular display or show

examples.text: The network will put on a spectacular for the holiday season.
examples.translation_cn: 该电视网将为假日季推出一档特别节目。

senses.meaning_en: a large tree of the genus Quercus

examples.text: We rested in the shade of an oak tree and read.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一棵橡树的树荫下休息读书。

senses.meaning_en: the hard wood of the oak tree

examples.text: This desk is made of oak, so it is very heavy.
examples.translation_cn: 这张桌子是橡木做的，所以很重。

senses.meaning_en: a rich brown color like oak wood

examples.text: These boots are available in oak and black.
examples.translation_cn: 这些靴子有橡木色和黑色可选。

senses.meaning_en: the flavor that comes from oak wood

examples.text: This Chardonnay has notes of oak and vanilla.
examples.translation_cn: 这款霞多丽带有橡木和香草的香气。

senses.meaning_en: (of a disease) lasting for a long time; difficult to cure

examples.text: If left untreated, the infection can become chronic.
examples.translation_cn: 如果不治疗，感染可能会变成慢性。

senses.meaning_en: (of a problem) lasting for a long time; difficult to solve

examples.text: Youth unemployment is a chronic problem in this region.
examples.translation_cn: 青年失业是这个地区一个长期存在的问题。

senses.meaning_en: (of a person) doing the same bad thing again and again; impossible to cure

examples.text: My uncle has been a chronic gambler since he was young.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔从年轻时起就是个积习难改的赌徒。

senses.meaning_en: (informal) very bad

examples.text: The weather has been chronic all week, so we stayed indoors.
examples.translation_cn: 这一周天气都很糟糕，所以我们一直待在家里。

senses.meaning_en: to live in a particular place permanently or for a long time

examples.text: My grandparents reside in a quiet village near the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父母住在海边附近一个安静的村庄里。

senses.meaning_en: to exist or be present in something

examples.text: The beauty of the plan resides in its simplicity.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划的美妙之处在于它的简单。

senses.meaning_en: to be vested in or belong to somebody/something

examples.text: The authority to appoint judges resides with the president.
examples.translation_cn: 任命法官的权力属于总统。

senses.meaning_en: happening at the same time

examples.text: The announcement was simultaneous with the product launch.
examples.translation_cn: 公告与产品发布同时进行。

senses.meaning_en: at the same time

examples.text: The new software update will be released simultaneously with the mobile app.
examples.translation_cn: 新软件更新将与移动应用同步发布。

senses.meaning_en: the lever pressed to fire a gun

examples.text: He slowly pulled the trigger and fired a single shot.
examples.translation_cn: 他慢慢扣动扳机，开了一枪。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes a reaction or event

examples.text: Stress can be a trigger for many health problems.
examples.translation_cn: 压力可能是许多健康问题的诱因。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes a strong negative emotional reaction

examples.text: That comment was a trigger for him, bringing back painful memories.
examples.translation_cn: 那番话对他来说是个情绪触发点，勾起了痛苦的回忆。

senses.meaning_en: legally taking another person's child and raising it as one's own

examples.text: The twins were put up for adoption as soon as they were born.
examples.translation_cn: 这对双胞胎一出生就被送去收养。

senses.meaning_en: starting to use something new or different such as a method or idea

examples.text: The adoption of electric vehicles has accelerated in recent years.
examples.translation_cn: 电动汽车的采用近年来加快了。

senses.meaning_en: formal acceptance of a plan, law, etc.

examples.text: The council unanimously approved the adoption of the new regulation.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会一致通过了新条例。

senses.meaning_en: a list of names, businesses, or organizations, often with contact details and arranged alphabetically
senses.pattern: look sth up in a directory

examples.text: You can look up the clinic's number in the telephone directory.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在电话簿里查到诊所的电话号码。

senses.meaning_en: a computer folder or a structured list of files stored on a device

examples.text: The installer stores temporary files in a hidden directory.
examples.translation_cn: 安装程序将临时文件存储在一个隐藏目录中。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of paper or card used to cast a vote

examples.text: Voters will cast a ballot for their preferred candidate.
examples.translation_cn: 选民将为自己喜欢的候选人投票。

senses.meaning_en: the process of voting, especially in secret

examples.text: The committee will elect its leader by secret ballot.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将通过无记名投票选出领导人。

senses.meaning_en: to vote by ballot

examples.text: Workers will ballot on the new pay offer tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们明天将就新的薪酬方案进行投票。

senses.meaning_en: the total number of votes cast in an election

examples.text: The youngest candidate topped the ballot in the local election.
examples.translation_cn: 最年轻的候选人在地方选举中得票最多。

senses.meaning_en: a net of thin threads that a spider makes

examples.text: The spider spun a large web between two branches.
examples.translation_cn: 蜘蛛在两根树枝间织了一张大网。

senses.meaning_en: the system of connected documents on the internet; the World Wide Web

examples.text: I found the recipe on the web in just a few minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 我几分钟就在网上找到了这个食谱。

senses.meaning_en: a complicated series of connections or an interconnected set of people or things

examples.text: The inquiry revealed a web of lies and corruption.
examples.translation_cn: 调查揭示了一张谎言和腐败的关系网。

senses.meaning_en: a good reason, explanation, or excuse for something

examples.text: There is no justification for treating her so unfairly.
examples.translation_cn: 没有理由如此不公平地对待她。

senses.meaning_en: the act by which God forgives a person's sins and accepts them as righteous

examples.text: The church teaches justification by faith, not by works.
examples.translation_cn: 教会教导因信称义，而不是因行为称义。

senses.meaning_en: a senior official in a college or university, in charge of a faculty or academic affairs

examples.text: She was appointed dean of the Faculty of Arts last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被任命为文学院院长。

senses.meaning_en: a priest in charge of a cathedral chapter

examples.text: The dean of the cathedral led the morning service.
examples.translation_cn: 大教堂的教长主持了晨祷。

senses.meaning_en: very specific, clear, or detailed

examples.text: The report makes the company's long-term goals explicit to all employees.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告让所有员工都明确了公司的长期目标。

senses.meaning_en: saying something openly and directly, without hiding anything

examples.text: She was explicit about her disappointment with the decision.
examples.translation_cn: 她直言不讳地表达了对该决定的失望。

senses.meaning_en: describing or showing sexual or violent activity in a very detailed way

examples.text: The film was criticized for its sexually explicit scenes.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因其露骨的色情场景而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: very great; deeply felt

examples.text: Her visit had a profound effect on the whole community.
examples.translation_cn: 她的到访对整个社区产生了深远影响。

senses.meaning_en: needing a lot of thought; difficult to understand

examples.text: The article is too profound for most readers.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章对大多数读者来说太深奥了。

senses.meaning_en: to officially end a law, system, institution, custom or practice

examples.text: The government decided to abolish the outdated tax law.
examples.translation_cn: 政府决定废除过时的税法。

senses.meaning_en: an organized group that tries to influence government decisions

examples.text: The gun lobby has spent millions trying to weaken the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 枪支游说团体花费数百万试图削弱新法律。

senses.meaning_en: a virtual waiting area where meeting participants wait to be admitted by the host

examples.text: All participants must wait in the lobby until the host admits them.
examples.translation_cn: 所有参与者必须在等候室等候，直到主持人允许他们进入。

senses.meaning_en: an entrance hall or reception area in a public building

examples.text: We will meet in the lobby before checking in.
examples.translation_cn: 我们将在办理入住前在大堂见面。

senses.meaning_en: a virtual area where online players can chat and find opponents before a game

examples.text: Players can chat and find opponents in the game lobby before a match.
examples.translation_cn: 玩家可以在比赛前在游戏大厅聊天并寻找对手。

senses.meaning_en: a physical feeling or perception

examples.text: She felt a sensation of cold as the door opened.
examples.translation_cn: 门打开时，她感到一阵寒冷。

senses.meaning_en: a widespread reaction of interest and excitement; a person or thing that causes it

examples.text: The young singer caused a sensation with her first single.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻歌手的第一首单曲引起了轰动。

senses.meaning_en: a particular characteristic or quality

examples.text: Patience is a trait of a good teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 耐心是一位好老师的特质。

senses.meaning_en: of high quality; high-end

examples.text: This hotel offers premium services to business travelers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店为商务旅客提供优质服务。

senses.meaning_en: the amount paid for an insurance policy

examples.text: You have to pay a higher premium for full coverage.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须为全面保险支付更高的保险费。

senses.meaning_en: an extra amount added to a normal price or payment

examples.text: Organic fruit usually sells at a premium in supermarkets.
examples.translation_cn: 有机水果在超市通常售价更高。

senses.meaning_en: a prize or extra reward

examples.text: The top salesperson received a cash premium for his results.
examples.translation_cn: 最佳销售员因业绩获得现金奖励。

senses.meaning_en: the fact that something can be obtained or used

examples.text: The availability of affordable housing is a major concern in many cities.
examples.translation_cn: 可负担住房的可获得性是许多城市的一大问题。

senses.meaning_en: something that is available, especially a room or time that can be booked

examples.text: The hotel still has availability for the holiday weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店在假期周末仍有可预订房间。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being free to see or talk to people

examples.text: Please confirm your availability for an interview on Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请确认你周五是否有空参加面试。

senses.meaning_en: a section at the end of a book or article with extra information

examples.text: The full interview is available in the appendix.
examples.translation_cn: 完整访谈见附录。

senses.meaning_en: a small organ near the lower intestine

examples.text: He had his appendix removed after a sudden infection.
examples.translation_cn: 他突然感染后切除了阑尾。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to something; the act of changing something

examples.text: We made several modifications to the original design.
examples.translation_cn: 我们对原始设计做了几处修改。

senses.meaning_en: a public meeting or place for discussion

examples.text: The school will hold a forum on road safety.
examples.translation_cn: 学校将举办一场关于道路安全的论坛。

senses.meaning_en: an online message board where people can discuss topics

examples.text: She decided to post on a forum to ask for advice.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定在论坛上发帖寻求建议。

senses.meaning_en: having meaning, significance, or purpose

examples.text: The volunteer work was meaningful to everyone involved.
examples.translation_cn: 这项志愿工作对每个参与者都有意义。

senses.meaning_en: full of unstated meaning or implication

examples.text: She gave him a meaningful look before leaving the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她离开房间前意味深长地看了他一眼。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong feeling of fear that makes it hard to think or act clearly

examples.text: The crowd rushed to the exits in a panic when the alarm rang.
examples.translation_cn: 警报响起时，人群惊慌地涌向出口。

senses.meaning_en: to suddenly feel so frightened that you cannot think clearly or act sensibly

examples.text: He panicked about his final exams and couldn't sleep the night before.
examples.translation_cn: 他因期末考试而惊慌失措，前一晚无法入睡。

senses.meaning_en: caused by or connected with panic

examples.text: Panic buying left supermarket shelves empty within hours.
examples.translation_cn: 恐慌性抢购让超市货架几小时内就空了。

senses.meaning_en: a person in a marriage or marital relationship

examples.text: He introduced his spouse to the team during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会议上向团队介绍了他的配偶。

senses.meaning_en: an extra amount of money added to someone's pay

examples.text: She received a bonus of £2,000 this year.
examples.translation_cn: 她今年收到了2000英镑的奖金。

senses.meaning_en: something extra that is good or useful

examples.text: As a bonus, the hotel offers free breakfast to all guests.
examples.translation_cn: 作为额外福利，酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。

senses.meaning_en: extra points added to a player's score

examples.text: Players earn bonus points for finishing the level quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 玩家快速完成关卡可获得奖励分。

senses.meaning_en: a soft silver-white metal, chemical element Na

examples.text: Processed foods are often high in sodium and can raise blood pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 加工食品通常钠含量高，会升高血压。

senses.meaning_en: a violent disturbance by a crowd

examples.text: Riots broke out in the city after the verdict.
examples.translation_cn: 判决宣布后，该市爆发了骚乱。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in a riot

examples.text: The prisoners rioted against the poor conditions in the jail.
examples.translation_cn: 囚犯们因监狱条件恶劣而闹事。

senses.meaning_en: a wide and unconstrained variety

examples.text: The garden was a riot of colour in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天花园里五彩缤纷。

senses.meaning_en: a very funny or entertaining person

examples.text: Her uncle is a riot at family gatherings.
examples.translation_cn: 她叔叔在家庭聚会上是个活宝。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain a substance from something by processing

examples.text: The factory extracts oil from locally grown sunflower seeds.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂从当地种植的葵花籽中提取油。

senses.meaning_en: to remove or pull out, especially by force

examples.text: The dentist extracted the broken tooth from the patient's gum.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医从病人的牙龈中取出了那颗断牙。

senses.meaning_en: to get information, money, etc. from someone who does not want to give it

examples.text: The police extracted a confession from the suspect during interrogation.
examples.translation_cn: 警方在审讯中从嫌疑人那里获取了口供。

senses.meaning_en: a short passage from a larger work

examples.text: The teacher read an extract from the novel to the class.
examples.translation_cn: 老师给全班读了小说的一个节选。

senses.meaning_en: a concentrated substance obtained from something

examples.text: The syrup is made from an extract of bitter orange peel.
examples.translation_cn: 这种糖浆由苦橙皮提取物制成。

senses.meaning_en: to give your time and effort to a particular purpose because you think it is important

examples.text: She has dedicated herself to helping the poor.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直致力于帮助穷人。

senses.meaning_en: to use a particular time, space, money, etc. only for a particular purpose

examples.text: He dedicated his weekends to fixing up the old house.
examples.translation_cn: 他把周末专门用来整修老房子。

senses.meaning_en: to say at the beginning of a book, piece of music, etc. that it was written for a particular person

examples.text: The author dedicated her first novel to her parents.
examples.translation_cn: 这位作家把她的第一部小说献给了父母。

senses.meaning_en: to give a building, especially a church, to God or a saint in a special ceremony

examples.text: The ancient Greeks dedicated the temple to Athena.
examples.translation_cn: 古希腊人把这座神庙奉献给雅典娜。

senses.meaning_en: to become pregnant with a child

examples.text: After years of trying, she finally conceived a child last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的努力，她去年春天终于怀上了孩子。

senses.meaning_en: to form an idea or plan in the mind

examples.text: The plan was well conceived and attracted many investors.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划构思得很好，吸引了许多投资者。

senses.meaning_en: to imagine something or think of it as something

examples.text: Many people conceive of the Internet as a public space.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人把互联网想象成一个公共空间。

senses.meaning_en: to understand something

examples.text: I cannot conceive what he means by that remark.
examples.translation_cn: 我无法理解他那句话的意思。

senses.meaning_en: to provide food and drink for an event

examples.text: The restaurant caters for weddings and birthday parties.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅为婚礼和生日聚会提供饮食。

senses.meaning_en: to provide what is wanted or needed

examples.text: The new policy caters to the needs of families with young children.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策满足了有年幼子女的家庭的需要。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being involved or interested in something

examples.text: Her engagement with local charities has grown over the years.
examples.translation_cn: 这些年来，她与当地慈善机构的互动越来越多。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement to do something or meet someone, especially to speak or perform

examples.text: She can't attend the party because she has a prior engagement.
examples.translation_cn: 她因有约在先，不能参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: an agreement to get married

examples.text: She announced her engagement to her college sweetheart last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周宣布了与大学恋人的婚约。

senses.meaning_en: fighting between armed forces

examples.text: The two armies met in a fierce engagement near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 两军在河边进行了一场激烈的交战。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that has the same position or function as another in a different place or situation

examples.text: She met her counterpart in the Berlin office to discuss the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她与柏林办事处的对口人员会面，讨论新政策。

senses.meaning_en: causing wonder or surprise; astonishing

examples.text: It is marvellous that a tiny seed can grow into a towering tree.
examples.translation_cn: 一粒小小的种子能长成参天大树，真令人惊叹。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; wonderful

examples.text: It is marvellous to spend a quiet afternoon by the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 在湖边度过一个安静的下午真是太好了。

senses.meaning_en: surrounded by; in the middle of (a place)

examples.text: A small cabin stood amid the pine trees.
examples.translation_cn: 一座小木屋矗立在松树林中。

senses.meaning_en: during something; in the middle of an event or situation

examples.text: The official announcement came amid growing economic uncertainty.
examples.translation_cn: 官方公告在日益增长的经济不确定性中发布。

senses.meaning_en: a person who earns a living by trading goods
senses.pattern: make a living as a trader

examples.text: She makes a living as a spice trader in the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 她靠做香料商人谋生，住在老城区。

senses.meaning_en: a person who buys and sells financial instruments such as shares or currencies

examples.text: He works as a currency trader at a bank in Singapore.
examples.translation_cn: 他在新加坡一家银行担任外汇交易员。

senses.meaning_en: to say exactly what illness a person has after examining them

examples.text: The patient was diagnosed with diabetes last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这位病人去年被诊断出患有糖尿病。

senses.meaning_en: to find out the cause of a problem or fault

examples.text: Experts are trying to diagnose why the system crashed.
examples.translation_cn: 专家们正试图查明系统崩溃的原因。

senses.meaning_en: to form a mental picture of something, especially something that may happen in the future

examples.text: I can't envisage living without access to the internet.
examples.translation_cn: 我无法想象没有网络的生活。

senses.meaning_en: to expect or consider that something will happen or be the case

examples.text: It is envisaged that the new tax will take effect next month.
examples.translation_cn: 预计新税将于下个月生效。

senses.meaning_en: graceful and attractive in style or manner

examples.text: She looked elegant in a silk evening gown.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着丝绸晚礼服看起来很优雅。

senses.meaning_en: clever but simple

examples.text: The algorithm offers an elegant solution to this common problem.
examples.translation_cn: 这种算法为这个常见问题提供了一个简洁巧妙的解决方案。

senses.meaning_en: minimalist, intuitive, and precise

examples.text: The software has an elegant design that is both intuitive and precise.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件设计优雅，既直观又精准。

senses.meaning_en: a large printed picture or notice put on a wall for decoration or advertising

examples.text: She put up a poster of her favorite singer on the bedroom wall.
examples.translation_cn: 她把喜欢的歌手的海报贴在卧室墙上。

senses.meaning_en: a person who posts a message online

examples.text: He is a frequent poster on several online forums.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常在几个在线论坛上发帖。

senses.meaning_en: to admit defeat, surrender, or yield

examples.text: The champion refused to concede to the challenger even after a clear defeat.
examples.translation_cn: 冠军即使在明显失利后仍拒绝向挑战者认输。

senses.meaning_en: to admit that something is true

examples.text: He reluctantly conceded that the plan might not work.
examples.translation_cn: 他不情愿地承认这个计划可能行不通。

senses.meaning_en: to give something away or allow something, often unwillingly

examples.text: The country refused to concede any territory to its neighbor.
examples.translation_cn: 该国拒绝向邻国让出任何领土。

senses.meaning_en: to have a goal or point scored against you

examples.text: The team conceded a goal just before half-time.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在半场结束前丢了一球。

senses.meaning_en: the act of conceding something, especially in an argument or negotiation

examples.text: He made a major concession and admitted the plan was flawed.
examples.translation_cn: 他作出了重大让步，承认计划有缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: a gift or act freely given as a token of respect or to gain favor

examples.text: The company gave the staff an extra day off as a concession to their hard work.
examples.translation_cn: 公司给员工额外放一天假，以感谢他们的辛勤工作。

senses.meaning_en: an item sold at a concession stand

examples.text: We bought popcorn and other concessions at the theater concession stand.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在剧院小卖部买了爆米花等食品。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is eligible for a reduced price

examples.text: Students and seniors qualify for concessions at the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 学生和老年人在博物馆可享受优惠。

senses.meaning_en: to put your arms around someone and hold them closely, especially to show love

examples.text: She hugged her mother tightly before getting on the train.
examples.translation_cn: 上火车前，她紧紧拥抱了母亲。

senses.meaning_en: an act of putting your arms around someone and holding them closely

examples.text: He gave his son a big hug when he came home.
examples.translation_cn: 儿子回家时，他给了他一个大大的拥抱。

senses.meaning_en: to hold each other closely

examples.text: The two friends hugged each other and said goodbye at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 两个朋友在机场互相拥抱告别。

senses.meaning_en: to stay close to something such as a road, coast, or path

examples.text: The road hugs the coast for several miles.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路紧贴海岸延伸数英里。

senses.meaning_en: to raise something to a higher position

examples.text: The doctor told him to elevate his injured leg above his heart.
examples.translation_cn: 医生让他把受伤的腿抬到心脏上方。

senses.meaning_en: to promote someone to a higher rank or give them an honour

examples.text: The board elevated her to the position of chief executive last year.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会去年晋升她为首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel happier or more hopeful

examples.text: The good news elevated everyone's spirits at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 这个好消息让会上所有人都振奋起来。

senses.meaning_en: to increase the level or amount of something
senses.pattern: elevate sth to a higher level

examples.text: These reforms will elevate safety standards to a higher level.
examples.translation_cn: 这些改革将把安全标准提升到更高水平。

senses.meaning_en: a fight or angry disagreement

examples.text: There was a clash between police and protesters after the demonstration.
examples.translation_cn: 示威游行后，警察和抗议者之间发生了冲突。

senses.meaning_en: a combination that looks bad because colours or styles do not match

examples.text: The bright pink sofa and orange curtains are a clash of colours.
examples.translation_cn: 亮粉色沙发和橙色窗帘颜色不协调。

senses.meaning_en: a sports match

examples.text: The cup final was a clash between the two rivals.
examples.translation_cn: 杯赛决赛是两支劲敌之间的一场交锋。

senses.meaning_en: a loud ringing sound made by metal objects hitting each other

examples.text: The two swords met with a clash of metal.
examples.translation_cn: 两把剑相撞，发出金属撞击声。

senses.meaning_en: either of the two latitudes about 23.5° north and south of the equator

examples.text: The Tropic of Cancer runs through the Sahara Desert.
examples.translation_cn: 北回归线穿过撒哈拉沙漠。

senses.meaning_en: the hot region between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn

examples.text: Many rare plants grow only in the tropics.
examples.translation_cn: 许多稀有植物只在热带地区生长。

senses.meaning_en: a distinct, independent unit, especially an organization

examples.text: The trust is a separate entity from the foundation.
examples.translation_cn: 该信托是一个独立于基金会的实体。

senses.meaning_en: a data item stored in a database

examples.text: Each entity in a database must have a unique identifier.
examples.translation_cn: 数据库中的每个实体都必须有一个唯一标识符。

senses.meaning_en: to intend in advance for a particular future, role, or purpose

examples.text: She was destined to become a famous writer.
examples.translation_cn: 她注定会成为一位著名作家。

senses.meaning_en: to intend for a particular destination

examples.text: The large cargo ship is destined for Shanghai.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘大型货轮预定开往上海。

senses.meaning_en: a report or message containing the latest information

examples.text: The manager gave us an update on the project timeline.
examples.translation_cn: 经理向我们通报了项目时间表的最新进展。

senses.meaning_en: to make something more modern or up to date

examples.text: Please update your contact details on the website.
examples.translation_cn: 请在网站上更新您的联系方式。

senses.meaning_en: a newer version of a product or document

examples.text: A new update to the app was released yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 这款应用的新版本昨天发布了。

senses.meaning_en: to inform someone about recent developments

examples.text: Please update me on any changes to the schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 请随时告知我日程表的任何变动。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of exploring unknown places or space

examples.text: The exploration of Mars has revealed evidence of ancient water.
examples.translation_cn: 对火星的探索发现了远古存在水的证据。

senses.meaning_en: the act of searching for natural resources such as oil or minerals

examples.text: The company began exploration for natural gas in the North Sea.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司开始在北海勘探天然气。

senses.meaning_en: the act of examining or discussing something in detail

examples.text: Her latest article is an exploration into the causes of poverty.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新的文章是对贫困成因的探讨。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or opinion that is discussed and proved with evidence

examples.text: The central thesis is that social media harms focus in subtle ways.
examples.translation_cn: 核心论点是社交媒体以微妙的方式损害注意力。

senses.meaning_en: a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree

examples.text: She is writing her PhD thesis on urban poverty.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在写关于城市贫困的博士论文。

senses.meaning_en: an independent state or republic

examples.text: The country officially became a commonwealth after independence.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家独立后正式成为一个联邦。

senses.meaning_en: the general good

examples.text: He donated his fortune for the commonwealth to fund public hospitals.
examples.translation_cn: 他捐出财产用于公共福利，资助公立医院。

senses.meaning_en: less important than something else

examples.text: These tasks are subsidiary to the main objective.
examples.translation_cn: 这些任务从属于主要目标。

senses.meaning_en: a company controlled by another company

examples.text: The company is a subsidiary of a large European group.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司是一家大型欧洲集团的子公司。

senses.meaning_en: the rate or act of happening

examples.text: The incidence of malaria has fallen sharply in this area.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区疟疾的发病率已大幅下降。

senses.meaning_en: the striking of radiation or a projectile upon a surface

examples.text: Light at normal incidence is less likely to be reflected.
examples.translation_cn: 光垂直入射时较少被反射。

senses.meaning_en: a person who receives something

examples.text: The recipient of the package must sign here.
examples.translation_cn: 包裹的收件人必须在这里签字。

senses.meaning_en: a person who receives an organ or tissue from a donor

examples.text: She was the recipient of a kidney transplant last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年接受了肾移植。

senses.meaning_en: an inclination or prejudice for or against something
senses.pattern: have a bias against/in favour of

examples.text: The committee was accused of having a bias against younger applicants.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会被指控对较年轻申请人有偏见。

senses.meaning_en: to influence someone unfairly or cause to have a bias

examples.text: The one-sided report biased the jury against the defendant.
examples.translation_cn: 那份片面报道使陪审团对被告产生了偏见。

senses.meaning_en: making a strong impression

examples.text: It is striking that nobody noticed the error.
examples.translation_cn: 令人惊讶的是竟无人注意到这个错误。

senses.meaning_en: on strike; taking part in industrial action

examples.text: Striking airline pilots caused hundreds of flight cancellations.
examples.translation_cn: 正在罢工的航空公司飞行员导致数百架次航班取消。

senses.meaning_en: extremely interesting or captivating

examples.text: It is fascinating to watch how ants build their nests.
examples.translation_cn: 观察蚂蚁如何筑巢非常有趣。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or action that shows respect and admiration

examples.text: The mayor paid tribute to the fallen firefighters in his speech.
examples.translation_cn: 市长在演讲中向牺牲的消防员致敬。

senses.meaning_en: a sign that shows how good something is

examples.text: Their successful rescue was a tribute to the team's careful planning.
examples.translation_cn: 他们成功的救援体现了团队周密的计划。

senses.meaning_en: a payment or gift given by one nation to another in submission

examples.text: The defeated kingdom sent tribute to the empire every year.
examples.translation_cn: 战败的王国每年向帝国进贡。

senses.meaning_en: money demanded by criminals for protection

examples.text: The mob extorted tribute from local businesses for protection.
examples.translation_cn: 那个黑帮向当地商家勒索保护费。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree

examples.text: We must minimize the risk of infection during surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须尽量减少手术期间感染的风险。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem less important or serious than it really is

examples.text: He tried to minimize the importance of his mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图贬低自己错误的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce a window to an icon on the taskbar

examples.text: To minimize a window, click the minimize button.
examples.translation_cn: 要最小化窗口，请点击最小化按钮。

senses.meaning_en: a person killed or injured in an accident or war

examples.text: The regiment suffered heavy casualties in the battle.
examples.translation_cn: 该团在战斗中伤亡惨重。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that suffers badly from an event or situation

examples.text: The village school was a casualty of the spending cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 那所乡村学校成了削减开支的牺牲品。

senses.meaning_en: the emergency department of a hospital (British English)

examples.text: He was taken to casualty with a suspected fracture.
examples.translation_cn: 他被送往急诊室，可能是骨折。

senses.meaning_en: in a firm or secure way; not loosely

examples.text: She held her mother's hand tightly in the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 在人群中她紧紧抓着母亲的手。

senses.meaning_en: closely, with little space between parts

examples.text: They packed the clothes tightly into the suitcase.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把衣服紧紧地塞进手提箱里。

senses.meaning_en: in a controlled and tense way, showing anger or annoyance

examples.text: "I don't want to discuss it," she said tightly.
examples.translation_cn: "我不想讨论这件事，"她生硬地说。

senses.meaning_en: to think about something carefully for a long time

examples.text: He is contemplating moving abroad but has not made a final decision.
examples.translation_cn: 他在考虑移居国外，但尚未做出最终决定。

senses.meaning_en: to intend or plan to do something

examples.text: He is contemplating retirement next year after three decades in the job.
examples.translation_cn: 他打算明年退休，已经在这份工作上干了三十年。

senses.meaning_en: to look at someone or something attentively or thoughtfully

examples.text: The couple paused at the viewpoint to contemplate the view in silence.
examples.translation_cn: 夫妇俩在观景台停下来，默默地凝视着景色。

senses.meaning_en: the part left over after other parts have been used or removed

examples.text: The remainder of the group stayed behind to discuss the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 小组中其余的人留下来讨论计划。

senses.meaning_en: the amount left over after division
senses.pattern: the remainder when ... is divided by ...

examples.text: The remainder when 25 is divided by 4 is 1.
examples.translation_cn: 25除以4的余数是1。

senses.meaning_en: a book sold at a reduced price because it has not sold well

examples.text: The store sold its unsold books as remainders at half price.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店把未售出的书作为滞销书半价出售。

senses.meaning_en: to become involved in a situation in order to change or prevent it

examples.text: The government refused to intervene in the currency market.
examples.translation_cn: 政府拒绝干预货币市场。

senses.meaning_en: to interrupt somebody when they are speaking

examples.text: She intervened to say that the figures were incorrect.
examples.translation_cn: 她插话说这些数字不准确。

senses.meaning_en: to happen between two events or points in time

examples.text: We heard nothing from them during the intervening period.
examples.translation_cn: 在中间那段时间里，我们没有他们的任何消息。

senses.meaning_en: to make something smaller or less

examples.text: The new evidence greatly diminished the impact of his argument.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据大大削弱了他论据的影响力。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something seem less important or valuable

examples.text: He never diminishes the achievements of his colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 他从不贬低同事的成就。

senses.meaning_en: to become smaller or less

examples.text: The pain diminished gradually after I took the medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 我服药后疼痛逐渐减轻。

senses.meaning_en: to become gradually weaker or smaller until it disappears

examples.text: The glow of the fire slowly diminished to nothing as dawn broke.
examples.translation_cn: 随着黎明到来，火焰的微光慢慢消失。

senses.meaning_en: the act of preventing or hindering something

examples.text: Prevention of disease is always better than treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 预防疾病总是胜于治疗。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a large city or its surrounding area

examples.text: Crime rates tend to be higher in metropolitan areas than in rural regions.
examples.translation_cn: 大都会地区的犯罪率往往高于农村地区。

senses.meaning_en: a bishop who oversees other bishops; an archbishop

examples.text: The metropolitan of the church province called the bishops to a synod.
examples.translation_cn: 该教会省的大主教召集主教们开宗教会议。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being understanding and caring about other people's feelings

examples.text: A good nurse shows sensitivity towards patients who are anxious.
examples.translation_cn: 好护士对焦虑的病人表现出体贴。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being easily affected or harmed by light, heat, or a substance

examples.text: Some patients develop a sensitivity to light after taking this medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 有些病人在服用这种药后会对光敏感。

senses.meaning_en: the tendency to be easily upset or offended

examples.text: His sensitivity to criticism makes it hard for him to accept feedback.
examples.translation_cn: 他对批评过于敏感，很难接受反馈。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of needing to be treated carefully because it may be secret or cause problems

examples.text: The lawyer reminded the team of the sensitivity of the case.
examples.translation_cn: 律师提醒团队案件具有敏感性。

senses.meaning_en: the stock of goods available for sale or use

examples.text: The store keeps a large inventory of spare parts.
examples.translation_cn: 这家店备有大量备件库存。

senses.meaning_en: a complete list of items

examples.text: We made a full inventory of office equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为办公设备做了一份完整清单。

senses.meaning_en: the process of making a list or counting stock

examples.text: We need to take inventory before closing the store.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要在关店前盘点库存。

senses.meaning_en: to make a list of or count items on hand

examples.text: Staff will inventory the remaining supplies on Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 员工将在周五清点剩余物资。

senses.meaning_en: better than average; extraordinarily good

examples.text: She shows exceptional talent in solving complex problems.
examples.translation_cn: 她在解决复杂问题方面表现出非凡的才能。

senses.meaning_en: unusual; not typical

examples.text: The company offers refunds only in exceptional circumstances.
examples.translation_cn: 公司只在特殊情况下提供退款。

senses.meaning_en: the large size, extent, or importance of something

examples.text: It took years to grasp the magnitude of the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 花了数年时间才理解这个问题的严重性。

senses.meaning_en: a measure of the energy released by an earthquake

examples.text: An earthquake of magnitude 7.2 struck the region early this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天凌晨该地区发生了7.2级地震。

senses.meaning_en: a level on a scale for comparing sizes, amounts, or quantities

examples.text: The new computer is faster by an order of magnitude.
examples.translation_cn: 这台新电脑快了一个数量级。

senses.meaning_en: a unit for measuring the brightness of stars, where a difference of 5 magnitudes means a brightness ratio of 100
senses.pattern: a star of the first magnitude

examples.text: Sirius is a star of the first magnitude.
examples.translation_cn: 天狼星是一等星。

senses.meaning_en: a person held as security to force others to meet demands

examples.text: Several tourists were taken hostage by the rebel group.
examples.translation_cn: 几名游客被叛军扣为人质。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being held or controlled as a means of pressure

examples.text: The whole region was held hostage by the threat of violence.
examples.translation_cn: 整个地区被暴力威胁所挟持。

senses.meaning_en: something that limits one's freedom because it is at risk

examples.text: His controversial remarks became a hostage to fortune during the campaign.
examples.translation_cn: 他的争议言论在竞选期间成了授人以柄的东西。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being widely liked or admired

examples.text: The mayor enjoys great popularity among young voters.
examples.translation_cn: 这位市长在年轻选民中很受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being widely accepted, used, or fashionable

examples.text: Online shopping has grown in popularity over the past decade.
examples.translation_cn: 网上购物在过去十年里越来越流行。

senses.meaning_en: to watch and direct a person or activity to make sure it is done correctly; to oversee or direct a task or organization

examples.text: She supervises a team of five engineers on the construction site.
examples.translation_cn: 她在建筑工地监督一个由五名工程师组成的团队。

senses.meaning_en: to be responsible for a student's academic work or research

examples.text: Dr. Chen supervises two graduate students working on AI safety.
examples.translation_cn: 陈博士指导两名从事人工智能安全研究的研究生。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of supervising people or activities

examples.text: The trainees worked under close supervision throughout the project.
examples.translation_cn: 受训人员整个项目期间都在密切监督下工作。

senses.meaning_en: the act of caring for or watching over someone

examples.text: Young children need constant supervision when near water.
examples.translation_cn: 幼儿在水边时需要始终有人照管。

senses.meaning_en: a tutorial meeting between a student and a tutor

examples.text: I have a supervision with my tutor this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天下午和导师有个别辅导。

senses.meaning_en: from outside a group or place; unfamiliar

examples.text: The local customs felt completely alien to me at first.
examples.translation_cn: 起初，当地习俗让我感到完全陌生。

senses.meaning_en: a creature from another planet

examples.text: The story describes an alien from a distant galaxy who seeks peace.
examples.translation_cn: 故事描述了一个来自遥远星系、寻求和平的外星人。

senses.meaning_en: a person from another country

examples.text: She was treated as an alien in the country where she was born.
examples.translation_cn: 她在自己出生的国家被当作外国人看待。

senses.meaning_en: to hold on very tightly

examples.text: She clung to the edge of the cliff until help arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直紧紧抓着悬崖边缘，直到救援到达。

senses.meaning_en: to stick to something

examples.text: The pages of the old book clung together in the damp air.
examples.translation_cn: 旧书的书页在潮湿空气中粘在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to stay close to somebody for emotional support

examples.text: He clings to his older brother for emotional support.
examples.translation_cn: 他依恋着哥哥，寻求情感支持。

senses.meaning_en: to keep believing or doing something

examples.text: He still clings to the belief that hard work always pays off.
examples.translation_cn: 他仍然坚持认为努力工作总会有回报。

senses.meaning_en: the art or process of taking photographs

examples.text: She developed a keen interest in photography during her teens.
examples.translation_cn: 她在青少年时期对摄影产生了浓厚的兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: the occupation of taking and often printing photographs

examples.text: He has worked in photography for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他从事摄影工作二十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: the act of killing someone as a legal punishment

examples.text: The execution of the prisoner was delayed by a last-minute appeal.
examples.translation_cn: 对那名囚犯的处决因最后一刻的上诉而被推迟。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of carrying out a plan, order, or law
senses.pattern: in the execution of one's duties

examples.text: The officer was injured in the execution of his duties.
examples.translation_cn: 那名警官在履行职责时受了伤。

senses.meaning_en: the manner or style of performing a piece of music or movement

examples.text: The audience admired her execution of the piano solo.
examples.translation_cn: 观众很欣赏她对那首钢琴独奏曲的演绎。

senses.meaning_en: the carrying out of an instruction or program by a computer

examples.text: The execution of the program was halted by an error.
examples.translation_cn: 程序的执行因一个错误而中止。

senses.meaning_en: required by law or rule; obligatory
senses.pattern: It is compulsory to do sth

examples.text: It is compulsory to wear a helmet on construction sites.
examples.translation_cn: 在建筑工地戴安全帽是强制性的。

senses.meaning_en: required as part of a course of study

examples.text: Latin is compulsory for all students in Year 7.
examples.translation_cn: 拉丁语是七年级所有学生的必修课。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being similar, especially in appearance

examples.text: There is a close similarity between the two paintings.
examples.translation_cn: 这两幅画很相似。

senses.meaning_en: a feature or aspect that things have in common

examples.text: This city shares several similarities with my hometown.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市与我的家乡有几个相似之处。

senses.meaning_en: a meeting or get-together; a party or social function

examples.text: We had a small gathering at our house last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚我们在家里举行了一个小型聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or things

examples.text: A large gathering of fans waited outside the stadium.
examples.translation_cn: 一大群球迷在体育场外等候。

senses.meaning_en: the act of collecting things or gradually increasing

examples.text: The gathering of accurate data is essential for the project.
examples.translation_cn: 收集准确数据对项目至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: to bring something unpleasant upon yourself, especially as a result of your actions

examples.text: The company will incur costs if the deal is cancelled.
examples.translation_cn: 如果交易取消，公司将产生费用。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a continent

examples.text: The theory of continental drift explains how the continents move.
examples.translation_cn: 大陆漂移理论解释了大陆如何移动。

senses.meaning_en: of the mainland as opposed to an offshore island
senses.pattern: be part of the continental United States

examples.text: Hawaii is not part of the continental United States.
examples.translation_cn: 夏威夷不属于美国本土。

senses.meaning_en: relating to continental Europe

examples.text: The high-speed train connects Britain with continental Europe.
examples.translation_cn: 高速列车将英国与欧洲大陆连接起来。

senses.meaning_en: an intimate relationship or idealized love

examples.text: She had a brief romance with a colleague last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年和一位同事有过一段短暂的恋爱。

senses.meaning_en: a mysterious or exciting quality

examples.text: The romance of the open road attracts many travelers.
examples.translation_cn: 公路旅行的浪漫吸引了许多旅行者。

senses.meaning_en: a story about love

examples.text: She enjoys reading historical romances set in Victorian England.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢读以维多利亚时代英国为背景的历史爱情小说。

senses.meaning_en: a strong attachment or fascination

examples.text: The nation's long romance with the car is fading.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家对汽车的长期迷恋正在消退。

senses.meaning_en: once every year; yearly

examples.text: The board of directors meets annually in March.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会每年三月开会。

senses.meaning_en: a large farm for raising cattle, sheep, or horses

examples.text: They raise cattle on a large ranch in Montana.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在蒙大拿州的一个大牧场上养牛。

senses.meaning_en: to run a ranch or work on one

examples.text: He has been ranching in Texas for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在得克萨斯州经营牧场已有二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a ranch-style house

examples.text: They live in a ranch-style house with a large backyard.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在一座带大后院的牧场式住宅里。

senses.meaning_en: a creamy salad dressing

examples.text: Can I order ranch dressing on the side?
examples.translation_cn: 我可以单点牧场沙拉酱吗？

senses.meaning_en: spoken rather than written

examples.text: We made a verbal agreement to share the costs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们达成了口头协议分摊费用。

senses.meaning_en: relating to words; consisting of words only

examples.text: The puzzle tests verbal reasoning rather than memory.
examples.translation_cn: 这道题考查言语推理而不是记忆力。

senses.meaning_en: derived from or having the nature of a verb

examples.text: A gerund is a verbal noun that ends in -ing.
examples.translation_cn: 动名词是以-ing结尾的动词性名词。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the coast; on or near the coast

examples.text: Many seabirds breed in coastal areas during summer.
examples.translation_cn: 许多海鸟夏季在沿海地区繁殖。

senses.meaning_en: considerably; to a large degree

examples.text: The new model is substantially more efficient than the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 新型号比旧型号的效率高得多。

senses.meaning_en: essentially; in essence

examples.text: The two proposals are substantially the same in content.
examples.translation_cn: 这两项提案在内容上基本相同。

senses.meaning_en: forming or helping to make a whole

examples.text: The constituent parts of the machine can be replaced individually.
examples.translation_cn: 这台机器的组成部件可以单独更换。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives in and can vote in a constituency

examples.text: The constituents of the district voted overwhelmingly for change.
examples.translation_cn: 该选区的选民以压倒性多数投票支持变革。

senses.meaning_en: one of the parts that form something

examples.text: Protein is a key constituent of a healthy diet.
examples.translation_cn: 蛋白质是健康饮食的一种关键成分。

senses.meaning_en: a view or opinion that is held or expressed

examples.text: Many voters share the sentiment that taxes are too high.
examples.translation_cn: 许多选民都认为税收太高。

senses.meaning_en: tender feelings, especially apart from reason or judgment

examples.text: The warm sentiment behind his words touched her deeply.
examples.translation_cn: 他话语背后温暖的情感深深打动了她。

senses.meaning_en: excessive or exaggerated emotion, especially in a romantic or nostalgic way

examples.text: She wallows in sentiment whenever she hears that song.
examples.translation_cn: 她一听到那首歌就沉溺于感伤。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a god; sacred

examples.text: The king believed he had a divine right to rule.
examples.translation_cn: 国王相信自己拥有神授的统治权。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; wonderful

examples.text: That rich chocolate cake she baked tasted simply divine.
examples.translation_cn: 她烤的巧克力蛋糕味道好极了。

senses.meaning_en: to discover by intuition or guess

examples.text: She tried to divine his intentions from his tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图从他的语气猜出他的意图。

senses.meaning_en: temporary and intended to be used until something better is available

examples.text: The interim government will remain in power until May.
examples.translation_cn: 临时政府将继续执政到五月。

senses.meaning_en: the period of time between two events

examples.text: The new manager starts in June; in the interim, Sarah will lead the team.
examples.translation_cn: 新经理六月上任；在此期间，莎拉将带领团队。

senses.meaning_en: a new idea, especially one that comes suddenly and is clever or creative

examples.text: In a flash of inspiration, she realized how to fix the engine.
examples.translation_cn: 她灵机一动，想到了修引擎的办法。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling or idea that helps you create something or solve a problem

examples.text: The young writer draws inspiration from everyday life.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻作家从日常生活中汲取灵感。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that makes you want to be better or more successful

examples.text: Her story is an inspiration to everyone who dreams of success.
examples.translation_cn: 她的故事激励着每一个渴望成功的人。

senses.meaning_en: a variable or value that affects how a system, equation, or function works and can be set or changed

examples.text: You can adjust the parameters of the model to improve its accuracy.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以调整模型的参数来提高其准确性。

senses.meaning_en: a set of fixed limits that control how something should be done

examples.text: The new policy must operate within strict parameters set by the board.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策必须在董事会设定的严格范围内运行。

senses.meaning_en: a state of balance between opposing forces or influences

examples.text: The market is in equilibrium when supply matches demand.
examples.translation_cn: 当供给与需求相匹配时，市场处于均衡状态。

senses.meaning_en: a calm state of mind

examples.text: She struggled to keep her equilibrium after the sudden criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 突然受到批评后，她努力保持镇静。

senses.meaning_en: a long or difficult search or journey toward a goal

examples.text: She embarked on a quest for the lost city.
examples.translation_cn: 她踏上了寻找失落之城的征途。

senses.meaning_en: to search for something with great effort

examples.text: He has spent years questing for a cure.
examples.translation_cn: 他花费多年寻找一种疗法。

senses.meaning_en: a blow with the open hand or something flat

examples.text: He gave his friend a cheerful slap on the back.
examples.translation_cn: 他开心地拍了拍朋友的背。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp percussive sound like a slap

examples.text: The book slipped from her hands and hit the floor with a sharp slap.
examples.translation_cn: 书从她手中滑落，啪的一声掉在地上。

senses.meaning_en: exactly or suddenly

examples.text: The hotel is actually slap in the middle of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆实际上正好在市中心。

senses.meaning_en: to strike someone with an open hand, often on the face

examples.text: She slapped him across the face and left the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她打了他一耳光然后离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: to strike or cause something to strike against something with a sharp slapping sound

examples.text: He slapped the newspaper down on the kitchen counter and sighed.
examples.translation_cn: 他啪地把报纸摔在厨房台面上，叹了口气。

senses.meaning_en: containing poison; harmful to health

examples.text: These chemicals are toxic to fish and plants.
examples.translation_cn: 这些化学品对鱼类和植物有毒。

senses.meaning_en: severely negative or harmful, especially in relationships or environments

examples.text: He stayed in a toxic relationship for years before seeking help.
examples.translation_cn: 他困在一段令人心力交瘁的关系里多年才寻求帮助。

senses.meaning_en: hateful or strongly antipathetic, especially of a person

examples.text: He is toxic and constantly puts down everyone around him.
examples.translation_cn: 他很讨厌，总是贬低周围的人。

senses.meaning_en: deep sadness, especially caused by death or loss

examples.text: She couldn't hide her grief over her husband's death.
examples.translation_cn: 她无法掩饰因丈夫去世的悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: problems or trouble

examples.text: Her boss gave her grief over the late report.
examples.translation_cn: 老板因报告迟交而责备她。

senses.meaning_en: a cause or instance of sorrow or distress
senses.pattern: be a source of grief for sb

examples.text: The accident was a source of grief for the whole community.
examples.translation_cn: 那场事故给全社区带来了悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: to give money, goods, etc. to a person or organization in need

examples.text: She donated blood to the local hospital last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周给当地医院献血。

senses.meaning_en: a mechanical failure; something that has had a mechanical failure

examples.text: My car had a breakdown on the way home.
examples.translation_cn: 我的车在回家的路上抛锚了。

senses.meaning_en: a failure of a relationship, discussion or system

examples.text: A breakdown in communication caused a serious delay.
examples.translation_cn: 沟通的破裂造成了严重的延误。

senses.meaning_en: separation into parts
senses.pattern: the breakdown of X into Y

examples.text: The breakdown of food into nutrients begins in the stomach.
examples.translation_cn: 食物分解为养分的过程从胃里开始。

senses.meaning_en: a mental collapse

examples.text: After losing his job, he had a nervous breakdown.
examples.translation_cn: 失去工作后，他精神崩溃了。

senses.meaning_en: always; without exception

examples.text: The trains invariably run late during the morning rush hour.
examples.translation_cn: 早高峰期间火车总是晚点。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being worthy of honor or respect

examples.text: She believes in the dignity of manual labor.
examples.translation_cn: 她相信体力劳动的尊严。

senses.meaning_en: self-respect; a sense of your own worth

examples.text: It is beneath your dignity to respond to such insults.
examples.translation_cn: 回应这样的侮辱有失你的尊严。

senses.meaning_en: a calm and serious manner that deserves respect

examples.text: She faced the public scandal with quiet dignity.
examples.translation_cn: 她以平静的庄重面对了公众丑闻。

senses.meaning_en: approaching or about to take place

examples.text: The candidates held a debate before the forthcoming election.
examples.translation_cn: 候选人在即将到来的选举前举行了一场辩论。

senses.meaning_en: available when needed; ready

examples.text: The money promised for the new school was not forthcoming.
examples.translation_cn: 为新学校承诺的资金并没有到位。

senses.meaning_en: willing to cooperate or provide information; candid

examples.text: She was forthcoming about her reasons for leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 她乐于分享自己离开的原因。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in which a difficult choice must be made between two or more equally undesirable alternatives

examples.text: She was in a dilemma over whether to accept the low-paying job or stay unemployed.
examples.translation_cn: 她在是接受低薪工作还是继续失业之间进退两难。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult situation or problem

examples.text: The factory closure posed a serious dilemma for the town council.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂关闭给镇议会带来了一个严重的难题。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has never had sexual intercourse

examples.text: He said he was still a virgin at the age of thirty.
examples.translation_cn: 他说他三十岁时仍是处男。

senses.meaning_en: a person with no experience of a particular activity

examples.text: He is still a complete virgin in politics.
examples.translation_cn: 他在政治方面仍然完全是个新手。

senses.meaning_en: chaste; having no sexual experience

examples.text: The virgin birth is a central belief in Christianity.
examples.translation_cn: 童贞女诞子是基督教的一个核心信仰。

senses.meaning_en: untouched; in its original state

examples.text: The explorers discovered vast areas of virgin forest.
examples.translation_cn: 探险家们发现了大片原始森林。

senses.meaning_en: to correspond or agree

examples.text: His version of events coincides with the witness's statement.
examples.translation_cn: 他对事件的描述与证人的陈述相符。

senses.meaning_en: to occur at the same time

examples.text: The concert coincides with the city's annual festival.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会恰逢该市的年度节日。

senses.meaning_en: to occupy exactly the same space

examples.text: The two triangles coincide with each other exactly after rotation.
examples.translation_cn: 旋转后两个三角形完全重合。

senses.meaning_en: the flesh of shrimp used as food

examples.text: We sat by the dock and peeled and ate shrimp straight from the cooler.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在码头边剥虾吃虾。

senses.meaning_en: a small or unimportant person

examples.text: He was a shrimp of a man, but he could lift twice his own weight.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个矮小的人，但能举起自己两倍的重量。

senses.meaning_en: to fish for shrimp

examples.text: Fishermen go shrimping in these waters every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 渔民每年夏天在这些水域捕虾。

senses.meaning_en: to create or prepare a plan, policy, or strategy carefully

examples.text: The committee formulated a plan to reduce waste.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会制定了一项减少浪费的计划。

senses.meaning_en: to put into a clear and definite form of statement or expression

examples.text: She formulated a new theory to explain the unusual results.
examples.translation_cn: 她构想出一个新理论来解释这些不寻常的结果。

senses.meaning_en: to express thoughts or ideas clearly and carefully using appropriate words

examples.text: He struggled to formulate his thoughts clearly under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 在压力下，他很难清楚地表达自己的想法。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of writing letters

examples.text: She kept up a regular correspondence with her former colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直与以前的同事保持定期通信。

senses.meaning_en: a close similarity or connection between things

examples.text: There is a close correspondence between the two maps.
examples.translation_cn: 这两张地图非常相似。

senses.meaning_en: letters, especially official or business letters

examples.text: Please send all correspondence to our head office.
examples.translation_cn: 请把所有信函寄往总公司。

senses.meaning_en: an outfit or disguise worn for a party, play, etc.

examples.text: The children came to the party in costume.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们穿着戏装来参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a style of dress typical of a particular country, period, or people.

examples.text: The performers danced in national costume at the opening ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 表演者在开幕式上穿着民族服装跳舞。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming, especially by women.

examples.text: She walked along the beach in a swimming costume.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着泳装沿着海滩散步。

senses.meaning_en: a humorous drawing, often with a caption or a strip of such drawings

examples.text: The newspaper published a cartoon of the prime minister.
examples.translation_cn: 报纸刊登了一幅首相的漫画。

senses.meaning_en: an animated film or television programme

examples.text: Children love to watch cartoons on Saturday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们喜欢在周六早晨看动画片。

senses.meaning_en: an insect, especially a small one

examples.text: He swatted a bug on the kitchen counter.
examples.translation_cn: 他拍死了厨房台面上的一只小虫。

senses.meaning_en: a problem with a machine or system

examples.text: The developers fixed a bug in the new app.
examples.translation_cn: 开发者修复了新应用中的一个错误。

senses.meaning_en: an infectious illness, especially a minor one

examples.text: I caught a bug and had to stay home from work.
examples.translation_cn: 我感染了病菌，不得不待在家里没去上班。

senses.meaning_en: a strong enthusiasm for something

examples.text: She's had the travel bug ever since her year abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 自从在国外待过一年后，她就一直痴迷于旅行。

senses.meaning_en: easy to understand

examples.text: The professor made the complex theory accessible to his students.
examples.translation_cn: 教授让这个复杂的理论对他的学生来说容易理解。

senses.meaning_en: friendly and easy to talk to

examples.text: The new CEO is remarkably accessible to all employees.
examples.translation_cn: 新首席执行官对所有员工都非常平易近人。

senses.meaning_en: available or usable

examples.text: The library's archives are now accessible to the public online.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆的档案现在在网上对公众开放使用。

senses.meaning_en: able to be reached or entered

examples.text: The remote village is only accessible by boat during the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 这个偏远的村庄在夏季只能乘船到达。

senses.meaning_en: a decision made by a jury or judge in a court of law

examples.text: The jury will return a verdict after hearing the evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 陪审团将在听取证据后作出裁决。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion or decision made after considering the facts

examples.text: The committee will give its verdict on the proposal tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会明天将对这项提议给出结论。

senses.meaning_en: to consider or judge something to be

examples.text: The board deemed it necessary to postpone the vote.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会认为有必要推迟投票。

senses.meaning_en: a legally declared condition of insolvency

examples.text: The company filed for bankruptcy after years of heavy losses.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在多年严重亏损后申请破产。

senses.meaning_en: a complete lack of a good quality, especially moral standards

examples.text: The scandal exposed the moral bankruptcy of the leadership.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻暴露了领导层的道德沦丧。

senses.meaning_en: the act of working with others

examples.text: The report was written in collaboration with two universities.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告是与两所大学合作撰写的。

senses.meaning_en: secret cooperation with an enemy

examples.text: Several officials were accused of collaboration with enemy forces.
examples.translation_cn: 几名官员被指控与敌军勾结。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of work produced together

examples.text: The exhibition features a new collaboration between an artist and a poet.
examples.translation_cn: 这次展览展出了一位艺术家和一位诗人的新合作作品。

senses.meaning_en: an animal that is hunted and killed by another animal for food

examples.text: The owl hunts for prey silently at night.
examples.translation_cn: 猫头鹰在夜里静静地捕猎。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is harmed, defeated, or exploited by someone or something

examples.text: Many elderly people fall prey to telephone scams.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老年人沦为电话诈骗的受害者。

senses.meaning_en: to cause constant worry or anxiety to someone

examples.text: The thought of the final exam has been preying on her mind for days.
examples.translation_cn: 期末考试的事已经在她脑海里烦扰了好几天。

senses.meaning_en: to hunt and kill animals for food

examples.text: Owls prey on mice and other small rodents.
examples.translation_cn: 猫头鹰捕食老鼠和其他小型啮齿动物。

senses.meaning_en: to go around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe

examples.text: Border guards patrol the fence line throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 边防警卫整夜沿着围栏线巡逻。

senses.meaning_en: the act of going around an area or building to check that it is safe

examples.text: Two soldiers were on patrol near the border when the incident occurred.
examples.translation_cn: 事件发生时，两名士兵正在边境附近巡逻。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or vehicles that go around an area to check that it is safe
senses.pattern: a patrol of + 数字 + 人员

examples.text: A patrol of four police officers arrested the suspect near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 一支由四名警察组成的巡逻队在河边逮捕了嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who held a job or position before another

examples.text: He was my predecessor as manager of the store.
examples.translation_cn: 他是我之前的门店经理。

senses.meaning_en: an earlier model or thing that has been replaced by another

examples.text: This device is the predecessor of the modern computer.
examples.translation_cn: 这台装置是现代计算机的前身。

senses.meaning_en: a surprising fact that has been made known

examples.text: The revelation that the company had hidden the data shocked investors.
examples.translation_cn: 公司隐瞒数据的惊人披露震惊了投资者。

senses.meaning_en: the act of revealing or disclosing something

examples.text: The revelation of the secret documents caused a political storm.
examples.translation_cn: 机密文件的披露引发了一场政治风暴。

senses.meaning_en: an event or person that is surprisingly impressive or interesting

examples.text: Her debut performance was a revelation to the critics.
examples.translation_cn: 她的首演让评论家们惊喜不已。

senses.meaning_en: a manifestation of divine truth

examples.text: He claimed to have received a revelation from God in a dream.
examples.translation_cn: 他声称在梦中得到了上帝的启示。

senses.meaning_en: to pull something heavy with effort

examples.text: She hauled the heavy suitcase up the stairs.
examples.translation_cn: 她费力地把沉重的手提箱拖上楼梯。

senses.meaning_en: to transport something, especially heavy goods

examples.text: Trucks haul fresh produce from the farm to the market.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车把新鲜农产品从农场运到市场。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount of something stolen or gained

examples.text: The police seized a huge haul of stolen goods.
examples.translation_cn: 警方缴获了一大批被盗物品。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone appear before a person in authority to be questioned or punished

examples.text: The manager hauled him up for missing the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 经理因他错过最后期限而严厉责问他。

senses.meaning_en: until now; up to this time

examples.text: The team discovered a hitherto unknown species of frog.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队发现了一种迄今未知的蛙类物种。

senses.meaning_en: a box in which a dead body is placed for burial or cremation

examples.text: A single rose was placed in a coffin before the lid was closed.
examples.translation_cn: 在棺材盖合上之前，一朵玫瑰被放入棺材。

senses.meaning_en: easily noticed; conspicuous; perceptible

examples.text: The report shows a notable increase in sales.
examples.translation_cn: 报告显示销售额显著增长。

senses.meaning_en: worthy of note; remarkable; noted; distinguished

examples.text: The town is notable for its ancient castle.
examples.translation_cn: 这座小镇以其古城堡而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing of distinction

examples.text: She is a notable in the field of climate science.
examples.translation_cn: 她是气候科学领域的知名人物。

senses.meaning_en: not affected by something

examples.text: No large company is immune to economic pressures.
examples.translation_cn: 没有哪家大公司能免受经济压力的影响。

senses.meaning_en: protected against a particular disease

examples.text: After vaccination, you are immune to the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 接种疫苗后，你对这种病毒有免疫力。

senses.meaning_en: exempt from a duty or punishment

examples.text: Under international law, diplomats are immune from prosecution.
examples.translation_cn: 根据国际法，外交官免于起诉。

senses.meaning_en: of or pertaining to immunity

examples.text: A weakened immune system makes you more vulnerable to infections.
examples.translation_cn: 免疫系统减弱会让你更容易受到感染。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to do something well enough to meet a general standard

examples.text: She has demonstrated competence in handling complex negotiations.
examples.translation_cn: 她在处理复杂谈判方面表现出了能力。

senses.meaning_en: the legal authority of a court or other body to deal with a matter

examples.text: Immigration decisions fall within the competence of the federal government.
examples.translation_cn: 移民决定属于联邦政府的权限范围。

senses.meaning_en: unusual or attractive because different

examples.text: The new sculpture looks exotic against the plain white walls.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新雕塑在纯白色墙壁的映衬下看起来很奇异。

senses.meaning_en: from a foreign country, especially in an exciting way

examples.text: Many tourists find the local food wonderfully exotic.
examples.translation_cn: 许多游客觉得当地食物极具异域风情。

senses.meaning_en: a device for holding things together

examples.text: She fastened the sheets together with a paper clip.
examples.translation_cn: 她用回形针把几页纸夹在一起。

senses.meaning_en: a short section of a film or video

examples.text: The news channel aired a clip from the president's interview.
examples.translation_cn: 新闻频道播放了总统采访的一个片段。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten or hold with a clip

examples.text: He clipped the microphone to the lapel of his jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 他把麦克风夹在夹克的翻领上。

senses.meaning_en: to cut or trim with scissors or shears

examples.text: She clipped off the overgrown branches from the rose bush.
examples.translation_cn: 她把玫瑰丛中长得过长的枝条剪掉了。

senses.meaning_en: speed or pace

examples.text: The crew worked at a fast clip to finish the roof before dark.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们加快速度，以便天黑前盖完屋顶。

senses.meaning_en: the upper part of the human leg between the hip and the knee

examples.text: He pulled a muscle in his left thigh during the match.
examples.translation_cn: 他在比赛中拉伤了左大腿肌肉。

senses.meaning_en: the process of finding people to work for a company or join an organization or the armed forces

examples.text: The recruitment of qualified teachers has become the school's top priority.
examples.translation_cn: 招聘合格教师已成为该校的首要任务。

senses.meaning_en: a film or TV program that presents real events or information

examples.text: We watched a documentary about climate change last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于气候变化的纪录片。

senses.meaning_en: based on or relating to documents; factual or objective

examples.text: The lawyer presented documentary evidence to support the claim.
examples.translation_cn: 律师提交了文件证据来支持该主张。

senses.meaning_en: documentary films as a genre; documentary works collectively

examples.text: Documentary as a genre has become more popular among young audiences.
examples.translation_cn: 纪录片作为一种类型在年轻观众中越来越受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: a public gathering organized to inspire enthusiasm

examples.text: Thousands of supporters attended a rally in the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 数千名支持者在市中心参加了一场集会。

senses.meaning_en: a recovery in prices or the market after a decline

examples.text: There was a rally in prices after the central bank cut rates.
examples.translation_cn: 央行降息后价格出现回升。

senses.meaning_en: a motor sport event with timed special stages

examples.text: She competes in a rally across the desert every year.
examples.translation_cn: 她每年参加穿越沙漠的拉力赛。

senses.meaning_en: a series of strokes in tennis before a point is scored

examples.text: They kept a long rally going from the baseline.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从底线持续对拉。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to geography

examples.text: The geographical location of the island makes it a strategic port.
examples.translation_cn: 这个岛屿的地理位置使其成为一个战略港口。

senses.meaning_en: to move, arrange or operate something using your hands

examples.text: He manipulated the lock with a thin piece of wire.
examples.translation_cn: 他用一根细铁丝拨弄锁。

senses.meaning_en: to control or influence someone or something, often unfairly

examples.text: He manipulated his colleagues into supporting the plan.
