examples.translation_cn: 他操控同事们支持了这个计划。

senses.meaning_en: to move a joint or part of the body as part of medical treatment

examples.text: The therapist gently manipulated the joint into position.
examples.translation_cn: 治疗师轻轻地将关节推入正确位置。

senses.meaning_en: involving cooperation between individuals or parties
senses.pattern: make a cooperative effort to do

examples.text: The two organizations made a cooperative effort to complete the project.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个组织合作完成了这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: ready to work with another person or in a team

examples.text: The witness was fully cooperative with the police during questioning.
examples.translation_cn: 证人在询问期间全力配合了警方。

senses.meaning_en: a business or organization owned and run by its members

examples.text: She joined a worker cooperative after leaving her job.
examples.translation_cn: 她离职后加入了一家工人合作社。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a cooperative or cooperatives

examples.text: They opened a savings account at a cooperative bank.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一家合作银行开了一个储蓄账户。

senses.meaning_en: causing great sadness or suffering

examples.text: It is tragic that so many people lost their homes in the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 这么多人因火灾失去家园，真是悲惨。

senses.meaning_en: relating to tragedy in a literary work

examples.text: In Greek drama, the main character is often a tragic hero.
examples.translation_cn: 在希腊戏剧中，主角往往是悲剧英雄。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet dish or confection served as the last course of a meal

examples.text: We had homemade apple pie with vanilla ice cream for dessert.
examples.translation_cn: 我们吃了自制的苹果派配香草冰淇淋作为甜点。

senses.meaning_en: a person who starts a business and takes financial risks

examples.text: The entrepreneur behind the coffee chain opened ten new stores last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡连锁店背后的创业者去年新开了十家门店。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing a strong desire to succeed or be powerful

examples.text: She is ambitious and determined to become the first female CEO.
examples.translation_cn: 她雄心勃勃，决心成为首位女性首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: describing plans or goals that show ambition and require great effort to achieve

examples.text: The government launched an ambitious plan to cut carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 政府启动了一项减少碳排放的宏大计划。

senses.meaning_en: very desirous; eager

examples.text: Her parents are ambitious for her academic success.
examples.translation_cn: 她的父母热切希望她在学业上取得成功。

senses.meaning_en: the movement of blood around the body

examples.text: He has poor circulation, so his hands are always cold.
examples.translation_cn: 他血液循环不好，所以手总是冰凉。

senses.meaning_en: the number of copies of a newspaper, magazine, etc. sold

examples.text: The newspaper has a daily circulation of about two million.
examples.translation_cn: 这家报纸的日发行量约为两百万份。

senses.meaning_en: the movement of air or water through a space

examples.text: The ceiling fan improves the circulation of air in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 吊扇改善了房间里的空气流通。

senses.meaning_en: the passing or spreading of something from one person or place to another

examples.text: The report has been in circulation among investors for weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告已在投资者中流传数周。

senses.meaning_en: violent or noisy public disorder

examples.text: A small group of fans caused a disturbance outside the stadium after the game.
examples.translation_cn: 一小群球迷在赛后于体育场外引发了一场骚乱。

senses.meaning_en: the act of interrupting or bothering someone

examples.text: We apologize for the disturbance to your online meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 对于打扰您的在线会议，我们深表歉意。

senses.meaning_en: a mental or emotional disorder

examples.text: Children who witness violence often show signs of emotional disturbance.
examples.translation_cn: 目睹暴力的儿童常常表现出情绪困扰的迹象。

senses.meaning_en: an interruption of normal functioning

examples.text: A disturbance in sleep can weaken your immune system.
examples.translation_cn: 睡眠失调会削弱免疫系统。

senses.meaning_en: to make something tighter

examples.text: She tightened the screws on the chair legs.
examples.translation_cn: 她拧紧了椅子腿上的螺丝。

senses.meaning_en: to make something stricter or more controlled

examples.text: The government tightened control on immigration last year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府去年加强了移民控制。

senses.meaning_en: to become tighter

examples.text: His grip tightened on the steering wheel as he drove through the fog.
examples.translation_cn: 他在雾中行驶时握紧了方向盘。

senses.meaning_en: to make money harder to borrow or obtain

examples.text: The central bank tightened monetary policy to curb inflation.
examples.translation_cn: 中央银行为抑制通货膨胀而紧缩货币政策。

senses.meaning_en: concerned with beauty or artistic effect

examples.text: The new museum has great aesthetic appeal for visitors.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新博物馆对游客极具审美吸引力。

senses.meaning_en: the study of art or beauty

examples.text: She studied aesthetics at university before becoming an art critic.
examples.translation_cn: 她在成为艺术评论家之前曾在大学学习美学。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of appealing to the senses

examples.text: The film is more concerned with the aesthetic than with plot.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影更关注审美体验而非情节。

senses.meaning_en: a set of artistic motifs or overall vibe

examples.text: The café has a warm, rustic aesthetic that attracts many customers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡馆拥有温暖质朴的风格，吸引了许多顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a refusal to accept something or somebody

examples.text: The rejection of his job application was a huge blow.
examples.translation_cn: 他的求职申请被拒是一个巨大打击。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being rejected

examples.text: Her fear of rejection stops her from speaking up.
examples.translation_cn: 她害怕被拒绝，因此不敢发言。

senses.meaning_en: an immune reaction against transplanted tissue

examples.text: Transplant rejection can often be controlled with medication.
examples.translation_cn: 移植排异通常可以用药物控制。

senses.meaning_en: something that has been achieved successfully

examples.text: Winning the national award was a great accomplishment for the young scientist.
examples.translation_cn: 赢得国家奖项对这位年轻科学家来说是一项重大成就。

senses.meaning_en: a skill or ability acquired by training

examples.text: Her accomplishments in music and dance impressed the judges.
examples.translation_cn: 她在音乐和舞蹈方面的才艺给评委留下了深刻印象。

senses.meaning_en: the act of completing something

examples.text: The accomplishment of this task will require time and teamwork.
examples.translation_cn: 完成这项任务将需要时间和团队合作。

senses.meaning_en: smallest possible amount or degree

examples.text: She completed the entire task with minimal effort.
examples.translation_cn: 她以极少的努力完成了整项任务。

senses.meaning_en: using simple forms or structures

examples.text: The apartment was decorated in a minimal style.
examples.translation_cn: 这套公寓以极简风格装饰。

senses.meaning_en: (of a person) not named or identified

examples.text: The donor chose to remain anonymous to avoid public attention.
examples.translation_cn: 那位捐赠者选择匿名以避免公众注意。

senses.meaning_en: (of a work) written by someone whose name is not made public

examples.text: The editor received an anonymous letter criticizing the article.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑收到了一封批评该文章的匿名信。

senses.meaning_en: having no unusual or interesting features; lacking individuality

examples.text: The hotel lobby looked anonymous and cold, with no personal touches.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店大堂看起来毫无特色，冷冷清清，没有个性化布置。

senses.meaning_en: to begin or start

examples.text: The ceremony will commence with a short speech.
examples.translation_cn: 典礼将以一段简短的讲话开始。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being grateful for something

examples.text: We want to express our appreciation for her hard work.
examples.translation_cn: 我们想对她辛勤的工作表示感谢。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to understand and enjoy the good qualities of something

examples.text: He has an appreciation of modern art and literature.
examples.translation_cn: 他对现代艺术和文学有欣赏力。

senses.meaning_en: a full understanding of a situation or problem

examples.text: The report helped us gain an appreciation of the risks involved.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告帮助我们认识了所涉及的风险。

senses.meaning_en: a rise in value

examples.text: The property has seen steady appreciation in value over five years.
examples.translation_cn: 这处房产在过去五年里价值稳步增值。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being fully developed or adult

examples.text: Female elephants reach maturity at around 15 years old.
examples.translation_cn: 雌象约15岁达到成熟。

senses.meaning_en: the time when a payment becomes due

examples.text: The bond pays a fixed amount at maturity.
examples.translation_cn: 债券到期时支付固定金额。

senses.meaning_en: to move or climb quickly and with difficulty, often using your hands

examples.text: We had to scramble over large rocks to reach the shore.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不爬过大石头到达岸边。

senses.meaning_en: to push or compete with others to get or do something

examples.text: Fans scrambled to buy tickets for the final.
examples.translation_cn: 球迷们争相抢购决赛门票。

senses.meaning_en: to cook eggs or similar food while stirring so that they form soft lumps

examples.text: She scrambled two eggs for a quick breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 她炒了两个鸡蛋当快手早餐。

senses.meaning_en: a rushed, disorganized struggle to get something

examples.text: There was a scramble for seats when the doors opened.
examples.translation_cn: 门一开，人们争抢座位。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns or manages a bank

examples.text: She worked as a banker before becoming a teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 她在成为教师之前当过银行家。

senses.meaning_en: the person who is in charge of the money in some gambling games

examples.text: He acted as banker in our weekly poker game.
examples.translation_cn: 他在我们每周的扑克牌局中担任庄家。

senses.meaning_en: the quantity of motion of a moving body, equal to its mass times velocity

examples.text: The momentum of a moving object is equal to its mass times velocity.
examples.translation_cn: 运动物体的动量等于其质量乘以速度。

senses.meaning_en: strength or force gained by motion or development

examples.text: The campaign has gained momentum over the past month.
examples.translation_cn: 这场运动在过去一个月里势头大增。

senses.meaning_en: the use of words to mean the opposite of their literal meaning, often for humorous effect

examples.text: She observed with irony that the rain was perfect beach weather.
examples.translation_cn: 她讽刺地说这场雨是完美的海滩天气。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to something; the act of changing something

examples.text: The manager requested an alteration to the schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 经理要求对日程作一项改动。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something somebody else has said is wrong, or to deny that it is true

examples.text: She flatly contradicted the minister's claim about spending.
examples.translation_cn: 她断然驳斥了部长关于开支的说法。

senses.meaning_en: to be inconsistent with something or with each other

examples.text: The two reports contradict each other on several key points.
examples.translation_cn: 这两份报告在几个关键点上互相矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: the act of officially stopping something for a period of time

examples.text: The committee ordered the suspension of all outdoor events.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会下令暂停所有户外活动。

senses.meaning_en: the punishment of barring a student or employee from school or work, usually temporarily

examples.text: He received a three-day suspension from school for cheating.
examples.translation_cn: 他因作弊被停学三天。

senses.meaning_en: the system of springs and shock absorbers that supports a vehicle on its wheels

examples.text: The truck has a heavy-duty suspension system for rough terrain.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆卡车装有适用于崎岖地形的重型悬架系统。

senses.meaning_en: a mixture in which small solid particles are suspended in a liquid

examples.text: The particles remain in suspension within the liquid.
examples.translation_cn: 这些颗粒在液体中保持悬浮状态。

senses.meaning_en: a blood vessel that carries blood to the heart

examples.text: The nurse injected the medicine into a vein in her arm.
examples.translation_cn: 护士把药注射进她手臂的静脉。

senses.meaning_en: the small tubes in a leaf or insect wing

examples.text: The veins of a leaf carry water, while those of a wing support flight.
examples.translation_cn: 叶脉输送水分，而翅脉支撑飞行。

senses.meaning_en: a thin line of different colour or material in something

examples.text: This cheese has veins of blue running through it.
examples.translation_cn: 这块奶酪有蓝色的纹理贯穿其中。

senses.meaning_en: a layer of mineral in rock

examples.text: They struck a vein of gold after months of digging.
examples.translation_cn: 他们挖了几个月后找到了金矿脉。

senses.meaning_en: a formal written request, often signed by many people, to an authority

examples.text: More than 10,000 people signed a petition for stricter gun laws.
examples.translation_cn: 一万多人签署了要求更严格枪支法律的请愿书。

senses.meaning_en: to make a formal request to an authority

examples.text: They petitioned the city council for a new park.
examples.translation_cn: 他们向市议会请愿要求建一个新公园。

senses.meaning_en: to take care of a child that is not your own for a period of time, without becoming the legal parent

examples.text: She was fostered by her aunt and uncle for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她由姑姑和姑父寄养了两年。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage the development or growth of something

examples.text: The project aims to foster understanding between the two communities.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目旨在促进两个社区之间的理解。

senses.meaning_en: used with some nouns in connection with the fostering of a child
senses.pattern: be placed in a foster home

examples.text: She was placed in a foster home after the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 事件发生后，她被安置在一个寄养家庭。

senses.meaning_en: an organized journey for a particular purpose, especially to a distant place

examples.text: The team went on an expedition to the Antarctic.
examples.translation_cn: 考察队去南极进行了一次远征。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people on an expedition
senses.pattern: be a member of an expedition

examples.text: He was the youngest member of the expedition.
examples.translation_cn: 他是考察队中最年轻的成员。

senses.meaning_en: a short trip for a particular purpose, often shopping

examples.text: They went on a shopping expedition to the mall.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去商场进行了一次购物之行。

senses.meaning_en: an urgent request or appeal

examples.text: The aid workers made an urgent plea for more food and medical supplies.
examples.translation_cn: 救援人员紧急请求更多食物和医疗用品。

senses.meaning_en: an excuse or justification

examples.text: He missed the meeting on the plea of a sudden illness.
examples.translation_cn: 他借口突然生病缺席了会议。

senses.meaning_en: a formal statement of guilt or innocence in court

examples.text: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty at the arraignment.
examples.translation_cn: 被告在传讯时提出了无罪抗辩。

senses.meaning_en: a product or raw material that can be bought and sold

examples.text: The firm trades in commodities such as rice and sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司经营大米和糖等商品。

senses.meaning_en: something useful or valuable, especially when limited

examples.text: In this small town, trust is a rare commodity.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个小镇，信任是稀缺的宝贵事物。

senses.meaning_en: the long central part of a church, between the main entrance and the transepts

examples.text: The congregation stood in the nave, facing the altar at the far end.
examples.translation_cn: 会众站在中殿，面向教堂尽头的祭坛。

senses.meaning_en: a flat piece of hard material used for covering floors, walls, or roofs

examples.text: Several tiles on the roof were cracked after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨后屋顶上有几块瓦片裂了。

senses.meaning_en: to cover a surface with tiles

examples.text: The builders will tile the bathroom with white ceramic tiles.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑工人们将用白色瓷砖铺浴室。

senses.meaning_en: a small flat piece used in a game

examples.text: Each player draws seven tiles in a game of Scrabble.
examples.translation_cn: 在一局拼字游戏中，每位玩家抽七张牌。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange windows or images side by side without overlapping

examples.text: You can tile windows on your screen to compare documents.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在屏幕上平铺窗口以对比文档。

senses.meaning_en: to push sb/sth roughly or with force

examples.text: He shoved her aside and ran for the exit.
examples.translation_cn: 他把她推到一边，朝出口跑去。

senses.meaning_en: a rough push

examples.text: She gave the door a shove and it swung open.
examples.translation_cn: 她推了一下门，门就开了。

senses.meaning_en: to put sth somewhere hurriedly or carelessly

examples.text: She quickly shoved the letter into her coat pocket.
examples.translation_cn: 她迅速把信塞进外套口袋里。

senses.meaning_en: to move away; to leave, especially in a boat

examples.text: The boat shoved off from the quay and headed out to sea.
examples.translation_cn: 船离岸后驶向大海。

senses.meaning_en: a high open area of land, especially covered with rough grass and heather

examples.text: We hiked across the moors until sunset last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越荒野直到日落。

senses.meaning_en: to attach a boat or ship to something with ropes or an anchor

examples.text: They moored the boat to the dock for the night.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把小船系泊在码头过夜。

senses.meaning_en: the official building or staff of an ambassador

examples.text: The embassy in Tokyo issued a travel warning this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 驻东京大使馆今天上午发布了旅行警告。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of armed troops under an officer's command

examples.text: My grandfather served in an infantry regiment during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父战争期间在一个步兵团服役。

senses.meaning_en: to organize or control very strictly

examples.text: She refused to live a regimented life after leaving the army.
examples.translation_cn: 离开军队后，她拒绝过那种受到严格控制的生活。

senses.meaning_en: a large number of people or things

examples.text: A regiment of eager volunteers showed up to clean the park.
examples.translation_cn: 一大群热心的志愿者前来打扫公园。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes progress difficult

examples.text: Lack of money is a serious handicap to their plan.
examples.translation_cn: 缺钱是他们计划的一个严重障碍。

senses.meaning_en: to put at a disadvantage

examples.text: He was severely handicapped by a lack of formal education.
examples.translation_cn: 他因缺乏正规教育而处于严重不利地位。

senses.meaning_en: a physical or mental disability

examples.text: Children with physical handicaps need extra support at school.
examples.translation_cn: 身体有残障的孩子在学校需要额外支持。

senses.meaning_en: an advantage given to a weaker competitor

examples.text: He plays off a handicap of twelve in amateur tournaments.
examples.translation_cn: 他在业余比赛中让十二杆。

senses.meaning_en: never seen or done before; without precedent

examples.text: The current economic crisis is unprecedented in modern history.
examples.translation_cn: 当前的经济危机在现代历史上是前所未有的。

senses.meaning_en: an official right to be the only person to make, use or sell an invention

examples.text: She applied for a patent on her new design.
examples.translation_cn: 她为她的新设计申请了专利。

senses.meaning_en: very obvious; easily seen or understood

examples.text: His lack of interest was patent to everyone in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 他的缺乏兴趣对房间里每个人都很明显。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to move or be moved freely and easily

examples.text: Regular stretching can improve mobility in older adults.
examples.translation_cn: 经常做拉伸运动可以改善老年人的活动能力。

senses.meaning_en: the ability of a military unit to move or be transported to a new position

examples.text: Helicopters greatly increased the mobility of the ground troops.
examples.translation_cn: 直升机大大提高了地面部队的机动性。

senses.meaning_en: the ability of people to move between different social levels or professional occupations

examples.text: Education is often seen as a key to social mobility.
examples.translation_cn: 教育常被视为实现社会流动的关键。

senses.meaning_en: to sit, stand, or lie in a lazy, relaxed way; to spend time doing nothing

examples.text: They spent the whole afternoon lounging around by the pool.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整个下午都在泳池边懒散地消磨时间。

senses.meaning_en: a room in a private house for sitting and relaxing; sitting room

examples.text: The family sat in the lounge and watched a film.
examples.translation_cn: 一家人坐在起居室里看电影。

senses.meaning_en: a room where people can wait, especially in an airport or office building

examples.text: We waited in the departure lounge until our flight was called.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在候机室里等候，直到航班通知登机。

senses.meaning_en: a bar in a hotel or club where people can sit and drink, often with music
senses.pattern: have a drink in the lounge

examples.text: They had a drink in the hotel lounge before dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他们晚饭前在酒店酒廊喝了一杯。

senses.meaning_en: the feel or shape of a surface or substance

examples.text: The texture of the bark was rough and deeply grooved.
examples.translation_cn: 树皮的纹理粗糙，沟壑很深。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of a work of art created by the arrangement and interaction of its parts

examples.text: The brief flashbacks add texture to the film.
examples.translation_cn: 简短的闪回为电影增添了质感。

senses.meaning_en: the way food feels in your mouth

examples.text: The warm soup has a smooth, velvety texture.
examples.translation_cn: 温热的汤口感顺滑柔软。

senses.meaning_en: to condemn strongly; to curse

examples.text: Environmental groups roundly damned the proposal as short-sighted.
examples.translation_cn: 环保团体强烈谴责这项提案目光短浅。

senses.meaning_en: used to express anger or annoyance with a person or thing

examples.text: I can't get this damn thing to work.
examples.translation_cn: 我搞不定这个该死的东西。

senses.meaning_en: used to show anger or frustration

examples.text: Damn it! I forgot to lock the door.
examples.translation_cn: 该死！我忘了锁门。

senses.meaning_en: to a very high degree; very

examples.text: That was a damn good movie, and I'd watch it again.
examples.translation_cn: 那部电影非常好看，我会再看一遍。

senses.meaning_en: a system of government or administration with many officials and complex rules

examples.text: The country's economy is burdened by the bureaucracy of its tax system.
examples.translation_cn: 该国经济被其税收体系的官僚体制所拖累。

senses.meaning_en: excessive rules and procedures that slow down action

examples.text: The project was bogged down in bureaucracy for months.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目被繁文缛节拖了好几个月。

senses.meaning_en: the officials and administrators in a government or large organization

examples.text: He was part of the state bureaucracy for over thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他是国家官僚机构的一员已超过三十年。

senses.meaning_en: a classical form of dance

examples.text: She studied ballet for ten years before becoming a professional dancer.
examples.translation_cn: 她学了十年芭蕾舞才成为职业舞者。

senses.meaning_en: a company of ballet dancers

examples.text: He joined a ballet company at nineteen and toured with them for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 他十九岁加入一家芭蕾舞团，随团巡演了五年。

senses.meaning_en: a person who writes music

examples.text: She became a well-known composer of film scores in her thirties.
examples.translation_cn: 她三十多岁时成为一位著名的电影配乐作曲家。

senses.meaning_en: to cheat or swindle a new student, especially at the start of the academic year

examples.text: Second-year students tried to shark the freshers out of their money during orientation.
examples.translation_cn: 大二学生试图在迎新期间骗取新生的钱财。

senses.meaning_en: a large predatory fish with a cartilaginous skeleton and several gill slits

examples.text: You may spot a shark in these waters.
examples.translation_cn: 你可能在这些水域看到鲨鱼。

senses.meaning_en: based on observation or experiment rather than theory

examples.text: The theory is based on empirical evidence rather than untested assumptions.
examples.translation_cn: 该理论基于实证证据而非未经检验的假设。

senses.meaning_en: a long walk, especially in the countryside, for pleasure or exercise

examples.text: We went hiking in the mountains last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末去山里徒步旅行了。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden large increase, especially in prices

examples.text: There was a sharp hike in energy costs last winter.
examples.translation_cn: 去年冬天能源成本急剧上涨。

senses.meaning_en: to increase prices or amounts suddenly or unfairly

examples.text: The company hiked its rates by 10 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司将费率提高了10%。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in which people or groups oppose or challenge each other directly

examples.text: The worker had a confrontation with his boss over pay.
examples.translation_cn: 这名工人因工资问题与老板发生了对峙。

senses.meaning_en: a conflict between armed forces

examples.text: The border dispute escalated into a military confrontation between the two countries.
examples.translation_cn: 边境争端升级为两国之间的军事冲突。

senses.meaning_en: the act of facing or dealing with something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: After years of denial, he had a painful confrontation with reality.
examples.translation_cn: 在多年否认之后，他痛苦地正视了现实。

senses.meaning_en: the expression of gratitude

examples.text: They made a donation in thanksgiving for the hospital's care.
examples.translation_cn: 他们捐款以感谢医院的照顾。

senses.meaning_en: a short prayer said at meals; grace, a benediction

examples.text: The children said a prayer of thanksgiving before dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在晚餐前做了谢饭祷告。

senses.meaning_en: a public celebration in acknowledgement of divine favour

examples.text: The church held a service of thanksgiving for the end of the war.
examples.translation_cn: 教会为战争结束举行了感恩礼拜。

senses.meaning_en: from a particular time or stage and continuing after that

examples.text: The policy has been in effect from 2020 onwards.
examples.translation_cn: 该政策自2020年起一直有效。

senses.meaning_en: moving forward or continuing in a forward direction

examples.text: The refugees moved onwards to the border at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 难民们在黎明时分继续向边境行进。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the human voice or speech

examples.text: His vocal range spans nearly three octaves, which is rare for a teenager.
examples.translation_cn: 他的音域将近三个八度，这对青少年来说很罕见。

senses.meaning_en: expressing opinions or criticism freely and loudly

examples.text: She has been vocal about the need for better wages.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直直言不讳地表达提高工资的必要性。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a piece of music that is sung; the singing in a popular song

examples.text: He is on vocals for the new jazz group, and his brother plays drums.
examples.translation_cn: 他在新爵士乐队中担任主唱，他的哥哥担任鼓手。

senses.meaning_en: to take something away from someone; to prevent someone from having or keeping something

examples.text: The new law will deprive many workers of their benefits.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律将剥夺许多工人的福利。

senses.meaning_en: a large building for storing goods

examples.text: Thousands of products are stored in a huge warehouse near the port.
examples.translation_cn: 成千上万的产品储存在港口附近的一个大仓库里。

senses.meaning_en: to store goods in a warehouse

examples.text: The firm warehouses imported goods before sending them to shops.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司先将进口货物存仓，再发往各家商店。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land and its natural features

examples.text: The rescue team drove slowly over rough terrain to reach the injured climber.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队缓慢驶过崎岖的地形，以到达受伤的登山者。

senses.meaning_en: small and neatly packed together

examples.text: This laptop is compact enough to fit into a small bag.
examples.translation_cn: 这台笔记本电脑小巧得能放进小包里。

senses.meaning_en: a formal agreement between people or groups

examples.text: The unions entered into a compact with management over working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 工会与管理层就工作时间达成了协议。

senses.meaning_en: a small case with a mirror and face powder

examples.text: She opened her compact to powder her nose in the restroom.
examples.translation_cn: 她在洗手间打开小粉盒往鼻子上扑粉。

senses.meaning_en: to use resources or skills effectively

examples.text: The school will deploy its resources to support struggling students.
examples.translation_cn: 学校将调配资源以支持学习困难的学生。

senses.meaning_en: to move troops or equipment into position for action

examples.text: The UN decided to deploy peacekeeping forces to the region.
examples.translation_cn: 联合国决定向该地区部署维和部队。

senses.meaning_en: to install and put a computer system or application into use

examples.text: We plan to deploy the new system before the end of the month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们计划在本月底前部署新系统。

senses.meaning_en: to start to do something new or difficult

examples.text: She decided to embark on a new research project.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定着手一项新的研究项目。

senses.meaning_en: to go aboard a ship or aircraft

examples.text: Passengers will embark at the main port tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客们明天将在主港上船。

senses.meaning_en: to put sb/sth aboard a ship or aircraft

examples.text: The crew embarked the passengers at the port.
examples.translation_cn: 船员们在港口让乘客上船。

senses.meaning_en: to take someone's attention away from something

examples.text: The loud music distracted me from my reading.
examples.translation_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心读书。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone to come to you

examples.text: She summoned a doctor to examine the child.
examples.translation_cn: 她叫来一位医生检查孩子。

senses.meaning_en: to officially order someone to appear in court

examples.text: The judge summoned him to court to answer the charges.
examples.translation_cn: 法官传唤他出庭应诉。

senses.meaning_en: to make yourself have a quality such as courage or strength
senses.pattern: summon up the courage to do

examples.text: She summoned up the courage to tell the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 她鼓起勇气说出了真相。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange an official meeting
senses.pattern: summon a meeting to do sth

examples.text: The council summoned an emergency meeting to discuss the budget.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会召开紧急会议讨论预算。

senses.meaning_en: a violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the western Atlantic

examples.text: The hurricane made landfall near Miami early this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 飓风今天清晨在迈阿密附近登陆。

senses.meaning_en: a very forceful rush or outburst of something

examples.text: A hurricane of criticism forced the minister to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 猛烈的批评浪潮迫使部长辞职。

senses.meaning_en: to move by hopping on alternate feet or with quick light jumps, especially from happiness

examples.text: The children skipped with joy when they saw the snow.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们看到雪时高兴得蹦蹦跳跳。

senses.meaning_en: to not attend (an event, class, or meeting)

examples.text: He often skips class on Friday afternoons to play video games.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常在周五下午逃课去打电子游戏。

senses.meaning_en: to skim or bounce over a surface

examples.text: The flat stone skipped across the surface of the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 扁平的石头掠过湖面弹跳。

senses.meaning_en: to throw (something) so that it bounces over a surface

examples.text: He skipped stones across the river all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个下午都在河边打水漂。

senses.meaning_en: a top-ranking diplomat who represents their country in another country

examples.text: She was ambassador to France from 2015 to 2019.
examples.translation_cn: 她于2015至2019年担任驻法国大使。

senses.meaning_en: a person who represents an organization, brand, or cause and promotes it publicly

examples.text: He is an ambassador for the charity and speaks at events.
examples.translation_cn: 他是该慈善机构的代言人，常在活动中演讲。

senses.meaning_en: the act of attacking another country or threatening to use force

examples.text: The country was condemned for its aggression against its neighbor.
examples.translation_cn: 该国因侵略邻国而受到谴责。

senses.meaning_en: hostile or destructive behavior

examples.text: Some dogs show aggression towards strangers if they feel afraid.
examples.translation_cn: 有些狗感到害怕时会对陌生人表现出攻击性。

senses.meaning_en: a community of organisms and their environment functioning as a unit

examples.text: In an ecosystem, plants, animals, and their environment all work together as one unit.
examples.translation_cn: 在一个生态系统中，植物、动物及其环境共同作为一个整体运作。

senses.meaning_en: to make something popular or active again

examples.text: The new museum hopes to revive interest in local history.
examples.translation_cn: 新博物馆希望重新激发人们对本地历史的兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: to refresh or make somebody feel active again

examples.text: A short nap revived my spirits before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会前小睡片刻让我恢复了精神。

senses.meaning_en: to return to consciousness

examples.text: She revived from a faint after a minute.
examples.translation_cn: 她晕倒一分钟后就苏醒了。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel less worried or frightened

examples.text: The doctor reassured her that the pain was normal.
examples.translation_cn: 医生让她放心，这种疼痛是正常的。

senses.meaning_en: a small open-fronted shop in a market or street

examples.text: We grabbed lunch from a food stall in the square.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在广场的一个小吃摊买了午餐。

senses.meaning_en: a small room or compartment for a shower or toilet

examples.text: He was standing in a shower stall when the phone rang.
examples.translation_cn: 电话响时他正站在淋浴间里。

senses.meaning_en: a compartment for a single animal in a barn

examples.text: The horse waited patiently in its stall for the morning feed.
examples.translation_cn: 马耐心地在它的隔间里等待早晨的饲料。

senses.meaning_en: a seat in the front part of a theatre, near the stage

examples.text: We sat in the stalls to get a clear view of the stage.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在正厅前座，以便清楚地看到舞台。

senses.meaning_en: to open or spread out (something folded)

examples.text: He unfolded the map and looked for the nearest town.
examples.translation_cn: 他展开地图，寻找最近的城镇。

senses.meaning_en: to develop or become clear

examples.text: As the story unfolds, the true motive becomes clear.
examples.translation_cn: 随着故事的展开，真正的动机变得清晰。

senses.meaning_en: to reveal or make known (plans, thoughts, etc.)

examples.text: She unfolded her plan to the team at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会议上向团队披露了她的计划。

examples.text: You should check the validity of your passport before travelling abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 出国旅行前你应该检查护照的有效性。

examples.text: Many researchers doubt the validity of these findings.
examples.translation_cn: 许多研究人员怀疑这些发现的正确性。

senses.meaning_en: to put an end to by force

examples.text: The government sent troops to suppress the armed rebellion.
examples.translation_cn: 政府派军队镇压武装叛乱。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent something from growing or developing

examples.text: This drug suppresses the growth of cancer cells.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药能抑制癌细胞的生长。

senses.meaning_en: to stop yourself from showing a feeling or reaction

examples.text: She suppressed a smile and continued with her work.
examples.translation_cn: 她忍住笑，继续工作。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent information from becoming known

examples.text: The government attempted to suppress the truth about the disaster.
examples.translation_cn: 政府试图封锁灾难真相。

senses.meaning_en: located near or next to another place

examples.text: The new airport will serve several neighbouring cities.
examples.translation_cn: 新机场将为几个邻近城市服务。

senses.meaning_en: to go somewhere quietly and secretly, often trying not to be noticed

examples.text: I sneaked out of the house after midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 午夜后我偷偷溜出了房子。

senses.meaning_en: to take or bring something somewhere secretly, especially without permission

examples.text: He sneaked a bottle of water into the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 他偷偷带了一瓶水进音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: to secretly tell someone in authority, such as a teacher, about something wrong that someone else has done

examples.text: She sneaked on her brother for breaking the vase.
examples.translation_cn: 她因弟弟打碎花瓶而告了他的密。

senses.meaning_en: to involve something as a necessary part or result

examples.text: This new position entails dealing with difficult customers every day.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新职位每天都要应付难缠的顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a wide road for fast traffic, with separate carriageways and no level crossings

examples.text: The accident caused long delays on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 事故导致高速公路上长时间的延误。

senses.meaning_en: to put a drug or liquid into the body using a needle

examples.text: The nurse injected the vaccine into my left arm.
examples.translation_cn: 护士把疫苗注射到我的左臂。

senses.meaning_en: to put money or something else into something, especially in large amounts

examples.text: The government injected extra cash into the health system.
examples.translation_cn: 政府向卫生系统注入额外资金。

senses.meaning_en: to add a quality, feeling, or new element to something

examples.text: His jokes injected a little humour into the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他的玩笑给会议增添了一点幽默。

senses.meaning_en: to administer an injection to (someone or something), especially of medicine or drugs

examples.text: The nurse injected the patient with insulin before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在早餐前给病人注射了胰岛素。

senses.meaning_en: after that time; from then on

examples.text: She left the company in May; thereafter she worked as a consultant.
examples.translation_cn: 她五月离开公司，此后做顾问。

senses.meaning_en: very bad or unpleasant

examples.text: It is dreadful that so many people are still living in poverty.
examples.translation_cn: 仍有许多人生活在贫困中，这很糟糕。

senses.meaning_en: causing great fear or dread

examples.text: The scene of the crash was dreadful to look at.
examples.translation_cn: 车祸现场看起来令人恐惧。

senses.meaning_en: used for emphasis, meaning very great

examples.text: He spends a dreadful lot of money on cars.
examples.translation_cn: 他花极多钱在汽车上。

senses.meaning_en: a short period of unrestrained enjoyment or a brief romantic or sexual relationship

examples.text: They had a final fling in Paris before they retired.
examples.translation_cn: 他们退休前在巴黎最后放纵了一次。

senses.meaning_en: to throw something with force or violence

examples.text: She angrily flung the letter into the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 她生气地把信扔进火里。

senses.meaning_en: to start doing something with great energy or enthusiasm

examples.text: After the loss, he flung himself into his work.
examples.translation_cn: 失利后，他全身心投入工作。

senses.meaning_en: an act of throwing something, often violently

examples.text: With a single fling, he sent the ball over the fence.
examples.translation_cn: 他用力一扔，把球扔过了栅栏。

senses.meaning_en: the act of changing or correcting something; a change made

examples.text: The editor made several revisions to the opening paragraph.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑对开头段落做了几处修改。

senses.meaning_en: the act of studying again for an exam

examples.text: She did some last-minute revision for her chemistry exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她为化学考试做了一些考前最后复习。

senses.meaning_en: a changed edition or new version

examples.text: The latest revision of the manual includes updated safety instructions.
examples.translation_cn: 手册的最新修订版包含了更新的安全说明。

senses.meaning_en: to make small changes to a law, document, etc.

examples.text: The committee agreed to amend the bill before the final vote.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会同意在最终表决前修改该法案。

senses.meaning_en: to change one's behaviour and improve it

examples.text: He promised to amend his ways after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻曝光后，他承诺改过自新。

senses.meaning_en: payment or action to make up for harm or a wrong
senses.pattern: make amends to sb for sth

examples.text: She made amends to her friend for missing the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她因错过会议而向朋友作出补偿。

senses.meaning_en: a boat or ship used to transport people, vehicles and goods

examples.text: We travelled by ferry to the nearby island.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘渡船去了附近的岛屿。

senses.meaning_en: to carry or transport people or goods

examples.text: A small boat ferries passengers across the river.
examples.translation_cn: 小船把乘客运过河。

senses.meaning_en: to move someone or something from one place to another, usually repeatedly
senses.pattern: ferry sb to and from sth

examples.text: I ferry my kids to and from school every day.
examples.translation_cn: 我每天接送孩子上下学。

senses.meaning_en: a copy of a book, article, etc. submitted for publication

examples.text: She submitted the manuscript to three publishers last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周把原稿投给了三家出版社。

senses.meaning_en: a handwritten book or document, especially an old one

examples.text: The museum displays a medieval manuscript written by monks.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆陈列着一份修道士抄写的中世纪手稿。

senses.meaning_en: written by hand, not printed

examples.text: The collection includes a manuscript letter by the famous poet.
examples.translation_cn: 该收藏中有一封那位著名诗人的手写信件。

senses.meaning_en: an edge around something, especially circular

examples.text: She ran her finger along the rim of the glass.
examples.translation_cn: 她用指尖沿着杯沿摸了摸。

senses.meaning_en: the outer edge of a wheel

examples.text: The mechanic replaced the bent rim of the front wheel.
examples.translation_cn: 修理工更换了前轮弯曲的轮圈。

senses.meaning_en: to form a rim around something

examples.text: The lake was rimmed with reeds and wildflowers.
examples.translation_cn: 湖边围着一圈芦苇和野花。

senses.meaning_en: to coat the rim of a glass with salt or another powder

examples.text: Rim each glass with lime juice and salt before pouring the drinks.
examples.translation_cn: 倒饮料前，给每个杯子蘸上酸橙汁和盐。

senses.meaning_en: joined as allies

examples.text: France was closely allied with Britain during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 法国在战争期间与英国紧密结盟。

senses.meaning_en: related

examples.text: The study of language is closely allied to cultural studies.
examples.translation_cn: 语言研究与文化研究密切相关。

senses.meaning_en: to close and reopen both eyes quickly

examples.text: He blinked in surprise at the camera flash.
examples.translation_cn: 在相机闪光灯下，他惊讶地眨了眨眼。

senses.meaning_en: to flash on and off at regular intervals

examples.text: The warning light blinked on and off all night.
examples.translation_cn: 警示灯一整夜不停地闪烁。

senses.meaning_en: to have the slightest doubt, hesitation or remorse

examples.text: She didn't blink at the idea of moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 对于移居国外的想法，她毫不犹豫。

senses.meaning_en: having the right or qualification to do something

examples.text: Students are eligible to apply for the research grant.
examples.translation_cn: 学生有资格申请研究资助。

senses.meaning_en: desirable as a marriage partner

examples.text: He is the most eligible bachelor in town.
examples.translation_cn: 他是镇上最合适的单身汉。

senses.meaning_en: a large, often expensive boat used for racing or pleasure trips

examples.text: They spent the weekend sailing along the coast on a luxury yacht.
examples.translation_cn: 他们周末乘豪华游艇沿海岸航行。

senses.meaning_en: to sail, voyage, or race in a yacht

examples.text: We yachted around the Greek islands last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去年夏天乘游艇环游了希腊群岛。

senses.meaning_en: a group within a larger organization, especially a political party, that has aims or beliefs different from the rest

examples.text: A faction within the party wants to block the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 党内的一个派系想阻止这项新法律。

senses.meaning_en: conflict or disagreement within a group or party

examples.text: The party was torn by faction and struggled to govern.
examples.translation_cn: 该党因派系斗争而陷入内讧，难以治理。

senses.meaning_en: not damaged, broken, or missing any parts; complete

examples.text: The ancient vase remained intact after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 这只古代花瓶在地震后完好无损。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy fuel oil used in diesel engines

examples.text: These trucks run on diesel, not gasoline, all year round.
examples.translation_cn: 这些卡车全年烧柴油，不烧汽油。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle powered by a diesel engine

examples.text: She drives a diesel because it is cheaper to run on long trips.
examples.translation_cn: 她开柴油车，因为长途跑起来更省钱。

senses.meaning_en: a thick slice of beef, typically grilled or fried

examples.text: He ordered a steak and chips for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 他午餐点了一份牛排和薯条。

senses.meaning_en: a thick slice of fish, meat, or vegetable, cooked by grilling or frying

examples.text: She grilled a thick salmon steak with lemon.
examples.translation_cn: 她烤了一块厚厚的三文鱼排，配柠檬。

senses.meaning_en: an official who makes sure rules are followed during a game; to act as such an official

examples.text: He was asked to referee a match between two local teams.
examples.translation_cn: 他被邀请担任两支当地队伍之间比赛的裁判。

senses.meaning_en: a person who provides a reference for someone, e.g. for a job application

examples.text: She agreed to be a referee for a job application I submitted.
examples.translation_cn: 她同意做我提交的工作申请的推荐人。

senses.meaning_en: an expert who judges a manuscript or article for publication

examples.text: He was asked to be a referee for a journal that reviews medical research.
examples.translation_cn: 他被邀请担任一家评审医学研究的期刊的审稿人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is asked to settle a disagreement
senses.pattern: act as referee in a dispute

examples.text: The union asked an outsider to act as referee in a dispute over pay.
examples.translation_cn: 工会请一位外部人士在薪酬纠纷中担任仲裁人。

senses.meaning_en: the mineralized remains of an animal or plant

examples.text: We found a fossil of a small mammal in the rock.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在岩石中发现了一块小型哺乳动物的化石。

senses.meaning_en: an extremely old-fashioned person or thing

examples.text: My grandfather is a fossil when it comes to technology.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父在科技方面是个老顽固。

senses.meaning_en: an oxide containing two oxygen atoms in each molecule

examples.text: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air during photosynthesis.
examples.translation_cn: 植物在光合作用过程中从空气中吸收二氧化碳。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body that you sit on

examples.text: She slipped on the ice and landed hard on her butt.
examples.translation_cn: 她在冰上滑倒，重重地摔坐在了地上。

senses.meaning_en: the thick or blunt end of something, such as a cigarette

examples.text: He dropped the butt of his cigarette into the ashtray.
examples.translation_cn: 他把烟头丢进烟灰缸里。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is the target of jokes or criticism

examples.text: He became the butt of every joke in the office.
examples.translation_cn: 他成了办公室里所有笑话的对象。

senses.meaning_en: to hit or push someone or something with the head

examples.text: The bull butted the fence and knocked it down.
examples.translation_cn: 公牛用头顶撞栅栏，把它撞倒了。

senses.meaning_en: a flower of the genus Lilium, typically with large, trumpet-shaped petals

examples.text: The garden was filled with white lilies in bloom.
examples.translation_cn: 花园里开满了白色的百合花。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives money or support to an artist, writer, organization, etc.; a defender or advocate
senses.pattern: be a patron of the arts

examples.text: She is a patron of the arts who helped fund the new gallery.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位帮助资助新画廊的艺术赞助人。

senses.meaning_en: a regular customer of a shop, restaurant, etc.

examples.text: She is a regular patron of the local café near her office.
examples.translation_cn: 她是办公室附近那家当地咖啡馆的常客。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a city or its local government

examples.text: The municipal government plans to improve public transportation.
examples.translation_cn: 市政府计划改善公共交通。

senses.meaning_en: willing to accept or allow behaviour, opinions, etc. that you do not agree with

examples.text: A good leader is tolerant towards people with different opinions.
examples.translation_cn: 好的领导者能宽容持有不同意见的人。

senses.meaning_en: able to survive or continue in difficult conditions

examples.text: These plants are tolerant of dry conditions and poor soil.
examples.translation_cn: 这些植物能耐干旱和贫瘠的土壤。

senses.meaning_en: great suffering or unhappiness

examples.text: Thousands of people were living in misery after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 地震后，成千上万的人生活在苦难中。

senses.meaning_en: poverty; extreme lack of money

examples.text: Thousands of families live in abject misery, unable to afford food.
examples.translation_cn: 成千上万的家庭生活在赤贫中，连食物都买不起。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes great suffering; a hardship

examples.text: The report describes the miseries of war in vivid detail.
examples.translation_cn: 报告生动地描述了战争的种种磨难。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is always unhappy and complaining

examples.text: He's a real misery, always moaning about his job.
examples.translation_cn: 他真是个讨厌鬼，总是抱怨工作。

senses.meaning_en: hair cut straight across the forehead

examples.text: She has a straight-cut fringe that almost covers her eyebrows.
examples.translation_cn: 她留着直刘海，几乎遮住了眉毛。

senses.meaning_en: the outer or less important part of an area, group, or activity

examples.text: Many refugees are forced to live on the fringes of society.
examples.translation_cn: 许多难民被迫生活在社会边缘。

senses.meaning_en: not mainstream; additional to the main thing

examples.text: The proposal was supported only by a fringe group of activists.
examples.translation_cn: 这个提案只得到了少数边缘活动人士群体的支持。

senses.meaning_en: a decorative border of hanging threads

examples.text: The scarf has a fringe of red threads at each end.
examples.translation_cn: 这条围巾两端有红色的流苏。

senses.meaning_en: a sea or lake voyage for pleasure

examples.text: We went on a Mediterranean cruise last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去年夏天去地中海乘船游览。

senses.meaning_en: to travel at a constant speed for maximum operating efficiency

examples.text: The car cruised at 70 mph on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车在高速公路上以每小时70英里的速度巡航。

senses.meaning_en: to move about an area leisurely looking for something or customers

examples.text: The taxi cruised the streets looking for passengers.
examples.translation_cn: 出租车在街上巡游寻找乘客。

senses.meaning_en: to sail about, especially for pleasure

examples.text: We cruised around the Greek islands for a week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在希腊群岛巡游了一周。

senses.meaning_en: to combine into a whole

examples.text: The software firm merged with a larger rival last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家软件公司去年与一家更大的竞争对手合并了。

senses.meaning_en: to blend gradually into something else

examples.text: The figure merged into the darkness behind the trees.
examples.translation_cn: 那个人影逐渐消失在树后的黑暗中。

senses.meaning_en: to join a line of moving traffic without slowing it down

examples.text: Slow down and wait for a gap before you merge into traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 减速并等待空当后再汇入车流。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong wish or urge to do something

examples.text: She bought the shoes on impulse after work.
examples.translation_cn: 她下班后一时冲动买了那双鞋。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes something else to happen or develop more quickly

examples.text: The new evidence gave a fresh impulse to the investigation.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据给调查注入了新的动力。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden force or push; (physics) impulse

examples.text: The collision applied a massive impulse to the stationary car.
examples.translation_cn: 碰撞给那辆静止的汽车施加了巨大冲力。

senses.meaning_en: savagely violent, vicious, or cruel

examples.text: The soldiers were brutal to the prisoners during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间，士兵们对囚犯很残暴。

senses.meaning_en: harsh and unrelenting

examples.text: They trained in brutal conditions to prepare for the marathon.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在极其艰难的条件下训练，为马拉松做准备。

senses.meaning_en: direct and clear about something unpleasant, without trying to be kind

examples.text: She was brutal about his performance, telling him it was unacceptable.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他的表现直言不讳，告诉他这令人无法接受。

senses.meaning_en: with certainty

examples.text: She stated positively that she had locked the door.
examples.translation_cn: 她肯定地说她锁好了门。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that shows optimism or approval

examples.text: The coach spoke positively about the team's progress.
examples.translation_cn: 教练积极评价了球队的进步。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize the truth of a statement or degree

examples.text: The children were positively thrilled with the surprise.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们对这个惊喜感到非常兴奋。

senses.meaning_en: refusing to give up

examples.text: She was persistent in applying for the scholarship.
examples.translation_cn: 她坚持不懈地申请奖学金。

senses.meaning_en: continuously or repeatedly occurring

examples.text: Persistent headaches forced him to see a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 持续性头痛迫使他去看医生。

senses.meaning_en: to fly high in the air

examples.text: The hawk soared above the hills without moving its wings.
examples.translation_cn: 鹰没有扇动翅膀，在山丘上空翱翔。

senses.meaning_en: to be very tall or rise to a great height

examples.text: The cliffs soar to a height of 500 metres above the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 悬崖高耸，高出海面500米。

senses.meaning_en: to increase rapidly in amount, level, or value

examples.text: House prices have soared to a record high this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年房价飙升到了历史最高点。

senses.meaning_en: to rise quickly in spirits or mood

examples.text: Her spirits soared when she heard the good news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到好消息时情绪高涨。

senses.meaning_en: thin in an attractive way

examples.text: She is slim and often goes jogging in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她很苗条，经常早上慢跑。

senses.meaning_en: very small; slight

examples.text: There is only a slim chance of finding a parking space here.
examples.translation_cn: 在这里找到停车位的可能性很小。

senses.meaning_en: to become thinner, usually by eating less

examples.text: He slimmed down by cutting out junk food and sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过戒掉垃圾食品和糖来减肥。

senses.meaning_en: suitable or right for the occasion

examples.text: It is fitting that the school named the library after her.
examples.translation_cn: 学校以她的名字命名图书馆是合适的。

senses.meaning_en: a small part used to connect or repair pipes or machines

examples.text: You need a new fitting for the gas pipe.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要一个新的煤气管道配件。

senses.meaning_en: movable items in a building such as carpets or curtains

examples.text: The fittings in the house were old but still functional.
examples.translation_cn: 房子里的固定设施很旧，但还能用。

senses.meaning_en: an occasion when you try on clothes being made for you

examples.text: She has a fitting for her wedding dress on Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 她周六要试穿婚纱。

senses.meaning_en: care taken to avoid danger or mistakes

examples.text: You should treat the results of this survey with caution.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该谨慎对待这项调查的结果。

senses.meaning_en: a warning, especially one given by the police to someone who has committed a minor offence
senses.pattern: be let off with a caution

examples.text: He was let off with a caution by the police.
examples.translation_cn: 他被警察警告后释放。

senses.meaning_en: to warn someone about a possible danger or problem

examples.text: The doctor cautioned him against lifting heavy weights.
examples.translation_cn: 医生告诫他不要举重物。

senses.meaning_en: the sill of a doorway or entrance

examples.text: He stepped over the threshold and turned on the light.
examples.translation_cn: 他跨过门槛并打开了灯。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or point of entry
senses.collocation: on the threshold of a new era

examples.text: The country is on the threshold of a technological revolution.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家正处在技术革命的开端。

senses.meaning_en: a quantitative level at which something is triggered

examples.text: The threshold for passing the exam is 70 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 通过考试的分数线是70分。

senses.meaning_en: the wage or salary at which income tax becomes due

examples.text: People earning below the tax threshold do not pay income tax.
examples.translation_cn: 收入低于起征点的人无需缴纳所得税。

senses.meaning_en: easily broken or damaged

examples.text: The antique vase is fragile and must be handled with great care.
examples.translation_cn: 这个古董花瓶很易碎，必须轻拿轻放。

senses.meaning_en: weak in health; easily becoming ill

examples.text: After the flu, he still feels fragile and avoids strenuous exercise.
examples.translation_cn: 流感过后，他仍感到虚弱，避免剧烈运动。

senses.meaning_en: emotionally delicate; easily upset

examples.text: She is emotionally fragile and often misinterprets neutral remarks as criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 她情感脆弱，常把中性的评价误解为批评。

senses.meaning_en: a ray of light

examples.text: A shaft of light cut through the dark room.
examples.translation_cn: 一道光穿过了黑暗的房间。

senses.meaning_en: the central stem of a feather

examples.text: The shaft of the feather is light but strong.
examples.translation_cn: 羽毛的轴很轻但很结实。

senses.meaning_en: a vertical passage, as in a mine or building
senses.pattern: a mine shaft / a lift shaft

examples.text: The miners went down the mine shaft before sunrise.
examples.translation_cn: 矿工们在日出前下到矿井里。

senses.meaning_en: a long rotating part in a machine

examples.text: The drive shaft transfers power from the engine to the wheels.
examples.translation_cn: 传动轴把动力从发动机传到车轮。

senses.meaning_en: principles concerning right and wrong; a set of social rules

examples.text: The law was changed to reflect a shift in public morality.
examples.translation_cn: 法律被修改以反映公共道德的转变。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being morally good; a sense of right and wrong

examples.text: His strong sense of morality keeps him from lying to his friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他强烈的道德感使他不向朋友撒谎。

senses.meaning_en: an assertion that something is not true

examples.text: The company issued a denial of the rumour.
examples.translation_cn: 公司对谣言发表了否认声明。

senses.meaning_en: a refusal to provide something that is requested or desired

examples.text: The denial of a visa to the journalist drew criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 拒绝向该记者发放签证引发了批评。

senses.meaning_en: refusal to believe that a problem exists

examples.text: He is in denial about his drinking problem.
examples.translation_cn: 他不愿承认自己的酗酒问题。

senses.meaning_en: refusal to admit responsibility for wrongdoing

examples.text: The company repeated its denial of responsibility for the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 公司反复否认对事故负有责任。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; excellent

examples.text: We had a fantastic time at the beach last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末在海滩玩得非常开心。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to fantasy; imaginary

examples.text: The novel is set in a fantastic world where dragons fly at night.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说以一个夜晚有龙飞翔的幻想世界为背景。

senses.meaning_en: very large; extraordinary in amount or degree

examples.text: He earns a fantastic amount of money every single month.
examples.translation_cn: 他每个月挣的钱多得惊人。

senses.meaning_en: a large luxurious house

examples.text: They live in a mansion with a private pool and a tennis court.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在一栋带私人泳池和网球场的豪宅里。

senses.meaning_en: personal ornaments such as rings, necklaces, and bracelets, often made of precious metals and set with gemstones

examples.text: She received a beautiful piece of jewellery as a wedding gift.
examples.translation_cn: 她收到一件漂亮的首饰作为结婚礼物。

senses.meaning_en: a strong desire or ambition to achieve something

examples.text: His aspiration to become a doctor kept him studying late into the night.
examples.translation_cn: 他想成为医生的抱负让他学习到深夜。

senses.meaning_en: a burst of air that follows the release of some consonants

examples.text: In English, the /p/ in pin is pronounced with aspiration.
examples.translation_cn: 英语中，pin 里的 /p/ 音是送气发音的。

senses.meaning_en: likely or expected to become or happen

examples.text: Several prospective buyers visited the apartment over the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 几位潜在的买家周末参观了这套公寓。

senses.meaning_en: an inverted U shape or a curved architectural element

examples.text: The arch of the old stone bridge has survived the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老石桥的桥拱在洪水中保存了下来。

senses.meaning_en: to form or make something form an arch shape

examples.text: The cat arched its back and hissed at the stranger.
examples.translation_cn: 那只猫弓起背，对陌生人发出嘶嘶声。

senses.meaning_en: the curved part of the bottom of the foot

examples.text: The arch of my left foot hurts after a long run.
examples.translation_cn: 我的左脚足弓在长跑后疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: a place covered by an arch; an archway

examples.text: We walked through a narrow arch into the quiet garden.
examples.translation_cn: 我们穿过一道窄拱门，进入安静的花园。

senses.meaning_en: a person's sense of their own value and importance

examples.text: Winning the championship boosted the young player's ego.
examples.translation_cn: 赢得冠军增强了这名年轻球员的自尊心。

senses.meaning_en: a long, soft seat with a back and arms for two or more people

examples.text: We all sat on the sofa and talked for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 我们都坐在沙发上聊了好几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to obey a rule or law

examples.text: All students must conform to the school's rules and regulations.
examples.translation_cn: 所有学生都必须遵守学校的规章制度。

senses.meaning_en: to behave according to social expectations

examples.text: Many teenagers conform to social norms to avoid being teased.
examples.translation_cn: 许多青少年为了不被嘲笑而遵从社会规范。

senses.meaning_en: to agree or match

examples.text: The experimental data conform to our earlier predictions.
examples.translation_cn: 实验数据与我们早先的预测相符。

senses.meaning_en: a copy of a work of art, piece of furniture, etc.

examples.text: The museum displayed a reproduction of a famous Greek statue.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出了一件著名希腊雕像的复制品。

senses.meaning_en: the process by which living things produce young

examples.text: Reproduction in mammals normally requires the union of two sex cells.
examples.translation_cn: 哺乳动物的繁殖通常需要两个性细胞的结合。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of reproduced sound or images

examples.text: The new speakers provide accurate reproduction of sound across all frequencies.
examples.translation_cn: 新扬声器在所有频率上提供准确的声音再现。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of making copies

examples.text: The law regulates the reproduction of medical records.
examples.translation_cn: 法律规范医疗记录的复制。

senses.meaning_en: to affect someone's emotions in a very powerful way, making it difficult for them to think clearly

examples.text: She was overwhelmed with joy when she saw her newborn baby.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到刚出生的婴儿时欣喜若狂。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat or overpower completely

examples.text: The troops were quickly overwhelmed by the enemy's assault.
examples.translation_cn: 部队很快被敌人的进攻压垮了。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone so much work or so many things that they cannot deal with it all

examples.text: We were overwhelmed by requests for information after the announcement.
examples.translation_cn: 公告发布后，索取信息的请求让我们应接不暇。

senses.meaning_en: to engulf, surge over and submerge completely

examples.text: The low-lying village was overwhelmed by floodwaters during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 地势低洼的村庄在暴风雨中被洪水淹没。

senses.meaning_en: small stones, often used for making paths and roads

examples.text: We followed a gravel road through the forest.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着一条砾石路穿过森林。

senses.meaning_en: used when something is surprising because it is the opposite of what you expected

examples.text: Ironically, the cheapest option turned out to be the best.
examples.translation_cn: 具有讽刺意味的是，最便宜的选择竟然是最好的。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that shows irony

examples.text: She smiled ironically when he repeated the same excuse.
examples.translation_cn: 当他再次重复同样的借口时，她讽刺地笑了笑。

senses.meaning_en: to form an opinion or guess about something without knowing all the facts

examples.text: Scientists have speculated about the origin of the universe for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们对宇宙的起源已经猜测了几十年。

senses.meaning_en: to buy and sell goods, shares, etc. hoping to make a profit, but risking losing money

examples.text: He speculated in oil futures and lost a fortune in one month.
examples.translation_cn: 他投机石油期货，一个月内损失了一大笔钱。

senses.meaning_en: to give a religious speech in a church

examples.text: The pastor preaches to the congregation every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 这位牧师每个星期天向会众讲道。

senses.meaning_en: to state or spread a belief or idea publicly

examples.text: They preach the gospel to people in remote villages.
examples.translation_cn: 他们向偏远村庄的人们宣扬福音。

senses.meaning_en: to give sb advice in a way that they find annoying

examples.text: My mother always preaches at me about healthy eating.
examples.translation_cn: 我妈妈总是对我说教健康饮食。

senses.meaning_en: of a bleached or pale golden (light yellowish) colour, especially of hair

examples.text: She has long blond hair that reaches her waist.
examples.translation_cn: 她有一头长及腰部的金发。

senses.meaning_en: a person with blond hair

examples.text: My sister is a natural blond with green eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹是自然金发，有一双绿眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: a pale yellowish (golden brown) colour

examples.text: Her hair is a light blond in summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她的头发在夏天是浅金黄色。

senses.meaning_en: a man who has joined a monastic order and lives a religious life

examples.text: He chose to become a monk and spent the rest of his life in a monastery.
examples.translation_cn: 他选择成为修道士，并在修道院度过余生。

senses.meaning_en: a solid or hollow shape with circular ends and straight sides

examples.text: The water storage tank is shaped like a cylinder and holds ten thousand litres.
examples.translation_cn: 这个储水罐呈圆柱形，能容纳一万升。

senses.meaning_en: the chamber in an engine where a piston moves

examples.text: This new model comes with a four-cylinder engine.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新车型配备四缸发动机。

senses.meaning_en: the rotating part of a revolver that holds cartridges

examples.text: He loaded six bullets into the cylinder of a revolver.
examples.translation_cn: 他把六发子弹装进左轮手枪的弹巢里。

senses.meaning_en: a single article of clothing

examples.text: She bought a garment made of soft cotton.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一件柔软的棉布衣服。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow opening or groove for inserting something

examples.text: He inserted a coin into the slot on the side of the machine.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一枚硬币投进机器侧面的投币口。

senses.meaning_en: a scheduled period of time for an activity

examples.text: I booked a slot for my driving test next Monday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我预约了下周一早上驾照考试的时间。

senses.meaning_en: a place or position in a team, list, or schedule

examples.text: She earned a slot on the national team this season.
examples.translation_cn: 她这个赛季在国家队赢得了一席之地。

senses.meaning_en: following one after another without interruption

examples.text: They have won the title for the third consecutive year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们连续第三年夺得冠军。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that provides nourishment essential for growth and life

examples.text: These dark leafy greens are rich in nutrients.
examples.translation_cn: 这些深绿色叶菜富含养分。

senses.meaning_en: providing nourishment

examples.text: The seedlings were watered with a nutrient solution twice a week.
examples.translation_cn: 幼苗每周浇两次营养液。

senses.meaning_en: existing as a natural or permanent part of something

examples.text: A certain level of risk is inherent in every medical procedure.
examples.translation_cn: 每种医疗程序都固有某种程度的风险。

senses.meaning_en: the act of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work

examples.text: The exploitation of workers is illegal in many countries.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多国家，剥削工人是违法的。

senses.meaning_en: the improper use of something for selfish purposes

examples.text: The exploitation of a legal loophole allowed him to avoid taxes.
examples.translation_cn: 利用法律漏洞让他得以避税。

senses.meaning_en: the act of using or developing something

examples.text: The commercial exploitation of ocean resources requires advanced technology.
examples.translation_cn: 海洋资源的商业开发需要先进技术。

senses.meaning_en: to seize or grip tightly

examples.text: The child clutched the toy to his chest and fell asleep.
examples.translation_cn: 这孩子把玩具紧紧抱在胸前睡着了。

senses.meaning_en: control or power over someone or something

examples.text: He found himself in the clutches of a ruthless gang.
examples.translation_cn: 他发现自己落入了一个残忍团伙的控制。

senses.meaning_en: the pedal or mechanism for disengaging the gears in a car

examples.text: You should release the clutch slowly when starting on a hill.
examples.translation_cn: 在坡道上起步时，你应该慢慢松开离合器。

senses.meaning_en: a group of eggs or young birds

examples.text: The hen laid a clutch of eggs in the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 母鸡在角落里下了一窝蛋。

senses.meaning_en: the shape or outline of something, determined by how its parts are arranged

examples.text: The mountains form a dramatic configuration against the evening sky.
examples.translation_cn: 山峦在傍晚的天空下形成引人注目的轮廓。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which parts are arranged or set up, especially in a computer system

examples.text: The system is arranged in a configuration that allows multiple users to connect.
examples.translation_cn: 该系统被设置成一种允许多个用户连接的配置。

senses.meaning_en: the arrangement of electrons in an atom or molecule

examples.text: The electron configuration of sodium determines its chemical properties.
examples.translation_cn: 钠的电子排布决定了它的化学性质。

senses.meaning_en: the process of setting up or customizing a computer system or software

examples.text: During configuration, the setup wizard asks you to choose a default language.
examples.translation_cn: 在配置过程中，设置向导会要求你选择默认语言。

senses.meaning_en: good at expressing ideas or feelings clearly in words

examples.text: She is articulate about her needs and rarely hesitates to explain them.
examples.translation_cn: 她善于表达自己的需求，很少犹豫解释。

senses.meaning_en: to express thoughts or ideas clearly, or to explain something specific clearly

examples.text: She articulated a plan for the project with clarity.
examples.translation_cn: 她清楚地阐述了项目计划。

senses.meaning_en: clearly expressed or presented

examples.text: She gave an articulate account of the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 她清晰讲述了事件经过。

senses.meaning_en: to speak clearly and pronounce words distinctly

examples.text: The child learned to articulate clearly after months of speech therapy.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几个月的言语治疗，孩子学会了清晰发音。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the work of a manager or to management

examples.text: She applied for a managerial position in a large company.
examples.translation_cn: 她申请了一家大公司的管理职位。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make something softer

examples.text: The dried mushrooms will soften in warm water for twenty minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 干蘑菇在温水中浸泡二十分钟会变软。

senses.meaning_en: to make something less harsh or bright

examples.text: She softened her tone when she saw the child was upset.
examples.translation_cn: 看到孩子难过，她缓和了语气。

senses.meaning_en: to make something less severe or unpleasant

examples.text: The government has taken steps to soften the impact of the tax increase.
examples.translation_cn: 政府已采取措施减轻增税带来的影响。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone more likely to agree or less resistant

examples.text: They tried to soften the manager up with compliments before asking for a raise.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在请求加薪前试图用恭维话来软化经理。

senses.meaning_en: to make or become straight

examples.text: She straightened the bent wire with her fingers.
examples.translation_cn: 她用手指把弯曲的金属丝弄直。

senses.meaning_en: to make tidy

examples.text: She straightened up the living room before the guests arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 客人到达前，她整理了客厅。

senses.meaning_en: to make clear

examples.text: We need to straighten out the facts before making a decision.
examples.translation_cn: 在做决定之前，我们需要澄清事实。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone heterosexual

examples.text: Some people wrongly believe therapy can straighten out gay people.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人错误地认为治疗能把同性恋者掰直。

senses.meaning_en: Having the form of a line; straight or roughly straight

examples.text: The drawing is linear in form, with clean straight lines.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画呈直线形，线条干净利落。

senses.meaning_en: following a clear order or sequence; step-by-step

examples.text: The chapters are arranged in linear order, from the earliest to the latest.
examples.translation_cn: 这些章节按线性顺序排列，从最早到最晚。

senses.meaning_en: Of or relating to lines; involving measurement in one dimension

examples.text: The fabric is sold by the linear meter.
examples.translation_cn: 这种布料按米出售。

senses.meaning_en: from the perspective of economics or the economy

examples.text: Economically speaking, rural areas still lag behind cities.
examples.translation_cn: 从经济角度看，农村地区仍落后于城市。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that saves money or resources

examples.text: She lives economically so she can save for retirement.
examples.translation_cn: 她生活节俭，以便为退休储蓄。

senses.meaning_en: the process by which land, rock, or soil is gradually worn away by water, wind, or ice

examples.text: The erosion of the coastline is a serious problem here.
examples.translation_cn: 这里的海岸线侵蚀是一个严重问题。

senses.meaning_en: the gradual loss or weakening of something such as trust, rights, or standards

examples.text: The scandal caused a serious erosion of public trust.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻导致公众信任严重受损。

senses.meaning_en: a small device, especially an electrode, used to explore or measure something by penetrating or being placed in it
senses.pattern: use a probe to do sth

examples.text: The doctor used a probe to examine the wound.
examples.translation_cn: 医生用探针检查了伤口。

senses.meaning_en: an investigation or inquiry into something

examples.text: The agency launched a probe into the safety failures.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构对安全漏洞展开了调查。

senses.meaning_en: to ask questions in order to find out secret or hidden information

examples.text: Reporters probed the minister for details about his secret deals.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们追问该部长其隐秘交易的细节。

senses.meaning_en: a spacecraft used to acquire information about its surroundings
senses.pattern: send a probe to do sth

examples.text: The country sent a probe to study the planet's atmosphere.
examples.translation_cn: 该国发射了一个探测器来研究这颗行星的大气层。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or consisting of molecules

examples.text: Scientists studied how proteins fold at the molecular level.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家研究了蛋白质如何在分子水平上折叠。

senses.meaning_en: relating to molecular gastronomy

examples.text: The chef uses molecular gastronomy to create surprising textures and flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 这位厨师运用分子料理来创造令人惊喜的口感和风味。

senses.meaning_en: a person sent to spread a religion, especially Christianity

examples.text: He served as a missionary in Kenya for twelve years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在肯尼亚做了十二年传教士。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a religious mission

examples.text: She did missionary work in rural areas for several years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在农村地区做了几年传教工作。

senses.meaning_en: a large structure used to produce nuclear energy

examples.text: Engineers shut down a nuclear reactor for routine maintenance.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师关停了一座核反应堆进行例行维护。

senses.meaning_en: a container or device where chemical reactions take place

examples.text: The gases are pumped into a chemical reactor and heated to 400 degrees.
examples.translation_cn: 这些气体被泵入一个化学反应器并加热到400度。

senses.meaning_en: a widespread disease that affects many people

examples.text: A severe flu epidemic swept through the region last winter.
examples.translation_cn: 去年冬天一场严重的流感疫情席卷了这一地区。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden rapid increase in something harmful

examples.text: The city is facing an epidemic of car thefts.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市正面临汽车盗窃案激增。

senses.meaning_en: to assume or suppose something is true without proof

examples.text: I presume that you have already heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 我推测你已经听到这个消息了。

senses.meaning_en: to be so bold as to do something without permission or appropriateness

examples.text: He wouldn't presume to tell you how to run your life.
examples.translation_cn: 他不会冒昧地告诉你如何过你的生活。

senses.meaning_en: to change the direction or course of something
senses.pattern: divert sth from sth to sth

examples.text: They diverted the river from its original course to a new channel.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把河流从原来的河道改道到了新河道。

senses.meaning_en: to take someone's attention away from something

examples.text: The noise outside diverted her attention from the lesson.
examples.translation_cn: 外面的噪音分散了她对课堂的注意力。

senses.meaning_en: to entertain or amuse someone

examples.text: The children were diverted by the puppet show.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们被木偶戏逗乐了。

senses.meaning_en: making you believe that something is true or right

examples.text: The jury found her testimony convincing and acquitted the defendant.
examples.translation_cn: 陪审团认为她的证词令人信服，宣告被告无罪。

senses.meaning_en: showing clearly that one side is much better than the other

examples.text: The team earned a convincing victory over their rivals last night.
examples.translation_cn: 球队昨晚以明显优势击败了对手。

senses.meaning_en: in an ideal way; perfectly

examples.text: The hotel is ideally located for exploring the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店位置理想，便于探索老城区。

senses.meaning_en: given ideal circumstances; preferably

examples.text: Ideally, we should leave before noon to avoid traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 理想情况下，我们应该中午前出发以避开交通。

senses.meaning_en: a device that detects physical changes and responds

examples.text: The sensor detects even the slightest change in temperature.
examples.translation_cn: 这个传感器能检测到甚至最微小的温度变化。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed, often oversimplified idea or image of a particular type of person or thing

examples.text: The report challenges the stereotype of teenagers as disrespectful.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告挑战了认为青少年无礼的刻板印象。

senses.meaning_en: to form a fixed, often oversimplified idea about someone or something

examples.text: Many films stereotype teenagers as lazy and rude.
examples.translation_cn: 许多电影把青少年刻画成懒惰粗鲁的刻板形象。

senses.meaning_en: deserving respect

examples.text: She comes from a respectable family of doctors.
examples.translation_cn: 她出身于一个受人尊敬的医生家庭。

senses.meaning_en: decent; satisfactory

examples.text: Despite a difficult season, the team achieved a respectable result.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管赛季艰难，球队还是取得了不错的成绩。

senses.meaning_en: moderately well-to-do

examples.text: They earn a respectable salary, enough to live comfortably.
examples.translation_cn: 他们挣着一份不错的薪水，足以舒适地生活。

senses.meaning_en: very strange or unusual, especially in a striking or shocking way

examples.text: It is bizarre that the committee approved the proposal without reading it.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会没有读提案就批准了，实在怪诞。

senses.meaning_en: to name someone as a candidate for a particular role or position, including that of an office

examples.text: The board nominated Ms. Chen as the new chief executive.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会任命陈女士为新任首席执行官。

senses.meaning_en: to formally suggest someone for a position, award, or honor

examples.text: The committee nominated her for the Nobel Peace Prize.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会提名她获诺贝尔和平奖。

senses.meaning_en: to propose someone for a task or role

examples.text: Several members nominated Maria to organize the charity event.
examples.translation_cn: 几位成员推荐玛丽亚组织慈善活动。

senses.meaning_en: having or expressing doubt; questioning

examples.text: Many scientists are skeptical of the new study's conclusions.
examples.translation_cn: 许多科学家对这项新研究的结论表示怀疑。

senses.meaning_en: careful and thorough examination of someone or something

examples.text: The evidence was subjected to close scrutiny by the forensic team.
examples.translation_cn: 该证据受到了法医小组的仔细检查。

senses.meaning_en: close observation or oversight, especially of a situation or case

examples.text: The company's safety record has come under public scrutiny after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后，该公司的安全记录受到了公众的监督。

senses.meaning_en: not needed; superfluous

examples.text: Email has made most written memos almost redundant.
examples.translation_cn: 电子邮件已使大多数书面备忘录几乎变得多余。

senses.meaning_en: dismissed from employment because no longer needed

examples.text: Over 200 workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂倒闭时，200多名工人被裁。

senses.meaning_en: providing backup if another component fails

examples.text: The backup generator acts as a redundant backup in case of a power failure.
examples.translation_cn: 备用发电机在停电时充当冗余备用。

senses.meaning_en: needlessly wordy or repetitive

examples.text: Try not to use redundant language in academic writing.
examples.translation_cn: 学术写作中尽量避免使用冗赘的语言。

senses.meaning_en: very important for the result; conclusive

examples.text: The judge's ruling was decisive in ending the dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 法官的裁决对结束这场纠纷起了决定性作用。

senses.meaning_en: able to decide quickly and confidently; resolute

examples.text: The new manager was decisive in handling the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 新经理处理危机时很果断。

senses.meaning_en: clear, definite and certain

examples.text: The committee gave a decisive answer to the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会对提案给出了明确的答复。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or proof that something is true or will happen
