examples.text: I received written confirmation of my flight reservation this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天早上收到了航班预订的书面确认。

senses.meaning_en: a Christian ceremony in which a person affirms their faith and becomes a full member of the Church

examples.text: She received the sacrament of confirmation at age fifteen.
examples.translation_cn: 她十五岁时领受了坚信礼圣事。

senses.meaning_en: formal approval or ratification

examples.text: The treaty still needs confirmation by the Senate.
examples.translation_cn: 该条约仍需参议院的批准。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of a substance that you take in

examples.text: A high intake of salt can raise your blood pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 盐摄入量过高会使血压升高。

senses.meaning_en: the number of people taken into an organization at a particular time

examples.text: This year's intake of students is larger than last year's.
examples.translation_cn: 今年的招生人数比去年多。

senses.meaning_en: an act of taking something in, especially breath
senses.pattern: with a sharp intake of breath

examples.text: She paused with a sharp intake of breath.
examples.translation_cn: 她猛吸一口气，停了下来。

senses.meaning_en: a place where air or liquid enters a machine

examples.text: Leaves blocked the air intake of the engine.
examples.translation_cn: 树叶堵住了发动机的进气口。

senses.meaning_en: a situation or factor that makes something more difficult

examples.text: Unexpected complications often arise during major construction projects.
examples.translation_cn: 大型建设项目期间常出现意外难题。

senses.meaning_en: a medical problem that occurs during or after an illness or treatment

examples.text: Patients often develop complications after major heart surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 患者在重大心脏手术后常出现并发症。

senses.meaning_en: real or genuine; not copied or false

examples.text: The museum confirmed that the painting is an authentic work by Van Gogh.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆确认这幅画是梵高的真迹。

senses.meaning_en: true and accurate; based on facts and therefore worthy of trust

examples.text: The witness gave an authentic account of what had happened that night.
examples.translation_cn: 目击者如实描述了当晚发生的事情。

senses.meaning_en: sincere and honest; showing one's true nature

examples.text: Don't be afraid to show your authentic self.
examples.translation_cn: 不要害怕展现真实的自己。

senses.meaning_en: a rounded roof or ceiling

examples.text: The dome of the cathedral can be seen from miles away.
examples.translation_cn: 大教堂的圆屋顶从几英里外就能看见。

senses.meaning_en: a person's head (informal)

examples.text: He felt a drop of rain land on his dome.
examples.translation_cn: 他感到一滴雨落在头上。

senses.meaning_en: a rounded uplifted area of rock

examples.text: The Black Hills form a large dome of ancient rock.
examples.translation_cn: 布莱克丘陵形成了巨大的古岩穹丘。

senses.meaning_en: a dome-shaped cover

examples.text: She kept the dessert under a glass dome.
examples.translation_cn: 她把甜点放在玻璃罩下面。

senses.meaning_en: a person who follows, supports, or admires another person or cause

examples.text: She is a loyal follower of the environmental movement.
examples.translation_cn: 她是环保运动的忠实追随者。

senses.meaning_en: an account holder who subscribes to see content from another account on social media

examples.text: She gained thousands of followers on TikTok last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周在TikTok上获得了数千名关注者。

senses.meaning_en: to visit a place as a ghost

examples.text: The old castle is said to be haunted by a headless ghost.
examples.translation_cn: 据说那座古城堡有一个无头鬼出没。

senses.meaning_en: to keep coming to someone's mind and cause worry or sadness

examples.text: The images of the crash still haunt his memory.
examples.translation_cn: 事故的画面仍萦绕在他的记忆中。

senses.meaning_en: to visit a place very often

examples.text: She haunts the same little café every morning before work.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天上班前都去同一家小咖啡馆。

senses.meaning_en: a place someone visits very often

examples.text: This café is one of my favourite haunts in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡馆是我在这座城市里最喜欢的去处之一。

senses.meaning_en: a ghost

examples.text: A ghostly haunt is said to walk these halls at midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 据说一个幽灵午夜时分在这些大厅里游荡。

senses.meaning_en: an official responsible for law enforcement in a county

examples.text: She has served as sheriff of Dallas County for six years.
examples.translation_cn: 她担任达拉斯县的治安官已有六年。

senses.meaning_en: a person who hoards money and hates spending it

examples.text: He is a miser who never turns on the heating.
examples.translation_cn: 他吝啬到从来不开暖气。

senses.meaning_en: to bring a memory, feeling, or image into the mind

examples.text: The old song evoked memories of her childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 那首老歌唤起了她童年的回忆。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a particular reaction or response

examples.text: The minister's speech evoked a strong response from the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 部长的讲话激起了听众强烈的反应。

senses.meaning_en: a friend

examples.text: I've been pals with Alex since our first year at college.
examples.translation_cn: 我从大学第一年起就和亚历克斯是朋友。

senses.meaning_en: used as a friendly form of address, often to a man

examples.text: Hey, pal, could you tell me how to get to the station?
examples.translation_cn: 嘿，老兄，你能告诉我去车站怎么走吗？

senses.meaning_en: a sudden large increase in something

examples.text: There has been a surge in demand for electric cars.
examples.translation_cn: 电动汽车的需求激增。

senses.meaning_en: to increase suddenly and greatly

examples.text: House prices surged by 15 percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年房价飙升了15%。

senses.meaning_en: to move suddenly and powerfully forward

examples.text: The crowd surged forward when the gates opened.
examples.translation_cn: 大门打开时，人群蜂拥向前。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden increase in the flow of electricity

examples.text: A sudden power surge damaged the computer's motherboard.
examples.translation_cn: 一次突然的电涌损坏了电脑的主板。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden, powerful forward movement of the sea

examples.text: The storm surge flooded the small coastal town.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴潮淹没了海边小镇。

senses.meaning_en: a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure, not as a job

examples.text: As an amateur, she paints for pleasure rather than for money.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名业余爱好者，她画画是为了乐趣而不是为了钱。

senses.meaning_en: showing a lack of skill or professionalism

examples.text: The website design looks amateur, with mismatched colors and fonts.
examples.translation_cn: 网站设计看起来不专业，颜色和字体都不匹配。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lacks skill or experience

examples.text: This kind of surgery is not for amateurs.
examples.translation_cn: 这种手术不适合外行。

senses.meaning_en: non-professional; done or made by amateurs

examples.text: She joined an amateur dramatics society at university.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大学加入了业余戏剧社。

senses.meaning_en: to assess the value of something, especially officially

examples.text: The bank appraised the house at three hundred thousand dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 银行把这所房子估值为三十万美元。

senses.meaning_en: to consider or examine somebody/something in order to form an opinion

examples.text: The supervisor appraised her team's performance after the project.
examples.translation_cn: 项目结束后，主管评估了她团队的表现。

senses.meaning_en: a judgment or assessment of the value or quality of something

examples.text: The report gives a detailed appraisal of the company's performance.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告对公司的业绩作了详细评估。

senses.meaning_en: the act of formally reviewing an employee's work and performance

examples.text: Employees receive a formal performance appraisal once a year.
examples.translation_cn: 员工每年接受一次正式的绩效评估。

senses.meaning_en: an expert estimate of how much something is worth

examples.text: The bank requires an independent appraisal of the property before a mortgage.
examples.translation_cn: 银行要求先对房产进行独立评估才能发放抵押贷款。

senses.meaning_en: a written explanation or set of notes on a text

examples.text: She wrote a detailed Bible commentary on the Book of Job.
examples.translation_cn: 她为《约伯记》写了一部详细的圣经注释。

senses.meaning_en: a spoken description of an event as it happens, especially on TV or radio

examples.text: He gave a running commentary on the football match.
examples.translation_cn: 他对足球比赛进行了实时解说。

senses.meaning_en: a written or spoken discussion that gives opinions or explanations

examples.text: Her article is a sharp political commentary on tax policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她的文章是对税收政策的尖锐政治评论。

senses.meaning_en: a person who watches an event, especially a sports event or performance

examples.text: She was a spectator at the game last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚是那场比赛的观众。

senses.meaning_en: to stay in one place in the air

examples.text: A helicopter hovered above the stadium for several minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 一架直升机在体育场上空悬停了几分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to stay near someone or somewhere, especially in an uncertain way

examples.text: A waiter hovered near our table, waiting to take the order.
examples.translation_cn: 一名服务员在我们桌旁徘徊，等着点单。

senses.meaning_en: to move a cursor over something on a screen without clicking

examples.text: Hover over the image to see the full description.
examples.translation_cn: 将光标悬停在图片上可查看完整说明。

senses.meaning_en: to be unable to decide between two choices

examples.text: She hovered between accepting the offer and staying with her current team.
examples.translation_cn: 她在接受录用和留在现团队之间犹豫不决。

senses.meaning_en: an act or state of staying in one place in the air

examples.text: The helicopter remained in a hover above the pad.
examples.translation_cn: 直升机在停机坪上方保持悬停。

senses.meaning_en: following or conforming to traditional or generally accepted beliefs or practices

examples.text: Her orthodox approach to teaching leaves little room for student creativity.
examples.translation_cn: 她正统的教学方法几乎没有给学生创造性留下空间。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Eastern Orthodox Church

examples.text: He was ordained as a priest in the Orthodox Church after years of study.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年学习，他被任命为东正教会的牧师。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Orthodox Judaism

examples.text: She follows the strict dietary rules of Orthodox Judaism.
examples.translation_cn: 她遵守犹太教正统派严格的饮食规定。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in which people have different opinions and often argue

examples.text: They had a sharp disagreement over how to spend the budget.
examples.translation_cn: 他们就如何花费预算发生了激烈的分歧。

senses.meaning_en: a difference between two things that should be the same
senses.pattern: there is a disagreement between A and B

examples.text: There was a minor disagreement between the two temperature readings.
examples.translation_cn: 两个温度读数之间有轻微的不一致。

senses.meaning_en: to grasp and remove quickly; to seize hastily or without permission

examples.text: The man snatched her handbag from her and ran away.
examples.translation_cn: 那个男人从她那里抢了手提包逃跑了。

senses.meaning_en: to attempt to seize something suddenly

examples.text: He snatched at the rope but missed it.
examples.translation_cn: 他一把抓向绳子但没抓住。

senses.meaning_en: to steal something by taking it quickly

examples.text: Someone snatched my wallet from my pocket on the crowded train.
examples.translation_cn: 有人在拥挤的火车上从我的口袋里偷走了钱包。

senses.meaning_en: to do or get something quickly in a limited time

examples.text: She managed to snatch a few hours of sleep before the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她设法在考试前抓紧睡了几小时。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden start of something unpleasant, such as war or disease

examples.text: The outbreak of war forced many civilians to flee the area.
examples.translation_cn: 战争的爆发迫使许多平民逃离该地区。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden increase in something unpleasant

examples.text: The city has seen an outbreak of violent crime in recent months.
examples.translation_cn: 近几个月该市暴力犯罪激增。

senses.meaning_en: to try very hard to achieve something

examples.text: The company is striving to reduce its carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正在努力减少碳排放。

senses.meaning_en: to struggle in opposition; to contend

examples.text: The students strove against the university's decision to raise tuition fees.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们反对大学提高学费的决定。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of fighting a war or armed conflict against an enemy

examples.text: After months of tension, the two countries are now in open warfare.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数月的紧张局势，两国现已处于公开交战状态。

senses.meaning_en: military operations of a particular kind

examples.text: The rebels engaged in guerrilla warfare in the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 叛乱分子在山区进行游击战。

senses.meaning_en: to move or make something move into a sloping position

examples.text: He tilted his chair back and listened to the radio.
examples.translation_cn: 他把椅子向后斜靠着听收音机。

senses.meaning_en: to make something/somebody change slightly so that a particular opinion, person, etc. is preferred
senses.collocation: tilt the balance in favour of

examples.text: The scandal may tilt public opinion toward the challenger.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻可能使公众舆论偏向挑战者。

senses.meaning_en: to be at an angle

examples.text: The picture on the wall tilts to one side.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上的画歪向一边。

senses.meaning_en: information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view

examples.text: The government spread propaganda against the opposition during the election.
examples.translation_cn: 政府在选举期间散布针对反对派的宣传。

senses.meaning_en: a male ruler of a barony

examples.text: He was made a baron after a long career in public service.
examples.translation_cn: 他在长期担任公职后被封为男爵。

senses.meaning_en: a powerful person in business or politics

examples.text: He became an industry baron after buying up several rival firms.
examples.translation_cn: 他在收购几家竞争对手公司后成为产业大亨。

senses.meaning_en: located in the interior of a country, away from the sea or open water

examples.text: The inland areas are much drier than the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 内陆地区比沿海干燥得多。

senses.meaning_en: towards the interior of a country, away from the coast

examples.text: We drove further inland to escape the coastal fog.
examples.translation_cn: 我们继续向内陆开，以避开沿海的雾。

senses.meaning_en: confined to one country or state; domestic; not foreign

examples.text: The new system will speed up delivery of inland mail.
examples.translation_cn: 新系统将加快国内邮件投递。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being sent to live in another country or place, especially as a punishment

examples.text: After the coup, the general spent ten years in exile.
examples.translation_cn: 政变后，这位将军在流亡中度过了十年。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to leave their own country, especially as a punishment

examples.text: The poet was exiled from his homeland for criticizing the regime.
examples.translation_cn: 这位诗人因批评政权而被驱逐出自己的祖国。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been forced to leave their own country and live in another

examples.text: He lived in London as an exile during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间他作为流亡者住在伦敦。

senses.meaning_en: suggested or understood without being stated directly

examples.text: Her criticism was implicit in her polite reply.
examples.translation_cn: 她的批评暗含在她礼貌的答复中。

senses.meaning_en: existing as an essential part, though not openly shown

examples.text: Risk is implicit in the nature of extreme sports.
examples.translation_cn: 风险是极限运动本质中所固有的。

senses.meaning_en: complete and without any doubt or reserve

examples.text: He placed implicit trust in his closest friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他对最亲密的朋友绝对信任。

senses.meaning_en: to give a concrete form to an idea or quality; to be a perfect example of

examples.text: The opening ceremony embodies the spirit of the Olympic Games.
examples.translation_cn: 开幕式体现了奥林匹克精神。

senses.meaning_en: to include or contain as a part

examples.text: The basic rights of workers are embodied in labor law.
examples.translation_cn: 工人的基本权利被纳入劳动法。

senses.meaning_en: an earlier event or action regarded as an example for future similar situations

examples.text: There is no precedent for a player being banned for such a minor foul.
examples.translation_cn: 一名球员因如此轻微的犯规被禁赛，并无先例。

senses.meaning_en: a legal case cited to justify a judgment in a later case

examples.text: The judge cited a 1998 ruling as a precedent.
examples.translation_cn: 法官援引1998年的一项裁决作为判例。

senses.meaning_en: a usual or accepted way of behaving based on past examples

examples.text: The committee followed precedent and approved the budget without debate.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会遵循惯例，未加辩论就批准了预算。

senses.meaning_en: forming a necessary part of something; essential

examples.text: Regular exercise is integral to a healthy lifestyle.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼对健康的生活方式不可或缺。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or being an integer

examples.text: Find all integral values of n that satisfy this equation.
examples.translation_cn: 求所有满足这个方程的整数 n 值。

senses.meaning_en: relating to integration (the process of finding the integral of a function)

examples.text: In integral calculus, students learn to find areas under curves.
examples.translation_cn: 在积分学中，学生学习计算曲线下面积。

senses.meaning_en: not real or sincere

examples.text: She gave a fake smile and turned away.
examples.translation_cn: 她假笑了一下，转身走开了。

senses.meaning_en: a copy made to deceive
senses.pattern: turn out to be a fake

examples.text: The painting turned out to be a fake.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画原来是赝品。

senses.meaning_en: to make a false copy of something

examples.text: He faked his father's signature on the check.
examples.translation_cn: 他在支票上伪造了父亲的签名。

senses.meaning_en: to pretend to have a feeling or illness

examples.text: He faked an illness to miss school yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨天装病逃学。

senses.meaning_en: the meat of a crab, eaten as food

examples.text: We ordered a salad with fresh crab meat.
examples.translation_cn: 我们点了一份新鲜蟹肉沙拉。

senses.meaning_en: any of various other animals that resemble a crab

examples.text: The hermit crab is not a true crab.
examples.translation_cn: 寄居蟹不是真正的螃蟹。

senses.meaning_en: a bad-tempered person

examples.text: He is a crab when he hasn't had enough sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 他睡眠不足时脾气很坏。

senses.meaning_en: to complain in an annoyed way

examples.text: He always crabs about the noise from upstairs.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是抱怨楼上传来的噪音。

senses.meaning_en: to hold back or keep in check; to restrain

examples.text: This drug inhibits the growth of cancer cells.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药物抑制癌细胞的生长。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel nervous or embarrassed so that they cannot act naturally

examples.text: She felt inhibited by the presence of strangers.
examples.translation_cn: 她在陌生人面前感到拘谨。

senses.meaning_en: negative and harmful; not favorable

examples.text: The new tax may have an adverse effect on small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 新税可能对小企业产生不利影响。

senses.meaning_en: a device that controls the flow of a gas or fluid

examples.text: The plumber closed the valve to stop the water.
examples.translation_cn: 水管工关上阀门以止住水流。

senses.meaning_en: a membranous fold in the heart that allows blood to flow in one direction

examples.text: The surgeon replaced the damaged heart valve during the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生在手术中更换了受损的心脏瓣膜。

senses.meaning_en: a device in some musical instruments that changes the pitch
senses.pattern: press a valve on a trumpet

examples.text: He pressed the valve on his trumpet to change notes.
examples.translation_cn: 他按下小号上的活塞来改变音高。

senses.meaning_en: an electronic device used in older radios and amplifiers to control electric current

examples.text: He replaced the valves in his vintage amplifier.
examples.translation_cn: 他更换了老式放大器里的电子管。

senses.meaning_en: old or unwanted items that have little value

examples.text: The garage was full of junk and broken furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 车库里堆满了废旧物品和破家具。

senses.meaning_en: junk food; unhealthy food

examples.text: Eating too much junk food can harm your health.
examples.translation_cn: 吃太多垃圾食品会损害健康。

senses.meaning_en: to get rid of something because it is useless

examples.text: He junked his old car when it stopped working.
examples.translation_cn: 旧车坏了以后，他就把它丢弃了。

senses.meaning_en: nonsense; meaningless talk

examples.text: Don't believe it; that article is a load of junk.
examples.translation_cn: 别信它，那篇文章全是废话。

senses.meaning_en: to shock or surprise someone very much

examples.text: The audience was stunned by the sudden announcement.
examples.translation_cn: 观众对这则突然发布的消息感到震惊。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone unconscious for a short time

examples.text: The thief was stunned by a blow to the head.
examples.translation_cn: 小偷头部遭到一击后晕了过去。

senses.meaning_en: extreme anger

examples.text: She left the meeting in a fury after the unfair criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 遭到不公平批评后，她愤怒地离开了会议。

senses.meaning_en: strength or violence in action

examples.text: The storm hit the island with full fury.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴全力袭击了该岛。

senses.meaning_en: capable of working together without conflict

examples.text: The new printer is compatible with all major operating systems.
examples.translation_cn: 新打印机与所有主流操作系统兼容。

senses.meaning_en: able to get along well

examples.text: She is compatible with her colleagues and enjoys working there.
examples.translation_cn: 她与同事们相处融洽，很喜欢在那里工作。

senses.meaning_en: consistent or in agreement

examples.text: The results are compatible with our earlier findings.
examples.translation_cn: 结果与我们早先的发现一致。

senses.meaning_en: most common or widespread

examples.text: Deep blue is predominant in the artist's later paintings.
examples.translation_cn: 深蓝色在画家晚期画作中最为常见。

senses.meaning_en: dominant or most influential

examples.text: Technology plays a predominant role in modern education.
examples.translation_cn: 技术在现代教育中发挥着主导作用。

senses.meaning_en: mostly; mainly; for the most part

examples.text: The northern region is predominantly agricultural and sparsely populated.
examples.translation_cn: 北部地区以农业为主，人口稀少。

senses.meaning_en: an organ that filters blood and produces urine

examples.text: He was diagnosed with kidney failure last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年被诊断出肾衰竭。

senses.meaning_en: such an organ cooked as food

examples.text: He tried steak and kidney pie for the first time.
examples.translation_cn: 他第一次尝试牛排腰子派。

senses.meaning_en: a mounted armoured soldier of the Middle Ages

examples.text: A knight in armour stood guard at the castle gate.
examples.translation_cn: 一名身穿盔甲的骑士守卫在城堡大门旁。

senses.meaning_en: a man given a non-hereditary rank of honour by a king or queen

examples.text: He was made a knight for his services to education.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对教育事业的贡献被封为爵士。

senses.meaning_en: a chess piece shaped like a horse's head that moves in an L-shape

examples.text: She moved a knight to control the centre.
examples.translation_cn: 她移动马以控制中心。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to read and write

examples.text: Adult literacy among rural women has improved over the past decade.
examples.translation_cn: 过去十年里，农村成年女性的读写能力有所提高。

senses.meaning_en: knowledge or skill in a particular area

examples.text: Literacy in financial planning is essential for young adults.
examples.translation_cn: 理财规划方面的素养对年轻人至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: the force believed to control future events

examples.text: She believes in destiny and rarely makes long-term plans.
examples.translation_cn: 她相信命运，很少做长期计划。

senses.meaning_en: a predetermined course of events; something that is destined to happen

examples.text: It was her destiny to become a great scientist.
examples.translation_cn: 她注定要成为一位伟大的科学家。

senses.meaning_en: the future or ultimate condition of a person or thing

examples.text: The destiny of the company now lies in our hands.
examples.translation_cn: 公司现在的前途掌握在我们手中。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone

examples.text: She played a solo on the piano at the school concert.
examples.translation_cn: 她在学校音乐会上钢琴独奏了一曲。

senses.meaning_en: without a companion or instructor

examples.text: After years with the band, she decided to go solo.
examples.translation_cn: 在乐队待了多年后，她决定单飞。

senses.meaning_en: a battlefield formation composed of two or more divisions

examples.text: The general commanded a corps of three divisions.
examples.translation_cn: 将军指挥了一个由三个师组成的军团。

senses.meaning_en: an organized group of people united by a common purpose

examples.text: A corps of volunteers helped rescue survivors after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 一群志愿者在地震后帮助营救幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: a list of fixed prices or charges

examples.text: The tariff for a single room is 80 dollars per night.
examples.translation_cn: 单人间收费标准是每晚80美元。

senses.meaning_en: a tax imposed on imported or exported goods

examples.text: The government imposed a tariff on all steel imports.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对所有钢铁进口征收关税。

senses.meaning_en: to impose a tariff on (goods)

examples.text: Imported electronics are tariffed at a higher rate.
examples.translation_cn: 进口电子产品被征收更高关税。

senses.meaning_en: based on personal feelings or opinions rather than facts

examples.text: His conclusion was purely subjective and not supported by any evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 他的结论纯属主观，没有任何证据支持。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of food eaten between meals or as a light meal

examples.text: We stopped to have a quick snack after the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途徒步后我们停下来吃了点零食。

senses.meaning_en: to eat a small amount of food between meals or as a light meal

examples.text: She often snacks on fruit instead of crisps between meals.
examples.translation_cn: 她常在正餐之间吃水果，而不是薯片。

examples.text: Migrant workers from rural areas often travel across the country to pick fruit.
examples.translation_cn: 来自农村的流动工人经常在全国各地奔波采摘水果。

examples.text: Many migrants to Canada settle there permanently and later become citizens.
examples.translation_cn: 许多移居加拿大的人永久定居在那里，后来成为公民。

examples.text: Migrant birds from northern Europe often fly south to Africa for the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 来自北欧的候鸟经常飞往非洲过冬。

examples.text: Migrant butterflies travel thousands of miles to reach this forest.
examples.translation_cn: 迁徙的蝴蝶飞行数千英里到达这片森林。

senses.meaning_en: to walk with long steps

examples.text: She strode into the meeting and demanded an explanation.
examples.translation_cn: 她大步走进会议室，要求作出解释。

senses.meaning_en: a long step

examples.text: He crossed the wide hall in two long strides.
examples.translation_cn: 他迈了两大步穿过宽敞的大厅。

senses.meaning_en: progress; improvement

examples.text: The company has made great strides in quality control.
examples.translation_cn: 公司在质量控制方面取得了巨大进步。

senses.meaning_en: the production of a compound by combining elements or simpler compounds

examples.text: The synthesis of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen requires high pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 由氮气和氢气合成氨需要高压。

senses.meaning_en: in Hegelian philosophy, the final stage that combines thesis and antithesis

examples.text: Hegel's dialectic progresses through thesis, antithesis, and synthesis.
examples.translation_cn: 黑格尔辩证法通过正题、反题和合题发展。

senses.meaning_en: a combination of different ideas, styles, etc. into a coherent whole
senses.pattern: a synthesis of A and B

examples.text: The design is a synthesis of modern and traditional styles.
examples.translation_cn: 这个设计是现代与传统风格的结合体。

senses.meaning_en: to make a solemn promise to do something

examples.text: The new government has pledged to cut taxes for small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 新政府承诺为小企业减税。

senses.meaning_en: to deposit something as security for a loan; to pawn

examples.text: He pledged his car as collateral for the business loan.
examples.translation_cn: 他把汽车作为商业贷款的抵押品。

senses.meaning_en: a solemn promise to do something
senses.pattern: make a pledge to do sth

examples.text: She made a pledge to donate half of her income to charity.
examples.translation_cn: 她承诺将一半收入捐给慈善机构。

senses.meaning_en: a warm-blooded animal that has hair or fur and feeds milk to its babies

examples.text: A whale is a mammal, not a fish, and it feeds its young with milk.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼，它用乳汁喂养幼崽。

senses.meaning_en: relating to space and the position of things within it

examples.text: The spatial distribution of shops in the city reflects population density.
examples.translation_cn: 城市中商店的空间分布反映了人口密度。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or acting as a cause
senses.pattern: causal link between A and B

examples.text: The study found a causal link between air pollution and asthma.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究发现空气污染与哮喘之间存在因果关系。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical compound whose molecules consist of many repeating units

examples.text: Polyethylene is a polymer of ethylene and is used in many everyday products.
examples.translation_cn: 聚乙烯是一种由乙烯聚合而成的聚合物，并用于许多日常产品中。

senses.meaning_en: the act of keeping something safe or in good condition

examples.text: The preservation of wildlife requires firm government action.
examples.translation_cn: 保护野生动物需要有力的政府行动。

senses.meaning_en: the process or state of treating food to prevent decay

examples.text: The preservation of food with salt was common before refrigeration.
examples.translation_cn: 用盐保藏食物在冷藏普及之前很常见。

senses.meaning_en: to choose or name somebody for a particular job or position

examples.text: She was designated to lead the investigation team.
examples.translation_cn: 她被指派领导调查小组。

senses.meaning_en: to officially say that a place or thing has a particular purpose or character; to mark or indicate

examples.text: This area has been designated as a nature reserve.
examples.translation_cn: 这一地区已被指定为自然保护区。

senses.meaning_en: to give a name or title to; to call

examples.text: They designated the new building as the Smith Centre.
examples.translation_cn: 他们将新楼命名为史密斯中心。

senses.meaning_en: chosen for a job but not yet officially doing it; used after the title

examples.text: The president designate will be sworn in next Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 候任总统将于下周一宣誓就职。

senses.meaning_en: used to introduce a new topic or add a remark that is not directly connected with the main subject

examples.text: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the station this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 顺便说一句，我今天早上在车站见到了你哥哥。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is not planned or not the main purpose

examples.text: She came across the old letter incidentally while cleaning the attic.
examples.translation_cn: 她打扫阁楼时偶然发现了那封旧信。

senses.meaning_en: kept secret within a limited group and not intended for public knowledge

examples.text: All staff must keep client details strictly confidential.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工必须对客户信息严格保密。

senses.meaning_en: a mechanical device that supports a rotating part and reduces friction

examples.text: The mechanic replaced the wheel bearing on the front axle.
examples.translation_cn: 技师更换了前轴上的车轮轴承。

senses.meaning_en: the horizontal direction of an object from a point, measured as an angle

examples.text: The captain took a bearing on the lighthouse before changing course.
examples.translation_cn: 船长在改变航向之前测定了灯塔的方位。

senses.meaning_en: relevance or connection

examples.text: This evidence may have a bearing on the final decision.
examples.translation_cn: 这项证据可能会影响最终决定。

senses.meaning_en: one's manner or way of carrying oneself

examples.text: He walked into the room with a calm, confident bearing.
examples.translation_cn: 他神态平静自信地走进房间。

senses.meaning_en: lack of knowledge or information

examples.text: Many people remain in ignorance of their legal rights.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人对自己的合法权利仍不知情。

senses.meaning_en: of the nature of a disaster; calamitous

examples.text: The oil spill was disastrous for the local fishing industry.
examples.translation_cn: 这次石油泄漏对当地渔业来说是灾难性的。

senses.meaning_en: polite behavior that shows respect for others

examples.text: He didn't even have the courtesy to reply to my email.
examples.translation_cn: 他甚至没有礼貌回复我的邮件。

senses.meaning_en: a polite action or remark, especially when not required
senses.pattern: do sb the courtesy of doing

examples.text: She did me the courtesy of reading the whole report.
examples.translation_cn: 她好心读完了整份报告。

senses.meaning_en: provided free as a polite gesture

examples.text: The hotel offers a free courtesy bus to the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店提供免费班车到机场。

senses.meaning_en: provided by; thanks to

examples.text: The image is courtesy of the National Museum.
examples.translation_cn: 这张图片由国家博物馆提供。

senses.meaning_en: relating to people's welfare

examples.text: They were granted asylum on humanitarian grounds after fleeing the war.
examples.translation_cn: 逃离战争后，他们基于人道主义理由获得了庇护。

senses.meaning_en: a person concerned with people's welfare; a do-gooder or philanthropist

examples.text: As a humanitarian, she helped thousands of refugees rebuild their lives.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名人道主义者，她帮助了数千名难民重建生活。

senses.meaning_en: to pay back money that you owe

examples.text: He promised to repay the loan by the end of the month.
examples.translation_cn: 他承诺本月底前偿还贷款。

senses.meaning_en: to give something in return for effort or kindness; to be worth it

examples.text: Her years of hard work were repaid with a promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年的努力得到了晋升的回报。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a song that is repeated after each verse

examples.text: We all sang along with the chorus when the song came on again.
examples.translation_cn: 当这首歌再次响起时，我们都跟着副歌唱了起来。

senses.meaning_en: a group of singers performing together; an instance of singing by many people

examples.text: The audience sang in chorus at the end of the show.
examples.translation_cn: 演出结束时，观众齐声合唱。

senses.meaning_en: a simultaneous utterance or expression of opinion by many people

examples.text: The proposal met with a chorus of criticism from parents.
examples.translation_cn: 这项提议遭到了家长们的齐声批评。

senses.meaning_en: a sound made by many birds, animals, or things together

examples.text: A chorus of frogs filled the night air.
examples.translation_cn: 青蛙的齐鸣充满了夜空。

senses.meaning_en: unified; sticking together

examples.text: The wet clay sticks together to form a coherent mass.
examples.translation_cn: 湿黏土粘在一起形成一个凝聚的团块。

senses.meaning_en: logical and consistent

examples.text: She gave a coherent account of the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 她对该事件作了条理清晰的叙述。

senses.meaning_en: ordered and harmonious; easy to understand

examples.text: The website has a coherent design and is easy to navigate.
examples.translation_cn: 这个网站设计协调，易于浏览。

senses.meaning_en: of waves having the same phase

examples.text: The laser emits coherent light of a single wavelength.
examples.translation_cn: 激光器发出单一波长的相干光。

senses.meaning_en: to throw out lava, ash, etc. suddenly and violently

examples.text: Smoke and ash erupted from the volcano during the night.
examples.translation_cn: 夜里，烟和火山灰从火山喷发出来。

senses.meaning_en: to start happening suddenly and violently

examples.text: Violence erupted in the city after the controversial verdict.
examples.translation_cn: 在有争议的判决之后，城里爆发了暴力事件。

senses.meaning_en: to suddenly express strong feeling or change into a particular state

examples.text: The audience erupted into applause at the end of the speech.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲结束时，观众爆发出掌声。

senses.meaning_en: to suddenly appear on the skin as spots or a rash

examples.text: A red rash erupted on her face after she used the new cream.
examples.translation_cn: 用了一种新面霜后，她脸上突然起了一片红疹。

senses.meaning_en: to end something such as a contract or agreement

examples.text: The company decided to terminate the contract with immediate effect.
examples.translation_cn: 公司决定立即终止合同。

senses.meaning_en: to end at a particular place, especially for a train, bus, or route

examples.text: This train terminates at Central Station and then heads back.
examples.translation_cn: 这趟列车在中央车站到达终点，然后返回。

senses.meaning_en: to end someone's employment; to fire someone

examples.text: The firm terminated several employees after the scandal became public.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻曝光后，公司解雇了几名员工。

senses.meaning_en: to kill someone, often deliberately or as part of an operation

examples.text: The agent was ordered to terminate the target before he could talk.
examples.translation_cn: 特工奉命在目标开口前将其干掉。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being impressive, grand, or dignified

examples.text: We stood in silence before the majesty of the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 我们静静地站在雄伟的群山面前。

senses.meaning_en: a title used to address or refer to a king or queen

examples.text: Your Majesty, the ambassador from France has just arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 陛下，法国大使刚刚到达。

senses.meaning_en: supreme power or authority of a monarch
senses.collocation: the power and majesty of the Crown

examples.text: The rebels refused to recognize the majesty of the Crown and demanded a republic.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军拒绝承认王室的最高权力，要求建立共和国。

senses.meaning_en: saving of the soul from sin and its consequences, especially in Christian belief

examples.text: She finally found salvation through faith in God.
examples.translation_cn: 她最终通过信仰上帝获得了救赎。

senses.meaning_en: a thing or action that saves someone from harm, danger, or a difficult situation
senses.collocation: be the salvation of the company

examples.text: The new loan was the salvation of the small company.
examples.translation_cn: 这笔新贷款挽救了这家小公司。

senses.meaning_en: to force somebody to experience something unpleasant; to impose

examples.text: The earthquake inflicted severe damage on the city.
examples.translation_cn: 地震给城市造成了严重破坏。

senses.meaning_en: a type of popular music with spoken words and a strong beat; a rap song

examples.text: My brother listens to rap while doing his homework.
examples.translation_cn: 我弟弟做作业时听说唱乐。

senses.meaning_en: to hit a hard object or surface several times quickly, making a noise

examples.text: He rapped on the door and waited for an answer.
examples.translation_cn: 他敲了敲门，等待回应。

senses.meaning_en: blame or responsibility for a crime; a criminal charge

examples.text: He took the rap for a crime he didn't commit.
examples.translation_cn: 他替自己没有犯的罪背了黑锅。

senses.meaning_en: a quick sharp blow or hit with something hard

examples.text: She gave the table a sharp rap with her knuckles.
examples.translation_cn: 她用指关节猛地敲了一下桌子。

senses.meaning_en: to interrupt or disturb something so that it cannot continue normally

examples.text: Heavy snow disrupted rail services across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 大雪使全国铁路服务中断。

senses.meaning_en: to cause major changes to a traditional industry or market

examples.text: The new app has completely disrupted the taxi industry.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新应用彻底颠覆了出租车行业。

senses.meaning_en: a smell, especially an unpleasant one

examples.text: The rubbish in the alley gave off an odor.
examples.translation_cn: 小巷里的垃圾散发出一股气味。

senses.meaning_en: a pervasive quality or atmosphere

examples.text: The scandal left an odor of corruption in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻在城里留下了腐败的气息。

senses.meaning_en: a legal document authorizing police to make an arrest, search, etc.

examples.text: The judge issued a warrant for the suspect's arrest.
examples.translation_cn: 法官签发了逮捕嫌疑人的令状。

senses.meaning_en: to make something necessary or appropriate; to deserve

examples.text: The committee's new findings warrant further investigation into safety procedures.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会的新发现表明有必要进一步调查安全程序。

senses.meaning_en: a good reason or authorization for something

examples.text: There is no warrant for such an accusation.
examples.translation_cn: 这种指控毫无根据。

senses.meaning_en: to feel angry or bitter about something unfair; to express displeasure or indignation at something

examples.text: She deeply resented being told what to do.
examples.translation_cn: 她非常反感被人指使。

senses.meaning_en: anger or displeasure caused by believing one has been wronged

examples.text: He felt deep resentment towards the company after being fired without notice.
examples.translation_cn: 他在无故被解雇后对公司心怀深深的怨恨。

senses.meaning_en: a raised platform extending from the shore into the water, used for ships to land or moor

examples.text: We walked along the pier to watch the fishing boats.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着码头散步，看渔船。

senses.meaning_en: a similar structure at a seaside resort, used for entertainment

examples.text: We spent the afternoon on the pier, playing arcade games.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在游乐码头上玩了一下午街机游戏。

senses.meaning_en: a structure supporting the junction between two spans of a bridge

examples.text: The central pier of the old stone bridge needs urgent repair.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老石桥的中央桥墩急需维修。

senses.meaning_en: a long corridor-like building with multiple gates extending from an airport terminal

examples.text: International flights to New York depart from Pier C.
examples.translation_cn: 飞往纽约的国际航班从C指廊出发。

senses.meaning_en: looking serious or gloomy

examples.text: He looked grim as he listened to the news.
examples.translation_cn: 他听新闻时表情阴沉。

senses.meaning_en: unpleasant, worrying, or depressing

examples.text: The news from the war zone makes grim reading.
examples.translation_cn: 来自战区的消息令人沮丧。

senses.meaning_en: unattractive and depressing, especially of a place or building

examples.text: The old housing estate is a grim place to live.
examples.translation_cn: 那个老住宅区是个阴森、不宜居的地方。

senses.meaning_en: determined and serious

examples.text: She overcame a serious injury with grim determination.
examples.translation_cn: 她凭着顽强的决心克服了重伤。

senses.meaning_en: a small round piece of glass, wood, plastic, etc. with a hole through it, used for making jewellery

examples.text: She strung tiny glass beads together to make a delicate bracelet.
examples.translation_cn: 她把细小的玻璃珠串在一起，做成了一条精致的手链。

senses.meaning_en: a small drop of liquid

examples.text: A bead of sweat rolled down his cheek.
examples.translation_cn: 一滴汗水顺着他的脸颊滚落。

senses.meaning_en: a string of small beads used for counting prayers in some religions

examples.text: The nun sat quietly, praying with beads in the chapel.
examples.translation_cn: 修女安静地坐在小教堂里，用念珠祈祷。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate with beads; to apply beads to

examples.text: She beaded the wedding dress with tiny pearls.
examples.translation_cn: 她用细小的珍珠装饰那件婚纱。

senses.meaning_en: to form into beads

examples.text: The glass beaded up with condensation in the humid air.
examples.translation_cn: 玻璃在潮湿的空气中结了一层冷凝水珠。

senses.meaning_en: to support and defend a law, principle, or right

examples.text: Every citizen has a duty to uphold the law.
examples.translation_cn: 每个公民都有维护法律的义务。

senses.meaning_en: (of a court) to confirm that a previous decision is correct

examples.text: The Supreme Court upheld the lower court's decision.
examples.translation_cn: 最高法院维持了下级法院的判决。

senses.meaning_en: entertainment; the state of being amused

examples.text: They often played cards for amusement after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他们晚饭后常打牌消遣。

senses.meaning_en: a machine or game at a fair or amusement park

examples.text: We tried all the amusements at the fair.
examples.translation_cn: 我们玩了集市上所有的游乐项目。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that entertains or amuses you

examples.text: Fishing is a popular amusement in this area.
examples.translation_cn: 钓鱼是这个地区人们喜爱的一种消遣。

senses.meaning_en: inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable

examples.text: She has earned a formidable reputation as a criminal lawyer.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为刑事律师赢得了令人敬畏的声誉。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to defeat or overcome

examples.text: Reducing the budget deficit is a formidable task.
examples.translation_cn: 削减预算赤字是一项艰巨的任务。

senses.meaning_en: Risky; dangerous; harmful

examples.text: Driving in heavy fog is hazardous to drivers.
examples.translation_cn: 在大雾中驾驶对司机是危险的。

senses.meaning_en: an act of coming down

examples.text: The climbers made a slow descent from the summit.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者从顶峰缓慢下降。

senses.meaning_en: a decline into a worse state

examples.text: The country's descent into chaos after the coup was rapid.
examples.translation_cn: 政变后该国迅速陷入混乱。

senses.meaning_en: family origins or ancestry

examples.text: She is of Irish descent but grew up in France.
examples.translation_cn: 她有爱尔兰血统，但在法国长大。

senses.meaning_en: a downward slope or incline

examples.text: The road makes a steep descent to the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路陡峭地向下延伸到海岸。

senses.meaning_en: lacking something essential, especially a nutrient or quality

examples.text: Many people are deficient in vitamin D during winter.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人在冬季缺乏维生素D。

senses.meaning_en: insufficient in amount or quantity

examples.text: The blood samples were deficient in number for the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 血液样本数量不足以进行试验。

senses.meaning_en: a lack or shortage of something that is needed

examples.text: The school suffers from a serious deficiency of basic equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 该校严重缺乏基本设备。

senses.meaning_en: a fault or weakness in something

examples.text: The mechanic corrected a deficiency in the braking system.
examples.translation_cn: 机械师修正了制动系统中的一个缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: a medical condition caused by a lack of a vitamin, mineral, etc.

examples.text: A deficiency of vitamin C can lead to scurvy.
examples.translation_cn: 缺乏维生素C可导致坏血病。

senses.meaning_en: to shine light on something

examples.text: The candles illuminated the small room with a warm glow.
examples.translation_cn: 蜡烛用温暖的光照亮了小房间。

senses.meaning_en: to clarify or make something understandable

examples.text: The professor used a diagram to illuminate the concept for us.
examples.translation_cn: 教授用图表为我们阐明了这个概念。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate the page of a manuscript with ornamental designs

examples.text: The monks spent years illuminating the manuscript with gold and bright colors.
examples.translation_cn: 僧侣们花费多年用金色和鲜艳色彩装饰手稿。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate something with lights

examples.text: The garden was illuminated with hundreds of fairy lights.
examples.translation_cn: 花园被数百盏小彩灯装饰。

senses.meaning_en: next to or very close to something

examples.text: The hotel is adjacent to the central station.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店紧邻中央车站。

senses.meaning_en: next in order before or after; facing

examples.text: The correct answer is on the adjacent page.
examples.translation_cn: 正确答案在相邻页上。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the biological theory of evolution

examples.text: Evolutionary biology explains why some traits become more common over generations.
examples.translation_cn: 进化生物学解释了为什么某些特征在世代中变得更加普遍。

senses.meaning_en: having formal similarities to the biological theory of evolution

examples.text: The changes in the industry were an evolutionary process, not a sudden shift.
examples.translation_cn: 该行业的变化是一个逐步演变的过程，而非突然转变。

senses.meaning_en: a comparison or similarity between two things, often used to explain something
senses.pattern: draw an analogy between A and B

examples.text: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
examples.translation_cn: 老师把人的心脏比作水泵。

senses.meaning_en: a fault or imperfection that makes something not perfect

examples.text: There is a serious flaw in the reasoning.
examples.translation_cn: 这个推理有一个严重缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: a crack or gap in something

examples.text: A flaw in the vase widened into a long crack.
examples.translation_cn: 花瓶上的一道裂纹扩大成了一条长裂缝。

senses.meaning_en: to make something imperfect or defective

examples.text: The whole study is flawed by poor sampling.
examples.translation_cn: 整个研究因抽样不佳而有缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: a particular area or neighborhood

examples.text: Several new businesses have opened in the locality this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年这个地区新开了几家店。

senses.meaning_en: the position or location of something

examples.text: The map shows the locality of each numbered tower.
examples.translation_cn: 地图标出了每座编号塔的位置。

senses.meaning_en: a tendency to expect the best or a favourable outcome

examples.text: There is growing optimism about the company's future.
examples.translation_cn: 对公司的未来，人们越来越乐观。

senses.meaning_en: the act of burying a dead body

examples.text: The burial of the war hero took place at the national cemetery with full military honors.
examples.translation_cn: 这位战争英雄以隆重的军礼安葬在国家公墓。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being unclear or having more than one possible meaning

examples.text: There is still some ambiguity in the job description.
examples.translation_cn: 职位描述中仍有一些含糊不清的地方。

senses.meaning_en: unity or mutual support within a group

examples.text: Workers went on strike in solidarity with their colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们举行罢工，声援他们的同事。

senses.meaning_en: a place or container where something is kept in store

examples.text: The tank acts as a reservoir for heating oil.
examples.translation_cn: 这个罐子用作取暖油的储存库。

senses.meaning_en: a large natural or artificial lake used as a water supply

examples.text: The new reservoir supplies clean water to three nearby towns.
examples.translation_cn: 新水库向附近三座城镇供应清洁用水。

senses.meaning_en: a large supply or source of something

examples.text: The region has a vast reservoir of skilled workers.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区拥有大量熟练工人。

senses.meaning_en: all the clothes a person owns

examples.text: She has a wardrobe of stylish clothes for every occasion.
examples.translation_cn: 她有适合各种场合的时髦衣服。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture for storing clothes

examples.text: He hung his coat in the wardrobe and closed the door.
examples.translation_cn: 他把外套挂进衣柜并关上了门。

senses.meaning_en: the costume department of a theatre or film company

examples.text: She works in wardrobe on a new drama.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一部新剧中负责服装。

senses.meaning_en: a large quantity; more than enough

examples.text: The study found an abundance of evidence linking diet to disease.
examples.translation_cn: 研究发现大量证据表明饮食与疾病有关。

senses.meaning_en: the outer covering of a fruit or seed

examples.text: The hull of the sunflower seed is too tough to eat.
examples.translation_cn: 葵花籽的外壳太硬，不能吃。

senses.meaning_en: the body or frame of a vessel, such as a ship or plane

examples.text: The collision tore a hole in the hull of the ship.
examples.translation_cn: 碰撞在船体上撕开了一个洞。

senses.meaning_en: to remove the outer covering of a fruit or seed

examples.text: She hulled the peas and added them to the salad.
examples.translation_cn: 她剥了豌豆并放进沙拉里。

senses.meaning_en: a rebirth or revival

examples.text: The city's historic center is experiencing a renaissance.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市的历史中心正在经历复兴。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Renaissance

examples.text: The museum owns several works of the Renaissance.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆藏有几件文艺复兴时期的作品。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the style of art or architecture of the Renaissance

examples.text: The library was built in the Renaissance style.
examples.translation_cn: 这座图书馆是以文艺复兴风格建造的。

senses.meaning_en: to do what is required or promised

examples.text: She finally fulfilled her promise to visit her grandparents.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于履行了去看望祖父母的承诺。

senses.meaning_en: to meet a requirement or condition

examples.text: To qualify, candidates must fulfill all the entry requirements.
examples.translation_cn: 要获得资格，候选人必须满足所有入学要求。

senses.meaning_en: to achieve something desired or expected

examples.text: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of becoming a pilot.
examples.translation_cn: 她努力工作，以实现成为飞行员的梦想。

senses.meaning_en: to package and send goods for an order

examples.text: The system automatically fulfills orders and emails tracking numbers to customers.
examples.translation_cn: 该系统自动发货，并向客户发送物流跟踪号。

senses.meaning_en: a letter or number written or printed below the normal line of text

examples.text: The number 2 in H2O is written in subscript.
examples.translation_cn: H2O 中的数字 2 写成下标。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement to receive a publication or service regularly by paying in advance, granting access for a period of time

examples.text: I took out a subscription to an online magazine.
examples.translation_cn: 我订阅了一份在线杂志。

senses.meaning_en: to make or cause to make a rapid series of short loud sounds

examples.text: The loose shutter rattled against the wall in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 松动的百叶窗在暴风雨中撞击墙壁嘎嘎作响。

senses.meaning_en: to frighten or worry someone

examples.text: The candidate was clearly rattled by the unexpected question.
examples.translation_cn: 候选人明显被这个意外问题弄得慌乱。

senses.meaning_en: a baby's toy that makes a rattling noise when shaken

examples.text: The toddler gave the rattle a shake and laughed.
examples.translation_cn: 幼儿摇了摇拨浪鼓，笑了起来。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly while making a rattling sound

examples.text: The old cart rattled along the narrow country lane.
examples.translation_cn: 旧马车沿着狭窄的乡间小路嘎嘎作响地行驶。

senses.meaning_en: to break suddenly into many small pieces

examples.text: The glass shattered into pieces when it hit the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 玻璃摔到地上时粉碎了。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy something such as a hope, belief, or plan

examples.text: The long drought shattered farmers' hopes for a good harvest.
examples.translation_cn: 长期的干旱粉碎了农民丰收的希望。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody feel extremely shocked and upset

examples.text: She was shattered by the sudden death of her father.
examples.translation_cn: 父亲的突然去世使她深受打击。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe in through the nose in order to smell something

examples.text: She sniffed the milk to check if it was still fresh.
examples.translation_cn: 她闻了闻牛奶，看看是否还新鲜。

senses.meaning_en: to say something while sniffing, often from emotion or contempt

examples.text: She sniffed that she didn't need any help.
examples.translation_cn: 她抽着鼻子说她不需要任何帮助。

senses.meaning_en: to perceive or discover something vaguely or by investigation

examples.text: The reporters quickly sniffed out a major corruption scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们很快嗅出了一桩重大腐败丑闻。

senses.meaning_en: to show contempt or disapproval of something

examples.text: She sniffed at my suggestion, calling it unrealistic.
examples.translation_cn: 她对我的建议嗤之以鼻，说那不切实际。

senses.meaning_en: very beautiful or richly dressed

examples.text: She looked absolutely gorgeous in her silk evening gown.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着丝绸晚礼服显得格外华丽。

senses.meaning_en: very pleasant or enjoyable

examples.text: It was a gorgeous day for a picnic by the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 那是一个在湖边野餐的极好日子。

senses.meaning_en: to make fun of somebody in a playful or unkind way

examples.text: The older boys teased him about his new glasses.
examples.translation_cn: 大一点的男孩们拿他的新眼镜取笑他。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately annoy or provoke somebody

examples.text: He teased the neighbor's dog by poking it with a stick until it barked.
examples.translation_cn: 他用棍子戳邻居家的狗，直到它叫起来。

senses.meaning_en: to tempt or attract somebody by offering something desirable

examples.text: She teased the cat with a piece of fish.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一块鱼逗引猫。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately arouse somebody sexually without intending to satisfy them

examples.text: She teased him sexually for hours, refusing to let him touch her.
examples.translation_cn: 她挑逗了他好几个小时，却不让他碰她。

senses.meaning_en: a particular combination of ingredients prepared in a certain way, especially for a medicine or chemical product

examples.text: Scientists tested a new formulation of the drug on volunteers.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在志愿者身上测试了该药的新配方。

senses.meaning_en: the act of creating or preparing something carefully, such as a plan or policy

examples.text: The committee is responsible for the formulation of public health policy.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会负责公共卫生政策的制定。

senses.meaning_en: a particular way of expressing an idea or opinion clearly

examples.text: His formulation of the argument convinced the entire committee.
examples.translation_cn: 他对论点的表述使整个委员会信服。

senses.meaning_en: to make a serious promise to do something

examples.text: She solemnly vowed to finish the work by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 她郑重发誓周五前完成工作。

senses.meaning_en: a solemn promise, especially one made to a religious order or in marriage

examples.text: He took a vow of silence after joining the monastery.
examples.translation_cn: 加入修道院后，他发誓保持沉默。

senses.meaning_en: to publicly declare a strong intention, often to take revenge

examples.text: He vowed revenge on the gang that had robbed him.
examples.translation_cn: 他扬言要向抢劫他的团伙报仇。

senses.meaning_en: a formal declaration or assertion

examples.text: Every new member made a vow of loyalty to the team.
examples.translation_cn: 每个新成员都宣誓效忠团队。

senses.meaning_en: a device that detects a substance or physical phenomenon and may sound an alarm

examples.text: A detector for carbon monoxide went off during the night.
examples.translation_cn: 夜间，一个一氧化碳探测器响了。

senses.meaning_en: an official order that has the force of law

examples.text: The government issued a decree banning smoking in public places.
examples.translation_cn: 政府颁布了一项禁止在公共场所吸烟的法令。

senses.meaning_en: a judicial decision in a court of equity

examples.text: The court granted a divorce decree to the couple.
examples.translation_cn: 法院准予这对夫妇离婚。

senses.meaning_en: to order or decide something officially

examples.text: The court decreed that the property be returned to its owner.
examples.translation_cn: 法院裁定将财产归还其所有者。

senses.meaning_en: a light blow or jolting collision

examples.text: The two cars had a bump but no one was hurt.
examples.translation_cn: 两辆车发生了轻微碰撞，但没有人受伤。

senses.meaning_en: the sound of such a collision

examples.text: She heard a bump at the front door and froze.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到前门砰的一声，吓得僵住了。

senses.meaning_en: a raised area on the body or a surface

examples.text: He has a bump on the head from the fall.
examples.translation_cn: 他因跌倒头上起了个包。

senses.meaning_en: a post made to raise a thread on an Internet forum

examples.text: She gave the thread a bump to the top of the forum.
examples.translation_cn: 她将那个帖子顶到论坛顶部。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Egypt, its people, or their language

examples.text: The museum has a remarkable collection of Egyptian art.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆收藏了非凡的埃及艺术品。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Egypt or of Egyptian descent

examples.text: Her grandfather was an Egyptian who moved to France in the 1950s.
examples.translation_cn: 她的祖父是一名埃及人，20世纪50年代移居法国。

senses.meaning_en: a permit to enter and leave a country

examples.text: She applied for a tourist visa to visit Japan.
examples.translation_cn: 她申请了赴日旅游签证。

senses.meaning_en: a credit card, especially one issued by Visa

examples.text: You can pay by Visa at most hotels.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数酒店都可以用维萨卡付款。

senses.meaning_en: an occasion when two or more similar things happen at the same time by chance in a way that seems surprising or unlikely

examples.text: By coincidence, we had both booked the same hotel.
examples.translation_cn: 碰巧我们订了同一家旅馆。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of occurring at the same time or place; agreement in nature
senses.pattern: the coincidence of A and B

examples.text: The coincidence of their views and ours surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他们和我们的观点一致，令大家惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: an open hearth for holding a fire at the base of a chimney

examples.text: We sat by the fireplace and told stories all evening.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐在壁炉旁，讲了一整晚故事。

senses.meaning_en: to care for and protect somebody/something while they are growing

examples.text: She nurtured the young bird until it was ready to fly.
examples.translation_cn: 她照料那只幼鸟，直到它准备好飞翔。

senses.meaning_en: to help something to develop and be successful

examples.text: We need to nurture a sense of responsibility in young people.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要培养年轻人的责任感。

senses.meaning_en: the act of caring for and encouraging the growth of somebody/something

examples.text: The debate over nature versus nurture continues among scientists.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们仍在争论先天禀赋与后天养育的问题。

senses.meaning_en: to step or walk on something heavily or in a way that crushes it

examples.text: You must not tread on the freshly planted seeds.
examples.translation_cn: 你不可以踩踏刚种下的种子。

senses.meaning_en: to act or proceed with caution

examples.text: You should tread carefully when discussing his divorce.
examples.translation_cn: 讨论他离婚的事时，你应该小心谨慎。

senses.meaning_en: the raised pattern on a tyre or shoe sole

examples.text: The tread of the tyre is almost worn away.
examples.translation_cn: 轮胎胎面几乎磨平了。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece or fragment

examples.text: He wrote her number on a scrap of paper.
examples.translation_cn: 他把她的号码写在一张碎纸片上。

senses.meaning_en: waste material, especially metal

examples.text: The old copper pipes were sold for scrap.
examples.translation_cn: 这些旧铜管被当作废料卖了。

senses.meaning_en: to cancel or abandon a plan

examples.text: They had to scrap the plan because of the cost.
examples.translation_cn: 由于成本问题，他们不得不放弃这个计划。

senses.meaning_en: a fight or quarrel

examples.text: He got into a scrap with a teammate at practice.
examples.translation_cn: 他在训练时和队友发生了争吵。

senses.meaning_en: leftover food

examples.text: We feed the dog table scraps every evening.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每天晚上用剩饭喂狗。

senses.meaning_en: without delay; quickly

examples.text: Please respond promptly to the school's request for information.
examples.translation_cn: 请迅速回应学校索取信息的要求。

senses.meaning_en: at the expected time; punctually

examples.text: The orientation session will begin promptly at nine.
examples.translation_cn: 迎新会将于九点准时开始。

senses.meaning_en: to allow yourself to have or do something you enjoy, often too much

examples.text: She indulged in a long, hot bath after a stressful week.
examples.translation_cn: 她在压力很大的一周后尽情洗了个热水澡。

senses.meaning_en: to let somebody have or do whatever they want

examples.text: Her grandparents indulge her every whim without question.
examples.translation_cn: 她的祖父母纵容她的每一个突发奇想，毫无异议。

senses.meaning_en: to allow more time for payment

examples.text: The bank indulged him with an extension on the loan repayment.
examples.translation_cn: 银行宽限他延长了贷款偿还期限。

senses.meaning_en: a file sent with an email

examples.text: Please find the report as an attachment to this email.
examples.translation_cn: 请在这封电子邮件的附件中查看报告。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of affection or dependence

examples.text: The child formed a strong attachment to his grandmother.
examples.translation_cn: 这个孩子对他的祖母形成了强烈的依恋。

senses.meaning_en: the act of attaching or being attached

examples.text: The attachment of the handle to the door took only a few minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 把手与门的连接只花了几分钟。

senses.meaning_en: legal seizure of property

examples.text: The court ordered the attachment of his wages to pay the debt.
examples.translation_cn: 法院下令扣押他的工资以偿还债务。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or things dealt with at the same time

examples.text: We review a batch of applications within ten days.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在十天内审核一批申请。

senses.meaning_en: the processing of data by a computer in batches

examples.text: The server runs large jobs in batch mode at night.
examples.translation_cn: 服务器夜间以批处理模式运行大型任务。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange things into batches

examples.text: The system batches incoming orders for overnight processing.
examples.translation_cn: 系统将收到的订单分批，以便夜间处理。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being obsessed; a compulsive fixation

examples.text: He has an obsession with collecting vintage cars.
examples.translation_cn: 他对收藏老爷车有一种执念。

senses.meaning_en: an activity, subject, etc. that someone is fixated on

examples.text: The new video game has become an obsession for many students.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新电子游戏已成为许多学生迷恋的对象。

senses.meaning_en: physical strength and good health; energy

examples.text: The children were full of vigor after the long nap.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们睡了长长一觉后充满活力。

senses.meaning_en: forcefulness or intensity

examples.text: She argued with vigor that the plan was deeply flawed.
examples.translation_cn: 她有力地论证该计划存在严重缺陷。

senses.meaning_en: the process of taking in food and using it for health

examples.text: The process of nutrition is essential for the body to function properly.
examples.translation_cn: 营养过程对身体的正常运作至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: substances that provide nourishment

examples.text: Nuts and seeds are an excellent source of nutrition.
examples.translation_cn: 坚果和种子是极好的营养来源。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of food and its effects on health

examples.text: She plans to study nutrition at university after graduation.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划毕业后在大学学习营养学。

senses.meaning_en: a sequence of notes that makes up a musical phrase

examples.text: She hummed a simple melody while preparing dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 她准备晚饭时哼着一支简单的旋律。

senses.meaning_en: beautiful music; a pleasing series of sounds

examples.text: We woke to hear the melody of birdsong outside our tent.
examples.translation_cn: 我们醒来时听见帐篷外鸟鸣悦耳的旋律。

senses.meaning_en: a tree of the genus Acer, typically with lobed leaves and winged seeds

examples.text: A maple tree stood at the edge of the field.
examples.translation_cn: 田地边矗立着一棵枫树。

senses.meaning_en: flavoured with or made from maple syrup

examples.text: I love maple-flavored oatmeal on cold winter mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我喜欢寒冷冬日早晨吃枫糖味燕麦片。

senses.meaning_en: the act of becoming aware of something

examples.text: He came to the realization that he had been wrong all along.
examples.translation_cn: 他最终认识到自己一直错了。

senses.meaning_en: the act of achieving something planned or hoped for

examples.text: Winning the championship was the realization of a lifelong dream for the team.
examples.translation_cn: 赢得冠军是这支球队毕生梦想的实现。

senses.meaning_en: without the ability to reason; unreasoning
senses.pattern: it is unreasonable of sb to do

examples.text: It was unreasonable of him to refuse to listen to any explanation.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝听任何解释，实在是不讲道理。

senses.meaning_en: excessive or too great in amount or degree

examples.text: The landlord is charging an unreasonable amount of rent for this tiny flat.
examples.translation_cn: 房东对这个狭小的公寓收取高得离谱的租金。

senses.meaning_en: not reasonable; going beyond what could be expected or asked for

examples.text: It is unreasonable to expect everyone to agree with you all the time.
examples.translation_cn: 指望大家事事都同意你的观点是不合理的。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to obey

examples.text: The soldiers were punished for defying direct orders.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们因违抗直接命令而受到惩罚。

senses.meaning_en: to not conform to or follow an expectation or description

examples.text: The sheer scale of the disaster defies description.
examples.translation_cn: 这场灾难规模之大难以形容。

senses.meaning_en: to challenge or dare someone to do something or brave a hazard

examples.text: I defy anyone to prove that I have lied.
examples.translation_cn: 我谅谁也证明不了我撒了谎。

senses.meaning_en: to restore friendship or harmony between people

examples.text: They finally reconciled with each other after years of silence.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的沉默，他们终于和好了。

senses.meaning_en: to make two things compatible or consistent

examples.text: It is difficult to reconcile the data with the earlier findings.
examples.translation_cn: 很难使这些数据与早期发现相一致。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone accept an unpleasant situation

examples.text: She reconciled herself to the loss of her sight.
examples.translation_cn: 她慢慢让自己接受了失明的现实。

senses.meaning_en: to check that an account or statement matches another

examples.text: The bookkeeper reconciles the accounts at the end of each month.
examples.translation_cn: 记账员每月底核对账目。

senses.meaning_en: a large rectangular case for carrying clothes when travelling

examples.text: She packed a suitcase and took a taxi to the station.
examples.translation_cn: 她收拾好行李箱，坐出租车去了车站。

senses.meaning_en: in an equal or regular way

examples.text: The inheritance was divided evenly among the four siblings.
examples.translation_cn: 遗产由四个兄弟姐妹平均分配。

senses.meaning_en: in a calm, steady way without strong emotion

examples.text: She spoke evenly even though she was nervous.
examples.translation_cn: 她虽然紧张，但说话很镇定。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of respect and approval

examples.text: She has always had great admiration for her grandmother's courage.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直非常钦佩祖母的勇气。

senses.meaning_en: very strong or powerful

examples.text: A mighty warrior defended the village with great courage.
examples.translation_cn: 一位强大的勇士以极大的勇气保卫了村庄。

senses.meaning_en: very large and impressive

examples.text: The mighty Mississippi flows through several American states.
examples.translation_cn: 壮阔的密西西比河流经美国多个州。

senses.meaning_en: very; extremely (informal)

examples.text: That was a mighty fine performance last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚的表演非常精彩。

senses.meaning_en: lasting forever; unending

examples.text: Many religions promise eternal life to their followers.
examples.translation_cn: 许多宗教许诺信徒永生。

senses.meaning_en: constant; never stopping

examples.text: She is an eternal optimist and never expects the worst.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个永远的乐观主义者，从不往坏处想。

senses.meaning_en: to hit each other violently

examples.text: A truck collided with a bus on the icy bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 一辆卡车在结冰的桥上撞上了一辆公交车。

senses.meaning_en: to be incompatible or in strong disagreement

examples.text: The two parties collided over the new housing bill.
examples.translation_cn: 两党在新的住房法案上发生了冲突。

senses.meaning_en: Aromatic or pungent plant matter used to season or flavor food

examples.text: Add a pinch of spice to the stew for a richer taste.
examples.translation_cn: 往炖菜里加一撮香料，味道会更浓郁。

senses.meaning_en: The quality of being spicy or exciting

examples.text: Variety is the spice of life, so I try new dishes every week.
examples.translation_cn: 变化是生活的乐趣，所以我每周都尝试新菜。

senses.meaning_en: a short jump

examples.text: A rabbit hopped over the log and vanished into the bushes.
examples.translation_cn: 一只兔子跳过原木，消失在灌木丛中。

senses.meaning_en: a short flight or journey, especially by plane
senses.pattern: a short hop from A to B

examples.text: It's just a short hop from London to Paris by plane.
examples.translation_cn: 从伦敦到巴黎乘飞机只是一段短途旅程。

senses.meaning_en: to jump on one foot

examples.text: He hopped on one foot to the door after hurting his ankle.
examples.translation_cn: 他伤了脚踝后单脚跳到门口。

senses.meaning_en: to get on or into a vehicle quickly; to move quickly

examples.text: She hopped on the bus just before it pulled away.
examples.translation_cn: 她刚跳上公交车，车就开走了。

senses.meaning_en: having a lively or creative imagination; able to think of new ideas

examples.text: As a child, she was imaginative in making up games for her friends.
examples.translation_cn: 小时候，她在为朋友们编游戏方面富有想象力。

senses.meaning_en: showing creativity or originality in design, solution, etc.

examples.text: The chef took an imaginative approach to the classic dish.
examples.translation_cn: 这位厨师对这道经典菜采用了别出心裁的做法。

senses.meaning_en: important in making something happen

examples.text: She was instrumental in getting the project approved.
examples.translation_cn: 她对于项目获批起到了重要作用。

senses.meaning_en: relating to music played on instruments, without singing

examples.text: The instrumental version of the song became a hit on streaming services.
examples.translation_cn: 这首歌的器乐版在流媒体平台上大受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of music played on instruments, without singing

examples.text: He played a beautiful piano instrumental at the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的钢琴器乐曲。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being highly regarded; respect and admiration

examples.text: The hospital enjoys great prestige among cancer researchers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院在癌症研究人员中享有很高的声望。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow hole or ditch in the ground, especially one used to shelter soldiers

examples.text: They dug a trench for the new drainage system.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为新的排水系统挖了一条沟。

senses.meaning_en: an excavation unit or pit made by archaeologists

examples.text: The team excavated a trench to examine the ancient walls.
examples.translation_cn: 考古队挖了一条探沟来考察古墙。

senses.meaning_en: a trench coat

examples.text: She arrived in a trench coat and ankle boots.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着风衣和及踝靴抵达。

senses.meaning_en: to dig a long narrow hole or trench in the ground

examples.text: Gardeners trench the soil in spring before planting vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 园丁们在春季栽种蔬菜之前给土壤开沟。

senses.meaning_en: contrary to reason; ridiculous; nonsensical

examples.text: It is absurd to expect children to sit still for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 期望孩子们连续几个小时坐着不动是荒谬的。

senses.meaning_en: mainly; chiefly

examples.text: The local economy depends principally on tourism and agriculture.
examples.translation_cn: 当地经济主要依赖旅游业和农业。

senses.meaning_en: an act of violence or an offensive, immoral act

examples.text: The bombing was an outrage against innocent civilians.
examples.translation_cn: 这次爆炸是对无辜平民的暴行。

senses.meaning_en: a strong feeling of shock and anger

examples.text: There was widespread outrage at the government's decision.
examples.translation_cn: 公众对政府的决定普遍感到愤慨。

senses.meaning_en: to treat with violence or gross disrespect

examples.text: The film was accused of outraging public decency.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影被控公然冒犯公序良俗。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody feel very angry and shocked

examples.text: Many people were outraged by the court's decision.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人对法院的判决感到震怒。

senses.meaning_en: to force or compel someone to do something

examples.text: She was constrained to apologize, even though she had done nothing wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 她被迫道歉，尽管她并没有做错什么。

senses.meaning_en: to limit or restrict something, keeping it within bounds

examples.text: The number of participants is constrained by the size of the room.
examples.translation_cn: 参加人数受到房间大小的限制。

senses.meaning_en: a female member of a religious community, especially in Christianity

examples.text: She decided to become a nun after finishing university.
examples.translation_cn: 她大学毕业后决定做修女。

senses.meaning_en: a tight roll of tobacco leaves for smoking

examples.text: He lit a cigar and watched the sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 他点燃一支雪茄，看着日落。

senses.meaning_en: a compensating equivalent; something that balances or makes up for something else

examples.text: The company offered flexible hours as an offset to the lower salary.
examples.translation_cn: 公司提供弹性工作时间作为较低薪水的补偿。

senses.meaning_en: the difference between a target memory address and a base address

examples.text: The value is stored at an offset from the start of the block.
examples.translation_cn: 该值存储在偏离块起始位置的地址处。

senses.meaning_en: something that completes or makes perfect; the full number or amount needed

examples.text: This wine is a perfect complement to the cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 这款葡萄酒是奶酪的绝佳搭配。

senses.meaning_en: the whole working force of a vessel
senses.pattern: with a full complement of sth

examples.text: The ship sailed with a full complement of officers and crew.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘船配齐了全体船员启航。

senses.meaning_en: an annoying or stupid person

examples.text: He was such a jerk to leave without saying goodbye.
examples.translation_cn: 他不辞而别，真是个混蛋。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden sharp movement or pull

examples.text: The train came to a stop with a jerk and threw me forward.
examples.translation_cn: 火车猛地一停，我向前跌去。

senses.meaning_en: a large disorderly crowd, especially one bent on violence

examples.text: A mob of angry protesters gathered outside the city hall.
examples.translation_cn: 一群愤怒的抗议者聚集在市政厅外。

senses.meaning_en: the Mafia; an organized crime group

examples.text: The Mob controlled illegal gambling in the city for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 黑手党控制了这座城市的非法赌博数十年。

senses.meaning_en: an Aboriginal extended family or community group

examples.text: My mob have lived along this river for generations.
examples.translation_cn: 我的家族世代居住在这条河边。

senses.meaning_en: to crowd around someone or a place, often with excitement or hostility

examples.text: Fans mobbed the singer as she left the theater.
examples.translation_cn: 歌迷们在歌手离开剧院时围住了她。

senses.meaning_en: to state firmly that something is true

examples.text: She affirmed that the rumors were completely false.
examples.translation_cn: 她断言那些传闻完全是假的。

senses.meaning_en: to confirm or uphold a decision

examples.text: The judge affirmed the lower court's decision yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 法官昨天维持了下级法院的判决。

senses.meaning_en: the process by which liquid flows away from an area

examples.text: The drainage of rainwater from the field was slow.
examples.translation_cn: 雨水从田野排走得很慢。

senses.meaning_en: a system of drains

examples.text: The drainage in the old town needs urgent repair.
examples.translation_cn: 老城区的排水系统急需维修。

senses.meaning_en: to stay somewhere longer than necessary, especially because one is reluctant to leave

examples.text: A few guests lingered behind to thank the host.
examples.translation_cn: 几位客人留下来向主人道谢。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to exist or be felt for a long time

examples.text: The memory of that evening lingered on for years.
examples.translation_cn: 那个夜晚的回忆萦绕了多年。

senses.meaning_en: to take a long time doing something, especially something pleasant

examples.text: We lingered over coffee, discussing the plan for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 我们边喝咖啡边讨论计划，磨蹭了好几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to remain alive in a weak state, often near death

examples.text: He lingered for days after being taken off life support.
examples.translation_cn: 他在撤去生命维持设备后弥留了几天。

senses.meaning_en: to express approval by clapping hands

examples.text: The audience applauded loudly when the performance ended.
examples.translation_cn: 演出结束时，观众大声鼓掌。

senses.meaning_en: to praise or express approval for sb/sth

examples.text: We applaud her for her courage in speaking out.
examples.translation_cn: 我们称赞她敢于直言的勇气。

senses.meaning_en: to make something stable

examples.text: The government took measures to stabilize food prices.
examples.translation_cn: 政府采取措施稳定食品价格。

senses.meaning_en: to become stable

examples.text: The patient's condition finally stabilized at a normal level.
examples.translation_cn: 病人的情况终于稳定在正常水平。

senses.meaning_en: a sheltered expanse of water where ships may anchor or dock

examples.text: Several fishing boats anchored in the harbor before the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 几艘渔船在暴风雨前停泊在海港里。

senses.meaning_en: to hold or persistently entertain in one's thoughts or mind

examples.text: She still harbors serious doubts about the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 她仍然对这个计划心存疑虑。

senses.meaning_en: to give shelter to; to hide and protect (a person, especially a criminal)

examples.text: It is illegal to harbor a fugitive from justice.
examples.translation_cn: 窝藏逃离司法审判的逃犯是违法的。

senses.meaning_en: any place of shelter or safety

examples.text: The small hut served as a safe harbor from the wind.
examples.translation_cn: 那间小茅屋成了躲避大风的庇护所。

senses.meaning_en: a person's child or descendants

examples.text: She is the offspring of two well-known doctors.
examples.translation_cn: 她是两位著名医生的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: the young of an animal or plant

examples.text: These insects produce offspring several times a year.
examples.translation_cn: 这些昆虫一年繁殖好几次。

senses.meaning_en: a result or product of something

examples.text: This book is the offspring of years of research.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书是多年研究的成果。

senses.meaning_en: the ruler of a monarchy

examples.text: The monarch of Denmark addressed the nation this evening.
examples.translation_cn: 丹麦君主今晚向全国发表了讲话。

senses.meaning_en: a monarch butterfly

examples.text: A monarch butterfly landed on the milkweed in our garden.
examples.translation_cn: 一只帝王蝶落在我们花园的马利筋上。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to former times; old-fashioned

examples.text: This ring is antique and worth a fortune.
examples.translation_cn: 这枚戒指很古老，值一大笔钱。

senses.meaning_en: an object that is very old, especially a piece of furniture or art

examples.text: The clock on the mantel is a genuine antique.
examples.translation_cn: 壁炉架上的钟是一件真正的古董。

senses.meaning_en: to search or shop for antiques
