examples.text: They went antiquing in the old town last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他们上周末在老城区淘古董。

senses.meaning_en: land covered with grass where animals feed

examples.text: The cattle are grazing in a pasture near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 牛群正在河边的牧场上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: to put animals to feed on grass

examples.text: They pasture their cattle on the high mountain slopes.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在高山坡上放牧牛群。

senses.meaning_en: to graze

examples.text: The sheep pastured on the hillside all summer.
examples.translation_cn: 羊群整个夏天都在山坡上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: an official statement or report

examples.text: The government issued a bulletin about the new travel rules.
examples.translation_cn: 政府发布了关于新旅行规定的公告。

senses.meaning_en: a short news report on radio or television

examples.text: Most people listen to the morning news bulletin while driving.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数人开车时会收听早间新闻简报。

senses.meaning_en: a regular printed newsletter of an organization

examples.text: Our names were published in the church bulletin last Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的名字上周日公布在教堂会刊上。

senses.meaning_en: a place where two or more roads meet or cross
senses.pattern: at the intersection of A and B

examples.text: There is a coffee shop at the intersection of Main Street and First Avenue.
examples.translation_cn: 主街和第一大道的交叉路口有一家咖啡店。

senses.meaning_en: the set of elements common to two or more sets

examples.text: The intersection of two sets contains all the elements they have in common.
examples.translation_cn: 两个集合的交集包含它们共有的所有元素。

senses.meaning_en: an overlap or confluence of different areas or ideas
senses.pattern: the intersection of A and B
senses.collocation: the intersection of work and life

examples.text: The intersection of art and technology creates new forms of expression.
examples.translation_cn: 艺术与技术的交汇创造了新的表达形式。

senses.meaning_en: the point or set of points common to two geometrical objects

examples.text: The intersection of the two lines can be found by solving the equations.
examples.translation_cn: 两条线的交点可以通过解方程求出。

senses.meaning_en: a person responsible for managing the money of an organization

examples.text: She serves as treasurer of the university chess club.
examples.translation_cn: 她担任大学国际象棋俱乐部的财务主管。

senses.meaning_en: a government official in charge of a nation's Treasury

examples.text: She served as Treasurer under the previous government.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾在上届政府中担任财政部长。

senses.meaning_en: a set of notes played together

examples.text: She played a C major chord on the piano.
examples.translation_cn: 她在钢琴上弹了一个C大调和弦。

senses.meaning_en: a line segment joining two points on a curve

examples.text: The longest chord of a circle is its diameter.
examples.translation_cn: 圆中最长的弦是直径。

senses.meaning_en: a building where Muslims worship

examples.text: Many people go to the mosque for Friday prayers.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人去清真寺参加周五礼拜。

senses.meaning_en: to break down and reuse component materials

examples.text: The company recycles old plastic bottles into new fibers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司把旧塑料瓶回收制成新纤维。

senses.meaning_en: to reuse something as a whole without breaking it down

examples.text: She recycles empty jars as small containers for spices.
examples.translation_cn: 她把空罐子再利用来装调料。

senses.meaning_en: to collect or place something in a bin for recycling

examples.text: Please recycle bottles and cans in the blue bin.
examples.translation_cn: 请把瓶子和易拉罐放进蓝色回收箱里回收。

senses.meaning_en: female; biologically female, not male

examples.text: The textbook includes a chapter on feminine anatomy.
examples.translation_cn: 这本教科书有一章是关于女性解剖学的。

senses.meaning_en: having qualities traditionally considered typical of women

examples.text: She looks very feminine in that red dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿那件红裙子看起来很女人味。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to or used by females

examples.text: These products are designed for feminine use only.
examples.translation_cn: 这些产品专供女性使用。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the feminine grammatical gender

examples.text: In French, 'la table' is a feminine noun.
examples.translation_cn: 在法语中，'la table' 是一个阴性名词。

senses.meaning_en: a long complex piece of music for an orchestra

examples.text: He composed his first symphony while he was still at music college.
examples.translation_cn: 他还在音乐学院时就创作了自己的第一部交响曲。

senses.meaning_en: a symphony orchestra; a large orchestra that plays symphonies

examples.text: She plays the viola in a professional symphony orchestra.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家专业交响乐团拉中提琴。

senses.meaning_en: a harmonious combination of elements, especially of colour or sound

examples.text: The garden is a symphony of colour in summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏天花园里色彩和谐。

senses.meaning_en: the process of taking in liquid, gas, or heat

examples.text: The absorption of water by the roots is essential for plant growth.
examples.translation_cn: 根部对水分的吸收对植物生长至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being completely occupied by something

examples.text: His absorption in the chess game was so deep that he forgot dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他对棋局如此专注，以至于忘了吃晚饭。

senses.meaning_en: the process of becoming part of something larger

examples.text: After its absorption into the empire, the region adopted new laws.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区并入帝国后采用了新法律。

senses.meaning_en: added to something else in order to improve it or complete it; additional

examples.text: This leaflet is supplementary to the main brochure.
examples.translation_cn: 这本小册子是主宣传册的补充。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody feel extremely frightened

examples.text: The horror movie terrified the kids so much that they couldn't sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 这部恐怖电影把孩子们吓得睡不着觉。

senses.meaning_en: plants considered collectively, especially those in a particular area or habitat

examples.text: The hillside was covered in dense vegetation after the heavy rains.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨过后，山坡上覆盖着茂密的植被。

senses.meaning_en: to attract or interest someone very strongly

examples.text: The historian fascinated the audience with little-known details of ancient Rome.
examples.translation_cn: 这位历史学家用古罗马鲜为人知的细节迷住了听众。

senses.meaning_en: a value or setting used when no alternative is specified

examples.text: The font is set to Arial by default.
examples.translation_cn: 字体默认设置为Arial。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to meet an obligation, especially a debt

examples.text: They risk losing their home if they default on the mortgage.
examples.translation_cn: 如果他们不按期偿还抵押贷款，就可能失去房子。

senses.meaning_en: the condition of having failed to meet an obligation

examples.text: The borrower is in default on the mortgage.
examples.translation_cn: 借款人未按期偿还抵押贷款。

senses.meaning_en: a loss incurred by failing to compete

examples.text: They won the match by default because their opponents did not show up.
examples.translation_cn: 由于对手未到场，他们不战而胜。

senses.meaning_en: an electromagnetic wave with a wavelength between infrared and radio waves

examples.text: Engineers use microwaves to transmit data over long distances.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师利用微波长距离传输数据。

senses.meaning_en: to cook or heat food in a microwave oven

examples.text: Microwave the soup on high for two minutes before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前把汤用微波炉高火加热两分钟。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to or typical of the middle class

examples.text: They enjoy a bourgeois lifestyle with a comfortable home in the suburbs.
examples.translation_cn: 他们享受中产阶级的生活方式，在郊区有一所舒适的房子。

senses.meaning_en: too concerned with wealth, possessions, and conventional respectable behaviour

examples.text: She finds his obsession with luxury brands deeply bourgeois.
examples.translation_cn: 她觉得他对奢侈品牌的痴迷十分庸俗。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the middle class, especially in historical contexts

examples.text: Before the revolution, the bourgeois demanded political power.
examples.translation_cn: 革命前，资产阶级要求获得政治权力。

senses.meaning_en: dishonest or illegal, especially in return for money or power

examples.text: The mayor was corrupt and accepted bribes for years.
examples.translation_cn: 那个市长腐败并受贿多年。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone dishonest or immoral

examples.text: Money and power can corrupt even honest people.
examples.translation_cn: 金钱和权力甚至能腐蚀诚实的人。

senses.meaning_en: containing errors or no longer working correctly

examples.text: The corrupt file was deleted from the system.
examples.translation_cn: 那个损坏的文件被从系统中删除了。

senses.meaning_en: to damage data or make it invalid

examples.text: The malware corrupted all the data on the hard drive.
examples.translation_cn: 恶意软件损坏了硬盘上的所有数据。

senses.meaning_en: one half of the earth or any sphere

examples.text: Australia is located entirely in the Southern Hemisphere.
examples.translation_cn: 澳大利亚完全位于南半球。

senses.meaning_en: either of the two halves of the cerebrum
senses.pattern: in the left hemisphere of the brain

examples.text: Language is processed mainly in the left hemisphere of the brain.
examples.translation_cn: 语言主要由大脑左半球处理。

senses.meaning_en: a divine calling to establish one's lifestyle

examples.text: She felt a clear vocation to become a missionary.
examples.translation_cn: 她明确感到成为传教士的神召。

senses.meaning_en: an occupation for which a person is suited, trained or qualified

examples.text: He decided to pursue carpentry as a vocation after leaving school.
examples.translation_cn: 离开学校后，他决定以木工为职业。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a job or career

examples.text: The college offers vocational guidance for students who are exploring career options.
examples.translation_cn: 学院为正在探索职业选择的学生提供职业指导。

senses.meaning_en: providing skills for a particular job rather than academic knowledge

examples.text: She completed vocational training in nursing before starting work at the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在开始医院工作前完成了护理方面的职业培训。

senses.meaning_en: to walk somewhere in a slow relaxed way; a slow relaxed walk

examples.text: We went for a stroll along the river after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚饭后沿河散了会儿步。

senses.meaning_en: to do or achieve something easily and without effort

examples.text: She strolled through the exam without any difficulty.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻松通过了考试。

senses.meaning_en: a determined attempt or effort to achieve something

examples.text: The team worked overtime in an endeavor to finish the project.
examples.translation_cn: 团队加班加点，努力完成这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: to try hard to do something

examples.text: The company always endeavors to provide excellent service.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司始终努力提供优质服务。

senses.meaning_en: causing a desire to know more; very interesting

examples.text: I find it intriguing that she never mentioned the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得有趣的是，她从没提过这次会议。

senses.meaning_en: widespread or common

examples.text: This misconception is prevalent among people who rarely read scientific studies.
examples.translation_cn: 这种误解在很少阅读科学研究的人群中很普遍。

senses.meaning_en: the fact or condition of being prevalent; widespread presence

examples.text: The prevalence of online scams has risen sharply this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年网络诈骗的普遍性急剧上升。

senses.meaning_en: a quantity with both magnitude and direction

examples.text: Velocity is a vector quantity with both magnitude and direction.
examples.translation_cn: 速度是一个既有大小又有方向的矢量。

senses.meaning_en: a carrier of a disease-causing agent

examples.text: A mosquito can act as a vector for malaria in tropical regions.
examples.translation_cn: 蚊子在热带地区可能成为疟疾的传播媒介。

senses.meaning_en: a force or development that directs the course of events

examples.text: The new law served as a vector for social change.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律成为社会变革的推动力。

senses.meaning_en: a dynamically resizable array

examples.text: The program stores all user inputs in a vector for later processing.
examples.translation_cn: 程序将所有用户输入存储在一个动态数组中。

senses.meaning_en: to make something more intense

examples.text: The government has decided to intensify efforts to reduce air pollution.
examples.translation_cn: 政府已决定加大力度减少空气污染。

senses.meaning_en: to become more intense

examples.text: The pain in his knee intensified during the climb.
examples.translation_cn: 他膝盖的疼痛在登山时加剧了。

senses.meaning_en: a curved line or shape, especially part of a circle

examples.text: The ball flew in an arc over the goalkeeper.
examples.translation_cn: 球呈弧线飞过守门员。

senses.meaning_en: the development of a story or character over time

examples.text: The film follows the arc of its main character from poverty to power.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影讲述了其主角从贫穷到掌权的人物弧线。

senses.meaning_en: a continuous electric discharge between two points

examples.text: The arc between the two wires produced a blinding flash.
examples.translation_cn: 两根导线之间的电弧产生了令人目眩的闪光。

senses.meaning_en: violent, destructive and cruel

examples.text: Two strangers carried out a vicious attack on the old man.
examples.translation_cn: 两名陌生人对老人实施了凶残的攻击。

senses.meaning_en: savage and aggressive

examples.text: The dog can be vicious to anyone who approaches its food.
examples.translation_cn: 那只狗对任何靠近它食物的人都可能变得凶暴。

senses.meaning_en: full of hatred and anger; intended to hurt

examples.text: She posted vicious comments about her former boss online.
examples.translation_cn: 她在网上对前老板发表了恶毒的评论。

senses.meaning_en: forming a cycle that gets worse and is hard to escape

examples.text: The region is trapped in a vicious cycle of poverty and crime.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区陷入了贫困和犯罪的恶性循环。

senses.meaning_en: an increase or improvement in quality, level, or rank

examples.text: The staff received an upgrade in pay and benefits.
examples.translation_cn: 员工们获得了薪资和福利的提升。

senses.meaning_en: an improved component or replacement item, especially for technology

examples.text: The company released an upgrade to its mobile app.
examples.translation_cn: 公司发布了其移动应用的升级版。

senses.meaning_en: to replace something with a better version

examples.text: You can upgrade the software to the latest version.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将软件升级到最新版本。

senses.meaning_en: easy to see or understand; obvious

examples.text: Their anxiety was manifest in the way they avoided eye contact.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的焦虑从他们回避眼神接触的方式中显而易见。

senses.meaning_en: to show something clearly, especially a feeling, attitude, or quality

examples.text: He rarely manifests his emotions in public, even among close friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他很少在公共场合表露情绪，即使在好友面前也是如此。

senses.meaning_en: to appear or become noticeable, especially as a symptom or problem

examples.text: The infection may manifest itself as a high fever.
examples.translation_cn: 这种感染可能表现为高烧。

senses.meaning_en: to change or make something change from its natural shape

examples.text: The intense heat distorted the shape of the plastic ruler.
examples.translation_cn: 高温使塑料尺子变形了。

senses.meaning_en: to give a false or misleading account of something

examples.text: The article deliberately distorted the truth to protect its sources.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章故意歪曲事实以保护其消息来源。

senses.meaning_en: to change a sound or signal so that it is unclear

examples.text: The signal was distorted by static during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨期间信号因静电而失真。

senses.meaning_en: of little significance or value; ordinary

examples.text: She considered the question trivial and refused to answer.
examples.translation_cn: 她认为这个问题无关紧要，拒绝回答。

senses.meaning_en: easy; requiring little skill or effort

examples.text: For an expert, these calculations are trivial to perform.
examples.translation_cn: 对专家来说，这些计算做起来毫不费力。

senses.meaning_en: a person of low general intelligence

examples.text: He is not an idiot; he just needs more time to learn.
examples.translation_cn: 他不是白痴，只是需要更多时间学习。

senses.meaning_en: a person who acts or decides foolishly

examples.text: I felt like an idiot when I forgot her name.
examples.translation_cn: 当我忘记她的名字时，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。

senses.meaning_en: the structure of bones that supports the body of a person or animal

examples.text: The skeleton of a whale is made of hundreds of bones.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸的骨骼由数百块骨头组成。

senses.meaning_en: a basic outline of a plan or written work

examples.text: The teacher asked us to write a skeleton of our essays first.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让我们先写作文的提纲。

senses.meaning_en: a supporting frame for a building or structure

examples.text: The skeleton of the new office building is already in place.
examples.translation_cn: 新办公楼的骨架已经就位。

senses.meaning_en: a model or image of a human skeleton, used as a symbol of death or for decoration

examples.text: A plastic skeleton was hanging from the door at the Halloween party.
examples.translation_cn: 万圣节晚会上，一个塑料骷髅挂在门上。

senses.meaning_en: into small, thin, or delicate pieces

examples.text: Add one finely chopped onion to the pan.
examples.translation_cn: 往平底锅里加入一个切得很碎的洋葱。

senses.meaning_en: in an attractive or excellent way

examples.text: The silver necklace was finely crafted by skilled artisans.
examples.translation_cn: 这条银项链由技艺娴熟的工匠精制而成。

senses.meaning_en: pale and without color

examples.text: His face looked bleak and pale after the long illness.
examples.translation_cn: 久病后，他的脸色显得苍白无华。

senses.meaning_en: bare and exposed to the wind

examples.text: They looked out over a bleak landscape of bare rock.
examples.translation_cn: 他们眺望着远处一片光秃秃的荒凉岩石景观。

senses.meaning_en: cold and cheerless

examples.text: It was a bleak day with icy winds and dark clouds.
examples.translation_cn: 那是一个阴冷的日子，寒风阵阵，乌云密布。

senses.meaning_en: not hopeful; depressing

examples.text: They face a bleak future unless sales improve.
examples.translation_cn: 除非销售好转，否则他们将面临惨淡的前景。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone familiar with or aware of something

examples.text: Please acquaint yourself with the safety rules before you begin.
examples.translation_cn: 开始前请熟悉安全规则。

senses.meaning_en: familiar with something; having knowledge of it

examples.text: We are acquainted with the new office procedures.
examples.translation_cn: 我们熟悉新的办公程序。

senses.meaning_en: a number or value that measures a property or characteristic

examples.text: The coefficient of friction between rubber and wet ice is surprisingly low.
examples.translation_cn: 橡胶与湿冰之间的摩擦系数低得惊人。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the cosmos or outer space

examples.text: The telescope captures light from cosmic dust clouds.
examples.translation_cn: 望远镜捕捉来自宇宙尘埃云的光。

senses.meaning_en: of extremely great importance or scale

examples.text: The findings are of cosmic significance to modern physics.
examples.translation_cn: 这些发现对现代物理学意义深远。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to abstract spiritual or metaphysical ideas

examples.text: The author explores the concept of cosmic consciousness in her novel.
examples.translation_cn: 作者在她的小说中探讨了宇宙意识的概念。

senses.meaning_en: to cause people or things to scatter in different directions

examples.text: Police used tear gas to disperse a crowd outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 警察使用催泪瓦斯驱散车站外的人群。

senses.meaning_en: to spread something such as seeds or information over a wide area

examples.text: A strong wind helps disperse seeds over a wide area.
examples.translation_cn: 强风帮助将种子散播到广阔区域。

senses.meaning_en: to break up and go away; to dissipate

examples.text: The large crowd dispersed slowly after the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会结束后，一大群人慢慢散去。

senses.meaning_en: to think deeply and carefully about something

examples.text: The committee pondered over the long-term consequences of the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会仔细考虑了该提案的长期后果。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize or speak out against someone or something publicly

examples.text: The foreign minister strongly denounced the leak as completely unacceptable.
examples.translation_cn: 外交部长强烈谴责这次泄密是完全不可接受的。

senses.meaning_en: to announce the termination of a treaty or armistice

examples.text: The government officially denounced the armistice in 1939.
examples.translation_cn: 政府于1939年正式宣布废止停战协定。

senses.meaning_en: to formally accuse someone, especially to the authorities

examples.text: He immediately denounced the traitor to the authorities.
examples.translation_cn: 他立即向当局告发了那个叛徒。

senses.meaning_en: to find out definitely; to discover or establish

examples.text: Investigators are trying to ascertain whether the fire was intentional.
examples.translation_cn: 调查人员正在设法查明火灾是否是蓄意的。

senses.meaning_en: of or for people walking

examples.text: He crossed the street at the pedestrian crossing.
examples.translation_cn: 他在人行横道过马路。

senses.meaning_en: ordinary and dull; unexciting

examples.text: The essay's pedestrian prose made it a dull read.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章平淡无奇的文笔读起来很乏味。

senses.meaning_en: a large sea fish

examples.text: We spotted a school of tuna leaping out of the water.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看见一群金枪鱼跃出水面。

senses.meaning_en: the flesh of tuna used as food

examples.text: She opened a can of tuna and mixed it into the pasta.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开一罐金枪鱼，拌进意大利面里。

senses.meaning_en: to be a sign or symbol of something; mean

examples.text: In many cultures, the colour white signifies purity.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多文化中，白色象征纯洁。

senses.meaning_en: to show or make known by a sign; indicate

examples.text: A slight nod signified that she approved the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 轻轻点头表明她同意这个计划。

senses.meaning_en: to be important; matter (formal, often in negative sentences)

examples.text: It doesn't signify whether he agrees or not.
examples.translation_cn: 他是否同意并不重要。

senses.meaning_en: a type of grass grown for its edible grains, or the grains themselves

examples.text: Farmers in this region grow cereal crops such as wheat and barley.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区的农民种植小麦、大麦等谷类作物。

senses.meaning_en: a food made from roasted grain, typically eaten with milk at breakfast

examples.text: I usually have cereal for breakfast with cold milk.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常早餐吃麦片，加冷牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: widely known for something bad

examples.text: The former mayor was notorious for accepting bribes.
examples.translation_cn: 这位前市长因受贿而臭名昭著。

senses.meaning_en: people of royal rank and their families as a group

examples.text: As a member of royalty, she must follow strict protocol.
examples.translation_cn: 作为王室成员，她必须遵守严格的礼仪。

senses.meaning_en: payment received for the use of a work or invention

examples.text: The author receives royalties from every copy sold.
examples.translation_cn: 作者从每本售出的书中获得版税。

senses.meaning_en: a group of performers who travel around and give shows with acrobats, clowns, and trained animals, usually in a large tent

examples.text: She joined a circus as an acrobat after leaving school.
examples.translation_cn: 她毕业后加入了一个马戏团，成为一名杂技演员。

senses.meaning_en: a noisy, confused, or chaotic event or place

examples.text: The meeting turned into a circus with people shouting.
examples.translation_cn: 会议变成了一场人们大喊大叫的喧闹场面。

senses.meaning_en: a round open area in a town or city where several streets meet

examples.text: We agreed to meet at Piccadilly Circus at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 我们约定中午在皮卡迪利广场见面。

senses.meaning_en: idle talk or stories about other people's private lives, often unkind or untrue

examples.text: There was a lot of gossip about her divorce.
examples.translation_cn: 关于她离婚有很多流言蜚语。

senses.meaning_en: to talk about other people's private lives, often in a way that spreads information

examples.text: She often gossips about her colleagues behind their backs.
examples.translation_cn: 她经常在背后议论同事的私事。

senses.meaning_en: to talk casually about unimportant things

examples.text: We often gossip over coffee on Sunday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我们经常在周日早上边喝咖啡边闲聊。

senses.meaning_en: a friendly conversation about unimportant things

examples.text: We had a good gossip about our holiday over lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们午饭时好好聊了聊假期。

senses.meaning_en: the act or service of welcoming, receiving, hosting, or entertaining guests; generous treatment of visitors

examples.text: The villagers showed hospitality to all the hikers caught in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 村民们款待了所有淋雨被困的徒步者。

senses.meaning_en: a doctor who treats teeth and gums

examples.text: You should see a dentist about that toothache as soon as possible.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该尽快去看牙医处理那颗牙痛。

senses.meaning_en: to delay someone or something

examples.text: She was unavoidably detained by a last-minute phone call.
examples.translation_cn: 她被一个临时打来的电话耽搁了。

senses.meaning_en: to keep someone in official custody

examples.text: The police detained the suspect for questioning last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚警方拘留了嫌疑人进行审问。

senses.meaning_en: to keep someone from leaving by holding them back or making claims on their attention

examples.text: The manager detained me for a moment to discuss the schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 经理留了我一会儿讨论日程。

senses.meaning_en: to seize goods for official purposes

examples.text: The imported goods were detained by customs for inspection.
examples.translation_cn: 该批进口货物被海关扣留待检。

senses.meaning_en: a salty brown liquid made from fermented soybeans

examples.text: Simmer the tofu in soy sauce and ginger for five minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 把豆腐放入酱油和姜片中炖五分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a type of bean, or protein made from it

examples.text: Some cereals contain soy and are safe for most vegans.
examples.translation_cn: 有些麦片含大豆，对大多数纯素食者安全。

senses.meaning_en: a very small copy or model of something

examples.text: He built a miniature of the old castle.
examples.translation_cn: 他建了一座古堡的微型复制品。

senses.meaning_en: a very small, detailed painting, especially a portrait or manuscript illustration

examples.text: She painted a miniature of the young king.
examples.translation_cn: 她画了一幅年轻国王的微型肖像画。

senses.meaning_en: a greatly reduced size or scale

examples.text: The model shows the whole city in miniature.
examples.translation_cn: 这个模型展示了整座城市的缩微风貌。

senses.meaning_en: done or existing alone; without companions

examples.text: She took a solitary walk along the river.
examples.translation_cn: 她沿着河边独自散步。

senses.meaning_en: single; only one

examples.text: This is a solitary example of his early work.
examples.translation_cn: 这是他早期作品中唯一的一个例子。

senses.meaning_en: not much visited or frequented; remote from society

examples.text: They found a solitary beach far from the road.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在远离公路的地方发现了一处僻静的海滩。

senses.meaning_en: solitary confinement

examples.text: The prisoner was kept in solitary confinement for a month.
examples.translation_cn: 那名囚犯被单独监禁了一个月。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives alone; a hermit

examples.text: After his wife died, he became a solitary and moved to a remote cottage.
examples.translation_cn: 妻子去世后，他成了一个独居者，搬到了一座偏僻的小屋。

senses.meaning_en: a social event for people who have not seen each other for a long time

examples.text: She attended a class reunion at her old high school.
examples.translation_cn: 她参加了在母校举行的一次同学聚会。

senses.meaning_en: the act of meeting again after being apart

examples.text: He had an emotional reunion with his brother after ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 十年后他与哥哥激动地重逢。

senses.meaning_en: a small wheeled vehicle for carrying things, especially in a supermarket or station

examples.text: He pushed a heavy trolley through the supermarket.
examples.translation_cn: 他推着一辆沉重的购物车穿过超市。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle that runs on rails along streets, used for public transport

examples.text: We took a trolley to the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 我们坐有轨电车去了老城区。

senses.meaning_en: a small table on wheels used to serve food or drinks

examples.text: The waiter wheeled a drinks trolley to our table.
examples.translation_cn: 服务员把饮料推车推到我们桌旁。

senses.meaning_en: existing in name only
senses.pattern: be the nominal head of sth

examples.text: He is the nominal head of the company, but his son runs it.
examples.translation_cn: 他是公司名义上的负责人，但实际由他的儿子经营。

senses.meaning_en: very small; token
senses.pattern: charge a nominal fee for sth

examples.text: The gym charges a nominal fee for day passes.
examples.translation_cn: 健身房对单日卡收取象征性费用。

senses.meaning_en: a large wild animal of the cow family, such as the water buffalo or the American bison

examples.text: A herd of buffalo was crossing the river.
examples.translation_cn: 一群水牛正在过河。

senses.meaning_en: to confuse or intimidate someone

examples.text: The lawyer tried to buffalo the witness into admitting guilt.
examples.translation_cn: 律师试图恐吓证人承认有罪。

senses.meaning_en: a fish with spiny fins, often caught for food

examples.text: He caught a large perch in the lake this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他今天早上在湖里钓到一条大鲈鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a place where a bird rests, such as a branch or bar

examples.text: The parrot dozed on its wooden perch in the cage.
examples.translation_cn: 鹦鹉在笼子里的栖木上打盹。

senses.meaning_en: a high or prominent position, especially one with a good view or advantage

examples.text: From their perch on the hill, they could see the whole valley.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从山上的高处可以俯瞰整个山谷。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of land

examples.text: They bought a large tract of land near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在河边买了一大片土地。

senses.meaning_en: a system of connected organs in the body

examples.text: This infection can spread through the digestive tract.
examples.translation_cn: 这种感染可以经消化道传播。

senses.meaning_en: a short booklet or piece of writing, often on a moral or political subject

examples.text: She wrote a short tract on prison reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她写了一篇关于监狱改革的短文。

senses.meaning_en: a holy place built to honour a god or saint

examples.text: The shrine of Apollo at Delphi was famous in ancient Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 德尔斐的阿波罗神殿在古希腊很有名。

senses.meaning_en: a place that people visit because it is connected with a respected person or event

examples.text: The poet's home has become a shrine to his memory.
examples.translation_cn: 诗人的故居已成为纪念他的圣地。

senses.meaning_en: a container for sacred relics

examples.text: The church displays a silver shrine containing the saint's bones.
examples.translation_cn: 教堂展示了一个装有圣人遗骨的银质圣物盒。

senses.meaning_en: a tendency to behave in a particular way

examples.text: He has a disposition to take risks when driving.
examples.translation_cn: 他开车时有冒险的倾向。

senses.meaning_en: a person's usual mood or temperament

examples.text: She is of a cheerful disposition and rarely complains.
examples.translation_cn: 她性格开朗，很少抱怨。

senses.meaning_en: the power or right to deal with something as one wishes
senses.collocation: at the disposition of the committee

examples.text: The emergency fund is at the disposition of the committee.
examples.translation_cn: 应急基金由委员会支配。

senses.meaning_en: the way things are arranged or placed

examples.text: The architect studied the disposition of rooms in the building.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑师研究了大楼里房间的布局。

senses.meaning_en: a person who receives money or property from a trust or estate

examples.text: She was named as the sole beneficiary under her grandfather's will.
examples.translation_cn: 她被指定为她祖父遗嘱的唯一受益人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is named to receive money from an insurance policy
senses.collocation: beneficiary of a life insurance policy

examples.text: You should name your spouse as the sole beneficiary of your life insurance policy.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该指定你的配偶为你人寿保险的唯一受益人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gains an advantage or benefit from something

examples.text: The region is the main beneficiary of the government's economic reform.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区是政府经济改革的主要受益者。

senses.meaning_en: a familiar, invented name used instead of a person's real name, often based on a characteristic

examples.text: He goes by the nickname 'Flash' because he runs so fast.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为跑得快而被人叫做“闪电”。

senses.meaning_en: a familiar, shortened or diminutive form of a name

examples.text: The nickname for Robert is Bob, and for Elizabeth it is Liz.
examples.translation_cn: 罗伯特的昵称是鲍勃，伊丽莎白的昵称是莉兹。

senses.meaning_en: to give a nickname to someone or something

examples.text: She was nicknamed 'the Iron Lady' for her tough negotiating style.
examples.translation_cn: 她因强硬的谈判风格而被称作“铁娘子”。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is unable to stop taking a harmful drug

examples.text: He became a drug addict after years of painkiller abuse.
examples.translation_cn: 在多年滥用止痛药后，他成了瘾君子。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to become dependent on something, especially a drug

examples.text: He is addicted to video games and plays until late.
examples.translation_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏，玩到很晚。

senses.meaning_en: a person who likes a particular activity very much

examples.text: She is a coffee addict and drinks several cups a day.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个咖啡迷，一天喝好几杯。

senses.meaning_en: a military operation in which an army surrounds a place to force its surrender

examples.text: The rebels laid siege to the capital for three months.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军围攻首都三个月。

senses.meaning_en: a long period of trouble, criticism, or annoyance

examples.text: The airline is under siege from angry passengers after cancelling hundreds of flights.
examples.translation_cn: 在取消数百个航班后，该航空公司正受到愤怒乘客的围攻。

senses.meaning_en: cured meat from a pig, usually sold in thin slices

examples.text: He put a slice of bacon on each burger.
examples.translation_cn: 他在每个汉堡上放了一片培根。

senses.meaning_en: a product used in place of bacon, often made without pork

examples.text: This soy product works well as a bacon substitute.
examples.translation_cn: 这种豆制品很适合作为培根替代品。

senses.meaning_en: a thick yellow or brown sauce made from mustard seeds, eaten cold with meat or salad

examples.text: He spread the sandwich with mustard before adding meat.
examples.translation_cn: 他在加肉之前给三明治抹了芥末酱。

senses.meaning_en: a plant with yellow flowers whose seeds are used to make mustard; its leaves can be eaten as a salad

examples.text: They grow mustard for its seeds and young leaves.
examples.translation_cn: 他们种植芥菜，取籽和嫩叶。

senses.meaning_en: a dark yellow or brownish-yellow colour

examples.text: She wore a coat in mustard to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一件芥末色外套去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: balls of ice falling as precipitation; a hailstorm

examples.text: The town was hit by hail last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚该镇遭到了冰雹袭击。

senses.meaning_en: to have hailstones fall from the sky

examples.text: It hailed heavily for about ten minutes this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上下冰雹下了大约十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to call out to sb or wave to stop a taxi, bus, etc.

examples.text: He stepped into the road to hail a taxi.
examples.translation_cn: 他走到路上去拦出租车。

senses.meaning_en: to praise sb/sth enthusiastically and publicly

examples.text: The discovery was hailed as a major breakthrough.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现被誉为重大突破。

senses.meaning_en: to come from a particular place

examples.text: She hails from a small town in Scotland.
examples.translation_cn: 她来自苏格兰的一个小镇。

senses.meaning_en: lacking experience, wisdom, or judgement

examples.text: It is naive to expect success without effort.
examples.translation_cn: 指望不努力就成功是幼稚的。

senses.meaning_en: not having been exposed to something and therefore too trusting

examples.text: She is naive about online scams and has lost all her savings.
examples.translation_cn: 她对网络诈骗太轻信，损失了所有积蓄。

senses.meaning_en: the northern polar region of the earth

examples.text: Polar bears live in the Arctic and depend on sea ice for hunting.
examples.translation_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区，依赖海冰捕猎。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Arctic region

examples.text: Scientists study Arctic wildlife to understand the effects of climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家研究北极野生动物以了解气候变化的影响。

senses.meaning_en: extremely cold; characteristic of polar regions

examples.text: We had to cancel the outdoor event because of the arctic conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 由于严寒的天气，我们不得不取消户外活动。

senses.meaning_en: designed for use in extremely cold conditions

examples.text: The expedition team packed arctic clothing for the freezing nights.
examples.translation_cn: 探险队为寒冷的夜晚准备了防寒衣物。

senses.meaning_en: serving to decorate; ornamental

examples.text: These buttons on the coat are purely decorative and serve no purpose.
examples.translation_cn: 外套上的这些扣子纯粹是装饰，没有任何实际用途。

senses.meaning_en: a device that heats water to provide heat and hot water for a building

examples.text: We installed a new boiler for the central heating system.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为中央供暖系统安装了一台新锅炉。

senses.meaning_en: a kitchen vessel for steaming, boiling or heating food

examples.text: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over low heat.
examples.translation_cn: 将巧克力放在双层蒸锅中用小火融化。

senses.meaning_en: a break in a bone or cartilage

examples.text: She suffered a fracture of her left arm during the match.
examples.translation_cn: 她在比赛中左臂骨折。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of breaking; a place where something has broken

examples.text: The mechanic discovered a fracture in the engine block.
examples.translation_cn: 机械师发现发动机缸体上有一道裂缝。

senses.meaning_en: written language in its ordinary form, not poetry

examples.text: He prefers to write in prose rather than verse.
examples.translation_cn: 他更喜欢写散文而不是诗歌。

senses.meaning_en: written or spoken in ordinary language; not poetic

examples.text: He wrote a prose version of the ancient epic.
examples.translation_cn: 他写了这部古代史诗的散文体版本。

senses.meaning_en: language which evinces little imagination or animation; dull and commonplace discourse

examples.text: Her speech was filled with the dull prose of corporate jargon.
examples.translation_cn: 她的演讲充斥着企业套话的平淡语言。

senses.meaning_en: predominant; widespread

examples.text: The prevailing view is that prices will continue to rise.
examples.translation_cn: 普遍的观点是价格将继续上涨。

senses.meaning_en: to combine into a single unit; to join together

examples.text: The two firms consolidated into one large company.
examples.translation_cn: 这两家公司合并成了一家大公司。

senses.meaning_en: to make stronger or more solid

examples.text: The party wants to consolidate its power by winning a second term.
examples.translation_cn: 该党希望通过赢得第二个任期来巩固权力。

senses.meaning_en: to combine several debts into a single loan
senses.pattern: consolidate debts into a single loan

examples.text: She consolidated all her credit card debts into one low-interest loan.
examples.translation_cn: 她将所有的信用卡债务合并为一笔低息贷款。

senses.meaning_en: a person descended from a particular ancestor

examples.text: She is a direct descendant of the last emperor.
examples.translation_cn: 她是末代皇帝的直系后裔。

senses.meaning_en: something that developed from an earlier type

examples.text: Jazz is a descendant of blues and ragtime.
examples.translation_cn: 爵士乐是蓝调和拉格泰姆的后代。

senses.meaning_en: a woody plant smaller than a tree with several stems

examples.text: They planted several shrubs along the garden path last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 去年春天他们沿着花园小径种了几棵灌木。

senses.meaning_en: cured or smoked meat from the upper part of a pig's leg

examples.text: We had ham and eggs for breakfast this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天早餐吃了火腿鸡蛋。

senses.meaning_en: a person who operates an amateur radio station

examples.text: My uncle is a keen ham radio operator.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔是个热心的业余无线电爱好者。

senses.meaning_en: to overact or perform with exaggerated emotions

examples.text: He tends to ham it up when the camera is on him.
examples.translation_cn: 当镜头对准他时，他往往会演得过火。

senses.meaning_en: to indicate or be a sign of

examples.text: A sudden drop in temperature may denote a fault in the engine.
examples.translation_cn: 温度突然下降可能表明发动机有故障。

senses.meaning_en: to be a name or symbol for; to refer to literally

examples.text: In mathematics, the symbol '≈' denotes approximate equality.
examples.translation_cn: 在数学中，符号“≈”表示近似相等。

senses.meaning_en: a large round orange fruit with thick skin, used as food

examples.text: She roasted a whole pumpkin with rosemary and garlic for the autumn dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 她用迷迭香和大蒜烤了一整个南瓜作为秋季晚餐。

senses.meaning_en: the plant that produces pumpkins

examples.text: Farmers plant pumpkins in rich soil and water them regularly.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种下南瓜并定期浇水。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who share an interest or aim

examples.text: He joined a local fellowship for amateur photographers.
examples.translation_cn: 他加入了当地的一个业余摄影师联谊会。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of friendship and connection between people

examples.text: We felt a deep sense of fellowship during the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 在长途徒步中我们感受到了深厚的同伴情谊。

senses.meaning_en: a grant or paid position for advanced study or research

examples.text: She received a research fellowship in biology at Harvard.
examples.translation_cn: 她获得了哈佛大学生物学研究员职位。

senses.meaning_en: sound recorded or broadcast using two separate channels

examples.text: The radio station broadcasts all its music in stereo.
examples.translation_cn: 这家广播电台用立体声播放所有音乐。

senses.meaning_en: a machine for playing music that uses two speakers

examples.text: He played the new album on the stereo all evening.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个晚上都在立体声音响上播放这张新专辑。

senses.meaning_en: recorded or broadcast using two separate channels

examples.text: The band released a stereo recording of the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队发行了这场音乐会的立体声录音。

senses.meaning_en: small oval fruit, eaten green or black

examples.text: Add a handful of black olives to the salad.
examples.translation_cn: 往沙拉里加一把黑橄榄。

senses.meaning_en: dark yellowish-green colour

examples.text: The soldiers wore simple uniforms in olive green.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们穿着简单的橄榄绿色制服。

senses.meaning_en: a document or achievement that proves someone's qualifications or status

examples.text: She gained strong credentials as a public health expert.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为公共卫生专家获得了良好的资历证明。

senses.meaning_en: to provide someone with credentials

examples.text: She is credentialed to teach in public schools.
examples.translation_cn: 她获得了在公立学校任教的资格。

senses.meaning_en: the act of distorting something

examples.text: The distortion of the image became obvious only after several hours.
examples.translation_cn: 图像的扭曲在数小时后才变得明显。

senses.meaning_en: a result of distorting

examples.text: The heat caused a distortion in the metal plate.
examples.translation_cn: 热量导致金属板发生变形。

senses.meaning_en: a misrepresentation of the truth

examples.text: The report was criticized for its distortion of the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 该报道因歪曲事实而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: noise or other artifacts caused in the electronic reproduction of sound or music

examples.text: You can hear distortion in the recording at high volume.
examples.translation_cn: 音量高时，你能听到录音中的失真。

senses.meaning_en: to walk or travel around without a definite aim or destination

examples.text: We roamed around the old town for three hours.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在老城区逛了三个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to range or wander over an area

examples.text: A stray dog roamed the streets near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 一只流浪狗在车站附近的街道上游荡。

senses.meaning_en: to use a mobile phone service outside its home network

examples.text: Your phone will roam on a local network while you are abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 你在国外时，手机会在本地网络中漫游。

senses.meaning_en: a soft material full of small holes, used for cushioning or insulation

examples.text: The armchair is made of foam that is covered with fabric.
examples.translation_cn: 这把扶手椅由泡沫制成，外面包着织物。

senses.meaning_en: a mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid or solid

examples.text: A thick layer of foam formed on top of the beer.
examples.translation_cn: 啤酒上面形成了一层厚厚的泡沫。

senses.meaning_en: to form or produce foam

examples.text: The milk foamed up quickly as it boiled.
examples.translation_cn: 牛奶沸腾时迅速起泡。

senses.meaning_en: to produce foam from the mouth, often because of anger or illness

examples.text: He was foaming at the mouth with rage.
examples.translation_cn: 他气得口吐白沫。

senses.meaning_en: having little or no hair on the head

examples.text: He is bald on top but still has hair on the sides.
examples.translation_cn: 他头顶秃了，但两侧还有头发。

senses.meaning_en: lacking a natural covering; worn smooth

examples.text: After the fire, the hills were completely bald.
examples.translation_cn: 火灾过后，山丘变得光秃秃的。

senses.meaning_en: plain and direct; without evidence or support

examples.text: The minister made a bald statement without offering any evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 部长发表了赤裸裸的声明，却没有提供任何证据。

senses.meaning_en: to become bald

examples.text: He started balding in his early twenties, much like his father.
examples.translation_cn: 他二十出头就开始变秃，很像他父亲。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is always present in a particular place or activity

examples.text: She is a regular fixture at the library on Tuesday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 每周二上午她都会出现在图书馆，是那里的常客。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment fixed in a building, such as a light or sink

examples.text: The old light fixtures in the kitchen need to be replaced.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房里的旧灯需要更换了。

senses.meaning_en: a sports event arranged for a particular date

examples.text: Saturday's fixture against United was postponed because of snow.
examples.translation_cn: 周六对曼联的比赛因大雪推迟了。

senses.meaning_en: a thin round slice of potato that is fried and eaten cold

examples.text: He opened a bag of crisps and shared them with his friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开一袋薯片，和朋友们分享。

senses.meaning_en: firm and fresh, making a sharp sound when bitten

examples.text: The fish was crisp on the outside and tender inside.
examples.translation_cn: 这条鱼外酥里嫩。

senses.meaning_en: pleasantly cool and dry

examples.text: The air felt crisp as we stepped outside at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时我们走到外面，空气清爽。

senses.meaning_en: clear and sharp, especially in sound or image

examples.text: The photo is crisp and clear, so you can read every sign in the background.
examples.translation_cn: 照片清晰明快，背景里的每个标志都能看清。

senses.meaning_en: lower in rank or position

examples.text: A captain is directly subordinate to a major.
examples.translation_cn: 上尉直接隶属于少校。

senses.meaning_en: inferior in importance or controlled by authority

examples.text: Safety concerns were subordinate to the company's profit goals.
examples.translation_cn: 安全问题从属于公司的利润目标。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is lower in rank or position

examples.text: As a subordinate of the director, he had little power.
examples.translation_cn: 作为主管的下属，他几乎没有权力。

senses.meaning_en: to place in a lower rank or make less important

examples.text: He subordinated his personal ambitions to the team's success.
examples.translation_cn: 他使个人抱负服从于团队成功。

senses.meaning_en: (grammar) dependent on a main clause

examples.text: A subordinate clause that begins with 'because' needs a main clause.
examples.translation_cn: 以 because 开头的从句需要一个主句。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or situated on the edge or periphery

examples.text: New industries are developing in peripheral areas of the country.
examples.translation_cn: 新兴产业正在该国的边缘地区发展。

senses.meaning_en: not central or important; auxiliary

examples.text: These minor details are peripheral to the main argument.
examples.translation_cn: 这些次要细节对主要论点来说并不重要。

senses.meaning_en: a device connected to a computer but not part of it

examples.text: You can connect a peripheral such as a printer to any USB port.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将打印机等外围设备连接到任何USB端口。

senses.meaning_en: a consultant or consulting firm

examples.text: She works for a management consultancy in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伦敦的一家管理咨询公司工作。

senses.meaning_en: the services offered by a consultant

examples.text: The firm provides consultancy to small businesses across the country.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司为全国的小企业提供咨询服务。

senses.meaning_en: to pull something hard or with effort, often repeatedly

examples.text: He tugged at the heavy rope until it finally moved.
examples.translation_cn: 他用力拉那根粗绳，直到它终于移动了。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong pull

examples.text: She gave the drawer a hard tug and it opened.
examples.translation_cn: 她用力拉了一下抽屉，抽屉就开了。

senses.meaning_en: a small powerful boat used for pulling larger ships

examples.text: A tug pulled the tanker into the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 一艘拖船把油轮拖进港口。

senses.meaning_en: likely to suffer from or do something bad

examples.text: He is prone to headaches when he stays up late.
examples.translation_cn: 他熬夜时容易头痛。

senses.meaning_en: lying flat with the face down

examples.text: The patient was lying prone on the hospital bed.
examples.translation_cn: 病人俯卧在病床上。

senses.meaning_en: a type of rock composed mainly of calcium carbonate

examples.text: The walls of the old church are made of limestone.
examples.translation_cn: 老教堂的墙壁是用石灰岩建造的。

senses.meaning_en: to change frequently in size, amount, level, etc.

examples.text: Temperatures fluctuate between 15 and 25 degrees during spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春季气温在15到25度之间波动。

senses.meaning_en: to waver; to be irresolute

examples.text: His feelings for her fluctuated between love and hate.
examples.translation_cn: 他对她的感情在爱与恨之间摇摆不定。

senses.meaning_en: a change or variation in level, amount, or degree

examples.text: There have been wide fluctuations in house prices this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年房价出现了大幅波动。

senses.meaning_en: a flexible tube for carrying water or other liquids

examples.text: We watered the vegetable garden with a hose for ten minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用水管给菜园浇了十分钟水。

senses.meaning_en: to water or wash something using a hose

examples.text: We hosed the car down after driving on wet, muddy roads.
examples.translation_cn: 在湿滑泥泞的道路上行驶后，我们用水管冲洗了汽车。

senses.meaning_en: a close-fitting garment covering the legs, worn by women; stockings or tights

examples.text: She wore a pair of silk hose under her wool dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她在羊毛连衣裙下穿了一双丝袜。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage people to act together in support of something

examples.text: The campaign mobilized thousands of volunteers to clean the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 这场活动动员了数千名志愿者清理海滩。

senses.meaning_en: to start to use resources, money, etc. for a particular purpose

examples.text: The charity mobilized funds for the disaster relief effort.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构为救灾工作调动了资金。

senses.meaning_en: to get ready for war; to assemble troops and equipment for war

examples.text: The army mobilized for war within just a few hours.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在短短几小时内就动员起来备战。

senses.meaning_en: problematic; open to doubt or challenge

examples.text: The decision to cancel the project is highly questionable.
examples.translation_cn: 取消这个项目的决定非常可疑。

senses.meaning_en: not certain or probably not true; doubtful

examples.text: It is questionable whether these figures are accurate.
examples.translation_cn: 这些数字是否准确值得怀疑。

senses.meaning_en: of dubious respectability or morality

examples.text: Several of his business partners were of questionable character.
examples.translation_cn: 他的好几个商业伙伴品行可疑。

senses.meaning_en: the act of having sex

examples.text: She refused to have intercourse with him until they were married.
examples.translation_cn: 她拒绝在婚前与他发生性行为。

senses.meaning_en: communication or dealings between people, groups, or countries

examples.text: There has been little intercourse between the two neighboring countries for years.
examples.translation_cn: 多年来，这两个邻国之间几乎没有交往。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of material, such as wood or metal, thick at one edge and tapered to a thin edge, used to split, tighten, or secure something or to keep it in place

examples.text: He used a wooden wedge to keep the heavy door open.
examples.translation_cn: 他用一个木楔子卡住沉重的门，让它保持敞开。

senses.meaning_en: something shaped like a V, especially a piece of food cut into this shape

examples.text: She put a wedge of lemon in each glass of iced tea.
examples.translation_cn: 她在每杯冰茶里放了一角柠檬。

senses.meaning_en: to force something into a narrow space or fix it in place with a wedge

examples.text: She wedged the book into her bag and ran out.
examples.translation_cn: 她把书塞进包里跑了出去。

senses.meaning_en: something that creates a division or gap between people or groups

examples.text: The scandal drove a wedge between the two leaders.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻使两位领导人之间产生了隔阂。

senses.meaning_en: a document showing that a person has earned a degree or completed a course of study

examples.text: She earned a diploma in nursing last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年获得了护理专业毕业文凭。

senses.meaning_en: an original or early model on which later forms are based or developed

examples.text: Engineers built a prototype of the new engine for testing.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师们制造了一个新发动机的原型进行测试。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the amount or number of something rather than with its quality

examples.text: The report presents quantitative data on income inequality.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告提供了关于收入不平等的量化数据。

examples.text: There is ample evidence to support this claim.
examples.translation_cn: 有充足的证据支持这一说法。

examples.text: The living room has ample space for a large sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 客厅里有充足的空间放一张大沙发。

senses.meaning_en: an atom or group of atoms that has an electrical charge

examples.text: A negative ion moves toward the positive electrode.
examples.translation_cn: 负离子向正电极移动。

senses.meaning_en: a shellfish with a rough irregular shell, eaten as food and sometimes producing pearls

examples.text: We like to eat oysters raw with lemon.
examples.translation_cn: 我们喜欢挤柠檬汁生吃牡蛎。

senses.meaning_en: opportunities or advantages available to someone

examples.text: The world is her oyster now that she has graduated.
examples.translation_cn: 既然她已经毕业，世界就是她的了。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make worse

examples.text: The economic crisis deteriorated into a full-blown recession.
examples.translation_cn: 经济危机恶化成全面衰退。

senses.meaning_en: not able to do something; not competent

examples.text: He is incapable of managing the project on his own.
examples.translation_cn: 他无法独力管理这个项目。

senses.meaning_en: food or a small object used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught

examples.text: The fisherman used live worms as bait to catch trout.
examples.translation_cn: 渔夫用活虫作饵钓鳟鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately try to make someone angry; to taunt

examples.text: He baited his opponent with insults during the debate.
examples.translation_cn: 他在辩论中用侮辱性言辞激怒对手。

senses.meaning_en: food containing poison used to kill pests

examples.text: We put out bait to kill the mice in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 我们放了毒饵杀死厨房里的老鼠。

senses.meaning_en: to attach bait to a hook or trap

examples.text: She baited the hook with a live worm.
examples.translation_cn: 她把活虫装到鱼钩上。

senses.meaning_en: something that is offered to attract or tempt someone, often deceptively

examples.text: The store offered a free gift as bait to attract new customers.
examples.translation_cn: 那家商店提供免费礼品作为诱饵来吸引新顾客。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is clear and easy to hear, see, or remember

examples.text: Please speak distinctly so that everyone can hear you.
examples.translation_cn: 请说清楚，以便大家都能听见。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is very noticeable or definite, used for emphasis

examples.text: The mood in the room was distinctly uneasy.
examples.translation_cn: 房间里的气氛明显不安。

senses.meaning_en: a line of rocks or coral near the surface of the sea

examples.text: The ship ran aground on the reef during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 船在暴风雨中触礁搁浅。

senses.meaning_en: a part of a sail that is rolled and tied down to reduce the area exposed to the wind

examples.text: The sailors took in a reef as the wind grew stronger.
examples.translation_cn: 风势渐强，水手们收起了一截帆。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce the area of a sail by rolling or tying part of it

examples.text: The crew reefed the sails before the storm hit.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨来临前，船员们收起了帆。

senses.meaning_en: a coin-like object used as money or as a voucher

examples.text: He inserted a token into the turnstile and went through.
examples.translation_cn: 他把代币投入旋转闸门并走了过去。

senses.meaning_en: a small object used to represent a player in a game

examples.text: Each player must choose a token and place it on the board before the game begins.
examples.translation_cn: 每个玩家必须在游戏开始前选择一个棋子并把它放在棋盘上。

senses.meaning_en: something that expresses or represents a feeling or fact; a keepsake

examples.text: She kept the ring as a token of their friendship.
examples.translation_cn: 她留着那枚戒指作为他们友谊的信物。

senses.meaning_en: a formal promise, especially one made in a court of law or when taking public office

examples.text: The witness took an oath to tell the truth before testifying.
examples.translation_cn: 证人在作证前宣誓说真话。

senses.meaning_en: a serious promise to do something

examples.text: She swore an oath to protect her family.
examples.translation_cn: 她发誓要保护家人。

senses.meaning_en: a swear word or offensive expression used to show anger

examples.text: He let out an oath when the car nearly hit him.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车差点撞到他，他骂了一句。

senses.meaning_en: believing that people are selfish and not trusting their motives
senses.collocation: a cynical view of human nature

examples.text: Many voters are cynical about the promises politicians make.
examples.translation_cn: 许多选民对政客的承诺持怀疑态度。

senses.meaning_en: showing contempt for accepted moral standards by one's actions

examples.text: The company showed a cynical disregard for worker safety.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司对工人安全表现出无所顾忌的漠视。

senses.meaning_en: a small metal or plastic sign worn to show membership, rank, or support

examples.text: Police officers must wear a badge while on duty.
examples.translation_cn: 警察执勤时必须佩戴徽章。

senses.meaning_en: a small name card or tag worn to show who you are

examples.text: Please show your badge at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 请在前台出示你的胸牌。

senses.meaning_en: something that shows a quality, condition, or achievement

examples.text: She sees her scar as a badge of courage.
examples.translation_cn: 她把自己的伤疤视作勇气的象征。

senses.meaning_en: a digital icon or emblem awarded for an achievement

examples.text: You can earn a badge by completing ten tasks in the app.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在应用中完成十项任务来获得一枚成就徽章。

senses.meaning_en: to make indistinct or hazy; to obscure or dim

examples.text: Tears blurred her vision as she said goodbye.
examples.translation_cn: 道别时，泪水模糊了她的视线。

senses.meaning_en: to become indistinct

examples.text: The lights blurred into one another as the car sped away.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车加速离去时，灯光模糊成一片。

senses.meaning_en: to make the difference between things less clear

examples.text: The new law blurs the line between public and private schools.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律模糊了公立和私立学校的界限。

senses.meaning_en: a smear or indistinct shape; a vague memory

examples.text: The city lights were just a blur through the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 透过雨水，城市的灯光只是一片模糊。

senses.meaning_en: to perceive or know in advance

examples.text: We did not foresee that the project would fail so quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 我们没有预料到项目会失败得这么快。

senses.meaning_en: happening before the expected or proper time

examples.text: The baby was born premature and needed special care.
examples.translation_cn: 那个婴儿早产，需要特别护理。

senses.meaning_en: done or made too soon, without enough thought

examples.text: It would be premature to praise the plan before seeing the results.
examples.translation_cn: 还没看到结果就称赞这个计划，为时过早。

senses.meaning_en: to give out or distribute to people

examples.text: The charity dispenses free meals to homeless people.
examples.translation_cn: 这家慈善机构向无家可归者分发免费餐食。

senses.meaning_en: to prepare and give out medicine

examples.text: The pharmacist dispenses the correct medicine to each patient.
examples.translation_cn: 药剂师给每位病人配发正确的药物。

senses.meaning_en: to do without or avoid using

examples.text: We can dispense with the formalities and start the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以省去繁文缛节，直接开始会议。

senses.meaning_en: to administer or apply laws and justice

examples.text: The court dispenses justice without fear or favor.
examples.translation_cn: 法院无畏无偏地主持正义。

senses.meaning_en: extremely useful; indispensable

examples.text: This travel guidebook is invaluable to first-time visitors.
examples.translation_cn: 这本旅行指南对初次到访的游客非常有帮助。

senses.meaning_en: having great or incalculable value

examples.text: The family portrait is considered invaluable by art experts.
examples.translation_cn: 艺术专家认为这幅家族肖像画是无价之宝。

senses.meaning_en: to move or turn something with skill or care

examples.text: She manoeuvred the car into a tight parking space.
examples.translation_cn: 她把车熟练地驶入一个狭窄的停车位。

senses.meaning_en: a clever plan or action to gain an advantage

examples.text: It was a manoeuvre to force him to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 这是迫使他辞职的手段。

senses.meaning_en: a military training exercise or movement

examples.text: The troops are on manoeuvres in the desert this week.
examples.translation_cn: 部队本周在沙漠中进行军事演习。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who serves customers in a restaurant or café

examples.text: My sister works as a waitress at a busy café.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在一家忙碌的咖啡馆当女服务员。

senses.meaning_en: to work as a waitress

examples.text: She waitressed at a seaside café all summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个夏天都在一家海滨咖啡馆当女服务员。

senses.meaning_en: a part left over after the rest has been used, destroyed, or disappeared

examples.text: Archaeologists found remnants of a Roman villa near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 考古学家在河边发现了一处罗马别墅的遗迹。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of cloth left over from a larger piece and often sold cheaply

examples.text: She bought a remnant of fabric to make a patchwork cushion.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一块零头布来做拼布垫子。

senses.meaning_en: to be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.

examples.text: The chairman presided over the annual meeting yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 主席昨天主持了年度会议。

senses.meaning_en: to be in charge of a company, organization, etc.

examples.text: She has presided over the firm for nearly a decade.
examples.translation_cn: 她掌管这家公司已近十年。

senses.meaning_en: not important; trivial

examples.text: The manager dismissed the staff's concerns as petty and irrelevant.
examples.translation_cn: 经理认为员工的担心琐碎且无关紧要，不予理会。

senses.meaning_en: caring too much about small matters; small-minded

examples.text: She can be petty about lending her notes even to her close friends.
examples.translation_cn: 她甚至在借笔记给好朋友时也会很小气。

senses.meaning_en: minor; not serious

examples.text: He was charged with petty theft last month.
examples.translation_cn: 他上个月被控轻微盗窃。

senses.meaning_en: to fight by grappling and trying to throw the opponent

examples.text: The two boys wrestled with each other in the yard.
examples.translation_cn: 两个男孩在院子里互相摔跤扭打。

senses.meaning_en: to struggle to deal with something difficult

examples.text: She is wrestling with a difficult decision at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在为工作中的一个艰难决定而苦苦思索。

senses.meaning_en: to move or handle someone or something with effort

examples.text: He wrestled the heavy suitcase into the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他费力地把沉重的行李箱搬进车里。

senses.meaning_en: to think or guess that something is smaller, less important, etc. than it really is

examples.text: We seriously underestimated the cost of the repairs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们严重低估了维修费用。

senses.meaning_en: an estimate that is too low

examples.text: The official figure was a serious underestimate of the true cost.
examples.translation_cn: 官方数字严重低估了实际成本。

senses.meaning_en: not easily convinced; having doubts

examples.text: Many experts are sceptical about the government's claims.
examples.translation_cn: 许多专家对政府的说法持怀疑态度。

senses.meaning_en: strong and healthy; large and strong

examples.text: Even at ninety, she remained robust and independent.
examples.translation_cn: 她九十岁时依然健壮独立。

senses.meaning_en: strong and unlikely to fail; able to withstand adverse conditions

examples.text: The company's earnings proved robust despite rising costs.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管成本上升，公司盈利依然强劲。

senses.meaning_en: having a rich, strong flavor

examples.text: This dark beer has a robust, smoky flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 这款黑啤酒有浓郁的烟熏味。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of the relationships between living things and their environment

examples.text: She decided to study ecology after a trip to the rainforest.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一趟雨林之旅后决定学习生态学。

senses.meaning_en: the relationships between living things and their environment; the state of these relationships

examples.text: The ecology of the island has been damaged by tourism.
examples.translation_cn: 该岛的生态因旅游业而遭到破坏。

senses.meaning_en: unnecessary excitement or worry about unimportant things

examples.text: Don't make such a fuss about a tiny scratch on the car.
examples.translation_cn: 别为车上一道小划痕这么大惊小怪。

senses.meaning_en: to worry or behave in an anxious way about unimportant things

examples.text: He spent the morning fussing over the seating plan.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个上午都在为座位安排瞎忙活。

senses.meaning_en: to fiddle; fidget; wiggle, or adjust

examples.text: She was fussing with her hair before the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试前她摆弄着头发。

senses.meaning_en: angry complaints or a noisy argument about something
senses.pattern: kick up a fuss about/over sth

examples.text: He kicked up a fuss about the cold soup.
examples.translation_cn: 他为冷汤大吵大闹。

senses.meaning_en: attention and affection given to someone to show admiration or love
senses.collocation: make a big fuss of sb

examples.text: Grandma made a big fuss of the new baby.
examples.translation_cn: 奶奶对新生儿宠爱有加。

senses.meaning_en: loyalty or commitment to a cause, group, or nation

examples.text: The soldiers swore allegiance to the new queen.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们宣誓效忠新女王。

senses.meaning_en: open to multiple interpretations

examples.text: The ending of the film is deliberately ambiguous as to whether he survived.
examples.translation_cn: 电影结尾故意模棱两可，让人无法确定他是否活了下来。

senses.meaning_en: not clear or definite

examples.text: The instructions were ambiguous about where to sign the form.
examples.translation_cn: 说明书上关于在哪里签字写得不明确。

senses.meaning_en: according to custom or usual practice

examples.text: It is customary to give a tip in this restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 在这家餐馆，付小费是惯常做法。

senses.meaning_en: covered with ice; very cold

examples.text: The roads are icy this morning, so drive carefully.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早晨道路结冰了，开车要小心。

senses.meaning_en: unfriendly and cold in manner

examples.text: She said hello in an icy voice and refused to look at me.
examples.translation_cn: 她冷冰冰地打了声招呼，不肯看我。

senses.meaning_en: the killing of a large number of people

examples.text: The massacre of unarmed civilians drew global condemnation.
examples.translation_cn: 对手无寸铁平民的屠杀引起了全球谴责。

senses.meaning_en: an overwhelming defeat

examples.text: The final was a massacre, ending in an 8-0 defeat.
examples.translation_cn: 决赛以 8-0 惨败收场。

senses.meaning_en: to kill many people

examples.text: The troops massacred hundreds of innocent people during the raid.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在突袭中屠杀了数百名无辜平民。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat decisively

examples.text: They massacred their opponents 5-0 in the semifinal.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在半决赛中以 5-0 大胜对手。

senses.meaning_en: to move away from a course, standard, or plan

examples.text: The project deviated from the original plan after the review.
examples.translation_cn: 审查后，项目偏离了原计划。

senses.meaning_en: the act of moving away from what is normal or expected

examples.text: Any deviation from the agreed plan will require approval.
examples.translation_cn: 任何偏离商定计划的行为都需要得到批准。

senses.meaning_en: a route that avoids a closed or blocked section of road or railway

examples.text: Motorists are advised to follow the signposted deviation around the closed bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 建议驾车者沿着有路标的绕行路线绕过封闭的桥梁。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving your time and energy to something, or strong love and loyalty

examples.text: Her devotion to her students earned her great respect.
examples.translation_cn: 她对学生的奉献赢得了极大的尊重。

senses.meaning_en: strong religious feeling or commitment

examples.text: The monks sang their evening prayers with quiet devotion.
examples.translation_cn: 僧侣们怀着宁静的虔诚唱着晚祷。

senses.meaning_en: prayers or religious observances

examples.text: Every morning she says her devotions before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早餐前做祈祷。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of the universe beyond Earth's atmosphere

examples.text: She decided to study astronomy because she loved watching the stars.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定学习天文学，因为她喜欢看星星。

senses.meaning_en: to accompany and protect someone or something somewhere

examples.text: Security guards escorted the visitor to the exit.
examples.translation_cn: 保安护送访客到出口。

senses.meaning_en: protection or accompaniment, or a person or group providing it

examples.text: The prisoner was moved under armed police escort.
examples.translation_cn: 那名囚犯在武装警察护卫下被转移。

senses.meaning_en: a person who accompanies someone to a social event

examples.text: He was her escort at the charity dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他是她慈善晚宴的男伴。

senses.meaning_en: having a serious mental illness; mad

examples.text: After years of isolation, he slowly went insane.
examples.translation_cn: 多年隔绝后，他渐渐精神失常了。

senses.meaning_en: extremely good; amazing

examples.text: Her new album is absolutely insane—every track is a hit.
examples.translation_cn: 她的新专辑棒极了——首首都是热门。

senses.meaning_en: extremely foolish or unreasonable

examples.text: It is insane to drive so fast in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 在雨中开这么快简直是疯了。

senses.meaning_en: enraged; furious

examples.text: He was insane with rage after the referee's decision.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判作出判罚后，他怒不可遏。

senses.meaning_en: seemingly valid or likely; credible

examples.text: His excuse seems plausible, but there is no evidence to support it.
examples.translation_cn: 他的借口似乎合理，但没有证据支持。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of being similar to somebody or something

examples.text: She bears a striking resemblance to her older sister.
examples.translation_cn: 她与姐姐惊人地相似。

senses.meaning_en: a small group of trees

examples.text: We rested in a grove of trees after the long walk.
examples.translation_cn: 长途散步后，我们在树丛里休息。

senses.meaning_en: a group of fruit trees, especially oranges or olives

examples.text: The workers rested in an orange grove at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们中午在橙园里休息。

senses.meaning_en: to an intense degree; extremely; strongly

examples.text: He reacted violently to the unfair decision by the referee.
examples.translation_cn: 他对裁判的不公判罚反应激烈。

senses.meaning_en: with great physical force or intensity

examples.text: The boat rocked violently in the rough sea.
examples.translation_cn: 船在汹涌的海面上剧烈摇晃。

senses.meaning_en: using physical force intended to hurt or damage

examples.text: The shopkeeper was violently attacked during the robbery.
examples.translation_cn: 店主在抢劫中遭到暴力袭击。

senses.meaning_en: a reptile with a hard shell that lives on land or in water

examples.text: A turtle's shell protects it from many dangers.
examples.translation_cn: 龟壳保护它免受许多危险。

senses.meaning_en: the hard white substance that forms the tusks of elephants and some other animals

examples.text: The antique figurine is made of ivory and is extremely valuable.
examples.translation_cn: 这尊古董小雕像由象牙制成，极为珍贵。

senses.meaning_en: a creamy white colour like that of ivory

examples.text: She looked elegant in ivory at the awards ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 她在颁奖典礼上穿象牙色衣服显得很优雅。

senses.meaning_en: an object made of or resembling ivory

examples.text: The museum displays a tiny figure carved in ivory from the Ming dynasty.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出了一件用象牙雕刻的明代小雕像。

senses.meaning_en: waste material such as paper, bottles, etc. that is left lying in a public place

examples.text: Litter in public places attracts rats and spreads disease.
examples.translation_cn: 公共场所的垃圾会招来老鼠并传播疾病。

senses.meaning_en: to drop or throw waste material in a public place instead of using a bin

examples.text: Do not litter in the park, or you may be fined.
examples.translation_cn: 不要在公园里乱扔垃圾，否则你可能会被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: a group of baby animals born at the same time to the same mother

examples.text: Our dog gave birth to a litter of six puppies.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的狗生了一窝六只小狗。

senses.meaning_en: a dry substance like straw or special material used as a bed or toilet for animals, especially cats

examples.text: Remember to change the litter in the cat's box every day.
examples.translation_cn: 记得每天更换猫砂盆里的猫砂。

senses.meaning_en: a state of great disorder or uncertainty

examples.text: The country is in turmoil after the disputed election.
examples.translation_cn: 争议选举后，该国陷入动荡。

senses.meaning_en: to move from one region to another with the seasons

examples.text: These birds migrate from Europe to Africa every autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 这些鸟每年秋天从欧洲迁徙到非洲。

senses.meaning_en: to move to a new area to live

examples.text: Many families migrated to the coast to find work.
examples.translation_cn: 许多家庭迁移到沿海地区找工作。

senses.meaning_en: to move computer code or files from one computer or network to another

examples.text: Our team will migrate the database to the new server this weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们团队将于本周末将数据库迁移到新服务器。

senses.meaning_en: the state or quality of being perfect; the highest attainable degree of excellence

examples.text: The chef cooked the salmon to perfection last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚厨师把三文鱼做得恰到好处。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being better than others

examples.text: The company's superiority over its competitors is based on quality.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司相对于竞争对手的优越性建立在质量之上。

senses.meaning_en: an attitude that shows you think you are better than others; arrogance

examples.text: He spoke with a sense of superiority that made him unpopular.
examples.translation_cn: 他说话带着优越感，使他不受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: something that provides protection against possible harm or damage

examples.text: The new law is a safeguard against financial fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新法律是防范金融欺诈的保护措施。

senses.meaning_en: to protect someone or something from harm or damage

examples.text: We must safeguard personal data against unauthorized access.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须保护个人数据防止未经授权的访问。

senses.meaning_en: an indifference to suffering or pleasure in inflicting suffering

examples.text: The court convicted him of cruelty to animals.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭判他犯有虐待动物罪。

senses.meaning_en: a cruel act

examples.text: Many civilians suffered terrible cruelties during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 许多平民在战争中遭受了可怕的暴行。

senses.meaning_en: clothes worn next to the skin, such as underpants and bras

examples.text: He walked around the house in his underwear.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿着内衣在屋里走来走去。

senses.meaning_en: to make something dirty or harmful by adding dangerous substances

examples.text: The city's water supply was contaminated with bacteria.
examples.translation_cn: 城市供水被细菌污染了。

senses.meaning_en: to influence someone's mind or attitudes in a harmful way

examples.text: The minds of children were contaminated by online hate.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们的思想被网络仇恨毒害了。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of contaminating

examples.text: The contamination of drinking water forced the town to close its wells.
examples.translation_cn: 饮用水污染迫使该镇关闭了水井。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that contaminates

examples.text: The filters are designed to remove contamination from the air.
examples.translation_cn: 这些过滤器旨在去除空气中的污染物。

senses.meaning_en: easy to see or notice; attracting attention

examples.text: The new museum building is conspicuous for its bright blue roof.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新博物馆建筑因其亮蓝色屋顶而显眼。

senses.meaning_en: the action or fact of vanishing or becoming no longer visible

examples.text: The boat's disappearance from view in the fog made the rescue difficult.
examples.translation_cn: 船在雾中从视野消失，使得救援变得困难。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of a person being missing or leaving without explanation

examples.text: Her mysterious disappearance from work left her colleagues worried.
examples.translation_cn: 她神秘地从工作场所消失，令同事们担忧。

senses.meaning_en: the process of ceasing to exist or becoming extinct

examples.text: The disappearance of local dialects is accelerating across the region.
examples.translation_cn: 地方方言的消失正在整个地区加速。

senses.meaning_en: an area of low, wet land, often with tall grass

examples.text: Wild rice grows in a marsh near the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 野生稻生长在湖边的沼泽里。

senses.meaning_en: the act of retaining something or someone

examples.text: The company introduced flexible hours to improve retention of staff.
examples.translation_cn: 公司引入弹性工作时间以提高员工留用率。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to remember things

examples.text: Regular review of lessons improves your retention of information.
examples.translation_cn: 定期复习课程能提高你对信息的记忆力。

senses.meaning_en: the state of keeping something such as water or heat

examples.text: Eating too much salt can lead to retention of water.
examples.translation_cn: 吃太多盐会导致水分滞留。

senses.meaning_en: to reach the highest point or end with a particular result

examples.text: The long negotiation culminated in a landmark agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的谈判以一项具有里程碑意义的协议告终。

senses.meaning_en: a statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true

examples.text: The paradox that less can be more is central to this design.
examples.translation_cn: 少即是多这一悖论是这种设计的核心。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing with contradictory qualities

examples.text: She is a paradox, both confident and full of doubt.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个矛盾体，既自信又充满疑虑。

senses.meaning_en: one's relatives or family members collectively

examples.text: The hospital contacted her next of kin immediately after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故发生后，医院立即联系了她的最近亲属。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or animals related by blood or having a common origin

examples.text: Foxes are kin to dogs, sharing a common ancestor.
examples.translation_cn: 狐狸与狗同族，拥有共同的祖先。

senses.meaning_en: a shirt for women or girls, typically with buttons and a collar

examples.text: She came to work in a white silk blouse.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一件白色丝绸衬衫来上班。

senses.meaning_en: a loose-fitting uniform jacket

examples.text: The nurse arrived in a clean uniform blouse.
examples.translation_cn: 护士穿着一件干净的工作罩衫来了。

senses.meaning_en: a short garment worn under a sari

examples.text: She danced in a bright sari blouse and long skirt.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着鲜艳的纱丽短上衣和长裙跳舞。

senses.meaning_en: closeness in space, time, or relationship

examples.text: Our apartment is in proximity to both the subway and the park.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的公寓靠近地铁和公园。

senses.meaning_en: to prepare yourself for something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: You should brace yourself for some difficult questions at the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该为面试中一些棘手的问题做好准备。

senses.meaning_en: a set of wires used to straighten teeth

examples.text: She has to wear braces for two years to straighten her teeth.
examples.translation_cn: 她得戴两年牙套来矫正牙齿。

senses.meaning_en: a device that supports or holds a part of the body in position

examples.text: He wears a brace on his injured knee.
examples.translation_cn: 他在受伤的膝盖上戴着支架。

senses.meaning_en: a religious talk given by a priest or minister during a service

examples.text: The pastor will deliver a sermon on forgiveness this Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师这周日将发表关于宽恕的布道。

senses.meaning_en: a long talk telling someone how to behave in a disapproving way

examples.text: My mother gave me a sermon about staying out late.
examples.translation_cn: 我妈妈就晚归的事说教了我一顿。

senses.meaning_en: done carefully and with a lot of attention to detail

examples.text: The researchers were rigorous in testing their results.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员在检验结果时十分严谨。

senses.meaning_en: demanding that rules or standards be strictly followed
