examples.text: The school is rigorous about enforcing its rules.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校在执行规则方面很严格。

senses.meaning_en: severe or intense

examples.text: The expedition endured rigorous conditions in the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 探险队在沙漠中忍受了严酷的环境。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of land extending into the sea or a lake

examples.text: The ship sailed around the cape at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时，那艘船绕过了海角。

senses.meaning_en: a sleeveless outer garment hanging from the shoulders

examples.text: The woman in a cape stood near the door.
examples.translation_cn: 穿斗篷的女子站在门边。

senses.meaning_en: strong and solid; not easily damaged

examples.text: This old table is sturdy enough to hold a heavy TV.
examples.translation_cn: 这张旧桌子足够结实，能放一台重电视。

senses.meaning_en: physically strong and healthy

examples.text: The young player has a sturdy build and great stamina.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻球员体格健壮，耐力极好。

senses.meaning_en: strong and steady in amount or degree

examples.text: The economy has shown sturdy growth this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年经济表现出强劲增长。

senses.meaning_en: firm and determined; not yielding

examples.text: They put up a sturdy resistance against the invaders.
examples.translation_cn: 他们对侵略者进行了顽强抵抗。

senses.meaning_en: to make something broad or broader

examples.text: The city plans to broaden the main road to four lanes.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市计划将主干道拓宽至四车道。

senses.meaning_en: to become broad or broader

examples.text: The valley broadens out into a wide plain.
examples.translation_cn: 山谷变宽，形成一片宽阔的平原。

senses.meaning_en: to push or drive something forward

examples.text: A powerful engine propels the boat forward through the water.
examples.translation_cn: 一台强劲的发动机推动小船在水中前进。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to do something or to make something happen

examples.text: The coach's speech propelled the team into action.
examples.translation_cn: 教练的讲话促使全队行动起来。

senses.meaning_en: something included with a letter or message

examples.text: Please find the invoice as an enclosure to this letter.
examples.translation_cn: 请查收本信所附的发票。

senses.meaning_en: the act of enclosing an area or land

examples.text: The enclosure of the field took the workers two days.
examples.translation_cn: 围起那块地花了工人们两天时间。

senses.meaning_en: an area enclosed by walls or fences

examples.text: The tiger was kept in an enclosure with a high fence.
examples.translation_cn: 那只老虎被关在一个有高围栏的围场里。

senses.meaning_en: the historical process of enclosing common land

examples.text: The enclosure movement transformed common land into private farms.
examples.translation_cn: 圈地运动把公地变成了私有农场。

senses.meaning_en: an insect or animal that harms crops, food, or livestock

examples.text: Gardeners often use fine netting to keep pests off vegetable seedlings.
examples.translation_cn: 园丁经常用细网防止害虫侵害蔬菜幼苗。

senses.meaning_en: an annoying person

examples.text: My little brother can be a real pest when I'm studying.
examples.translation_cn: 我学习的时候，我的小弟弟真烦人。

senses.meaning_en: to follow quietly and secretly, especially to attack or harm

examples.text: The lion stalked its prey through the tall grass.
examples.translation_cn: 狮子在高高的草丛中悄悄跟踪猎物。

senses.meaning_en: the main stem of a plant

examples.text: The stalk of the plant was thin but strong enough to hold the flower.
examples.translation_cn: 那株植物的茎很细，但足以支撑花朵。

senses.meaning_en: to walk in an angry or proud way with long steps

examples.text: She stalked out of the room in anger.
examples.translation_cn: 她怒气冲冲地走出房间。

senses.meaning_en: an act of prohibiting something

examples.text: The committee called for the prohibition of smoking in all public buildings.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会呼吁在所有公共建筑内禁止吸烟。

senses.meaning_en: a law or rule that forbids something

examples.text: The court upheld a prohibition against selling alcohol near schools.
examples.translation_cn: 法院维持了禁止在学校附近售酒的禁令。

senses.meaning_en: the period from 1920 to 1933 when alcohol was illegal in the US

examples.text: Thousands of illegal bars operated across the country during Prohibition.
examples.translation_cn: 禁酒时期，成千上万的非法酒吧在全国各地经营。

senses.meaning_en: a female deity

examples.text: Athena was the goddess of wisdom in ancient Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 雅典娜是古希腊的智慧女神。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who is greatly admired for her beauty, charm, or influence

examples.text: Fans treat her like a goddess and adore every move she makes.
examples.translation_cn: 粉丝们像对待女神一样崇拜她，对她的一举一动都着迷。

senses.meaning_en: the edge or point at which something starts to happen

examples.text: The peace talks were on the verge of collapse.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判濒临破裂。

senses.meaning_en: to be very close to something; to border on

examples.text: The actor's confidence verges on arrogance at times.
examples.translation_cn: 那位演员的自信有时近乎傲慢。

senses.meaning_en: any widespread and deadly infectious disease

examples.text: A deadly plague broke out in the crowded city.
examples.translation_cn: 一种致命的瘟疫在拥挤的城市中爆发。

senses.meaning_en: the specific disease caused by Yersinia pestis

examples.text: The plague is caused by a bacterium carried by rat fleas.
examples.translation_cn: 鼠疫是由鼠蚤携带的细菌引起的。

senses.meaning_en: to cause continual trouble or distress to

examples.text: She was plagued by guilt over the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 她因那次事故而深感内疚，备受折磨。

senses.meaning_en: a thing or large number of things that cause trouble or destruction

examples.text: A plague of locusts stripped the fields bare.
examples.translation_cn: 一大群蝗虫把田地扫荡一空。

senses.meaning_en: to become no longer valid or come to an end

examples.text: The contract will expire at the end of this month.
examples.translation_cn: 合同将在本月底到期。

senses.meaning_en: to die

examples.text: The old man expired peacefully in his sleep last night.
examples.translation_cn: 老人昨晚在睡梦中平静地去世。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe out

examples.text: Take a deep breath, then expire the air slowly through your nose.
examples.translation_cn: 深吸一口气，然后通过鼻子慢慢呼出空气。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden event causing great damage or suffering

examples.text: The oil spill led to a catastrophe for the local fishing industry.
examples.translation_cn: 石油泄漏给当地渔业带来了灾难。

senses.meaning_en: a complete failure or a very bad end to something

examples.text: The peace talks ended in catastrophe after the ceasefire collapsed.
examples.translation_cn: 停火破裂后，和平谈判以彻底失败告终。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to give or reveal something

examples.text: The committee withheld the report from the public for several months.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会好几个月没有向公众公布这份报告。

senses.meaning_en: to hold back or restrain (an emotion, tears, etc.)

examples.text: She struggled to withhold her tears during the farewell.
examples.translation_cn: 在告别仪式上，她强忍着眼泪。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or involving analysis

examples.text: The researcher takes an analytic approach to the survey data.
examples.translation_cn: 研究者对调查数据采取分析的方法。

senses.meaning_en: having the ability to analyse; analytical

examples.text: She has a sharp analytic mind and solves complex problems quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 她有敏锐的分析头脑，能快速解决复杂问题。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or using analysis

examples.text: The report takes an analytical approach to the housing crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告对住房危机采取了分析性的方法。

senses.meaning_en: good at examining things in detail

examples.text: She is analytical by nature and enjoys solving complex puzzles.
examples.translation_cn: 她天生善于分析，喜欢解决复杂的难题。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or used for diagnosis

examples.text: The hospital introduced a rapid diagnostic test for the virus.
examples.translation_cn: 医院引进了一种针对该病毒的快速诊断检测。

senses.meaning_en: characteristic of a particular disease

examples.text: A persistent cough may be diagnostic of asthma.
examples.translation_cn: 持续咳嗽可能提示哮喘。

senses.meaning_en: intended to assess a student's preexisting knowledge of the material being taught

examples.text: We took a diagnostic test before the course to identify weak areas.
examples.translation_cn: 开课前我们做了摸底测试，以找出薄弱环节。

senses.meaning_en: a medical test or technique used for diagnosis

examples.text: The lab ran diagnostics on the patient's blood samples.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室对患者的血样进行了诊断检测。

senses.meaning_en: to go beyond the limits of something

examples.text: Her art transcends the boundaries of culture and language.
examples.translation_cn: 她的艺术超越了文化和语言的界限。

senses.meaning_en: to be greater or better than something or somebody

examples.text: The young pianist transcended all expectations at the competition.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻钢琴家在比赛中超越了所有人的期望。

senses.meaning_en: anger or sadness from fear of losing sb/sth

examples.text: His jealousy over his girlfriend's close friendship with another man caused constant arguments.
examples.translation_cn: 他对女友与另一个男人的亲密友谊的嫉妒导致了不断的争吵。

senses.meaning_en: unhappiness because sb else has what you want

examples.text: Her jealousy of her sister's academic success strained their relationship.
examples.translation_cn: 她对姐姐学业成功的嫉妒使她们的关系紧张。

senses.meaning_en: to cause or draw out a response or reaction

examples.text: The comedian's joke quickly elicited a warm response from the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 喜剧演员的笑话迅速引起了观众的热烈回应。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain information or a reply from someone

examples.text: The detective tried to elicit information from the witness.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探试图从证人那里套出信息。

senses.meaning_en: to derive or deduce something by reasoning

examples.text: The researchers elicited a general principle from the experimental evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员从实验证据中推断出一条一般原则。

senses.meaning_en: a device that produces heat

examples.text: She turned on the heater as soon as she got home.
examples.translation_cn: 她一回到家就打开了暖气。

senses.meaning_en: height above sea level

examples.text: The mountain village lies at an elevation of 2,000 metres.
examples.translation_cn: 这个山村位于海拔2000米处。

senses.meaning_en: the act of raising someone to a higher position or rank

examples.text: Her elevation to the post of director was widely welcomed.
examples.translation_cn: 她被提升为主任一职广受欢迎。

senses.meaning_en: a place that is higher than the surrounding area

examples.text: The house sits on a slight elevation overlooking the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 房子坐落在俯瞰湖泊的一块高地上。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of inferring

examples.text: You can draw an inference from the data in the report.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以从报告中的数据得出推断。

senses.meaning_en: an instance or example of this, such as a prediction, classification, decision, etc.

examples.text: The inference is that the policy has failed.
examples.translation_cn: 结论是这项政策已经失败。

senses.meaning_en: a violent ejection of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano

examples.text: The eruption of the volcano forced thousands to leave their homes.
examples.translation_cn: 火山喷发迫使数千人离开家园。

senses.meaning_en: an outbreak of spots or a rash on the skin

examples.text: The nurse noticed an eruption on the child's skin during the checkup.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在体检时注意到孩子皮肤上出疹了。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden outbreak of violence, anger, disease, etc.

examples.text: There was an eruption of violence in the city center last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚市中心爆发了暴力冲突。

senses.meaning_en: to cover part of the same space

examples.text: The roof tiles overlap each other to keep out rain.
examples.translation_cn: 屋顶的瓦片相互交叠以防雨水。

senses.meaning_en: to have something in common

examples.text: Our responsibilities overlap with yours in several areas.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的职责与你们的在几个方面有重叠。

senses.meaning_en: to happen partly at the same time

examples.text: The two events overlap in time, so I can't attend both.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个活动时间重叠，所以我不能都参加。

senses.meaning_en: something that overlaps or is overlapped

examples.text: There is considerable overlap between the two courses, so you can choose either.
examples.translation_cn: 这两门课程之间有大量重叠，所以你可以任选其一。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent someone from succeeding in a plan or attempt

examples.text: Police foiled an attempt to smuggle stolen goods across the border.
examples.translation_cn: 警方挫败了一起走私赃物越境的企图。

senses.meaning_en: a very thin sheet of metal used for wrapping or covering

examples.text: Wrap the fish in foil before you put it in the oven.
examples.translation_cn: 把鱼放进烤箱前先用箔纸包好。

senses.meaning_en: a light, thin sword used in fencing

examples.text: She learned to fence with a foil at her local sports club.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地的体育俱乐部学会了用花剑击剑。

senses.meaning_en: someone or something that shows the qualities of another by contrast

examples.text: His serious manner was a perfect foil to her playful wit.
examples.translation_cn: 他严肃的举止恰好衬托出她的俏皮风趣。

senses.meaning_en: to lift or raise something heavy with effort

examples.text: They heaved the heavy sofa onto the truck with great effort.
examples.translation_cn: 他们费了很大劲把沉重的沙发抬上了卡车。

senses.meaning_en: to rise and fall regularly

examples.text: The boat heaved up and down in the rough sea.
examples.translation_cn: 船在波涛汹涌的海面上上下颠簸。

senses.meaning_en: to utter with effort

examples.text: She heaved a sigh of relief when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到消息后松了一口气。

senses.meaning_en: to feel sick or to vomit

examples.text: The smell of rotten garbage makes me heave.
examples.translation_cn: 闻到腐烂垃圾我就恶心。

senses.meaning_en: a concrete edge along a road

examples.text: She sat on the curb to catch her breath after the run.
examples.translation_cn: 她坐在路缘上喘口气。

senses.meaning_en: to control or limit something

examples.text: The government took steps to curb inflation last year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府去年采取措施抑制通货膨胀。

senses.meaning_en: a limit or restraint

examples.text: The government imposed a curb on public spending.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对公共开支实施了限制。

senses.meaning_en: to act between conflicting parties to help them resolve differences or reach an agreement

examples.text: The UN is trying to mediate between the two sides.
examples.translation_cn: 联合国正在努力在双方之间进行调解。

senses.meaning_en: to succeed in bringing about a settlement or agreement

examples.text: They managed to mediate a settlement between the two companies.
examples.translation_cn: 他们设法促成两家公司达成和解。

senses.meaning_en: to influence or modify an effect or process

examples.text: Regular exercise can mediate the effects of chronic stress.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼可以调节慢性压力带来的影响。

senses.meaning_en: a leader with total power over a country

examples.text: They suffered under a brutal dictator for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一个残暴的独裁者统治下受苦二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a bossy person who gives orders and expects obedience

examples.text: He behaves like a dictator at work, barking orders at everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他在工作中表现得像个专横的人，对每个人都发号施令。

senses.meaning_en: an ancient Roman official appointed for a limited term in an emergency

examples.text: In an emergency, he was appointed dictator by the Roman Senate for six months.
examples.translation_cn: 在紧急情况下，他被罗马元老院任命为独裁官，任期六个月。

senses.meaning_en: without any limits on amount or number

examples.text: The library provides unlimited access to its digital archives.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆提供对其数字档案的无限制访问。

senses.meaning_en: very great in amount or degree

examples.text: She dealt with the children's questions with unlimited patience.
examples.translation_cn: 她以极大的耐心处理孩子们的问题。

senses.meaning_en: complete and without any limits or controls

examples.text: The president was given unlimited power to deal with the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 总统被赋予了处理这场危机的绝对权力。

senses.meaning_en: exact correspondence on either side of a dividing line, plane, center or axis

examples.text: The symmetry of the butterfly's wings means each side is a mirror image of the other.
examples.translation_cn: 蝴蝶双翅的对称意味着每一侧都是另一侧的镜像。

senses.meaning_en: satisfying arrangement of a balanced distribution of the elements of a whole

examples.text: The designer achieved symmetry in the room by repeating soft blue tones.
examples.translation_cn: 设计师通过重复柔和的蓝色调在房间中营造出均衡和谐之美。

senses.meaning_en: a mythical creature whose singing lured sailors to destruction

examples.text: The sailors were lured by the sirens onto the rocks.
examples.translation_cn: 水手们被塞壬引诱到礁石上。

senses.meaning_en: a dangerously seductive woman

examples.text: She was a screen siren in the golden age of Hollywood.
examples.translation_cn: 她是好莱坞黄金时代的银幕妖女。

senses.meaning_en: a device that makes a loud warning sound

examples.text: The police sounded the siren as they chased the stolen car.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在追失窃车辆时拉响了警报器。

senses.meaning_en: an excessive desire for more than is needed, especially money or food

examples.text: His greed for money caused him to cheat his closest friends.
examples.translation_cn: 他对金钱的贪婪使他欺骗了最亲密的朋友。

senses.meaning_en: to make a sharp sibilant sound

examples.text: The large snake hissed at the approaching dog.
examples.translation_cn: 大蛇冲着靠近的狗嘶嘶叫。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp sibilant sound, often of air, steam, or disapproval

examples.text: A hiss of disapproval ran through the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 人群中传出一阵不满的嘘声。

senses.meaning_en: to say something in a quiet, angry voice

examples.text: She hissed a warning at the noisy students.
examples.translation_cn: 她低声向吵闹的学生发出警告。

senses.meaning_en: to move with a hissing sound

examples.text: The old train hissed past the small station.
examples.translation_cn: 旧火车呼啸着驶过小站。

senses.meaning_en: to show disapproval or contempt by hissing

examples.text: The audience hissed the villain whenever he came on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 每次反派一登台，观众就发出嘘声。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has at least one million dollars, pounds, etc.

examples.text: He became a millionaire by investing in property.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过投资房地产成了百万富翁。

senses.meaning_en: a name, symbol, or word legally registered to identify a company's product

examples.text: The company logo is a registered trademark in several countries.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司的标志在多个国家是注册商标。

senses.meaning_en: a distinctive characteristic or feature typically associated with someone or something

examples.text: His witty humor is a trademark of the show.
examples.translation_cn: 他风趣的幽默是该节目的一个标志。

senses.meaning_en: to register something as a trademark

examples.text: The company trademarked its brand name last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司去年将其品牌名称注册为商标。

senses.meaning_en: distinctive, characteristic, signature (used before a noun)

examples.text: She answered the question with her trademark smile.
examples.translation_cn: 她带着标志性的微笑回答了这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: to take the place of someone or something

examples.text: Online streaming has displaced radio as the main source of music.
examples.translation_cn: 在线流媒体已取代广播成为主要音乐来源。

senses.meaning_en: to force people to leave their homes

examples.text: Thousands of people were displaced by the fighting.
examples.translation_cn: 成千上万的人因战斗而流离失所。

senses.meaning_en: to move something from its usual position

examples.text: The accident displaced the bone from its normal position in her wrist.
examples.translation_cn: 事故使她腕部的骨头从正常位置移位。

senses.meaning_en: to occupy an amount of water equal to its weight

examples.text: The new ship displaces 50,000 tonnes of water.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘新船排水量为5万吨。

senses.meaning_en: the atmosphere of the Earth and the region of space around it

examples.text: The rocket climbed into aerospace beyond the clouds within minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 火箭几分钟内就爬升到云层之外的航空航天空间。

senses.meaning_en: the industry concerned with aircraft, missiles, satellites and spacecraft

examples.text: My brother works in aerospace, focusing on satellite navigation systems.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥在航空航天工业工作，专注于卫星导航系统。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the Earth's atmosphere and nearby space, or to the industry that builds aircraft and spacecraft

examples.text: The aerospace industry has attracted many young engineers.
examples.translation_cn: 航空航天工业吸引了许多年轻工程师。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the North or South Pole or the areas around them

examples.text: The polar regions are warming faster than the rest of the planet.
examples.translation_cn: 极地地区的变暖速度快于地球其他地区。

senses.meaning_en: completely opposite or very different from each other

examples.text: Their attitudes toward risk and reward are polar opposites.
examples.translation_cn: 他们对风险和回报的态度完全相反。

senses.meaning_en: a young dog

examples.text: We adopted a puppy from the local animal shelter last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末从当地动物收容所领养了一只小狗。

senses.meaning_en: containing nothing; empty; lacking

examples.text: His voice was void of emotion as he read the verdict.
examples.translation_cn: 宣读判决时他的声音毫无感情。

senses.meaning_en: having no legal force

examples.text: The agreement was declared void by the committee.
examples.translation_cn: 该协议被委员会宣布无效。

senses.meaning_en: a large empty space or feeling of emptiness

examples.text: Her death left a void that no one could fill.
examples.translation_cn: 她的去世留下了一个无人能填补的空虚。

senses.meaning_en: a hard, granular, crystalline rock used in building

examples.text: The old city walls are made of granite.
examples.translation_cn: 古老的城墙由花岗岩建成。

senses.meaning_en: to make musical sounds with your lips closed, without singing words

examples.text: She hummed a tune while washing the dishes.
examples.translation_cn: 她洗碗时哼着小曲。

senses.meaning_en: a low continuous sound, like that of a machine or insect

examples.text: The hum of the air conditioner made it hard to concentrate.
examples.translation_cn: 空调的嗡嗡声让人难以集中注意力。

senses.meaning_en: busy activity, like the buzz of a beehive
senses.pattern: be filled with the hum of activity

examples.text: The office was filled with the hum of activity before the product launch.
examples.translation_cn: 产品发布前，办公室里一片忙碌。

senses.meaning_en: to make a low continuous sound, like that of a machine or insect

examples.text: The old refrigerator hummed quietly in the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 那台旧冰箱在角落里轻声嗡嗡响。

senses.meaning_en: an extensive area of flat grassland with few trees, especially in North America

examples.text: Millions of bison once grazed on the prairie.
examples.translation_cn: 数百万头野牛曾在这片大草原上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: dirty, very unpleasant, or disgusting

examples.text: The water in the pond smelled foul after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，池塘里的水闻起来很臭。

senses.meaning_en: obscene, vulgar, or abusive

examples.text: He was fined for using foul language at the referee.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对裁判使用脏话而被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: dishonest or against the rules

examples.text: The tackle was ruled foul by the referee and earned a yellow card.
examples.translation_cn: 那次铲球被裁判判为犯规，并得到一张黄牌。

senses.meaning_en: very unpleasant or detestable

examples.text: He's been in a foul mood all day because of the delay.
examples.translation_cn: 由于延误，他一整天情绪都很恶劣。

senses.meaning_en: feeling doubt or uncertainty about something

examples.text: I was dubious about the plan from the start.
examples.translation_cn: 我从一开始就对计划没有把握。

senses.meaning_en: probably not honest, safe, or reliable

examples.text: He was seen with a man of dubious character.
examples.translation_cn: 有人看见他和一个品行可疑的人在一起。

senses.meaning_en: not considered good or desirable; of questionable value

examples.text: The city has the dubious distinction of being the most polluted capital.
examples.translation_cn: 这个城市有个不光彩的名号：污染最严重的首都。

senses.meaning_en: extreme and sudden, with serious effect

examples.text: The company took drastic action to cut costs.
examples.translation_cn: 公司采取了严厉措施来削减成本。

senses.meaning_en: to go beyond or exceed something in amount, quality, or degree

examples.text: Her latest novel has surpassed all her previous works in popularity.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新的小说在受欢迎程度上超过了她之前的所有作品。

senses.meaning_en: having large, well-developed muscles; brawny

examples.text: He is very muscular after years of lifting weights.
examples.translation_cn: 他经过多年举重，肌肉非常发达。

senses.meaning_en: robust, strong

examples.text: The government launched a muscular response to the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 政府针对危机做出了强有力的回应。

senses.meaning_en: relating to muscles

examples.text: Regular exercise helps keep the muscular system strong and healthy.
examples.translation_cn: 经常锻炼有助于保持肌肉系统强健。

senses.meaning_en: to pay for regular delivery of a publication or service

examples.text: We subscribe to a daily newspaper and a streaming service.
examples.translation_cn: 我们订阅一份日报和一个流媒体服务。

senses.meaning_en: to agree with or support an idea, belief, or theory

examples.text: She subscribes to the view that hard work pays off.
examples.translation_cn: 她同意努力会有回报的观点。

senses.meaning_en: to pay or promise to contribute money to a charity, organization, or common fund

examples.text: Many employees subscribe to a local charity and a disaster relief fund.
examples.translation_cn: 许多员工定期向当地慈善机构和救灾基金捐款。

senses.meaning_en: to sign one's name to a document
senses.pattern: subscribe one's name to a document

examples.text: The director subscribed his name to the contract without hesitation.
examples.translation_cn: 董事毫不犹豫地在合同上签了名。

senses.meaning_en: an expression of praise, admiration, or flattering courtesy
senses.pattern: pay sb a compliment on sth

examples.text: My boss paid me a compliment on my report.
examples.translation_cn: 老板称赞了我的报告。

senses.meaning_en: polite greetings or regards, often used in the plural

examples.text: Please send my compliments to your parents when you see them.
examples.translation_cn: 见到你父母时请代我问候他们。

senses.meaning_en: to pay a compliment (to someone); to express a favourable opinion (of someone)

examples.text: The manager complimented the team on their creative solution to the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 经理称赞团队对这个问题提出了有创意的解决方案。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce a legal sentence to a less severe one

examples.text: The judge commuted his death sentence to life imprisonment.
examples.translation_cn: 法官将他的死刑改判为无期徒刑。

senses.meaning_en: the regular journey between home and work

examples.text: The commute to the city centre takes about an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 到市中心的通勤路程大约需要一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to make the same journey regularly between home and work, typically by public transport

examples.text: She commutes to work by train every day.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天乘火车通勤上班。

senses.meaning_en: an inconsistency between facts or figures
senses.pattern: a discrepancy between A and B

examples.text: The accountant found a discrepancy between the two sets of financial records.
examples.translation_cn: 会计发现两套财务记录之间存在差异。

senses.meaning_en: to make (someone or something) rich or richer

examples.text: The discovery of oil enriched the small nation and improved its economy.
examples.translation_cn: 石油的发现使这个小国富裕起来，并改善了它的经济。

senses.meaning_en: to make something richer or more meaningful by adding good qualities; to enhance

examples.text: She enriched her essay with detailed examples and clear reasoning.
examples.translation_cn: 她用详细的例子和清晰的推理充实了文章。

senses.meaning_en: to improve the nutritional value of food by adding vitamins or minerals

examples.text: The cereal is enriched with iron and B vitamins.
examples.translation_cn: 这种麦片添加了铁和B族维生素。

senses.meaning_en: to add nutrients or fertilizer to the soil; to fertilize

examples.text: Farmers enrich the soil with compost before planting vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在种植蔬菜前用堆肥使土壤肥沃。

senses.meaning_en: a very thin book with a paper cover, usually giving information about something

examples.text: She picked up a pamphlet on local bus routes.
examples.translation_cn: 她拿起一本关于当地公交线路的小册子。

senses.meaning_en: a performer in a circus who wears funny clothes, a red nose, face paint, and a wig, and makes people laugh

examples.text: The circus clown juggled balls while riding a unicycle.
examples.translation_cn: 那个马戏团小丑一边骑独轮车一边抛接球。

senses.meaning_en: a person who behaves in a silly way, often to make others laugh

examples.text: He acted like a clown at the party and made everyone laugh.
examples.translation_cn: 他在聚会上表现得像个活宝，逗得大家都笑了。

senses.meaning_en: to behave in a silly or playful way, often to make people laugh

examples.text: The children were clowning around in the back seat during the long drive.
examples.translation_cn: 长途驾车时，孩子们在后座胡闹。

senses.meaning_en: to ridicule or make fun of somebody

examples.text: His friends clowned him for his old-fashioned hairstyle.
examples.translation_cn: 他的朋友们因他过时的发型取笑他。

senses.meaning_en: the period between daylight and darkness

examples.text: We sat on the hill as the city lights came on at twilight.
examples.translation_cn: 黄昏时分，我们坐在山上，城市的灯光亮了起来。

senses.meaning_en: a period of decline or the final stage of life or career

examples.text: The biography follows a famous actor in the twilight of his career.
examples.translation_cn: 这本传记追踪了一位著名演员在事业晚期的经历。

senses.meaning_en: to understand something fully

examples.text: I couldn't comprehend why she had left without a word.
examples.translation_cn: 我无法理解她为什么一句话不说就走了。

senses.meaning_en: to include or contain something

examples.text: The report comprehends a wide range of social and economic issues.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告涵盖了广泛的社会和经济问题。

senses.meaning_en: to open a lock or something locked by using a key or combination

examples.text: He unlocked the front door with a key card.
examples.translation_cn: 他用钥匙卡打开了前门。

senses.meaning_en: to make available or reveal something such as potential or value

examples.text: The training helped her unlock her full potential.
examples.translation_cn: 培训帮助她充分发挥了自己的潜能。

senses.meaning_en: to weaken or remove something that controls a situation

examples.text: The new proposal unlocked a long-standing deadlock in the negotiations.
examples.translation_cn: 新提议打破了谈判中长期的僵局。

senses.meaning_en: to become unfastened or unlocked

examples.text: The car doors unlock automatically when you approach.
examples.translation_cn: 当你靠近时，车门会自动解锁。

senses.meaning_en: arousing pity or compassion

examples.text: The stray dog looked pathetic in the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 那只流浪狗在雨中看起来很可怜。

senses.meaning_en: arousing scorn or contempt; ridiculous

examples.text: It is pathetic that he refuses to admit his mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝承认错误，真是可鄙。

senses.meaning_en: very bad, weak, or deserving no respect

examples.text: He is absolutely pathetic at keeping his promises.
examples.translation_cn: 他在信守承诺方面差劲极了。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling that makes you want to do something

examples.text: I had no inclination to argue with him.
examples.translation_cn: 我当时没有与他争辩的意愿。

senses.meaning_en: a tendency

examples.text: She shows an inclination to interrupt when she is excited.
examples.translation_cn: 她一兴奋就表现出打断别人的倾向。

senses.meaning_en: a slant or slope

examples.text: The ramp was built with an inclination of 12 degrees.
examples.translation_cn: 这条坡道的坡度为12度。

senses.meaning_en: not tightly; in a loose way

examples.text: She held the rope loosely in one hand.
examples.translation_cn: 她一只手松松地握着绳子。

senses.meaning_en: approximately

examples.text: The novel is loosely based on a true story.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说大致取材于一个真实故事。

senses.meaning_en: used to indicate an imprecise use of words; loosely speaking

examples.text: Loosely speaking, the term 'theory' often means just a guess.
examples.translation_cn: 粗略地说，theory 一词通常只是指一种猜测。

senses.meaning_en: a sport played in a walled court with a soft rubber ball and rackets

examples.text: We usually play squash at the local sports centre on Fridays.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常在周五去当地体育中心打壁球。

senses.meaning_en: a drink made from fruit concentrate diluted with water

examples.text: The children drank a glass of orange squash with their lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们午餐时喝了一杯橘子汁饮料。

senses.meaning_en: to press or crush into a flat mass

examples.text: He squashed the empty can flat under his boot.
examples.translation_cn: 他用靴子把空罐子踩扁了。

senses.meaning_en: to squeeze into a small space

examples.text: We all squashed into the back of his small car.
examples.translation_cn: 我们都挤进了他那辆小汽车的后座。

senses.meaning_en: to suppress or put an end to something by force

examples.text: The police were ordered to squash the street protest quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 警察奉命迅速镇压街头抗议。

senses.meaning_en: The act or process of making or becoming clear.

examples.text: The clearing of the land for farming took several months.
examples.translation_cn: 为耕种而清理土地花了好几个月。

senses.meaning_en: An open space in a forest or woodland where there are no trees.

examples.text: We found a small clearing in the forest and camped there.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在森林里发现了一小块空地，并在那里露营。

senses.meaning_en: The process of exchanging and settling transactions through a central system.

examples.text: The cheque will go through clearing before the money is transferred to your account.
examples.translation_cn: 这张支票在款项转入你的账户之前会进行清算。

senses.meaning_en: a state of being likely to change suddenly or become worse

examples.text: There is growing political instability in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的政治动荡日益加剧。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being unsteady or not firm

examples.text: The instability of the tower made it sway in the wind.
examples.translation_cn: 塔的不稳固使它在风中摇晃。

senses.meaning_en: an organization that is officially connected with a larger organization

examples.text: The station is an affiliate of a national television network.
examples.translation_cn: 该电视台是一家全国性电视网的附属机构。

senses.meaning_en: to cause an organization to become officially connected with a larger one

examples.text: Several community hospitals are affiliated with the regional health system.
examples.translation_cn: 几家社区医院隶属于该地区医疗系统。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing a lot of energy and enthusiasm

examples.text: After a short break, she felt energetic enough to continue the hike.
examples.translation_cn: 短暂休息后，她感到精力充沛，足以继续徒步。

senses.meaning_en: showing strong support or a lot of activity

examples.text: The students marched in energetic support of climate action.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们游行表示对气候行动的有力支持。

senses.meaning_en: likely to be affected, harmed, or influenced by something

examples.text: Young children are susceptible to colds and flu.
examples.translation_cn: 幼儿易患感冒和流感。

senses.meaning_en: easily influenced by feelings or emotions; sensitive

examples.text: He is so susceptible to emotion that he cries at happy endings.
examples.translation_cn: 他很容易动感情，看圆满结局也会哭。

senses.meaning_en: not finished; not having all the necessary parts

examples.text: The highway project remained incomplete for years because of funding delays.
examples.translation_cn: 由于资金延误，公路项目多年未完工。

senses.meaning_en: a grade given when coursework is not finished

examples.text: He got an incomplete in chemistry and had to finish the lab work.
examples.translation_cn: 他化学课得了未完成成绩，不得不完成实验作业。

senses.meaning_en: the body's ability to resist infection or disease

examples.text: Breast milk gives babies immunity to common infections.
examples.translation_cn: 母乳使婴儿对常见感染具有免疫力。

senses.meaning_en: exemption from a legal obligation or punishment

examples.text: The witness was granted immunity from prosecution in the fraud case.
examples.translation_cn: 该证人在欺诈案中获得了起诉豁免权。

senses.meaning_en: to try hard to do something difficult

examples.text: The team endeavoured to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 团队努力按时完成项目。

senses.meaning_en: an earnest attempt or effort

examples.text: She travelled abroad in an endeavour to learn the language.
examples.translation_cn: 她出国努力学这门语言。

senses.meaning_en: something that draws attention away from the real action or threat

examples.text: The thieves set off the alarm to create a diversion.
examples.translation_cn: 窃贼拉响警报以转移人们的注意。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that relaxes or entertains you

examples.text: She plays the piano for diversion after a long day.
examples.translation_cn: 漫长的一天结束后，她弹钢琴作为消遣。

senses.meaning_en: an act of changing direction or a route used to avoid an obstruction

examples.text: Drivers had to take a diversion around the flooded street.
examples.translation_cn: 司机们不得不绕开被淹的街道行驶。

senses.meaning_en: the act of transporting goods

examples.text: The company is preparing the goods for shipment to the port.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正在准备将货物装运到港口。

senses.meaning_en: a load of goods that is transported

examples.text: A shipment of medical supplies arrived at the hospital this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 一批医疗物资今天上午抵达医院。

senses.meaning_en: angry and unhappy feelings caused by unfair treatment; resentment

examples.text: She felt great bitterness towards the company that fired her.
examples.translation_cn: 她对解雇她的公司感到强烈愤恨。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being very critical, angry, or intense

examples.text: The bitterness of the argument surprised everyone in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 争论的激烈程度让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of having a bitter taste

examples.text: The bitterness of the coffee was too strong for me.
examples.translation_cn: 咖啡的苦味对我来说太浓了。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of supplying water to land or crops

examples.text: The irrigation of farmland requires a reliable water supply.
examples.translation_cn: 农田灌溉需要可靠的水源。

senses.meaning_en: the state or process of a species dying out

examples.text: Many species are threatened with extinction because of habitat loss.
examples.translation_cn: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而濒临灭绝。

senses.meaning_en: the act of extinguishing or the state of being extinguished; the destruction of hope or feeling

examples.text: The extinction of hope can be more damaging than failure itself.
examples.translation_cn: 希望的破灭可能比失败本身更令人痛苦。

senses.meaning_en: not tight; loose

examples.text: The rope suddenly went slack in his hands.
examples.translation_cn: 绳子突然在他手中松了下来。

senses.meaning_en: not busy or active; weak

examples.text: Demand for new cars was slack last month.
examples.translation_cn: 上个月新汽车的需求低迷。

senses.meaning_en: not careful; not diligent

examples.text: She has been slack about answering emails lately.
examples.translation_cn: 她最近回复邮件很懈怠。

senses.meaning_en: to work less hard; to be less active

examples.text: He tends to slack off on Friday afternoons.
examples.translation_cn: 他周五下午往往会松懈偷懒。

senses.meaning_en: to be enough or sufficient; to meet the need

examples.text: A single example should suffice to illustrate the point.
examples.translation_cn: 一个例子就足以说明这一点。

senses.meaning_en: something that encourages a process or activity to develop more quickly

examples.text: The new trade agreement gave fresh impetus to the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 新的贸易协定给经济带来了新的推动力。

senses.meaning_en: kind and gentle

examples.text: She answered the child's question with a benign smile.
examples.translation_cn: 她带着慈祥的微笑回答了孩子的问题。

senses.meaning_en: mild and favorable

examples.text: The island has a benign climate for growing grapes.
examples.translation_cn: 这个岛屿有着适合种植葡萄的温和气候。

senses.meaning_en: not harmful to health
senses.pattern: turn out to be a benign tumor

examples.text: The lump turned out to be a benign tumor.
examples.translation_cn: 那个肿块结果是一个良性肿瘤。

senses.meaning_en: not harmful to the environment

examples.text: The company claims its new packaging is environmentally benign.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司声称其新包装对环境无害。

senses.meaning_en: an orgasm

examples.text: Many women find it hard to reach a climax during intercourse.
examples.translation_cn: 许多女性发现在性交中难以达到高潮。

senses.meaning_en: the highest point; an acme

examples.text: The election victory was the climax of her political career.
examples.translation_cn: 那次选举胜利是她政治生涯的顶点。

senses.meaning_en: to reach a climax

examples.text: The concert climaxed with a stunning fireworks display.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会以一场绚丽的烟花表演达到高潮。

senses.meaning_en: to form the climax to; to be the climax of

examples.text: A dazzling fireworks display climaxed the week-long celebrations.
examples.translation_cn: 一场绚丽的烟花表演使为期一周的庆祝活动达到高潮。

senses.meaning_en: in a systematic manner; methodically

examples.text: We need to go through the data systematically before drawing any conclusions.
examples.translation_cn: 在得出结论之前，我们需要系统地检查这些数据。

senses.meaning_en: to take someone away illegally by force and keep them prisoner, especially to demand money

examples.text: The gang kidnapped the businessman and demanded a large ransom.
examples.translation_cn: 该团伙绑架了商人并索要大笔赎金。

senses.meaning_en: the crime or an act of taking somebody away illegally by force

examples.text: The kidnap of the journalist shocked the public.
examples.translation_cn: 记者遭绑架一事震惊了公众。

senses.meaning_en: the act of imitating

examples.text: He spoke in a deep voice in imitation of his father.
examples.translation_cn: 他模仿父亲用低沉的声音说话。

senses.meaning_en: a copy or simulation; something that is not the real thing

examples.text: The handbag is a cheap imitation of a designer original.
examples.translation_cn: 这个手提包是仿名牌正品的廉价仿制品。

senses.meaning_en: suitable; appropriate

examples.text: The soil here is apt for growing grapes.
examples.translation_cn: 这里的土壤适合种植葡萄。

senses.meaning_en: having a tendency; likely

examples.text: She is apt to lose her temper when she is tired.
examples.translation_cn: 她累的时候容易发脾气。

senses.meaning_en: quick to learn; clever

examples.text: The new student is apt at grasping difficult concepts.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新学生很善于掌握困难的概念。

senses.meaning_en: to throw something with great force

examples.text: He hurled the ball into the far corner of the net.
examples.translation_cn: 他把球猛扔进网窝远角。

senses.meaning_en: to shout insults or abuse at someone

examples.text: The fans hurled abuse at the referee after the final whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 终场哨响后，球迷们对裁判大声辱骂。

senses.meaning_en: to vomit; to throw up

examples.text: He felt sick and hurled up on the pavement.
examples.translation_cn: 他感到恶心，在人行道上吐了。

senses.meaning_en: most favourable or desirable; best possible

examples.text: The soil conditions are optimal for healthy crop growth.
examples.translation_cn: 这些土壤条件最适合健康庄稼的生长。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of being dissatisfied

examples.text: There is growing discontent among workers over pay.
examples.translation_cn: 工人对薪酬的不满日益增长。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone dissatisfied

examples.text: The proposed changes have discontented many long-time employees.
examples.translation_cn: 拟议的变革使许多长期员工感到不满。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent something or make it impossible; to prevent someone from doing something

examples.text: His injury precluded him from playing in the final.
examples.translation_cn: 他的伤势使他无法参加决赛。

senses.meaning_en: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall

examples.text: She staggered into the room and collapsed on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 她踉踉跄跄地走进房间，瘫倒在沙发上。

senses.meaning_en: to shock or surprise someone very much

examples.text: I was staggered by the size of the bill.
examples.translation_cn: 我被账单的金额吓了一跳。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange events or times so that they do not happen at the same time

examples.text: The school staggers lunch times to avoid crowding.
examples.translation_cn: 学校错开午餐时间以避免拥挤。

senses.meaning_en: an unsteady movement of the body in walking or standing

examples.text: He walked with a stagger after the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途徒步后，他走路摇摇晃晃的。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce something by half

examples.text: The government hopes to halve child poverty within ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 政府希望在十年内将儿童贫困人口减少一半。

senses.meaning_en: to divide something into two equal halves

examples.text: Halve the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds.
examples.translation_cn: 将辣椒纵向切成两半，并去掉籽。

senses.meaning_en: to wash something quickly with water and no soap

examples.text: Rinse the rice with cold water before cooking.
examples.translation_cn: 煮之前用冷水冲洗大米。

senses.meaning_en: to remove soap from something or move liquid around the inside of something, especially your mouth

examples.text: She rinsed her mouth out after brushing her teeth.
examples.translation_cn: 她刷完牙后漱了口。

senses.meaning_en: an act of rinsing something

examples.text: Give the dishes a rinse before you put them in the dishwasher.
examples.translation_cn: 放进洗碗机之前，先把餐具冲洗一下。

senses.meaning_en: used to express sorrow, regret, disappointment, etc.

examples.text: Alas, the outdoor concert was cancelled due to heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 唉，户外音乐会因大雨取消了。

senses.meaning_en: attractive or interesting

examples.text: The small town is appealing to tourists who enjoy quiet beaches.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇对喜欢安静海滩的游客很有吸引力。

senses.meaning_en: showing that you want help or sympathy

examples.text: She gave the nurse an appealing look, hoping for some relief from the pain.
examples.translation_cn: 她恳求地看了护士一眼，希望能减轻疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: goods that are offered for sale

examples.text: The store has a wide range of merchandise for sale.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店有琳琅满目的商品在售。

senses.meaning_en: to promote the sale of goods, especially by attractive display

examples.text: The store merchandised the new snacks at eye level to boost sales.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店把新零食陈列在视线高度以促进销售。

senses.meaning_en: to promote or publicize a person or idea as if for sale

examples.text: The campaign merchandised the candidate as a family man.
examples.translation_cn: 竞选活动把这位候选人包装成顾家男人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who announces important news

examples.text: The king's herald announced the truce in the square.
examples.translation_cn: 国王的传令官在广场上宣布了休战。

senses.meaning_en: a sign that something is about to happen

examples.text: The first swallow is a herald of spring.
examples.translation_cn: 第一只燕子是春天的预兆。

senses.meaning_en: to announce or praise something publicly

examples.text: The film was heralded as a masterpiece by critics.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影被评论家誉为杰作。

senses.meaning_en: to be a sign that something is going to happen

examples.text: The agreement heralded a new era of peace.
examples.translation_cn: 该协议预示着一个和平新时代的到来。

senses.meaning_en: having a thick edge or point; not sharp

examples.text: This knife is blunt and won't cut the tomato easily.
examples.translation_cn: 这把刀钝了，不容易切番茄。

senses.meaning_en: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite

examples.text: She was blunt with me about my poor performance.
examples.translation_cn: 她直言不讳地告诉我我的表现很差。

senses.meaning_en: to make a feeling or effect weaker or less severe

examples.text: The new measures will blunt the impact of the recession.
examples.translation_cn: 新措施将减轻经济衰退的影响。

senses.meaning_en: to be better than or surpass someone or something

examples.text: She excels all her rivals in speed and accuracy.
examples.translation_cn: 她在速度和准确性上胜过所有对手。

senses.meaning_en: to be very good at something

examples.text: She has always excelled at languages and music.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直擅长语言和音乐。

senses.meaning_en: to do much better than usual

examples.text: He excelled himself in the final and scored two goals.
examples.translation_cn: 他在决赛中超常发挥，攻入两球。

senses.meaning_en: to put animals on land to eat grass

examples.text: The farmer grazes his cattle on the hillside in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 这位农民春天在山坡上放牛。

senses.meaning_en: to eat growing grass

examples.text: The cows were grazing on the grass by the fence.
examples.translation_cn: 牛群在围栏旁吃草。

senses.meaning_en: to eat small amounts of food often instead of having full meals

examples.text: Many office workers graze throughout the day instead of taking a lunch break.
examples.translation_cn: 许多上班族整天吃零食，而不是午休吃正餐。

senses.meaning_en: to touch or scrape the skin lightly, often causing a minor injury

examples.text: The bullet grazed his shoulder as it flew past.
examples.translation_cn: 子弹飞过时擦伤了他的肩膀。

senses.meaning_en: a slight injury caused by the skin rubbing or scraping against something rough

examples.text: The little boy had a graze on his knee from falling over.
examples.translation_cn: 小男孩摔倒后膝盖上有擦伤。

senses.meaning_en: made up of three related elements

examples.text: The three nations formed a triple alliance to defend the region.
examples.translation_cn: 三个国家组成了三方同盟来保卫该地区。

senses.meaning_en: three times as much or as many

examples.text: They charged us triple the price for the concert tickets.
examples.translation_cn: 他们向我们收取了音乐会门票三倍的价格。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make three times as much or as many

examples.text: The company tripled its profits within three years.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在三年内使利润增至三倍。

senses.meaning_en: designed for three users

examples.text: We booked a triple room with three single beds.
examples.translation_cn: 我们预订了一间有三张单人床的三人间。

senses.meaning_en: having plenty of space; large in expanse

examples.text: The living room is spacious enough for a large sofa and a bookshelf.
examples.translation_cn: 客厅宽敞得能放下一张大沙发和一个书架。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the collection, sorting and delivery of mail

examples.text: The postal service delivers mail to every home in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 邮政服务把邮件送到全国每家每户。

senses.meaning_en: crazy or violent, especially as in go postal

examples.text: He went postal on his coworkers after hearing the news.
examples.translation_cn: 他听到消息后对同事们大发雷霆。

senses.meaning_en: spreading quickly from one person to another; able to pass on disease

examples.text: The flu virus is highly infectious and spreads quickly in winter.
examples.translation_cn: 流感病毒传染性很强，冬天传播迅速。

senses.meaning_en: making people feel excited or interested and want to copy it

examples.text: His infectious laughter made the whole audience laugh along.
examples.translation_cn: 他富有感染力的笑声让全场观众跟着笑起来。

senses.meaning_en: a religious song of praise to God

examples.text: The choir sang a hymn during the service.
examples.translation_cn: 唱诗班在礼拜中唱了一首赞美诗。

senses.meaning_en: based on qualities rather than quantities

examples.text: There is a qualitative difference between reading a novel and watching its film adaptation.
examples.translation_cn: 阅读小说和观看其改编电影之间存在质的差异。

senses.meaning_en: identifying the chemical constituents of a compound

examples.text: The lab conducts qualitative analysis of the unknown metal ions.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室对未知金属离子进行定性分析。

senses.meaning_en: being in conflict or inconsistent; diametrically opposed

examples.text: His account of the accident was contradictory to the security footage.
examples.translation_cn: 他对事故的描述与监控录像相互矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: containing internal contradiction; self-contradictory

examples.text: The argument was internally contradictory and collapsed under scrutiny.
examples.translation_cn: 该论点自相矛盾，一经推敲便站不住脚。

senses.meaning_en: to make something necessary; to require

examples.text: The new regulations necessitate updating the security system.
examples.translation_cn: 新规定使更新安全系统成为必要。

senses.meaning_en: remaining after the greater part has gone or been removed

examples.text: The fire left a residual smell of smoke in the hall.
examples.translation_cn: 大火过后大厅里残留着烟味。

senses.meaning_en: a quantity remaining after other things have been subtracted or allowed for

examples.text: The residuals from the analysis were plotted on a graph.
examples.translation_cn: 分析中的残差被标绘在图表上。

senses.meaning_en: payments made to performers, writers, and directors when a recorded broadcast is repeated

examples.text: Actors earn residuals from repeated broadcasts of their shows.
examples.translation_cn: 演员们从其剧目的重复播出中获得重播报酬。

examples.text: She made a hearty beef stew for the family.
examples.translation_cn: 她为家人做了一锅丰盛的炖牛肉。

examples.text: She stewed the beef for two hours until it was tender.
examples.translation_cn: 她把牛肉炖了两个小时，直到肉质变软。

examples.text: He sat stewing over the problem all evening.
examples.translation_cn: 他整个晚上都在为这个问题苦恼。

senses.meaning_en: a thin sensory organ on the head of an insect or other animal

examples.text: A butterfly uses its antennas to taste and smell.
examples.translation_cn: 蝴蝶用触角来品尝和闻气味。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of equipment for receiving or sending radio or television signals
senses.pattern: install an antenna on the roof

examples.text: They installed an antenna on the roof to improve reception.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在屋顶安装了天线以改善接收信号。

senses.meaning_en: the natural ability to notice things and understand their importance

examples.text: Good journalists have antennas for stories that matter.
examples.translation_cn: 优秀记者对重要新闻有敏锐直觉。

senses.meaning_en: relating to pregnancy, birth, and the period shortly after birth

examples.text: She is currently on maternity leave until September.
examples.translation_cn: 她目前正在休产假，直到九月。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being a mother; motherhood

examples.text: She often talks about the joys of maternity.
examples.translation_cn: 她经常谈论为人母的快乐。

senses.meaning_en: a ward or department in a hospital where babies are born

examples.text: She works in maternity at the city hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市医院的产科工作。

senses.meaning_en: to be on both sides of something or someone

examples.text: The entrance is flanked by two stone lions.
examples.translation_cn: 入口两侧各有一只石狮。

senses.meaning_en: the left or right side of an army or military formation

examples.text: Our troops were positioned on the left flank.
examples.translation_cn: 我军被部署在左翼。

senses.meaning_en: to attack the side of an enemy or military force

examples.text: The cavalry flanked the enemy on the left.
examples.translation_cn: 骑兵从左翼包抄了敌军。

senses.meaning_en: the side of the body between the ribs and the hip

examples.text: He felt a sharp pain in his left flank.
examples.translation_cn: 他感到左肋一阵剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: a cut of meat from the side of an animal, especially a cow

examples.text: We ordered a flank steak with chips and salad.
examples.translation_cn: 我们点了一份腹肉牛排配薯条和沙拉。

senses.meaning_en: having supreme power

examples.text: The island became a sovereign state in 1962.
examples.translation_cn: 该岛于1962年成为主权国家。

senses.meaning_en: a supreme ruler

examples.text: The king served as sovereign of the country for four decades.
examples.translation_cn: 国王担任该国君主长达四十年。

senses.meaning_en: extremely effective

examples.text: She claimed the herb was a sovereign remedy for colds.
examples.translation_cn: 她声称这种草药是治疗感冒的特效药。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow cut or depression in a surface; to make such a cut

examples.text: The machine cut a deep groove in the stone floor.
examples.translation_cn: 机器在石地板上切出了一道深槽。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed routine or a comfortable state

examples.text: After a few busy weeks, she finally got into a groove at work.
examples.translation_cn: 忙了几周后，她终于在工作中进入了得心应手的状态。

senses.meaning_en: to dance or enjoy rhythmic music

examples.text: The whole crowd was grooving to the beat at the street festival.
examples.translation_cn: 整个人群都在街头音乐节上随着节拍舞动。

senses.meaning_en: a strong rhythmic quality in music

examples.text: The band played the whole set with an infectious groove.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队整场演出都带着富有感染力的律动。

senses.meaning_en: to put someone or something in danger

examples.text: Oil spills can endanger marine wildlife along the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 石油泄漏可能危及沿海的海洋野生动物。

senses.meaning_en: to make a person or part of the body unable to move or feel; to afflict with paralysis

examples.text: After the accident, he was paralyzed from the waist down.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后，他从腰部以下瘫痪了。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent a system, organization, etc. from working normally

examples.text: The entire city was paralyzed by a transit strike.
examples.translation_cn: 整个城市因公交罢工而瘫痪。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone unable to think or behave normally, especially because of fear or shock

examples.text: She was paralyzed with fear when she heard the window break.
examples.translation_cn: 听到窗户破碎，她吓得不能动。

senses.meaning_en: relating to heat or temperature

examples.text: Thermal energy from the sun drives ocean currents and weather systems.
examples.translation_cn: 来自太阳的热能驱动洋流和天气系统。

senses.meaning_en: providing effective insulation to keep the body warm

examples.text: Wear thermal underwear if you plan to hike in freezing temperatures.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你打算在严寒天气远足，请穿保暖内衣。

senses.meaning_en: a column of rising warm air in the atmosphere

examples.text: A hawk can ride a thermal to gain height without flapping.
examples.translation_cn: 鹰可以借助上升暖气流攀升，无需拍打翅膀。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of cloth or paper used at the table to wipe the mouth and hands while eating
senses.pattern: put a napkin on one's lap

examples.text: He put a paper napkin on his lap and used it to wipe his mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 他在腿上放了一张纸巾，并用它擦了嘴。

senses.meaning_en: a pad worn by women to absorb menstrual blood; a sanitary napkin

examples.text: She changes her sanitary napkin every four hours during her period.
examples.translation_cn: 她在经期每四个小时换一次卫生巾。

senses.meaning_en: bright red in colour, sometimes with a slight orange tone

examples.text: The maple leaves turn scarlet in late autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 深秋时节枫叶变得鲜红。

senses.meaning_en: blushing; embarrassed or mortified

examples.text: He went scarlet when he forgot his lines on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 当他在舞台上忘词时，脸涨得通红。

senses.meaning_en: the colour scarlet

examples.text: She was dressed in scarlet from head to toe.
examples.translation_cn: 她从头到脚穿着鲜红色的衣服。

senses.meaning_en: a path or trail for people to walk on

examples.text: We walked along the footpath through the woods.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着穿过树林的小路走。

senses.meaning_en: a paved path beside a road for pedestrians

examples.text: Cyclists should keep off the footpath beside the road.
examples.translation_cn: 骑自行车的人应该远离路边的人行道。

senses.meaning_en: a person who advocates or promotes a cause or idea

examples.text: She became a prophet of educational reform in the 1980s.
examples.translation_cn: 她在20世纪80年代成为教育改革的倡导者。

senses.meaning_en: someone who predicts the future; a soothsayer

examples.text: The economist was a prophet of doom during the recession.
examples.translation_cn: 这位经济学家在经济衰退期间是个末日预言家。

senses.meaning_en: a person regarded as an inspired teacher or proclaimer of the will of God

examples.text: Moses was a prophet of God who led the Israelites out of Egypt.
examples.translation_cn: 摩西是带领以色列人出埃及的神的先知。

senses.meaning_en: warm, comfortable and safe, especially in a small space

examples.text: We felt cozy in the cabin while the wind howled outside.
examples.translation_cn: 外面狂风呼啸时，我们在小屋里感到很舒适。

senses.meaning_en: intimate and relaxed; showing closeness

examples.text: After dinner they had a cozy chat by the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后他们在炉火旁亲切地聊了一会儿。

senses.meaning_en: too close, suggesting dishonesty or improper influence

examples.text: The senator was criticized for being too cozy with the oil lobby.
examples.translation_cn: 那位参议员因与石油游说团体关系过于密切而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: the set of technical terms used in a particular subject

examples.text: The terminology of law can confuse ordinary people.
examples.translation_cn: 法律术语可能让普通人困惑。

senses.meaning_en: the study or systematic treatment of technical terms

examples.text: The study of terminology is essential for translators working with specialist texts.
examples.translation_cn: 术语学研究对于处理专业文本的译者至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: containing or made with milk; with a lot of milk

examples.text: She drinks her coffee milky, with no sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 她喝咖啡加奶，不加糖。

senses.meaning_en: having a white or pale colour like milk

examples.text: The water turned milky when she added the powder.
examples.translation_cn: 她加入粉末后，水变成了乳白色。

senses.meaning_en: fighting or ready to fight; aggressively active in support of a cause

examples.text: Some teachers are militant in defending their rights.
examples.translation_cn: 一些老师在捍卫自身权利方面十分激进。

senses.meaning_en: a person who aggressively supports a particular cause

examples.text: Armed militants from the group seized the building.
examples.translation_cn: 该团体的武装激进分子占领了那栋大楼。

senses.meaning_en: to live or reside in a place, especially in a formal or literary style

examples.text: The old man dwelt in a small cottage by the sea for over forty years.
examples.translation_cn: 那位老人在海边的一间小屋里住了四十多年。

senses.meaning_en: to keep thinking or talking about something, especially something unpleasant

examples.text: She tends to dwell on negative comments for days.
examples.translation_cn: 她往往会连续几天纠结于负面评论。

senses.meaning_en: a line of stitches joining two pieces of fabric

examples.text: She sewed a neat seam along the side of the dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她沿着裙子侧边缝了一条整齐的线缝。

senses.meaning_en: a line of stitches used to close a wound; a suture

examples.text: The surgeon closed the cut with a neat seam of stitches.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生用一排整齐的缝线闭合了切口。

senses.meaning_en: a thin layer of coal or mineral in the ground

examples.text: The miners found a thick seam of coal under the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 矿工们在山谷下发现了一层厚厚的煤。

senses.meaning_en: a line where two pieces of metal, wood, etc. are joined

examples.text: They sealed the seam between the two metal panels.
examples.translation_cn: 他们密封了两块金属板之间的接缝。

senses.meaning_en: strong and able to bear difficult conditions

examples.text: The pony is hardy enough to sleep outside all winter.
examples.translation_cn: 这匹小马很健壮，整个冬天都能睡在户外。

senses.meaning_en: able to survive cold or harsh growing conditions

examples.text: This perennial is hardy in cold weather and survives frost without protection.
examples.translation_cn: 这种多年生植物耐寒，无需保护就能在霜冻中存活。

senses.meaning_en: brave and determined

examples.text: Only a hardy soul would dare to cross the desert alone.
examples.translation_cn: 只有勇敢的人才会独自穿越沙漠。

senses.meaning_en: a small group of people very close together

examples.text: The tourists stood in a huddle near the bus.
examples.translation_cn: 游客们在公交车旁挤成一团。

senses.meaning_en: to crowd together

examples.text: We huddled together under the shelter to keep warm.
examples.translation_cn: 我们挤在遮蔽处下取暖。

senses.meaning_en: to curl the body into a small position

examples.text: She huddled up in the corner, trying to stay warm.
examples.translation_cn: 她蜷缩在角落里，想暖和一点。

senses.meaning_en: to get together and discuss something

examples.text: The managers huddled with lawyers to discuss the settlement.
examples.translation_cn: 经理们与律师私下商议和解事宜。

senses.meaning_en: an insect with hard wing covers

examples.text: We saw a beetle crawling slowly up the tree trunk.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看到一只甲虫慢慢爬上树干。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly away

examples.text: The children beetled off as soon as they saw the teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们一看到老师就匆忙离开了。

senses.meaning_en: to stick out or hang over

examples.text: Dark cliffs beetled over the narrow path below.
examples.translation_cn: 黑暗的悬崖悬垂在下面狭窄的小路上。

senses.meaning_en: relating to men or boys; for men

examples.text: The store has a section for masculine clothing and accessories.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店有男性服装和配饰专区。

senses.meaning_en: having qualities considered typical of men

examples.text: He grew a beard to look more masculine.
examples.translation_cn: 他留了胡子，看起来更有男子气概。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the masculine grammatical gender

examples.text: In Spanish, the word 'día' is masculine and takes the article 'el'.
examples.translation_cn: 在西班牙语中，‘día’是阳性，与冠词‘el’连用。

senses.meaning_en: the masculine gender in grammar

examples.text: In Portuguese, the word 'amor' is in the masculine.
examples.translation_cn: 在葡萄牙语中，‘amor’是阳性。

senses.meaning_en: a strong building or place used for military defence or as a base

examples.text: The soldiers defended the fort for three days.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们守卫了这座堡垒三天。

senses.meaning_en: a structure built by children for play, often using blankets, cushions, or other furniture

examples.text: The kids built a fort out of blankets and cushions.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们用毯子和靠垫搭了一个游戏小屋。

senses.meaning_en: a person who attacks and robs ships at sea

examples.text: The crew were attacked by pirates off the Somali coast.
examples.translation_cn: 船员在索马里海岸附近遭到海盗袭击。

senses.meaning_en: to illegally copy and use or sell software, films, music, etc.

examples.text: It is illegal to pirate movies and share them online.
examples.translation_cn: 在网上盗版电影并分享是违法的。

senses.meaning_en: a person who makes or sells illegal copies of protected works

examples.text: He was arrested for being a software pirate.
examples.translation_cn: 他因是软件盗版者而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: a ship used by pirates

examples.text: They imagined living on a pirate ship in the Caribbean.
examples.translation_cn: 他们想象自己住在加勒比海的一艘海盗船上。

senses.meaning_en: a container with a handle and lip, used for holding and pouring liquids

examples.text: He filled the glass jug with cold milk and put it on the table.
examples.translation_cn: 他把玻璃壶装满冷牛奶，放在桌上。

senses.meaning_en: the amount that a jug can hold

examples.text: Add a jug of water to the flour and stir well.
examples.translation_cn: 往面粉里加一壶水，搅拌均匀。

senses.meaning_en: intended to arouse sexual interest; sexy

examples.text: She looked incredibly provocative in that red dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿那件红裙子显得格外性感撩人。

senses.meaning_en: intended to make people angry or upset; causing a strong reaction

examples.text: The senator was deliberately provocative throughout the hearing.
examples.translation_cn: 那位参议员在听证会上一直故意挑衅。

senses.meaning_en: stimulating thought or discussion

examples.text: The report raises a provocative question about the future of education.
examples.translation_cn: 那份报告提出了一个关于教育未来的发人深思的问题。

senses.meaning_en: formal admission to a position or organization

examples.text: Her induction into the society took place at a ceremony attended by all members.
examples.translation_cn: 她的入会仪式在一场全体会员出席的典礼上举行。

senses.meaning_en: a method of reasoning from particular facts to general principles

examples.text: They arrived at this conclusion by induction from many individual cases.
examples.translation_cn: 他们通过对许多个别案例进行归纳得出了这个结论。

senses.meaning_en: the production of an electric current by a changing magnetic field

examples.text: The induction of current in a wire requires a changing magnetic field.
examples.translation_cn: 导线中产生感应电流需要变化的磁场。

senses.meaning_en: an area of land where fruit trees are grown

examples.text: They decided to plant an orchard on the south slope.
examples.translation_cn: 他们决定在南坡上建一个果园。

senses.meaning_en: the fruit trees themselves growing in such an area

examples.text: The orchard in blossom stood in neat rows behind the farmhouse.
examples.translation_cn: 盛开的果树整齐地排列在农舍后面。

senses.meaning_en: to be a typical example of something; to embody

examples.text: Her success exemplifies the value of hard work and patience.
examples.translation_cn: 她的成功体现了努力和耐心的价值。

senses.meaning_en: to give an example of something; to illustrate by example

examples.text: The professor exemplified the concept with a vivid everyday example.
examples.translation_cn: 教授用一个生动的日常例子来说明这个概念。

senses.meaning_en: a hand tool with a handle and broad blade, used for moving earth, snow, etc.

examples.text: He used a shovel to dig a hole in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 他用铲子在花园里挖了一个坑。

senses.meaning_en: to move materials with a shovel

examples.text: They shovelled the snow onto the side of the road.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把雪铲到路边。

senses.meaning_en: to move something somewhere quickly and carelessly with a shoveling motion

examples.text: She shovelled the papers into her briefcase and rushed out of the office.
examples.translation_cn: 她把文件胡乱塞进公文包，然后冲出了办公室。

senses.meaning_en: having many small parts or details arranged in a complicated way

examples.text: The geometric pattern on the handmade ceramic tile is intricate.
examples.translation_cn: 手工瓷砖上的几何图案复杂精巧。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of repairing and improving a building

examples.text: The old courthouse has been under renovation for nearly a year.
examples.translation_cn: 这座旧法院大楼已经翻修了将近一年。

senses.meaning_en: including all amounts so far

examples.text: The cumulative total of donations has now reached $50,000.
examples.translation_cn: 捐款的累计总额现已达到五万美元。

senses.meaning_en: increasing as more is added

examples.text: Lack of sleep can have a cumulative effect on memory.
examples.translation_cn: 睡眠不足会对记忆力产生累积性影响。

senses.meaning_en: a person who enters a building illegally in order to steal
senses.pattern: a burglar breaks into a place

examples.text: The burglar broke into the house through an unlocked window.
examples.translation_cn: 那名入室窃贼从一扇未上锁的窗户闯进了屋里。

senses.meaning_en: a metal device that heats a room by hot water or steam flowing through it

examples.text: We turned on the radiator because the room was freezing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们打开了暖气片，因为房间太冷了。

senses.meaning_en: a device that cools an engine by passing air through metal fins

examples.text: Check the radiator for leaks before a long drive.
examples.translation_cn: 长途驾驶前检查散热器是否漏水。

senses.meaning_en: present but not active or visible

examples.text: The disease can remain latent in the body for years before symptoms appear.
examples.translation_cn: 这种疾病可以在体内潜伏多年后才出现症状。

senses.meaning_en: the right to reject a decision or proposal

examples.text: The president has a veto over any new legislation.
examples.translation_cn: 总统对任何新立法都有否决权。

senses.meaning_en: an act of rejecting a decision or proposal using this right

examples.text: The governor used her veto to block the education bill.
examples.translation_cn: 州长行使否决权阻止了教育法案。

senses.meaning_en: to reject a decision or proposal by using a veto

examples.text: The president vetoed the spending bill on Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 总统周二否决了开支法案。

senses.meaning_en: an event that delays or blocks progress

examples.text: The team's defeat was a serious setback to their title hopes.
examples.translation_cn: 球队的失利对他们夺冠的希望是一个严重挫折。

senses.meaning_en: the removal of someone from office

examples.text: The deposition of the king shocked the whole country.
examples.translation_cn: 国王被废黜震惊了全国。

senses.meaning_en: the act of depositing material, especially by a natural process

examples.text: The deposition of silt formed a delta at the river mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 泥沙沉积在河口形成了三角洲。

senses.meaning_en: testimony given under oath, especially in writing

examples.text: The witness will give a deposition next week.
examples.translation_cn: 证人下周将提供庭外证词。

senses.meaning_en: the process of taking sworn testimony out of court

examples.text: The lawyer took a deposition from the key witness yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 律师昨天对关键证人进行了庭外取证。

senses.meaning_en: relating to numbers; expressed in numbers

examples.text: The survey results are easier to compare when expressed in numerical terms.
examples.translation_cn: 调查结果用数值表示时更容易比较。

senses.meaning_en: in an extraordinary manner; very; unusually

examples.text: The new drug has proven extraordinarily effective in treating the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药在治疗该疾病方面已证明异常有效。

senses.meaning_en: the holy books or writings of a religion

examples.text: Creation stories appear in the scriptures of many ancient cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 创世故事出现在许多古代文化的宗教经典中。

senses.meaning_en: a passage from the Bible

examples.text: She read a passage from scripture about hope to the group.
examples.translation_cn: 她给小组读了一段关于希望的圣经经文。

senses.meaning_en: a bill; a document issued by a seller to a buyer showing products, quantities, prices and payment terms

examples.text: We received an invoice for the design work last Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周五收到了设计工作的发票。

senses.meaning_en: to send a bill to someone for goods or services

examples.text: They will invoice you for the shipping costs.
examples.translation_cn: 他们会向你开具运费发票。

senses.meaning_en: the root of a tropical plant, used as a spice

examples.text: Add a little grated ginger to the soup for extra flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 往汤里加一点磨碎的姜来提味。

senses.meaning_en: the tropical plant that produces ginger

examples.text: They grow ginger in the greenhouse for its vivid flowers.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在温室里种姜，因为它的花很鲜艳。

senses.meaning_en: a reddish-brown colour

examples.text: The front door was painted a warm ginger.
examples.translation_cn: 前门被刷成了温暖的姜黄色。

senses.meaning_en: energy and liveliness

examples.text: The young players showed plenty of ginger in the second half.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻球员在下半场展现出了十足的劲头。

senses.meaning_en: taking place in the air

examples.text: The documentary opens with a stunning aerial view of the coastline.
examples.translation_cn: 纪录片以海岸线的壮丽鸟瞰图开场。

senses.meaning_en: an antenna for receiving or transmitting signals

examples.text: We installed an aerial on the roof to get better reception.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在屋顶安装了一根天线以获得更好的接收信号。

senses.meaning_en: imaginary; insubstantial

examples.text: He dismissed the plan as a mere aerial fantasy with no practical value.
examples.translation_cn: 他认为这个计划纯粹是空中楼阁，毫无实用价值。

senses.meaning_en: to eat dinner, especially in a formal way

examples.text: We often dine out with friends on Friday evenings.
examples.translation_cn: 我们经常在周五晚上和朋友外出用餐。

senses.meaning_en: to give dinner to someone, usually as entertainment

examples.text: The company wined and dined its best clients last night.
examples.translation_cn: 公司昨晚盛情款待了最佳客户。

senses.meaning_en: to send someone or something somewhere, especially for a specific purpose

examples.text: The government dispatched a team of volunteers to the island after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴过后，政府派遣了一支志愿者队伍前往该岛。

senses.meaning_en: to send an important official message or document promptly

examples.text: The general dispatched an urgent message to headquarters before dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 将军在黎明前向总部发送了一份紧急函件。

senses.meaning_en: to deal with or finish something quickly and efficiently

examples.text: She dispatched the remaining tasks quickly and left the office.
examples.translation_cn: 她迅速处理完剩余的任务，然后离开了办公室。

senses.meaning_en: a slope or incline

examples.text: The hill rises with a gradient of one in ten.
examples.translation_cn: 这座小山以十分之一的坡度上升。

senses.meaning_en: a rate of change; a gradient

examples.text: There is a strong gradient in temperature across the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 沙漠上的温度变化率很大。

senses.meaning_en: a gradual change in color

examples.text: The designer chose a gradient from blue to green for the logo.
examples.translation_cn: 设计师为标志选择了一种从蓝到绿的渐变。

senses.meaning_en: makeup for coloring the lips, usually in stick form

examples.text: She applied lipstick to her lips and checked the mirror.
examples.translation_cn: 她涂上口红，照了照镜子。

senses.meaning_en: the political and economic theories of Marx; any left-wing ideology or policy promoting a welfare state, nationalisation, etc.

examples.text: Marxism holds that class struggle drives historical change.
examples.translation_cn: 马克思主义认为阶级斗争推动历史变革。

senses.meaning_en: to set fire to something

examples.text: The match ignited the dry leaves in seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 火柴几秒钟就点燃了干树叶。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a strong emotion or start a debate

examples.text: The new policy ignited a fierce public debate.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策引发了激烈的公众辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to start to burn

examples.text: The leaking gas ignited without any warning at all.
examples.translation_cn: 泄漏的燃气毫无预警地着火了。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a circle around a central point

examples.text: The earth revolves around the sun once a year.
examples.translation_cn: 地球每年绕太阳公转一圈。

senses.meaning_en: to turn around a fixed point; to make something turn around a fixed point

examples.text: The mill wheel revolves slowly on its axis.
examples.translation_cn: 磨坊的水轮缓慢地绕轴旋转。

senses.meaning_en: a speech sound produced without blocking the breath

examples.text: The vowel in 'sheep' is longer than the vowel in 'ship'.
examples.translation_cn: sheep 中的元音比 ship 中的元音长。

senses.meaning_en: a letter that represents a vowel sound

examples.text: In English, the letter 'y' is sometimes a vowel.
examples.translation_cn: 英语中，字母 y 有时是元音字母。

senses.meaning_en: to make something flat or flatter

examples.text: She flattened the wet clay with her palms before shaping it into a bowl.
examples.translation_cn: 她用手掌把湿黏土压平，再把它塑成碗。

senses.meaning_en: to become flat or level; to stop rising or falling

examples.text: The rate of new infections is finally starting to flatten out.
examples.translation_cn: 新增感染率终于开始趋于平缓。

senses.meaning_en: to knock someone down

examples.text: A sudden punch flattened the champion in the second round.
examples.translation_cn: 第二回合中，一记突如其来的重拳击倒了冠军。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or knock down a building or area

examples.text: Entire city blocks were flattened by the wildfire last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 去年夏天，整个城区被野火夷为平地。

senses.meaning_en: to weaken or damage something, especially a function or ability

examples.text: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate.
examples.translation_cn: 睡眠不足会削弱你集中注意力的能力。

senses.meaning_en: a stick of black carbon material used for drawing

examples.text: She drew a quick sketch of the garden with charcoal.
examples.translation_cn: 她用炭笔快速勾画了花园。

senses.meaning_en: of a very dark grey colour

examples.text: The walls of the office were charcoal grey.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室的墙壁是炭灰色的。

senses.meaning_en: a drawing made with charcoal

examples.text: The gallery has several portraits done in charcoal.
examples.translation_cn: 画廊里有几幅炭笔肖像画。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the essential nature of a thing

examples.text: The desire to learn is intrinsic to all children.
examples.translation_cn: 学习的欲望是所有儿童固有的。

senses.meaning_en: a forest in a climate with high annual rainfall and no dry season

examples.text: Scientists discovered a new frog species in the rainforest.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在热带雨林中发现了一种新蛙种。

senses.meaning_en: to return land to a suitable condition for use

examples.text: The city reclaimed the derelict land for a public park.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市把废弃的土地改造为公园。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain useful products from waste or to recycle

examples.text: The plant reclaims plastic bottles from household waste.
examples.translation_cn: 该工厂从家庭垃圾中回收塑料瓶。

senses.meaning_en: to get something back or ask to have it back after it has been lost or taken away

examples.text: You can reclaim your luggage from the carousel after landing.
examples.translation_cn: 着陆后你可以从行李传送带上取回行李。

senses.meaning_en: to help someone behave in a normal way again after being involved in crime or bad behaviour
senses.pattern: be reclaimed from a life of crime

examples.text: Many young offenders have been reclaimed from a life of crime through education.
examples.translation_cn: 许多青少年罪犯通过教育得到挽救。

senses.meaning_en: to handle a weapon or tool with skill and ease

examples.text: He can wield a sword with great skill.
examples.translation_cn: 他能熟练地挥舞剑。

senses.meaning_en: to exercise authority or influence effectively

examples.text: The committee wields considerable influence over education policy.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会对教育政策有着相当大的影响力。

senses.meaning_en: done or happening at the right time; prompt

examples.text: We received a timely warning about the approaching storm.
examples.translation_cn: 我们及时收到了暴风雨临近的警报。

senses.meaning_en: death, destruction, or a terrible fate

examples.text: The villain met his doom in the final scene.
examples.translation_cn: 那个反派在最后一幕中丧了命。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling that something bad is going to happen

examples.text: She waited with a growing sense of doom.
examples.translation_cn: 她怀着越来越强烈的不祥预感等待着。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something certain to fail or be destroyed

examples.text: The project was doomed to fail from the start.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目从一开始就注定要失败。

senses.meaning_en: a small container of medicine that you swallow

examples.text: Take a capsule with a full glass of water.
examples.translation_cn: 用满满一杯水送服一粒胶囊。

senses.meaning_en: a small container with a substance inside
