examples.text: She let out a long lamentation as the coffin was lowered into the ground.
examples.translation_cn: 棺材放入地下时，她发出长长的哀哭声。

senses.meaning_en: in a boring way; without liveliness or interest

examples.text: The speaker droned dully on for another twenty minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 演讲者又枯燥地讲了二十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is felt but not sharply or intensely

examples.text: His arm ached dully throughout the long night.
examples.translation_cn: 他的手臂整夜隐隐作痛。

senses.meaning_en: slowly or without energy; unresponsively

examples.text: He stared dully at the wall, too tired to move.
examples.translation_cn: 他呆呆地盯着墙壁，累得动不了。

senses.meaning_en: able to regrow or repair damaged tissue or parts

examples.text: The human liver has remarkable regenerative capacity after injury.
examples.translation_cn: 人类肝脏在受伤后具有惊人的再生能力。

senses.meaning_en: helping to restore or renew something, especially in farming or the environment

examples.text: This farming system is regenerative, restoring soil health each year.
examples.translation_cn: 这种农业系统具有再生性，每年都能恢复土壤健康。

senses.meaning_en: serving to regenerate

examples.text: This hybrid car uses regenerative braking to save energy.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆混合动力汽车使用再生制动来节省能量。

senses.meaning_en: eager to acquire and own things; greedy

examples.text: She is acquisitive by nature, never satisfied with what she owns.
examples.translation_cn: 她天性贪婪，从不满足于自己拥有的东西。

senses.meaning_en: able to cure or heal illness

examples.text: This herb is curative for many stomach problems.
examples.translation_cn: 这种草药对许多胃病有疗效。

senses.meaning_en: a substance or treatment that cures
senses.pattern: be used as a curative for

examples.text: The plant was used as a curative for fever.
examples.translation_cn: 这种植物曾被用作治疗发烧的药物。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that does not allow heat, electricity, or sound to pass through it

examples.text: Rubber acts as an insulator against electric current.
examples.translation_cn: 橡胶是防止电流通过的绝缘体。

senses.meaning_en: a device used to support electric wires and prevent the flow of electricity to the ground

examples.text: The ceramic insulator on the power pole cracked in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 电线杆上的陶瓷绝缘子在暴风雨中裂开了。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to install insulation in buildings

examples.text: He works as an insulator in commercial buildings.
examples.translation_cn: 他在商业建筑中做隔热材料安装工。

senses.meaning_en: a person who travels around selling goods, especially on the streets

examples.text: A pedlar selling roasted chestnuts stood outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 一个卖烤栗子的小贩站在车站外。

senses.meaning_en: a person who spreads ideas, rumours, etc., often with negative connotations

examples.text: He was a pedlar of misinformation during the election campaign.
examples.translation_cn: 他是竞选期间错误信息的散布者。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone lose their sense of direction

examples.text: The dense fog disoriented the hikers, and they had to use a compass.
examples.translation_cn: 浓雾使徒步者迷失了方向，他们只好使用指南针。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel confused and unable to think clearly

examples.text: She was disoriented by the sudden change in plans and needed time to adjust.
examples.translation_cn: 计划的突然改变使她不知所措，她需要时间适应。

senses.meaning_en: set in advance, especially as a default

examples.text: The oven turns on at a preset time every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 烤箱每天早上在预设时间启动。

senses.meaning_en: to set in advance

examples.text: You can preset the washing machine to start later.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以预设洗衣机稍后开始。

senses.meaning_en: a setting that is set in advance

examples.text: You can save this filter as a preset for later use.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把这个滤镜保存为预设，供以后使用。

senses.meaning_en: to separate grain from chaff by beating

examples.text: Farmers thresh wheat with a wooden flail after the harvest.
examples.translation_cn: 收割后，农民们用木连枷给小麦脱粒。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to tension

examples.text: Steel cables have high tensile strength and are used in bridges.
examples.translation_cn: 钢缆具有很高的抗张强度，常用于桥梁。

senses.meaning_en: capable of being stretched; ductile

examples.text: This polymer is tensile enough to be stretched into a thin film without tearing.
examples.translation_cn: 这种聚合物有足够的延展性，可以被拉伸成薄膜而不会撕裂。

senses.meaning_en: the science and technology of extracting metals from their ores and preparing them for use

examples.text: The metallurgy of copper requires high temperatures to remove impurities.
examples.translation_cn: 铜的冶炼需要高温来去除杂质。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of power equal to 1,000 watts

examples.text: A typical microwave uses about one kilowatt of power.
examples.translation_cn: 一台典型的微波炉功率约为一千瓦。

senses.meaning_en: to make poor

examples.text: Many families were impoverished by the long war.
examples.translation_cn: 许多家庭因长期战争而陷入贫困。

senses.meaning_en: to weaken in quality or deprive of strength or richness

examples.text: Intensive farming can impoverish the soil over time.
examples.translation_cn: 集约化耕作会使土壤逐渐贫瘠。

senses.meaning_en: used to express approval, appreciation, or happiness

examples.text: Hurrah for our team—they've won the championship at last!
examples.translation_cn: 好哇，我们队终于赢得了冠军！

senses.meaning_en: a shout of joy or approval

examples.text: The crowd gave a loud hurrah for the young players.
examples.translation_cn: 人群为年轻球员们高声欢呼。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone earnestly or anxiously to do something

examples.text: The nurse gently entreated the patient to take his medicine on time.
examples.translation_cn: 护士温和地恳求病人按时服药。

senses.meaning_en: a person who murders by strangling

examples.text: The strangler who murdered three women was sentenced to life in prison.
examples.translation_cn: 谋杀了三名女子的勒杀者被判处终身监禁。

senses.meaning_en: constantly changing or developing

examples.text: Earth's climate is a dynamical system that changes over many timescales.
examples.translation_cn: 地球气候是一个在许多时间尺度上变化的动态系统。

senses.meaning_en: relating to dynamics, the branch of mechanics concerned with forces and motion

examples.text: The book explains how to derive dynamical equations for moving objects.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书解释了如何为运动物体推导动力学方程。

senses.meaning_en: a single piece of information or fact used as a basis for reasoning

examples.text: The datum that inflation fell surprised the central bank.
examples.translation_cn: 通胀下降这一数据让央行感到意外。

senses.meaning_en: the SI unit of electrical resistance

examples.text: The resistance of this component is measured in ohms.
examples.translation_cn: 这个元件的电阻以欧姆为单位测量。

senses.meaning_en: of or containing iron

examples.text: Cast iron is a ferrous metal widely used in construction.
examples.translation_cn: 铸铁是一种广泛用于建筑的含铁金属。

senses.meaning_en: capable of being solved

examples.text: The puzzle is solvable by applying basic logic.
examples.translation_cn: 这个谜题通过运用基本逻辑就可以解决。

senses.meaning_en: to confuse or puzzle someone, especially with many choices

examples.text: She was bewildered by the many choices on the menu.
examples.translation_cn: 菜单上众多选择使她感到困惑。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the photoelectric effect

examples.text: The photoelectric effect occurs when light shines on a metal surface.
examples.translation_cn: 当光照射到金属表面时就会产生光电效应。

senses.meaning_en: the electrode through which electric current enters a device

examples.text: During the electrolysis of water, oxygen is produced at the anode.
examples.translation_cn: 电解水时，阳极产生氧气。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of material that is being worked on or shaped

examples.text: He clamped a workpiece made of aluminium to the drill table.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一个铝制工件夹在钻床工作台上。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is powerful because they are rich

examples.text: A plutocrat who owns most of the country's newspapers can shape public opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 一个拥有该国大多数报纸的富豪统治者可以左右公众舆论。

senses.meaning_en: capable of being touched; tangible or palpable

examples.text: The museum's interactive exhibits are touchable, so children are encouraged to explore them.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆的互动展品可触摸，因此鼓励儿童探索它们。

senses.meaning_en: located in a specific place

examples.text: The hotel is situated on a hill overlooking the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店坐落在俯瞰大海的山丘上。

senses.meaning_en: supplied with money or means

examples.text: After years of saving, she is well situated for retirement.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年储蓄，她退休后的经济状况很好。

senses.meaning_en: cigarette (dated spelling)

examples.text: He smoked a cigaret outside the office this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他今天早上在办公室外面抽了一支烟。

senses.meaning_en: congratulations (informal)

examples.text: She sent a warm cong to the champion team after their victory.
examples.translation_cn: 她在他们获胜后向冠军队表示了热烈的祝贺。

senses.meaning_en: to determine something in advance, as if by fate or divine will

examples.text: The plan seemed predestined to fail from the start.
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划从一开始似乎就注定会失败。

senses.meaning_en: a person who helps someone to commit a crime

examples.text: She was an accessary to the theft but never entered the building.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这起盗窃案的从犯，但从未进入大楼。

senses.meaning_en: something made incidentally during the production of something else

examples.text: Sulfur dioxide is released as a by-product of the process.
examples.translation_cn: 二氧化硫作为该过程的副产品被释放。

senses.meaning_en: a consequence, especially a side effect

examples.text: The increased stress was a by-product of the new schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 压力增加是新日程带来的附带后果。

senses.meaning_en: to become blocked or obstructed

examples.text: The city's main roads become congested with traffic during the morning rush.
examples.translation_cn: 城市的主要道路在早高峰期间因车流而变得拥堵。

senses.meaning_en: to provide with necessary things

examples.text: The rescue team is equiped with modern communication devices.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队配备了现代通讯设备。

senses.meaning_en: to prepare someone for a particular situation

examples.text: These training workshops equipe students for leadership roles.
examples.translation_cn: 这些培训工作坊使学生能够胜任领导角色。

senses.meaning_en: of the best sort; very high quality

examples.text: The restaurant is first-rate, but the prices are high.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅一流，但价格很高。

senses.meaning_en: very well; excellently

examples.text: She performed first-rate in the final interview yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 她在昨天的最终面试中表现得极好。

senses.meaning_en: a sum of money given by a government or organization for a particular purpose

examples.text: Government grants for scientific research have increased sharply.
examples.translation_cn: 科研领域的政府拨款大幅增加。

senses.meaning_en: a proposed explanation for a phenomenon, made as a starting point for further investigation

examples.text: Scientists formulate hypotheses before testing them with experiments.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在用实验检验之前先提出假说。

senses.meaning_en: to stretch out or extend

examples.text: A rocky ledge protends into the cold sea.
examples.translation_cn: 一块岩石平台伸入冰冷的海中。

senses.meaning_en: previously owned or used by someone else

examples.text: He bought a second-hand car for his son.
examples.translation_cn: 他给儿子买了一辆二手车。

senses.meaning_en: learned or obtained from others rather than from direct experience

examples.text: The article was based only on second-hand information.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章仅仅基于二手信息。

senses.meaning_en: to spread or disseminate (ideas, information, etc.)

examples.text: The group seminated new medical information among rural clinics last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织去年向乡村诊所传播了新的医疗信息。

senses.meaning_en: to sow (seeds)

examples.text: Farmers seminated the raised beds with carrot seeds in March.
examples.translation_cn: 农民们三月份在高架苗床上播种了胡萝卜种子。

senses.meaning_en: a room in a house where people sit and relax, usually with sofas and chairs

examples.text: We spent the evening chatting in the sitting-room.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚上在客厅里聊天。

senses.meaning_en: a particular method used to achieve something

examples.text: They used various tactics to persuade customers to sign up.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用了各种手段说服顾客注册。

senses.meaning_en: the art of arranging and using military forces

examples.text: The general's clever tactics in battle saved his outnumbered troops.
examples.translation_cn: 将军巧妙的战术在战斗中拯救了他兵力不足的部队。

senses.meaning_en: away from the inside or centre; not at home

examples.text: She went out to buy some milk and bread.
examples.translation_cn: 她出去买牛奶和面包。

senses.meaning_en: used up; no longer burning

examples.text: We ran out of milk and sugar this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天早上用完了牛奶和糖。

senses.meaning_en: become visible or known publicly

examples.text: The truth finally came out at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 真相最终在会议上公开了。

senses.meaning_en: a building used for living in, usually for one family

examples.text: They live in a small house near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在河边的一所小房子里。

senses.meaning_en: the people who live in a house

examples.text: The loud music from the party woke the whole house.
examples.translation_cn: 聚会传来的喧闹音乐吵醒了全家人。

senses.meaning_en: a building used for a particular purpose

examples.text: The city is building an opera house on the waterfront.
examples.translation_cn: 该市正在滨水区修建一座歌剧院。

senses.meaning_en: the audience in a theatre or concert hall

examples.text: The band played to a full house every night.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队每晚都为满座观众演出。

senses.meaning_en: to perceive sounds through the ear

examples.text: I can hear, but the voice is too faint to understand.
examples.translation_cn: 我能听见，但声音太轻，听不清说的什么。

senses.meaning_en: to listen to; to pay attention to

examples.text: We went to hear the professor speak on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去听了教授关于气候变化的演讲。

senses.meaning_en: to receive information; to be contacted by

examples.text: I heard about the accident on the radio.
examples.translation_cn: 我从收音机里听到了那起事故。

senses.meaning_en: to listen to a case in court; to try

examples.text: The judge will hear a case involving fraud next week.
examples.translation_cn: 法官下周将审理一起涉及欺诈的案件。

senses.meaning_en: a cause or explanation for something

examples.text: The main reason for the delay was heavy traffic on the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 延误的主要原因是桥上交通拥堵。

senses.meaning_en: the power of the mind to think and understand logically

examples.text: When he saw the damage, he almost lost his reason.
examples.translation_cn: 看到损坏时，他几乎失去理智。

senses.meaning_en: to form a judgment by thinking logically

examples.text: She reasoned from the symptoms that the patient had a simple cold.
examples.translation_cn: 她根据症状推断病人只是得了普通感冒。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade someone by reasoning or argument
senses.collocation: reason sb into/out of doing sth

examples.text: She reasoned with her father until he agreed to see a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她劝父亲，直到他同意看医生。

senses.meaning_en: to plan or schedule something; to give a computer or other device a set of instructions

examples.text: You can programme the washing machine to start in three hours.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把洗衣机设定为三小时后启动。

senses.meaning_en: a show or performance, especially on television or radio

examples.text: We watched a programme about rainforest wildlife last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚看了一个关于雨林野生动物的节目。

senses.meaning_en: a set of instructions that makes a computer do something
senses.pattern: a computer programme to do sth

examples.text: She wrote a computer programme to analyse the survey data.
examples.translation_cn: 她编写了一个计算机程序来分析调查数据。

senses.meaning_en: to manage or be in charge of an organization, business, etc.

examples.text: She administrates a large international organization with thousands of employees.
examples.translation_cn: 她管理一家拥有数千名员工的大型国际组织。

senses.meaning_en: to put into effect or carry out laws, rules, plans

examples.text: The federal agency administrates the new environmental law.
examples.translation_cn: 联邦机构执行新的环境法。

senses.meaning_en: a television set

examples.text: He turned on the TV to watch the evening news.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开电视看晚间新闻。

senses.meaning_en: television programmes or broadcasting

examples.text: There is nothing worth watching on TV tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 今晚电视上没有什么值得看的节目。

senses.meaning_en: to understand or become aware of something

examples.text: I suddenly realised that I had left my keys at home.
examples.translation_cn: 我突然意识到我把钥匙落在家里了。

senses.meaning_en: to achieve something you hoped for

examples.text: She worked hard to realise her dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她努力工作以实现成为医生的梦想。

senses.meaning_en: to choose; to select

examples.text: Many workers opted for flexible hours rather than a higher salary.
examples.translation_cn: 许多工人选择弹性工作时间而不是更高的薪水。

senses.meaning_en: work, especially physical work

examples.text: He does manual labor on a construction site.
examples.translation_cn: 他在建筑工地上做体力劳动。

senses.meaning_en: workers, especially people who do practical work with their hands

examples.text: The company needs more skilled labor for the new factory.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的新工厂需要更多熟练工人。

senses.meaning_en: the process of childbirth, especially the period of contractions

examples.text: She was in labor for ten hours before the delivery.
examples.translation_cn: 她分娩了十个小时才生下孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives next to or near another

examples.text: We've been neighbors with the Parkers for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 我们和帕克一家做了十多年的邻居。

senses.meaning_en: to be located next to or very near something

examples.text: The hotel neighbors a quiet park in the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店紧邻市中心的一个安静公园。

senses.meaning_en: houses, flats, etc. that people live in

examples.text: The city lacks affordable housing for low-income families.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市缺乏面向低收入家庭的经济适用住房。

senses.meaning_en: a hard protective cover for a machine or device

examples.text: A waterproof housing for the camera allows underwater photography.
examples.translation_cn: 相机防水外壳使水下摄影成为可能。

senses.meaning_en: the act of providing accommodation for people

examples.text: The government has a duty to ensure the housing of refugees.
examples.translation_cn: 政府有责任确保难民得到住房安置。

senses.meaning_en: a building where plays and shows are performed

examples.text: We spent the evening at the theater watching a musical.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚上在剧院看音乐剧。

senses.meaning_en: a region where military operations take place

examples.text: The Pacific was a major theater of war in the 1940s.
examples.translation_cn: 太平洋是20世纪40年代的一个主要战区。

senses.meaning_en: drama or performance as a profession or art form

examples.text: She has worked in theater for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 她从事戏剧工作已有二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a building where films are shown; a cinema

examples.text: The new comedy is playing at the movie theater downtown.
examples.translation_cn: 这部新喜剧正在市中心的电影院上映。

senses.meaning_en: carrying too much body fat; plump

examples.text: People who eat too much junk food often get fat.
examples.translation_cn: 吃太多垃圾食品的人常常会发胖。

senses.meaning_en: large in amount; generous

examples.text: The company reported a fat profit last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司去年公布了一笔丰厚的利润。

senses.meaning_en: containing much fat; greasy (said of food)

examples.text: The recipe calls for fat bacon, not lean bacon.
examples.translation_cn: 这个食谱要用肥培根，而不是瘦培根。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to hear

examples.text: She began to lose her hearing in her seventies.
examples.translation_cn: 她七十多岁时开始失去听力。

senses.meaning_en: an official meeting at which evidence or arguments are presented

examples.text: Several witnesses testified at a hearing held last Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 几名证人上周二在听证会上作了证。

senses.meaning_en: a chance to explain or defend yourself

examples.text: Every employee should get a fair hearing before being dismissed.
examples.translation_cn: 每位员工在被解雇前都应获得公平的申辩机会。

senses.meaning_en: able to hear, not deaf

examples.text: My cousin is hearing but works as a sign language interpreter.
examples.translation_cn: 我的表妹听力正常，但从事手语翻译工作。

senses.meaning_en: covered in blood or bleeding

examples.text: His nose was bloody and his lip was swollen after the fight.
examples.translation_cn: 打架后他鼻子流血，嘴唇也肿了。

senses.meaning_en: used before a noun to express anger or emphasis

examples.text: You bloody fool—you left the door unlocked again.
examples.translation_cn: 你这个该死的傻瓜——你又没锁门了。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb; very

examples.text: That was a bloody good film; I'd watch it again.
examples.translation_cn: 那是一部非常好的电影，我想再看一遍。

senses.meaning_en: involving a lot of violence and killing

examples.text: The country was torn apart by a bloody civil war.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家被一场血腥的内战弄得四分五裂。

senses.meaning_en: to make an opponent bleed in a fight; to harm or weaken them

examples.text: The boxer bloodied his opponent's nose in the first round.
examples.translation_cn: 那名拳击手在第一回合就把对手的鼻子打出了血。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people buy and drink alcoholic drinks, often with food and entertainment

examples.text: We had a drink at the pub after work.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下班后在酒吧喝了点东西。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of being male or female

examples.text: The study included adult participants of either gender.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究纳入了任一性别的成年参与者。

senses.meaning_en: the social and cultural roles associated with being male, female, etc.

examples.text: Some people identify as a different gender from the one they were assigned at birth.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人认同的性别与出生时被指定的性别不同。

senses.meaning_en: a grammatical category of nouns, pronouns, etc.

examples.text: In Spanish, adjectives must agree in gender with the nouns they modify.
examples.translation_cn: 在西班牙语中，形容词必须与其修饰的名词在性上保持一致。

senses.meaning_en: a group of words containing a subject and a verb, forming part of a sentence

examples.text: A complex sentence contains at least one main clause and one subordinate clause.
examples.translation_cn: 一个复合句至少包含一个主句和一个从句。

senses.meaning_en: a particular part of a legal document, such as a contract or law

examples.text: The clause in the contract allows either party to end the agreement early.
examples.translation_cn: 合同中的条款允许任何一方提前终止协议。

senses.meaning_en: the reporting of an event or topic in the media

examples.text: The media coverage of the protest was surprisingly balanced.
examples.translation_cn: 媒体对这次抗议的报道出乎意料地均衡。

senses.meaning_en: the protection provided by an insurance policy

examples.text: The policy offers coverage against fire and theft.
examples.translation_cn: 这份保单提供火灾和失窃的承保范围。

senses.meaning_en: the area where a mobile phone or radio can receive a signal, or the strength of that signal

examples.text: We can't get mobile coverage in this remote valley.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个偏远的山谷里，手机没有信号覆盖。

senses.meaning_en: the range of subjects or topics included in a course, book, etc.

examples.text: The textbook provides comprehensive coverage of modern history.
examples.translation_cn: 这本教科书对现代历史的涵盖非常全面。

senses.meaning_en: a prize or award that shows respect and admiration

examples.text: She received the nation's highest honor for her scientific research.
examples.translation_cn: 她因科研工作获得了国家最高荣誉。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone a public reward or make them feel proud

examples.text: The university honored her with a lifetime achievement award.
examples.translation_cn: 大学授予她终身成就奖。

senses.meaning_en: to do what you promised or agreed to do

examples.text: The new owners agreed to honor all existing contracts.
examples.translation_cn: 新业主同意履行所有现有合同。

senses.meaning_en: a privilege or special opportunity
senses.pattern: it is an honor to do sth
senses.collocation: have the honor of doing sth

examples.text: It was a great honor to be invited to speak here.
examples.translation_cn: 受邀在此发言是极大的荣幸。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that brings respect and pride to others

examples.text: She is an honor to her family and community.
examples.translation_cn: 她是家庭和社区的骄傲。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of data organized for fast access, especially by computer

examples.text: You can search the database for any customer by name.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以按姓名在数据库中搜索任何客户。

senses.meaning_en: a software program for storing, retrieving, and managing data
senses.pattern: use a database to do sth

examples.text: We use a database to manage all our customer orders.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用数据库软件管理所有客户订单。

senses.meaning_en: help or aid

examples.text: She offered me assistance with my visa application.
examples.translation_cn: 她为我的签证申请提供了帮助。

senses.meaning_en: to officially charge someone with a crime in court

examples.text: The police decided to prosecute the driver for dangerous driving.
examples.translation_cn: 警方决定以危险驾驶罪起诉该司机。

senses.meaning_en: to continue to carry out an activity or task

examples.text: The organization will prosecute a campaign for educational reform.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织将开展一场教育改革运动。

senses.meaning_en: a lawyer who prosecutes criminal cases on behalf of the state

examples.text: She works as a prosecutor in the district court.
examples.translation_cn: 她在地区法院担任检察官。

senses.meaning_en: a plan or list of matters to be dealt with

examples.text: Climate change is on the agenda for tomorrow's meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 气候变化被列入明天会议的议程。

senses.meaning_en: an ulterior motive or hidden purpose

examples.text: He had an agenda when he offered to help.
examples.translation_cn: 他主动提出帮忙时另有企图。

senses.meaning_en: a set of policies or issues to be addressed, especially in politics

examples.text: The party has set the agenda for the election.
examples.translation_cn: 该党为这次选举设定了议题。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that holds something

examples.text: She bought a holder for her kitchen knives.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一个放厨房刀具的架子。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns or possesses something

examples.text: He is the holder of a valid driver's license.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一张有效驾照的持有人。

senses.meaning_en: the defending champion

examples.text: She is the holder of the women's singles title.
examples.translation_cn: 她是女子单打冠军头衔的保持者。

senses.meaning_en: to get, buy, or obtain something, especially drugs or something wanted

examples.text: She copped two concert tickets online last week.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周在网上买了两张音乐会门票。

senses.meaning_en: to receive or be forced to accept something unpleasant, especially blame or punishment

examples.text: He copped the blame for a mistake his assistant made.
examples.translation_cn: 他替助手犯的错误背了黑锅。

senses.meaning_en: a police officer

examples.text: A cop stopped me for speeding on the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 一名警察在高速公路上因超速拦下了我。

senses.meaning_en: to steal something

examples.text: He copped a wallet from the table when no one was looking.
examples.translation_cn: 趁着没人注意，他从桌上偷了一个钱包。

senses.meaning_en: to move back or away

examples.text: After days of rain, the floodwaters slowly receded from the fields.
examples.translation_cn: 下了几天雨后，洪水慢慢地从田野退去。

senses.meaning_en: to move back from the forehead as hair thins

examples.text: His hair began to recede at the temples in his early thirties.
examples.translation_cn: 他三十出头时鬓角发际线开始后移。

senses.meaning_en: to become weaker or less clear

examples.text: As the years passed, the painful memories slowly receded into the background.
examples.translation_cn: 随着岁月流逝，痛苦的记忆慢慢变得模糊。

senses.meaning_en: the head of a university, especially in the US

examples.text: The chancellor of the university approved the new research fund.
examples.translation_cn: 大学校长批准了新的研究基金。

senses.meaning_en: the head of government in Germany or Austria

examples.text: The German Chancellor met the French president in Brussels.
examples.translation_cn: 德国总理在布鲁塞尔会见了法国总统。

senses.meaning_en: the British government minister responsible for finance

examples.text: The Chancellor of the Exchequer will deliver the annual budget next week.
examples.translation_cn: 财政大臣将于下周公布年度预算。

senses.meaning_en: an opening or gap in a wall, barrier, or defence

examples.text: Water poured through a breach in the dam wall.
examples.translation_cn: 水从大坝墙上的裂口涌出。

senses.meaning_en: an act of breaking a law, promise, agreement, or rule

examples.text: The company was sued for breach of contract.
examples.translation_cn: 那家公司因违反合同而被起诉。

senses.meaning_en: a break in friendly relations or a difference between groups
senses.pattern: a breach between A and B

examples.text: The argument caused a breach between the two friends.
examples.translation_cn: 那场争吵导致两个朋友之间产生了裂痕。

senses.meaning_en: a boy or young man

examples.text: He's a bright lad of sixteen who loves football.
examples.translation_cn: 他是个聪明的十六岁小伙子，热爱足球。

senses.meaning_en: a young man who likes pleasure and avoids responsibility
senses.pattern: be a bit of a lad

examples.text: He was a bit of a lad in his twenties, always out drinking.
examples.translation_cn: 他二十多岁时有点爱玩，总在外面喝酒。

senses.meaning_en: a familiar form of address to a young man

examples.text: Come on, lad, we need to catch the last bus.
examples.translation_cn: 快点，小伙子，我们要赶末班车。

senses.meaning_en: a person who practices a profession, especially law or medicine

examples.text: She works as a legal practitioner specializing in family law.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一名专门处理家庭法的执业律师。

senses.meaning_en: a person who does something regularly as a habit or practice

examples.text: He is a regular practitioner of meditation before work.
examples.translation_cn: 他习惯在工作前冥想。

senses.meaning_en: a series of games or matches to decide a winner

examples.text: Several local teams will compete in a tournament this Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 几支当地球队将在本周六参加锦标赛。

senses.meaning_en: fame; renown

examples.text: He achieved celebrity as a singer in his early twenties.
examples.translation_cn: 他二十出头时作为歌手获得了名声。

senses.meaning_en: a famous person

examples.text: The young chef became a celebrity after appearing on the cooking show.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻厨师在烹饪节目中露面后成了名人。

senses.meaning_en: a rule or principle that gives guidance on how to act or behave

examples.text: The school issued new guidelines for dealing with online bullying.
examples.translation_cn: 学校发布了应对网络欺凌的新准则。

senses.meaning_en: a cash payment made by a company to its shareholders

examples.text: The company paid a dividend of two dollars per share.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司支付了每股两美元的股息。

senses.meaning_en: a benefit or advantage from an investment of time or effort

examples.text: All that extra practice paid dividends during the championship.
examples.translation_cn: 所有的额外练习在锦标赛期间带来了回报。

senses.meaning_en: a number that is divided by another number

examples.text: In the expression 15 ÷ 3, the dividend is 15.
examples.translation_cn: 在表达式15 ÷ 3中，被除数是15。

senses.meaning_en: relating to courts of law or the administration of justice

examples.text: The government's decision is subject to judicial review by the High Court.
examples.translation_cn: 政府的决定须接受高等法院的司法审查。

senses.meaning_en: to tell a story or describe a series of events

examples.text: She narrated the whole adventure to her friends at dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 她在晚餐时向朋友们讲述了整个冒险经历。

senses.meaning_en: to provide spoken commentary for a film, documentary, etc.

examples.text: David Attenborough will narrate a documentary about ocean life.
examples.translation_cn: 大卫·爱登堡将为一部关于海洋生命的纪录片作旁白。

senses.meaning_en: machines collectively, especially in industry

examples.text: The factory bought a new piece of heavy machinery.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂购买了一台新的重型机械。

senses.meaning_en: the working parts of a machine as a group

examples.text: She studied the delicate machinery of the antique watch.
examples.translation_cn: 她仔细观察了那座古董表里精密的机件。

senses.meaning_en: the organization or structure of something

examples.text: The government set up new machinery for handling appeals.
examples.translation_cn: 政府设立了处理申诉的新机构。

senses.meaning_en: located in or relating to the main business area of a city

examples.text: Her company is located in the downtown area.
examples.translation_cn: 她的公司位于市中心地区。

senses.meaning_en: in or towards the main business area of a city

examples.text: Let's go downtown for dinner and a movie tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今晚去市中心吃晚饭看电影吧。

senses.meaning_en: the main business area of a city

examples.text: The museum is in the heart of downtown.
examples.translation_cn: 这座博物馆位于市中心核心区。

senses.meaning_en: the particular taste of a food or drink

examples.text: This ice cream has a rich strawberry flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 这种冰淇淋有浓郁的草莓味。

senses.meaning_en: a distinctive quality or atmosphere

examples.text: They designed the hotel with a Scandinavian flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把酒店设计成斯堪的纳维亚风格。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used to give food a particular taste

examples.text: This brand of yogurt contains no artificial flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 这个牌子的酸奶不含人工香精。

senses.meaning_en: to add seasoning or spices to food

examples.text: Flavor the soup with fresh herbs before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前用新鲜香草给汤调味。

senses.meaning_en: a thin, flat, circular plate or object

examples.text: She cut the cucumber into thin discs for the salad.
examples.translation_cn: 她把黄瓜切成薄圆片做沙拉。

senses.meaning_en: a flat, round storage device such as a CD or hard disk

examples.text: The whole dictionary is stored on a single compact disc.
examples.translation_cn: 整本词典存储在一张光盘上。

senses.meaning_en: a pad of cartilage between two bones in the spine

examples.text: He was off work for two weeks after suffering from a slipped disc.
examples.translation_cn: 他因椎间盘突出休息了两周。

senses.meaning_en: to introduce new ideas or methods

examples.text: Successful companies must constantly innovate to remain competitive.
examples.translation_cn: 成功的公司必须不断创新以保持竞争力。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to cook, especially the head cook in a restaurant or hotel

examples.text: She works as a chef in a French restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家法国餐厅当厨师。

senses.meaning_en: to treat a person or group differently, especially unfairly, based on race, sex, age, etc.

examples.text: Companies must not discriminate against job applicants by gender.
examples.translation_cn: 公司不得因性别歧视求职者。

senses.meaning_en: to recognize or show the difference between things

examples.text: You need to learn to discriminate between reliable and unreliable sources.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要学会区分可靠和不可靠的信息来源。

senses.meaning_en: to make a loud deep resonant sound

examples.text: Thunder boomed across the valley late last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚深夜雷声在山谷中轰鸣。

senses.meaning_en: to grow or increase rapidly

examples.text: Online shopping has been booming since last year.
examples.translation_cn: 自去年以来，网上购物一直蓬勃发展。

senses.meaning_en: to say something in a loud deep voice

examples.text: The officer boomed out the command to stop.
examples.translation_cn: 警官用低沉有力的声音喊出了停下的命令。

senses.meaning_en: an official examination of accounts or records

examples.text: The bank conducted an audit of its loan records.
examples.translation_cn: 银行对其贷款记录进行了审计。

senses.meaning_en: to examine accounts or records officially

examples.text: The tax office may audit the company's accounts next year.
examples.translation_cn: 税务局明年可能审计该公司的账目。

senses.meaning_en: to attend a course without taking it for credit

examples.text: She plans to audit a biology course this semester.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划这学期旁听一门生物课。

senses.meaning_en: the natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism

examples.text: The panda lives in its natural habitat in the mountains of China.
examples.translation_cn: 大熊猫生活在中国山区的自然栖息地。

senses.meaning_en: the degree to which something is likely to happen

examples.text: The odds of winning the lottery are extremely low.
examples.translation_cn: 赢得彩票的几率极低。

senses.meaning_en: in disagreement with someone or something

examples.text: The two leaders are at odds with each other over tax policy.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人在税收政策上意见不一。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being human and not living for ever
senses.pattern: be aware of one's own mortality

examples.text: He is suddenly aware of his own mortality after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后他突然意识到自己的必死性。

senses.meaning_en: death, especially the number of deaths in a particular situation or period

examples.text: The mortality rate among children under five has dropped sharply.
examples.translation_cn: 五岁以下儿童的死亡率已大幅下降。

senses.meaning_en: a country formed by a group of states with one central government

examples.text: Australia is a federation of six states and two territories.
examples.translation_cn: 澳大利亚是一个由六个州和两个地区组成的联邦。

senses.meaning_en: an organization formed from separate groups or bodies

examples.text: The association is a federation of over 200 local clubs.
examples.translation_cn: 该协会是一个由200多个地方俱乐部组成的联合会。

senses.meaning_en: the act of joining together into a single political entity

examples.text: The federation of the six colonies was completed in 1901.
examples.translation_cn: 六个殖民地的联邦化于1901年完成。

senses.meaning_en: an island, usually very small

examples.text: They stopped for lunch on an isle in the middle of the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们停在河中央的一个小岛上吃午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to keep, check, or audit financial accounts

examples.text: She works as an accountant for a large technology company in London.
examples.translation_cn: 她在伦敦一家大型科技公司做会计。

senses.meaning_en: the crime of forcing someone to have sex without their consent

examples.text: He was accused of rape and arrested last night.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨晚被指控强奸并被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to have sex without their consent

examples.text: She was brutally raped on her way home last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚在回家路上遭到残忍强奸。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or spoil a place, especially by using its resources badly

examples.text: The logging company has raped the countryside for profit.
examples.translation_cn: 这家伐木公司为了牟利而肆意破坏乡村。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of combining two or more things, especially companies, into a single unit
senses.pattern: the merger of A and B

examples.text: The merger of the two banks created the country's largest lender.
examples.translation_cn: 这两家银行的合并造就了该国最大的贷款机构。

senses.meaning_en: information or a statement that is passed from person to person but may not be true

examples.text: A rumor that the factory would close spread through the town.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂要关闭的谣言传遍了小镇。

senses.meaning_en: to say or spread a rumor about someone or something

examples.text: He is rumored to be leaving the company next month.
examples.translation_cn: 据传他下个月要离开公司。

senses.meaning_en: sparkling white wine

examples.text: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the good news.
examples.translation_cn: 他们打开一瓶香槟来庆祝这个好消息。

senses.meaning_en: a glass of champagne

examples.text: She took a glass of champagne from the waiter's tray.
examples.translation_cn: 她从服务员的托盘上拿了一杯香槟。

senses.meaning_en: a man or boy; a fellow

examples.text: A chap from the garage fixed my car this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 一个汽车修理厂的小伙子今天早上修好了我的车。

senses.meaning_en: to become cracked and rough, especially from cold or dryness

examples.text: My lips chap in cold weather unless I wear lip balm.
examples.translation_cn: 我的嘴唇在寒冷天气里会皲裂，除非我涂润唇膏。

senses.meaning_en: a customer; a buyer

examples.text: The greengrocer stopped to serve a chap in the queue before me.
examples.translation_cn: 蔬菜水果商停下来先招呼排在我前面的一个顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a person who represents their country officially abroad

examples.text: She has served as a diplomat in three countries.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾在三个国家担任外交官。

senses.meaning_en: someone who is good at dealing with people in a sensitive way

examples.text: You have to be a diplomat when you tell someone bad news.
examples.translation_cn: 当你告诉别人坏消息时，你得有点手腕。

senses.meaning_en: very strange or unusual and difficult to explain

examples.text: It is weird that the same song was playing on every radio station.
examples.translation_cn: 每个电台都在放同一首歌，真是奇怪。

senses.meaning_en: to manage or organize the affairs of an organization, project, etc.

examples.text: She administers a small department with a very limited budget.
examples.translation_cn: 她管理着一个预算非常有限的小部门。

senses.meaning_en: to put laws, rules, etc. into effect

examples.text: The judge administers the law fairly in every case.
examples.translation_cn: 法官在每个案件中公正执法。

senses.meaning_en: to give something formally, especially medicine or punishment

examples.text: The nurse administered the vaccine to the patient.
examples.translation_cn: 护士给病人注射了疫苗。

senses.meaning_en: to be responsible for organizing or supervising a ceremony, exam, etc.

examples.text: The school will administer the final exam next week.
examples.translation_cn: 学校下周将举行期末考试。

senses.meaning_en: the opening or passage where a door is; an entrance

examples.text: She stood in the doorway and watched the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 她站在门口看雨。

senses.meaning_en: an economic system based on private ownership of resources and capital for profit

examples.text: Under capitalism, private individuals and businesses own most resources and seek to make a profit.
examples.translation_cn: 在资本主义制度下，私人拥有大部分资源，企业以营利为目的。

senses.meaning_en: the act of pressing a button on a mouse, or the short sharp sound it makes

examples.text: You can open the file with a click of the mouse.
examples.translation_cn: 单击鼠标即可打开文件。

senses.meaning_en: a speech sound made by drawing air into the mouth, used as a consonant in some languages

examples.text: Speakers of Xhosa use three different click consonants in everyday speech.
examples.translation_cn: 科萨语使用者日常说话时使用三种不同的搭嘴音。

senses.meaning_en: a single instance of content on the Internet being accessed

examples.text: Her blog post received over a million clicks on a single link.
examples.translation_cn: 她的博客文章在一个链接上获得了超过一百万次点击。

senses.meaning_en: to suddenly become clear or understood

examples.text: Everything clicked into place when she explained the problem.
examples.translation_cn: 当她解释完问题，一切恍然大悟。

senses.meaning_en: to become friendly or popular with someone, or to work well together

examples.text: She clicked with her new roommate on the first day.
examples.translation_cn: 她和新室友第一天就很合得来。

senses.meaning_en: an act of collecting a person or people in a vehicle

examples.text: The hotel arranges pickup of guests from the station.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店安排到车站接客人。

senses.meaning_en: a light truck with an open back

examples.text: He drove an old pickup truck to the farm.
examples.translation_cn: 他开着一辆旧皮卡车去了农场。

senses.meaning_en: the act of collecting something ordered or left somewhere

examples.text: The supermarket now offers free order pickup for online shoppers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家超市现在为网购顾客提供免费订单自提。

senses.meaning_en: an improvement, especially in economic activity

examples.text: The company reported a pickup in sales last month.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司报告上月销售额有所回升。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body below the chest; the stomach

examples.text: After the big meal, he patted his belly and smiled.
examples.translation_cn: 大餐之后，他拍了拍肚子，笑了。

senses.meaning_en: the underside of an aircraft or ship

examples.text: The mechanic checked the belly of the plane for damage.
examples.translation_cn: 机械师检查了飞机腹部是否有损坏。

senses.meaning_en: a child's toy in the shape of a person

examples.text: She often lets her daughter play with a doll before bath time.
examples.translation_cn: 她经常让女儿在洗澡前玩娃娃。

senses.meaning_en: an attractive young woman

examples.text: She's a real doll in that red dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着那条红裙子，真是个美人。

senses.meaning_en: a kind and helpful person
senses.pattern: be a doll and do sth

examples.text: Could you be a doll and pass me the salt?
examples.translation_cn: 劳驾，把盐递给我好吗？

senses.meaning_en: to dress someone up in an attractive or stylish way

examples.text: She dolled herself up before going to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她去参加聚会前把自己打扮得漂漂亮亮。

senses.meaning_en: a substance in foods such as sugar and bread that provides the body with energy

examples.text: Foods that are rich in carbohydrates give you energy for exercise.
examples.translation_cn: 富含碳水化合物的食物能为你提供运动所需的能量。

senses.meaning_en: foods that are rich in starch or other carbohydrates

examples.text: She is trying to cut down on carbohydrates before the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 她正努力在婚礼前减少碳水化合物的摄入。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being redundant; something that is unnecessary or repeated

examples.text: The editor removed all redundancy in the final draft.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑删除了终稿中的所有冗余内容。

senses.meaning_en: a situation in which someone loses their job because their work is no longer needed

examples.text: Hundreds of employees are at risk of redundancy after the merger.
examples.translation_cn: 合并后，数百名员工面临裁员风险。

senses.meaning_en: the right or condition of self-government; freedom to act or function independently

examples.text: The central government granted full autonomy to the region in 1998.
examples.translation_cn: 中央政府于1998年给予该地区完全自治权。

senses.meaning_en: the capacity to make an informed, uncoerced decision

examples.text: Doctors must respect their patients' autonomy when discussing treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在讨论治疗方案时必须尊重病人的自主权。

senses.meaning_en: a word or phrase used to describe something by comparing it to something else, or the use of such comparisons

examples.text: The novel is a metaphor for the immigrant experience.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说是移民经历的隐喻。

senses.meaning_en: a familiar object or idea used in computer design to represent a function or process

examples.text: Many apps use the metaphor of a desktop to organize files.
examples.translation_cn: 许多应用程序使用桌面隐喻来组织文件。

senses.meaning_en: the driver's compartment in a truck or train
senses.pattern: in the cab of the truck

examples.text: The driver sat in the cab of the truck.
examples.translation_cn: 司机坐在卡车驾驶室里。

senses.meaning_en: a taxi

examples.text: We took a cab to the airport to catch our flight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们乘出租车去机场赶飞机。

senses.meaning_en: a time or date by which something must be completed

examples.text: She stayed up late to meet a deadline at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她熬夜以赶上工作中的截止日期。

senses.meaning_en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings or necklaces

examples.text: She bought a piece of jewelry as a birthday gift.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一件首饰作为生日礼物。

senses.meaning_en: not religious; civil rather than clerical

examples.text: The state became officially secular after the 1923 revolution.
examples.translation_cn: 1923年革命后，该国正式成为世俗国家。

senses.meaning_en: developing or changing gradually over a long period

examples.text: The industry has been in secular decline for two decades.
examples.translation_cn: 这个行业二十年来一直处于长期衰退中。

senses.meaning_en: a secret agreement between people to do something illegal or harmful

examples.text: He was charged with conspiracy to defraud his employers.
examples.translation_cn: 他被控密谋诈骗雇主。

senses.meaning_en: the bones of the head considered as a unit

examples.text: He fell from the ladder and fractured his skull.
examples.translation_cn: 他从梯子上摔下来，颅骨骨折。

senses.meaning_en: these bones as a symbol of death

examples.text: The bottle was marked with a skull and crossbones.
examples.translation_cn: 这个瓶子上标有骷髅和交叉骨图案。

senses.meaning_en: the mind or brain, especially when thinking

examples.text: He can't get it into his skull that the war is over.
examples.translation_cn: 他脑子里就是无法明白战争已经结束。

senses.meaning_en: a mass of abnormal cells in or on the body

examples.text: Doctors found a tumour in his brain last week.
examples.translation_cn: 医生上周在他的大脑里发现了一个肿瘤。

senses.meaning_en: a pattern of signs and symptoms, especially of a disease or psychological condition

examples.text: The patient was diagnosed with chronic fatigue syndrome last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这位患者去年被诊断出慢性疲劳综合征。

senses.meaning_en: a set of characteristics or behaviours typical of a particular type, group, or situation, often negative

examples.text: Low morale and high turnover are a common syndrome among overworked teams.
examples.translation_cn: 士气低落和高员工流失是工作过度团队的典型表现。

senses.meaning_en: a set of related things

examples.text: The new model comes with a full suite of safety features.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新车型配备了一整套安全功能。

senses.meaning_en: a set of connected rooms, especially in a hotel

examples.text: They booked a hotel suite overlooking the ocean for their anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为纪念日预订了一间海景酒店套房。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of music consisting of several short related pieces

examples.text: Bach composed a famous suite for solo cello.
examples.translation_cn: 巴赫创作了一部著名的独奏大提琴组曲。

senses.meaning_en: a group of related computer programs distributed together

examples.text: She installed an office suite on her laptop.
examples.translation_cn: 她在笔记本电脑上安装了一个办公软件套件。

senses.meaning_en: to remove the internal organs of an animal or fish; to destroy the inside of a building

examples.text: The fire gutted the old factory in under an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 大火不到一小时就烧毁了旧工厂的内部。

senses.meaning_en: the tube in the body through which food passes; the internal organs

examples.text: Healthy bacteria in the gut help digest food.
examples.translation_cn: 肠道中的健康细菌帮助消化食物。

senses.meaning_en: courage and determination

examples.text: She had the guts to tell the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 她有说出真相的勇气。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling or reaction based on instinct rather than reason

examples.text: Always trust your gut when something feels wrong.
examples.translation_cn: 当感觉不对劲时，始终相信你的直觉。

senses.meaning_en: a person's abdomen, especially when large

examples.text: He's developed quite a gut since he stopped running.
examples.translation_cn: 他自从停止跑步后长出了相当明显的肚腩。

senses.meaning_en: a powerful addictive drug used illegally as a stimulant and sometimes medically as a local anesthetic

examples.text: He is addicted to cocaine and needs professional help.
examples.translation_cn: 他对可卡因上瘾，需要专业帮助。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for information

examples.text: She called the hotel to enquire about room availability.
examples.translation_cn: 她打电话给酒店询问房间是否有空。

senses.meaning_en: to investigate something officially

examples.text: The committee will enquire into the causes of the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将调查事故的原因。

senses.meaning_en: a public sale where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder

examples.text: The painting was sold at auction for over a million dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画在拍卖会上以超过一百万美元的价格售出。

senses.meaning_en: to sell something at an auction

examples.text: The company's remaining assets will be auctioned off on Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 公司剩余的资产将在周五被拍卖。

senses.meaning_en: a set of clothes worn together

examples.text: She arrived in an outfit that looked expensive.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一套看起来很贵的衣服到了。

senses.meaning_en: a set of equipment or tools for a particular purpose

examples.text: He bought a complete camping outfit for the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 他为这次旅行买了一套完整的露营装备。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people working together; a business or sports team

examples.text: She runs an outfit that sells handmade bags.
examples.translation_cn: 她经营一家卖手工包的店。

senses.meaning_en: to supply with equipment or clothing

examples.text: The lab outfitted each station with new computers.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室为每个工位配备了新电脑。

senses.meaning_en: useless physical things to be discarded; rubbish

examples.text: Please take out the trash before you go to bed.
examples.translation_cn: 请睡前把垃圾拿出去。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize someone or something very strongly

examples.text: Critics trashed the director's new film for its weak plot.
examples.translation_cn: 评论家猛烈批评了那位导演的新片，认为其情节薄弱。

senses.meaning_en: to damage or destroy something, especially in a violent way

examples.text: The band trashed the hotel room after the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 演唱会结束后，乐队把酒店房间砸得一团糟。

senses.meaning_en: something worthless or of poor quality; nonsense

examples.text: The movie was trash, but the special effects were impressive.
examples.translation_cn: 那部电影很糟糕，但特效很棒。

senses.meaning_en: a dubious assertion, especially one that is untrue or boastful

examples.text: He was talking trash to his opponent before the game.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛前他一直在对对手说挑衅和吹嘘的话。

senses.meaning_en: the row of bones in the back that surrounds the spinal cord

examples.text: The doctor noticed a slight curve in her spine during the check-up.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在检查时注意到她的脊柱有轻微弯曲。

senses.meaning_en: the narrow edge of a book where the pages are attached
senses.pattern: on the spine of a book

examples.text: The author's name is printed on the spine of the book.
examples.translation_cn: 作者的名字印在书的书脊上。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp pointed part on a plant or animal

examples.text: The cactus is covered in sharp spines to protect itself from animals.
examples.translation_cn: 仙人掌长满尖刺以保护自己免受动物侵害。

senses.meaning_en: courage or strength of character

examples.text: She finally had the spine to tell him the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于鼓起勇气告诉他真相。

senses.meaning_en: the intestines, especially the large intestine

examples.text: A blockage in the large bowel can cause severe pain.
examples.translation_cn: 大肠堵塞会引起剧烈疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: the deep interior of something, especially when hidden or hard to reach

examples.text: They explored the bowels of the old mine.
examples.translation_cn: 他们探索了旧矿的深处。

senses.meaning_en: the hair above each eye

examples.text: She plucks her eyebrows every two weeks to keep them neat.
examples.translation_cn: 她每两周拔一次眉毛，让它们保持整洁。

senses.meaning_en: a passage between rows of seats or shelves, especially in a plane, theatre, or supermarket

examples.text: Passengers were asked not to stand in the aisle during takeoff.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客被要求起飞时不要站在过道上。

senses.meaning_en: a side section of a church, separated from the nave by pillars

examples.text: The choir sits in the side aisle of the cathedral.
examples.translation_cn: 唱诗班坐在大教堂的侧廊。

senses.meaning_en: to make a device, system, or process start working

examples.text: You can activate the system from your phone.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用手机激活这个系统。

senses.meaning_en: to set off an alarm, mechanism, etc.

examples.text: The alarm is activated by opening the door.
examples.translation_cn: 门一打开警报就会触发。

senses.meaning_en: to make a chemical or biological process more active

examples.text: This enzyme is activated by heat and speeds up the chemical reaction.
examples.translation_cn: 这种酶受热后被激活，并加速化学反应。

senses.meaning_en: the practice or state of obeying a rule, law, or request

examples.text: The factory operates in compliance with environmental laws.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂的运营符合环境法。

senses.meaning_en: the tendency to agree with or give in to the wishes of others

examples.text: Blind compliance with the group's wishes discourages independent thought.
examples.translation_cn: 盲目顺从群体的意愿会阻碍独立思考。

senses.meaning_en: the act of doing what someone wants you to do, especially unwillingly

examples.text: The fearful employees were forced into compliance with the manager's demands.
examples.translation_cn: 惊恐的员工被迫顺从经理的要求。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to 1,000 metres

examples.text: The hotel is only a few kilometres from the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆离机场只有几公里。

senses.meaning_en: a place where dead people are buried

examples.text: Many old soldiers are buried in this cemetery.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老兵葬在这个墓地里。

senses.meaning_en: to annoy or bother someone repeatedly, often over a period of time

examples.text: The reporters kept harassing the actor about his private life.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们不停地就私生活问题骚扰那名演员。

senses.meaning_en: to trouble someone or a group of people through repeated military-style attacks

examples.text: Guerrilla fighters harassed enemy supply lines throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 游击队员整夜袭扰敌军补给线。

senses.meaning_en: persistent attacks, criticism, or intimidation causing worry and distress

examples.text: The company introduced a policy to prevent the harassment of female employees.
examples.translation_cn: 公司出台了一项政策，以防止对女性员工的骚扰。

senses.meaning_en: the use of repeated small-scale attacks to wear down an enemy force

examples.text: The general viewed the harassment of enemy forces as a key strategy.
examples.translation_cn: 将军将骚扰敌军视为一项关键策略。

senses.meaning_en: money paid for using a road, bridge, etc.

examples.text: You have to pay a toll to cross the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 过这座桥必须交费。

senses.meaning_en: loss or damage caused by something

examples.text: Years of war took a heavy toll on the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 多年战争给经济造成了巨大损失。

senses.meaning_en: to ring slowly with a single note

examples.text: The church bell tolled for the victims of the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 教堂的钟为火灾遇难者而鸣响。

senses.meaning_en: an official limit on the number or amount of something

examples.text: The government imposed a quota on imported steel to protect local producers.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对进口钢铁实施配额以保护本地生产商。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed amount or number that someone is expected to achieve

examples.text: Sales staff have to meet a monthly quota of new clients.
examples.translation_cn: 销售人员必须每月完成新客户定额。

senses.meaning_en: a number of places reserved for a particular group

examples.text: The university reserves a quota for students from rural areas.
examples.translation_cn: 该大学为农村学生保留名额。

senses.meaning_en: a legume resembling a nut

examples.text: Many farmers grow peanuts in this warm region.
examples.translation_cn: 许多农民在这个温暖的地区种植花生。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount of money

examples.text: Many young interns work for peanuts every day.
examples.translation_cn: 许多年轻实习生每天为微薄的薪水工作。

senses.meaning_en: the body of people ordained for religious service

examples.text: Several members of the clergy attended the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 几位神职人员出席了仪式。

senses.meaning_en: to talk in a friendly informal way

examples.text: We chatted with our neighbors about the new park.
examples.translation_cn: 我们和邻居聊了聊新公园。

senses.meaning_en: an informal conversation

examples.text: I had a quick chat with my boss after the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会后我和老板简短聊了几句。

senses.meaning_en: a real-time exchange of online messages

examples.text: She explained the error in a group chat.
examples.translation_cn: 她在群聊中解释了那个错误。

senses.meaning_en: to exchange text or voice messages in real time through a computer network

examples.text: She chats with her cousins online every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周日都和表亲在网上聊天。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to theology

examples.text: The debate raised a theological question about human suffering.
examples.translation_cn: 这场辩论提出了一个关于人类苦难的神学问题。

senses.meaning_en: a small book with information or advertisements

examples.text: The hotel sent us a brochure about local attractions.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店给我们寄了一本当地景点的小册子。

senses.meaning_en: historical documents or the place where they are kept

examples.text: The original treaty is preserved in the archives.
examples.translation_cn: 原始条约保存在档案馆里。

senses.meaning_en: to store documents or records in an archive

examples.text: The system automatically archives all incoming emails after thirty days.
examples.translation_cn: 系统会在三十天后自动归档所有收到的电子邮件。

senses.meaning_en: a woman who is getting married or has just got married

examples.text: The bride-to-be spent hours choosing her wedding dress.
examples.translation_cn: 那位准新娘花了几个小时挑选她的婚纱。

senses.meaning_en: a person's life story, especially one published

examples.text: She has just published a biography of Winston Churchill.
examples.translation_cn: 她刚刚出版了一本温斯顿·丘吉尔的传记。

senses.meaning_en: the art of writing biographies

examples.text: He studied biography as a literary genre at university.
examples.translation_cn: 他在大学学习传记这一文学体裁。

senses.meaning_en: strong and forceful; making you feel you must do something
senses.pattern: feel a compelling need to do

examples.text: He felt a compelling need to explain his decision.
examples.translation_cn: 他感到一股强烈的需要去解释他的决定。

senses.meaning_en: capable of making someone believe or agree

examples.text: The lawyer made a compelling argument for his client.
examples.translation_cn: 律师为他的当事人提出了令人信服的论点。

senses.meaning_en: holding your attention; very interesting

examples.text: I found the novel compelling and read it in one sitting.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得这部小说引人入胜，一口气读完了。

senses.meaning_en: a poisonous gas with a sharp smell that is formed from oxygen and is present in the upper atmosphere as a protective layer

examples.text: Ozone in the ozone layer blocks most harmful ultraviolet radiation.
examples.translation_cn: 臭氧层中的臭氧阻挡了大部分有害的紫外线辐射。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical element (symbol Ca) that is needed for strong bones and teeth

examples.text: Milk is rich in calcium and helps build strong bones.
examples.translation_cn: 牛奶富含钙，有助于强健骨骼。

senses.meaning_en: a person who doubts claims or beliefs accepted by others

examples.text: He is a skeptic about the government's claims.
examples.translation_cn: 他对政府的说法持怀疑态度。

senses.meaning_en: deep sympathy for someone who is suffering, often with a desire to help

examples.text: The doctor had compassion for the injured child and stayed late to treat her.
examples.translation_cn: 医生对受伤的孩子深表同情，留下来治疗她到很晚。

senses.meaning_en: a lockable storage compartment for personal belongings

examples.text: Put your valuables in a locker before you go swimming.
examples.translation_cn: 去游泳前把你的贵重物品放进储物柜。

senses.meaning_en: exceptionally beautiful or attractive

examples.text: The bride looked stunning in her white dress.
examples.translation_cn: 新娘穿着白色婚纱显得极美。

senses.meaning_en: having an effect that stuns; causing great surprise or shock

examples.text: The news of his resignation came as a stunning blow to the company.
examples.translation_cn: 他辞职的消息对公司来说是一个令人震惊的打击。

senses.meaning_en: amazing; wonderfully good

examples.text: The team delivered a stunning performance to win the championship.
examples.translation_cn: 该队表现出色，赢得了冠军。

senses.meaning_en: to be successful and thrive, especially in business or economy

examples.text: Many small businesses continue to prosper in this region.
examples.translation_cn: 许多小企业在这个地区持续兴旺。

senses.meaning_en: a short written note or message

examples.text: She sent a memo about the new policy to all staff.
examples.translation_cn: 她向全体员工发送了一份关于新政策的备忘录。

senses.meaning_en: to record something or send someone a note

examples.text: He memoed the key decisions to the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 他把关键决定以备忘录形式发送给了整个团队。

senses.meaning_en: to recognize or show the difference between things

examples.text: Children gradually learn to differentiate between fact and opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们逐渐学会区分事实和观点。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something appear different
senses.collocation: differentiate a brand from its rivals

examples.text: The company uses a distinctive logo to differentiate its brand from rivals.
examples.translation_cn: 公司使用独特的标志使其品牌区别于竞争对手。

senses.meaning_en: a formal agreement between people, groups, or countries

examples.text: The two companies signed a pact with local farmers to buy grain at a fair price.
examples.translation_cn: 两家公司与当地农民签订了以公平价格收购粮食的协议。

senses.meaning_en: an alliance or coalition

examples.text: Several small parties formed a pact against the ruling coalition to win more seats.
examples.translation_cn: 几个小党派结成联盟反对执政联盟以赢得更多席位。

senses.meaning_en: an official count of the population of a country, usually carried out at regular intervals

examples.text: The government takes a census of the entire population every ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 政府每十年对全体人口进行一次人口普查。

senses.meaning_en: an official count or survey of a particular group or number of things, such as patients or traffic
senses.pattern: carry out a census of sth

examples.text: The city council carried out a census of local traffic last month.
examples.translation_cn: 市议会上个月对当地交通进行了一次统计调查。

senses.meaning_en: a typical or perfect example of something

examples.text: Her career is a paradigm of dedication and hard work.
examples.translation_cn: 她的事业是奉献和勤奋的典范。

senses.meaning_en: a set of all the different forms of a word

examples.text: The paradigm of the verb 'go' includes go, went, and gone.
examples.translation_cn: 动词 go 的词形变化表包括 go、went 和 gone。

senses.meaning_en: a model or framework of ideas or methods

examples.text: The internet brought a paradigm shift in how people communicate.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网带来了人们交流方式的范式转变。

senses.meaning_en: a picture or pattern made by arranging small colored pieces of stone, tile, or glass

examples.text: The villa's entrance is decorated with a mosaic of colored tiles.
examples.translation_cn: 别墅入口处装饰着彩色瓷砖拼成的马赛克。

senses.meaning_en: a pixelated effect used to hide part of an image, especially to protect a person's identity

examples.text: They put a mosaic over his face to conceal his identity.
examples.translation_cn: 他们给他的脸打上马赛克以隐藏其身份。

senses.meaning_en: a combination of diverse elements forming a unified whole

examples.text: The neighborhood is a mosaic of cultures and customs.
examples.translation_cn: 这个街区是各种文化和习俗的组合体。

senses.meaning_en: to join the armed forces

examples.text: Her brother enlisted in the army after high school.
examples.translation_cn: 她哥哥高中毕业后参军了。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade others to help or support you; to obtain help, support, etc.

examples.text: The charity enlisted local volunteers to distribute food.
examples.translation_cn: 这家慈善机构争取当地志愿者分发食物。

senses.meaning_en: young; not fully developed

examples.text: The rate of juvenile crime has fallen sharply in recent years.
examples.translation_cn: 近年来，青少年犯罪率大幅下降。

senses.meaning_en: characteristic of youth or immaturity; childish

examples.text: His behaviour was juvenile and embarrassed everyone at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他的行为很幼稚，让会议上的每个人都感到尴尬。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is not yet an adult; a minor

examples.text: As a juvenile, he was tried in a special court.
examples.translation_cn: 他未成年时在一个特别法庭受审。

senses.meaning_en: amusing or humorous

examples.text: She always manages to see the comic side of office problems.
examples.translation_cn: 她总能从办公室问题中看到滑稽的一面。

senses.meaning_en: connected with comedy as a genre or style

examples.text: He played a comic role in a production of Shakespeare's comedy As You Like It.
examples.translation_cn: 他在莎士比亚喜剧《皆大欢喜》中扮演了一个喜剧角色。

senses.meaning_en: a story told in drawing sequences; a comic book

examples.text: She enjoys reading comics on the bus to work.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在上班的公交车上看漫画。

senses.meaning_en: a comedian

examples.text: He works as a stand-up comic in small clubs.
examples.translation_cn: 他在小俱乐部当单口喜剧演员。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade someone to do something by offering something attractive

examples.text: The ads lure young people into spending too much.
examples.translation_cn: 这些广告引诱年轻人过度消费。

senses.meaning_en: the quality or thing that attracts people
senses.collocation: resist the lure of social media

examples.text: The lure of city life draws many young people to Beijing.
examples.translation_cn: 城市生活的诱惑力吸引许多年轻人去北京。

senses.meaning_en: an artificial bait used to catch fish

examples.text: He tied a fishing lure to the end of the line.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一个钓鱼诱饵系在线的末端。

senses.meaning_en: to be likely to happen soon, especially something worrying

examples.text: With the deadline looming ahead, the team worked through the night.
examples.translation_cn: 随着截止日期迫近，团队通宵工作。

senses.meaning_en: to appear as a large, unclear shape, especially from a distance or in darkness

examples.text: A dark castle loomed out of the mist.
examples.translation_cn: 一座黑色城堡从雾中隐约耸现。

senses.meaning_en: a machine for weaving cloth

examples.text: She weaves cotton scarves on a wooden hand loom.
examples.translation_cn: 她在木制手工织布机上织棉围巾。

senses.meaning_en: a woman with magical powers, often evil
senses.pattern: be accused of being a witch

examples.text: Many innocent women were accused of being witches during the trials.
examples.translation_cn: 许多无辜妇女在审判中被指控为女巫。

senses.meaning_en: a person who follows Wicca or a similar modern pagan religion

examples.text: She identifies as a witch and practises Wicca.
examples.translation_cn: 她自称女巫，信奉威卡教。

senses.meaning_en: an unpleasant or ugly old woman, used as an insult

examples.text: He called his neighbour an old witch after the argument.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵后，他骂邻居是个老巫婆。

senses.meaning_en: to say sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem

examples.text: He apologised to his teacher for being late.
examples.translation_cn: 他因迟到向老师道歉。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand, or thinking clearly

examples.text: She explained the procedure with clarity and confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 她清晰而自信地解释了流程。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being clear and transparent, especially of liquids or images

examples.text: The clarity of the water astonished the new divers.
examples.translation_cn: 水的清澈让新潜水员们惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being easy to hear

examples.text: From the back row, we could hear every syllable with surprising clarity.
examples.translation_cn: 在后排，我们能异常清晰地听到每一个音节。

senses.meaning_en: a container for rubbish or waste

examples.text: Please put the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
examples.translation_cn: 请把空瓶子放进回收箱。

senses.meaning_en: a large container used for storing things

examples.text: We store spare blankets in a large storage bin under the bed.
examples.translation_cn: 我们把备用的毯子放在床下的大储物箱里。

senses.meaning_en: to throw away, especially by putting in a bin

examples.text: Don't bin that receipt; you might need it later.
examples.translation_cn: 别把那张收据扔掉，你以后可能用得着。

senses.meaning_en: connected with drawing or visual representation

examples.text: My sister works in graphic design at a tech company.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在一家科技公司从事平面设计工作。

senses.meaning_en: clear and detailed, especially about sex or violence

examples.text: The report describes the crash in graphic detail.
examples.translation_cn: 报告以逼真的细节描述了这起事故。

senses.meaning_en: a drawing or picture, often used for explanation or display

examples.text: The page includes a graphic of the human heart.
examples.translation_cn: 这页含有人类心脏的图形。

senses.meaning_en: a computer-generated image, especially on a screen

examples.text: Many video games now use computer graphics to create realistic scenes.
examples.translation_cn: 许多电子游戏现在使用计算机图形来创建逼真的场景。

senses.meaning_en: the position in which you hold your body when standing or sitting

examples.text: He has good posture even when he is tired.
examples.translation_cn: 即使累了，他也保持良好的姿势。

senses.meaning_en: an attitude or position on an issue

examples.text: The government adopted a tough posture on illegal immigration.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对非法移民采取了强硬立场。

senses.meaning_en: to behave in a way intended to impress or deceive others

examples.text: He postured for the cameras, pretending to be a hero.
examples.translation_cn: 他在镜头前装模作样，假装自己是英雄。

senses.meaning_en: unexpected and often amusing because it is the opposite of what you expected

examples.text: It is ironic that the fire station burned down during a safety inspection.
examples.translation_cn: 消防站在安全检查期间被烧毁，真是讽刺。

senses.meaning_en: showing that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying

examples.text: He praised my cooking in an ironic tone that made everyone laugh.
examples.translation_cn: 他用挖苦的语气夸我做的饭，逗得大家都笑了。

senses.meaning_en: used as a polite form of address or title for a French-speaking woman

examples.text: Madame Roux gave an inspiring lecture on modern French poetry.
examples.translation_cn: 鲁女士做了一场关于现代法国诗歌的启发式讲座。

senses.meaning_en: the legal right to control the copying and distribution of a work

examples.text: The author holds the copyright to her first novel.
examples.translation_cn: 这位作者拥有她第一部小说的版权。

senses.meaning_en: to secure copyright for a work

examples.text: Many authors copyright their work before sharing it online.
examples.translation_cn: 许多作者在网上分享作品前会为其取得版权。

senses.meaning_en: to fill the mind of someone continually

examples.text: She has been obsessed with collecting vintage stamps since childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她从小就痴迷于收集复古邮票。

senses.meaning_en: to think or talk about something all the time

examples.text: He tends to obsess over every small mistake he makes.
examples.translation_cn: 他往往会纠结于自己犯的每一个小错误。

senses.meaning_en: a fixture attached to a wall to hold up a shelf

examples.text: The shelf is mounted on a wall bracket above the sink.
examples.translation_cn: 这个架子安装在洗碗槽上方的墙支架上。

senses.meaning_en: any of the marks ( ), [ ], { }, < > used in pairs to enclose words or numbers

examples.text: Put the date in brackets after the title.
examples.translation_cn: 把日期放在标题后面的括号里。

senses.meaning_en: one of several ranges of numbers, amounts, or ages

examples.text: Families in a lower income bracket often rent.
examples.translation_cn: 收入较低的家庭往往租房。

senses.meaning_en: to consider people or things as similar or connected; to put them in the same group

examples.text: He was bracketed with the other suspects despite the lack of evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管缺乏证据，他仍被与其他嫌疑人归为一类。

senses.meaning_en: a diagram of games in a tournament

examples.text: The top seed was placed in the tournament bracket after the draw.
examples.translation_cn: 抽签后，头号种子被安排进锦标赛对阵表。

senses.meaning_en: a mythical being in human form with magical powers, typically small and winged

examples.text: In fairy tales, fairies often grant three wishes.
examples.translation_cn: 在童话故事里，小仙子们经常能实现三个愿望。

senses.meaning_en: the process of thinking about something in a logical way to form a conclusion

examples.text: She carefully explained the reasoning behind her decision.
examples.translation_cn: 她仔细解释了她决定背后的推理。

senses.meaning_en: a small mouthful of a drink

examples.text: She took a sip of water before answering the question.
examples.translation_cn: 她喝了一小口水才回答问题。

senses.meaning_en: to drink slowly in small amounts

examples.text: He sipped at his tea while reading the newspaper.
examples.translation_cn: 他一边看报，一边小口喝茶。

senses.meaning_en: a metric unit of volume equal to one cubic decimetre

examples.text: The recipe calls for a litre of milk.
examples.translation_cn: 这个食谱需要一升牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: an open area partially or wholly surrounded by walls or buildings

examples.text: The children were playing in the courtyard behind the old house.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们正在老房子后面的院子里玩耍。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to fable, myth or legend

examples.text: The unicorn is a fabulous creature that appears in many legends.
examples.translation_cn: 独角兽是一种出现在许多传说中的神话生物。

senses.meaning_en: extraordinary, incredible

examples.text: He amassed a fabulous fortune through his business empire.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过自己的商业帝国积累了一笔巨额财富。

senses.meaning_en: very good; wonderful

examples.text: You look absolutely fabulous in that dress tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 你今晚穿那条裙子看起来棒极了。

senses.meaning_en: fictional or not believable; made up

examples.text: He told a fabulous story about meeting a famous actor, but it was all made up.
examples.translation_cn: 他讲了一个关于遇见著名演员的离奇故事，但全是编造的。

senses.meaning_en: to meet and cross each other

examples.text: The two lines intersect at a right angle.
examples.translation_cn: 这两条线以直角相交。

senses.meaning_en: to share common interests or features

examples.text: Our interests intersect with theirs on environmental issues.
examples.translation_cn: 在环境问题上，我们的兴趣与他们的一致。

senses.meaning_en: to pass across or through

examples.text: The plain is intersected by several small rivers.
examples.translation_cn: 这片平原被几条小河横穿。

senses.meaning_en: to remove marks or writing from a surface

examples.text: He erased the wrong answer from the page.
examples.translation_cn: 他把错误答案从页面上擦掉了。

senses.meaning_en: to remove data or information from a computer, disk, etc.

examples.text: He accidentally erased an important file from the disk.
examples.translation_cn: 他意外地从磁盘上删除了一个重要文件。

senses.meaning_en: to remove a memory, feeling, or influence completely

examples.text: She tried to erase the painful memory from her mind.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图从脑海中抹去那段痛苦的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: to be the basis or cause of something

examples.text: Several economic factors underlie most major political decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 几个经济因素构成了大多数重大政治决策的基础。

senses.meaning_en: a powerful illegal drug made from morphine

examples.text: He was addicted to heroin for several years before seeking treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 他吸食海洛因成瘾多年，后来寻求治疗。

senses.meaning_en: a small portable computer that you can carry and use on your lap

examples.text: She checks email and drafts reports on a laptop during long flights.
examples.translation_cn: 她在长途飞行中用笔记本电脑查看邮件和起草报告。

senses.meaning_en: a Christian festival celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ

examples.text: Many schools close for two weeks at Easter.
examples.translation_cn: 许多学校在复活节期间放假两周。

senses.meaning_en: a second-year student at a high school or college

examples.text: My roommate is a sophomore at Boston College.
examples.translation_cn: 我的室友是波士顿学院的大二学生。

senses.meaning_en: second in a series, especially the second year or second album

examples.text: She changed her major during her sophomore year.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大二期间换了专业。

senses.meaning_en: a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body

examples.text: A blockage in a coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
examples.translation_cn: 冠状动脉堵塞可导致心脏病发作。

senses.meaning_en: a major transit corridor in a system of roads, rivers, or railway lines

examples.text: The new highway serves as a major artery for regional traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 这条新高速公路是区域交通的一条主要干道。

senses.meaning_en: a card for sending a message by mail without an envelope

examples.text: I received a postcard from my aunt in Rome.
examples.translation_cn: 我收到了我姑妈从罗马寄来的一张明信片。

senses.meaning_en: the industry or activity of catching, processing, and selling fish

examples.text: Her family has been in fisheries for over thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 她家从事渔业已三十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a place where fish are caught or raised

examples.text: He worked at a fishery near the harbor last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年夏天在海港附近的一个渔场工作。

senses.meaning_en: to set or fix something in a surrounding mass or material

examples.text: The craftsman embedded turquoise in the silver bracelet.
examples.translation_cn: 工匠把绿松石镶嵌在银手镯里。

senses.meaning_en: to fix something firmly into something else or make it an integral part

examples.text: The new policy embeds environmental standards into every project.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策把环境标准融入每一个项目。

senses.meaning_en: to make an attitude, belief, etc. firmly fixed in a person or group

examples.text: The idea that hard work brings success is deeply embedded in many cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 努力带来成功的观念在许多文化中根深蒂固。

senses.meaning_en: to insert media, code, etc. into a document or data file
senses.collocation: embed a video in a webpage

examples.text: You can embed a live feed directly into your website.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将直播流直接嵌入你的网站。

senses.meaning_en: a game or system in which tickets are sold and prizes are given to holders of randomly chosen numbers

examples.text: She won the lottery and bought a house for her parents.
examples.translation_cn: 她中了彩票，给父母买了房子。

senses.meaning_en: something whose outcome is determined by chance rather than by skill or effort
