examples.text: Getting a seat on this train is a lottery in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 早上在这趟火车上找到座位全凭运气。

senses.meaning_en: a short passage taken from a book, film, speech, etc.

examples.text: The teacher read an excerpt from Martin Luther King's speech.
examples.translation_cn: 老师朗读了马丁·路德·金演讲的一段节选。

senses.meaning_en: to take or select a short passage from a larger work

examples.text: The editor excerpted the key passage from the report.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑从报告中摘录了关键段落。

senses.meaning_en: a separate section or space, especially in a vehicle

examples.text: He fell asleep in a quiet compartment of the train.
examples.translation_cn: 他在火车一个安静的车厢里睡着了。

senses.meaning_en: a category or division into which something abstract can be placed

examples.text: He always tried to keep his work and private life in separate compartments.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是尽量把工作和私人生活分开看待。

senses.meaning_en: a school or class for young children, usually between the ages of four and six

examples.text: Our daughter is in kindergarten at the local school.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的女儿在本地学校上幼儿园。

senses.meaning_en: a large ancient stone structure with a square base and triangular sides, built especially in Egypt or Mesoamerica

examples.text: The pyramids of Egypt were built as royal tombs.
examples.translation_cn: 埃及金字塔是为王室陵墓而建。

senses.meaning_en: a solid figure with a polygonal base and triangular faces meeting at a point

examples.text: A square-based pyramid has a square base and four triangular faces.
examples.translation_cn: 底面为正方形的棱锥体有一个正方形底面和四个三角形侧面。

senses.meaning_en: an illegal business model in which earlier investors are paid with money from new investors

examples.text: Investors lost their savings in a pyramid scheme.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者在一个金字塔式骗局中损失了积蓄。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being officially connected to a larger organization or another thing

examples.text: The research center has a close affiliation with the university.
examples.translation_cn: 该研究中心与这所大学有密切的隶属关系。

senses.meaning_en: a person's connection with a political party, religion, etc.

examples.text: The policy applies to everyone regardless of political affiliation.
examples.translation_cn: 该政策适用于所有人，不分政治派别。

senses.meaning_en: a club, society or umbrella organization so formed, especially a trade union

examples.text: Each local branch operates as an affiliation of the national union.
examples.translation_cn: 每个地方分会作为全国工会的附属机构运作。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of thinking deeply in silence, especially for religious or relaxation purposes

examples.text: She practices meditation for twenty minutes every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上冥想二十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: the act of thinking deeply and carefully about something

examples.text: After much meditation, she decided to accept the job.
examples.translation_cn: 经过深思熟虑后，她决定接受这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: a written or spoken discourse expressing considered thoughts on a subject

examples.text: He published his meditations on religion last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年发表了他的宗教沉思录。

senses.meaning_en: a musical composition based on a theme, typically in a contemplative style

examples.text: The composer wrote a meditation on a theme from an old hymn.
examples.translation_cn: 作曲家根据一首古老赞美诗的主题写了一首冥想曲。

senses.meaning_en: to turn over or capsize

examples.text: The delivery truck overturned onto its side on the icy highway.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆送货车在结冰的高速公路上侧翻了。

senses.meaning_en: to overthrow or subvert a government or system

examples.text: The rebels attempted to overturn the military regime last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 叛乱分子去年春天试图推翻军政府。

senses.meaning_en: to reverse or rescind a decision or conviction

examples.text: The appeals court overturned the original conviction yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 上诉法院昨天推翻了原判。

senses.meaning_en: to come back from a losing position; to reverse a disadvantage

examples.text: The team overturned a two-goal deficit to win the match.
examples.translation_cn: 球队扭转两球落后的局面，赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: pertaining to marriage

examples.text: They sought counseling to resolve their marital problems.
examples.translation_cn: 他们寻求咨询以解决婚姻问题。

senses.meaning_en: a short pleasure trip or excursion

examples.text: We went on an outing to the lake last Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 上周日我们去湖边短途游玩了。

senses.meaning_en: the act of publicly revealing someone's sexual orientation or gender identity without their consent

examples.text: The outing of the actor by a tabloid sparked widespread criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 这名演员被小报公开性向后引发了广泛批评。

senses.meaning_en: the arrival or beginning of something important
senses.collocation: with the advent of the internet

examples.text: The advent of the internet has changed the way we work and learn.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网的出现改变了我们工作和学习的方式。

senses.meaning_en: having high prestige; respected and admired

examples.text: He studied at a prestigious university in London.
examples.translation_cn: 他在伦敦一所久负盛名的大学学习。

senses.meaning_en: the state of thinking about something continuously and giving it all your attention

examples.text: His preoccupation with video games affected his schoolwork.
examples.translation_cn: 他一心扑在电子游戏上，影响了学业。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that occupies someone's mind; a concern or interest that is hard to put aside
senses.pattern: one's main preoccupation is sth/doing sth

examples.text: Her main preoccupation is earning enough money to pay the rent.
examples.translation_cn: 她最关心的是挣够钱付房租。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that relates to the most basic and important parts of something; completely

examples.text: The new system is radically different from the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 新系统与旧系统根本不同。

senses.meaning_en: in a radical manner; fundamentally; very

examples.text: She thinks radically about welfare, proposing a universal basic income.
examples.translation_cn: 她对福利制度的看法很激进，提议实行全民基本收入。

senses.meaning_en: angry disagreement or dispute

examples.text: The issue of pay has long been a point of contention between the two sides.
examples.translation_cn: 薪酬问题长期以来一直是双方争论的焦点。

senses.meaning_en: a belief or opinion that you express

examples.text: It is her contention that the law unfairly targets small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 她认为这项法律不公平地针对小企业。

senses.meaning_en: the act of competing for something

examples.text: She is still in contention for a place in the Olympic team.
examples.translation_cn: 她仍有机会入选奥运代表队。

senses.meaning_en: a printed voucher that gives a discount on a product or service

examples.text: I used a coupon to get 10 percent off my groceries.
examples.translation_cn: 我用优惠券买食品杂货打了九折。

senses.meaning_en: a detachable part of a ticket or document that entitles someone to a service or allowance

examples.text: The coupon for a free drink is attached to your cinema ticket.
examples.translation_cn: 你的电影票上附有一张免费饮料券。

senses.meaning_en: an interest payment on a bond or similar debt security

examples.text: The bond pays a coupon every six months.
examples.translation_cn: 这只债券每六个月支付一次利息。

senses.meaning_en: to laugh in a silly or nervous way with short repeated sounds

examples.text: The children giggled at the clown's clumsy tricks.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们被小丑笨拙的把戏逗得咯咯笑。

senses.meaning_en: a high-pitched, silly laugh

examples.text: She burst into giggles at the absurd remark.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到那句荒唐的话突然咯咯笑起来。

senses.meaning_en: fun; an amusing episode

examples.text: We hid his glasses just for a giggle.
examples.translation_cn: 我们藏起他的眼镜只是为了好玩。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe air or gas into your lungs

examples.text: She inhaled the fresh mountain air and smiled.
examples.translation_cn: 她吸了一口山间的新鲜空气，笑了起来。

senses.meaning_en: a metal frame used for cooking food outdoors over an open fire.

examples.text: We grilled some vegetables on a barbecue in the backyard.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在后院用烤架烤了一些蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: to cook food on a barbecue.

examples.text: Dad taught me how to barbecue chicken properly.
examples.translation_cn: 爸爸教我如何正确地烧烤鸡肉。

senses.meaning_en: meat, especially pork or beef, that has been smoked on a barbecue and then chopped or shredded.

examples.text: They serve barbecue with pickles and white bread.
examples.translation_cn: 他们供应手撕烤肉配泡菜和白面包。

senses.meaning_en: a party or meal held outdoors where food is cooked on a barbecue.

examples.text: We met some new friends at a barbecue last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 上周末我们在烧烤聚会上认识了一些新朋友。

senses.meaning_en: a thread-like structure in cells that carries genetic information

examples.text: Most human cells have 46 chromosomes in total.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数人类细胞总共有46条染色体。

senses.meaning_en: a drink, such as tea, coffee, juice, or alcohol, often excluding water

examples.text: We stopped at a café to have a beverage before catching our train.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在赶火车前到咖啡馆喝了杯饮料。

senses.meaning_en: arranged in a series

examples.text: The documents are filed in serial order for easy access.
examples.translation_cn: 文件按连续顺序归档以便查阅。

senses.meaning_en: who performs a specified action repeatedly or regularly

examples.text: The police finally arrested a serial killer who had terrorized the city.
examples.translation_cn: 警方最终逮捕了一名曾使城市陷入恐慌的连环杀手。

senses.meaning_en: published or produced in installments

examples.text: The novel was first published in serial form in a literary magazine.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说最初在一家文学杂志上连载。

senses.meaning_en: a story or play that is broadcast or published in parts

examples.text: She follows her favorite TV serial every week.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周都追她最喜欢的电视连续剧。

senses.meaning_en: a very difficult or unfortunate situation

examples.text: The film highlights the plight of homeless families.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影突出了无家可归家庭的困境。

senses.meaning_en: warm and comfortable; snug

examples.text: The little café felt cosy as the rain poured outside.
examples.translation_cn: 外面下着雨，那家小咖啡馆里感觉很舒适。

senses.meaning_en: close and friendly, often suggesting something improper

examples.text: The politician is cosy with several business leaders.
examples.translation_cn: 这位政客与几位商界领袖关系密切。

senses.meaning_en: a padded covering for a teapot, egg, etc. to keep it warm

examples.text: She knitted a blue cosy for the teapot.
examples.translation_cn: 她给茶壶织了一个蓝色保温套。

senses.meaning_en: to make oneself comfortable and warm (cosy up)

examples.text: We cosied up by the fire and watched a movie.
examples.translation_cn: 我们舒舒服服地蜷在炉火旁看电影。

senses.meaning_en: to try to become friendly with sb, often for advantage (cosy up to sb)

examples.text: He tried to cosy up to the new manager to get a promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图讨好新经理以获得晋升。

senses.meaning_en: main; principal; basic

examples.text: Rice is the staple food in many Asian countries.
examples.translation_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。

senses.meaning_en: a main product or food produced or used in a place

examples.text: Olive oil is a staple of the Mediterranean diet.
examples.translation_cn: 橄榄油是地中海饮食中的主要产品。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten with staples

examples.text: Staple the receipt to the expense report before you file it.
examples.translation_cn: 归档前把收据钉在费用报告上。

senses.meaning_en: a recurring topic, character, or item

examples.text: Phone-in shows are a staple of daytime television.
examples.translation_cn: 听众来电节目是日间电视的固定节目。

senses.meaning_en: to state officially that something meets an official standard

examples.text: The farm was certified as organic last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该农场去年被认证为有机农场。

senses.meaning_en: to give an official certificate showing that someone has completed training or passed an exam

examples.text: He is certified to teach physics in this state.
examples.translation_cn: 他获认证可在本州教授物理。

senses.meaning_en: to state officially, especially in writing, that something is true or correct

examples.text: He certified that the document was a true copy.
examples.translation_cn: 他证明该文件为真实副本。

senses.meaning_en: a tool with a heavy metal blade and a handle, used for chopping wood

examples.text: He cut down the old tree with an axe.
examples.translation_cn: 他用斧头砍倒了那棵老树。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce or cut drastically, especially jobs or spending

examples.text: The hospital is planning to axe over 100 jobs next year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院计划明年削减一百多个工作岗位。

senses.meaning_en: to dismiss someone from their job

examples.text: He was axed from his job as director last month.
examples.translation_cn: 他上个月被解除了董事职务。

senses.meaning_en: to cancel or stop something, such as a project or TV show

examples.text: The studio axed the show after just two seasons.
examples.translation_cn: 该工作室在仅两季后便取消了那部剧集。

senses.meaning_en: a dismissal or rejection

examples.text: She got the axe after twenty years at the company.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公司工作了二十年后被解雇了。

senses.meaning_en: bringing or deserving honor

examples.text: It is honorable to serve your country in times of need.
examples.translation_cn: 国家需要时为国效力是光荣的。

senses.meaning_en: deserving respect because of high moral standards

examples.text: She is an honorable person who always treats people fairly.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一个正直可敬的人，总是公平待人。

senses.meaning_en: electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength longer than visible light

examples.text: The new telescope observes distant galaxies in the infrared.
examples.translation_cn: 这台新望远镜在红外波段观测遥远星系。

senses.meaning_en: having a wavelength in the infrared spectrum

examples.text: The camera uses infrared light to see in the dark.
examples.translation_cn: 相机利用红外光在黑暗中视物。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of fear, reverence, or amazement

examples.text: The children stood in awe of the ancient tree.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们对这棵古树心怀敬畏。

senses.meaning_en: to inspire fear and reverence in

examples.text: She was awed by the sheer size of the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 她因群山之庞大而感到敬畏。

senses.meaning_en: the time of daylight between sunrise and sunset

examples.text: The city park is much quieter in the daytime.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市公园白天要安静得多。

senses.meaning_en: happening during the day; suitable for the day

examples.text: She enjoys watching daytime television on lazy weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在慵懒的周末看日间电视节目。

senses.meaning_en: of or concerning the teeth

examples.text: Too much sugar can cause dental decay in children.
examples.translation_cn: 儿童吃糖过多会导致蛀牙。

senses.meaning_en: of or concerning dentistry

examples.text: She has a dental appointment scheduled this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 她今天下午安排了一次牙科预约。

senses.meaning_en: a remarkable or difficult achievement

examples.text: The bridge is a remarkable feat of engineering.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥是一项了不起的工程壮举。

senses.meaning_en: a high area; land that is higher than surrounding areas

examples.text: Many local families keep sheep in the highlands.
examples.translation_cn: 许多当地家庭在高地养羊。

examples.text: The pilot had to perform a maneuver to avoid the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员不得不做一个机动动作来躲避暴风雨。

examples.text: The soldiers are on maneuvers in the desert.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们正在沙漠中进行军事演习。

examples.text: The tax cut was a maneuver to win votes.
examples.translation_cn: 这次减税是赢得选票的一个策略。

examples.text: She maneuvered the car into a tight parking space.
examples.translation_cn: 她巧妙地把车开进了一个狭窄的停车位。

examples.text: The manager maneuvered him into taking the job.
examples.translation_cn: 经理设法让他接受了这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: happening again and again

examples.text: The patient has had recurrent chest infections this winter.
examples.translation_cn: 这位病人今年冬天反复出现胸部感染。

senses.meaning_en: to impose and collect a tax, fine, or fee

examples.text: The city council voted to levy a tax on sugary drinks.
examples.translation_cn: 市议会投票决定对含糖饮料征税。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money that must be paid as a tax

examples.text: The government imposed a 10% levy on imported steel.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对进口钢铁征收了10%的税。

senses.meaning_en: to officially call people into military service

examples.text: The king levied troops to defend the northern border.
examples.translation_cn: 国王征召军队保卫北方边境。

senses.meaning_en: to give money to help pay for the cost of something

examples.text: The local government subsidizes housing for low-income families.
examples.translation_cn: 地方政府为低收入家庭提供住房补贴。

senses.meaning_en: an animal or plant that lives on or in another living thing and gets food from it

examples.text: The mistletoe is a parasite on apple trees.
examples.translation_cn: 槲寄生是苹果树上的寄生植物。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives off other people and gives little or nothing back

examples.text: He was accused of living like a parasite on his wealthy uncle.
examples.translation_cn: 他被指责像寄生虫一样靠富有的叔叔生活。

senses.meaning_en: domestic chores such as cleaning and cooking

examples.text: She does the housework on Saturday morning while the children are at school.
examples.translation_cn: 她周六早上趁孩子们上学时做家务。

senses.meaning_en: to stop a protest or rebellion by force

examples.text: The government repressed a protest in the capital last night.
examples.translation_cn: 政府昨晚镇压了首都的一场抗议。

senses.meaning_en: to try not to have or show a feeling or emotion

examples.text: He repressed his feelings and said nothing all evening.
examples.translation_cn: 他一晚上都压抑着情绪，什么也没说。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately forget unpleasant thoughts or memories

examples.text: She had repressed the memory of the accident for years.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年来一直压抑着那次事故的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: to press again

examples.text: They will repress the record after the first batch sells out.
examples.translation_cn: 首批售完后，他们将重新压制这张唱片。

senses.meaning_en: the use of force to control a group of people or a country

examples.text: The repression of peaceful protests drew international criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 对和平抗议的镇压招致了国际社会的批评。

senses.meaning_en: the unconscious rejection of painful ideas, memories, or feelings

examples.text: The repression of memories can cause anxiety in later life.
examples.translation_cn: 对记忆的压抑可能导致日后的焦虑。

senses.meaning_en: the act of controlling or suppressing strong feelings or desires

examples.text: The repression of feelings often leads to emotional outbursts later.
examples.translation_cn: 对情感的压抑往往会导致日后情绪爆发。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the side of something or movement to the side

examples.text: The player made a lateral move to avoid the tackle.
examples.translation_cn: 那名球员横向移动以躲避擒抱。

senses.meaning_en: involving a creative or non-obvious way of thinking

examples.text: This puzzle requires you to use lateral thinking.
examples.translation_cn: 这个谜题需要你运用横向思维。

senses.meaning_en: of fundamental importance; crucial, pivotal

examples.text: Honesty is of cardinal importance in any lasting friendship.
examples.translation_cn: 诚实在任何长久的友谊中都是最重要的。

senses.meaning_en: describing a number used to indicate quantity, as opposed to ordinal

examples.text: The number five is a cardinal number because it tells us how many.
examples.translation_cn: 数字五是一个基数词，因为它告诉我们数量。

senses.meaning_en: a senior official in the Roman Catholic Church, ranking below the pope

examples.text: He was appointed cardinal by the pope last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年被教皇任命为红衣主教。

senses.meaning_en: a North American songbird with a red crest

examples.text: A northern cardinal on the fence caught my eye.
examples.translation_cn: 栅栏上的一只北美红雀吸引了我的注意。

senses.meaning_en: a game in which players roll balls down a narrow track to knock over wooden pins

examples.text: We go bowling with friends every Friday night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周五晚上和朋友打保龄球。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is intentionally cruel to weaker people

examples.text: The school bully often takes lunch money from smaller children.
examples.translation_cn: 学校里的恶霸经常从低年级孩子那里抢午餐钱。

senses.meaning_en: to frighten or hurt someone weaker, or force them by threats

examples.text: He bullied the new student into giving him his lunch money.
examples.translation_cn: 他胁迫新生把午餐钱给了他。

senses.meaning_en: a living organism produced asexually from a single ancestor, to which it is genetically identical

examples.text: Dolly the sheep was a clone of an adult ewe.
examples.translation_cn: 多利羊是一只成年母羊的克隆体。

senses.meaning_en: a copy or imitation of something already existing, especially when designed to simulate it

examples.text: He bought a cheap clone of a popular smartwatch.
examples.translation_cn: 他买了一块流行智能手表的廉价仿制品。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is exactly like or very similar to another person, in looks or behavior

examples.text: He is a clone of his father in both looks and personality.
examples.translation_cn: 他的外貌和性格都酷似父亲。

senses.meaning_en: to create a clone of

examples.text: Scientists have cloned a sheep from an adult cell.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家用成年细胞克隆了一只羊。

senses.meaning_en: to make something increase in extent or intensity

examples.text: The new policy escalated tensions between the two countries.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策加剧了两国之间的紧张局势。

senses.meaning_en: to become worse or more serious

examples.text: The argument quickly escalated into a physical fight.
examples.translation_cn: 争吵迅速升级为肢体冲突。

senses.meaning_en: the outer areas of a city or town

examples.text: They bought a small farm on the outskirts of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在市郊买了一座小农场。

senses.meaning_en: a detailed technical drawing, especially for a building or machine

examples.text: The architect studied the blueprint of the new hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑师研究了新医院的蓝图。

senses.meaning_en: a detailed plan for achieving something

examples.text: The committee presented a blueprint for improving public transport.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会提出了改善公共交通的蓝图。

senses.meaning_en: to plan or design something in detail

examples.text: The team carefully blueprinted each phase of the project.
examples.translation_cn: 团队仔细规划了项目的每个阶段。

senses.meaning_en: gas or vapour that is strong-smelling or dangerous to inhale

examples.text: Thick black fumes from the burning car filled the street.
examples.translation_cn: 燃烧的汽车冒出的浓烈黑烟充满了街道。

senses.meaning_en: to be very angry, often without expressing it

examples.text: She was still fuming over the referee's unfair decision.
examples.translation_cn: 她还在为裁判的不公平决定而生气。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being reassured and free from worry

examples.text: He took reassurance from the doctor's steady voice.
examples.translation_cn: 他从医生平稳的语气中得到了安心。

senses.meaning_en: the act of comforting someone or giving confidence

examples.text: The doctor gave her reassurance that the test results were normal.
examples.translation_cn: 医生向她保证检查结果正常。

senses.meaning_en: a flat case for carrying documents and papers, often used for work

examples.text: He carried a black briefcase into the office.
examples.translation_cn: 他拎着一个黑色公文包走进办公室。

senses.meaning_en: to block or fill (a passage) with obstacles

examples.text: A fallen tree is obstructing the road near the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 一棵倒下的树正堵塞桥附近的路。

senses.meaning_en: to impede or hinder

examples.text: The company was accused of obstructing the investigation into its finances.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司被指控妨碍对其财务的调查。

senses.meaning_en: to get in the way of so as to hide from sight

examples.text: Those tall buildings obstruct the view of the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 那些高楼挡住了山景。

senses.meaning_en: the act of blocking or delaying something

examples.text: He was charged with obstruction of the investigation.
examples.translation_cn: 他被控妨碍调查。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that blocks a passage or path

examples.text: A fallen tree caused an obstruction in the road.
examples.translation_cn: 一棵倒下的树造成了道路阻塞。

senses.meaning_en: to exist in large numbers

examples.text: Rumours abound about the cause of the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 有关火灾原因的谣言四起。

senses.meaning_en: to be filled or supplied with

examples.text: The national park abounds with rare birds and plants.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家公园里满是珍稀鸟类和植物。

senses.meaning_en: careful about what you say or do, especially to avoid embarrassing or offending others

examples.text: She was discreet about the reasons for her resignation.
examples.translation_cn: 她对辞职的原因守口如瓶。

senses.meaning_en: not drawing attention; inconspicuous

examples.text: The hotel is in a discreet location near the park.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆坐落在公园附近一个不显眼的位置。

senses.meaning_en: extreme pain of body or mind

examples.text: She cried out in anguish when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到消息后痛苦地叫了出来。

senses.meaning_en: to suffer extreme pain or distress

examples.text: He anguished over whether to accept the offer.
examples.translation_cn: 他因是否接受这个提议而痛苦不已。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone extreme pain or distress

examples.text: He was anguished by the thought of losing his job.
examples.translation_cn: 他因可能失去工作而痛苦不堪。

senses.meaning_en: having a hot, pungent taste

examples.text: The sauce tastes spicy because of the chili peppers.
examples.translation_cn: 这酱汁因为有辣椒而尝起来辣。

senses.meaning_en: exciting and slightly shocking, often involving sexual content

examples.text: Some of his jokes were too spicy for the children.
examples.translation_cn: 他的一些笑话对孩子们来说太下流了。

senses.meaning_en: to take great pleasure in something; to enjoy very much

examples.text: He relishes solving difficult puzzles late into the night.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢在深夜解决难题。

senses.meaning_en: great enjoyment or pleasure

examples.text: The children ate their dinner with obvious relish.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们吃得津津有味。

senses.meaning_en: a spicy or piquant condiment, often made of chopped vegetables or fruit

examples.text: She spread some tomato relish on fresh bread.
examples.translation_cn: 她在新鲜面包上涂了一些番茄调味酱。

senses.meaning_en: to examine something very carefully, often to find mistakes or hidden problems

examples.text: The police scrutinized the documents for hidden clues.
examples.translation_cn: 警方仔细审查了这些文件以寻找隐藏线索。

senses.meaning_en: a series of rulers from the same family

examples.text: She came from a powerful dynasty that ruled northern India.
examples.translation_cn: 她出身于一个统治印度北部的强大家族王朝。

senses.meaning_en: the period during which a particular dynasty rules

examples.text: The Silk Road flourished during the Han dynasty.
examples.translation_cn: 丝绸之路在汉朝时期繁荣。

senses.meaning_en: a team or organization which has an extended period of success or dominant performance

examples.text: The Chicago Bulls were a basketball dynasty in the 1990s.
examples.translation_cn: 芝加哥公牛队在20世纪90年代是一支篮球王朝球队。

senses.meaning_en: a meal at which people serve themselves from a table; a table or counter where food and drinks are served

examples.text: The hotel serves a hot and cold buffet breakfast every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店每天早上供应冷热自助早餐。

senses.meaning_en: to strike repeatedly or violently; to batter

examples.text: The little boat was buffeted by the strong wind all night.
examples.translation_cn: 小船整夜受到强风冲击。

senses.meaning_en: to aggressively challenge, denounce, or criticise

examples.text: The minister was buffeted by criticism from all sides after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻发生后，部长遭到来自各方的批评。

examples.text: She has always aspired to become a professional musician.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直渴望成为一名职业音乐家。

senses.meaning_en: to serve as a memorial to someone or something

examples.text: A stone monument commemorates the dead of both world wars.
examples.translation_cn: 一座石碑纪念两次世界大战的死难者。

senses.meaning_en: to honour the memory of someone or something with a ceremony or object

examples.text: The town holds a ceremony to commemorate the battle every year.
examples.translation_cn: 该镇每年举行仪式纪念那场战役。

senses.meaning_en: a book with a flexible paper cover

examples.text: Her latest novel is now available in paperback.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新的小说现在有平装本了。

senses.meaning_en: having a flexible paper cover

examples.text: I prefer the paperback edition because it is lighter.
examples.translation_cn: 我更喜欢平装版，因为它更轻。

senses.meaning_en: a strip or string of pasta, typically cooked in boiling water and served with sauce or in soup

examples.text: She ordered a bowl of noodles with beef for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 她午餐点了一碗牛肉面。

senses.meaning_en: an object that is long and thin like a noodle

examples.text: She floated across the pool on a bright pink pool noodle.
examples.translation_cn: 她靠着一根亮粉色浮条漂过泳池。

senses.meaning_en: a new growth on a plant

examples.text: A young sprout of wheat needs plenty of sunlight.
examples.translation_cn: 一株小麦幼苗需要充足的阳光。

senses.meaning_en: to cause seeds to germinate

examples.text: Sprout the seeds in a jar until tiny shoots appear.
examples.translation_cn: 把种子放在罐子里发芽，直到长出小芽。

senses.meaning_en: to appear suddenly in large numbers

examples.text: New cafes have sprouted up across the city.
examples.translation_cn: 新咖啡馆在全城涌现。

senses.meaning_en: to grow from seed; to germinate

examples.text: The seeds began to sprout from the warm soil.
examples.translation_cn: 种子开始从温暖的土壤中发芽。

senses.meaning_en: a place where prescription drugs are sold or dispensed

examples.text: You can buy this medicine at any pharmacy.
examples.translation_cn: 你在任何药店都能买到这种药。

senses.meaning_en: the science of medicinal substances

examples.text: She wants to study pharmacy at a well-known university.
examples.translation_cn: 她想在一所知名大学学习药剂学。

senses.meaning_en: the role or occupation of a pharmacist

examples.text: She built a successful career in pharmacy after university.
examples.translation_cn: 她大学毕业后在药剂师行业取得了成功。

senses.meaning_en: relating to feudalism

examples.text: Under the feudal system, peasants worked the land for lords.
examples.translation_cn: 在封建制度下，农民为领主耕种土地。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being alone

examples.text: After retiring, he chose to live in solitude in a small mountain cottage.
examples.translation_cn: 退休后，他选择住在一座小山屋里独处清静。

senses.meaning_en: a lonely or deserted place

examples.text: The cabin sits in the solitude of the mountains, miles from the nearest road.
examples.translation_cn: 小屋坐落在群山的荒凉之中，离最近的公路有好几英里。

senses.meaning_en: relation by blood, marriage, or adoption

examples.text: The DNA test confirmed their kinship with the royal family.
examples.translation_cn: DNA检测证实了他们与王室的亲属关系。

senses.meaning_en: connection by nature or character

examples.text: There is a close kinship between mathematics and music.
examples.translation_cn: 数学与音乐之间有紧密的天然联系。

senses.meaning_en: feeling of closeness based on shared qualities or interests

examples.text: She felt a deep kinship with the villagers over their shared love of music.
examples.translation_cn: 由于共同热爱音乐，她对村民感到深深的亲切感。

senses.meaning_en: connected with emotions rather than reason

examples.text: She kept the old letters only for sentimental reasons.
examples.translation_cn: 她留着这些旧信只是出于情感上的原因。

senses.meaning_en: too easily affected by emotions such as sadness or sympathy

examples.text: My father gets sentimental about his old photographs.
examples.translation_cn: 父亲看到旧照片就会多愁善感。

senses.meaning_en: producing emotions such as pity, romantic love or sadness, sometimes too strongly

examples.text: The movie was too sentimental for most adult viewers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影对多数成年观众来说太煽情了。

senses.meaning_en: the act, process, or result of modernizing

examples.text: The modernization of the city's transport system has reduced travel times.
examples.translation_cn: 城市交通系统的现代化缩短了出行时间。

senses.meaning_en: to hit someone or something with a whip or a thin stick

examples.text: The guard lashed the prisoner with a leather belt.
examples.translation_cn: 看守用皮带抽打那名囚犯。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize someone or something in very strong language

examples.text: The senator lashed out at reporters after the hearing.
examples.translation_cn: 听证会后，那名参议员猛烈抨击了记者。

senses.meaning_en: to hit something with great force

examples.text: The rain lashed against the windows all night.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨整夜猛烈拍打着窗户。

senses.meaning_en: one of the small hairs growing on the edge of the eyelid

examples.text: She batted her long lashes at him slowly.
examples.translation_cn: 她慢慢地朝他扑闪着长睫毛。

senses.meaning_en: the thin leather cord or strip at the end of a whip

examples.text: The lash of a whip cracked in the air.
examples.translation_cn: 鞭梢在空中发出脆响。

senses.meaning_en: to escape or avoid by cleverness or trickery

examples.text: The fugitive managed to evade capture for several months.
examples.translation_cn: 这名逃犯设法躲避抓捕数月。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid answering a question or dealing with an issue directly

examples.text: She evaded my question about her marriage plans.
examples.translation_cn: 她回避了我关于她婚姻计划的问题。

senses.meaning_en: the highest university degree

examples.text: She earned a doctorate in chemistry from the University of Oxford.
examples.translation_cn: 她获得了牛津大学的化学博士学位。

senses.meaning_en: to move very fast with a humming noise

examples.text: The motorcycle zoomed past us on the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 摩托车在高速公路上从我们身边飞驰而过。

senses.meaning_en: to change the focal length of a camera lens to get a closer or wider view

examples.text: The camera zoomed in on the actor's face.
examples.translation_cn: 镜头拉近对准了演员的脸。

senses.meaning_en: to increase suddenly and quickly

examples.text: House prices zoomed up by 20 percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年房价猛涨了20%。

senses.meaning_en: a popular video conferencing software application

examples.text: We will hold the interview on Zoom at 3 p.m.
examples.translation_cn: 我们将在下午三点通过Zoom进行面试。

senses.meaning_en: to repair and redecorate a building or room so that it looks new again

examples.text: The owners plan to renovate the old hotel before the summer season.
examples.translation_cn: 业主们计划在夏季前翻修这家旧酒店。

senses.meaning_en: distinguished and noteworthy; outstanding

examples.text: She is eminent in the field of neuroscience.
examples.translation_cn: 她在神经科学领域成就卓著。

senses.meaning_en: a serious illness in which the lungs become inflamed and filled with fluid, caused by infection

examples.text: Many elderly people develop pneumonia during the winter months.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老年人在冬季患上肺炎。

senses.meaning_en: special words or expressions used by a particular profession or group and often difficult for others to understand

examples.text: The manual is written in the jargon of software engineering.
examples.translation_cn: 这本手册是用软件工程的行话写的。

senses.meaning_en: speech or writing that is very difficult to understand and seems meaningless

examples.text: His explanation sounded like jargon to everyone in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 他的解释在房间里的每个人听来都像晦涩难懂的话。

senses.meaning_en: looking back on or dealing with the past

examples.text: The book offers a retrospective look at the band's early years.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书回顾了乐队早期的岁月。

senses.meaning_en: an exhibition or show of an artist's work covering their career or a period

examples.text: The museum is staging a retrospective of her entire career.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆正在举办她整个职业生涯的回顾展。

senses.meaning_en: applying to or affecting past events; retroactive

examples.text: The new tax law is retrospective to last May.
examples.translation_cn: 新的税法追溯到去年五月。

senses.meaning_en: to move unsteadily; to stumble

examples.text: The runner faltered for a moment but did not fall.
examples.translation_cn: 那名赛跑运动员踉跄了一下但没有摔倒。

senses.meaning_en: to hesitate in purpose or action

examples.text: He faltered at the last moment and refused to sign.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最后一刻犹豫了，拒绝签字。

senses.meaning_en: to become weaker or less steady

examples.text: The economy faltered after a strong start to the year.
examples.translation_cn: 经济年初强劲开局后转为疲软。

senses.meaning_en: to speak with hesitation or in a weak, trembling manner; to stammer

examples.text: He faltered over his words during the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试时他支支吾吾。

senses.meaning_en: no longer in use or useful; outmoded

examples.text: This fax machine became obsolete once email was introduced.
examples.translation_cn: 电子邮件出现后，这台传真机就过时了。

senses.meaning_en: a fastener used to close openings in clothes, bags, etc.

examples.text: She did up the zip on her jacket before going out.
examples.translation_cn: 她出门前拉上了夹克的拉链。

senses.meaning_en: to compress a computer file so that it takes less space

examples.text: You should zip the folder before emailing it to me.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该先把文件夹压缩再通过电子邮件发给我。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly

examples.text: The cyclist zipped past us and disappeared around the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 那个骑自行车的人从我们身边飞驰而过，消失在拐角处。

senses.meaning_en: energy; vigor

examples.text: The kids were full of zip even after the long hike.
examples.translation_cn: 长途远足之后，孩子们仍然精力充沛。

senses.meaning_en: the high-pitched sound of a small object moving rapidly through air

examples.text: We heard the zip of a bullet close to our ears.
examples.translation_cn: 我们听到一颗子弹从耳边呼啸而过。

senses.meaning_en: a short, often amusing account of a real incident or person

examples.text: She told us an amusing anecdote about her first day at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我们讲了一个关于她第一天上班的趣闻。

senses.meaning_en: a previously secret account of an incident

examples.text: The report contains secret anecdotes about the minister's hidden dealings.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告包含关于该部长秘密交易的秘闻。

senses.meaning_en: a person who does not eat meat or fish

examples.text: She has been a strict vegetarian for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她已经做了十多年的严格素食者。

senses.meaning_en: without meat; suitable for vegetarians

examples.text: All the dishes here are vegetarian and clearly labelled.
examples.translation_cn: 这里所有的菜都是素食的，并且有清晰标注。

senses.meaning_en: an attractive or exciting quality that makes someone or something seem special

examples.text: The glamor of city life fades once you live there.
examples.translation_cn: 城市生活的魅力一旦你住下来就会消退。

senses.meaning_en: the attractive and exciting quality of being connected with wealth and success

examples.text: He was seduced by the glamor of wealth and fame.
examples.translation_cn: 他被财富和名声的光鲜所诱惑。

senses.meaning_en: a short pole with a flat blade at one or both ends, used to move a small boat through water

examples.text: He steered the canoe with a long wooden paddle.
examples.translation_cn: 他用长木桨操控独木舟。

senses.meaning_en: an act or period of paddling a boat

examples.text: We went for a paddle on the lake at sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 日落时我们去湖上划了会儿桨。

senses.meaning_en: a walk or play in shallow water, especially at the seaside

examples.text: The children had a paddle in the shallows at the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在海滩的浅水区蹚了会儿水。

senses.meaning_en: to move the hands or feet gently in water, especially to swim or stay afloat

examples.text: The child paddled around in the shallow water, trying to stay afloat.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子一边在浅水里用手脚轻轻划水，努力保持浮起。

senses.meaning_en: a device that increases the strength of an electrical signal, especially for sound

examples.text: He plugged his keyboard into an amplifier before the performance.
examples.translation_cn: 他在演出前把键盘插进了放大器。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of claiming to have beliefs or virtues that one does not actually have

examples.text: He was accused of hypocrisy for urging others to eat healthily while living on fast food.
examples.translation_cn: 他因敦促别人健康饮食自己却以快餐为生而被指责虚伪。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of hypocrisy
senses.pattern: be a glaring example of hypocrisy

examples.text: His refusal to pay taxes while using public schools was a glaring example of hypocrisy.
examples.translation_cn: 他一边使用公立学校一边拒绝纳税，是明显的伪善事例。

senses.meaning_en: a list of books and articles on a particular subject or used in preparing a written work

examples.text: The book includes an annotated bibliography of sources on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书包括一个关于气候变化来源的注释文献目录。

senses.meaning_en: the study of the history, classification, and physical description of books

examples.text: She studied bibliography to understand how early books were printed and sold.
examples.translation_cn: 她学习目录学是为了了解早期书籍是如何印刷和销售的。

senses.meaning_en: physically unable to feel anything

examples.text: My fingers were numb with cold after the long walk.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间散步后我的手指冻得麻木了。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a person or part of the body to lose feeling

examples.text: His leg was numbed by the local anaesthetic.
examples.translation_cn: 他的腿被局部麻醉药麻醉了。

senses.meaning_en: emotionally unable to feel or respond normally

examples.text: She felt numb with shock after hearing the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到消息后她因震惊而麻木了。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a feeling to be less intense

examples.text: This medicine numbs the pain but does not cure the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 这种药能减轻疼痛，但不能治愈疾病。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel ashamed or lose the respect of others

examples.text: The tabloid article humiliated the minister in public last week.
examples.translation_cn: 那篇小报文章上周当众羞辱了这位部长。

senses.meaning_en: not expressed strongly or openly; subdued and understated

examples.text: The committee gave a muted response to the controversial proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会对这项有争议的提议反应克制。

senses.meaning_en: quiet or soft

examples.text: They discussed the news in muted tones at the office.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在办公室里低声讨论这个消息。

senses.meaning_en: subdued and soft (of colours or light)

examples.text: The room was decorated in muted colours and soft lighting.
examples.translation_cn: 房间用柔和的颜色和柔和的灯光装饰。

senses.meaning_en: producing no useful result; pointless
senses.pattern: it is futile to do sth

examples.text: It is futile to argue with someone who refuses to listen.
examples.translation_cn: 和一个拒绝倾听的人争辩是徒劳的。

senses.meaning_en: a decline or fall in standards

examples.text: The inspector noted a lapse in standards during the inspection.
examples.translation_cn: 检查员在检查期间注意到标准下降。

senses.meaning_en: an interval of time between events; a pause in continuity

examples.text: After a lapse of ten years, they finally met again.
examples.translation_cn: 相隔十年后，他们终于再次见面。

senses.meaning_en: a small mistake or temporary failure, especially a slip in concentration or memory

examples.text: He had a brief lapse of concentration and missed the goal.
examples.translation_cn: 他一时走神，错过了进球。

senses.meaning_en: to end or stop being valid, usually because a condition or time limit has not been met

examples.text: Her visa lapsed after 90 days because she did not renew it.
examples.translation_cn: 她的签证在90天后失效，因为她没有续签。

senses.meaning_en: deserving attention; notable

examples.text: The new policy is noteworthy for its focus on renewable energy.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新政策因其对可再生能源的重视而值得注意。

senses.meaning_en: a yellow chemical element used in industry

examples.text: The soil is rich in sulfur, which helps the crops grow.
examples.translation_cn: 土壤富含硫，这有助于作物生长。

senses.meaning_en: of a yellowish-green color

examples.text: Her dress is sulfur yellow and stands out in the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿的裙子是硫黄色的，在人群中很显眼。

senses.meaning_en: having a smell like sulfur

examples.text: The hot springs give off a strong smell of sulfur.
examples.translation_cn: 温泉散发出强烈的硫磺气味。

senses.meaning_en: having a healthy mind; not mentally ill

examples.text: He managed to remain sane during months of isolation.
examples.translation_cn: 在数月的隔离中他保持了神志正常。

senses.meaning_en: sensible and reasonable

examples.text: Choosing a cheaper option was the sane thing to do.
examples.translation_cn: 选择更便宜的方案是明智的做法。

senses.meaning_en: a large room for public meetings or performances

examples.text: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
examples.translation_cn: 毕业典礼在学校礼堂举行。

senses.meaning_en: the seating area for the audience in a theater

examples.text: The audience filled the auditorium, leaving no empty seats.
examples.translation_cn: 观众坐满了观众席，没有空位。

senses.meaning_en: to throw and catch several objects continuously

examples.text: He can juggle five balls at once without dropping them.
examples.translation_cn: 他能同时抛接五个球而不掉下来。

senses.meaning_en: the act or performance of juggling

examples.text: The street performer performed a juggling act in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 街头艺人在公园里表演杂耍。

senses.meaning_en: to try to deal with several important things at the same time

examples.text: She has to juggle work and family every day.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天都必须同时应付工作和家庭。

senses.meaning_en: to change figures or information dishonestly

examples.text: He was caught juggling figures to hide the company's losses.
examples.translation_cn: 他被发现篡改数字以掩盖公司亏损。

senses.meaning_en: the act of managing many tasks at the same time
senses.pattern: it is a juggle to do sth

examples.text: It's a constant juggle to balance work and family.
examples.translation_cn: 要同时兼顾工作和家庭，真得不断调整。

senses.meaning_en: very surprising, shocking, or great in amount

examples.text: The company lost a staggering amount of money last year.
examples.translation_cn: 公司去年损失了惊人的一大笔钱。

senses.meaning_en: walking or moving unsteadily, as if about to fall

examples.text: He walked with staggering steps after being hit on the head.
examples.translation_cn: 他头部被击中后，踉踉跄跄地走着。

senses.meaning_en: assessment, estimation, or regard; especially favourable regard

examples.text: She is held in high esteem by all her colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 她深受所有同事的尊敬。

senses.meaning_en: to set a high value on; to regard with respect or prize

examples.text: We esteem her for her dedication to the community.
examples.translation_cn: 我们因她对社区的奉献而敬重她。

senses.meaning_en: to look upon something in a particular way

examples.text: I esteem it an honour to serve on this committee.
examples.translation_cn: 我认为能在该委员会任职是一种荣幸。

senses.meaning_en: to act together to bring about a bad result

examples.text: Several factors conspired to bring about the war.
examples.translation_cn: 几个因素共同导致了战争。

senses.meaning_en: to secretly plan together to do something illegal or harmful

examples.text: The general conspired with foreign agents to overthrow the government.
examples.translation_cn: 这位将军与外国特工密谋推翻政府。

senses.meaning_en: rising quickly to a very high level

examples.text: Many small businesses are struggling with soaring prices this year.
examples.translation_cn: 许多小企业今年正艰难应对飞涨的物价。

senses.meaning_en: flying high or standing very tall

examples.text: The cathedral, soaring above the old town, attracts many visitors.
examples.translation_cn: 那座大教堂高耸于老城之上，吸引众多游客。

senses.meaning_en: to enter or interfere where you are not wanted

examples.text: I didn't mean to intrude on your conversation.
examples.translation_cn: 我不是故意打扰你们的谈话的。

senses.meaning_en: to force something upon someone

examples.text: She often intrudes her views on everyone around her.
examples.translation_cn: 她常常把自己的观点强加给周围所有人。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of contempt or scorn

examples.text: She felt nothing but disdain for the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 她对这个提议只有鄙视。

senses.meaning_en: to regard (someone or something) with strong contempt

examples.text: He openly disdained the committee's decision to reduce funding.
examples.translation_cn: 他公开鄙视委员会减少资金的决定。

senses.meaning_en: to refuse to do something because you feel it is beneath you

examples.text: He disdained to answer the reporter's insulting question.
examples.translation_cn: 他不屑于回答记者侮辱性的问题。

senses.meaning_en: showing that something is certainly true or ending doubt

examples.text: The clinical trial provided conclusive proof that the vaccine is safe.
examples.translation_cn: 临床试验提供了该疫苗安全的确凿证据。

senses.meaning_en: qualifications, achievements, or qualities that make someone suitable for something

examples.text: She has the right credentials for a management role.
examples.translation_cn: 她具备担任管理职务的适当资历。

senses.meaning_en: documents or information that prove who you are or that you are authorized to do something

examples.text: All visitors must present their credentials at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 所有访客必须在前台出示证件。

senses.meaning_en: a username and password or other data used to access a computer system

examples.text: Please enter your credentials to access the account.
examples.translation_cn: 请输入您的登录信息以访问该账户。

senses.meaning_en: the lower front part of the body between the chest and hips; the cavity inside this part

examples.text: The patient complained of a sharp pain in her abdomen after eating.
examples.translation_cn: 患者饭后主诉腹部剧痛。

senses.meaning_en: the rear part of the body of an insect or other arthropod

examples.text: The abdomen of an insect contains its digestive organs.
examples.translation_cn: 昆虫的腹部容纳着消化器官。

senses.meaning_en: to make something widely known to attract attention or support

examples.text: The music festival was widely publicized on social media this year.
examples.translation_cn: 这个音乐节今年在社交媒体上得到了广泛宣传。

senses.meaning_en: to make information available to the general public

examples.text: The committee publicized the safety report to the public yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会昨天向公众公布了这份安全报告。

senses.meaning_en: severity or strictness

examples.text: The judge applied the full rigour of the law to repeat offenders.
examples.translation_cn: 法官对惯犯依法从严惩处。

senses.meaning_en: careful thoroughness or precision

examples.text: The findings were examined with scientific rigour before publication.
examples.translation_cn: 这些研究结果在发表前经过了严谨的科学检验。

senses.meaning_en: harsh or difficult conditions

examples.text: The explorers endured the rigours of an Arctic winter.
examples.translation_cn: 探险家们忍受了北极严冬的艰难。

senses.meaning_en: able to be foreseen or anticipated

examples.text: No major changes are expected in the foreseeable future.
examples.translation_cn: 预计在可预见的未来不会有重大变化。

senses.meaning_en: an idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal meaning

examples.text: The word 'skinny' can carry a connotation of disapproval.
examples.translation_cn: “skinny”这个词可能带有贬义。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of medicine concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders

examples.text: He works as a consultant in psychiatry at a London hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 他在伦敦一家医院担任精神病学顾问。

senses.meaning_en: the act of provoking or inciting someone to do something

examples.text: The man attacked him without any provocation whatsoever.
examples.translation_cn: 那个男人毫无缘由地攻击了他。

senses.meaning_en: something that provokes; a provocative act

examples.text: His remarks were a provocation to the entire community.
examples.translation_cn: 他的言论是对整个社区的挑衅。

senses.meaning_en: the fastest gait of a horse or a rapid run

examples.text: The horse crossed the field at a gallop.
examples.translation_cn: 那匹马疾驰穿过田野。

senses.meaning_en: to ride or run at a galloping pace

examples.text: A herd of wild horses galloped across the plain.
examples.translation_cn: 一群野马疾驰过平原。

senses.meaning_en: the habit of saving money and spending it carefully

examples.text: Her parents taught her the value of thrift from a young age.
examples.translation_cn: 她父母从小就教她节俭的价值。

senses.meaning_en: to shop or browse at a thrift shop; to buy (something) at a thrift shop

examples.text: We went thrifting for vintage furniture last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末逛二手店淘复古家具。

senses.meaning_en: not giving enough care or attention; failing in a duty

examples.text: The nurse was negligent in monitoring the patient's vital signs.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在监测病人生命体征方面疏忽了。

senses.meaning_en: a social or cultural ban

examples.text: There is a strong taboo against eating beef in that community.
examples.translation_cn: 那个社区对吃牛肉有强烈禁忌。

senses.meaning_en: forbidden by social custom

examples.text: In some cultures, it is taboo to point at the moon.
examples.translation_cn: 在一些文化中，用手指月亮是禁忌。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid or ban as taboo

examples.text: The community taboos any mention of the incident.
examples.translation_cn: 这个社区忌讳提及那起事件。

senses.meaning_en: a comprehensive reference work with articles on many or one subject
senses.pattern: look sth up in an encyclopedia

examples.text: You can look up historical dates in an encyclopedia.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在百科全书中查找历史日期。

senses.meaning_en: harmful or malevolent

examples.text: The drug trade has a malignant influence on urban communities.
examples.translation_cn: 毒品交易对城市社区有恶劣影响。

senses.meaning_en: serious and tending to spread and cause death

examples.text: The tumour was malignant and had spread quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 肿瘤是恶性的，而且扩散得很快。

senses.meaning_en: showing strong hatred or a desire to harm others

examples.text: He acted with malignant intent towards his former friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他对他从前的朋友怀有恶意。

senses.meaning_en: the use of humor, irony, or exaggeration to criticize or expose faults

examples.text: The play uses satire to attack political corruption.
examples.translation_cn: 这部戏剧运用讽刺来抨击政治腐败。

senses.meaning_en: a satirical work

examples.text: The novel is a biting satire on modern society.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说是对现代社会辛辣的讽刺作品。

senses.meaning_en: to touch someone or something gently in a loving way

examples.text: She caressed the old man's hand and spoke to him softly.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻抚老人的手，轻声对他说话。

senses.meaning_en: a gentle loving touch

examples.text: He gave his daughter a gentle caress on the cheek before leaving.
examples.translation_cn: 离开前他轻抚了女儿的脸颊。

senses.meaning_en: to touch something lightly and pleasantly

examples.text: The morning breeze gently caressed her sunburnt shoulders.
examples.translation_cn: 晨风轻拂着她晒伤的肩膀。

senses.meaning_en: to give back money to someone

examples.text: The airline refunded the ticket price to all passengers.
examples.translation_cn: 航空公司把机票款退给了所有乘客。

senses.meaning_en: an amount of money returned

examples.text: You can get a full refund if you cancel within 24 hours.
examples.translation_cn: 如果在24小时内取消，你可以获得全额退款。

senses.meaning_en: causing disruption or annoyance by being unwelcome

examples.text: She finds the interviewer's questions about her age intrusive.
examples.translation_cn: 她觉得面试官问她年龄的问题很冒昧。

senses.meaning_en: forced while molten into cracks of other rocks

examples.text: Granite is an intrusive rock formed deep underground.
examples.translation_cn: 花岗岩是一种在地下深处形成的侵入岩。

senses.meaning_en: to repair or change something completely to improve it

examples.text: The government plans to overhaul the health care system.
examples.translation_cn: 政府计划全面改革医疗保健体系。

senses.meaning_en: a major repair, renovation, or revision

examples.text: The old engine underwent a complete overhaul before the race.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧发动机在比赛前进行了彻底检修。

senses.meaning_en: to catch up with and pass

examples.text: The runner overhauled the leader on the final lap.
examples.translation_cn: 那名赛跑选手在最后一圈超过了领先者。

senses.meaning_en: taking care to do things carefully and thoroughly

examples.text: She is conscientious about checking every detail before submitting her reports.
examples.translation_cn: 她提交报告前总是一丝不苟地检查每个细节。

senses.meaning_en: guided by conscience; principled

examples.text: He refused to serve in the army on conscientious grounds.
examples.translation_cn: 他出于良心拒服兵役。

senses.meaning_en: showing great energy and determination

examples.text: The team made strenuous efforts to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 团队为按时完成项目付出了巨大努力。

senses.meaning_en: requiring great effort or energy

examples.text: He found the climb strenuous and had to stop for breath.
examples.translation_cn: 他觉得这次攀登很费力，不得不停下来喘气。

senses.meaning_en: anxious or fearful that something bad will happen

examples.text: She was apprehensive about starting her new job.
examples.translation_cn: 她对开始新工作感到忧虑。

senses.meaning_en: the period when male and female mammals are sexually active

examples.text: The stags are in rut in early autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 公鹿在初秋发情。

senses.meaning_en: a deep track made by wheels on a road

examples.text: Heavy trucks left deep ruts in the dirt road.
examples.translation_cn: 重型卡车在土路上留下了深深的车辙。

senses.meaning_en: a boring fixed way of life that is difficult to change

examples.text: I was stuck in a rut at work and needed a change.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得工作一成不变，需要改变。

senses.meaning_en: to sleep lightly or briefly

examples.text: He tends to doze off during long meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 他开长会时容易打瞌睡。

senses.meaning_en: a light, short sleep

examples.text: I decided to have a doze after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我决定午饭后打个盹儿。

senses.meaning_en: to lose or give up something as a penalty

examples.text: He forfeited his right to a refund by opening the box.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开包装，就丧失了退款的权利。

senses.meaning_en: a penalty or something lost as punishment

examples.text: He paid a hundred dollars as a forfeit for returning the car late.
examples.translation_cn: 他因逾期还车支付了一百美元罚金。

senses.meaning_en: a penalty paid in a game

examples.text: We played forfeits at the party and she had to sing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在聚会上玩罚物游戏，她只得唱歌。

senses.meaning_en: to have property taken away officially, especially by court order

examples.text: The court ordered him to forfeit his assets to the state.
examples.translation_cn: 法院命令他将财产上缴国家。

senses.meaning_en: using force or laws to control people and limit their freedom

examples.text: This regime is repressive towards anyone who criticizes its policies.
examples.translation_cn: 这个政权镇压任何批评其政策的人。

senses.meaning_en: restricting personal freedom and self-expression

examples.text: Many employees find the strict dress code repressive and outdated.
examples.translation_cn: 许多员工觉得严格的着装规定令人压抑且过时。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams

examples.text: I bought a kilo of rice at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 我在市场上买了一公斤大米。

senses.meaning_en: to shock or disgust someone greatly

examples.text: Local residents were appalled by the sudden rise in crime.
examples.translation_cn: 当地居民对犯罪率突然上升感到震惊。

senses.meaning_en: the clear liquid produced in your mouth that helps you to chew and digest food

examples.text: Chewing sugar-free gum helps your mouth produce saliva and protects your teeth.
examples.translation_cn: 嚼无糖口香糖能帮助口腔产生唾液并保护牙齿。

senses.meaning_en: a group of performers such as actors, singers, or dancers who work together, especially one that travels

examples.text: A troupe of actors performed a new play in the village hall.
examples.translation_cn: 一个演员剧团在村礼堂演了一出新戏。

senses.meaning_en: to make something as good or effective as possible; to use something in the best way

examples.text: We need to optimize the use of our limited resources.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要优化有限资源的利用。

senses.meaning_en: to understand or grasp mentally

examples.text: She could not apprehend why he had left without a word.
examples.translation_cn: 她无法理解他为何不辞而别。

senses.meaning_en: to arrest someone

examples.text: Two men were apprehended for the robbery late last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚深夜，两名男子因抢劫被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to anticipate with anxiety or dread

examples.text: The captain apprehended that the storm would sink their small boat.
examples.translation_cn: 船长担心暴风雨会吞没他们的小船。

senses.meaning_en: surpassing others; supremely excellent

examples.text: The pianist's performance was transcendent; the audience gave a standing ovation.
examples.translation_cn: 那位钢琴家的演奏超凡脱俗，观众起立鼓掌。

senses.meaning_en: beyond ordinary perception or material limits

examples.text: They believed in a transcendent reality beyond what the senses reveal.
examples.translation_cn: 他们相信一种超越感官所揭示的超验实在。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to fit and repair pipes and other apparatus for water, gas or drainage

examples.text: We need to call a plumber to fix the leaking pipe.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要叫水管工来修漏水的管道。

senses.meaning_en: relating to perception

examples.text: The test measures a child's perceptual abilities in several ways.
examples.translation_cn: 这项测试从几个方面测量儿童的感知能力。

senses.meaning_en: friendly and kind; easy to like

examples.text: Our new neighbour is amiable by nature, so she soon made friends with everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的新邻居天性友善，所以她很快和大家都成了朋友。

senses.meaning_en: the online world where people communicate and share information

examples.text: They met for the first time in cyberspace.
examples.translation_cn: 他们第一次在虚拟空间相遇。

senses.meaning_en: to praise highly

examples.text: The novel was acclaimed as a masterpiece by critics.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说被评论家称赞为杰作。

senses.meaning_en: enthusiastic praise

examples.text: Her performance won critical acclaim from audiences worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 她的表演赢得了全世界观众的赞誉。

examples.text: The former employee was accused of blackmail by the company.
examples.translation_cn: 那名前雇员被公司指控敲诈。

examples.text: He blackmailed his boss into giving him a raise.
examples.translation_cn: 他敲诈老板给他加薪。

examples.text: She used the photographs as blackmail to force him to resign.
examples.translation_cn: 她用那些照片作为把柄逼他辞职。

senses.meaning_en: able to read and write

examples.text: She became literate as an adult after enrolling in a night class.
examples.translation_cn: 她成年后通过上夜校学会了读写。

senses.meaning_en: well educated and cultured

examples.text: Her parents were highly literate and encouraged her to read widely.
examples.translation_cn: 她的父母很有文化，鼓励她广泛阅读。

senses.meaning_en: able to understand and evaluate something; knowledgeable in a field

examples.text: Today's students need to be scientifically literate to evaluate news reports.
examples.translation_cn: 今天的学生需要具备科学素养才能评价新闻报道。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel anxious, upset, or excited

examples.text: She was clearly agitated by the long delay.
examples.translation_cn: 她因长时间的延误而明显焦虑不安。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in political or social agitation

examples.text: Workers agitated for higher wages and safer conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们为争取更高工资和更安全条件而鼓动。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a liquid to move violently

examples.text: Agitate the mixture gently before adding the powder.
examples.translation_cn: 加入粉末前轻轻搅动混合液。

senses.meaning_en: to cause to divide into opposing groups

examples.text: The new policy has polarized the nation into two opposing camps.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策使国家分裂成两个对立的阵营。

senses.meaning_en: an unusual habit or feature

examples.text: One quirk of her personality is that she refuses to eat anything green.
examples.translation_cn: 她性格的一个怪癖是拒绝吃任何绿色食物。

senses.meaning_en: a strange coincidence

examples.text: By a quirk of fate, they met again at the same café in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 由于命运的巧合，他们在巴黎同一家咖啡馆再次相遇。

senses.meaning_en: polite behaviour; courtesy

examples.text: He always treats his opponents with civility, even in a heated debate.
examples.translation_cn: 即使在激烈辩论中，他也总是礼貌地对待对手。

senses.meaning_en: an act or expression of polite behaviour; a courtesy

examples.text: The two leaders exchanged civilities before the summit began.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人在峰会开始前互相客套了几句。

senses.meaning_en: having self-contradictory properties

examples.text: It is paradoxical that such a rich country has so many poor people.
examples.translation_cn: 这样一个富裕的国家有这么多穷人，真是自相矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: to illegally seize control of a vehicle, ship, or aircraft

examples.text: The men planned to hijack a plane to Cuba.
examples.translation_cn: 这些人计划劫持一架飞机去古巴。

senses.meaning_en: to seize control of a process or resource for a different purpose

examples.text: A small group tried to hijack a meeting to push their own plan.
examples.translation_cn: 一小群人试图劫持一场会议以推行自己的计划。

senses.meaning_en: an instance of hijacking; a seizure and redirection of a process

examples.text: The hijack of the cargo ship ended after two days.
examples.translation_cn: 货船劫持事件两天后结束。

senses.meaning_en: an extreme enthusiasm or obsession for something

examples.text: He has a mania for collecting old stamps.
examples.translation_cn: 他有收集旧邮票的狂热癖好。

senses.meaning_en: a serious mental illness involving violent or confused behaviour

examples.text: She has suffered from mania since her twenties and responds well to lithium.
examples.translation_cn: 她从二十多岁起就患有躁狂症，服用锂剂后反应良好。

senses.meaning_en: forming a united whole; causing people to be united

examples.text: The team became a cohesive unit after weeks of practice.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几周的训练，这支队伍成了一个有凝聚力的整体。

senses.meaning_en: connected and working together well; unified

examples.text: A cohesive argument links each paragraph to the central claim.
examples.translation_cn: 连贯的论证将每一段与中心论点联系起来。

senses.meaning_en: the use of remarks that clearly mean the opposite of what they say, made to criticize or hurt someone in a humorous way

examples.text: "I'm so glad you're here," she said with sarcasm, rolling her eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 她翻了个白眼，讽刺地说：“我真高兴你来了。”

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

examples.text: The crack in the wall is only two millimeters wide.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上的裂缝只有两毫米宽。

senses.meaning_en: to fill with horror or indignation; to shock greatly

examples.text: I was appalled by the conditions in the factory.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂里的情况让我大为震惊。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing insight; perceptive

examples.text: She is insightful about the challenges facing small businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 她对小企业面临的挑战很有见地。

senses.meaning_en: connected with being a father or typical of a father

examples.text: He felt deep paternal affection for the boy.
examples.translation_cn: 他对这个男孩怀有深深的父亲般的爱。

senses.meaning_en: related through the father's side of a family

examples.text: Blue eyes run in her family on the paternal side.
examples.translation_cn: 蓝眼睛是她父系家族的遗传特征。

senses.meaning_en: to adapt a literary work for performance in the theatre or on screen

examples.text: The director dramatized the novel for the stage last year.
examples.translation_cn: 导演去年将这部小说改编成了舞台剧。

senses.meaning_en: to present something as more dramatic or serious than it really is

examples.text: The article dramatized the disagreement as a bitter fight.
examples.translation_cn: 文章把分歧夸大成了一场激烈的争斗。

senses.meaning_en: Having the personality trait of expressing sarcasm

examples.text: He is sarcastic by nature, but he doesn't mean to hurt you.
examples.translation_cn: 他生性爱挖苦人，但并无恶意。

senses.meaning_en: using remarks that clearly mean the opposite of what you say, in order to hurt someone's feelings or humorously criticize something

examples.text: She was sarcastic about my new haircut at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她在聚会上挖苦我的新发型。

senses.meaning_en: Containing sarcasm

examples.text: She replied in a sarcastic tone that the meeting had been 'fascinating'.
examples.translation_cn: 她用讽刺的语气回答说会议“精彩极了”。

senses.meaning_en: an unbroken view of a wide area

examples.text: From the tower you can enjoy a panorama of the whole city.
examples.translation_cn: 从塔上你可以欣赏到整座城市的全景。

senses.meaning_en: a picture or photograph showing a wide view

examples.text: The photographer captured a stunning panorama of the coastline.
examples.translation_cn: 摄影师拍下了一张壮丽的海岸线全景照片。

senses.meaning_en: a comprehensive survey or description

examples.text: The report gives a panorama of rural life in modern China.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告概述了现代中国的乡村生活。

senses.meaning_en: a unit used to measure the energy value of food and drink, equal to 1,000 small calories

examples.text: This cake is too high in calories to eat every day.
examples.translation_cn: 这个蛋糕热量太高，不能天天吃。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of heat energy equal to 4.184 joules, formerly used in chemistry and physics

examples.text: In chemistry, one calorie equals exactly 4.184 joules.
examples.translation_cn: 在化学中，1卡路里恰好等于4.184焦耳。

senses.meaning_en: used in the names of orchestras, music societies, etc.; devoted to music

examples.text: She plays the violin in a philharmonic orchestra.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个爱乐乐团拉小提琴。

senses.meaning_en: a full-size symphony orchestra

examples.text: The philharmonic performed Mahler's Fifth Symphony last night.
examples.translation_cn: 爱乐乐团昨晚演奏了马勒第五交响曲。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being futile or useless

examples.text: He soon realized the futility of arguing with her.
examples.translation_cn: 他很快意识到与她争论毫无意义。

senses.meaning_en: something, especially an act, that is futile

examples.text: Trying to change his mind is an exercise in futility.
examples.translation_cn: 试图改变他的想法是徒劳之举。

senses.meaning_en: continued effort and determination to achieve something despite difficulties

examples.text: Her perseverance in training despite repeated injuries finally earned her a national medal.
examples.translation_cn: 她不顾反复受伤坚持训练，最终赢得了全国奖牌。

senses.meaning_en: the receding movement of the tide

examples.text: The tide was on the ebb, exposing rocks and pools along the shore.
examples.translation_cn: 潮水正在退去，露出岸边的岩石和水洼。

senses.meaning_en: a period of decline or a low condition

examples.text: Public trust in the government is at a low ebb.
examples.translation_cn: 公众对政府的信任处于低谷。

senses.meaning_en: to gradually become weaker or less

examples.text: His strength ebbed away during the long illness.
examples.translation_cn: 在长期生病期间他的体力逐渐衰退。

senses.meaning_en: to flow back or recede

examples.text: The tide ebbed slowly, exposing a strip of dark sand.
examples.translation_cn: 潮水缓缓退去，露出一条深色沙带。

senses.meaning_en: more than is needed or wanted

examples.text: Further explanation is superfluous because the instructions are clear.
examples.translation_cn: 说明已经很清楚了，再作解释是多余的。

senses.meaning_en: tedious and lacking variety

examples.text: He found the repetitive office work monotonous and soon lost interest.
examples.translation_cn: 他觉得重复的办公室工作单调乏味，很快就失去了兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: having an unvarying pitch or tone

examples.text: She read the story in a monotonous voice, and the children soon got bored.
examples.translation_cn: 她用单调的声音读故事，孩子们很快就觉得无聊了。

senses.meaning_en: a medical condition in which the blood cannot carry enough oxygen, causing tiredness and pale skin

examples.text: She suffers from anemia and often feels tired and dizzy.
examples.translation_cn: 她患有贫血，经常感到疲倦和头晕。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being careful and avoiding risks

examples.text: Investors should exercise prudence in dealing with unfamiliar markets.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者在应对不熟悉的市场时应保持谨慎。

senses.meaning_en: careful management of money; economy

examples.text: Thanks to her prudence with money, they never struggled to pay bills.
examples.translation_cn: 多亏她用钱节俭，他们从未为支付账单发愁。

senses.meaning_en: susceptible to superstitions

examples.text: My grandmother is superstitious about walking under ladders.
examples.translation_cn: 我奶奶对于从梯子下走过很迷信。

senses.meaning_en: arising from or having the character of superstitions

examples.text: He held a superstitious belief that black cats bring bad luck.
examples.translation_cn: 他抱有一种迷信的想法，认为黑猫会带来厄运。

senses.meaning_en: to laugh at or mock harshly; to ridicule or scorn

examples.text: Many critics derided the proposal as completely unrealistic.
examples.translation_cn: 许多评论家嘲笑该提议完全不切实际。

senses.meaning_en: tending to socialize; friendly and outgoing

examples.text: She is sociable with everyone she meets and makes friends easily.
examples.translation_cn: 她跟每个遇到的人都合得来，很容易交到朋友。

senses.meaning_en: offering opportunities for conversation; characterized by much conversation

examples.text: The café is designed to create a sociable atmosphere for guests.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡馆旨在为客人营造便于交谈的氛围。

senses.meaning_en: having fixed and often unfair ideas about a person or thing

examples.text: The report presents a stereotyped view of working mothers.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告呈现了对职场母亲的刻板印象。

senses.meaning_en: a failure to function

examples.text: The crash was caused by a malfunction in the braking system.
examples.translation_cn: 这次撞车是由制动系统故障引起的。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to function properly

examples.text: The engine malfunctioned without warning on the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 发动机在高速公路上毫无预警地发生了故障。

senses.meaning_en: to make things happen or move at the same time or rate

examples.text: The app synchronizes your calendar with your phone.
examples.translation_cn: 这个应用会把你的日历与手机同步。

senses.meaning_en: to set a clock or watch to the same time as another

examples.text: We synchronized our watches with the station clock before the hike.
examples.translation_cn: 远足前我们按车站时钟校准了手表。

senses.meaning_en: to fit well together or agree with something

examples.text: The soundtrack synchronizes perfectly with the actor's movements.
examples.translation_cn: 配乐与演员的动作完美同步。

senses.meaning_en: to supply farmland with water through ditches or pipes

examples.text: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
examples.translation_cn: 农民用河水灌溉田地。

senses.meaning_en: to clean a wound with a liquid

examples.text: The nurse irrigated the wound with sterile saline.
examples.translation_cn: 护士用无菌生理盐水冲洗伤口。

senses.meaning_en: in Kantian philosophy, concerned with the a priori basis of knowledge, independent of experience

examples.text: Kant's transcendental deduction is central to his philosophy.
examples.translation_cn: 康德的先验演绎是其哲学的核心。

senses.meaning_en: beyond ordinary experience; extraordinary

examples.text: She described the concert as a transcendental experience.
examples.translation_cn: 她形容这场音乐会是超凡的体验。

senses.meaning_en: to move forward in sharp turns from side to side

examples.text: The cyclist zigzagged through the heavy traffic on his way to work.
examples.translation_cn: 骑自行车的人上班路上在拥堵的车流中曲折穿行。

senses.meaning_en: a line or pattern that goes in sharp turns from side to side

examples.text: Lightning flashed in a zigzag across the night sky.
examples.translation_cn: 闪电呈之字形划过夜空。

senses.meaning_en: moving in or having a zigzag line or course

examples.text: A zigzag path led up to the old temple.
examples.translation_cn: 一条之字形小路通向古庙。

senses.meaning_en: likely to become suddenly upset or angry; moody

examples.text: He is a temperamental person who gets angry over small things.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一个喜怒无常的人，常因小事生气。

senses.meaning_en: not working reliably; erratic

examples.text: This old printer is a temperamental machine that often jams.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧打印机性能不稳定，经常卡纸。

senses.meaning_en: An athlete who performs acts requiring skill, agility and coordination, often in a circus.

examples.text: She works as an acrobat in a traveling circus.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个巡回马戏团当杂技演员。

senses.meaning_en: A person who is skilled at changing their opinions or behavior to suit a situation, often used disapprovingly.

examples.text: The senator is a political acrobat who changes positions to win votes.
examples.translation_cn: 那位参议员是个见风使舵的政客，为了赢得选票而改变立场。

senses.meaning_en: the quality or condition of being sufficient

examples.text: The sufficiency of the evidence was questioned during the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 证据的充分性在审判中受到质疑。

senses.meaning_en: an adequate amount

examples.text: We have a sufficiency of food and water for the journey.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有足够的食物和水供旅途使用。

senses.meaning_en: evil or harmful in effect or intention

examples.text: Social media can have a malign effect on public debate.
examples.translation_cn: 社交媒体可能对公共讨论产生有害影响。

senses.meaning_en: to say false and harmful things about; to slander

examples.text: He was maligned as a traitor by his political enemies.
examples.translation_cn: 他被政敌污蔑为叛徒。

senses.meaning_en: never changing; always the same

examples.text: Her daily routine is invariable; she gets up at six and then goes for a walk.
examples.translation_cn: 她的日常安排不变；她六点起床，然后去散步。

senses.meaning_en: great technical skill in an artistic pursuit

examples.text: Her virtuosity in piano playing amazed the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 她在钢琴演奏上的高超技艺令观众惊叹。

senses.meaning_en: a road or bridge that crosses over another road or railway

examples.text: The new overpass above the rail yard has made commuting much faster.
examples.translation_cn: 铁路货场上方的立交桥使通勤快多了。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of medicine that deals with disorders of the nervous system

examples.text: Recent advances in neurology have led to better treatments for epilepsy.
examples.translation_cn: 神经病学的最新进展带来了更好的癫痫治疗方法。

senses.meaning_en: a person who plays a musical instrument

examples.text: She works as an instrumentalist in a chamber orchestra.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一支室内管弦乐队中担任器乐演奏者。

senses.meaning_en: to make a liquid pure by heating and cooling it

examples.text: They distill fresh water from seawater in this plant.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂从海水中蒸馏淡水。

senses.meaning_en: to extract the essential meaning or most important aspects

examples.text: The author distills complex ideas into simple language.
examples.translation_cn: 这位作者把复杂的想法提炼成简单的语言。

senses.meaning_en: walking on two legs; two-footed

examples.text: Humans are bipedal, while most other mammals walk on four legs.
examples.translation_cn: 人类是两足行走的，而大多数其他哺乳动物用四条腿行走。

senses.meaning_en: a person who studies or practises genealogy; an expert in genealogy

examples.text: My aunt works as a genealogist and helps people trace their family roots.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑妈是一名系谱学家，帮助人们追溯家族根源。

senses.meaning_en: to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently

examples.text: The soldier was accused of maltreating prisoners during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 这名士兵被指控在战争期间虐待囚犯。

senses.meaning_en: used when leaving or ending a conversation

examples.text: Goodby to all of you, and thanks for everything.
examples.translation_cn: 再见，各位，感谢一切。

senses.meaning_en: an act of saying farewell

examples.text: We stayed behind to say goodby to our old neighbors.
examples.translation_cn: 我们留下来和我们的老邻居告别。

senses.meaning_en: the act of thinking about past events

examples.text: The reunion prompted a moment of retrospection for the old classmates.
examples.translation_cn: 这次聚会让老同学们不禁回顾起往事。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is passing by, especially on foot

examples.text: A passerby in the street noticed the child crying and called the police.
examples.translation_cn: 街上的一个过路人看到孩子在哭，于是报了警。

senses.meaning_en: wastefully reckless with money or resources

examples.text: He is thriftless with his salary and often runs out before the month ends.
examples.translation_cn: 他花钱无度，经常不到月底就花光。

senses.meaning_en: to know how to do something; to have the ability to

examples.text: My younger brother can play the guitar very well.
examples.translation_cn: 我弟弟吉他弹得很好。

senses.meaning_en: to be allowed to; to have permission to

examples.text: Can I use your phone for a minute?
examples.translation_cn: 我可以用一下你的电话吗？

senses.meaning_en: to be possible; used to say that something is sometimes true or likely

examples.text: Driving in thick fog can be very dangerous.
examples.translation_cn: 在大雾中开车可能非常危险。

senses.meaning_en: used to ask someone to do something

examples.text: Can you open the window for me, please?
examples.translation_cn: 你能帮我打开窗户吗？

senses.meaning_en: a method, manner, or style of doing something

examples.text: There is a way of learning that suits every student.
examples.translation_cn: 有一种适合每个学生的学习方法。

senses.meaning_en: a route or path taken to reach a place

examples.text: Could you tell me the way to the nearest bank?
examples.translation_cn: 你能告诉我去最近的银行怎么走吗？

senses.meaning_en: the direction or position in which somebody or something moves or faces

examples.text: Go this way until you see the red mailbox.
examples.translation_cn: 往这边走，直到你看到那个红色邮筒。

senses.meaning_en: a particular aspect or respect of something

examples.text: In a way, this job is harder than my last one.
examples.translation_cn: 在某种程度上，这份工作比我上一份更难。

senses.meaning_en: in a good or satisfactory way

examples.text: She did well in the interview and got the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她在面试中表现很好，得到了这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: completely or fully

examples.text: Mix all the ingredients well before you bake the cake.
examples.translation_cn: 烘烤蛋糕之前，把所有原料充分混合。
