senses.meaning_en: to a significant degree; very

examples.text: The temperature is well above average for this time of year.
examples.translation_cn: 气温远高于往年同期的平均水平。

senses.meaning_en: in good health

examples.text: She doesn't feel well enough to go to work today.
examples.translation_cn: 她今天感觉身体不适，不能去上班。

senses.meaning_en: from a higher position to a lower one; downwards

examples.text: The little cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
examples.translation_cn: 小猫从厨房桌子上跳了下来。

senses.meaning_en: sad or ill

examples.text: She has been feeling down since she lost her job.
examples.translation_cn: 自从失业后她一直情绪低落。

senses.meaning_en: at or to a lower or further point along a path

examples.text: They live just down the street from us.
examples.translation_cn: 他们就住在我们这条街前面。

senses.meaning_en: to cause to fall or shoot down

examples.text: The soldiers shot down an enemy plane yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们昨天击落了一架敌机。

senses.meaning_en: to or in the south

examples.text: They moved down south with their family last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去年和家人搬到了南方。

senses.meaning_en: flat and level

examples.text: The floor must be perfectly even before you lay the tiles.
examples.translation_cn: 铺瓷砖前地面必须完全平坦。

senses.meaning_en: equal in amount, size, or degree

examples.text: The two teams were even with each other at halftime.
examples.translation_cn: 半场时两队不分胜负。

senses.meaning_en: exactly divisible by two

examples.text: Twelve is an even number, so it can be divided by two exactly.
examples.translation_cn: 十二是偶数，所以可以被二整除。

senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize something surprising or extreme

examples.text: The new phone is even more expensive than the old model.
examples.translation_cn: 新手机比旧型号更贵。

senses.meaning_en: continuing to happen or be true

examples.text: She is still working on her essay this evening.
examples.translation_cn: 她今晚仍在写论文。

senses.meaning_en: to an even greater degree; used with comparatives

examples.text: He studied hard, but his sister studied still harder.
examples.translation_cn: 他学习很努力，但他妹妹学习更努力。

senses.meaning_en: not moving; calm and quiet

examples.text: The photographer asked us to stand still for a moment.
examples.translation_cn: 摄影师让我们站着别动了一会儿。

senses.meaning_en: not sparkling; without carbonation

examples.text: Would you like still water or sparkling water?
examples.translation_cn: 你想要无汽水还是气泡水？

senses.meaning_en: employment; a job

examples.text: He goes to work as a teacher at a local school.
examples.translation_cn: 他在当地一所学校当老师。

senses.meaning_en: a product of effort, especially an artistic or literary one

examples.text: This sculpture is a work of art by a local artist.
examples.translation_cn: 这个雕塑是当地艺术家的作品。

senses.meaning_en: to function or operate correctly

examples.text: The new software doesn't work properly on older phones.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新软件在旧手机上无法正常运行。

senses.meaning_en: effort; mental or physical effort made to achieve something

examples.text: Learning a new language is hard work for most people.
examples.translation_cn: 对大多数人来说，学习一门新语言是件辛苦的事。

senses.meaning_en: to do a job or specific task, especially as a regular occupation

examples.text: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地医院当护士。

senses.meaning_en: final; being the only one remaining

examples.text: She offered me the last slice of pizza.
examples.translation_cn: 她给了我最后一块披萨。

senses.meaning_en: most recent; latest

examples.text: We went hiking at the lake last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末去湖边徒步了。

senses.meaning_en: to continue for a particular length of time; to be enough

examples.text: Our food supplies lasted for nearly a month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的食品储备维持了将近一个月。

senses.meaning_en: least likely or desirable

examples.text: He is the last person to believe such rumors.
examples.translation_cn: 他是最不可能相信这种谣言的人。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to be something; to turn into something

examples.text: She became a lawyer after years of hard work.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的努力，她成了一名律师。

senses.meaning_en: to start to be; to change into a different state

examples.text: The weather became much colder as night fell.
examples.translation_cn: 随着夜幕降临，天气冷了许多。

senses.meaning_en: to happen to someone or something; to come about

examples.text: What became of the old cinema in town?
examples.translation_cn: 镇上的那家老电影院后来怎么样了？

senses.meaning_en: to attempt or make an effort to do something

examples.text: I tried to call you several times last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我昨晚给你打了好几次电话。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt or effort to do something

examples.text: Let's have a try at solving this puzzle.
examples.translation_cn: 我们来试试解这个谜题吧。

senses.meaning_en: to test or experiment with something to see if it works or is suitable

examples.text: Why don't you try using a different key?
examples.translation_cn: 你为什么不试试用另一把钥匙？

senses.meaning_en: to examine and decide a legal case in court

examples.text: The suspect will be tried for fraud next month.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人下个月将以欺诈罪受审。

senses.meaning_en: a group of actors, dancers, etc. who perform together

examples.text: She joined a theatre company after graduating from drama school.
examples.translation_cn: 她从戏剧学校毕业后加入了一个剧团。

senses.meaning_en: companionship

examples.text: Will you keep me company while I cook dinner?
examples.translation_cn: 我做饭时你陪陪我好吗？

senses.meaning_en: a business organization that makes or sells goods or services

examples.text: He started a tech company in his garage.
examples.translation_cn: 他在车库里创办了一家科技公司。

senses.meaning_en: a guest or guests

examples.text: We expect company this weekend, so we cleaned the house.
examples.translation_cn: 这个周末我们有客人来，所以把房子打扫了。

senses.meaning_en: a person or group involved in a legal case or contract

examples.text: Both companies are parties to the agreement and must follow it.
examples.translation_cn: 两家公司都是该协议的当事人，必须遵守协议。

senses.meaning_en: to celebrate or have fun at a party

examples.text: They partied all night after the final exam.
examples.translation_cn: 期末考试后他们狂欢了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: a social event where people meet to enjoy themselves

examples.text: We first met at a party in New York.
examples.translation_cn: 我们第一次在纽约的一个聚会上见面。

senses.meaning_en: a political organization that tries to get its members elected

examples.text: He belongs to a party that supports tax reform.
examples.translation_cn: 他属于一个支持税收改革的政党。

senses.meaning_en: to be on your feet in an upright position

examples.text: He stood at the corner waiting for the bus.
examples.translation_cn: 他站在街角等公共汽车。

senses.meaning_en: to remain without ruin or injury

examples.text: This old bridge has stood the test of time.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老桥经受住了时间的考验。

senses.meaning_en: to accept or bear something unpleasant

examples.text: I can't stand waiting in long queues at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 我无法忍受在机场排长队等候。

senses.meaning_en: an attitude or opinion about something

examples.text: The senator took a strong stand on climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 这位参议员在气候变化问题上采取了强硬立场。

senses.meaning_en: the front part of the head

examples.text: Look me in the face and tell me the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 看着我的脸，告诉我实话。

senses.meaning_en: one's facial expression

examples.text: She delivered the bad news with a straight face.
examples.translation_cn: 她绷着脸宣布了这个坏消息。

senses.meaning_en: the surface or front side of something

examples.text: The face of the watch was badly scratched.
examples.translation_cn: 手表表面被严重划伤了。

senses.meaning_en: public reputation or dignity

examples.text: He would rather admit his mistake than lose face in public.
examples.translation_cn: 他宁愿承认错误，也不愿当众丢面子。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of time equal to sixty seconds

examples.text: The trip takes about thirty minutes by car.
examples.translation_cn: 开车大约需要三十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a very short time or a particular point in time

examples.text: I will be with you in a minute.
examples.translation_cn: 我马上就来。

senses.meaning_en: a written record of a meeting

examples.text: The secretary read the minutes of the last meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 秘书宣读了上次会议的记录。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of angle equal to one sixtieth of a degree

examples.text: The latitude is 51 degrees and 30 minutes north.
examples.translation_cn: 纬度是北纬51度30分。

senses.meaning_en: to put forward an idea or plan for someone to consider

examples.text: I suggest taking a short break before we continue.
examples.translation_cn: 我建议我们先休息一下再继续。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem likely or be a sign of something

examples.text: The latest findings suggest that the treatment is effective.
examples.translation_cn: 最新研究结果表明这种治疗有效。

senses.meaning_en: to mention someone or something as being suitable for a particular purpose

examples.text: The committee suggested her for the leadership role.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会推荐她担任领导职务。

senses.meaning_en: to imply something without saying it directly

examples.text: Are you suggesting that I made a mistake?
examples.translation_cn: 你是在暗示我犯了错吗？

senses.meaning_en: a small portable or wearable timepiece

examples.text: He glanced at his watch before answering the phone.
examples.translation_cn: 他接电话前看了一眼手表。

senses.meaning_en: the act of guarding and observing someone or something

examples.text: The police kept a close watch on the suspect's house.
examples.translation_cn: 警方严密监视着嫌疑人的住所。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time when someone is on duty to guard or observe

examples.text: The young officer was on watch from midnight to four.
examples.translation_cn: 这名年轻军官从午夜到四点值班。

senses.meaning_en: to be careful about someone or something, often used to warn

examples.text: Watch out for the loose step on the stairs.
examples.translation_cn: 当心楼梯上松动的那一级。

senses.meaning_en: to look at someone or something for a period of time, paying attention to what is happening

examples.text: You can watch the class first before joining.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以先观看课堂再参加。

senses.meaning_en: the main topic of a paper, work of art, discussion, etc.

examples.text: She wrote a long essay on the subject of climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的长文章。

senses.meaning_en: a particular area of study

examples.text: Students have to study a core subject for at least three years.
examples.translation_cn: 学生必须学习一门核心科目至少三年。

senses.meaning_en: the noun or noun phrase about which a statement is made

examples.text: The subject of a clause usually comes before the verb in English.
examples.translation_cn: 英语中从句的主语通常位于动词之前。

senses.meaning_en: likely to be affected by something; liable

examples.text: Flights are often subject to delays in bad weather.
examples.translation_cn: 航班在恶劣天气下常会受延误影响。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to experience something unpleasant

examples.text: He subjected his staff to constant criticism and impossible deadlines.
examples.translation_cn: 他让员工不断遭受批评和不切实际的最后期限。

senses.meaning_en: a particular point in time or opportunity

examples.text: The crowd cheered at the moment of the final whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 终场哨响的那一刻，人群欢呼起来。

senses.meaning_en: a brief period of time; the present time

examples.text: At the moment, she is working on a new project.
examples.translation_cn: 目前她正在做一个新项目。

examples.text: She started learning French at the age of six.
examples.translation_cn: 她六岁开始学法语。

examples.text: He took up gardening only in old age.
examples.translation_cn: 他直到晚年才迷上园艺。

examples.text: She started painting seriously only in middle age.
examples.translation_cn: 她直到中年才开始认真画画。

examples.text: You must be of age to enter this club.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须成年才能进入这家俱乐部。

senses.meaning_en: the mixture of gases that surrounds the Earth and that we breathe

examples.text: We opened the window to breathe in the cool night air.
examples.translation_cn: 我们打开窗户呼吸凉爽的夜晚空气。

senses.meaning_en: the open space above the ground where planes, birds, etc. move

examples.text: A plane flew high in the air above the clouds.
examples.translation_cn: 一架飞机在云层上方的高空飞行。

senses.meaning_en: a person's manner or the general character of a situation; atmosphere

examples.text: She faced the crisis with an air of calm.
examples.translation_cn: 她以平静的神态面对危机。

senses.meaning_en: a tune, especially an aria from an opera

examples.text: The soprano sang a lovely air from the opera.
examples.translation_cn: 女高音演唱了歌剧中一段优美的咏叹调。

senses.meaning_en: to make a choice or judgment after thinking

examples.text: She decided to take the job after a long talk.
examples.translation_cn: 她在长谈后决定接受这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: to settle a contest, dispute, or case

examples.text: The court will decide the case on Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 法院将在周一裁决此案。

senses.meaning_en: to be the factor that determines an outcome

examples.text: His goal decided the outcome of the match.
examples.translation_cn: 他的进球决定了比赛的结果。

senses.meaning_en: to grow or cause to grow

examples.text: The tiny seed developed into a tall tree over several years.
examples.translation_cn: 那颗小种子经过几年长成了一棵大树。

senses.meaning_en: to create or design something new

examples.text: They developed a new product to clean solar panels.
examples.translation_cn: 他们开发了一种清洁太阳能板的新产品。

senses.meaning_en: to begin to have something such as a habit, interest, or disease/problem

examples.text: He developed a serious illness after years of smoking.
examples.translation_cn: 他吸了多年烟后患上了重病。

senses.meaning_en: to treat photographic film with chemicals to make pictures visible

examples.text: She developed the film and printed the photos.
examples.translation_cn: 她冲洗了胶卷并打印了照片。

senses.meaning_en: a religious group that has separated from a larger religion

examples.text: He joined a strict religious sect in his early twenties.
examples.translation_cn: 他二十出头时加入了一个严格的宗教教派。

senses.meaning_en: a group following a particular ideal or leader

examples.text: They belong to a political sect that rejects compromise.
examples.translation_cn: 他们属于一个拒绝妥协的政治派别。

senses.meaning_en: to increase the amount or level of something

examples.text: The government raised taxes by five percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府去年将税收提高了五个百分点。

senses.meaning_en: to bring up for discussion or attention

examples.text: She raised a question with the teacher after class.
examples.translation_cn: 她课后向老师提出了一个问题。

senses.meaning_en: to care for a child or animal until it is fully grown

examples.text: She was raised by her grandparents in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 她由祖父母在乡下抚养长大。

senses.meaning_en: to collect money for a particular purpose

examples.text: The school raised enough money for a new playground.
examples.translation_cn: 学校筹集了足够的资金修建一个新操场。

senses.meaning_en: an increase in salary

examples.text: She asked her boss for a raise after working there for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在那里工作两年后向老板要求加薪。

senses.meaning_en: to move something towards you, usually with force

examples.text: He pulled the box towards him and opened it.
examples.translation_cn: 他把盒子拉向自己，然后打开。

senses.meaning_en: to attract or pull in

examples.text: The new exhibition is pulling in large crowds.
examples.translation_cn: 新展览正吸引大量观众。

senses.meaning_en: to remove or pull out

examples.text: She pulled a tissue out of the box.
examples.translation_cn: 她从盒子里抽出一张纸巾。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a particular direction, especially used of vehicles

examples.text: The bus pulled away from the stop and turned left.
examples.translation_cn: 公共汽车驶离车站，左转。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the body from the shoulder to the hand

examples.text: She held the crying baby in her arms.
examples.translation_cn: 她怀里抱着哭泣的婴儿。

senses.meaning_en: weapons, especially guns

examples.text: The rebels took up arms against the government.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军拿起武器反抗政府。

senses.meaning_en: to provide someone with information or skills

examples.text: The course arms students with practical job skills.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程使学生具备实用的工作技能。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the arm
senses.collocation: tear the arm of a jacket

examples.text: The right arm of my coat is torn.
examples.translation_cn: 我外套的右袖破了。

senses.meaning_en: a branch or division of an organization
senses.collocation: the research arm of a company

examples.text: The agency is an arm of the federal government.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构是联邦政府的一个分支。

senses.meaning_en: to connect or combine two or more things

examples.text: He joined the hose to the tap and turned on the water.
examples.translation_cn: 他把软管接到水龙头上，然后打开了水。

senses.meaning_en: to come into the company of someone

examples.text: Would you like to join us for dinner?
examples.translation_cn: 你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

senses.meaning_en: to become a member of a group or organization

examples.text: She joined a local choir to meet new people.
examples.translation_cn: 她加入了本地合唱团以结识新朋友。

senses.meaning_en: to do something with another person or group

examples.text: They joined us in singing the school song.
examples.translation_cn: 他们和我们一起唱了校歌。

senses.meaning_en: a period of the year with particular weather or natural conditions, especially when plants ripen or animals breed

examples.text: Vegetables are cheaper when they are in season.
examples.translation_cn: 蔬菜当季时更便宜。

senses.meaning_en: a period of the year when a particular sport or event takes place

examples.text: He broke the record during the basketball season.
examples.translation_cn: 他在篮球赛季期间打破了纪录。

senses.meaning_en: the time of year when a place is most popular or busy for travel or business

examples.text: The town is crowded during the tourist season.
examples.translation_cn: 旅游旺季时这个镇子很拥挤。

senses.meaning_en: a set of episodes of a television or radio series broadcast together

examples.text: The first season of the series got high ratings.
examples.translation_cn: 该剧第一季获得了高收视率。

senses.meaning_en: to have something on your body as clothing or decoration

examples.text: She was wearing a blue coat and a gold necklace.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一条金项链。

senses.meaning_en: to have your hair or beard in a particular style or length

examples.text: My older brother wears his hair long at the back.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥在脑后留着长发。

senses.meaning_en: to have a particular expression on your face
senses.pattern: wear a ... expression on one's face

examples.text: He wore a puzzled expression on his face when I told him the news.
examples.translation_cn: 当我告诉他这个消息时，他脸上露出困惑的表情。

senses.meaning_en: to become thinner or damaged through continuous use

examples.text: The marble steps have worn away after centuries of foot traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 这些大理石台阶经过几个世纪的踩踏已经磨损了。

senses.meaning_en: a small sheltered bay

examples.text: The fishing boat anchored in a sheltered cove for the night.
examples.translation_cn: 渔船停泊在一个隐蔽的小海湾里过夜。

senses.meaning_en: a thing used to cover a container or opening

examples.text: Put the cover on the pan while the rice cooks.
examples.translation_cn: 米饭煮着的时候，把锅盖盖好。

senses.meaning_en: the front or back part of a book or magazine

examples.text: Her portrait appeared on the cover of the magazine.
examples.translation_cn: 她的肖像出现在那本杂志的封面上。

senses.meaning_en: the top covering on a bed

examples.text: She stayed warm under the covers until noon.
examples.translation_cn: 她待在暖和的被窝里直到中午。

senses.meaning_en: to include or deal with a subject or area

examples.text: The course will cover a topic that many students find difficult.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程会涉及一个许多学生觉得困难的主题。

senses.meaning_en: to report news about something for a newspaper, television, etc.

examples.text: The newspaper sent a reporter to cover the story.
examples.translation_cn: 报社派了一名记者去报道这件事。

senses.meaning_en: a specific day or time when something happens or is arranged to happen

examples.text: We need to set a date for our next meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要为下次会议确定一个日期。

senses.meaning_en: a planned meeting with someone you like or have a romantic relationship with

examples.text: He went on a date with a colleague last Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 上周五他和一位同事约会了。

senses.meaning_en: to write the date on something; to find out the age of something

examples.text: The experts dated the fossil to the Jurassic period.
examples.translation_cn: 专家们确定该化石属于侏罗纪时期。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet brown fruit that grows on palm trees

examples.text: He often snacks on dried dates after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常晚饭后吃干椰枣当零食。

senses.meaning_en: to grasp something moving; to capture a person or animal

examples.text: She caught the ball with both hands after a long pass.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一次长传后用双手接住了球。

senses.meaning_en: to be in time for a bus, train, etc.

examples.text: We need to hurry if we want to catch the last train.
examples.translation_cn: 我们得快点儿，如果要赶上末班火车。

senses.meaning_en: to become infected with an illness

examples.text: He caught a cold from his sister last week.
examples.translation_cn: 他上周被他姐姐传染了感冒。

senses.meaning_en: the act of catching something, especially a ball

examples.text: She made a great catch to win the game.
examples.translation_cn: 她完成了一次精彩的接球，赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: an item used on stage or in a film

examples.text: The actor used a wooden sword as a prop in the play.
examples.translation_cn: 演员在剧中使用一把木剑作为道具。

senses.meaning_en: to support or keep in place

examples.text: He propped his bike against the fence before going inside.
examples.translation_cn: 他进去之前把自行车靠在篱笆上。

senses.meaning_en: a propeller, especially on an aircraft or boat

examples.text: The prop of the boat churned the water as it sped away.
examples.translation_cn: 船飞驰而去时，螺旋桨搅动着水面。

senses.meaning_en: an object that supports something

examples.text: He placed a wooden block as a prop under the sagging shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 他在下陷的架子下面放了一块木块作支撑。

senses.meaning_en: almost; virtually

examples.text: We nearly missed the last train home last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚差点错过了回家的最后一班火车。

senses.meaning_en: worried or anxious

examples.text: Parents are concerned about their children's safety online.
examples.translation_cn: 父母担心孩子的网络安全。

senses.meaning_en: involved or responsible

examples.text: Several officials were concerned in the financial scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 几名官员卷入了金融丑闻。

senses.meaning_en: about a particular subject

examples.text: The report is concerned with the effects of climate change.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告涉及气候变化的影响。

senses.meaning_en: to remove or block an opening, gap or passage through

examples.text: She closed the window because it was getting cold.
examples.translation_cn: 因为天气变冷，她关上了窗户。

senses.meaning_en: not far in distance or time

examples.text: Our hotel is close to the train station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的旅馆离火车站很近。

senses.meaning_en: having a strong relationship

examples.text: She is close to her grandmother and tells her all her secrets.
examples.translation_cn: 她与祖母很亲近，把所有秘密都告诉她。

senses.meaning_en: careful and thorough

examples.text: The police paid close attention to every detail.
examples.translation_cn: 警察密切注意每一个细节。

senses.meaning_en: the action of defending or protecting from attack, danger, or injury

examples.text: The immune system is the body's defense against infection.
examples.translation_cn: 免疫系统是人体抵抗感染的防御系统。

senses.meaning_en: an argument in support or justification of something

examples.text: She spoke in defense of her decision to leave.
examples.translation_cn: 她为自己离开的决定进行了辩护。

senses.meaning_en: the players in a team whose main job is to prevent the opposing team from scoring

examples.text: The defense held their opponents to only one goal.
examples.translation_cn: 防守队员们只让对手进了一个球。

senses.meaning_en: government policy or infrastructure related to the military

examples.text: The country increased its spending on national defense this year.
examples.translation_cn: 该国今年增加了国防开支。

senses.meaning_en: of high quality; satisfactory

examples.text: She stayed at a fine hotel near the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 她住在湖边一家很好的酒店。

senses.meaning_en: a sum of money paid as a penalty

examples.text: He had to pay a heavy fine for speeding.
examples.translation_cn: 他因超速不得不缴付高额罚款。

senses.meaning_en: thin, delicate, or made of very small pieces

examples.text: The artist captures every wrinkle in fine detail.
examples.translation_cn: 这位艺术家精细地捕捉每一条皱纹。

senses.meaning_en: in a satisfactory or pleasant way

examples.text: The new system works fine after the update.
examples.translation_cn: 新系统更新后运行良好。

senses.meaning_en: to send an object through the air with force from your hand

examples.text: He threw the ball to his teammate across the field.
examples.translation_cn: 他把球扔给了场地对面的队友。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone or something to suddenly be in a particular state or condition

examples.text: The unexpected news threw him into deep confusion.
examples.translation_cn: 这个意外的消息使他陷入深深的困惑。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately lose a game or match, especially for money

examples.text: The team was accused of throwing the match for money.
examples.translation_cn: 这支队伍被指控为了钱而放水。

senses.meaning_en: to organize and host a party or event

examples.text: They threw a surprise party for her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为她的生日举办了一个惊喜聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a formal, rhythmic way of walking, used especially by soldiers

examples.text: The enemy troops are on the march toward the border.
examples.translation_cn: 敌军正朝边境行进。

senses.meaning_en: to walk with long, regular strides, as soldiers do

examples.text: Thousands of students marched through the city center.
examples.translation_cn: 数千名学生穿过市中心游行。

senses.meaning_en: a political rally or parade

examples.text: She joined a march against climate change last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 她上周末参加了一场反对气候变化的游行。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of music with a strong regular rhythm, written for marching to

examples.text: The band played a lively march as the parade began.
examples.translation_cn: 游行开始时，乐队演奏了一首轻快的进行曲。

senses.meaning_en: no longer living

examples.text: The bird was dead when we found it this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我们发现那只鸟时，它已经死了。

senses.meaning_en: lacking life or activity (of a place)

examples.text: The old town was dead at night, with almost no one around.
examples.translation_cn: 老城区夜里死气沉沉的，几乎没什么人。

senses.meaning_en: completely; absolutely

examples.text: I am dead certain that we have met before.
examples.translation_cn: 我完全确定我们以前见过。

senses.meaning_en: not working, especially because of no power

examples.text: My laptop went dead halfway through the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我的笔记本电脑在会议进行到一半时没电关机了。

senses.meaning_en: having a circular shape

examples.text: The ball is perfectly round and easy to roll.
examples.translation_cn: 这个球非常圆，容易滚动。

senses.meaning_en: complete or whole

examples.text: She bought a round dozen eggs for the recipe.
examples.translation_cn: 她为这道食谱买了整整一打鸡蛋。

senses.meaning_en: convenient for rounding to; ending in zero

examples.text: The total cost is $500 in round numbers.
examples.translation_cn: 总成本按整数算是500美元。

senses.meaning_en: pronounced with rounded lips

examples.text: The vowel sound in 'moon' is a rounded vowel.
examples.translation_cn: 'moon' 中的元音是一个圆唇元音。

senses.meaning_en: a stage in a game or competition

examples.text: Let's play one more round of this game.
examples.translation_cn: 我们再玩一轮这个游戏吧。

senses.meaning_en: a common animal with four legs, kept as a pet or used for work

examples.text: She walks the dog in the park every morning before work.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上上班前在公园里遛狗。

senses.meaning_en: a person of a particular type (informal)

examples.text: He is a lucky dog to have such a caring partner.
examples.translation_cn: 他真是个幸运的家伙，有个这么体贴的伴侣。

senses.meaning_en: to cause problems for someone or something over a long period

examples.text: The project has been dogged by bad weather all week.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目整周都被恶劣天气所困扰。

senses.meaning_en: to follow someone closely and persistently

examples.text: The detective dogged the suspect through the crowded market.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探穿过拥挤的市场尾随嫌疑人。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone happy or satisfied

examples.text: Her cheerful smile pleased everyone in the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她愉快的微笑使房间里每个人都很高兴。

senses.meaning_en: to want or like; to do as one wishes

examples.text: You may stay or leave as you please.
examples.translation_cn: 去留悉听尊便。

senses.meaning_en: used to make a polite request

examples.text: Please turn off your phone during the show.
examples.translation_cn: 演出期间请关闭手机。

senses.meaning_en: used to accept an offer politely

examples.text: Would you like another cup of tea? Yes, please.
examples.translation_cn: 你想再来一杯茶吗？好的，请。

senses.meaning_en: prepared for immediate action or use

examples.text: The hotel room is ready for its first guests.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店房间已为第一批客人准备好。

senses.meaning_en: willing to do something

examples.text: She is always ready to help her colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是乐于帮助同事。

senses.meaning_en: likely to do something or about to do something

examples.text: The old wooden bridge is ready to collapse.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老木桥快要塌了。

senses.meaning_en: quick in action or perception; not slow or hesitating

examples.text: She is always ready with a witty answer.
examples.translation_cn: 她总能机敏地给出妙答。

senses.meaning_en: the way a person or animal acts or behaves

examples.text: His behaviour towards his colleagues has changed recently.
examples.translation_cn: 他最近对同事的态度变了。

senses.meaning_en: the way a substance, machine, etc. behaves or responds under particular conditions

examples.text: The behaviour of the material under high pressure surprised the engineers.
examples.translation_cn: 这种材料在高压下的表现令工程师们惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: having the colour of a clear sky

examples.text: The lake was deep blue under the clear sky.
examples.translation_cn: 晴朗天空下湖水是深蓝色的。

senses.meaning_en: sad or depressed

examples.text: She has been feeling blue since her dog died.
examples.translation_cn: 自从她的狗死后，她一直情绪低落。

senses.meaning_en: having bluish skin from lack of oxygen or cold

examples.text: His lips turned blue with cold during the long swim.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间游泳时他的嘴唇冻得发紫。

senses.meaning_en: extremely rare; almost raw and still cold inside

examples.text: He had his steak blue rare, so it was almost cold in the middle.
examples.translation_cn: 他点了一份近生牛排，中间几乎是凉的。

senses.meaning_en: to complete something; to bring to an end

examples.text: He finished painting the kitchen wall before lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 他在午饭前刷完了厨房的墙。

senses.meaning_en: to eat or drink all of something

examples.text: He finished his dinner before the news started.
examples.translation_cn: 他在新闻开始前吃完了晚饭。

senses.meaning_en: an end; the end of anything

examples.text: The whole journey from start to finish took just under two hours.
examples.translation_cn: 整个旅程从开始到结束只用了不到两个小时。

senses.meaning_en: the surface appearance or texture of a material; a protective coating

examples.text: Apply the varnish evenly to achieve a smooth finish.
examples.translation_cn: 均匀涂上清漆以获得光滑的表面。

senses.meaning_en: a finishing touch; careful elaboration; polish

examples.text: She spent an hour putting the finishing touches to her speech.
examples.translation_cn: 她花了一个小时给演讲稿做最后润色。

senses.meaning_en: an inspection or examination

examples.text: The school carried out a safety check on all equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 学校对所有设备进行了安全检查。

senses.meaning_en: an order to a bank to pay money to a named person or entity

examples.text: She wrote a check for $200 to pay the rent.
examples.translation_cn: 她开了一张200美元的支票来付房租。

senses.meaning_en: a mark (✓) used to show something is correct or done

examples.text: Please put a check next to each answer that is correct.
examples.translation_cn: 请在每个正确答案旁边打一个勾号。

senses.meaning_en: a control or limit on something

examples.text: We need to keep a check on our monthly spending.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要控制每月的开支。

senses.meaning_en: to examine something to make sure it is correct, safe, or satisfactory; to find out information about something

examples.text: I will check the status for you.
examples.translation_cn: 我会为您查询状态。

senses.meaning_en: to send a letter or parcel by mail

examples.text: I need to post this parcel to my parents before noon.
examples.translation_cn: 我得在中午之前把这个包裹寄给我父母。

senses.meaning_en: to announce publicly; to publish

examples.text: The school posted the exam timetable online last Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 学校上周五在网上发布了考试时间表。

senses.meaning_en: the official system for sending letters and parcels, or the letters themselves

examples.text: Your new passport should arrive in the post tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 你的新护照应该明天邮寄到。

senses.meaning_en: a job or official position, often a responsible one

examples.text: He held a senior post at the bank for years.
examples.translation_cn: 他多年来在银行担任高级职务。

senses.meaning_en: a long piece of wood or metal fixed upright in the ground, used as a support or marker

examples.text: He tied the horse to a fence post beside the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 他把马系在门边的栅栏柱上。

senses.meaning_en: to move or burst forth suddenly

examples.text: He sprang out of his chair when the phone rang.
examples.translation_cn: 电话一响，他从椅子上跳了起来。

senses.meaning_en: the season between winter and summer

examples.text: The valley is covered with wildflowers in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天山谷里开满野花。

senses.meaning_en: a coiled piece of metal that returns to its original shape after being pressed or pulled

examples.text: The seats are mounted on springs to reduce vibration.
examples.translation_cn: 座椅安装在弹簧上以减小震动。

senses.meaning_en: a place where water naturally flows out of the ground

examples.text: The village gets its water from a natural spring.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村庄从一处天然泉取水。

senses.meaning_en: to speak or write about something briefly

examples.text: He mentioned the meeting to his boss this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 他今天早上向老板提到了会议。

senses.meaning_en: an act of mentioning something; a brief reference

examples.text: She blushed at the mention of his name.
examples.translation_cn: 一提到他的名字，她就脸红了。

senses.meaning_en: a social media feed of posts or replies that mention a person

examples.text: She checked her mentions after posting the photo.
examples.translation_cn: 她发布照片后查看了别人@她的消息。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supports democracy

examples.text: She is a committed democrat and has fought for free elections for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一名坚定的民主主义者，几十年来一直为自由选举而奋斗。

senses.meaning_en: a member or supporter of the US Democratic Party

examples.text: She plans to run as a Democrat for Congress next year.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划明年以民主党人身份竞选国会议员。

senses.meaning_en: to claim something, often insincerely

examples.text: He professed to know nothing about the missing files.
examples.translation_cn: 他声称对丢失的文件一无所知。

senses.meaning_en: to declare one's adherence to a religion, deity, or principle

examples.text: She professes her faith in God at every service.
examples.translation_cn: 她每次做礼拜都表明自己对上帝的信仰。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is taught by a teacher, especially at school, or a student of an expert

examples.text: She was a pupil at the local primary school.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾是当地小学的一名学生。

senses.meaning_en: the round opening in the centre of the eye that lets light in

examples.text: Her pupils dilated quickly in the dim light.
examples.translation_cn: 在昏暗的光线下，她的瞳孔迅速放大。

senses.meaning_en: a journey, especially one for pleasure or business

examples.text: They took a trip to Paris for their anniversary.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去巴黎旅行庆祝结婚纪念日。

senses.meaning_en: to fall or nearly fall because your foot hits something; to make someone do this

examples.text: She tripped over the rug and nearly fell.
examples.translation_cn: 她被地毯绊了一下，差点摔倒。

senses.meaning_en: an unusual or exciting experience

examples.text: Meeting the cast backstage was a real trip for him.
examples.translation_cn: 在后台见到全体演员对他来说是一次奇特的经历。

senses.meaning_en: a fall or stumble caused by hitting your foot on something

examples.text: He had a trip on the top step.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最上面一级台阶上绊了一下。

senses.meaning_en: the outside or top layer of an object

examples.text: She placed a vase on the surface of the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一个花瓶放在桌面上。

senses.meaning_en: the top layer of an area of water or land

examples.text: The submarine stayed below the surface of the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 潜艇停留在海面之下。

senses.meaning_en: the outward appearance of someone or something, often hiding the truth

examples.text: On the surface, the plan seems simple, but there are hidden costs.
examples.translation_cn: 表面上看，这个计划似乎简单，但有隐性成本。

senses.meaning_en: difficulty; problems; worry

examples.text: She often has trouble sleeping at night because of stress.
examples.translation_cn: 她因压力常常夜里难以入睡。

senses.meaning_en: a person who causes trouble

examples.text: He's been a real trouble to his teachers.
examples.translation_cn: 他一直是老师们的麻烦。

senses.meaning_en: unrest; violent disturbance

examples.text: Trouble broke out in the streets after the match.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛后街上发生了骚乱。

senses.meaning_en: effort; bother

examples.text: She took the trouble to explain it again.
examples.translation_cn: 她不厌其烦地又解释了一遍。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a military force

examples.text: My uncle served as a soldier in the army for eight years before joining the police.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔在陆军当了八年兵，后来加入了警队。

senses.meaning_en: to continue doing something despite difficulty

examples.text: The team was exhausted, but they soldiered on until the work was done.
examples.translation_cn: 团队已经精疲力竭，但他们还是坚持到工作完成。

senses.meaning_en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking

examples.text: Open your mouth wide so I can see your throat.
examples.translation_cn: 张大嘴，好让我看看你的喉咙。

senses.meaning_en: the place where a river enters the sea or a larger body of water
senses.pattern: at the mouth of a river

examples.text: They built a lighthouse at the mouth of the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在河口建了一座灯塔。

senses.meaning_en: to say something without making a sound

examples.text: She mouthed the answer to me from the back of the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她从房间后面用口型把答案告诉了我。

senses.meaning_en: an opening or entrance
senses.pattern: at the mouth of a cave

examples.text: We waited at the mouth of the cave until the rain stopped.
examples.translation_cn: 我们就在洞口等着，直到雨停。

senses.meaning_en: superficial and showing little careful thought

examples.text: Many critics dismissed the theory as facile and superficial.
examples.translation_cn: 许多评论家认为这个理论肤浅而轻率，不予采纳。

senses.meaning_en: achieved too easily and therefore not deserving respect
senses.pattern: win a facile victory over sb

examples.text: The team won a facile victory over their weakened rivals.
examples.translation_cn: 那支队伍轻松战胜了实力削弱的对手。

senses.meaning_en: complicated

examples.text: The plot became too involved to follow by the end of the novel.
examples.translation_cn: 到了小说结尾，情节变得太复杂，让人看不懂。

senses.meaning_en: taking part in something or being connected with it

examples.text: She has been actively involved in local politics for years.
examples.translation_cn: 她多年来一直积极参与地方政治。

senses.meaning_en: having an affair with someone

examples.text: He is romantically involved with a woman he met at college.
examples.translation_cn: 他与一位在大学认识的女子关系亲密。

senses.meaning_en: the basic unit of time in music; a pulse in a rhythm

examples.text: The crowd clapped in time with the beat of the song.
examples.translation_cn: 人群随着歌曲的节拍拍手。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat someone in a game, competition, or fight

examples.text: She beat him at chess in just ten moves last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚仅用十步棋就赢了他。

senses.meaning_en: to hit something repeatedly

examples.text: She beat the rug with a stick to remove the dust.
examples.translation_cn: 她用棍子拍打地毯以除去灰尘。

senses.meaning_en: to make regular movements or sounds, as the heart does

examples.text: My heart beats fast whenever I hear that song.
examples.translation_cn: 每当我听到那首歌，我的心就跳得很快。

senses.meaning_en: a single pulsation or throb, especially of the heart

examples.text: Every beat of my heart seemed to echo in the silence.
examples.translation_cn: 每一次心跳似乎都在寂静中回响。

senses.meaning_en: a room or area for preparing food

examples.text: She is cooking dinner in the kitchen while the children watch TV.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在厨房做晚饭，孩子们在看电视。

senses.meaning_en: a style of cooking; cuisine

examples.text: The book explores the French kitchen in detail.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书详细探讨了法式烹饪。

senses.meaning_en: one of four equal parts

examples.text: A quarter of the students voted against the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 四分之一的学生投票反对这个计划。

senses.meaning_en: a period of fifteen minutes

examples.text: The bus leaves at a quarter past eight.
examples.translation_cn: 公共汽车八点一刻开出。

senses.meaning_en: a period of three months, especially as a division of a year for financial purposes

examples.text: The company's profits rose sharply in the first quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 公司第一季度的利润大幅增长。

senses.meaning_en: a coin worth 25 cents in the US and Canada

examples.text: He put a quarter into the vending machine.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一枚25美分硬币投入自动售货机。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being opposed to something or in a contrasting position

examples.text: The new law was passed in opposition to public opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律在违背公众意见的情况下通过了。

senses.meaning_en: a political party or movement opposed to the party or government in power

examples.text: The party is now in opposition after losing the election.
examples.translation_cn: 该党在选举失利后现处于在野状态。

senses.meaning_en: the people you are competing against in business, a competition, a game, etc.

examples.text: They put in a strong performance against the opposition to win the final.
examples.translation_cn: 他们面对对手表现出色，赢得决赛。

senses.meaning_en: finally resulting or occurring; inevitable

examples.text: The eventual outcome of the negotiations was far better than anyone had expected.
examples.translation_cn: 谈判的最终结果远比任何人预期的都要好。

senses.meaning_en: a sports event where people or teams compete

examples.text: The team won the match after a tense penalty shoot-out.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在紧张的点球大战后赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a small stick for lighting a fire

examples.text: She struck a match to light the candle.
examples.translation_cn: 她划了一根火柴点亮蜡烛。

senses.meaning_en: to be similar to or look good with something else

examples.text: He carefully matched his tie with his shirt.
examples.translation_cn: 他仔细地把领带和衬衫搭配起来。

senses.meaning_en: to be as good as or equal to someone or something

examples.text: No one can match her at solving puzzles.
examples.translation_cn: 没有人能比得上她解谜的能力。

senses.meaning_en: a marriage or a marriage partner

examples.text: Her parents hoped she would make a good match.
examples.translation_cn: 她的父母希望她能结成好姻缘。

senses.meaning_en: recognition, respect or admiration

examples.text: He got little credit for his role in the team's success.
examples.translation_cn: 他在团队成功中所起的作用很少得到赞扬。

senses.meaning_en: to acknowledge somebody's contribution or quality

examples.text: She was credited with discovering the new vaccine.
examples.translation_cn: 她因发现新疫苗而受到赞誉。

senses.meaning_en: belief or trust in the truth of something

examples.text: The new evidence lent credit to her version of events.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据使她的事件版本更可信。

senses.meaning_en: written information about a film or television programme

examples.text: My sister's name appears in the credits of that documentary.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐的名字出现在那部纪录片的制作组名单中。

senses.meaning_en: to believe or put credence in something

examples.text: I could hardly credit what I was hearing when they announced the winner.
examples.translation_cn: 当他们宣布获胜者时，我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

senses.meaning_en: lower in spatial position than

examples.text: The old mine extends far below ground level.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老矿井延伸到地下很深的地方。

senses.meaning_en: lower than a particular number, amount, level, or standard

examples.text: Her salary is below the national average for teachers.
examples.translation_cn: 她的工资低于全国教师的平均水平。

senses.meaning_en: later in the same text

examples.text: See below for a full list of references.
examples.translation_cn: 完整的参考文献列表见下文。

senses.meaning_en: having no faults or flaws; exactly right; ideal

examples.text: This old jacket is perfect for working in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 这件旧夹克非常适合在花园里干活。

senses.meaning_en: complete and total, used for emphasis

examples.text: They sat in perfect silence for what felt like an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 他们默不作声地坐了一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a verb form that expresses a completed action

examples.text: The sentence 'I have finished' is in the perfect tense.
examples.translation_cn: 句子‘I have finished’是完成时态。

senses.meaning_en: an informal talk in which people exchange ideas, news, or feelings

examples.text: I had a conversation with my neighbor about the noise.
examples.translation_cn: 我和邻居就噪音问题谈了一次。

senses.meaning_en: an imitation, sometimes of inferior quality

examples.text: This handbag is a cheap copy of a designer original.
examples.translation_cn: 这个手提包是名牌原版的廉价仿制品。

senses.meaning_en: a single printed or digital instance of a book, report, etc.

examples.text: She printed a copy of the report for each member.
examples.translation_cn: 她为每位成员打印了一份报告副本。

senses.meaning_en: to produce an object identical to a given object
senses.pattern: copy sth from A to B

examples.text: He copied the photos from his phone to a computer.
examples.translation_cn: 他把照片从手机复制到电脑上。

senses.meaning_en: written material for an advertisement or publication

examples.text: The copy for the new advertisement was short and clever.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新广告的文案简短巧妙。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people, organizations, or countries that have joined together for a common purpose

examples.text: The independent towns formed a league to protect their trade routes.
examples.translation_cn: 这些独立城镇组成了一个联盟来保护他们的贸易路线。

senses.meaning_en: a class or level of ability, quality, etc.

examples.text: This young singer is not in the same league as the world's top tenors.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻歌手与世界顶级男高音不在同一个档次。

senses.meaning_en: an organization of sports teams that compete against each other for a championship

examples.text: They finished top of the league for the first time.
examples.translation_cn: 他们第一次在联赛中排名榜首。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a region or regions

examples.text: Funding for schools is decided at a regional level.
examples.translation_cn: 学校的资金是在地区层面决定的。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to one part of the body

examples.text: The surgeon examined the regional lymph nodes for signs of cancer.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生检查了局部淋巴结以寻找癌症迹象。

senses.meaning_en: a circular piece of metal or other material, especially one worn on a finger

examples.text: She wears a gold ring on her left hand.
examples.translation_cn: 她左手戴着一枚金戒指。

senses.meaning_en: a circular area or arena used for sports or performances

examples.text: The two boxers met in the ring for the title fight.
examples.translation_cn: 两位拳击手在拳击场上进行冠军争夺战。

senses.meaning_en: the sound made by a bell or phone

examples.text: The phone rang twice before I picked it up.
examples.translation_cn: 电话响了两声我才接起来。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people involved in secret or illegal activities

examples.text: The police broke up a ring of car thieves operating in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 警方打掉了一个在市内活动的盗车团伙。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent movement, passage, or progress

examples.text: A large suitcase was blocking the entrance to the hall.
examples.translation_cn: 一个大行李箱堵住了大厅的入口。

senses.meaning_en: a solid piece of hard material with flat sides, or a child's toy piece

examples.text: A block of stone fell from the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 一块石头从墙上掉下来。

senses.meaning_en: the distance along a street from one road crossing to the next, or the area of buildings surrounded by streets

examples.text: The gym is only two blocks from my office.
examples.translation_cn: 健身房离我办公室只有两个街区远。

senses.meaning_en: something that prevents something from passing

examples.text: A piece of food caused a block in the kitchen sink.
examples.translation_cn: 一块食物堵住了厨房水槽。

senses.meaning_en: a cuboid or approximately cuboid building

examples.text: They live in a block of flats near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在车站附近的一栋公寓楼里。

senses.meaning_en: to trust someone enough to tell them your secrets or private feelings

examples.text: She confided in her sister about her problems at work.
examples.translation_cn: 她向姐姐倾诉了工作上的烦恼。

senses.meaning_en: to tell someone something secret or private, trusting them not to repeat it

examples.text: He confided his deepest doubts to his closest friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他向最亲密的朋友吐露了自己最深的疑虑。

senses.meaning_en: to make or pass laws

examples.text: The new parliament will legislate on tax reform this session.
examples.translation_cn: 新议会将在本届会期内就税收改革立法。

senses.meaning_en: something given to another voluntarily, without charge

examples.text: He gave a gift to his daughter on her birthday.
examples.translation_cn: 他在女儿生日时送了她一份礼物。

senses.meaning_en: a natural ability to do something well

examples.text: She has a real gift for learning new languages.
examples.translation_cn: 她学新语言真的很有天赋。

senses.meaning_en: to give something as a gift or donation

examples.text: The painting was generously gifted to the museum.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画被慷慨地赠送给了博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: something gained incidentally, without effort, often very cheap

examples.text: At that price, the laptop came as a real gift.
examples.translation_cn: 按那个价格，这台笔记本电脑真是个意外收获。

senses.meaning_en: to give away, to concede easily (especially in a game or contest)

examples.text: The defense gifted the opposition a soft goal in the final minute.
examples.translation_cn: 防守在最后一分钟轻易送给对手一球。

senses.meaning_en: to produce an air current

examples.text: A cold wind blew from the north all night.
examples.translation_cn: 冷风从北方吹了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: to send out air from the mouth to play an instrument or clear the nose
senses.collocation: blow your nose with a tissue

examples.text: He stopped to blow his nose before answering the question.
examples.translation_cn: 他停下来擤了擤鼻子，然后回答问题。

senses.meaning_en: to be moved by the wind

examples.text: The leaves blew in the wind all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 树叶在风中飘了一下午。

senses.meaning_en: to move something by blowing

examples.text: The strong wind blew the door shut with a bang.
examples.translation_cn: 强风砰的一声把门吹得关上了。

senses.meaning_en: a person who votes or has the right to vote

examples.text: As a voter, you should learn about each candidate's policies.
examples.translation_cn: 作为选民，你应该了解每位候选人的政策。

senses.meaning_en: to deny the existence or truth of something

examples.text: The new evidence negates the existence of any hidden agenda.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据否认存在任何隐藏议程。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to have no effect

examples.text: High inflation could negate the effect of wage increases.
examples.translation_cn: 高通胀可能抵消工资上涨的效果。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used to treat or prevent illness

examples.text: She took some cough medicine before bed to stop the cough.
examples.translation_cn: 她睡前服了些咳嗽药来止咳。

senses.meaning_en: a treatment or cure

examples.text: Laughter is often the best medicine for stress.
examples.translation_cn: 笑声往往是缓解压力的良药。

senses.meaning_en: the science or study of diagnosing and treating disease

examples.text: She decided to study medicine after volunteering at a clinic.
examples.translation_cn: 她在诊所志愿服务后决定学医。

senses.meaning_en: the profession or practice of physicians

examples.text: He went into medicine because he wanted to help sick people.
examples.translation_cn: 他从医是因为想帮助病人。

senses.meaning_en: a flat dish used for serving or eating food

examples.text: She put the cheese and crackers on a plate.
examples.translation_cn: 她把奶酪和饼干放在盘子上。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of food on a plate; a course served on a plate

examples.text: I ordered a plate of fried rice for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我午餐点了一盘炒饭。

senses.meaning_en: a flat metal sign, especially a vehicle registration plate

examples.text: The officer wrote down my license plate number.
examples.translation_cn: 警官记下了我的车牌号。

senses.meaning_en: one of the large sections of the earth's crust that move slowly

examples.text: The Pacific Plate is the largest tectonic plate on Earth.
examples.translation_cn: 太平洋板块是地球上最大的板块。

senses.meaning_en: free from dirt, germs, or contamination

examples.text: You should keep the cut clean to prevent infection.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该保持伤口清洁以防感染。

senses.meaning_en: free from guilt, blame, or criminal record

examples.text: He has a clean record and has never been arrested.
examples.translation_cn: 他没有犯罪记录，从未被捕。

senses.meaning_en: free from hidden listening devices or surveillance equipment

examples.text: The agent made sure the office was clean of listening devices.
examples.translation_cn: 特工确保办公室没有窃听装置。

senses.meaning_en: smooth, exact, and performed well

examples.text: The striker hit a clean shot into the corner.
examples.translation_cn: 前锋干净利落地将球射入角落。

senses.meaning_en: a visual representation of an area

examples.text: The island is clearly marked on the map.
examples.translation_cn: 这个岛清楚地标在地图上。

senses.meaning_en: to represent by means of a map

examples.text: Scientists mapped the ocean floor using sonar equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家使用声呐设备绘制了海底地图。

senses.meaning_en: a printed piece of paper or electronic record that gives you the right to travel, enter a place, or attend an event

examples.text: We booked two tickets for the opening night of the play.
examples.translation_cn: 我们订了两张该剧首演之夜的票。

senses.meaning_en: a written notice issued by police for breaking a traffic law

examples.text: He got a ticket for parking in a disabled spot.
examples.translation_cn: 他因在残疾人停车位停车被开了一张罚单。

senses.meaning_en: a record of a request for help from a support team

examples.text: Please open a support ticket if the app keeps crashing.
examples.translation_cn: 如果这款应用持续崩溃，请开一张支持请求单。

senses.meaning_en: a list of candidates representing a political party in an election

examples.text: She is running on the Democratic ticket for mayor.
examples.translation_cn: 她正以民主党候选人身份竞选市长。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of paper or card given as proof of ownership or for later collection

examples.text: Keep this ticket for pickup.
examples.translation_cn: 请保留这张领取凭证。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet substance obtained from sugar cane or sugar beet, used to sweeten food and drinks

examples.text: He offered me tea with sugar and lemon.
examples.translation_cn: 他给了我一杯加糖和柠檬的茶。

senses.meaning_en: to add sugar to something or cover it with sugar

examples.text: She sugared the fresh strawberries before serving them with cream.
examples.translation_cn: 她给新鲜草莓撒上糖，然后配上奶油端上桌。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of sugar, typically one teaspoon, used to sweeten a drink

examples.text: I usually take two sugars in my morning coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常在早上的咖啡里加两茶匙糖。

senses.meaning_en: a word used to address someone you like or love

examples.text: He always calls his little daughter sugar affectionately.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是亲昵地叫他的小女儿“宝贝”。

senses.meaning_en: to make a mistake

examples.text: The court erred in allowing the evidence to be presented.
examples.translation_cn: 法院允许该证据被呈上，这是一个错误。

senses.meaning_en: not crooked, curly, or bent; having a constant direction throughout its length

examples.text: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
examples.translation_cn: 用尺子画一条直线。

senses.meaning_en: direct in communication; unevasive; straightforward

examples.text: Let me be straight with you: this plan won't work.
examples.translation_cn: 我直截了当地对你说：这个计划行不通。

senses.meaning_en: perfectly horizontal or vertical; not diagonal or oblique

examples.text: Make sure the picture on the wall is straight.
examples.translation_cn: 确保墙上的画挂正了。

senses.meaning_en: consecutive; without interruption

examples.text: The team won five straight games to reach the final.
examples.translation_cn: 该队连赢五场比赛进入决赛。

senses.meaning_en: in a straight line; directly

examples.text: Go straight for two blocks.
examples.translation_cn: 直走两个街区。

senses.meaning_en: the state of the atmosphere at a particular time and place

examples.text: We stayed indoors in bad weather all day.
examples.translation_cn: 天气不好时，我们整天待在家里。

senses.meaning_en: to come safely through a difficult period or situation; to endure

examples.text: The company weathered the storm and recovered quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 公司经受住了风暴，并很快恢复。

senses.meaning_en: to change or be changed by exposure to the weather; to wear away or fade

examples.text: The old stone walls have been weathered by centuries of wind.
examples.translation_cn: 古老的石墙被几个世纪的风侵蚀了。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of happiness or satisfaction

examples.text: She takes great pleasure in helping others learn English.
examples.translation_cn: 她在帮助他人学习英语中获得极大乐趣。

senses.meaning_en: something that causes enjoyment
senses.pattern: it is a pleasure to do sth

examples.text: It is always a pleasure to cook for friends.
examples.translation_cn: 为朋友做饭总是件乐事。

senses.meaning_en: sexual enjoyment

examples.text: They talked openly about what gives them pleasure in bed.
examples.translation_cn: 他们坦率地谈论什么能让彼此在床上获得愉悦。

senses.meaning_en: one's preference or the will of someone in power

examples.text: The governor serves at the president's pleasure and can be removed at any time.
examples.translation_cn: 州长任职取决于总统意愿，可随时被免职。

senses.meaning_en: having little body fat or flesh

examples.text: She looks thin and weak after the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后她看上去瘦弱。

senses.meaning_en: having little thickness

examples.text: The lake was covered by a thin layer of ice.
examples.translation_cn: 湖面覆盖着一层薄冰。

senses.meaning_en: of low viscosity or specific gravity

examples.text: The soup is too thin to satisfy hungry guests.
examples.translation_cn: 这汤太稀了，无法让饥饿的客人吃饱。

senses.meaning_en: scarce; not close or numerous; lacking body or volume

examples.text: Volunteers were thin on the ground after the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水过后志愿者很少。

senses.meaning_en: to ask for something, especially money or support, in a persistent way

examples.text: Several charities solicit donations from local businesses every year.
examples.translation_cn: 几家慈善机构每年向当地企业募捐。

senses.meaning_en: to ask people for their opinions, feedback, etc.

examples.text: The university solicited feedback from students about the new schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 学校就新课表征求了学生的反馈。

senses.meaning_en: to offer sex for money; to approach someone and offer services

examples.text: The man was arrested for soliciting a passenger for sex at the train station.
examples.translation_cn: 该男子因在火车站向一名乘客拉客卖淫而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade or incite someone to do something, especially something illegal or harmful

examples.text: He was charged with soliciting a witness to commit perjury.
examples.translation_cn: 他被控教唆证人作伪证。

senses.meaning_en: a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares documents, especially in the UK

examples.text: She consulted a solicitor about the contract before signing it.
examples.translation_cn: 她在签署合同前咨询了一位初级律师。

senses.meaning_en: containing nothing; vacant

examples.text: The classroom was empty when I arrived this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我到教室时里面空无一人。

senses.meaning_en: to remove everything from a container or place

examples.text: She emptied the crumbs into the kitchen bin.
examples.translation_cn: 她把面包屑倒进厨房垃圾桶。

senses.meaning_en: feeling unhappy because life lacks purpose

examples.text: After his retirement, he felt empty for months.
examples.translation_cn: 退休后，他有好几个月感到空虚。

senses.meaning_en: lacking sincerity or real meaning

examples.text: Politicians often make empty promises during their campaigns.
examples.translation_cn: 政客在竞选期间常做空洞的承诺。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to care for people who are sick or injured

examples.text: She works as a nurse in a children's hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家儿童医院当护士。

senses.meaning_en: to care for (someone) especially during sickness

examples.text: She nursed her mother back to health after surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后她照料母亲恢复了健康。

senses.meaning_en: to feed (a baby) at the breast

examples.text: She nursed her baby at the breast until he fell asleep.
examples.translation_cn: 她给婴儿喂奶，直到他睡着。

senses.meaning_en: to hold (a feeling or idea) in the mind

examples.text: He nursed a secret hope of winning the prize.
examples.translation_cn: 他心怀获奖的秘密希望。

senses.meaning_en: suffering from a disease or illness; not well

examples.text: He has been sick with the flu all week.
examples.translation_cn: 他这一周因流感一直生病。

senses.meaning_en: feeling that you want to vomit

examples.text: I felt sick to my stomach after eating too much cake.
examples.translation_cn: 我吃了太多蛋糕后感到恶心想吐。

senses.meaning_en: bored or annoyed because you have had too much of something

examples.text: She is sick of hearing the same excuse.
examples.translation_cn: 她听腻了同一个借口。

senses.meaning_en: very good, excellent, awesome

examples.text: The skateboarding trick he did was totally sick.
examples.translation_cn: 他做的滑板动作太棒了。

senses.meaning_en: a very small piece of dust
senses.collocation: motes of dust in a sunbeam

examples.text: A mote of dust floated in the beam of sunlight.
examples.translation_cn: 一粒微尘在阳光光束中飘浮。

senses.meaning_en: having the colour of chocolate or coffee

examples.text: The river water is brown after the heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨过后，河水呈棕色。

senses.meaning_en: the colour brown

examples.text: The invitations were printed in brown and gold.
examples.translation_cn: 邀请函是用棕色和金色印制的。

senses.meaning_en: the brown ball used in snooker, worth four points

examples.text: He potted the brown and then the blue to win the frame.
examples.translation_cn: 他打进棕色球，接着打进蓝球，赢了这一局。

senses.meaning_en: taking care to avoid danger, mistakes, or harm

examples.text: Be careful with that knife; it is very sharp.
examples.translation_cn: 小心那把刀，它很锋利。

senses.meaning_en: giving attention to detail; thorough and conscientious

examples.text: After careful consideration, she decided to accept the job offer.
examples.translation_cn: 经过仔细考虑，她决定接受这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: a paragraph or section of a text or piece of music

examples.text: The teacher read a passage from the novel aloud.
examples.translation_cn: 老师大声朗读了小说中的一段。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow way or corridor

examples.text: There is a passage to the kitchen behind the stairs.
examples.translation_cn: 楼梯后面有一条通往厨房的通道。

senses.meaning_en: the process of time passing

examples.text: The passage of time has made the memory less painful.
examples.translation_cn: 时间的流逝使那段记忆不再那么痛苦。

senses.meaning_en: a duct or channel in the body

examples.text: The cold caused swelling in her nasal passages.
examples.translation_cn: 感冒使她的鼻腔通道肿胀。

senses.meaning_en: a competition to determine a champion, especially the final of a series

examples.text: They are competing in the European championship this summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们今年夏天正在参加欧洲锦标赛。

senses.meaning_en: the position or title of champion

examples.text: She has held the championship for three straight years.
examples.translation_cn: 她已连续三年保持冠军头衔。

senses.meaning_en: defense or support of a cause

examples.text: Her championship of workers' rights earned her great respect.
examples.translation_cn: 她对工人权利的捍卫为她赢得了极大的尊重。

senses.meaning_en: a plant or part of a plant used as food

examples.text: My kids refuse to eat vegetables unless I hide them in sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 我的孩子们拒绝吃蔬菜，除非我把它们藏在酱汁里。

senses.meaning_en: relating to plants or vegetables

examples.text: These cookies are made with vegetable oil instead of butter.
examples.translation_cn: 这些饼干用植物油代替黄油制成。

senses.meaning_en: a person in a persistent vegetative state (informal, offensive)

examples.text: He has been a vegetable since the stroke last year.
examples.translation_cn: 自从去年中风以来，他一直是个植物人。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to me

examples.text: A former colleague of mine recommended this small restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 我的一位前同事推荐了这家小餐馆。

senses.meaning_en: a place where minerals are dug from underground

examples.text: His grandfather worked in a coal mine for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他的祖父在一座煤矿工作了三十年。

senses.meaning_en: a bomb hidden underground or underwater that explodes when touched

examples.text: A fishing boat hit a mine and sank quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 一艘渔船触雷并迅速沉没。

senses.meaning_en: a firework that shoots sparks upward from the ground

examples.text: Bright gold sparks shot up from the mine during the finale.
examples.translation_cn: 在压轴表演中，明亮的金色火花从地面烟花喷射而出。

senses.meaning_en: to repeatedly annoy, harass, or worry someone

examples.text: Reporters harried the mayor with questions about the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 记者们就这起丑闻不断追问市长，使他不得安宁。

senses.meaning_en: to make repeated attacks on an enemy or place

examples.text: Small units harried the enemy forces throughout the night.
examples.translation_cn: 小股部队整夜不断袭扰敌军。

senses.meaning_en: at first; in the beginning

examples.text: The building was originally intended to be a library.
examples.translation_cn: 这座楼原本打算用作图书馆。

senses.meaning_en: to carry out or conduct business or a transaction

examples.text: Our firm transacts all property sales through a licensed agent.
examples.translation_cn: 我们公司通过持牌代理办理所有房产销售。

senses.meaning_en: to do business with someone

examples.text: We prefer to transact with suppliers who use electronic invoicing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们更愿意与使用电子发票的供应商进行交易。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a parliament or its activities

examples.text: A parliamentary committee has launched an inquiry into the housing crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 一个议会委员会已对住房危机展开调查。

senses.meaning_en: still left after other parts have been removed or dealt with

examples.text: We used the remaining time to review the key points.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用剩下的时间复习重点。

senses.meaning_en: to bind legally or morally; compel

examples.text: Employers are legally obligated to provide a safe workplace.
examples.translation_cn: 雇主在法律上有义务提供安全的工作场所。

senses.meaning_en: reputation, especially a good one; the state of being held in high esteem

examples.text: The hospital is held in high repute for its heart unit.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院因其心脏科而享有很高的声望。

senses.meaning_en: to consider, think, or reckon a person or thing to be; usually passive

examples.text: He is reputed to be the best surgeon in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 他被认为是全国最好的外科医生。

senses.meaning_en: in or to a foreign country

examples.text: He went abroad last year to study engineering.
examples.translation_cn: 他去年出国学习工程。

senses.meaning_en: in circulation; widely known

examples.text: Rumours were abroad that the minister would resign.
examples.translation_cn: 有谣言说部长将辞职。

senses.meaning_en: a person who brings a legal case against someone else in court

examples.text: The plaintiff alleges that the company broke the contract.
examples.translation_cn: 原告声称该公司违反了合同。

senses.meaning_en: very surprising

examples.text: It is amazing that no one was hurt in the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 没有人在这场事故中受伤，真令人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: very good; impressive

examples.text: I found the street food absolutely amazing and went back for more.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得街头小吃好极了，又回去再吃。

senses.meaning_en: relating to punishment

examples.text: Under the penal code, theft is punished by imprisonment.
examples.translation_cn: 根据刑法，盗窃会被判处监禁。

senses.meaning_en: punishable by law

examples.text: Tax evasion is a penal offense in most countries.
examples.translation_cn: 逃税在大多数国家属于可处罚的违法行为。

senses.meaning_en: serving as a place of punishment

examples.text: The remote island was once a penal colony.
examples.translation_cn: 这个偏远岛屿曾是一处惩处场所。

senses.meaning_en: exorbitantly high

examples.text: Borrowers who miss payments may be charged penal rates.
examples.translation_cn: 错过还款的借款人可能会被收取高额罚息。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a congress, especially the United States Congress

examples.text: The congressional committee will vote on the bill tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 国会委员会将于明天对该法案进行投票。

senses.meaning_en: the liquid from fruit or vegetables, or a drink made from it

examples.text: I usually have a glass of fresh orange juice with breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常早餐时喝一杯鲜橙汁。

senses.meaning_en: liquid that comes out of food, especially meat, during cooking

examples.text: The juices from the meat soaked into the potatoes.
examples.translation_cn: 肉的汁液渗进了土豆里。

senses.meaning_en: electricity or petrol (informal)

examples.text: My phone is low on juice, so I can't chat.
examples.translation_cn: 我的手机快没电了，所以不能聊天。

senses.meaning_en: a wide stretch of sea, sky, or land

examples.text: They crossed an expanse of desert in silence.
examples.translation_cn: 他们默默地穿越了一大片沙漠。

senses.meaning_en: staying the same; not changing

examples.text: Bus fares will remain fixed until next year.
examples.translation_cn: 公交车票价在明年之前将保持不变。

senses.meaning_en: definite; settled

examples.text: The event will take place on a fixed date in May.
examples.translation_cn: 活动将在五月的一个确定日期举行。

senses.meaning_en: unable to change or vary

examples.text: He has fixed ideas about the role of women in society.
examples.translation_cn: 他对女性在社会中的角色有固执的看法。

senses.meaning_en: arranged dishonestly so that the result is known beforehand

examples.text: The boxing match was fixed in advance by a betting syndicate.
examples.translation_cn: 这场拳击比赛被一个赌博集团预先操纵了。

senses.meaning_en: a quality detected by the nose

examples.text: The smell of fresh coffee drifted into the hallway.
examples.translation_cn: 新鲜咖啡的气味飘进了走廊。

senses.meaning_en: the sense that detects smells

examples.text: Dogs have a keen sense of smell for detecting drugs.
examples.translation_cn: 狗的嗅觉很灵敏，能探测毒品。

senses.meaning_en: to perceive a smell

examples.text: I can smell something burning in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 我能闻到厨房里有东西烧焦了。

senses.meaning_en: to have a particular smell

examples.text: The soup smells of garlic and fresh herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 这汤有大蒜和新鲜香草的气味。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a festival or holiday

examples.text: The store stays open late during the festive season.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店在节日期间营业到很晚。

senses.meaning_en: cheerful and celebratory

examples.text: Everyone was in a festive mood at the office party.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室聚会上大家都心情愉快。

senses.meaning_en: knowledge or perception of something

examples.text: The workshop raised my awareness of environmental issues.
examples.translation_cn: 这次工作坊提高了我对环境问题的认识。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being conscious of something or of things around you

examples.text: The patient slowly regained awareness after the anaesthetic.
examples.translation_cn: 病人在麻醉后逐渐恢复了意识。

senses.meaning_en: visible gases and particles from burning

examples.text: Thick smoke rises from the chimney and fills the air.
examples.translation_cn: 浓烟从烟囱升起，弥漫在空气中。

senses.meaning_en: cigarettes, cigars, or other substances for smoking

examples.text: He bought a pack of smokes at the corner store.
examples.translation_cn: 他在街角商店买了一包烟。

senses.meaning_en: an act of smoking

examples.text: She went outside to have a smoke after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午饭后她出去抽了支烟。

senses.meaning_en: something used to obscure or conceal; an obscuring condition

examples.text: The company's excuses were just smoke and mirrors to distract investors.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的借口不过是分散投资者注意力的烟幕弹。

senses.meaning_en: a stored copy of sound or video

examples.text: We listened to a recording of the concert last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我们昨晚听了音乐会的录音。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making a recording

examples.text: The band played each song several times during recording.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队在录制期间把每首歌都演奏了好几遍。

senses.meaning_en: relating to administration or management

examples.text: She works in an administrative role at a local hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地一家医院担任行政职务。

senses.meaning_en: a person who manages or directs the affairs of a business or institution

examples.text: She was appointed administrator of the county hospital last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年被任命为县医院的管理者。

senses.meaning_en: a person responsible for managing a computer system or network

examples.text: The network administrator reset my password this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 网络管理员今天早上重置了我的密码。

senses.meaning_en: all the time; continuously

examples.text: Engineers constantly monitor the system to detect any faults.
examples.translation_cn: 工程师不断监控系统以检测任何故障。

senses.meaning_en: very often; repeatedly

examples.text: He is constantly interrupting me during our meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 他老是在我们开会时打断我。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being diverse or different; a difference or unlikeness

examples.text: There is wide diversity between the two groups in their reading habits.
examples.translation_cn: 这两组在阅读习惯上有很大差异。

senses.meaning_en: a variety; diverse types or examples

examples.text: The island is home to a diversity of bird species.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛是多种鸟类的家园。

senses.meaning_en: equal-opportunity inclusion

examples.text: The company has a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司坚定致力于多元化和包容性。

senses.meaning_en: an event at which something is shown or explained

examples.text: The chef gave a demonstration of how to make fresh pasta.
examples.translation_cn: 厨师演示了如何制作新鲜意大利面。

senses.meaning_en: something that proves or makes something clear

examples.text: The study is a clear demonstration that early treatment works.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究清楚地证明早期治疗有效。

senses.meaning_en: a public meeting or march at which people show protest or support

examples.text: Thousands of people joined a demonstration against the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 数千人参加了反对新法律的示威游行。

senses.meaning_en: an act of showing a feeling or opinion

examples.text: He sent her flowers as a demonstration of his love.
examples.translation_cn: 他送花给她以表达爱意。

senses.meaning_en: a person between 13 and 19 years old

examples.text: She started her own business as a teen.
examples.translation_cn: 她十几岁时就创办了自己的公司。

senses.meaning_en: of or having to do with teenagers; teenage

examples.text: The library has a new teen fiction section.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆有一个新的青少年小说区。

senses.meaning_en: to leave an office or position

examples.text: The chairman vacated his post after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻后，主席辞去了职务。

senses.meaning_en: to leave a place, room, or seat so that it is empty

examples.text: All guests are required to vacate their rooms before noon on the day of departure.
examples.translation_cn: 所有客人必须在离店当天中午前腾出房间。

senses.meaning_en: the act of working together for a shared purpose

examples.text: The project was completed in cooperation with local universities.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目是与当地大学合作完成的。

senses.meaning_en: help given willingly, often by sharing space or resources

examples.text: The charity received cooperation from several local shops.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构得到了几家当地商店的协助。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or permitted by a constitution

examples.text: The court ruled that the new law was constitutional.
examples.translation_cn: 法庭裁定新法律合宪。

senses.meaning_en: range of knowledge or understanding

examples.text: The details of quantum physics are beyond the ken of most people.
examples.translation_cn: 量子物理的细节超出了大多数人的知识范围。

senses.meaning_en: Significantly; to a degree worth considering.

examples.text: The new model is considerably more fuel-efficient than the old one.
examples.translation_cn: 新车型比旧车型省油得多。

senses.meaning_en: a conversation between two or more people

examples.text: I had a friendly dialogue with my neighbour about gardening.
examples.translation_cn: 我和邻居就园艺进行了一次友好交谈。

senses.meaning_en: the spoken parts of a play, film, or story

examples.text: The dialogue between the hero and the villain reveals their conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 英雄与反派之间的对白揭示了他们的冲突。

senses.meaning_en: formal discussion between groups or countries to solve a problem

examples.text: The union entered into a dialogue with management over pay.
examples.translation_cn: 工会与管理层就薪酬问题展开了对话。

senses.meaning_en: a small group of soldiers organized for a purpose

examples.text: A squad of soldiers crossed the river at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 黎明时一小队士兵渡过了河。

senses.meaning_en: a group of players from which a sports team is chosen

examples.text: He is one of the best players on the squad.
examples.translation_cn: 他是队里最好的球员之一。

senses.meaning_en: a group of friends or people who regularly do things together

examples.text: I'm going camping with my squad next weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我下周末要和我的一伙朋友去露营。

senses.meaning_en: a person who establishes a company, organization, or institution

examples.text: She is the founder of a successful design firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一家成功设计公司的创始人。

senses.meaning_en: to fill with water and sink

examples.text: The ship foundered in heavy seas off the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 那艘船在近海汹涌的海面上沉没了。

senses.meaning_en: (of a plan or project) to fail

examples.text: The peace talks foundered on a dispute over territory.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判因领土争端而失败。

senses.meaning_en: remaining in force; ongoing
senses.pattern: have a standing invitation to do sth

examples.text: We have a standing invitation to visit them.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有随时去拜访他们的邀请。

senses.meaning_en: position or reputation in society or a profession

examples.text: The professor is of high standing in her field.
examples.translation_cn: 这位教授在她的领域享有很高声望。

senses.meaning_en: performed from an erect position; erect, not cut down

examples.text: The crowd gave the singer a standing ovation.
examples.translation_cn: 人群为这位歌手起立鼓掌。

senses.meaning_en: stagnant; not moving or flowing

examples.text: Mosquitoes often lay eggs in standing water after heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨过后，蚊子常在静止的水中产卵。

senses.meaning_en: the act of announcing something

examples.text: The announcement of the exam results was delayed by one day.
examples.translation_cn: 考试成绩的宣布被推迟了一天。

senses.meaning_en: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something

examples.text: The government issued an official announcement about the policy change.
examples.translation_cn: 政府就政策变化发布了正式公告。

senses.meaning_en: having no job despite being able and willing to work

examples.text: She is unemployed and actively looking for work.
examples.translation_cn: 她失业了，正在积极找工作。

senses.meaning_en: people who are unemployed as a group

examples.text: The government offered free training for the unemployed.
examples.translation_cn: 政府为失业者提供免费培训。

senses.meaning_en: having no use or not doing work

examples.text: Large amounts of capital remained unemployed during the economic downturn.
examples.translation_cn: 经济低迷期间，大量资本闲置未用。

senses.meaning_en: up to the time of; until

examples.text: The shop stays open till 9 p.m. on Fridays.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店周五营业到晚上9点。

senses.meaning_en: a cash register or its money drawer

examples.text: The shopkeeper counted the money in the till at closing time.
examples.translation_cn: 店主在打烊时数了收银机里的钱。

senses.meaning_en: to cultivate or plow land

examples.text: Farmers till the soil before planting crops in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在春天播种前犁地。

senses.meaning_en: until the time that
