examples.text: I'll wait here till you finish your work.
examples.translation_cn: 我会在这里等到你完成工作。

senses.meaning_en: an addition to or change to the Constitution

examples.text: The First Amendment to the Constitution protects free speech.
examples.translation_cn: 宪法第一修正案保护言论自由。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to a legal document or proposal

examples.text: The committee made an amendment to the contract before signing.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会在签署前对合同做了一处修改。

senses.meaning_en: intended for defence; protective

examples.text: The thick walls served a defensive purpose against invaders.
examples.translation_cn: 这些厚墙在抵御入侵者方面起到了防御作用。

senses.meaning_en: relating to preventing the other team or player from scoring

examples.text: The coach asked the team to adopt a defensive style after the break.
examples.translation_cn: 教练要求球队在中场休息后采取防守风格。

senses.meaning_en: showing that you feel criticized and want to defend yourself

examples.text: She was defensive about her decision when questioned.
examples.translation_cn: 当她被问及时，她对自己的决定变得辩解起来。

senses.meaning_en: a means, attitude or position of defense; chiefly in on the defensive

examples.text: The interviewer's questions put her on the defensive.
examples.translation_cn: 采访者的问题使她处于防御姿态。

senses.meaning_en: having a specified age

examples.text: The class is open to children aged six and seven.
examples.translation_cn: 这个班对六岁和七岁的孩子开放。

senses.meaning_en: matured by aging

examples.text: This cheese is aged for at least two years.
examples.translation_cn: 这种奶酪至少陈化两年。

senses.meaning_en: old; elderly

examples.text: He takes care of his aged parents every day.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天照顾他年迈的父母。

senses.meaning_en: old people as a group

examples.text: The charity provides free meals for the aged.
examples.translation_cn: 这家慈善机构为老年人提供免费餐食。

senses.meaning_en: having a legal or moral right to have or do something

examples.text: All employees are entitled to paid leave during public holidays.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工在公共假日都有带薪休假。

senses.meaning_en: called or titled (used after a noun to give the name of a book, film, etc.)

examples.text: She published a novel entitled The Silent Sea.
examples.translation_cn: 她出版了一本名为《静海》的小说。

senses.meaning_en: feeling that one deserves special treatment or privileges without having earned them

examples.text: He feels entitled to special treatment though he never earned it.
examples.translation_cn: 他自认为应得到特殊待遇，尽管他从未凭本事挣得。

senses.meaning_en: continuing; in progress

examples.text: The ongoing investigation has entered its third month.
examples.translation_cn: 这项进行中的调查已进入第三个月。

senses.meaning_en: a person trained to give guidance on personal or psychological problems

examples.text: She works as a counselor for teenagers with eating disorders.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一名帮助有饮食障碍的青少年的咨询师。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to give advice to students at a school

examples.text: The school counselor helped him choose courses that fit his career goals.
examples.translation_cn: 学校辅导员帮他选择了符合他职业目标的课程。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supervises children at a camp

examples.text: She worked as a camp counselor at a summer camp in Maine.
examples.translation_cn: 她在缅因州的一个夏令营当辅导员。

senses.meaning_en: completely sure that something is true or right

examples.text: She was firmly convinced that the plan would work.
examples.translation_cn: 她坚信这个计划会奏效。

senses.meaning_en: having a very firm belief, especially in a religion or cause

examples.text: As a convinced pacifist, she refuses to join the army.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名坚定的和平主义者，她拒绝参军。

senses.meaning_en: a person who remains alive after an accident or disaster

examples.text: He was the only survivor of the train crash.
examples.translation_cn: 他是火车事故中唯一的幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: a person who outlives another, especially a family member

examples.text: The survivors of the deceased are entitled to survivor benefits.
examples.translation_cn: 死者的遗属有权领取遗属抚恤金。

senses.meaning_en: a person who copes well with difficulties

examples.text: She is a born survivor who never gives up.
examples.translation_cn: 她是个天生的强者，从不放弃。

senses.meaning_en: an expert who studies the mind and behavior

examples.text: A psychologist specializing in memory will give a lecture tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 一位专门研究记忆的心理学家今晚将发表演讲。

senses.meaning_en: a person trained to treat mental or emotional problems

examples.text: He is seeing a psychologist about his panic attacks.
examples.translation_cn: 他正在看心理医生治疗自己的惊恐发作。

senses.meaning_en: a thin stick used by magicians or fairies to cast spells

examples.text: The magician waved her wand over the hat and a rabbit appeared.
examples.translation_cn: 魔术师在帽子上方挥动魔杖，一只兔子出现了。

senses.meaning_en: a hand-held tool or device shaped like a wand

examples.text: The guard ran a wand over my bag at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 安检员在机场用探测棒扫过我的包。

senses.meaning_en: to scan somebody with a hand-held metal detector

examples.text: All passengers were wanded before boarding the plane.
examples.translation_cn: 所有乘客登机前都接受了金属探测器扫描。

senses.meaning_en: the work or profession of keeping financial records

examples.text: She works in accounting at a large law firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家大型律师事务所从事会计工作。

senses.meaning_en: a report or explanation of events or actions

examples.text: The CEO gave a full accounting of the company's losses.
examples.translation_cn: 首席执行官对公司的亏损作了全面说明。

senses.meaning_en: a list of the food that is available in a restaurant or at a meal

examples.text: There are many vegetarian dishes on the menu at this restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅的菜单上有许多素菜。

senses.meaning_en: a list of options on a computer screen from which a user can choose

examples.text: Select 'Settings' from the menu at the top of the window.
examples.translation_cn: 从窗口顶部的菜单中选择“设置”。

senses.meaning_en: a list or range of things to choose from

examples.text: The website offers a menu of search tools and filters.
examples.translation_cn: 该网站提供一系列搜索工具和筛选条件。

senses.meaning_en: not formal or ceremonious

examples.text: The two leaders held an informal meeting before the summit.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人在峰会前举行了一次非正式会晤。

senses.meaning_en: suitable for everyday wear or occasions

examples.text: We can wear informal clothes to the barbecue.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以穿休闲装去烧烤。

senses.meaning_en: used in everyday conversation; not formal in language

examples.text: The word 'kids' is an informal term for children.
examples.translation_cn: 'kids' 是表示儿童的口语词。

senses.meaning_en: a small change, or the act of making a small change, to correct or improve something

examples.text: He made a small adjustment to the seat height.
examples.translation_cn: 他对座椅高度做了一点调整。

senses.meaning_en: the settling or balancing of a financial account
senses.pattern: post an adjustment to an account

examples.text: The accountant posted an adjustment to the account to correct the balance.
examples.translation_cn: 会计在该账户过账了一笔调整以纠正余额。

senses.meaning_en: a person appointed to carry out official duties

examples.text: She was appointed as commissioner for children's services.
examples.translation_cn: 她被任命为儿童事务专员。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a commission

examples.text: She served as a commissioner on the city planning board.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾在城市规划委员会担任委员。

senses.meaning_en: the head of a city's police force

examples.text: He served as police commissioner for over a decade.
examples.translation_cn: 他担任警察局长超过十年。

senses.meaning_en: the chief executive of a professional sports league

examples.text: She was named league commissioner of the National Basketball Association.
examples.translation_cn: 她被任命为美国职业篮球联赛总裁。

senses.meaning_en: willingness to do something; enthusiasm

examples.text: He lacks the motivation to practice every day.
examples.translation_cn: 他缺乏每天练习的积极性。

senses.meaning_en: a reason for doing something

examples.text: The main motivation for his move was a better job.
examples.translation_cn: 他搬家的主要原因是找到了更好的工作。

senses.meaning_en: especially; in particular

examples.text: Several countries signed the agreement, notably France and Germany.
examples.translation_cn: 几个国家签署了协议，尤其是法国和德国。

senses.meaning_en: in a noticeable or remarkable way

examples.text: The results were notably better after the new training program.
examples.translation_cn: 新的培训项目之后，成绩明显更好了。

senses.meaning_en: to forgive someone for a small mistake or wrongdoing

examples.text: He excused the child for breaking the window because it was an accident.
examples.translation_cn: 他原谅了那个孩子打破窗户，因为那是个意外。

senses.meaning_en: to allow someone not to do a duty or attend something

examples.text: Students with doctor's notes were excused from the final exam.
examples.translation_cn: 有医生证明的学生被允许不参加期末考试。

senses.meaning_en: a reason given to explain bad behavior; to give such a reason

examples.text: He made an excuse for being late, but his boss did not believe him.
examples.translation_cn: 他为迟到找了借口，但他的老板不相信他。

senses.meaning_en: a very poor example of someone or something
senses.collocation: a poor excuse for a leader

examples.text: He is a poor excuse for a captain and never takes responsibility.
examples.translation_cn: 他根本不像个队长，从不肯承担责任。

senses.meaning_en: a natural solid substance with a definite chemical composition and crystal structure, found in rocks or in the ground

examples.text: The area is rich in minerals such as copper and gold.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区富含铜和金等矿物。

senses.meaning_en: relating to minerals or containing minerals

examples.text: The company extracts mineral resources from the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司从山区开采矿产资源。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical element that is necessary for the health of living things, obtained from food or drink

examples.text: We get essential minerals from foods like beans and nuts.
examples.translation_cn: 我们从豆类和坚果等食物中获取必需矿物质。

senses.meaning_en: mineral water

examples.text: She always drinks mineral water instead of sugary sodas.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是喝矿泉水而不喝含糖汽水。

senses.meaning_en: the act of taking money out of a bank account or the amount taken

examples.text: I made a withdrawal of three hundred dollars from the ATM.
examples.translation_cn: 我从自动取款机取出了三百美元。

senses.meaning_en: the act of moving back or removing something from a place

examples.text: The withdrawal of troops from the border began last week.
examples.translation_cn: 部队从边境的撤退于上周开始。

senses.meaning_en: the unpleasant effects experienced when a person stops taking a drug that they are dependent on

examples.text: She was in withdrawal for three days after quitting heroin.
examples.translation_cn: 她戒除海洛因后三天都处于戒断状态。

senses.meaning_en: a method of birth control in which the man withdraws his penis from the vagina before ejaculation

examples.text: Some couples use the withdrawal method to avoid pregnancy.
examples.translation_cn: 有些夫妇使用体外射精法来避孕。

senses.meaning_en: having exceptional natural ability or talent, especially intellectual ability

examples.text: She is gifted in mathematics and has won several national competitions.
examples.translation_cn: 她在数学方面有天赋，多次在全国比赛中获奖。

senses.meaning_en: a small building or room used for Christian worship, smaller than or subordinate to a church

examples.text: Morning prayers are held in the college chapel every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 每个星期天早晨的祷告都在学院小教堂举行。

senses.meaning_en: a room or building where funeral services are held

examples.text: Relatives said their final goodbyes in the funeral chapel before the burial.
examples.translation_cn: 亲友们在葬礼前于殡仪馆追悼厅作了最后的告别。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being annoyed because you cannot achieve something

examples.text: He sighed in frustration when the printer jammed again.
examples.translation_cn: 当打印机再次卡纸时，他沮丧地叹了口气。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that makes you feel frustrated
senses.pattern: one of the frustrations of doing sth

examples.text: Bureaucracy is one of the frustrations of running a small business.
examples.translation_cn: 官僚程序是经营小企业的烦心事之一。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed amount of food, fuel, etc. officially allowed when there is a shortage

examples.text: Each soldier received a ration of rice and beans each day.
examples.translation_cn: 每个士兵每天得到一份大米和豆类的配给。

senses.meaning_en: to control the amount of food, fuel, etc. that someone is allowed to have

examples.text: During the war, ration books were issued and sugar was rationed to one pound per person.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间，发放配给票证，糖按每人一磅定量供应。

senses.meaning_en: to limit the amount of something that someone is allowed to use or have

examples.text: Parents often ration their children's screen time to protect their eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 父母常常限制孩子看屏幕的时间以保护视力。

senses.meaning_en: to cross a stream by walking through it

examples.text: The soldiers forded the icy river at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们黎明时蹚过了冰冷的河流。

senses.meaning_en: a shallow place where a stream can be crossed

examples.text: They crossed at a ford just below the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在桥下的浅滩处过了河。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle made by the Ford company

examples.text: My grandfather drove a Ford pickup for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父开一辆福特皮卡已有三十年。

senses.meaning_en: to violently disturb the peace of; to throw into chaos
senses.collocation: rend the air with a scream

examples.text: A single shot rent the air behind the barn.
examples.translation_cn: 一声枪响划破了谷仓后的空气。

senses.meaning_en: to separate into parts with force or sudden violence; to split

examples.text: The small island was rent by war for six years.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小岛因战乱分裂了六年。

senses.meaning_en: to cause great emotional pain to someone

examples.text: Her heart was rent by grief when her father died.
examples.translation_cn: 父亲去世时，她的心被悲伤撕裂。

senses.meaning_en: to emit or reflect light so as to glow

examples.text: The morning sun shone through the curtains and woke me up.
examples.translation_cn: 清晨的阳光透过窗帘照进来，把我唤醒了。

senses.meaning_en: to be very good at something; to be outstanding

examples.text: He shone at chess and won the school trophy.
examples.translation_cn: 他在国际象棋方面表现出色，赢得了学校奖杯。

senses.meaning_en: to point a light in a particular direction

examples.text: The guard shone his flashlight at the door.
examples.translation_cn: 警卫用手电筒照向门口。

senses.meaning_en: to polish something; to make it bright by rubbing

examples.text: He shines his shoes every morning before work.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天上班前擦皮鞋。

senses.meaning_en: in a dramatic manner; theatrically

examples.text: She spoke dramatically about the rescue, making everyone listen.
examples.translation_cn: 她戏剧性地讲述救援经过，让每个人都听。

senses.meaning_en: to a great degree or in a noticeable way

examples.text: The number of users has increased dramatically over the past month.
examples.translation_cn: 过去一个月用户数量急剧增加。

senses.meaning_en: having experience and skill in a subject

examples.text: She is experienced in dealing with difficult customers.
examples.translation_cn: 她在应付难缠的顾客方面很有经验。

senses.meaning_en: in a traditional manner; according to tradition

examples.text: Traditionally, these textiles are dyed with natural plant extracts.
examples.translation_cn: 传统上，这些纺织品用天然植物提取物染色。

senses.meaning_en: the power or right to interpret and apply the law

examples.text: The federal court has jurisdiction over cases involving federal law.
examples.translation_cn: 联邦法院对涉及联邦法律的案件拥有管辖权。

senses.meaning_en: the limits or territory within which authority may be exercised

examples.text: The town lies within the jurisdiction of the county sheriff.
examples.translation_cn: 该镇位于县治安官的辖区内。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of being effective; the quality of producing results

examples.text: The trial confirmed the effectiveness of the new drug.
examples.translation_cn: 试验证实了新药的有效性。

senses.meaning_en: the degree to which something produces results

examples.text: We need to measure the effectiveness of this training program.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要衡量这个培训项目的成效。

senses.meaning_en: the player who throws the ball to the batter in baseball
senses.pattern: as a pitcher for the team

examples.text: He spent ten years as a pitcher for the Boston Red Sox.
examples.translation_cn: 他在波士顿红袜队当了十年投手。

senses.meaning_en: a large container with a handle and a spout for holding liquids

examples.text: She poured a pitcher of water into the glasses.
examples.translation_cn: 她把一壶水倒进杯子里。

senses.meaning_en: showing compassion or concern for the suffering of others
senses.pattern: treat sb in a humane way

examples.text: They urged the government to treat asylum seekers in a humane way.
examples.translation_cn: 他们敦促政府以人道的方式对待寻求庇护者。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the humanities or humane learning

examples.text: He was schooled in humane letters before turning to science.
examples.translation_cn: 他在转向科学之前接受过古典人文教育。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Spain or to Spanish-speaking countries, especially in Latin America

examples.text: Many students of Hispanic origin attend this school.
examples.translation_cn: 许多西裔学生在这所学校上学。

senses.meaning_en: a person from a Spanish-speaking country or background

examples.text: She is the first Hispanic to lead the department.
examples.translation_cn: 她是第一位领导该部门的西语裔人士。

senses.meaning_en: a corridor in a building that connects rooms

examples.text: Please leave your shoes in the hallway when you come in.
examples.translation_cn: 进门时请把鞋放在走廊里。

senses.meaning_en: in good working order

examples.text: The old washing machine is still fully functional after twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧洗衣机用了二十年仍能正常运转。

senses.meaning_en: useful; serving a purpose

examples.text: These shelves serve a functional purpose in the kitchen.
examples.translation_cn: 这些架子在厨房里有实用功能。

senses.meaning_en: designed for use rather than decoration

examples.text: The building's design is purely functional, with no ornament.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋建筑的设计纯粹功能化，没有装饰。

senses.meaning_en: the act of returning something to an earlier good condition, situation, or practice

examples.text: The restoration of peace brought hope to the region.
examples.translation_cn: 和平的恢复给该地区带来了希望。

senses.meaning_en: the return of a former monarchy or monarch to power, usually after having been forced to step down

examples.text: The king's restoration to power followed years of civil war.
examples.translation_cn: 国王的复辟发生在多年内战之后。

senses.meaning_en: the work of repairing and cleaning something old or damaged so that it looks like its original form

examples.text: The old theater is under restoration and will reopen next year.
examples.translation_cn: 那座老剧院正在修复，明年将重新开放。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving back something that was lost or stolen to its owner

examples.text: The restoration of the stolen paintings to the museum took months.
examples.translation_cn: 被盗画作归还博物馆花了数月时间。

senses.meaning_en: a person who oversees the work of other people or operations

examples.text: She reported the problem to her supervisor immediately.
examples.translation_cn: 她立即向主管报告了这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: a person who guides and monitors a student's research, especially at graduate level

examples.text: He met with his supervisor to discuss the next chapter.
examples.translation_cn: 他与导师会面讨论下一章。

senses.meaning_en: an enclosed area used for sports, concerts, and other public events

examples.text: Thousands of fans gathered at the arena for the championship final.
examples.translation_cn: 成千上万的球迷聚集在体育场观看冠军决赛。

senses.meaning_en: a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict

examples.text: She has become a major voice in the political arena.
examples.translation_cn: 她已成为政界的重要声音。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of identifying a disease or the cause of a medical condition

examples.text: The doctor made a diagnosis of diabetes after reviewing the blood test results.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在查看血液检查结果后做出了糖尿病的诊断。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to change or adapt easily

examples.text: Our new policy allows greater flexibility in choosing working hours.
examples.translation_cn: 我们的新政策在选择工作时间方面提供了更大的灵活性。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to bend easily without breaking

examples.text: Regular stretching improves the flexibility of the lower back.
examples.translation_cn: 经常拉伸能改善下背部的柔韧性。

senses.meaning_en: wild animals and plants living in their natural environment

examples.text: The wetlands are home to a rich variety of wildlife.
examples.translation_cn: 这些湿地是多种野生生物的家园。

senses.meaning_en: a person who makes or repairs things, especially wooden objects or wheels

examples.text: He works as a wright in a small workshop, repairing wooden cart wheels.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一个小工场里当工匠，修理木制车轮。

senses.meaning_en: the study or practice of drawing plans and designs

examples.text: He is studying graphics to become a draughtsman.
examples.translation_cn: 他正在学习制图，想成为一名绘图员。

senses.meaning_en: pictures or images produced by a computer

examples.text: The graphics on the screen are extremely detailed.
examples.translation_cn: 屏幕上的图形非常精细。

senses.meaning_en: visual designs or illustrations

examples.text: She creates graphics for a website, including logos and banners.
examples.translation_cn: 她为网站制作图形，包括标志和横幅。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that is owed money

examples.text: The bank is a creditor of the company and can demand repayment.
examples.translation_cn: 银行是该公司的债权人，可以要求还款。

senses.meaning_en: kept in reserve; extra

examples.text: We keep a spare key under the mat.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在门垫下留了一把备用钥匙。

senses.meaning_en: to not harm or punish

examples.text: The soldiers were told to spare the women and children.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们被告知不要伤害妇女和儿童。

senses.meaning_en: free; not occupied

examples.text: She likes to paint in her spare time.
examples.translation_cn: 她喜欢在空闲时间画画。

senses.meaning_en: to give time or money when possible

examples.text: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
examples.translation_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我一下吗？

senses.meaning_en: the act of forming opinions or guessing without certain knowledge

examples.text: There is growing speculation that the company will be sold.
examples.translation_cn: 越来越多的人猜测这家公司将被出售。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of buying and selling assets in hope of profiting from price changes

examples.text: He made a fortune through speculation in the stock market.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过股票市场投机发了财。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being separated from others; the act of isolating

examples.text: The patient was kept in isolation for two weeks to prevent the spread of infection.
examples.translation_cn: 这名患者被隔离了两周，以防止感染扩散。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being alone and without friends or help

examples.text: She felt a deep sense of isolation after moving to a new city.
examples.translation_cn: 她搬到一个新城市后深感孤独。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being discreet; careful and circumspect in one's speech or actions

examples.text: She always acts with discretion when dealing with sensitive issues.
examples.translation_cn: 她在处理敏感问题时总是谨慎行事。

senses.meaning_en: the freedom or power to decide what should be done in a particular situation

examples.text: The judge has the discretion to reduce the sentence in special circumstances.
examples.translation_cn: 法官在特殊情况下有酌情减刑的权力。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to a place since ancient times

examples.text: The Maori people are indigenous to New Zealand.
examples.translation_cn: 毛利人是新西兰的土著民族。

senses.meaning_en: growing naturally in a particular area

examples.text: These plants are indigenous to the Mediterranean region.
examples.translation_cn: 这些植物原产于地中海地区。

senses.meaning_en: the art of using language to persuade or influence others

examples.text: She plans to major in rhetoric at university.
examples.translation_cn: 她打算在大学主修修辞学。

senses.meaning_en: speech or writing that sounds impressive but lacks sincerity or real meaning

examples.text: His campaign promises turned out to be mere rhetoric.
examples.translation_cn: 他的竞选承诺结果只是空话。

senses.meaning_en: an official order or instruction to do something

examples.text: The governor issued a mandate to close all public schools.
examples.translation_cn: 州长发布命令关闭所有公立学校。

senses.meaning_en: the authority given to someone to do something
senses.pattern: give sb a mandate to do

examples.text: Voters gave the president a clear mandate to reform education.
examples.translation_cn: 选民明确授权总统改革教育。

senses.meaning_en: the period during which a government is in power

examples.text: The prime minister introduced new taxes during her mandate.
examples.translation_cn: 首相在任期内推出了新税种。

senses.meaning_en: to officially require something or order someone to do something

examples.text: The law mandates that all children attend school until age sixteen.
examples.translation_cn: 法律强制要求所有儿童上学到十六岁。

senses.meaning_en: the act or effect of making someone morally corrupt

examples.text: He warned against the corruption of children by violent media.
examples.translation_cn: 他警告说暴力媒体会使儿童堕落。

senses.meaning_en: dishonest or illegal behaviour, especially by people in authority

examples.text: Several officials were accused of corruption in the housing project.
examples.translation_cn: 几名官员在住房项目中被指控贪污。

senses.meaning_en: damage to data or files caused by errors or failure

examples.text: A power failure caused corruption of data on the server.
examples.translation_cn: 停电导致服务器上的数据损坏。

senses.meaning_en: a nonstandard form of a word, expression, or text resulting from a mistake

examples.text: The term 'chaise lounge' is a corruption of the French 'chaise longue'.
examples.translation_cn: ‘chaise lounge’一词是法语‘chaise longue’的讹变。

senses.meaning_en: a scientist who studies stars, planets, and other objects in space

examples.text: She decided to become an astronomer after attending a public lecture on black holes.
examples.translation_cn: 她在参加了一场关于黑洞的公开讲座后，决定成为一名天文学家。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that builds or improves buildings or structures

examples.text: They hired a building contractor to renovate the old warehouse.
examples.translation_cn: 他们雇了一个建筑承包商来翻新那座旧仓库。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that performs specific tasks such as electrical or plumbing work in construction projects

examples.text: The contractor responsible for the plumbing fixed the burst pipe quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 负责管道的承包方迅速修好了爆裂的水管。

senses.meaning_en: a person hired to do a job on a business contract, as opposed to a permanent employee

examples.text: She works as an independent contractor for several marketing agencies.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为独立承包人给几家营销代理公司工作。

senses.meaning_en: to build something again

examples.text: They had to rebuild the bridge after the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水过后，他们不得不重建这座桥。

senses.meaning_en: to make something strong or successful again

examples.text: The therapy helped him rebuild confidence in his own abilities.
examples.translation_cn: 这种治疗帮助他重新建立对自己能力的信心。

senses.meaning_en: in or from the local area

examples.text: All the ingredients are locally sourced from nearby farms.
examples.translation_cn: 所有食材均来自本地附近农场。

senses.meaning_en: in a restricted part of the body

examples.text: The dentist applied the anesthetic locally to numb the tooth.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医局部使用麻醉剂以使牙齿麻木。

senses.meaning_en: a person or organization that gives money or goods to help others

examples.text: An anonymous donor to the museum gave one million dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 一位匿名捐赠者向博物馆捐赠了一百万美元。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives blood, tissue, or an organ for medical use

examples.text: As a regular blood donor, he helps save many lives every year.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名定期献血者，他每年帮助挽救许多生命。

senses.meaning_en: to express support or approval, especially officially or publicly

examples.text: The board endorsed her as the new principal after a long discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间讨论，董事会支持她担任新校长。

senses.meaning_en: to write your signature on the back of a cheque, especially in order to transfer or cash it
senses.collocation: endorse the back of a cheque

examples.text: You must endorse the cheque before the bank can cash it.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须先在支票背面签名，银行才能兑现。

senses.meaning_en: to appear in an advertisement and say that you use and like a product

examples.text: The famous tennis player endorses a new sports drink in TV commercials.
examples.translation_cn: 这位著名网球运动员在电视广告中为一种新运动饮料代言。

senses.meaning_en: to record or sign something on a document

examples.text: The clerk endorsed the document before filing it.
examples.translation_cn: 那名职员在文件上批注后才将其归档。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to examine financial accounts

examples.text: The auditor for the charity checked all the donations.
examples.translation_cn: 这名慈善机构的审计员核查了所有捐款。

senses.meaning_en: to throw so as to turn over

examples.text: He flipped the coin into the air and called heads.
examples.translation_cn: 他把硬币抛向空中并喊了正面。

senses.meaning_en: a maneuver which rotates an object end over end

examples.text: She did a flip off the diving board.
examples.translation_cn: 她从跳水板上做了一个空翻。

senses.meaning_en: the purchase of an asset (usually a house) which is then improved and sold quickly for profit
senses.pattern: make a profit on a flip

examples.text: They made a profit on a house flip in Austin.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从奥斯汀的一次快速翻修转售中获利。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of paper with a design and value used to prepay postage

examples.text: She put a stamp on the envelope and mailed it.
examples.translation_cn: 她把邮票贴在信封上寄走了。

senses.meaning_en: to bring down one's foot heavily

examples.text: He stamped on the ground to shake the snow from his boots.
examples.translation_cn: 他跺着地面，抖掉靴子上的雪。

senses.meaning_en: a mark or indentation made by stamping

examples.text: The contract bears an official government stamp at the bottom.
examples.translation_cn: 合同底部盖有官方印章。

senses.meaning_en: a device for imprinting designs

examples.text: The clerk used a rubber stamp to mark the form.
examples.translation_cn: 职员用橡皮图章在表格上做记号。

senses.meaning_en: an act of stamping the foot, paw or hoof
senses.pattern: with a stamp of one's foot

examples.text: She showed her impatience with a stamp of her foot.
examples.translation_cn: 她跺了一下脚，显出不耐烦。

senses.meaning_en: the feeling of being sad because something was not as good as expected

examples.text: Her disappointment at losing the match was clear.
examples.translation_cn: 她因输掉比赛而失望，这很明显。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that disappoints

examples.text: The new policy was a disappointment to many voters.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策令许多选民失望。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the official rules that control an activity or industry

examples.text: The commission has regulatory authority over telecom companies.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会对电信公司拥有监管权。

senses.meaning_en: a person who entertains an audience

examples.text: The performer on stage impressed the audience with her singing.
examples.translation_cn: 舞台上的表演者用她的歌声打动了观众。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that performs in a particular way, especially well or badly

examples.text: This model is a good performer in fuel efficiency tests.
examples.translation_cn: 这款车型在燃油效率测试中表现良好。

senses.meaning_en: Of, relating to, or belonging to a city, a citizen, or citizenship; municipal or civil.

examples.text: The old civic centre will be turned into a museum.
examples.translation_cn: 旧的市政中心将被改建为博物馆。

senses.meaning_en: Of or relating to the citizen, or of good citizenship and its rights and duties.

examples.text: It is your civic duty to report illegal parking to the police.
examples.translation_cn: 向警方举报非法停车是你的公民义务。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being hostile

examples.text: There is open hostility towards the proposed changes in the community.
examples.translation_cn: 社区里对拟议的变革存在公开敌意。

senses.meaning_en: acts of fighting in a war

examples.text: Hostilities broke out between the two nations last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 去年春天两国之间爆发了战斗。

senses.meaning_en: a place where an event or activity is held

examples.text: The exhibition centre is a popular venue for international conferences.
examples.translation_cn: 该展览中心是举办国际会议的热门场地。

senses.meaning_en: the place where a legal case is tried

examples.text: The judge ruled that the venue for the trial was improper.
examples.translation_cn: 法官裁定审判地不当。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being relevant or pertinent

examples.text: His comments have little relevance to the current debate.
examples.translation_cn: 他的评论与当前的辩论几乎没有关联。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being important or useful in a particular situation

examples.text: The results of this study are of little practical relevance to classroom teachers.
examples.translation_cn: 这项研究的结果对课堂教师实际意义不大。

senses.meaning_en: on fire; very hot and likely to burn

examples.text: Firefighters pulled two children from the burning house.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出了两个孩子。

senses.meaning_en: feeling very hot

examples.text: My cheeks felt burning hot after I came in from the cold.
examples.translation_cn: 我从外面冷风里进屋后，脸颊热得发烫。

senses.meaning_en: full of strong feeling or passion

examples.text: She spoke about music with a burning passion.
examples.translation_cn: 她怀着炽热的激情谈论音乐。

senses.meaning_en: very strong or urgent

examples.text: The burning question is who will lead the team next year.
examples.translation_cn: 当务之急是谁明年将领导这支球队。

senses.meaning_en: the act of excluding or state of being excluded

examples.text: His sudden exclusion from the team surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他突然被排除在队外，这让所有人感到惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: an item not covered by an insurance policy

examples.text: The policy has an exclusion for damage caused by floods.
examples.translation_cn: 这份保单对洪水造成的损失有除外责任。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a tribe or tribes

examples.text: The tribal council met to discuss land rights.
examples.translation_cn: 部落委员会开会讨论土地权利。

senses.meaning_en: based on or organized according to tribes; characterized by strong loyalty to a group

examples.text: The election campaign strongly appealed to tribal loyalties.
examples.translation_cn: 选举活动强烈地诉诸族群忠诚。

senses.meaning_en: incorporating designs or styles typical of an indigenous people

examples.text: She wanted several tribal designs on her shoulder.
examples.translation_cn: 她想在肩上纹几个部落风格的图案。

senses.meaning_en: to supervise or manage

examples.text: She was hired to oversee the work on the new office building.
examples.translation_cn: 她被雇来监督新办公楼的工作。

senses.meaning_en: to inspect or examine

examples.text: The committee met to oversee the records for any signs of fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会开会检查记录，寻找任何欺诈迹象。

senses.meaning_en: to survey from a high place

examples.text: From the observation deck, visitors can oversee the whole city.
examples.translation_cn: 从观景台上，游客能俯瞰整座城市。

senses.meaning_en: to observe secretly or unintentionally

examples.text: Detectives were assigned to oversee the suspect's movements around the clock.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探们被派去昼夜监视嫌疑人的行动。

senses.meaning_en: combining separate parts into a unified whole

examples.text: The new payment system is fully integrated with the online store.
examples.translation_cn: 新的支付系统与在线商店完全集成。

senses.meaning_en: bringing together people of different races and treating them equally

examples.text: The school is racially integrated, and children of all races learn together.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校实行种族融合，不同种族的孩子一起学习。

senses.meaning_en: characterized by strict, uncompromising adherence to a political ideology, rather than practical concerns

examples.text: He rejected the reform on ideological grounds alone, ignoring the evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 他仅以意识形态为由拒绝改革，无视证据。

senses.meaning_en: relating to ideology or ideologies

examples.text: The party split along ideological lines during the debate.
examples.translation_cn: 辩论期间该党沿意识形态界线分裂。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of mechanics concerned with forces and motion

examples.text: The dynamics of a spinning top are governed by torque and angular momentum.
examples.translation_cn: 陀螺的动力学受转矩和角动量支配。

senses.meaning_en: the forces or patterns that produce change or development

examples.text: The dynamics of the classroom changed after the new students arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 新学生到来后，班级的动态发生了变化。

senses.meaning_en: variation in loudness in music

examples.text: The dynamics of this passage require a gradual increase in volume.
examples.translation_cn: 这一乐段的力度要求音量逐渐增强。

senses.meaning_en: having a natural ability to do something well

examples.text: She is talented at languages and learned French in six months.
examples.translation_cn: 她有语言天赋，六个月就学会了法语。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been nominated for a position or award

examples.text: She is the party's nominee for the position of mayor.
examples.translation_cn: 她是该党提名的市长职位候选人。

senses.meaning_en: made longer in length; elongated

examples.text: The new SUV has an extended body and offers more cargo space.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新SUV车身加长，提供了更大的载货空间。

senses.meaning_en: stretched out or spread out

examples.text: She stood with her arms extended, waiting for a hug.
examples.translation_cn: 她伸开双臂站着，等待一个拥抱。

senses.meaning_en: lasting for a long time; prolonged

examples.text: She worked from home for an extended period last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年她在家办公了很长一段时间。

senses.meaning_en: having a wide scope; extensive

examples.text: My extended family gathers every year for a reunion.
examples.translation_cn: 我的大家族每年聚会一次。

senses.meaning_en: single; not part of a series

examples.text: This was an isolated case and did not reflect a wider trend.
examples.translation_cn: 这只是一个孤立的个案，并不反映更广泛的趋势。

senses.meaning_en: far away from other places

examples.text: The village is isolated from the nearest town by high mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村庄被高山隔断，与最近的城镇隔绝。

senses.meaning_en: having little contact with others

examples.text: After moving to the city, she felt isolated and struggled to make new friends.
examples.translation_cn: 搬到城市后，她感到孤立，结交新朋友很困难。

senses.meaning_en: kept separate from others

examples.text: Patients with the virus should be kept isolated from healthy people.
examples.translation_cn: 感染这种病毒的患者应与健康人隔离。

senses.meaning_en: a friend or casual acquaintance

examples.text: I am buddies with a few guys from work.
examples.translation_cn: 我和几个同事是朋友。

senses.meaning_en: used to address someone, often in a friendly or annoyed way

examples.text: Hey, buddy, could you move your car, please?
examples.translation_cn: 嘿，老兄，你能把车挪一下吗？

senses.meaning_en: a partner for a particular activity

examples.text: He is my study buddy for the math exam.
examples.translation_cn: 他是我数学考试的学习伙伴。

senses.meaning_en: not interesting; making you feel tired and impatient

examples.text: Most students find his lectures extremely boring because he just reads from the slides.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数学生觉得他的讲座极其无聊，因为他只是照着幻灯片念。

senses.meaning_en: to keep something cold by putting it in a refrigerator

examples.text: You need to refrigerate the dough overnight before baking.
examples.translation_cn: 烘烤前你需要把面团冷藏一夜。

senses.meaning_en: a person who expects a favourable outcome

examples.text: He is an optimist about the project's future.
examples.translation_cn: 他对项目的前景很乐观。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used to protect people from a disease

examples.text: Scientists developed a vaccine against the virus last year.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家去年研制出了一种抗这种病毒的疫苗。

senses.meaning_en: opposite; completely different

examples.text: Their approaches to the problem are diametrically opposed.
examples.translation_cn: 他们处理这个问题的方法截然相反。

senses.meaning_en: disagreeing with or disapproving of something

examples.text: Many local residents are opposed to the construction of a new highway.
examples.translation_cn: 许多当地居民反对修建一条新高速公路。

senses.meaning_en: the act of submitting something

examples.text: The submission of the final report is due by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 最终报告的提交截止到星期五。

senses.meaning_en: the act of surrendering or the attitude of obeying

examples.text: She nodded her head in submission to the court's ruling.
examples.translation_cn: 她向法庭的裁决点头表示顺从。

senses.meaning_en: something that has been submitted

examples.text: You must send a submission to the editor by Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须在星期一之前向编辑提交一份稿件。

senses.meaning_en: a formal statement or opinion presented to an authority

examples.text: The lawyer made a submission to the court on behalf of his client.
examples.translation_cn: 律师代表他的当事人向法庭提交了意见。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Cuba or of Cuban descent

examples.text: Her new colleague is a Cuban and speaks Spanish at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她的新同事是古巴人，在家说西班牙语。

senses.meaning_en: a cigar made in Cuba

examples.text: He sat on the balcony and smoked a Cuban after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后，他坐在阳台上抽了一支古巴雪茄。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Cuba, its people, or their culture

examples.text: The festival features Cuban music and dance performances.
examples.translation_cn: 该节日以古巴音乐和舞蹈表演为特色。

senses.meaning_en: a carnivorous cetacean with a beak-like snout, known for its intelligence

examples.text: A pod of dolphins was swimming near our boat this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上，一群海豚在我们的船附近游动。

senses.meaning_en: unhappy and without hope

examples.text: She feels deeply depressed about failing the exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她因考试不及格而感到非常沮丧。

senses.meaning_en: suffering from clinical depression

examples.text: He is clinically depressed and needs professional treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 他患有临床抑郁症，需要专业治疗。

senses.meaning_en: suffering from economic recession

examples.text: A depressed economy can lead to high unemployment.
examples.translation_cn: 经济不景气会导致高失业率。

senses.meaning_en: lower than the surrounding area

examples.text: After heavy rain, water gathered in a depressed area of ground.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨过后，水积在了一块低洼处。

senses.meaning_en: very surprised and upset

examples.text: Many residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the local hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 许多居民对当地医院突然关闭感到震惊。

senses.meaning_en: a score in American football

examples.text: They scored a touchdown on the first drive.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在第一次进攻中就达阵得分。

senses.meaning_en: the moment of landing

examples.text: The plane made a smooth touchdown on the runway.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机在跑道上平稳着陆。

senses.meaning_en: a tornado touching the ground

examples.text: Officials reported a tornado touchdown near the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 官员报告说机场附近有龙卷风触地。

senses.meaning_en: to a great or noticeable degree; in a surprising or unusual way

examples.text: She remained remarkably calm throughout the entire crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 她在整个危机中始终异常冷静。

senses.meaning_en: used to draw special attention to a proposition

examples.text: Remarkably, no one was hurt in the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 值得注意的是，事故中无人受伤。

senses.meaning_en: in an active manner

examples.text: She is actively involved in several local charities.
examples.translation_cn: 她积极参与几个当地慈善机构。

senses.meaning_en: meeting the standards, requirements, and training for a position

examples.text: She is fully qualified to teach chemistry in high school.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全有资格在高中教化学。

senses.meaning_en: restricted or limited by conditions

examples.text: The new drug was only a qualified success in the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药在试验中只能算有限的成功。

senses.meaning_en: something given to a person or organization to help them

examples.text: A generous donation to the shelter paid for food and medicine for the animals.
examples.translation_cn: 一笔给收容所的慷慨捐款支付了动物们的食物和药品。

senses.meaning_en: the act of giving something, especially money, to help

examples.text: The donation of blood saves millions of lives each year.
examples.translation_cn: 献血每年能拯救数百万人的生命。

senses.meaning_en: a small picture or symbol on a screen that represents something

examples.text: Tap on the printer icon to start printing.
examples.translation_cn: 点击打印机图标开始打印。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing widely admired as a representative symbol or best example

examples.text: She became an icon of the women's movement.
examples.translation_cn: 她成为妇女运动的标志性人物。

senses.meaning_en: a religious painting of a saint or holy scene, especially in the Eastern Orthodox Church

examples.text: She lit a candle and prayed before the icon.
examples.translation_cn: 她点燃蜡烛并在圣像前祈祷。

senses.meaning_en: to make a process or action happen sooner or be completed more quickly

examples.text: The new software will expedite the application process significantly.
examples.translation_cn: 新软件将大大加快申请流程。

senses.meaning_en: to deal with or send something quickly

examples.text: The agency expedited the visa documents to the embassy.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构将签证文件加急发送到了大使馆。

senses.meaning_en: a governmental body with the power to make, amend and repeal laws

examples.text: The new education bill is still being debated in the legislature.
examples.translation_cn: 新教育法案仍在立法机关进行辩论。

senses.meaning_en: soft and able to bend easily without breaking

examples.text: The leather remains supple even after years of use.
examples.translation_cn: 这块皮革即使使用多年后仍然柔软。

senses.meaning_en: able to change or adapt quickly to new situations

examples.text: A good leader must be supple enough to adjust to changing circumstances.
examples.translation_cn: 优秀的领导者必须足够灵活，能适应不断变化的环境。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes you remember to do something

examples.text: He set a reminder to take his medication before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 他设了一个提醒，早餐前服药。

senses.meaning_en: a letter or note asking for payment of an unpaid bill

examples.text: The landlord sent a final reminder for payment of the overdue rent.
examples.translation_cn: 房东寄来了一封催缴逾期租金的最后通知。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes you remember a person, place, or event from the past

examples.text: The statue serves as a constant reminder of the city's proud past.
examples.translation_cn: 这座雕像不断提醒着人们这座城市辉煌的过去。

senses.meaning_en: relating to ecology or the relationships between living things and their environment

examples.text: The oil spill upset the ecological balance of the bay.
examples.translation_cn: 石油泄漏破坏了海湾的生态平衡。

senses.meaning_en: not harmful to the environment

examples.text: Many families now buy ecological products to protect rivers.
examples.translation_cn: 许多家庭现在购买环保产品来保护河流。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being kept in prison or the punishment of being put in prison

examples.text: He was sentenced to five years' imprisonment for fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 他因诈骗被判处五年监禁。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical substance produced in the body that controls growth, mood, etc.

examples.text: The pancreas releases hormones that control blood sugar levels.
examples.translation_cn: 胰腺释放控制血糖水平的激素。

senses.meaning_en: a synthetic compound with similar activity

examples.text: Some women take hormones to relieve menopausal symptoms such as hot flashes.
examples.translation_cn: 一些妇女服用激素以缓解潮热等更年期症状。

senses.meaning_en: a similar substance in plants

examples.text: Root tips produce plant hormones that make stems grow toward light.
examples.translation_cn: 根尖产生植物激素，使茎向光生长。

senses.meaning_en: characterized by new ideas or inventions

examples.text: The company adopted an innovative approach to recycling plastic waste.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司采用了一种回收塑料废物的创新方法。

senses.meaning_en: feeling calm and not worried

examples.text: She feels relaxed after doing yoga in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 在公园做完瑜伽后，她感到很放松。

senses.meaning_en: calm and informal

examples.text: We chatted in a relaxed atmosphere after the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会后我们在轻松的气氛中聊天。

senses.meaning_en: not strict; lenient

examples.text: The school is relaxed about its uniform policy.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学校对校服政策要求不严。

senses.meaning_en: soft; not tensed

examples.text: Keep your shoulders relaxed while you lift the weight.
examples.translation_cn: 举重时保持肩膀放松。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is among the first to explore or settle a new area or develop a new idea

examples.text: Marie Curie was a pioneer in the field of radioactivity.
examples.translation_cn: 玛丽·居里是放射性领域的先驱。

senses.meaning_en: to be the first to develop or use a new method, area of knowledge, etc.

examples.text: She pioneered the use of lasers in eye surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 她率先在眼科手术中使用激光。

senses.meaning_en: a soldier who builds roads, bridges, etc. for an advancing army

examples.text: He served in a pioneer unit that built roads for the advancing army.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一个为推进部队修路的工兵分队服役。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a children's organization, typically in a communist party system

examples.text: She joined the Young Pioneers at school last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年在学校加入了少先队。

senses.meaning_en: to imagine something as a possible future event or situation

examples.text: The company envisions expanding into international markets within five years.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司设想在五年内扩展到国际市场。

senses.meaning_en: involving the possibility of danger or failure
senses.pattern: it is risky to do sth

examples.text: It is risky to drive fast on icy roads.
examples.translation_cn: 在结冰的路面上开快车是有风险的。

senses.meaning_en: a particular type or category, especially of literature, art, or music

examples.text: Science fiction is a popular genre of literature.
examples.translation_cn: 科幻小说是一种流行的文学体裁。

senses.meaning_en: not connected with or relevant to something

examples.text: Her age is irrelevant to her ability to do the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她的年龄与做这份工作的能力无关。

senses.meaning_en: a thick, solid piece cut or broken off something

examples.text: He cut off a chunk of bread and handed it to me.
examples.translation_cn: 他切下一大块面包递给我。

senses.meaning_en: a large amount or part of something

examples.text: A large chunk of the budget goes to healthcare.
examples.translation_cn: 预算的很大一部分用于医疗保健。

senses.meaning_en: to break something into large pieces or chunks

examples.text: Chunk the potatoes before you add them to the pot.
examples.translation_cn: 把土豆切成大块，然后放进锅里。

senses.meaning_en: a group of information or data processed as a unit

examples.text: The download is sent in chunks to keep the connection stable.
examples.translation_cn: 下载内容分块发送以保持连接稳定。

senses.meaning_en: to break down language or information into conceptual pieces of manageable size

examples.text: Chunk the list into shorter groups so it is easier to memorize.
examples.translation_cn: 把这份清单拆成更短的组，这样更容易记住。

senses.meaning_en: the action or process of taking air into the lungs and sending it out again

examples.text: She focused on breathing in and out slowly.
examples.translation_cn: 她专注于缓慢地吸气和呼气。

senses.meaning_en: the movement of people to a new place to live or work

examples.text: The mass migration from rural areas to cities transformed the country's economy.
examples.translation_cn: 从农村到城市的大规模迁移改变了这个国家的经济。

senses.meaning_en: the seasonal movement of animals from one region to another

examples.text: Scientists track the seasonal migration of whales across the ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家追踪鲸鱼跨越大洋的季节性迁徙。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that sells goods to the public

examples.text: The company is a leading retailer of outdoor equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司是户外装备的主要零售商。

senses.meaning_en: the work of collecting and reporting news

examples.text: She has worked in journalism for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她从事新闻工作已有十多年。

senses.meaning_en: the study of news media

examples.text: He is currently studying journalism at Columbia University.
examples.translation_cn: 他目前在哥伦比亚大学学习新闻学。

senses.meaning_en: news stories and reporting as a whole

examples.text: This documentary is a fine piece of investigative journalism.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片是一部优秀的调查性新闻报道作品。

senses.meaning_en: according to what is said or believed, often with doubt about its truth

examples.text: He supposedly earns a fortune from his online business.
examples.translation_cn: 据称他从网上生意中赚了一大笔钱。

senses.meaning_en: according to what is expected or claimed, often contrary to reality

examples.text: Supposedly, the museum is open until six, but it was closed when we arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 按理说博物馆开到六点，但我们到达时它关门了。

senses.meaning_en: an irregular line or mark

examples.text: There were dark streaks of dirt on the window.
examples.translation_cn: 窗户上有暗色的污渍条纹。

senses.meaning_en: a characteristic or tendency, especially an unpleasant one

examples.text: He has a rebellious streak that worries his parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他有叛逆的倾向，令父母担心。

senses.meaning_en: a continuous series of similar events, especially wins or losses

examples.text: He has had a streak of bad luck recently.
examples.translation_cn: 他最近一连串地倒霉。

senses.meaning_en: to move very quickly

examples.text: A bright meteor streaked across the night sky.
examples.translation_cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。

senses.meaning_en: an area of work or study that somebody knows a lot about

examples.text: Her specialty is criminal law, and she has won many famous cases.
examples.translation_cn: 她的专长是刑法，赢过许多著名案件。

senses.meaning_en: a product that is typical of a place

examples.text: This cheese is a specialty of the region and is exported worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 这种奶酪是该地区的特产，并出口到世界各地。

senses.meaning_en: a dish that a restaurant or place is famous for

examples.text: The roast duck is the house specialty and draws customers from far away.
examples.translation_cn: 烤鸭是这家店的招牌菜，吸引了远道而来的顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a thing used for decoration, especially on a special occasion

examples.text: We put up colorful decorations for the school festival.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为学校节日挂上了五颜六色的装饰品。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of decorating something

examples.text: The decoration of the wedding cake took her two hours.
examples.translation_cn: 装饰婚礼蛋糕花了她两个小时。

senses.meaning_en: the act of painting and wallpapering a room, house, etc.; renovation

examples.text: The old apartment is in need of decoration.
examples.translation_cn: 这套旧公寓需要装修。

senses.meaning_en: a medal or other award given as an honor

examples.text: The soldier received a decoration for his bravery.
examples.translation_cn: 这名士兵因勇敢获得了一枚勋章。

senses.meaning_en: an object made by a human being, typically of historical or cultural interest

examples.text: The museum displays ancient artifacts from the Qin dynasty.
examples.translation_cn: 博物馆展出秦朝的古代文物。

senses.meaning_en: a feature that appears in a scientific image or result but is not actually present in the original

examples.text: The bright spot is just an artifact in the image from the camera sensor.
examples.translation_cn: 亮点只是图像中来自相机传感器的伪影。

senses.meaning_en: a wise and trusted counselor or teacher

examples.text: She was a mentor to many young scientists.
examples.translation_cn: 她曾是许多青年科学家的导师。

senses.meaning_en: to act as a mentor to someone

examples.text: He mentors new teachers at our school every fall.
examples.translation_cn: 他每年秋天在我们学校指导新教师。

senses.meaning_en: to leave someone in a place they cannot get away from

examples.text: Hundreds of passengers were stranded at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 数百名乘客滞留在机场。

senses.meaning_en: a single thin length of thread, wire, hair, etc.

examples.text: A single strand of hair fell across her face.
examples.translation_cn: 一缕头发落在她的脸上。

senses.meaning_en: one of the different parts of an idea, a plan, a story, etc.

examples.text: The book brings together many different strands of evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书汇集了许多不同的证据线索。

senses.meaning_en: rubble, wreckage, scattered remains of something destroyed

examples.text: Rescue workers searched for survivors in the debris after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 救援人员在地震后的废墟中搜寻幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: litter and discarded refuse

examples.text: The playground was littered with debris after the fair.
examples.translation_cn: 游乐场在集市后到处都是垃圾。

senses.meaning_en: large rock fragments left by a melting glacier

examples.text: The valley floor is covered with debris from a glacier that melted long ago.
examples.translation_cn: 谷底覆盖着很久以前冰川融化留下的岩屑。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being continuous or connected without interruption

examples.text: There is little continuity between the two halves of the novel.
examples.translation_cn: 小说两部分之间几乎没有连贯性。

senses.meaning_en: the property of a continuous function

examples.text: You should check the continuity of the function at x = 0.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该检查该函数在x=0处的连续性。

senses.meaning_en: an established fictional universe or canon

examples.text: The new episode breaks continuity with the earlier seasons.
examples.translation_cn: 新一集破坏了与前几季的设定连续性。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives opinions on events or issues, especially in the media

examples.text: She is a well-known commentator on international politics.
examples.translation_cn: 她是国际政治方面的知名评论员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives a live description of an event, especially a sports game

examples.text: He works as a commentator for the national basketball league.
examples.translation_cn: 他是全国篮球联赛的解说员。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or supporting feminism

examples.text: Her research examines education from a feminist perspective.
examples.translation_cn: 她的研究从女权主义视角审视教育。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supports feminism and equality of the sexes

examples.text: As a feminist, she campaigns against workplace discrimination.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名女权主义者，她开展运动反对职场歧视。

senses.meaning_en: divine aid or a spoken prayer for good fortune

examples.text: The priest gave a blessing to the couple at the end of the service.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师在仪式结束时为这对夫妇祝福。

senses.meaning_en: approval or permission

examples.text: She finally gave her blessing to the marriage proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 她最终同意了求婚。

senses.meaning_en: a very helpful or positive thing to be grateful for

examples.text: The new park is a blessing to the whole neighborhood.
examples.translation_cn: 新公园对全社区来说是一件幸事。

senses.meaning_en: a prayer before a meal; grace

examples.text: We always say a blessing before we eat dinner together.
examples.translation_cn: 我们总是一起吃晚饭前做感恩祷告。

senses.meaning_en: having a tendency or preference to do something; likely to do something

examples.text: I am inclined to agree with her assessment.
examples.translation_cn: 我倾向于同意她的评价。

senses.meaning_en: having a natural ability or interest in something

examples.text: He is naturally inclined toward mathematics and science.
examples.translation_cn: 他天生对数学和科学感兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: sloping or at an angle

examples.text: The road is inclined at a steep angle near the summit.
examples.translation_cn: 这条路在靠近山顶处坡度很陡。

senses.meaning_en: repeatedly; very often

examples.text: She is continually interrupting me while I'm working.
examples.translation_cn: 我工作时她不断地打断我。

senses.meaning_en: without stopping

examples.text: The machines ran continually for hours in the factory.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂里的机器连续运转了好几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: for a limited period of time; not permanently

examples.text: The online payment system is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance.
examples.translation_cn: 由于维护，在线支付系统暂时不可用。

senses.meaning_en: an animal that hunts and kills other animals for food

examples.text: Eagles are predators of fish and small mammals.
examples.translation_cn: 鹰是鱼类和小型哺乳动物的捕食者。

senses.meaning_en: a person who attacks or takes advantage of others for gain

examples.text: The scammer acted like a predator, targeting elderly people's savings.
examples.translation_cn: 那个骗子像掠夺者一样行事，盯上了老年人的积蓄。

senses.meaning_en: completely; entirely

examples.text: His excuse was utterly ridiculous and nobody believed him.
examples.translation_cn: 他的借口完全荒唐，没有人相信他。

senses.meaning_en: to make a bill into law

examples.text: Congress enacted a new tax law last year.
examples.translation_cn: 国会去年通过了一项新税法。

senses.meaning_en: to act the part of; to play

examples.text: The students enacted a scene from Romeo and Juliet.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们表演了《罗密欧与朱丽叶》中的一场戏。

senses.meaning_en: to do; to effect

examples.text: The government enacted several reforms to improve healthcare.
examples.translation_cn: 政府实施了几项改革以改善医疗保健。

senses.meaning_en: an easily recognized place or object that helps you find your way

examples.text: The lighthouse serves as a familiar landmark for ships approaching the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 这座灯塔是船只驶近海岸时的一个熟悉地标。

senses.meaning_en: a place of historical or cultural importance

examples.text: The palace is a historic landmark known for its royal history.
examples.translation_cn: 这座宫殿是一处因王室历史而闻名的历史古迹。

senses.meaning_en: an important event or discovery

examples.text: The reform was a landmark in the struggle for workers' rights.
examples.translation_cn: 这项改革是工人权利斗争中的一个里程碑。

senses.meaning_en: celebrated, well-known or eminent

examples.text: He is distinguished for his contributions to modern medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对现代医学的贡献而著名。

senses.meaning_en: having a dignified appearance or demeanor

examples.text: The old professor looked distinguished in his dark suit.
examples.translation_cn: 这位老教授穿着深色西装，显得很尊贵。

senses.meaning_en: specified, noted

examples.text: Each item on the list is distinguished by a unique code.
examples.translation_cn: 清单上的每一项都有一个唯一代码作为标志。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that has become common or expected

examples.text: Doctors routinely check patients' blood pressure before surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在手术前常规检查病人的血压。

senses.meaning_en: very; extremely

examples.text: I am terribly sorry for the mix-up with your order.
examples.translation_cn: 对于您订单的混淆，我非常抱歉。

senses.meaning_en: very badly

examples.text: The team played terribly in the first half.
examples.translation_cn: 球队上半场打得很糟糕。

senses.meaning_en: something that is rented

examples.text: We picked up a rental car at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在机场取了一辆租来的车。

senses.meaning_en: the payment made to rent something

examples.text: The monthly rental for the office is $2,000.
examples.translation_cn: 办公室的月租金是2000美元。

senses.meaning_en: a business that rents out something to its customers

examples.text: A local rental company supplied the chairs and tables.
examples.translation_cn: 当地一家租赁公司提供了桌椅。

senses.meaning_en: the act of renting

examples.text: The landlord put the cottage up for rental last spring.
examples.translation_cn: 去年春天房东将小屋挂牌出租。

senses.meaning_en: including many different types of things or people

examples.text: The library offers a varied range of books for all ages.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆为各个年龄段提供各种各样的书。

senses.meaning_en: not all the same; changing often

examples.text: Public opinions on this issue are widely varied.
examples.translation_cn: 公众对这个问题的看法差异很大。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being relaxed; rest

examples.text: After the exam, he sat in a state of deep relaxation.
examples.translation_cn: 考试后，他坐着，处于深度放松状态。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that provides rest and enjoyment

examples.text: She does yoga for relaxation after a busy day.
examples.translation_cn: 她忙碌一天后练瑜伽来消遣放松。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making rules or restrictions less strict

examples.text: The government announced a relaxation of travel restrictions.
examples.translation_cn: 政府宣布放宽旅行限制。

senses.meaning_en: a forecast or estimate based on present trends or data

examples.text: The government's projections for next year were too optimistic.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对明年的预测过于乐观。

senses.meaning_en: an image shown on a surface by a projector or light

examples.text: The projection on the screen was too small to read.
examples.translation_cn: 屏幕上的投影太小，看不清楚。

senses.meaning_en: something that sticks out from a surface

examples.text: A small projection from the wall caught her sleeve.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上一个小小的凸出部分钩住了她的袖子。

senses.meaning_en: the act of attributing one's own feelings or thoughts to others

examples.text: She recognized her criticism as a projection of her own fears.
examples.translation_cn: 她意识到自己的批评是自己恐惧的心理投射。

senses.meaning_en: the passing of property or rights to someone after the owner's death

examples.text: The inheritance of property often involves complex legal procedures.
examples.translation_cn: 财产继承常常涉及复杂的法律程序。

senses.meaning_en: the biological process by which characteristics are passed from parents to children

examples.text: The inheritance of a single trait is easier to study in plants.
examples.translation_cn: 单一性状的遗传在植物中更容易研究。

senses.meaning_en: something from the past that has a strong influence on the present

examples.text: The ancient ruins are a cultural inheritance for all humanity.
examples.translation_cn: 这些古代遗迹是全人类的文化遗产。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone the authority to do something

examples.text: The manager authorized her assistant to sign the contract.
examples.translation_cn: 经理授权她的助理签署合同。

senses.meaning_en: to give official permission for something to happen

examples.text: The board voted to authorize the construction of a new hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会投票批准了新医院的建设。

senses.meaning_en: a deep, narrow valley with steep sides

examples.text: The river flows through the canyon near the national park.
examples.translation_cn: 河流流经国家公园附近的峡谷。

senses.meaning_en: giving the wrong idea or impression
senses.pattern: it is misleading to do sth

examples.text: It is misleading to suggest that the vaccine is completely risk-free.
examples.translation_cn: 暗示这种疫苗完全没有风险是误导性的。

senses.meaning_en: not suitable for the situation, time, or place

examples.text: Wearing jeans is inappropriate for a formal dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 穿牛仔裤不适合正式晚宴。

senses.meaning_en: improper or offensive, especially of a sexual nature

examples.text: He was fired for making inappropriate remarks of a sexual nature to a colleague.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对同事发表带性暗示的不当言论而被解雇。

senses.meaning_en: to restore someone to their former reputation or status

examples.text: The new evidence fully rehabilitated the politician's reputation.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据彻底恢复了这位政治家的名誉。

senses.meaning_en: to return something to its original condition, especially a building or vehicle

examples.text: They plan to rehabilitate the old bridge and reopen it next year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划修复那座旧桥并于明年重新开放。

senses.meaning_en: to help someone return to good health after illness or addiction

examples.text: The clinic helps rehabilitate patients after serious injuries.
examples.translation_cn: 该诊所帮助病人在重伤后康复。

senses.meaning_en: to recover, especially from an illness or injury

examples.text: She is rehabilitating well after her knee surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 她膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

senses.meaning_en: the process of rehabilitating somebody or something

examples.text: The rehabilitation of the old bridge took nearly a year.
examples.translation_cn: 这座旧桥的修复花了将近一年。

senses.meaning_en: the process of recovering from illness, injury, or surgery

examples.text: She spent months in rehabilitation after serious injuries.
examples.translation_cn: 她因重伤接受了数月的康复治疗。

senses.meaning_en: the process of helping someone return to normal life after prison or addiction

examples.text: The local center provides rehabilitation for young offenders.
examples.translation_cn: 当地中心为年轻罪犯提供改造。

senses.meaning_en: the process of restoring someone's reputation or position

examples.text: The new evidence led to the rehabilitation of his reputation.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据促成了他名誉的恢复。

senses.meaning_en: a place where stone is dug out of the ground

examples.text: He spent ten years working in a quarry in northern England.
examples.translation_cn: 他在英格兰北部的一个采石场工作了十年。

senses.meaning_en: an animal that is hunted

examples.text: The lioness stalked her quarry silently through the tall grass.
examples.translation_cn: 母狮悄无声息地穿过高草跟踪猎物。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is being chased or sought

examples.text: The police followed their quarry into a narrow alley.
examples.translation_cn: 警察跟踪他们的追捕对象进入一条狭窄的小巷。

senses.meaning_en: to dig stone out of a quarry

examples.text: They quarry large blocks of limestone from the hills nearby.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从附近的山丘开采大块石灰石。

senses.meaning_en: the first four books of the New Testament, or the teachings of Jesus Christ

examples.text: The story appears in the Gospel of Matthew.
examples.translation_cn: 这个故事出现在马太福音中。

senses.meaning_en: something considered absolutely true or authoritative

examples.text: You shouldn't take everything you read online as gospel.
examples.translation_cn: 你不应该把网上读到的一切都当作绝对真理。

senses.meaning_en: a style of Christian music with strong rhythms and religious lyrics

examples.text: They sing gospel music at the community center every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每个星期天在社区中心唱福音音乐。

senses.meaning_en: admission of wrongdoing or guilt

examples.text: He made a full confession to stealing the money.
examples.translation_cn: 他对自己偷钱一事供认不讳。

senses.meaning_en: disclosure of sins to a priest

examples.text: She goes to confession every Saturday evening at the local church.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周六晚上去当地教堂告解。

senses.meaning_en: statement of faith

examples.text: He made a public confession of faith in front of the congregation.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会众面前公开宣告了自己的信仰。

senses.meaning_en: a statement revealing private feelings or a secret, especially love

examples.text: He wrote a nervous confession of love and sent it to her.
examples.translation_cn: 他写了一份紧张的爱意表白并寄给了她。

senses.meaning_en: causing great damage or destruction

examples.text: The hurricane was devastating to the island's infrastructure.
examples.translation_cn: 飓风给岛上基础设施带来了毁灭性破坏。

senses.meaning_en: causing severe shock or distress

examples.text: The news of the accident was devastating for the small community.
examples.translation_cn: 事故的消息让这个小社区深感悲痛。

senses.meaning_en: failure to give proper care or attention

examples.text: The company was accused of negligence in maintaining safety equipment.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司被指控在维护安全设备方面疏忽。

senses.meaning_en: the legal status of being a citizen of a country

examples.text: Thousands of people apply for citizenship every year.
examples.translation_cn: 每年有成千上万的人申请公民身份。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being a responsible and active member of a community

examples.text: Volunteering is one way to show good citizenship.
examples.translation_cn: 志愿服务是展现良好公民意识的一种方式。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being sovereign

examples.text: The island nation asserted its sovereignty over the surrounding waters.
examples.translation_cn: 这个岛国宣称对周边海域拥有主权。

senses.meaning_en: the state of relying on someone or something

examples.text: Her dependence on her parents decreased after she got a job.
examples.translation_cn: 找到工作后，她对父母的依赖减少了。

senses.meaning_en: an urgent physical or psychological need for a substance

examples.text: He developed a dangerous dependence on painkillers after surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后，他对止痛药产生了危险的依赖。

senses.meaning_en: a claim that someone has done something wrong; the act of accusing

examples.text: He was upset by her accusation of lying.
examples.translation_cn: 他对她指责自己说谎感到生气。

senses.meaning_en: a formal charge brought before a court

examples.text: He faces an accusation of fraud in court.
examples.translation_cn: 他在法庭上面临欺诈指控。

senses.meaning_en: the act or state of being exempt from an obligation, duty, etc.

examples.text: Students with a medical certificate can apply for exemption from physical education.
examples.translation_cn: 有医生证明的学生可以申请免修体育课。

senses.meaning_en: a deduction from the normal amount of taxes

examples.text: The government raised the tax exemption for low-income families this year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府今年提高了低收入家庭的税收免征额。

senses.meaning_en: a thin layer of tissue that covers or lines a body part

examples.text: A thin membrane around the heart protects it from friction.
examples.translation_cn: 心脏周围的一层薄膜保护它免受摩擦。

senses.meaning_en: to wear away the surface of something gradually

examples.text: The cliffs are being eroded by the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 这些悬崖正被海水侵蚀。

senses.meaning_en: to gradually weaken or destroy something

examples.text: Years of unfair treatment gradually eroded his confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 多年的不公平待遇逐渐削弱了他的信心。

senses.meaning_en: giving equal attention to all sides or parts; not too much of one thing

examples.text: The university takes a balanced approach to teaching and research.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学采取教学与研究并重的方法。

senses.meaning_en: fair and not influenced by personal opinions; giving equal treatment to all sides

examples.text: The journalist gave a balanced account of the conflict despite her own views.
examples.translation_cn: 这位记者不顾个人观点，对冲突作了不偏不倚的报道。

senses.meaning_en: mentally and emotionally stable

examples.text: She remains calm and balanced even under great stress.
examples.translation_cn: 即使压力很大，她依然保持冷静和情绪稳定。

senses.meaning_en: a recurring or dominant theme in an artistic work

examples.text: The loss of innocence is a recurring motif in her poetry.
examples.translation_cn: 失去纯真是她诗歌中反复出现的主题。

senses.meaning_en: a repeated decorative design or pattern

examples.text: The vase is decorated with floral motifs on a blue background.
examples.translation_cn: 花瓶上装饰着蓝底的花卉图案。

senses.meaning_en: a short recurring musical phrase

examples.text: A recurring musical motif in the piece returns in the finale.
examples.translation_cn: 该作品中反复出现的音乐动机在终曲中再次出现。

senses.meaning_en: something that you say; spoken words

examples.text: His public utterance on the issue was widely quoted.
examples.translation_cn: 他关于该问题的公开言论被广泛引用。

senses.meaning_en: the act of expressing something in words

examples.text: He gave utterance to his frustration in a diary entry.
examples.translation_cn: 他在日记中表达了自己的沮丧。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to speak

examples.text: After the shock, she briefly lost the power of utterance.
examples.translation_cn: 受惊后，她一时说不出话来。

senses.meaning_en: a person who promotes something

examples.text: The company hired a promoter of its new drink to attract customers.
examples.translation_cn: 公司聘请了一名新饮品的推广员来吸引顾客。

senses.meaning_en: a person who starts or supports a project, cause, etc.

examples.text: She became a leading promoter of educational reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她成了教育改革的主要倡导者。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that organizes and finances an event

examples.text: The promoter of a concert is responsible for financing and organizing the event.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会主办方负责筹资并组织活动。

senses.meaning_en: the person or voice telling a story

examples.text: The narrator of the story remains unnamed throughout the book.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书中故事的叙述者始终没有透露姓名。

senses.meaning_en: a person who provides spoken commentary for a film, broadcast, etc.

examples.text: The narrator of the documentary explains how the brain forms memories.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片的解说员解释了大脑如何形成记忆。

senses.meaning_en: extending throughout an entire nation

examples.text: The company launched a nationwide campaign to reduce plastic waste.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司发起了一场全国性的减少塑料垃圾的运动。

senses.meaning_en: throughout a nation

examples.text: The police have searched nationwide for any sign of the missing man.
examples.translation_cn: 警方已在全国范围内搜查失踪男子的任何踪迹。

senses.meaning_en: a small stream of fresh water, smaller than a river

examples.text: We walked along a creek until we came to an old wooden bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 我们沿着一条小河走，直到来到一座旧木桥。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow inlet of the sea, often used as a sheltered place for small boats

examples.text: The fishing boats moored in a sheltered creek just inside the harbor.
examples.translation_cn: 渔船停泊在港内一个避风的小港汊里。

senses.meaning_en: a place where you can cross a road, river, railway, etc.

examples.text: She waited at a pedestrian crossing for the green light.
examples.translation_cn: 她在人行横道等待绿灯。

senses.meaning_en: a place where two roads, lines, or tracks cross

examples.text: The accident occurred at the crossing of two busy roads.
examples.translation_cn: 事故发生在两条繁忙道路的交叉处。

senses.meaning_en: the act of crossing something, or a voyage across water

examples.text: The crossing of the Atlantic took six days.
examples.translation_cn: 横渡大西洋用了六天。

senses.meaning_en: experiencing relief; freed from stress or discomfort

examples.text: I was relieved to hear that the test was cancelled.
examples.translation_cn: 听到考试被取消，我松了一口气。

senses.meaning_en: agreement or harmony among parts or between different things

examples.text: There is little consistency between his words and his actions.
examples.translation_cn: 他的言行之间几乎没有一致性。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of always behaving or performing in a similar way

examples.text: The team has played with consistency throughout the season.
examples.translation_cn: 这支球队整个赛季都表现得很稳定。

senses.meaning_en: how thick or smooth a substance is

examples.text: Stir the mixture until it has the consistency of thick cream.
examples.translation_cn: 搅拌混合物，直到它达到浓奶油的稠度。

senses.meaning_en: involving active communication or direct involvement between people or groups

examples.text: The workshop was highly interactive, with participants asking questions throughout.
examples.translation_cn: 研讨会互动性很强，参与者全程提问。

senses.meaning_en: offering or involving interaction with the user

examples.text: The new exhibit is interactive: visitors can tap the screen to learn more.
examples.translation_cn: 新展品具有交互性：参观者可以点击屏幕了解更多。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of writing that gives an opinion about a book, film, etc.

examples.text: Her critique of the novel was published in the Sunday paper.
examples.translation_cn: 她对那部小说的评论文章发表在周日报纸上。

senses.meaning_en: to review or criticize something

examples.text: Our professor critiqued the draft before we submitted it.
examples.translation_cn: 我们提交之前，教授对草稿进行了评论。

senses.meaning_en: a critical comment or judgment

examples.text: The report offers a sharp critique of current policy.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告对现行政策提出了尖锐的批评意见。

senses.meaning_en: lasting for a long time; overlong in time

examples.text: Getting a visa can be a lengthy process.
examples.translation_cn: 办理签证可能是一个漫长的过程。

senses.meaning_en: speaking or writing at too great a length; long-winded

examples.text: The chairperson gave a lengthy speech full of unnecessary details.
examples.translation_cn: 主席发表了一篇充满不必要细节的冗长演讲。

senses.meaning_en: having great love and loyalty for someone or something

examples.text: She has always been devoted to her family.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直深爱并忠于她的家人。

senses.meaning_en: giving all your time and energy to something

examples.text: He has been devoted to helping homeless people.
examples.translation_cn: 他一直热心帮助无家可归的人。

senses.meaning_en: existing only in legends

examples.text: The phoenix is a legendary creature in Greek mythology.
examples.translation_cn: 凤凰是希腊神话中的传说生物。

senses.meaning_en: very famous and admired

examples.text: The chef is legendary for his innovative desserts.
examples.translation_cn: 这位厨师因其创新的甜点而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: so good or exciting that people tell stories about it

examples.text: The party after the final concert was absolutely legendary.
examples.translation_cn: 最后一场音乐会后的派对棒极了。

senses.meaning_en: having two parts or aspects

examples.text: The new app serves a dual purpose: it tracks spending and reminds you of bills.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新应用有双重用途：记录开支并提醒账单。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a grammatical number that refers to two items

examples.text: In Ancient Greek, some nouns have a dual form.
examples.translation_cn: 在古希腊语中，一些名词有双数形式。

senses.meaning_en: slightly different from others of the same type

examples.text: The dictionary lists variant forms of the word.
examples.translation_cn: 词典列出了这个词的不同形式。

senses.meaning_en: a slightly different form or type of something

examples.text: The vaccine targets a new variant of the virus.
