examples.translation_cn: 该疫苗针对病毒的一种新变种。

senses.meaning_en: a state of disagreement or conflict; difference of opinion

examples.text: The two witnesses are at variance with each other.
examples.translation_cn: 两位证人的说法互相矛盾。

senses.meaning_en: a difference between expected and observed values; deviation

examples.text: The test results showed significant variance from the expected values.
examples.translation_cn: 测试结果与预期值有显著偏差。

senses.meaning_en: a statistical measure of spread; the square of the standard deviation

examples.text: You can calculate the variance of a dataset by averaging the squared deviations from the mean.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以通过求平方偏差的平均值来计算数据集的方差。

senses.meaning_en: a man who works with cattle or identifies with cowboy culture

examples.text: He worked as a cowboy on a cattle ranch in Texas.
examples.translation_cn: 他在得克萨斯州的一个牧牛场当牛仔。

senses.meaning_en: a person who behaves recklessly or does poor-quality work, especially a builder

examples.text: He acted like a cowboy and ignored all the safety warnings.
examples.translation_cn: 他行事鲁莽，无视所有安全警告。

senses.meaning_en: to compete eagerly

examples.text: Local restaurants vie to attract tourists during the summer.
examples.translation_cn: 当地餐馆在夏季争相吸引游客。

senses.meaning_en: able to be done or to work successfully; feasible

examples.text: Taking the train is a viable option for daily commuters.
examples.translation_cn: 乘火车是日常通勤者一个可行的选择。

senses.meaning_en: able to live, grow, or develop

examples.text: These seeds can remain viable for decades in dry soil.
examples.translation_cn: 这些种子在干燥土壤中能保持活力数十年。

senses.meaning_en: too many to be counted; innumerable

examples.text: She has called me countless times since the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 自从那次事故以来，她给我打了无数次电话。

senses.meaning_en: a scientist who studies biology

examples.text: She works as a biologist at a marine research institute.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家海洋研究所担任生物学家。

senses.meaning_en: a medicine that kills bacteria and cures infections

examples.text: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my chest infection.
examples.translation_cn: 医生给我的胸部感染开了抗生素。

senses.meaning_en: relating to antibiotics

examples.text: She was given antibiotic treatment for a bacterial infection.
examples.translation_cn: 她因细菌感染接受了抗生素治疗。

senses.meaning_en: relating to architecture

examples.text: The old church is of great architectural importance.
examples.translation_cn: 这座古老的教堂在建筑方面非常重要。

senses.meaning_en: lack of ability to do something

examples.text: The patient's inability to speak made communication very difficult.
examples.translation_cn: 病人无法说话，使沟通非常困难。

senses.meaning_en: required by law or rules; compulsory

examples.text: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for all passengers.
examples.translation_cn: 系安全带对所有乘客是强制性的。

senses.meaning_en: reflecting or emitting light

examples.text: The polished floor looked shiny under the bright lights.
examples.translation_cn: 抛光的地板在明亮的灯光下闪闪发光。

senses.meaning_en: excellent; remarkable

examples.text: Her shiny new approach to marketing doubled our sales.
examples.translation_cn: 她的新营销方法出彩，让我们的销售额翻了一番。

senses.meaning_en: the process of becoming active, popular, or strong again

examples.text: There was a revival of the local economy after the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机过后，当地经济出现了复苏。

senses.meaning_en: a period when something becomes popular again

examples.text: Vinyl records have enjoyed a revival among young listeners.
examples.translation_cn: 黑胶唱片在年轻听众中重新流行起来。

senses.meaning_en: a new production of an old play or show
senses.pattern: a revival of a classic play

examples.text: The theatre staged a revival of a classic play last month.
examples.translation_cn: 上个月剧院重演了一部经典戏剧。

senses.meaning_en: to build again or restore something that has been damaged or destroyed

examples.text: They plan to reconstruct the old bridge next year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划明年重建那座旧桥。

senses.meaning_en: to describe or show exactly how a past event happened, based on evidence

examples.text: Detectives used the evidence to reconstruct how the accident happened.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探们利用证据重现了事故是如何发生的。

senses.meaning_en: the act of restoring something to an earlier state

examples.text: The reconstruction of the old bridge restored it to its original design.
examples.translation_cn: 这座旧桥的重建使它恢复了原有的设计。

senses.meaning_en: the process of creating a model or description of a past event from available evidence

examples.text: A reconstruction of events helped police understand the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 对事件的重现帮助警方了解了事故。

senses.meaning_en: a dead body, especially of a human being

examples.text: The corpse of a young man was found in the river.
examples.translation_cn: 一名年轻男子的尸体在河中被发现。

senses.meaning_en: official documents or records used as evidence or proof

examples.text: Applicants must provide supporting documentation for their visa applications.
examples.translation_cn: 申请人必须为签证申请提供证明文件。

senses.meaning_en: written instructions or information about a product or computer system

examples.text: The user documentation for this printer is available online.
examples.translation_cn: 这款打印机的用户文档可在网上获取。

senses.meaning_en: the act of recording information or events in documents

examples.text: Careful documentation of patient histories is essential in this hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 仔细记录病人病史在这家医院至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: the process of body cells repairing themselves

examples.text: The healing process after surgery can be slow.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后的愈合过程可能会很慢。

senses.meaning_en: the psychological process of dealing with problems

examples.text: Healing from the loss of a parent takes time.
examples.translation_cn: 从失去父母的痛苦中走出来需要时间。

senses.meaning_en: the act of ending something, especially a law or system

examples.text: The abolition of slavery was a turning point in history.
examples.translation_cn: 奴隶制的废除是历史上的一个转折点。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of merging separate things
senses.pattern: a fusion of A and B

examples.text: The building is a fusion of Eastern and Western styles.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑融合了东方和西方的风格。

senses.meaning_en: a nuclear reaction in which atomic nuclei combine

examples.text: The sun's energy comes from the fusion of hydrogen nuclei.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳的能量来自氢原子核的聚变。

senses.meaning_en: an extremely large number

examples.text: There are trillions of stars in the universe.
examples.translation_cn: 宇宙中有无数的恒星。

examples.text: The national debt is over a trillion dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 国家债务超过一万亿美元。

senses.meaning_en: the process of coming out of a difficult situation or state

examples.text: The country's emergence from recession was slower than expected.
examples.translation_cn: 该国摆脱衰退的速度慢于预期。

senses.meaning_en: the process of appearing or becoming known

examples.text: The emergence of social media has changed how people communicate.
examples.translation_cn: 社交媒体的出现改变了人们的交流方式。

senses.meaning_en: the killing of one person by another

examples.text: He was charged with homicide after the fight outside the bar.
examples.translation_cn: 酒吧外斗殴后，他被控杀人罪。

senses.meaning_en: a victim of homicide; a person who has been unlawfully killed

examples.text: He was a homicide victim found near the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 他是在高速公路附近发现的一名他杀案受害者。

senses.meaning_en: the department within a police force that investigates cases of homicide

examples.text: He has worked in homicide for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在凶杀组工作五年了。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing strong feelings of enthusiasm for something

examples.text: My sister is passionate about teaching young children.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐对教小孩子充满热情。

senses.meaning_en: showing or expressing strong emotions in a way that impresses people

examples.text: The lawyer made a passionate appeal for justice.
examples.translation_cn: 律师为正义发出了激昂的呼吁。

senses.meaning_en: involving strong romantic or sexual feelings

examples.text: They shared a passionate kiss under the stars.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在星空下热烈亲吻。

senses.meaning_en: clearly stated or described in detail

examples.text: The meeting will begin at the specified time.
examples.translation_cn: 会议将在规定的时间开始。

senses.meaning_en: a change made to suit new conditions

examples.text: The company's adaptation to remote work was quick and effective.
examples.translation_cn: 公司对远程办公的适应既迅速又有效。

senses.meaning_en: a film, play, etc. based on a different work

examples.text: The new film is an adaptation of a popular novel.
examples.translation_cn: 这部新电影改编自一部流行小说。

senses.meaning_en: the process of adapting a work from another medium

examples.text: Her adaptation of the novel for the screen took five years.
examples.translation_cn: 她将这部小说改编成影视作品花了五年时间。

senses.meaning_en: the use of vivid or figurative language to create mental pictures

examples.text: Poets often use imagery to express complex emotions.
examples.translation_cn: 诗人经常使用意象来表达复杂的情感。

senses.meaning_en: visible images collectively, especially those produced by cameras or satellites

examples.text: The storm is clearly visible in satellite imagery.
examples.translation_cn: 这场风暴在卫星图像中清晰可见。

senses.meaning_en: to move or travel from one location to another

examples.text: Some small robots can locomote from one room to another on wheels.
examples.translation_cn: 一些小型机器人能靠轮子从一个房间移动到另一个房间。

senses.meaning_en: a twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving

examples.text: She bought a ball of yarn to knit a scarf for her brother.
examples.translation_cn: 她买了一团毛线给弟弟织围巾。

senses.meaning_en: a story, especially one that is incredible or exaggerated

examples.text: He spun a yarn about meeting a famous actor in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 他编了个故事，说在公园里遇见了一位著名演员。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that owes money
senses.pattern: a debtor owes money to sb

examples.text: The debtor owes money to three different creditors.
examples.translation_cn: 该债务人欠三个不同的债权人钱。

senses.meaning_en: a bright object in space with a tail of gas and dust, moving around the sun

examples.text: The tail of a comet always points away from the sun.
examples.translation_cn: 彗尾总是背离太阳。

senses.meaning_en: a protein or RNA molecule that speeds up a biochemical reaction

examples.text: An enzyme that catalyzes the breakdown of starch is present in saliva.
examples.translation_cn: 催化淀粉分解的酶存在于唾液中。

senses.meaning_en: a coordinated outfit made up of matching items

examples.text: She wore a matching navy ensemble to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿了一身配套的深蓝色套装去参加聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a piece for several instrumentalists or vocalists

examples.text: They performed an ensemble piece for two flutes and piano.
examples.translation_cn: 他们演奏了一首为两支长笛和钢琴而作的合奏曲。

senses.meaning_en: a group of musicians, actors, or dancers who perform together

examples.text: She performs in a jazz ensemble at weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 她周末在一个爵士乐团里演奏。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of forming a united whole; the overall effect

examples.text: The rooms look best as an ensemble rather than individually.
examples.translation_cn: 这些房间作为一个整体比单独看效果更好。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects and weeds

examples.text: Farmers spray pesticides on crops to protect them from insects.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在庄稼上喷洒农药以防虫害。

senses.meaning_en: a military establishment for making and storing weapons and ammunition

examples.text: He worked in an arsenal that produced rifles for the army.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家为军队生产步枪的兵工厂工作。

senses.meaning_en: a country's supply of weapons, especially nuclear weapons

examples.text: The treaty limits the nation's arsenal of chemical weapons.
examples.translation_cn: 该条约限制了该国的化学武器库。

senses.meaning_en: a large collection of useful things, skills, or arguments

examples.text: She has an arsenal of arguments ready for the debate.
examples.translation_cn: 她为辩论准备好了一整套论据。

senses.meaning_en: inexpensive; reasonably priced

examples.text: The newly built apartments are affordable for young working families.
examples.translation_cn: 这些新建公寓对年轻的工薪家庭来说是负担得起的。

senses.meaning_en: veneration and rites offered to a deity or saint

examples.text: The ancient Greeks practiced the cult of Apollo at Delphi.
examples.translation_cn: 古希腊人在德尔斐举行阿波罗崇拜仪式。

senses.meaning_en: a group with extreme devotion to a charismatic leader, often isolated from society

examples.text: She joined a cult and lost touch with her family.
examples.translation_cn: 她加入了一个邪教，并与家人失去了联系。

senses.meaning_en: a small, enthusiastic group of fans; something with such appeal

examples.text: The novel has gained a cult following among teenagers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说在青少年中收获了一批小众追随者。

senses.meaning_en: enjoyed by a small, loyal group of fans

examples.text: The low-budget horror movie became a cult classic.
examples.translation_cn: 这部低成本恐怖片成了一部小众经典。

senses.meaning_en: below the surface of the ground

examples.text: The hotel's car park is underground and secure.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店的停车场在地下，而且安全。

senses.meaning_en: hidden, furtive, secretive

examples.text: The activists remained underground for years after the ban.
examples.translation_cn: 禁令颁布后，活动人士隐匿了多年。

senses.meaning_en: outside the mainstream

examples.text: Her band is still considered underground, playing only in small clubs.
examples.translation_cn: 她的乐队仍被视为地下乐队，只在小型俱乐部演出。

senses.meaning_en: below the ground

examples.text: The power lines run underground through the city centre.
examples.translation_cn: 输电线路从市中心地下穿过。

senses.meaning_en: at risk of extinction or harm

examples.text: Many birds in this region are endangered due to habitat destruction.
examples.translation_cn: 由于栖息地破坏，这个地区的许多鸟类濒临灭绝。

senses.meaning_en: a question or inquiry

examples.text: Please contact us if you have a query about your order.
examples.translation_cn: 如果您对订单有任何疑问，请联系我们。

senses.meaning_en: to ask a question or express doubt about something

examples.text: Several board members queried whether the proposed plan was realistic.
examples.translation_cn: 几位董事会成员质疑该提案是否现实。

senses.meaning_en: a request for information from a database

examples.text: The software lets you query a database for customer records.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件可让您查询数据库中的客户记录。

senses.meaning_en: communication and cooperation between groups or people

examples.text: The school maintains very close liaison with parents throughout the year.
examples.translation_cn: 学校全年与家长保持非常密切的联系。

senses.meaning_en: a secret sexual relationship, especially one that people disapprove of

examples.text: He had a secret liaison with a married woman.
examples.translation_cn: 他与一名已婚女子有私情。

senses.meaning_en: the linking of a final consonant to a following vowel in speech, as in French

examples.text: In French, liaison between "les" and "amis" produces a /z/ sound.
examples.translation_cn: 法语中，“les”和“amis”之间的连读会产生一个 /z/ 音。

senses.meaning_en: specially developed or trained for a particular purpose or field

examples.text: This hospital is specialized in treating rare blood diseases.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院专门治疗罕见血液病。

senses.meaning_en: a very large extinct reptile that lived millions of years ago

examples.text: Scientists discovered a dinosaur called Spinosaurus in Egypt.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家在埃及发现了一种叫棘龙的恐龙。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is old-fashioned and unwilling to change

examples.text: He was seen as a dinosaur because he still uses a typewriter.
examples.translation_cn: 他被视为守旧的人，因为他仍然使用打字机。

senses.meaning_en: recently; newly

examples.text: The bread was freshly baked this morning, so it's still warm.
examples.translation_cn: 面包今天早上刚烤好，所以还热乎。

senses.meaning_en: a person who believes that something is true or good

examples.text: She is a firm believer in the power of education.
examples.translation_cn: 她坚信教育的力量。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has religious faith

examples.text: My grandmother has always been a devout believer in God.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖母一直虔诚地信仰上帝。

senses.meaning_en: the act of renewing

examples.text: The old building will undergo renewal next spring.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老建筑明年春天将进行更新。

senses.meaning_en: the act of extending a contract, subscription, or license

examples.text: My gym membership is up for renewal in May.
examples.translation_cn: 我的健身会员资格五月份要续期。

senses.meaning_en: a return of energy, interest, or popularity

examples.text: The town has seen a renewal of interest in local theatre.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小镇重新燃起了对本地戏剧的兴趣。

senses.meaning_en: the restoration of a relationship or formal ties

examples.text: Both sides welcomed the renewal of relations after years of tension.
examples.translation_cn: 双方欢迎多年紧张之后关系的恢复。

senses.meaning_en: having no companions; isolated or lonely

examples.text: A lone traveller stood on the empty platform.
examples.translation_cn: 一个孤零零的旅客站在空荡荡的站台上。

senses.meaning_en: being the only one

examples.text: She was the lone survivor of the air crash.
examples.translation_cn: 她是空难的唯一幸存者。

senses.meaning_en: situated by itself with no neighbours

examples.text: A lone house stood on the windswept hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 一座孤零零的房子矗立在迎风的山坡上。

senses.meaning_en: a male member of congress, especially the US House of Representatives

examples.text: The congressman from Ohio announced his resignation yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 来自俄亥俄州的男国会议员昨天宣布辞职。

senses.meaning_en: lack of good judgement; foolishness

examples.text: It is folly to ignore the early warning signs.
examples.translation_cn: 忽视早期预警信号是愚蠢的。

senses.meaning_en: a thoughtless action that results in serious harm or failure

examples.text: The military invasion was an act of folly.
examples.translation_cn: 那次军事入侵是愚蠢的行为。

senses.meaning_en: a decorative building with no practical purpose, especially in a garden or park

examples.text: A small garden folly was built near the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 湖边建了一座小型花园装饰性建筑。

senses.meaning_en: to cite or appeal to something as an authority or in support of a case

examples.text: The judge invoked a rarely used law to settle the dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 法官援引了一条很少使用的法律来解决争端。

senses.meaning_en: to bring a feeling or memory into the mind

examples.text: The smell of salt air invoked memories of childhood summers.
examples.translation_cn: 咸咸的空气气味唤起了童年夏日的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: to call upon a god or person for help or support

examples.text: Ancient people invoked the gods to bring rain.
examples.translation_cn: 古代人祈求神灵带来雨水。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a program or function to run

examples.text: The script invokes a function to check the user's input.
examples.translation_cn: 该脚本调用一个函数来检查用户的输入。

senses.meaning_en: relating to geography

examples.text: The map clearly shows the main geographic features of the region.
examples.translation_cn: 地图清楚显示了该地区的主要地理特征。

senses.meaning_en: determined by geography, as opposed to magnetic (i.e. North)

examples.text: A compass points to magnetic north, not geographic north.
examples.translation_cn: 指南针指向磁北极，而不是地理北极。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the location or position of something on the earth

examples.text: The geographic location of the island makes it an important shipping hub.
examples.translation_cn: 该岛屿的地理位置使其成为重要的航运枢纽。

senses.meaning_en: a person who manages or directs an organization or activity

examples.text: The new superintendent of schools will visit every school in the district this fall.
examples.translation_cn: 新任学区主管将于今年秋天访问该学区的每所学校。

senses.meaning_en: a senior police officer rank in the UK and some other countries, above chief inspector and below chief superintendent

examples.text: A police superintendent is leading the investigation into the robbery.
examples.translation_cn: 一位警司正在领导这起抢劫案的调查。

senses.meaning_en: a person who manages and maintains a residential building, often collecting rent and handling repairs

examples.text: The building superintendent repaired the broken lock within an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 大楼管理员在一小时内修好了坏锁。

senses.meaning_en: a deep, narrow valley with steep rocky sides, usually with a stream or river running through it

examples.text: The river carved a deep gorge through the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 这条河在山间切割出一条深峡谷。

senses.meaning_en: to eat greedily and too much

examples.text: He gorged himself on chocolate and felt sick afterwards.
examples.translation_cn: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了巧克力，随后感到恶心。

senses.meaning_en: a written note or message used as a reminder or for communication within an organization

examples.text: She sent a memorandum to all staff about the new safety rules.
examples.translation_cn: 她向全体员工发送了一份关于新安全规定的备忘录。

senses.meaning_en: a formal written communication between governments or officials

examples.text: The ambassador delivered a memorandum to the foreign ministry.
examples.translation_cn: 大使向外交部递交了一份照会。

senses.meaning_en: to tell or narrate something in detail

examples.text: She recounted her adventures to a group of eager listeners.
examples.translation_cn: 她向一群热切的听众讲述了自己的冒险经历。

senses.meaning_en: a second count of votes

examples.text: The losing candidate demanded a recount of the ballots.
examples.translation_cn: 落选候选人要求重新清点选票。

senses.meaning_en: to count again, especially votes

examples.text: Officials agreed to recount the ballots after the close result.
examples.translation_cn: 结果接近后，官员们同意重新清点选票。

senses.meaning_en: a narrative or account of events

examples.text: The witness gave a recount of the accident to the police.
examples.translation_cn: 目击者向警方叙述了事故经过。

senses.meaning_en: a strong lamp used to light a small area, especially on a stage

examples.text: The technician pointed the spotlight at the lead singer as she began to sing.
examples.translation_cn: 技术员在主唱开始演唱时将聚光灯对准她。

senses.meaning_en: the center of public attention

examples.text: The new policy is in the spotlight this week.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策本周受到公众关注。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something receive a lot of public attention

examples.text: The report spotlights the need for better training.
examples.translation_cn: 报告突出了加强培训的必要性。

senses.meaning_en: acting independently

examples.text: Teenagers need to be autonomous in making decisions about their future.
examples.translation_cn: 青少年需要在决定自己的未来方面独立自主。

senses.meaning_en: governing itself independently

examples.text: The island is autonomous and has its own parliament.
examples.translation_cn: 该岛自治，并拥有自己的议会。

senses.meaning_en: operating without human control

examples.text: The factory's robots are fully autonomous and require no human supervision.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂的机器人完全自主运行，无需人工监督。

senses.meaning_en: the study of methods in a field

examples.text: The course provides a critical introduction to the methodology of social research.
examples.translation_cn: 该课程对社会科学研究方法论进行批判性介绍。

senses.meaning_en: a set of methods used in a particular field

examples.text: The team adopted a new methodology for testing the software.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队采用了一套测试软件的新方法。

senses.meaning_en: a total score or sum

examples.text: They won the tie 3–2 on aggregate and advanced to the final.
examples.translation_cn: 他们以3–2的总比分赢得比赛并晋级决赛。

senses.meaning_en: a whole formed by combining separate elements

examples.text: Granite is an aggregate of several different minerals.
examples.translation_cn: 花岗岩是几种不同矿物的聚合体。

senses.meaning_en: an official pardon for people who have been convicted of political offences

examples.text: The president declared an amnesty for all political prisoners.
examples.translation_cn: 总统宣布对所有政治犯实行大赦。

senses.meaning_en: to grant amnesty to a person or group

examples.text: The new law will amnesty thousands of undocumented workers.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律将大赦数千名无证工人。

senses.meaning_en: solid particles that settle at the bottom of a liquid or body of water

examples.text: The geologist examined a layer of sediment at the bottom of the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 地质学家检查了湖底的一层沉积物。

senses.meaning_en: to settle or cause particles to settle as sediment

examples.text: The particles gradually sediment out of the solution.
examples.translation_cn: 颗粒逐渐从溶液中沉淀出来。

senses.meaning_en: a device that converts digital signals to analog signals and back, allowing computers to communicate over telephone lines

examples.text: Most home networks connect to the internet via a modem.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数家庭网络通过调制解调器连接互联网。

senses.meaning_en: relating to concepts or ideas

examples.text: The book provides a conceptual framework for understanding social change.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书为理解社会变迁提供了一个概念框架。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or tear down a building

examples.text: The old factory was demolished to make room for a housing estate.
examples.translation_cn: 那座老工厂被拆除，为住宅区腾出空间。

senses.meaning_en: to prove that an idea or argument is completely wrong

examples.text: The new evidence demolished the argument that the economy would recover quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 新证据驳倒了经济会迅速复苏的论点。

senses.meaning_en: to eat something quickly and completely

examples.text: The kids demolished the whole birthday cake in under five minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们不到五分钟就把整个生日蛋糕吃光了。

senses.meaning_en: to defeat somebody completely in a competition or contest

examples.text: The home side demolished the opposition 5-0 to reach the final.
examples.translation_cn: 主队以5比0横扫对手闯入决赛。

senses.meaning_en: making you feel afraid

examples.text: I find the dark forest frightening at night.
examples.translation_cn: 我晚上觉得那片黑暗的森林很可怕。

senses.meaning_en: very bad or unpleasant; used to emphasize how bad something is

examples.text: The report shows a frightening level of pollution in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 报告显示这座城市的污染程度高得令人震惊。

senses.meaning_en: consisting of or full of rocks

examples.text: The soil here is too rocky for growing vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 这里的土壤石头太多，不适合种菜。

senses.meaning_en: unstable; full of difficulties
senses.pattern: get off to a rocky start

examples.text: The new restaurant got off to a rocky start but is now busy.
examples.translation_cn: 这家新餐馆起步艰难，但现在生意很好。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or using magic

examples.text: The wizard used his magical powers to open the locked door.
examples.translation_cn: 巫师用他的魔力打开了锁着的门。

senses.meaning_en: enchanting; very enjoyable or beautiful

examples.text: We spent a magical evening watching the sunset from the hill.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在山上度过了一个迷人的黄昏，看着日落。

senses.meaning_en: producing amazing or seemingly impossible results

examples.text: The new drug has a magical effect on the infection.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药对感染有奇效。

senses.meaning_en: the act of providing funds for a business

examples.text: The startup secured financing for its new product line.
examples.translation_cn: 这家初创公司为其新产品线获得了融资。

senses.meaning_en: an official accusation of a crime; a formal charge

examples.text: A federal grand jury returned an indictment for tax evasion.
examples.translation_cn: 联邦大陪审团提起了逃税罪的公诉。

senses.meaning_en: a sign that a system, society, etc. is very bad or very wrong; a criticism

examples.text: The report is a damning indictment of the government's housing policy.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告是对政府住房政策的严厉控诉。

senses.meaning_en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a person or group

examples.text: The coach tried to boost the team's morale before the final.
examples.translation_cn: 教练在决赛前努力鼓舞球队的士气。

senses.meaning_en: to include or cover completely

examples.text: The syllabus encompasses a wide range of topics, from ancient history to modern economics.
examples.translation_cn: 这份教学大纲涵盖从古代史到现代经济学的广泛主题。

senses.meaning_en: to surround or encircle

examples.text: The medieval castle is encompassed by massive stone walls.
examples.translation_cn: 这座中世纪城堡被巨大的石墙环绕着。

examples.text: The company was run by a tight-knit clan of former colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 那家公司由一帮关系紧密的前同事把持。

examples.text: She belongs to a clan that has lived in the Scottish Highlands for centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 她属于一个在苏格兰高地生活了数世纪的氏族。

examples.text: He joined an online gaming clan and they now compete together every weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他加入了一个网络游戏公会，现在他们每个周末一起比赛。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of managing relations between countries

examples.text: The two countries resolved the conflict through diplomacy.
examples.translation_cn: 两国通过外交手段解决了这场冲突。

senses.meaning_en: tact and skill in dealing with people

examples.text: She handled the awkward question with great diplomacy.
examples.translation_cn: 她十分圆滑地处理了这个尴尬的问题。

senses.meaning_en: a period of 1,000 years

examples.text: This ancient custom has survived for over a millennium.
examples.translation_cn: 这一古老习俗已延续了一千多年。

senses.meaning_en: the year 2000 or the time when a new millennium begins
senses.pattern: at the turn of the millennium

examples.text: The city hosted a huge fireworks display at the turn of the millennium.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市在千禧年之交举办了盛大的烟花表演。

senses.meaning_en: a future age of peace and happiness

examples.text: Some reformers dreamed of ushering in a millennium of peace.
examples.translation_cn: 一些改革者梦想开创一个和平的太平盛世。

senses.meaning_en: closeness and openness in a relationship

examples.text: There was a growing intimacy between them after months of working together.
examples.translation_cn: 一起工作几个月后，他们之间越来越亲密。

senses.meaning_en: a sexual relationship

examples.text: They had not had physical intimacy with each other for a long time.
examples.translation_cn: 他们很长时间没有肌肤之亲了。

senses.meaning_en: a private or secret detail

examples.text: The novel explores the intimacies of married life.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说探讨了婚姻生活的私密细节。

senses.meaning_en: pots, dishes, etc. made from clay

examples.text: The archaeologists found a piece of pottery dating back to the Bronze Age.
examples.translation_cn: 考古学家发现了一件可追溯到青铜时代的陶器。

senses.meaning_en: a place where pots, dishes, etc. are made

examples.text: We spent the afternoon at a working pottery in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在乡下一家仍在生产的陶器作坊待了一下午。

senses.meaning_en: the craft or art of making objects from clay

examples.text: My sister is learning pottery at a local art school.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐正在当地一所艺术学校学习制陶。

senses.meaning_en: to hang or swing loosely; to let something hang or swing loosely

examples.text: A rope ladder dangled from the helicopter, swaying in the wind.
examples.translation_cn: 绳梯从直升机上垂下，在风中晃动。

senses.meaning_en: to offer something as an incentive or temptation, especially to persuade someone to do something
senses.pattern: dangle something before/in front of someone
senses.collocation: dangle a reward in front of someone

examples.text: The company dangled a promotion in front of her to get her to stay.
examples.translation_cn: 公司用晋升的前景诱惑她留下来。

senses.meaning_en: a safe place, especially for people in danger

examples.text: The small island became a haven for refugees fleeing the war.
examples.translation_cn: 这座小岛成了逃避战争的难民的避难所。

senses.meaning_en: a peaceful or quiet place

examples.text: The garden is a haven of peace in the busy city.
examples.translation_cn: 在繁忙的城市里，这座花园是一处宁静的港湾。

senses.meaning_en: in a state of competition, often without intending to

examples.text: The store sells several competing brands of running shoes.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店销售几个相互竞争的跑鞋品牌。

senses.meaning_en: conflicting or incompatible; unable to both be true or valid

examples.text: The two witnesses gave competing accounts of the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 两名目击者对撞车事故给出了相互矛盾的说法。

senses.meaning_en: the act of packing something

examples.text: The packaging of the products takes place in a separate room.
examples.translation_cn: 产品的包装在单独的房间进行。

senses.meaning_en: the materials used to pack something

examples.text: The packaging for the tablets is made from recycled paper.
examples.translation_cn: 这些药片的包装是用再生纸制成的。

senses.meaning_en: the industry that produces packaging material

examples.text: He has worked in the packaging industry for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在包装业工作了二十多年。

senses.meaning_en: the manner in which a person or product is promoted
senses.pattern: the packaging of sb as sth

examples.text: The packaging of the candidate as an outsider proved highly effective.
examples.translation_cn: 将这位候选人包装成局外人非常有效。

senses.meaning_en: darkness or dimness

examples.text: We could barely make out the road in the gloom.
examples.translation_cn: 在昏暗中我们几乎看不清路。

senses.meaning_en: a sad or depressed mood

examples.text: The sudden resignation cast a gloom over the office.
examples.translation_cn: 突然的辞职给办公室蒙上了一层忧郁的气氛。

senses.meaning_en: able to be predicted

examples.text: The outcome was predictable from the early data.
examples.translation_cn: 结果从早期数据就可以预测。

senses.meaning_en: not interesting because expected; lacking originality

examples.text: The ending was predictable, so the film felt dull.
examples.translation_cn: 结尾不出所料，所以电影显得乏味。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been removed

examples.text: The fire left a sticky residue of soot on the kitchen walls.
examples.translation_cn: 火在厨房墙壁上留下了一层黏腻的烟灰残留物。

senses.meaning_en: a person who supports or advocates something

examples.text: She is a leading proponent of renewable energy.
examples.translation_cn: 她是可再生能源的主要倡导者。

senses.meaning_en: wide, broad, affecting many things

examples.text: The government made sweeping changes to the tax system.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对税收制度进行了全面改革。

senses.meaning_en: too general and ignoring differences

examples.text: That is a sweeping statement that ignores regional differences.
examples.translation_cn: 那是一个忽视地区差异的笼统说法。

senses.meaning_en: completely overwhelming

examples.text: The party won a sweeping victory in the election.
examples.translation_cn: 该党在选举中取得了压倒性胜利。

senses.meaning_en: the re-establishment of friendly relations

examples.text: The two communities finally achieved reconciliation after years of conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 两个社区经过多年冲突后终于达成和解。

senses.meaning_en: the process of comparing and resolving differences between accounting records

examples.text: The accountant performed a reconciliation of the bank statements.
examples.translation_cn: 会计对银行对账单进行了核对。

senses.meaning_en: the process of making different ideas, beliefs, or situations exist together without conflict
senses.pattern: the reconciliation of A with B

examples.text: Her work explores the reconciliation of modern life with traditional values.
examples.translation_cn: 她的作品探讨现代生活与传统价值观的调和。

senses.meaning_en: protective covering worn or carried to defend the body, including natural coverings on animals

examples.text: The soldiers advanced across the field in full armor.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们穿着全副盔甲穿过战场。

senses.meaning_en: metal plating protecting a ship, military vehicle, or aircraft; to fit with such plating

examples.text: The warship was armored with thick steel plates.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘军舰装有厚厚的钢制装甲。

senses.meaning_en: a hard substance made from the skeletons of tiny sea animals

examples.text: This necklace is made of coral from the Mediterranean.
examples.translation_cn: 这条项链是用地中海珊瑚制成的。

senses.meaning_en: a pinkish-orange colour

examples.text: She wore a silk dress in coral at the party.
examples.translation_cn: 她在聚会上穿了一件珊瑚色的丝绸连衣裙。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or consisting of cells

examples.text: The new therapy attacks cancer at the cellular level.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新疗法在细胞层面攻击癌症。

senses.meaning_en: (of fabric) loosely woven with small holes

examples.text: These hospital gowns are made of cellular fabric.
examples.translation_cn: 这些医院病号服由蜂窝式织物制成。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a cellular network or mobile phone system

examples.text: The message was sent over a cellular network.
examples.translation_cn: 这条消息是通过蜂窝网络发送的。

senses.meaning_en: the process of gradually increasing in amount

examples.text: The accumulation of evidence in the case took several months.
examples.translation_cn: 这个案子的证据积累花了几个月。

senses.meaning_en: a mass or quantity of something that has accumulated

examples.text: An accumulation of dust covered the old wooden furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 一层积尘覆盖着旧木家具。

senses.meaning_en: a suitable position or role

examples.text: She finally found her niche as a science teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于找到了自己作为科学教师的合适位置。

senses.meaning_en: appealing to a small, specialized group

examples.text: The magazine appeals to a niche audience interested in modern art.
examples.translation_cn: 这本杂志吸引了对现代艺术感兴趣的小众读者。

senses.meaning_en: the role of an organism in its ecosystem

examples.text: These birds occupy a unique ecological niche in the rainforest.
examples.translation_cn: 这些鸟在雨林中占据着独特的生态位。

senses.meaning_en: a recess in a wall for a statue or ornament

examples.text: The small statue stood in a niche above the door.
examples.translation_cn: 小雕像立在门上方的一个壁龛里。

senses.meaning_en: to emphasize or draw attention to

examples.text: The report underscores the importance of early detection.
examples.translation_cn: 报告强调了及早发现的重要性。

senses.meaning_en: a line drawn or printed beneath text; the character _

examples.text: Use an underscore to separate words in file names.
examples.translation_cn: 在文件名中，用下划线分隔单词。

senses.meaning_en: pale and sickly-looking

examples.text: She looks wan from working night shifts for a month.
examples.translation_cn: 她因为上了一个月夜班而面色苍白。

senses.meaning_en: dim and faint
senses.pattern: by the wan light of sth

examples.text: She read by the wan light of a single candle.
examples.translation_cn: 她借着一支蜡烛的微弱光线读书。

senses.meaning_en: connected with reproduction

examples.text: The reproductive system of birds is very different from that of mammals.
examples.translation_cn: 鸟类的生殖系统与哺乳动物的截然不同。

senses.meaning_en: capable of reproducing

examples.text: The clinic offers free health checks for women of reproductive age.
examples.translation_cn: 这家诊所为育龄妇女提供免费健康检查。

senses.meaning_en: a solid or surface with a circular base and a point at the top

examples.text: The students calculated the volume of a cone using the formula.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们用公式计算了圆锥体的体积。

senses.meaning_en: anything shaped like a cone, such as a traffic cone or an ice-cream cone

examples.text: The workers placed orange traffic cones around the hole.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们在坑周围放置了橙色交通锥。

senses.meaning_en: the dry fruit of a pine or fir tree

examples.text: He threw a pine cone into the fire and watched it burn.
examples.translation_cn: 他把一个松果扔进火里，看着它燃烧。

senses.meaning_en: the process of reaching or achieving something through effort

examples.text: The attainment of peace required years of patient negotiation.
examples.translation_cn: 实现和平需要多年的耐心谈判。

senses.meaning_en: an achievement, especially a skill or piece of knowledge

examples.text: Her attainments in mathematics earned her a scholarship.
examples.translation_cn: 她在数学上的造诣为她赢得了奖学金。

senses.meaning_en: dealing with real, important or serious matters; having practical importance

examples.text: The committee held substantive discussions about the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会就新政策进行了实质性的讨论。

senses.meaning_en: the clear liquid part of the blood

examples.text: The hospital keeps a supply of blood plasma for emergency transfusions.
examples.translation_cn: 医院储备血浆用于紧急输血。

senses.meaning_en: a state of matter made of charged particles

examples.text: At extremely high temperatures, the gas turns into plasma.
examples.translation_cn: 在极高温下，气体变成等离子体。

senses.meaning_en: a protein on a cell wall that binds with specific molecules

examples.text: The receptor for insulin is located on the surface of muscle and fat cells.
examples.translation_cn: 胰岛素受体位于肌肉和脂肪细胞表面。

senses.meaning_en: a cell or structure that responds to sensory stimuli

examples.text: Sensory receptors in the skin respond to touch, heat, and pain.
examples.translation_cn: 皮肤中的感受器对触觉、热和疼痛作出反应。

senses.meaning_en: a transparent tank for keeping live fish and other water animals

examples.text: We keep tropical fish in an aquarium in the living room.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在客厅的一个鱼缸里养热带鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a public building where live fish and other water animals are exhibited

examples.text: The children watched the sharks at the aquarium yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们昨天在水族馆看了鲨鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to produce and release a liquid substance from cells or glands

examples.text: The pancreas secretes insulin into the bloodstream to control blood sugar.
examples.translation_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素到血液中以控制血糖。

senses.meaning_en: to hide something or put it in a secret place

examples.text: She secreted the spare key behind the clock.
examples.translation_cn: 她把备用钥匙藏在钟后面。

senses.meaning_en: a substance produced and released by an organism

examples.text: The wound produced a yellowish secretion from the infected area.
examples.translation_cn: 伤口从感染区域渗出淡黄色分泌物。

senses.meaning_en: the process of producing and releasing a substance

examples.text: The secretion of insulin is regulated by blood glucose levels.
examples.translation_cn: 胰岛素的分泌受血糖水平调节。

senses.meaning_en: existing or happening after a war, especially World War II

examples.text: Many European countries faced housing shortages in the postwar period.
examples.translation_cn: 许多欧洲国家在战后时期面临住房短缺。

senses.meaning_en: connected with recreation

examples.text: The lake is used mainly for recreational purposes.
examples.translation_cn: 这个湖主要用于休闲目的。

senses.meaning_en: having attained a high level of education

examples.text: She is well educated and speaks three languages.
examples.translation_cn: 她受过良好教育，会说三种语言。

senses.meaning_en: based on relevant information

examples.text: Analysts made an educated guess about next year's sales.
examples.translation_cn: 分析员对明年的销售做出了有根据的推测。

senses.meaning_en: to return to a previous state, practice, or topic

examples.text: After the fever, her appetite reverted to normal.
examples.translation_cn: 退烧后，她的胃口恢复了正常。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to return to a former condition or to reverse a change

examples.text: Please revert the changes before the next release.
examples.translation_cn: 请在下一个版本发布前撤销这些更改。

senses.meaning_en: a public building housing courts of law

examples.text: The jury gathered at the courthouse early this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 陪审团今天一早在法院集合。

senses.meaning_en: to cut with a sharp blade using a sweeping stroke

examples.text: He slashed the rope with a sharp knife.
examples.translation_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀砍绳子。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce something by a large amount

examples.text: The company slashed its marketing budget by half.
examples.translation_cn: 公司将营销预算削减了一半。

senses.meaning_en: a diagonal slash mark (/) used to separate alternatives
senses.pattern: a slash between A and B

examples.text: Write “and/or” with a slash between the two words.
examples.translation_cn: 写“and/or”时在两个词之间加上斜线号。

senses.meaning_en: a long, deep cut made by a sharp blade

examples.text: The slash across his cheek left a scar.
examples.translation_cn: 他脸颊上的刀痕留下了一道疤。

senses.meaning_en: a slashing action or motion

examples.text: With a slash of his knife, he opened the box.
examples.translation_cn: 他用刀一挥，打开了箱子。

senses.meaning_en: to an unusual or remarkable degree; extremely

examples.text: She is exceptionally talented at drawing realistic portraits.
examples.translation_cn: 她非常擅长画逼真的肖像。

senses.meaning_en: only in unusual circumstances; as an exception

examples.text: The museum is open only exceptionally on Sundays, usually for special events.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆仅在特殊情况下周日开放，通常是为特别活动。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being urgent; pressing importance

examples.text: The urgency of the situation required immediate action.
examples.translation_cn: 形势紧迫，需要立即采取行动。

senses.meaning_en: insistence, pressure, or urge

examples.text: She spoke with urgency about the need for immediate action.
examples.translation_cn: 她急切地谈到了立即采取行动的必要性。

senses.meaning_en: a person who manages or organizes a museum collection or exhibition

examples.text: She works as a curator at the British Museum.
examples.translation_cn: 她在大英博物馆担任策展人。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent something from happening

examples.text: The new security measures are designed to deter attacks.
examples.translation_cn: 新的安全措施旨在防止袭击。

senses.meaning_en: to discourage someone from doing something

examples.text: The high cost did not deter her from applying to college.
examples.translation_cn: 高昂的费用并没有阻止她申请大学。

senses.meaning_en: a place of safety or refuge

examples.text: The refugees sought sanctuary in an abandoned monastery after fleeing the war.
examples.translation_cn: 难民们在逃离战争后，在一座废弃的修道院寻求庇护。

senses.meaning_en: a protected area for animals or plants

examples.text: The island was declared a sanctuary for endangered seabirds.
examples.translation_cn: 这座岛被宣布为濒危海鸟的保护区。

senses.meaning_en: the right to be protected from danger or arrest

examples.text: The journalist was granted sanctuary in Sweden last year.
examples.translation_cn: 这名记者去年在瑞典获得了庇护权。

senses.meaning_en: the sacred area around an altar in a church or temple

examples.text: The choir sang in the sanctuary during the service.
examples.translation_cn: 唱诗班在礼拜期间于圣所内歌唱。

senses.meaning_en: causing great surprise or wonder; amazing

examples.text: It is astonishing that she finished the project so quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 她如此迅速地完成这个项目，令人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: cautious about possible dangers or problems

examples.text: You should be wary of emails that ask for your password.
examples.translation_cn: 对索要密码的邮件要保持警惕。

senses.meaning_en: not completely trusting or certain about someone or something

examples.text: Investors are wary of promises that seem too good to be true.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者对好得令人难以置信的承诺持怀疑态度。

senses.meaning_en: full; unable to hold or contain any more

examples.text: The local market is saturated with similar products.
examples.translation_cn: 当地市场充斥着类似产品。

senses.meaning_en: containing all the solute that can normally be dissolved at a given temperature

examples.text: The chemist prepared a saturated solution of sodium chloride.
examples.translation_cn: 化学家配制了氯化钠饱和溶液。

senses.meaning_en: soaked or drenched with moisture

examples.text: My shoes were completely saturated with water after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨后我的鞋子完全湿透了。

senses.meaning_en: having a high level of color saturation

examples.text: The artist used highly saturated colors in the painting.
examples.translation_cn: 画家在画中使用了高饱和度的颜色。

senses.meaning_en: worth remembering or easy to remember, especially because it is special or unusual

examples.text: The ceremony was memorable for its moving speeches.
examples.translation_cn: 仪式因其感人的演讲而令人难忘。

senses.meaning_en: causing shock or outrage

examples.text: Many viewers found the violent scenes genuinely shocking.
examples.translation_cn: 许多观众觉得这些暴力场面确实令人震惊。

senses.meaning_en: extremely bad

examples.text: The roads were in a shocking state after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴雨过后，道路状况极差。

senses.meaning_en: obscene or indecent

examples.text: The comedian's act was full of shocking language.
examples.translation_cn: 那位喜剧演员的表演充满下流语言。

senses.meaning_en: in opposition; contradictory

examples.text: Police received conflicting reports about what had happened.
examples.translation_cn: 警方收到了关于所发生事情的相互矛盾的报道。

senses.meaning_en: incompatible; unable to be met at once

examples.text: Working parents often face conflicting demands on their time.
examples.translation_cn: 职场父母常常面临难以同时满足的时间要求。

senses.meaning_en: a routine task, especially for keeping a house clean or organised

examples.text: The children do chores after school every day.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们每天放学后做家务。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult or unpleasant task that you have to do

examples.text: Filling out tax forms is a real chore.
examples.translation_cn: 填写纳税申报表真是件苦差事。

senses.meaning_en: a trainee, especially in a skilled trade

examples.text: He is an apprentice to a master carpenter.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一位木匠大师的学徒。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is just learning something

examples.text: He is an apprentice in the art of negotiation.
examples.translation_cn: 他在谈判艺术上是个初学者。

senses.meaning_en: to be an apprentice to

examples.text: She was apprenticed to a master tailor at sixteen.
examples.translation_cn: 她十六岁时师从一位裁缝大师当学徒。

senses.meaning_en: a person who owns a business, especially a hotel, store, or land

examples.text: The proprietor of the hotel personally welcomed every guest.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店的老板亲自欢迎每位客人。

senses.meaning_en: unfair treatment; lack of fairness

examples.text: The injustice of the situation was obvious to everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 这种不公正的局面人人一看便知。

senses.meaning_en: an unfair act, especially a violation of someone's rights

examples.text: He suffered an injustice when he was falsely accused of lying.
examples.translation_cn: 他被诬告撒谎，蒙受了不公。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow place in a hard surface, usually caused by a blow

examples.text: The falling rock left a dent in the roof.
examples.translation_cn: 落石在屋顶上留下了一个凹痕。

senses.meaning_en: a reduction or noticeable negative effect

examples.text: The tax increase made a dent in our savings.
examples.translation_cn: 增税使我们的积蓄减少了不少。

senses.meaning_en: to make a dent in something

examples.text: The hail dented the roof of my car.
examples.translation_cn: 冰雹把我汽车的车顶砸出了凹痕。

senses.meaning_en: to develop a dent or dents

examples.text: The soft metal dents easily if you press it.
examples.translation_cn: 这种软金属一按就凹陷。

senses.meaning_en: the act of depriving someone of something

examples.text: The court ruled that the deprivation of liberty was unlawful.
examples.translation_cn: 法院裁定剥夺自由是非法的。

senses.meaning_en: the state of not having basic things

examples.text: After the war, many people suffered from severe deprivation.
examples.translation_cn: 战后，许多人遭受了严重的贫困。

senses.meaning_en: an omission; something left out or forgotten

examples.text: Due to an oversight, her name was left off the list.
examples.translation_cn: 由于疏忽，名单上漏掉了她的名字。

senses.meaning_en: supervision or management

examples.text: The committee has oversight of all government contracts.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会对全部政府合同有监督权。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to control your movements smoothly and skillfully

examples.text: Professional tennis players must have excellent hand-eye coordination.
examples.translation_cn: 职业网球运动员必须具备出色的手眼协调能力。

senses.meaning_en: the act of organizing people or things so that they work together effectively

examples.text: Close coordination between departments is essential for a smooth launch.
examples.translation_cn: 部门之间的密切配合对于顺利推出至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: shocking and unacceptable

examples.text: It is outrageous that he was fired for telling the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 他因说真话而被解雇，这太令人震惊了。

senses.meaning_en: very unusual and slightly shocking

examples.text: She looked outrageous in a bright green wig.
examples.translation_cn: 她戴着一顶亮绿色假发，看上去很古怪。

senses.meaning_en: extreme or excessive

examples.text: They charged an outrageous amount for a small glass of juice.
examples.translation_cn: 一小杯果汁他们竟要价高得离谱。

senses.meaning_en: a soft green or black growth that appears on old food or damp surfaces

examples.text: The bread was covered in mold and smelled sour.
examples.translation_cn: 面包上长满了霉菌，闻起来发酸。

senses.meaning_en: a hollow container used to give shape to liquid or soft material

examples.text: The workers poured hot metal into a mold to make engine parts.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们把热金属倒入模具中制造发动机零件。

senses.meaning_en: to shape a soft substance into a particular form

examples.text: She molded the clay into a small bowl with her hands.
examples.translation_cn: 她用双手把黏土捏成一个小碗。

senses.meaning_en: a model or frame used to shape something

examples.text: The dentist made a mold of my teeth to create a mouthguard.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医给我的牙齿做了模型，用来制作牙套。

senses.meaning_en: to influence the formation or development of someone or something

examples.text: Her character was molded by years of hardship.
examples.translation_cn: 她的性格是多年困苦造就的。

senses.meaning_en: an inclined surface connecting two levels

examples.text: They built a ramp to the entrance for wheelchair users.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为轮椅使用者修建了一个通往入口的坡道。

senses.meaning_en: a road connecting a freeway to another road

examples.text: Take the ramp onto Highway 5 and stay in the right lane.
examples.translation_cn: 从匝道驶入5号公路，并保持在右车道。

senses.meaning_en: to increase something or make it more intense, often gradually

examples.text: The factory will ramp up production to meet demand.
examples.translation_cn: 该工厂将提高产量以满足需求。

senses.meaning_en: a mobile staircase attached to an aircraft

examples.text: Passengers walked down the ramp from the plane to the tarmac.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客们沿舷梯从飞机走到停机坪。

senses.meaning_en: a practical attitude of accepting reality as it is

examples.text: We must face the current crisis with realism.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须以现实态度面对当前的危机。

senses.meaning_en: an artistic style that represents reality as it is

examples.text: His early works are rooted in 19th-century realism.
examples.translation_cn: 他早期的作品植根于19世纪的现实主义。

senses.meaning_en: the act or state of continuing

examples.text: The continuation of the peace talks offers hope for the region.
examples.translation_cn: 和平谈判的继续给该地区带来希望。

senses.meaning_en: something that continues or adds to something else

examples.text: The new series is a continuation of the original story.
examples.translation_cn: 这部新系列是原故事的续篇。

senses.meaning_en: a thick flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or wood

examples.text: A thick slab of concrete formed the base of the statue.
examples.translation_cn: 一块厚混凝土板构成了雕像的底座。

senses.meaning_en: a very large rock

examples.text: A huge boulder in the road blocked the traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 路上的一块巨石挡住了交通。

senses.meaning_en: the winner in a fight or contest

examples.text: The victor in the contest received a gold medal.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛的获胜者获得了一枚金牌。

senses.meaning_en: continuing for a long time without interruption

examples.text: The region saw a sustained period of political stability.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区经历了一段持续的政治稳定时期。

senses.meaning_en: relating to a season or changing with the seasons

examples.text: Retailers often notice a seasonal variation in customer spending.
examples.translation_cn: 零售商经常注意到顾客消费的季节性变化。

senses.meaning_en: suitable for or available during a particular season

examples.text: The restaurant's menu features seasonal produce from local farms.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅的菜单主打当地农场的时令农产品。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of becoming visible or clear

examples.text: The manifestation of the northern lights depends on solar activity.
examples.translation_cn: 北极光的显现取决于太阳活动。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that embodies or shows something intangible

examples.text: The gift was a manifestation of his gratitude.
examples.translation_cn: 这份礼物是他感激之情的体现。

senses.meaning_en: a symptom or observable sign of a disease

examples.text: Fever is a common manifestation of the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 发烧是这种疾病的常见症状。

senses.meaning_en: causing death; deadly

examples.text: The venom is lethal to mice within minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 这种毒液在几分钟内就能使老鼠致死。

senses.meaning_en: extremely harmful or destructive

examples.text: The scandal dealt a lethal blow to his career.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻给他的职业生涯造成了毁灭性打击。

senses.meaning_en: to fall heavily and suddenly, as from exhaustion or weakness

examples.text: After running the marathon, she slumped to the ground in exhaustion.
examples.translation_cn: 跑完马拉松后，她累得瘫倒在地上。

senses.meaning_en: to fall suddenly and by a large amount, especially in value or amount

examples.text: The company's profits slumped by 20 percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司去年的利润暴跌了20%。

senses.meaning_en: to sit or stand with the shoulders bent forward, often because of tiredness or sadness

examples.text: She slumped in her chair after hearing the bad news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到坏消息后，她瘫坐在椅子上。

senses.meaning_en: a period when the economy or a particular industry is doing badly

examples.text: The construction industry is in a severe slump.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑业正处于严重的衰退期。

senses.meaning_en: a natural liking or attraction to a person or thing

examples.text: She has a natural affinity for languages and music.
examples.translation_cn: 她对语言和音乐有天然的喜爱。

senses.meaning_en: a close relationship or similarity between things

examples.text: There is a close affinity between the two languages.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种语言之间有密切的相似性。

senses.meaning_en: a relationship by marriage rather than blood

examples.text: A step-parent is related to the child by affinity, not by blood.
examples.translation_cn: 继父母与孩子是因婚姻而成为亲属，而非血缘关系。

senses.meaning_en: having reliance on somebody or something

examples.text: The region is heavily reliant on imported oil.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区严重依赖进口石油。

senses.meaning_en: a small rocky body that orbits a star

examples.text: Most asteroids orbit the Sun in the asteroid belt.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数小行星在小行星带中绕太阳运行。

senses.meaning_en: left alone and no longer wanted, used, or cared for

examples.text: The farmhouse was left abandoned after the owners moved away.
examples.translation_cn: 主人搬走后，那座农舍就被遗弃了。

senses.meaning_en: given up to vice; immoral

examples.text: The young man was abandoned to vice and spent every night in the casino.
examples.translation_cn: 那个年轻人沉溺于恶习，每晚都在赌场度过。

senses.meaning_en: free from constraint; uninhibited

examples.text: The crowd sang with abandoned joy when the team won the final.
examples.translation_cn: 球队赢得决赛时，人群无拘无束地欢唱。

senses.meaning_en: the act of providing approval and support; backing

examples.text: The museum was built under the patronage of a wealthy industrialist.
examples.translation_cn: 这座博物馆是在一位富有实业家的赞助下建成的。

senses.meaning_en: customers collectively; business; the act of being a customer

examples.text: The airline thanked its frequent flyers for their patronage with bonus miles.
examples.translation_cn: 该航空公司用奖励里程感谢常旅客的惠顾。

senses.meaning_en: the power to give someone an important job or position as a reward for their support

examples.text: He secured the government post through political patronage rather than merit.
examples.translation_cn: 他靠政治任命权而不是靠能力获得了这个政府职位。

senses.meaning_en: the act of expecting something to happen

examples.text: The airport hired extra staff in anticipation of a busy holiday season.
examples.translation_cn: 机场预计假期会很繁忙，因此增雇了人手。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of excitement about something pleasant that is going to happen

examples.text: The children waited with anticipation for the show to begin.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们满怀期待地等待演出开始。

senses.meaning_en: making you feel annoyed or discouraged because you cannot achieve what you want
senses.pattern: It is frustrating to do sth

examples.text: It is frustrating to wait for a reply that never comes.
examples.translation_cn: 等待一个永远不会来的回复令人沮丧。

senses.meaning_en: to show or introduce something for the first time

examples.text: The company will unveil its latest electric car to the public tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司将于明天向公众推出其最新款电动汽车。

senses.meaning_en: to reveal something hidden or secret

examples.text: The documentary unveiled the truth about the factory's safety record.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片揭露了该工厂安全记录方面的真相。

senses.meaning_en: to remove a cover from something as part of a ceremony

examples.text: The mayor unveiled a plaque at the ceremony in memory of the victims.
examples.translation_cn: 在仪式上，市长为一块纪念遇难者的牌匾揭幕。

senses.meaning_en: to become visible or reveal oneself

examples.text: The truth slowly unveiled before the public during the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 审判期间真相在公众面前逐渐显露。

senses.meaning_en: a written copy of words that were spoken

examples.text: The lawyer read from a transcript of the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 律师读了采访的文字记录。

senses.meaning_en: an official record of the courses a student has taken and the grades they received

examples.text: Your final grades will appear on your official transcript.
examples.translation_cn: 你的最终成绩会出现在你的官方成绩单上。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone the official power or legal right to do something

examples.text: The new law empowers the board to set safety standards.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律授权委员会制定安全标准。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone more confidence and control over their own life or situation

examples.text: The course helps women feel empowered to start their own businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程帮助女性更有信心自主创业。

senses.meaning_en: a large sea crustacean with a hard shell and claws, or a similar crustacean, used as seafood and turning red when cooked

examples.text: They had lobster for dinner at a seaside restaurant last night.
examples.translation_cn: 他们昨晚在海边餐厅吃了龙虾。

senses.meaning_en: to fish for lobsters

examples.text: He goes lobstering with his uncle every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 每年夏天他和叔叔一起去捕龙虾。

senses.meaning_en: red-colored, especially from a sunburn

examples.text: After hours in the sun, his neck went lobster red.
examples.translation_cn: 在太阳下晒了几个小时后，他的脖子变得通红。

senses.meaning_en: continuing to exist or have an effect for a long time

examples.text: The training had a lasting effect on her confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 这次培训对她的信心产生了持久的影响。

senses.meaning_en: a fervent supporter or proponent of a party, cause, faction, person, or idea

examples.text: She is a staunch partisan of educational reform.
examples.translation_cn: 她是教育改革的坚定支持者。

senses.meaning_en: a member of an irregular military force operating behind enemy lines; a guerrilla fighter

examples.text: He fought as a partisan behind enemy lines during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间他在敌后当游击队员作战。

senses.meaning_en: devoted to or biased in support of a party, group, or cause

examples.text: The judge was criticized for being partisan during the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 法官因在审判中偏袒而受到批评。

senses.meaning_en: confining or limiting within defined bounds

examples.text: The new import rules are too restrictive for small producers and local trade.
examples.translation_cn: 新的进口规则对小生产者和本地贸易限制过多。

senses.meaning_en: limiting free and easy bodily movement

examples.text: The cast on his arm felt restrictive when he tried to write.
examples.translation_cn: 他试着写字时，手臂上的石膏让他感到活动受限。

senses.meaning_en: a clause that restricts the meaning of a noun or noun phrase

examples.text: A restrictive clause is necessary to identify the specific noun you mean.
examples.translation_cn: 限定性从句对明确你所指的具体名词是必要的。

senses.meaning_en: the study of the past by excavation and analysis of material remains

examples.text: A career in archaeology requires patience and careful excavation skills.
examples.translation_cn: 考古学职业需要耐心和细致的发掘技能。

senses.meaning_en: relating to archaeology

examples.text: The team discovered an archaeological site during road construction.
examples.translation_cn: 在道路施工期间，该团队发现了一处考古遗址。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of speech with one vowel sound and usually one or more consonants

examples.text: The teacher asked the class to break the word into syllables.
examples.translation_cn: 老师让全班把这个词划分成音节。

senses.meaning_en: a word or part of a word; a single sound, especially in negative contexts

examples.text: He didn't utter a syllable about the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 他对这个计划只字未提。

senses.meaning_en: a group of organizations, companies, or investors formed to work together on a large project

examples.text: A consortium of companies was formed to build the new airport terminal.
examples.translation_cn: 一个企业联合体为建造新机场航站楼而成立。

senses.meaning_en: to lower the body by bending the legs

examples.text: The athlete crouched down at the starting line.
examples.translation_cn: 运动员在起跑线上蹲下。

senses.meaning_en: a low position with the legs bent

examples.text: The sprinter waited in a crouch for the starting signal.
examples.translation_cn: 短跑运动员以蹲姿等待起跑信号。

senses.meaning_en: a state of balance or equilibrium

examples.text: The tower remained in a state of poise despite the strong wind.
examples.translation_cn: 那座塔在强风中保持平衡。

senses.meaning_en: composure and self-possession

examples.text: She answered the journalist's questions with great poise.
examples.translation_cn: 她极其镇定地回答了记者的提问。

senses.meaning_en: graceful and controlled bearing or deportment

examples.text: She moved with the poise of a trained dancer.
examples.translation_cn: 她动作中带有训练有素舞者的仪态。

senses.meaning_en: to hold balanced and ready; to be ready to act

examples.text: The cat was poised to pounce on the mouse.
examples.translation_cn: 猫蓄势待发，准备扑向老鼠。

senses.meaning_en: made at home rather than bought from a shop

examples.text: She served us a jar of homemade strawberry jam.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我们端上了一罐自制草莓酱。

senses.meaning_en: to make a hole or tunnel in the ground

examples.text: They will excavate a long tunnel through the hill.
examples.translation_cn: 他们将在山中开凿一条长隧道。

senses.meaning_en: to remove soil or rock by digging

examples.text: The workers excavated tons of soil from the old riverbed.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们从旧河床中挖出了大量泥土。

senses.meaning_en: to uncover buried objects or remains by digging

examples.text: The archaeologists are excavating a site near the ancient city wall.
examples.translation_cn: 考古学家们正在古城墙附近发掘一处遗址。

senses.meaning_en: the act of digging, especially for archaeological purposes, or something uncovered by such digging

examples.text: The archaeological excavation of the Roman villa uncovered several mosaics.
examples.translation_cn: 对这座罗马别墅的考古发掘出土了几幅马赛克。

senses.meaning_en: a hole or cavity made by digging

examples.text: The deep excavation for the new hotel was fenced off to prevent accidents.
examples.translation_cn: 为新酒店挖的深基坑被围起来以防止事故。

senses.meaning_en: an organism in its early stages of development before birth or hatching

examples.text: A human embryo develops into a fetus after about eight weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 人类胚胎大约八周后发育成胎儿。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning or early stage of something

examples.text: The plan was still in embryo when the company collapsed.
examples.translation_cn: 公司倒闭时，该计划仍处于萌芽阶段。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to produce a desired effect

examples.text: The efficacy of the new drug was proven in a large trial.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新药的效力在一项大型试验中得到了证实。

senses.meaning_en: a change in the genetic material of an organism

examples.text: A single mutation in this gene can cause the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 这个基因中的单一突变就可能引发这种疾病。

senses.meaning_en: the process of changing from one form or state to another

examples.text: The story underwent a slow mutation from comedy to tragedy.
examples.translation_cn: 这个故事经历了一场从喜剧到悲剧的缓慢转变。

senses.meaning_en: powerful and influential; effective

examples.text: Social media is a potent tool for political campaigns.
examples.translation_cn: 社交媒体是政治竞选活动的强大工具。

senses.meaning_en: having a strong effect (of a drug or chemical)

examples.text: The new antibiotic is potent against most bacteria.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新抗生素对大多数细菌都很有效。

senses.meaning_en: strong and persuasive (of an argument, reason, influence, etc.)

examples.text: The rising prices provide a potent argument for higher wages.
examples.translation_cn: 物价上涨为加薪提供了有力的理由。

senses.meaning_en: the home of a wild animal, especially a cave

examples.text: The bear slept in a den all winter.
examples.translation_cn: 那只熊整个冬天都睡在洞穴里。

senses.meaning_en: a comfortable room in a house, used for relaxing or studying

examples.text: He likes to read in his den after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在书房里读书。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people meet secretly, especially for illegal or immoral activities

examples.text: The basement became a den of gambling and drug dealing.
examples.translation_cn: 那个地下室成了赌博和贩毒的窝点。

senses.meaning_en: a group of Cub Scouts of the same age

examples.text: My son joined a den in the local Cub Scout pack.
examples.translation_cn: 我儿子加入了当地幼童军小队。

senses.meaning_en: a formal promise that something is true or will happen, especially in a sale

examples.text: The seller gave a warranty that the car had never been in an accident.
examples.translation_cn: 卖方保证这辆车从未出过事故。

senses.meaning_en: a written guarantee to repair or replace a product within a fixed period

examples.text: The laptop is still under warranty, so the repair is free.
examples.translation_cn: 这台笔记本电脑仍在保修期内，因此维修免费。

senses.meaning_en: learning through repeated association of stimulus and response

examples.text: Many phobias are learned through conditioning in early life.
examples.translation_cn: 许多恐惧症在早年通过条件作用习得。

senses.meaning_en: physical training to improve fitness and performance

examples.text: He does extra conditioning for the marathon each week.
examples.translation_cn: 他每周为马拉松进行额外的体能训练。

senses.meaning_en: relating to academic study or scholarship

examples.text: She wrote a scholarly article on climate policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她写了一篇关于气候政策的学术文章。

senses.meaning_en: having or showing knowledge, learning, or devotion to study
senses.pattern: have a scholarly turn of mind

examples.text: She has a scholarly turn of mind and reads constantly.
examples.translation_cn: 她有学者的心智，经常阅读。

senses.meaning_en: in a scholarly manner

examples.text: The professor spoke scholarly about the historical context.
examples.translation_cn: 教授以学者的风范谈论了历史背景。

senses.meaning_en: a quiet laugh

examples.text: She answered his question with a soft chuckle.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻声笑着回答了他的问题。

senses.meaning_en: to laugh quietly or inwardly

examples.text: He chuckled at the thought of working from home.
examples.translation_cn: 他想到要居家办公，不禁轻声笑了。

senses.meaning_en: to communicate through chuckling

examples.text: She chuckled a quick apology and left the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她低声笑着匆匆道了歉，然后离开了房间。

senses.meaning_en: designed or made according to an official standard

examples.text: The national exam is standardized across all public schools.
examples.translation_cn: 全国性考试在所有公立学校都是统一标准的。

senses.meaning_en: having the same design or forming part of a set

examples.text: She wore a matching pair of silver earrings.
examples.translation_cn: 她戴着一对相配的银耳环。

senses.meaning_en: the process of pairing people or things together
senses.pattern: the matching of A with B

examples.text: The matching of volunteers with host families usually takes a few days.
examples.translation_cn: 志愿者与寄宿家庭的匹配通常需要几天时间。

senses.meaning_en: invented, not real

examples.text: The events in the film are purely fictional, not based on real incidents.
examples.translation_cn: 电影中的事件纯属虚构，并非基于真实事件。

senses.meaning_en: connected with fiction; occurring in novels

examples.text: The novel is set in a fictional world inspired by ancient Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说设定在一个以古希腊为灵感的虚构世界中。

senses.meaning_en: willing to work hard and give time and energy; loyal and enthusiastic

examples.text: She is deeply committed to helping her students succeed.
examples.translation_cn: 她尽心尽力地帮助学生成功。

senses.meaning_en: in a serious, faithful romantic or sexual relationship

examples.text: They have been in a committed relationship for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一段认真的感情关系中已经五年了。

senses.meaning_en: obligated by a promise or pledge to do something

examples.text: The company is legally committed to paying all its debts.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司有法定义务偿还所有债务。

senses.meaning_en: relating to diet

examples.text: The doctor asked about her dietary habits during the consultation.
examples.translation_cn: 医生在问诊时询问了她的饮食习惯。

senses.meaning_en: to add nutrients to soil to make it more fertile

examples.text: Farmers fertilize their fields with compost each spring.
examples.translation_cn: 农民每年春天用堆肥给田地施肥。

senses.meaning_en: to make an egg, seed, or female animal able to develop into a new individual by combining with sperm or pollen

examples.text: In humans, a single sperm fertilizes an egg in the fallopian tube.
examples.translation_cn: 在人类中，一个精子在输卵管内使卵子受精。

senses.meaning_en: an act of demanding something firmly or refusing to accept refusal

examples.text: His insistence on checking every detail prevented several mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 他坚决要求检查每个细节，避免了好几个错误。

senses.meaning_en: the act of stating firmly that something is true, especially when others disagree

examples.text: Despite her insistence that she was right, no one believed her.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管她坚持认为自己是对的，但没人相信她。

senses.meaning_en: a small battery-powered electric lamp held in the hand

examples.text: We explored the old mine by flashlight, staying close together.
examples.translation_cn: 我们靠手电筒探索旧矿井，彼此紧靠在一起。

senses.meaning_en: in a strange or unusual way

examples.text: The office was oddly quiet on Monday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 周一早上办公室里出奇地安静。

senses.meaning_en: shared by all members of a group or community

examples.text: Residents share communal facilities such as the laundry and the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 住户共用洗衣房和花园等公共设施。

senses.meaning_en: done or shared by all members of a group

examples.text: Preparing the school fair was a communal effort involving parents and teachers.
examples.translation_cn: 筹备学校义卖是家长和老师共同参与的一项集体努力。

senses.meaning_en: relating to relations between different groups in society

examples.text: The city has seen growing communal tension between different religious groups.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市不同宗教群体之间的紧张关系日益加剧。

senses.meaning_en: a person who holds a particular office or position

examples.text: The current occupant of the post will retire soon.
examples.translation_cn: 该职位现任者即将退休。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is in a vehicle or seat at a particular time

examples.text: The occupants of the car escaped with minor injuries.
examples.translation_cn: 车上的乘客只受轻伤脱险。

senses.meaning_en: the owner or tenant of a property

examples.text: The previous occupants of the house left it clean.
examples.translation_cn: 这所房子之前的住户把它留得很干净。

senses.meaning_en: a characteristic style of cooking, especially one associated with a particular country or region

examples.text: The cuisine of Thailand is known for its balance of sweet, sour, and spicy flavours.
examples.translation_cn: 泰国菜系以甜、酸、辣风味的平衡而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: food prepared in a particular style or place

examples.text: We sampled the local cuisine at the night market.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在夜市品尝了当地菜肴。

senses.meaning_en: increasing in size, extent, or volume

examples.text: The expanding economy is creating new jobs in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 不断增长的经济正在该地区创造新的就业机会。

senses.meaning_en: about to happen very soon

examples.text: The ceasefire is imminent, according to the latest reports.
examples.translation_cn: 根据最新报道，停火即将到来。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or ruin a place or area completely

examples.text: The hurricane devastated the entire coastal region last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年飓风摧毁了整个沿海地区。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone to feel extremely shocked and sad

examples.text: She was devastated by the news of her brother's death.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到哥哥去世的消息悲痛欲绝。

senses.meaning_en: to plan and direct the route of a vehicle or vessel

examples.text: The captain navigated the ship through dense fog into the harbour.
examples.translation_cn: 船长在浓雾中把船驶入港口。

senses.meaning_en: to find a way through a difficult situation

examples.text: She helped him navigate through a difficult divorce.
examples.translation_cn: 她帮助他度过了一次艰难的离婚。

senses.meaning_en: to move around a website or menu to find information

examples.text: Use the menu to navigate to the contact page.
examples.translation_cn: 使用菜单浏览至联系页面。

senses.meaning_en: an unoccupied position or job

examples.text: The restaurant has a vacancy for a kitchen assistant.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅有一个厨房助理的职位空缺。

senses.meaning_en: an available room in a hotel

examples.text: Luckily, the hotel had a vacancy when we arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 幸运的是，我们到达时旅馆有空房。

senses.meaning_en: empty space

examples.text: The missing brick left a vacancy in the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 缺失的砖块在墙上留下一个空洞。

senses.meaning_en: unable to stop thinking about something; extremely interested in it

examples.text: She is obsessed with collecting rare stamps from around the world.
examples.translation_cn: 她痴迷于收集世界各地的稀有邮票。

senses.meaning_en: haunted or troubled by an idea or feeling

examples.text: She was obsessed by the fear that she had left the stove on.
examples.translation_cn: 她因担心忘关炉子而心神不宁。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of slight pain or of being physically or mentally uncomfortable

examples.text: She was in obvious discomfort after the long flight.
examples.translation_cn: 长途飞行后她明显感到不适。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes you feel uncomfortable or annoyed

examples.text: Lack of privacy is one of the discomforts of hostel life.
examples.translation_cn: 缺乏隐私是青年旅舍生活的一个不便之处。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel slightly uncomfortable or distressed

examples.text: The graphic images in the report discomforted many readers.
examples.translation_cn: 报告中的写实画面让许多读者感到不安。

senses.meaning_en: a bag carried on the back, often with straps, used for carrying things when hiking or going to school

examples.text: Students often carry heavy backpacks full of books.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们经常背着装满书的沉重背包。

senses.meaning_en: to hike and camp overnight in the backcountry, carrying your equipment in a backpack

examples.text: They went backpacking in the Rocky Mountains for a week.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在落基山脉背包徒步露营了一周。

senses.meaning_en: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant or a disease

examples.text: The onset of the disease was sudden and severe.
examples.translation_cn: 这种病的发作突然而严重。

senses.meaning_en: to produce or deposit eggs in water

examples.text: Salmon spawn in the river where they were born.
examples.translation_cn: 鲑鱼在它们出生的河里产卵。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to develop or exist, often in large numbers

examples.text: The discovery spawned a heated debate about ethics.
examples.translation_cn: 这一发现引发了关于伦理的激烈辩论。

senses.meaning_en: to appear or make someone/something appear in a game world

examples.text: Enemies spawn at random points on the map.
examples.translation_cn: 敌人在地图上的随机点生成。

senses.meaning_en: very strongly or deeply

examples.text: She felt profoundly grateful for their quiet kindness.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他们默默的善意深怀感激。

senses.meaning_en: of or concerning the body

examples.text: The virus can be transmitted through bodily fluids.
examples.translation_cn: 病毒可通过体液传播。

senses.meaning_en: having a body or material form; physical

examples.text: In some stories, angels take bodily form to help people.
examples.translation_cn: 在一些故事中，天使会以肉身现形来帮助人们。

senses.meaning_en: by moving the whole body; with force

examples.text: Police lifted him bodily out of the car.
examples.translation_cn: 警察把他整个人从车里抬了出来。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean to maintain health

examples.text: Good hygiene in the kitchen can prevent food poisoning.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房里保持良好的卫生可以防止食物中毒。

senses.meaning_en: a formal or religious ceremony or prescribed act

examples.text: The priest performed a funeral rite for the deceased.
examples.translation_cn: 神父为逝者举行了丧葬仪式。

senses.meaning_en: a habitual or customary practice

examples.text: Spring cleaning is an annual rite in this household.
examples.translation_cn: 春季大扫除是这个家庭一年一度的惯例。

senses.meaning_en: pleasantness; comfort

examples.text: The amenity of the lake adds to the value of the surrounding houses.
examples.translation_cn: 湖泊的宜人环境提升了周边房屋的价值。

senses.meaning_en: a useful or pleasant facility or feature

examples.text: The area offers many amenities such as parks, shops, and a clinic.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区提供许多便利设施，如公园、商店和一家诊所。
