examples.text: Dogs must be kept on a leash in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 狗在公园里必须系上牵狗带。

senses.meaning_en: to attach a leash to an animal

examples.text: She leashed her dog to a fence before entering the shop.
examples.translation_cn: 她进店前把狗拴在了围栏上。

senses.meaning_en: control or restraint
senses.collocation: keep sb on a short leash

examples.text: The manager keeps the team on a short leash to meet the deadline.
examples.translation_cn: 经理为了赶上最后期限，对团队管得很紧。

senses.meaning_en: to control or restrain something

examples.text: He struggled to leash his anger during the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试时他努力克制自己的怒火。

senses.meaning_en: relating to hearing or the sense of hearing

examples.text: The auditory nerve carries sound signals from the ear to the brain.
examples.translation_cn: 听觉神经将声音信号从耳朵传递到大脑。

senses.meaning_en: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way

examples.text: He has a propensity to overspend when he shops online.
examples.translation_cn: 他在网上购物时倾向于超支。

senses.meaning_en: a large freshwater fish

examples.text: A school of carp swam slowly across the pond.
examples.translation_cn: 一群鲤鱼缓慢地游过池塘。

senses.meaning_en: to complain or find fault continually about petty things

examples.text: She kept carping about every little detail of the plan.
examples.translation_cn: 她不停地对计划的每一个小细节吹毛求疵。

senses.meaning_en: Containing salt; salty.

examples.text: The water in this lake is slightly saline.
examples.translation_cn: 这个湖里的水略带咸味。

senses.meaning_en: Water containing dissolved salt, especially normal saline.

examples.text: She rinsed her contact lenses carefully with saline.
examples.translation_cn: 她小心地用盐水冲洗隐形眼镜。

senses.meaning_en: strange and mysterious, causing unease

examples.text: It is uncanny how quiet the house is at night.
examples.translation_cn: 夜里房子安静得诡异。

senses.meaning_en: extraordinary; beyond normal
senses.pattern: have an uncanny ability to do

examples.text: She has an uncanny ability to recall names after one introduction.
examples.translation_cn: 她有一种非凡的能力，只听一次介绍就能记住名字。

senses.meaning_en: hoping to become

examples.text: As an aspiring doctor, she volunteers at the local hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她立志成为一名医生，在当地医院做志愿者。

senses.meaning_en: to make something slightly wet

examples.text: She dampened the cloth with water before wiping the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她先用清水把抹布弄湿，然后再擦桌子。

senses.meaning_en: to make something less strong or intense

examples.text: The defeat did not dampen the team's spirits.
examples.translation_cn: 这次失利并没有打击球队的士气。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe with great difficulty because of smoke, dust, or lack of air

examples.text: The miners were smothering in the thick smoke when rescuers finally reached them.
examples.translation_cn: 救援人员最终到达时，矿工们正在浓烟中窒息。

senses.meaning_en: to cover something thickly or to stop someone or something from breathing

examples.text: The chicken was smothered in a rich cream sauce.
examples.translation_cn: 鸡肉上浇了厚厚一层奶油酱。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent an emotion or sound from being expressed

examples.text: She smothered a laugh when the professor tripped on the rug.
examples.translation_cn: 教授被地毯绊倒时，她强忍住笑。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone too much love or attention so that they feel restricted

examples.text: She smothered her boyfriend with attention, and he began to feel trapped.
examples.translation_cn: 她对男友关怀得让他透不过气，他开始感到被束缚。

senses.meaning_en: to sit on eggs or keep them at the right temperature for them to develop
senses.collocation: incubate the eggs for three weeks

examples.text: The hen incubates her eggs for about three weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 母鸡孵蛋大约三周。

senses.meaning_en: to develop an idea or plan slowly over time

examples.text: She incubated the idea for years before launching the startup.
examples.translation_cn: 她酝酿这个想法多年后才创办这家初创公司。

senses.meaning_en: to keep microorganisms or cells at a suitable temperature so they can grow

examples.text: The lab incubated the bacterial cultures at 37°C overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室在37°C下将细菌培养物培养过夜。

senses.meaning_en: in turns; one after the other in a repeated order

examples.text: The nurses worked alternately at the clinic and at the hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 护士们轮流在诊所和医院工作。

senses.meaning_en: as an alternative; alternatively

examples.text: The orca, alternately known as the killer whale, is widely studied.
examples.translation_cn: 逆戟鲸，又名虎鲸，被广泛研究。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the back or upper side

examples.text: The dark spots appear on the dorsal side of the frog.
examples.translation_cn: 这些深色斑点出现在青蛙的背侧。

senses.meaning_en: existing in myth

examples.text: The dragon is a mythical creature in many cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 龙在许多文化中是一种神话中的生物。

senses.meaning_en: not real; false or fabricated

examples.text: His claim of meeting aliens is purely mythical.
examples.translation_cn: 他声称见过外星人完全是虚构的。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to think and behave in a sensible and reasonable way

examples.text: Sanity prevailed, and the two sides finally reached a compromise.
examples.translation_cn: 理智占了上风，双方最终达成了妥协。

senses.meaning_en: the state of having a healthy mind

examples.text: He was terrified of losing his sanity after weeks of isolation.
examples.translation_cn: 数周的隔离让他害怕失去理智。

senses.meaning_en: to completely change something, especially a way of doing something

examples.text: The internet has revolutionized the way we communicate.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网已经彻底改变了我们交流的方式。

senses.meaning_en: an extinct hairy elephant-like mammal with long curved tusks

examples.text: A herd of mammoths once crossed this frozen valley.
examples.translation_cn: 一群猛犸象曾经穿过这座冰冻的山谷。

senses.meaning_en: something very large of its kind

examples.text: The new stadium is a mammoth of a building.
examples.translation_cn: 新体育场是一座庞然大物般的建筑。

senses.meaning_en: very large; enormous

examples.text: The company faced a financial crisis of mammoth proportions.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司面临着一场规模巨大的金融危机。

senses.meaning_en: intense and passionate feeling

examples.text: She spoke with great fervor about the need for change.
examples.translation_cn: 她满怀热情地谈论变革的必要性。

senses.meaning_en: the bottom edge of a piece of clothing, folded and sewn

examples.text: She pinned the hem of her skirt before sewing.
examples.translation_cn: 她缝之前先别住裙子的下摆。

senses.meaning_en: to make a hem; to put a hem on sth

examples.text: My grandmother taught me how to hem a skirt neatly.
examples.translation_cn: 祖母教我如何整齐地给裙子缝边。

senses.meaning_en: to surround or restrict

examples.text: The small village was hemmed in by mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 小村庄被群山包围。

senses.meaning_en: to hesitate or make a sound while thinking
senses.collocation: hem and haw about a decision

examples.text: He hemmed and hawed before giving his answer.
examples.translation_cn: 他犹豫了一会儿才回答。

senses.meaning_en: living by preying on other animals

examples.text: Lions are predatory animals that hunt in groups.
examples.translation_cn: 狮子是成群捕食的掠食动物。

senses.meaning_en: exploiting or victimizing others for personal gain

examples.text: The company used predatory pricing to drive smaller rivals out of business.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司使用掠夺性定价将较小的竞争对手挤出市场。

senses.meaning_en: a large cave, especially underground

examples.text: We found ancient paintings deep in a cavern.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在一个洞穴深处发现了古代壁画。

senses.meaning_en: the spreading of something such as information, ideas, or culture among people; the gradual spread and adoption of goods or services

examples.text: The diffusion of new ideas often faces strong resistance.
examples.translation_cn: 新思想的传播常常面临强烈抵制。

senses.meaning_en: the intermingling of the molecules of a fluid due to random thermal agitation

examples.text: The diffusion of oxygen molecules through the membrane keeps the cells alive.
examples.translation_cn: 氧分子通过膜的扩散使细胞保持活力。

senses.meaning_en: the scattering of light by reflection from a rough surface or by passage through a translucent medium

examples.text: The diffusion of light through the frosted glass gives the room a soft glow.
examples.translation_cn: 光线透过磨砂玻璃散射，给房间带来柔和的光。

senses.meaning_en: to flow out slowly

examples.text: Blood was oozing from a cut on his forehead.
examples.translation_cn: 血正从他额头的伤口慢慢渗出。

senses.meaning_en: to show a particular quality or feeling very strongly

examples.text: She oozes confidence when she speaks in public.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公众面前发言时充满自信。

senses.meaning_en: soft wet earth; a thick liquid that oozes out

examples.text: The boat sank slowly into the thick ooze.
examples.translation_cn: 小船慢慢沉入厚厚的软泥中。

senses.meaning_en: filled with something unpleasant or undesirable

examples.text: The negotiations were fraught with difficulties from the start.
examples.translation_cn: 谈判从一开始就困难重重。

senses.meaning_en: causing or feeling anxiety and worry; tense

examples.text: She looked fraught after the tense meeting with her boss.
examples.translation_cn: 她与老板的紧张会面后显得焦虑不安。

senses.meaning_en: thin in substance or consistency

examples.text: The moon has a tenuous atmosphere of sodium and potassium.
examples.translation_cn: 月球有一层由钠和钾组成的稀薄大气。

senses.meaning_en: weak, uncertain, or not secure

examples.text: The new government has a tenuous hold on power.
examples.translation_cn: 新政府对权力的掌控很脆弱。

senses.meaning_en: causing trouble or difficulty, especially in terms of time, effort or comfort

examples.text: The new bus schedule is inconvenient for many commuters.
examples.translation_cn: 新的公交时刻表对许多通勤者来说很不方便。

senses.meaning_en: not suitable or appropriate for a particular time or situation

examples.text: She called me at an inconvenient time last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚在一个不方便的时间打电话给我。

senses.meaning_en: relating to teaching or education

examples.text: The new teaching materials are of great pedagogic value.
examples.translation_cn: 新教材具有很大的教学价值。

senses.meaning_en: relating to teaching or pedagogy

examples.text: The school encourages a student-centred pedagogical approach to science.
examples.translation_cn: 学校鼓励以学生为中心的科学教学方法。

senses.meaning_en: haughty and formal

examples.text: He addressed the guests in a pedagogical tone that sounded both formal and condescending.
examples.translation_cn: 他以一种既正式又居高临下的学究语气对客人讲话。

senses.meaning_en: to a remarkable degree; very noticeably

examples.text: The two brothers look strikingly similar, especially around the eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 两兄弟看起来惊人地相似，尤其是眼睛周围。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that attracts attention

examples.text: She always dresses strikingly, even for casual events.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是穿得很醒目，即使是参加休闲活动。

senses.meaning_en: a fierce attack

examples.text: The army launched a full-scale onslaught on the enemy camp at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在拂晓时向敌营发动了全面猛攻。

senses.meaning_en: a large number of people or things resembling an attack

examples.text: The company faced an onslaught of complaints after the data leak.
examples.translation_cn: 数据泄露后，公司遭到大量投诉。

senses.meaning_en: very careful and precise about details

examples.text: He is meticulous about every detail of his work.
examples.translation_cn: 他对工作中的每个细节都一丝不苟。

senses.meaning_en: to give off water vapour through stomata

examples.text: Plants transpire water vapour through tiny pores on their leaves.
examples.translation_cn: 植物通过叶片上的微小气孔排出水汽。

senses.meaning_en: to become known

examples.text: It later transpired that she had known the truth.
examples.translation_cn: 后来得知她早已知道真相。

senses.meaning_en: to happen

examples.text: We will investigate what transpired during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们将调查会议期间发生了什么。

senses.meaning_en: done together by agreement or combined effort
senses.pattern: make a concerted effort to do

examples.text: The team made a concerted effort to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 团队齐心协力按时完成了项目。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain or collect something such as support, information, or attention

examples.text: The campaign has garnered widespread support from local residents.
examples.translation_cn: 这场运动赢得了当地居民的广泛支持。

senses.meaning_en: a thin piece of building material used to cover roofs or walls

examples.text: The old roof is covered with gray shingles.
examples.translation_cn: 旧屋顶覆盖着灰色木瓦。

senses.meaning_en: a small signboard showing a professional office

examples.text: She hung out her shingle as a dentist last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年挂出牙医开业招牌。

senses.meaning_en: small round stones on a beach

examples.text: The children played on the shingle by the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在海边的卵石滩上玩耍。

senses.meaning_en: to cover with shingles

examples.text: The workers will shingle the roof next Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们下周一将给屋顶铺木瓦。

senses.meaning_en: to surround or attack from all sides

examples.text: The old castle was beset by hostile forces.
examples.translation_cn: 那座古老的城堡被敌军围困。

senses.meaning_en: to affect somebody seriously and cause difficulty or worry

examples.text: The new project is beset with financial problems.
examples.translation_cn: 这个新项目受到财务问题的困扰。

senses.meaning_en: dishonest and intended to deceive people, especially to gain money or an advantage

examples.text: The company's accounting practices were fraudulent and illegal.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司的会计操作是欺诈且违法的。

senses.meaning_en: made or used to deceive people, especially about its origin or authenticity

examples.text: He was arrested for using fraudulent documents at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 他因在机场使用伪造证件而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to move slightly or be moved from a fixed position

examples.text: The heavy stone will not budge even with three people pushing.
examples.translation_cn: 这块沉重的石头即使三个人推也纹丝不动。

senses.meaning_en: to yield in one's opinions or beliefs

examples.text: The government refused to budge on tax reform.
examples.translation_cn: 政府在税收改革上拒绝让步。

senses.meaning_en: to search widely for food

examples.text: Wild pigs often forage for roots and nuts at night.
examples.translation_cn: 野猪常在夜间觅食根茎和坚果。

senses.meaning_en: food for animals, especially cattle and horses

examples.text: The dried grass is used as forage for cattle.
examples.translation_cn: 干草被用作牛的饲料。

senses.meaning_en: an act or instance of foraging

examples.text: The children went for a forage in the woods after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们午饭后到树林里去搜寻食物。

senses.meaning_en: to search for something by moving things around untidily

examples.text: She foraged in the drawer for a pen.
examples.translation_cn: 她在抽屉里翻找一支笔。

senses.meaning_en: to make something an established part of a system or society

examples.text: The new safety checks have been institutionalized as standard practice in the company.
examples.translation_cn: 新的安全检查已成为公司的标准做法。

senses.meaning_en: to place someone in an institution for care or treatment

examples.text: After the diagnosis, he was institutionalized for severe depression.
examples.translation_cn: 确诊后，他因严重抑郁被送入收容机构。

senses.meaning_en: outdated; old-fashioned

examples.text: The special effects look dated by today's standards.
examples.translation_cn: 以今天的标准来看，这些特效显得过时了。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone something to look after or deal with

examples.text: She consigned the original documents to her lawyer for safekeeping.
examples.translation_cn: 她把原始文件托付给律师保管。

senses.meaning_en: to put someone or something into an unpleasant situation

examples.text: The old bridge was consigned to history after the new one opened.
examples.translation_cn: 新桥建成后，那座旧桥便成了历史。

senses.meaning_en: to transfer to the custody of someone for sale
senses.pattern: consign sth to sb for sale

examples.text: The artist consigned her paintings to a London gallery for sale.
examples.translation_cn: 这位艺术家把她的画作委托给伦敦一家画廊代销。

senses.meaning_en: to send something to a final destination

examples.text: The factory consigned the components to an assembly plant in Poland.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂把零部件发往波兰的一家装配厂。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being useful, suitable, or likely to succeed
senses.collocation: assess the practicality of a plan

examples.text: We need to assess the practicality of building a new bridge here.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要评估在这里建一座新桥的可行性。

senses.meaning_en: the real facts and practical aspects of a situation, rather than theories or ideas

examples.text: They discussed the practicalities of moving to a smaller apartment.
examples.translation_cn: 他们讨论了搬到更小公寓的实际问题。

senses.meaning_en: to prove that something is true or right, especially when others doubted it

examples.text: His theory was fully vindicated by later experiments.
examples.translation_cn: 他的理论后来被实验完全证实。

senses.meaning_en: to prove that someone is not guilty or is free from blame

examples.text: She was completely vindicated in court after the DNA test.
examples.translation_cn: DNA检测后，她在法庭上被完全证明清白。

senses.meaning_en: showing a desire to resist authority, control, or convention

examples.text: He is rebellious by nature and often challenges authority.
examples.translation_cn: 他天生叛逆，经常挑战权威。

senses.meaning_en: hard to control or deal with

examples.text: She uses gel to tame her rebellious hair.
examples.translation_cn: 她用发胶来驯服难梳理的头发。

senses.meaning_en: differing from each other or from something else

examples.text: The two experts' views on the issue are widely divergent.
examples.translation_cn: 两位专家在这个问题上的观点截然不同。

senses.meaning_en: developing in different directions

examples.text: Their career paths gradually became divergent after university.
examples.translation_cn: 大学毕业后，他们的职业道路逐渐分道扬镳。

senses.meaning_en: not approaching a limit

examples.text: This series is divergent, so it has no finite sum.
examples.translation_cn: 这个级数是发散的，所以它没有有限和。

senses.meaning_en: deviating from a standard or norm

examples.text: The new design is divergent from the original plan in key ways.
examples.translation_cn: 新设计在关键方面偏离了原计划。

senses.meaning_en: burdensome and slow, especially of a process or system

examples.text: The current application procedure is cumbersome and time-consuming.
examples.translation_cn: 目前的申请程序既繁琐又耗时。

senses.meaning_en: large and heavy and therefore difficult to carry or move

examples.text: The old refrigerator is cumbersome to move down the narrow stairs.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧冰箱笨重，很难搬下狭窄的楼梯。

senses.meaning_en: continuous; without interruption

examples.text: The coastline stretched in an unbroken line for miles.
examples.translation_cn: 海岸线绵延数英里，没有中断。

senses.meaning_en: of a horse, not tamed

examples.text: It takes skill to ride an unbroken horse safely.
examples.translation_cn: 安全骑乘一匹未驯服的马需要技巧。

senses.meaning_en: not damaged or broken; intact

examples.text: The ancient vase remained unbroken after the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 那只古花瓶在地震后依然完好无损。

senses.meaning_en: not surpassed or beaten (of a record)

examples.text: The world record has stood unbroken for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 这项世界纪录已保持二十多年未被打破。

senses.meaning_en: a device controlling the flow of fuel to an engine

examples.text: The motorcycle raced along the highway at full throttle.
examples.translation_cn: 摩托车在高速公路上全速疾驰。

senses.meaning_en: to strangle or choke someone

examples.text: The attacker tried to throttle the victim with a rope.
examples.translation_cn: 袭击者试图用绳子勒死受害者。

senses.meaning_en: to prevent something from developing or being expressed

examples.text: The new law will throttle free expression online.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律将扼杀网络言论自由。

senses.meaning_en: to control the speed of an engine

examples.text: The pilot throttled up the engine before takeoff.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员在起飞前加大了油门。

senses.meaning_en: a colourless, odourless gas used as fuel and produced by decaying matter

examples.text: Landfill sites release methane into the atmosphere as waste decays.
examples.translation_cn: 垃圾填埋场的废物腐烂时会向大气释放甲烷。

senses.meaning_en: in a relaxed, unhurried way

examples.text: She explored the old town in a leisurely way, stopping at every little shop.
examples.translation_cn: 她悠闲地逛着老城，在每家小店里都停下来。

senses.meaning_en: taking plenty of time; unhurried

examples.text: We took a leisurely stroll along the river after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午饭后我们沿着河边悠闲地散步。

senses.meaning_en: an indirect reference to something

examples.text: Her remark was an allusion to the recent scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 她的话暗指最近的丑闻。

senses.meaning_en: a reference to a famous person, place, event, or work of art

examples.text: The poem makes an allusion to Homer's Odyssey.
examples.translation_cn: 这首诗引用了荷马的《奥德赛》。

senses.meaning_en: the highest or greatest part of something, especially forming a point

examples.text: The architect placed a glass dome at the apex of the building.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑师在大楼的最高点安放了一个玻璃穹顶。

senses.meaning_en: the moment of greatest success, expansion, etc.

examples.text: Her influence reached its apex during the reform period.
examples.translation_cn: 她的影响力在改革时期达到了顶峰。

senses.meaning_en: the top of the food chain
senses.pattern: at the apex of the food chain

examples.text: Wolves are at the apex of the food chain in this forest.
examples.translation_cn: 狼是这片森林食物链的顶端。

senses.meaning_en: the crime of lying under oath

examples.text: She was charged with perjury after lying under oath to the jury.
examples.translation_cn: 她在向陪审团宣誓后作伪证，被控伪证罪。

senses.meaning_en: to accept, allow, or forgive behaviour that is morally wrong

examples.text: The school does not condone cheating in exams.
examples.translation_cn: 学校不容忍考试作弊。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of doubt or worry

examples.text: She had serious misgivings about accepting the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她对接受这份工作深感疑虑。

senses.meaning_en: extremely violent and aggressive

examples.text: The guard dog was ferocious when a stranger approached the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 当陌生人靠近大门时，看门狗非常凶猛。

senses.meaning_en: extremely intense or strong

examples.text: Competition for places on the team is ferocious this season.
examples.translation_cn: 本赛季队内位置的竞争非常激烈。

senses.meaning_en: the highest point or climax of something

examples.text: The festival reached its culmination with a grand fireworks display last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨夜节日以盛大烟花表演达到高潮。

senses.meaning_en: the final result or product of a process
senses.collocation: the culmination of years of work

examples.text: This invention is the culmination of more than a decade of research.
examples.translation_cn: 这项发明是十多年研究的最终成果。

senses.meaning_en: of or caused by an earthquake

examples.text: Scientists monitor seismic activity along the fault line.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家监测断层线上的地震活动。

senses.meaning_en: subject to earthquakes

examples.text: The city is located in a seismic zone and has strict building codes.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市位于地震多发区，并有严格的建筑规范。

senses.meaning_en: having a very large or widespread effect

examples.text: The internet caused a seismic shift in how people communicate.
examples.translation_cn: 互联网引发了人们沟通方式的巨大转变。

senses.meaning_en: a comic dramatic style or work using exaggerated, improbable situations

examples.text: She acted in a farce on stage in London last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年夏天在伦敦登台出演了一部闹剧。

senses.meaning_en: a ridiculous, often empty situation or event

examples.text: The committee meeting turned into a complete farce.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会会议变成了一场十足的闹剧。

senses.meaning_en: expressing praise or admiration

examples.text: She was extremely complimentary about my new hairstyle.
examples.translation_cn: 她对我的新发型赞不绝口。

senses.meaning_en: given free of charge

examples.text: The parking is complimentary for all hotel guests.
examples.translation_cn: 停车对所有酒店客人都是免费的。

senses.meaning_en: used as a polite formula in the closing of a letter

examples.text: The letter ended with the complimentary close "Yours sincerely."
examples.translation_cn: 这封信以“您真诚的”这一问候语结尾。

senses.meaning_en: very cold; icy

examples.text: The lake water was frigid to the touch even in July.
examples.translation_cn: 即使在七月，湖水摸起来冰冷刺骨。

senses.meaning_en: cold and unfriendly; lacking warmth

examples.text: He replied in a frigid tone that made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 他用冷淡的语气回答，让每个人都不舒服。

senses.meaning_en: a detailed plan or schedule of a journey

examples.text: Let's plan an itinerary that gives us enough time to rest.
examples.translation_cn: 我们来制定一个留出足够休息时间的行程安排吧。

senses.meaning_en: a route or proposed route of a journey

examples.text: We followed the itinerary through the mountains without making any changes.
examples.translation_cn: 我们按照路线穿过山区，没有做任何更改。

senses.meaning_en: to eat something with small quick bites

examples.text: She nibbled at a piece of toast while reading.
examples.translation_cn: 她一边看书一边小口吃着一片吐司。

senses.meaning_en: to bite gently and playfully or lovingly

examples.text: The little boy giggled as the puppy nibbled his fingers.
examples.translation_cn: 小男孩咯咯笑着，小狗轻咬他的手指。

senses.meaning_en: to remove something by taking small quick bites

examples.text: Mice had nibbled away the corners of the cardboard box.
examples.translation_cn: 老鼠啃掉了纸箱的边角。

senses.meaning_en: showing initiative and resourcefulness in starting new things or in business

examples.text: She was enterprising enough to turn a small family recipe into a successful bakery chain.
examples.translation_cn: 她很有开拓精神，把一份家传食谱发展成成功的面包连锁店。

senses.meaning_en: to flow out suddenly and in large amounts; to send out in a gush

examples.text: Water gushed out of the broken pipe for several minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 水从破裂的管道中涌出，持续了好几分钟。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden fast flow of liquid

examples.text: A gush of water flooded the narrow street after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴雨过后，一股水流淹没了狭窄的街道。

senses.meaning_en: to express admiration or pleasure too eagerly

examples.text: She gushed over her colleague's new haircut all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个下午都在对同事的新发型赞不绝口。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden strong feeling expressed too strongly

examples.text: A sudden gush of gratitude moved her to tears.
examples.translation_cn: 一股突然涌上的感激之情使她热泪盈眶。

senses.meaning_en: to dislike someone or something very much

examples.text: I loathe getting up early on cold mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我讨厌在寒冷的早晨早起。

senses.meaning_en: perfect, without faults or errors

examples.text: Her taste in art and interior design is impeccable.
examples.translation_cn: 她对艺术和室内设计的品味无可挑剔。

senses.meaning_en: showing emphasis; definite and forceful

examples.text: He was emphatic that no further changes were necessary.
examples.translation_cn: 他坚决表示没有必要再改动。

senses.meaning_en: clear and strong; impossible to doubt

examples.text: It was an emphatic win for the home side.
examples.translation_cn: 主队取得了一场压倒性的胜利。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem less good or valuable; to take away from

examples.text: The poor lighting detracted from the beauty of the room.
examples.translation_cn: 昏暗的灯光减损了房间的美感。

senses.meaning_en: a barrier placed across a road

examples.text: The police set up a barricade across the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 警察在桥上设置了路障。

senses.meaning_en: an obstacle to progress

examples.text: Prejudice can act as a barricade to social reform.
examples.translation_cn: 偏见可能成为社会改革的障碍。

senses.meaning_en: to block or close a road, door, etc. with a barricade

examples.text: Students barricaded the main gate with wooden benches.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们用木凳堵住了大门。

senses.meaning_en: a scientist who studies ecology

examples.text: She works as an ecologist at a marine research institute.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家海洋研究所担任生态学家。

senses.meaning_en: intending or intended to undermine an established system or institution

examples.text: The group was accused of being subversive of the state.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织被指控颠覆国家。

senses.meaning_en: a person who tries to undermine an established system or institution

examples.text: He was arrested as a suspected subversive and held without trial.
examples.translation_cn: 他作为疑似颠覆分子被逮捕，并被未经审判关押。

senses.meaning_en: happening occasionally or at irregular intervals; not constant

examples.text: Sporadic rain showers are expected throughout the afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 预计下午有零星阵雨。

senses.meaning_en: to contaminate or spoil something, especially food or water

examples.text: The town's water supply was tainted with toxic chemicals.
examples.translation_cn: 该镇的供水被有毒化学品污染。

senses.meaning_en: contamination, decay or putrefaction, especially in food

examples.text: The food was rejected because it had a taint of decay.
examples.translation_cn: 该食品因有腐坏味而被拒收。

senses.meaning_en: a mark of disgrace or damage to reputation

examples.text: The corruption scandal left a taint on his reputation.
examples.translation_cn: 腐败丑闻给他的名声留下了污点。

senses.meaning_en: not disturbed or agitated; calm and untouched

examples.text: The old library remained undisturbed for decades, with dust on every shelf.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老图书馆几十年来一直原封未动，每个架子上都落满了灰尘。

senses.meaning_en: to prove the truth of something by providing evidence

examples.text: The allegations were substantiated by strong documentary evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 这些指控得到了确凿书面证据的证实。

senses.meaning_en: Having or showing keen insight or understanding

examples.text: He is surprisingly perceptive about what motivates people.
examples.translation_cn: 他对人们的动机有着惊人的洞察力。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that came before and influenced a later one

examples.text: The abacus was the forerunner of the modern calculator.
examples.translation_cn: 算盘是现代计算器的前身。

senses.meaning_en: a sign of something that is going to happen

examples.text: Dark clouds are often a forerunner of a storm.
examples.translation_cn: 乌云常常是暴风雨的前兆。

senses.meaning_en: polite respect

examples.text: The young lawyer showed deference to the senior judge.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻律师对资深法官表示敬意。

senses.meaning_en: willingness to carry out the wishes of others

examples.text: He changed the plan in deference to her wishes.
examples.translation_cn: 他遵从她的意愿改变了计划。

senses.meaning_en: a waterfall or one section of a waterfall

examples.text: A cascade of water fell into the pool below.
examples.translation_cn: 一道小瀑布落入下面的水潭。

senses.meaning_en: a large number or sequence of things

examples.text: The announcement triggered a cascade of questions from the audience.
examples.translation_cn: 公告引发了听众一连串的提问。

senses.meaning_en: to fall like a waterfall

examples.text: Water cascaded down the mountainside after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴雨过后，水从山坡上倾泻而下。

senses.meaning_en: perfect happiness

examples.text: They spent their vacation in bliss on a quiet beach.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在一个安静的海滩上度过了幸福的假期。

senses.meaning_en: to feel or reach a state of bliss

examples.text: He blissed out completely during the yoga session.
examples.translation_cn: 他在瑜伽课上完全感到极乐。

senses.meaning_en: to confirm or support a statement, theory, etc. with evidence

examples.text: Her testimony corroborated a claim made by the victim.
examples.translation_cn: 她的证词证实了受害者提出的说法。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult or unpleasant situation

examples.text: She showed great courage in the face of adversity.
examples.translation_cn: 面对逆境，她表现出极大的勇气。

senses.meaning_en: able to be seen, noticed, or understood

examples.text: A note of anger was discernible in her voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音里明显带着一丝怒意。

senses.meaning_en: able to be identified or distinguished

examples.text: The original is clearly discernible from the copy under a microscope.
examples.translation_cn: 在显微镜下，原件与副本清晰可辨。

senses.meaning_en: to stir up feelings or behavior

examples.text: The dictator's speech incited hatred in the crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 独裁者的演讲在人群中激起了仇恨。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage someone to do something unlawful or violent

examples.text: His speech incited the crowd to attack the police station.
examples.translation_cn: 他的演讲煽动人群袭击了警察局。

senses.meaning_en: impossible to imagine or believe; extremely unlikely

examples.text: It is inconceivable that he would refuse such a generous offer.
examples.translation_cn: 他竟会拒绝如此慷慨的提议，真让人难以置信。

senses.meaning_en: strong dislike or hostility

examples.text: There is deep antagonism between the two rival groups.
examples.translation_cn: 两个对立群体之间存在着深深的敌意。

senses.meaning_en: to break up and cease to exist as a group

examples.text: The committee disbanded after the corruption scandal last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会在腐败丑闻后于去年解散了。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a group to break up or disperse

examples.text: The government disbanded the task force after public criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 政府在公众批评之后解散了工作组。

senses.meaning_en: bees living together in a hive

examples.text: A hive of bees settled in the old oak tree.
examples.translation_cn: 一群蜜蜂落在了那棵老橡树上。

senses.meaning_en: a place full of busy people

examples.text: The office became a hive of activity after the announcement.
examples.translation_cn: 消息公布后，办公室变得一片忙碌。

senses.meaning_en: a structure for housing a swarm of honeybees

examples.text: The bees stored enough honey in a hive to survive the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 蜜蜂在蜂箱里储存了足够的蜂蜜以过冬。

senses.meaning_en: to collect bees into a hive

examples.text: The beekeeper hived the bees before the rain began.
examples.translation_cn: 养蜂人在下雨前把蜜蜂收进了蜂箱。

senses.meaning_en: to undermine or overthrow from the foundation, especially a government or system

examples.text: They used propaganda to subvert authority in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 他们利用宣传颠覆该地区的权威。

senses.meaning_en: a deep narrow valley with steep sides

examples.text: A small village lies hidden in a ravine between two hills.
examples.translation_cn: 一个小村庄隐藏在两山之间的沟壑中。

senses.meaning_en: to spread through every part of something, especially ideas or feelings

examples.text: A feeling of excitement pervaded the crowd as the band came on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队上台时，兴奋的情绪在人群中蔓延开来。

senses.meaning_en: to spread through a place and be present everywhere in it, especially a smell, light, or sound

examples.text: The air was pervaded by the sweet scent of jasmine.
examples.translation_cn: 空气中弥漫着茉莉花的甜香。

senses.meaning_en: the traditional stories, customs, beliefs, etc. of a particular community or culture

examples.text: In local folklore, the lake is said to hide a water spirit.
examples.translation_cn: 在当地民间传说中，据说这个湖里藏着水精灵。

senses.meaning_en: appearing threatening or unfriendly

examples.text: The old castle looked forbidding against the dark sky.
examples.translation_cn: 那座古城堡在黑暗的天空下显得阴森。

senses.meaning_en: seeming difficult or daunting

examples.text: Rebuilding the economy after the war remains a forbidding task.
examples.translation_cn: 战后重建经济仍然是一项严峻的任务。

senses.meaning_en: a plant with stinging hairs

examples.text: We found a patch of nettles behind the old shed.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在旧棚子后面发现了一片荨麻。

senses.meaning_en: to irritate or annoy

examples.text: He was nettled by her constant criticism at work.
examples.translation_cn: 他被她工作中不断的批评惹恼了。

senses.meaning_en: a river or stream that flows into a larger river

examples.text: The Missouri River is a major tributary of the Mississippi.
examples.translation_cn: 密苏里河是密西西比河的一条主要支流。

senses.meaning_en: a state or nation that pays tribute to a more powerful ruler

examples.text: The small kingdom was a tributary of the empire.
examples.translation_cn: 这个小王国是帝国的一个附庸国。

senses.meaning_en: paying tribute to a ruler or country

examples.text: The region was tributary to the Roman Empire for centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区几个世纪以来一直向罗马帝国纳贡。

senses.meaning_en: the act of deliberately avoiding something, especially a responsibility, law, tax, or truth

examples.text: Their evasion of safety regulations led to a serious accident.
examples.translation_cn: 他们规避安全法规，导致了一起严重事故。

senses.meaning_en: a statement that avoids giving a direct answer

examples.text: His answer was a transparent evasion of the question.
examples.translation_cn: 他的回答显然是在回避问题。

senses.meaning_en: to remove things from a box, bag, or container

examples.text: He unpacked the plates from the cardboard box.
examples.translation_cn: 他从纸箱里取出盘子。

senses.meaning_en: to open a suitcase or bag and take out the things inside

examples.text: We unpacked after arriving at the hotel around noon.
examples.translation_cn: 我们中午左右到达酒店后打开了行李。

senses.meaning_en: to explain or analyze something in detail

examples.text: The lecture unpacked the theory for a general audience.
examples.translation_cn: 讲座为普通听众剖析了这一理论。

senses.meaning_en: to decompress a file or data

examples.text: You need to unpack the archive before installing the program.
examples.translation_cn: 安装程序之前，你需要解压这个压缩文件。

senses.meaning_en: showing love and tender feelings; loving

examples.text: He is affectionate towards his grandchildren and often gives them hugs.
examples.translation_cn: 他对孙辈很慈爱，经常拥抱他们。

senses.meaning_en: a strong liking for something

examples.text: She has a penchant for vintage jazz records.
examples.translation_cn: 她酷爱老爵士乐唱片。

senses.meaning_en: to take somebody away illegally by force or deception; to kidnap

examples.text: The businessman was abducted by armed men on his way home.
examples.translation_cn: 这名商人在回家途中被武装分子绑架。

senses.meaning_en: something that is helpful or beneficial

examples.text: The new train line has been a boon to commuters in the area.
examples.translation_cn: 这条新铁路线对当地通勤者来说是一大便利。

senses.meaning_en: willing to respond to persuasion or suggestions; easily led

examples.text: She is amenable to suggestions from her team.
examples.translation_cn: 她愿意接受团队的建议。

senses.meaning_en: liable to the legal authority of something

examples.text: The company is amenable to prosecution under the new law.
examples.translation_cn: 根据新法律，公司可能面临起诉。

senses.meaning_en: to improve and repair something so that it looks new again

examples.text: The city plans to refurbish the old railway station next year.
examples.translation_cn: 该市计划明年翻新那座老火车站。

senses.meaning_en: the act of pretending; false or simulated show

examples.text: He made a pretense of reading the report.
examples.translation_cn: 他装出在读报告的样子。

senses.meaning_en: affectation or ostentation of manner

examples.text: Despite his fame, the actor remained friendly and entirely without pretense.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管名气很大，这位演员仍然友好且毫不做作。

senses.meaning_en: a false reason or excuse; a pretext

examples.text: She left early under the pretense of a headache.
examples.translation_cn: 她借口头痛提前离开了。

senses.meaning_en: a claim to have a particular quality or ability

examples.text: He makes no pretense to being a great writer.
examples.translation_cn: 他并不自命为伟大的作家。

senses.meaning_en: to give time, money, tasks, etc. to somebody or something as a share

examples.text: The manager allotted a separate office to each new employee.
examples.translation_cn: 经理给每位新员工分配了单独的办公室。

senses.meaning_en: to get off a vehicle or horse

examples.text: She alighted from the bus outside the station.
examples.translation_cn: 她在车站外下了公交车。

senses.meaning_en: to descend and settle on something

examples.text: A robin alighted on a branch and began to sing.
examples.translation_cn: 一只知更鸟落在树枝上开始唱歌。

senses.meaning_en: to notice or chance upon

examples.text: Her gaze alighted on a small detail in the old photograph.
examples.translation_cn: 她的目光偶然落在旧照片中的一个小细节上。

senses.meaning_en: burning; lit

examples.text: The bonfire was still alight long after midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 午夜过后很久篝火仍然燃烧着。

senses.meaning_en: not planned or organized; random

examples.text: He organizes his notes in a haphazard way and often loses important information.
examples.translation_cn: 他杂乱无章地整理笔记，经常丢失重要信息。

senses.meaning_en: an organism too small to be seen without a microscope, such as a bacterium

examples.text: Microorganisms in the soil help break down dead plants.
examples.translation_cn: 土壤中的微生物帮助分解死去的植物。

senses.meaning_en: having a slope

examples.text: A sloping path led down to the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 一条倾斜的小路通向湖边。

senses.meaning_en: showing deep understanding

examples.text: Her essay offers a penetrating insight into modern loneliness.
examples.translation_cn: 她的文章对现代孤独感提供了深刻的见解。

senses.meaning_en: seeming to see deeply; piercing

examples.text: He stared at me with a penetrating gaze, making me feel exposed.
examples.translation_cn: 他用锐利的目光盯着我，让我感到无处遁形。

senses.meaning_en: loud and sharp, cutting through other sounds

examples.text: A penetrating voice rang out over the cheering crowd.
examples.translation_cn: 一个尖锐的声音盖过了欢呼的人群。

senses.meaning_en: very strong and noticeable

examples.text: A penetrating smell of gas filled the whole house.
examples.translation_cn: 一股刺鼻的煤气味充满了整栋房子。

senses.meaning_en: greatly praised or lauded

examples.text: The film was acclaimed for its powerful story.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因其有力的故事而广受好评。

senses.meaning_en: including every possible element; fully comprehensive

examples.text: The team carried out an exhaustive study of local dialects before proposing changes.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队在提出修改建议前对地方方言进行了详尽的研究。

senses.meaning_en: death and destruction, especially on a large scale

examples.text: The bombing left the city a scene of carnage.
examples.translation_cn: 轰炸后这座城市一片大屠杀景象。

senses.meaning_en: a situation with many deaths or injuries, especially in accidents

examples.text: Drunk driving causes carnage on the roads every year.
examples.translation_cn: 酒后驾车每年都在道路上造成严重伤亡。

senses.meaning_en: the remains of dead bodies and blood after a violent event

examples.text: Bodies lay amid the carnage of the battlefield.
examples.translation_cn: 战场上尸体横陈，血肉模糊。

senses.meaning_en: a great loss by a team; a game in which one team wins overwhelmingly

examples.text: The game was carnage for the visitors, who lost 8–0.
examples.translation_cn: 这场比赛对客队来说是一场惨败，他们以0比8告负。

senses.meaning_en: a place where things join; a junction

examples.text: The bridge stands at the juncture of two rivers.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥位于两条河流的交汇处。

senses.meaning_en: a critical moment in time

examples.text: At this juncture, the board decided to postpone the vote.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个关头，董事会决定推迟投票。

senses.meaning_en: to forcibly remove people from an organization

examples.text: The dictator purged all political rivals from the cabinet.
examples.translation_cn: 独裁者将所有政敌清除出了内阁。

senses.meaning_en: to clear the mind or conscience of unwanted feelings, guilt, or suspicion

examples.text: She tried to purge herself of guilt after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后她努力消除内心的愧疚。

senses.meaning_en: to remove impurities, harmful substances, or other unwanted things by cleansing

examples.text: The new filter purges the water of harmful bacteria.
examples.translation_cn: 新过滤器能清除水中的有害细菌。

senses.meaning_en: to evacuate the bowels or stomach; to cause defecation or vomiting

examples.text: The doctor gave him a laxative to purge his bowels before surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 医生给了他一剂泻药在手术前清空肠道。

senses.meaning_en: a complex network of paths or passages

examples.text: We wandered for hours in a labyrinth of tunnels beneath the old castle.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在古老城堡地下迷宫般的隧道里走了几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a complex or confusing situation
senses.pattern: get lost in a labyrinth of sth

examples.text: Applicants often get lost in a labyrinth of regulations.
examples.translation_cn: 申请者常常在一大堆规章中迷失方向。

senses.meaning_en: watching carefully for possible danger or trouble; alert

examples.text: Parents should remain vigilant about their children's online activity.
examples.translation_cn: 父母应留意孩子的网上活动。

senses.meaning_en: spread from person to person by contact

examples.text: Chickenpox is highly contagious and spreads quickly in schools.
examples.translation_cn: 水痘传染性很强，会在学校里迅速传播。

senses.meaning_en: spreading quickly among people

examples.text: Her excitement was contagious, and soon everyone was cheering.
examples.translation_cn: 她的兴奋很有感染力，很快大家都欢呼起来。

senses.meaning_en: having a disease that can be spread to others

examples.text: You should stay home because you are still contagious.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该待在家里，因为你仍然具有传染性。

senses.meaning_en: of great importance or consequence

examples.text: The cabinet made the momentous decision to reform the tax system.
examples.translation_cn: 内阁做出了改革税制的重大决定。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or resembling a utopia

examples.text: The novel depicts a utopian society free from crime and poverty.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说描绘了一个没有犯罪和贫穷的乌托邦社会。

senses.meaning_en: ideal but often impractical

examples.text: It is utopian to expect a perfect solution to every problem.
examples.translation_cn: 期望每个问题都有完美的解决方案是不切实际的。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a person's life or an account of a person's life, as told by the subject

examples.text: Her latest book is an autobiographical account of her years in Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新的书是对她在巴黎岁月的自传式叙述。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing resentment

examples.text: She was resentful of being passed over for promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 她因晋升被忽视而愤愤不平。

senses.meaning_en: mysterious and difficult to understand

examples.text: The exact cause of the disease remains enigmatic even after years of study.
examples.translation_cn: 这种病的确切病因经过多年研究仍是个谜。

senses.meaning_en: dull, bleak, and depressing; dark and cheerless

examples.text: The abandoned factory looked dreary under the dark clouds.
examples.translation_cn: 废弃的工厂在乌云下显得阴沉。

senses.meaning_en: boring and monotonous

examples.text: She finds data entry dreary and longs for more creative work.
examples.translation_cn: 她觉得数据录入枯燥乏味，渴望更有创造性的工作。

senses.meaning_en: reject as false; deny

examples.text: The minister repudiated the allegations, calling them false and misleading.
examples.translation_cn: 部长驳斥了这些指控，称其虚假且具有误导性。

senses.meaning_en: refuse to honor or obey (an agreement, duty, etc.)

examples.text: The company repudiated the agreement after the takeover.
examples.translation_cn: 公司在被收购后拒绝履行该协议。

senses.meaning_en: disown or reject (a person, especially a family member)

examples.text: He publicly repudiated his eldest son after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻后，他公开与长子断绝了关系。

senses.meaning_en: refuse to pay or honor (a debt)

examples.text: The new regime announced it would repudiate the country's foreign debts.
examples.translation_cn: 新政权宣布将拒绝偿还该国的外债。

senses.meaning_en: a claim or aspiration to a particular status or quality

examples.text: He has no pretensions to being a professional musician.
examples.translation_cn: 他并不自称是职业音乐家。

senses.meaning_en: pretentiousness or showy, artificial behaviour

examples.text: He writes with admirable clarity and without pretension.
examples.translation_cn: 他写作清晰得令人钦佩，且毫不矫饰。

senses.meaning_en: a social environment or setting

examples.text: She grew up in a conservative religious milieu.
examples.translation_cn: 她在保守的宗教环境中长大。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that follows accepted customs or standards; traditionally

examples.text: Conventionally, the bride wears white at the wedding ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 按照惯例，新娘在婚礼上穿白色婚纱。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is not unusual or original

examples.text: The office building is conventionally designed, with no bold features.
examples.translation_cn: 办公楼按常规设计，没有大胆特色。

senses.meaning_en: obscured by haze

examples.text: The valley was hazy with smoke in the early morning.
examples.translation_cn: 清晨的山谷因烟雾而雾蒙蒙的。

senses.meaning_en: confused; not clear in the mind

examples.text: I was hazy about what the instructions meant after the lecture.
examples.translation_cn: 讲座结束后，我对那些指令的意思感到迷糊。

senses.meaning_en: not clear in memory or detail

examples.text: She had only a hazy memory of her grandmother's face.
examples.translation_cn: 她只对祖母的面容有模糊的记忆。

senses.meaning_en: covered with a smooth shiny coating

examples.text: The ceramic bowl was glazed with a shiny clear coat.
examples.translation_cn: 这只陶瓷碗上了一层光滑的透明釉。

senses.meaning_en: showing no liveliness or focus, especially of eyes

examples.text: He stared at the screen with glazed eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 他目光呆滞地盯着屏幕。

senses.meaning_en: covered with a sweet or shiny substance

examples.text: The ham was glazed with honey and mustard.
examples.translation_cn: 火腿涂了一层蜂蜜芥末酱。

senses.meaning_en: fitted with glass

examples.text: All the windows are double-glazed to keep out the cold.
examples.translation_cn: 所有窗户都是双层玻璃，以抵御寒冷。

senses.meaning_en: a record or total of scores, amounts, etc.

examples.text: We keep a tally of the total points scored.
examples.translation_cn: 我们记录总得分。

senses.meaning_en: to calculate the total number or amount of something

examples.text: The judges will tally up the scores at the end.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判将在最后统计总分。

senses.meaning_en: to agree or correspond; to match

examples.text: Her account of the event does not tally with the video evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 她对事件的描述与视频证据不符。

senses.meaning_en: made of wool or like wool in texture

examples.text: She knitted a woolly jumper for her nephew last winter.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年冬天给侄子织了一件羊毛衫。

senses.meaning_en: confused and not clear

examples.text: The committee dismissed the proposal as woolly thinking because it lacked concrete details.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会以思路混乱为由否决了该提案，因为它缺乏具体细节。

senses.meaning_en: a sweater or similar garment made of wool, usually in the plural

examples.text: She washed her winter woollies and put them away for spring.
examples.translation_cn: 她洗了冬天穿的毛线衣，然后收起来等春天再穿。

senses.meaning_en: to encourage or urge someone to do something harmful or illegal

examples.text: The protest leader was arrested for instigating the crowd to riot.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议领袖因煽动人群暴动而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a formal process or action to begin

examples.text: The committee voted to instigate an inquiry into the matter.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会投票决定就此事展开调查。

senses.meaning_en: a special personal quality that attracts and influences others

examples.text: She has the charisma to inspire loyalty in others.
examples.translation_cn: 她拥有那种能激发他人忠诚的魅力。

senses.meaning_en: a person who gives money or help to a person or organization

examples.text: A generous benefactor of the hospital asked to remain anonymous.
examples.translation_cn: 一位慷慨的医院捐助者要求匿名。

senses.meaning_en: severe punishment that someone deserves as a result of their bad actions

examples.text: The court sentenced him to life in prison as retribution for his crimes.
examples.translation_cn: 法院判处他终身监禁，作为对他罪行的惩罚。

senses.meaning_en: the whole of something; everything

examples.text: The jury considered the totality of the evidence before reaching a verdict.
examples.translation_cn: 陪审团在作出裁决前审查了全部证据。

senses.meaning_en: the period during a solar or lunar eclipse when the sun or moon is completely obscured

examples.text: The totality of the eclipse lasted just over two minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 全食阶段持续了两分多钟。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being new, unusual and inventive

examples.text: Her latest film shows real originality in both story and style.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新一部电影在故事和风格上都显示出真正的独创性。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to think independently and produce new ideas

examples.text: She has the originality to question ideas that everyone else accepts.
examples.translation_cn: 她有独创力去质疑其他人都接受的想法。

senses.meaning_en: to publicly criticize or condemn something as bad or harmful

examples.text: The senator decried the cuts as harmful to education.
examples.translation_cn: 这位参议员谴责削减开支对教育有害。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something has little value or worth, often unfairly

examples.text: The painting was widely decried as worthless, but it later sold for millions.
examples.translation_cn: 这幅画曾被广泛贬低为一文不值，但后来卖出了数百万美元。

senses.meaning_en: cunning or deceiving; not straightforward or honest

examples.text: They used devious methods to win the contract from their competitors.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用狡猾的手段从竞争对手那里赢得了合同。

senses.meaning_en: not direct; winding

examples.text: We took a devious route through the old town to avoid the main road.
examples.translation_cn: 我们走了一条穿过老城区的迂回路线，以避开主路。

senses.meaning_en: a small earthquake

examples.text: An earth tremor shook buildings in the city last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚一场小地震震动了城里的建筑。

senses.meaning_en: to shake or quiver rapidly or involuntarily

examples.text: His hands tremor with fear whenever he speaks in public.
examples.translation_cn: 他当众讲话时，双手因恐惧而颤抖。

senses.meaning_en: a slight shaking movement in your body or voice

examples.text: There was a slight tremor in her hands as she picked up the cup.
examples.translation_cn: 她端起杯子时，双手微微颤抖。

senses.meaning_en: able to be obtained

examples.text: The report is obtainable from the university library.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告可从大学图书馆获得。

senses.meaning_en: an official publication containing public and legal notices

examples.text: The new law was published in the official gazette.
examples.translation_cn: 新法律在官方公报上公布了。

senses.meaning_en: a newspaper, especially one used in the title of a local paper

examples.text: The story first appeared in a local gazette last week.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇报道上周首次出现在当地一家报纸上。

senses.meaning_en: to publish something in an official gazette

examples.text: The proposed boundary changes were gazetted last Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 拟议的边界变更上周五已刊于公报。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the aristocracy; a noble

examples.text: He was an aristocrat by birth and owned a large estate in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 他生来就是贵族，在乡下拥有大片地产。

senses.meaning_en: conveying knowledge or information; providing useful instruction

examples.text: It is instructive to compare the two approaches.
examples.translation_cn: 比较这两种方法很有启发性。

senses.meaning_en: to lose strength and become weak

examples.text: The garden plants languished from lack of water.
examples.translation_cn: 花园里的植物因缺水而枯萎。

senses.meaning_en: to be neglected and make little progress

examples.text: The novel languished in obscurity until a critic praised it.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说一直默默无闻，直到一位评论家称赞它。

senses.meaning_en: to be forced to stay in a difficult or unpleasant situation for a long time; to live in miserable conditions

examples.text: He languished in prison for a crime he did not commit.
examples.translation_cn: 他因一项并未犯下的罪行在狱中受尽煎熬。

senses.meaning_en: to become weak or unhappy because you want somebody/something very much

examples.text: She languished for her homeland during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间她因思念故土而憔悴。

senses.meaning_en: to sit or lie in pleasant warmth, especially sunlight

examples.text: Tourists basked in the sun on the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 游客们在海滩上晒太阳。

senses.meaning_en: to take great pleasure or satisfaction in something

examples.text: The team basked in glory after their cup final win.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在杯赛决赛获胜后沉浸在荣耀中。

senses.meaning_en: connected with or helping digestion

examples.text: The digestive system breaks down food into nutrients.
examples.translation_cn: 消化系统将食物分解成营养物质。

senses.meaning_en: a type of semi-sweet biscuit made from wholemeal flour

examples.text: She offered me a digestive biscuit with my coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我拿了一块消化饼干配咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: strong dislike or hostility

examples.text: There is deep animosity between the two rival families.
examples.translation_cn: 这两个敌对家族之间积怨很深。

senses.meaning_en: a weight attached to a line to show a vertical direction

examples.text: They used a plumb line to check whether the wall was vertical.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用铅锤线检查墙壁是否垂直。

senses.meaning_en: completely; exactly

examples.text: The dart landed plumb in the middle of the board.
examples.translation_cn: 飞镖正好落在靶子正中。

senses.meaning_en: to investigate or understand deeply

examples.text: The novel plumbs the depths of human suffering.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说深入探究了人类的苦难。

senses.meaning_en: exactly vertical

examples.text: Check that the fence post is plumb before you fill the hole.
examples.translation_cn: 填土之前，检查篱笆桩是否垂直。

senses.meaning_en: connected or joined to something

examples.text: The old garage is attached to the side of the house.
examples.translation_cn: 那个旧车库连着房子的一侧。

senses.meaning_en: in a romantic or sexual relationship

examples.text: She's attached, so you shouldn't ask her out.
examples.translation_cn: 她有伴侣了，所以你不该约她出去。

senses.meaning_en: liking someone or something very much

examples.text: He is deeply attached to his old dog.
examples.translation_cn: 他很依恋他的老狗。

senses.meaning_en: to waste money, time, or an opportunity

examples.text: He squandered all his money on expensive cars.
examples.translation_cn: 他把所有的钱都浪费在昂贵的汽车上。

senses.meaning_en: the customary rules of polite behaviour in society or in a particular profession

examples.text: Business etiquette requires that you reply to emails within a few days.
examples.translation_cn: 商务礼仪要求你在几天内回复邮件。

examples.text: He was in a state of oblivion after the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后他处于无意识状态。

examples.text: The once-famous actor sank into oblivion after the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻过后，这位曾经著名的演员湮没无闻。

senses.meaning_en: not alike; different

examples.text: The two cultures are dissimilar to each other.
examples.translation_cn: 这两种文化彼此不同。

senses.meaning_en: impossible to reverse or undo

examples.text: The damage to the environment may become irreversible if we do not act now.
examples.translation_cn: 如果我们现在不采取行动，对环境的破坏可能变得不可逆转。

senses.meaning_en: a temporary metal or wooden frame outside a building used by workers during construction or repair

examples.text: Several workers were working on scaffolding outside the building.
examples.translation_cn: 几名工人正在楼外的脚手架上作业。

senses.meaning_en: basic code that is incomplete and used as a basis for further development

examples.text: This basic module serves as scaffolding for the full application.
examples.translation_cn: 这个基础模块用作完整应用程序的脚手架。

senses.meaning_en: a semiaquatic rodent with a wide flat tail and webbed feet

examples.text: Beavers build dams across streams to create ponds.
examples.translation_cn: 海狸在小河上筑坝以形成池塘。

senses.meaning_en: to work very hard, especially in the phrase beaver away

examples.text: She has been beavering away at her thesis all week.
examples.translation_cn: 她整个星期都在埋头苦干写论文。

senses.meaning_en: the fur of a beaver, used especially for making hats

examples.text: This hat is made of beaver and feels very soft.
examples.translation_cn: 这顶帽子是海狸毛皮做的，摸起来很柔软。

senses.meaning_en: relating to public health and cleanliness

examples.text: The city improved sanitary conditions in crowded neighborhoods to reduce disease risks.
examples.translation_cn: 该市改善了拥挤社区的卫生条件以降低疾病风险。

senses.meaning_en: clean and free from germs

examples.text: Keep the wound sanitary by changing the dressing daily.
examples.translation_cn: 每天更换敷料以保持伤口清洁。

senses.meaning_en: of greatest importance; primary

examples.text: Safety is of primal importance in the workplace.
examples.translation_cn: 在工作场所，安全是头等大事。

senses.meaning_en: relating to early or instinctive feelings; primitive

examples.text: She felt a primal instinct to protect her child.
examples.translation_cn: 她感到一种保护孩子的原始本能。

senses.meaning_en: to combine or join together to form a single organization

examples.text: The two firms amalgamated into a single company to cut costs.
examples.translation_cn: 这两家公司合并为一家公司以削减成本。

senses.meaning_en: to mix or blend different things together

examples.text: The chef amalgamated local spices with traditional herbs to create a new flavour.
examples.translation_cn: 厨师将当地香料与传统香草融合，创造出新的风味。

senses.meaning_en: with little light; not brightly

examples.text: The room was dimly lit by a single candle.
examples.translation_cn: 房间仅由一支蜡烛发出昏暗的光。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is not clear or distinct

examples.text: I remember the incident dimly from my childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 我隐约记得童年时的那件事。

senses.meaning_en: that you must do because of a rule or law; mandatory

examples.text: Attendance at the meeting is obligatory for all staff members.
examples.translation_cn: 所有员工都必须参加会议。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is suitable or appropriate in the circumstances

examples.text: The restaurant is aptly named "The View" because it overlooks the bay.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅被恰当地命名为“The View”，因为它俯瞰海湾。

senses.meaning_en: money demanded for the release of a prisoner or hostage

examples.text: The kidnappers demanded a ransom for the release of the businessman.
examples.translation_cn: 绑匪要求支付赎金才释放那名商人。

senses.meaning_en: to pay money to secure the release of a captive

examples.text: We raised enough money to ransom the hostages from the armed group.
examples.translation_cn: 我们筹集了足够的钱从武装组织手中赎回人质。

senses.meaning_en: a principle or belief that people are expected to accept without question

examples.text: He rejected the political dogma that lower taxes always create jobs.
examples.translation_cn: 他拒绝接受降低税收总能创造就业这一政治教条。

senses.meaning_en: a doctrine of a church or religious group on matters of faith or morals

examples.text: They were taught to obey the dogma of the church.
examples.translation_cn: 他们被教导要服从教会的教义。

senses.meaning_en: between or among the stars

examples.text: Interstellar travel remains a distant dream for humanity.
examples.translation_cn: 星际旅行对人类来说仍是一个遥远的梦想。

senses.meaning_en: to hypnotize someone by mesmerism, formerly used to treat illness

examples.text: A 19th-century doctor tried to mesmerize patients to relieve their pain.
examples.translation_cn: 一位19世纪的医生试图催眠病人以减轻疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: to hold someone's attention completely so that they cannot think of anything else

examples.text: The children were mesmerized by the street performer's tricks.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们被街头艺人的把戏迷住了。

senses.meaning_en: to pull or carry something heavy with great effort

examples.text: We had to lug a heavy suitcase up three flights of stairs.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不把一个沉重的行李箱费力拖上三层楼梯。

senses.meaning_en: to refrain from something, especially an indulgence

examples.text: Patients are often advised to abstain from alcohol before surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 患者常被建议手术前避免饮酒。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately refrain from casting a vote

examples.text: Several member states decided to abstain on the budget resolution.
examples.translation_cn: 几个成员国决定对预算决议投弃权票。

senses.meaning_en: understood without being stated openly

examples.text: His silence was interpreted as tacit consent to the proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 他的沉默被视为对该提案的默许。

senses.meaning_en: to stick out or extend from a surface

examples.text: A rusty nail was protruding from the old wooden fence.
examples.translation_cn: 一根生锈的钉子从旧木栅栏上突出来。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to stick out or extend from a surface

examples.text: He protruded his lower lip in a sulk.
examples.translation_cn: 他噘起下唇生闷气。

senses.meaning_en: making you feel very excited and full of energy

examples.text: Many people find skydiving exhilarating, but it is not for everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人觉得跳伞令人极度兴奋，但它不适合所有人。

senses.meaning_en: rain, snow, etc. that falls from the sky

examples.text: Heavy precipitation falls across the region during the summer months.
examples.translation_cn: 夏季该地区有强降水。

senses.meaning_en: a solid substance that forms in a liquid

examples.text: White precipitation forms at the bottom of the test tube.
examples.translation_cn: 试管底部形成白色沉淀。

senses.meaning_en: rash haste

examples.text: He acted with precipitation and signed the contract before reading it.
examples.translation_cn: 他仓促行事，没读合同就签了。

senses.meaning_en: great courage and brave actions of a hero

examples.text: She showed remarkable heroism in saving the child from the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 她在从火中救出那个孩子时表现出非凡的英雄气概。

senses.meaning_en: to breathe out air from the lungs

examples.text: Take a deep breath and exhale slowly through your mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 深吸一口气，然后从嘴里缓缓呼出。

senses.meaning_en: to give off or release gas, vapour, odour, etc.

examples.text: The factory chimney exhaled thick black smoke into the cold air.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂烟囱向寒冷的空气中排出浓浓黑烟。

senses.meaning_en: unable to move or act; sluggish or lethargic

examples.text: The injured bird remained inert on the ground.
examples.translation_cn: 那只受伤的鸟一动不动地躺在地上。

senses.meaning_en: not readily reacting with other elements or compounds

examples.text: Helium is inert to most common chemical substances.
examples.translation_cn: 氦对大多数常见化学物质呈惰性。

senses.meaning_en: something attached or added to something else in a subordinate capacity

examples.text: Physical therapy is often used as an adjunct to medication.
examples.translation_cn: 物理治疗常被用作药物治疗的辅助手段。

senses.meaning_en: an optional word or phrase that adds meaning to a clause

examples.text: The phrase 'after lunch' functions as an adjunct of time.
examples.translation_cn: 短语“after lunch”起时间附加语的作用。

senses.meaning_en: a person associated with another, usually in a subordinate position; a colleague

examples.text: She works as an adjunct at the local community college.
examples.translation_cn: 她在当地社区大学做兼职教师。

senses.meaning_en: to stop or end something before it is completed

examples.text: Mission control aborted the launch due to a fuel leak.
examples.translation_cn: 由于燃料泄漏，任务控制中心中止了发射。

senses.meaning_en: to end a pregnancy so that the baby is not born alive; to miscarry

examples.text: She decided to abort the pregnancy after severe abnormalities were found.
examples.translation_cn: 发现严重异常后，她决定终止妊娠。

senses.meaning_en: to stop developing before reaching full size or maturity

examples.text: Some seeds abort before maturation under drought stress.
examples.translation_cn: 在干旱胁迫下，一些种子在成熟前败育。

senses.meaning_en: failing to achieve the intended result

examples.text: The rebels made an abortive attempt to seize the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军曾试图夺取机场，但未能成功。

senses.meaning_en: the chemical element of atomic number 2, an inert noble gas

examples.text: Helium is a noble gas that rarely forms compounds with other elements.
examples.translation_cn: 氦是一种稀有气体，很少与其他元素形成化合物。

senses.meaning_en: helium gas, a form or sample of this element

examples.text: The balloon was filled with helium and floated up to the ceiling.
examples.translation_cn: 气球被充入氦气后飘到了天花板上。

senses.meaning_en: the highest point or peak, especially of achievement or success

examples.text: Winning the award marked the pinnacle of her career.
examples.translation_cn: 获奖标志着她事业的巅峰。

senses.meaning_en: a tall, sharp, craggy rock or mountain peak

examples.text: The mountain goat stood on a pinnacle of rock above the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 那只野山羊站在山谷上方的岩石尖峰上。

senses.meaning_en: a small pale insect that lives in large groups and eats wood, often damaging buildings

examples.text: The old wooden house is infested with termites.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老木屋被白蚁侵扰了。

senses.meaning_en: not fully developed

examples.text: The animal's hind limbs remained rudimentary and could not support its weight.
examples.translation_cn: 这种动物的后肢未充分发育，无法支撑其体重。

senses.meaning_en: basic or minimal

examples.text: She has only a rudimentary understanding of how the engine works.
examples.translation_cn: 她对发动机的工作原理只有初步了解。

senses.meaning_en: to cut apart a dead animal or plant to study its internal structure

examples.text: Students dissect a frog in biology class to learn about its organs.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们在生物课上解剖青蛙以了解其器官。

senses.meaning_en: to examine and explain something in great detail

examples.text: We dissected the report in detail to find hidden flaws.
examples.translation_cn: 我们详细剖析了报告以找出隐藏瑕疵。

senses.meaning_en: a very deep, seemingly bottomless hole or chasm

examples.text: The mountaineer looked down into the abyss and quickly stepped back.
examples.translation_cn: 登山者向下凝视深渊，迅速后退。

senses.meaning_en: a very large difference that separates people or things

examples.text: The abyss between the two sides seemed impossible to bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 双方之间的鸿沟似乎无法弥合。

senses.meaning_en: moral depravity; vast intellectual or moral depth

examples.text: After losing his job, he fell into an abyss of despair.
examples.translation_cn: 失去工作后，他陷入了绝望的深渊。

senses.meaning_en: the process of grinding down or wearing away by friction

examples.text: The rocks were smoothed by attrition in the river.
examples.translation_cn: 河里的岩石因磨损而变得光滑。

senses.meaning_en: a gradual reduction in number, especially of employees or participants

examples.text: The company is trying to reduce attrition among new hires.
examples.translation_cn: 公司正努力减少新员工的流失。

senses.meaning_en: done or kept in secret, often to hide an illicit or improper purpose

examples.text: They held a clandestine meeting in the basement.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在地下室举行了一次秘密会面。

senses.meaning_en: weapons or military equipment, especially when considered collectively

examples.text: The warship was equipped with powerful armaments before the mission.
examples.translation_cn: 在执行任务前，这艘军舰配备了威力强大的武器。

senses.meaning_en: the process of building up military forces and weapons

examples.text: The rapid armament of the country alarmed its neighbours.
examples.translation_cn: 该国迅速的军备扩张令邻国感到恐慌。

senses.meaning_en: the power to attract or charm

examples.text: The allure of city life draws many young people.
examples.translation_cn: 城市生活的诱惑吸引了许多年轻人。

senses.meaning_en: to attract or tempt

examples.text: The shop allures customers with colorful window displays.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店用色彩缤纷的橱窗展示吸引顾客。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to control; disorderly

examples.text: The crowd became unruly when the concert was delayed.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐会推迟时，人群变得难以控制。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to manage, especially hair; untidy

examples.text: She has unruly hair that takes ages to brush.
examples.translation_cn: 她头发乱蓬蓬的，要花很长时间梳理。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately avoid or give up (something)

examples.text: The company eschews aggressive marketing in favor of word-of-mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司避免激进营销，转而依靠口碑。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being unique or unlike anything else

examples.text: The uniqueness of each culture should be celebrated.
examples.translation_cn: 每种文化的独特性都应该受到颂扬。

senses.meaning_en: a festive occasion with parades and entertainment, especially one held before Lent

examples.text: People often wear costumes and masks at the carnival before Lent.
examples.translation_cn: 在大斋期前的狂欢节上，人们常穿盛装、戴面具。

senses.meaning_en: a traveling amusement park

examples.text: The kids persuaded us to go to the carnival for the bumper cars.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们说服我们去游乐场玩碰碰车。

senses.meaning_en: a rich mixture or display of something

examples.text: The market is a carnival of colors and smells.
examples.translation_cn: 市场是色彩和气味的盛宴。

senses.meaning_en: polite and attentive to women; chivalrous

examples.text: He was gallant to the elderly lady, offering her his arm as they crossed the street.
examples.translation_cn: 过马路时，他对那位老太太很殷勤，伸出手臂让她挽着。

senses.meaning_en: brave; heroic

examples.text: The firefighters made a gallant effort to rescue the trapped family.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员们为营救被困家庭做出了英勇的努力。

senses.meaning_en: in a meticulous manner; extremely carefully and precisely

examples.text: She meticulously checked every page of the contract before signing it.
examples.translation_cn: 她签字前一丝不苟地检查了合同的每一页。

senses.meaning_en: natural ability to learn or do something

examples.text: He has an aptitude for music and learns new pieces quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 他有音乐天资，学新曲子很快。

senses.meaning_en: a person who helps another commit a crime

examples.text: She was an accomplice to the robbery, but she never entered the bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这起抢劫案的共犯，但从未进入银行。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid or get around something, especially a rule or law

examples.text: Companies often circumvent the law by moving profits to tax havens.
examples.translation_cn: 公司常常通过把利润转移到避税天堂来规避法律。

senses.meaning_en: to surround and besiege a place

examples.text: Enemy forces circumvented the fortress and cut off all supply routes.
examples.translation_cn: 敌军包围了要塞，切断了所有补给线。

senses.meaning_en: to outwit or outsmart someone

examples.text: He circumvented his opponents with a bold legal move.
examples.translation_cn: 他以大胆的法律举措智胜对手。

senses.meaning_en: to make unauthorized or improper changes to something, especially in order to damage it

examples.text: The inspector found that someone had tampered with the safety valve.
examples.translation_cn: 检查员发现有人动过安全阀。

senses.meaning_en: to try to influence or deal with someone in an illegal or improper way, especially a witness, jury, or player under contract

examples.text: The club was fined for tampering with a player under contract.
examples.translation_cn: 该俱乐部因与合同期内的球员私下接触而被罚款。

senses.meaning_en: a person who works to protect the natural environment and wildlife

examples.text: She is a conservationist who has spent decades protecting rainforests.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位花了数十年保护雨林的环保主义者。

senses.meaning_en: the process of a gas becoming liquid, or the drops of liquid that form

examples.text: There was heavy condensation on the inside of the car windscreen.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车挡风玻璃内侧有大量冷凝水。

senses.meaning_en: a shortened version of something

examples.text: The textbook is a condensation of his earlier two-volume work.
examples.translation_cn: 这本教科书是他早期两卷本著作的缩写本。

senses.meaning_en: a chemical reaction in which two molecules combine and release a small molecule such as water

examples.text: An alcohol and an acid undergo condensation to form an ester and water.
examples.translation_cn: 醇和酸发生缩合反应生成酯和水。

senses.meaning_en: a public performance by a soloist

examples.text: She gave a piano recital at the town hall last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚在市政厅举办了一场钢琴独奏会。

senses.meaning_en: an account or narration of events

examples.text: He gave a recital of the day's events at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会上讲述了当天发生的事情。

senses.meaning_en: the act of saying something aloud from memory, especially a poem or list

examples.text: The teacher asked the students to give a recital of the poem from memory.
examples.translation_cn: 老师要求学生凭记忆背诵这首诗。

senses.meaning_en: to take control of a country or region, especially by force

examples.text: The empire annexed the small kingdom after a brief war.
examples.translation_cn: 帝国在短暂战争后吞并了这个小王国。

senses.meaning_en: an addition or extension to a building

examples.text: The annex to the main building houses the new offices.
examples.translation_cn: 主楼的附属建筑容纳了新的办公室。

senses.meaning_en: an appendix to a book or document

examples.text: The full budget is set out in an annex to the report.
examples.translation_cn: 完整预算在报告的附件中有所说明。

senses.meaning_en: an addition to the territory of a country or state

examples.text: The island became an annex of the neighbouring country.
examples.translation_cn: 这个岛成了邻国吞并的领土。

senses.meaning_en: a dried plum

examples.text: He ate a prune as an afternoon snack.
examples.translation_cn: 他下午吃了一个李子干当零食。

senses.meaning_en: cut back a tree or bush

examples.text: She pruned the apple tree in early spring.
examples.translation_cn: 她在早春修剪了苹果树。

senses.meaning_en: reduce by removing unnecessary parts

examples.text: The editor pruned the article down to 500 words.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑把文章删减到500词。

senses.meaning_en: the art or occupation of a mason

examples.text: He worked in masonry for most of his adult life.
examples.translation_cn: 他成年后的大部分时间从事石工行业。

senses.meaning_en: the work or performance of a mason

examples.text: The old church was built of solid masonry.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老教堂是用坚固的砖石建成的。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to stop or control

examples.text: His compulsive gambling eventually destroyed his marriage and career.
examples.translation_cn: 他难以控制的赌博习惯最终毁了他的婚姻和事业。

senses.meaning_en: unable to stop doing something

examples.text: As a compulsive gambler, he spent all his savings in one night.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一个不能自制的赌徒，他一夜之间花光了所有积蓄。

senses.meaning_en: so interesting or exciting that you cannot stop reading or watching

examples.text: The documentary was compulsive viewing from start to finish.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片从头到尾都引人入胜。

senses.meaning_en: a person or company that buys goods in large quantities and sells them to retailers

examples.text: The company is a major wholesaler of fresh produce.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司是新鲜农产品的主要批发商。

senses.meaning_en: occurring after a surgical operation

examples.text: The nurse checked her vital signs in the postoperative period.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在术后期间检查了她的生命体征。

senses.meaning_en: easily annoyed or made angry

examples.text: He is often irritable with his colleagues when he is under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 他压力大时常常对同事发脾气。

senses.meaning_en: very sensitive and easily inflamed

examples.text: She suffers from irritable bowel syndrome and avoids many foods.
examples.translation_cn: 她患有肠易激综合征，要避开很多食物。

senses.meaning_en: warm and comfortable; cosy

examples.text: We were snug in our sleeping bags as the temperature dropped.
examples.translation_cn: 气温下降时，我们睡在睡袋里很温暖舒适。

senses.meaning_en: close-fitting

examples.text: The jacket is a little snug around the shoulders.
examples.translation_cn: 这件夹克肩部有点紧。

senses.meaning_en: small, neat and compact; sheltered

examples.text: They live in a snug little cottage by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在河边一栋小巧整洁的村舍里。

senses.meaning_en: a small comfortable back room in a pub

examples.text: We sat in the snug until closing time.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在酒吧包间里坐到打烊。

senses.meaning_en: a poisonous liquid produced by animals such as snakes or spiders

examples.text: The snake injects venom into its prey to immobilize it.
examples.translation_cn: 蛇向猎物注入毒液使其不能动弹。

senses.meaning_en: strong bitter anger or hatred shown in speech or behaviour

examples.text: She spoke with venom about her former boss.
examples.translation_cn: 她谈起前老板时语带恶意。

senses.meaning_en: to damage something very badly or destroy it

examples.text: A huge fire ravaged the forest last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 去年夏天一场大火严重毁坏了森林。

senses.meaning_en: the destructive effects of something

examples.text: The ancient walls show the ravages of time.
examples.translation_cn: 古老的城墙显示出时间的破坏痕迹。

senses.meaning_en: to overcome or deal successfully with (a difficulty, problem, etc.)

examples.text: With patience and support, they were able to surmount difficulties.
examples.translation_cn: 凭借耐心和支持，他们得以克服困难。

senses.meaning_en: to cap; to sit on top of; to cover the top of

examples.text: The monument is surmounted by a bronze eagle.
examples.translation_cn: 纪念碑顶部是一只青铜鹰。

senses.meaning_en: to climb over or reach the top of (a mountain, wall, etc.)

examples.text: Their goal was to surmount a mountain before sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的目标是在日落前翻越一座山。

senses.meaning_en: very hot; of tremendous heat

examples.text: The pavement was blazing hot in the afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 午后的人行道热得发烫。

senses.meaning_en: burning brightly and strongly; extremely bright

examples.text: The torches were blazing brightly in the dark.
examples.translation_cn: 火把在黑暗中熊熊燃烧，十分耀眼。

senses.meaning_en: very fast

examples.text: He drove at blazing speed along the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 他在公路上以极快的速度行驶。

senses.meaning_en: exceedingly angry

examples.text: She was blazing with anger after the unfair decision.
examples.translation_cn: 这个不公的决定让她愤怒不已。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement of events in the order in which they happened; often presented as a timeline

examples.text: The museum exhibit presents a chronology of events from the civil rights movement.
examples.translation_cn: 该博物馆展览呈现民权运动事件年表。

senses.meaning_en: the science or method of determining the order of past events

examples.text: Radiocarbon dating is essential for establishing the chronology of prehistoric sites.
examples.translation_cn: 放射性碳定年法对于确定史前遗址的年代顺序至关重要。
