examples.translation_cn: 他们穿着用家纺粗布做的外套。

senses.meaning_en: simple and plain; unsophisticated

examples.text: The inn has a homespun charm that guests love.
examples.translation_cn: 这家客栈有一种客人喜爱的朴素魅力。

senses.meaning_en: in an ingenious manner; cleverly and originally

examples.text: The new folding bike is ingeniously designed to fit in a backpack.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆新折叠自行车设计巧妙，可以装进背包。

senses.meaning_en: in an impartial manner; fairly

examples.text: A good manager should treat all employees impartially.
examples.translation_cn: 一位好的管理者应该公正地对待所有员工。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate or mark a surface with a design in relief

examples.text: The diary cover was embossed with her initials.
examples.translation_cn: 日记封面压印着她名字首字母的浮雕。

senses.meaning_en: to make a design stand out from a surface

examples.text: The hotel's name was embossed on the stationery.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店的名字凸印在信纸上。

senses.meaning_en: willing to help others or make things easier

examples.text: The staff were very accommodating to our needs.
examples.translation_cn: 工作人员对我们的需求非常乐于通融。

senses.meaning_en: believing without question; completely loyal and uncritical

examples.text: The soldiers followed their commander's orders with unquestioning obedience.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们不假思索地执行了指挥官的命令。

senses.meaning_en: not deserved or merited; unfair

examples.text: The harsh criticism he received was completely undeserved.
examples.translation_cn: 他受到的严厉批评完全是不应有的。

senses.meaning_en: the act of making something easier or more likely to happen

examples.text: The facilitation of trade between the two countries has boosted economic growth.
examples.translation_cn: 两国间贸易的便利化促进了经济增长。

senses.meaning_en: the act of helping a group to have a discussion or reach agreement

examples.text: Skilled facilitation of a meeting can help participants reach consensus.
examples.translation_cn: 熟练的会议引导能帮助与会者达成共识。

senses.meaning_en: in a reverent manner; with deep respect

examples.text: He always speaks reverently of his former teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是恭敬地谈起他以前的老师。

senses.meaning_en: insolent, ill-mannered, or disrespectful
senses.pattern: it is impertinent of sb to do sth

examples.text: It was impertinent of her to ask about his salary.
examples.translation_cn: 她打听他的薪水，这很无礼。

senses.meaning_en: deserving or causing public disgrace; shameful

examples.text: The corrupt senator met an ignominious end after the scandal broke.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻曝光后，那名腐败的参议员落得个耻辱的下场。

senses.meaning_en: to cover something with a thin layer of gold or gold leaf

examples.text: The artist gilded the old frame with gold leaf.
examples.translation_cn: 艺术家用金箔给旧画框镀金。

senses.meaning_en: to make something look bright or golden; to give a pleasing aspect to something

examples.text: The setting sun gilded the lake with golden light.
examples.translation_cn: 夕阳给湖面洒上一层金光。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem better or more attractive than it really is

examples.text: He gilded the truth to make the news sound less alarming.
examples.translation_cn: 他粉饰事实，好让消息听起来不那么令人担忧。

senses.meaning_en: to waste time or money on unimportant things

examples.text: Don't fritter away your money on useless gadgets.
examples.translation_cn: 别把钱浪费在无用的东西上。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of batter fried in hot oil, often containing fruit or meat

examples.text: He ordered a corn fritter with maple syrup.
examples.translation_cn: 他点了一个配枫糖浆的玉米炸饼。

senses.meaning_en: an act of plundering or destroying, especially crops or livestock

examples.text: Farmers have reported serious depredations on their crops by wild boars.
examples.translation_cn: 农民报告说野猪对他们的庄稼造成了严重破坏。

senses.meaning_en: without previous thought or preparation; immediately

examples.text: I can't say offhand how much the repair will cost.
examples.translation_cn: 我一时说不准修理要花多少钱。

senses.meaning_en: careless or unfriendly; curt

examples.text: She was rather offhand with the waiter, which embarrassed her friend.
examples.translation_cn: 她对服务员很唐突，这让她的朋友很尴尬。

senses.meaning_en: agreement; mutual consent

examples.text: The plan was approved with the concurrence of all committee members.
examples.translation_cn: 该计划经全体委员会成员同意后获得批准。

senses.meaning_en: simultaneous occurrence
senses.pattern: the concurrence of X and Y

examples.text: The fire was caused by the concurrence of high winds and dry weather.
examples.translation_cn: 这场火灾是由大风和干燥天气同时出现引起的。

senses.meaning_en: a person who wrangles horses or cattle; a cowboy who takes care of saddle horses

examples.text: He works as a wrangler on a horse ranch in Texas.
examples.translation_cn: 他在得克萨斯州的一个牧马场当牧马人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who handles or trains animals, especially on film sets

examples.text: She works as an animal wrangler on film sets.
examples.translation_cn: 她在电影片场担任动物驯养员。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that can burn easily

examples.text: Combustibles are stored in a separate, fire-resistant cabinet.
examples.translation_cn: 易燃物存放在单独的防火柜中。

senses.meaning_en: easily becoming angry or excited

examples.text: He has a combustible temperament and often argues over small issues.
examples.translation_cn: 他性情易怒，经常为小事争吵。

senses.meaning_en: able to catch fire and burn easily

examples.text: These vapors are highly combustible and can ignite at low temperatures.
examples.translation_cn: 这些蒸气高度易燃，低温下可能引燃。

senses.meaning_en: a plant with blue flowers, grown for its fibre and seeds

examples.text: Farmers grow flax for its fibre and seeds on this coastal plain.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在这片沿海平原种植亚麻以获取纤维和种子。

senses.meaning_en: the fibres of the flax plant, used to make linen and related textiles

examples.text: The workers spin flax into strong linen thread.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们把亚麻纤维纺成结实的亚麻线。

senses.meaning_en: a sailboat with one mast and a single headsail

examples.text: They spent the afternoon aboard a sloop, learning to trim the sails.
examples.translation_cn: 他们整个下午都在一艘单桅帆船上学习调整帆。

senses.meaning_en: full of energy and playfulness

examples.text: The puppies were frisky after their long nap and chased each other around the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 小狗们睡了长觉后很活泼，在花园里互相追逐。

senses.meaning_en: sexually excited

examples.text: After the romantic dinner, they got frisky with each other on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 浪漫晚餐后，他们在沙发上亲热起来。

senses.meaning_en: the act or result of describing or depicting something precisely

examples.text: The report provides a clear delineation of each department's duties.
examples.translation_cn: 报告清楚描述了各部门的职责。

senses.meaning_en: an image or drawing that shows the outline of something

examples.text: The map shows a precise delineation of the island's coastline.
examples.translation_cn: 地图精确勾勒出该岛的海岸线。

senses.meaning_en: a line on a map from the North Pole to the South Pole, used for measuring longitude

examples.text: All points on the same meridian share the same longitude.
examples.translation_cn: 同一经线上的所有点都有相同的经度。

senses.meaning_en: the highest point or stage of development

examples.text: Her career was at its meridian in the 1990s.
examples.translation_cn: 她的职业生涯在20世纪90年代达到顶峰。

senses.meaning_en: the science or practice of growing flowers, fruit, and vegetables

examples.text: She plans to study horticulture at a local agricultural college.
examples.translation_cn: 她计划在当地农学院学习园艺学。

senses.meaning_en: small-scale crop production, often for local use

examples.text: On small farms, many families rely on horticulture for food and income.
examples.translation_cn: 在小农场，许多家庭依靠小规模种植获取食物和收入。

senses.meaning_en: allowing liquids or gases to pass through

examples.text: This rock is permeable to water and air.
examples.translation_cn: 这种岩石可渗透水和空气。

senses.meaning_en: allowing people, information, or influences to pass through

examples.text: The organization is quite permeable to outside influence.
examples.translation_cn: 该组织很容易受到外部影响。

senses.meaning_en: quiet and inactive; at rest

examples.text: The volcano has remained quiescent for over a century.
examples.translation_cn: 这座火山已经沉寂了一个多世纪。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden violent event that causes great change or destruction

examples.text: The asteroid impact brought about a cataclysm that wiped out the dinosaurs.
examples.translation_cn: 小行星撞击引发了一场使恐龙灭绝的大灾难。

senses.meaning_en: to become septic; to become rotten

examples.text: If a wound festers, it becomes red, swollen, and painful.
examples.translation_cn: 如果伤口化脓，会变得红肿疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: to worsen, especially due to lack of attention

examples.text: A small misunderstanding can fester into a bitter quarrel.
examples.translation_cn: 小小的误解可能恶化成激烈的争吵。

senses.meaning_en: not offensive

examples.text: The audience found the comedian's remarks completely inoffensive.
examples.translation_cn: 观众觉得那位喜剧演员的言论完全没有冒犯性。

senses.meaning_en: harmless

examples.text: The tiny spider is inoffensive and rarely bites.
examples.translation_cn: 这种小蜘蛛无害，很少咬人。

senses.meaning_en: a green pigment found in plants that absorbs light for photosynthesis

examples.text: Plant leaves contain chlorophyll, which absorbs light energy for photosynthesis.
examples.translation_cn: 植物叶片含有叶绿素，能吸收光能进行光合作用。

senses.meaning_en: becoming gradually narrower toward one end

examples.text: This tropical bird has a long, tapering tail.
examples.translation_cn: 这只热带鸟有一条长长的、逐渐变细的尾巴。

senses.meaning_en: to chew the cud again

examples.text: Cows often ruminate for hours after grazing in the field.
examples.translation_cn: 牛在田野吃草后常常反刍几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to think deeply about something

examples.text: She ruminated on his words for a long time.
examples.translation_cn: 她长时间反复思考他的话。

senses.meaning_en: in the direction opposite to the rotation of clock hands

examples.text: Turn the dial counterclockwise to reduce the volume.
examples.translation_cn: 逆时针转动旋钮以减小音量。

senses.meaning_en: moving or located in the direction opposite to the rotation of clock hands

examples.text: The storm rotated in a counterclockwise direction over the ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 风暴在海洋上空逆时针旋转。

senses.meaning_en: clever but sometimes dishonest behaviour used to deceive people

examples.text: The prisoner escaped by guile, hiding in a laundry cart.
examples.translation_cn: 囚犯施诡计躲进洗衣车逃走了。

senses.meaning_en: to deceive or trick someone

examples.text: The dishonest salesman guiled the couple into signing an unfair contract.
examples.translation_cn: 那个不诚实的推销员哄骗那对夫妇签下不公平合同。

senses.meaning_en: to catch and hold someone or something in a trap or difficult situation

examples.text: The miners were entrapped in the tunnel after the collapse.
examples.translation_cn: 矿工在坍塌后被堵在了隧道里。

senses.meaning_en: to trick or lure someone into a dangerous situation or into doing something wrong or illegal, especially to get evidence

examples.text: The police entrapped the suspect into attempting to bribe an officer.
examples.translation_cn: 警方设圈套诱使该嫌疑人企图向一名警官行贿。

senses.meaning_en: manufactured in advance for quick assembly on site

examples.text: The hospital was built from prefabricated parts in just ten days.
examples.translation_cn: 这所医院仅用十天就用预制构件建成了。

senses.meaning_en: produced in advance; not spontaneous

examples.text: The suspect's apology sounded prefabricated and completely unconvincing.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人的道歉听起来像预先编造的，完全没有说服力。

senses.meaning_en: to make something dirty or unclean

examples.text: The factory defiled the river with chemical waste.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂用化学废料污染了河流。

senses.meaning_en: to make something morally impure or to tarnish it

examples.text: The article defiled his reputation with false accusations.
examples.translation_cn: 那篇文章用不实指控玷污了他的名誉。

senses.meaning_en: to bring about the catalysis of a chemical reaction

examples.text: Enzymes catalyze a chemical reaction in the cell.
examples.translation_cn: 酶在细胞中催化化学反应。

senses.meaning_en: to accelerate or inspire a process or change

examples.text: New technology often catalyzes changes in modern industry.
examples.translation_cn: 新技术常常促成现代工业的变革。

senses.meaning_en: to indicate or be evidence of; show

examples.text: Her generous donation bespeaks a deeply caring nature.
examples.translation_cn: 她慷慨的捐赠表明她天性非常关心他人。

senses.meaning_en: a car licensed to transport passengers for a fare, usually fitted with a taximeter

examples.text: We took a taxicab from the hotel to the station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们从酒店坐出租车去了车站。

senses.meaning_en: a member of the family Hominidae, including humans and great apes

examples.text: The skull belongs to an early hominid that lived about three million years ago.
examples.translation_cn: 这块头骨属于一种生活在约三百万年前的早期人科动物。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the family Hominidae

examples.text: Hominid evolution spans more than six million years.
examples.translation_cn: 人科动物的进化跨越了六百多万年。

senses.meaning_en: a device that shows the time by a shadow cast by a pointer on a marked dial

examples.text: The shadow on the sundial showed that it was noon.
examples.translation_cn: 日晷上的影子表明当时是正午。

senses.meaning_en: a small ape with long arms that swings from branch to branch

examples.text: Gibbons are found in the rainforests of Southeast Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 长臂猿见于东南亚的热带雨林。

senses.meaning_en: calm and not easily excited to action or passion; sluggish

examples.text: He remained phlegmatic about the sudden change in plans.
examples.translation_cn: 他对计划的突然改变保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: determined to do as one pleases; willful

examples.text: She is headstrong and rarely listens to advice.
examples.translation_cn: 她很任性，很少听人劝告。

senses.meaning_en: abnormally thin and weak, typically due to illness or lack of food

examples.text: The prisoner was emaciated from months of starvation.
examples.translation_cn: 那名囚犯因数月的饥饿而极度消瘦。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that gives crucial help in a difficult situation

examples.text: The spare tire was a lifesaver for our desert drive.
examples.translation_cn: 备用轮胎是我们沙漠之旅的救星。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rescues someone from drowning or danger

examples.text: She worked as a lifesaver at the local pool last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年夏天在本地游泳池当救生员。

senses.meaning_en: Awkward or lacking social grace
senses.pattern: it is gauche to do sth

examples.text: It is gauche to ask how much someone earns.
examples.translation_cn: 问别人挣多少钱是不老练的。

senses.meaning_en: covered with spines or thorns

examples.text: The desert plant is covered with spiny leaves to keep animals away.
examples.translation_cn: 这种沙漠植物长满带刺的叶子以驱赶动物。

senses.meaning_en: difficult or troublesome

examples.text: The committee avoided a spiny issue about tax reform.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会回避了一个棘手的税收改革问题。

senses.meaning_en: to trick or deceive someone, often by being charming

examples.text: The salesman beguiled the elderly woman into buying worthless insurance.
examples.translation_cn: 推销员诱骗那位老妇人购买了毫无价值的保险。

senses.meaning_en: to charm, delight or captivate

examples.text: Visitors are beguiled by the charm of the old town.
examples.translation_cn: 游客们被古镇的魅力迷住了。

senses.meaning_en: to cause time to pass pleasantly

examples.text: They beguiled the time with board games and stories.
examples.translation_cn: 他们以桌游和故事消磨时间。

senses.meaning_en: having enormous strength or size

examples.text: The wrestler lifted the fallen log with herculean strength.
examples.translation_cn: 这位摔跤手以神力举起了倒下的原木。

senses.meaning_en: requiring a huge amount of effort

examples.text: Completing the bridge on time was a herculean task.
examples.translation_cn: 按时建成这座桥是一项艰巨的任务。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being shy and lacking confidence

examples.text: She tried to overcome her timidity and speak to the group.
examples.translation_cn: 她努力克服自己的胆怯，去和小组说话。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being easily frightened or hesitant to act

examples.text: His timidity in the face of danger surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 他在危险面前的怯懦令所有人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: a secret way of writing messages

examples.text: The spy sent the message in cipher to headquarters.
examples.translation_cn: 间谍用密码把消息发到了总部。

senses.meaning_en: a person of no importance or influence

examples.text: He felt like a mere cipher in the huge company.
examples.translation_cn: 在这家大公司里，他觉得自己只是个无足轻重的人。

senses.meaning_en: a person who paddles a canoe or kayak

examples.text: A paddler in a kayak steered skillfully through the narrow channel.
examples.translation_cn: 皮划艇桨手熟练地驾驶着穿过狭窄的水道。

senses.meaning_en: a large fish-eating bird of prey with long narrow wings

examples.text: We watched an osprey dive into the lake and seize a fish.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看着一只鱼鹰俯冲入湖并抓住一条鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a formal, often ceremonial speech

examples.text: The university president delivered an oration at the graduation ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 大学校长在毕业典礼上发表了演说。

senses.meaning_en: a lengthy speech or argument in a private setting

examples.text: He gave us an oration on the importance of punctuality.
examples.translation_cn: 他给我们就守时的重要性发表了一通长篇大论。

senses.meaning_en: untidy in appearance; unkempt

examples.text: He looked slovenly in his wrinkled shirt and uncombed hair.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿着皱巴巴的衬衫，头发也没梳，看上去邋里邋遢。

senses.meaning_en: careless and disorderly; dirty and unwashed

examples.text: He is slovenly in his work, leaving dirty cups and papers everywhere.
examples.translation_cn: 他工作马虎，脏杯子和文件到处乱放。

senses.meaning_en: the ability of a material to conduct electricity, heat, fluid, or sound

examples.text: The conductivity of copper makes it ideal for electrical wiring.
examples.translation_cn: 铜的传导性使其成为电线的理想材料。

senses.meaning_en: a measure of how well a material conducts electricity, equal to the reciprocal of resistivity

examples.text: We can measure the conductivity of a solution to estimate its salt content.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以测量溶液的电导率来估算其盐含量。

senses.meaning_en: based on a false or misleading idea

examples.text: It is fallacious to assume that correlation proves causation.
examples.translation_cn: 认为相关关系意味着因果关系是谬误的。

senses.meaning_en: a large heavy animal with thick skin and one or two horns on its nose

examples.text: A rhinoceros has thick skin and one or two horns on its nose.
examples.translation_cn: 犀牛有厚皮，鼻子上长着一只或两只角。

senses.meaning_en: ability to produce offspring

examples.text: The fecundity of rabbits is essential for the survival of the species.
examples.translation_cn: 兔子的繁殖力对该物种的生存至关重要。

senses.meaning_en: fertility of soil or land; capacity to produce abundant crops

examples.text: Farmers depend on the fecundity of the soil for good harvests.
examples.translation_cn: 农民依靠土壤的肥沃获得好收成。

senses.meaning_en: ability to cause growth or increase; creative productivity

examples.text: The fecundity of her imagination produced three novels in two years.
examples.translation_cn: 她丰富的想象力使她在两年内写出了三部小说。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to move from place to place, or the act of doing so

examples.text: Many bacteria use their flagella for locomotion in water.
examples.translation_cn: 许多细菌在水中利用鞭毛移动。

senses.meaning_en: to steal or misappropriate money one has been trusted with

examples.text: The finance director embezzled money from the charity for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 该财务主管从慈善机构盗用资金长达五年。

senses.meaning_en: having a lot of space inside; roomy

examples.text: The museum has a capacious hall for large exhibitions.
examples.translation_cn: 这个博物馆有一个宽敞的大厅，用于大型展览。

senses.meaning_en: a state of physical or mental inactivity and reduced alertness

examples.text: After the long flight, he sat in a state of torpor on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 长途飞行后，他坐在沙发上，处于迟钝麻木的状态。

senses.meaning_en: a state of deep sleep in animals to save energy

examples.text: Some hummingbirds enter torpor at night to conserve energy.
examples.translation_cn: 一些蜂鸟夜间进入蛰伏状态以节省能量。

senses.meaning_en: an alcoholic drink

examples.text: He likes to have a tipple after work.
examples.translation_cn: 他喜欢下班后喝点酒。

senses.meaning_en: to drink alcohol, especially regularly in small amounts

examples.text: She tipples a little wine with dinner most evenings.
examples.translation_cn: 她大多数晚上吃晚饭时都会喝一点葡萄酒。

senses.meaning_en: to pay out money, especially from a public fund or treasury

examples.text: The state agency will disburse funds to families affected by the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 该州立机构将向受洪水影响的家庭拨付资金。

senses.meaning_en: shy and easily embarrassed

examples.text: He was too bashful to ask her to dance.
examples.translation_cn: 他太害羞，不敢请她跳舞。

senses.meaning_en: the distance from one wingtip to the other

examples.text: The golden eagle has a wingspan of over two metres.
examples.translation_cn: 金雕的翼展超过两米。

senses.meaning_en: the distance from fingertip to fingertip with arms stretched out

examples.text: The coach measured each player's wingspan before the draft.
examples.translation_cn: 教练在选秀前测量了每位球员的臂展。

senses.meaning_en: to cause or encourage trouble, rebellion, or violence

examples.text: He was arrested for fomenting rebellion among the workers.
examples.translation_cn: 他因在工人中煽动叛乱而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to apply a poultice to; to bathe with a cloth or sponge

examples.text: The nurse fomented his injured knee with a warm cloth.
examples.translation_cn: 护士用热布热敷他受伤的膝盖。

senses.meaning_en: a medical operation to tighten the skin of the face to make someone look younger

examples.text: She decided to undergo a facelift before her wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 她决定在婚礼前做面部拉皮手术。

senses.meaning_en: changes made to improve the appearance of something

examples.text: The owners gave the old hotel a facelift last year.
examples.translation_cn: 业主去年给这家老酒店做了翻新。

senses.meaning_en: to perform a facelift on someone or something

examples.text: The brand facelifted its packaging to attract younger buyers.
examples.translation_cn: 该品牌改进了包装以吸引年轻买家。

senses.meaning_en: a violent or brutal man; a thug or scoundrel

examples.text: A ruffian who tried to rob a bank was caught.
examples.translation_cn: 一个试图抢银行的暴徒被抓住了。

senses.meaning_en: lack of intelligence or sense; extremely foolish behaviour

examples.text: The idiocy of the decision soon became obvious.
examples.translation_cn: 这个决定的愚蠢之处很快变得明显。

senses.meaning_en: an idiotic act or utterance

examples.text: He apologized for the series of idiocies he uttered during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他为在会上说的一连串蠢话道歉。

senses.meaning_en: to make it difficult for someone or something to move or act freely

examples.text: The rescue team was encumbered by thick mud and could not reach the village.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队被厚厚的泥浆拖累，无法到达村庄。

senses.meaning_en: to load someone or something with a heavy burden, especially debt or legal obligation

examples.text: The young couple was encumbered with student loans and a large mortgage.
examples.translation_cn: 这对年轻夫妇背负着学生贷款和巨额抵押贷款。

senses.meaning_en: to remove frost or ice from something

examples.text: You should defrost the freezer every few months.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该每隔几个月给冰箱除霜一次。

senses.meaning_en: to thaw frozen food

examples.text: You should defrost the chicken in the fridge overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 你应该把鸡放进冰箱冷藏室解冻一夜。

senses.meaning_en: generally believed or considered to be something

examples.text: She is reputed to be the best chef in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 据说她是该地区最好的厨师。

senses.meaning_en: said to be, but not definitely known or proven

examples.text: The reputed leader of the gang was arrested last night.
examples.translation_cn: 那个据说是黑帮头目的人昨晚被捕。

senses.meaning_en: to speak or act evasively; avoid giving a direct answer

examples.text: The witness prevaricated about his whereabouts that night.
examples.translation_cn: 证人对自己当晚的行踪含糊其辞。

senses.meaning_en: a substance added to food or drink to give it a particular taste

examples.text: Add a little flavoring to the soup and taste it again.
examples.translation_cn: 往汤里加一点调味料，然后再尝尝。

senses.meaning_en: glowing; radiant

examples.text: The evening sky was aglow with orange and pink light.
examples.translation_cn: 傍晚的天空被橙粉色的光芒照亮。

senses.meaning_en: showing excitement or happiness

examples.text: Her face was aglow with excitement when she opened the gift.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开礼物时，脸上因兴奋而容光焕发。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of the atmosphere and weather

examples.text: She studied meteorology at university and now works as a weather forecaster.
examples.translation_cn: 她大学学习气象学，现在是一名天气预报员。

senses.meaning_en: to officially charge someone in a court of law

examples.text: The suspect was arraigned on fraud charges in federal court.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人因欺诈指控在联邦法院被提审。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being frugal; careful use of money

examples.text: Her frugality in daily spending allowed her to retire early.
examples.translation_cn: 她在日常开支上的节俭使她得以提前退休。

senses.meaning_en: to hide or move around secretly, especially because you are planning something bad or feel guilty

examples.text: A thief was seen skulking around the empty car park.
examples.translation_cn: 有人看见一个小偷在空停车场里鬼鬼祟祟地走动。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid an obligation or responsibility

examples.text: He tried to skulk out of taking the blame for the mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他试图逃避承担错误的责任。

senses.meaning_en: the floor or bottom of the sea or ocean

examples.text: Marine archaeologists discovered shipwrecks resting on the seabed.
examples.translation_cn: 海洋考古学家发现了躺在海底的沉船。

senses.meaning_en: to behave in a particular way

examples.text: He comported himself with dignity throughout the trial.
examples.translation_cn: 他在整个审判过程中举止庄重。

senses.meaning_en: to agree or be consistent with something

examples.text: His version of events does not comport with the evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 他对事件的描述与证据不符。

senses.meaning_en: to ring a bell slowly, especially for a funeral

examples.text: The village church bell knelled for the war dead at noon.
examples.translation_cn: 村里的教堂钟在正午为战争死难者缓缓鸣响。

senses.meaning_en: to signal or proclaim something (especially a death) by ringing a bell

examples.text: The cathedral bells knelled the death of the old bishop.
examples.translation_cn: 大教堂的钟声宣告了老主教的死讯。

senses.meaning_en: the sound of a bell knelling; a toll

examples.text: They heard the knell of the old chapel at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 天刚亮时他们听到了旧教堂的丧钟声。

senses.meaning_en: a sign of the end or demise of something
senses.pattern: sound the death knell for sth
senses.collocation: a death knell for the industry

examples.text: The rise of streaming sounded the death knell for video rental stores.
examples.translation_cn: 流媒体的兴起为录像带租赁店敲响了丧钟。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used for cooling, as in refrigerators and air conditioners

examples.text: Industrial refrigeration systems often use ammonia as a refrigerant.
examples.translation_cn: 工业制冷系统常用氨作为制冷剂。

senses.meaning_en: a small edible fish of the family Osmeridae

examples.text: Fishermen spotted a shoal of smelt near the river mouth.
examples.translation_cn: 渔民在河口附近发现了一群胡瓜鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to heat ore to extract metal

examples.text: The factory smelts iron ore into pure metal.
examples.translation_cn: 这家工厂将铁矿石熔炼成纯金属。

senses.meaning_en: a secret political group

examples.text: A cabal of generals seized power in the early hours.
examples.translation_cn: 一群将军组成的阴谋集团在凌晨夺取了政权。

senses.meaning_en: a secret plot

examples.text: They hatched a cabal to assassinate the prime minister.
examples.translation_cn: 他们密谋暗杀首相。

senses.meaning_en: a cover placed over a lamp to soften or direct its light

examples.text: A silk lampshade on a brass lamp gave the room a warm glow.
examples.translation_cn: 黄铜灯上的丝绸灯罩给房间带来了温暖的光。

senses.meaning_en: elegant and well-bred manners

examples.text: She behaves with gentility even in a heated argument.
examples.translation_cn: 即使在激烈争论中她也表现得文雅。

senses.meaning_en: people of high social class

examples.text: He spent his holidays among the local gentility at the resort.
examples.translation_cn: 他在度假胜地与当地上流社会人士共度假期。

senses.meaning_en: very happy, especially at someone else's defeat or failure

examples.text: The fans were exultant over their rival's defeat.
examples.translation_cn: 球迷们对对手的失利欣喜若狂。

senses.meaning_en: of a yellowish or sickly pale colour, especially of face

examples.text: The patient looked sallow after months of chemotherapy.
examples.translation_cn: 经过几个月的化疗，病人脸色蜡黄。

senses.meaning_en: a person who writes satire

examples.text: The satirist of modern politics has written a sharp new play.
examples.translation_cn: 这位以现代政治为讽刺对象的作家写了一部犀利的新剧。

senses.meaning_en: to make a substance uniform in consistency

examples.text: The dairy homogenizes milk to keep the cream from separating.
examples.translation_cn: 乳品厂对牛奶进行均质处理，防止奶油分离。

senses.meaning_en: to make things similar or uniform, often reducing diversity

examples.text: Mass tourism is rapidly homogenizing local cultures across the region.
examples.translation_cn: 大众旅游业正在迅速使该地区的本土文化趋于同质化。

senses.meaning_en: to become uniform in consistency or character

examples.text: Over the centuries, local dialects gradually homogenized into a national language.
examples.translation_cn: 几个世纪以来，各地方言逐渐同质化为一种全国性语言。

senses.meaning_en: greedy and taking by force

examples.text: The company is rapacious for land and has displaced many local farmers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司对土地贪得无厌，已经迫使许多当地农民迁离。

senses.meaning_en: to do something in a way that shows you think you are too important to do it

examples.text: He did not deign to answer our questions.
examples.translation_cn: 他不屑于回答我们的问题。

senses.meaning_en: a style of jazz piano music with a syncopated rhythm

examples.text: My grandfather loved to play ragtime on the piano after supper.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父喜欢晚饭后在钢琴上弹拉格泰姆音乐。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of music in ragtime style

examples.text: The band closed the set with a lively ragtime tune.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队以一首欢快的拉格泰姆乐曲结束了演出。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone appear guilty or show their guilt

examples.text: The lawyer warned him not to incriminate himself during cross-examination.
examples.translation_cn: 律师警告他在交叉质证时不要自证其罪。

senses.meaning_en: a large bee of the genus Bombus

examples.text: Bumblebees pollinate a wide range of wildflowers and crops.
examples.translation_cn: 大黄蜂为多种野花和农作物授粉。

senses.meaning_en: unable to stop taking or using a harmful substance, especially a drug

examples.text: She has been addicted to alcohol for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她对酒精上瘾已经十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: liking something so much that you spend too much time or money on it

examples.text: He is addicted to playing video games every night.
examples.translation_cn: 他每晚都沉迷于玩电子游戏。

senses.meaning_en: a house that provides lodging and meals for paying guests

examples.text: They stayed at a quiet boardinghouse near the beach for two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在海滩附近一家安静的寄宿公寓住了两周。

senses.meaning_en: clear and transparent

examples.text: After the rain, the stream was limpid and calm.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后，溪流清澈而平静。

senses.meaning_en: clear and simple to understand

examples.text: He explains the theory in limpid prose that students can follow.
examples.translation_cn: 他用清晰明快的文字解释这个理论，学生都能跟上。

senses.meaning_en: a chain or shackle placed around a prisoner's leg

examples.text: The prisoners were led into the courtroom in fetters.
examples.translation_cn: 囚犯们戴着脚镣被带进法庭。

senses.meaning_en: something that restricts or restrains

examples.text: She finally managed to break the fetters of convention.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于设法摆脱了习俗的束缚。

senses.meaning_en: to restrain, impede, or shackle

examples.text: The economy is often fettered by excessive government regulation.
examples.translation_cn: 经济常因过度的政府监管而受束缚。

senses.meaning_en: from which the water has been removed

examples.text: Dehydrated food is light and keeps for months.
examples.translation_cn: 脱水食品轻便，可保存数月。

senses.meaning_en: suffering from dehydration

examples.text: The runner was badly dehydrated after the race.
examples.translation_cn: 那名赛跑者在比赛后严重脱水。

senses.meaning_en: the hard shell on the back of some animals

examples.text: The carapace of a sea turtle is composed of fused ribs.
examples.translation_cn: 海龟的背甲由融合的肋骨构成。

senses.meaning_en: a protective outer layer or attitude

examples.text: She hides behind a carapace of sarcasm to protect herself.
examples.translation_cn: 她躲在讽刺的外壳后面保护自己。

senses.meaning_en: to damage someone's reputation by saying or writing untrue things about them

examples.text: The newspaper publicly defamed the mayor by printing unverified allegations.
examples.translation_cn: 这家报纸通过刊登未经证实的指控公开诽谤了市长。

senses.meaning_en: a place where weapons are stored

examples.text: The soldiers keep their weapons in the armory near the barracks.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们把武器存放在军营附近的军械库中。

senses.meaning_en: a large collection of useful things

examples.text: The library is an armory of ideas for young writers.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆是年轻作家的思想宝库。

senses.meaning_en: having a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements

examples.text: The rhythmical beat of the drums made everyone want to dance.
examples.translation_cn: 鼓声的节奏让每个人都想跳舞。

senses.meaning_en: a skilled woodworker who makes high-quality wooden cabinets and furniture

examples.text: He works as a cabinetmaker in a small workshop, building custom cabinets and tables.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家小作坊当家具木工，制作定制柜子和桌子。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel nervous, confused, or embarrassed

examples.text: She was disconcerted by his sudden change of tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她被他突然的语气变化弄得不安。

senses.meaning_en: present from birth; natural rather than learned

examples.text: Her compassion seems to be inborn rather than learned.
examples.translation_cn: 她的同情心似乎是与生俱来的，而不是后天习得的。

senses.meaning_en: to destroy or weaken something, leaving it ineffective

examples.text: The amendments would eviscerate the existing privacy law.
examples.translation_cn: 这些修正案会掏空现行隐私法的实质。

senses.meaning_en: to remove the internal organs of a person or animal

examples.text: The animal was eviscerated as part of the ritual.
examples.translation_cn: 这只动物作为仪式的一部分被取出内脏。

senses.meaning_en: in an extraordinary or amazing way

examples.text: Her first novel was phenomenally successful in several countries.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一部小说在几个国家取得了惊人的成功。

senses.meaning_en: careless; unaware

examples.text: He walked on, heedless of the traffic around him.
examples.translation_cn: 他继续走，对周围的车辆毫不在意。

senses.meaning_en: a vein of metallic ore that lies within definite boundaries or a fissure

examples.text: They discovered a lode of copper ore deep in the hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在山坡深处发现了一条铜矿矿脉。

senses.meaning_en: a rich source or supply of something

examples.text: The old letters proved to be a rich lode of family history.
examples.translation_cn: 这些旧信件原来是一座丰富的家族史宝库。

senses.meaning_en: relating to diet

examples.text: The clinic offers dietetic advice about healthy eating.
examples.translation_cn: 诊所提供关于健康饮食的饮食建议。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the preparation of food for people on a restricted diet

examples.text: The company produces dietetic foods for patients with food allergies.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司为食物过敏患者生产特殊饮食食品。

senses.meaning_en: a person trained to examine eyes and prescribe glasses or contact lenses

examples.text: If you have frequent headaches or blurred vision, you should see an optometrist.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你经常头痛或视力模糊，就应该去看验光师。

senses.meaning_en: not prudent; lacking care or wisdom about consequences

examples.text: It is imprudent to invest all your savings in one stock.
examples.translation_cn: 把所有积蓄都投到一只股票上是不谨慎的。

senses.meaning_en: to drink (especially alcoholic beverages)

examples.text: The guests imbibed red wine and chatted late into the night.
examples.translation_cn: 客人们喝着红酒，一直聊到深夜。

senses.meaning_en: to absorb or take in (ideas, knowledge, etc.)

examples.text: She imbibed a love of music from her father.
examples.translation_cn: 她从父亲那里汲取了对音乐的热爱。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to accept something they do not want

examples.text: The company tried to foist hidden charges on unsuspecting customers.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司试图把隐性收费强加给不知情的顾客。

senses.meaning_en: to pass off as genuine or worthy
senses.collocation: foist a fake off on a buyer

examples.text: The dealer tried to foist the fake off on an elderly collector as an original.
examples.translation_cn: 这个商人试图把假货冒充真品塞给一位老年收藏家。

senses.meaning_en: a deadly epidemic disease

examples.text: An outbreak of pestilence swept through the crowded city.
examples.translation_cn: 一场瘟疫席卷了这座拥挤的城市。

senses.meaning_en: treating serious issues with inappropriate humour; flippant

examples.text: He was being facetious about the budget cuts, which made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 他对预算削减乱开玩笑，让大家很不舒服。

senses.meaning_en: filled with grief; mournful

examples.text: The old dog looked doleful when we left for work.
examples.translation_cn: 我们出门上班时，那只老狗看上去很忧伤。

senses.meaning_en: bad-tempered or unwilling to speak because you are angry

examples.text: The child was in a sulky mood after losing the game.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子输掉比赛后一直闷闷不乐。

senses.meaning_en: dark and gloomy, suggesting bad weather

examples.text: The sky turned sulky before the rain began.
examples.translation_cn: 下雨前天空变得阴沉。

senses.meaning_en: a deep pile of snow formed by the wind

examples.text: The car was buried in a snowdrift overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车一夜之间被雪堆埋住了。

senses.meaning_en: a manufactured fiber made from cellulose

examples.text: Rayon is made from cellulose and is a common fiber in summer clothing.
examples.translation_cn: 人造丝由纤维素制成，是夏季服装中常见的一种纤维。

senses.meaning_en: fabric made from rayon fiber

examples.text: The dress is made of rayon and dries quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 这条连衣裙由人造丝制成，干得快。

senses.meaning_en: the science of the conversions between heat and other forms of energy

examples.text: The thermodynamics of a steam engine explains how heat is converted into work.
examples.translation_cn: 蒸汽机的热力学解释了热如何转化为功。

senses.meaning_en: intolerable; unbearable

examples.text: I find his constant complaining absolutely insufferable at family dinners.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得他在家庭聚餐时不停地抱怨，真让人难以忍受。

senses.meaning_en: a person who makes quilts

examples.text: My grandmother has been a quilter for over fifty years.
examples.translation_cn: 我奶奶缝被子已经五十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: a long-tailed American songbird known for mimicking other birds' calls

examples.text: A mockingbird can copy the songs of other birds.
examples.translation_cn: 一只嘲鸫能模仿其他鸟的叫声。

senses.meaning_en: a North American mammal that resembles an antelope

examples.text: A herd of pronghorn crossed the open plain at dusk.
examples.translation_cn: 一群叉角羚在黄昏时穿过了开阔的平原。

senses.meaning_en: an easily melted alloy used to join or coat metal surfaces

examples.text: He applied fresh solder to the cracked joint.
examples.translation_cn: 他把新焊料涂在裂开的接头上。

senses.meaning_en: a circumstance or emotion that strongly bonds people or things

examples.text: Trust is often the solder of lasting partnerships.
examples.translation_cn: 信任往往是持久伙伴关系的纽带。

senses.meaning_en: to join metal items together using solder

examples.text: The technician soldered the wire to the circuit board.
examples.translation_cn: 技术员把电线焊接到电路板上。

senses.meaning_en: to join things together as if with solder

examples.text: Shared hardships often solder a diverse team together.
examples.translation_cn: 共同的艰辛常常把多元的团队凝聚在一起。

senses.meaning_en: having no odor

examples.text: Carbon monoxide is odorless and colorless, so it is difficult to detect.
examples.translation_cn: 一氧化碳无臭无色，所以很难察觉。

senses.meaning_en: having a pleasant melody or sound; tuneful

examples.text: She has a soft, melodious voice that calms everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 她有着柔和悦耳的嗓音，能让所有人平静下来。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of listlessness and dissatisfaction arising from a lack of occupation or excitement

examples.text: She was overcome by ennui during the long, rainy weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 在漫长而多雨的周末，她感到无聊透顶。

senses.meaning_en: to erase or wipe out; to cause to disappear

examples.text: She tried to efface the memory of the accident from her mind.
examples.translation_cn: 她试图把事故的记忆从脑海中抹去。

senses.meaning_en: to make oneself inconspicuous; to be modest

examples.text: He effaced himself at the party and let others speak.
examples.translation_cn: 他在聚会上不引人注意，让别人说话。

senses.meaning_en: wood from coniferous trees, especially used as timber

examples.text: The shelves are made of softwood and need a protective coat.
examples.translation_cn: 这些架子是软木材做的，需要加保护层。

senses.meaning_en: a coniferous tree, such as a pine or fir

examples.text: Softwoods such as pines and firs grow well on this mountain.
examples.translation_cn: 松树和冷杉等针叶树在这座山上长势良好。

senses.meaning_en: the process of removing salt from sea water in order to make drinking water

examples.text: The desalination of seawater provides fresh water for the city.
examples.translation_cn: 海水淡化为这座城市提供淡水。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sound or the science of sound

examples.text: In acoustical terms, the room has excellent sound quality.
examples.translation_cn: 从声学角度来说，这个房间音质极好。

senses.meaning_en: designed to absorb or control sound

examples.text: Acoustical panels on the walls help reduce unwanted noise.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上的吸音板有助于减少不必要的噪音。

senses.meaning_en: making a show of being morally better than others, especially hypocritically pious

examples.text: She is sanctimonious about recycling, yet she drives a huge SUV.
examples.translation_cn: 她对回收摆出一副道貌岸然的样子，却开着一辆大型SUV。

senses.meaning_en: to make something longer; to stretch or extend something

examples.text: The yoga pose elongates the spine and relieves tension.
examples.translation_cn: 这个瑜伽姿势拉长了脊柱并缓解了紧张。

senses.meaning_en: to become longer; to grow longer

examples.text: The cells elongate into long, thin fibers during development.
examples.translation_cn: 这些细胞在发育过程中伸长成细长的纤维。

senses.meaning_en: a person who lives in a city or urban area

examples.text: As an urbanite, he enjoys easy access to public transport.
examples.translation_cn: 作为都市人，他享有便捷的公共交通。

senses.meaning_en: a bluish-green colour; of a bluish-green colour

examples.text: The bedroom walls were painted in soft aquamarine.
examples.translation_cn: 卧室墙壁粉刷成了柔和的蓝绿色。

senses.meaning_en: a transparent bluish-green variety of beryl

examples.text: She wore a silver ring set with a large aquamarine.
examples.translation_cn: 她戴着一枚镶有大颗海蓝宝石的银戒指。

senses.meaning_en: of a bluish-green colour

examples.text: The shallow water was aquamarine and perfectly clear.
examples.translation_cn: 浅水呈蓝绿色，清澈见底。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that expresses a threat or intimidation

examples.text: The angry customer spoke threateningly to the manager.
examples.translation_cn: 那位愤怒的顾客威胁地对经理说话。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that suggests something bad or dangerous will happen

examples.text: The sky was threateningly dark before the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨来临前，天空阴沉得吓人。

senses.meaning_en: a valuable stone, especially one cut and polished for use in jewellery

examples.text: The antique brooch is set with a large blue gemstone.
examples.translation_cn: 这枚古董胸针镶嵌着一颗蓝色大宝石。

senses.meaning_en: to push or thrust out

examples.text: The snail extruded its tentacles from its shell.
examples.translation_cn: 蜗牛从壳里伸出触角。

senses.meaning_en: to form or shape by forcing through a die

examples.text: The factory extrudes plastic through a heated die.
examples.translation_cn: 工厂把塑料挤过加热的模具。

senses.meaning_en: a cage or small enclosure for birds or animals

examples.text: The farmer keeps the hens in a coop at night.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫晚上把母鸡关在鸡笼里。

senses.meaning_en: to confine or shut up in a narrow space

examples.text: After the storm, we were cooped up in the house for three days.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，我们被困在屋里三天。

senses.meaning_en: made pure or more pure

examples.text: Only purified water is allowed in the laboratory.
examples.translation_cn: 实验室只允许使用净化水。

senses.meaning_en: late; arriving or happening after the expected time

examples.text: She was tardy for work again because of heavy traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 由于堵车，她上班又迟到了。

senses.meaning_en: moving or reacting slowly; sluggish

examples.text: The old server was tardy in responding to user requests.
examples.translation_cn: 这台旧服务器响应用户请求很慢。

senses.meaning_en: the bending of a wave when it passes from one medium to another

examples.text: The refraction of light explains why a straw looks bent in water.
examples.translation_cn: 光的折射解释了为什么吸管在水中看起来弯曲。

senses.meaning_en: the ability of the eye to bend light; an eye test

examples.text: An eye doctor can perform a refraction test to check your vision.
examples.translation_cn: 眼科医生可以做一次验光来检查你的视力。

senses.meaning_en: the outer protective layer of the skin of vertebrates; a similar outer layer in plants and invertebrates

examples.text: Melanin is produced in the epidermis by cells called melanocytes.
examples.translation_cn: 黑色素由表皮中称为黑素细胞的细胞产生。

senses.meaning_en: to expose to radiation

examples.text: Doctors irradiate the tumour to destroy cancer cells.
examples.translation_cn: 医生用放射线照射肿瘤以杀死癌细胞。

senses.meaning_en: to light up or illuminate

examples.text: The valley was irradiated by the first light of dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 清晨的第一缕阳光照亮了山谷。

senses.meaning_en: to make radiant or fill with joy

examples.text: Her face was irradiated with joy when she heard the news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到这个消息时，脸上洋溢着喜悦。

senses.meaning_en: having become solid crystals

examples.text: The honey became crystallized after being stored in a cold room.
examples.translation_cn: 蜂蜜在冷室里存放后结晶了。

senses.meaning_en: covered with sugar crystals

examples.text: We served crystallized fruit with coffee after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚餐后我们提供了蜜饯水果配咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: having been given definite or precise form

examples.text: The report presented a crystallized plan for reform.
examples.translation_cn: 报告提出了一个明确的改革计划。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a gland or glands

examples.text: Glandular tissue releases hormones directly into the blood.
examples.translation_cn: 腺体组织将激素直接释放到血液中。

senses.meaning_en: the state or quality of being late, especially for work or school

examples.text: Chronic tardiness to class can affect your grade.
examples.translation_cn: 长期上课迟到会影响你的成绩。

senses.meaning_en: slowness to act, respond, or complete something

examples.text: His tardiness in responding to emails annoyed his clients.
examples.translation_cn: 他回复邮件拖沓，让客户很恼火。

senses.meaning_en: produced or given in large amounts; generous

examples.text: She was profuse in her apologies for the mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 她为这个错误连声道歉。

senses.meaning_en: to summarize and state again the main points

examples.text: At the end of the lecture, the professor briefly recapitulated the main points.
examples.translation_cn: 讲座结束时，教授简要概括了要点。

senses.meaning_en: dishes, cutlery, and glassware used for setting a table

examples.text: We bought a set of tableware for the dinner party.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为晚宴买了一套餐具。

senses.meaning_en: a person who obeys someone too willingly

examples.text: He was a lackey to the dictator, agreeing with every order.
examples.translation_cn: 他是独裁者的走狗，对每一道命令都唯唯诺诺。

senses.meaning_en: a male servant in uniform

examples.text: He works as a lackey in livery at the royal palace.
examples.translation_cn: 他在皇宫当穿制服的男仆。

senses.meaning_en: showy in speech and using elaborate language with little meaning

examples.text: He gave a bombastic speech full of empty promises.
examples.translation_cn: 他发表了一场充满空洞承诺的浮夸演讲。

senses.meaning_en: the study of cities

examples.text: She decided to study urbanism after living in Tokyo.
examples.translation_cn: 在东京生活后，她决定研究城市学。

senses.meaning_en: the way of life in cities

examples.text: The novel captures the urbanism of modern Shanghai.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说捕捉了现代上海的城市生活方式。

senses.meaning_en: the process of urbanization

examples.text: Urbanism is spreading quickly across the developing region.
examples.translation_cn: 城市化正在发展中地区迅速推进。

senses.meaning_en: urban planning

examples.text: The city recently adopted principles of urbanism for sustainable growth.
examples.translation_cn: 该市最近采纳了城市规划原则以实现可持续增长。

senses.meaning_en: not flattering or attractive

examples.text: That bright yellow hat looks unbecoming on you.
examples.translation_cn: 那顶亮黄色的帽子你戴着不好看。

senses.meaning_en: not appropriate for one's position or character

examples.text: His rude remarks were unbecoming of a judge.
examples.translation_cn: 他的粗鲁言论有失法官身份。

senses.meaning_en: to use less of something to save money or resources

examples.text: Many families are trying to economize on food these days.
examples.translation_cn: 如今许多家庭都在想办法节省食物开支。

senses.meaning_en: a natural or artificial channel through which water flows

examples.text: Rainwater flows through a concrete watercourse into the pond.
examples.translation_cn: 雨水顺着一条混凝土水道流入池塘。

senses.meaning_en: a stream or small river

examples.text: The hikers followed a small watercourse through the forest to the village.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者沿着一条小溪穿过森林走到村庄。

senses.meaning_en: a large continuous area of land

examples.text: The landmass of Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice.
examples.translation_cn: 南极洲大陆几乎完全被冰覆盖。

senses.meaning_en: careful not to waste money or resources; thrifty

examples.text: She is provident with money, never buying things she does not need.
examples.translation_cn: 她对金钱很节俭，从不买她不需要的东西。

senses.meaning_en: showing foresight; making provision for future needs

examples.text: They are provident in planning for their children's education.
examples.translation_cn: 他们未雨绸缪，为孩子的教育提前规划。

senses.meaning_en: lack of appropriate seriousness; flippancy

examples.text: She spoke about the accident with levity, which upset the victims' families.
examples.translation_cn: 她轻率地谈论那起事故，令受害者家属感到不安。

senses.meaning_en: to suffer from extreme heat and sweat heavily

examples.text: We sweltered in the heat without air conditioning.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在没有空调的酷热中热得难受。

senses.meaning_en: to persuade someone by flattery

examples.text: He wheedled me into lending him my car.
examples.translation_cn: 他甜言蜜语哄我把车借给他。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain something by flattery or guile

examples.text: She wheedled the secret out of her brother.
examples.translation_cn: 她从她弟弟那里哄出了秘密。

senses.meaning_en: blowing in strong sudden bursts

examples.text: Gusty conditions forced us to postpone the outdoor concert.
examples.translation_cn: 狂风大作的天气迫使我们推迟了户外音乐会。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is dissatisfied and rebellious

examples.text: He was a malcontent who never approved of any proposal.
examples.translation_cn: 他是一个对任何提议都不满意的爱抱怨者。

senses.meaning_en: dissatisfied and complaining or rebellious

examples.text: A malcontent faction inside the union rejected the deal.
examples.translation_cn: 工会内部一个不满的派系拒绝了这项协议。

senses.meaning_en: easily influenced; tractable

examples.text: The committee remained pliant to the government's wishes.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会仍顺从政府的意愿。

senses.meaning_en: easily bent or flexible; yielding without breaking

examples.text: The willow branches were pliant enough to twist into a wreath.
examples.translation_cn: 柳枝柔韧得可以编成花环。

senses.meaning_en: a flat shape with six straight sides and six angles
senses.pattern: in the shape of a hexagon

examples.text: The garden was laid out in the shape of a hexagon.
examples.translation_cn: 这个花园被设计成六边形。

senses.meaning_en: having teeth

examples.text: Toothed whales use sound to locate their prey.
examples.translation_cn: 有齿鲸用声音定位猎物。

senses.meaning_en: having projections resembling teeth

examples.text: The knife has a toothed edge that cuts bread easily.
examples.translation_cn: 这把刀有锯齿边，切面包很容易。

senses.meaning_en: a musician who leads a band

examples.text: Duke Ellington was the bandleader of a famous jazz orchestra.
examples.translation_cn: 艾灵顿公爵是一支著名爵士乐队的领队。

senses.meaning_en: a hobby or minor occupation

examples.text: He pursues photography as an avocation, not as a career.
examples.translation_cn: 他从事摄影是作为业余爱好，而非职业。

senses.meaning_en: to put too heavy a burden on someone or something

examples.text: Don't overtax yourself while you are recovering from surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 手术后恢复期间不要让自己过度劳累。

senses.meaning_en: to tax to an excessive degree

examples.text: Many local shops feel they are being overtaxed by the city government.
examples.translation_cn: 许多当地商店觉得被市政府征税过重。

senses.meaning_en: to bind by pledge or security; to engage

examples.text: He gaged his house as security for the loan.
examples.translation_cn: 他把房子抵押作为贷款担保。

senses.meaning_en: flabby; lacking firmness or muscle tone

examples.text: After lying in bed for weeks, his leg muscles became flaccid.
examples.translation_cn: 卧床数周后，他的腿部肌肉变得松弛了。

senses.meaning_en: soft; weak; lacking energy or vigor

examples.text: The team's response to the crisis was flaccid and uninspired.
examples.translation_cn: 该团队对危机的回应软弱无力且毫无新意。

senses.meaning_en: lack of proper respect; the quality of being irreverent

examples.text: He showed irreverence toward the judge by yawning openly in court.
examples.translation_cn: 他在法庭上公开打哈欠，表现出对法官的不敬。

senses.meaning_en: to fill someone with great delight or joy

examples.text: The audience was ravished by the violinist's performance.
examples.translation_cn: 听众被小提琴家的演奏迷住了。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to have sex; to rape

examples.text: The soldiers ravished many women during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在战争期间强暴了许多妇女。

senses.meaning_en: the study of crustal plates and other large-scale structural features of the Earth

examples.text: Plate tectonics explains how mountain ranges are formed.
examples.translation_cn: 板块构造学解释了山脉是如何形成的。

senses.meaning_en: to change a solid directly into gas and back to solid

examples.text: The chemist sublimated the iodine crystals into purple gas.
examples.translation_cn: 化学家将碘晶体升华成紫色气体。

senses.meaning_en: to direct a strong desire into a higher or acceptable activity

examples.text: He sublimated his deep grief into writing poetry.
examples.translation_cn: 他将深切的悲痛升华为创作诗歌。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone feel bitter, resentful or unhappy

examples.text: She was embittered by years of neglect and felt no joy.
examples.translation_cn: 多年的忽视使她满怀怨恨，感受不到快乐。

senses.meaning_en: to make a situation, relationship, or feeling worse or more unpleasant

examples.text: The border clash embittered relations between the two countries.
examples.translation_cn: 边境冲突使两国关系恶化。

senses.meaning_en: a person from a rural mountain area, often regarded as unsophisticated

examples.text: People called him a hillbilly because of his thick mountain accent and simple ways.
examples.translation_cn: 人们因为他浓重的山里口音和朴素的生活方式而叫他乡巴佬。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of moving or happening quickly

examples.text: The illness spread with alarming swiftness through the camp.
examples.translation_cn: 疾病以惊人的速度在营地蔓延。

senses.meaning_en: brisk and fresh; fast and energetic

examples.text: We walked at a spanking pace to catch the train.
examples.translation_cn: 我们快步走着去赶火车。

senses.meaning_en: very; completely (as an intensifier)

examples.text: She left the kitchen spanking clean after scrubbing for an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 她擦洗了一小时后，厨房里干干净净。

senses.meaning_en: a beating on the buttocks as punishment

examples.text: He got a spanking for breaking the window.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为打破窗户被打了屁股。

senses.meaning_en: feeling desire; eager to obtain

examples.text: He is desirous of obtaining a permanent position at the university.
examples.translation_cn: 他渴望在大学获得一个固定职位。

senses.meaning_en: not in accordance with the season; unusually (of weather)

examples.text: The weather turned unseasonably cold in late April.
examples.translation_cn: 四月末天气冷得不合时令。

senses.meaning_en: a handmade object; handicraft

examples.text: The market sells traditional handcrafts from nearby mountain villages.
examples.translation_cn: 市场出售来自附近山村的传统手工艺品。

senses.meaning_en: to make (something) by hand with skill

examples.text: The potter handcrafts each bowl before firing it in the kiln.
examples.translation_cn: 陶工在入窑烧制前手工制作每个碗。

senses.meaning_en: to pay someone for loss, damage, or injury

examples.text: The airline must indemnify passengers for lost luggage.
examples.translation_cn: 航空公司必须赔偿乘客丢失的行李。

senses.meaning_en: to protect someone against loss or damage

examples.text: The insurance policy indemnifies the company against fire and theft.
examples.translation_cn: 这份保险单保障公司免受火灾和盗窃损失。

senses.meaning_en: to give dignity or honor to something

examples.text: A living wage dignifies everyday labor and gives workers self-respect.
examples.translation_cn: 维持生计的工资使日常工作有尊严，并给予工人自尊。

senses.meaning_en: to add distinction or importance to something

examples.text: The opening ceremony was dignified by the minister's presence.
examples.translation_cn: 开幕式因部长的出席而增光。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem better or more acceptable than it really is
senses.pattern: dignify sth with the name of sth
senses.collocation: dignify greed with the name of ambition

examples.text: He dignified his greed with the name of ambition.
examples.translation_cn: 他把贪婪美其名曰雄心。

senses.meaning_en: to treat something as worthy of attention or response
senses.pattern: not dignify sth with a reply/response

examples.text: She did not dignify the rumor with a response.
examples.translation_cn: 她没有屈尊回应那个谣言。

senses.meaning_en: a painter or photographer who makes portraits

examples.text: She has worked as a portraitist for over thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 她当肖像画家已有三十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a person who works in stone

examples.text: My grandfather worked as a stonemason on the old cathedral.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父曾在那座古老的大教堂当石匠。

senses.meaning_en: relating to comets

examples.text: Some of the dust grains appear to be of cometary origin.
examples.translation_cn: 一些尘埃颗粒似乎来源于彗星。

senses.meaning_en: excessively talkative, especially in a rambling or tiresome way

examples.text: The garrulous old man at the bar rambled on for hours about his youth.
examples.translation_cn: 酒吧里那个絮絮叨叨的老人没完没了地讲他的青年时代，一讲就是几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: natural and correct for a native speaker

examples.text: After years in London, her English sounds idiomatic.
examples.translation_cn: 在伦敦生活多年后，她的英语听起来很地道。

senses.meaning_en: containing or consisting of idioms

examples.text: Break a leg is an idiomatic expression in English.
examples.translation_cn: “Break a leg”在英语中是一个习语表达。

senses.meaning_en: suited to the natural capabilities of a particular instrument or player

examples.text: The composer always writes music that is idiomatic for the violin.
examples.translation_cn: 这位作曲家写的小提琴曲总是很适合小提琴演奏。

senses.meaning_en: calm and in control of your emotions

examples.text: She remained composed throughout the interview despite the difficult questions.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管问题很难，她在整个面试中保持镇静。

senses.meaning_en: made up of; consisting of

examples.text: The committee is composed of representatives from twelve countries.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会由来自十二个国家的代表组成。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody enjoy home life and be good at cooking, cleaning, etc.

examples.text: He became quite domesticated after the birth of his first child.
examples.translation_cn: 他第一个孩子出生后变得很适应家庭生活。

senses.meaning_en: to tame an animal and keep it as a pet or for farm produce

examples.text: Early farmers domesticated wild sheep for wool and meat.
examples.translation_cn: 早期农民驯养野绵羊以获取羊毛和肉。

senses.meaning_en: to bring a plant under cultivation and modify it for human use

examples.text: People first domesticated rice in the Yangtze Valley.
examples.translation_cn: 人们最早在长江流域驯化水稻。

senses.meaning_en: to adapt a text to fit local culture

examples.text: The classic novel was domesticated for modern American readers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部经典小说为现代美国读者做了归化处理。

senses.meaning_en: an alliance of persons, parties, or states

examples.text: The unions were in confederacy with student groups to demand lower tuition.
examples.translation_cn: 工会与学生团体结成同盟要求降低学费。

senses.meaning_en: the government formed by the southern states that seceded from the US during the Civil War

examples.text: Virginia joined the Confederacy soon after the Civil War began.
examples.translation_cn: 内战开始后不久，弗吉尼亚加入了南部邦联。

senses.meaning_en: a state where the sovereign constituent units delegate their authority to the centre

examples.text: Switzerland was once a loose confederacy of independent cantons.
examples.translation_cn: 瑞士曾是独立州组成的松散邦联。

senses.meaning_en: A newly hatched bird, reptile, or other animal that has emerged from an egg.

examples.text: A sea turtle hatchling emerges from its egg and crawls toward the sea.
examples.translation_cn: 一只刚孵出的海龟幼体从蛋中钻出，朝大海爬去。

senses.meaning_en: tending to boast or brag

examples.text: He was boastful about his business success after the deal.
examples.translation_cn: 交易后他对自己生意上的成功自吹自擂。

senses.meaning_en: skillful and clever, especially in dealing with people or difficult situations

examples.text: She is adroit at handling awkward questions from reporters.
examples.translation_cn: 她善于应对记者提出的尴尬问题。

senses.meaning_en: showing skill in using the hands or body

examples.text: The carpenter is adroit with his hands and can carve delicate patterns.
examples.translation_cn: 这位木匠双手灵巧，能雕刻出精细的图案。

senses.meaning_en: to talk quickly and unclearly

examples.text: He was gabbling on about his new car and I couldn't understand a word.
examples.translation_cn: 他叽里咕噜地说着他的新车，我一个字也听不懂。

senses.meaning_en: fast, confused or unintelligible speech

examples.text: She answered in a gabble, and I could hardly make out her words.
examples.translation_cn: 她含糊不清地回答，我几乎听不出她在说什么。

senses.meaning_en: a pot with a lid and handle for making or serving coffee

examples.text: She made a fresh coffeepot of coffee for the guests.
examples.translation_cn: 她为客人们煮了一壶新鲜的咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: a ruler with absolute power

examples.text: The country was ruled by an autocrat for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 这个国家被独裁者统治了数十年。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate or adorn

examples.text: The streets were bedecked with colourful banners for the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 街道上为节日挂满了彩旗。

senses.meaning_en: intended to help people escape from reality

examples.text: The film is escapist entertainment for a tired audience.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影是供疲惫观众逃避现实的娱乐片。

senses.meaning_en: someone who wants to escape from reality

examples.text: His friends call him an escapist because he spends every weekend lost in fantasy novels.
examples.translation_cn: 他的朋友称他为逃避现实的人，因为他每个周末都沉迷于幻想小说。

senses.meaning_en: having a moral or legal duty to do something

examples.text: I am obligated to help because they supported me last year.
examples.translation_cn: 我因他们去年支持过我而有义务帮忙。

senses.meaning_en: used so often that it is no longer original or interesting

examples.text: The plot of the movie is hackneyed and offers no surprises.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影的情节陈腐老套，毫无新意。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of combining ideas, styles, or methods from different sources

examples.text: The eclecticism of her music is evident in its blend of jazz, folk, and classical styles.
examples.translation_cn: 她音乐的兼收并蓄在融合爵士、民谣和古典风格方面显而易见。

senses.meaning_en: happening at the same time

examples.text: The power outage was coincident with the thunderstorm that hit the city.
examples.translation_cn: 停电与袭击该市的雷暴同时发生。

senses.meaning_en: in agreement; matching

examples.text: The committee's conclusions are coincident with the facts presented in the report.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会的结论与报告中提出的事实一致。

senses.meaning_en: the study of language in historical texts

examples.text: The philology of a language involves tracing how its forms changed over centuries.
examples.translation_cn: 一门语言的语文学涉及追溯其形式在几个世纪中的变化。

senses.meaning_en: formed from molten rock or magma

examples.text: Igneous rocks form when magma cools and hardens.
examples.translation_cn: 当岩浆冷却变硬时，火成岩便形成。

senses.meaning_en: circular or spiral motion; rotation

examples.text: The leaves fell in a slow gyration to the ground.
examples.translation_cn: 树叶打着旋儿缓缓飘落。

senses.meaning_en: rapid or unpredictable fluctuations, especially in markets

examples.text: Investors are worried by the wild gyrations in the stock market.
examples.translation_cn: 投资者对股市的剧烈波动感到担忧。

senses.meaning_en: to pass solid waste from the bowels

examples.text: The patient had been unable to defecate for five days.
examples.translation_cn: 病人已经五天无法排便。

senses.meaning_en: to make something inactive or no longer effective

examples.text: These harmful bacteria are inactivated by boiling water.
examples.translation_cn: 这些有害细菌会被沸水灭活。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of searching for minerals, oil, or other valuable substances in the ground

examples.text: Prospecting for gold requires patience, capital, and a good knowledge of geology.
examples.translation_cn: 勘探金矿需要耐心、资金和丰富的地质知识。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of searching for potential customers or business opportunities

examples.text: Prospecting for new customers is a core part of the sales representative's role.
examples.translation_cn: 寻找新客户是销售代表职责的核心部分。

senses.meaning_en: a person who patrols

examples.text: The patroller on duty noticed a broken fence near the gate.
examples.translation_cn: 值班巡逻员发现大门附近有一处破损的围栏。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone or something weak or feeble

examples.text: The infection debilitated her to the point where she could barely walk.
examples.translation_cn: 感染使她虚弱到几乎无法行走。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody extremely thin and weak

examples.text: He was emaciated by months of untreated illness.
examples.translation_cn: 他因数月的疾病未得到治疗而极度消瘦。

senses.meaning_en: extremely thin and weak

examples.text: The rescued hiker looked pale and emaciated after a week.
examples.translation_cn: 获救的徒步者一周后看起来苍白而极度消瘦。

senses.meaning_en: to hide your true feelings, motives, or intentions by behaving in a misleading way

examples.text: He dissembled about his past during the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 面试时他对自己的过去含糊其辞。

senses.meaning_en: any salt of silica or silicic acid; a mineral composed of silicates

examples.text: Jadeite is a silicate of sodium and aluminium.
examples.translation_cn: 硬玉是一种钠和铝的硅酸盐。

senses.meaning_en: to make a book, text, etc. shorter

examples.text: The publisher abridged the long novel for young readers.
examples.translation_cn: 出版方为年轻读者删节了那部长篇小说。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce or limit rights or freedom

examples.text: The new law would abridge citizens' freedom of speech.
examples.translation_cn: 这项新法律会限制公民的言论自由。

senses.meaning_en: to fill with great delight or joy; to fascinate

examples.text: The audience was enraptured by the violinist's performance.
examples.translation_cn: 听众被小提琴家的演奏迷住了。

senses.meaning_en: lazy; avoiding activity

examples.text: He is indolent by nature and avoids any strenuous activity.
examples.translation_cn: 他天性懒惰，避免任何费力的活动。

senses.meaning_en: to make somebody become used to something unpleasant

examples.text: After years of hardship, she is inured to criticism.
examples.translation_cn: 经历多年艰辛后，她对批评已习以为常。

senses.meaning_en: not allowing liquids or gases to pass through

examples.text: This fabric is impermeable to water, making it ideal for rainwear.
examples.translation_cn: 这种织物不透水，非常适合做雨衣。

senses.meaning_en: loyalty and obedience to a lord or master, especially in feudal times

examples.text: The vassal swore fealty to his lord in exchange for the lord's protection.
examples.translation_cn: 这位封臣向领主宣誓效忠，以换取领主的保护。

senses.meaning_en: a contract binding a person to work for another, often as an apprentice

examples.text: She served as an apprentice under an indenture for seven years.
examples.translation_cn: 她作为学徒按契约服务了七年。

senses.meaning_en: to bind a person by indenture

examples.text: Many children were indentured to factory owners in the nineteenth century.
examples.translation_cn: 在十九世纪，许多孩子被契约约束给工厂主做工。

senses.meaning_en: salty; of or like seawater or brine

examples.text: The sea air smelled briny and fresh after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，海风闻起来又咸又清新。

senses.meaning_en: honest and without deception; naive

examples.text: With a guileless smile, she admitted she had never heard of the famous author.
examples.translation_cn: 她带着天真的微笑承认自己从未听说过那位著名作家。

senses.meaning_en: quick and efficient

examples.text: The agency was expeditious in processing the visa application.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构迅速处理了签证申请。

senses.meaning_en: emotionally moved (by); made to feel emotion (by)

examples.text: I was deeply touched by the letter you sent me.
examples.translation_cn: 你寄来的信让我深受感动。

senses.meaning_en: slightly mentally deficient; touched in the head
senses.collocation: a bit touched in the head

examples.text: People said he was a bit touched in the head.
examples.translation_cn: 人们说他头脑有点不正常。

senses.meaning_en: extreme desire for wealth or gain

examples.text: He accepted the offer out of avarice rather than kindness.
examples.translation_cn: 他接受这个提议是出于贪婪，而不是善意。

senses.meaning_en: failure or refusal to follow generally accepted ways of thinking or behaving

examples.text: His nonconformity to tradition made him an outsider at school.
examples.translation_cn: 他不遵从传统，在学校里成了局外人。

senses.meaning_en: the fact of not agreeing with or matching something

examples.text: There is nonconformity between his claims and the evidence.
examples.translation_cn: 他的说法与证据之间存在不一致。

senses.meaning_en: to mix or blend together

examples.text: The report commingles economic data with political opinion.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告把经济数据与政治观点混在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to become mixed or blended

examples.text: Cultures from different regions commingle with each other in this city.
examples.translation_cn: 来自不同地区的文化在这座城市里交融。

senses.meaning_en: irritable; tending to complain

examples.text: He is grouchy about almost everything on Monday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 他周一早上几乎对一切都爱发牢骚。

senses.meaning_en: to release from military duty; to disband troops

examples.text: After the war, thousands of soldiers were demobilized from the army.
examples.translation_cn: 战后，成千上万的士兵从部队复员。

senses.meaning_en: unparalleled; without equal

examples.text: She is peerless in the field of modern art.
examples.translation_cn: 她在现代艺术领域无与伦比。

senses.meaning_en: to declare openly and frankly

examples.text: She avowed that she would never abandon her principles.
examples.translation_cn: 她公开声明自己永远不会放弃原则。

senses.meaning_en: worthy of esteem; admirable

examples.text: She is an estimable colleague whose fairness is widely admired.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一位可敬的同事，其公正广受钦佩。

senses.meaning_en: a device for condensing vapor into liquid

examples.text: The gas turns back into a liquid in the condenser of the refrigerator.
examples.translation_cn: 气体在冰箱的冷凝器中变回液体。

senses.meaning_en: a lens or system of lenses for concentrating light

examples.text: The microscope focuses light through a condenser lens onto the specimen.
examples.translation_cn: 显微镜通过聚光透镜将光线聚焦到标本上。

senses.meaning_en: a dental instrument for packing filling material
senses.pattern: use a condenser to pack a filling

examples.text: The dentist used a condenser to pack a filling into the cavity.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医用充填器将填充材料压入牙洞。

senses.meaning_en: a vehicle that travels over land or water on a cushion of air

examples.text: Passengers can travel from Portsmouth to the Isle of Wight by hovercraft in about ten minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 乘客可以乘坐气垫船从朴次茅斯到怀特岛，大约十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: abnormally sensitive to a substance, especially an allergen

examples.text: Some people are hypersensitive to pollen in early spring.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人在早春对花粉过敏。

senses.meaning_en: excessively sensitive and easily offended

examples.text: He is hypersensitive to any criticism of his work.
examples.translation_cn: 他对任何关于他工作的批评都过度敏感。

senses.meaning_en: untanned hide

examples.text: These traditional drum heads are made of rawhide.
examples.translation_cn: 这些传统鼓面是用生皮制成的。

senses.meaning_en: very small in amount; meager

examples.text: The company offered a miserly amount of severance pay.
examples.translation_cn: 公司提供了少得可怜的遣散费。

senses.meaning_en: unwilling to spend money or share what one has; stingy

examples.text: He is miserly with his money and never invites anyone to dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 他对钱很吝啬，从不请人吃饭。

senses.meaning_en: a movement made to confuse an opponent, especially a pretended blow or attack

examples.text: He made a feint to the left before passing the ball.
examples.translation_cn: 他向左做了一个假动作，然后传球。

senses.meaning_en: to make a deceptive movement, especially in order to deceive an opponent

examples.text: The striker feinted to the left before shooting past the keeper.
examples.translation_cn: 前锋向左虚晃，然后射门越过了守门员。

senses.meaning_en: lacking courage or determination; weak

examples.text: He was too spineless to stand up to his boss.
examples.translation_cn: 他太懦弱，不敢反驳老板。

senses.meaning_en: having no spinal column; invertebrate

examples.text: Jellyfish are spineless, so they can squeeze through narrow gaps.
examples.translation_cn: 水母没有脊椎，所以能挤过狭窄缝隙。

senses.meaning_en: a potassium compound, especially potassium carbonate, used in fertilizers and in making soap and glass

examples.text: Farmers apply potash to the soil before planting to increase crop yields.
examples.translation_cn: 农民在播种前向土壤施用钾肥以提高作物产量。

senses.meaning_en: not reliable or serious; likely to change suddenly and unpredictably, often in a silly or unplanned way

examples.text: She is flighty and changes her plans without warning.
examples.translation_cn: 她反复无常，更改计划毫无预兆。

senses.meaning_en: able to fly easily or often

examples.text: Swallows are flighty and cover great distances each day.
examples.translation_cn: 燕子善于飞行，每天能飞很远。

senses.meaning_en: an attack on someone's reputation or good name

examples.text: The report cast aspersions on the minister's integrity.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇报道诋毁了部长的诚信。

senses.meaning_en: the study of the physical sounds of human speech

examples.text: The phonetics of English vowels is covered in this introductory course.
examples.translation_cn: 这门入门课程涵盖英语元音的语音学。

senses.meaning_en: too confident; excessively confident

examples.text: He was overconfident about his chances of winning the race.
examples.translation_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛的机会过于自信。

senses.meaning_en: covered with scales or scale-like structures

examples.text: The lizard's skin is scaled, protecting it from sharp rocks.
examples.translation_cn: 蜥蜴的皮肤有鳞片，保护它免受锋利岩石的伤害。

senses.meaning_en: reduced or enlarged proportionally according to a scale

examples.text: The architect showed a scaled-down version of the stadium at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 建筑师在会议上展示了这座体育场的按比例缩小的模型。

senses.meaning_en: joined together by fusing

examples.text: The glass pieces were fused together in the kiln.
examples.translation_cn: 这些玻璃片在窑中熔合在一起。

senses.meaning_en: melted

examples.text: The metal remained in a fused state for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 这种金属保持熔融状态数小时。

senses.meaning_en: furnished with a fuse

examples.text: A fused plug will cut the current if there is a fault.
examples.translation_cn: 装有保险丝的插头会在发生故障时切断电流。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is slow to learn or stupid

examples.text: He is a dunce at physics, but he excels at literature.
examples.translation_cn: 他在物理方面很笨，但在文学方面很出色。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange into a systematic order; to make systematic

examples.text: We need to systematize the process to reduce errors.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要使流程系统化以减少错误。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to a funeral

examples.text: The priest performed the funereal rites beside the grave.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师在墓旁主持了葬礼仪式。

senses.meaning_en: a person who makes silver articles, especially larger than jewellery

examples.text: She works as a silversmith in a small workshop near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 她在河边的一个小作坊里做银匠。

senses.meaning_en: a person with a very loud voice

examples.text: He shouted like a foghorn across the crowded room.
examples.translation_cn: 他在拥挤的房间里像雾角一样大声喊叫。

senses.meaning_en: a very loud low-pitched horn used in lighthouses and on large boats

examples.text: The foghorn sounded as the fog rolled in.
examples.translation_cn: 浓雾涌来时雾角响了。

senses.meaning_en: courtesy and considerate behaviour towards others; social harmony

examples.text: Comity in the classroom encourages students to share their ideas respectfully.
examples.translation_cn: 课堂上的礼让鼓励学生尊重地分享自己的想法。

senses.meaning_en: friendly understanding and mutual recognition between two entities, especially nations

examples.text: Comity between nations allows courts to recognize each other's judgments.
examples.translation_cn: 国家间的礼让使得法院能够相互承认对方的判决。

senses.meaning_en: a performer who creates without preparation

examples.text: She works as an improviser at a jazz club every Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周六在一家爵士俱乐部当即兴表演者。

senses.meaning_en: a person who improvises in response to situations

examples.text: As an improviser, she kept the meeting on track when the video link failed.
examples.translation_cn: 作为随机应变者，视频链接出故障时她让会议照常进行。

senses.meaning_en: the process of forming crystals

examples.text: Evaporation of seawater leads to the crystallization of salt.
examples.translation_cn: 海水蒸发导致盐的结晶。

senses.meaning_en: the process or result of becoming clear and definite
senses.pattern: a crystallization of sth into sth

examples.text: The essay is a crystallization of scattered ideas into a clear argument.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章是零散想法凝聚为清晰论点的结晶。

senses.meaning_en: the act of renouncing a belief or faith, especially one's religion

examples.text: Her apostasy from the Catholic faith shocked her devout parents.
examples.translation_cn: 她背弃天主教信仰，令虔诚的父母大为震惊。

senses.meaning_en: shameful; not honorable
senses.pattern: it is ignoble of sb to do sth

examples.text: It was ignoble of him to betray his friend.
examples.translation_cn: 他背叛朋友，真是可耻。

senses.meaning_en: the highest point or most perfect example of something

examples.text: The building is widely regarded as the acme of modern architecture.
examples.translation_cn: 这座建筑被广泛视为现代建筑的巅峰之作。

senses.meaning_en: self-restraint, especially in sexual activity

examples.text: Monks take a vow of continence when they enter the monastery.
examples.translation_cn: 僧侣进入修道院时要发誓保持节制。

senses.meaning_en: the ability to control urination and defecation

examples.text: Many elderly people struggle to maintain continence during the night.
examples.translation_cn: 许多老年人夜间难以控制大小便。

senses.meaning_en: to grow or develop quickly

examples.text: The small startup has burgeoned into a global company.
examples.translation_cn: 这家小型初创公司已发展成一家全球性企业。

senses.meaning_en: the condition of being survivable

examples.text: The survivability of the species depends on the preservation of its habitat.
examples.translation_cn: 该物种的生存能力取决于其栖息地的保护。

senses.meaning_en: a measure of the extent to which something is survivable

examples.text: The team assessed the survivability of the new building in an earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 研究小组评估了这座新大楼在地震中的可生存性。

senses.meaning_en: selfishness; excessive concern with your own interests

examples.text: He refused to help out of pure egoism.
examples.translation_cn: 他出于纯粹的利己主义拒绝帮忙。

senses.meaning_en: the belief that moral behavior should be directed toward one's self-interest only

examples.text: Ethical egoism is a form of egoism that holds that we should act only for ourselves.
examples.translation_cn: 伦理利己主义是一种利己主义，认为我们只应为自己而行动。

senses.meaning_en: not showing due respect; rude and insolent
senses.pattern: it is impudent of sb to do

examples.text: It was impudent of him to speak to his mother like that.
examples.translation_cn: 他那样跟母亲说话真是无礼。

senses.meaning_en: to instruct or improve morally or intellectually
