examples.translation_cn: 酒店客人可以免费使用健身房。

senses.meaning_en: to appear as a guest on a television or radio show

examples.text: She guested on a popular radio show last month.
examples.translation_cn: 她上个月在一个热门广播节目中客串。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been invited to take part in a show or event
senses.pattern: be a guest on a show

examples.text: He was a guest on a popular talk show.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一个受欢迎的脱口秀节目中担任嘉宾。

senses.meaning_en: a user who has temporary access to a computer system or website without a personal account

examples.text: You can log in as a guest to try the app.
examples.translation_cn: 您可以以访客身份登录来试用该应用。

senses.meaning_en: items of clothing; apparel

examples.text: She bought new clothes for the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 她为求职面试买了新衣服。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of a course or book that teaches a particular subject or skill

examples.text: This chapter includes a lesson on basic first aid.
examples.translation_cn: 本章包含一节基础急救课。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time in which someone is taught a subject or skill

examples.text: I have a driving lesson at six, so I can't stay late.
examples.translation_cn: 我六点有一节驾驶课，所以不能待得太晚。

senses.meaning_en: something learned from an experience, especially an unpleasant one that helps you avoid mistakes

examples.text: He learned a valuable lesson from his failed business.
examples.translation_cn: 他从失败的生意中吸取了宝贵的教训。

senses.meaning_en: something that serves as a warning or encouragement
senses.collocation: let that be a lesson to you

examples.text: His accident was a lesson to the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 他的事故给全队敲响了警钟。

senses.meaning_en: a device used for talking to someone over a distance

examples.text: She answered the telephone on the second ring.
examples.translation_cn: 电话响了两声她就接了。

senses.meaning_en: to contact someone by telephone

examples.text: He telephoned his lawyer as soon as he got home.
examples.translation_cn: 他一到家就给律师打了电话。

senses.meaning_en: to make a telephone call

examples.text: She telephoned for a taxi as soon as she arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 她一到就打电话叫了出租车。

senses.meaning_en: a photograph or digital picture made by a camera

examples.text: This is a photo of my grandparents on their wedding day.
examples.translation_cn: 这是一张我祖父母结婚当天的照片。

senses.meaning_en: to take a photograph of somebody or something

examples.text: A witness was asked to photo the accident scene.
examples.translation_cn: 一名目击者被要求拍下事故现场。

senses.meaning_en: having a comfortably high temperature

examples.text: We felt warm by the fireplace after the long walk.
examples.translation_cn: 长途步行后，我们在壁炉旁感到温暖。

senses.meaning_en: keeping you warm

examples.text: This warm coat keeps me warm even in freezing weather.
examples.translation_cn: 这件保暖外套让我在严寒天气里也暖和。

senses.meaning_en: friendly and showing affection

examples.text: She was warm towards us from the moment we met.
examples.translation_cn: 她从我们见面的那一刻起就对我们很热情。

senses.meaning_en: close to guessing or finding an answer

examples.text: When I guessed the answer, she said I was getting warm.
examples.translation_cn: 当我猜答案时，她说我快猜中了。

senses.meaning_en: the Romance language of France

examples.text: The contract was written in French and English.
examples.translation_cn: 这份合同是用法语和英语写的。

senses.meaning_en: the people of France considered as a group

examples.text: The French are known for their excellent cuisine.
examples.translation_cn: 法国人以出色的美食闻名。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to France

examples.text: The cheese we bought is French and very fresh.
examples.translation_cn: 我们买的奶酪是法国的，而且非常新鲜。

senses.meaning_en: a hot drink made from coffee beans

examples.text: I drink coffee every morning to stay awake.
examples.translation_cn: 我每天早上喝咖啡来保持清醒。

senses.meaning_en: a cup of this drink

examples.text: We ordered a coffee and a slice of cake.
examples.translation_cn: 我们点了一杯咖啡和一块蛋糕。

senses.meaning_en: coffee powder

examples.text: Add a spoonful of ground coffee to the cake mix for extra flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 在蛋糕混合料中加入一勺咖啡粉以增添风味。

senses.meaning_en: low in price; inexpensive

examples.text: This car is cheap to buy but expensive to run.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车买起来便宜，但开起来贵。

senses.meaning_en: of poor quality

examples.text: The headphones looked good but felt cheap and nasty after two days.
examples.translation_cn: 这副耳机看起来不错，但两天后就觉得质量低劣。

senses.meaning_en: stingy; mean

examples.text: He is too cheap to turn on the heating even in January.
examples.translation_cn: 他吝啬到一月份都不开暖气。

senses.meaning_en: underhanded or unfair

examples.text: The reviewer took a cheap shot at the actor's family during the show.
examples.translation_cn: 评论员在节目中对演员的家人进行了恶意的攻击。

senses.meaning_en: a large motor vehicle that carries passengers by road

examples.text: Most students in this area travel to school by bus.
examples.translation_cn: 这个地区的大多数学生乘公共汽车上学。

senses.meaning_en: a shared electrical pathway connecting multiple components or circuits

examples.text: The CPU and main memory exchange data via a bus.
examples.translation_cn: CPU 和主内存通过总线交换数据。

senses.meaning_en: to transport people by bus

examples.text: The company buses its employees to the factory every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 那家公司每天早上用公交车送员工去工厂。

senses.meaning_en: to travel by bus

examples.text: Many commuters bus to work to avoid driving.
examples.translation_cn: 许多通勤者乘公交车上班以避免开车。

senses.meaning_en: food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time

examples.text: We usually have a meal before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常在会议前吃一餐饭。

senses.meaning_en: a person who prepares food

examples.text: My sister works as a cook in a busy French restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在一家繁忙的法式餐厅当厨师。

senses.meaning_en: a covering for the foot, usually with a sole and heel, not extending above the ankle

examples.text: I bought a new pair of shoes for work.
examples.translation_cn: 我为上班买了一双新鞋。

senses.meaning_en: to put shoes on a person or animal; to fit a horse with horseshoes

examples.text: The blacksmith will shoe the horse this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 蹄铁匠今天下午会给这匹马钉蹄铁。

senses.meaning_en: a score or mark given for schoolwork or an exam

examples.text: She got a high grade on the final exam.
examples.translation_cn: 她在期末考试中得了高分。

senses.meaning_en: a level of quality or rank

examples.text: This tea is of the highest grade available.
examples.translation_cn: 这种茶是现有最高等级的。

senses.meaning_en: a year or level of school

examples.text: My sister is now in the fifth grade.
examples.translation_cn: 我妹妹现在上五年级。

senses.meaning_en: to give a mark or rank to something

examples.text: The teacher grades our essays on both content and language.
examples.translation_cn: 老师从内容和语言两方面给我们的文章评分。

senses.meaning_en: a structure built over a river, road, etc. to allow people or vehicles to cross

examples.text: They are building a new bridge across the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们正在河上修建一座新桥。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce or get rid of the difference between two things or groups
senses.pattern: bridge the gap/difference between A and B

examples.text: The new policy aims to bridge the gap between rich and poor.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策旨在弥合贫富差距。

senses.meaning_en: a connection, real or abstract
senses.pattern: a bridge between A and B

examples.text: Music can serve as a bridge between different cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 音乐可以成为不同文化之间的桥梁。

senses.meaning_en: put clothes on (someone or oneself)

examples.text: The nurse dressed the baby in soft cotton clothes.
examples.translation_cn: 护士给婴儿穿上柔软的棉质衣服。

senses.meaning_en: apply a dressing to a wound

examples.text: The nurse dressed the wound with clean bandages.
examples.translation_cn: 护士用干净的绷带包扎伤口。

senses.meaning_en: a one-piece garment worn by women or girls

examples.text: She arrived at the party in a bright red dress.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一条鲜红色连衣裙来到聚会上。

senses.meaning_en: clothing of a particular type or for a particular occasion

examples.text: The guests arrived in traditional dress for the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 客人们穿着传统服装来参加典礼。

senses.meaning_en: design, make, provide, or select clothes for someone

examples.text: The whole cast was dressed by the award-winning costume designer.
examples.translation_cn: 整个剧组的服装由获奖服装设计师设计。

senses.meaning_en: well known

examples.text: She is famous for her groundbreaking research in genetics.
examples.translation_cn: 她因其开创性的遗传学研究而闻名。

senses.meaning_en: a room where classes are held, usually in a school

examples.text: The students waited quietly in the classroom before the teacher arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们在老师到来前安静地在教室里等着。

senses.meaning_en: the situation or setting in which teaching and learning happen

examples.text: Teachers often bring real-world problems into the classroom to make lessons relevant.
examples.translation_cn: 老师们经常把现实问题带进课堂，使课程更有现实意义。

senses.meaning_en: a building or group of buildings where goods are made

examples.text: My father works in a factory that makes car parts.
examples.translation_cn: 我父亲在一家生产汽车零件的工厂工作。

senses.meaning_en: the original state of an electronic device, as it was when it came from the manufacturer

examples.text: You can reset the phone to factory settings to erase all personal data.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以将手机恢复出厂设置以清除所有个人数据。

senses.meaning_en: the way in which a machine, system, organization, etc. operates

examples.text: The book explores the workings of the human brain.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书探讨了人脑的运作方式。

senses.meaning_en: having a job; employed

examples.text: She is a working mother with two young children.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一个有两个年幼孩子的职场母亲。

senses.meaning_en: that is or are functioning

examples.text: The mechanic checked that the brakes were in working order.
examples.translation_cn: 机修工检查了刹车是否运转正常。

senses.meaning_en: a place where work is carried on, especially mining or digging

examples.text: The old mine workings are dangerous and fenced off.
examples.translation_cn: 旧矿井作业区很危险，已被围栏隔开。

senses.meaning_en: giving many details and facts; thorough

examples.text: The report provides a detailed description of the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 报告对新政策作了详细描述。

senses.meaning_en: a room for sleeping in

examples.text: She left her phone charging in the bedroom.
examples.translation_cn: 她把手机放在卧室里充电。

senses.meaning_en: the location of sexual activity

examples.text: The film includes a bedroom scene that shocked some viewers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影包含一个让一些观众震惊的床戏。

senses.meaning_en: costing a lot of money

examples.text: It is expensive to live in this city.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个城市生活花费很高。

senses.meaning_en: using a lot of time or resources

examples.text: This algorithm is expensive in terms of memory.
examples.translation_cn: 这种算法内存开销很大。

senses.meaning_en: a light meal eaten around midday

examples.text: We had lunch at a small café near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆吃了午饭。

senses.meaning_en: to eat lunch

examples.text: We lunched on fresh sandwiches and seasonal fruit.
examples.translation_cn: 我们午餐吃了新鲜三明治和时令水果。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to education

examples.text: Mobile phones are now common in educational settings.
examples.translation_cn: 手机现在在教育环境中很常见。

senses.meaning_en: instructive or helping to educate

examples.text: This online game is educational for young children.
examples.translation_cn: 这款在线游戏对幼儿有教育意义。

senses.meaning_en: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday

examples.text: We hold our weekly team meeting on Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周五开团队会议。

senses.meaning_en: on Friday

examples.text: I'll see you Friday at the usual time.
examples.translation_cn: 我周五老时间见你。

senses.meaning_en: made up of two matching parts or meant for two people

examples.text: They booked a double room for their parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为父母订了一间双人房。

senses.meaning_en: twice the usual size, amount, or number

examples.text: The city now has double the number of buses.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市现在的公交车数量翻了一番。

senses.meaning_en: to become or make twice as much

examples.text: The population has doubled in size since 1990.
examples.translation_cn: 自1990年以来，这里的人口规模翻了一番。

senses.meaning_en: folded in two or made of two layers

examples.text: Wrap the glass in a double layer of newspaper.
examples.translation_cn: 用双层报纸把玻璃包起来。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture with a flat top, used for writing or office work

examples.text: I left your keys on my desk this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 今天早上我把你的钥匙落在我的书桌上了。

senses.meaning_en: a counter where you can get information or service in a hotel, airport, etc.

examples.text: You can leave your key at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以把钥匙留在前台。

senses.meaning_en: a department of a newspaper or organization that deals with a particular subject

examples.text: She works on the news desk of a daily paper.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家日报社的新闻编辑部工作。

senses.meaning_en: the color of lemons or sunflower petals

examples.text: The walls in the kitchen are bright yellow.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房的墙壁是亮黄色的。

senses.meaning_en: a yellow card shown by a referee as a warning

examples.text: The referee showed him a yellow card for the late tackle.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判因他铲球过晚向他出示了一张黄牌。

senses.meaning_en: a yellow ball used in pool or snooker, worth two points in snooker

examples.text: He potted the yellow to win the frame.
examples.translation_cn: 他击入黄球赢得了这一局。

senses.meaning_en: loud or unpleasant sounds

examples.text: The noise from traffic kept me awake all night.
examples.translation_cn: 交通噪音让我整夜无法入睡。

senses.meaning_en: any sound

examples.text: I heard a strange noise coming from the kitchen last night.
examples.translation_cn: 我昨晚听到厨房传来一个奇怪的声音。

senses.meaning_en: the second day of the week, after Sunday and before Tuesday

examples.text: The new school term starts on Monday after the winter break.
examples.translation_cn: 新学期在寒假结束后的星期一开始。

senses.meaning_en: the process of using your mind to consider or reason about something

examples.text: The course encourages critical thinking about modern social issues.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程鼓励对现代社会问题进行批判性思考。

senses.meaning_en: an opinion or idea about something

examples.text: Current thinking on climate change suggests urgent action is needed.
examples.translation_cn: 目前关于气候变化的普遍看法是必须采取紧急行动。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing anger

examples.text: He was angry with me for losing the keys.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为我弄丢了钥匙而生我的气。

senses.meaning_en: red, swollen and painful

examples.text: The skin around the cut was red and angry.
examples.translation_cn: 伤口周围的皮肤红肿疼痛。

senses.meaning_en: dark and stormy, menacing

examples.text: The small boat struggled against an angry sea all night.
examples.translation_cn: 小船整夜在汹涌的海面上挣扎。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Japan or its language

examples.text: The Japanese team won the match in the final minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 日本队在最后几分钟赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: the language of Japan

examples.text: My brother speaks Japanese well enough to watch anime without subtitles.
examples.translation_cn: 我哥哥日语说得很好，可以不用字幕看动漫。

senses.meaning_en: a native or inhabitant of Japan

examples.text: The Japanese I met were very kind to strangers.
examples.translation_cn: 我遇到的日本人对陌生人非常友善。

senses.meaning_en: any of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing

examples.text: The dentist reminded me to brush my teeth gently but thoroughly every night.
examples.translation_cn: 牙医提醒我每天晚上要轻柔而彻底地刷牙。

senses.meaning_en: a sharp projection on a saw, comb, gear, etc.

examples.text: He sharpened the teeth of the saw until it cut smoothly.
examples.translation_cn: 他把锯条上的齿磨锋利，直到切割顺畅。

senses.meaning_en: a place where aircraft take off and land, with runways and passenger terminals

examples.text: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达机场。

senses.meaning_en: an idea or plan put forward for consideration; the act of suggesting

examples.text: At his suggestion, we moved the meeting to Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 根据他的建议，我们把会议改到了周五。

senses.meaning_en: a slight indication or hint; something implied

examples.text: There was a suggestion of irony in her tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她的语气中带有一丝讽刺。

senses.meaning_en: a slight amount or trace of something

examples.text: The soup had just a suggestion of garlic.
examples.translation_cn: 汤里只有一丝蒜味。

senses.meaning_en: the flesh of an animal used as food; a type or cut of meat

examples.text: This cut of meat comes from the shoulder and is best slow-cooked.
examples.translation_cn: 这块肉来自肩部，最适合慢煮。

senses.meaning_en: food made from plants that imitates the taste and texture of meat

examples.text: Many people now eat meat made from plants, such as soy or pea protein.
examples.translation_cn: 现在许多人吃用大豆或豌豆蛋白等制成的植物肉。

senses.meaning_en: the most important or central part of something

examples.text: Let's get to the meat of the discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 让我们切入讨论的实质。

senses.meaning_en: the soft, thick part of a fruit or nut

examples.text: The meat of this fruit is sweet and juicy.
examples.translation_cn: 这种水果的果肉又甜又多汁。

senses.meaning_en: a serious disease caused by HIV that damages the immune system

examples.text: He was diagnosed with AIDS two years ago.
examples.translation_cn: 他两年前被诊断出患有艾滋病。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that achieves the intended result

examples.text: Managers must learn to use their time effectively.
examples.translation_cn: 管理者必须学会有效利用时间。

senses.meaning_en: used to say what actually happens or is true in practice

examples.text: The new policy effectively means that small shops will close.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策实际上意味着小商店将关闭。

senses.meaning_en: a country in southern Europe

examples.text: We spent two weeks in Italy last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去年夏天在意大利待了两周。

senses.meaning_en: a large area of water surrounded by land

examples.text: We went swimming in the lake near our cabin.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在小屋附近的湖里游泳。

senses.meaning_en: a country in the southern hemisphere

examples.text: My cousin has lived in Australia for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 我的表亲已经在澳大利亚住了五年。

senses.meaning_en: the act or process of creating something

examples.text: The creation of the new park took three years.
examples.translation_cn: 新公园的创建花了三年时间。

senses.meaning_en: something that has been created, especially an artistic work or invention

examples.text: The device is a creation of our engineering team.
examples.translation_cn: 这个装置是我们工程团队的一件创作品。

senses.meaning_en: all that exists; the universe or world, especially as made by God

examples.text: The human mind is one of the most complex things in all creation.
examples.translation_cn: 人的心智是宇宙万物中最复杂的事物之一。

senses.meaning_en: to make something clean with water or soap; to clean oneself with water

examples.text: He washed the dog with warm water after their walk.
examples.translation_cn: 散步后他用温水给狗洗澡。

senses.meaning_en: to carry away by the force of water

examples.text: The young tree was washed away by the strong current.
examples.translation_cn: 那棵小树被湍急的水流冲走了。

senses.meaning_en: to flow against or over something continuously

examples.text: Big waves washed against the rocks during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨期间大浪拍打着岩石。

senses.meaning_en: to remain in good condition when washed, especially of clothes

examples.text: This cotton shirt washes well and keeps its shape.
examples.translation_cn: 这件棉衬衫耐洗而且不变形。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of promoting, selling and distributing a product or service

examples.text: The marketing of the new phone was handled by an outside agency.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新手机的营销由外部代理公司负责。

senses.meaning_en: the white liquid produced by cows, goats, etc., used as food

examples.text: She drinks a glass of milk with her breakfast every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上早餐时喝一杯牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: to draw milk from a cow, goat, etc.

examples.text: The farmer gets up at dawn to milk the cows.
examples.translation_cn: 农夫天亮就起床挤牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: to get as much money, advantage, etc. as possible from sb/sth

examples.text: The scandal revealed how executives milked the company dry for years.
examples.translation_cn: 这起丑闻揭露了高管们多年来如何榨干公司。

senses.meaning_en: a flat, shallow container for serving food

examples.text: She placed the fruit on a large ceramic dish.
examples.translation_cn: 她把水果放在一个大陶瓷盘子上。

senses.meaning_en: a portion of food served in a dish

examples.text: She ate a dish of fresh strawberries with cream.
examples.translation_cn: 她吃了一碟新鲜草莓配奶油。

senses.meaning_en: a particular type of prepared food

examples.text: The chef served a traditional fish dish with herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 厨师端上了一道传统的香草鱼。

senses.meaning_en: all the plates, cups, etc. that have been used for a meal and need washing

examples.text: Could you do the dishes while I clean the kitchen?
examples.translation_cn: 你能洗碗吗，我打扫厨房。

senses.meaning_en: a large and lavishly ornate residence, especially the official home of a king, queen, or president

examples.text: The president received foreign guests in the palace.
examples.translation_cn: 总统在宫殿里接见外国客人。

senses.meaning_en: a large, ornate public building used for entertainment or exhibitions

examples.text: The city turned the old hall into a palace for exhibitions.
examples.translation_cn: 市政府把旧大厅改造成了展览馆。

senses.meaning_en: the deliberate ending of a pregnancy

examples.text: She decided to have an abortion after discussing her options with a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她与医生讨论各种选择后决定做人工流产。

senses.meaning_en: failure or abandonment of a project, promise, goal, etc.

examples.text: The whole plan was an abortion and was soon dropped.
examples.translation_cn: 整个计划彻底失败，很快就被放弃了。

senses.meaning_en: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday

examples.text: The committee will publish its report on Wednesday.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会将在星期三公布其报告。

senses.meaning_en: on Wednesday

examples.text: The final version of the essay is due Wednesday.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇论文的最终稿应在星期三提交。

senses.meaning_en: an area of ground covered in short grass

examples.text: The children sat on the grass and ate their lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们坐在草坪上吃午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a common plant with narrow leaves that grows in lawns and fields

examples.text: A single blade of grass pushed through the soil.
examples.translation_cn: 一片草叶从土里钻出来。

senses.meaning_en: a covering for the head

examples.text: She put on a warm hat before going outside.
examples.translation_cn: 她出门前戴上了一顶暖和的帽子。

senses.meaning_en: a role or capacity

examples.text: He wears two hats in this project: coder and designer.
examples.translation_cn: 他在这个项目里身兼两职：程序员和设计师。

senses.meaning_en: a container from which names or numbers are drawn in a lottery
senses.pattern: draw sth out of a hat
senses.collocation: pick a name out of a hat

examples.text: The teacher drew a name out of a hat to decide who would speak first.
examples.translation_cn: 老师从帽子里抽出一个名字来决定谁先发言。

senses.meaning_en: the first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning

examples.text: We usually have breakfast at seven before leaving for work.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常在七点吃早餐，然后出门上班。

senses.meaning_en: to eat the morning meal

examples.text: We breakfasted on toast and coffee before leaving for the station.
examples.translation_cn: 我们出发去车站前，早餐吃了吐司和咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: a country in southwestern Europe

examples.text: They spent their summer holiday in Spain last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去年在西班牙度过了暑假。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of catching fish for sport or food

examples.text: We went fishing at the lake every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每年夏天都去湖边钓鱼。

senses.meaning_en: the act of trying to get something indirectly

examples.text: She kept praising her colleagues, clearly fishing for compliments.
examples.translation_cn: 她不停地夸同事，显然是在旁敲侧击地讨夸奖。

senses.meaning_en: a place where fish are caught in large numbers

examples.text: The boats headed to the rich fishing grounds before dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 船只在黎明前驶向富饶的渔场。

senses.meaning_en: the business or industry of catching fish and other seafood for sale

examples.text: Commercial fishing is the main industry in this coastal town.
examples.translation_cn: 商业捕鱼是这个沿海小镇的主要产业。

senses.meaning_en: a country in Eastern Europe and northern Asia

examples.text: They plan to study in Russia for one year.
examples.translation_cn: 他们计划在俄罗斯学习一年。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone trouble or inconvenience

examples.text: I'm sorry to bother you with such a trivial matter.
examples.translation_cn: 很抱歉为这么一件小事打扰你。

senses.meaning_en: to take the trouble to do something

examples.text: He didn't even bother to say goodbye to us.
examples.translation_cn: 他甚至没费心跟我们道别。

senses.meaning_en: fuss or unnecessary trouble

examples.text: Why all this bother over a minor mistake?
examples.translation_cn: 为什么为一个小错误这么大惊小怪？

senses.meaning_en: to worry or upset someone

examples.text: It bothers me that he hasn't called since the accident.
examples.translation_cn: 自从事故后他一直没打电话，这让我很担心。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of making products or services known to possible customers

examples.text: The company spent millions on advertising for its new electric car.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司花了数百万为新款电动汽车做广告。

senses.meaning_en: the industry or profession that produces advertisements

examples.text: She works in advertising and handles major clients.
examples.translation_cn: 她在广告业工作，负责大客户。

senses.meaning_en: a set of steps connecting two floors

examples.text: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
examples.translation_cn: 她一步两级地跑上楼梯。

senses.meaning_en: a cutting tool with a sharp blade and a handle

examples.text: He carefully opened the box with a knife.
examples.translation_cn: 他小心翼翼地用刀打开了盒子。

senses.meaning_en: a weapon with a short sharp blade

examples.text: The attacker pulled a knife on the guard.
examples.translation_cn: 袭击者向保安拔出了刀。

senses.meaning_en: to cut or stab with a knife

examples.text: He was knifed in the chest during the fight.
examples.translation_cn: 他在打斗中胸部被刀刺伤。

senses.meaning_en: to cut through as if with a knife

examples.text: The cold wind knifed through his thin jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 寒风像刀一样刺透他薄薄的外套。

senses.meaning_en: land outside towns and cities, especially considered as a rural area or scenery

examples.text: We spent the weekend at a cottage in the countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在乡村的一间小屋度过了周末。

senses.meaning_en: connected to a larger network

examples.text: The new power plant will come online next month.
examples.translation_cn: 新发电厂下个月将并网运行。

senses.meaning_en: available or provided through the Internet

examples.text: She took an online course in marketing last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年上过一门市场营销的在线课程。

senses.meaning_en: connected to the Internet

examples.text: I'll be online after dinner if you want to chat.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后我会在线，如果你想聊天的话。

senses.meaning_en: while connected to the Internet

examples.text: You can renew your passport online these days.
examples.translation_cn: 现在你可以在网上更新护照。

senses.meaning_en: the fifth day of the week, following Wednesday and preceding Friday

examples.text: The school concert will take place on Thursday.
examples.translation_cn: 学校音乐会将在星期四举行。

senses.meaning_en: on Thursday

examples.text: She works at the downtown public library on Thursdays.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周四在市中心公共图书馆工作。

senses.meaning_en: a person who examines a situation to find out the truth

examples.text: She works as an investigator for the city police department.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市警察局担任调查员。

senses.meaning_en: a person who conducts research or academic study

examples.text: He is the lead investigator on the cancer research project.
examples.translation_cn: 他是这个癌症研究项目的首席研究员。

senses.meaning_en: the act of parking a vehicle

examples.text: Parking is not allowed on this side of the street.
examples.translation_cn: 这条街的这一侧不允许停车。

senses.meaning_en: a space or area where vehicles can be parked

examples.text: The hotel has free parking for overnight guests.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店为过夜客人提供免费停车。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of money spent, especially by a government or organization

examples.text: Government spending on education rose by five percent last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年政府在教育上的支出增加了百分之五。

senses.meaning_en: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday

examples.text: The new policy will take effect on Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策将于星期二生效。

senses.meaning_en: the University of Cambridge, a prestigious university in England

examples.text: She studied law at Cambridge for three years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在剑桥大学学了三年法律。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is travelling or visiting a place for pleasure

examples.text: Tourists flock to the beach in July every year.
examples.translation_cn: 每年七月，游客纷纷涌向海滩。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has only a superficial interest in something

examples.text: He is just a tourist in philosophy, reading popular books instead of serious works.
examples.translation_cn: 他对哲学只是浅尝辄止，只读通俗读物而不读严肃著作。

senses.meaning_en: the ordinal number matching the number five; in the position number five

examples.text: The fifth chapter of the book offers a clear summary.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书的第五章提供了一个清晰的总结。

senses.meaning_en: one of five equal parts of a whole

examples.text: A fifth of the students chose the online course.
examples.translation_cn: 五分之一的学生选择了在线课程。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to design things

examples.text: She works as a fashion designer in Milan.
examples.translation_cn: 她在米兰做时装设计师。

senses.meaning_en: made by a well-known designer

examples.text: She only buys expensive designer clothes from Paris.
examples.translation_cn: 她只从巴黎买昂贵名牌服饰。

senses.meaning_en: a person who plans something secretly

examples.text: The designer of the bombing plot was arrested.
examples.translation_cn: 爆炸阴谋的策划者被逮捕了。

senses.meaning_en: a request for information

examples.text: She made an enquiry about the cost of the course.
examples.translation_cn: 她询问了课程费用。

senses.meaning_en: an official investigation

examples.text: The committee launched an enquiry into the safety procedures.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会对安全程序展开了调查。

senses.meaning_en: the system for sending letters and packages

examples.text: You can return the form by mail or online.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以通过邮寄或在线方式退回表格。

senses.meaning_en: letters and packages delivered by post

examples.text: He opened his mail and found a wedding invitation.
examples.translation_cn: 他打开邮件，发现一份婚礼请柬。

senses.meaning_en: messages sent electronically

examples.text: I check my mail on my phone before I get out of bed.
examples.translation_cn: 我起床前用手机查看邮件。

senses.meaning_en: a US, Australian, or New Zealand dollar

examples.text: A cup of coffee costs only a few bucks here.
examples.translation_cn: 这里一杯咖啡只花几美元。

senses.meaning_en: a male deer, rabbit, or certain other animal

examples.text: We spotted a buck and a doe near the river.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在河边看到一只雄鹿和一只雌鹿。

senses.meaning_en: to resist or oppose something

examples.text: This company has managed to buck the trend and grow.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司设法逆势而上并实现了增长。

senses.meaning_en: to jump with all four feet off the ground and back arched

examples.text: The frightened horse began to buck and kick.
examples.translation_cn: 受惊的马开始弓背尥蹶子。

senses.meaning_en: a major city in central England, UK

examples.text: She has lived in Birmingham since she was a child.
examples.translation_cn: 她从小就住在伯明翰。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is accused in a legal case, especially a civil or divorce case

examples.text: The respondent in a civil case denied any liability.
examples.translation_cn: 民事案件中的被告否认任何责任。

senses.meaning_en: a person who answers or replies, especially in a survey

examples.text: Most respondents in a survey said they were satisfied with the service.
examples.translation_cn: 在一项调查中，大多数受访者表示对服务满意。

senses.meaning_en: a person or animal that kills

examples.text: The killer of the shop owner left no clues.
examples.translation_cn: 杀害店主的凶手没有留下任何线索。

senses.meaning_en: something very difficult or exhausting

examples.text: Today's training session was a real killer for me.
examples.translation_cn: 今天的训练课真是累死我了。

senses.meaning_en: something that defeats or destroys its competitors

examples.text: That streaming service became a killer app for the console.
examples.translation_cn: 那个流媒体服务成了这款游戏主机的杀手级应用。

senses.meaning_en: something very impressive or excellent

examples.text: Her latest dance single is an absolute killer.
examples.translation_cn: 她最新的舞曲单曲绝对是一首神曲。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to Canada or its people

examples.text: He is Canadian by birth, but he has spent most of his life in Australia.
examples.translation_cn: 他出生时是加拿大籍，但大半生在澳大利亚度过。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Canada

examples.text: As a Canadian, she is used to harsh winters.
examples.translation_cn: 作为加拿大人，她习惯了严寒的冬天。

senses.meaning_en: having a disability

examples.text: Their daughter was born disabled, but she is learning to read.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的女儿天生残疾，但正在学习阅读。

senses.meaning_en: not working correctly; out of order

examples.text: The car was disabled and had to be towed away.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆车无法行驶，只能被拖走。

senses.meaning_en: people who are disabled (used especially as the disabled)

examples.text: The city has improved access for the disabled.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市改善了残疾人出入的便利设施。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is easily led or influenced

examples.text: They followed their leader like sheep, without questioning anything.
examples.translation_cn: 他们像绵羊一样盲目追随领袖，从不质疑。

senses.meaning_en: a member of a church or religious group

examples.text: The pastor reminded the sheep of the church to love one another.
examples.translation_cn: 牧师提醒教会中的信徒要彼此相爱。

senses.meaning_en: a farm animal kept for its wool and meat

examples.text: A flock of sheep was grazing on the hillside.
examples.translation_cn: 一群羊正在山坡上吃草。

senses.meaning_en: the largest continent, located in the Eastern Hemisphere

examples.text: The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia.
examples.translation_cn: 长江是亚洲最长的河流。

senses.meaning_en: connected with something or somebody

examples.text: The rise in obesity is closely related to changes in diet.
examples.translation_cn: 肥胖增多与饮食变化密切相关。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to the same family

examples.text: She is related to the owner of the restaurant by blood.
examples.translation_cn: 她与这家餐馆的老板有血缘关系。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to the Olympic Games

examples.text: She won three gold medals in swimming at the Olympic Games.
examples.translation_cn: 她在奥运会上赢得了三枚游泳金牌。

senses.meaning_en: the plant or its grain, used as food

examples.text: He ordered a bowl of rice with grilled fish.
examples.translation_cn: 他点了一碗米饭配烤鱼。

senses.meaning_en: to press cooked potatoes or other food through a ricer into rice-sized pieces

examples.text: She riced the cooked potatoes before adding butter and milk.
examples.translation_cn: 她把煮熟的土豆压成米粒状，然后加入黄油和牛奶。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of chasing and killing wild animals for food or sport

examples.text: They go hunting in the highlands every autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 他们每年秋天都去高地打猎。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of looking for something, especially a job or flat

examples.text: She spent weeks hunting for a new flat.
examples.translation_cn: 她花了几周时间寻找新公寓。

senses.meaning_en: a kind of heavy paper; Bristol board

examples.text: She drew the design on a sheet of bristol.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一张布里斯托尔纸板上画了设计图。

senses.meaning_en: a sport played with rackets and a ball over a net

examples.text: We usually play tennis on the indoor court after school.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常放学后在室内球场打网球。

senses.meaning_en: to move through water by moving your body

examples.text: She swims in the lake every morning before breakfast.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早餐前在湖里游泳。

senses.meaning_en: to cross a stretch of water or a distance by swimming

examples.text: She swam the Channel in just twelve hours.
examples.translation_cn: 她仅用十二小时就游过了英吉利海峡。

senses.meaning_en: to seem to spin or move around; to feel dizzy

examples.text: My head swam as I tried to understand the complex terms.
examples.translation_cn: 我努力理解这些复杂的术语时，头晕目眩。

senses.meaning_en: to be full of liquid; to be drenched

examples.text: The kitchen floor was swimming in water after the pipe burst.
examples.translation_cn: 管道破裂后，厨房地板上全是水。

senses.meaning_en: the capital city of Germany

examples.text: I have lived in Berlin for five years.
examples.translation_cn: 我在柏林已经住了五年。

senses.meaning_en: someone who guards, watches over, or protects

examples.text: The charity acts as a guardian of children's rights.
examples.translation_cn: 这家慈善机构充当儿童权利的守护者。

senses.meaning_en: a person legally responsible for a child or an adult who cannot manage their own affairs

examples.text: Her uncle was appointed as her guardian after her parents passed away.
examples.translation_cn: 父母去世后，她的叔叔被指定为她的监护人。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of eating dinner, especially as a social occasion

examples.text: Dining with colleagues after work is a pleasant way to relax.
examples.translation_cn: 下班后与同事一起用餐是一种放松的好方式。

senses.meaning_en: the act of imposing taxes and the fact of being taxed

examples.text: Imported goods are subject to taxation at the border.
examples.translation_cn: 进口货物在边境须缴税。

senses.meaning_en: a particular system of taxing people or companies

examples.text: The country adopted a new system of taxation for digital services.
examples.translation_cn: 该国对数字服务采用了新的税制。

senses.meaning_en: the revenue gained from taxes

examples.text: The government relies on revenue from taxation to fund public services.
examples.translation_cn: 政府依靠税收收入来资助公共服务。

senses.meaning_en: a way of living that reflects the attitudes and values of a person or group

examples.text: He leads a very busy lifestyle in the city.
examples.translation_cn: 他在城市里过着非常忙碌的生活。

senses.meaning_en: a woman someone is having a romantic relationship with

examples.text: He has a serious girlfriend and plans to marry her next year.
examples.translation_cn: 他有一个感情认真的女朋友，计划明年与她结婚。

senses.meaning_en: a female friend, especially among women or gay men
senses.collocation: go to the gym with girlfriends

examples.text: Brenda goes to the gym with her girlfriends.
examples.translation_cn: 布伦达和她的闺蜜们一起去健身房。

senses.meaning_en: relating to Australia, its people, or its languages

examples.text: She speaks English with a broad Australian accent.
examples.translation_cn: 她说英语带浓重的澳大利亚口音。

senses.meaning_en: a person from Australia

examples.text: As an Australian, he is proud of the country's multicultural society.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一名澳大利亚人，他为这个国家的多元文化社会感到自豪。

senses.meaning_en: the act of signing up or registering

examples.text: Registration for the summer camp closes on Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 暑期夏令营的注册周五截止。

senses.meaning_en: a form or document that registers or makes something official

examples.text: Please fill in the registration and return it by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请填写登记表并在周五前寄回。

senses.meaning_en: the process of preparing food by heating it

examples.text: My mother usually does the cooking on weekdays.
examples.translation_cn: 我妈妈通常在工作日做饭。

senses.meaning_en: food that has been prepared by heating it

examples.text: We all enjoyed my grandmother's home cooking during the holidays.
examples.translation_cn: 假期里我们都喜欢我奶奶做的家常菜。

senses.meaning_en: used for cooking

examples.text: Use a little cooking oil to fry the vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 用少量食用油炒蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or business of growing crops

examples.text: Many local families work in farming and grow crops.
examples.translation_cn: 许多当地家庭从事耕作并种植庄稼。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or business of breeding and raising animals

examples.text: The farming of salmon has expanded along the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 鲑鱼养殖已在沿海地区扩大。

senses.meaning_en: relating to agriculture or farming

examples.text: Many young people in farming areas are moving to cities.
examples.translation_cn: 许多农业地区的年轻人正在迁往城市。

senses.meaning_en: a large keyboard musical instrument with black and white keys

examples.text: She has been learning to play the piano since she was six.
examples.translation_cn: 她从六岁起就在学弹钢琴。

senses.meaning_en: softly, as a musical direction

examples.text: The conductor asked the strings to play the passage piano.
examples.translation_cn: 指挥要求弦乐轻柔地演奏这一段。

senses.meaning_en: a car with a driver that you can hire to take you somewhere

examples.text: I usually take a taxi home after midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常在午夜后乘出租车回家。

senses.meaning_en: to move an aircraft on the ground under its own power

examples.text: Airplanes taxi down the runway before taking off.
examples.translation_cn: 飞机起飞前沿跑道滑行。

senses.meaning_en: fairness or justice in the way people are treated

examples.text: The law promotes equity in hiring and promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 法律促进招聘和晋升中的公平。

senses.meaning_en: a system of law that supplements common law and is based on principles of fairness

examples.text: The court applied principles of equity to settle the dispute.
examples.translation_cn: 法院运用衡平法原则解决了这一纠纷。

senses.meaning_en: the value of a property after all debts have been paid

examples.text: They have built up equity in their home.
examples.translation_cn: 他们已经积累了房屋净值。

senses.meaning_en: shares in a company that give the owner a claim on profits and assets

examples.text: She bought equity in the startup last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年购买了那家初创公司的股票。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or an occasion of drinking alcohol

examples.text: Excessive drinking can seriously damage your liver and brain.
examples.translation_cn: 过度饮酒会严重损害你的肝脏和大脑。

senses.meaning_en: suitable or used for drinking

examples.text: They provided clean drinking water to the village.
examples.translation_cn: 他们向村庄提供了干净的饮用水。

senses.meaning_en: the business activity of banks and people who work in them

examples.text: He has worked in banking for twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他在银行业工作了二十年。

senses.meaning_en: a sign or symbol that points to or shows something

examples.text: The green arrow on the map serves as an indicator of your current location.
examples.translation_cn: 地图上的绿色箭头用作你当前位置的指示符。

senses.meaning_en: a needle, dial, gauge, or other device that shows a measurement or state

examples.text: The pilot checked the fuel indicator before takeoff.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员在起飞前检查了燃油表。

senses.meaning_en: a flashing light on a vehicle that signals a turn

examples.text: She put on her indicator before turning left.
examples.translation_cn: 左转前她打开了转向灯。

senses.meaning_en: something that shows or gives information about something

examples.text: The unemployment rate is an indicator of economic health.
examples.translation_cn: 失业率是经济健康状况的一个指标。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of clothing worn by women and girls that hangs from the waist

examples.text: My sister always wears a skirt to work.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐总是穿裙子去上班。

senses.meaning_en: to avoid or go around something such as an issue or a problem

examples.text: He tried to skirt around the question during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会议上试图回避这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: a border, edge, or margin

examples.text: The village lies on the skirts of the mountain.
examples.translation_cn: 这个村庄坐落在山脚下。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a dress or robe that hangs below the waist

examples.text: The skirt of her dress was stained with mud.
examples.translation_cn: 她连衣裙的下摆沾了泥。

senses.meaning_en: the act of receiving something

examples.text: You must sign the form to acknowledge receipt of the goods.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须签署表格以确认收到货物。

senses.meaning_en: a written acknowledgment that goods or money have been received

examples.text: Always ask for a receipt when you pay by card.
examples.translation_cn: 刷卡付款时一定要索取收据。

senses.meaning_en: the amount of money received, especially by a business

examples.text: The restaurant's receipts from takeout orders increased sharply last month.
examples.translation_cn: 这家餐厅上个月的外卖订单收入大幅增长。

senses.meaning_en: used for walking or suitable for walking

examples.text: I bought a pair of comfortable walking shoes for the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 我为这次旅行买了一双舒适的步行鞋。

senses.meaning_en: having the qualities of a particular type of person or thing; living

examples.text: My grandfather is a walking encyclopedia of local history.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父是一部活的地方历史百科全书。

senses.meaning_en: able to walk despite injury or illness

examples.text: The soldier was among the walking wounded and did not need surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 这名士兵属于能走动的伤员，不需要手术。

senses.meaning_en: a person who dances as a hobby or profession

examples.text: She works as a dancer in the national ballet company.
examples.translation_cn: 她在国家芭蕾舞团当舞蹈演员。

senses.meaning_en: the process of producing young animals or plants, especially in a controlled way

examples.text: The breeding of rare birds is strictly controlled by law.
examples.translation_cn: 珍稀鸟类的繁殖受到法律的严格控制。

senses.meaning_en: good manners and polite behaviour that come from being well brought up

examples.text: She is of good breeding and speaks to everyone politely.
examples.translation_cn: 她很有教养，对每个人说话都很礼貌。

senses.meaning_en: the family or social class that you come from

examples.text: He is of noble breeding, though he lives simply.
examples.translation_cn: 他出身贵族，却过着简朴的生活。

senses.meaning_en: very strong and heavy, especially of rain or snow

examples.text: The hikers pushed on in the driving rain.
examples.translation_cn: 徒步者冒着倾盆大雨继续前进。

senses.meaning_en: the action or skill of controlling a vehicle

examples.text: Texting while driving is dangerous and illegal in many countries.
examples.translation_cn: 在许多国家，开车时发短信既危险又违法。

senses.meaning_en: providing the force or motivation to make something happen

examples.text: She is the driving force behind the project.
examples.translation_cn: 她是这个项目背后的推动力。

senses.meaning_en: wild, uncultivated land

examples.text: They spent a month hiking in the wilderness.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在荒野中远足了一个月。

senses.meaning_en: an uncared-for place that has become wild or disorderly

examples.text: The old abandoned garden soon became a wilderness.
examples.translation_cn: 那座废弃的旧花园很快变成了一片荒芜之地。

senses.meaning_en: a state of being out of favour or out of office

examples.text: After the scandal, the senator was in the wilderness for years.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻过后，这位参议员多年不受重用。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of work samples or documents, especially for showing skills

examples.text: She showed us a portfolio of her best work.
examples.translation_cn: 她向我们展示了她最优秀的作品合集。

senses.meaning_en: the responsibilities of a government minister or department head

examples.text: She holds the portfolio for health in the new cabinet.
examples.translation_cn: 她在新内阁中负责卫生事务。

senses.meaning_en: a set of investments held by a person or organization

examples.text: He holds a diverse portfolio of stocks and bonds.
examples.translation_cn: 他持有股票和债券的多元化投资组合。

senses.meaning_en: a range of products or services offered by a company

examples.text: The company offers a wide portfolio of software products.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司提供广泛的软件产品组合。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is traveling or who often travels

examples.text: The traveler from Canada checked into the hotel.
examples.translation_cn: 那位从加拿大来的旅行者入住了酒店。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or activity of moving through water

examples.text: We usually go swimming at the local pool on Saturday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常星期六早上去当地游泳池游泳。

senses.meaning_en: a room or building equipped for physical exercise

examples.text: I usually work out at the gym near my office after work.
examples.translation_cn: 我通常下班后在办公室附近的健身房锻炼。

senses.meaning_en: physical exercise or a class in gymnastics

examples.text: The children have gym in the school hall on Friday afternoons.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们每周五下午在学校礼堂上体操课。

senses.meaning_en: the act of something that starts

examples.text: The starting of the new project was postponed until June.
examples.translation_cn: 新项目的启动被推迟到六月。

senses.meaning_en: used at the beginning of a period or activity, or as the first in a series

examples.text: This report provides a useful starting point for our discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告为我们的讨论提供了一个有用的起点。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is trained to treat people, especially a psychotherapist

examples.text: He sees a therapist about his social anxiety.
examples.translation_cn: 他因为社交焦虑去看治疗师。

senses.meaning_en: a device that starts an engine or machine

examples.text: The starter motor turns the engine over when you turn the key.
examples.translation_cn: 拧钥匙时，起动机带动发动机运转。

senses.meaning_en: a small savoury dish served before the main course of a meal

examples.text: We ordered soup as a starter and pasta for the main course.
examples.translation_cn: 我们点了汤作开胃菜，意面当主菜。

senses.meaning_en: a person or horse that takes part in a race from the start

examples.text: There were only six starters in the race because of the heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 由于大雨，只有六名参赛者参加了比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a player in the starting lineup at the beginning of a game

examples.text: He was a starter for the school team in every game last season.
examples.translation_cn: 他上赛季每场比赛都是校队首发。

senses.meaning_en: a country in southeastern Europe with a mainland and many islands

examples.text: Olive oil is an important product in Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 橄榄油是希腊的一种重要产品。

senses.meaning_en: relating to your job or profession

examples.text: Back pain is a common occupational hazard for office workers.
examples.translation_cn: 背痛是办公室职员常见的职业风险。

senses.meaning_en: due to be paid

examples.text: The invoice is payable within 30 days of receipt.
examples.translation_cn: 发票须在收到后30天内支付。

senses.meaning_en: able to be paid; made out to a named payee

examples.text: All cheques should be payable to the company.
examples.translation_cn: 所有支票都应写明支付给该公司。

senses.meaning_en: debts owed by a business; liabilities

examples.text: Accounts payable are recorded under current liabilities on the balance sheet.
examples.translation_cn: 应付账款在资产负债表上列于流动负债项下。

senses.meaning_en: a large self-service store selling groceries and household goods

examples.text: She does her weekly grocery shopping at the supermarket.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周在超市购买食品杂货。

senses.meaning_en: (of a remark) meant to hurt someone's feelings

examples.text: She can be very cutting about people she dislikes.
examples.translation_cn: 她对自己不喜欢的人说话很尖刻。

senses.meaning_en: (of wind or cold) very cold and sharp

examples.text: A cutting wind blew across the open field.
examples.translation_cn: 凛冽的风吹过空旷的田野。

senses.meaning_en: a piece cut from a newspaper or magazine

examples.text: I kept a cutting from the local paper about the flood.
examples.translation_cn: 我保留了一张当地报纸上关于洪水的那篇剪报。

senses.meaning_en: a piece cut from a plant to grow a new one

examples.text: You can grow a new rose bush from a cutting.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用插枝培育出一株新玫瑰。

senses.meaning_en: the editing of film or other recordings

examples.text: The cutting of the film was finished only a week before the premiere.
examples.translation_cn: 影片剪辑在首映前一周才完成。

senses.meaning_en: connected with a parent or parents

examples.text: The school requires parental consent for the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 学校要求这次旅行须经父母同意。

senses.meaning_en: the action of the verb to wash

examples.text: The constant washing of the waves slowly eroded the cliff.
examples.translation_cn: 海浪不断的冲刷慢慢侵蚀了悬崖。

senses.meaning_en: clothes, sheets, etc. that need washing or have just been washed

examples.text: She hung out the washing before it started to rain.
examples.translation_cn: 她趁着还没下雨把洗好的衣物晾了出去。

senses.meaning_en: a formal test of knowledge or ability

examples.text: She has an exam in chemistry tomorrow morning.
examples.translation_cn: 她明天早上有一场化学考试。

senses.meaning_en: a medical examination of a part or all of the body

examples.text: The doctor gave him a medical exam before the surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 手术前医生给他做了一次体检。

senses.meaning_en: the currency of the United Kingdom; pound sterling

examples.text: Payment is due in sterling, not in euros.
examples.translation_cn: 付款应以英镑支付，而不是欧元。

senses.meaning_en: excellent; very good

examples.text: Her volunteer work is a sterling example of community spirit.
examples.translation_cn: 她的志愿工作是社区精神的一个杰出典范。

senses.meaning_en: of standard quality; made of pure silver

examples.text: She bought a pair of sterling silver earrings at the market.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市场上买了一对纯银耳环。

senses.meaning_en: the cardinal number 0, indicating no quantity or amount

examples.text: She got zero points on the quiz because she left it blank.
examples.translation_cn: 她因为交了白卷，测验得了零分。

senses.meaning_en: the symbol or digit that represents the number 0

examples.text: Computer data is stored as a series of zeros and ones.
examples.translation_cn: 计算机数据以一连串0和1的形式存储。

senses.meaning_en: nothing; not any

examples.text: He started from zero and built a successful company.
examples.translation_cn: 他从零开始，建立了一家成功的公司。

senses.meaning_en: the value of a magnitude corresponding to the cardinal number zero, especially temperature

examples.text: The temperature dropped to ten below zero last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚气温降到了零下十度。

senses.meaning_en: the way someone deals with a person or situation

examples.text: The government's handling of the crisis was widely criticized.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对危机的处理受到了广泛批评。

senses.meaning_en: the way a vehicle or machine responds to control

examples.text: The handling of the car felt light and precise on mountain roads.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车的操控在山路上感觉轻快而精准。

senses.meaning_en: the crime of dealing in stolen goods
senses.pattern: be charged with handling stolen goods

examples.text: He was charged with handling stolen goods from the warehouse.
examples.translation_cn: 他因处理从仓库偷来的赃物而被起诉。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow street or passageway between buildings

examples.text: A stray cat was sleeping in an alley behind the restaurant.
examples.translation_cn: 一只流浪猫睡在餐馆后面的小巷里。

senses.meaning_en: a building or room with lanes for bowling

examples.text: We celebrated her birthday at a bowling alley last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们上周末在保龄球馆为她庆祝了生日。

senses.meaning_en: attractive in a sweet or endearing way

examples.text: The little girl with pigtails is so cute.
examples.translation_cn: 扎着马尾辫的小女孩真可爱。

senses.meaning_en: physically attractive or pleasing; good-looking

examples.text: I find the new guy across the hall really cute.
examples.translation_cn: 我觉得走廊对面新来的那个男生真的很帅。

senses.meaning_en: clever in an annoying or manipulative way

examples.text: Don't get cute with me—just answer the question.
examples.translation_cn: 别跟我耍小聪明——直接回答问题。

senses.meaning_en: Occupying a middle position; middle.

examples.text: She began her law career in her mid-20s.
examples.translation_cn: 她在二十多岁时开始了她的法律生涯。

senses.meaning_en: the industry of extracting minerals from the earth

examples.text: His father worked in mining for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他父亲在采矿业工作了三十年。

senses.meaning_en: the process of extracting or undermining something

examples.text: Mining for personal data raises serious privacy concerns.
examples.translation_cn: 挖掘个人数据引发严重的隐私问题。

senses.meaning_en: the act of planting explosive mines

examples.text: The mining of the harbor blocked all enemy ships.
examples.translation_cn: 在港口布设地雷封锁了所有敌舰。

senses.meaning_en: the process of creating cryptocurrency by validating transactions

examples.text: Mining for cryptocurrency requires powerful computers and cheap electricity.
examples.translation_cn: 挖加密货币需要强大的计算机和廉价电力。

senses.meaning_en: the act of placing something or the state of being placed; a location

examples.text: The strategic placement of the mirrors makes the room look brighter.
examples.translation_cn: 镜子的巧妙摆放让房间显得更明亮。

senses.meaning_en: a temporary period of work for gaining experience

examples.text: She is on placement at a local hospital this term.
examples.translation_cn: 她这学期在当地一家医院实习。

senses.meaning_en: the act of finding a job for someone

examples.text: The agency provides job placement for people with disabilities.
examples.translation_cn: 该机构为残疾人提供就业安置服务。

senses.meaning_en: the practice of featuring a product in a film or TV show for advertising

examples.text: There was very obvious product placement in the final scene.
examples.translation_cn: 最后一幕里有非常明显的产品植入。

senses.meaning_en: the activity of travelling to or visiting a place, especially for pleasure

examples.text: Tourism to the island has increased sharply this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年去该岛旅游的人数急剧增加。

senses.meaning_en: the business of providing services for tourists

examples.text: She has worked in tourism for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在旅游业工作了十多年。

senses.meaning_en: a direct popular vote on a proposed law or constitutional amendment; a vote by all the people on an important political or social question

examples.text: The government will hold a referendum on the new constitution next year.
examples.translation_cn: 政府明年将就新宪法举行公民投票。

senses.meaning_en: an action or choice perceived as passing judgment on another matter
senses.pattern: be seen as a referendum on sth

examples.text: The election was seen as a referendum on the government's handling of the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 这次选举被看作对政府危机处理的间接表态。

senses.meaning_en: the process of making or producing something

examples.text: The new bridge was five years in the making.
examples.translation_cn: 这座新桥花了五年时间才建成。

senses.meaning_en: the qualities needed to become something

examples.text: She has the makings of a great doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 她具备成为优秀医生的素质。

senses.meaning_en: rules for exchanging data between computers or networks

examples.text: The devices use a protocol to exchange data securely.
examples.translation_cn: 这些设备使用一种协议来安全地交换数据。

senses.meaning_en: the official rules of polite behaviour in diplomacy or formal ceremonies

examples.text: The ambassador strictly observed protocol at the state banquet.
examples.translation_cn: 大使在国宴上严格遵守了外交礼仪。

senses.meaning_en: a standard procedure for conducting an experiment or medical procedure

examples.text: Researchers must follow the protocol for collecting blood samples.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员必须遵循采集血液样本的规程。

senses.meaning_en: an official amendment or addition to a treaty

examples.text: The two countries signed a protocol to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.translation_cn: 两国签署了一项减少碳排放的议定书。

senses.meaning_en: a person who plans something

examples.text: She works as a planner for the city government.
examples.translation_cn: 她为市政府做规划工作。

senses.meaning_en: a book or software for recording plans and appointments

examples.text: I write all my appointments and deadlines in a daily planner.
examples.translation_cn: 我把我所有的约会和截止日期都写在每日计划本上。

senses.meaning_en: an arrangement to reserve a service, room, seat, or performance

examples.text: You can make a booking for the guided tour at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以到前台预订导览。

senses.meaning_en: a caution given to a player in a game, recorded by the referee

examples.text: The midfielder received a booking for a late challenge in the first half.
examples.translation_cn: 那名中场因上半场一次铲球过晚而被记名警告。

senses.meaning_en: an estimate or act of estimating how much something is worth

examples.text: The valuation of the house was much higher than expected.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋房子的估值比预期高很多。

senses.meaning_en: produced by a printing press or computer printer

examples.text: She handed me a printed copy of the report before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她在会前递给我一份打印好的报告。

senses.meaning_en: having a pattern printed on fabric or clothing

examples.text: She wore a printed dress with small white dots.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一件带小白点的印花连衣裙。

senses.meaning_en: written by hand in separate block letters

examples.text: Fill out the form in printed letters, not cursive.
examples.translation_cn: 请用印刷体填写表格，不要用草书。

senses.meaning_en: a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares, used especially on maps or puzzles

examples.text: The map is overlaid with a grid of small squares to make locations easier to find.
examples.translation_cn: 地图上覆盖着小方格网格，以方便查找位置。

senses.meaning_en: a network of computers that work together to process large amounts of data

examples.text: The research centre uses a grid of computers to process huge datasets.
examples.translation_cn: 该研究中心使用计算机网格来处理海量数据。

senses.meaning_en: a system of wires and stations for delivering electricity over a large area

examples.text: The solar farm is connected to the local power grid.
examples.translation_cn: 这座太阳能发电场接入了当地电网。

senses.meaning_en: the starting positions of the drivers in a race

examples.text: His car was placed on the second row of the starting grid.
examples.translation_cn: 他的赛车被安排在起跑排位的第二排。

senses.meaning_en: breastfeeding; in the state of breastfeeding

examples.text: Nursing mothers often find frequent nursing exhausting at night.
examples.translation_cn: 哺乳期的妈妈们常常觉得夜间频繁喂奶令人疲惫。

senses.meaning_en: relating to nurses or the care of patients

examples.text: The hospital is hiring more nursing staff this year.
examples.translation_cn: 这家医院今年正在招聘更多护理人员。

senses.meaning_en: the profession or work of caring for patients as a nurse

examples.text: She decided to study nursing after high school.
examples.translation_cn: 她高中毕业后决定学习护理。

senses.meaning_en: work assigned by a teacher to be done outside class

examples.text: Please hand in your homework before you leave the classroom.
examples.translation_cn: 请在离开教室前交作业。

senses.meaning_en: work done to prepare for a meeting or decision

examples.text: You should do your homework on the company before the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 你在面试前应该对这家公司做些功课。

senses.meaning_en: the process or business of producing printed material

examples.text: The printing of the first books was slow and costly.
examples.translation_cn: 第一批书籍的印刷既慢又贵。

senses.meaning_en: a style of handwriting in which letters are not joined together

examples.text: Please write your name in neat printing on the form.
examples.translation_cn: 请在表格上用工整的印刷体写下你的名字。

senses.meaning_en: printed matter; printed material considered collectively

examples.text: The library holds a notable collection of early printing.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆藏有一批著名的早期印刷品。

senses.meaning_en: severe emotional shock or injury

examples.text: After the accident, she suffered from emotional trauma for months.
examples.translation_cn: 事故后，她遭受了数月的情感创伤。

senses.meaning_en: an event that causes great distress

examples.text: The trauma of divorce affected the children for years.
examples.translation_cn: 离婚的痛苦经历影响了孩子们多年。

senses.meaning_en: physical injury to the body

examples.text: He suffered blunt trauma to his head in the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 他在车祸中头部受到钝性外伤。

senses.meaning_en: situated nearby or adjacent

examples.text: We spent the afternoon exploring the neighboring village.
examples.translation_cn: 我们花了一下午探索邻近的村庄。

senses.meaning_en: a British unit of money equal to one hundredth of a pound

examples.text: The price is shown in pence, not pounds.
examples.translation_cn: 价格以便士而非英镑显示。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of interlinked web pages on the World Wide Web, typically accessible from the same base URL

examples.text: I found the opening hours on the school's website.
examples.translation_cn: 我在学校网站上找到了开放时间。

senses.meaning_en: difficult, requiring effort

examples.text: The final exam was challenging for most students.
examples.translation_cn: 期末考试对大多数学生来说有挑战性。

senses.meaning_en: the process of making something clean

examples.text: We usually do the cleaning on Sunday mornings.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常在周日早上打扫卫生。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or activity of moving over snow on skis

examples.text: We often go skiing in the Alps during winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们冬天常去阿尔卑斯山滑雪。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to clean rooms, floors, windows, etc.

examples.text: My aunt works as a cleaner in a large office.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑妈在一间大办公室做清洁工。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used for cleaning things

examples.text: Spray an all-purpose cleaner on the greasy surface before wiping.
examples.translation_cn: 擦拭前先在油腻的表面上喷上多用途清洁剂。

senses.meaning_en: a shop where clothes are dry-cleaned

examples.text: She dropped off the curtains at the cleaner's on her way to work.
examples.translation_cn: 她在上班路上把窗帘送到干洗店。

senses.meaning_en: a machine or device that cleans something

examples.text: Use a vacuum cleaner with strong suction for thick carpets.
examples.translation_cn: 清洁厚地毯请用吸力强的真空吸尘器。

senses.meaning_en: relating to land or territory belonging to a country

examples.text: The ship was caught in foreign territorial waters.
examples.translation_cn: 那艘船在他国领海被扣。

senses.meaning_en: guarding an area against other animals

examples.text: The cat is territorial about its favorite spot on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 这只猫对沙发上它最喜欢的位置有地盘意识。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who sing together, especially in church or as a trained group

examples.text: She has sung in the church choir since she was a child.
examples.translation_cn: 她从小就在教堂唱诗班唱歌。

senses.meaning_en: a person who arranges the details of an event

examples.text: The organizer of the meeting handled every detail smoothly.
examples.translation_cn: 会议组织者顺利处理了每一个细节。

senses.meaning_en: a small electronic device used to store personal information and appointments

examples.text: She stores her contacts and appointments in a personal organizer.
examples.translation_cn: 她把联系人和约见时间都储存在个人电子记事本里。

senses.meaning_en: a small rise in temperature

examples.text: The warming of the Arctic affects global weather.
examples.translation_cn: 北极变暖影响全球天气。

senses.meaning_en: making you feel warm

examples.text: She sipped a warming drink beside the fire.
examples.translation_cn: 她在炉火旁喝了一杯暖身的饮料。

senses.meaning_en: a small or thin book

examples.text: I picked up a free booklet on local walking trails.
examples.translation_cn: 我拿了一本关于当地步行路线的小册子。

senses.meaning_en: a mixed alcoholic drink

examples.text: The bartender mixed a cocktail with rum, lime, and mint for the guests.
examples.translation_cn: 调酒师用朗姆酒、青柠和薄荷为客人调了一杯鸡尾酒。

senses.meaning_en: a mixture of different substances or things

examples.text: The stew was a cocktail of spices and herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 这道炖菜是各种香料和香草的混合。

senses.meaning_en: a small dish of seafood or fruit served as a starter

examples.text: She ordered a prawn cocktail and a green salad.
examples.translation_cn: 她点了一份大虾冷盘和一份蔬菜沙拉。

senses.meaning_en: to adulterate something by mixing in another substance

examples.text: Some dealers cocktail diesel with kerosene to raise profits.
examples.translation_cn: 一些商贩在柴油里掺煤油来提高利润。

senses.meaning_en: increasing in level or amount
senses.pattern: a rising number of + plural noun

examples.text: A rising number of students are choosing online courses.
examples.translation_cn: 选择在线课程的学生人数正在增多。

senses.meaning_en: becoming more important or famous
senses.pattern: one of the rising stars of + field

examples.text: She is one of the rising stars of British fashion.
examples.translation_cn: 她是英国时装界一颗崭露头角的新星。

senses.meaning_en: an occasion when people protest violently against those in power

examples.text: An armed rising against the government broke out in 1848.
examples.translation_cn: 1848年爆发了一场反对政府的武装起义。

senses.meaning_en: going up; moving to a higher position or level

examples.text: The rising sun cast a golden light over the hills.
examples.translation_cn: 升起的太阳在群山之上投下一片金光。

senses.meaning_en: an official document that proves your identity and nationality and allows you to travel abroad

examples.text: She had to apply for a passport before studying abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她在出国留学前必须申请护照。

senses.meaning_en: a thing that makes it possible to achieve something

examples.text: A good education can be a passport to a better future.
examples.translation_cn: 良好的教育可能是通向更美好未来的通行证。

senses.meaning_en: an advance through and past enemy lines
senses.pattern: a breakthrough in the enemy lines

examples.text: The army made a breakthrough in the enemy lines.
examples.translation_cn: 军队在敌军防线上取得了突破。

senses.meaning_en: any major progress or discovery that overcomes a significant obstacle

examples.text: The new treatment marks a major breakthrough in cancer research.
examples.translation_cn: 这种新疗法标志着癌症研究的一项重大突破。

senses.meaning_en: characterized by major progress or overcoming an obstacle

examples.text: The company launched a breakthrough product that changed the industry.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司推出了一款改变行业的突破性产品。

senses.meaning_en: Material applied to a wound for protection or therapy.

examples.text: The nurse applied a clean dressing to the wound.
examples.translation_cn: 护士在伤口上敷了干净的敷料。

senses.meaning_en: A sauce, especially a cold one for salads.

examples.text: She poured a little dressing over the salad before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前她在沙拉上倒了一点沙拉酱。

senses.meaning_en: Something added to the soil as a fertilizer; manure applied to a garden.

examples.text: Spread a dressing of compost over the soil in spring.
examples.translation_cn: 春天在土壤上撒一层堆肥。

senses.meaning_en: The activity of getting dressed.

examples.text: Dressing for the ceremony took longer than expected.
examples.translation_cn: 为仪式穿衣比预期花的时间长。

senses.meaning_en: a cooking device with a metal frame over heat

examples.text: We cooked the fish on the grill in the backyard.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在后院的烤架上烤了鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a metal frame with bars or holes that lets air or liquid pass through

examples.text: The fan draws air through the grill at the back of the unit.
examples.translation_cn: 风扇将空气从设备背面的格栅吸入。

senses.meaning_en: to ask someone a lot of questions in an aggressive way

examples.text: Police grilled the suspect about his movements that night.
examples.translation_cn: 警方盘问了嫌疑人关于他当晚的行踪。

senses.meaning_en: food cooked on a grill, often a mixed grill

examples.text: You can have a mixed grill with chips for lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午餐你可以吃混合烧烤配薯条。

senses.meaning_en: relating to psychiatry or mental illness

examples.text: She has been receiving psychiatric treatment for depression.
examples.translation_cn: 她因抑郁症一直在接受精神科治疗。

senses.meaning_en: the murder of an important person, especially for political reasons

examples.text: The assassination of the president led to nationwide mourning.
examples.translation_cn: 总统遇刺导致全国哀悼。

senses.meaning_en: the act of destroying someone's reputation or a plan

examples.text: The leaked memo was a blatant assassination of her character.
examples.translation_cn: 泄露的备忘录是对她人格的公然诋毁。

senses.meaning_en: the capital city of Greece, known for its ancient history and landmarks

examples.text: The Acropolis is one of the most famous ancient landmarks in Athens.
examples.translation_cn: 雅典卫城是雅典最著名的古代地标之一。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the eye or vision

examples.text: The optic nerve carries visual information from the eye to the brain.
examples.translation_cn: 视神经将视觉信息从眼睛传送到大脑。

senses.meaning_en: the chief administrative officer of a prison

examples.text: She served as warden of the county jail for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在县监狱当了十年监狱长。

senses.meaning_en: an official with supervisory or enforcement duties, such as a traffic or game warden

examples.text: She works as a traffic warden in the city centre.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市中心担任交通督导员。

senses.meaning_en: the head of certain university colleges or residences in the UK

examples.text: The warden of St Mary's College welcomed the new residents.
examples.translation_cn: 圣玛丽学院的院长欢迎了新入住的学生。

senses.meaning_en: in a proper or suitable manner

examples.text: All complaints were duly recorded by the staff.
examples.translation_cn: 所有投诉都被工作人员妥善记录。

senses.meaning_en: at the proper time; on time

examples.text: The package duly arrived early on Monday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 包裹在星期一早上准时到达。

senses.meaning_en: sale of goods at reduced prices

examples.text: All winter coats are on clearance this week.
examples.translation_cn: 所有冬季大衣本周都在清仓。

senses.meaning_en: act of removing unwanted things

examples.text: The clearance of the old building took two days.
examples.translation_cn: 拆除旧楼花了两天。

senses.meaning_en: official permission, especially security clearance or permission to travel

examples.text: She received clearance to enter the restricted area.
examples.translation_cn: 她获准进入限制区域。

senses.meaning_en: space or distance between objects

examples.text: There is enough clearance between the truck and the bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车和桥梁之间有足够的间隙。

senses.meaning_en: used in a practical way; not just theoretical

examples.text: The university offers a course in applied physics.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学开设一门应用物理课程。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or activity of travelling in a boat with sails

examples.text: We go sailing on the lake every weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每个周末都去湖上帆船航行。

senses.meaning_en: a scheduled voyage by a ferry or ship

examples.text: The last sailing to the island was cancelled due to rough seas.
examples.translation_cn: 去岛上的最后一班船因风浪太大取消了。

senses.meaning_en: the time when a ship leaves a port

examples.text: What time is the next sailing to the island?
examples.translation_cn: 下一班去岛上的船几点开？

senses.meaning_en: a factory where raw materials are processed or manufactured

examples.text: My grandfather worked in cotton mills for thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父在棉纺厂工作了三十年。

senses.meaning_en: a building with machinery for grinding grain into flour

examples.text: These old mills still grind grain into flour every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 这些老磨坊每天早晨仍在把谷物磨成面粉。

senses.meaning_en: a machine that crushes or grinds solid materials

examples.text: Electric pepper mills grind peppercorns in just seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 电动胡椒研磨机几秒钟就能磨碎胡椒粒。

senses.meaning_en: a city in Australia, the capital of New South Wales

examples.text: My sister has lived in Sydney for over ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在悉尼已经住了十多年。

senses.meaning_en: an organization of craftsmen or merchants formed to protect their trade interests

examples.text: A guild of bakers controlled bread prices in the medieval town.
examples.translation_cn: 面包师行会控制着中世纪城镇的面包价格。

senses.meaning_en: an organized group of players who regularly play together in a multiplayer game

examples.text: She joined a gaming guild to find teammates for weekly raids.
examples.translation_cn: 她加入了一个游戏公会，寻找每周团队副本的队友。

senses.meaning_en: the business of providing food and related services for events

examples.text: The hotel provides catering for conferences, weddings, and other large events.
examples.translation_cn: 这家酒店为会议、婚礼和其他大型活动提供餐饮服务。

senses.meaning_en: a place of safety or refuge

examples.text: The monastery offered asylum to travelers caught in the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 修道院为遭遇风暴的旅客提供了避难所。

senses.meaning_en: protection given by a government to someone who has left their own country to escape danger or war

examples.text: She was granted asylum in Canada after fleeing the war.
examples.translation_cn: 她在逃离战争后获得了加拿大的政治庇护。

senses.meaning_en: a hospital for people with mental illness

examples.text: In the 19th century, patients were often confined in asylums for years.
examples.translation_cn: 在19世纪，病人常常被关在精神病院里多年。

senses.meaning_en: a genre of dance music popular in the 1970s, with a strong beat and Latin-American influence

examples.text: They danced to disco all night at the party last weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他们上周末在聚会上伴着迪斯科音乐跳了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: a dance or social gathering where dancing is the main activity

examples.text: They met at a school disco when they were teenagers.
examples.translation_cn: 他们十几岁时在学校迪斯科舞会上认识。

senses.meaning_en: land that is covered mostly with water, with occasional marshy and soggy areas

examples.text: Many rare birds nest in wetlands every spring.
examples.translation_cn: 每年春天，许多珍稀鸟类在湿地筑巢。

senses.meaning_en: used for sleep; helping one to sleep

examples.text: She packed a sleeping bag and a sleeping pill for the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 她为这次旅行打包了一个睡袋和一片安眠药。

senses.meaning_en: asleep; in a state of sleep

examples.text: A sleeping child lay on the sofa without moving.
examples.translation_cn: 一个睡着的孩子躺在沙发上一动不动。

senses.meaning_en: a system of government in which a king or queen is the head of state

examples.text: Under a monarchy, the throne is usually inherited rather than elected.
examples.translation_cn: 在君主制下，王位通常是继承的，而不是选举产生的。

senses.meaning_en: a country ruled by a king or queen

examples.text: Belgium is a monarchy in the west of Europe.
examples.translation_cn: 比利时是欧洲西部的一个君主国。

senses.meaning_en: the science or practice of planting and managing forests

examples.text: Students who study forestry learn how to plant and manage forests.
examples.translation_cn: 学习林业的学生学习如何种植和管理森林。

senses.meaning_en: a person or organization that lends money

examples.text: The bank is a lender to many local farmers in the county.
examples.translation_cn: 这家银行是该县许多当地农民的贷款机构。

senses.meaning_en: able to be believed or trusted

examples.text: The witness's statement is credible to the jury despite minor inconsistencies.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管有些小矛盾，证人的陈述对陪审团来说是可信的。

senses.meaning_en: able to be accepted as possible or effective

examples.text: The rebel group posed a credible threat to the capital.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军对首都构成了切实的威胁。

senses.meaning_en: authentic or convincing

examples.text: The actor gave a credible performance as a war veteran.
examples.translation_cn: 这位演员饰演一名退伍军人，表演令人信服。

senses.meaning_en: the process of collecting and treating waste materials so that they can be used again

examples.text: The recycling of plastic bottles reduces the amount of waste sent to landfills.
examples.translation_cn: 回收利用塑料瓶减少了送往填埋场的垃圾数量。

senses.meaning_en: materials such as paper, glass, and plastic that are separated from waste to be recycled

examples.text: Don't forget to put out the recycling before you leave for work.
examples.translation_cn: 别忘了在上班前把可回收物放出去。

senses.meaning_en: an activity you enjoy doing in your spare time

examples.text: My grandfather builds model ships as a hobby.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父把制作船模当作业余爱好。

senses.meaning_en: the choice and style of words used in a particular context

examples.text: We need to review the exact wording of the contract before signing.
examples.translation_cn: 我们签署前需要审阅合同的确切措辞。

senses.meaning_en: a grade or score given for academic work

examples.text: She got good marks in every subject last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年每门课都取得了好成绩。

senses.meaning_en: an open motor vehicle with two or three wheels, steered by handlebars

examples.text: He travels to work on a motorcycle every day.
examples.translation_cn: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

senses.meaning_en: to ride or travel by motorcycle

examples.text: They went motorcycling across the country last summer.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去年夏天骑摩托车穿越了这个国家。

senses.meaning_en: protective metal clothing worn by soldiers in the past

examples.text: The knight was dressed in full armour for the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 骑士穿着全套盔甲参加仪式。

senses.meaning_en: thick metal covering on military vehicles or ships for protection

examples.text: The tank is protected by several inches of steel armour plating.
examples.translation_cn: 坦克由几英寸厚的钢装甲板保护。
