senses.meaning_en: hard shell or covering on some animals that protects them

examples.text: The armadillo is covered in thick bony armour.
examples.translation_cn: 犰狳覆盖着厚厚的骨质甲壳。

senses.meaning_en: to replace the original speech in a film or television programme with speech in another language

examples.text: The documentary was dubbed into six languages for international viewers.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片配了六种语言供国际观众观看。

senses.meaning_en: to give someone or something a particular name or title, often unofficially

examples.text: Critics dubbed the young player the future of tennis.
examples.translation_cn: 评论家称这位年轻选手为网球的未来。

senses.meaning_en: a park where live animals are kept for the public to see

examples.text: We go to the zoo every summer to see the new baby animals.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每年夏天都去动物园看新生的动物宝宝。

senses.meaning_en: a place that is crowded, noisy, and chaotic

examples.text: The office was a zoo on the day of the product launch.
examples.translation_cn: 产品发布那天办公室里一片混乱。

senses.meaning_en: a state of political or social disturbance, often involving protests or riots

examples.text: Political unrest in the region has disrupted supply chains.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的政治动荡扰乱了供应链。

senses.meaning_en: a printed or digital token that entitles the holder to a discount or can be exchanged for goods or services

examples.text: I received a voucher for a free meal at the new cafe.
examples.translation_cn: 我收到了一张新咖啡馆的免费餐券。

senses.meaning_en: a receipt or document proving that a payment has been made

examples.text: The committee accepted the hotel bill as a voucher for the travel claim.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会接受了酒店账单作为差旅报销凭证。

senses.meaning_en: temporary; intended to be replaced or made permanent later

examples.text: The ceasefire was provisional until both sides signed the formal agreement.
examples.translation_cn: 停火是临时的，直到双方签署正式协议为止。

senses.meaning_en: Of or relating to a department

examples.text: All major decisions are made at departmental level.
examples.translation_cn: 所有重大决定都在部门层面做出。

senses.meaning_en: to move around quickly in circles; to make something do this

examples.text: The leaves swirled around in the autumn wind.
examples.translation_cn: 秋风中树叶打着旋。

senses.meaning_en: to circulate or spread (of rumors, stories, etc.)

examples.text: Rumors swirled around the sudden resignation for weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 谣言围绕这起突然辞职传了好几个星期。

senses.meaning_en: to arrange or be arranged in a twist or spiral

examples.text: Her hair was swirled into an elegant bun.
examples.translation_cn: 她的头发被盘成一个优雅的发髻。

senses.meaning_en: a swirling movement or amount of something

examples.text: The car drove off in a swirl of dust.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车在一片尘土的旋动中驶离。

senses.meaning_en: a confused mass of feelings or thoughts
senses.pattern: be caught up in a swirl of

examples.text: She was caught up in a swirl of emotions after the news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到消息后，她陷入纷乱的情绪之中。

senses.meaning_en: something that distracts

examples.text: The phone on the desk was a constant distraction during the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会议期间桌上的手机让人不断分心。

senses.meaning_en: the state or process of being distracted

examples.text: It is hard to avoid distraction from social media while studying.
examples.translation_cn: 学习时很难避免社交媒体造成的分心。

senses.meaning_en: an activity that you do for pleasure or to relax

examples.text: He plays golf as a distraction from work, finding it both relaxing and enjoyable.
examples.translation_cn: 他打高尔夫球作为工作之余的消遣，觉得它既放松又愉快。

senses.meaning_en: a woman with light-coloured hair

examples.text: She is a natural blonde with curly hair.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一个天生金发、卷发的女子。

senses.meaning_en: a liquid used to dissolve other substances

examples.text: We used ethanol as a solvent to dissolve the resin.
examples.translation_cn: 我们用乙醇作为溶剂来溶解树脂。

senses.meaning_en: able to pay all one's debts

examples.text: The company struggled to remain solvent during the crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 危机期间，这家公司艰难维持偿付能力。

senses.meaning_en: able to dissolve other substances

examples.text: Acetone has a solvent effect on many plastics.
examples.translation_cn: 丙酮对许多塑料有溶解作用。

senses.meaning_en: connected with the production of medicines

examples.text: She works in the pharmaceutical industry in Basel.
examples.translation_cn: 她在巴塞尔从事制药行业工作。

senses.meaning_en: a drug or medicine

examples.text: The doctor prescribed pharmaceuticals to control her blood pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 医生开了药物来控制她的血压。

senses.meaning_en: the equipment or system used to control the direction of a vehicle

examples.text: The new model is equipped with power steering as standard.
examples.translation_cn: 这款新车型标配动力转向。

senses.meaning_en: the act of guiding or controlling an organization, project, etc.

examples.text: The board's steering of the project kept it on schedule.
examples.translation_cn: 董事会对项目的掌控使其按计划进行。

senses.meaning_en: an official order forbidding ships to leave or enter a port

examples.text: The navy imposed an embargo on all vessels leaving the port.
examples.translation_cn: 海军对所有驶离港口的船只实施了封港令。

senses.meaning_en: an official ban on trade with another country

examples.text: The United Nations imposed an embargo on trade with the country.
examples.translation_cn: 联合国对该国实施了贸易禁运。

senses.meaning_en: to impose an embargo on trading certain goods with another country

examples.text: The government embargoed all arms exports to the region.
examples.translation_cn: 政府对该地区实施了全部武器出口禁运。

senses.meaning_en: a temporary ban on making certain information public

examples.text: The report is under embargo until Friday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告在周五早上之前禁发。

senses.meaning_en: a type of rock or a rectangular piece of slate used for roofing or writing

examples.text: The roof of the old house is made of slate.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老房子的屋顶是石板瓦做的。

senses.meaning_en: a list of candidates for election or a group of such candidates

examples.text: The party announced a slate of candidates for the council elections.
examples.translation_cn: 该党公布了市议会选举的候选人名单。

senses.meaning_en: to plan or schedule something

examples.text: The new product is slated for release in May.
examples.translation_cn: 新产品定于五月发布。

senses.meaning_en: to criticize severely

examples.text: The minister was slated by the press for the decision.
examples.translation_cn: 部长因这一决定受到新闻界的严厉批评。

senses.meaning_en: a record of money owed

examples.text: He asked the barman to put the drinks on the slate.
examples.translation_cn: 他让酒吧招待把酒记在账上。

senses.meaning_en: the act of enrolling or state of being enrolled

examples.text: Enrollment in the new program has already begun.
examples.translation_cn: 新课程的注册已经开始。

senses.meaning_en: the people or number of people enrolled

examples.text: The university has a total enrollment of about 25,000 students.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学的注册学生总数约为25,000人。

senses.meaning_en: giving a lot of time and energy to something because you believe it is important; devoted and loyal

examples.text: She is dedicated to caring for her patients.
examples.translation_cn: 她致力于照顾她的病人。

senses.meaning_en: used or intended for a particular purpose; focused

examples.text: The library has a dedicated area for silent study.
examples.translation_cn: 图书馆有一个专门用于安静学习的区域。

senses.meaning_en: not having a brand name; nonproprietary

examples.text: The pharmacy sells a generic version of the brand-name drug.
examples.translation_cn: 药房出售该品牌药的仿制药。

senses.meaning_en: shared by or typical of a whole group; not specific

examples.text: Malware is a generic term for harmful software.
examples.translation_cn: 恶意软件是有害软件的总称。

senses.meaning_en: lacking distinctive qualities; ordinary

examples.text: The hotel room was comfortable but looked generic.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店房间舒适但看起来毫无特色。

senses.meaning_en: lacking in precision; vague

examples.text: She was deliberately generic about her future plans.
examples.translation_cn: 她刻意对自己的未来计划含糊其辞。

senses.meaning_en: waste water and solid waste carried away in sewers

examples.text: The treatment plant treats sewage from the entire city.
examples.translation_cn: 这座处理厂处理整个城市的污水。

senses.meaning_en: a single-storey house

examples.text: My grandparents live in a bungalow near the coast.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖父母住在海边的一栋平房里。

senses.meaning_en: large guns used in warfare

examples.text: The soldiers fired artillery at the enemy positions.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵向敌军阵地开炮。

senses.meaning_en: the part of the army that uses large guns

examples.text: He served in the artillery during the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战争期间他在炮兵部队服役。

senses.meaning_en: a way of thinking; a set of beliefs

examples.text: She has a very competitive mentality when it comes to work.
examples.translation_cn: 她在工作上心态非常争强好胜。

senses.meaning_en: a plant or clipping that has just been planted; a planted area

examples.text: The new plantings in the front yard need daily watering.
examples.translation_cn: 前院新栽的植物需要每天浇水。

senses.meaning_en: the act of putting a plant in the ground to grow

examples.text: The planting of rice usually starts after the first rain.
examples.translation_cn: 水稻的栽种通常在头场雨后开始。

senses.meaning_en: a person who interviews someone, especially as a journalist

examples.text: As an interviewer for a national newspaper, she has met many politicians.
examples.translation_cn: 作为一家全国性报纸的采访记者，她见过许多政界人士。

senses.meaning_en: a person who asks questions in a job or college interview

examples.text: The interviewer asked about my previous work experience during the job interview.
examples.translation_cn: 在求职面试中，面试官询问了我之前的工作经历。

senses.meaning_en: a person who asks questions in a survey or research study

examples.text: The interviewer for the survey asked me about my household income.
examples.translation_cn: 负责这项调查的访谈员询问了我的家庭收入。

senses.meaning_en: a shop that sells books

examples.text: I found a rare first edition in an independent bookshop.
examples.translation_cn: 我在一家独立书店找到了一本珍本初版。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of grass and soil cut from the ground; sod

examples.text: We laid fresh turf over the bare patch of soil.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在裸露的土地上铺了新草皮。

senses.meaning_en: an area that a group considers its own territory, especially a gang's area

examples.text: You're not safe on their turf after dark.
examples.translation_cn: 天黑后你在他们的地盘上不安全。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or business of horse racing

examples.text: Many famous jockeys have made their names on the turf.
examples.translation_cn: 许多著名骑师在赛马界成名。

senses.meaning_en: a surface of synthetic fibers made to look like grass; artificial turf

examples.text: The players practiced on artificial turf all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 队员们整个下午都在人造草皮上训练。

senses.meaning_en: nothing; zero, especially as a score

examples.text: England won the friendly against Spain two-nil last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚英格兰队在那场友谊赛中以二比零战胜了西班牙队。

senses.meaning_en: a person who smokes tobacco or similar substances habitually

examples.text: He has been a heavy smoker for over twenty years.
examples.translation_cn: 他烟瘾很重，已有二十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by following theories

examples.text: She is pragmatic about the risks involved in starting a business.
examples.translation_cn: 她对创业所涉及的风险持务实态度。

senses.meaning_en: a list of the topics to be studied in a course or for an exam

examples.text: Several modern novels are on the syllabus for this term.
examples.translation_cn: 本学期教学大纲中有几部现代小说。

senses.meaning_en: the right to use land or property under a lease

examples.text: The young couple holds the tenancy of the flat.
examples.translation_cn: 这对年轻夫妇持有这套公寓的租约。

senses.meaning_en: arriving; coming in

examples.text: All incoming flights were delayed by heavy snow.
examples.translation_cn: 所有进港航班因大雪延误。

senses.meaning_en: about to take office

examples.text: The incoming president will take office next month.
examples.translation_cn: 新任总统将于下个月就职。

senses.meaning_en: income; money coming in

examples.text: Her monthly incomings are just enough to cover rent.
examples.translation_cn: 她每月的收入刚够支付房租。

senses.meaning_en: food from the sea, including fish and shellfish

examples.text: The soup is made with seafood and fresh herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 这道汤是用海鲜和新鲜香草做的。

senses.meaning_en: bullets, shells, and other explosives used in weapons

examples.text: The soldiers ran out of ammunition during the battle.
examples.translation_cn: 战斗中士兵们弹药耗尽。

senses.meaning_en: facts or arguments that can be used to support a case or attack an opponent

examples.text: Protesters used the report as ammunition against the government.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议者利用这份报告作为攻击政府的把柄。

senses.meaning_en: a person with whom one shares a room or home

examples.text: I have been roommates with Tom for two years.
examples.translation_cn: 我和汤姆做室友已经两年了。

senses.meaning_en: the period of life when a child develops into an adult

examples.text: Friendships often change in adolescence as young people seek more independence.
examples.translation_cn: 青春期友谊常发生变化，因为年轻人寻求更多独立。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being committed to a task or purpose

examples.text: Her dedication to patient care impressed the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 她对病人护理的投入给全队留下了深刻印象。

senses.meaning_en: a note at the beginning of a book or piece of music thanking or mentioning someone

examples.text: The author thanked her parents in the dedication to her first novel.
examples.translation_cn: 作者在首部小说的献词中感谢了父母。

senses.meaning_en: not level or smooth; having bumps, pits, or grooves

examples.text: The old road was uneven in places and hard to walk on.
examples.translation_cn: 这条老路有些地方凹凸不平，很难走。

senses.meaning_en: not evenly balanced or fair; with one side much stronger

examples.text: It was an uneven contest, and the stronger team won easily.
examples.translation_cn: 这是一场实力悬殊的比赛，强队轻松获胜。

senses.meaning_en: varying in quality; not consistent

examples.text: The essays are of uneven quality: some are clear, others are confusing.
examples.translation_cn: 这些文章质量参差不齐：有些清晰，有些混乱。

senses.meaning_en: at regular intervals; in a periodic manner

examples.text: We update the database periodically, once every hour.
examples.translation_cn: 我们定期更新数据库，每小时一次。

senses.meaning_en: from time to time; at intervals; not continuously

examples.text: She periodically glanced at her phone throughout the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 会议期间她不时地看一眼手机。

senses.meaning_en: a possible event that may happen, especially one that causes problems

examples.text: We need to prepare for every possible contingency.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要为每一种可能发生的意外情况做好准备。

senses.meaning_en: a cover or holder for keeping loose papers together

examples.text: I keep all my paper receipts in a folder on my desk.
examples.translation_cn: 我把所有纸质收据都放在桌上的文件夹里。

senses.meaning_en: a virtual container in a computer file system

examples.text: Create a new folder for these photos on your computer.
examples.translation_cn: 在电脑上为这些照片新建一个文件夹。

senses.meaning_en: a committee formed by a larger committee to deal with a particular subject

examples.text: The Senate has formed a subcommittee on climate change to study the issue.
examples.translation_cn: 参议院成立了一个气候变化小组委员会来研究这个问题。

senses.meaning_en: causing stress or mental pressure

examples.text: Many people find moving to a new city stressful.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人觉得搬到一个新城市压力很大。

senses.meaning_en: to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse

examples.text: The drought exacerbated the food shortage in the region.
examples.translation_cn: 干旱加剧了该地区的粮食短缺。

senses.meaning_en: a growth of hair between the nose and the upper lip

examples.text: He plans to grow a moustache during the winter holidays.
examples.translation_cn: 他打算在寒假期间留小胡子。

senses.meaning_en: a sentence allowing a criminal to stay in the community under conditions instead of going to prison

examples.text: He was placed on probation for two years after being convicted of theft.
examples.translation_cn: 他因盗窃罪被定罪后，被判处两年缓刑。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time during which someone's ability to do a job is tested

examples.text: New employees are on probation for the first three months.
examples.translation_cn: 新员工在前三个月处于试用期。

senses.meaning_en: an official in a college or university who keeps student records

examples.text: She has worked as a registrar at the university for twelve years.
examples.translation_cn: 她在那所大学担任注册主任已有十二年。

senses.meaning_en: an official who keeps official records, especially of births, deaths, and marriages
senses.collocation: registrar of births, deaths and marriages

examples.text: The registrar of births, deaths and marriages issued the certificate.
examples.translation_cn: 户籍登记员签发了证书。

senses.meaning_en: a company that manages the reservation of internet domain names

examples.text: Choose a reputable registrar for .com domains to protect your brand.
examples.translation_cn: 选择一家信誉良好的 .com 域名注册商来保护你的品牌。

senses.meaning_en: a very small piece of baked food such as bread or cake

examples.text: She brushed the crumbs of bread off the table.
examples.translation_cn: 她把面包屑从桌上轻轻拂掉。

senses.meaning_en: a very small amount or piece of something

examples.text: He offered a crumb of hope to the desperate family.
examples.translation_cn: 他给了这个绝望的家庭一丝希望。

senses.meaning_en: the soft inner part of bread

examples.text: This artisan loaf has a soft crumb and a crisp crust.
examples.translation_cn: 这种手工面包内里柔软，外皮酥脆。

senses.meaning_en: a medical condition in which the body reacts badly to a substance

examples.text: Many people suffer from an allergy to pollen in the spring.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人在春天对花粉过敏。

senses.meaning_en: a strong dislike or aversion to something

examples.text: He has an allergy to housework and avoids doing dishes whenever possible.
examples.translation_cn: 他对家务活反感，尽可能避免洗碗。

senses.meaning_en: a hamburger; a similar sandwich or patty

examples.text: I had a burger and fries for lunch yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 我昨天午餐吃了一个汉堡和薯条。

senses.meaning_en: a young bird, especially a baby chicken

examples.text: The chicks hatched from the eggs this morning.
examples.translation_cn: 小鸡们今天早上从蛋里孵出来了。

senses.meaning_en: an attractive young woman; sometimes used as a general term for a woman (informal, sometimes offensive)

examples.text: He asked a chick out on a date last night.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨晚约了一个年轻女子出去约会。

senses.meaning_en: the group of people who have high social rank and titles, especially those who hold hereditary titles

examples.text: He was born into the Russian nobility but later lost his title.
examples.translation_cn: 他出生于俄国贵族，但后来失去了爵位。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of being noble in character or mind

examples.text: He acted with nobility and refused to blame anyone for the mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 他行为高尚，拒绝因此错误责怪任何人。

senses.meaning_en: a country in Southeast Asia

examples.text: My uncle has lived in Malaysia for ten years.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔在马来西亚住了十年了。

senses.meaning_en: to raise or increase something

examples.text: The landlord threatened to higher the rent by ten percent.
examples.translation_cn: 房东威胁要把房租提高百分之十。

senses.meaning_en: to a greater height or degree; more strongly

examples.text: The balloon rose higher and higher until it disappeared.
examples.translation_cn: 气球越升越高，直到消失。

senses.meaning_en: having no purpose or meaning; unable to achieve anything

examples.text: It is pointless to argue with someone who refuses to listen.
examples.translation_cn: 和一个拒绝倾听的人争论毫无意义。

senses.meaning_en: having no point or sharp tip; blunt

examples.text: This pencil is pointless, so I need to sharpen it before writing.
examples.translation_cn: 这支铅笔没有尖，我得先削一下再写。

senses.meaning_en: the highest university degree, especially one obtained by advanced research

examples.text: She earned a PhD in physics from MIT.
examples.translation_cn: 她在麻省理工学院获得了物理学博士学位。

senses.meaning_en: the state of expecting or hoping that something good or exciting will happen

examples.text: The room was filled with an air of expectancy before the results were announced.
examples.translation_cn: 结果公布前，房间里充满了一种期待的气氛。

senses.meaning_en: a drug used to reduce pain and fever

examples.text: Doctors often use aspirin for mild pain and fever.
examples.translation_cn: 医生经常用阿司匹林治疗轻微疼痛和发烧。

senses.meaning_en: a tablet containing aspirin
senses.collocation: take an aspirin for a headache

examples.text: She took an aspirin for her headache and lay down for a while.
examples.translation_cn: 她吃了一片阿司匹林治头痛，然后躺了一会儿。

senses.meaning_en: a system of exercises for the body and mind, often involving breathing and meditation

examples.text: She practises yoga every morning to reduce stress.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天早上练瑜伽来减压。

senses.meaning_en: having a lot of experience in a particular activity

examples.text: The negotiator is seasoned in handling complex international deals.
examples.translation_cn: 这位谈判专家在处理复杂的国际交易方面经验丰富。

senses.meaning_en: having had salt, herbs, or spices added for flavour

examples.text: The chicken was seasoned with garlic and rosemary before roasting.
examples.translation_cn: 鸡肉在烤之前用蒜和迷迭香调了味。

senses.meaning_en: a simple, portable bed used for camping or temporary sleeping

examples.text: The soldiers slept on narrow cots in the tent.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们睡在帐篷里的窄行军床上。

senses.meaning_en: a small bed with high sides for a baby or young child

examples.text: She put the baby in the cot for a nap.
examples.translation_cn: 她把婴儿放进婴儿床里小睡。

senses.meaning_en: a medicinal substance that restores or invigorates the body

examples.text: My grandmother takes an herbal tonic every morning to stay healthy.
examples.translation_cn: 我的祖母每天早上服用一剂草药补品来保持健康。

senses.meaning_en: something that makes you feel happier or more energetic

examples.text: The sunny weather was a tonic for everyone after the long winter.
examples.translation_cn: 久冬过后，晴朗的天气让每个人都精神振奋。

senses.meaning_en: a fizzy drink with a slightly bitter taste, often mixed with gin

examples.text: She ordered a gin and tonic with ice and lemon.
examples.translation_cn: 她点了一杯加冰和柠檬的金汤力。

senses.meaning_en: restorative or invigorating

examples.text: The mountain air had a tonic effect on her mood.
examples.translation_cn: 山间的空气使她的心情为之一振。

senses.meaning_en: of or relating to war or the military; warlike

examples.text: The region was placed under martial law during the conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 冲突期间该地区被置于戒严状态。

senses.meaning_en: a person who leaves school or college before finishing

examples.text: He is a college dropout who later started a software company.
examples.translation_cn: 他大学辍学，后来创办了一家软件公司。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rejects conventional society

examples.text: He became a dropout from society and moved to a remote cabin.
examples.translation_cn: 他脱离社会，搬到了一个偏僻的小屋。

senses.meaning_en: a person who flirts or enjoys flirting

examples.text: He's a shameless flirt at every party he attends.
examples.translation_cn: 他每参加一个聚会都是个厚脸皮的调情者。

senses.meaning_en: to consider an idea or risk without serious intent

examples.text: She is flirting with the idea of moving abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她正不认真地考虑移居国外。

senses.meaning_en: one of a number of payments made regularly until a debt is paid

examples.text: We paid for the car in instalments over five years.
examples.translation_cn: 我们分期付款，在五年内付清了车款。

senses.meaning_en: love of your country and willingness to serve or defend it

examples.text: He was filled with patriotism and joined the army to defend his country.
examples.translation_cn: 他满怀爱国精神，参军保卫祖国。

senses.meaning_en: a group of voters or politicians who share common goals

examples.text: A bloc of voters backed the education reform bill.
examples.translation_cn: 一个选民集团支持了教育改革法案。

senses.meaning_en: a group of countries acting together for political or economic goals, an alliance

examples.text: A bloc of countries agreed to reduce trade barriers.
examples.translation_cn: 一些国家组成的集团同意减少贸易壁垒。

senses.meaning_en: a stopper for a bottle, especially one made of cork

examples.text: He took the cork out of the bottle and poured the wine.
examples.translation_cn: 他把瓶塞拔出来，倒了葡萄酒。

senses.meaning_en: to seal or stop up, especially with a cork stopper

examples.text: Cork the bottle tightly so the wine stays fresh.
examples.translation_cn: 把瓶塞塞紧，好让葡萄酒保持新鲜。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or activity of riding a bicycle

examples.text: We often go cycling along the river on weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 我们周末经常沿河骑自行车。

senses.meaning_en: a layer of impurities on the surface of a liquid

examples.text: Skim the thick scum off the surface of the soup before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上汤前撇去汤面的厚浮沫。

senses.meaning_en: a worthless or contemptible person or group

examples.text: He described the protesters as the scum of the earth.
examples.translation_cn: 他把抗议者说成是人渣。

senses.meaning_en: the action, sound, or rhythm of the heart as it pumps blood

examples.text: She felt her heartbeat quicken as she opened the envelope.
examples.translation_cn: 她打开信封时感到心跳加速。

senses.meaning_en: the vital center or driving force of something

examples.text: Small businesses are the heartbeat of the local economy.
examples.translation_cn: 小企业是当地经济的命脉。

senses.meaning_en: a very short space of time; an instant

examples.text: The whole incident was over in a heartbeat.
examples.translation_cn: 整个事件一瞬间就结束了。

senses.meaning_en: a word used as the key to a code or cipher

examples.text: You must use a keyword to decode this message.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须使用关键词来解码这条消息。

senses.meaning_en: a word used to search for information or to index a document

examples.text: You can search by keyword to find relevant articles.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以通过关键词搜索来找到相关文章。

senses.meaning_en: a reserved word in a programming language

examples.text: The word 'class' is a keyword in Python.
examples.translation_cn: 在 Python 中，class 是一个关键字。

senses.meaning_en: to tag with keywords

examples.text: You can keyword each photo with place names for easy searching.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以给每张照片加上地点关键词以便于搜索。

senses.meaning_en: suggesting that something bad is going to happen

examples.text: The dark clouds looked ominous before the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨来临前，乌云显得很不祥。

senses.meaning_en: to bring people or soldiers together for a purpose

examples.text: The general mustered his troops for the surprise attack.
examples.translation_cn: 将军召集他的部队进行突袭。

senses.meaning_en: to find as much courage, strength, etc. as you can

examples.text: She finally mustered up the courage to ask for a raise.
examples.translation_cn: 她终于鼓起勇气要求加薪。

senses.meaning_en: a gathering of people, especially for inspection

examples.text: All cadets must be present at morning muster on time.
examples.translation_cn: 所有学员必须按时参加早点名。

senses.meaning_en: to come together or assemble

examples.text: The soldiers mustered for inspection in the square.
examples.translation_cn: 士兵们在广场集合接受检阅。

senses.meaning_en: not aware of what is happening around you; unaware

examples.text: She was completely oblivious to the noise outside.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全没有注意到外面的噪音。

senses.meaning_en: having a sharp point; not dull

examples.text: The witch wore a pointed hat and a black cloak.
examples.translation_cn: 女巫戴着一顶尖顶帽和一件黑斗篷。

senses.meaning_en: direct and critical; cutting

examples.text: She made a pointed remark about his constant lateness.
examples.translation_cn: 她对他总是迟到发表了尖锐的评论。

senses.meaning_en: clearly aimed at someone or something; intentional

examples.text: She asked him a pointed question about his absence.
examples.translation_cn: 她问了他一个关于他缺席的明确问题。

senses.meaning_en: a metal grill through which liquid, ash, or small objects can fall

examples.text: The water ran slowly through the grate and left the floor almost dry.
examples.translation_cn: 水慢慢流经箅子，地板几乎干了。

senses.meaning_en: a metal frame for holding burning fuel

examples.text: A small log fire was burning in the grate when we entered the room.
examples.translation_cn: 我们进屋时，炉栅里燃着一小堆木柴火。

senses.meaning_en: to make an unpleasant rasping sound

examples.text: The rusty gate grated against the pavement as I dragged it open.
examples.translation_cn: 我推开那扇生锈的门时，它刮着地面发出刺耳的摩擦声。

senses.meaning_en: to irritate or annoy

examples.text: His constant apologies began to grate on everyone in the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他不停地道歉，很快让与会者都烦躁起来。

senses.meaning_en: to rub food into small pieces using a grater

examples.text: Grate some fresh ginger over the stir-fry just before serving.
examples.translation_cn: 上桌前，往炒菜里擦些新鲜姜末。

senses.meaning_en: to make something such as fog or darkness go away by scattering it

examples.text: The morning sun soon dispelled the mist over the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 早晨的阳光很快驱散了山谷上的雾气。

senses.meaning_en: to remove fears, doubts, etc. by showing that they are without reason

examples.text: The doctor tried to dispel her fears about the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 医生试图消除她对手术的恐惧。

senses.meaning_en: abandoned and in poor condition

examples.text: The derelict factory has become a safety hazard.
examples.translation_cn: 那座荒废的工厂已成为安全隐患。

senses.meaning_en: failing to do one's duty

examples.text: The captain was derelict in his duty during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 船长在暴风雨中玩忽职守。

senses.meaning_en: a person with no home or job, often living on the streets

examples.text: A derelict sleeps in the doorway of the old station.
examples.translation_cn: 一个流浪汉睡在老火车站门口。

senses.meaning_en: more than is necessary, acceptable, or reasonable

examples.text: The new policy placed undue pressure on hospital staff.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策给医院员工带来了过大的压力。

senses.meaning_en: not proper, illegal, or unjustified

examples.text: He was accused of exercising undue influence over the contract award.
examples.translation_cn: 他被指控对合同授予施加了不正当影响。

senses.meaning_en: a short race run at top speed

examples.text: She will compete in the 200-metre sprint on Saturday.
examples.translation_cn: 她将在星期六参加200米短跑比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden quick run or burst of activity

examples.text: She broke into a sprint to catch the last bus.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然冲刺去赶末班车。

senses.meaning_en: to run at full speed for a short distance

examples.text: He sprinted towards the finish line in the final seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 他在最后几秒全速冲向终点线。

senses.meaning_en: a book, film, etc. with an exciting, suspenseful story, often about crime or spying

examples.text: She read a thriller about a missing diplomat.
examples.translation_cn: 她读了一本关于失踪外交官的惊悚小说。

senses.meaning_en: something that thrills, especially an exciting contest or event

examples.text: The cup final was a real thriller, decided by a late goal.
examples.translation_cn: 这场杯赛决赛真是一场激动人心的比赛，直到最后时刻才分出胜负。

senses.meaning_en: in the middle of or surrounded by; among

examples.text: Amidst growing concern over climate change, many cities are investing in green infrastructure.
examples.translation_cn: 在人们对气候变化日益担忧的情况下，许多城市正在投资绿色基础设施。

senses.meaning_en: to bring food up from the stomach through the mouth

examples.text: He vomited violently after eating the spoiled seafood.
examples.translation_cn: 他吃了变质海鲜后剧烈呕吐。

senses.meaning_en: food that has been brought back up from the stomach

examples.text: The floor was covered in vomit outside the bar.
examples.translation_cn: 酒吧外面的地板上满是呕吐物。

senses.meaning_en: to expel swallowed matter through the mouth

examples.text: He vomited up his breakfast on the way to school.
examples.translation_cn: 他在上学的路上把早餐呕了出来。

senses.meaning_en: the act of vomiting

examples.text: He had a sudden bout of vomiting and diarrhoea after lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 他午饭后突然呕吐和腹泻。

senses.meaning_en: passed from a parent to a child through genes

examples.text: Her condition is hereditary, so her children may develop it too.
examples.translation_cn: 她的病是遗传的，因此她的孩子也可能患上这种病。

senses.meaning_en: legally given to a person's descendants, or holding such a title

examples.text: She is a hereditary peer in the House of Lords.
examples.translation_cn: 她是上议院的世袭贵族。

senses.meaning_en: passed on as an inheritance by law or will

examples.text: The family's hereditary estate has been passed down for generations.
examples.translation_cn: 这个家族的祖传庄园已经传承了好几代。

senses.meaning_en: a phrase or idea that has been used so often that it is no longer original or interesting

examples.text: It may sound like a cliche, but love really does conquer all.
examples.translation_cn: 这听起来像陈词滥调，但爱确实能征服一切。

senses.meaning_en: money or food given to people in need, especially by the state to unemployed people

examples.text: He has been on the dole since last year.
examples.translation_cn: 他从去年起一直领取失业救济金。

senses.meaning_en: to give out small amounts of money, food, etc.

examples.text: The volunteers doled out food to the refugees.
examples.translation_cn: 志愿者向难民发放食物。

senses.meaning_en: a special right or advantage that only a particular person or group has

examples.text: Only the board has the prerogative to change the rules.
examples.translation_cn: 只有董事会才有权修改规则。

senses.meaning_en: a narrow bed fixed to a wall, often in tiers, especially on a ship or train

examples.text: He slept in the top bunk because the lower one was taken.
examples.translation_cn: 他睡在上铺，因为下铺已经有人了。

senses.meaning_en: nonsense; empty talk

examples.text: He said the whole plan was a load of bunk.
examples.translation_cn: 他说整个计划是一派胡言。

senses.meaning_en: (British English, informal) to stay away from school or work without permission

examples.text: They bunked off school and went to the beach.
examples.translation_cn: 他们逃学去了海滩。

senses.meaning_en: a period of time when two sides agree to stop fighting

examples.text: The two countries finally called a truce after months of border clashes.
examples.translation_cn: 两国在数月边境冲突后终于宣布休战。

senses.meaning_en: a man from Scotland; a Scot

examples.text: A Scotsman from the Isle of Skye showed us around the castle.
examples.translation_cn: 一位来自斯凯岛的苏格兰男人带我们参观了城堡。

senses.meaning_en: an unusual and unexpected event

examples.text: He lost his leg in a freak accident on the farm.
examples.translation_cn: 他在农场的一次意外事故中失去了一条腿。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is considered strange because of their unusual appearance or behaviour

examples.text: She was treated as a freak at school because of her unusual appearance.
examples.translation_cn: 在学校里，她因外表与众不同而被当作怪人对待。

senses.meaning_en: a person with extremely well-developed muscles

examples.text: After years of weightlifting, he became a muscle freak.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的举重训练，他变成了一个肌肉发达的人。

senses.meaning_en: to react very strongly, especially with fear or anger

examples.text: She freaked out when she saw the spider on her bed.
examples.translation_cn: 她看到床上的蜘蛛时吓坏了。

senses.meaning_en: a person with an extreme interest or obsession in something

examples.text: Her father is a control freak who plans every minute of the day.
examples.translation_cn: 她父亲是个控制狂，连每天每分钟都要计划好。

senses.meaning_en: very small pieces of stone or sand

examples.text: I had a piece of grit in my shoe all afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 整个下午我鞋里都有一粒沙砾。

senses.meaning_en: courage and determination
senses.pattern: have the grit to do sth

examples.text: She had the grit to admit her mistake and apologize.
examples.translation_cn: 她有勇气承认错误并道歉。

senses.meaning_en: to bite your teeth tightly together
senses.collocation: grit your teeth and bear it

examples.text: He gritted his teeth against the pain and kept running.
examples.translation_cn: 他咬紧牙关忍住疼痛，继续跑步。

senses.meaning_en: to take care of oneself without help
senses.collocation: be left to fend for yourself

examples.text: After leaving home, she had to fend for herself.
examples.translation_cn: 离开家后，她不得不自谋生计。

senses.meaning_en: to defend yourself against something or somebody, or to avoid dealing with something

examples.text: The spokesperson fended off questions about the scandal.
examples.translation_cn: 发言人避开了有关丑闻的提问。

senses.meaning_en: a large room used for dancing and banquets

examples.text: The guests waited in the ballroom while the band prepared to play.
examples.translation_cn: 乐队准备演奏时，客人们在舞厅里等候。

senses.meaning_en: an elegant type of dance

examples.text: Many couples do ballroom dancing to stay active.
examples.translation_cn: 很多情侣跳交际舞来保持活力。

senses.meaning_en: a short sentence or phrase that expresses a guiding principle or is used as a slogan

examples.text: Her personal motto is 'Never give up', and she repeats it before every match.
examples.translation_cn: 她的个人座右铭是“永不放弃”，每场比赛前她都会重复这句话。

senses.meaning_en: very remarkable; extraordinary; amazing

examples.text: Her first novel was a phenomenal success worldwide.
examples.translation_cn: 她的第一部小说在全球取得了非凡的成功。

senses.meaning_en: a long and difficult journey, especially on foot

examples.text: We went on a three-day trek through the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在山里进行了三天的长途跋涉。

senses.meaning_en: to make a slow or arduous journey, especially on foot

examples.text: They trekked through the snow for two days to reach the village.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在雪地里跋涉了两天才到达村子。

senses.meaning_en: a very slight difference in meaning, sound, colour, or feeling
senses.pattern: the nuance between A and B

examples.text: The nuance between 'happy' and 'content' is hard to explain.
examples.translation_cn: “happy”和“content”之间的细微差别很难解释。

senses.meaning_en: to give a subtle distinction to; to change or refine slightly

examples.text: The author nuances her earlier claim in the new edition.
examples.translation_cn: 作者在新版本中微妙地修正了她早先的主张。

senses.meaning_en: a heading or title of a document or part of it

examples.text: The report was published under the caption 'Breaking the Cycle'.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇报道以“打破循环”为标题发表。

senses.meaning_en: words shown on screen that show dialogue or sound, especially for viewers who cannot hear

examples.text: He always watches shows with captions so he can catch every word.
examples.translation_cn: 他看节目时总开着字幕，以便听清每句话。

senses.meaning_en: a short text added to an image, often to tell a story or add a comment

examples.text: She posted a holiday photo with the caption 'Take me back'.
examples.translation_cn: 她发了一张度假照片，配文是“带我回去”。

senses.meaning_en: to add a caption or captions to a text, illustration, film, or broadcast

examples.text: She captioned the photo with the date and place.
examples.translation_cn: 她给照片加上了日期和地点说明。

senses.meaning_en: the 100th anniversary of an event; relating to a 100th anniversary

examples.text: The city is celebrating the centenary of the poet's birth.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市正在庆祝这位诗人诞辰一百周年。

senses.meaning_en: a disease spread by mosquitoes, in which a protozoan multiplies in the blood

examples.text: She contracted malaria while volunteering in a remote village.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一个偏远村庄志愿服务时感染了疟疾。

senses.meaning_en: scarcely sufficient; meager

examples.text: There was scant evidence to support the claim.
examples.translation_cn: 几乎没有证据支持这一说法。

senses.meaning_en: Of or pertaining to allergy.

examples.text: An allergic reaction to the vaccine is rare but possible.
examples.translation_cn: 对疫苗出现过敏反应很罕见，但有可能。

senses.meaning_en: Having an allergy.

examples.text: My younger brother is allergic to peanuts and tree nuts.
examples.translation_cn: 我弟弟对花生和坚果过敏。

senses.meaning_en: Highly averse.

examples.text: My dad is allergic to doing the dishes after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我爸爸很讨厌晚饭后洗碗。

senses.meaning_en: a reward offered for capture or killing

examples.text: There is a bounty on the escaped prisoner.
examples.translation_cn: 这名逃犯身上有悬赏金。

senses.meaning_en: an abundance of something

examples.text: The garden produced a bounty of fresh vegetables this year.
examples.translation_cn: 今年菜园收获了大量的新鲜蔬菜。

senses.meaning_en: generosity; the act of giving generously

examples.text: The foundation shows bounty to families in crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 该基金会向陷入困境的家庭慷慨赠予。

senses.meaning_en: elegant and stylish

examples.text: She looked chic in her new tailored jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着新的定制夹克看起来很时髦。

senses.meaning_en: elegance and style

examples.text: She decorated the entire house with modern chic.
examples.translation_cn: 她把整座房子装饰得现代又优雅。

senses.meaning_en: a container made of cardboard or plastic, used for holding food or drink

examples.text: She bought a carton of orange juice from the shop.
examples.translation_cn: 她从商店买了一盒橙汁。

senses.meaning_en: a light box made of cardboard, used for packing goods

examples.text: The books were packed in a large carton for the move.
examples.translation_cn: 搬家时，书被打包在一个大纸箱里。

senses.meaning_en: a pack of cigarettes, usually ten, wrapped in cellophane or packed in a light cardboard box

examples.text: He bought a carton of cigarettes at the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 他在机场买了一条香烟。

senses.meaning_en: a cardboard box that holds (usually 24) beer bottles or cans

examples.text: They carried a carton of beer to the party.
examples.translation_cn: 他们带了一箱啤酒去聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of sickness with an urge to vomit

examples.text: Some patients experience nausea after taking this medicine.
examples.translation_cn: 一些病人服用这种药后会感到恶心。

senses.meaning_en: strong disgust or revulsion

examples.text: He felt nausea at the brutal images on the news.
examples.translation_cn: 他对新闻里那些残忍的画面感到厌恶。

senses.meaning_en: involving three or more countries or groups

examples.text: Several countries signed a multilateral agreement to reduce trade barriers.
examples.translation_cn: 一些国家签署了一项多边协议以减少贸易壁垒。

senses.meaning_en: done by one side only; not involving agreement by others

examples.text: The government took unilateral action to reduce imports.
examples.translation_cn: 政府采取了单方面行动来减少进口。

senses.meaning_en: affecting only one side of the body

examples.text: She has unilateral hearing loss in her left ear.
examples.translation_cn: 她左耳有单侧听力损失。

senses.meaning_en: binding or affecting one party only

examples.text: A unilateral contract imposes obligations on only one party.
examples.translation_cn: 单方合同只使一方承担义务。

senses.meaning_en: having a rough, uneven edge with sharp points

examples.text: He caught his sleeve on a jagged edge of metal.
examples.translation_cn: 他的袖子被一块锯齿状金属边缘钩住了。

senses.meaning_en: having a rough, irregular quality in outline

examples.text: Lightning cut a jagged line across the dark sky.
examples.translation_cn: 闪电在黑暗的天空中划出一道不规则的光线。

senses.meaning_en: to use authority to reject or cancel a decision

examples.text: The court can override a government decision that violates the law.
examples.translation_cn: 法院可以推翻违反法律的政府决定。

senses.meaning_en: to be more important than something else

examples.text: The need for safety overrides all other concerns.
examples.translation_cn: 安全的需要凌驾于其他所有考虑之上。

senses.meaning_en: to take manual control of an automatic system

examples.text: The pilot had to override the autopilot during the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨中，飞行员不得不人工接管自动驾驶仪。

senses.meaning_en: to define a method again in a subclass

examples.text: You can override the draw method to customize how the button is displayed.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以重写 draw 方法来定制按钮的显示方式。

senses.meaning_en: deficient or inferior in amount, quality or extent

examples.text: The family survives on a meagre amount of rice each day.
examples.translation_cn: 这家人每天靠微薄数量的大米过活。

senses.meaning_en: having little flesh; lean; thin

examples.text: After months of hunger, the rescued dog had a meagre frame.
examples.translation_cn: 经过数月的饥饿，这只获救的狗身体瘦弱。

senses.meaning_en: used for traveling; designed to be used on a journey

examples.text: She always takes a small traveling bag on weekend trips.
examples.translation_cn: 她周末旅行时总带着一个小旅行包。

senses.meaning_en: going from place to place; itinerant

examples.text: The traveling exhibition will visit three cities this summer.
examples.translation_cn: 这个巡回展览今年夏天将到访三座城市。

senses.meaning_en: the action of traveling

examples.text: She hopes to do a lot of traveling abroad after she retires.
examples.translation_cn: 她希望退休后能多出国旅行。

senses.meaning_en: completely unreasonable or absurd, often in a way that is funny

examples.text: It is ludicrous to pay $15 for a cup of coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 花15美元买一杯咖啡是荒谬的。

senses.meaning_en: showing a deliberate and stubborn desire to behave in a way that is unreasonable or unacceptable
senses.pattern: it is perverse of sb to do

examples.text: It is perverse of him to refuse help when he is clearly struggling.
examples.translation_cn: 他明明在挣扎却拒绝帮助，真是执拗。

senses.meaning_en: contrary to what is expected or reasonable; wayward; vexing
senses.pattern: have the perverse effect of doing sth

examples.text: The new policy has the perverse effect of rewarding laziness.
examples.translation_cn: 新政策产生了奖励懒惰的反常效果。

senses.meaning_en: an elaborate public procession or show in historical or traditional costume

examples.text: Local residents take part in a historical pageant every summer.
examples.translation_cn: 当地居民每年夏天都参加历史盛装游行。

senses.meaning_en: a competition in which people, especially young women, are judged on beauty and other qualities

examples.text: She competed in a national beauty pageant last year.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年参加了全国选美比赛。

senses.meaning_en: a shiny surface or luster

examples.text: The polished table has a high gloss that reflects the light.
examples.translation_cn: 这张抛光的桌子光泽度很高，能反射光线。

senses.meaning_en: a superficially or deceptively attractive appearance

examples.text: Beneath a gloss of politeness, she was deeply angry.
examples.translation_cn: 在礼貌的外表下，她非常生气。

senses.meaning_en: to give a gloss or sheen to something

examples.text: He glossed the cabinet with a clear varnish.
examples.translation_cn: 他用清漆给柜子上光。

senses.meaning_en: to make something seem more attractive by deception

examples.text: The manager tried to gloss over the company's financial losses.
examples.translation_cn: 经理试图粉饰公司的财务亏损。

senses.meaning_en: not good for your health; likely to make you ill

examples.text: Eating too much processed food is unhealthy for your heart.
examples.translation_cn: 吃太多加工食品对心脏有害。

senses.meaning_en: not normal and likely to be harmful, especially about feelings or behaviour

examples.text: She has an unhealthy obsession with checking her phone.
examples.translation_cn: 她对查看手机有一种病态的痴迷。

senses.meaning_en: sick or ill; not in good health

examples.text: After months without treatment, he looked unhealthy and pale.
examples.translation_cn: 几个月没治疗，他看起来不健康，脸色苍白。

senses.meaning_en: widespread destruction and disorder

examples.text: The storm will wreak havoc on the coastal villages.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨将给沿海村庄造成浩劫。

senses.meaning_en: able to speak two languages fluently

examples.text: She has been bilingual in English and Spanish since childhood.
examples.translation_cn: 她从小就通晓英语和西班牙语。

senses.meaning_en: using or involving two languages

examples.text: The school publishes a bilingual newspaper every month.
examples.translation_cn: 学校每月出版一份双语报纸。

senses.meaning_en: a person who can use two languages

examples.text: My sister is a bilingual and translates for international clients.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐是双语者，为国际客户做翻译。

senses.meaning_en: the natural quality, colour, or appearance of the skin on a person's face

examples.text: She has a clear complexion that many people envy.
examples.translation_cn: 她的面部皮肤很光洁，令许多人羡慕。

senses.meaning_en: the general character or aspect of something; the way a situation appears

examples.text: The scandal altered the political complexion of the election.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻改变了选举的政治面貌。

senses.meaning_en: open refusal to obey; bold resistance

examples.text: The protesters marched in defiance of the curfew.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议者违反宵禁进行游行。

senses.meaning_en: an entrance hall in a house or apartment

examples.text: He dropped his keys in the foyer and went straight upstairs to change.
examples.translation_cn: 他把钥匙往门厅一放，径直上楼换衣服去了。

senses.meaning_en: a large open area inside the entrance of a hotel, theatre, etc.

examples.text: We arranged to meet in the foyer of the theatre before the play.
examples.translation_cn: 我们约好演出前在剧院大堂见面。

senses.meaning_en: an extra benefit, especially from a job

examples.text: Free gym membership is a perk of the job.
examples.translation_cn: 免费健身房会员是这份工作的额外待遇。

senses.meaning_en: to raise (one's ears, head) suddenly

examples.text: The dog perked up its ears at the sound.
examples.translation_cn: 狗听到声音竖起了耳朵。

senses.meaning_en: to make coffee in a percolator

examples.text: She perked coffee for the guests before they woke up.
examples.translation_cn: 她在客人醒来前煮了咖啡。

senses.meaning_en: to appear or emerge suddenly

examples.text: A groundhog perked out from behind the woodpile.
examples.translation_cn: 一只土拨鼠从木堆后面探出身来。

senses.meaning_en: able to float; having buoyancy

examples.text: The life jacket remains buoyant even when it is soaking wet.
examples.translation_cn: 救生衣即使湿透了也能保持浮力。

senses.meaning_en: successful and active, especially in trade or business

examples.text: Low interest rates have kept the housing market buoyant.
examples.translation_cn: 低利率使房地产市场保持活跃。

senses.meaning_en: cheerful and optimistic; light-hearted

examples.text: She arrived at the interview in a buoyant mood.
examples.translation_cn: 她带着轻松乐观的心情去参加面试。

senses.meaning_en: the condition of being more important or coming before others

examples.text: Safety must take precedence over speed in this project.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个项目中，安全必须优先于速度。

senses.meaning_en: the department in a hotel responsible for cleaning rooms

examples.text: You can call housekeeping if you need extra towels.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你需要额外的毛巾，可以叫客房服务。

senses.meaning_en: the management of a home and the work involved in it

examples.text: She manages the housekeeping while raising three young children.
examples.translation_cn: 她一边管理家务，一边抚养三个年幼的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: routine operations that keep a system or program working properly

examples.text: The program performs housekeeping at midnight to clear old logs.
examples.translation_cn: 该程序在午夜执行内务处理，以清除旧日志。

senses.meaning_en: general tasks that involve preparation

examples.text: Let's take care of the housekeeping before we begin the discussion.
examples.translation_cn: 在开始讨论之前，我们先处理一些会前杂务。

senses.meaning_en: the distance travelled in miles or air miles

examples.text: I bought a used car with low mileage.
examples.translation_cn: 我买了一辆里程数低的二手车。

senses.meaning_en: an allowance for travel expenses at a specified rate per mile

examples.text: Employees can claim mileage for travel to client meetings.
examples.translation_cn: 员工可以申报去参加客户会议的里程补贴。

senses.meaning_en: benefit or advantage gained from something

examples.text: They got a lot of mileage out of the story.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从这个故事中得到了很多好处。

senses.meaning_en: the number of miles a vehicle can travel using a particular amount of fuel

examples.text: This car gets good gas mileage on the highway.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上油耗很低。

senses.meaning_en: causing great horror or shock

examples.text: It was ghastly to see the wreckage of the plane after the explosion.
examples.translation_cn: 爆炸后看到飞机的残骸真可怕。

senses.meaning_en: very bad or unpleasant

examples.text: I have a ghastly headache and can hardly work.
examples.translation_cn: 我头疼得厉害，几乎没法工作。

senses.meaning_en: very pale and ill-looking

examples.text: You look ghastly today; have you been ill?
examples.translation_cn: 你今天脸色苍白，是不是病了？

senses.meaning_en: a safe distance or room to move, especially for a ship at sea

examples.text: The ferry gave the rocks a wide berth.
examples.translation_cn: 渡轮远远避开了礁石。

senses.meaning_en: a bed for sleeping in on a train, ship, or caravan

examples.text: She reserved a berth on the overnight train to Glasgow.
examples.translation_cn: 她预订了去格拉斯哥的夜火车的卧铺。

senses.meaning_en: a job or position, especially one that is comfortable or well paid

examples.text: He landed a comfortable berth as a consultant.
examples.translation_cn: 他得到了一份舒适的顾问职位。

senses.meaning_en: a place or seed in a tournament bracket

examples.text: The team earned a playoff berth after Saturday's win.
examples.translation_cn: 球队在周六获胜后赢得了季后赛席位。

senses.meaning_en: to swell or stick out

examples.text: His leather bag bulged with books and papers.
examples.translation_cn: 他的皮包里塞满了书和文件，鼓了起来。

senses.meaning_en: a rounded swelling or protrusion

examples.text: There was a noticeable bulge in the middle of the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 墙中间有一处明显的凸起。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden temporary increase

examples.text: There was a sudden bulge in sales last month.
examples.translation_cn: 上个月销售额突然激增。

senses.meaning_en: the act of using something in an incorrect, improper or unlawful way

examples.text: The report revealed serious misuse of public funds.
examples.translation_cn: 报告披露了公共资金的严重滥用。

senses.meaning_en: to use something incorrectly

examples.text: He was accused of misusing company funds last year.
examples.translation_cn: 去年他被指控滥用公司资金。

senses.meaning_en: a large predatory reptile with a long tail and powerful jaws, living in tropical rivers and lakes

examples.text: A fisherman was attacked by a crocodile while checking his nets.
examples.translation_cn: 一名渔民在检查渔网时遭到鳄鱼攻击。

senses.meaning_en: a long line of people (especially children) walking together

examples.text: The children walked to the pool in a crocodile.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们排成队走向游泳池。

senses.meaning_en: to sexually assault or harass someone, especially a child

examples.text: He was accused of molesting a child at a charity event.
examples.translation_cn: 他被指控在一次慈善活动上猥亵一名儿童。

senses.meaning_en: to disturb or annoy someone, especially by interfering with their peace

examples.text: The sign warns visitors not to molest the nesting birds.
examples.translation_cn: 牌子上提醒游客不要打扰正在筑巢的鸟。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that makes something impure or harmful

examples.text: Contaminants in the river have made the water unsafe to drink.
examples.translation_cn: 河流中的污染物使水不能安全饮用。

senses.meaning_en: to obtain something, especially with care or effort

examples.text: The aid agency procured clean water for the refugee camp.
examples.translation_cn: 援助机构为难民营获取了干净的水。

senses.meaning_en: to provide a prostitute for somebody

examples.text: He was jailed for procuring young women for wealthy clients.
examples.translation_cn: 他因向富有的客户介绍年轻女子卖淫而入狱。

senses.meaning_en: original; indigenous; primitive

examples.text: The aboriginal people of Australia have lived there for over 40,000 years.
examples.translation_cn: 澳大利亚的原住民已经在那里生活了4万多年。

senses.meaning_en: native to a region

examples.text: This bird is aboriginal to the island and found nowhere else.
examples.translation_cn: 这种鸟是该岛的原生物种，其他地方没有。

senses.meaning_en: an aboriginal person

examples.text: Many of the aboriginals in this region speak their own languages.
examples.translation_cn: 该地区的许多原住民说自己的语言。

senses.meaning_en: a dog kept to guard property

examples.text: The German shepherd serves as a watchdog for the family.
examples.translation_cn: 那条德国牧羊犬为这家人担任看门狗。

senses.meaning_en: a person or group that monitors the activities of others to ensure they act legally and ethically
senses.pattern: act as a watchdog over sth

examples.text: The committee acts as a watchdog over government spending.
examples.translation_cn: 该委员会对政府开支进行监督。

senses.meaning_en: a group of three people or things; three combined as one

examples.text: The recipe calls for a trinity of herbs: basil, thyme, and oregano.
examples.translation_cn: 这个食谱需要三种香草：罗勒、百里香和牛至。

senses.meaning_en: the union of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit as one God

examples.text: Many Christians believe in the Holy Trinity as revealed in the Bible.
examples.translation_cn: 许多基督徒相信圣经所启示的三位一体。

senses.meaning_en: the act of officially forcing someone to leave a school or organization

examples.text: His expulsion from school followed a series of warnings.
examples.translation_cn: 他因多次警告而被学校开除。

senses.meaning_en: the act of forcing someone to leave a country or place

examples.text: The court ordered his expulsion from the country for visa fraud.
examples.translation_cn: 法院因签证欺诈下令将他驱逐出境。

senses.meaning_en: the act of forcing something out of a container or body

examples.text: Deep breathing promotes the expulsion of air from the lungs.
examples.translation_cn: 深呼吸促进空气从肺部排出。

senses.meaning_en: to convert a code or cipher into plain text

examples.text: They managed to decipher a code written in an ancient language.
examples.translation_cn: 他们设法破译了一种用古代语言写成的密码。

senses.meaning_en: to read text that is almost illegible or obscure

examples.text: I could barely decipher her handwriting on the prescription.
examples.translation_cn: 我几乎无法辨认她在处方上的字迹。

senses.meaning_en: to make sense of a complex situation or find a solution to a problem

examples.text: Detectives are trying to decipher what led to the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 侦探们正在努力弄清是什么导致了车祸。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people or companies formed to do business or achieve a common aim

examples.text: A syndicate of banks financed the new airport terminal.
examples.translation_cn: 一个银行财团为新的机场航站楼提供了资金。

senses.meaning_en: to publish or broadcast something in many newspapers, TV stations, etc. at the same time

examples.text: Her advice column is syndicated in over two hundred newspapers.
examples.translation_cn: 她的建议专栏在两百多家报纸上联合发表。

senses.meaning_en: without conditions or limits; absolute

examples.text: Her support for the team is completely unconditional.
examples.translation_cn: 她对团队的支持完全是无条件的。

senses.meaning_en: the capital of Victoria and second-largest city in Australia

examples.text: She has lived in Melbourne for five years now.
examples.translation_cn: 她已经在墨尔本住了五年。

senses.meaning_en: a fertile place with water in a desert

examples.text: The travelers stopped at an oasis in the desert to rest and drink water.
examples.translation_cn: 旅行者在沙漠中的绿洲停下休息、喝水。

senses.meaning_en: a peaceful place or situation separated from surrounding noise

examples.text: The garden was an oasis of calm in the busy city.
examples.translation_cn: 这个花园是繁忙城市中的宁静之地。

senses.meaning_en: having force or revealing

examples.text: It is telling that the company refused to publish the full report.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司拒绝公布完整报告，这一点很能说明问题。

senses.meaning_en: the act of narration

examples.text: The story seems less impressive in the telling.
examples.translation_cn: 这个故事讲起来就不那么令人印象深刻了。

senses.meaning_en: ability to determine

examples.text: There is no telling how long the meeting will last.
examples.translation_cn: 会议要开多久无法预料。

senses.meaning_en: a long speech by one actor in a play, especially when alone on stage

examples.text: She performed a moving monologue from Hamlet last night.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨晚表演了《哈姆雷特》中一段感人的独白。

senses.meaning_en: a long series of jokes and funny stories performed by one person as entertainment

examples.text: The comedian did a hilarious monologue about family life.
examples.translation_cn: 这位喜剧演员就家庭生活讲了一段很滑稽的独角戏。

senses.meaning_en: a long, uninterrupted speech that prevents others from taking part in a conversation

examples.text: He went into a long monologue about his trip.
examples.translation_cn: 他就自己的旅行滔滔不绝地说了一大段。

senses.meaning_en: a wealthy and powerful person, especially in business or industry

examples.text: The shipping magnate built a fortune in container shipping.
examples.translation_cn: 这位航运巨头靠集装箱航运积累了财富。

senses.meaning_en: a feeling of deep regret or guilt for doing wrong

examples.text: He felt deep remorse for lying to his parents.
examples.translation_cn: 他因对父母撒谎而感到深深的自责。

senses.meaning_en: working for a short time in different places

examples.text: She works as a touring musician, performing in a new city each week.
examples.translation_cn: 她是一名巡回音乐人，每周都在一座新城市演出。

senses.meaning_en: intended for a journey through a country or region, related to tourism

examples.text: They bought a touring map before driving through the mountains.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在驾车穿越山区前买了一张旅游地图。

senses.meaning_en: a humorous or satirical imitation of a serious work

examples.text: The film is a hilarious parody of a classic spy movie.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影是对经典间谍片的滑稽模仿。

senses.meaning_en: a very poor or false imitation of something

examples.text: The whole trial was a parody of justice.
examples.translation_cn: 整个审判简直是对正义的拙劣模仿。

senses.meaning_en: to imitate someone or something in a humorous or mocking way

examples.text: The comedian brilliantly parodied the president's speech on stage.
examples.translation_cn: 这位喜剧演员在台上精彩地滑稽模仿了总统的演讲。

senses.meaning_en: irrational distrust or suspicion of others, sometimes as a mental illness

examples.text: His paranoia about being followed made him constantly check the mirror.
examples.translation_cn: 他总怀疑被人跟踪，不断查看后视镜。

senses.meaning_en: the mental ability to recover quickly from difficulties or misfortune
senses.pattern: resilience in the face of sth

examples.text: She showed great resilience in the face of repeated setbacks.
examples.translation_cn: 面对一次次挫折，她表现出很强的恢复力。

senses.meaning_en: the ability of a material to return to its original shape after being stretched or pressed

examples.text: The foam quickly regains its resilience after pressure is removed.
examples.translation_cn: 压力解除后，泡沫很快恢复弹性。

senses.meaning_en: the capacity to resist destruction or defeat under extreme pressure

examples.text: Communities need to build resilience under pressure to survive major disasters.
examples.translation_cn: 社区需要培养抗压能力，才能在重大灾害中生存。

senses.meaning_en: a protective bar or device that absorbs impact

examples.text: He noticed a small dent on the rear bumper.
examples.translation_cn: 他注意到后保险杠上有一处小凹痕。

senses.meaning_en: unusually large or abundant

examples.text: Farmers harvested a bumper crop of wheat this summer.
examples.translation_cn: 农民们今年夏天收获了大量小麦。

senses.meaning_en: third in order or rank

examples.text: Students can choose from many courses at tertiary level.
examples.translation_cn: 学生在高等教育阶段可以选择许多课程。

senses.meaning_en: the act of reducing or using up a resource, often faster than it can be replaced; exhaustion

examples.text: The depletion of fish stocks threatens coastal communities.
examples.translation_cn: 鱼类资源的枯竭正威胁着沿海社区。

senses.meaning_en: the act of officially registering or signing up for a course, school, or programme

examples.text: Enrolment in the new language course begins next week.
examples.translation_cn: 新语言课程的注册下周开始。

senses.meaning_en: morally right and good

examples.text: He raised his children to be righteous in all their dealings.
examples.translation_cn: 他教育孩子们在一切交往中要正直。

senses.meaning_en: morally justified

examples.text: They fought for a righteous cause and won the support of the public.
examples.translation_cn: 他们为正义事业而战，并赢得了公众的支持。

senses.meaning_en: showing an annoying belief in one's own moral superiority

examples.text: He always gets all righteous about other people's eating habits.
examples.translation_cn: 他对别人的饮食习惯总是摆出一副道德优越感。

senses.meaning_en: to talk wildly or angrily as if mad

examples.text: He raved on about imaginary enemies for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 他连续数小时胡言乱语地说着假想敌。

senses.meaning_en: to praise with great enthusiasm

examples.text: Critics raved about her lead performance in the play.
examples.translation_cn: 评论家们对她在剧中的主演表演赞不绝口。

senses.meaning_en: a large dance party with electronic music

examples.text: They went to an illegal rave in an old warehouse.
examples.translation_cn: 他们去旧仓库参加了一个非法狂欢舞会。

senses.meaning_en: electronic dance music played at raves

examples.text: The DJ played rave music all night at the beach party.
examples.translation_cn: DJ 在海滩派对上整晚播放锐舞音乐。

senses.meaning_en: an enthusiastic review

examples.text: The film received rave reviews for its sharp writing and acting.
examples.translation_cn: 这部电影因其犀利的剧本和表演而获得好评。

senses.meaning_en: helping to make something happen or exist

examples.text: A calm atmosphere is conducive to productive work.
examples.translation_cn: 平静的氛围有助于高效工作。

senses.meaning_en: heavily loaded with something

examples.text: The truck was laden with fresh produce from the valley.
examples.translation_cn: 卡车满载着从山谷运来的新鲜农产品。

senses.meaning_en: filled with something unpleasant or heavy

examples.text: Her voice was low and laden with guilt.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音低沉，充满内疚。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or ability of speaking

examples.text: She has improved a lot in public speaking.
examples.translation_cn: 她在公开演讲方面进步了很多。

senses.meaning_en: involving or using speech

examples.text: We will have a speaking test in class tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 我们明天课堂上会有一个口语测试。

senses.meaning_en: having lines to say

examples.text: She got a speaking part in the school play.
examples.translation_cn: 她在学校话剧里得到了一个有台词的角色。

senses.meaning_en: a shelf or shelves for storing books

examples.text: She keeps her favorite novels on the bookshelf beside her bed.
examples.translation_cn: 她把自己最喜欢的小说放在床边的书架上。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to receive and pay out money

examples.text: My sister works as a cashier at a downtown bank.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐在市中心一家银行做出纳员。

senses.meaning_en: to spread over or occupy in large numbers, causing harm

examples.text: The garden was overrun with weeds after the rain.
examples.translation_cn: 雨后花园里长满了杂草。

senses.meaning_en: to go beyond the scheduled time

examples.text: The meeting overran by nearly thirty minutes yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 会议昨天超时近三十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to take control by military force

examples.text: The capital was overrun by rebel forces in a week.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军在一周内占领了首都。

senses.meaning_en: an amount beyond the limit, especially cost

examples.text: The bridge project had a cost overrun of $2 million.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥的项目超支了两百万美元。

senses.meaning_en: to go beyond; to extend in part beyond

examples.text: The river overran its banks after heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 大雨后河水漫过了河岸。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone very angry

examples.text: Residents were maddened by the endless construction noise.
examples.translation_cn: 居民们被无休止的施工噪音激怒了。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone insane or crazy

examples.text: The wounded animal was maddened with pain and attacked the hunter.
examples.translation_cn: 受伤的动物因疼痛而发狂，攻击了猎人。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to clean and maintain a building

examples.text: He works as a janitor at the local library.
examples.translation_cn: 他在当地图书馆当清洁工。

senses.meaning_en: to force somebody to do something by using threats or intimidation

examples.text: The gang coerced the shopkeeper into paying them protection money.
examples.translation_cn: 这伙人强迫店主向他们交保护费。

senses.meaning_en: to decide in court that an objection is not valid

examples.text: The judge overruled an objection from the defense.
examples.translation_cn: 法官驳回了辩方提出的一项反对。

senses.meaning_en: to reject or cancel a decision or ruling by higher authority

examples.text: The appeals court overruled the trial court's decision.
examples.translation_cn: 上诉法院推翻了初审法院的裁决。

senses.meaning_en: to be more important than something else

examples.text: Safety concerns overruled cost in the final decision.
examples.translation_cn: 安全考虑在最终决定中压倒了成本。

senses.meaning_en: a formal, usually lengthy, systematic discourse on some subject

examples.text: She wrote a treatise on economic policy that influenced government decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 她写了一部影响政府决策的经济政策专著。

senses.meaning_en: a person who watches an event without taking part

examples.text: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
examples.translation_cn: 一群旁观者聚集在车祸现场。

senses.meaning_en: a doctor for animals

examples.text: You should see a veterinarian if your cat refuses to eat.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你的猫不吃东西，你应该带它去看兽医。

senses.meaning_en: a sign of something good or bad that will happen in the future

examples.text: The sudden drop in temperature was an omen of the harsh winter to come.
examples.translation_cn: 气温骤降是严冬将至的预兆。

senses.meaning_en: to force someone to leave a property

examples.text: The landlord evicted them from the apartment for not paying rent.
examples.translation_cn: 房东因他们未付房租而将他们赶出了公寓。

senses.meaning_en: to deliberately damage or destroy something in order to prevent it from being successful

examples.text: A disgruntled employee sabotaged the assembly line before quitting.
examples.translation_cn: 一名心怀不满的员工在辞职前破坏了装配线。

senses.meaning_en: the act of deliberately destroying or damaging something, especially to prevent an enemy or competitor from succeeding

examples.text: The fire was clearly an act of sabotage.
examples.translation_cn: 这场火灾显然是蓄意破坏行为。

senses.meaning_en: thinking you are more important than other people

examples.text: He is pompous about his position and expects special treatment everywhere.
examples.translation_cn: 他因职位而自命不凡，到哪里都指望特殊待遇。

senses.meaning_en: using grand or formal language that lacks real meaning

examples.text: The article is written in a pompous style but says nothing new.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章文风浮夸，却毫无新意。

senses.meaning_en: a secondary title or heading below or after a title

examples.text: The book was published with the subtitle 'A Modern History'.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书出版时带有副标题《现代史》。

senses.meaning_en: text at the bottom of a screen showing dialogue

examples.text: We watched a French film with English subtitles.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看了一部带英文字幕的法国电影。

senses.meaning_en: to add subtitles to a film or video

examples.text: The documentary has been subtitled in six languages.
examples.translation_cn: 这部纪录片已被配上六种语言的字幕。

senses.meaning_en: noisy confusion or disturbance

examples.text: The sudden noise caused a commotion in the library.
examples.translation_cn: 突然的噪音在图书馆引起一阵骚动。

senses.meaning_en: the natural ending of a pregnancy before the baby can survive

examples.text: She had a miscarriage in the early stages of her pregnancy.
examples.translation_cn: 她在怀孕早期流产了。

senses.meaning_en: a failure of justice or a mistake

examples.text: The judge's ruling was a miscarriage of justice.
examples.translation_cn: 法官的裁决是司法不公。

senses.meaning_en: to jump suddenly forward in order to attack or seize

examples.text: The cat pounced on the mouse and caught it in one swift move.
examples.translation_cn: 猫扑向老鼠，一下子抓住了它。

senses.meaning_en: to eagerly seize an opportunity
senses.pattern: pounce on a chance to do

examples.text: She pounced on the chance to study abroad without hesitation.
examples.translation_cn: 她毫不犹豫地抓住了出国留学的机会。

senses.meaning_en: suffering from a neurosis; overly anxious

examples.text: She's neurotic about checking that the front door is locked.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是神经质地检查前门是否锁好。

senses.meaning_en: a person with a neurosis

examples.text: My uncle is a neurotic who constantly worries about his health.
examples.translation_cn: 我叔叔是个总是担心自己健康的神经质的人。

senses.meaning_en: a stain on someone's reputation or character; a disgrace

examples.text: The scandal was a blot on his long career in politics.
examples.translation_cn: 这个丑闻是他长期从政生涯中的一个污点。

senses.meaning_en: a spot or stain made by a coloured substance

examples.text: There was a dark blot of ink on the bottom of the page.
examples.translation_cn: 页面底部有一个深色墨渍。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a blot on something by spilling a coloured substance

examples.text: He accidentally blotted the letter with a few drops of coffee.
examples.translation_cn: 他不小心把几滴咖啡滴在信上留下了污渍。

senses.meaning_en: to soak up liquid or dry something using an absorbent material

examples.text: Blot up the spill with a paper towel.
examples.translation_cn: 用纸巾吸干洒出来的液体。

senses.meaning_en: having a bad smell

examples.text: The kitchen bin was smelly, so I had to take it outside.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房垃圾桶有臭味，我不得不把它拿到外面。

senses.meaning_en: Reverence and devotion to God.

examples.text: She showed deep piety toward God through daily prayer.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过每日祈祷向上帝表达深切虔诚。

senses.meaning_en: Similar reverence to one's parents and family or to one's country.

examples.text: Filial piety toward one's parents remains a core value in many cultures.
examples.translation_cn: 对父母的孝顺在许多文化中仍是核心价值。

senses.meaning_en: A devout or otherwise laudable act, thought, or statement.

examples.text: Many believers still practice the simple pieties of faith.
examples.translation_cn: 许多信徒仍践行信仰的朴素虔诚之举。

senses.meaning_en: to change direction suddenly, especially to avoid something

examples.text: The car swerved to avoid a cyclist on the road.
examples.translation_cn: 汽车突然转弯避开路上的一名骑自行车的人。

senses.meaning_en: to deviate from a principle, duty, or course

examples.text: He never swerved from his principles even under pressure.
examples.translation_cn: 即使在压力下，他也从不背离自己的原则。

senses.meaning_en: a book of maps
senses.pattern: look sth up in an atlas

examples.text: I looked up the small town in an atlas before the trip.
examples.translation_cn: 出发前我在地图集上查了那个小镇。

senses.meaning_en: a book of illustrations or diagrams on a subject

examples.text: The surgeon studied an atlas of human anatomy before the operation.
examples.translation_cn: 手术前，外科医生研究了一本人体解剖图谱。

senses.meaning_en: illegal or antisocial behaviour, especially by young people

examples.text: Delinquency among teenagers has risen sharply in some cities.
examples.translation_cn: 青少年犯罪在一些城市急剧上升。

senses.meaning_en: a debt that is overdue for payment

examples.text: A delinquency on your credit-card payment can damage your credit record.
examples.translation_cn: 信用卡还款逾期会损害你的信用记录。

senses.meaning_en: neglect of duty or obligation

examples.text: Delinquency in reporting the incident led to serious consequences.
examples.translation_cn: 未及时报告该事件导致了严重后果。

senses.meaning_en: to relate to or be connected with something

examples.text: These documents pertain to the recent changes in employment law.
examples.translation_cn: 这些文件涉及就业法的最新修订。

senses.meaning_en: to apply or be applicable

examples.text: The same rule pertains to every member of staff.
examples.translation_cn: 同样的规则适用于每位员工。

senses.meaning_en: a meeting or date, often secret or arranged

examples.text: The two leaders arranged a secret rendezvous to avoid media attention.
examples.translation_cn: 两位领导人安排了一次秘密会面，以避开媒体关注。

senses.meaning_en: to meet at an agreed time and place

examples.text: The rescue team will rendezvous with the hikers at the mountain hut.
examples.translation_cn: 救援队将在山间小屋与徒步者会合。

senses.meaning_en: a place where people have arranged to meet

examples.text: The café is a popular rendezvous for local artists.
examples.translation_cn: 这家咖啡馆是当地艺术家常聚会的地方。

senses.meaning_en: a situation where no progress can be made because both sides refuse to change

examples.text: The talks ended in deadlock over border issues.
examples.translation_cn: 会谈在边境问题上以僵局告终。

senses.meaning_en: a situation where two processes each wait for the other to act

examples.text: A deadlock between two processes left the system unresponsive.
examples.translation_cn: 两个进程之间的死锁导致系统无响应。

senses.meaning_en: to become stuck or cause something to become stuck because neither side will compromise

examples.text: The two sides were deadlocked over wages for weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 双方在工资问题上僵持了数周。

senses.meaning_en: a US state in the far northwest of North America

examples.text: She spent last summer fishing for salmon in Alaska.
examples.translation_cn: 她去年夏天在阿拉斯加钓鲑鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a faint or flashing light

examples.text: We saw a glimmer of light through the trees.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看到树丛中透出一丝微光。

senses.meaning_en: a faint sign or small amount of a feeling or quality

examples.text: The doctor's words gave the family a glimmer of hope.
examples.translation_cn: 医生的话给这家人带来了一丝希望。

senses.meaning_en: to shine with a faint unsteady light

examples.text: The old candle glimmered in the dark hallway.
examples.translation_cn: 旧蜡烛在黑暗的走廊里发出微光。

senses.meaning_en: an event that causes great harm or loss

examples.text: A sudden calamity struck the coastal town, leaving hundreds homeless.
examples.translation_cn: 一场突如其来的灾难袭击了这个沿海小镇，导致数百人无家可归。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of furniture for storing and displaying books

examples.text: He keeps his collection of poetry on the bookcase in the living room.
examples.translation_cn: 他把他的诗集收藏放在客厅的书架上。

senses.meaning_en: a person who says that someone has done something wrong or illegal, especially in a court of law

examples.text: The defendant has the right to face his accuser in court.
examples.translation_cn: 被告有权在法庭上与指控他的人对质。

senses.meaning_en: to agree to pay for something, especially a project or event, as financial support

examples.text: The charity agreed to underwrite the costs of the new library.
examples.translation_cn: 该慈善机构同意承担新图书馆的费用。

senses.meaning_en: to accept responsibility for an insurance risk

examples.text: The insurance policy was underwritten by a large international insurer.
examples.translation_cn: 这份保单由一家大型国际保险公司承保。

senses.meaning_en: to agree to buy any unsold shares in a new share issue

examples.text: The bank agreed to underwrite a new share issue.
examples.translation_cn: 银行同意包销一次新股发行。

senses.meaning_en: a natural wide flow of water across the land into the sea, a lake, or another river

examples.text: Several major rivers flow into the Atlantic Ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 几条主要河流流入大西洋。

senses.meaning_en: a general belief that bad things will happen

examples.text: He expressed deep pessimism about the future of the economy.
examples.translation_cn: 他对经济前景表达了深深的悲观情绪。

senses.meaning_en: the doctrine that this world is the worst of all possible worlds

examples.text: Schopenhauer developed a philosophy of pessimism which holds that this world is the worst possible.
examples.translation_cn: 叔本华发展了一种悲观主义哲学，认为这个世界是最坏的可能世界。

senses.meaning_en: a waterproof coat worn in the rain

examples.text: You should wear a raincoat when the forecast predicts heavy rain.
examples.translation_cn: 天气预报预测有大雨时，你应该穿雨衣。

senses.meaning_en: a booklet giving details about a school, college, or other institution

examples.text: She requested a prospectus for a university in Scotland.
examples.translation_cn: 她索取了一所苏格兰大学的招生简章。

senses.meaning_en: a document offering shares for sale to investors

examples.text: The company issued a prospectus for its share offer.
examples.translation_cn: 公司发布了股票发行的招股说明书。

senses.meaning_en: a written proposal for a project or book

examples.text: She wrote a prospectus for a book about the city's history.
examples.translation_cn: 她为一部关于该城历史的书写了选题方案。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is being interviewed, especially for a job or in a media interview

examples.text: As an interviewee, she answered each question honestly.
examples.translation_cn: 作为被面试者，她如实地回答了每一个问题。

senses.meaning_en: a line or mark made by folding or pressing

examples.text: There was a deep crease in his shirt after he slept in it.
examples.translation_cn: 他穿着衬衫睡觉后，上面留下了一道很深的折痕。

senses.meaning_en: to make a crease in something; to wrinkle

examples.text: Don't sit on my jacket, or you'll crease the fabric.
examples.translation_cn: 别坐在我的夹克上，否则你会把布料弄皱。

senses.meaning_en: one of the white lines on a cricket pitch marking the batsman's ground

examples.text: The opening batsman was at the crease for three hours.
examples.translation_cn: 这位首发击球手在击球线上坚守了三个小时。

senses.meaning_en: to form wrinkles; to become creased

examples.text: This linen shirt creases easily, so hang it up after ironing.
examples.translation_cn: 这件亚麻衬衫很容易起皱，所以熨烫后要挂起来。

senses.meaning_en: a large group of fish swimming together

examples.text: A shoal of fish darted away when the boat approached.
examples.translation_cn: 船靠近时，一群鱼迅速游走了。

senses.meaning_en: a sandbank or sandbar creating a shallow

examples.text: The ship ran aground on a shoal near the harbor entrance.
examples.translation_cn: 船在港口入口附近的浅滩上搁浅了。
