senses.meaning_en: (of fish) to swim together in a group

examples.text: Small fish often shoal together to confuse predators.
examples.translation_cn: 小鱼经常成群游动以迷惑捕食者。

senses.meaning_en: a fixed sum of money paid to someone regularly, especially for the rest of their life

examples.text: She receives an annuity of $1,000 each month for the rest of her life.
examples.translation_cn: 她余生每月领取1,000美元年金。

senses.meaning_en: a leading American business magazine known for its lists of the richest people and companies

examples.text: Her company was featured in Forbes last month.
examples.translation_cn: 她的公司上个月被《福布斯》报道。

senses.meaning_en: to make sb/sth completely wet

examples.text: He was drenched in sweat after the long run.
examples.translation_cn: 长跑之后他浑身被汗水湿透。

senses.meaning_en: the act, practice, or occupation of supervising and taking care of young children

examples.text: Many working parents rely on grandparents to provide childcare for their young children.
examples.translation_cn: 许多上班族父母依靠祖父母来照看年幼的孩子。

senses.meaning_en: a place where young children are supervised while away from their parents or guardians

examples.text: She dropped her son off at childcare before work.
examples.translation_cn: 她上班前把儿子送到托儿所。

senses.meaning_en: not strict or careful enough

examples.text: The company was lax about enforcing safety rules.
examples.translation_cn: 公司对执行安全规定很松懈。

senses.meaning_en: loose; not tight or taut

examples.text: His muscles became lax after weeks of bed rest.
examples.translation_cn: 卧床几周后，他的肌肉变松弛了。

senses.meaning_en: hard work, especially work that makes you very tired

examples.text: After years of toil, they finally bought a small farm.
examples.translation_cn: 经过多年的辛劳，他们终于买下了一座小农场。

senses.meaning_en: to work very hard for a long time

examples.text: She toiled away at the report until midnight.
examples.translation_cn: 她埋头写报告直到午夜。

senses.meaning_en: to move slowly and with difficulty

examples.text: We toiled up the steep hill with heavy backpacks.
examples.translation_cn: 我们背着沉重的背包艰难地爬上陡峭的山坡。

senses.meaning_en: not told or revealed; secret

examples.text: Many details of the trip remain untold today.
examples.translation_cn: 这次旅行的许多细节至今未透露。

senses.meaning_en: too great to be counted; immense

examples.text: The floods caused untold damage to the region.
examples.translation_cn: 洪水对该地区造成了难以估量的破坏。

senses.meaning_en: an area of deep, wet mud

examples.text: The tractor was stuck in the mire for hours.
examples.translation_cn: 拖拉机陷在泥沼里好几个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a difficult situation that is hard to escape from
senses.pattern: be stuck in a mire of

examples.text: The company is stuck in a mire of bad loans.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司陷入了不良贷款的困境。

senses.meaning_en: to cause someone or something to become stuck in mud or a difficult situation

examples.text: The project was mired in controversy from the start.
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目一开始就陷入了争议。

senses.meaning_en: a telephone service offering help or information

examples.text: You can call a helpline if you need urgent advice.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你需要紧急建议，可以拨打求助热线。

senses.meaning_en: prolonged enthusiastic applause

examples.text: The audience gave the band a standing ovation.
examples.translation_cn: 观众起立为乐队鼓掌。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the sounds of spoken language

examples.text: She wrote the word in phonetic symbols so I could say it correctly.
examples.translation_cn: 她用语音符号写下那个词，这样我就能正确发音。

senses.meaning_en: the part of a Chinese character that gives a clue to its pronunciation

examples.text: In the character 沐, the right part serves as the phonetic.
examples.translation_cn: “沐”字的右边是声旁。

senses.meaning_en: a loud, unpleasant noise that lasts for a long time

examples.text: She raised her voice to be heard above the din of traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 她提高嗓门以盖过交通的嘈杂声。

senses.meaning_en: to make a loud unpleasant noise; (of a place) to be filled with sound; to resound

examples.text: The warning bells dinned in his ears all night.
examples.translation_cn: 警报声在他耳边响了一整夜。

senses.meaning_en: an object kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event

examples.text: She kept the ticket as a memento of their first date.
examples.translation_cn: 她留着那张票作为他们第一次约会的纪念品。

senses.meaning_en: in a cheerful, happy way

examples.text: She laughed gaily when she heard the good news.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到那个好消息时快活地笑了。

senses.meaning_en: in a bright, colourful, showy way

examples.text: The hall was gaily decorated with balloons and ribbons.
examples.translation_cn: 大厅用气球和彩带装饰得鲜艳夺目。

senses.meaning_en: the service of providing medical care

examples.text: Every citizen should have access to healthcare, regardless of their income.
examples.translation_cn: 每个公民无论收入如何都应能获得医疗保健服务。

senses.meaning_en: an amount by which something increases; the action of increasing

examples.text: The company raises salaries in increments of $500 every year.
examples.translation_cn: 公司每年按500美元的增量加薪。

senses.meaning_en: an addition to a letter after the signature

examples.text: She added a brief postscript to her letter yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 她昨天在信末加了一段简短的附言。

senses.meaning_en: an addition to a story, play, etc. after completion

examples.text: The author added a final chapter as a postscript to the novel.
examples.translation_cn: 作者又加了一章，作为小说的后记。

senses.meaning_en: to treat with excessive care or indulgence

examples.text: The spa pampers its guests with hot stone massages.
examples.translation_cn: 这家水疗中心用热石按摩无微不至地照顾客人。

senses.meaning_en: an approach or proposal made to initiate communication or establish a relationship

examples.text: The rebels made overtures to the government about a ceasefire.
examples.translation_cn: 叛军向政府提出了停火建议。

senses.meaning_en: a musical introduction to a longer work, often a medley of its main themes

examples.text: The orchestra played the overture to The Marriage of Figaro.
examples.translation_cn: 管弦乐队演奏了《费加罗的婚礼》的序曲。

senses.meaning_en: sympathy expressed to someone who has lost a loved one

examples.text: We expressed our condolences to the family after hearing of the death.
examples.translation_cn: 听到死讯后，我们向家属表达了慰问。

senses.meaning_en: robbery at sea; seizing a ship from its lawful owners

examples.text: The sailors were arrested for committing piracy on the high seas.
examples.translation_cn: 船员们因在公海实施海盗行为而被捕。

senses.meaning_en: the unauthorized copying of goods protected by intellectual property law

examples.text: The firm was charged with software piracy for distributing unlicensed copies.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司因分发未经授权的复制品而被控软件盗版。

senses.meaning_en: to let air or gas out of sth so it becomes smaller

examples.text: He deflated the air mattress before packing it into the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他把气垫床放进车里之前放掉了气。

senses.meaning_en: to make sb feel less confident or proud; to become less confident

examples.text: The editor's harsh review deflated his confidence overnight.
examples.translation_cn: 编辑苛刻的评论让他一夜之间失去了信心。

senses.meaning_en: to reduce the amount of money in circulation so that prices fall

examples.text: The central bank raised interest rates to deflate prices.
examples.translation_cn: 央行提高利率以降低物价。

senses.meaning_en: to exceed or surpass

examples.text: Demand for the new phone has outstripped supply.
examples.translation_cn: 对新手机的需求已经超过了供应。

senses.meaning_en: to run faster than someone or something

examples.text: She outstripped all her rivals in the final lap of the race.
examples.translation_cn: 她在比赛的最后一圈把所有对手都甩在了后面。

senses.meaning_en: the highest singing voice or part; a person or instrument with this pitch

examples.text: She sings treble in the church choir every Sunday.
examples.translation_cn: 她每周在教堂唱诗班唱高音。

senses.meaning_en: three times as much or as many; to become or make three times as much

examples.text: The company's profits trebled in value over five years.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司的利润在五年间增长至原来的三倍。

senses.meaning_en: three major trophies or victories in a single season or competition

examples.text: The club won the treble for the second consecutive season.
examples.translation_cn: 该俱乐部连续第二个赛季赢得三冠王。

senses.meaning_en: a trip to see or hunt wild animals, especially in East Africa

examples.text: They saw a pride of lions while on safari in Tanzania.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在坦桑尼亚游猎时看到了一群狮子。

senses.meaning_en: to urge or advise earnestly

examples.text: The captain exhorted the crew to stay calm as the storm approached.
examples.translation_cn: 船长力劝船员们在暴风雨逼近时保持冷静。

senses.meaning_en: the shape and size of a person's body, especially when muscular

examples.text: She has a lean, athletic physique from daily running.
examples.translation_cn: 她每天跑步，身材精干健美。

senses.meaning_en: the natural physical constitution of a person

examples.text: He has a delicate physique and often catches colds in winter.
examples.translation_cn: 他体质弱，冬天经常感冒。

senses.meaning_en: extremely unpleasant or offensive; brazenly rude

examples.text: He was obnoxious to everyone at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 他在会议上对每个人都很无礼。

senses.meaning_en: not erect or perpendicular; at an angle

examples.text: The two streets meet at an oblique angle near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 这两条街在车站附近斜交。

senses.meaning_en: not straightforward; indirect or implied

examples.text: The director made an oblique reference to the budget cuts.
examples.translation_cn: 那位负责人间接提到了预算削减。

senses.meaning_en: the sport or activity of moving on skates

examples.text: We often go skating on the frozen lake in winter.
examples.translation_cn: 我们冬天经常在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

senses.meaning_en: to attach or stick something to something else
senses.collocation: affix a stamp to an envelope

examples.text: Please affix a stamp to the envelope before mailing.
examples.translation_cn: 邮寄前请把邮票贴在信封上。

senses.meaning_en: a letter or group of letters added to the beginning or end of a word to change its meaning
senses.collocation: use an affix to form a word

examples.text: You can use the affix "-less" to form adjectives like "careless".
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用词缀“-less”构成像“careless”这样的形容词。

senses.meaning_en: in a state of disrepair or deterioration, especially through neglect

examples.text: The old mill has stood in a dilapidated state for over thirty years.
examples.translation_cn: 那座老磨坊破败失修已经三十多年了。

senses.meaning_en: the state or quality of being a father; fatherhood

examples.text: He is on paternity leave after the birth of his daughter.
examples.translation_cn: 他女儿出生后他正在休陪产假。

senses.meaning_en: legal recognition of a man as the father of a child

examples.text: A DNA test can establish paternity with almost complete certainty.
examples.translation_cn: DNA检测几乎可以完全确定亲子关系。

senses.meaning_en: descent from a father; paternal origin

examples.text: In this tribe, clan membership is determined by paternity, not maternity.
examples.translation_cn: 在这个部落，氏族成员身份由父系血统而非母系血统决定。

senses.meaning_en: a lack or scarcity; shortage

examples.text: There is a dearth of affordable housing in major cities.
examples.translation_cn: 大城市里缺乏经济适用房。

senses.meaning_en: producing a deep, clear, echoing sound

examples.text: His deep voice was resonant with quiet authority.
examples.translation_cn: 他低沉的声音带着沉静的威严回荡着。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has been rejected by society or a group

examples.text: After the scandal, he was treated like an outcast by his former colleagues.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻过后，以前的同事都把他当作被排斥的人。

senses.meaning_en: rejected and not accepted by society or a group

examples.text: After the scandal, she felt outcast in the community where she had grown up.
examples.translation_cn: 丑闻过后，她在自己从小长大的社区里感到被排斥。

senses.meaning_en: a small amount of a feeling or quality

examples.text: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice.
examples.translation_cn: 她的声音里带着一丝悲伤。

senses.meaning_en: a slight amount of colour; a shade or tint

examples.text: The sky had a tinge of colour at sunset.
examples.translation_cn: 日落时天空带有一丝色彩。

senses.meaning_en: to give something a small amount of a colour, feeling, or quality

examples.text: His memories of that summer were tinged with regret.
examples.translation_cn: 他对那个夏天的记忆带有一丝遗憾。

senses.meaning_en: infected with harmful bacteria, often producing pus

examples.text: The wound became septic and needed urgent treatment.
examples.translation_cn: 伤口受感染化脓，需要紧急处理。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sewage or the disposal of sewage, especially by using bacteria to break down waste

examples.text: Bacteria break down sewage in a septic tank.
examples.translation_cn: 细菌在化粪池中分解污水。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sepsis

examples.text: The patient developed septic shock after major surgery.
examples.translation_cn: 患者在重大手术后出现了脓毒性休克。

senses.meaning_en: water that falls as rain or is collected from rain

examples.text: They collect rainwater to water the garden during dry spells.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在干旱期收集雨水浇灌花园。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem

examples.text: He was apologetic for the confusion he had caused.
examples.translation_cn: 他因自己造成的混乱表示歉意。

senses.meaning_en: a copy made using a photocopier

examples.text: Please keep a photocopy of your passport in a safe place.
examples.translation_cn: 请把护照复印件放在安全的地方。

senses.meaning_en: to make a copy using a photocopier

examples.text: She photocopied her notes for everyone in the class.
examples.translation_cn: 她为全班同学复印了她的笔记。

senses.meaning_en: clear and easy to understand

examples.text: She gave a lucid account of the new policy.
examples.translation_cn: 她对这项新政策作了清晰的说明。

senses.meaning_en: mentally clear and rational

examples.text: Despite the sedative, she remained lucid enough to answer the doctor's questions.
examples.translation_cn: 尽管服用了镇静剂，她仍保持足够清醒回答医生的问题。

senses.meaning_en: bright and clear; transparent

examples.text: We could see small fish in lucid water.
examples.translation_cn: 我们能看见清澈水中的小鱼。

senses.meaning_en: a tendency to be affected by something or to behave in a particular way

examples.text: Some people have a natural predisposition to addictive behavior.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人天生有成瘾行为的倾向。

senses.meaning_en: a genetic or inherent susceptibility to a particular disease or condition
senses.pattern: have a genetic predisposition to sth

examples.text: She has a genetic predisposition to breast cancer.
examples.translation_cn: 她有患乳腺癌的遗传易感性。

senses.meaning_en: a metal pin used for fastening pieces of metal together

examples.text: The bridge is held together by thousands of steel rivets.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥由数千个钢铆钉连接在一起。

senses.meaning_en: to hold someone's attention completely

examples.text: The audience was riveted by her powerful speech.
examples.translation_cn: 观众被她有力的演讲吸引住了。

senses.meaning_en: to fasten parts together with rivets

examples.text: Workers riveted the steel plates to the frame.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们将钢板铆接到框架上。

senses.meaning_en: to make firm or immovable

examples.text: She was riveted to the spot by the sudden crash.
examples.translation_cn: 她因突然的撞击声而吓得一动不动。

examples.text: The surface of the lake shimmered in the moonlight.
examples.translation_cn: 湖面在月光下闪烁微光。

examples.text: The silk had a shimmer of light under the lamp.
examples.translation_cn: 丝绸在灯光下泛着微光。

senses.meaning_en: the act or effort of keeping something in good condition

examples.text: The landlord is responsible for the upkeep of the building.
examples.translation_cn: 房东负责这栋楼的维护保养。

senses.meaning_en: a long, eventful journey full of adventures or difficulties

examples.text: His solo voyage across the Pacific was an odyssey of storms, mechanical failures, and close calls.
examples.translation_cn: 他独自横渡太平洋的航行是一次历经风暴、机械故障和险情的漫长历险。

senses.meaning_en: the ancient Greek epic poem attributed to Homer

examples.text: Homer's Odyssey describes Odysseus's ten-year journey home from Troy.
examples.translation_cn: 荷马的《奥德赛》描述了奥德修斯从特洛伊返乡的十年旅程。

senses.meaning_en: an intellectual or spiritual quest

examples.text: Writing the novel became an odyssey into his family's past.
examples.translation_cn: 写这部小说成了对他家族往事的一次精神探索。

senses.meaning_en: piece by piece; gradually or in small stages

examples.text: We assembled the furniture piecemeal over several weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 我们花了几个周末逐件组装好这件家具。

senses.meaning_en: done or made gradually in separate stages

examples.text: The committee took a piecemeal approach to reform.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会采取了逐步改革的做法。

senses.meaning_en: insane; very angry

examples.text: He went nuts when he saw the dent in his new car.
examples.translation_cn: 他看到新车上的凹痕时气疯了。

senses.meaning_en: very fond of; very enthusiastic about

examples.text: She's nuts about that new band and has all their albums.
examples.translation_cn: 她疯狂迷恋那支新乐队，拥有他们所有专辑。

senses.meaning_en: a soldier who fights for a foreign country or group for money

examples.text: He worked as a mercenary in several foreign conflicts.
examples.translation_cn: 他在几场外国冲突中当过雇佣兵。

senses.meaning_en: motivated only by money or personal gain

examples.text: His motives for taking the job were purely mercenary.
examples.translation_cn: 他接受这份工作的动机完全是唯利是图。

senses.meaning_en: a person who is motivated by money or gain

examples.text: She called him a mercenary for demanding such a high fee.
examples.translation_cn: 她因为他索要如此高的费用而称他唯利是图。

senses.meaning_en: to make a person or animal unable to reproduce

examples.text: Many owners have their pets sterilized to prevent unwanted litters.
examples.translation_cn: 许多主人给宠物做绝育手术，以免产下不想要的幼崽。

senses.meaning_en: to kill all living microorganisms and spores on a surface or in a substance

examples.text: All surgical instruments must be sterilized after each use.
examples.translation_cn: 所有外科手术器械每次使用后都必须消毒。

senses.meaning_en: an insane person, especially one who behaves violently or recklessly

examples.text: He was driving like a maniac on the motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 他在高速公路上像个疯子一样开车。

senses.meaning_en: a fanatic; a person with an extreme enthusiasm or obsession

examples.text: My sister is a maniac for detective novels.
examples.translation_cn: 我姐姐是个侦探小说迷。

senses.meaning_en: impossible to defeat or overcome

examples.text: After winning the final, she felt completely invincible.
examples.translation_cn: 赢得决赛后，她觉得自己完全不可战胜。

senses.meaning_en: too bright and showy, often in a tasteless way

examples.text: The necklace is too gaudy for a formal dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 这条项链太俗艳，不适合正式晚宴。

senses.meaning_en: a sign with a written message, displayed in public

examples.text: The protesters' demands were written on large placards.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议者的要求写在大标语牌上。

senses.meaning_en: to put placards on a wall or place

examples.text: The walls were placarded with posters advertising the concert.
examples.translation_cn: 墙上贴满了宣传音乐会的海报。

senses.meaning_en: open to discussion or modification

examples.text: The starting salary is negotiable for candidates with relevant experience.
examples.translation_cn: 起薪对有相关经验的候选人来说是可以协商的。

senses.meaning_en: extremely happy and excited

examples.text: She was elated at the news of her promotion.
examples.translation_cn: 她听到自己升职的消息后兴高采烈。

senses.meaning_en: a small sharp knife used by surgeons in operations
senses.pattern: make an incision with a scalpel

examples.text: The surgeon made a small incision with a scalpel.
examples.translation_cn: 外科医生用手术刀做了一个小切口。

senses.meaning_en: miscellaneous items, especially the set of equipment required for a particular activity

examples.text: The shop sells all the paraphernalia for making your own beer.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店出售自酿啤酒的全套器具。

senses.meaning_en: personal belongings or items, especially those related to a person's private life

examples.text: She kept all her personal paraphernalia in a locked drawer.
examples.translation_cn: 她把自己所有的私人物品都锁在一个抽屉里。

senses.meaning_en: a sweet brown fizzy drink flavoured with kola nuts

examples.text: He poured himself a glass of cola and added some ice.
examples.translation_cn: 他给自己倒了一杯可乐，加了些冰块。

senses.meaning_en: a small drink of liquid with medicinal, magical, or poisonous powers

examples.text: She gave him a potion of garlic and honey for his cold.
examples.translation_cn: 她给了他一剂大蒜蜂蜜药水治感冒。

senses.meaning_en: arranged according to the letters of the alphabet

examples.text: The index lists all topics in alphabetical order.
examples.translation_cn: 索引按字母顺序列出所有主题。

senses.meaning_en: not strict; tolerant

examples.text: The judge was lenient with the young offender.
examples.translation_cn: 法官对这名年轻罪犯很宽容。

senses.meaning_en: impossible to remove or wash away

examples.text: She wrote her name in indelible ink on the luggage label.
examples.translation_cn: 她用擦不掉的墨水在行李标签上写下了自己的名字。

senses.meaning_en: impossible to forget or cancel

examples.text: Her kindness left an indelible impression on everyone she met.
examples.translation_cn: 她的善良给每个遇到她的人都留下了不可磨灭的印象。

senses.meaning_en: very thin and bony, often from hunger or illness

examples.text: He looked gaunt and exhausted after weeks of fever.
examples.translation_cn: 发烧几周后，他看上去瘦削疲惫。

senses.meaning_en: bleak and bare; desolate

examples.text: The ruined tower stood gaunt against the grey sky.
examples.translation_cn: 那座废墟中的塔楼在灰暗的天空下显得荒凉。

senses.meaning_en: a mischievous child, especially one who is poor, homeless, or lives on the streets

examples.text: A group of urchins in ragged clothes begged near the station.
examples.translation_cn: 一群衣衫褴褛的流浪儿在车站附近乞讨。

senses.meaning_en: a sea urchin; a small sea animal with a round spiny shell

examples.text: The chef served fresh sea urchin over rice.
examples.translation_cn: 厨师把新鲜海胆盖在米饭上。

senses.meaning_en: an extreme, irrational fear of something

examples.text: She has a phobia of flying and avoids planes whenever possible.
examples.translation_cn: 她有飞行恐惧症，尽可能避免坐飞机。

senses.meaning_en: a strong dislike or aversion to something

examples.text: He has a real phobia about filling in forms.
examples.translation_cn: 他极讨厌填表格。

senses.meaning_en: to swing back and forth with a regular rhythm

examples.text: The pendulum oscillated back and forth in a steady rhythm.
examples.translation_cn: 钟摆以稳定的节奏来回摆动。

senses.meaning_en: to keep changing between two states, opinions, or feelings

examples.text: He oscillated between confidence and doubt before making the decision.
examples.translation_cn: 他在做决定前在自信和怀疑之间摇摆不定。

senses.meaning_en: a large Australian marsupial with strong hind legs for hopping

examples.text: We saw a kangaroo hopping across the road.
examples.translation_cn: 我们看到一只袋鼠跳过马路。

senses.meaning_en: a speech or section that introduces a play, novel, etc.

examples.text: The prologue to the play introduces the main conflict.
examples.translation_cn: 这部戏的序幕引入了主要冲突。

senses.meaning_en: a mental disorder characterized by anxiety, obsessive thoughts, or distress without loss of contact with reality

examples.text: She was diagnosed with an anxiety neurosis after months of panic attacks.
examples.translation_cn: 她在数月恐慌发作后被诊断患有焦虑性神经症。

senses.meaning_en: excessive worry or anxiety about a particular thing, often used informally

examples.text: She has a neurosis about punctuality and arrives an hour early.
examples.translation_cn: 她对守时有种神经质，总是提前一小时到。

senses.meaning_en: a person from the Western world, especially Europe or North America

examples.text: For a westerner from Germany, local customs may seem confusing at first.
examples.translation_cn: 对来自德国的西方人来说，当地习俗起初可能令人困惑。

senses.meaning_en: a person who comes from the western part of the US

examples.text: A westerner from Montana is used to wide open spaces.
examples.translation_cn: 来自蒙大拿的美国西部人习惯了开阔的空间。

senses.meaning_en: to lean back or lie down

examples.text: She reclined on the sofa and closed her eyes.
examples.translation_cn: 她斜靠在沙发上，闭上了眼睛。

senses.meaning_en: to make a seat lean back

examples.text: You can recline your seat to get more comfortable on long flights.
examples.translation_cn: 长途飞行时，你可以把座椅靠背向后调，让自己更舒服。

senses.meaning_en: to do better than someone or something; surpass

examples.text: The young athlete outdid all his rivals in the 100-meter race.
examples.translation_cn: 这位年轻运动员在100米赛跑中胜过了所有对手。

senses.meaning_en: a heavy fall of rain

examples.text: We got soaked in a sudden downpour on our way home.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在回家路上被一场突如其来的倾盆大雨淋湿了。

senses.meaning_en: a fictitious name used by someone, especially a writer or performer

examples.text: She wrote her first novel under a pseudonym to protect her privacy.
examples.translation_cn: 她为了保护隐私，用笔名写了她的第一部小说。

senses.meaning_en: relating to sailing, sailors, or the sea

examples.text: The coastguard described the accident in nautical terms, saying the boat was two nautical miles offshore.
examples.translation_cn: 海岸警卫队用航海术语描述事故，说船离岸两海里。

senses.meaning_en: to present oneself falsely as something

examples.text: He misrepresented himself as a qualified dentist to get the job.
examples.translation_cn: 他冒充有资格的牙医来获得这份工作。

senses.meaning_en: to give a false or misleading account of something

examples.text: The article misrepresented the committee's position on the issue.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇文章歪曲了委员会在该问题上的立场。

senses.meaning_en: an agreement to risk money on an event; the money risked

examples.text: He placed a large wager on the championship game.
examples.translation_cn: 他在冠军赛上押了一大笔赌注。

senses.meaning_en: to risk money or something valuable on the result of a future event

examples.text: She wagered her savings on the new business.
examples.translation_cn: 她把自己的积蓄押在了新生意上。

senses.meaning_en: to suppose; to dare say

examples.text: I'd wager that he forgot to set an alarm.
examples.translation_cn: 我敢说他忘了定闹钟。

senses.meaning_en: an animal that can live both on land and in water

examples.text: Many amphibians, such as frogs and salamanders, breed in freshwater ponds.
examples.translation_cn: 许多两栖动物，如青蛙和蝾螈，在淡水池塘中繁殖。

senses.meaning_en: relating to the class Amphibia

examples.text: Amphibian populations have declined sharply in recent decades.
examples.translation_cn: 近几十年来两栖动物种群数量急剧下降。

senses.meaning_en: able to operate on both land and water

examples.text: The pilot landed the amphibian aircraft on the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 飞行员将水陆两用飞机降落在湖面上。

senses.meaning_en: the rainy season when the monsoon blows

examples.text: The village is cut off during the monsoon.
examples.translation_cn: 雨季期间，这个村庄与外界隔绝。

senses.meaning_en: a seasonal wind that brings the rainy season

examples.text: The monsoon blows from the southwest in summer.
examples.translation_cn: 夏季，季风从西南方向吹来。

senses.meaning_en: the rain that falls during the monsoon

examples.text: The monsoon rains washed away the old bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 季风雨冲垮了那座旧桥。

senses.meaning_en: the act of sending money to someone

examples.text: You can make a remittance to the charity online in minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在几分钟内在线向该慈善机构汇款。

senses.meaning_en: money sent to someone, especially to someone in another country

examples.text: She receives a regular remittance from her son who works in Dubai.
examples.translation_cn: 她定期收到在迪拜工作的儿子寄来的汇款。

senses.meaning_en: in agreement or consistent

examples.text: The company's actions are congruent with its stated values.
examples.translation_cn: 公司的行动与其宣称的价值观一致。

senses.meaning_en: coinciding exactly when superimposed

examples.text: The two shapes shown in the diagram are congruent to each other.
examples.translation_cn: 图中显示的两个形状彼此全等。

senses.meaning_en: satisfying a congruence relation

examples.text: The numbers 17 and 31 are congruent modulo 7.
examples.translation_cn: 17和31模7同余。

senses.meaning_en: unable to pay debts; having more debts than assets

examples.text: The business may become insolvent if sales continue to fall.
examples.translation_cn: 如果销售继续下滑，这家企业可能会资不抵债。

senses.meaning_en: a circular movement of air or water

examples.text: Dry leaves spun in an eddy near the storm drain.
examples.translation_cn: 干树叶在雨水口附近的漩涡中打转。

senses.meaning_en: to move in a circular way

examples.text: Dust eddied around the empty courtyard in the afternoon wind.
examples.translation_cn: 下午的风中，尘土在空荡荡的院子里打旋。

senses.meaning_en: a book that lists synonyms and related words
senses.pattern: look up a word in a thesaurus

examples.text: I looked up the word in a thesaurus before writing my essay.
examples.translation_cn: 我在写论文前用同义词词典查了这个词。

senses.meaning_en: a collection or storehouse of knowledge or information

examples.text: The archive is a thesaurus of ancient medical knowledge.
examples.translation_cn: 该档案是古代医学知识的宝库。

senses.meaning_en: to make legally invalid

examples.text: The contract was nullified by the court because it was signed under duress.
examples.translation_cn: 该合同因系在胁迫下签署而被法院废止。

senses.meaning_en: to make something have no effect or value; to prevent something from happening

examples.text: The antidote may nullify the effect of the poison within minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 解毒剂可能在几分钟内消除毒药的作用。

senses.meaning_en: unwilling to communicate; reserved

examples.text: He is reticent about his life before the war.
examples.translation_cn: 他不愿多谈战前的生活。

senses.meaning_en: anything light, soft or fuzzy, especially fur, hair, feathers

examples.text: The young birds are covered in pale grey fluff for the first few weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 幼鸟在最初几周里身上覆盖着浅灰色的绒毛。

senses.meaning_en: to shake or brush something so that it becomes fuller and softer

examples.text: She fluffed up the cushions before the guests arrived.
examples.translation_cn: 客人到来之前她把靠垫抖松了。

senses.meaning_en: to fail to do something correctly, especially when speaking or performing

examples.text: The actor fluffed a line and the audience laughed.
examples.translation_cn: 那个演员念错了一句台词，观众笑了。

senses.meaning_en: anything inconsequential or superficial

examples.text: The report is just fluff and lacks concrete proposals.
examples.translation_cn: 这份报告只是空话，缺乏具体建议。

senses.meaning_en: a wrong or illegal act

examples.text: He was dismissed for committing a serious misdeed.
examples.translation_cn: 他因严重行为不端被解雇。

senses.meaning_en: a building with a domed ceiling where shows about stars and planets are projected
senses.pattern: go to a planetarium to do sth

examples.text: Last week we went to a planetarium to watch a show about Saturn.
examples.translation_cn: 上周我们去天文馆观看了一场关于土星的演出。

senses.meaning_en: a type of fungus that grows on damp surfaces

examples.text: The bathroom ceiling is covered in mildew and needs cleaning.
examples.translation_cn: 浴室天花板上长满了霉，需要清洁。

senses.meaning_en: to become covered with mildew

examples.text: The forgotten books started to mildew in a damp room.
examples.translation_cn: 被遗忘的书在潮湿的房间里开始发霉。

senses.meaning_en: to make something become covered with mildew

examples.text: The old tent was mildewed by months of damp weather.
examples.translation_cn: 旧帐篷因数月的潮湿天气而发霉。

senses.meaning_en: the quality that awakens pity or sadness

examples.text: The pathos of the old photograph made her cry.
examples.translation_cn: 那张旧照片的悲怆让她哭了起来。

senses.meaning_en: an appeal to the audience's emotions as a means of persuasion

examples.text: The speech was an appeal to pathos rather than reason.
examples.translation_cn: 这篇演讲是诉诸情感，而非理性。

senses.meaning_en: brief, concise, and to the point

examples.text: The report summarized the findings in terse terms.
examples.translation_cn: 报告用简洁的语言总结了调查结果。

senses.meaning_en: abrupt and curt

examples.text: The coach was terse with reporters after the defeat.
examples.translation_cn: 失败后，教练对记者说话简短生硬。

senses.meaning_en: a small, roughly built hut or cabin

examples.text: Many new arrivals lived in a shanty on the edge of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 许多新来者住在城边的一间棚屋里。

senses.meaning_en: a rhythmic work song sung by sailors

examples.text: The sailors sang a sea shanty as they raised the heavy sail.
examples.translation_cn: 水手们一边升起沉重的帆一边唱着船工号子。

senses.meaning_en: a small inflamed spot on the skin, often filled with pus

examples.text: He has a painful pimple on the tip of his nose.
examples.translation_cn: 他鼻尖上有一颗疼痛的粉刺。

senses.meaning_en: the ratio of reflected light to the light falling on a surface

examples.text: The reflectance of snow is about 90 percent.
examples.translation_cn: 雪的反射率约为90%。

senses.meaning_en: a small detail or distinction

examples.text: The lawyer explained the legal niceties of the contract to us.
examples.translation_cn: 律师向我们解释了合同的细节。

senses.meaning_en: a polite conventional act or remark

examples.text: She exchanged niceties with her colleagues at lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 午餐时她和同事们寒暄了几句。

senses.meaning_en: subtlety or precision of use; exactness

examples.text: She timed the entire speech to a nicety.
examples.translation_cn: 她把整个演讲的时间计算得非常精确。

senses.meaning_en: able to be perceived or sensed

examples.text: A faint change in her tone was perceptible to everyone at the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 她语气中细微的变化在会上的每个人都察觉到了。

senses.meaning_en: to travel by getting free rides in other people's vehicles

examples.text: They decided to hitchhike to the coast for the weekend.
examples.translation_cn: 他们决定周末搭便车去海边。

senses.meaning_en: very careful about details and difficult to please

examples.text: She is fastidious about grammar and rejects any essay with a single error.
examples.translation_cn: 她对语法非常挑剔，任何有一处错误的文章都不接受。

senses.meaning_en: overly concerned about tidiness and cleanliness

examples.text: He is fastidious about personal hygiene and showers twice a day.
examples.translation_cn: 他过分讲究个人卫生，每天洗两次澡。

senses.meaning_en: a very steep cliff
senses.pattern: on the edge of a precipice

examples.text: They stood on the edge of a precipice, looking down at the valley below.
examples.translation_cn: 他们站在悬崖边缘，俯瞰下面的山谷。

senses.meaning_en: the brink of a dangerous situation

examples.text: The country found itself on the precipice of economic collapse.
examples.translation_cn: 该国发现自己处于经济崩溃的危险边缘。

senses.meaning_en: to bring peace to a place or situation by ending violence or disorder

examples.text: The government sent extra police to pacify the riot-torn district.
examples.translation_cn: 政府增派警力去平息那个暴乱地区。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone calm or less angry

examples.text: The teacher spoke softly to pacify the upset student.
examples.translation_cn: 老师轻声安抚那名心烦意乱的学生。

senses.meaning_en: to learn something so that you remember it exactly

examples.text: She memorised the poem for her English class.
examples.translation_cn: 她为了英语课背熟了那首诗。

senses.meaning_en: sounding sorrowful or mournful

examples.text: The old woman asked for help in a plaintive voice.
examples.translation_cn: 老妇人用哀怨的声音请求帮助。

senses.meaning_en: tiny plants and animals that drift in water

examples.text: These waters are rich in plankton, supporting large schools of fish.
examples.translation_cn: 这些水域富含浮游生物，养育了大群鱼类。

senses.meaning_en: a building where goods are stored

examples.text: The old stone storehouse for grain still stands by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 那座古老的石头粮仓仍矗立在河边。

senses.meaning_en: a place or thing that has a large supply of something

examples.text: The archives are a storehouse of information on local history.
examples.translation_cn: 档案馆是当地历史信息的宝库。

senses.meaning_en: to break or violate a law, rule, etc.

examples.text: He transgressed the law by selling alcohol without a licence.
examples.translation_cn: 他无证售酒，违反了法律。

senses.meaning_en: to behave in a morally wrong way or go beyond accepted limits

examples.text: Many people transgress against social norms without realizing it.
examples.translation_cn: 许多人在没有意识到的情况下违背了社会规范。

senses.meaning_en: to go beyond or overstep a limit or boundary

examples.text: The novel transgresses the boundaries of traditional fiction.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说逾越了传统小说的界限。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to keep financial records for a business

examples.text: She works as a bookkeeper for a small law firm.
examples.translation_cn: 她在一家小型律师事务所做记账员。

senses.meaning_en: nothing

examples.text: All her hard work was for naught in the end.
examples.translation_cn: 她所有的辛勤工作最终都白费了。

senses.meaning_en: zero; the number 0

examples.text: The sports car goes from naught to sixty in four seconds.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆跑车从零加速到六十英里每小时只需四秒。

senses.meaning_en: solid waste matter excreted from the bowels; feces

examples.text: They must dispose of human excrement properly to prevent disease.
examples.translation_cn: 他们必须妥善处理人类粪便以预防疾病。

senses.meaning_en: lacking variety or excitement; dull; boring

examples.text: He was tired of his humdrum office job.
examples.translation_cn: 他厌倦了单调乏味的办公室工作。

senses.meaning_en: the quality of lacking variety or excitement; monotony

examples.text: She longed to escape the humdrum of city life.
examples.translation_cn: 她渴望逃离城市生活的单调乏味。

senses.meaning_en: the dead body of an animal, especially one prepared for meat

examples.text: The carcase of a pig was hung in the cold store.
examples.translation_cn: 猪的胴体挂在冷库中。

senses.meaning_en: the remains or framework of something, such as a building or vehicle

examples.text: The carcase of the old truck was left in the field.
examples.translation_cn: 那辆旧卡车的残骸被留在了田野里。

senses.meaning_en: consisting of small grains or particles

examples.text: The soil here is granular in texture and drains quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 这里的土壤呈颗粒状，排水很快。

senses.meaning_en: detailed or fine-grained

examples.text: The software lets you set permissions at a granular level.
examples.translation_cn: 该软件允许你在细粒度级别设置权限。

senses.meaning_en: not graceful; awkward or clumsy

examples.text: The young deer moved in an ungainly way across the ice.
examples.translation_cn: 那只小鹿在冰面上行走时姿态笨拙。

senses.meaning_en: difficult to move or manage; unwieldy

examples.text: The old sofa was ungainly and difficult to carry through the narrow doorway.
examples.translation_cn: 那张旧沙发笨重难搬，很难通过窄门。

senses.meaning_en: a small pincer-like tool used for picking up or pulling out small objects

examples.text: She used a pair of tweezers to remove the tiny splinter from my finger.
examples.translation_cn: 她用一把镊子从我手指里取出了细小的刺。

senses.meaning_en: to send someone back to their own country

examples.text: The refugees were repatriated to their homeland after the war.
examples.translation_cn: 战后，这些难民被遣返回了祖国。

senses.meaning_en: to send money or profits back to one's own country

examples.text: The company repatriated its overseas profits to Japan last year.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司去年将其海外利润汇回了日本。

senses.meaning_en: to return something such as a work of art to its country of origin

examples.text: The museum repatriated the ancient statues to Greece.
examples.translation_cn: 该博物馆将古代雕像归还给了希腊。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has returned to their own country

examples.text: As a repatriate from Canada, she had to rebuild her life in Seoul.
examples.translation_cn: 作为从加拿大回国的归国者，她在首尔重新开始生活。

senses.meaning_en: casual clothing worn for sport or exercise

examples.text: All players must be in sportswear for the training session.
examples.translation_cn: 所有队员必须穿运动服参加训练课。

senses.meaning_en: the branch of biology that deals with microorganisms

examples.text: Researchers who study microbiology often work in clinical laboratories.
examples.translation_cn: 研究微生物学的研究人员通常在临床实验室工作。

senses.meaning_en: lacking flavor; tasteless

examples.text: The soup tasted insipid, so I added salt and herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 这汤尝起来淡而无味，所以我加了盐和香草。

senses.meaning_en: lacking interest, excitement, or liveliness; dull

examples.text: Many readers found the novel insipid and gave up halfway.
examples.translation_cn: 许多读者觉得这部小说乏味，读到一半就放弃了。

senses.meaning_en: generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone who has wronged you

examples.text: He was magnanimous toward the reporters who criticized him.
examples.translation_cn: 他对批评他的记者们很宽宏大量。

senses.meaning_en: a waterproof coat worn to keep off the rain

examples.text: She waited at the bus stop in a hooded mackintosh.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着带兜帽的雨衣在公交站等车。

senses.meaning_en: apparent or stated, but perhaps not true

examples.text: The ostensible reason for the delay was bad weather, but many suspected a deeper problem.
examples.translation_cn: 延误的表面理由是天气恶劣，但许多人怀疑另有更深层的问题。

senses.meaning_en: a large brown seaweed

examples.text: The shore was covered in kelp after the storm.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨过后，海岸上覆盖着海带。

senses.meaning_en: an extra payment given for service

examples.text: We left a gratuity for the waiter after the meal.
examples.translation_cn: 用餐后我们给服务员留了小费。

senses.meaning_en: the condition of being bald

examples.text: He has suffered from baldness since his early twenties.
examples.translation_cn: 他从二十几岁起就开始秃头了。

senses.meaning_en: the scientific study of animals

examples.text: She is taking an introductory course in zoology.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在修一门动物学入门课程。

senses.meaning_en: showing great respect or reverence

examples.text: He spoke about his mentor in a reverent tone.
examples.translation_cn: 他用恭敬的语气谈论他的导师。

senses.meaning_en: longer than wide; not square or circular

examples.text: The oak table is oblong, measuring six feet by four.
examples.translation_cn: 那张橡木桌子是长方形的，长六英尺宽四英尺。

senses.meaning_en: an object or shape that is oblong

examples.text: Cut the chilled dough into small oblongs, then bake for 20 minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 将冷藏面团切成小长方形块，然后烘烤20分钟。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being confused or puzzled

examples.text: She stared in perplexity at the instruction manual, unable to find the start button.
examples.translation_cn: 她困惑地盯着说明书，找不到启动按钮。

senses.meaning_en: something that is difficult to understand

examples.text: The novel explores the perplexities of modern life.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说探讨了现代生活中令人费解的种种问题。

senses.meaning_en: an infectious disease that damages nerves and skin

examples.text: She was diagnosed with leprosy after returning from abroad.
examples.translation_cn: 她从国外回来后被诊断出患有麻风病。

senses.meaning_en: like a meteor in speed; brilliant but brief

examples.text: She had a meteoric rise to fame that surprised everyone.
examples.translation_cn: 她迅速成名，让所有人惊讶。

senses.meaning_en: relating to meteors

examples.text: Some rare metals on Earth are meteoric in origin.
examples.translation_cn: 地球上一些稀有金属是陨石来源的。

senses.meaning_en: made stronger or containing reinforcement

examples.text: The walls, reinforced with steel bars, resisted the earthquake.
examples.translation_cn: 用钢筋加固的墙抵御了地震。

senses.meaning_en: a roll of film containing very small photographs of documents

examples.text: The city's newspaper archives are stored on microfilm.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市的报纸档案以缩微胶卷保存。

senses.meaning_en: to photograph documents on microfilm

examples.text: The hospital microfilmed all the old patient records before destroying them.
examples.translation_cn: 医院在销毁前将所有旧病历缩微拍摄下来。

senses.meaning_en: a group of letters and numbers added to an address to help sort and deliver mail

examples.text: Please enter the postcode for your home address.
examples.translation_cn: 请输入你家庭住址的邮政编码。

senses.meaning_en: a student who stays away from school without permission

examples.text: The teacher caught a truant from school behind the gym.
examples.translation_cn: 老师在学校体育馆后面抓住了一个逃学的学生。

senses.meaning_en: absent from school without permission

examples.text: The boy was truant from school and spent the whole day in the park.
examples.translation_cn: 那个男孩逃学了，在公园里待了一整天。

senses.meaning_en: an idle or lazy person; an idler

examples.text: He was a truant from duty, often leaving the office early.
examples.translation_cn: 他逃避职责，经常提前离开办公室。

senses.meaning_en: to add to; to supplement
senses.collocation: eke out an essay with quotes

examples.text: She eked out her essay with quotes from famous authors.
examples.translation_cn: 她用名作家的引文补充她的文章。

senses.meaning_en: to manage to live with very little

examples.text: They eked out a living by selling vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 他们靠卖菜勉强维持生计。

senses.meaning_en: to make something last longer by using it carefully

examples.text: We eked out the little food over the whole week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们节约使用那点食物，撑过了整整一周。

senses.meaning_en: a rented room used for both living and sleeping in

examples.text: He lives in a bedsit near the university.
examples.translation_cn: 他住在大学附近的一间单间公寓里。

senses.meaning_en: to misunderstand; to form a wrong idea of

examples.text: She completely misconceived the nature of their relationship.
examples.translation_cn: 她完全误解了他们关系的性质。

senses.meaning_en: to judge or plan badly, typically because of a misunderstanding

examples.text: The plan was misconceived from the start and wasted public money.
examples.translation_cn: 该计划从一开始就设想不当，浪费了公共资金。

senses.meaning_en: the state of being married; marriage

examples.text: They lived together in matrimony for nearly half a century.
examples.translation_cn: 他们以婚姻关系共同生活了近半个世纪。

senses.meaning_en: the ceremony of marriage

examples.text: The couple were joined in holy matrimony in a village church.
examples.translation_cn: 这对夫妇在乡村教堂结为夫妻。

senses.meaning_en: to walk with slow, awkward steps, almost dragging your feet

examples.text: He shambled along the corridor as if he had just woken up.
examples.translation_cn: 他沿着走廊蹒跚而行，好像刚睡醒。

senses.meaning_en: capable of being navigated by ships or boats

examples.text: This stretch of the river is navigable by large cargo ships.
examples.translation_cn: 这段河流可供大型货船通航。

senses.meaning_en: to surround or cover, especially with mist or smoke

examples.text: The old castle was wreathed in thick morning mist.
examples.translation_cn: 那座古堡笼罩在清晨的浓雾中。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone's face show a large smile

examples.text: Her face was wreathed in smiles at the good news.
examples.translation_cn: 听到这个好消息，她满脸笑容。

senses.meaning_en: to decorate with a wreath of flowers or leaves

examples.text: They wreathed the statue with laurel leaves for the ceremony.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用月桂叶装饰雕像，以举行仪式。

senses.meaning_en: to twist or entwine around something

examples.text: She wreathed her arms around his neck in a warm embrace.
examples.translation_cn: 她双臂缠绕着他的脖子，热情地拥抱。

senses.meaning_en: young people who are not yet adults

examples.text: The playground is designed for children under five.
examples.translation_cn: 这个游乐场是为五岁以下儿童设计的。

senses.meaning_en: a person's descendants
senses.pattern: pass sth down to one's children

examples.text: They passed the family business down to their children.
examples.translation_cn: 他们把家族企业传给了子女。

senses.meaning_en: a black sticky substance obtained from petroleum, used for road surfaces and roofing

examples.text: Workers spread a layer of hot bitumen on the road before adding gravel.
examples.translation_cn: 工人们把一层热沥青铺在路面上，然后撒上碎石。

senses.meaning_en: a storage facility for grain or sometimes animal feed

examples.text: Farmers store grain in the granary after the harvest.
examples.translation_cn: 农民们在收割后把粮食存放在谷仓里。

senses.meaning_en: a fertile, grain-growing region

examples.text: The valley is the granary of the entire nation.
examples.translation_cn: 这个河谷是全国的产粮区。

senses.meaning_en: a type of brown bread containing whole grains of wheat

examples.text: I'd like a slice of granary with my soup.
examples.translation_cn: 我想要一片谷粒面包配汤。

senses.meaning_en: to illegally touch the ball with the hand or arm

examples.text: He deliberately handballed the ball on the goal line and was sent off.
examples.translation_cn: 他在球门线上故意手球犯规，被罚下场。

senses.meaning_en: an act of illegally touching the ball with the hand or arm

examples.text: The referee missed a clear handball in the penalty area.
examples.translation_cn: 裁判漏判了禁区内一次明显的手球犯规。

senses.meaning_en: a game in which two teams of players throw and catch a ball and try to score goals

examples.text: We play handball in the gym every Tuesday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们每周二在体育馆打手球。

senses.meaning_en: a ball used in the game of handball

examples.text: He bounced a handball on the court before the game.
examples.translation_cn: 赛前他在球场上拍手球。

senses.meaning_en: the state of feeling sleepy and lethargic

examples.text: Drowsiness after a heavy meal often makes drivers less alert.
examples.translation_cn: 饭后困倦常常使司机警觉性降低。

senses.meaning_en: relating to birth or the time of birth

examples.text: She was born in her natal home, as were her siblings.
examples.translation_cn: 她出生在她的出生地，她的兄弟姐妹也一样。

senses.meaning_en: a form of journalism in which stories are told mainly through photographs

examples.text: She built a highly successful career in photojournalism.
examples.translation_cn: 她在新闻摄影领域建立了很成功的事业。

senses.meaning_en: to use someone else's words, ideas, or work as your own

examples.text: She plagiarized several paragraphs from a published article.
examples.translation_cn: 她从一篇发表的文章中抄袭了几段。

senses.meaning_en: the punctuation mark ' used to show possession or omission

examples.text: Use an apostrophe to show possession in the phrase "the boy's bike".
examples.translation_cn: 用撇号表示短语“the boy's bike”中的所属关系。

senses.meaning_en: a public officer who witnesses the signing of important documents

examples.text: A will must be signed before a notary to be legally valid.
examples.translation_cn: 遗嘱必须在公证人面前签署才具有法律效力。

senses.meaning_en: existing; having life or being; current

examples.text: This tradition is still existent in a few mountain areas.
examples.translation_cn: 这一传统在一些山区仍然存在。

senses.meaning_en: to walk with short unsteady steps, as a small child does

examples.text: The little boy toddled across the room to his father.
examples.translation_cn: 小男孩蹒跚着穿过房间走向爸爸。

senses.meaning_en: to walk or go somewhere in a relaxed, unhurried way

examples.text: We toddled around the old town, looking in the shop windows.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在老城区溜达，看商店橱窗。

senses.meaning_en: a short relaxed walk

examples.text: We went for a short toddle along the beach before dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭前我们沿着海滩慢慢走了一小段。

senses.meaning_en: an optical instrument for viewing objects above the level of direct sight

examples.text: The captain looked through the periscope to check for enemy ships.
examples.translation_cn: 船长透过潜望镜观察敌舰。

senses.meaning_en: pieces of furniture for sleeping on; places to sleep, especially in a hotel or hospital

examples.text: The hotel has beds for over 200 guests during the festival.
examples.translation_cn: 这家旅馆在节日期间为200多名客人提供床位。

senses.meaning_en: areas of ground in a garden where plants are grown

examples.text: The gardener planted roses in beds behind the house.
examples.translation_cn: 园丁在房子后面的花坛里种了玫瑰。

senses.meaning_en: the bottom of a river, sea, or other body of water

examples.text: They found ancient bones in the beds of dried-up lakes.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在干涸湖泊的底部发现了古代骨头。

senses.meaning_en: a ceremonial low-level flight by military aircraft

examples.text: The president watched the flyover by navy helicopters.
examples.translation_cn: 总统观看了海军直升机的飞行表演。

senses.meaning_en: a bridge carrying a road or railway over another

examples.text: He used the flyover to cross the busy motorway.
examples.translation_cn: 他利用立交桥穿过繁忙的高速公路。

senses.meaning_en: relating to or resembling mucus

examples.text: A cold can irritate the mucous membranes in your nose.
examples.translation_cn: 感冒会刺激你鼻子里的黏膜。

senses.meaning_en: recorded on film; made into a film

examples.text: We watched a filmed version of the stage play.
examples.translation_cn: 我们观看了这部舞台剧的电影版。

senses.meaning_en: relating to psycholinguistics

examples.text: They analyzed the errors from a psycholinguistic perspective.
examples.translation_cn: 他们从心理语言学的角度分析了这些错误。

senses.meaning_en: extra benefits or advantages, especially from an employer
senses.pattern: one of the perks of sth

examples.text: One of the perks of the job is free health insurance.
examples.translation_cn: 这份工作的额外待遇之一是免费健康保险。

senses.meaning_en: very nervous, upset, or emotionally tense

examples.text: She became overwrought about the money problems at home.
examples.translation_cn: 她为家里的钱的问题变得烦躁不安。

senses.meaning_en: too elaborate or ornate in style

examples.text: The novel is written in an overwrought style, full of unnecessary detail.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说以过于雕琢的风格写成，充满了不必要的细节。

senses.meaning_en: showy display intended to impress

examples.text: The ostentation of the wedding reception made some guests uncomfortable.
examples.translation_cn: 婚宴的铺张炫耀让一些客人感到不舒服。

senses.meaning_en: a small plastic disc on which sound or data is stored

examples.text: Her new album is available on CD and vinyl.
examples.translation_cn: 她的新专辑有CD和黑胶唱片版本。

senses.meaning_en: a certificate issued by a bank to a depositor for a fixed term

examples.text: She invested $5,000 in a five-year CD at the bank.
examples.translation_cn: 她在银行投资了5000美元于五年期定期存款。

senses.meaning_en: to spend time drowsily or half-asleep

examples.text: He drowsed away the long afternoon on the sofa.
examples.translation_cn: 他在沙发上半睡半醒地度过了漫长的下午。

senses.meaning_en: to make someone heavy with drowsiness or dullness

examples.text: The warm lecture drowsed several students in the back row.
examples.translation_cn: 那场暖和的讲座使后排的几个学生昏昏欲睡。

senses.meaning_en: to be dull and inactive as if sleepy

examples.text: She drowsed through the entire meeting without hearing a word.
examples.translation_cn: 她昏昏沉沉地熬过了整场会议，一个字也没听进去。

senses.meaning_en: to be half-asleep; to be drowsy or sleepy

examples.text: The cat was drowsing in the sun by the window.
examples.translation_cn: 猫在窗边晒太阳打瞌睡。

senses.meaning_en: outside normal working hours

examples.text: Doctors often work unsocial hours, including nights and weekends.
examples.translation_cn: 医生经常在非正常工作时间上班，包括夜间和周末。

senses.meaning_en: not sociable; avoiding company

examples.text: He is unsocial by nature and avoids large gatherings.
examples.translation_cn: 他天性不合群，避免参加大型聚会。

senses.meaning_en: a shackle for the wrist or ankle; a restriction

examples.text: The suspect was led into court in manacles.
examples.translation_cn: 嫌疑人戴着手铐被带进法庭。

senses.meaning_en: to confine with manacles

examples.text: The prisoner was manacled to the wall for three days.
examples.translation_cn: 那名囚犯被铐在墙上三天。

senses.meaning_en: the education of male and female students in the same institution

examples.text: Coeducation in schools has been common in many countries for decades.
examples.translation_cn: 几十年来，许多国家的学校实行男女同校教育已经很普遍。

senses.meaning_en: unwilling; reluctant

examples.text: She was loth to criticize her friend's decision in front of the whole team.
examples.translation_cn: 她不愿意当着整个团队的面批评朋友的决定。

senses.meaning_en: a word that means the opposite of another word

examples.text: In everyday English, the word 'big' is an antonym of 'small'.
examples.translation_cn: 在日常英语中，单词 big 是 small 的反义词。

senses.meaning_en: a list of books, especially one published by a publisher or recommended for reading

examples.text: This novel is on the booklist for the literature course.
examples.translation_cn: 这部小说在文学课程的书单上。

senses.meaning_en: to oversee and direct the work of others; to supervise or administer

examples.text: She was hired to superintend the construction of the new bridge.
examples.translation_cn: 她受雇监督新桥的建设。

senses.meaning_en: to transfer blood into a person's body, especially by medical transfusion

examples.text: The doctors transfused two units of blood into the injured driver.
examples.translation_cn: 医生给受伤司机输了两单位血。

senses.meaning_en: to bring new life, energy, or a quality into someone or something

examples.text: The new leader transfused confidence into the whole department.
examples.translation_cn: 新领导给整个部门注入了信心。

senses.meaning_en: an organized trip to visit places of interest

examples.text: The museum offers guided tours of the ancient castle.
examples.translation_cn: 这家博物馆提供古堡导览游。

senses.meaning_en: a series of performances or games in different places

examples.text: The orchestra goes on concert tours across Europe every autumn.
examples.translation_cn: 这个管弦乐队每年秋天在欧洲各地巡回演出。

senses.meaning_en: to travel around a place for pleasure or to perform

examples.text: My aunt tours around Italy every spring to paint.
examples.translation_cn: 我姑姑每年春天去意大利游览作画。

senses.meaning_en: bad luck; an unlucky accident

examples.text: By mischance, the bus broke down on the way to the airport.
examples.translation_cn: 倒霉的是，公交车在去机场的路上抛锚了。

senses.meaning_en: intense study just before an exam

examples.text: He did some last-minute cramming for the final exam.
examples.translation_cn: 他为期末考试临阵磨枪。

senses.meaning_en: relating to mathematics

examples.text: The students solved a very complex mathematic problem.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们解出了一个非常复杂的数学问题。

senses.meaning_en: exact or precise, like mathematics

examples.text: He arranged all the tools with mathematic precision.
examples.translation_cn: 他以数学般的精确排列所有工具。

senses.meaning_en: not suitable or appropriate

examples.text: His joke was inapt for such a formal occasion.
examples.translation_cn: 他的玩笑在这样正式的场合不合时宜。

senses.meaning_en: a person whose job is to keep or check financial accounts

examples.text: Many graduates choose to work as accountants after getting certified.
examples.translation_cn: 许多毕业生获得资格后选择做会计工作。

senses.meaning_en: things that people do, especially for enjoyment or to achieve a purpose

examples.text: They take part in activities that are both fun and educational.
examples.translation_cn: 他们参加既有趣又有教育意义的活动。

senses.meaning_en: a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable position

examples.text: Students enjoy the advantages of studying in small classes.
examples.translation_cn: 学生们享有小班学习的好处。

senses.meaning_en: a position of superiority or dominance

examples.text: Online stores have many advantages over traditional shops.
examples.translation_cn: 网上商店比传统商店有许多优势。

senses.meaning_en: public or political matters; current events

examples.text: His speech focused on China's role in world affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 他的演讲聚焦于中国在世界事务中的角色。

senses.meaning_en: personal or business matters

examples.text: The lawyer helps elderly clients manage their own affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 这位律师帮助老年客户管理他们自己的事务。

senses.meaning_en: a romantic or sexual relationship, usually secret

examples.text: The politician was rumored to have several extramarital affairs.
examples.translation_cn: 这位政治家据传有几段婚外情。

senses.meaning_en: medicines that kill or stop the growth of bacteria and are used to treat infections

examples.text: He is on antibiotics for a chest infection.
examples.translation_cn: 他因胸部感染正在服用抗生素。

senses.meaning_en: a large primate without a tail, such as a chimpanzee or gorilla

examples.text: Apes such as chimpanzees use tools to find food.
examples.translation_cn: 像黑猩猩这样的类人猿会使用工具寻找食物。

senses.meaning_en: to imitate someone, often in a mocking way

examples.text: He often apes his teacher's accent to make us laugh.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常模仿老师的口音逗我们笑。

senses.meaning_en: a way of dealing with something

examples.text: There are several approaches to learning a new language.
examples.translation_cn: 学习一门新语言有几种方法。

senses.meaning_en: to deal with a problem or task in a particular way

examples.text: She always approaches a task with calm confidence.
examples.translation_cn: 她总是冷静自信地处理任务。

senses.meaning_en: to come near to someone or something in distance

examples.text: The train slowly approaches the station every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 火车每天早晨缓缓驶近车站。

senses.meaning_en: a collection of historical documents or records

examples.text: The original manuscript is preserved in the archives.
examples.translation_cn: 原始手稿保存在档案馆里。

senses.meaning_en: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult

examples.text: The team made several attempts to reach the summit before turning back.
examples.translation_cn: 团队在返回前几次尝试登顶。

senses.meaning_en: to make an effort to do something

examples.text: The committee attempts to reach a consensus on the budget by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会试图在周五前就预算达成共识。

senses.meaning_en: a group of musicians who play popular music together

examples.text: She has played guitar in several local bands since college.
examples.translation_cn: 她自从大学以来已经在几个本地乐队里弹吉他。

senses.meaning_en: a thin strip of material used for tying things together

examples.text: She tied the stack of papers with rubber bands.
examples.translation_cn: 她用橡皮筋把一叠纸捆住了。

senses.meaning_en: a long narrow area of colour or pattern

examples.text: The walls were painted in bands of blue and green.
examples.translation_cn: 墙壁被刷成蓝绿相间的色带。

senses.meaning_en: the hard parts of the body that form the skeleton

examples.text: The bones in the human body support the muscles.
examples.translation_cn: 人体中的骨骼支撑着肌肉。

senses.meaning_en: the basic or essential parts of something; the main outline
senses.collocation: the bare bones of a story

examples.text: We outlined the bones of the plan before writing it.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在动笔前先勾勒了计划的基本框架。

senses.meaning_en: a game in which players roll biased balls toward a smaller ball

examples.text: My grandfather plays bowls every Saturday at the local club.
examples.translation_cn: 我祖父每周六在当地俱乐部玩草地滚球。

senses.meaning_en: a biased ball used in the game of bowls

examples.text: He rolled the bowls carefully toward the jack.
examples.translation_cn: 他小心地把滚球滚向目标球。

senses.meaning_en: a small book or magazine with pictures and information about a product or service

examples.text: The travel agency gave us brochures about holiday packages.
examples.translation_cn: 旅行社给了我们关于度假套餐的宣传册。

senses.meaning_en: a male sibling

examples.text: One of my brothers lives in Canada with his family.
examples.translation_cn: 我的一个兄弟和家人住在加拿大。

senses.meaning_en: used as a form of address for a man or boy, often showing friendliness

examples.text: Brothers, let's finish this job together before it gets dark.
examples.translation_cn: 兄弟们，咱们天黑前一起把这活儿干完吧。

senses.meaning_en: a stick of wax with a wick that is burned to give light or for decoration

examples.text: The children blew out the candles on the cake and made a wish.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们吹灭了蛋糕上的蜡烛并许了愿。

senses.meaning_en: a game played with a set of playing cards

examples.text: We often play cards with family after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们经常晚饭后和家人打牌。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of plastic or card used for payment, identification, or membership

examples.text: You can pay with cards at most stores.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在大多数商店刷卡支付。

senses.meaning_en: a small piece of card with a picture and often a message, sent on special occasions

examples.text: She sends cards to all her friends on their birthdays.
examples.translation_cn: 她在朋友们生日时给他们寄贺卡。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that makes something happen

examples.text: Scientists have identified the causes of the disease.
examples.translation_cn: 科学家们已经确定了这种疾病的起因。

senses.meaning_en: to make something happen, especially something bad

examples.text: Lack of sleep causes people to make mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 睡眠不足会导致人们犯错。

senses.meaning_en: an aim, belief, or organization that a group of people support or fight for

examples.text: She has devoted her life to fighting for social causes.
examples.translation_cn: 她一生致力于为社会事业而奋斗。

senses.meaning_en: a large natural hole in rock or in the ground

examples.text: Bats often roost in caves during the day.
examples.translation_cn: 蝙蝠通常白天在洞穴里栖息。

senses.meaning_en: to collapse or give way under pressure

examples.text: The tunnel caves in under pressure from heavy trucks.
examples.translation_cn: 隧道在重型卡车的压力下塌陷。

senses.meaning_en: an optical disc containing data that can be read but not changed

examples.text: The full encyclopedia is available on CD-ROM for offline use.
examples.translation_cn: 完整百科全书以只读光盘形式提供，供离线使用。

senses.meaning_en: an official document that proves a fact, qualification, or achievement

examples.text: She holds certificates in first aid and lifeguarding.
examples.translation_cn: 她持有急救和救生证书。

senses.meaning_en: money paid for a service or goods

examples.text: The bank imposes additional charges for late payment.
examples.translation_cn: 银行对逾期付款收取额外费用。

senses.meaning_en: an official statement accusing someone of a crime

examples.text: The police pressed charges against the driver yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 警方昨天对司机提起了指控。

senses.meaning_en: costing less money than something else

examples.text: This model is cheaper than the previous one.
examples.translation_cn: 这个型号比前一个更便宜。

senses.meaning_en: at a lower price

examples.text: You can buy the same phone cheaper online.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在网上以更低价格买到同款手机。

senses.meaning_en: a person in the same class at school or college

examples.text: She often discusses homework with her classmates after school.
examples.translation_cn: 她放学后经常和同班同学讨论作业。

senses.meaning_en: a photograph or film image taken at close range, showing the subject large in the frame

examples.text: The director asked for a close-up of the actor's hands.
examples.translation_cn: 导演要求拍一个演员手部的特写镜头。

senses.meaning_en: the act of working together for a common purpose

examples.text: The project was completed in co-operation with local schools.
examples.translation_cn: 该项目与当地学校合作完成。

senses.meaning_en: willingness to be helpful and do as you are asked

examples.text: The police asked for the public's co-operation during the search.
examples.translation_cn: 警方在搜查期间请求公众配合。

senses.meaning_en: involving shared effort or working together towards a common goal

examples.text: The construction of the bridge was a co-operative effort between the two cities.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥的建设是两个城市之间的合作成果。

senses.meaning_en: an institution of higher education that awards degrees

examples.text: She was accepted by one of the top colleges in the country.
examples.translation_cn: 她被该国一所顶尖大学录取。

senses.meaning_en: a professional organization that sets standards

examples.text: The professional colleges issue guidelines for ethical practice.
examples.translation_cn: 专业学会发布道德实践指南。

senses.meaning_en: a television or radio advertisement

examples.text: The TV commercials for the new phone ran during the football game.
examples.translation_cn: 新手机的电视广告在足球赛期间播出。

senses.meaning_en: something you give up to end a disagreement

examples.text: The company made concessions to the union after long talks.
examples.translation_cn: 经过长时间谈判，公司向工会作出了让步。

senses.meaning_en: a special right or advantage given by a government or business

examples.text: The government granted concessions to foreign oil companies.
examples.translation_cn: 政府给予外国石油公司特许权。

senses.meaning_en: an act of admitting something is true

examples.text: The politician made several concessions about his past mistakes.
examples.translation_cn: 那位政治家多次承认自己过去的错误。

senses.meaning_en: a stand selling food and drinks

examples.text: We bought popcorn at the concessions stand before the movie.
examples.translation_cn: 看电影前我们在小吃摊位买了爆米花。

senses.meaning_en: the circumstances in which people live or work

examples.text: Many workers live in poor conditions and earn very little.
examples.translation_cn: 许多工人生活条件差，收入微薄。

senses.meaning_en: something that must be true or happen before something else is possible, especially in an agreement

examples.text: The contract sets out the conditions under which you can use the software.
examples.translation_cn: 合同规定了你可以使用该软件的条件。

senses.meaning_en: the state of something, especially weather or roads

examples.text: Drivers are advised to slow down in icy conditions.
examples.translation_cn: 建议司机在结冰路况下减速。

senses.meaning_en: substances that make something impure or harmful

examples.text: The new treatment system removes contaminants in the water supply.
examples.translation_cn: 新的处理系统能去除供水中的污染物。

senses.meaning_en: that which is contained

examples.text: She poured the contents of the bottle into a glass.
examples.translation_cn: 她把瓶里的东西倒进杯子里。

senses.meaning_en: a list of the chapters or parts in a book or document

examples.text: You can find the chapter titles in the contents.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在目录中找到章节标题。

senses.meaning_en: a formal agreement between two or more parties

examples.text: The company signed contracts with three new suppliers last week.
examples.translation_cn: 该公司上周与三家新供应商签订了合同。

senses.meaning_en: to become smaller or shorter

examples.text: The metal contracts by about 1% as it cools.
examples.translation_cn: 这种金属冷却时收缩约1%。

senses.meaning_en: to become ill with a disease

examples.text: A person often contracts a disease from contaminated food.
examples.translation_cn: 人们经常从受污染的食物中感染疾病。

senses.meaning_en: money paid as compensation for loss or injury

examples.text: The court awarded damages to the injured worker.
examples.translation_cn: 法院判给受伤工人损害赔偿金。

senses.meaning_en: problems or things that are hard to deal with; a series of frustrations

examples.text: She has serious difficulties with reading and writing.
examples.translation_cn: 她在读写方面有严重困难。

senses.meaning_en: to cause a building to fall into ruin or disrepair

examples.text: The old building was dilapidated by years of neglect.
examples.translation_cn: 这座老建筑因多年疏于维护而破败不堪。

senses.meaning_en: an official document certifying completion of a course of study

examples.text: The college awards diplomas in nursing each spring.
examples.translation_cn: 这所学院每年春季颁发护理文凭。

senses.meaning_en: the activity or chore of washing dirty dishes

examples.text: We take turns doing the dishes after dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭后我们轮流洗碗。

senses.meaning_en: plates, bowls, cups, etc. used for eating or serving food

examples.text: Please help me put away the dishes in the cupboard.
examples.translation_cn: 请帮我把碗碟放进橱柜。

senses.meaning_en: food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal

examples.text: They ordered dishes that included both fish and vegetables.
examples.translation_cn: 他们点了包括鱼和蔬菜的菜肴。

senses.meaning_en: an argument or disagreement

examples.text: Border disputes over fishing rights have increased recently.
examples.translation_cn: 最近关于捕鱼权的边界争端有所增加。

senses.meaning_en: to argue or disagree

examples.text: He often disputes with his brother over small matters.
examples.translation_cn: 他经常为小事与兄弟争论。

senses.meaning_en: to say that something is not true

examples.text: She disputes that the accident was her fault.
examples.translation_cn: 她否认事故是她的错。

senses.meaning_en: to fight for control of something

examples.text: The two countries dispute ownership of the island.
examples.translation_cn: 两国争夺该岛的主权。

senses.meaning_en: alcohol; alcoholic beverages

examples.text: We had drinks with some old friends at a wine bar last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨晚我们和一些老朋友在葡萄酒吧喝了一杯。

senses.meaning_en: the act of delivering or leaving something or someone

examples.text: The courier made a drop-off at the front desk.
examples.translation_cn: 快递员在前台完成了交付。

senses.meaning_en: a place where passengers can be left or where vehicles stop for that purpose

examples.text: Taxis may stop at the drop-off outside the entrance.
examples.translation_cn: 出租车可以在入口外的下客区停车。

senses.meaning_en: a decrease, especially a sudden one

examples.text: There was a sharp drop-off in sales last quarter.
examples.translation_cn: 上个季度销售额急剧下降。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden downward slope or cliff

examples.text: The path ends at a steep drop-off above the river.
examples.translation_cn: 小路在河边的陡坡处到了尽头。

senses.meaning_en: a person who leaves school or college before finishing their studies

examples.text: He became a school drop-out at sixteen and never returned to class.
examples.translation_cn: 他十六岁辍学，再也没有回到课堂。

senses.meaning_en: a person who rejects conventional society and its values

examples.text: He chose to live as a drop-out from society, rejecting a steady job.
examples.translation_cn: 他选择做一个脱离社会的人，拒绝稳定的工作。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used as a medicine or in making medicines

examples.text: Some infections are commonly treated with antiviral drugs.
examples.translation_cn: 有些感染通常用抗病毒药物治疗。

senses.meaning_en: results or consequences

examples.text: The long working hours began to have serious effects on her health.
examples.translation_cn: 长时间工作开始对她的健康产生严重影响。

senses.meaning_en: personal belongings or possessions

examples.text: He packed his personal effects into a small suitcase.
examples.translation_cn: 他把个人财物装进了一个小手提箱。

senses.meaning_en: visual or sound effects in film, theatre, etc.

examples.text: The director used special effects to bring the monsters to life.
examples.translation_cn: 导演使用特效让怪物活灵活现。

senses.meaning_en: bad weather, especially wind or rain, seen as a destructive force

examples.text: The old cottage was exposed to the elements for years.
examples.translation_cn: 那座旧小屋多年来一直受风吹雨打。

senses.meaning_en: the basic parts of a subject

examples.text: This course covers the elements of financial accounting.
examples.translation_cn: 这门课程涵盖财务会计的基本原理。

senses.meaning_en: a substance that consists of atoms of only one type

examples.text: Carbon is one of the elements found in all living things.
examples.translation_cn: 碳是所有生物体中都能找到的元素之一。

senses.meaning_en: a system for sending messages by computer

examples.text: You can contact me by email at any time.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以随时通过电子邮件联系我。

senses.meaning_en: the quantity of messages sent by email

examples.text: I receive a lot of email every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我每天早上都会收到大量电子邮件。

senses.meaning_en: a message sent by email

examples.text: Please send an email to confirm your booking.
examples.translation_cn: 请发一封电子邮件确认你的预订。

senses.meaning_en: to send something to someone by email

examples.text: I will email you the details this afternoon.
examples.translation_cn: 我今天下午会把详情用电子邮件发给你。

senses.meaning_en: a sudden serious situation that requires immediate action

examples.text: Firefighters are trained to respond to emergencies quickly.
examples.translation_cn: 消防员接受过快速应对紧急情况的训练。

senses.meaning_en: the physical and mental effort you put into an activity

examples.text: She devoted all her energies to finishing the project on time.
examples.translation_cn: 她把全部精力投入到按时完成项目上。

senses.meaning_en: different forms of power, such as electricity, heat, or light, that can be used

examples.text: Many countries are turning to renewable energies such as solar and wind.
examples.translation_cn: 许多国家正转向太阳能和风能等可再生能源。

senses.meaning_en: money that you spend, especially on business or personal needs

examples.text: The grant can cover living expenses for graduate students.
examples.translation_cn: 助学金可以为研究生支付生活费。

senses.meaning_en: a scientific test done to discover or prove something

examples.text: The researchers conducted experiments on mice to test the vaccine.
examples.translation_cn: 研究人员用小鼠进行实验来测试疫苗。

senses.meaning_en: an attempt to try a new method, activity, or idea

examples.text: The city's car-free days were experiments in reducing traffic.
examples.translation_cn: 这个城市的无车日是对减少交通的一种尝试。

senses.meaning_en: buildings, equipment, or services provided for a particular purpose; a place where a particular activity happens

examples.text: The university provides excellent facilities for scientific research.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学提供出色的科研设施。

senses.meaning_en: a toilet or lavatory

examples.text: We stopped at a petrol station to use the facilities.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在加油站停下来上了趟洗手间。

senses.meaning_en: a building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled

examples.text: Thousands of workers assemble electronic parts in factories on the outskirts of the city.
examples.translation_cn: 成千上万的工人在城郊的工厂里组装电子零件。

senses.meaning_en: the plural of foot, the body part at the end of the leg

examples.text: The dancers stamped their feet in time to the music.
examples.translation_cn: 舞者们随着音乐节拍跺脚。

senses.meaning_en: a unit of length equal to 12 inches or 0.3048 metres

examples.text: The room measures twelve feet by ten feet.
examples.translation_cn: 这个房间长十二英尺，宽十英尺。

senses.meaning_en: a boat or ship for taking passengers and vehicles across an area of water
senses.pattern: ferries run between A and B

examples.text: Ferries run between the island and the mainland every hour.
examples.translation_cn: 渡轮每小时往返于该岛和大陆之间。

senses.meaning_en: one of the four long thin parts of the hand

examples.text: She balanced the coin on her fingers.
examples.translation_cn: 她把硬币平衡在手指上。

senses.meaning_en: to identify someone as a criminal or suspect

examples.text: The witness fingers the suspect as the burglar.
examples.translation_cn: 目击者指认嫌疑人为窃贼。

senses.meaning_en: relating to emergency medical treatment given before professional help arrives

examples.text: Every workplace should keep a well-stocked first-aid kit.
examples.translation_cn: 每个工作场所都应备有充足的急救箱。

senses.meaning_en: the act or state of flourishing; prosperity

examples.text: The flourishment of the arts in Florence attracted scholars from across Europe.
examples.translation_cn: 佛罗伦萨艺术的繁荣吸引了来自欧洲各地的学者。

senses.meaning_en: the preserved remains or impression of a prehistoric organism

examples.text: They found fossils in the rocks by the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们在河边的岩石中发现了化石。

senses.meaning_en: a person or thing that is old-fashioned or unable to adapt

examples.text: The young staff see the older employees as old fossils.
examples.translation_cn: 年轻员工把老员工看作老顽固。

senses.meaning_en: involving or working a full amount of time

examples.text: She works full-time as a nurse at the city hospital.
examples.translation_cn: 她在市医院全职做护士。

senses.meaning_en: to collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or organization

examples.text: We need to fund-raise for the school trip next month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下个月需要为学校旅行筹款。

senses.meaning_en: something that you want to achieve or accomplish

examples.text: She set clear goals for her team at the start of the season.
examples.translation_cn: 她在赛季初为团队设定了明确的目标。

senses.meaning_en: the area in sports where you try to send the ball, or the score made by sending the ball into it

examples.text: The team has scored ten goals in their last three games.
examples.translation_cn: 这支球队在最近三场比赛中打进了十个球。

senses.meaning_en: a person who has completed a degree at a university or college

examples.text: Graduates of this university are highly sought after by employers.
examples.translation_cn: 这所大学的毕业生深受雇主青睐。

senses.meaning_en: difficult or tiring work

examples.text: Digging ditches is hard-work, but it pays well.
examples.translation_cn: 挖沟是苦活，但报酬不错。

senses.meaning_en: effort or diligence

examples.text: She achieved great success through hard-work and determination.
examples.translation_cn: 她通过努力和决心取得了巨大成功。

senses.meaning_en: a covering for the head, typically with a brim and a crown

examples.text: People often wear hats to protect themselves from the sun.
examples.translation_cn: 人们经常戴帽子来防晒。

senses.meaning_en: a role or function, especially when one person has several

examples.text: As a small business owner, she wears many hats every day.
examples.translation_cn: 作为小企业主，她每天都身兼多职。

senses.meaning_en: an adult female chicken

examples.text: Many families keep hens in their back garden.
examples.translation_cn: 许多家庭在后院养母鸡。

senses.meaning_en: a tall building with many storeys

examples.text: They live in a high-rise overlooking the river.
examples.translation_cn: 他们住在一栋俯瞰河流的高楼里。

senses.meaning_en: designed to sit high on or above the hips

examples.text: She looked stylish in high-rise jeans and a crop top.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着高腰牛仔裤和短上衣看起来很时尚。

senses.meaning_en: a group of people who live together, especially a family

examples.text: Many households with children rely on public transport.
examples.translation_cn: 许多有孩子的家庭依赖公共交通。

senses.meaning_en: suggestions or thoughts about possible actions

examples.text: She came up with several creative ideas for the school fair.
examples.translation_cn: 她为学校集市想出了几个有创意的主意。

senses.meaning_en: opinions or beliefs

examples.text: The committee members have different ideas about the best approach.
examples.translation_cn: 委员会成员对最佳方法有不同的意见。
