examples.text: You can still edit documents in offline mode.
examples.translation_cn: 你仍然可以在离线模式下编辑文档。

senses.meaning_en: used to describe the age of a person or thing

examples.text: How old is your child?
examples.translation_cn: 你的孩子多大了？

senses.meaning_en: temporarily delayed or not being dealt with

examples.text: The project is on hold until Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 项目暂缓到周一再处理。

senses.meaning_en: done or located at a particular place, especially a workplace, rather than remotely

examples.text: The role requires on-site work four days a week.
examples.translation_cn: 这个职位要求每周四天在现场工作。

senses.meaning_cn: 入职流程；新员工适应期
senses.meaning_en: the process of integrating a new employee into an organization

examples.text: The onboarding process takes about two weeks.
examples.translation_cn: 入职流程大约需要两周。

senses.meaning_en: used to connect alternatives or choices

examples.text: Would you like tea or water?
examples.translation_cn: 你想喝茶还是水？

senses.meaning_en: a data point that differs significantly from other observations

examples.text: That January figure is an outlier.
examples.translation_cn: 一月份的那个数据是一个异常值。

senses.meaning_en: a short structured description of the main points

examples.text: She sent a rough outline of the report before writing the full version.
examples.translation_cn: 她在写完整版本之前先发了一份报告的大纲。

senses.meaning_en: on or to the outer side of

examples.text: The ball is outside the box.
examples.translation_cn: 球在盒子外面。

senses.meaning_en: in or to a place that is there, at a distance

examples.text: The cat is over there.
examples.translation_cn: 猫在那边。

senses.meaning_en: to become too hot

examples.text: Avoid overheating the device by not covering it while charging.
examples.translation_cn: 充电时不要盖住设备，以免过热。

senses.meaning_en: to replace old information with new information

examples.text: I can overwrite the old phone number now.
examples.translation_cn: 我现在可以覆盖旧的电话号码。

senses.meaning_en: belonging to oneself; done without help

examples.text: I can handle the longer commute on my own.
examples.translation_cn: 我可以独自应对更长的通勤。

examples.text: I did it on my own.
examples.translation_cn: 我独立完成了这件事。

senses.meaning_en: to admit that you have done something wrong or are responsible for something

examples.text: He owned up to breaking the window.
examples.translation_cn: 他承认打破了窗户。

senses.meaning_cn: 评审小组成员；专题讨论小组成员
senses.meaning_en: a member of a panel, especially a group of people who answer questions or give opinions in a discussion or contest

examples.text: One panelist is out sick this week.
examples.translation_cn: 一位评审小组成员本周因病缺席。

senses.meaning_en: the secret word or phrase needed to connect to a Wi-Fi network

examples.text: The wifi password is garden108.
examples.translation_cn: 无线网络密码是garden108。

senses.meaning_en: an Italian food made from flour, eggs, and water, typically served with a sauce

examples.text: We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们晚餐吃了番茄酱意大利面。

senses.meaning_en: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly and lives in cold regions

examples.text: The penguins waddled across the ice.
examples.translation_cn: 企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过冰面。

senses.meaning_en: an official document with a photograph that proves who you are

examples.text: You must show a valid photo ID to collect the parcel.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须出示有效的带照片身份证件才能领取包裹。

senses.meaning_en: to go somewhere to collect something that has been left or is ready

examples.text: You can pick up your bag before seven p.m.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在晚上七点前取回你的包。

senses.meaning_en: to start doing something again after a pause

examples.text: She picked up running again after a long break.
examples.translation_cn: 她休息了很长一段时间后重新开始跑步。

senses.meaning_en: the act of collecting a child from school

examples.text: Pick-up is at 3:15.
examples.translation_cn: 接孩子的时间是3点15分。

senses.meaning_en: a part of something that has been separated or broken into smaller parts

examples.text: The last piece of the puzzle was missing.
examples.translation_cn: 拼图的最后一块不见了。

senses.meaning_en: a small object used in board games, representing a player's position

examples.text: Move your piece to the next square.
examples.translation_cn: 把你的棋子移到下一个格子。

senses.meaning_en: to take part in a game or activity for enjoyment

examples.text: We can play together.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以一起玩。

senses.meaning_cn: 游戏约会；同伴玩耍安排
senses.meaning_en: an arrangement for children to play together

examples.text: We can plan a playdate for another day.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以改天安排一次游戏约会。

senses.meaning_en: able to be done or achieved
senses.pattern: it is possible to do sth

examples.text: Would it be possible to move the meeting to Thursday?
examples.translation_cn: 是否可能把会议改到周四？

senses.meaning_en: a series of letters and numbers used in a postal address to identify a location

examples.text: What is your postal code?
examples.translation_cn: 你的邮政编码是多少？

senses.meaning_en: a meal where each guest brings a dish to share

examples.text: We're having a potluck on Saturday, so please bring a dish to share.
examples.translation_cn: 我们周六要办百乐餐，请带一道菜来分享。

senses.meaning_en: to register or sign up for something before the usual time

examples.text: You must pre-register for the class before Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 你必须在周五之前提前预约这门课。

senses.meaning_en: short for preparation area; a place where food is prepared

examples.text: The kitchen has a shared prep area.
examples.translation_cn: 厨房有一个共用的备料区。

senses.meaning_en: paid for in advance

examples.text: This is a prepaid plan with no contract.
examples.translation_cn: 这是一个无合约的预付费套餐。

senses.meaning_en: to treat something as more important than other things

examples.text: I would prioritize the urgent tasks first.
examples.translation_cn: 我会优先处理紧急任务。

senses.meaning_en: calculated proportionally according to a rate or share

examples.text: The pro-rated charge for the remaining days is $50.
examples.translation_cn: 剩余天数的按比例收费是50美元。

senses.meaning_en: the process of buying supplies or equipment for a company; the department responsible for this

examples.text: He handles procurement for the company.
examples.translation_cn: 他负责公司的采购工作。

senses.meaning_en: a series of workers and machines in a factory by which a succession of identical items is progressively assembled

examples.text: The main production line runs 24 hours a day.
examples.translation_cn: 主生产线每天24小时运转。

senses.meaning_cn: 按比例计算的（部分周期）
senses.meaning_en: calculated proportionally for a partial period

examples.text: The charge is prorated for 10 days.
examples.translation_cn: 费用按10天比例计算。

senses.meaning_en: to postpone a deadline to a later time

examples.text: We need to push back the deadline to next Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要把截止日期推迟到下周五。

senses.meaning_cn: 把电话转接给某人或某部门
senses.meaning_en: to connect someone's phone call to another person or department
senses.collocation: put you through to the sales department

examples.text: I'll put you through to the sales department.
examples.translation_cn: 我会把您的电话转接到销售部。

senses.meaning_en: to build or erect something such as a shelf, fence, or tent

examples.text: He put up a new shelf yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 他昨天安装了一个新架子。

senses.meaning_en: making little or no noise; calm and peaceful

examples.text: We found a quiet corner in the library to study.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在图书馆找到了一个安静的角落学习。

senses.meaning_cn: 安静地；轻声地；不喧哗地
senses.meaning_en: in a quiet manner; without making much noise

examples.text: Please speak quietly in the library.
examples.translation_cn: 在图书馆里请轻声说话。

senses.meaning_en: not completely; to a certain extent

examples.text: Not quite. Let me correct that.
examples.translation_cn: 不完全对。让我纠正一下。

senses.meaning_en: water that falls from the sky in drops

examples.text: The rain made me cold.
examples.translation_cn: 雨让我感到冷。

senses.meaning_en: to fall as rain

examples.text: It's raining outside, so we can't go to the playground.
examples.translation_cn: 外面正在下雨，所以我们不能去操场。

senses.meaning_cn: 改天再用的凭证；延期接受邀请
senses.meaning_en: a promise to do something at a later date

examples.text: We can take a rain check and go next week.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以改天再去，下周去。

senses.meaning_en: to confirm again

examples.text: Please re-confirm your flight 24 hours before departure.
examples.translation_cn: 请在起飞前24小时重新确认您的航班。

senses.meaning_en: to make something active again after it has been stopped or suspended

examples.text: We can reactivate your account today.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天就可以恢复您的账户。

senses.meaning_cn: 实际上；真正地（用于强调或否定）
senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize what you are saying, especially when you are saying what is true or what actually happens

examples.text: I didn't really like the movie.
examples.translation_cn: 我并不怎么喜欢那部电影。

senses.meaning_en: to book something again or for a different time

examples.text: We had to rebook the venue for next month.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不把场地重新预订到下个月。

senses.meaning_cn: 课间休息；户外活动时间
senses.meaning_en: a break between classes, especially for outdoor play

examples.text: The children play outside during recess.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在课间休息时到户外玩耍。

senses.meaning_en: to get back your energy and strength

examples.text: I need a vacation to recharge.
examples.translation_cn: 我需要休假来恢复精力。

senses.meaning_cn: 重新考虑先前的决定或立场
senses.meaning_en: to think again about a decision or opinion in order to decide if it should be changed

examples.text: Could we reconsider the 24-hour plan?
examples.translation_cn: 我们能重新考虑一下24小时计划吗？

senses.meaning_en: a number used to identify a particular record or transaction

examples.text: Please quote your reference number when you call.
examples.translation_cn: 打电话时请提供你的参考编号。

senses.meaning_en: a letter from a doctor or other professional that sends a patient to see a specialist

examples.text: Bring the referral letter.
examples.translation_cn: 带上转诊信。

senses.meaning_cn: 可退还的，用于描述押金或费用
senses.meaning_en: able to be returned or paid back, especially of a deposit or fee

examples.text: The deposit is fully refundable if there is no damage.
examples.translation_cn: 如果没有损坏，押金可以全额退还。

senses.meaning_en: to move to a new place, especially for work

examples.text: I am willing to relocate for this role.
examples.translation_cn: 我愿意为这个职位搬迁。

senses.meaning_en: help provided by an employer to an employee who moves for a job

examples.text: We offer relocation assistance for this role.
examples.translation_cn: 我们为这个职位提供搬迁协助。

senses.meaning_en: to have or keep an image or idea in your mind of something from the past

examples.text: I remember waiting for the ice cream.
examples.translation_cn: 我记得当时在等冰淇淋。

senses.meaning_en: an act of setting a device or system back to its original state or starting it again

examples.text: If the computer freezes, try a full reset.
examples.translation_cn: 如果电脑死机，尝试完全重置。

senses.meaning_cn: 重置；把设备或系统恢复到初始状态
senses.meaning_en: to set a device or system back to its original state

examples.text: Have you tried to reset the router?
examples.translation_cn: 你试过重置路由器吗？

senses.meaning_en: a period of relaxing or ceasing activity to recover strength

examples.text: The pain gets better with rest.
examples.translation_cn: 休息后疼痛会好转。

senses.meaning_en: to relax or take a break

examples.text: You can rest here.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在这里休息。

examples.text: Rest on the couch.
examples.translation_cn: 在沙发上休息。

senses.meaning_en: a room with a toilet and sink, especially in a public place

examples.text: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
examples.translation_cn: 打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？

senses.meaning_en: a form that you fill in when you return goods or when you acknowledge receipt of something

examples.text: Please fill out the return slip and include it in the box.
examples.translation_cn: 请填写退货单并放入箱内。

senses.meaning_en: to write something again in a different way

examples.text: To rewrite something means to write it again in a different way.
examples.translation_cn: 重写某事意味着以不同的方式再次书写。

senses.meaning_en: a free journey in a vehicle, or an act of taking someone somewhere in your car
senses.pattern: give someone a ride to + place

examples.text: Can you give me a ride to the airport?
examples.translation_cn: 你能开车送我去机场吗？

senses.meaning_en: to sit on and control a bicycle, scooter, etc.

examples.text: She learned to ride a bike when she was five.
examples.translation_cn: 她五岁时学会了骑自行车。

senses.meaning_en: correct or true

examples.text: So you need a quiet space, is that right?
examples.translation_cn: 所以你需要一个安静的空间，对吗？

examples.text: That's right, I agree with you.
examples.translation_cn: 没错，我同意你的看法。

senses.meaning_cn: 正好；恰好（加强时间或位置的含义）
senses.meaning_en: used to emphasize an exact time or place

examples.text: We need to leave right now.
examples.translation_cn: 我们现在就得离开。

senses.meaning_en: immediately; without delay

examples.text: I will check the wardrobe right away.
examples.translation_cn: 我马上检查衣柜。

senses.meaning_en: at the present moment

examples.text: I didn't want to go right now.
examples.translation_cn: 我当时不想现在就去。

examples.text: I don't want to read right now.
examples.translation_cn: 我现在不想读书。

senses.meaning_en: a barrier placed across a road to stop traffic

examples.text: The police set up a roadblock to check drivers' licenses.
examples.translation_cn: 警察设置了路障检查驾驶执照。

senses.meaning_cn: 回滚；撤销（恢复到之前的状态或版本）
senses.meaning_en: the act of restoring a system or data to a previous state

examples.text: There's a rollback option if the update fails.
examples.translation_cn: 如果更新失败，有一个回滚选项。

examples.text: Rollback isn't available when the status is In Progress.
examples.translation_cn: 当状态为“进行中”时，无法回滚。

senses.meaning_cn: （新产品、系统或政策的）推出；分阶段实施
senses.meaning_en: the introduction of a new product, system, or policy, often in stages

examples.text: The new booking system rollout will begin next Monday.
examples.translation_cn: 新预订系统的推出将于下周一开始。

senses.meaning_en: a response to an invitation indicating whether one will attend

examples.text: We need an RSVP from each guest by Wednesday.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要每位客人在周三前回复是否参加。

senses.meaning_en: to respond to an invitation, indicating whether one will attend

examples.text: Please RSVP by Friday so we can finalize the seating.
examples.translation_cn: 请在周五前回复是否参加，以便我们确定座位安排。

senses.meaning_en: a set of criteria used for grading or evaluating work

examples.text: According to the rubric, the conclusion should connect to the research question.
examples.translation_cn: 根据评分标准，结论应与研究问题相关联。

senses.meaning_en: to move quickly on foot, faster than walking

examples.text: The children run to the playground every morning.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们每天早上跑向游乐场。

senses.meaning_en: to organize and lead a session or event

examples.text: I have run a training session before.
examples.translation_cn: 我以前主持过培训课程。

senses.meaning_en: to operate or execute a program or system

examples.text: The application runs on that same server.
examples.translation_cn: 该应用程序在同一台服务器上运行。

senses.meaning_en: to run in different directions, especially for fun or exercise

examples.text: The children were running around in the garden.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在花园里跑来跑去。

senses.meaning_cn: 进度落后；比预定时间晚
senses.meaning_en: to be behind schedule; to be later than planned

examples.text: The project is running late because of the missing data.
examples.translation_cn: 由于数据缺失，项目进度落后了。

senses.meaning_en: to continue beyond the planned time

examples.text: The meeting ran over by twenty minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 会议超时了二十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to practice or review something quickly from beginning to end

examples.text: Let's run through the presentation once more before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 开会前我们再快速过一遍演示文稿。

senses.meaning_en: feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy

examples.text: He felt sad.
examples.translation_cn: 他感到伤心。

senses.meaning_en: a shallow pit or box filled with sand for children to play in

examples.text: The kids are digging in the sandpit.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子们在沙坑里挖沙。

senses.meaning_en: feeling fear or worry

examples.text: She seemed scared of the waves at first.
examples.translation_cn: 起初她似乎很害怕海浪。

senses.meaning_en: causing fear; frightening

examples.text: I don't like scary movies.
examples.translation_cn: 我不喜欢恐怖电影。

senses.meaning_en: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events

examples.text: What is your worst-case scenario?
examples.translation_cn: 你最坏的情况是什么？

senses.meaning_cn: 屏幕时间；使用电子设备的时间
senses.meaning_en: time spent using electronic devices with screens

examples.text: Screen time is finished for today.
examples.translation_cn: 今天的屏幕时间结束了。

senses.meaning_en: a person employed to protect buildings, people, or property

examples.text: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
examples.translation_cn: 保安在入口处检查了我们的包。

senses.meaning_cn: 似乎，好像；用于表达基于观察的推测
senses.meaning_en: to appear to be; used to express an inference based on observation
senses.collocation: It seems like Turtle was upset

examples.text: It seems like Turtle was upset.
examples.translation_cn: 看起来乌龟当时很不高兴。

senses.meaning_en: to cause something to go or be taken to a place

examples.text: We can send your suitcase to your hotel.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以把你的手提箱送到你的酒店。

senses.meaning_en: to send something to someone, especially by email or another electronic method

examples.text: Could you send over the updated file today?
examples.translation_cn: 你今天能把更新后的文件发过来吗？

senses.meaning_en: the process of installing and configuring something

examples.text: The initial setup takes about an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 初始安装大约需要一个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body, typically with a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front

examples.text: He put on a clean shirt before going to the interview.
examples.translation_cn: 去面试前他穿上一件干净的衬衫。

senses.meaning_en: a cord used to fasten a shoe

examples.text: Tie your shoelaces.
examples.translation_cn: 系好你的鞋带。

senses.meaning_en: lasting or intended to last for only a short period of time

examples.text: Is there any short-term option?
examples.translation_cn: 有短期的选择吗？

examples.text: This is not just a short-term skill.
examples.translation_cn: 这不仅仅是一项短期技能。

senses.meaning_cn: 本应该（表示对过去未做之事的遗憾或承认失误）
senses.meaning_en: used to express regret or acknowledge a mistake about a past action that did not happen
senses.collocation: should have brought, should have sent

examples.text: I should have called you earlier.
examples.translation_cn: 我本应该早点给你打电话。

senses.meaning_cn: 应该（用于提出建议或征询同意）
senses.meaning_en: used to suggest an action or ask for agreement

examples.text: Do you think we should hide behind this wall?
examples.translation_cn: 你觉得我们应该躲在这堵墙后面吗？

senses.meaning_en: a performance or entertainment event

examples.text: The fountain show starts at eight o'clock.
examples.translation_cn: 喷泉表演八点开始。

senses.meaning_en: to explain or demonstrate something to someone by doing it or by giving instructions
senses.pattern: show someone how to do something
senses.collocation: show me how, show you the way

examples.text: Can you show me how to use this app?
examples.translation_cn: 你能教我如何使用这个应用吗？

senses.meaning_en: to appear or be displayed in a particular way

examples.text: My name shows as N in your system.
examples.translation_cn: 我的名字在你们的系统中显示为 N。

senses.meaning_en: to arrive or appear at a place, especially when expected

examples.text: Just show up fifteen minutes early to get a good seat.
examples.translation_cn: 提前十五分钟到场就能占到好座位。

senses.meaning_en: a path for people to walk on beside a road

examples.text: The sidewalk is crowded with pedestrians.
examples.translation_cn: 人行道上挤满了行人。

senses.meaning_en: to give formal approval

examples.text: Who needs to sign off on the plan?
examples.translation_cn: 这个计划需要谁批准？

senses.meaning_en: to officially approve something by signing a document

examples.text: We need you to sign off on the revised scope.
examples.translation_cn: 我们需要你批准修改后的范围。

senses.meaning_en: to put your name on a list or register to join an activity, course, or organization

examples.text: You need to sign up by Friday to join the workshop.
examples.translation_cn: 你需要在周五前报名才能参加工作坊。

senses.meaning_cn: 正式批准；确认可以进入下一阶段
senses.meaning_en: formal approval or confirmation to proceed to the next stage

examples.text: We're waiting for client sign-off before launch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在等待客户正式批准后再发布。

senses.meaning_en: to be in a sitting position next to someone in order to be with them

examples.text: I'll sit with you for a while.
examples.translation_cn: 我会陪你坐一会儿。

senses.meaning_en: not quick to understand or think clearly

examples.text: I didn't sleep well, so my brain feels slow today.
examples.translation_cn: 我没睡好，所以今天脑子反应有点慢。

senses.meaning_en: of a size that is less than normal or usual

examples.text: I saw a small cat.
examples.translation_cn: 我看见一只小猫。

senses.meaning_en: to make a dirty mark by rubbing or touching something
senses.pattern: The paint smudged when I touched it.

examples.text: The paint smudged when I touched it.
examples.translation_cn: 我一碰，油漆就蹭花了。

senses.meaning_cn: 因此，所以；用于引出基于前述情况的结果或推断
senses.meaning_en: therefore; used to introduce a result or inference based on the preceding situation

examples.text: So the fox waited by the door because he may have felt lonely.
examples.translation_cn: 所以狐狸在门边等着，因为他可能感到孤独。

senses.meaning_en: a device in a wall that you connect electrical equipment to
senses.pattern: the socket in the {room}; three-pin socket

examples.text: The socket in the hotel room is a three-pin socket.
examples.translation_cn: 酒店房间里的插座是三孔插座。

senses.meaning_en: an unspecified thing

examples.text: Can I have something to eat now?
examples.translation_cn: 我现在可以吃点东西吗？

senses.meaning_en: in a short time from now
senses.collocation: call back as soon as possible

examples.text: Please call back as soon as possible.
examples.translation_cn: 请尽快回电话。

senses.meaning_en: feeling regret or sadness
senses.pattern: be sorry (that); be sorry to do something

examples.text: I'm sorry I blamed you.
examples.translation_cn: 很抱歉我错怪了你。

senses.meaning_en: to organize or resolve a problem or situation

examples.text: I need to sort out my schedule before the meeting.
examples.translation_cn: 开会前我需要整理一下我的日程。

senses.meaning_en: a plant-based milk made from soybeans, used as a substitute for dairy milk
senses.pattern: drink soy milk; soy milk instead of regular milk

examples.text: Could I get soy milk instead of regular milk in my coffee?
examples.translation_cn: 我的咖啡里可以换成豆浆而不是普通牛奶吗？

senses.meaning_en: a group exercise class on stationary bicycles, often led by an instructor

examples.text: I'm going to a spin class at the gym after work.
examples.translation_cn: 下班后我要去健身房上动感单车课。

senses.meaning_en: an outdoor area with sprinklers or fountains for children to play in

examples.text: We spent half an hour at the splash pad.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在戏水池玩了半个小时。

senses.meaning_en: a play area with water features such as fountains and sprinklers for children to play in

examples.text: We took the kids to the splash park to cool off.
examples.translation_cn: 我们带孩子们去戏水公园凉快一下。

senses.meaning_en: having no stairs; accessible without using stairs

examples.text: Is there a stair-free route to the platform?
examples.translation_cn: 去站台有无台阶的路线吗？

senses.meaning_en: to remain in a place or condition

examples.text: We can stay here for ten minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以在这里待十分钟。

senses.meaning_en: to remain in the same place or position
senses.pattern: Stay put until I come back.

examples.text: Stay put while I go get the car.
examples.translation_cn: 我去取车，你待在原地别动。

senses.meaning_en: a book with pages for collecting and displaying stickers

examples.text: We have a new sticker book.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有一本新的贴纸书。

senses.meaning_en: to no longer continue doing something

examples.text: It stopped working yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 它昨天停止工作了。

senses.meaning_en: a period of very bad weather with strong winds, rain, snow, etc.

examples.text: The storm passed quickly, and the sun came out.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨很快过去了，太阳出来了。

senses.meaning_en: a book containing stories, especially for children

examples.text: We can read the dinosaur storybook.
examples.translation_cn: 我们可以读那本恐龙故事书。

senses.meaning_en: a small folding chair on wheels that a baby or small child sits in and is pushed around in

examples.text: She pushed the stroller through the park.
examples.translation_cn: 她推着婴儿车穿过公园。

senses.meaning_en: unable to move or make progress

examples.text: I'm stuck on the third section.
examples.translation_cn: 我在第三部分卡住了。

examples.text: I'm trying to fill out the form, but I'm stuck at the address section.
examples.translation_cn: 我正试着填写表格，但卡在了地址栏。

examples.text: The refund is stuck because the system didn't sync.
examples.translation_cn: 退款被卡住了，因为系统没有同步。

examples.text: I got stuck at the submit button.
examples.translation_cn: 我在提交按钮那里卡住了。

examples.text: The process gets stuck if the connection is lost.
examples.translation_cn: 如果连接断开，进程就会卡住。

examples.text: I'm stuck on question three and can't figure out the answer.
examples.translation_cn: 我卡在第三题上，想不出答案。

examples.text: The toy car got stuck between two tiles.
examples.translation_cn: 玩具车卡在两块瓷砖之间。

examples.text: I'm stuck on this math problem and need some help.
examples.translation_cn: 我卡在这道数学题上了，需要帮助。

examples.text: The part I am stuck on is the third question.
examples.translation_cn: 我卡住的部分是第三个问题。

examples.text: I'm stuck on the last part of the assignment.
examples.translation_cn: 我在作业的最后一部分卡住了。

examples.text: The zipper is stuck on the backpack.
examples.translation_cn: 背包上的拉链卡住了。

senses.meaning_en: a specialized area within a broader field of study or activity

examples.text: She works in a different subfield of biology.
examples.translation_cn: 她在生物学的另一个子领域工作。

senses.meaning_en: to rent a property you are renting to someone else

examples.text: Am I allowed to sublet the room?
examples.translation_cn: 我可以转租这个房间吗？

senses.meaning_en: the star that provides light and heat for the earth

examples.text: The sun was too bright.
examples.translation_cn: 太阳太刺眼了。

senses.meaning_cn: 供应商，提供材料或服务的公司
senses.meaning_en: a company that provides materials or services
senses.pattern: The supplier will send the final files by Friday.

examples.text: The supplier will send the final files by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 供应商将在周五前发送最终文件。

senses.meaning_en: certain; having no doubt
senses.collocation: we are not sure yet if we can go

examples.text: We are not sure yet if we can go.
examples.translation_cn: 我们还不确定是否能去。

examples.text: I'm not sure yet if Grandma is coming.
examples.translation_cn: 我还不确定奶奶是否会来。

examples.text: I'm not sure about the answer.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定答案。

examples.text: I'm not sure where my friend is.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定我的朋友在哪里。

examples.text: I'm still not sure about the last step.
examples.translation_cn: 我仍然对最后一步不太确定。

examples.text: I'm not sure about the answer to that question.
examples.translation_cn: 我对那个问题的答案不太确定。

examples.text: I'm not sure about the new schedule yet.
examples.translation_cn: 我还不确定新的时间安排。

examples.text: I'm not sure if you need to bring any previous medication list.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定你是否需要带之前的用药清单。

examples.text: I am not sure about the meeting time.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定会议时间。

examples.text: I'm not sure if it started before that.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定它是否在那之前就开始了。

examples.text: I'm not entirely sure about the end date.
examples.translation_cn: 我对结束日期不太确定。

examples.text: I am not sure how to fix this error.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定如何修复这个错误。

examples.text: I'm not sure about the meeting time.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定会议时间。

examples.text: I'm not sure if it's a crane.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定它是不是鹤。

examples.text: I'm not sure about the exact name.
examples.translation_cn: 我不确定确切的名称。

senses.meaning_en: to exchange one thing for another
senses.collocation: swap your Wednesday with my Thursday

examples.text: Can we swap seats?
examples.translation_cn: 我们能换一下座位吗？

senses.meaning_en: to make two or more things work together or match, especially devices or data

examples.text: The return record wasn't synced from the terminal.
examples.translation_cn: 退货记录没有从终端同步过来。

senses.meaning_en: food that you buy at a restaurant to eat somewhere else

examples.text: We usually get takeout on Friday nights.
examples.translation_cn: 我们通常周五晚上叫外卖。

senses.meaning_en: to speak about a particular subject

examples.text: Do you want to talk about it?
examples.translation_cn: 你想谈谈这件事吗？

senses.meaning_en: the number 10

examples.text: The delivery will arrive in ten days.
examples.translation_cn: 货物将在十天后到达。

senses.meaning_en: in a way that is not definite or certain

examples.text: The meeting is tentatively scheduled for Thursday.
examples.translation_cn: 会议暂定在周四。

senses.meaning_en: after that; next

examples.text: We went to the store, and then we had lunch.
examples.translation_cn: 我们去了商店，然后吃了午饭。

senses.meaning_en: a device that automatically regulates temperature

examples.text: Could you turn down the thermostat?
examples.translation_cn: 你能把温控器调低吗？

senses.meaning_en: feeling the need to drink something

examples.text: Are you thirsty?
examples.translation_cn: 你渴吗？

examples.text: I'm thirsty.
examples.translation_cn: 我渴了。

senses.meaning_en: used to identify oneself on the phone

examples.text: This is Li Ming from Ankang Insurance.
examples.translation_cn: 我是安康保险的李明。

senses.meaning_en: a plan that shows when events or tasks will happen

examples.text: What's your timeline for this project?
examples.translation_cn: 这个项目你的时间安排是怎样的？

senses.meaning_en: to walk quietly on the tips of one's toes

examples.text: The cat quietly tiptoed past the guard.
examples.translation_cn: 猫悄悄地踮着脚从守卫身边走过。

senses.meaning_en: feeling that you need to rest or sleep

examples.text: I'm tired after the long walk.
examples.translation_cn: 走了很长的路后，我累了。

senses.meaning_en: on this present day

examples.text: We cannot go today.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今天不能去。

senses.meaning_en: a soft white food made from soybeans, used in cooking

examples.text: I'd like a tofu stir-fry, please.
examples.translation_cn: 请给我一份豆腐炒菜。

senses.meaning_en: with each other or in one group

examples.text: Let's check the handlebar together.
examples.translation_cn: 我们一起检查一下车把。

senses.meaning_en: on the day after today

examples.text: I have a meeting tomorrow morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我明天早上有个会议。

senses.meaning_en: on the present or coming evening or night

examples.text: We can see Jupiter tonight.
examples.translation_cn: 我们今晚可以看到木星。

senses.meaning_en: excessively fatigued

examples.text: I'm too tired to go right now.
examples.translation_cn: 我现在太累了，去不了。

senses.meaning_en: a substance used for cleaning teeth

examples.text: Let's put a little bit of toothpaste on the brush.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在牙刷上挤一点点牙膏吧。

senses.meaning_en: having a tear or rip, especially in fabric

examples.text: The pants are torn at the knee.
examples.translation_cn: 这条裤子膝盖处破了。

senses.meaning_en: to make brief contact with someone to exchange information or check progress

examples.text: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project.
examples.translation_cn: 我们下周简单联系一下，讨论项目。

senses.meaning_en: a unique number used to track a package or shipment

examples.text: You can check the tracking number online.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以在网上查询跟踪号。

senses.meaning_cn: 权衡，不同目标之间的取舍
senses.meaning_en: a balance achieved between two desirable but incompatible features; a compromise
senses.pattern: there is a trade-off between X and Y

examples.text: There is always a trade-off between cost and quality.
examples.translation_cn: 成本和质量之间总是需要权衡。

senses.meaning_cn: 可迁移的；可转移的（指技能、经验等可用于不同情境）
senses.meaning_en: able to be transferred or used in a different situation, especially skills or experience

examples.text: Those transferable skills are valuable in any job.
examples.translation_cn: 那些可迁移技能在任何工作中都很有价值。

examples.text: I bring transferable skills from my sales background.
examples.translation_cn: 我带来了销售背景中的可迁移技能。

senses.meaning_cn: 排查故障；一步步找出问题原因
senses.meaning_en: to find and fix problems in a system or device

examples.text: The technician remotely troubleshooted my screen and fixed the issue.
examples.translation_cn: 技术人员远程排查了我的屏幕问题并解决了故障。

senses.meaning_en: the morning of Tuesday

examples.text: I have a dentist appointment on Tuesday morning.
examples.translation_cn: 我周二上午约了牙医。

senses.meaning_en: stomach (childish term)

examples.text: My tummy feels funny.
examples.translation_cn: 我的肚子感觉怪怪的。

senses.meaning_en: to give something to a person in authority

examples.text: Please turn in your homework by Friday.
examples.translation_cn: 请在周五前上交作业。

senses.meaning_en: two times; on two occasions

examples.text: Take the medicine twice daily, once in the morning and once at night.
examples.translation_cn: 每天服药两次，早上一次，晚上一次。

senses.meaning_en: the time 2:30, expressed as half past two

examples.text: The meeting is at half past two.
examples.translation_cn: 会议在两点半。

senses.meaning_en: an object used for protection against rain or sun

examples.text: Don't leave your wet umbrella on the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 别把湿伞放在地板上。

senses.meaning_en: not yet confirmed or verified

examples.text: Two students showed as unconfirmed.
examples.translation_cn: 两名学生显示为未确认。

examples.text: The report remains unconfirmed.
examples.translation_cn: 该报告仍未得到证实。

senses.meaning_cn: 低于，少于（某数量、年龄、价格等）
senses.meaning_en: less than a particular amount, number, age, etc.

examples.text: I'm looking for a gift under twenty dollars.
examples.translation_cn: 我在找一件二十美元以下的礼物。

senses.meaning_en: in or to a lower position than something else

examples.text: The rabbit is under the mushroom.
examples.translation_cn: 兔子在蘑菇下面。

senses.meaning_en: likely to fall or collapse; not firmly fixed
senses.collocation: That part of the wall is unstable.

examples.text: The ladder is unstable; be careful.
examples.translation_cn: 梯子不稳固，小心。

senses.meaning_en: up to the time that; before

examples.text: We have to wait until the rain stops.
examples.translation_cn: 我们必须等到雨停。

senses.meaning_en: paid or required in advance

examples.text: They asked for an upfront payment of 20%.
examples.translation_cn: 他们要求预付20%的款项。

senses.meaning_cn: 上传；上传的文件或数据
senses.meaning_en: the act or process of transferring data to a server or computer system; a file or set of data that has been uploaded

examples.text: The document upload failed twice yesterday.
examples.translation_cn: 昨天文件上传失败了两次。

senses.meaning_en: a person who looks at something, such as a poster or display

examples.text: Some viewers found the poster confusing.
examples.translation_cn: 一些观众觉得这张海报令人困惑。

senses.meaning_en: a system for recording and storing spoken messages left by phone callers

examples.text: It went to voice mail, so I left a message.
examples.translation_cn: 电话转到了语音信箱，所以我留了言。

senses.meaning_en: to walk with short steps, moving the body from side to side

examples.text: The ducks waddled across the road.
examples.translation_cn: 鸭子摇摇摆摆地穿过马路。

senses.meaning_en: to stay in a place or delay action until something happens

examples.text: We should wait for approval before ordering supplies.
examples.translation_cn: 我们应该在订购物资之前等待批准。

senses.meaning_cn: 候补名单；当有空位时可以按顺序加入的名单
senses.meaning_en: a list of people waiting for a place that may become available
senses.pattern: on the waitlist; join the waitlist

examples.text: I can put you on the waitlist for the next available spot.
examples.translation_cn: 我可以把你加入候补名单，等下一个名额。

senses.meaning_en: a document that you sign to formally give up a right or claim, often to release an organization from liability

examples.text: You need to sign a waiver before joining the climbing session.
examples.translation_cn: 参加攀岩活动前你需要签署一份免责声明。

senses.meaning_en: to have a desire or wish for something
senses.pattern: want something; want to do something

examples.text: I want the blue jacket.
examples.translation_cn: 我想要那件蓝色夹克。

senses.meaning_cn: 加热；把凉了的食物变热
senses.meaning_en: to make something warm again, especially food

examples.text: Let's warm up the soup before dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 晚饭前我们把汤热一热吧。

senses.meaning_en: a period of seven days

examples.text: The rent is $200 per week.
examples.translation_cn: 租金是每周200美元。

examples.text: I will visit the client next week.
examples.translation_cn: 我下周将拜访客户。

senses.meaning_en: covered or soaked with water or another liquid

examples.text: The snail is wet.
examples.translation_cn: 蜗牛是湿的。

examples.text: The paint is still wet.
examples.translation_cn: 油漆还没干。

senses.meaning_en: to make something wet

examples.text: Wet the toothbrush first.
examples.translation_cn: 先把牙刷弄湿。

senses.meaning_cn: 用于主动询问另一项未提及的交接事项
senses.meaning_en: used to ask about another item or matter that has not been mentioned yet

examples.text: What about the bathroom? Should I wait while you inspect it?
examples.translation_cn: 浴室呢？您检查时我要等着吗？

senses.meaning_en: used to ask about a possibility or suggest an alternative

examples.text: What if we try a different ending?
examples.translation_cn: 如果我们试试另一个结局呢？

senses.meaning_en: at what time; used to ask about the time of an event or action

examples.text: When do you need the report?
examples.translation_cn: 您什么时候需要这份报告？

senses.meaning_en: for what reason or purpose
senses.pattern: used in questions and indirect questions

examples.text: I don't know why.
examples.translation_cn: 我不知道为什么。

examples.text: Why are we not going?
examples.translation_cn: 我们为什么不去？

senses.meaning_cn: 万能牌（可代替任意颜色或数字）
senses.meaning_en: a card that can be used as any other card in a game

examples.text: A wild card can be any color.
examples.translation_cn: 万能牌可以是任意颜色。

senses.meaning_en: to move unsteadily from side to side

examples.text: The tower wobbled and then fell over.
examples.translation_cn: 塔摇晃了一下，然后倒了。

senses.meaning_en: moving unsteadily from side to side; not firm or stable

examples.text: The table is wobbly because one leg is shorter.
examples.translation_cn: 这张桌子摇摇晃晃的，因为一条腿短。

senses.meaning_en: the sequence of steps or tasks that make up a particular work process

examples.text: The new software disrupts our daily workflow.
examples.translation_cn: 新软件打乱了我们的日常工作流程。

senses.meaning_en: unhappy because you are thinking about problems or unpleasant things that might happen

examples.text: I'm a bit worried about the test.
examples.translation_cn: 我有点担心考试。

senses.meaning_cn: 用于礼貌地提供某物或提出建议
senses.meaning_en: used for offering something or suggesting something politely

examples.text: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples.translation_cn: 你想喝杯茶吗？

senses.meaning_en: a band worn around the wrist, often for identification or decoration

examples.text: The child wore a wristband with his name on it.
examples.translation_cn: 孩子戴着一个写有他名字的手环。

senses.meaning_en: a device consisting of two rows of metal or plastic teeth that are brought together by a sliding piece, used for fastening clothes, bags, etc.

examples.text: Please close the zipper on the bag.
examples.translation_cn: 请把包上的拉链拉上。
